papers.title: Can Language Models Play the Wikipedia Game?
papers.abstract_en: Language models increasingly support or automate information retrieval from document collections too large to index. This task is difficult when it requires specialist linguistic or scientific knowledge. We used the Wikipedia Game to test language models on an analogous information retrieval task. In the game, players must reach a target article using only article links. We compared sentence embedding models and LLMs across five Wikipedia languages and five academic-literature datasets. We construct very large local graphs of Wikipedia pages and of paper citations using OpenAlex and provide code to build and navigate them. This allows the study of language models' navigation capabilities without relying on third-party APIs. We compared the models with human and TF-IDF benchmarks. The Wikipedia Game format enables robust comparisons across techniques, languages, and domains. No model significantly outperformed humans, although the best models (GPT-o3 mini, GPT-4o, QwQ:32B, and DeepSeek-R1:70B) achieved comparable success. Performance and rankings varied across languages and topics, with implications for practitioners utilising these techniques.
papers.comment: 64 pages (14-page main text, references and 16 appendices), 17 figures, 10 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Wikipedia Game（只能沿文章链接跳转到达目标页）测试语言模型在超大文档集上的信息检索导航能力，在五种 Wikipedia 语言与五个学术文献数据集上对比句嵌入模型和 LLM，并与人类和 TF-IDF 基线比较。没有模型显著超过人类，最佳模型（GPT-o3 mini、GPT-4o、QwQ:32B、DeepSeek-R1:70B）仅达到与人类相当的成功率，且表现与排名随语言和主题变化。
Motivation: 当文档集合大到无法索引、且需要专业语言或科学知识时，信息检索变难；需要一种不依赖第三方 API、可跨技术语言与领域做稳健比较的评测方式。
Method: 以 Wikipedia Game 为任务框架，用 OpenAlex 构建超大规模 Wikipedia 页面图与论文引用图并提供构建与导航代码；比较句嵌入模型与 LLM，基线为人类表现和 TF-IDF，评测覆盖五种 Wikipedia 语言与五个学术文献数据集。
Result: 没有任何模型显著超过人类，最佳模型 GPT-o3 mini、GPT-4o、QwQ:32B、DeepSeek-R1:70B 达到与人类相当的成功率；性能与排名在不同语言和主题间存在差异。
Conclusion: Wikipedia Game 格式可用于跨技术、语言与领域的稳健比较，语言模型的图导航能力尚不足以超越人类，且其表现对语言和领域敏感，这对使用这类检索技术的实践者有直接影响。

papers.title: Towards Physically Grounded Articulated 3D Assets: A Multi-Agent Pipeline and Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study physically grounded articulated 3D asset generation---moving the goal from reproducing how objects look to capturing how they move and function. Inspired by the literature on procedural and agentic generation, we present Artisan, a system that extends the latest method Articraft by introducing a multi-agent pipeline with physical simulation feedback, enabling comprehensive attributes beyond geometry, appearance, and physically plausible articulation, such as collision-free motion, stability under gravity, and accurate mass and material properties. Furthermore, we construct a unified benchmark spanning four key aspects: spatial fidelity, physical plausibility, downstream task performance, and overall quality. The benchmark encompasses 100 reference assets from ArtVIP and LightWheel, 50 stability prompts, and 50 ABO objects with reference masses, with protocols evaluating various metrics. Through extensive evaluation of more than 10 representative models, Artisan achieves competitive spatial fidelity while attaining the lowest collision rates and highest stability rates among the evaluated methods. Together, our system and benchmark establish insights for advancing 3D generation towards physically plausible, functionally usable assets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Artisan 用多智能体流水线加物理仿真反馈生成铰接 3D 资产，把目标从外观复现转向运动与功能正确：碰撞自由、重力下稳定、质量与材质准确。配套基准覆盖 100 个 ArtVIP/LightWheel 参考资产、50 个稳定性 prompt、50 个带参考质量的 ABO 物体，在 10 余个代表性模型上评测，Artisan 空间保真度具竞争力且碰撞率最低、稳定率最高。
Motivation: 现有 3D 生成只追求外观复现，铰接资产缺少运动与功能层面的物理正确性，也缺少统一评测基准。
Method: 在 Articraft 基础上引入多智能体流水线与物理仿真反馈，联合优化几何、外观与物理可行铰接（碰撞自由运动、重力稳定、质量与材质属性）；构建四方面基准：空间保真、物理合理性、下游任务表现、总体质量。
Result: 基准含 100 个 ArtVIP 与 LightWheel 参考资产、50 个稳定性 prompt、50 个带参考质量的 ABO 物体；在 10 余个代表性模型上评测，Artisan 空间保真度具竞争力，同时取得最低碰撞率与最高稳定率。
Conclusion: 把物理仿真反馈放进多智能体生成循环，可在不牺牲空间保真度的前提下让铰接 3D 资产达到可下游使用的物理合理性。

papers.title: Splat2Act: From Captured Scenes to Personalized VLA Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: A user who brings a generalist manipulation policy into their home or office wants it to pick up their objects from their shelves, counters, and tables. Yet even a strong generalist like $π_{0.5}$ achieves 0% pickup success in our captured deployment scenes without adaptation, and collecting real demonstrations in every user's environment is prohibitively expensive. We present Splat2Act, an automated real-to-sim-to-real pipeline that personalizes a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policy to a specific scene and object set using only a handheld phone scan and images of the user's objects. Unlike prior real-to-sim work that reconstructs individual tabletops, Splat2Act operates on building-scale indoor environments: it builds a photorealistic digital twin with 3D Gaussian Splatting and collision geometry, automatically discovers tabletop and non-tabletop receptacles, constructs feasible pickup tasks, and generates successful demonstrations with a privileged simulation oracle, with only scene and object capture required from a human. Applied to 101 scanned campus environments with a median navigable area of 104.87 m$^2$ and 7 receptacles, the pipeline yields 852 receptacles and over 68,000 pickup demonstrations. We fine-tune $π_{0.5}$ in two stages: Stage 1 adapts to hundreds of public object assets, drawn either from the deployment scene alone or from all 101 scenes; Stage 2 personalizes to the user's own objects on the deployment scene's receptacles. Our strongest personalized policy reaches 62.5% aggregate pickup success in the target scene. Deployed on a real Stretch 3, the same policy achieves 63.9% success on a 12-task subset, closely tracking its 66.7% simulated success on those tasks. These results suggest that automated real-to-sim-to-real training can personalize VLA manipulation policies using only simulation-oracle data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Splat2Act 把手机扫描的建筑级室内场景重建为 3D Gaussian Splatting 数字孪生，自动发现容器、构造可拾取任务并用特权仿真 oracle 生成演示，从而在无需真人示教的情况下个性化微调 VLA 策略。在 101 个校园扫描场景上生成 852 个容器与逾 68,000 条拾取演示，最强个性化策略在目标场景达到 62.5% 拾取成功率，并在真实 Stretch 3 上取得 63.9%（对应仿真 66.7%）。
Motivation: 通用 VLA 策略在用户真实场景中直接部署会失败（π0.5 未适配时拾取成功率 0%），而在每个用户环境中采集真人示教成本过高。
Method: real-to-sim-to-real 流水线：手持手机扫描 + 物体图像，用 3D Gaussian Splatting 与碰撞几何构建照片级数字孪生，自动发现桌面与非桌面容器，构造可行拾取任务，用特权仿真 oracle 生成成功演示；两阶段微调 π0.5——Stage 1 适配数百个公开物体资产（来自部署场景或全部 101 个场景），Stage 2 用用户自有物体在部署场景容器上个性化。
Result: 101 个扫描校园环境（中位可导航面积 104.87 m²、7 个容器）产出 852 个容器与逾 68,000 条拾取演示；未适配的 π0.5 在部署场景拾取成功率 0%；最强个性化策略在目标场景达到 62.5% 汇总拾取成功率；在真实 Stretch 3 的 12 任务子集上取得 63.9%，接近其仿真 66.7%。
Conclusion: 自动化 real-to-sim-to-real 训练仅用仿真 oracle 数据即可个性化 VLA 操作策略，且仿真成功率能较好迁移到真实机器人。

papers.title: InstantFusion: A Shared Latent Interface for Heterogeneous Image Generators
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion/flow models have emerged as the de facto paradigms for image generation, giving rise to a diverse family of modern generators with increasingly heterogeneous architectures and representations. Despite their remarkable generation capabilities, the cross-model alignment of latent representations and the consistency of their underlying denoising dynamics remain underexplored. In this work, we uncover an intriguing cross-model compatibility: independently trained generators exhibit similar latent spatial organization, while directly handing off intermediate states between unaligned models can still preserve coarse visual content. Motivated by these observations, we propose InstantFusion, a lightweight shared latent interface that connects the denoising trajectories of heterogeneous image generators. Specifically, to enable flexible cross-model state translation, model-specific Latent AutoEncoders (LAEs) are introduced to project intermediate states from different generators into a shared latent space and decode them into the latent space of a target generator. This shared space is constrained by two complementary objectives: aligning intermediate states derived from the same image at matched noise levels and synchronizing their corresponding local denoising velocities. Once trained, InstantFusion allows denoising to seamlessly transition across frozen generators without requiring a dedicated mapping for every model pair. The versatility of InstantFusion is demonstrated across acceleration, multi-preference composition, cross-architecture on-policy distillation, and cross-model composition, achieving competitive performance across these diverse settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: InstantFusion 用一组模型专属的 Latent AutoEncoder (LAE) 把异构扩散/流模型的中间状态投到共享潜空间，再解码到目标生成器的潜空间，使去噪轨迹可在冻结模型间直接切换，无需为每对模型单独训练映射。共享空间用同一图像在匹配噪声水平下的状态对齐与局部去噪速度同步两个目标约束，在加速、多偏好组合、跨架构 on-policy 蒸馏与跨模型组合四类设置上取得有竞争力的表现。
Motivation: 现代扩散/流式图像生成器架构与表示日益异构，但跨模型潜表示对齐和去噪动力学一致性研究不足，模型间状态交接缺少通用接口。
Method: 先观察到独立训练的生成器潜空间具有相似的空间组织、未对齐模型间直接交接中间状态仍能保留粗略视觉内容；据此引入模型特定 LAE，把各生成器中间状态投影到共享潜空间并解码到目标生成器潜空间，训练时联合优化同图同噪声水平的状态对齐与对应局部去噪速度同步两个目标，训练后可连接任意冻结生成器。
Result: 在加速、多偏好组合、跨架构 on-policy 蒸馏、跨模型组合四类设置上均取得有竞争力的表现 (competitive performance)；核心经验发现是独立训练的生成器潜空间组织相似，且未对齐模型间直接交接中间状态可保留粗略视觉内容。
Conclusion: 异构图像生成器之间存在可利用的跨模型兼容性，一个轻量共享潜接口即可让去噪过程在冻结模型间无缝切换，不必为每对模型单独训练映射。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Images Talk Back: Guiding MMDiTs by Suppressing Image-to-Text Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal diffusion transformers (MMDiTs) allow the evolving image to update internal text representations through joint attention. These representations then guide subsequent image updates, raising a question: does this feedback help correct deviations from the prompt, or preserve them? We find that image-to-text (I2T) feedback can preserve the objects and attributes already represented in the evolving image, including errors. Transplanting I2T messages can rescue failures or disrupt successes. At matched intervention strengths, suppressing the influence of I2T feedback improves generation, whereas opposite controls degrade it. These findings motivate Semantic Feedback Guidance (SFG), which suppresses the influence of I2T feedback by guiding away from an auxiliary branch that strengthens this feedback and weakens text-to-image conditioning. The in-place variant, iSFG, directly suppresses I2T feedback and strengthens text-to-image conditioning, requiring no extra model evaluations. Temporal interventions motivate running the SFG branch during the first 20% of image sampling steps, requiring about $1.2\times$ the base NFE without classifier-free guidance (CFG). Experiments across three image-generation backbones show gains in alignment and preference-model scores. On FLUX, adding SFG to CFG raises GenEval from $0.6661$ to $0.7479$; on SD3.5M, iSFG adds $+1.33$ HPSv2.1 over CFG at zero extra NFE. The control also transfers to text-to-video and image-to-video generation, improving VBench scores. Code is available at https://github.com/yyc1215lll-creator/SFG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MMDiT 中图像到文本 (I2T) 的反馈会把演化图像里已有的物体与属性（包括错误）写回文本表征，抑制这种反馈反而提升生成质量。提出 Semantic Feedback Guidance (SFG)：引导模型远离强化 I2T、削弱文本到图像条件的辅助分支；其原位版本 iSFG 无需额外模型评估。FLUX 上 SFG+CFG 使 GenEval 从 0.6661 升到 0.7479，SD3.5M 上 iSFG 在零额外 NFE 下给 HPSv2.1 加 +1.33。
Motivation: MMDiT 的联合注意力让图像更新内部文本表征，这些表征再反过来指导后续图像更新；需要判定这条 I2T 反馈是在纠正偏离提示的偏差，还是在保留乃至固化这些偏差。
Method: 先做干预实验：移植 I2T 消息可挽救失败也可破坏成功，在匹配干预强度下抑制 I2T 反馈改善生成、反向对照则变差。据此提出 SFG，通过引导远离一个强化 I2T、弱化 T2I 条件的辅助分支来抑制反馈；iSFG 为原位变体，直接抑制 I2T 并强化 T2I 条件，不需要额外模型评估；SFG 分支只在采样步的前 20% 运行。
Result: SFG 分支仅在前 20% 采样步运行，无 CFG 时开销约为基线 NFE 的 1.2 倍。三个图像生成骨干上对齐与偏好模型分数均有提升：FLUX 上 SFG 加到 CFG 之上使 GenEval 从 0.6661 升至 0.7479；SD3.5M 上 iSFG 在零额外 NFE 下比 CFG 多 +1.33 HPSv2.1。该控制还能迁移到文生视频与图生视频，提高 VBench 分数。
Conclusion: I2T 反馈会保留图像中已表征的物体与属性（含错误），因此抑制它并强化文本到图像条件是提升 MMDiT 生成对齐与偏好的有效方向，且 iSFG 可零开销实现。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: MMDiT 中图像到文本 (I2T) 的反馈会把演化图像里已有的物体与属性（包括错误）写回文本表征，抑制这种反馈反而提升生成质量。提出 Semantic Feedback Guidance (SFG)：引导模型远离强化 I2T、削弱文本到图像条件的辅助分支；其原位版本 iSFG 无需额外模型评估。FLUX 上 SFG+CFG 使 GenEval 从 0.6661 升到 0.7479，SD3.5M 上 iSFG 在零额外 NFE 下给 HPSv2.1 加 +1.33。
summary_sections.motivation: MMDiT 的联合注意力让图像更新内部文本表征，这些表征再反过来指导后续图像更新；需要判定这条 I2T 反馈是在纠正偏离提示的偏差，还是在保留乃至固化这些偏差。
summary_sections.method: 先做干预实验：移植 I2T 消息可挽救失败也可破坏成功，在匹配干预强度下抑制 I2T 反馈改善生成、反向对照则变差。据此提出 SFG，通过引导远离一个强化 I2T、弱化 T2I 条件的辅助分支来抑制反馈；iSFG 为原位变体，直接抑制 I2T 并强化 T2I 条件，不需要额外模型评估；SFG 分支只在采样步的前 20% 运行。
summary_sections.result: SFG 分支仅在前 20% 采样步运行，无 CFG 时开销约为基线 NFE 的 1.2 倍。三个图像生成骨干上对齐与偏好模型分数均有提升：FLUX 上 SFG 加到 CFG 之上使 GenEval 从 0.6661 升至 0.7479；SD3.5M 上 iSFG 在零额外 NFE 下比 CFG 多 +1.33 HPSv2.1。该控制还能迁移到文生视频与图生视频，提高 VBench 分数。
summary_sections.conclusion: I2T 反馈会保留图像中已表征的物体与属性（含错误），因此抑制它并强化文本到图像条件是提升 MMDiT 生成对齐与偏好的有效方向，且 iSFG 可零开销实现。

papers.title: Hide and Seek: HIDE Concepts to SEEK explanations for black box models
papers.abstract_en: Interpreting machine learning model predictions is a central challenge, particularly for black-box vision models. Concept-based attribution methods interpret models using human-understandable concepts. Existing concept-based methods can only interpret classification and regression models. They require access to model weights or large concept-annotated datasets, and most methods cannot provide image-level attribution. We propose Hide and Seek (HnS), a new method for concept-level attribution that does not require access to model weights or labeled concept datasets. HnS can interpret a wide range of vision models. Given a concept and image set, HnS retrieves concept-aligned images using a vision-language model, localizes the concept within each image, masks the localized region, and measures attribution from the change in the black-box model's output between the original and masked images. This enables faithful attribution by directly measuring the model's behavior and supporting local attributions. We validated HnS on CelebA and COCO-Stuff. Compared to existing methods, HnS showed better agreement with ground-truth attributions. We demonstrated the applicability of HnS on diverse tasks, including image captioning and satellite image segmentation, where no existing concept attribution method can be used. We provided our anonymous code in the supplementary material.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出黑盒视觉模型的概念级归因方法 Hide and Seek (HnS)：用视觉-语言模型检索概念对齐图像并定位概念区域，遮蔽后比较模型输出变化来度量归因，无需模型权重或概念标注数据。在 CelebA 与 COCO-Stuff 上与现有方法相比更贴合真实归因，并可扩展到图像描述和卫星图像分割等此前无概念归因方法可用的任务。
Motivation: 现有概念归因方法只能处理分类与回归模型，且大多需要模型权重或大规模概念标注数据集，无法给出图像级归因，也覆盖不了描述、分割等任务。
Method: HnS 流程：给定概念与图像集，先用 vision-language model 检索概念对齐图像，再在每张图内定位概念区域并遮蔽，通过遮蔽前后黑盒模型输出之差计算归因，从而直接测量模型行为并支持局部归因。
Result: 在 CelebA 与 COCO-Stuff 上验证，与已有概念归因方法相比与 ground-truth attribution 的一致性更好；并在图像描述 (image captioning) 与卫星图像分割 (satellite image segmentation) 上演示了可用性，这些任务此前没有可用的概念归因方法。
Conclusion: 不依赖权重与概念标注、仅靠遮蔽前后输出差的黑盒测量，就能把概念归因推广到分类/回归之外的多种视觉模型与任务。

papers.title: Constructive Bounds for the Topological Expressivity of Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: The expressivity of a neural network $Φ$ describes the class of functions that a network can express. The term topological expressivity refers to a family of measures particularly suited to understand binary classification and is often formulated in terms of the Betti numbers of a decision boundary $β(Φ^{-1}(0))$. Despite its popularity, this measure is not as useful for regression and other problems that do not involve a decision boundary. Instead, we propose to study topological expressivity in terms of the Betti numbers of the output of a neural network $β(Φ(X))$. We formally prove that a ReLU network with architecture $(d,\sum\limits_{k=1}^{d } β_k(3k+2),\sum\limits_{k=1}^{d}β_k(k+1))$ can express spaces homotopy equivalent to wedge sums of spheres with arbitrary Betti numbers. This gives upper bounds for any arbitrary connected ($β_0=1$) sequence of Betti numbers, but by constructing spaces homotopy equivalent to products of $N$ spheres of dimension $d_1,...,d_N$ we achieve much better bounds $(\sum\limits_{n=1} d_n, 3\sum\limits_{n=1}\limits^N d_n + 2N, \sum\limits_{n=1}\limits^N d_n + N) $ for Betti numbers given by $\prod_n (1+x^{d_n})$. Finally we conjecture a much stronger tight bound which gives the architectural bound $(d,d+1,d+1)$ for a space homeomorphic to the sphere.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把拓扑表达力的度量从决策边界的 Betti 数 β(Φ⁻¹(0)) 换成网络输出本身的 Betti 数 β(Φ(X))，使其适用于回归类问题。证明 ReLU 网络架构 (d, Σβ_k(3k+2), Σβ_k(k+1)) 可表达同伦等价于任意 Betti 数楔和球的空间；对形如 ∏(1+x^{d_n}) 的 Betti 数，用 N 个球的乘积构造把上界压到 (Σd_n, 3Σd_n+2N, Σd_n+N)，并猜想球面只需 (d,d+1,d+1)。
Motivation: 以决策边界 Betti 数刻画的拓扑表达力只对二分类有意义，回归等不含决策边界的问题缺少对应的度量方式。
Method: 以输出空间 β(Φ(X)) 定义拓扑表达力；先构造同伦等价于楔和球的空间给出一般上界，再构造 N 维球乘积 (维度 d_1,...,d_N) 的空间收紧界，并对球面提出紧界猜想。
Result: ReLU 架构 (d, Σ_{k=1}^{d}β_k(3k+2), Σ_{k=1}^{d}β_k(k+1)) 可表达任意连通 (β₀=1) Betti 数序列对应的楔和球空间；对 Betti 数 ∏_n(1+x^{d_n}) 得到更紧的 (Σd_n, 3Σd_n+2N, Σd_n+N)；猜想球面的架构上界为 (d,d+1,d+1)。
Conclusion: 用输出 Betti 数替代决策边界 Betti 数后，拓扑表达力可覆盖回归问题，且球乘积构造给出的界明显优于楔和的一般上界；球面紧界目前是猜想。

papers.title: Chronos Policy: Learning Robot Policies on Physical Time
papers.abstract_en: Robot policies often convert sensing and control into fixed-rate observation-action sequences, leaving physical time implicit in sequence position. This assumption breaks when observation rates or delays vary, or when inference latency changes. We introduce Chronos Policy, which makes physical time explicit by conditioning on observation capture times and desired action execution times. We study two ways to incorporate time into a diffusion transformer: adding timestamp embeddings to token features, or encoding physical time in positional encoding through time-aware rotary positional encodings (time-aware RoPE). We find that time-aware RoPE is more robust, allowing attention to depend directly on physical time while keeping token content unchanged. During training, we temporally randomize which observations are sampled and when the action chunk begins, exposing the policy to a wider range of sensing and execution schedules that may occur during deployments. This also enables learning from asynchronous, multi-rate data without forcing all measurements onto a fixed temporal grid. Across simulation and real-world experiments, Chronos Policy improves performance on dynamic tasks, where observation-to-action timing is critical, and on multisensory tasks, where the relative timing between observations matters. On standard quasi-static tasks, it preserves nominal performance while improving robustness to changes in sensing and inference timing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Chronos Policy 把物理时间显式注入机器人策略：以观测采集时刻和期望动作执行时刻为条件，在 diffusion transformer 中对比时间戳嵌入与 time-aware RoPE 两种编码，发现 time-aware RoPE 更鲁棒，且训练时随机化采样时刻与动作块起点。仿真与真机上它提升动态任务与多传感器任务表现，在准静态任务上保持原有性能并增强对感知与推理时序变化的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 固定帧率的观测-动作序列把物理时间隐含在序列位置里，一旦观测速率、延迟或推理时延变化，策略假设即失效。
Method: 在 diffusion transformer 中以观测采集时刻与动作执行时刻为条件，比较两种时间注入方式：token 特征加时间戳嵌入，或用 time-aware rotary positional encodings (time-aware RoPE) 编码物理时间；训练时随机化观测采样时刻与动作块起始位置，从而直接学习异步、多速率数据而不必对齐到固定时间栅格。
Result: time-aware RoPE 比时间戳嵌入更鲁棒，使 attention 直接依赖物理时间且不改动 token 内容；在仿真与真实实验中，动态任务（观测到动作的时序关键）与多传感器任务（观测间相对时序关键）性能提升，准静态任务保持标称性能同时对感知与推理时序变化更鲁棒。
Conclusion: 把物理时间作为显式条件并用 time-aware RoPE 编码，配合训练期的时序随机化，可让机器人策略跨观测速率、延迟与推理时延保持性能。

papers.title: AI Models Can Provably Hide Arbitrary Capabilities
papers.abstract_en: Capability evaluations aim to surface dangerous model behaviors before deployment, but their reliability depends on the assumption that hidden capabilities can be elicited. We show this assumption does not hold under adversarial conditions by constructing backdoor attacks that embed encrypted neural networks within host model weights, decrypting and executing them only upon receiving a secret trigger. Using digital lockers, these hidden circuits remain provably hard to elicit and interpret under cryptographic assumptions, even given full access to model weights, extending prior work from hiding fixed strings to arbitrary computations. We implement our proof of concept constructions in PyTorch and evaluate elicitation through fine-tuning, weight noising, gradient-based trigger search, and latent adversarial training on a small chemical reaction prediction task - a proxy for CBRN-relevant capabilities. Our results demonstrate resistance to these methods and, together with our cryptographic guarantees, reveal a limit of elicitation-based capability audits. We release our models to support the improvement of defenses.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在宿主模型权重中嵌入加密的神经网络，只有收到秘密触发器才解密执行，使隐藏能力在密码学假设下即使攻击者拿到全部权重也难以被引出或解释。在小规模化学反应预测任务上，微调、加权噪声、基于梯度的触发器搜索与潜空间对抗训练都无法引出该能力，说明基于引出的能力审计存在原理性上限。
Motivation: 能力评估默认危险能力可以被引出，但这一假设在对抗条件下不成立，直接威胁部署前审计的可靠性。
Method: 用 digital lockers 把加密神经网络嵌入宿主权重，仅在秘密触发器下解密执行；在 PyTorch 中实现概念验证，并在小规模化学反应预测任务（作为 CBRN 相关能力的代理）上测试引出攻击。
Result: 在该代理任务上，微调、weight noising、基于梯度的触发器搜索与 latent adversarial training 均未能引出隐藏电路；密码学保证使隐藏电路在给定全部权重时仍难以引出与解释，把先前隐藏固定字符串的结果推广到任意计算。
Conclusion: 在密码学假设下，基于引出的能力审计存在原理性上限，仅靠引出无法保证发现被植入的任意能力；作者公开模型以推动防御改进。

papers.title: Can machines reason non-verbally?
papers.abstract_en: Modern machines can solve equations, follow logic and reason through language, yet they still struggle with problems that require visual non-verbal reasoning. This is evident even in advanced systems such as DeepSeek, ChatGPT and Gemini, which remain limited on visual tasks such as completing abstract patterns or delineating ambiguous regions-of-interest. Unlike explicit intermediate steps in verbal reasoning which can be verified through logic or automated tests, visual reasoning involves implicit intermediate steps with no clear methods for verification. Non-verbal reasoning is therefore challenging to model and, as a result, remains a fundamental limitation of current machine intelligence. Here we introduce GenVerOpt, a general framework that unifies generation, verification and optimisation into a reasoning pipeline for machines. By generating candidate solutions, verifying their correctness, and iteratively refining them, GenVerOpt enables per-sample optimisation rather than relying solely on dataset-level trends captured during model training. This process mirrors human problem-solving where multiple possibilities are imagined, evaluated, and refined until a correct solution emerges. Across diverse domains, GenVerOpt demonstrates capabilities beyond existing systems: it surpasses humans on abstract IQ puzzles, matches clinicians in prostate cancer segmentation, exceeds experts in liver vessel reconstruction and outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in tumour boundary alignment. These results show that machine reasoning can extend beyond language, establishing visual non-verbal reasoning as a foundation for more flexible and generalisable intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 GenVerOpt，把生成、验证、优化统一成一条推理流水线，对每个样本做迭代式求解而非只依赖训练期学到的数据集级规律。在抽象 IQ 拼图上超过人类，在前列腺癌分割上匹配临床医生，在肝脏血管重建上超过专家，在肿瘤边界对齐上优于现有最优方法。
Motivation: 机器能解方程、做逻辑和语言推理，却在视觉非语言任务（补全抽象图案、勾画模糊感兴趣区域）上受限；与语言推理不同，视觉推理的中间步骤是隐式的，缺少可验证手段，因而难以建模。
Method: GenVerOpt 框架将 generation、verification、optimisation 统一为推理流水线：先生成候选解，再验证其正确性，然后迭代精化，实现 per-sample optimisation，而非仅依赖训练时从数据集学到的规律；作者称其类比人类设想、评估、精化多种可能的解题过程。

Conclusion: 机器推理可以超出语言范畴，视觉非语言推理可作为更灵活、更可泛化智能的基础；其关键在于用可验证的迭代优化替代仅靠数据集级训练规律。

papers.title: KL Before and After Mixing: A Round-Complexity Separation in Parallel Sampling
papers.abstract_en: A parallel sampler can choose at random which coordinates to generate together. For a target $p$ and the output law $q_U$ of a schedule $U$ drawn afresh for each output, we compare the schedule-averaged divergence $\mathbb{E}_U D_{\mathrm{KL}}(p\|q_U)$ with the output-law divergence $D_{\mathrm{KL}}(p\|\mathbb{E}_U q_U)$, in nats. Rounds commit independent draws from exact conditional marginals frozen at the round's start, each output's schedule is drawn before sampling from a finite mixture of schedules, and every scheduled round is charged. For the uniform distribution on binary strings of even length $n$ with $n/2$ ones, the least expected number of rounds at a fixed tolerance $\varepsilon>0$ is $Θ_\varepsilon((\log n)^2)$ under the first criterion but $(e^{-\varepsilon}+o(1))\log_2\ln n$ under the second, and the double-logarithmic order is attainable with the same round count on every run. For this target, a count-state recursion gives the exact least output divergence at every round cap over all causal randomized policies. The separation extends to weighted fixed-count targets with bounded weight ratios and quota fractions bounded away from zero and one, without permutation symmetry, and to the full-support Beta$(1,1)$--Bernoulli target, where the sharp expected cost under the output-law criterion is $(e^{-\varepsilon}/2+o(1))\log_2\log_2n$, attained with rare $n$-round runs. Prior work implies the order of the schedule-averaged cost on the balanced target and its $O_\varepsilon((\log n)^2)$ upper bounds on both extensions.
papers.comment: 15 pages of main text; 169 pages total including references and appendices; 7 figures. Formal proof materials included as ancillary files
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在并行采样器的轮复杂度分析中，作者比较两种 KL 判据：先取调度平均再算散度 E_U D_KL(p‖q_U)，与先混合输出分布再算 D_KL(p‖E_U q_U)。对长度为 n、恰含 n/2 个 1 的均匀二元串目标，固定容差 ε>0 下最小期望轮数在第一判据下为 Θ_ε((log n)^2)，在第二判据下仅为 (e^{-ε}+o(1))log_2 ln n，且双对数阶在每次运行中都可达。
Motivation: 并行采样中调度随机性带来的散度度量方式不统一：按调度平均与按输出混合两种 KL 判据此前未被区分，导致轮复杂度的理论刻画缺失，无法判断双对数级轮数是否可达。
Method: 定义两种 KL 判据并建立轮模型：每轮从轮开始时冻结的精确条件边缘独立抽样，每个输出的调度在采样前从有限调度混合中抽取，所有被调度的轮都计费。用计数状态递归 (count-state recursion) 在所有因果随机策略上给出每轮上限下的精确最小输出散度，并把结论推广到权重比有界、配额分数远离 0 和 1 的加权定额目标以及全支撑 Beta(1,1)–Bernoulli 目标。
Result: 均匀平衡二元串目标上，固定 ε>0 的最小期望轮数：调度平均判据为 Θ_ε((log n)^2)，输出律判据为 (e^{-ε}+o(1))log_2 ln n，且双对数阶在每次运行中以相同轮数可达。Beta(1,1)–Bernoulli 目标下输出律判据的锐利期望代价为 (e^{-ε}/2+o(1))log_2 log_2 n，由罕见的 n 轮运行达成。既有工作给出平衡目标上调度平均代价的阶，以及两个推广上的 O_ε((log n)^2) 上界。
Conclusion: 两种 KL 判据在并行采样轮复杂度上存在本质分离：按输出混合再算散度可把代价从 (log n)^2 压到双对数级，且该分离在无置换对称性的加权定额目标与全支撑 Beta–Bernoulli 目标上同样成立。

papers.title: Goal-Oriented Bundle Management and Flow Control for Deep-Space Communications via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Deep-space communications operate under intermittent connectivity, long propagation delays, and relay storage constraints. In such networks, the Bundle Protocol enables store-carry-forward communication, requiring relay nodes to manage limited storage and scarce contact opportunities. Relay-side scheduling and dropping decisions are inherently goal-oriented: transmission resources should be allocated to bundles most valuable to downstream mission objectives. Conventional schedulers, such as FIFO, do not explicitly optimize task utility and may provide unfair service across heterogeneous planetary sources. This paper presents a closed-loop modeling and learning framework for relay-side bundle and flow management in a contact-driven deep-space network, where lunar and Martian updates are forwarded through a shared-buffer relay to Earth. We quantify destination-side information freshness using excess age $Δ_i^e(t)=[Δ_i(t)-d_i(t)]^+$, where $Δ_i(t)$ denotes the Age of Information of source $i$ and $d_i(t)$ is a source-dependent delay baseline. Based on this metric, we define a goal-oriented loss that supports source-dependent nonlinear penalties, allowing prioritization according to mission relevance. We formulate relay control as a constrained semi-Markov decision process (CSMDP) and solve it using masked Lagrangian Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO). Feasibility-aware action masking restricts transmissions to bundles that can complete within the remaining contact window. DTNSim simulations indicate improved age-based utility and inter-flow fairness compared with baseline schedulers. The proposed framework jointly optimizes relay-side bundle scheduling, dropping, and flow control under contact-driven dynamics with explicit fairness considerations across heterogeneous sources.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Presented at the 77th International Astronautical Congress (IAC 2026), Antalya, Turkey, 5-9 October 2026. Paper ID: IAC-26-B2.5.8-x113206
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向深空 Bundle Protocol 中继提出闭环强化学习框架：用目的端信息新鲜度 excess age Δ_i^e(t)=[Δ_i(t)-d_i(t)]^+ 定义带源相关非线性惩罚的目标导向损失，把中继调度建模为约束半马尔可夫决策过程 (CSMDP)，再用带可行性动作掩码的 Lagrangian PPO 求解。DTNSim 仿真显示相比 FIFO 等基线调度器，age 效用与跨异构源的流间公平性均有提升。
Motivation: 深空网络连接间断、传播时延长、中继存储受限，FIFO 等常规调度器不显式优化任务效用，对月球与火星等异构源可能给出不公平服务。
Method: 在共享缓冲中继的接触驱动网络中量化目的端信息新鲜度 excess age Δ_i^e(t)=[Δ_i(t)-d_i(t)]^+，据此构造支持源相关非线性惩罚的目标导向损失；将中继的调度、丢弃与流控统一表述为约束半马尔可夫决策过程 (CSMDP)，用 masked Lagrangian PPO 求解，可行性动作掩码只允许在剩余接触窗口内能传完的 bundle 被发送。
Result: DTNSim 仿真表明，相比基线调度器（如 FIFO），age 效用与跨异构源的流间公平性均得到改善；论文共 15 页、3 图、4 表。
Conclusion: 把任务效用、信息新鲜度与公平性作为显式约束一起优化，可在接触驱动的深空网络中联合决定 bundle 调度、丢弃与流控，优于不优化任务效用的常规调度器。

papers.title: DyssomniaNN: Multi-Scale Spiking Neural Modeling of Human Sleep Disorders and Perceived Restedness
papers.abstract_en: Clinical sleep medicine repeatedly documents profound divergences between objective sleep duration and subjective daytime impairment, notably exemplified by sleep state misperception in paradoxical insomnia and boundary instability in narcolepsy type 1. Here, we present DyssomniaNN: a multi-scale biophysical computational framework coupling Borbély's two-process regulation of sleep homeostasis and circadian drive with Saper's hypothalamic reciprocal flip-flop circuit and a recurrent corticothalamic leaky integrate-and-fire spiking neural network. We formalize five clinical cohorts across an identical 72-hour photoperiod: healthy control, circadian rhythm sleep-wake disorder (delayed-phase), chronic insomnia, paradoxical insomnia, and narcolepsy type 1. The synthetic local field potential converges closely with empirical human electroencephalography spectra from the PhysioNet Sleep-EDF database across all canonical frequency bands (spectral mean absolute error of 0.33--0.35). Furthermore, we introduce the Well-Rested Index to quantify restorative efficacy. Simulations reveal that sleep duration fails to predict restorative recovery: paradoxical insomnia achieves normal total sleep time (21.15 h) yet yields low restoration (37.6%) from unsuppressed cortical beta-band intrusion, whereas hypocretin deficiency in narcolepsy produces severe nocturnal fragmentation (781 min of wake after sleep onset) and 35 sleep-onset rapid eye movement periods. DyssomniaNN provides an in silico platform for mechanistic sleep research and virtual neuropharmacology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DyssomniaNN 把 Borbély 双过程模型、Saper 下丘脑翻转电路与皮层丘脑 LIF 脉冲神经网络耦合，在统一 72 小时光照周期下模拟五个临床睡眠队列。模拟显示睡眠时长无法预测恢复性：矛盾性失眠总睡眠时间正常（21.15 h）但 Well-Rested Index 仅 37.6%，发作性睡病 1 型因 hypocretin 缺乏出现 781 min 睡后觉醒与 35 次睡眠始发 REM。
Motivation: 临床上客观睡眠时长与主观日间损害长期背离（矛盾性失眠的睡眠状态误判、1 型发作性睡病的边界不稳定），缺少能在机制层面同时再现这种背离的可计算平台。
Method: 耦合 Borbély 双过程睡眠稳态/昼夜节律驱动、Saper 下丘脑相互抑制 flip-flop 电路与循环皮层丘脑 leaky integrate-and-fire SNN；在相同 72 小时光照周期下形式化五个队列（健康对照、延迟相位昼夜节律睡眠-觉醒障碍、慢性失眠、矛盾性失眠、1 型发作性睡病），生成合成局部场电位并提出 Well-Rested Index 量化恢复效力，与 PhysioNet Sleep-EDF 人类 EEG 谱对照。
Result: 合成 LFP 在 Sleep-EDF 全部经典频带上与经验 EEG 谱收敛，谱平均绝对误差 (spectral MAE) 0.33–0.35；矛盾性失眠总睡眠时间 21.15 h 属正常，但因皮层 beta 波段侵入未被抑制，恢复度仅 37.6%；1 型发作性睡病 hypocretin 缺乏导致睡后觉醒 781 min、35 次睡眠始发快速眼动期。
Conclusion: 睡眠时长不足以预测恢复性恢复，DyssomniaNN 可作为机制性睡眠研究与虚拟神经药理学的 in silico 平台。

papers.title: Designing Protein Structures from Natural Language
papers.abstract_en: A central challenge in de novo protein design is generating proteins with desired structural and functional properties. Existing design models typically require a dedicated input representation for each property, limiting the design objectives they support. We develop Prompteina, the first all-atom structure generation model that supports new and broader design objectives specified in natural language, analogous to text-to-image generation. To train Prompteina, we construct Prompteina-Data, a paired text--protein structure dataset of 1.8M structures and 50M+ captions describing global and residue-specific structural and functional properties. We adapt Proteina-Complexa, a pretrained structure generation model, through text-conditioned pretraining and finetuning that aligns residues with their corresponding text. Prompteina outperforms baselines on 15 of 18 structural properties and generates proteins that more closely match descriptions of their intended functions. In binder design, it leads baselines on at least 13 of 20 targets and improves interface confidence by 14\% over the strongest baseline. With iterative in silico feedback, Prompteina's gain over non-iterative generation is 57\% larger than the next-best baseline on the hardest targets. Finally, we experimentally validate Prompteina designs against GM2A, a target with no reported de novo binders. We identify nine binders, with the strongest at an apparent $K_{\mathrm{D}}$ of 107 nM. These results establish natural language as an effective and powerful conditioning interface for protein structure generation.
papers.comment: 53 pages, 9 figures. Code, data, and model weights: https://github.com/jleechung/prompteina
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Prompteina 是首个用自然语言指定设计目标的全原子蛋白结构生成模型：基于预训练模型 Proteina-Complexa 做文本条件预训练与微调，把残基与对应描述对齐。在 18 项结构性质中 15 项胜过基线，binder 设计在 20 个靶点中至少 13 个领先、界面置信度比最强基线高 14%，最难靶点上迭代式 in silico 反馈带来的增益比次优基线大 57%；对无已报道 de novo binder 的 GM2A 实验验证得到 9 个 binder，最强表观 KD 为 107 nM。
Motivation: 现有蛋白设计模型每种性质都要专用输入表示，能支持的设计目标受限，无法像 text-to-image 那样用一句自然语言同时表达全局与残基级的结构和功能要求。
Method: 构建 Prompteina-Data 配对数据集（1.8M 结构、50M+ 描述全局与残基级结构/功能性质的 caption），在预训练结构生成模型 Proteina-Complexa 上做文本条件预训练与微调，使残基与文本对齐；binder 设计中加入迭代式 in silico 反馈。
Result: 18 项结构性质中 15 项优于基线，生成蛋白更贴合其功能描述；binder 设计在 20 个靶点中至少 13 个领先，界面置信度比最强基线提高 14%；最难靶点上迭代反馈相对非迭代生成的增益比次优基线大 57%；对 GM2A 实验验证识别出 9 个 binder，最强表观 KD 107 nM。
Conclusion: 自然语言可作为蛋白结构生成的有效条件接口，同时覆盖更广的设计目标，并在无已报道 de novo binder 的靶点上产出实验可验证的结合分子。

papers.title: Markov Chain Convergence in Kernel-Induced Geometry
papers.abstract_en: We study the convergence of Markov chains in the geometry induced by Hilbertian embeddings associated with positive definite kernels, also called Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD). Under a contraction assumption in the kernel-induced geometry, and a standard spectral gap assumption, we establish non-asymptotic, high-probability bounds for the convergence of the empirical occupation measure to the invariant measure. The obtained bounds separate the roles of the two conditions: the spectral gap determines the effective sample size in the leading term, while the kernel contraction enters only through a linear correction. As an application, we study one-step prediction of dynamical systems from a single trajectory, deriving fast learning rates for a nonlinear least-squares estimator. The rates highlight the interplay between mixing properties in the kernel-induced geometry and the classical source and capacity conditions used in the analysis of least-squares.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在正定核诱导的几何（即 MMD 距离）下研究 Markov 链收敛：假设核几何中的收缩与标准谱隙条件，给出经验占据测度逼近不变测度的非渐近高概率界，并把两个条件的作用分离——谱隙决定主项的有效样本数，核收缩只以线性修正出现。作为应用，从单条轨迹做动力系统一步预测，为非线性最小二乘估计量导出快速学习速率。
Motivation: MMD 几何下的 Markov 链收敛分析通常把收缩与谱隙两个条件混在一起，难以看出各自对有效样本量的贡献；同时单轨迹动力系统预测的速率分析需要把核几何的混合性与最小二乘的 source/capacity 条件衔接起来。
Method: 在 Hilbertian embedding（MMD）诱导的核几何中，假设收缩条件与标准谱隙条件，推导经验占据测度到不变测度的非渐近高概率收敛界；再将结果用于单条轨迹上动力系统一步预测的非线性最小二乘估计量，导出学习速率。
Result: 得到的界把两个条件解耦：谱隙决定主项中的有效样本数，核收缩仅通过线性修正进入；对单轨迹一步预测的非线性最小二乘估计量导出快速学习速率，速率体现核几何混合性与经典 source、capacity 条件的相互作用。
Conclusion: 核几何中的收缩条件对收敛界只是线性修正，起决定作用的是谱隙给出的有效样本量；这一分解可直接迁移到单轨迹动力系统预测的最小二乘速率分析。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Where to Look Matters: Rethinking Sub-Volume Sampling in 3D Medical Self-supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised learning on 3D medical images commonly relies on random sub-volume sampling during pretraining. However, random cropping implicitly treats all spatial regions as equally worth observing, despite anatomical priors and spatial redundancy that make regions inherently unequal in their value for representation learning. To this end, we first show through controlled crop-quality manipulations that better sub-volumes lead to better downstream transfer, revealing the observation policy as an overlooked bottleneck in 3D medical SSL. Motivated by this finding, we revisit sub-volume sampling as a \emph{where-to-look} problem. We propose \textbf{\method}, a plug-and-play framework that replaces random cropping with an offline coarse-to-fine probe bank guided by \textit{anatomy-awareness}, \textit{informativeness}, and \textit{diversity}. We instantiate \method as a lightweight \lite variant using geometric and image-statistical cues, and a diagnostic \feat variant using frozen visual features, to examine whether lightweight volume-intrinsic priors suffice or richer semantic cues reliably provide additional value. Extensive experiments across multiple 3D medical SSL backbones and downstream tasks demonstrate that \method-\lite consistently improves transfer performance over random sampling. Mechanistic analyses further attribute these gains to more anatomically plausible and informative observations, reduced spatial redundancy, more efficient learning dynamics, and more structured representations.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted by NeurIPS 2026 (The 40th Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 3D 医体自监督预训练中的随机子体积采样把所有空间区域当作同等有价值，作者将其重述为 where-to-look 问题，用离线 coarse-to-fine probe bank 按 anatomy-awareness、informativeness、diversity 三个准则选子体积替换随机裁剪。受控裁剪质量操纵显示更好的子体积带来更好的下游迁移；在多个 3D 医学 SSL backbone 与下游任务上，轻量的 	extbf{\method}-\lite 变体相对随机采样一致提升迁移性能。
Motivation: 随机裁剪隐含假设各空间区域观测价值相等，但解剖先验与空间冗余使区域价值本就不均；作者据此把观测策略 (observation policy) 视为 3D 医学 SSL 中被忽视的瓶颈。
Method: 提出即插即用框架 \method：用离线 coarse-to-fine probe bank 替代随机裁剪，选择受 anatomy-awareness、informativeness、diversity 三准则引导。实例化两个变体——轻量 \lite 用几何与图像统计线索，诊断 \feat 用冻结视觉特征，用于检验轻量体积内在先验是否足够、还是更丰富语义线索能稳定带来额外价值。
Result: 受控裁剪质量操纵表明更好的子体积带来更好的下游迁移；在多个 3D 医学 SSL backbone 与下游任务上，\method-\lite 相对随机采样一致提升迁移性能。机理分析把增益归因于更符合解剖、信息量更高的观测，空间冗余降低，学习动力学更高效，表示更结构化。
Conclusion: 子体积的观测策略是 3D 医学 SSL 的可改进瓶颈：把随机裁剪换成受解剖与信息量引导的选点，即可稳定改善迁移；轻量体积内在先验足以支撑这一改进。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Revisiting Tabular Deep Regression: Objectives and the Limits of Global Early Stopping
papers.abstract_en: While deep learning models for tabular data have recently received significant research attention, the choice of objective functions for regression tasks remains an understudied degree of freedom. Several lines of research offer alternatives to the standard Mean Squared Error (MSE), but differences in datasets, backbones, and evaluation protocols make their practical benefits difficult to compare. In this work, we address this gap by performing a systematic re-evaluation of regression objectives across a broad collection of established tabular datasets and multiple neural backbones. Our comparison reveals that many proposed objectives provide limited or inconsistent gains over a properly tuned MSE baseline, while quantile loss yields consistent aggregate improvements over MSE across the tested backbones. We then identify a limitation that remains even with this strong objective: regions with different levels of target noise can reach their best predictive performance at different training epochs. Consequently, a single global early-stopping checkpoint can impose a compromise between uncertainty regions, even when the objective can represent heteroskedastic target distributions. Motivated by this limitation, we introduce a heteroskedasticity-aware extension of quantile loss that uses input-dependent label smoothing as a potential remedy and improves over quantile loss on several backbones. Overall, our results provide a modern empirical picture of regression objectives for tabular deep learning and highlight how differences in optimal stopping times across uncertainty regions can limit the effectiveness of global early stopping. The code is available at https://github.com/yandex-research/tabular-regression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统重评表格数据回归目标函数后发现：多数替代损失相对调好的 MSE 基线收益有限或不一致，而 quantile loss 在多个 backbone 上稳定优于 MSE。即便用上这一强目标，不同目标噪声区域的最佳训练 epoch 仍不同，单一全局 early-stopping checkpoint 会在各不确定性区域间被迫折中。作者据此提出异方差感知的 quantile loss 扩展，用输入依赖的 label smoothing 作补救，并在若干 backbone 上进一步超过 quantile loss。
Motivation: 表格回归的目标函数选择是被忽视的自由度：既有替代损失在数据集、backbone 与评测协议上互不一致，实际收益难以比较；同时全局 early-stopping 在异方差目标下会牺牲部分噪声区域。
Method: 在大量既有表格数据集与多个神经 backbone 上系统重评回归目标（含 MSE 与 quantile loss 等），统一评测协议；再针对不同噪声区域最优 epoch 不一致的问题，提出以输入依赖 label smoothing 扩展 quantile loss。
Result: 多数被提目标相对调好的 MSE 基线收益有限或不一致；quantile loss 在所测各 backbone 上带来一致的聚合改进；所提异方差感知扩展在若干 backbone 上优于 quantile loss。代码发布于 github.com/yandex-research/tabular-regression。
Conclusion: quantile loss 是表格深度回归中比多数替代目标更可靠的选择，但全局 early-stopping 本身构成上限：最优停止时刻随不确定性区域而异，需按噪声水平区分处理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hitting-Time Bounds for Asynchronous Q-Learning
papers.abstract_en: We study the last iterate of standard asynchronous Q-learning from a single trajectory of a finite Markov decision process. The trajectory follows a fixed behavior policy whose state--action chain is irreducible and may be periodic. For discount factor $γ$, write $H=(1-γ)^{-1}$, and let $μ_{\min}$ be the minimum stationary state--action probability and $\mathfrak h_\star$ the largest expected hitting time of the reverse state--action chain. We prove that zero-initialized Q-learning with a constant step size achieves sup-norm error at most $\varepsilon$ with high probability using $\widetilde{O}(H^4/(μ_{\min}\varepsilon^2)+\mathfrak h_\star)$ transitions, for $0<\varepsilon\le1$. The statistical term retains the quartic effective-horizon dependence of standard Q-learning, while initialization cost is additive in $\mathfrak h_\star$. For aperiodic behavior chains, a comparison with mixing time yields a transient term $\widetilde{O}(t_{\mathrm{mix}}/μ_{\min})$. An empirical state--action count rule selects a constant step size for a subsequent training run and attains the same rate without prior knowledge of model parameters, target accuracy, or confidence level. The output is the last training iterate, with both stages included in the sample count. The proof uses two deterministic Bellman envelopes to separate statistical error from fixed-policy initialization error and adapts reverse-time hitting-cost compensation from TD learning to state--action propagation. An exploration lower bound holds for arbitrary predictable step sizes. Together with the existing statistical lower bound and its extension to pilot-selected constant steps, it yields matching mean-square rates up to logarithmic factors on the stated large-sample parameter classes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出有限 MDP 单轨迹异步 Q-learning 最后迭代的 hitting-time 上界：零初始化加常数步长时，sup-norm 误差至多 ε 所需转移数为 Õ(H⁴/(μ_min ε²)+h*)，其中初始化代价以 h* 加性出现而非乘进统计项。经验状态-动作计数规则可在不知模型参数、目标精度与置信水平的情况下选出常数步长并达到同一速率；配合已有下界得到均方速率匹配（差对数因子）。
Motivation: 标准异步 Q-learning 的样本复杂度分析通常把固定策略初始化的瞬态代价与统计误差混在一起，且常数步长的选择需要知道目标精度等先验参数；单轨迹、可周期状态-动作链下缺少含 hitting time 的显式界。
Method: 在行为策略状态-动作链不可约（可周期）的单轨迹上分析零初始化、常数步长的 Q-learning 最后迭代；用两个确定性 Bellman envelope 把统计误差与固定策略初始化误差分离，并把 TD learning 中的 reverse-time hitting-cost 补偿技术适配到状态-动作传播；再用经验状态-动作计数规则在后续训练轮次中选步长。
Result: 0<ε≤1 时以高概率达到 sup-norm 误差 ε 需 Õ(H⁴/(μ_min ε²)+h*) 次转移，H=(1-γ)^{-1}；统计项保留标准 Q-learning 的四次有效视界依赖，初始化代价在 h* 上为加性。非周期行为链下瞬态项为 Õ(t_mix/μ_min)。步长计数规则达到同一速率且无需先验参数。对任意可预测步长有探索下界，与已有统计下界及其对 pilot 选择常数步长的扩展合起来，在所述大样本参数类上给出匹配的均方速率（差对数因子）。
Conclusion: 异步 Q-learning 的样本复杂度可写成统计项与 reverse-chain hitting time 的加性分解，且常数步长可由数据驱动的经验计数规则选出而不损失速率。

summary_sections.method: 在行为策略状态-动作链不可约（可周期）的单轨迹上分析零初始化、常数步长的 Q-learning 最后迭代；用两个确定性 Bellman envelope 把统计误差与固定策略初始化误差分离，并把 TD learning 中的 reverse-time hitting-cost 补偿技术适配到状态-动作传播；再用经验状态-动作计数规则在后续训练轮次中选步长。
summary_sections.result: 0<ε≤1 时以高概率达到 sup-norm 误差 ε 需 Õ(H⁴/(μ_min ε²)+h*) 次转移，H=(1-γ)^{-1}；统计项保留标准 Q-learning 的四次有效视界依赖，初始化代价在 h* 上为加性。非周期行为链下瞬态项为 Õ(t_mix/μ_min)。步长计数规则达到同一速率且无需先验参数。对任意可预测步长有探索下界，与已有统计下界及其对 pilot 选择常数步长的扩展合起来，在所述大样本参数类上给出匹配的均方速率（差对数因子）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 异步 Q-learning 的样本复杂度可写成统计项与 reverse-chain hitting time 的加性分解，且常数步长可由数据驱动的经验计数规则选出而不损失速率。

papers.title: Task Context Shapes Component Roles in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models reuse the same attention heads across tasks, but identifying these shared heads does not explain what they do differently in each task. A natural source of inspiration is task-dependent interactions among shared brain regions, which motivate a network view of language-model computation. Here, we compare fixed model components across tasks using identical graph facts, statements specifying which directed connections are present. We measure how interventions affect attention heads and the activation state in later layers (influence), as well as the answer (importance). Task changes redistribute the influence in five open-weight models spanning four families and 1.5-14 billion parameters. In Gemma-2-9B and Qwen3-14B, an activation edit changes an early internal activation vector and switches which fact the model reads while the written instruction stays fixed. The same heads then respond to different graph facts and influence later components differently. For each prompt, we construct two linear response maps, one before the edit and one after it. Each map predicts a later head's response from a measured change in an earlier head. For a separate factual intervention, the map for the corresponding condition reduces mean squared prediction error by 53.6% in Gemma and 5.0% in Qwen compared with the average of the two maps. These findings show that task context changes both which graph facts the shared components respond to and how their outputs affect later computation. A network account may help explain how models use shared parameters to perform different computations. Measurements of task-dependent influence could also guide interventions intended to alter one behavior while preserving others.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 同一组注意力头在不同任务上下文中被重新分配角色：用完全相同的图事实 (graph facts) 干预五个开源模型，任务切换会改变共享头响应哪些事实、以及其输出如何影响后续层。在 Gemma-2-9B 与 Qwen3-14B 中，一次激活编辑在指令不变时切换模型读取的事实；编辑前后各建一张线性响应图，对应条件的那张图把后续头响应的均方预测误差相对两图平均降低 53.6%（Gemma）与 5.0%（Qwen）。
Motivation: 已有工作能找出跨任务复用的注意力头，但识别出共享头并不能解释同一头在各任务中究竟做了什么不同的计算。
Method: 以图事实为统一探针，对固定模型组件做干预并分别测量两件事：对后续层注意力头与激活状态的影响 (influence)，以及对答案的重要性 (importance)；对每个 prompt 在编辑前后各构造一张线性响应图，由早期头的实测变化预测后期头的响应。
Result: 任务切换在覆盖四个模型家族、参数量 1.5–14B 的五个开源模型中重新分配 influence。Gemma-2-9B 与 Qwen3-14B 中，激活编辑改变早期内部激活向量并切换模型读取的事实，指令保持不变，同一批头随后响应不同图事实并以不同方式影响后续组件。对独立的事实干预，对应条件的响应图相对两图平均把均方预测误差降低 53.6%（Gemma）与 5.0%（Qwen）。
Conclusion: 任务上下文同时决定共享组件响应哪些图事实及其输出如何影响后续计算，网络视角可解释共享参数如何执行不同计算；任务依赖的 influence 测量可用来设计只改一种行为而保留其他行为的干预。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unifying spherical convolutions through lifting
papers.abstract_en: We develop a unified description of convolution on the sphere by lifting to the rotation group. A number of definitions of spherical convolution have been proposed, differing in whether the kernel is axisymmetric or directional, whether the output is on the sphere or the rotation group, whether the signals carry spin, and in their computational cost. No unified treatment exists. Regarding the sphere as the homogeneous space $S^2 \cong \text{SO(3)}/\text{SO(2)}$, we lift a spin $s$ field to the rotation group, convolve on $\text{SO(3)}$, and project back to the sphere through the adjoint of the lift for a potentially different spin $s'$. We recover every rotation-equivariant convolution considered previously through constraints on the kernel, spin choices and inclusion or omission of the lift and projection. For maps between fields of fixed input and output spin, we prove that directional kernels, output on the sphere and equivariance cannot be achieved simultaneously. We make explicit that spin fields are sections of associated line bundles, linking the physics and bundle literatures, and express the spin rotation phase as the character of the twist of the section. We present harmonic-space algorithms for the exact and efficient computation of lifted spherical convolutions of band-limited fields by appealing to sampling theorems on the sphere and rotation group. All operators are implemented in the open-source s2conv code, and numerical experiments confirm the reductions and the equivariance of the operators to machine precision. Finally, we illustrate the operators on fields measured on the Earth and on the celestial sky.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把球面卷积统一为在旋转群 SO(3) 上的卷积：将自旋 s 场 lift 到 SO(3)、卷积后再经 lift 的伴随投影回球面得到自旋 s' 输出，通过核约束、自旋选择与是否含 lift/projection 恢复此前所有旋转等变卷积定义。证明了对固定输入输出自旋的映射，方向性核、输出在球面、等变性三者不可同时满足；数值实验确认各算子的化简关系与等变性达机器精度。
Motivation: 球面卷积已有多种互不兼容的定义（核是否轴对称、输出在球面还是旋转群、信号是否带自旋、计算代价不同），缺少统一处理，物理与几何两支文献对自旋场的表述也未打通。
Method: 视球面为齐性空间 S² ≅ SO(3)/SO(2)，将自旋 s 场 lift 到 SO(3) 上卷积，再经 lift 的伴随投影回球面得到自旋 s'；用核约束、自旋取值以及 lift/projection 的取舍恢复既有全部旋转等变卷积。对带限场给出基于球面与旋转群采样定理的调和空间 (harmonic-space) 精确高效算法，全部算子在开源 s2conv 中实现。
Result: 证明固定输入/输出自旋的映射中，方向性核、球面输出与等变性三者不可兼得；数值实验确认各算子的化简关系与等变性达到机器精度；在地球与天球实测场上演示这些算子。
Conclusion: 球面卷积可由 lift 到旋转群这一单一框架生成并严格刻画，且自旋场应表述为 associated line bundle 的截面、自旋旋转相位即该截面 twist 的 character，从而连接物理与几何两支文献。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Beyond the Snowflakes: Disentangling Weather Effects from Confounding Meta-Factors in LiDAR Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) is critical for autonomous perception, yet its performance is known to degrade in adverse weather. While existing literature models snow as atmospheric noise that degrades performance, our granular evaluation on the WADS-3D and CADC datasets reveals a counter-intuitive phenomenon: detection accuracy consistently improves as snow intensity increases. Through ablation study and meta-information analysis, we reconcile this by confirming that while falling snow acts as noise, its negative impact is outweighed by a dominant, concurrent factor: significantly increased object point count. We hypothesize that this object point count boost acts as a geometric enhancement, driven by snow accumulation increasing vehicle surface area and a shift from specular to diffuse reflectance. Our findings demonstrate that evaluating perception systems using broad weather-severity bins without accounting for correlated object-level data can lead to misleading conclusions about detector robustness. We conclude that accurate evaluation requires decoupling atmospheric noise from surface accumulation effects and outline future research to validate these physical models. The WADS-3D dataset is available at: https://digitalcommons.mtu.edu/wads-3d/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 WADS-3D 与 CADC 上做细粒度评测发现，LiDAR 检测精度随雪强增大反而持续上升，因为降雪噪声的负效应被同时出现的目标点数增加压过。作者据此指出：按宽泛天气严重度分箱评估会得出误导性的鲁棒性结论，正确做法是把大气噪声与积雪表面效应解耦后再评。
Motivation: 既有文献把雪一律建模为大气噪声、认为性能随天气恶化，但这种按宽泛天气分箱的评估混入了目标级相关变量，可能给出关于检测器鲁棒性的误导结论。
Method: 在 WADS-3D 与 CADC 数据集上做细粒度（granular）检测评测，结合消融实验与 meta-information 分析定位主导因素，并提出目标点数提升源于积雪增大车辆表面积、镜面反射转漫反射的物理解释假设。
Result: 检测精度随雪强增大一致提升（counter-intuitive）；消融与元信息分析确认降雪本身是噪声，但其负效应被显著增加的目标点数这一主导并发因素抵消并反超。
Conclusion: 评估感知系统必须把大气噪声与积雪表面效应解耦，否则宽泛天气分箱会掩盖真实鲁棒性；点数提升的物理模型仍属假设，作者列出后续验证工作。

papers.title: RATED: Reliability-Aware AI Agent Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: As AI agents increasingly rely on external tools, accurate retrieval is essential for reliable behavior. Existing methods optimize semantic relevance but largely ignore tool availability during execution. To address this gap, we propose RATED (Reliability-Aware Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics), a retrieval framework that combines robust semantic matching with dynamic reliability adaptation. RATED employs a frozen dual-encoder with contrastive fine-tuning for semantic matching, and a lightweight contextual bandit module that re-ranks candidates based on real-time execution feedback. This design enables rapid adaptation to runtime tool failures without expensive model retraining. We introduce EcoAgent, a benchmark of 5,172 real-world tools and over 210,000 query-tool pairs for offline retrieval and dynamic reliability evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that RATED achieves a 52.2% relative MRR improvement over the ToolLLM API retriever on real-world queries, and reduces fault selection rate from 86.2% to 2.9% under severe API outage scenarios with a 30% failure rate, while incurring negligible latency overhead of less than 1 ms over encode-only inference. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Elliotes/EcoAgent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RATED 把工具检索从纯语义匹配改成语义 + 运行时可靠性双通道：冻结双编码器做对比微调的语义匹配，轻量 contextual bandit 依据实时执行反馈重排候选，从而在 API 故障时快速切换而不重训模型。在自建 EcoAgent（5,172 个真实工具、逾 210,000 条 query-tool 对）上，相对 ToolLLM API retriever 的 MRR 提升 52.2%，30% 故障率的严重 API 中断场景下错误选择率从 86.2% 降到 2.9%，编码延迟开销不足 1 ms。
Motivation: AI agent 检索外部工具时只优化语义相关性，忽略执行期工具是否真的可用，一旦 API 中断就大量选中失效工具。
Method: RATED 框架：冻结双编码器加对比微调负责语义匹配，轻量 contextual bandit 模块读取实时执行反馈对候选重排，实现免重训的动态可靠性适配；并构建离线检索与动态可靠性评测基准 EcoAgent。
Result: 在真实查询上相对 ToolLLM API retriever 的 MRR 提升 52.2%；在 30% 失败率的严重 API 中断场景下错误选择率由 86.2% 降至 2.9%；相对仅编码推理的延迟开销小于 1 ms。基准规模为 5,172 个真实工具、逾 210,000 条 query-tool 对。
Conclusion: 工具检索必须同时建模语义相关性与执行期可靠性，用执行反馈在线重排即可在不重训模型的前提下把故障工具选择压到个位数百分比。

papers.title: X-AgentRed: Red-Teaming Personal Agents in Evolving Multi-Service Ecosystems
papers.abstract_en: Personal agents increasingly connect to services across the web and applications by using tools. As the effects of their actions accumulate and interact across services, unintended or harmful outcomes can arise when agents fulfill benign user requests. Proactively identifying these compositional failures requires systematically exploring diverse cross-service paths. Existing red-teaming methods often simply prompt LLMs to identify potentially harmful paths from task and environment descriptions or decompose harmful objectives specified by humans or LLMs into seemingly benign action combinations. However, generation is biased toward patterns learned during training, potentially favoring familiar tool combinations and leaving novel cross-service interactions underexplored. To address this, we propose X-AgentRed, a self-evolving red-teaming framework that discovers harmful tool call paths through a graph of tool dependencies and expands and refines them using execution feedback. By analyzing each tool's effects, potential harms, and preconditions for execution, the red-teaming agent constructs a directed graph that captures how one tool's effects can satisfy another's execution preconditions. Recipes sampled from this graph are instantiated as realistic scenarios in which agents can produce harmful outcomes. Execution feedback enables self-improvement by diversifying paths that produce harm through tool substitution and refining preconditions at blocked steps in unsuccessful paths to enable further execution. papers.title: Prediction Is Not a Sufficient Memory State
papers.abstract_en: A memory that reproduces every current prediction may still have forgotten how to learn from the next observation. We characterize this distinction for exact cumulative learning and attention. For smooth convex residual losses with unrestricted real features and labels, a continuous recurrent state of fixed dimension exists exactly when the loss is polynomial. With ordinary, unweighted observations, degree $D$ requires precisely $r=\binom{d+D}{D}-1$ coordinates; even among histories with one fixed current predictor, exactly $r-d$ coordinates can remain necessary for continuation. Nonpolynomial losses have unbounded requirements on such equal-prediction histories. Bounded scalar logistic examples retain this obstruction after fixing any finite derivative jet. For ridge regression, the hidden evidence is the design matrix: the exact state costs $dp+d(d+1)/2$, versus $dp$ for the predictor. On a well-conditioned zero-prediction family, optimal $B$-bit compression has average one-update error of order $d^{-1}2^{-2B/s_d}$, $s_d=d(d+1)/2$, even with arbitrary randomized codes. Kernel attention gives a second exact closure classification. The results identify what future updates reveal, rather than proposing a new regression algorithm or asserting trained-model gains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文给出精确累积学习的记忆状态刻画：对光滑凸残差损失，固定维连续循环状态存在当且仅当损失为多项式；次数 D 恰需 r=binom(d+D, D)-1 个坐标，非多项式损失在等预测历史上需求无界。岭回归中隐藏证据是设计矩阵，精确状态代价 dp+d(d+1)/2 而预测子只需 dp；B 比特压缩在良态零预测族上单次更新平均误差量级为 d^{-1}2^{-2B/s_d}。
Motivation: 能复现当前预测的记忆未必保留了从下一次观测继续学习的能力；现有刻画未区分这两者，也未给出精确累积学习所需状态维数的充要条件。
Method: 对光滑凸残差损失、无限制实特征与标签，刻画固定维连续循环状态存在的充要条件（损失为多项式），并按次数 D 计算所需坐标数；在固定当前预测子的历史上分析剩余必要坐标；对岭回归把隐藏证据识别为设计矩阵并计数精确状态；给出 B 比特压缩的单次更新误差下界，并对核注意力给出第二套精确闭包分类。
Result: 次数 D 恰需 r=binom(d+D, D)-1 个坐标；固定当前预测子的历史上恰有 r-d 个坐标仍可能必要；非多项式损失在等预测历史上需求无界，有界标量 logistic 例子在固定任意有限阶导数 jet 后仍保留该障碍。岭回归精确状态代价 dp+d(d+1)/2，对比预测子的 dp；良态零预测族上最优 B 比特压缩（含任意随机化编码）平均单次更新误差量级 d^{-1}2^{-2B/s_d}，s_d=d(d+1)/2。
Conclusion: 未来更新所揭示的信息才是记忆状态的本质，预测复现不足以保证可继续学习；结果属于精确累积学习与注意力的刻画，作者明确不提出新回归算法也不主张训练模型增益。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Tracking the Invisible: Self-Supervised Wheel Track Detection with Thermal-RGB Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Accurate detection of drivable area is essential for autonomous driving and advanced driver assistance systems. While state-of-the-art methods focus on general traversability estimation, they prove inadequate for snow-covered roads where following existing wheel tracks offers crucial advantages: improved traction, predictable vehicle dynamics, and verified path stability. To address this, we propose a low-cost, self-supervised approach detecting safety-critical wheel tracks using synchronized RGB-I (RGB + Long-Wave Infrared) imagery. Our method automatically generates training labels by projecting future wheel trajectories from recorded GNSS data. A neural network is designed to identify wheel tracks with the 4-channel RGB-I images from challenging, white-out road surfaces. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in visually monotonous and featureless adverse environment, offering a robust and cost-effective alternative for winter autonomy. The newly introduced ThermalTrack dataset is available at: https://digitalcommons.mtu.edu/thermaltrack/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出自监督的雪地车辙检测方法：用记录的 GNSS 轨迹投影自动生成训练标签，再用神经网络从同步的 RGB-I（RGB + 长波红外）四通道图像中识别白色路面下的车辙。在视觉单调、无特征的冬季路面上验证有效，作为低成本冬季自动驾驶方案，并公开 ThermalTrack 数据集。
Motivation: 雪覆盖路面上通用可通行性估计失效，而跟随已有车辙能带来更好牵引力、可预测的车辆动力学与已验证的路径稳定性，需要在白化路面上直接检测车辙。
Method: 自监督标签生成：把记录的 GNSS 未来轮迹投影回图像得到训练标签；网络输入同步的 4 通道 RGB-I（RGB + LWIR）图像，在白化、无纹理路面上回归或分割车辙位置。
Result: 在视觉单调、无特征的恶劣冬季环境中实验验证了方法的有效性，作为低成本替代方案；同时发布新数据集 ThermalTrack（digitalcommons.mtu.edu/thermaltrack）。
Conclusion: 低成本的热红外-RGB 融合加 GNSS 自监督标签，可以在冬季白化路面上稳健检测车辙，支撑雪地自动驾驶。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Partially Informed Stochastic Optimization via Zeroth-Order Residual Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Many optimization problems provide direct access to only part of the gradient, while the remaining component must be inferred from function evaluations. This structure arises in performative prediction, performative reinforcement learning, and bilevel optimization with a black-box lower level. We introduce Partially Informed Stochastic Optimization (PISO), which combines the available gradient component with a running estimate of the residual. By centring each zeroth-order observation on this estimate, PISO makes the variance due to random probing depend on the tracking error rather than the residual's magnitude. This yields a randomized sketch iteration with an explicit contraction mechanism and a principled interpretation of momentum. For smooth nonconvex objectives, we establish convergence guarantees that depend on the residual's variation and initial magnitude, without requiring a uniform bound on the unavailable gradient component. With independently sampled function evaluations and Gaussian or spherical probes, PISO attains leading function-evaluation complexities of \(O(d^{2}\varepsilon^{-6})\) under Lipschitz gradients and \(O(d^{2}\varepsilon^{-5})\) under an additional Lipschitz-Hessian assumption. These rates require only one probe direction, two function samples, and one known-component sample per update. The analysis also quantifies how batching trades observations for fewer deployments. Across five settings, PISO variants improve on the tested baselines with comparable oracle access in three, reach a comparable solution faster in bilevel routing, and perform best among methods without response-model derivatives in performative reinforcement learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Partially Informed Stochastic Optimization (PISO)：当梯度只有一部分可直接获得、其余需靠函数值估计时，把零阶探测中心对准残差的运行估计，使随机探测方差取决于跟踪误差而非残差本身。在 Lipschitz 梯度下函数值复杂度达 O(d²ε⁻⁶)，加 Lipschitz Hessian 后为 O(d²ε⁻⁵)；五个设置中三个优于同等 oracle 访问的基线。
Motivation: 许多问题只能拿到部分梯度，剩余分量须由函数值推断（performative prediction、performative RL、黑盒下层的双层优化），而现有零阶方法的探测方差随残差幅值放大，收敛界还需对不可得梯度分量做一致有界假设。
Method: PISO 将已知梯度分量与残差的运行估计结合，每次零阶观测以该估计为中心做随机探测（Gaussian 或 spherical probes，每步仅一个探测方向、两个函数样本、一个已知分量样本），得到带显式收缩机制的 randomized sketch 迭代，并给出 momentum 的原理性解释；分析刻画 batching 如何用观测换更少部署。
Result: 光滑非凸目标下函数值复杂度 O(d²ε⁻⁶)（Lipschitz 梯度）与 O(d²ε⁻⁵)（额外 Lipschitz Hessian），无需对不可得梯度分量的一致上界。五个设置中，PISO 变体在三个上优于同等 oracle 访问的受测基线，在双层 routing 中更快达到相当解，在 performative reinforcement learning 中于无 response-model 导数的方法里表现最佳。
Conclusion: 把零阶观测对准残差跟踪估计，可让探测噪声随跟踪误差而非残差幅值缩放，从而在只需部分梯度的问题上给出不依赖不可得分量一致界的收敛保证。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: Make It Flow: Animating Water in 3D Gaussian Splatting Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Explicit 3D scene representations such as 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have recently enabled high-quality, real-time novel view synthesis. However, these methods assume static scenes, limiting realism in the presence of dynamic phenomena ubiquitous in real-world environments. While coherent motion (e.g., humans or vehicles) can be captured and reconstructed, high-frequency effects such as flowing water remain intractable under casual capture conditions, where dense multi-view, high-speed acquisition is not feasible. We present a method to animate water in static 3DGS scenes, enabling visually plausible motion without requiring dynamic capture or physical simulation. Our approach estimates 2D optical flow from reference images or model renderings and lifts it into a consistent 3D Eulerian motion field. We propose a cinemagraph-inspired algorithm that applies this motion field to deform Gaussian primitives, producing temporally seamless looping animations. The resulting representation retains real-time rendering performance, significantly enhances perceptual realism, and preserves free-viewpoint navigation within the scene. We evaluate our method on a newly captured dataset of in-the-wild waterfall scenes and demonstrate clear improvements over prior work in dynamic Gaussian splatting and 3D cinemagraph generation in visual quality and computational efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在静态 3D Gaussian Splatting 场景中让水流活动起来：从参考图像或模型渲染估计 2D 光流，提升为一致的 3D Eulerian 运动场，再用 cinemagraph 式算法让该场驱动高斯基元形变，生成时间上无缝循环的水流动画。方法无需动态采集或物理仿真，保持实时渲染与自由视角导航，并在新采集的野外瀑布数据集上相对动态高斯泼溅与 3D cinemagraph 既有工作在视觉质量与计算效率上均有明显提升。
Motivation: 3DGS 等显式场景表示默认场景静态，而真实环境中普遍存在动态现象；连贯运动尚可重建，但流水这类高频效果在随手采集条件下难以用稠密多视角高速采集捕捉。
Method: 从参考图像或模型渲染估计 2D 光流，将其提升为一致的 3D Eulerian 运动场；提出 cinemagraph 启发的算法把该运动场施加到高斯基元上做形变，产生时间无缝的循环动画，无需动态采集与物理仿真。
Result: 在新采集的野外瀑布场景数据集 (newly captured dataset of in-the-wild waterfall scenes) 上评估，相对动态 Gaussian splatting 与 3D cinemagraph 生成的先前工作，在视觉质量与计算效率上均展示出清晰提升；生成表示保持实时渲染性能与自由视角导航。
Conclusion: 静态 3DGS 场景配合从 2D 光流提升的 3D 运动场即可产生视觉可信的循环水流动画，不必依赖动态采集或物理仿真。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: 从参考图像或模型渲染估计 2D 光流，将其提升为一致的 3D Eulerian 运动场；提出 cinemagraph 启发的算法把该运动场施加到高斯基元上做形变，产生时间无缝的循环动画，无需动态采集与物理仿真。
summary_sections.result: 在新采集的野外瀑布场景数据集 (newly captured dataset of in-the-wild waterfall scenes) 上评估，相对动态 Gaussian splatting 与 3D cinemagraph 生成的先前工作，在视觉质量与计算效率上均展示出清晰提升；生成表示保持实时渲染性能与自由视角导航。
summary_sections.conclusion: 静态 3DGS 场景配合从 2D 光流提升的 3D 运动场即可产生视觉可信的循环水流动画，不必依赖动态采集或物理仿真。

papers.title: LapMerge: Differentiable Exact-Budget Token Merging in Linear Time
papers.abstract_en: Modern vision and language models process ever longer token sequences, and reducing them is the main lever on downstream cost. Token compression, however, faces a fundamental trade-off: selecting tokens discards information, while existing merging methods preserve it only through pairwise token-to-token matching or $MN$ token-to-output interactions. We introduce LapMerge, a differentiable merging operator that resolves this trade-off for ordered sequences: a learned mass distribution partitions the sequence into exactly $N$ equal-mass segments under a Laplace-kernel density, and prefix/suffix scans aggregate each segment, so both the forward and the backward pass run in $\mathcal{O}(M+N)$ time. This combination - an exact output budget, end-to-end differentiability, and linear cost - is precisely what previous reducers trade off against one another. The budget can be changed without changing operator parameters, and the learned mass doubles as a token-level map of where the budget is allocated. Across vision and vision-language tasks, LapMerge matches or improves on strong token reducers while being up to two orders of magnitude faster at large sequence lengths; it is particularly effective when token order reflects spatial or temporal locality, and works both as a drop-in reduction module and as a trainable architectural component.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LapMerge 是一个可微 token 合并算子：用学习到的质量分布在 Laplace 核密度下把有序序列切成恰好 N 个等质量片段，再用前缀/后缀扫描聚合，前向与反向均为 O(M+N) 线性时间。它同时给出精确输出预算、端到端可微与线性代价，在视觉与视觉-语言任务上匹配或改进强 token reducer，长序列下最快可达两个数量级加速，且当 token 顺序反映空间或时间局部性时尤其有效。
Motivation: 长序列视觉与语言模型的主要下游开销来自 token 数，而现有 token 压缩方法要么丢信息，要么只靠 token 间两两匹配或 MN 的 token-to-output 交互，无法同时拿到精确预算、可微与线性代价。
Method: 学习一个质量分布，在 Laplace 核密度下把序列划分为恰好 N 个等质量片段，用前缀/后缀扫描 (prefix/suffix scans) 聚合每段；预算 N 可在不改算子参数的情况下更换，学到的质量同时充当预算分配的 token 级地图，既可作即插即用降维模块也可作可训练架构组件。
Result: 在视觉与视觉-语言任务上匹配或改进强 token reducer，长序列时最高快两个数量级；当 token 顺序反映空间或时间局部性时效果尤其好。
Conclusion: 对有序序列，精确输出预算、端到端可微与 O(M+N) 线性代价可以同时拿到，而不必像先前 reducer 那样三者互相取舍。

papers.title: Revisiting the Task of Building Damage Assessment by Satellite Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Natural disasters such as earthquakes, tropical storms, and floods cause extensive damage to buildings, and rapid, reliable damage maps are essential to guide emergency response. Automating this task, referred to as building damage assessment (BDA), from satellite imagery, has become an active research topic at the intersection of remote sensing, computer vision, and machine learning, particularly since supervised deep learning methods were shown to outperform earlier handcrafted approaches. Yet, despite a decade of intense activity and the release of several large-scale datasets, the field lacks a shared foundation. This chapter revisits the task of BDA from first principles, organized around three pillars: data, evaluation, and methods. We first clarify the candidate task for- mulations and argue for a sensor-agnostic, instance-based definition that tolerates missing pre-event imagery. We then review existing datasets along the axes of sensing modality, temporal configuration, and geographic coverage. On the evaluation side, we show that prevailing practices, largely based on a single aggregate score, are theoretically fragile, and we lay the foundations of a more informative, ranking-based, multi-score protocol. We further review methods ranging from task-specific deep networks to recent Earth observation foundation models, noticing that generalization to unseen events and regions remains an open difficulty. Finally, we discuss how these elements can inform the organization of a BDA challenge, including cross-validation, challenge, and private data-sharing setups designed to build trust between developers and users.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一章关于卫星影像建筑损毁评估 (BDA) 的任务重构综述，主张采用传感器无关、以实例为单位且容忍缺失震前影像的任务定义，并指出当前单一综合评分的评测方式在理论上脆弱，应换成基于排序的多指标协议。作者同时点明方法侧的公开难题：对未见事件与未见地区的泛化仍未解决。
Motivation: BDA 领域虽有十年积累和多个大规模数据集，但缺少共享基础：任务定义不统一，评测长期依赖单一综合分数，损毁模型在新事件、新地区上泛化差，阻碍应急响应方信任并使用这些系统。
Method: 按数据、评测、方法三根支柱从第一性原理重构任务：提出传感器无关、实例级、容忍缺失震前影像的任务定义；沿传感模态、时相配置、地理覆盖三个轴梳理现有数据集；论证主流单分数评测的理论脆弱性并建立基于排序的多指标协议；综述从任务专用深网络到 Earth observation foundation models 的方法，并讨论 BDA 挑战赛组织中的交叉验证与私有数据共享设置。
Result: 本章为综述性论述，给出的结论性主张是：以单一聚合分数为主的主流评测在理论上脆弱，应改用信息量更大的基于排序的多指标协议；并指出方法对未见事件与地区的泛化仍是公开难题。
Conclusion: BDA 需要先统一任务定义与评测协议，再谈方法排名；跨事件、跨地区的泛化是当前方法侧最需要突破的瓶颈，挑战赛设计应服务于开发者与使用方之间的信任建立。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Event-based Action Recognition by Pre-Training on Multi-Frame Representations
papers.abstract_en: Action recognition is a crucial task in domains like robotics, patient monitoring, or surveillance. Recently, event-based action recognition has attracted much attention due to the event camera's ability to capture fast motions and its improved privacy over conventional vision cameras. While frame-based event representations work well for short event sequences, their discriminative ability declines sharply with longer and more complex event sequences. In this work, we introduce a multi-frame representation that greatly improves recognition performance over its single-frame counterpart. We adopt a masked auto-encoding framework to pre-train a Vision Transformer using a sparsity-aware masking algorithm and token selection mechanism to improve downstream performance and control computational complexity. We also introduce multiple mask tokens for the decoder with a position-aware attention mechanism, leading to further improved performance. Our proposed method shows impressive performance for challenging long-duration and complex event sequences, yielding state-of-the-art performance on THU-EACT-50 CHL and DailyDVS-200.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 事件相机动作识别中，单帧事件表征在长序列上判别力急剧下降；作者提出多帧事件表征，配合稀疏感知掩码与 token 选择机制预训练 Vision Transformer，并在解码器引入多个带位置感知注意力的 mask token。在 THU-EACT-50 CHL 与 DailyDVS-200 上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，尤其改善长时、复杂事件序列的识别。
Motivation: 帧式事件表征在短序列上有效，但序列变长变复杂后判别力急剧下降，长时动作识别精度不足。
Method: 提出多帧事件表征替代单帧；采用 masked auto-encoding 框架预训练 Vision Transformer，配合稀疏感知掩码算法与 token 选择机制以提升下游性能并控制计算复杂度；解码器使用多个 mask token 与位置感知注意力 (position-aware attention)。
Result: 在 THU-EACT-50 CHL 与 DailyDVS-200 上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，对长时、复杂事件序列的识别提升尤为明显；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 多帧表征加掩码预训练能显著缓解长序列事件动作识别的判别力衰减，达到这两个基准上的最优水平。

papers.title: SLICE: Sequential Likelihood-Free Inference via Conformal E-Values
papers.abstract_en: Many scientific models can be simulated but have intractable likelihoods, making frequentist uncertainty quantification difficult. We construct exact anytime-valid confidence sequences for the parameters of such models. At each observation, fresh simulations from each candidate null conformalize a positive predictable score into a conditional e-value; their product is a test martingale, which we invert over the parameter. Validity holds for any such score, whatever its accuracy. We show that the oracle likelihood-ratio score maximizes expected log growth, which motivates approximating it with an amortized neural ratio estimator. On synthetic benchmarks, an audit of model routing in an LLM API, and microlensing data, the resulting confidence sequences stay valid under continuous monitoring, where fixed-sample methods do not, and neural scores remain competitive with exact likelihood ratios and application-specific scores.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SLICE 为似然不可解的可仿真模型构造精确的 anytime-valid 置信序列 (confidence sequence)：每来一个观测，就用候选参数下的新仿真把一个正的可预测评分 conformal 化为条件 e-value，其乘积构成检验鞅并对参数求逆。有效性对任意评分都成立、与其精度无关；oracle 似然比评分最大化期望对数增长，因此用摊销式神经比值估计器 (amortized neural ratio estimator) 近似它。
Motivation: 许多科学模型只能仿真、似然不可解，频率派不确定性量化因此困难；固定样本方法在连续监测下失效。
Method: 对每个观测在候选 null 下做新仿真，把正的可预测评分 conformalize 成条件 e-value，乘积形成 test martingale，再对参数求逆得到置信序列；理论上证明 oracle 似然比评分最大化期望对数增长，实践中用摊销神经比值估计器近似该评分。
Result: 在合成基准、LLM API 模型路由审计和微引力透镜 (microlensing) 数据上，所得置信序列在连续监测下保持有效，而固定样本方法失效；神经评分与精确似然比及领域专用评分相比保持竞争力。
Conclusion: e-value 与 conformal 组合可以在似然不可解模型上给出对评分精度不敏感、且能承受连续监测的精确置信序列，神经比值估计是逼近最优评分的可行途径。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Finite-Sample Guarantees for Fully Discrete Conditional Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: We establish finite-sample guarantees for conditional diffusion models learned from data and implemented with finitely many denoising steps. Our approach aligns the score-training objective with the sampling grid, allowing statistical estimation and numerical discretization errors to be analyzed together. Under a smooth conditional density model, we derive high-probability bounds on the generated distribution's error and quantify the required number of score evaluations. For every smoothness index $β>0$, a suitable grid yields averaged conditional Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence $\widetilde O_p(n^{-2β/(d_x+d_y+2β)})$ relative to the original target with or without early stopping. Both the full and early-stopped samplers attain average target total-variation (TV) error $\widetilde O_p(n^{-β/(d_x+d_y+2β)})$. Here $n$ is the sample size, $d_x,d_y$ are the data and conditioning dimensions, and errors are averaged over the conditioning variable. The total-variation bound matches the rate established in existing conditional distribution-estimation theory, up to logarithmic factors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为从数据学习、且只用有限步去噪的条件扩散模型建立有限样本误差界：把 score 训练目标与采样网格对齐，使统计估计误差和数值离散误差可一起分析。在光滑条件密度模型下，对任意光滑度指数 β>0，选取合适网格可得平均条件 KL 散度 Õ_p(n^{-2β/(d_x+d_y+2β)})（带或不带 early stopping），平均目标 TV 误差 Õ_p(n^{-β/(d_x+d_y+2β)})，与既有条件分布估计理论的速率在对数因子内匹配。
Motivation: 条件扩散模型的统计误差（score 估计）与数值误差（有限去噪步的离散化）此前缺少统一的有限样本分析框架，无法给出生成分布相对真实目标的高概率误差界与所需 score 评估次数。
Method: 将 score 训练目标与采样网格对齐，在光滑条件密度模型假设下联合分析统计估计误差与数值离散误差；对每个光滑度指数 β>0 设计合适网格，推导生成分布相对目标的高概率界，并量化所需 score 评估次数，覆盖带 early stopping 与不带 early stopping 两种采样器。
Result: 对任意 β>0，合适网格下平均条件 KL 散度为 Õ_p(n^{-2β/(d_x+d_y+2β)})（含 early stopping 与否两种情形）；full 与 early-stopped 采样器的平均目标 TV 误差均为 Õ_p(n^{-β/(d_x+d_y+2β)})，其中 n 为样本量，d_x、d_y 分别为数据维度与条件维度，误差对条件变量取平均。TV 界与既有条件分布估计理论的速率在对数因子内匹配。
Conclusion: 把 score 训练目标与采样网格对齐后，条件扩散模型的统计与数值误差可合并分析，并在光滑条件密度模型下达到条件分布估计理论的最优速率（对数因子内），同时给出所需 score 评估次数的量化。

papers.title: Inference-Time Steering Across Scaffolds and Epitopes for Sample-Efficient De Novo Nanobody Design
papers.abstract_en: Generative molecular design typically relies on over-generation and post-hoc filtering. Inference-time steering methods like Feynman-Kac (FK) steering improve efficiency by biasing trajectories toward high-reward candidates, yet they optimize within a single fixed configuration. In de novo nanobody design, upfront commitment to conditioning choices like scaffold identity or target epitope creates a bottleneck. Since yield varies across these conditions, steering unpromising setups wastes compute. We recast generative condition selection as an inference-time resource-allocation problem. We propose two dynamic budget allocators: a joint Global Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) formulation that steers and allocates compute across configurations concurrently, and a decoupled approach adapting Batched Successive Elimination (BaSE). Empirically, these dynamic allocators increase the yield of designable candidates per GPU-hour nearly 5$\times$ without sacrificing diversity across distinct therapeutic targets and generative configurations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把生成式分子设计中的条件选择（scaffold、epitope）重构为推理时的算力分配问题，提出两种动态预算分配器：联合 Global Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) 同时在各配置间做 steering 与算力分配，以及解耦改造的 Batched Successive Elimination (BaSE)。在多个治疗靶点与生成配置上，动态分配使每 GPU 小时可设计候选产出提升近 5×，且不牺牲多样性。
Motivation: de novo 纳米抗体设计需在生成前就锁定 scaffold 与 target epitope 等条件，而不同条件的 yield 差异大；固定配置下的推理时 steering（如 Feynman-Kac）会在无望配置上浪费算力，过度生成加事后筛选效率低。
Method: 将条件选择重构为推理时资源分配：一是联合 Global Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) 公式，在多个配置间并发地做轨迹 steering 与算力分配；二是解耦方案，改造 Batched Successive Elimination (BaSE) 来自适应分配预算。
Result: 在不同治疗靶点与生成配置上，动态分配器将每 GPU 小时的可设计候选产出 (yield per GPU-hour) 提升近 5×，同时不牺牲多样性。
Conclusion: 把 scaffold/epitope 等条件选择当作推理时算力分配问题处理，可在不损失多样性的前提下大幅提高样本效率，避免在低 yield 配置上浪费 steering 算力。

papers.title: Returning to Development States: When Full Sandbox Snapshots Help Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents often make useful progress before they fail, but retry-from-scratch discards the machine state created along the way. This makes failure recovery an interesting search problem: if intermediate environment states preserve meaningful progress, restoring and branching from them could outperform repeatedly restarting from the initial state. We implement Go-Explore-style search over full Daytona snapshots and find that higher and more efficient solve rates depend mainly on progress that sits outside the repository, such as databases, services, and other runtime state. Our results suggest that full-snapshot search is most effective when long-horizon coding work spans multiple services whose state cannot be reconstructed from a single diff.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 6 figures. Preprint. Not peer reviewed
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把编码 agent 的失败恢复建模为搜索问题：在 Daytona 全量沙箱快照上做 Go-Explore 式的恢复与分支，而不是每次从零重跑。结果表明求解率的提升与效率主要来自仓库之外的进度（数据库、服务等运行时状态），因此当长程编码任务横跨多个服务、其状态无法由单个 diff 重建时，全快照搜索最有效。
Motivation: 编码 agent 常在已有进展后失败，而从头重试会丢弃沿途建立的机器状态；若中间环境状态保留了有意义的进度，从其恢复和分支可能优于反复从初始状态重启。
Method: 在 Daytona 全量沙箱快照 (full snapshots) 上实现 Go-Explore 风格搜索，把恢复与分支作为失败恢复机制，对照从初始状态重试的流程。
Result: 更高且更高效的求解率 (solve rates) 主要取决于仓库之外的进度，即数据库、服务及其他运行时状态；全快照搜索在长程编码工作跨越多个服务、且状态无法从单个 diff 重建时最有效。
Conclusion: 失败恢复的价值取决于进度是否存在于仓库之外：只要运行时状态无法用单个 diff 重建，就应从全量沙箱快照恢复并分支，而不是从零重跑。

papers.title: Studying Comics at Scale with Artificial Intelligence: The PAGE Framework and Three Studies of American Comics and Japanese Manga
papers.abstract_en: Comics are one of the great visual records of the twentieth century: hundreds of thousands of pages in which a mass readership saw its leaders, its wars and its heroes. Most of this record has never been studied as a whole; comics scholarship proceeds one book at a time. We argue that artificial intelligence, including generative models, can change this to the benefit of the medium itself. We propose PAGE, a framework that makes artificial intelligence an instrument for comics research. It parses every scan into panels, text and a bibliographic record; annotates each page with a vision-language model that follows a written codebook, as a human coder would; grounds samples of these readings in human annotation; and explains change across an archive, with estimates controlled for publisher and genre. We demonstrate the framework on 3,929 American comic books (1938--1956) and 87 volumes of Japanese manga, in three studies, each resting on a different capability. The first pairs text search with visual reading to recover how a mass medium portrayed political power. The second measures the page's visual form across an industry and recovers the hand of individual artists. The third follows who speaks across two comics traditions, checked against human annotation. Beyond research, the same instruments can make archives searchable by what is drawn, open comics to blind and low-vision readers, and help preserve fragile collections and credit uncredited artists. We outline a research agenda in which artificial intelligence strengthens the study, preservation and reach of the medium.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PAGE 把 AI 变成漫画研究的通用仪器：逐页解析分镜、文本与书目记录，用遵循书面 codebook 的视觉-语言模型标注并以人工标注校准，再在控制出版社与题材的估计下解释档案层面的变化。在 3,929 本美国漫画 (1938–1956) 与 87 卷日本 manga 上完成三项研究，分别复原政治权力的呈现方式、量化整行业的页面视觉形式并识别个体画师笔迹、追踪两种漫画传统中的发言者分布。
Motivation: 漫画是二十世纪重要的视觉档案，但现有研究一次只能做一本书，数十万页的整体现象无法被系统考察。
Method: PAGE 将每份扫描件解析为 panels、文本与书目记录，用遵循书面 codebook 的视觉-语言模型逐页标注（如同人工编码员），抽样结果与人工标注对齐做 grounding，再用控制 publisher 与 genre 的估计解释跨档案变化；三项研究分别依赖文本检索+视觉阅读、页面视觉形式测量、发言者追踪三种能力。
Result: 在 3,929 本美国漫画 (1938–1956) 与 87 卷日本 manga 上演示三项研究：复原大众媒介如何呈现政治权力；在全行业尺度测量页面视觉形式并复原个体艺术家的笔迹；跨两种漫画传统追踪谁在发言，且该研究与人工标注做了核对。
Conclusion: AI 可以把漫画研究从单本书推进到整批档案，并同时服务于按画面内容检索档案、为盲人与低视力读者开放漫画、保护脆弱馆藏与为未署名画师追认贡献。
