papers.title: Specialists Learn Faster: Knowledge Organization in Pre-training Shapes Knowledge Update Efficiency
papers.abstract_en: An ideal (language) model must continually update its knowledge. Existing work largely focuses on making these updates efficient after training. We investigate how the organization of time-varying knowledge during pre-training shapes the efficiency of subsequent updates. Models trained on chronologically ordered knowledge specialize in the most recently encountered knowledge; we call them specialists. In contrast, models trained on the same knowledge in randomly shuffled order perform well across all represented time periods; we call them generalists. Surprisingly, specialists require far fewer update steps than generalists to acquire new knowledge. To explain this advantage, we derive a law from first principles that relates update cost to the model's optimization dynamics and that closely predicts empirical results. Guided by these findings, we design a strategy for organizing pre-training data that preserves stable historical knowledge while enabling efficient updates to current knowledge. We also show that the benefits of temporal knowledge organization extend to real-world pre-trained models and existing knowledge update tools, and generalize to other knowledge orderings. Project page: https://horizon-lab.org/specialist/
papers.comment: 25 pages, 12 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://horizon-lab.org/specialist/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 按时间顺序组织预训练知识会把模型训成对最新知识专精的 specialist，而随机打乱顺序得到各时段均衡的 generalist；surprisingly，specialist 更新新知识所需步数远少于 generalist。作者从第一性原理导出更新代价与优化动力学的关系式，能紧密预测实证结果，并据此设计保留稳定历史知识、同时高效更新当前知识的预训练数据组织策略。
Motivation: 现有知识更新工作集中在训练之后如何高效更新，而预训练阶段时变知识的组织方式如何影响后续更新效率这一前置问题被忽略。
Method: 对比时间有序与随机打乱两种预训练顺序，定义 specialist 与 generalist；从第一性原理导出关联更新代价与模型优化动力学的定律，并据此设计预训练数据组织策略，再检验其在真实预训练模型与现有知识更新工具上的可用性。
Result: specialist 达到新知识所需更新步数 far fewer 于 generalist；导出的定律紧密预测实证结果；该时间知识组织的收益可扩展到真实预训练模型与现有知识更新工具，并推广到其他知识排序方式。
Conclusion: 预训练阶段的知识时间组织本身决定后续更新效率，按时间顺序训练出的 specialist 更新更快，且这一规律不依赖特定更新工具或单一知识排序。

papers.title: On the Design Space of Continuous Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Continuous diffusion language models (CDLMs) promise to bring the benefits of continuous flow modelling to language, including accelerated sampling and controllable generation. The field has grown rapidly, and the capabilities of CDLMs have begun to rival those of discrete diffusion. Yet, unlike for continuous modalities such as images or videos, our grasp of the levers that matter when training CDLMs remains limited. In this work, we focus on two of these levers, namely self-conditioning and embedding geometry, and shed light on some of the mechanisms behind them, which in turn suggest cheaper and more effective designs. We begin by showing that self-conditioning corrects a train/inference mismatch by exposing the model to inference-like states that are otherwise rare during training. These gains can be recovered without an extra forward pass by a two-level interpolant, coined $\mathrm{DoubleCat}$, which improves TinyGSM accuracy more than threefold. Self-conditioning also aids in recognising tokens dominated by large-norm Gaussians$\unicode{x2013}$an issue known as token identifiability. To address it directly, we introduce discrete reveals to $\mathrm{DoubleCat}$, yielding $\mathrm{SemiCat}$, which achieves discrete diffusion-level performance on TinyGSM, reaching $49.94\%$ with standard training hyperparameters and a tuned sampler. At the $1.7$B scale, $\mathrm{SemiCat}$ outperforms discrete diffusion on four of six likelihood-based evaluations, and surpasses one-hot flows on unconditional generation. On embedded spaces, we find that cross-entropy drives embeddings towards a geometry whose decoding error rate closely matches the one-hot one. We briefly explore a range of further options, such as hybrid corruption processes and noise schedules, including asynchronous ones. We believe this exploration can help the community better understand and advance the design space of CDLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇工作研究连续扩散语言模型 (CDLM) 的训练设计杠杆，指出 self-conditioning 通过暴露推理式状态纠正训练/推理失配，并提出两级插值 DoubleCat 与加入离散揭示的 SemiCat。SemiCat 在 TinyGSM 上以标准超参加调优采样器达到 49.94%，1.7B 规模在六项基于似然的评测中四项胜过离散扩散。
Motivation: CDLM 能力已接近离散扩散，但与图像视频等连续模态不同，训练时哪些杠杆真正起作用仍不清楚，缺少可复用的设计原则。
Method: 聚焦 self-conditioning 与 embedding geometry 两个杠杆：先论证 self-conditioning 缓解训练/推理失配，再提出无需额外前向的两级插值 DoubleCat，并加入离散揭示 (discrete reveals) 得到 SemiCat；另考察交叉熵下的嵌入几何、混合破坏过程与含异步的噪声调度。
Result: DoubleCat 使 TinyGSM 精度提升三倍以上；SemiCat 在 TinyGSM 达到 49.94%（标准训练超参 + 调优采样器），达到离散扩散水平；1.7B 规模上 SemiCat 在六项基于似然的评测中四项优于离散扩散，并在无条件生成上超过 one-hot flows；交叉熵驱动嵌入几何使解码错误率与 one-hot 接近。

papers.title: SpatialASM: Internalizing Active Mentalization for Spatial Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: When solving complex spatial reasoning tasks, ordinary humans naturally revisit the scenes from task-relevant viewpoints and mentally reconstruct the spatial layouts from those viewpoints. But can Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) proactively think in the same way? We term this ability Active Spatial Mentalization (ASM), an intrinsic component of visual intelligence that remains substantially underdeveloped in current LVLMs. To bridge this gap, we introduce SpatialASM, a scalable framework to internalize ASM into LVLMs through training-time spatial simulation. SpatialASM employs an allocentric novel-view generator to ground hypothetical viewpoints in visual evidence and produces two complementary forms of supervision: i) explicit ASM trajectories that teach LVLMs when and how to adaptively invoke view planning and imagination during spatial reasoning, and ii) automatically-constructed perspective-taking tasks that further strengthens viewpoint-conditioned scene imagination. On seven benchmarks spanning relatively perception-oriented spatial understanding to more challenging tasks requiring multi-image, cross-view and viewpoint-transformation reasoning, SpatialASM yields performance gain on LVLMs of four LVLM backbones in spatial reasoning while retaining their original general vision capabilities. The experimental results demonstrate that our approach improves average accuracy across the seven spatial benchmarks. And the synthesis of ASM trajectories provides a scalable pathway to alleviate the scarcity of spatial Chain-of-Thought (CoT) supervision for eliciting active viewpoint exploration and mental scene simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpatialASM 通过训练期空间模拟把「主动空间心智化 (Active Spatial Mentalization)」注入 LVLM：用 allocentric 新视角生成器落地假设视角，产出显式 ASM 轨迹与自动构造的视角采择 (perspective-taking) 任务两类监督。在七个空间推理基准上，四个 LVLM backbone 的平均准确率均提升，且原有通用视觉能力保持不变。
Motivation: 人类解空间题会主动换视角重建布局，而当前 LVLM 缺乏这种主动视角规划与心智场景模拟能力，且空间 Chain-of-Thought 监督数据稀缺。
Method: 训练期空间模拟框架：allocentric 新视角生成器把假设视角锚定到视觉证据，产生两类监督——显式 ASM 轨迹（教模型何时、如何在推理中调用视角规划与想象）和自动构造的视角采择任务（强化视角条件下的场景想象），在四个 LVLM backbone 上训练。
Result: 在七个空间推理基准（覆盖感知型空间理解到多图像、跨视角、视角变换推理）上，四个 LVLM backbone 的空间推理性能均获得增益，平均准确率提升，同时保留原有通用视觉能力。
Conclusion: 合成 ASM 轨迹是缓解空间 CoT 监督稀缺、激发主动视角探索与心智场景模拟的可扩展路径。

papers.title: MC-EvoBench: Auditing Experience-Driven Self-Improvement in Minecraft Agents
papers.abstract_en: A central challenge in embodied recursive self-improvement is enabling agents to convert interaction history into capabilities that persist beyond one world and transfer to later tasks. A saved memory or successful final action does not by itself establish that a reusable capability was acquired; evaluation must separate capability change from carried-over resources, unequal source exposure, and early execution failures. We construct MC-EvoBench as a controlled Minecraft benchmark with a fixed catalog of 19 registered evolution chains, including 12 primary evaluation chains and seven calibration or probe chains, together with three graph-aligned paired probe families for transfer. The benchmark represents each task as a task-state graph, defines stage-level environment verifiers, assigns matched source and target roles, resets the target world, and permits only a declared agent artifact to cross the source-target boundary. For each probe, no-prior, related, unrelated, and shuffled source conditions are evaluated under matched environment-step budgets and five seeds; we report TSR, WGP, and VMP and retain provenance records. The benchmark reveals a consistent direct-capability gap between controller and planner-backed variants, while related experience yields no stable transfer: it does not improve either tool probe, its small wood-species gain hinges on one seed, and all intervals include zero. Stage audits further show that early wood-collection and crafting bottlenecks often leave later capabilities unobserved. MC-EvoBench thus offers a controlled testbed for durable, transferable embodied capabilities. Code and data are available at https://github.com/xzw-ustc/mc-bench-open-source
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MC-EvoBench 是一个受控的 Minecraft 具身自我改进基准：19 条注册演化链（12 条主评测 + 7 条校准/探针）、三组图对齐配对探针，用任务状态图、阶段级环境验证器、目标世界重置和只允许声明过的 agent artifact 跨源-目标边界，把能力增长与携带资源、不等源暴露、早期执行失败分离开。在匹配环境步预算与五个种子下，planner 支持的变体在直接能力上稳定优于 controller，但相关经验不产生稳定迁移：工具探针无提升，木材物种的小幅收益依赖单一种子，所有区间都含零。
Motivation: 具身递归自我改进中，保存的记忆或一次成功的最终动作并不等于获得了可复用能力；现有评测无法把真实能力变化与携带资源、源任务暴露不均、早期执行失败区分开。
Method: 构建受控 Minecraft 基准 MC-EvoBench：固定 19 条注册演化链（12 条主评测链、7 条校准/探针链）与三组图对齐配对探针族；每个任务表示为 task-state graph，配阶段级 environment verifier、匹配的源/目标角色、目标世界重置，且只允许一个声明的 agent artifact 跨越源-目标边界。对每个探针在 no-prior、related、unrelated、shuffled 四种源条件下，以匹配的环境步预算和五个种子评测，报告 TSR、WGP、VMP 并保留 provenance 记录。
Result: 控制器与 planner 支持变体之间存在一致的直接能力差距（planner 更高）。相关经验不带来稳定迁移：两个工具探针均无改善，木材物种上的小幅收益取决于单一种子，所有置信区间都包含零。阶段审计显示早期采木与合成瓶颈常使后续能力根本未被观测到。
Conclusion: 要证明具身能力持久且可迁移，必须用受控源条件、世界重置与阶段审计把能力变化同资源携带和早期瓶颈分离；相关经验本身不足以产生稳定迁移。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Same Query, Different Answer: Run-to-Run Variance in Semantic Query Processing
papers.abstract_en: Semantic query engines ask a large language model (LLM) to judge individual rows, and benchmarks compare these engines on the quality of a few executions at temperature 0. We measure how much another execution changes. We re-execute the text and tabular workloads of SemBench, LRO-Bench, and UDA-Bench through their own harnesses, log every one of 1.2 million model calls, and reanalyze SemBench's published executions. At temperature 0, between 0.07% and 10.2% of rows change their operator output over five executions, depending on the model, and up to 24.0% on one task. Plans amplify these changes exponentially in the number of rows an answer exposes, as a possible-worlds model predicts: on UDA-Bench, a few percent of extracted values change, but about two thirds of the answers do. In SemBench's published results, 21% of text results change quality between executions, including on engines whose plans are deterministic. Several per-query system comparisons, and 16 of 28 tests of LRO-Bench's implementation recommendations, are not settled by the executions the benchmarks run. Changing rows are rows on which models disagree with each other; identical requests within one execution disagree as often as across executions; and one execution's decision margin or reasoning length predicts which rows change. Voting reduces the variance but does not remove it, and a calibrated cascade keeps its guarantee while the rows it returns change. We derive reporting rules for benchmarks and design rules for engines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 语义查询引擎 (semantic query engine) 用 LLM 逐行判定，基准测试只比较 temperature 0 下少数几次执行，但重复执行会改变结果：0.07%–10.2% 的行在五次执行中改变算子输出（单个任务最高 24.0%），计划按可能世界模型在答案暴露行数上指数放大这些变化（UDA-Bench 上仅几个百分点的抽取值变化导致约三分之二的答案改变）。结论是基准的单次执行比较不足以判定系统优劣，作者据此给出基准报告规则与引擎设计规则。
Motivation: 语义查询引擎的基准评测默认 temperature 0 的少数几次执行是确定的，但行级 LLM 判定本身存在 run-to-run 方差，且计划会放大它，导致系统间比较和实现建议的结论不可靠。
Method: 通过 SemBench、LRO-Bench、UDA-Bench 各自的 harness 重新执行其文本与表格工作负载，记录 120 万次模型调用，并重新分析 SemBench 已发表的执行结果；用可能世界模型解释计划对行级变化的指数放大，并考察投票 (voting) 与校准级联 (calibrated cascade) 对方差的作用。
Result: temperature 0 下五次执行间 0.07%–10.2% 的行改变算子输出（依模型而异），单个任务最高 24.0%；UDA-Bench 上几个百分点的抽取值变化对应约三分之二的答案改变；SemBench 已发表结果中 21% 的文本结果在执行间改变质量，包括计划本身确定的引擎；LRO-Bench 实现建议的 28 项检验中有 16 项无法被基准现有执行判定；变化行正是模型间分歧的行，单次执行内相同请求的分歧率与跨执行相当，单次执行的决策边距或推理长度可预测哪些行会变；投票降低但不消除方差，校准级联保持其保证但返回的行会变。
Conclusion: 语义查询处理的单次 temperature 0 执行不足以支撑基准层面的系统比较与实现建议，基准需要报告规则、引擎需要针对 run-to-run 方差的设计规则。

papers.title: Shared Canonical Component Removal Beyond Expert Views
papers.abstract_en: In clinical practice, experts often begin by converting raw inputs into a set of expert features before making a decision. While black-box models trained on raw input can outperform models trained on expert views, it remains unclear what predictive signal the raw model exploits beyond what the expert view captures. We introduce an audit framework to quantify this gap using Shared Canonical Component Removal (SCCR). Unlike standard residualization or concept erasure, SCCR selectively removes only those directions strongly shared between learned raw and expert embeddings. Evaluations on synthetic data, coronary artery disease (CAD) detection, antidepressant treatment dropout prediction, and skin lesion classification using SkinCon annotations show that SCCR identifies the ways in which expert views are insufficient and recovers residual predictive signal while minimizing redundancy with the expert view.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SCCR（Shared Canonical Component Removal）审计框架，只删除原始输入嵌入与专家视图嵌入之间强共享的成分，从而量化黑箱模型在专家特征之外还利用了哪些预测信号。在合成数据、冠心病 (CAD) 检测、抗抑郁治疗脱落预测和基于 SkinCon 标注的皮肤病变分类上，SCCR 识别出专家视图的不足之处，并在尽量减少与专家视图冗余的前提下恢复残余预测信号。
Motivation: 黑箱模型直接吃原始输入时往往优于只用专家特征的模型，但原始模型到底利用了专家视图之外的什么信号并不清楚，缺少量化这一差距的审计手段。
Method: SCCR 作为审计框架，与标准残差化 (residualization) 和概念擦除 (concept erasure) 不同，只选择性移除在学到的原始嵌入与专家嵌入之间强共享的方向，再检查剩余信号的预测力。
Result: 在合成数据、冠心病 (CAD) 检测、抗抑郁治疗脱落预测、以及使用 SkinCon 标注的皮肤病变分类四类设置上，SCCR 识别出专家视图不足的具体方式，并恢复了残余预测信号，同时最小化与专家视图的冗余。
Conclusion: 专家视图与原始输入之间的共享方向可以被选择性剥离，剩下的成分即原始模型超越专家特征的那部分预测信号，可作为临床模型的审计依据。

summary_sections.motivation: 黑箱模型直接吃原始输入时往往优于只用专家特征的模型，但原始模型到底利用了专家视图之外的什么信号并不清楚，缺少量化这一差距的审计手段。
summary_sections.method: SCCR 作为审计框架，与标准残差化 (residualization) 和概念擦除 (concept erasure) 不同，只选择性移除在学到的原始嵌入与专家嵌入之间强共享的方向，再检查剩余信号的预测力。

summary_sections.conclusion: 专家视图与原始输入之间的共享方向可以被选择性剥离，剩下的成分即原始模型超越专家特征的那部分预测信号，可作为临床模型的审计依据。

papers.title: TabMF: Learning Dataset Representations with Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Representations of supervised datasets support higher-level machine-learning tasks such as dataset retrieval and distribution-shift monitoring. However, existing approaches typically rely either on hand-crafted meta-features or on dataset encoders trained specifically for representation learning. We introduce TabMF, a framework that repurposes pretrained tabular foundation models (TFMs) as encoders of supervised datasets. TabMF equips a predictive TFM with an architecture-aware dataset-level readout and adapts the model end-to-end using contrastive post-training on stochastic views of synthetic supervised datasets. We instantiate TabMF on TabICLv2 and TabPFN-2.5 and evaluate the resulting representations across six tasks on unseen real datasets. Simple frozen TFM readouts yield competitive representations, indicating that predictive pretraining already induces substantial dataset-level structure. The two TabMF encoders obtain the strongest aggregate performance among the evaluated learned and classical dataset representations, with particularly strong results in dataset retrieval, compact benchmark construction, and distribution-shift severity assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TabMF 把预训练表格基础模型 (tabular foundation model, TFM) 改造成监督数据集的编码器：给预测型 TFM 加一个架构感知的数据集级 readout，再用对合成数据集随机视图的对比后训练端到端适配。在 TabICLv2 与 TabPFN-2.5 上实例化后，在六个任务的未见真实数据集上取得已评估学习式与经典数据集表示中最强的聚合表现，数据集检索、紧凑基准构建与分布偏移严重度评估尤为突出。
Motivation: 数据集表示支撑检索与分布偏移监控等上层任务，但现有方法要么依赖人工设计的 meta-features，要么需要专门为表示学习训练数据集编码器。
Method: 给预测型 TFM 装上架构感知的数据集级 readout，并在合成监督数据集的随机视图上做对比后训练 (contrastive post-training) 端到端适配；在 TabICLv2 与 TabPFN-2.5 两个 TFM 上实例化为 TabMF 编码器，同时保留简单冻结 TFM readout 作为对照。
Result: 在六个任务、未见真实数据集上评测：冻结 TFM readout 即已给出有竞争力的表示，说明预测式预训练本身已诱导出显著的数据集级结构；两个 TabMF 编码器在所评测的学习式与经典数据集表示中聚合表现最强，尤其在数据集检索、紧凑基准构建、分布偏移严重度评估三项上结果突出。
Conclusion: 预测式表格预训练已经蕴含可复用的数据集级结构，因此无需专门训练数据集编码器，改造现成 TFM 即可得到最强的通用数据集表示。

papers.title: Dream to Remember: Continual Steering of Generalist Robot Policies with World Models
papers.abstract_en: Generalist robot policies are trained with imitation learning and are bounded by the quality and coverage of their demonstrations. Reinforcement learning can improve and extend them, either by fine-tuning the policy weights or by training a small module to steer the input noise of a frozen generative policy. When tasks arrive sequentially, both approaches suffer from catastrophic forgetting. Fine-tuning on a task degrades prior tasks, and steering only shifts forgetting to the shared steering module. We propose Dream to Remember (D2R), which continually steers a frozen generalist policy toward new tasks, while retaining its earlier skills. As the steering module learns a new task, a frozen pretrained world model rehearses prior tasks through imagined rollouts, anchoring the module to its earlier behavior without a replay buffer or new data. When the world model is faithful enough, D2R learns the new task entirely in imagination. Otherwise, it learns the task in the environment while using the world model only to rehearse prior tasks. On CALVIN, D2R improves eight tasks in sequence entirely in imagination, raising average success from 63.7% to 74.8%, while LoRA fine-tuning on the same sequence drops it to 11.7%. With a frozen off-the-shelf generalist policy and world model, $π_0$ and A2World, D2R learns unseen LIBERO-90 tasks in the environment while keeping $π_0$'s performance on the LIBERO suites it was fine-tuned on, even though the world model is not accurate enough for policy optimization. Finally, on a real Franka robot, D2R improves three tasks in sequence entirely in imagination while retaining the earlier improvements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: D2R 用冻结的预训练 world model 在想象 rollout 中持续复习旧任务，从而持续引导 (steer) 冻结的通用机器人策略学习新任务而不灾难性遗忘。在 CALVIN 上纯想象学习八任务序列，平均成功率从 63.7% 升到 74.8%，而同序列 LoRA 微调掉到 11.7%。
Motivation: 通用机器人策略受演示质量与覆盖限制，顺序任务下微调会损害旧任务，而 steering 只把遗忘转移到共享的 steering 模块，两者都受灾难性遗忘制约。
Method: Dream to Remember (D2R) 冻结通用策略，只训练一个小的 steering 模块；训练新任务时由冻结的预训练 world model 通过 imagined rollouts 复习先前任务，无需 replay buffer 或新数据。world model 足够准时新任务完全在想象中学习，否则在环境中学习新任务、仅用 world model 复习旧任务；使用的冻结现成组件为 π0 策略与 A2World world model。
Result: CALVIN 上八任务序列纯想象学习使平均成功率 63.7% → 74.8%，同序列 LoRA 微调降至 11.7%；在 LIBERO-90 未见任务上以冻结的 π0 与 A2World 在环境中学习，同时保持 π0 在其微调过的 LIBERO suites 上的表现（尽管 world model 精度不足以做策略优化）；真实 Franka 机器人上纯想象顺序改进三个任务并保留先前改进。
Conclusion: 把遗忘复习交给冻结 world model 的想象 rollout，可以在不微调策略权重、不用 replay buffer 的情况下持续学习新任务并保住旧技能；world model 的保真度决定新任务能否完全在想象中学会。

papers.title: Spanning Diffusion and Flow-based Posterior Sampling via Exact Gaussian Conditioning
papers.abstract_en: Flow-matching and diffusion models are increasingly used as priors for linear inverse problems, however, most methods are bespoke to one class of trajectory prior. Plug-and-play methods have been proposed, however these implicitly decorrelate the guided trajectory, resulting in broad priors that can struggle when data is sparse. This work proposes $β$-Flow: a general plug-and-play method indexed by a correlation parameter $β$ that generalises over flow, diffusion, and decorrelated priors, and a confidence parameter $κ$ that controls how strongly the path distribution is enforced. Each step requires only one forward evaluation of a denoising network, followed by a Gaussian conditioning step. This step is an exact Kalman update that is not dependent on network gradients. We show that many existing guided samplers can be interpreted as instances or approximations of our method, each implicitly using a different trajectory prior and operator in place of the Kalman gain. From this viewpoint, we provide a qualitative comparison of methods in terms of their implicit biases and assumptions. We demonstrate consistently state-of-the-art level performance across 7 inverse problems over 4 datasets in terms of PSNR and SSIM. Moreover, we demonstrate the utility of this prior control, by showing that confident high correlations (strict priors) work best when observations are less informative, while low correlation is preferred when observations are more informative, reflecting the complementary roles of the prior and likelihood in Bayesian inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 β-Flow：用相关参数 β 和置信参数 κ 把 flow、diffusion 与去相关先验统一成一个 plug-and-play 后验采样框架，每步只需一次去噪网络前向加一次精确高斯条件化（Kalman 更新），不依赖网络梯度。在 4 个数据集、7 个线性逆问题上 PSNR/SSIM 达到一致的 SOTA 水平；观测信息量少时用高相关（严格先验）最好，观测信息量多时低相关更好。
Motivation: flow-matching 与 diffusion 作线性逆问题先验的引导方法大多绑定单一轨迹先验；plug-and-play 方法又隐式地把引导轨迹去相关，先验变宽，在数据稀疏时表现差。
Method: β-Flow 以相关参数 β 索引轨迹先验（覆盖 flow、diffusion 与去相关先验），以置信参数 κ 控制路径分布的强制强度；每步做一次去噪网络前向，再做一步精确高斯条件化，即不依赖网络梯度的 Kalman 更新。作者把多种已有引导采样器解释为该方法的实例或近似，差异在于隐式轨迹先验与替代 Kalman gain 的算子。
Result: 在 4 个数据集的 7 个线性逆问题上，PSNR 与 SSIM 一致达到 state-of-the-art 水平；先验控制实验显示观测信息较少时高相关（严格先验）表现最好，观测信息较多时低相关更优。
Conclusion: 引导采样可统一为带可调相关与置信度的精确高斯条件化框架，先验强度应随观测信息量反向调节，以体现贝叶斯推断中先验与似然的互补作用。

papers.title: QTestBench: A Test Framework for Evaluating LLM-Generated Quantum Code
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong results in classical code generation and are increasingly used to write the unit tests that safeguard that code. Whether they can do the same for quantum software is less clear, because quantum programs are probabilistic, depend on numerical tolerances, and are judged by domain-specific checkers, so a well-formed test can still disagree with the benchmark's verdict. Existing quantum benchmarks measure whether a model produces a correct solution, but not whether its tests can distinguish correct implementations from faulty ones. We introduce QTestBench, a framework that evaluates LLM-generated quantum test suites against independent benchmark checkers, never treating the tests themselves as ground truth. For each task, QTestBench prompts models to produce syntactic, semantic, and behavioral tests, injects candidate solutions at runtime, and compares each test verdict with the checker's label under three validation cohorts, each answering a distinct diagnostic question. We benchmark five LLMs on eight PennyLane QHack challenges and ten Qiskit HumanEval tasks. Generated suites almost always execute, but discrimination lags behind: the best generator reaches a test quality of 0.71 on QHack and 0.34 on Qiskit HumanEval, so executability alone overstates test quality. Oracle-verified synthetic mutants stabilize bug-detection estimates when natural faulty solutions are scarce, as on three of ten Qiskit tasks that yield none. QTestBench offers a reproducible, cross-framework benchmark for the trustworthiness of LLM-generated quantum tests.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Quantum Artificial Intelligence (QAI), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 QTestBench：不把 LLM 生成的量子测试当真值，而是对照独立 benchmark checker 判定测试能否区分正确与错误实现。在 8 道 PennyLane QHack 与 10 道 Qiskit HumanEval 任务上测 5 个 LLM，最佳生成器测试质量仅 QHack 0.71、Qiskit 0.34，说明可执行性远高于判别力。
Motivation: LLM 已能写经典代码的单元测试，但量子程序具概率性、依赖数值容差、由领域专用 checker 判定，格式正确的测试仍可能与 benchmark 结论冲突；现有量子 benchmark 只衡量解法正确性，不衡量测试能否区分正确与错误实现。
Method: QTestBench 提示模型生成 syntactic、semantic、behavioral 三类测试，运行时注入候选解，把每个测试判定与 checker 标签比对，并在三个 validation cohort 下分别回答不同诊断问题；对自然错误解稀缺的任务用 oracle 验证的合成变异体 (synthetic mutants) 稳定 bug-detection 估计。
Result: 在 5 个 LLM、8 道 PennyLane QHack 与 10 道 Qiskit HumanEval 上：生成测试几乎总能执行，但最佳生成器测试质量 QHack 0.71、Qiskit HumanEval 0.34；10 道 Qiskit 任务中有 3 道不产生任何自然错误解，需合成变异体补充。
Conclusion: 可执行性会高估 LLM 量子测试的真实质量，判别力才是瓶颈；QTestBench 提供跨框架、可复现的评测路径来衡量生成测试的可信度。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Diversity-Aware Ensemble of Quantum-Classical Models via Combinatorial Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Variational quantum circuits (VQCs) are highly sensitive to circuit architecture, yet most quantum machine learning pipelines select a single best design and discard the remaining candidates. This paper addresses whether the structural diversity across quantum circuit search spaces can be used to produce stronger predictions through model fusion. We apply Combinatorial Fusion Analysis (CFA), a model fusion framework that selects and combines multiple scoring systems using rank-score function (RSF) and cognitive diversity (CD), to a pool of 29 architecturally diverse classical models and quantum circuits. Using a diversity-aware model selection method, we identify subsets of maximally diverse models and combine them with both score and rank combination. Experiments on four binary classification benchmarks covering different domains demonstrate that CFA-based hybrid classical-quantum fusion consistently outperform the best individual model on every dataset considered with improvements up to 6.03% in accuracy. When comparing with relevant literatures, the CFA framework further achieves superior performance across all four datasets.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 4 tables, 6 figures; Accepted to the 2026 IEEE Conference on Quantum Computing and Engineering (IEEE Quantum Week 2026/QCE26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把组合融合分析 (Combinatorial Fusion Analysis, CFA) 用到 29 个结构多样的经典模型与变分量子线路 (VQC) 池上，用 rank-score function (RSF) 与 cognitive diversity (CD) 挑出最大多样性的子集再做分数与秩融合。在四个跨领域二分类基准上，CFA 混合经典-量子融合在每个数据集上都超过最优单模型，准确率提升最高 6.03%。
Motivation: VQC 对线路结构极敏感，而主流量子机器学习流程只保留单个最优设计、丢弃其余候选，搜索空间里的结构多样性没有被利用起来。
Method: 对 29 个架构多样的经典模型与量子线路组成的池应用 CFA：先用多样性感知的模型选择方法识别最大多样性子集，再同时做 score combination 与 rank combination，依据 RSF 与 CD 度量融合多个打分系统。

papers.title: FORTE: A Production Framework for Feature Evaluation and Deprecation in Industrial Recommender Systems
papers.abstract_en: Production recommender systems have feature-lifecycle asymmetry: adding new features must produce gains on some metric, while feature removal must not regress any metric. In practice, feature deprecation is hard to prioritize as a feature can fail to be removed if it interacts with other features, its importance changes daily, it cannot be evaluated before production models change or data drift occurs, it is in contention for A/B test space with other launches, it causes regressions in an online A/B test, or it is consumed by multiple models that need to coordinate its deprecation. We present FORTE, a model-agnostic production framework for discovering, validating, and removing features. Its efficient perturbation implementation allows daily feature evaluation. To account for interactions, it evaluates candidate feature sets constructed from all the low-rank features through grouped ablation and its offline results are sufficiently predictive of online A/B tests to allow deprecations to proceed to online testing with confidence. Lineage tracing identifies all downstream consumer models to realize the full savings of removing a feature from the training set. We validate FORTE over 2 large-scale recommender systems and find that it identifies deprecable feature sets which do not cause online regressions, while the impact on efficiency depends on model characteristics. On a search-relevance model, FORTE resulted in 3 nested candidate sets of 32, 48, and 59 features. Online guardrails rejected the largest treatment. The 48-feature set was selected for deprecation, removing 43.3% of the model's features. On a large ranking model, FORTE identified 8 candidates for removal. Retraining and A/B testing confirmed no regression. Its launch reduced the trainable parameters by 29.9%, improved serving throughput by 19.8-25.5%, and reduced annual training costs by hundreds of thousands of dollars.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FORTE 是面向工业推荐系统的特征生命周期框架，用高效扰动实现每日特征评估、分组消融处理特征交互、血缘追踪定位下游消费模型，使离线结果足以预测线上 A/B 结果并直接推进下线。在搜索相关性模型上选出 48 特征集、移除模型 43.3% 的特征且线上无回归；在大型排序模型上移除 8 个候选特征后可训练参数降 29.9%、服务吞吐升 19.8–25.5%、年训练成本降数十万美元。
Motivation: 推荐系统特征增删不对称：新增只需在某指标上带来收益，删除却不能让任何指标回退，加上特征交互、日度重要性波动、与上线争抢 A/B 流量、多模型共用等因素，特征下线难以排期。
Method: FORTE 是模型无关的发现、验证、移除特征的生产框架：高效扰动实现支持每日特征评估；对所有低秩特征构造候选特征集并做分组消融 (grouped ablation) 以刻画交互；血缘追踪 (lineage tracing) 找出全部下游消费模型；离线结果用于判断是否推进线上 A/B 测试。
Result: 在 2 个大规模推荐系统上验证。搜索相关性模型得到 32、48、59 特征的 3 个嵌套候选集，线上 guardrail 否决最大集，最终选 48 特征集下线，移除模型 43.3% 的特征；大型排序模型识别出 8 个可移除候选，重训与 A/B 测试确认无回归，上线后可训练参数减少 29.9%、服务吞吐提升 19.8–25.5%、年训练成本降低数十万美元。
Conclusion: 离线扰动与分组消融的结果足以预测线上 A/B，可让特征下线带着信心直接进入线上测试；效率收益取决于模型特性，且需血缘追踪覆盖全部下游模型才能兑现完整节省。

papers.title: Constrained Probabilistic Numerics: Gaussian Process Solvers for Linear PDEs under Linear Inequality Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian process solvers for linear partial differential equations (PDEs) return posteriors rather than point estimates, but they condition only on equality information: the PDE residual, boundary data, and measurements. Many solutions of interest also obey inequality constraints, including nonnegativity, monotonicity, and absence of arbitrage, which equality conditioning cannot enforce. We prove that conditioning a Gaussian process prior jointly on linear equality observations and a finite-dimensional inequality event is equivalent to conditioning sequentially in terms of Borel measures on the solution space. The physics-informed posterior is therefore a valid prior for the inequality update at virtual points. The combined law is non-Gaussian yet computable through truncated-Gaussian moments, and neither the PDE conditioning nor the inequality update requires modification. We evaluated the construction on a Poisson benchmark, option-price surfaces, and air-quality fields. Under incomplete boundary data, a monotonicity constraint lowered the error of a two-dimensional Poisson reconstruction by $63\%$. On a real S&P 500 option chain thinned to $20$ retained quotes, no-arbitrage constraints reduced held-out extrapolation error by $22\%$ and cut the calendar-arbitrage rate from $10\%$ to $1\%$. On four real air-quality snapshots, nonnegativity reduced a Gaussian moment-based sub-zero-tail proxy by $74\%$ at the sparsest monitor count. Changes in mean accuracy and constraint diagnostics differed across data regimes. The probability of the noisy virtual constraint event under the equality posterior measures agreement with the specified bounds before the update. The construction turns admissibility from a post-processing step into conditioning information for probabilistic PDE solvers.
papers.comment: 9 figures, 3 tables. Code available at https://github.com/bydeng01/linpde-gp
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把线性不等式约束（单调性、无套利、非负性）作为条件信息直接注入 Gaussian process 线性 PDE 求解器，而非事后后处理：先按 PDE 残差与边界/观测做等式条件，再在虚拟点上对不等式事件做截断高斯矩更新。不完整边界下 2D Poisson 重建误差降 63%，S&P 500 期权链（20 条报价）外推误差降 22%、日历套利率从 10% 降到 1%，四张真实空气质量快照最稀疏监测点数下亚零尾部代理降 74%。
Motivation: GP 类 PDE 求解器只以等式信息（PDE 残差、边界数据、观测）为条件，无法强制非负、单调、无套利等不等式约束，而这些约束正是许多解的固有性质。
Method: 证明在解空间的 Borel 测度意义下，对线性等式观测与有限维不等式事件的联合条件等价于序贯条件，因此 physics-informed 后验可直接作为不等式更新的先验；在虚拟点上用截断高斯矩 (truncated-Gaussian moments) 计算非高斯联合分布，PDE 条件与不等式更新均无需修改。
Result: 不完整边界数据下，单调性约束使二维 Poisson 重建误差降低 63%；真实 S&P 500 期权链稀疏至 20 条保留报价时，无套利约束使留出外推误差降低 22%，日历套利率从 10% 降至 1%；四张真实空气质量快照在最稀疏监测点数下，非负性使基于 Gaussian 矩的亚零尾部代理降低 74%。均值精度与约束诊断的变化随数据 regime 不同。
Conclusion: 不等式约束应作为条件信息进入概率 PDE 求解器，而不是事后后处理；等式后验下噪声虚拟约束事件的概率可在更新前度量所设界与数据的一致程度。

papers.title: Adaptive Variance Reduction without Knowing Oracle Smoothness
papers.abstract_en: Variance reduction improves the convergence rate of stochastic non-convex optimization under the average smoothness condition. Existing adaptive variance reduction methods are especially designed for average smoothness and do not adapt to standard smoothness. In this paper, we study how one algorithm can adapt to these two settings and the noiseless setting without knowing the smoothness constants or the variance bound. Given the gradient budget $T$, we develop a two-phase method. The first phase compares two independent gradients and switches to normalized momentum when their difference exceeds a threshold. This phase provides both a candidate with standard smooth and noiseless guarantees and also ensures a bounded expected function gap for the second variance reduction phase. The resulting rates are $O(T^{-1/3})$ under average smoothness, $O(T^{-1/4})$ under standard smoothness, and $O(T^{-1/2})$ without noise. When $T$ is unknown, we propose a method with two paths that attain the corresponding rates with logarithmic factors in the stochastic settings. Here, we use a variance reduction path to deal with average smoothness and employ the AdaGrad-Norm for standard smoothness and noiseless setting. Neither method restarts from the initial point or requires a growing number of oracle calls in each round.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在随机非凸优化中提出一种无需知道平滑常数与方差上界的两阶段自适应方差缩减：第一阶段比较两个独立梯度，差值超阈值就切到 normalized momentum，为第二阶段方差缩减提供候选解与有界期望函数间隙。给定梯度预算 T 时收敛率为平均平滑 O(T^{-1/3})、标准平滑 O(T^{-1/4})、无噪声 O(T^{-1/2})；T 未知时用双路径版本（方差缩减路径 + AdaGrad-Norm）在随机设定下带对数因子达到同样速率，且都不重启、每轮 oracle 调用数不增长。
Motivation: 现有自适应方差缩减算法只针对 average smoothness 设计，无法自动适配 standard smoothness 与无噪声情形，而实践中这些平滑常数和方差上界事先未知。
Method: 给定梯度预算 T 的两阶段方法：第一阶段比较两个独立梯度，差值超过阈值即切换到 normalized momentum，产出带 standard smooth 与 noiseless 保证的候选解并保证第二阶段的期望函数间隙有界；第二阶段做方差缩减。T 未知时改为双路径版本，average smoothness 走方差缩减路径，standard smoothness 与无噪声走 AdaGrad-Norm。
Result: 收敛率：average smoothness 下 O(T^{-1/3})，standard smoothness 下 O(T^{-1/4})，无噪声下 O(T^{-1/2})；T 未知的双路径方法在随机设定下以对数因子达到对应速率。两种方法都不从初始点重启，每轮也不需要增长的 oracle 调用数。
Conclusion: 一个算法可以在不知道平滑常数与方差上界的情况下同时适配 average smoothness、standard smoothness 与无噪声三种设定，并保持方差缩减的收敛速率。

papers.title: OccludeBench: Can VLMs Find What's Missing?
papers.abstract_en: How well can vision-language models (VLMs) reason about what is missing from an image? We study this question with OccludeBench, a manually curated benchmark for recovering fully occluded objects from the visual evidence that remains. OccludeBench distinguishes direct cases, where the hidden object must be recovered from a specific physical cue such as a shadow or reflection, from inferential cases, where it can be inferred from broader scene context. Across five VLMs, accuracy averages 42.7% on direct cases versus 62.7% on inferential cases, exhibiting a 20.0-point gap. Humans attain higher accuracies of 63.4% versus 68.5% for direct and inferential images, respectively, with no significant gap. To locate this failure, we introduce OccludeTrace, a four-stage diagnostic that isolates where the visual reasoning process breaks down. The bottleneck emerges when models must recover the relevant object from the projection within the full image: they succeed on only 50% of failed examples, compared with 91% of examples they answer correctly. Extended reasoning, tool use, and few-shot prompting yield inconsistent improvements and do not reliably eliminate the gap. In contrast, an inpaint-then-confront intervention, which prompts models to first generate a candidate hidden object and then evaluate that hypothesis against the visible physical cue, reduces the gap to a statistically non-significant difference for both models with image-generation capabilities. Together, our results establish a tractable, controlled diagnostic for isolating how VLMs reason about visual content that is missing from an image.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OccludeBench 是人工构建的 VLM 遮挡物体推理基准：五个 VLM 在需靠阴影/反射等物理线索恢复被完全遮挡物体的 direct 案例上平均准确率 42.7%，靠场景上下文推断的 inferential 案例为 62.7%，差距 20.0 个百分点，而人类为 63.4% 对 68.5%、无显著差距。诊断显示瓶颈在从整幅图像的投影中恢复目标（失败样本仅 50% 成功，答对样本 91%），inpaint-then-confront 干预（先生成候选隐藏物体再对照可见物理线索检验）把差距降到统计上不显著。
Motivation: VLM 能识别可见物体，但从残留视觉证据推理图像中缺失内容的能力缺乏受控诊断；direct 与 inferential 两类缺失推理的性能鸿沟及其断裂环节此前未被定位。
Method: 构建人工整理的 OccludeBench，将案例分为 direct（靠阴影、反射等特定物理线索恢复）与 inferential（靠更广场景上下文推断）；提出四阶段诊断 OccludeTrace 定位推理链断裂处，并测试 extended reasoning、tool use、few-shot prompting 及 inpaint-then-confront 干预（先生成候选隐藏物体，再用可见物理线索评估该假设）。
Result: 五个 VLM 平均准确率 direct 42.7% vs inferential 62.7%，差 20.0 个百分点；人类 63.4% vs 68.5%，无显著差距。OccludeTrace 显示瓶颈在从整幅图像投影中恢复目标：失败样本上仅 50% 成功，答对样本为 91%。extended reasoning、tool use、few-shot 改善不一致；inpaint-then-confront 在具备图像生成能力的两个模型上把差距降到统计不显著。
Conclusion: VLM 缺失物体推理的短板特异于依赖物理线索的 direct 案例，且卡在从图像投影恢复目标这一步；先生成假设再对照物理线索检验可消除该鸿沟，而单纯加长推理或用工具不可靠。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Randomized Momentum Transport with Cheap Predictors
papers.abstract_en: Momentum methods such as STORM and second-order momentum track the gradient by adding a transport correction to momentum, at the cost of an extra oracle call per iteration. We introduce randomized momentum transport, which evaluates the correction with probability $q$ and otherwise uses a cheap prediction, with importance weighting that preserves the conditional mean and adds $(q^{-1}-1)$ times the prediction loss to the variance. Under transport-bias, second-moment, and residual-control assumptions, linear minimization oracle (LMO) updates, including normalized, sign, and exact spectral (Muon) directions, retain an $O(T^{-1/3})$ stationarity bound for each fixed $q>0$ with a single-gradient initialization. For unnormalized STORM, some $q<1$ lowers the leading coefficient of our sufficient gradient budget if and only if the gradient-difference noise modulus exceeds the smoothness constant, by at most about $10\%$. An online diagonal predictor admits a regret-to-convergence guarantee. At approximately equal oracle cost, querying a quarter of the corrections lowers the final training loss by $18$ to $43\%$ on MNIST1D and raises the test accuracy of Hessian-vector transport on CIFAR-10 by $1.5$ points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出随机化动量传输 (randomized momentum transport)：以概率 q 计算传输校正项，其余时候用廉价预测器代替，并用重要性加权保持条件均值无偏，代价是方差增加 (q^{-1}-1) 倍预测损失。在传输偏差、二阶矩与残差控制假设下，含 normalized、sign、exact spectral (Muon) 方向的 LMO 更新对任意固定 q>0 仍保持 O(T^{-1/3}) 平稳性界；在近似等 oracle 成本下只查询四分之一校正，MNIST1D 最终训练损失降低 18% 到 43%，CIFAR-10 上 Hessian-vector transport 测试精度提高 1.5 个百分点。
Motivation: STORM 类动量与二阶动量方法每步都要多打一次梯度 oracle 来算传输校正，训练成本高；能否用廉价预测替代大部分校正而不破坏收敛界，是这类方法的实际瓶颈。
Method: 以概率 q 触发真实校正评估、否则用在线对角预测器 (online diagonal predictor) 代替，配合保持条件均值的重要性加权；在 transport-bias、second-moment、residual-control 三组假设下分析 LMO 更新（normalized、sign、exact spectral/Muon）与未归一化 STORM，并给出预测器的 regret-to-convergence 保证。
Result: 任意固定 q>0 下 LMO 更新保持 O(T^{-1/3}) 平稳性界且只需单梯度初始化；未归一化 STORM 中当梯度差噪声模量超过光滑性常数时，某些 q<1 能降低充分梯度预算的主项系数，幅度至多约 10%。近似等 oracle 成本下查询四分之一校正：MNIST1D 最终训练损失下降 18% 到 43%，CIFAR-10 上 Hessian-vector transport 测试精度提升 1.5 个百分点。
Conclusion: 随机跳过大部分传输校正并用预测器补上，可以在保持 O(T^{-1/3}) 收敛率的同时显著省 oracle 调用并降低训练损失；是否降低梯度预算取决于梯度差噪声模量与光滑性常数的相对大小。

papers.title: Optimal Algorithms for Nonsmooth Nonconvex Stochastic Optimization with Constraints
papers.abstract_en: We present new algorithms for stochastic optimization problems in which the objective is neither smooth nor convex, subject to a convex constraint set. Our algorithms return a $(δ,\varepsilon)$-Goldstein stationary point, as recently defined for constrained problems by Liu et al. (2024), with improved complexities, and are the first to achieve optimal convergence rates for this task in several settings. In particular, we design projection-based and projection-free algorithms that achieve a $\widetilde O(δ^{-1}\varepsilon^{-3})$ rate using stochastic gradients, which we show to be optimal, and a $\widetilde O(dδ^{-1}\varepsilon^{-3})$ rate using zeroth-order queries, which is also optimal in its dependence on the dimension $d$ and improves over prior work. Notably, our lower bound is given in terms of the Frank-Wolfe gap and holds even for smooth problems, which is of independent interest. These results show that in nonconvex stochastic optimization, the convergence rate is degraded neither by the presence of constraints nor by nonsmoothness. Our analysis is based on a reduction to online linear optimization, extending a related technique from unconstrained optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在凸约束集上处理既非光滑也非凸的目标，给出投影式与免投影两类算法，返回 (δ,ε)-Goldstein 稳定点，随机梯度下复杂度为 Õ(δ⁻¹ε⁻³) 并证明最优，零阶查询下为 Õ(dδ⁻¹ε⁻³) 且对维数 d 依赖最优。下界以 Frank-Wolfe gap 表述且在光滑问题上已成立，说明约束与非光滑都不额外劣化收敛率。
Motivation: 非光滑非凸随机优化在凸约束下的最优收敛率此前未知：已有算法复杂度偏松，且缺少匹配的下界来判断约束与非光滑本身是否带来代价。
Method: 设计投影式与投影-free 算法求 (δ,ε)-Goldstein 稳定点（定义沿用 Liu et al. 2024 的约束版本）；分析基于归约到在线线性优化 (online linear optimization)，把无约束情形的技术推广到带约束情形；另给出基于 Frank-Wolfe gap 的下界。
Result: 随机梯度下复杂度 Õ(δ⁻¹ε⁻³)，证明为最优；零阶查询下 Õ(dδ⁻¹ε⁻³)，对维数 d 的依赖最优并改进先前工作；下界用 Frank-Wolfe gap 表述且在光滑问题上即成立。
Conclusion: 在非凸随机优化中，收敛率既不因约束而劣化，也不因非光滑而劣化；若干设定下首次给出最优收敛率，Frank-Wolfe gap 下界本身具有独立价值。

papers.title: Your Discrete Graph Diffusion Model is Secretly Memorizing
papers.abstract_en: Discrete graph diffusion models (GDMs) corrupt the graph structure by adding noise independently to nodes and edges under a Markovian noise model. In the unconditional setting without node features, an equivariant denoiser trained on a single graph is able to generate novel graphs and sample-level metrics such as edge overlap and WL kernel similarity find no evidence of memorization. In this work, we challenge this view and show for the first time that graph diffusion models indeed exhibit memorization. Analyzing the reverse diffusion trajectories of GDMs trained on two-block stochastic block models (SBMs), we find a strong train-data bias: the model recovers a corrupted training graph almost perfectly compared to a held-out test graph. We term this conditional memorization, as it surfaces only when the reverse trajectory is conditioned on a corrupted training graph and is not apparent during inference. It coincides with a growing generalization gap, where the training loss improves as the loss on held-out graphs degrades, and it cannot be mitigated by early stopping. The onset of memorization always precedes the emergence of community structure in the generated graphs, thus every checkpoint earlier produces structureless graphs. This behavior holds across all node sizes we test.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop BeNTo: Beyond Next Token Prediction
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 离散图扩散模型 (GDM) 在单图训练下看似不记忆：样本级指标（edge overlap、WL kernel）查不出来。但把反向扩散轨迹条件在被污染的训练图上时，模型几乎完美复原训练图而明显差于留出测试图，作者称之为条件记忆 (conditional memorization)；它伴随训练损失降而留出损失升的泛化缺口，早停无法缓解，且记忆出现总是先于生成图中社区结构的涌现。
Motivation: 无节点特征的无条件图生成里，等变去噪器在单图上训练即可生成新图，样本级指标未发现记忆，这一结论可能掩盖了反向轨迹层面的过拟合。
Method: 在两块随机块模型 (two-block SBM) 上训练离散图扩散模型（节点与边独立加噪的 Markov 噪声模型），分析其反向扩散轨迹，比较条件在被污染训练图与留出测试图上的复原质量，并跨多种节点规模检验。
Result: 条件在被污染训练图上时模型几乎完美复原训练图，明显优于留出测试图；泛化缺口同步扩大（训练损失改善而留出损失恶化），早停无法缓解；记忆出现先于生成图的社区结构涌现，早检查点只产出无结构图；该行为在测试的所有节点规模上都成立。
Conclusion: 样本级生成指标不足以判定图扩散模型的记忆与否，记忆只在反向轨迹被训练图条件化时暴露，且无法用早停消除。

papers.title: UkrMeme: Multimodal Explainable Persuasion Detection in Ukrainian Memes
papers.abstract_en: Memes play a central role in modern online communication, especially in contexts of political conflict where visual and textual cues combine to convey persuasive messages. We study persuasive technique detection in Ukrainian memes using vision-language models (VLMs). We introduce UkrMeme, a dataset of 200 organically produced Ukrainian wartime memes annotated for persuasion techniques, and PTM-UA, a Ukrainian translation of a subset of the Propaganda 950 benchmark that preserves original visual content while translating meme text. We evaluate VLMs in a zero-shot prompting setup across image, text, and multimodal inputs using hierarchical F1 metrics. Finally, we compare Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) and model-generated token attributions and analyze the semantic categories of evidence emphasized by each explanation method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 UkrMeme 数据集（200 条乌克兰战时自然传播的 meme，标注说服技巧）与 PTM-UA（Propaganda 950 子集的乌克兰语翻译、保留原图），用零样本提示在图像、文本、多模态三种输入上评测视觉语言模型的说服技巧检测，指标为 hierarchical F1，并对比 Layer-wise Relevance Propagation 与模型生成的 token attribution 两类解释方法所强调证据的语义类别差异。
Motivation: 政治冲突语境下 meme 把视觉与文本线索结合传递说服性信息，但缺少乌克兰语的说服技巧检测数据与可解释性评测。
Method: 构建 UkrMeme（200 条标注说服技巧的乌克兰战时 meme）与 PTM-UA（Propaganda 950 子集的乌克兰语翻译，保留原始视觉内容）；以零样本提示评测 VLM 在 image、text、multimodal 三种输入上的表现，用 hierarchical F1 度量；再用 LRP 与模型生成的 token attribution 做解释方法对比并分析其证据语义类别。
Result: 数据集规模为 200 条乌克兰战时 meme，另有 PTM-UA 作为 Propaganda 950 子集的乌克兰语翻译版本；评测采用零样本提示与 hierarchical F1，覆盖图像、文本、多模态三种输入，并比较 LRP 与 token attribution 强调的证据语义类别。
Conclusion: 说服技巧检测可在乌克兰 meme 上用零样本 VLM 加层级 F1 评测，而解释方法的选择会改变被强调证据的语义类别。

papers.title: SimVTA: Simulation-Grounded Video-Trajectory Alignment for Driving World Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Driving world action models (WAMs) learn from paired trajectories and future observations. Post-training with reinforcement learning allows the policy to explore alternative trajectories and improve planning using driving rewards. However, driving logs contain future videos only for the recorded trajectories, leaving these alternatives without corresponding visual supervision. Thus, we introduce SimVTA, a simulation-grounded post-training framework that combines trajectory optimization with video supervision. First, we sample candidate trajectories for each observation and use a real-world simulator (e.g., World Engine) to render future videos for high-reward candidates in real-world scenes reconstructed with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). This provides trajectory-matched supervision independent of the model's own predictions. Under a limited rendering budget, we prioritize video supervision for higher-error futures among these rendered candidates. Finally, we optimize trajectory planning with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and use a flow-matching loss on the matched videos to update shared representations. At inference time, the model predicts trajectories directly, without simulator calls. On NAVSIM v1, applying SimVTA to a WAM initialization improves PDMS from 86.2 to 91.3 (+5.1). It achieves 88.2 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 and an average HD-Score of 38.8 in closed-loop evaluation on HUGSIM. Ablations show that updating shared representations with video supervision improves planning, while prioritizing higher-error futures among high-reward trajectories further improves performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SimVTA 为驾驶世界动作模型 (WAM) 的后训练补上替代轨迹的视觉监督：用 3D Gaussian Splatting 重建真实场景，经模拟器 (World Engine) 为高奖励候选轨迹渲染未来视频，再以 GRPO 优化轨迹、用 flow-matching 损失在配对视频上更新共享表征。在 NAVSIM v1 上把 WAM 初始化的 PDMS 从 86.2 提到 91.3（+5.1）。
Motivation: 驾驶日志只记录被实际走过的轨迹的未来视频，RL 后训练探索出的替代轨迹没有对应视觉监督，轨迹优化与视频监督因此脱节。

Conclusion: 为未被走过的轨迹补渲染配对视频并共享表征，可在不增加推理开销的前提下提升驾驶策略的规划质量，且渲染预算应优先给高误差未来。

papers.title: Detection of extremely rare dead cells in fluorescence microscopy images
papers.abstract_en: Dead cell detection in fluorescence microscopy is essential for phenotypic screening and drug efficacy assessment. However, automated identification remains challenging due to signal variability, optical artifacts, and colocalization ambiguities across multiple channels. Markers that define nuclear boundaries do not neatly coincide spatially or temporally with apoptotic markers. Furthermore, marker accumulation kinetics vary across individual cells and apoptosis stages, making universal thresholds unreliable. We present a systematic comparison of several computational approaches for detecting apoptotic cells in nucleus-stained specimens: (1) heuristic methods using intensity thresholds, distributions, correlations, and domain guidance; (2) classification using numerical features (Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost and LightGBM) and image features (ResNet-18 and EfficientNet-B0); and (3) anomaly detection, also using numerical features (Isolation Forest, one-class SVM and PCA reconstruction) and image features (convolutional autoencoders and Deep SVDD). Using a dataset of 258 images containing 65,527 cells/nuclei across multiple scenes with 243 manually annotated ground truth dead cells, we evaluate each method on metrics such as PR-AUC, Precision, Recall, F1-score, and macro-F1. Our results indicate that classification using image features (deep learning) and numerical features (traditional) achieved the best performance, with ResNet-18 and XGBoost significantly outperforming manually designed heuristics and anomaly detection methods. Our findings demonstrate that such biomedical problems remain highly challenging to solve even with the state-of-the-art computational and learning techniques. We aim to provide an effective decision-support tool to researchers while tackling such problems either fully-automatically or in a human-in-the-loop setting as an aide to domain scientists.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在荧光显微镜死细胞检测中，基于图像特征的分类（ResNet-18）与基于数值特征的分类（XGBoost）显著优于人工阈值启发式和各类异常检测方法，但作者同时指出这类生物医学问题即便用当前最先进的计算与学习技术仍高度困难。数据集含 258 张图像、65,527 个细胞/细胞核，其中仅 243 个手工标注的真实死细胞。
Motivation: 核染色边界标记与凋亡标记在空间和时间上不重合，且单个细胞与凋亡阶段间的标记累积动力学各异，导致通用阈值失效，自动识别受信号波动、光学伪影和多通道共定位歧义困扰。
Method: 系统比较三类方法：(1) 启发式（强度阈值、分布、相关性与领域先验）；(2) 分类——数值特征用 Logistic Regression、Random Forest、XGBoost、LightGBM，图像特征用 ResNet-18 与 EfficientNet-B0；(3) 异常检测——数值特征用 Isolation Forest、one-class SVM、PCA 重建，图像特征用卷积自编码器与 Deep SVDD。在 258 张图像、65,527 个细胞/细胞核、243 个手工标注死细胞上以 PR-AUC、Precision、Recall、F1-score、macro-F1 评估。
Result: 在 258 张图像 / 65,527 细胞 / 243 标注死细胞上，ResNet-18（图像特征分类）与 XGBoost（数值特征分类）表现最佳，显著优于人工启发式与异常检测方法；评估指标为 PR-AUC、Precision、Recall、F1-score、macro-F1。
Conclusion: 监督分类（无论图像还是数值特征）是该稀有死细胞检测任务的首选路线，而异常检测与启发式阈值不足；即便如此，作者认为该问题用当前最先进技术仍高度困难，定位为面向研究人员的决策支持工具，可全自动或人在回路使用。

papers.title: ReplaySSM: Cache SSM Inputs, Not State
papers.abstract_en: State-space models (SSMs) maintain a fixed-size recurrent state, but reading and writing it at every decoding step can bottleneck hybrid models. This eager state management causes large state I/O with low arithmetic intensity, leaves speculative decoding no cheap rollback, and feeds state quantization error into subsequent recurrent updates. We introduce ReplaySSM, which unrolls the recurrence to represent the state as a checkpoint and a buffer of recent SSM inputs. This separates output computation from checkpoint updates. By updating the checkpoint periodically, ReplaySSM avoids state writes on most steps and roughly halves the dominant state memory traffic. Keeping recent inputs also makes speculative rollback a buffer-pointer operation and enables output-only verification without materializing intermediate states. The same separation allows a low-precision checkpoint to serve output computation on most steps while a higher-precision checkpoint serves recurrent updates, so rounding error in the low-precision copy never enters later updates. We implement ReplaySSM in vLLM for Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet. At serving batch size 256, it accelerates standard decoding by $1.20$--$1.47\times$ over a tuned vLLM baseline across four hybrid models, and delivers about $1.8\times$ the throughput of vLLM's speculative decoding on the two 120B-class models. Separate state precisions also reduce output KL divergence and downstream accuracy losses compared with a shared low-precision checkpoint.
papers.comment: 11 pages (35 pages counting references and appendix), 6 figures, 2 tables. Code: https://github.com/Johnny-Liou/ReplaySSM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReplaySSM 把 SSM 的循环展开成「检查点 + 最近输入缓冲区」，让输出计算与检查点更新解耦：多数解码步只读低精度检查点、不写状态，投机解码的回退变成缓冲区指针操作。在 vLLM 上对 Mamba-2 与 Gated DeltaNet 实现后，batch 256 时标准解码比调优过的 vLLM 基线快 1.20–1.47×，两个 120B 级模型上吞吐约为 vLLM 投机解码的 1.8×。
Motivation: SSM 混合模型在每个解码步读写固定大小的循环状态，状态 I/O 大、算术强度低，成为推理瓶颈；同时投机解码缺少廉价回退手段，状态量化误差还会被后续循环更新不断累积。
Method: 将循环展开，用检查点加最近 SSM 输入缓冲区表示状态，周期性更新检查点以避免多数步的状态写入；保留近期输入使投机回退只需移动缓冲区指针，并支持只验证输出而不物化中间状态；低精度检查点服务输出计算、高精度检查点服务循环更新。在 vLLM 中为 Mamba-2 与 Gated DeltaNet 实现。
Result: 服务 batch size 256 下，四个混合模型上标准解码相对调优 vLLM 基线加速 1.20–1.47×；两个 120B 级模型上吞吐约为 vLLM 投机解码的 1.8×；主导状态内存流量大致减半；分离状态精度相比共享低精度检查点降低了输出 KL 散度与下游准确率损失。
Conclusion: 把 SSM 状态表示改为检查点加输入缓冲区，可以在不牺牲精度的前提下同时改善解码速度、投机解码回退与量化误差传播，且已在 vLLM 生产推理栈中落地。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: READ: Reading the Selective Scan for Faithful Video Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Selective state-space models are an efficient approach to long-sequence video modeling. However, their recurrent computation makes it difficult to determine which video tokens drive a prediction. Existing attribution methods often require additional backward passes or repeated model evaluations, making them substantially more expensive than the forward inference they aim to explain. In this work, we introduce READ, a parameter-free attribution method for selective state-space models that unrolls the recurrence at the position read by the classifier. READ traces the contribution accumulated in the recurrent state back to the video tokens that contribute to the final prediction. By anchoring attribution at the classifier's readout, it produces a single spatiotemporal relevance map from which frame- and region-level relevance can be obtained directly. Despite requiring only one forward pass, READ achieves competitive faithfulness and localisation compared with substantially more expensive attribution methods. Experimental results show that READ avoids the systematic relevance biases of existing methods while recovering meaningful temporal and class-specific structure across datasets and backbones. More broadly, our results show that the recurrence underlying selective state-space models is not only an efficient mechanism for inference, but also a direct source of interpretable evidence for their predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 READ：在分类器读出位置展开选择性状态空间模型 (selective SSM) 的循环，把循环状态中累积的贡献回溯到视频 token，只需一次前向传播就得到单张时空相关性图。相比需要额外反向传播或多次模型评估的归因方法，READ 在保真度与定位上仍有竞争力，并避免了现有方法的系统性相关性偏差。
Motivation: 选择性 SSM 做长序列视频建模效率高，但循环计算使预测难以归因到具体视频 token；现有归因方法需额外反向传播或重复评估，成本远高于其解释的前向推理。
Method: READ 是免参数归因方法：在分类器读出位置展开循环，将循环状态中累积的贡献回溯到视频 token，直接从该相关性图导出帧级与区域级归因，只需一次前向传播。
Result: 在多个数据集与骨干网络上，READ 以单次前向传播取得与昂贵归因方法相当的保真度与定位表现，并避免现有方法的系统性相关性偏差，恢复出有意义的时间与类别特定结构。
Conclusion: 选择性 SSM 的循环不仅是高效推理机制，其本身即可作为预测的可解释证据来源，无需额外计算开销。

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Multi-Objective Optimization: Norm-Constrained Oracles with Entropic Weight Updates
papers.abstract_en: Multiple-gradient descent is typically formulated in Euclidean geometry, whereas matrix-aware optimizers use directions induced by other norms. We analyze a single-loop multi-objective method combining a norm-constrained linear minimization oracle with entropic updates of task weights. For any finite-dimensional norm pair, we establish an $O(T^{-1/2})$ ergodic stationarity rate in the deterministic setting, deriving the required trajectory gradient bound from smoothness and lower-boundedness in the unregularized case. With stochastic gradients and a bounded-gradient assumption, one persistent blended-gradient momentum buffer yields an $O(T^{-1/4})$ rate whose leading term has no explicit dependence on the number of tasks. We also establish static regret for the inner weighting objective on arbitrary bounded gradient sequences and, with entropy regularization and a weight floor, iteration-wise inner-gap control after burn-in while retaining ergodic stationarity, conditional on a trajectory gradient bound. The optimal blended gradient can be nonunique in spectral and sign geometries, motivating a selection-independent inner gap. Our analysis extends the spectral construction studied by concurrent MOON to general norms. Experiments compare the method with existing multi-task optimizers and examine its oracle, weighting, and momentum choices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出单循环多目标优化方法：用范数约束线性最小化 oracle (norm-constrained LMO) 生成下降方向，配合任务权重的熵更新 (entropic weight updates)。对任意有限维范数对，确定性情形得 O(T^{-1/2}) 遍历平稳率，随机梯度下用单个 blended-gradient momentum buffer 得 O(T^{-1/4}) 且首项不显式依赖任务数；并给出内层加权目标的静态 regret 与 burn-in 后的逐迭代 inner-gap 控制。
Motivation: 多梯度下降 (MGD) 通常在欧氏几何下表述，而 matrix-aware 优化器用其他范数诱导的方向，两者缺少统一的单循环理论框架；谱与符号几何下最优 blended gradient 可能非唯一，使内层权重目标的 gap 定义依赖选择。
Method: 单循环框架：每步解范数约束线性最小化 oracle 得方向，用熵正则加权重下限 (weight floor) 更新任务权重，并维护一个 blended-gradient momentum buffer；从光滑性与下界性推导轨迹梯度界，随机梯度下附加有界梯度假设。
Result: 任意有限维范数对下确定性情形 O(T^{-1/2}) 遍历平稳率；随机梯度加有界梯度假设下 O(T^{-1/4})，首项对任务数无显式依赖；任意有界梯度序列上内层加权目标静态 regret 成立，熵正则加权重下限给出 burn-in 后逐迭代 inner-gap 控制（条件为轨迹梯度界）。实验将该方法与现有 multi-task 优化器比较，并检验 oracle、加权与动量的选择。
Conclusion: 范数约束 oracle 加熵权重更新可把谱几何构造（并发工作 MOON 所研究）推广到一般范数，同时保住遍历平稳性与选择无关的 inner gap；内层 gap 控制以轨迹梯度界为条件。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: 提出单循环多目标优化方法：用范数约束线性最小化 oracle (norm-constrained LMO) 生成下降方向，配合任务权重的熵更新 (entropic weight updates)。对任意有限维范数对，确定性情形得 O(T^{-1/2}) 遍历平稳率，随机梯度下用单个 blended-gradient momentum buffer 得 O(T^{-1/4}) 且首项不显式依赖任务数；并给出内层加权目标的静态 regret 与 burn-in 后的逐迭代 inner-gap 控制。
summary_sections.motivation: 多梯度下降 (MGD) 通常在欧氏几何下表述，而 matrix-aware 优化器用其他范数诱导的方向，两者缺少统一的单循环理论框架；谱与符号几何下最优 blended gradient 可能非唯一，使内层权重目标的 gap 定义依赖选择。
summary_sections.method: 单循环框架：每步解范数约束线性最小化 oracle 得方向，用熵正则加权重下限 (weight floor) 更新任务权重，并维护一个 blended-gradient momentum buffer；从光滑性与下界性推导轨迹梯度界，随机梯度下附加有界梯度假设。
summary_sections.result: 任意有限维范数对下确定性情形 O(T^{-1/2}) 遍历平稳率；随机梯度加有界梯度假设下 O(T^{-1/4})，首项对任务数无显式依赖；任意有界梯度序列上内层加权目标静态 regret 成立，熵正则加权重下限给出 burn-in 后逐迭代 inner-gap 控制（条件为轨迹梯度界）。实验将该方法与现有 multi-task 优化器比较，并检验 oracle、加权与动量的选择。
summary_sections.conclusion: 范数约束 oracle 加熵权重更新可把谱几何构造（并发工作 MOON 所研究）推广到一般范数，同时保住遍历平稳性与选择无关的 inner gap；内层 gap 控制以轨迹梯度界为条件。

papers.title: From Pixels to Privacy-Sensitive Features: An Information-Theoretic Framework for Reconstruction Bounds
papers.abstract_en: What can an adversary recover from a model trained with DP-SGD? Its $(\varepsilon,δ)$ guarantee does not answer this question directly. We derive a distortion bound that can be computed before training and applies even to an adversary who observes the parameter trajectory during training, knows every other training record and the population distribution from which the training records are drawn. The analyst may choose the representation in which error is measured, allowing the bound to target the aspects of reconstruction that are privacy-sensitive in a given application. Our information-theoretic framework separates two contributions: the information about a record revealed by training, measured through conditional mutual information, and the uncertainty already present in the data distribution, measured through source entropy. Rate-distortion theory combines them into a lower bound on the expected error of every reconstruction attack. For DP-SGD, the leakage bound depends only on the sampling rates and noise multipliers, while the source entropy is lower-bounded from a sample with finite-sample confidence. An orthogonal block construction keeps the resulting bound informative for high-dimensional images. We instantiate the framework in pixel space and in LPIPS feature space, obtaining, to our knowledge, the first lower bound on reconstruction distortion measured directly by LPIPS. On a range of image datasets the bounds establish non-trivial unavoidable expected reconstruction error within heuristically recommended privacy-budget ranges and beyond. Experiments compare the bounds with strong reconstruction attacks and identify the principal sources of the remaining slack.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个可在训练前计算的信息论框架，用条件互信息刻画训练泄露、用源熵刻画数据本身的不确定性，经 rate-distortion 合并得到对任意重建攻击的期望误差下界；对 DP-SGD，界只依赖采样率与噪声乘子。在像素空间与 LPIPS 特征空间实例化，得到据称首个以 LPIPS 直接度量的重建失真下界，并在多组图像数据集上显示推荐隐私预算范围内存在非平凡的不可避免重建误差。
Motivation: DP-SGD 的 (ε,δ) 保证不能直接回答攻击者究竟能从模型中恢复出什么，也无法指明哪些重建方面在具体应用中是隐私敏感的。
Method: 框架把两部分分开：训练泄露用条件互信息度量，数据分布已有不确定性用源熵度量，再由 rate-distortion 理论合成任意重建攻击的期望误差下界；分析者可自选误差度量的表示空间。DP-SGD 的泄露界只依赖采样率与噪声乘子，源熵从样本以有限样本置信度下界；用 orthogonal block 构造使高维图像上的界仍非平凡，并在像素空间与 LPIPS 特征空间各实例化一次。
Result: 得到据称首个以 LPIPS 直接度量的重建失真下界；在一系列图像数据集上，界在启发式推荐的隐私预算范围内及其之外都给出非平凡的不可避免期望重建误差；实验将该界与强重建攻击比较，并指出剩余 slack 的主要来源。
Conclusion: 重建隐私可以在训练前用信息论下界来约束，且泄露项只由 DP-SGD 的采样率与噪声乘子决定，度量表示可按应用的隐私敏感方面选择。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DualQuant: Dual-scale Calibration-free Weight-and-Activation Quantization for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Low-bit inference on accelerators with native 4-bit support requires quantizing both weights and activations to realize the full throughput gains these formats provide. While post-training weight quantization has been extensively studied, activation quantization remains considerably more challenging and typically requires calibration data. In this work, we introduce DUALQUANT, a dual-scale, calibration-free post-training quantization framework that directly minimizes the weight-reconstruction Mean Squared Error (MSE) and, as an immediate by-product, yields per-channel activation rescalings prior to activation quantization. Our key observation is that the scaling factors obtained by minimizing weight-reconstruction error provide effective activation rescalings, enabling competitive activation quantization without calibration data. We formulate DUALQUANT as a non-differentiable weight-reconstruction problem and develop an efficient solver based on variable splitting and block coordinate descent, where each subproblem admits a closed-form update. DUALQUANT provides a unified algorithm supporting a wide range of formats, including the full MX family and NVFP4. To our knowledge, DUALQUANT is the first dual-scaling method to formally support MX and NV block formats. Across Llama and Qwen models evaluated on WikiText-2, C4, and zero-shot downstream tasks, DUALQUANT matches or exceeds the accuracy of calibration-based SmoothQuant across most models and formats, and substantially outperforms calibration-free baselines, with large gains for MX and NV block formats. We validate these gains with a real packed W4A4 inference path for Llama-3.1-8B on an RTX 4090. The resulting implementation closely matches the accuracy of fake quantization while delivering up to 2.61x memory reduction and up to 2.46x throughput speedup over BF16.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DualQuant 是免校准 (calibration-free) 的权重量化+激活量化后训练框架：直接最小化权重重构 MSE，其副产物即为激活量化前的 per-channel 激活缩放因子。在 Llama 与 Qwen 上用 WikiText-2、C4 和 zero-shot 下游任务评测，多数模型与格式下匹配或超过依赖校准数据的 SmoothQuant，并显著优于免校准基线；Llama-3.1-8B 在 RTX 4090 的真实 W4A4 推理路径上相对 BF16 最高 2.61× 内存下降、2.46× 吞吐提升。
Motivation: 原生 4-bit 加速器要同时量化权重与激活才能拿到全部吞吐收益，但激活量化比权重量化难得多，通常必须依赖校准数据。
Method: 把权重重构写成不可微优化问题，用变量分裂 (variable splitting) 与块坐标下降 (block coordinate descent) 求解，每个子问题有闭式更新；由最小化权重重构误差得到的缩放因子直接充当激活缩放，统一支持 MX 全家族与 NVFP4 等块格式，据称是首个正式支持 MX 与 NV block 格式的双缩放方法。
Result: 在 Llama、Qwen 的 WikiText-2、C4 与 zero-shot 下游任务上，多数模型与格式下准确率匹配或超过依赖校准的 SmoothQuant，并大幅优于免校准基线，在 MX 与 NV block 格式上增益最大；Llama-3.1-8B 在 RTX 4090 上的真实打包 W4A4 推理实现精度接近 fake quantization，相对 BF16 内存最高降低 2.61×、吞吐最高提升 2.46×。
Conclusion: 权重重构误差最小化得到的缩放因子足以充当有效的激活缩放，因此激活量化可以不依赖校准数据，同时覆盖 MX 与 NV 块格式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Shortcut Learning in Geospatial Foundation Model Embeddings for Cross-Disaster Damage Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Geospatial foundation models can support disaster damage assessment, but high accuracy on familiar disasters may hide shortcut learning: prediction from event or scene characteristics rather than evidence that transfers to a new disaster. We study embeddings from TerraMind, Prithvi-EO-2.0, DOFA, and DINOv3 on the multi-disaster datasets xView2 and BRIGHT. Holding out an entire disaster, instead of randomly splitting image tiles, reduces mean balanced accuracy from 0.807 to 0.638 on xView2 and from 0.818 to 0.568 on BRIGHT. Four sets of tests examine what information supports prediction: event and acquisition context, before/after image inputs, building count, and correct image pairing. Pre-event images remain predictive, and a classifier given only the annotated number of buildings reaches balanced accuracy of 0.629 and 0.653. Combining before/after features performs best on average on xView2, but does not improve over pre-only features on BRIGHT. Shuffling image pairs within the same disaster and damage class causes modest losses. Motivated by these findings, we test whether feature transformations learned only from training disasters improve generalization to unseen disasters. These transformations improve performance, with supervised contrastive learning performing best on xView2 and PCA on BRIGHT. Our results highlight the importance of evaluation on unseen domains for assessing model robustness and show that simple feature-level transformations can improve generalization. Code and experiments can be found at https://github.com/alishibli97/gfm-shortcut-learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在跨灾害损伤评估中，地理空间基础模型 (GFM) 的高分主要来自捷径而非可迁移证据：xView2 上随机切分平均平衡准确率 0.807，整场灾害留出后降到 0.638，BRIGHT 从 0.818 降到 0.568。只给标注建筑数量的分类器就能达到 0.629/0.653，灾前影像单独仍有预测力；仅用训练灾害学的特征变换（xView2 上 supervised contrastive learning 最好，BRIGHT 上 PCA 最好）可提升对未见灾害的泛化。
Motivation: 在熟悉灾害上的高准确率可能掩盖捷径学习——模型依赖事件或场景特征而非能迁移到新灾害的证据，随机切分 tile 的评估方式会掩盖这一问题。
Method: 对 TerraMind、Prithvi-EO-2.0、DOFA、DINOv3 的 embedding，在多灾害数据集 xView2 与 BRIGHT 上对比随机切分与整场灾害留出两种评估；用四组探针检验预测依据：事件与采集上下文、前后影像输入、建筑数量、影像配对正确性；再测试仅从训练灾害学习的特征变换（supervised contrastive learning、PCA 等）对未见灾害泛化的改进。
Result: 整场灾害留出使平均平衡准确率从 0.807 降至 0.638（xView2）、从 0.818 降至 0.568（BRIGHT）；仅用标注建筑数量的分类器平衡准确率达 0.629 与 0.653；xView2 上前后特征组合平均最佳但在 BRIGHT 上不优于仅灾前特征；在同一灾害与损伤类别内打乱影像配对只造成 modest 损失；特征变换提升性能，supervised contrastive learning 在 xView2 最佳、PCA 在 BRIGHT 最佳。
Conclusion: 评估必须在未见灾害域上进行才能反映模型鲁棒性，而简单的特征级变换即可改善跨灾害泛化。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: When Edge Independence Fails: Joint Graph Diffusion with Latent Sociability Priors
papers.abstract_en: Discrete graph diffusion models corrupt graph structure through independent edge updates with a Markovian noise model. Combined with the exchangeability requirement on the output distribution, the terminal prior is necessarily an Erdős--Rényi (E-R) random graph. This has a fundamental consequence for unconditional graph generation without node features: in the large graph limit, any GNN denoiser applied to an E-R graph approximately outputs an E-R graph, making effective denoising difficult. In practice, generated graphs fail to recover meaningful node heterogeneity and higher-order structure. Previous models introduced specialized node features to compensate, framing this as an expressivity problem, while the role of the prior remained unexamined. We instead address the root cause by introducing the Latent Sociability Prior (LSP) and a join} diffusion process that co-evolves latent node sociability variables and graph structure, removing edge independence while preserving exchangeability. Unlike existing latent graph diffusion methods, the sociability mechanism requires no complex encoder: its sole role is to guide edge updates and preserve node heterogeneity throughout the trajectory. We validate our approach on multiple graph generation datasets and show that the proposed framework more accurately captures graph distributions than baseline methods without node features.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 离散图扩散用独立边更新加 Markov 噪声，配合输出分布的可交换性，终末先验必然是 Erdős–Rényi 随机图，导致大图极限下任何 GNN 去噪器近似输出 E-R 图、去噪失效。作者提出 Latent Sociability Prior (LSP) 与联合扩散过程，让隐变量节点社交度与图结构共同演化，在保持可交换性的同时打破边独立性。在多个无节点特征的图生成数据集上，该框架比基线更准确地捕捉图分布。
Motivation: 无节点特征的无条件图生成中，E-R 终末先验使 GNN 去噪器在大图极限下难以恢复节点异质性与高阶结构；此前工作用专门节点特征补偿，把它当成 expressivity 问题，而先验本身的角色一直未被审视。
Method: 提出 Latent Sociability Prior (LSP) 与联合扩散 (joint diffusion) 过程：隐变量节点社交度与图结构共同演化，社交度机制不需复杂编码器，唯一作用是在整个轨迹中引导边更新并保持节点异质性，同时保留输出的可交换性。
Result: 在多个图生成数据集上验证，所提框架在无节点特征设定下比基线方法更准确地捕捉图分布。
Conclusion: 边独立性与 E-R 先验是无节点特征图生成失效的根因，直接对先验建模（联合演化社交度与结构）比事后补节点特征更对症。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 边独立性与 E-R 先验是无节点特征图生成失效的根因，直接对先验建模（联合演化社交度与结构）比事后补节点特征更对症。

papers.title: How Well Do Prior-Data Fitted Networks Amortize Bayesian Inference?
papers.abstract_en: Prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) are trained to approximate the Bayesian posterior predictive distribution (PPD) of a synthetic prior, yet results about the approximation quality are surprisingly thin. Taking an empirical risk minimization perspective, we decompose the deployment error of PFNs into prior, context, and amortization error, and measure the latter against a reference PPD under a realistic prior. Results show that PFNs generally recover the targeted PPD very well. Nevertheless, we find that parts of the residual amortization error persist, especially in \textit{rare} settings under the prior pretraining distribution, even when scaling the model size, which manifests in disagreement between independently pretrained PFNs and leaves uncertainty about the predictor at inference time. As a remedy, we study multiple types of Bayesian model averages and find that these can consistently reduce this uncertainty and improve predictions up to full-size TabICLv2 models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 从经验风险最小化视角把 PFN 的部署误差分解为 prior、context 与 amortization 三部分，并对照真实先验下的参考 PPD 度量 amortization 误差。PFN 总体上能很好还原目标 PPD，但先验预训练分布中的 rare 设定下残余 amortization 误差不会随模型规模消失，表现为独立预训练 PFN 之间的预测分歧；用多种 Bayesian model average 可一致降低该不确定性并提升预测，效果可达全尺寸 TabICLv2 模型。
Motivation: PFN 被训练来逼近合成先验的贝叶斯后验预测分布 (PPD)，但其逼近质量的系统性证据很少，且推理时预测不确定性来源难以归因。
Method: 以经验风险最小化 (ERM) 视角将 PFN 部署误差分解为 prior error、context error 与 amortization error，并在 realistic prior 下把 amortization 误差对照参考 PPD 度量；随后比较多种 Bayesian model average 作为补救，并以全尺寸 TabICLv2 模型为参照。
Result: PFN 总体上非常好地还原目标 PPD；残余 amortization error 在先验预训练分布的 rare 设定下持续存在，即使扩大模型规模也不消除，造成独立预训练 PFN 之间的分歧；多种 Bayesian model average 一致降低该不确定性并改善预测，提升幅度可达全尺寸 TabICLv2 模型。
Conclusion: PFN 的逼近误差并非随规模消失，而是集中在先验下的稀有设定；对推理时的预测不确定性，Bayesian model average 是一致有效的补救手段。

papers.title: Neurons++: A Unified Visual-Stream Framework for Image and Video Reconstruction from fMRI with Neural-to-Visual Interpretability
papers.abstract_en: Decoding visual experience from fMRI is important for understanding human perception and developing brain-computer interfaces. Recent generative decoding methods can reconstruct plausible images and videos, but visual plausibility alone does not ensure that the output is faithfully grounded in brain activity. In this work, we propose Neurons++, a visual-stream fMRI reconstruction framework for both static image and dynamic video reconstruction. Compared with our conference version Neurons, Neurons++ extends the paradigm from video-only reconstruction to visual-stream reconstruction for both images and videos, and replaces parallel task conditioning with serial cortex-inspired decoding. The model first uses image-fMRI pretraining to obtain a stable spatial-semantic initialization, and then performs subject-specific fine-tuning for image and video reconstruction separately. The serial design organizes fMRI-derived representations into explicit spatial, semantic, language-level, and temporal cues. Extensive experiments show that Neurons++ achieves state-of-the-art video reconstruction and competitive image reconstruction across standard benchmarks. Beyond reconstruction fidelity, neural-to-visual analyses indicate that Neurons++ exhibits qualitative directional controllability under neural perturbation, that its fMRI encoder read-out is sensitive to stimulus-relevant cortical features, and that it supports ROI-guided semantic modulation. Code and model weights are available at: https://github.com/xmed-lab/NeuronsPlusPlus.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Neurons++ 把 fMRI 解码从仅视频扩展到图像与视频统一的 visual-stream 重建，用串行的皮层启发式解码替代会议版 Neurons 的并行任务条件化，先以 image-fMRI 预训练获得空间-语义初始化，再分别做被试微调。实验显示其视频重建达到 SOTA、图像重建具竞争力，神经扰动下表现出定性方向可控性与 ROI 引导的语义调制。
Motivation: 生成式 fMRI 解码能产出看似合理的图像视频，但视觉合理性不等于输出忠实锚定于脑活动，且现有方法多局限于单一模态。
Method: 先用 image-fMRI 预训练得到稳定的空间-语义初始化，再对图像与视频分别做 subject-specific 微调；串行 cortex-inspired 解码把 fMRI 表征组织为空间、语义、语言层与时间线索四类显式 cue，取代会议版 Neurons 的并行任务条件化。
Result: 在标准基准上 Neurons++ 取得 SOTA 级视频重建与有竞争力的图像重建；神经到视觉分析给出定性结论：神经扰动下输出具方向可控性，fMRI encoder read-out 对刺激相关皮层特征敏感，并支持 ROI 引导的语义调制。
Conclusion: 串行的皮层启发式解码加 image-fMRI 预训练，可把 fMRI 重建统一到图像与视频两路，并在重建保真度之外提供神经到视觉的可解释控制接口。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Gaussian Splatting with Reflections Guided by What is Seen
papers.abstract_en: While novel view synthesis methods like Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have shown impressive performance on common scenes, they often struggle with capturing view-dependent specular effects, particularly near-field reflections. Existing methods utilize environment maps, which only represent lights from infinity, or environment Gaussians, which rely solely on indirect supervision from reflections, are insufficient for accurately modeling such effects. Here, we propose a framework based on 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS) that leverages directly observable environment information in input images. Our approach also integrates a hybrid reflection appearance representation and view-dependent specular modeling. Experiments on public benchmarks and a newly curated near-field reflection dataset demonstrate that our method achieves superior rendering quality and geometric accuracy.
papers.journal_ref: 2026 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP), Tampere, Finland, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出以 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS) 为基础、由输入图像中直接可见的环境信息引导反射建模的新视角合成框架，结合混合反射外观表示与视角相关高光建模。在公开基准与新整理的近场反射数据集上，渲染质量与几何精度均优于既有方法。
Motivation: NeRF 与 3DGS 在常规场景表现好，但难以刻画视角相关的镜面效果，尤其是近场反射；现有环境贴图只表示无穷远光源，环境高斯又仅靠反射的间接监督，建模这类效果不够准确。
Method: 基于 2D Gaussian Splatting 构建框架，直接利用输入图像中可观测的环境信息，而非仅靠间接监督；同时引入混合反射外观表示 (hybrid reflection appearance representation) 与视角相关的镜面建模 (view-dependent specular modeling)。
Result: 在公开基准和新整理的近场反射数据集上，该方法取得更优的渲染质量与几何精度（摘要未列出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把直接可观测的环境信息引入 2DGS 反射建模，可改善近场镜面效果的新视角合成质量与几何精度。

papers.title: Matched-Context Group Policy Optimization for LLM Agent Training
papers.abstract_en: Training long-horizon language model agents requires assigning credit to intermediate decisions from sparse terminal feedback. Within a finite group of sibling rollouts, useful action comparisons depend on their context, evidence for both alternatives, and how that evidence enters learning. We propose Matched-Context Group Policy Optimization (MCGPO), a procedure for constructing weighted action preferences from already collected trajectories. MCGPO defines comparison contexts with pre-action state summaries and observed rubric progress, annotated by task rules. Two-action support selects among ordered exact and coarse matching rules. Fixed folds separate candidate decisions from the terminal outcomes used to orient their preferences, and support-dependent evidence weights scale an auxiliary pairwise objective alongside shared GraphGPO task learning. MCGPO reuses rollout data and each response's original history, preserving critic-free training. Across six environment-backbone settings with three training seeds each, MCGPO improves mean success over matched GraphGPO: by 0.47-1.46 percentage points on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B and 7B, and by 3.96 and 5.16 points on WebShop with Qwen3-4B and 8B. The ALFWorld gains build on baseline success above 92%, where remaining headroom is limited. Integrated success improves in three of four Qwen2.5 settings. Three-seed factorial controls support opposite-fold evidence and evidence weighting; joint state-rubric matching achieves the highest mean in all four representation-control settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MCGPO（Matched-Context Group Policy Optimization），用动作前状态摘要与 rubric 进度构造配对比较上下文，从已收集的兄弟 rollout 中生成加权动作偏好，为稀疏终端反馈下的长程 LLM agent 分配中间决策信用。在六个环境-骨干组合、每组三个种子下，MCGPO 相对 GraphGPO 提升平均成功率：ALFWorld 与 WebShop（Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B）提升 0.47–1.46 个百分点，WebShop（Qwen3-4B/8B）提升 3.96 与 5.16 个百分点。
Motivation: 长程 LLM agent 训练只有稀疏终端反馈，中间决策的信用分配困难；同组兄弟 rollout 的动作比较依赖上下文、双方证据及其进入学习的方式，缺少系统的构造规则。
Method: MCGPO 从已收集轨迹构造加权动作偏好：以动作前状态摘要和观测到的 rubric 进度定义比较上下文并用任务规则标注；两动作支持选择精确与粗匹配的有序规则；固定 fold 把候选决策与用于定向偏好的终端结果分开；支持相关的证据权重缩放辅助成对目标，与共享的 GraphGPO 任务学习并行；复用 rollout 数据与原始历史，保持 critic-free 训练。
Result: 六个环境-骨干设置、每设置三个训练种子：相对 GraphGPO 的平均成功率提升在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop（Qwen2.5-1.5B、7B）为 0.47–1.46 个百分点，在 WebShop（Qwen3-4B、8B）为 3.96 与 5.16 个百分点；ALFWorld 基线成功率已高于 92%，剩余空间有限；integrated success 在四个 Qwen2.5 设置中的三个提升；三种子因子对照支持反向 fold 证据与证据加权，联合 state-rubric 匹配在全部四个表示控制设置中均值最高。
Conclusion: 在配对偏好中显式匹配上下文并按证据强度加权，可在不引入 critic 的前提下提升长程 agent 的成功率，且上下文表示的联合匹配优于单独的状态或 rubric 匹配。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Studying the Effects of Task Diversity Using Small Mathematical Worlds
papers.abstract_en: Basic mathematical tasks like modular addition have been a valuable tool for illuminating aspects of neural network behavior that are challenging to see in noisy, unverifiable, large-scale, real-world settings. These studies have typically focused on a single task. However, modern language models are exposed to a vast number of tasks despite being trained with a next-token prediction objective. In this work, we introduce two mathematical task ecosystems, IntWorld and PermWorld, built from distinct but related tasks on integers and permutations. Both are designed to simulate task diversity within a cohesive mathematical 'world' where tasks are distinct but related. Because the datasets are procedurally generated, we can precisely vary the number of tasks, allowing us to begin to disentangle the role of task variety from other factors in training. After describing the datasets, we provide some initial results obtained from these datasets which support the idea that increasing task diversity increases the richness of a model's internal representations.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 13 figures. Accepted for poster presentation at the NeurIPS 2026 MATH-AI Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出两个程序化生成的数学任务生态 IntWorld 与 PermWorld，在同一“数学世界”内构造整数与排列上既区分又相关的多任务，用可精确调节的任务数量把任务多样性与训练中其他因素分离。初步结果支持：任务多样性越高，模型内部表征越丰富。
Motivation: 神经网络行为研究多在单一任务（如 modular addition）上进行，而现代语言模型同时暴露于海量任务，任务多样性在训练中的作用难以与数据量等其他因素解耦。
Method: 构建 IntWorld（整数）与 PermWorld（排列）两个程序化生成的任务生态，任务彼此不同但相关，可精确改变任务数量；在该设置下考察模型内部表征随任务多样性的变化。
Result: 初步结果支持任务多样性提升模型内部表征的丰富度；数据集由程序生成，任务数量可精确变化，从而把任务种类的作用与训练中其他因素区分开。
Conclusion: 在可控的数学世界中，增加任务多样性会使模型学到更丰富的内部表征，这为理解多任务训练下的表征形成提供证据。
Relevance: 0
