papers.title: A Privileged Teacher That Only Scores Cannot Search: Critique-Conditioned On-Policy Self-Distillation for Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation promises to replace the sparse outcome signal of verifiable-reward RL with dense token-level credit: a teacher conditioned on the reference solution scores the student's own rollout, and the resulting distributional shift is distilled back into the policy. We investigate whether this scoring signal actually contains corrective credit. Using gold error spans in student rollouts, we test the two signals consumed by self-distillation objectives, the full-distribution KL and the token log-ratio, for two properties: whether they localize errors and whether they push probability away from erroneous student tokens. They exhibit neither of these properties nor can they reliably distinguish correct from incorrect rollouts within the same problem. We argue that this failure is structural: locating an error in a reasoning trace is itself a search problem, while a scoring teacher is never explicitly asked to perform that search. The same model, with the same privileged information, localizes errors substantially better when allowed to generate a critique. This forms the motivation for \emph{critique-conditioned self-distillation}: first generate a critique of the current rollout, then condition the scoring teacher on that critique. The resulting signal localizes errors, is corrective within error spans, and shifts probability toward tokens that initiate backtracking such as ``Wait'', ``But'', and ``Actually''. We further show that the critique is useful both at test time, where resuming a wrong rollout with the critique in context converts math problems the model cannot solve by sampling, and in cold-start GRPO, where it provides an advantage signal on prompts for which verifiable rewards alone provide none.
papers.comment: Accepted as an oral at the FLLMPT workshop, NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在可验证奖励 RL 的 on-policy 自蒸馏中，只做打分的特权教师给出的 KL 与 token log-ratio 信号既不能定位推理错误，也不能把概率推离错误 token，甚至无法区分同一题目下的对错 rollout。作者论证这是结构性的：定位错误本身就是搜索问题，而打分教师从未被要求做这个搜索；让同一模型先生成 critique 再以 critique 为条件打分后，信号能定位错误、在错误区间内具纠正性，并把概率推向 Wait、But、Actually 这类回溯起始 token。critique 还能在测试时让模型解出纯采样解不出的数学题，并在 cold-start GRPO 中为可验证奖励给不出信号的 prompt 提供 advantage。
Motivation: on-policy 自蒸馏本想用稠密 token 级 credit 替代可验证奖励 RL 的稀疏结果信号，但打分式教师是否真的携带可纠正的 credit 尚无检验，而错误定位本身是一个未被显式要求的搜索问题。
Method: 用学生 rollout 中的 gold error spans 检验自蒸馏消费的两个信号：full-distribution KL 与 token log-ratio，考察它们能否定位错误、能否把概率推离错误 token、能否区分同一题目下的对错 rollout；随后提出 critique-conditioned self-distillation，先对当前 rollout 生成 critique，再以该 critique 为条件让教师打分，并把信号用于测试时续写与 cold-start GRPO。
Result: KL 与 log-ratio 两个信号都不具备错误定位与纠错推离性质，也无法可靠区分同一问题内的对错 rollout；同一模型在同等特权信息下允许生成 critique 时错误定位能力显著更好。加 critique 后的信号能定位错误、在错误区间内具纠正性，并把概率移向 Wait、But、Actually 等回溯 token；测试时把 critique 放进上下文续写错误 rollout，可解出模型纯采样无法解决的数学题，cold-start GRPO 中则在可验证奖励本身为零的 prompt 上给出 advantage 信号。
Conclusion: 打分式特权教师的稠密信号在结构上缺少纠错 credit，因为定位错误需要搜索；把搜索结果以 critique 形式显式生成再条件化打分，才能让自蒸馏信号变得可定位、可纠正。

papers.title: SmolWAM: A Latent World-Action Model for Robotic Manipulation on Edge Devices
papers.abstract_en: World-action models (WAMs) predict a robot's actions together with the observations those actions will produce. However, the strongest models rely on video diffusion transformers that are far too computationally expensive for resource-constrained edge devices. We present SmolWAM, a latent WAM that we derive from the 2B-parameter Cosmos Policy by keeping its pretrained trunk and rebuilding its inference interface: single-frame visual latents, cached text features that preserve the trunk's attention sinks, 12 of 28 transformer blocks, and 1,008 tokens from which actions and future visual latents are read out in one rectified-flow step. Trained in 3.6 GPU-hours, SmolWAM succeeds in 95.5% of 400 LIBERO episodes at 57 ms and 2.3 TFLOP per 16-action chunk with 2.4 GiB of GPU memory, 11x faster than its teacher with 18.5x fewer FLOPs and 3.2x less memory, and its world head still forecasts scene motion.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Robot Learning with World Models Workshop. Code: https://github.com/iitimii/SmolWAM Project: https://smolwam.vercel.app/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SmolWAM 把 2B 参数的 Cosmos Policy 裁剪成可在边缘设备运行的潜空间世界-动作模型 (latent world-action model)：保留预训练 trunk，重建推理接口为单帧视觉 latent、缓存文本特征、28 层中只用 12 层、1,008 个 token，一次 rectified-flow 步同时读出动作与未来视觉 latent。仅用 3.6 GPU-hours 训练后，在 LIBERO 400 个 episode 上成功率 95.5%，单次 16 动作块推理 57 ms、2.3 TFLOP、显存 2.4 GiB，比 teacher 快 11 倍、FLOP 少 18.5 倍、显存省 3.2 倍，且 world head 仍能预报场景运动。
Motivation: 最强的 world-action model 依赖 video diffusion transformer，算力开销远超资源受限的边缘设备，机器人操作难以在本地部署。
Method: 从 2B 参数的 Cosmos Policy 出发保留其预训练 trunk，只重建推理接口：单帧视觉 latent、保留 trunk attention sink 的缓存文本特征、28 个 transformer block 中取 12 个、1,008 个 token 上用单步 rectified flow 同时读出动作与未来视觉 latent；训练耗时 3.6 GPU-hours。
Result: LIBERO 400 个 episode 成功率 95.5%；每个 16 动作块推理 57 ms、2.3 TFLOP、GPU 显存 2.4 GiB；相对 teacher 快 11 倍、FLOP 少 18.5 倍、显存少 3.2 倍；world head 仍能预报场景运动。
Conclusion: 裁剪 trunk 深度与 token 数并改用单步 rectified flow 读出，可以在保留世界模型运动预报能力的同时把 video-diffusion 级 WAM 压到边缘设备可跑的延迟、算力与显存预算内。

papers.title: SafeDiSTL: Decomposing Joint Constraints for Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Cooperative multi-agent tasks often impose constraints on a shared objective or collective safety. A team level violation cost function can measure this constraint outcome, but does not distinguish which agents' actions most strongly influence that violation. We present SafeDiSTL, a constrained multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that allows for credit assignment even with joint constraint measurements. We use Signal Temporal Logic (STL) robustness to measure episode-level violation through running-maximum cost increments. Smooth full-episode robustness and differentiable dynamics provide action sensitivities, which allocate each cost increment across agents at the same decision time. These sensitivities account for delayed effects when weighting agents' shares of each cost increment. We study the framework in cooperative payload transport, connected navigation, and networked traffic control tasks. SafeDiSTL achieves 1.6-5.1x the safe-success rate in transport, improves navigation safe-success by 11.1%, and delivers 50-68% more throughput in traffic when compared to constrained baselines. Results demonstrate a strong improvement of the learned policy in dealing with shared constraint while retaining the performance of unconstrained policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SafeDiSTL 在联合约束只有团队级违规代价时，用 STL robustness 的 running-maximum 代价增量度量回合违规，再用平滑全回合 robustness 与可微动力学算出的动作敏感度把每个增量按同一决策时刻分摊到各智能体，并计入延迟效应。在协作搬运、连通导航与网络交通控制任务中，相对约束基线搬运 safe-success 达 1.6–5.1 倍、导航 safe-success 提升 11.1%、交通吞吐量多 50–68%，同时保持无约束策略的性能。
Motivation: 协作多智能体任务的约束常定义在共享目标或集体安全上，团队级违规代价只能说明约束被违反，无法区分哪些智能体的动作对该违规影响最大，导致联合约束下的信用分配 (credit assignment) 缺失。
Method: SafeDiSTL 是一个受约束多智能体强化学习框架：用 Signal Temporal Logic (STL) robustness 通过 running-maximum 代价增量度量回合级违规；由平滑的全回合 robustness 与可微动力学求出动作敏感度，在同一决策时刻把每个代价增量分摊给各智能体，并在加权时计入延迟效应。
Result: 在协作搬运 (payload transport)、连通导航 (connected navigation) 与网络交通控制 (networked traffic control) 三类任务上，相对约束基线：搬运任务 safe-success rate 达其 1.6–5.1 倍，导航 safe-success 提升 11.1%，交通控制吞吐量 (throughput) 多 50–68%。
Conclusion: 在联合约束测量下用动作敏感度做代价分摊，能在共享约束下显著提升学到策略的 safe-success 与吞吐量，同时保留无约束策略的性能水平。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Orthros: Phase-Aware Heterogeneous Attention for Efficient Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Efficient attention mechanisms, such as linear and sliding window attention, aim to reduce the computational complexity of Transformers from quadratic to linear. However, their degraded in-context recall often necessitates interleaving full attention layers, leaving the quadratic bottleneck unresolved in long-context processing. To address this, we introduce Orthros attention, which shifts the efficiency paradigm from structural allocation to phase-aware decoupling. As a unified module, it dynamically switches its computation pattern across different phases of sequence processing, enabling linear complexity prefilling and full attention decoding. Our design grants Orthros attention a lower asymptotic complexity compared to vanilla Transformers in prevalent long-context scenarios characterized by heavy prefilling and light decoding. Beyond theoretical formulation and complexity analysis, extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate Orthros's superiority across multiple dimensions. First, we validate its fundamental language modeling capabilities, demonstrating scalability across varying model sizes and strong competitiveness in comprehensive architectural comparisons. Second, Orthros exhibits exceptional conversion feasibility via a data-efficient Transformer-to-Orthros conversion, yielding performance that even surpasses the original Transformer. Finally, Orthros achieves a $21.9\times$ prefilling speedup over Transformers with end-to-end inference gains, while preserving long-context capabilities, as demonstrated by near-perfect 128K needle-in-a-haystack results and Transformer-level performance on real-world in-context recall tasks. Overall, these advantages in high performance, flexibility, and efficiency position Orthros as a promising candidate to succeed the Transformer in industrial applications.
papers.comment: neurips 2026 paper, preprint version with lab's template
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Orthros attention：同一模块在序列处理的不同阶段切换计算模式，prefill 用线性复杂度、decode 用全注意力，从而在重 prefill、轻 decode 的长上下文场景下取得低于 vanilla Transformer 的渐近复杂度。在长上下文评测中实现 21.9× prefill 加速，128K needle-in-a-haystack 接近满分，in-context recall 保持 Transformer 水平。
Motivation: 线性注意力与滑窗注意力把复杂度降到线程级，但 in-context recall 退化，常需插入全注意力层，长上下文处理中的二次瓶颈并未真正解除。
Method: Orthros attention 作为统一模块，在 prefill 阶段用线性复杂度计算、decode 阶段切换为全注意力；配套提出数据高效的 Transformer-to-Orthros 转换方法，并做理论复杂度分析与多维度实证评估。
Result: prefill 相对 Transformer 加速 21.9×，端到端推理也有增益；128K needle-in-a-haystack 结果接近完美，真实 in-context recall 任务达到 Transformer 级性能；转换后的模型性能甚至超过原 Transformer，并在不同模型规模上展示可扩展性与架构对比中的强竞争力。
Conclusion: 在重 prefill、轻 decode 的长上下文工作负载上，按阶段解耦注意力计算模式可以同时保住召回能力并解除二次瓶颈，作者据此认为 Orthros 有潜力在工业应用中接替 Transformer。

papers.title: KVeil: First-Place Solution to ECCV 2026 LifeGenIP Challenge on Unlearnable Videos
papers.abstract_en: The rapid development of personalized video generation has raised serious concerns over identity privacy, as a few facial videos of a person now suffice to reproduce their identity in synthetic videos. This report presents the first-place solutions to both phases of the ECCV 2026 LifeGenIP Challenge on Unlearnable Videos, which aims to protect facial videos from unauthorized customization under a limited and imperceptible perturbation budget. For Phase 1, we introduce Reference Capacity Collapse, a pair of complementary losses that degrade the information carried by the reference condition while keeping subsequent video representations dependent on it, together with a Motion-Guided EOT mechanism that improves robustness across unknown inference conditions. Phase 2 further considers tuning-based customization and unseen generative models. To address both threats within a single perturbation, we design a two-layer framework that protects the facial and background regions separately, constructing structure-aligned perturbations from a synthetic target identity in the former and strengthening the white-box disruption of Phase 1 in the latter. Our method achieves nearly perfect protection under white-box reference-based customization, and remains effective under other customization paradigms, various models, and temporal attacks. Both solutions are built upon our recent work LETHE. We hope our solutions can inspire future work on protecting facial videos against unauthorized customization. Our code is available at https://github.com/AntigoneRandy/KVeil.
papers.comment: Technical report for the winning solution (1st place, both phases) of the ECCV 2026 LifeGenIP Challenge on Unlearnable Videos against Diffusion-based Customization
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KVeil 是 ECCV 2026 LifeGenIP Challenge（不可学习视频，两阶段均获第一）的获奖方案：用 Reference Capacity Collapse 双损失削弱参考条件信息量、配合 Motion-Guided EOT 抗未知推理条件，Phase 2 再用分层框架分别保护人脸与背景。在白盒参考式定制下达到近乎完美的保护，并在其他定制范式、多种模型与时间攻击下仍有效。
Motivation: 几段人脸视频即可让扩散定制模型复现他人身份，个性化视频生成带来身份隐私风险；需要在有限且不可察觉的扰动预算内阻止未经授权的定制。
Method: Phase 1 提出 Reference Capacity Collapse（一对互补损失，压低参考条件携带信息同时让后续视频表征仍依赖它）与 Motion-Guided EOT 机制以覆盖未知推理条件；Phase 2 面向 tuning-based 定制与未见生成模型，设计双层框架分别处理人脸与背景：人脸区用合成目标身份构造结构对齐扰动，背景区加强 Phase 1 的白盒扰动。两套方案均构建在作者此前工作 LETHE 之上。

papers.title: LAPT-Scale: Scaling Embodied Policies with Latent Action Pre-Training on Human Videos
papers.abstract_en: Scaling generalist robotic policies is limited by the high cost of collecting embodied interaction data. Large-scale egocentric human videos offer a rich alternative, but they lack robot action labels, and existing action annotation methods are often noisy under real-world visual complexity and diverse manipulation dynamics. We introduce LAPT-Scale, a scalable latent action pre-training paradigm with two components: LAPT-Scale-LAM learns continuous latent actions by explaining frame-to-frame visual transitions in human videos and uses them as human-derived supervision, while LAPT-Scale-Policy trains a VLA policy through human-video latent-action pre-training, target-robot embodiment alignment, and task-specific post-training. Unlike prior vector-quantized LAMs, LAPT-Scale-LAM uses a continuous latent space to preserve fine-grained motion and interaction dynamics. We further combine perceptual, semantic, and optical-flow alignment signals to improve transition-level supervision beyond pixel reconstruction. Trained on 23.3K hours of egocentric video, LAPT-Scale-LAM provides implicit action supervision for policy pre-training, yielding consistent scaling gains and improving real-robot success from 63.3% to 85.0% as annotated human video scales from 1K to 5K hours. The learned policy also generalizes to unseen visual conditions.
papers.comment: Accepted at CoRL 2026; 24 pages including appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LAPT-Scale 用人类第一视角视频做隐动作预训练来替代昂贵的机器人交互数据：LAPT-Scale-LAM 在连续隐空间中通过解释逐帧视觉转移学习隐动作，LAPT-Scale-Policy 再用这些隐动作做预训练、机器人本体对齐与任务后训练。标注人类视频从 1K 小时扩到 5K 小时时，真机成功率从 63.3% 升到 85.0%，且策略能泛化到未见过的视觉条件。
Motivation: 通用机器人策略受限于具身交互数据的高采集成本；大规模第一视角人类视频虽丰富但没有动作标签，现有动作标注方法在真实视觉复杂度与多样操作动力学下噪声很大。
Method: LAPT-Scale-LAM 在连续隐空间（区别于向量量化 LAM）中以逐帧视觉转移为解释目标学习连续隐动作，监督信号结合感知、语义与光流对齐，超出像素重建；LAPT-Scale-Policy 依次做人类视频隐动作预训练、目标机器人本体对齐 (embodiment alignment) 和任务特定后训练，构成 VLA 策略。
Result: LAPT-Scale-LAM 在 23.3K 小时第一视角视频上训练；随标注人类视频从 1K 小时增至 5K 小时，真机成功率由 63.3% 提升到 85.0%，呈一致的 scaling 增益；学到的策略可泛化到未见过的视觉条件。

papers.title: SeoulMMOD: A Large-Scale Multimodal Origin-Destination Flow Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Origin-destination (OD) flow forecasting supports urban mobility decisions by predicting the volume and patterns of human movement across a city. Most existing public OD benchmarks provide only a partial view of citywide mobility, covering a single transport service or at most two modes. With partial mode coverage, observed demand changes are difficult to separate into shifts across transport modes and changes in total travel. We introduce SeoulMMOD, a large-scale public benchmark for citywide multimodal mobility in Seoul. SeoulMMOD provides three years of hourly OD flows estimating total mobility for 6 urban travel modes across 25 districts and 426 sub-districts, together with travel-time, travel-distance, calendar, rainfall, and point-of-interest (POI) signals. Using SeoulMMOD, we benchmark 14 forecasting baselines under a common protocol and analyse the effects of spatial scaling, joint versus mode-separate training, and cross-year generalization. Results show that several spatio-temporal models that work at district level do not scale to sub-district OD forecasting, and that naive joint multi-mode training does not consistently improve accuracy. Together, the dataset and benchmark establish a reproducible testbed for multi-mode, multi-year OD forecasting at the city scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SeuolMMOD 提供首尔全市 6 种出行方式、25 个区与 426 个子区、三年逐小时 OD 流量基准，并附出行时间、距离、日历、降雨与 POI 信号。在统一协议下测 14 个基线发现：在区级有效的时空模型无法扩展到子区级 OD 预报，朴素的多方式联合训练也不能一致提升精度。
Motivation: 现有公开 OD 基准只覆盖单一交通服务至多两种方式，导致需求变化难以拆分为方式间转移与总量变化，且缺少全市、多方式、跨年的可复现评测。
Method: 构建覆盖 6 种出行方式、25 区与 426 子区、三年逐小时 OD 流量的数据集，附带 travel-time、travel-distance、calendar、rainfall、POI 信号；在统一协议下对 14 个预报基线做基准测试，并分析空间尺度、联合与分方式训练、跨年泛化三组效应。
Result: 多个在区级表现有效的时空模型无法扩展到子区级 OD 预报；朴素的联合多方式训练并未一致提高预报精度。
Conclusion: OD 预报的结论对空间尺度与训练方式敏感，区级结果不能外推到子区级，多方式联合训练不是默认更优的方案。

papers.title: Amortized Counterfactual Prediction with Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Counterfactual inference asks how an observed outcome might have differed under different circumstances, such as whether a patient would have recovered had they received a different treatment. Such questions arise whenever decisions depend on the outcomes of alternatives that were not observed. Answering counterfactual queries generally requires knowledge of the underlying causal structure, which is often unavailable in practice. A common approach is therefore to first estimate the causal graph from observational data and then perform counterfactual inference. However, errors in the estimated causal graph can propagate to downstream counterfactual predictions. To address this challenge, we introduce the Counterfactual Graph Neural Process (CFGNP), an end-to-end approach that answers counterfactual queries directly from observational data without first estimating a causal graph. CFGNP uses Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to exploit the dual-graph structure by restricting cross-world message passing to corresponding factual--counterfactual variables. Across synthetic and image-based benchmarks, CFGNP achieves stronger predictive performance than existing approaches, including on the German Loan benchmark, where it reduces MSE from $4.51 \times 10^{-2}$ to $0.19 \times 10^{-2}$. Furthermore, on synthetic causal graphs, a model trained only on 10-node graphs maintains strong predictive performance on graphs with up to 30 nodes, without retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CFGNP 用图神经网络直接从观测数据回答反事实查询，跳过先估计因果图的两步流程，从而避免图估计误差传到下游反事实预测。在合成与图像基准上预测性能超过现有方法，German Loan 上 MSE 从 4.51×10⁻² 降到 0.19×10⁻²；只在 10 节点图上训练的模型可零重训推广到 30 节点图。
Motivation: 回答反事实问题通常要先从观测数据估计因果图，而估计误差会传播到下游反事实预测；实践中底层因果结构往往未知。
Method: 提出 Counterfactual Graph Neural Process (CFGNP)，端到端地直接从观测数据回答反事实查询，不先估计因果图；用 Graph Neural Networks (GNN) 利用 dual-graph 结构，把 cross-world message passing 限制在对应的 factual–counterfactual 变量之间。
Result: 在合成与图像基准上预测性能强于现有方法；German Loan 基准上 MSE 从 4.51×10⁻² 降至 0.19×10⁻²；在合成因果图上，仅用 10 节点图训练的模型在最多 30 节点的图上无需重训仍保持强预测性能。
Conclusion: 绕开显式因果图估计、直接做反事实预测是可行的，且对图规模变化具有免重训的泛化能力。

papers.title: State-Isolated Vision Mamba via Update-Tendency Routing for Underwater Image Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Vision Mamba has recently emerged as an efficient alternative to convolutional and Transformer-based architectures by modeling long-range spatial dependencies through recurrent state evolution. Existing studies primarily improve token serialization, scanning strategies, or expert routing, yet largely overlook a state level question question: how should recurrent states be organized for spatially heterogeneous visual restoration? In this paper, we show that forcing tokens with heterogeneous update behaviors to recurrently modify a shared hidden state leads to persistent cross-content interference, which we term \textbf{State Contention}. We further argue that effective recurrent modeling should organize state evolution according to token compatibility rather than token ordering. Based on this observation, we introduce \textbf{State Isolation}, a new recurrent state organization principle for Vision Mamba,tokens with compatible state-update tendencies evolve within independent recurrent state streams. To instantiate this principle, we propose \textbf{IsoMamba}, a $Δ$-guided architecture that constructs model-intrinsic update representations, discovers update-compatible token groups through label-free clustering, and routes them to isolated Mamba experts following a \textbf{cluster--route--isolate} paradigm. In addition, we develop a dynamic channel-wise reweighting objective to compensate for wavelength-dependent reconstruction difficulty in underwater images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that IsoMamba consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple underwater image enhancement benchmarks while providing cleaner hidden state responses, validating the effectiveness of state isolated recurrent modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IsoMamba 指出 Vision Mamba 中异质 token 共享同一隐状态会互相干扰（State Contention），改按 token 的状态更新倾向分组：Δ 引导的无标签聚类把更新兼容的 token 路由到彼此隔离的 Mamba 专家（cluster–route–isolate）。在多个水下图像增强基准上达到 state-of-the-art，并给出更干净的隐状态响应。
Motivation: Vision Mamba 现有改进集中在 token 序列化、扫描策略与专家路由，却忽略隐状态如何组织：让更新行为异质的 token 反复修改共享状态会造成持续的跨内容干扰，而空间异质的图像恢复任务正需要按兼容性而非顺序组织状态演化。
Method: 提出 State Isolation 原则与 IsoMamba 架构：用 Δ 引导构造模型内在的更新表示，做无标签聚类发现更新兼容的 token 组，再按 cluster–route–isolate 范式路由到隔离的 Mamba 专家；另加一个动态通道重加权目标，补偿水下图像随波长变化的重建难度。
Result: 在多个水下图像增强基准 (underwater image enhancement benchmarks) 上一致达到 state-of-the-art，并呈现更干净的隐状态响应；摘要以定性对比为主，未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 按状态更新倾向而非 token 顺序组织递归状态，可缓解共享隐状态的跨内容干扰，是 Vision Mamba 做空间异质视觉恢复的有效组织方式。

papers.title: Machine Unlearning for Federated Socially Fair k-Means Clustering
papers.abstract_en: Federated clustering can support applications such as patient stratification across hospitals and customer segmentation across distributed financial datasets. Responsible AI calls for fair representation of demographic groups and support for data deletion, motivated in part by rights such as the GDPR's right to erasure. These goals interact: deleting records can change the balance between groups and alter the clustering of the remaining population. We study exact machine unlearning for federated socially fair $k$-means, whose objective is to minimize the largest group-average squared distance to the nearest center. Our approach keeps separate local summaries for each group, so summaries at unaffected institutions remain valid as global fairness weights change. For two groups, we prove an initialization approximation guarantee independent of client group proportions under ideal sampling, and we show that same-seed replay reproduces retraining exactly. Reuse pays off most when a whole client withdraws: across three datasets, replay is $35.8\times$ faster than retraining for the initialization-only model and remains $2.4\times$ and $1.7\times$ faster with one and two fair-refinement rounds, which improve worst-group cost. For individual record deletions, gains are modest (about $1.06\times$), and certifying cached assignments can cost more than it saves. These results map where exact unlearning can profitably reuse computation. Code and reproducibility materials are available at https://github.com/arareddy/mufsc.
papers.comment: 53 pages, 7 figures, including appendices. The first three authors contributed equally. Supplementary code, data and scoped Lean proofs (v1.0.0): https://github.com/arareddy/mufsc/releases/tag/v1.0.0
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对联邦社会公平 k-means 的精确遗忘（machine unlearning），按群体分别保存局部摘要，使全局公平权重变化时未受影响机构的摘要仍可复用，并证明同种子重放可精确复现重训练。整客户端退出时三个数据集上初始化阶段重放比重训练快 35.8×，加一轮公平细化后仍快 2.4×、两轮后 1.7×；单条记录删除仅约 1.06×，缓存分配的认证开销可能超过收益。
Motivation: GDPR 删除权要求联邦聚类支持数据删除，而删除会改变群体间平衡并影响剩余人群的聚类结果；公平目标与遗忘目标相互耦合，直接重训练代价高。
Method: 为联邦社会公平 k-means（目标为最小化最大群体平均到最近中心的平方距离）设计精确 unlearning：按群体维护独立局部摘要，配合 same-seed replay 复现重训练；对两群体在理想采样下证明与客户端群体比例无关的初始化近似保证，并给出 scoped Lean 形式化证明。
Result: 三个数据集上，整客户端退出时初始化阶段 replay 比 retraining 快 35.8×，加入一轮与两轮 fair-refinement 后分别保持 2.4× 与 1.7× 加速且细化改善最差群体代价；单条记录删除加速仅约 1.06×，缓存分配认证成本可能高于其节省。
Conclusion: 精确 unlearning 的复用收益集中在整客户端退出场景，个体记录删除收益微薄甚至为负，因此应按删除粒度决定是否复用计算。

papers.title: Towards Understanding the Training of GFlowNets: A Theoretical Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) learn policies that sample discrete objects in proportion to a positive reward. They are trained by minimizing balance objectives, whose exact satisfaction guarantees correct sampling. However, a comprehensive theory linking nonzero balance loss and approximate stationarity to sampling accuracy, especially under evolving sampling distributions and backward policies, is still lacking. To bridge this gap, we develop a unified theory for Flow Matching, Detailed Balance, and Trajectory Balance in this regime. We first bound terminal symmetric KL by the square root of the expected balance loss. Then, we show that approximate stationarity controls this distribution error up to a tangent-space residual measuring parameterization incompleteness. Finally, we establish finite-time convergence under fixed or controlled sampling and fixed, balance-trained, or separately updated backward policies. Under standard smoothness assumptions, with fixed or controlled sampling and a fixed or balance-trained backward policy, the expected loss is $O(\barε^2+T^{-1})$ and expected terminal symmetric KL is $O(\barε+T^{-1/2})$ under uniform coverage. For a separately updated backward policy, we characterize the sufficient update decay to approach the residual neighborhood and preserve these rates. These results connect balance objectives to sampling accuracy and clarify how parameterization, coverage, and moving components govern GFlowNet training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为 GFlowNet 的三个平衡目标（Flow Matching、Detailed Balance、Trajectory Balance）建立统一收敛理论：终端对称 KL 被期望平衡损失的平方根控制，近似平稳性再把该误差压到刻画参数化不完备性的切空间残差邻域。在固定或受控采样、固定或平衡训练的后向策略下，期望损失为 O(ε̄²+T⁻¹)、终端对称 KL 为 O(ε̄+T⁻¹/²)（一致覆盖条件）；后向策略单独更新时，只要更新量按足够速率衰减即可保持同样速率。
Motivation: 平衡损失非零、平稳性只是近似、且采样分布与后向策略都在训练中演化时，缺少把平衡损失与采样精度联系起来的完整理论。
Method: 对 FM、DB、TB 三个平衡目标给出统一分析：先以期望平衡损失的平方根界定终端对称 KL，再用切空间残差刻画参数化不完备性对近似平稳性的限制，最后在标准光滑性假设下推导固定/受控采样与固定、平衡训练或单独更新后向策略下的有限时间收敛。
Result: 固定或受控采样加固定或平衡训练后向策略时，期望损失 O(ε̄²+T⁻¹)，一致覆盖下期望终端对称 KL O(ε̄+T⁻¹/²)；后向策略单独更新时给出足以进入残差邻域并保持该速率的更新衰减条件。
Conclusion: 平衡目标的采样精度由参数化完备性、覆盖程度与移动组件（采样分布、后向策略）的更新速率共同决定，而非仅由训练步数决定。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Adaptive DHiSparse: Speculative Decoding over a Load-Adaptive KV Hierarchy
papers.abstract_en: Long-context serving runs out of KV memory before the hardware reaches its useful throughput. HiSparse stores history in host memory and fetches only the selected entries, but it uses one cache budget at every load and does not handle draft-model speculative decoding such as DSpark and DFlash2. We present Adaptive DHiSparse, which supports speculative decoding over hierarchical sparse KV and adapts residency to load. It protects the required working set, retains additional history while GPU memory is spare, and recovers the rest through exact fused retrieval. DSpark and DFlash2 keep their proposal and acceptance rules: queries share missing-row retrieval, draft KV uses a window-bounded ring, and verification staging is reused across layer groups. At 100K context and concurrency 128, GLM-5.3 with DFlash2 delivers 793 output tokens/s per decode GPU, 1.45$\times$ HiSparse and 1.27$\times$ non-speculative adaptive serving. Held to the same latency bounds as HiSparse, it sustains up to 4$\times$ the concurrency and 2.3 to 3.7$\times$ the output, depending on the per-token bound. On DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at 500K context and concurrency 512, Adaptive DHiSparse with DSpark delivers 1.85$\times$ the output of resident serving with DSpark. In a load step, optional residency reduces host fetches from 14.2% to 1.4% of selected rows at low load and releases memory under pressure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Adaptive DHiSparse：在 HiSparse 的分层稀疏 KV（历史放主机内存、按需取回）之上支持 DSpark / DFlash2 投机解码，并让常驻量随负载自适应——保护必需工作集、显存有余时多留历史、其余走精确融合检索。在 100K 上下文、并发 128 下 GLM-5.3 + DFlash2 达到每解码 GPU 793 output tokens/s，为 HiSparse 的 1.45 倍、非投机自适应服务的 1.27 倍。
Motivation: 长上下文服务先耗尽 KV 显存而非算力；HiSparse 用主机内存分层缓解，但对所有负载只用一个缓存预算，且不支持草稿模型式投机解码（DSpark、DFlash2）。
Method: 在分层稀疏 KV 上叠加投机解码：保留 DSpark/DFlash2 的提议与接受规则，多个 query 共享缺失行检索，草稿 KV 用窗口受限 ring，验证 staging 在层组间复用；常驻策略按负载自适应，保护必需工作集、显存空闲时多留历史、其余用精确融合检索取回。
Result: 100K 上下文、并发 128 时 GLM-5.3 + DFlash2 每解码 GPU 793 output tokens/s，为 HiSparse 的 1.45 倍、非投机自适应服务的 1.27 倍；在与 HiSparse 相同延迟上限下可支撑最高 4 倍并发、输出为 2.3 至 3.7 倍（随每 token 延迟上限而定）；DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 在 500K 上下文、并发 512 下，Adaptive DHiSparse + DSpark 的输出为常驻服务 + DSpark 的 1.85 倍；负载阶跃下可选常驻把主机取回比例从 14.2% 降到 1.4%（低负载、按选中行计），并在压力下释放内存。
Conclusion: 把投机解码与负载自适应常驻叠加到分层稀疏 KV 上，可在相同延迟约束下同时提高长上下文服务的吞吐与并发上限，且主机取回开销随负载自适应而大幅下降。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: GLIMPSE: Global-Local Indexing with Multi-Precision Spectral Encoding for Explorable Video World Models
papers.abstract_en: A camera-controlled video world model must keep a scene consistent when the camera returns to it. Memories that render stored features into the target frame can turn depth and pose errors into ghosting or duplicated structure. Positional transport avoids that resampling by relocating a historical patch's address rather than its content, but assigns full positional precision even to inaccurate projections. We present GLIMPSE, a global-local memory interface with band-wise multi-precision coordinates and geometry-conditioned spectral attenuation to reduce sensitivity to inaccurate projected addresses. Local patch memory supplies view-specific appearance, while recurrent global memory provides scene context. Footprint-guided retrieval selects historical patches under a fixed local read budget. Under matched retrieval and read budgets, GLIMPSE improves geometric correspondence and photometric consistency over deterministic positional transport.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GLIMPSE 是面向相机可控视频世界模型的全局-局部记忆接口：用按频带分配的多精度坐标 (band-wise multi-precision coordinates) 加几何条件谱衰减 (geometry-conditioned spectral attenuation) 降低对不准投影地址的敏感度，局部 patch 记忆供视角外观、循环全局记忆供场景上下文，足迹引导检索在固定局部读取预算下选历史 patch。在匹配检索与读取预算下，其几何对应与光度一致性优于确定性位置传输 (deterministic positional transport)。
Motivation: 把存储特征重采样渲染到目标帧的记忆方案会把深度与位姿误差放大成鬼影或重复结构；而位置传输虽避免重采样，却对本就不准的投影地址分配满额位置精度。
Method: 位置传输改为只搬历史 patch 的地址而非内容，并引入按频带的多精度坐标与几何条件谱衰减来抑制不准地址的影响；局部 patch 记忆提供视角特有外观，循环全局记忆提供场景上下文，足迹引导检索 (footprint-guided retrieval) 在固定局部读取预算下挑选历史 patch。
Result: 在匹配的检索与读取预算下，GLIMPSE 在几何对应 (geometric correspondence) 与光度一致性 (photometric consistency) 上均优于确定性位置传输基线。
Conclusion: 对投影地址按其可靠性分配位置精度并做谱衰减，能在不增加读取预算的前提下提升相机可控视频世界模型的场景一致性。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: A Baseline Assessment for the Agentic Web Technology Stack
papers.abstract_en: The fast pace in which protocols, frameworks, and technologies are being proposed for LLM-based agents results in a complex scenario for anyone aiming to create state-of-the-art AI solutions. Without an assessment on how different protocols, frameworks, and libraries work together to compose an Agentic Web solution, developers and organizations face different challenges (e.g., skilling, governance, infrastructure) even before becoming part of the Agentic Web ecosystem. In this context, we propose a system for performing Agentic Web evaluations called MASTIF (Multi-Agent System TestIng Framework) and present a baseline assessment of Agentic Web technologies, including 3 LLMs, 3 protocols, and 4 agent implementation frameworks, against 300 Mind2Web benchmark tasks. Results suggest that selecting a task-specific technology stack may result in gains of task completion rate, efficiency score, and social value stability scores; and reductions in verbosity and time to complete tasks. With the presented results, we expect to present a baseline in terms of metrics and results for this complex and fast evolving scenario for those aiming at designing, assessing, and developing multi-agent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MASTIF（Multi-Agent System TestIng Framework）评估 Agentic Web 技术栈，在 Mind2Web 的 300 个任务上组合测试 3 个 LLM、3 个协议与 4 个 agent 实现框架。结果表明按任务挑选技术栈可提升任务完成率、效率分数与社会价值稳定性分数，同时降低输出冗长度和完成任务耗时。
Motivation: LLM agent 的协议、框架与库更新极快，缺少它们如何协同构成 Agentic Web 方案的评估，开发者在进入生态前就面临技能、治理与基础设施障碍。
Method: 构建 MASTIF 多智能体系统测试框架，对 3 个 LLM、3 个协议、4 个 agent 实现框架做组合式基线评估，评测任务取自 Mind2Web benchmark 的 300 个任务，指标含任务完成率、效率分数、社会价值稳定性分数、冗长度与完成耗时。
Result: 在 Mind2Web 300 个任务上评估 3 个 LLM、3 个协议、4 个框架的组合：按任务选择技术栈带来任务完成率、效率分数与社会价值稳定性分数的提升，并使冗长度与任务完成时间下降。
Conclusion: Agentic Web 技术栈不存在通用最优解，任务特定的栈选择才能同时改善完成率与效率、压低冗余与耗时；作者以此给出该快速演化场景的指标与结果基线。

summary_sections.conclusion: Agentic Web 技术栈不存在通用最优解，任务特定的栈选择才能同时改善完成率与效率、压低冗余与耗时；作者以此给出该快速演化场景的指标与结果基线。

papers.title: Improving Semantic Coverage in AI Test & Evaluation through Generative Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: In test and evaluation (T&E) of AI models, evaluators typically have access only to a held-out test dataset and no knowledge of the training data or its semantic composition. If critical input conditions---such as time-of-day, weather, or scene location---are underrepresented in this test dataset, T&E results can be misleadingly due to this semantic coverage gap. We propose a three-stage generative AI pipeline to detect and fill such semantic gaps without requiring ground-truth labels of these semantics. First, vision-language models (VLMs) perform zero-shot binary labeling of semantic factors, and an embedding-space clustering step identifies which semantics most affect downstream model behavior. Second, diffusion-based image-to-image models transform existing covered images into the underrepresented semantic domain, preserving scene content while augmenting high-level appearance. Third, statistical analysis of the augmented image embeddings verifies that the synthetic imagery improves dataset coverage before it is incorporated. Crucially, the synthetic data is used only to enrich the test set and no model retraining is performed for T&E. We validate the full pipeline on both image classification and object detection under day/night semantic gaps, showing that the augmented test datasets better distinguish models with and without exposure to the missing semantic, thereby yielding T&E conclusions that more closely match those of an ideal, fully covered dataset. Code available at https://github.com/Hashe037/DEDUCE
papers.comment: 21 pages total, previously published at Society of Photo-Optical Instrumentation Engineers (SPIE) Conference Series, Volume 14046
papers.journal_ref: Hashemi, Connor, et al. "Improving semantic coverage in AI test and evaluation through generative augmentation." Society of Photo-Optical Instrumentation Engineers (SPIE) Conference Series. Vol. 14046. 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在只有测试集、不知训练数据语义构成的 AI 测试评估 (T&E) 中，提出三阶段生成式流水线检测并填补语义覆盖缺口：VLM 零样本标注语义因子并用嵌入聚类定位影响下游行为的语义，扩散模型把已有图像改写到欠表示语义域，再用统计分析验证覆盖提升后才并入测试集。合成数据只扩充测试集、不重训模型；在图像分类与目标检测的昼/夜语义缺口上，扩充后的测试集更能区分见过与没见过该语义的模型，使 T&E 结论更接近理想全覆盖数据集。
Motivation: 评估方通常只有留出测试集，不知道训练数据及其语义构成；当时间、天气、场景位置等关键输入条件在测试集中欠表示时，T&E 结果会被语义覆盖缺口误导。
Method: 三阶段流水线：先用视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 对语义因子做零样本二分类标注，再在嵌入空间聚类以找出最影响下游模型行为的语义；随后用扩散式 image-to-image 模型把已覆盖图像转换到欠表示语义域，保持场景内容、只改高层外观；最后对增强后图像嵌入做统计分析，验证覆盖确实改善后才并入测试集。合成数据仅用于丰富测试集，T&E 过程不重训任何模型。
Result: 在图像分类与目标检测两个任务上、以昼/夜语义缺口为验证场景，扩充后的测试集能更好区分接触过与未接触该缺失语义的模型，所得 T&E 结论更贴近理想全覆盖数据集的表现；摘要给出的是定性比较结论。
Conclusion: 无需语义真值标签、也不动模型权重，仅靠生成式增强测试集就能纠正语义覆盖缺口导致的误导性评估结论；代码在 github.com/Hashe037/DEDUCE 开源。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Calibration in One Go: Jointly Learning Accurate and Calibrated Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks (NNs), while highly flexible and versatile, are often poorly calibrated. Post-hoc calibration methods adjust the outputs of an already trained model using a separate calibration dataset and additional calibration parameters. This process adds overhead that requires separate optimization of the calibrator and subsequent model selection. In this paper, we show that standard (post-hoc) calibrators can be trained end-to-end with the backbone via a bilevel Stackelberg formulation. This formulation eliminates the need for a separate calibration set or a dedicated calibration loss by jointly optimizing accuracy and calibration using cross-entropy, introducing only one additional hyperparameter: the calibrator learning rate. Although our framework supports calibrators ranging from temperature and matrix scaling to NN layers, our results show that using the final classification layer itself as the calibrator yields accurate, well-calibrated models with no additional parameters. Our approach outperforms SOTA calibrators with minimal added complexity, while also avoiding the multiplicative overhead of separate calibration components in settings such as multi-task learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把事后校准器与骨干网络用双层 Stackelberg 博弈端到端联合训练，用交叉熵同时优化精度与校准，无需独立校准集和专门校准损失，只引入校准器学习率一个超参数。直接把最终分类层当作校准器即可得到准确且校准良好的模型且不增参数，并以极小复杂度超过 SOTA 校准器。
Motivation: 事后校准需要单独的校准数据集和额外校准参数，校准器与模型要分开优化再做模型选择，开销在多任务学习等场景下还会相乘放大。
Method: 用双层 Stackelberg (bilevel) 公式把标准事后校准器（temperature scaling、matrix scaling 到 NN layer）与骨干端到端联合训练，以交叉熵同时优化精度与校准，省去独立校准集与专门校准损失，仅新增校准器学习率一个超参数；最优配置直接用最终分类层充当校准器。
Result: 在所评估的设置下超过 SOTA 校准器且新增复杂度极小；用最终分类层作校准器得到准确且校准良好的模型，不引入额外参数，并避免多任务学习等场景中独立校准组件的乘性开销。
Conclusion: 校准不必作为训练后的独立步骤：与骨干联合优化即可同时拿到精度和校准，且最简实现（复用分类层）就够。

papers.title: Variance-Reduced Policy Gradient is Nearly Minimax-Optimal
papers.abstract_en: Standard Policy Gradient (PG) algorithms suffer from high estimation variance because they rely on Monte Carlo updates. While off-policy variance reduction mitigates this problem, establishing optimal sample complexity currently requires either restrictive assumptions, such as uniformly bounded importance weights, or impractical second-order operations. In this work, we introduce Loopless Variance-Reduced PG (LVR-PG), a unified theoretical framework that abstracts a class of first-order estimators that integrate recursive updates with defensive importance sampling, including known estimators such as PAGE-PG and STORM-PG. We prove that this algorithmic class achieves $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(ε^{-2})$ last-iterate global convergence under weak gradient domination for general parametric policies. We establish this guarantee using purely first-order updates, with minimal assumptions and without gradient preconditioners. By extending state-of-the-art lower bounds to continuous parametric policies, we establish an $Ω(ε^{-2})$ sample complexity limit, confirming our framework is minimax-optimal up to logarithmic factors and horizon terms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Loopless Variance-Reduced PG (LVR-PG)：一个统一的一阶方差缩减策略梯度框架，抽象了递归更新加防御性重要性采样 (defensive importance sampling) 的一类估计器，涵盖 PAGE-PG 与 STORM-PG。在弱梯度支配 (weak gradient domination) 下对一般参数化策略证明末次迭代全局收敛为 õ(ε^{-2})，并把已有下界推广到连续参数化策略得到 Ω(ε^{-2})，即在对数因子与 horizon 项内 minimax 最优。
Motivation: 标准 PG 依赖 Monte Carlo 更新导致估计方差高；现有方差缩减的最优样本复杂度假设要么要求重要性权重一致有界，要么需要不实用的二阶操作。
Method: LVR-PG 作为统一理论框架，把递归更新与防御性重要性采样结合的一阶估计器类抽象出来（含 PAGE-PG、STORM-PG）；收敛保证只用纯一阶更新、无梯度预条件器，假设尽量弱；下界通过把已有结果推广到连续参数化策略得到。
Result: 弱梯度支配下一般参数化策略的末次迭代全局收敛为 õ(ε^{-2})；样本复杂度下界 Ω(ε^{-2})，框架在对数因子与 horizon 项内 minimax 最优。
Conclusion: 方差缩减 PG 可以在纯一阶、弱假设条件下达到 minimax 最优样本复杂度，无需一致有界重要性权重或二阶操作。

papers.title: Transformer-based In-Context Score Operator Learning for Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models typically learn the generative dynamics of a single target distribution or a family of distributions indexed by conditioning variables fixed during training. This limits their ability to adapt to a previously unseen distribution from only a small set of examples. We introduce an in-context solution operator learning framework for diffusion models, in which each target distribution is treated as a task drawn from a meta-distribution and is specified at inference time by an empirical context set. Our method learns an in-context score operator that maps the context samples, a noisy query point, and the diffusion time to the task-dependent score, enabling reverse-diffusion sampling on unseen tasks without retraining or parameter updates. A key observation is that the task-dependent score admits a Gaussian-kernel conditional-mean representation. Its empirical Nadaraya--Watson approximation can be represented exactly by a model in our constructed transformer class, providing a principled foundation for the proposed query-dependent attention architecture. The operator is trained through amortized denoising score matching across task distributions. We establish generalization-error bounds that quantify the effects of the context size, the numbers of training tasks and within-task samples, model complexity, and intrinsic and ambient dimensions. Numerically, we evaluate the method on a range of scientific and visual datasets, including Navier-Stokes, ERA5 climate data, QuickDraw sketches, and Food-101. The results show that the proposed method performs well on relatively simple task families, while its performance degrades as task complexity increases, thereby illustrating both the promise and the limitations of in-context learning for diffusion models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出扩散模型的 in-context score operator 学习框架：把每个目标分布当作一个任务，用 Transformer 学习从上下文样本、含噪查询点和扩散时间到任务相关 score 的算子，从而在未见任务上免重训采样。理论上给出泛化误差界，数值上在 Navier-Stokes、ERA5、QuickDraw、Food-101 上表现随任务族复杂度上升而退化。
Motivation: 扩散模型通常只学单一目标分布或训练时条件变量固定的一族分布，难以仅凭少量样本适应未见过的分布。
Method: 把每个目标分布视为 meta-distribution 抽出的任务，由推理时的经验上下文集指定；构造 query-dependent attention 的 Transformer 类，其可精确表示任务相关 score 的 Gaussian-kernel 条件均值的 Nadaraya--Watson 经验近似；训练用跨任务分布的 amortized denoising score matching，并建立含上下文规模、训练任务数与任务内样本数、模型复杂度、内在与环境维度的泛化误差界。
Result: 在 Navier-Stokes、ERA5 气候数据、QuickDraw 草图与 Food-101 等科学与视觉数据集上评测：方法在相对简单的任务族上表现良好，随任务复杂度增加性能退化。
Conclusion: in-context score operator 让扩散模型在未见任务上免参数更新采样，且有泛化界支撑，但其收益在任务族变复杂时明显衰减。

papers.title: VQIL: Visible Quantum Interference Learning for Perturbation Response Ranking on Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Learning how local perturbations affect a network is important for identifying which components drive or absorb a system's response. We formulate this as seed-conditioned response ranking: given a perturbation at one seed node, ranking all other nodes by response strength. This is challenging when the model is given only the interaction topology, while the mechanism governing how perturbations propagate must be learned from data. We present VQIL (Visible Quantum Interference Learning), a trainable Szegedy quantum walk for seed-conditioned ranking. Edge weights, link phases, and per-node phase rotations are optimized end-to-end by backpropagation while the walk operator remains unitary throughout training. Node scores are obtained from a geometrically discounted coherent sum of quantum-walk amplitudes, enabling quantum interference before the final squared-norm readout. Because each learned parameter is attached to a named edge or node, the trained model provides directly inspectable hypotheses about the roles of individual graph components in the propagation mechanism. On AC power-flow perturbations over six transmission grids, with electrical parameters withheld from the model, VQIL improves Spearman rank correlation from 0.147 for the untrained walk to 0.831 and outperforms an identically trained random-walk model. On gene perturbation over five protein-protein interaction networks with Perturb-seq supervision, VQIL improves rank correlation from 0.171 to 0.620, outperforming the strongest learned classical and neural baselines. These results show that trainable quantum-walk interference provides a scalable and interpretable inductive bias for learning seed-conditioned response rankings on graphs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VQIL 把 Szegedy quantum walk 变成可训练模型：边权、链路相位与逐节点相位旋转端到端反向传播优化，且训练全程保持 walk 算子幺正，节点得分取几何折扣的量子振幅相干和再取模平方，从而在读出前产生量子干涉。在六个输电网的 AC 潮流扰动（电气参数对模型隐藏）上 Spearman 秩相关从未训练 walk 的 0.147 提到 0.831，并优于同法训练的 random-walk 模型；在五个蛋白互作网络的 Perturb-seq 基因扰动上从 0.171 提到 0.620，超过最强的经典与神经基线。
Motivation: 只给交互拓扑、机制需从数据学的条件下，按种子节点扰动对其余节点响应强度排序很困难；现有方法难以在保持可解释性的同时学出传播机制。
Method: VQIL (Visible Quantum Interference Learning)：可训练的 Szegedy quantum walk，边权、link phases、per-node phase rotations 由反向传播端到端优化，walk 算子训练中保持 unitary；节点得分来自几何折扣的量子游走振幅相干和，最后做 squared-norm readout，每个参数绑定到具名边或节点以提供可检视假设。
Result: AC 潮流扰动、六个输电网、电气参数隐藏：Spearman 秩相关 0.147（未训练 walk）→ 0.831，并优于同法训练的 random-walk 模型。基因扰动、五个蛋白互作网络、Perturb-seq 监督：秩相关 0.171 → 0.620，超过最强的经典与神经基线。
Conclusion: 可训练量子游走干涉是学习图上种子条件响应排序的可扩展且可解释的归纳偏置，参数绑定使训练后模型直接给出图组件角色的可检视假设。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.tldr: VQIL 把 Szegedy quantum walk 变成可训练模型：边权、链路相位与逐节点相位旋转端到端反向传播优化，且训练全程保持 walk 算子幺正，节点得分取几何折扣的量子振幅相干和再取模平方，从而在读出前产生量子干涉。在六个输电网的 AC 潮流扰动（电气参数对模型隐藏）上 Spearman 秩相关从未训练 walk 的 0.147 提到 0.831，并优于同法训练的 random-walk 模型；在五个蛋白互作网络的 Perturb-seq 基因扰动上从 0.171 提到 0.620，超过最强的经典与神经基线。

papers.title: X-AVDD: Cross-Attentive Audio-Visual Dataset Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Audio-visual dataset distillation aims to synthesize a small dataset from a large paired audio-visual dataset, while nearly preserving the training utility for neural networks. Existing approaches such as DM and AVDD face two critical limitations: 1) they are memory-intensive, making them difficult to scale to complex architectures and higher samples-per-class (SPC) settings, and 2) they often fail to preserve strong cross-modal semantic correspondence. To tackle these issues, we propose X-AVDD, a cross-attention-based distillation method that explicitly captures inter-modal relationships during synthesis. By decoupling cross-modal alignment from joint optimization, X-AVDD is substantially more memory-efficient, reducing end-to-end synthesis cost by $\sim 8\times$ GPU-hours, while producing highly aligned synthetic data. Empirically, X-AVDD significantly outperforms other audio-visual distillation methods. On VGGSound, an audio-visual dataset of short YouTube clips, X-AVDD improves top-1 test accuracy from $8.2\%\rightarrow24.0\%$ at SPC=$10$ and $9.8\%\rightarrow26.5\%$ at SPC=$20$. Furthermore, X-AVDD improves cross-architecture generalization (e.g., $25.5\%\rightarrow35.3\%$ for a ViT target on AVE dataset at SPC $=50$) and successfully scales to complex architectures such as AudioCLIP, achieving $62.3\%$ accuracy using only $5.65\%$ of the full dataset, against the full dataset accuracy of $72.4\%$ while completing in $9\times$ lower training time compared to the full dataset.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Camera-ready version forthcoming. 17 pages, 6 figures, 16 tables

Conclusion: 把跨模态对齐从联合优化中解耦出来，可在音视频数据集蒸馏中同时换取显存效率、跨架构泛化与对复杂架构的可扩展性。

papers.title: PhysForge: Material-Controllable 3D Reconstruction with Separable Components
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in physical 3D generation have enabled visually faithful assets with simulatable mechanical behavior. However, existing methods provide limited control over material behavior beyond appearance-based inference and struggle to estimate physical properties from complex interactions between objects and semantic parts. Therefore, we present PhysForge, a Video Diffusion Model (VDM)-based framework for addressing these challenges, comprising two complementary modules for material-controllable physical fitting and componentlevel interaction modeling. The first, PhysFit, leverages material-conditioned VDM dynamics as references for physical-property fitting, introducing windowed fitting to focus on material-revealing interactions and Hallucinated Forcing to disentangle nonphysical motion hallucinated by the VDM from material responses. The second, PhysComp decomposes complex interactions into individual objects and semantic components, enabling their physical parameters to be optimized independently and flexibly composed for joint simulation. Experiments on PhysAssets and Google Scanned Objects demonstrate that, compared with existing methods, PhysForge provides stronger control over material-dependent physical responses while supporting component-level physical modeling for complex interactions. It achieves the best CLIP and physical controllability scores on both common and uncommon materials, with qualitative comparisons, component-level ablations, and a user study further supporting these improvements. Our project page is available at https://masterwanna.github.io/PhysForge.html .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhysForge 用视频扩散模型 (VDM) 做材质可控的物理 3D 重建：PhysFit 以材质条件化的 VDM 动力学为参考拟合物理属性，用窗口化拟合聚焦揭示材质的交互，并用 Hallucinated Forcing 剥离 VDM 生成的非物理运动幻觉；PhysComp 把复杂交互拆成单物体与语义部件，独立优化物理参数后再组合联合仿真。在 PhysAssets 与 Google Scanned Objects 上，它在常见与罕见材质上均取得最佳 CLIP 与物理可控性分数。
Motivation: 现有物理 3D 生成只能从外观推断材质，难以从物体与语义部件间的复杂交互中估计物理属性，材质行为可控性弱。
Method: 基于 Video Diffusion Model 的两模块框架：PhysFit 用材质条件化 VDM 动力学作为物理属性拟合的参考，引入窗口化拟合 (windowed fitting) 只取揭示材质的交互片段，并用 Hallucinated Forcing 将 VDM 幻觉出的非物理运动与真实材质响应解耦；PhysComp 把复杂交互分解为独立物体与语义部件，各自优化物理参数后灵活组合做联合仿真。
Result: 在 PhysAssets 与 Google Scanned Objects 两个数据集上，PhysForge 在常见与罕见材质上均取得最佳 CLIP 分数与物理可控性分数；另有定性对比、部件级消融与用户研究支持其改进。
Conclusion: 把材质条件化的视频生成当作物理拟合参考、并把交互拆到部件级独立优化，能同时增强材质相关物理响应的可控性与复杂交互的部件级物理建模。

papers.title: On the Encoding of Calendar Features in Covariate-Informed Time Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) increasingly offer covariate support, with calendar information being the most common type of categorical covariate in practice, as it is available for every point in time. However, how these features are encoded is largely treated as an implementation detail rather than as an object of study, despite encoding being one of the few design choices left for pretrained models at inference time. With the present study, we demonstrate that the way information is propagated into the model substantially affects forecast accuracy of TSFMs. Therefore, we systematically compare seven calendar encodings, including three conventional target-agnostic representations (ordinal, one-hot, and cyclic) and four target encodings, across four state-of-the-art TSFMs on nine datasets from multiple domains in a zero-shot rolling evaluation. The nine datasets are influenced by social activities, such as weekends and holidays, making calendar information particularly relevant for forecasting. We find that encoding choice affects forecast accuracy across all models, with MASE differences of up to 9.9 % on non-holidays and 83 % on holidays within a single model. Effectiveness and utilization vary substantially across models. Improvements are concentrated around holidays, where calendar information provides signals unavailable from target history, while some model encoding combinations also improve non-holiday forecasts. A SHAP-based attribution analysis locates the contribution of the covariates relative to the autoregressive component and explains why some model-encoding combinations degrade performance. Our findings suggest that current benchmarks for covariate-informed TSFMs can distort model comparisons by imposing fixed encoding strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 时间序列基础模型 (TSFM) 的日历协变量编码方式会实质改变零样本预报精度：在四个 SOTA TSFM、九个受周末与节假日影响的数据集上系统比较七种编码，同一模型内 MASE 差异在非节假日最高 9.9%、节假日最高 83%。节假日是收益集中处，因为日历提供了目标历史中不存在的信号；SHAP 归因定位了协变量相对自回归分量的贡献，并解释了部分模型-编码组合为何反而变差。
Motivation: 日历特征的编码在 TSFM 中被当作实现细节，但它是预训练模型在推理时仅剩的设计自由度之一；若基准固定编码策略，会扭曲模型之间的比较。
Method: 比较七种日历编码：ordinal、one-hot、cyclic 三种目标无关表示，加四种 target encoding；在四个 SOTA TSFM、九个多领域数据集上做 zero-shot rolling evaluation，并用 SHAP 归因把协变量贡献与自回归分量对比。
Result: 编码选择在所有模型上都影响预报精度，单一模型内 MASE 差异最高达 9.9%（非节假日）与 83%（节假日）；效果与利用程度因模型而异，改进集中在节假日，部分模型-编码组合也能改善非节假日预报，另有组合使性能下降。
Conclusion: 日历编码是影响 TSFM 精度的实质设计选择而非实现细节，现有协变量 TSFM 基准因固定编码策略会扭曲模型比较。

papers.title: Can Multimodal Decision Models Classify Breast Ultrasound Images? Benchmarking CLEF and CLEF-Flash Across Prompts and Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal decision models return probabilities over predefined alternatives, offering a structured interface for image classification. This study benchmarks inference with CLEF and CLEF-Flash on 2818 breast ultrasound images from Dataset B, BUSI, and BUS-BRA. Dataset B and BUS-BRA use binary benign-malignant classification, whereas BUSI includes normal, benign, and malignant categories. Model parameters remain unchanged, and original images are submitted without user-defined preprocessing. Three prompts provide minimal labels, an explicit classification task, or sonographic criteria. We report accuracy, macro F1, balanced accuracy, macro precision, throughput, and latency. CLEF-Flash with the clinical prompt achieves the highest accuracy on all three datasets: 74.85% on Dataset B, 66.28% on BUSI, and 51.63% on BUS-BRA. On BUSI, however, CLEF with the task-guided prompt achieves the highest macro F1 (64.51%) and balanced accuracy (68.72%). CLEF-Flash has lower latency in every matched comparison. Clinical instructions improve CLEF-Flash accuracy relative to the minimal prompt but reduce CLEF accuracy on all datasets. Confusion matrices reveal frequent benign-to-malignant errors, particularly on BUS-BRA, where all configurations fall below the 67.63% accuracy of a majority-class predictor. These findings demonstrate dataset-and prompt-dependent performance and motivate class-specific evaluation before applying multimodal decision models to breast ultrasound analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 2818 张乳腺超声图像上基准测试多模态决策模型 CLEF 与 CLEF-Flash 的推理表现：临床提示使 CLEF-Flash 在三个数据集上取得最高准确率（Dataset B 74.85%、BUSI 66.28%、BUS-BRA 51.63%），却在全部数据集上降低 CLEF 的准确率。BUS-BRA 上所有配置都低于多数类基线 67.63%，且常见良性误判为恶性，因此作者主张在用于乳腺超声分析前先做类别别评估。
Motivation: 多模态决策模型以预定义选项概率的形式做图像分类，但其在医学超声上的表现对数据集与提示写法高度敏感，且缺少按类别拆分的评估，直接部署可能掩盖系统性误判。
Method: 对 CLEF 与 CLEF-Flash 做零参数改动的推理基准，直接提交原始图像、不做用户自定义预处理；在 Dataset B、BUSI、BUS-BRA 共 2818 张乳腺超声图像上比较三种提示（仅标签、显式分类任务、超声诊断标准），报告 accuracy、macro F1、balanced accuracy、macro precision、throughput 与 latency，并查看混淆矩阵。
Result: CLEF-Flash 配临床提示在三个数据集上准确率最高：Dataset B 74.85%、BUSI 66.28%、BUS-BRA 51.63%；BUSI 上 CLEF 配任务引导提示取得最高 macro F1 64.51% 与 balanced accuracy 68.72%。CLEF-Flash 在每一组配对比较中延迟更低；临床提示相对最小提示提升 CLEF-Flash 准确率但降低 CLEF 准确率。BUS-BRA 上所有配置均低于多数类预测器的 67.63% 准确率，混淆矩阵显示良性被判为恶性的错误频繁。
Conclusion: 多模态决策模型在乳腺超声上的表现是数据集与提示依赖的，应用前必须做类别别评估，尤其在 BUS-BRA 这类连多数类基线都打不过的场景。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Not All Dimensions Are Equal: Outlier-Aware Attention Linearization with Grouped Quadratic Kernels
papers.abstract_en: Linearizing softmax attention offers a route to efficient Transformer inference, but preserving pretrained attention remains challenging. We identify an important source of approximation error overlooked by standard linearization methods: a small number of outlier dimensions contribute disproportionately to query-key dot products and account for a large fraction of the approximation error. Motivated by this heterogeneity, we propose Outlier-Aware Attention Linearization (OAL), a dimension-aware method for constructing quadratic attention approximations. Starting from a second-order Taylor approximation, we introduce a Hadamard-product formulation that makes individual query-key contributions explicit. This formulation relaxes globally shared coefficients to support dimension-specific linear terms and cross-dimensional quadratic interactions while preserving separable evaluation. To retain this flexibility with fewer parameters, OAL groups dimensions with similar contribution scales to share coefficients, while allowing distinct treatment of the few outliers. The resulting positive quadratic kernel is calibrated against pretrained attention outputs and admits linear-time evaluation with respect to sequence length for fixed head dimensions. On Qwen2.5-0.5B, OAL reduces frozen-attention output relative MSE by approximately 8.9% compared with DiJiang. Replacing middle-layer attention modules and jointly fine-tuning the kernel coefficients with LoRA further lowers WikiText-103 perplexity from 31.71 to 27.50 compared with a learned global quadratic, while improving accuracy on PIQA, HellaSwag, and ARC-E. These results demonstrate the value of outlier-aware dimension grouping for both attention approximation and pretrained-model conversion. The code is available at https://github.com/wuqianyue09/OAL

Method: 从二阶 Taylor 近似出发，引入 Hadamard 积形式使单个 query-key 贡献显式化，把全局共享系数放松为维度特定线性项与跨维二次交互，同时保持可分离求值；按贡献尺度对维度分组共享系数、对少数 outlier 单独处理，得到正二次核，针对预训练注意力输出校准，在固定头维度下对序列长度为线性复杂度。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-0.5B 上，OAL 相比 DiJiang 将冻结注意力输出相对 MSE 降低约 8.9%；替换中间层注意力模块并与 LoRA 联合微调核系数后，WikiText-103 perplexity 从 31.71 降至 27.50（对比 learned global quadratic），同时 PIQA、HellaSwag、ARC-E 准确率提升。

papers.title: Inject a Turn, Not a Token: Learning Where to Redirect LLM Reasoning for Self-Correction
papers.abstract_en: Large language models struggle to reliably identify and correct errors in their own reasoning. Unlike prior training-based approaches that fine-tune an LLM to generate revisions or feedback, we learn where to intervene in failed rollouts and determine how to redirect them. To choose where to intervene, we train a 130K-parameter MLP head on a frozen encoder using only final-answer correctness. For redirection, we find that under a fixed generation budget, the tested inline injections fail to reliably redirect reasoning, whereas presenting the same instruction in a new user turn changes the model's course. The resulting correction framework, UPTURN (User-Prompt TURN injection at a learned position), requires no LLM fine-tuning: it retains a selected prefix, injects an instruction as a new user turn, and regenerates the suffix. Across four reasoners and six math benchmarks, UPTURN improves average accuracy in every setting over a 32-rollout baseline. It outperforms self-correction and reflection-token injection baselines under matched correction budgets, transfers across reasoners and to GPQA-Diamond without retraining, and complements GRPO and self-correction methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UPTURN 不微调 LLM，而是用一个 130K 参数的 MLP 头在冻结编码器上仅凭最终答案对错学出失败 rollout 中的干预位置，再把纠正指令作为新的 user turn 注入以重定向推理。在四个 reasoner、六个数学基准上，其平均准确率在每种设置中都超过 32-rollout 基线，并在匹配纠正预算下胜过 self-correction 与 reflection-token 注入。
Motivation: LLM 难以可靠识别并修正自身推理错误；既有方法靠微调生成修订或反馈，成本高且泛化差，而固定生成预算下常见的 inline 注入无法可靠改变推理走向。
Method: 冻结编码器上训练 130K 参数 MLP 头，仅用最终答案正确性预测失败 rollout 的干预位置；保留选定前缀、把指令作为新 user turn 注入、重新生成后缀，全程不微调 LLM。
Result: 在四个 reasoner 与六个数学基准上，UPTURN 在每种设置中平均准确率均高于 32-rollout 基线；在匹配纠正预算下优于 self-correction 与 reflection-token 注入基线；无需重训练即可跨 reasoner 迁移并迁移到 GPQA-Diamond，且与 GRPO 及 self-correction 方法互补。
Conclusion: 改变推理走向的关键是注入位置与注入形式（新 user turn 而非 inline token），因此不微调模型也能实现可靠自纠错并跨模型、跨任务迁移。

papers.title: A Step Harder, Not a Step Too Far: The Benefits and Limits of Curriculum Difficulty Progression in GRPO
papers.abstract_en: Curriculum learning typically organizes training samples from easy to hard. In GRPO, medium-difficulty samples are attractive for online selection because they are more likely to yield informative group-relative learning signals, and prioritizing them can improve training efficiency. However, it remains unclear whether persistently selecting such samples also leads to the strongest final model performance, or whether training can benefit from progressing toward harder samples. Meanwhile, sample difficulty changes as the policy evolves, so fixed difficulty estimates can become misaligned with the current policy. We therefore re-estimate sample difficulty under the current policy and, inspired by the easy-to-hard principle of curriculum learning, design and evaluate a staged curriculum that progressively shifts the active difficulty band toward harder samples. Experiments on GSM8K show that persistent medium-difficulty selection does not achieve the strongest observed performance. Across three random seeds, progressing to a moderately harder difficulty band improves test accuracy to $0.6591 \pm 0.0077$, compared with $0.6449 \pm 0.0024$ for the fixed-medium curriculum. However, further progression to a harder difficulty band reduces accuracy to $0.6405 \pm 0.0053$. These results show that staged difficulty progression can outperform persistent medium-difficulty selection, but its benefit is non-monotonic. Effective GRPO curricula can therefore benefit from progressing beyond medium difficulty, while avoiding excessive progression toward overly difficult samples.}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 GRPO 在线选样中，固定选中等难度样本并非最优：随策略演化重估难度、并分阶段把活跃难度带推向更难样本，GSM8K 测试准确率从 0.6449±0.0024 提到 0.6591±0.0077（三个随机种子）。但收益非单调，继续推进到更难难度带后准确率回落到 0.6405±0.0053，因此课程应越过中等难度但止步于过难样本。
Motivation: GRPO 在线选样偏好中等难度样本以获得信息量更大的组相对学习信号，但持续选中等难度是否带来最强最终性能并不清楚；且样本难度随策略演化而变，固定难度估计会与当前策略失配。
Method: 在当前策略下重新估计样本难度，借鉴课程学习由易到难原则设计分阶段课程 (staged curriculum)，把活跃难度带逐步推向更难样本，并与固定中等难度课程对比评估。
Result: GSM8K 上，三个随机种子下推进到中等偏难难度带的测试准确率为 0.6591±0.0077，固定中等难度课程为 0.6449±0.0024；继续推进到更难难度带后降至 0.6405±0.0053。持续选中等难度样本未取得观察到的最强性能。
Conclusion: 分阶段难度推进可胜过持续中等难度选样，但收益非单调：有效 GRPO 课程应越过中等难度，同时避免推进过度而落入过难样本。

papers.title: A Multi-Agent LLM System for Automated Tuning of Specialized Neural Network Models
papers.abstract_en: Many machine learning approaches are two-level: an expert selects a class of methods, within this class the choice of key components is critical and usually manual. This paper addresses the automatic tuning of these components and proposes a framework transferable across models of different nature. The multi-agent large language model (LLM) framework has three roles---analyst, coder, and recorder~---with an experiment log and a sandboxed execution environment. Unlike systems that optimize the entire ML script or search architectures in a discrete space, the framework operates over an open but semantically narrow space: the agent generates code only for the specified components, leaving the overall network structure unchanged. The approach is validated in two directions: tuning a classification spiking neural network with correlation learning, and solving high-order differential equations with Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINN). Across five tasks---spiking classification on MNIST and Digits, and boundary-value problems for the generalized nonlinear Schrödinger equation (GNLSE) and Kuramoto--Sivashinsky (KS) equations---the agent outperforms the baselines: classification accuracy is 13 percentage points (MNIST) and 6 percentage points (Digits) higher; the error against the analytical single-soliton solution is reduced approximately 2491-fold; the invariant-preservation error drops approximately 325-fold in the selected GNLSE run with a Gaussian perturbation and by more than 100-fold on average over repeated initializations; and the mass drift drops 14-fold for the KS problem with a Gaussian perturbation. The framework thus tunes key components on tasks of different nature without changing its internal structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出三角色（analyst、coder、recorder）多-agent LLM 框架，在实验日志与沙箱执行环境中只对指定组件生成代码、不改动整体网络结构，从而跨模型类型自动调参。在 MNIST、Digits 与 GNLSE、KS 方程共五个任务上超过基线：分类准确率分别高 13 和 6 个百分点，单孤子解析解误差约降 2491 倍，KS 质量漂移降 14 倍。
Motivation: 两段式机器学习流程中，专家选定方法类之后关键组件的选择仍靠手工，且现有自动方法多针对整段脚本或离散架构搜索，缺少在语义狭窄的开放代码空间内只调指定组件的通用框架。
Method: 多-agent LLM 框架设 analyst、coder、recorder 三种角色，配实验日志与沙箱执行环境；agent 只为指定组件生成代码，保持网络总体结构不变。验证方向为带相关性学习的脉冲神经网络分类，以及用 PINN 求解高阶微分方程。
Result: 五个任务上超过基线：MNIST 分类准确率高 13 个百分点，Digits 高 6 个百分点；对解析单孤子解的误差约降 2491 倍；GNLSE 在高斯扰动选定运行中不变量保持误差降约 325 倍、多次初始化平均降 100 倍以上；KS 问题高斯扰动下质量漂移降 14 倍。
Conclusion: 只调指定组件而不改整体结构的 LLM 调参框架，可在性质不同的任务（脉冲网络分类与 PINN 微分方程）上复用同一内部结构并取得一致改进。

papers.title: Pretraining and Test-Time Training Budgets Matter for ARC: A Controlled Study of VARC and TRM
papers.abstract_en: The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) is increasingly used to evaluate whether neural networks can infer task-specific transformations from few demonstrations. Recent ARC models differ in architecture, but also in broader training and evaluation protocols, including pretraining data, data augmentation, test-time setup, and optimization budgets, making conclusions about architecture benefits debatable. In this work, we study how the performance of the vision-inspired VARC and recursion-based TRM models is affected by pretraining and test-time training (TTT) budgets under a common inductive protocol on ARC-AGI-1. We cross five pretraining budgets with four TTT budgets for each test task. Each budget specifies a task-variant count and total sample presentations, defining the controlled training budgets. We observe that increasing TTT sample presentations improves the standard ARC pass@2 metric in all settings for both models. Increasing the TTT task-variant count consistently helps only TRM, whereas VARC often performs better with fewer variants. VARC also remains competitive without pretraining, while TRM benefits much more from it. These results show that pretraining and TTT budgets affect ARC evaluation and motivate reporting at comparable budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ARC-AGI-1 上用统一归纳协议交叉 5 档预训练预算与 4 档测试时训练 (TTT) 预算，控制任务变体数与总样本呈现次数，比较视觉启发的 VARC 与递归式 TRM。增加 TTT 样本呈现次数在两种模型的全部设置下都提升 pass@2；增加任务变体数只对 TRM 稳定有益，而 VARC 往往用更少变体更好。
Motivation: ARC 模型之间架构、预训练数据、增广、测试时设置与优化预算各不相同，导致架构优劣的结论难以比较，需要在共同协议下把预算作为受控变量。
Method: 在 ARC-AGI-1 上对 VARC 与 TRM 采用统一归纳协议，交叉 5 档预训练预算与每测试任务 4 档 TTT 预算；每档预算由任务变体数 (task-variant count) 与总样本呈现次数 (total sample presentations) 定义，以此构成受控训练预算。
Result: 提高 TTT 样本呈现次数在两种模型的所有设置下都提升标准 ARC pass@2；提高 TTT 任务变体数仅对 TRM 一致有效，VARC 常在更少变体下表现更好；VARC 在无预训练时仍有竞争力，TRM 从预训练中获益大得多。
Conclusion: 预训练与 TTT 预算会实质影响 ARC 评测结果，因此报告架构结论时应在可比预算下进行。

papers.title: Scalable Sparse Autoregressive Variational Inference for Non-Gaussian Spatial Fields
papers.abstract_en: Latent field models are essential for spatial statistics, but the posterior distribution of the latent field, even with a Gaussian process (GP) prior, is analytically intractable whenever the likelihood is non-Gaussian. Existing approximations are either too slow or too restrictive for large non-Gaussian datasets. We present a scalable variational inference framework that mirrors the sparse nearest-neighbor autoregressive structure of the prior in the variational family, uses normalizing-flow conditionals for expressiveness, and amortizes all variational parameters via a single shared neural conditioner. Doubly stochastic optimization with reduced ancestor sets achieves polylogarithmic complexity per iteration.

papers.title: TabReliBench: Evaluating Tabular Foundation Models Beyond Predictive Accuracy
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are increasingly popular for their strong predictive performance. Many also provide posterior predictive distributions (PPDs), whose reliability remains less studied. We assess reliability through point prediction, distributional quality, marginal and subgroup calibration, and interval efficiency. We then introduce TabReliBench, a large classification and regression benchmark for these comparisons and dataset-level analyses. We find that TFMs' rankings change between TabArena and our benchmark and across reliability metrics. Regression TFMs usually achieve near-nominal marginal coverage and retain narrow intervals, but this favorable marginal behavior does not imply valid conditional coverage. Dataset-level analyses show that classification difficulty often accompanies poor calibration, whereas regression predictive performance is not a reliable indicator of calibration. Ensembling improves predictive performance but does not consistently improve calibration of PPDs; TFMs also benefit little from conformal post-processing, which does not reliably resolve subgroup gaps. Reliable TFM selection therefore requires multidimensional evaluation beyond aggregate rankings. Code is available at https://github.com/Tianqi-Zhao/TabReliBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TabReliBench 用点预测、分布质量、边缘与子群校准、区间效率四个维度评估表格基础模型 (TFM) 的后验预测分布 (PPD) 可靠性。发现 TFM 排名在 TabArena 与本基准之间以及不同可靠性指标之间都会改变；回归 TFM 边缘覆盖接近名义值且区间窄，但不代表条件覆盖有效；集成提升预测却不一致改善校准，conformal 后处理对子群差距作用有限。结论是选 TFM 必须做超越聚合排名的多维评估。
Motivation: TFM 凭预测性能流行，其提供的后验预测分布 (PPD) 可靠性研究不足，而仅看聚合排名会误导模型选择。
Method: 提出 TabReliBench——一个大规模分类与回归基准，从点预测、分布质量、边缘与子群校准、区间效率四个维度比较 TFM，并做数据集层面分析；同时对照 TabArena 排名，并检验集成与 conformal 后处理对 PPD 校准的作用。
Result: TFM 排名在 TabArena 与 TabReliBench 之间、以及不同可靠性指标之间均发生改变；回归 TFM 通常达到接近名义值的边缘覆盖且区间保持窄，但该良好边缘表现不代表条件覆盖有效；分类难度常伴随差校准，而回归预测性能不是校准的可靠指标；集成提升预测性能但不一致改善 PPD 校准，TFM 从 conformal 后处理获益很少，无法可靠弥合子群差距。
Conclusion: 可靠的 TFM 选择需要超越聚合排名的多维评估；边缘覆盖良好不等于子群/条件覆盖有效，集成与 conformal 都不能替代校准维度的独立考核。

papers.title: A Critical Look at Power Sampling when Test Time Sharpening LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved LLM reasoning, yet growing evidence suggests it mainly performs distribution sharpening: concentrating probability mass on reasoning paths the base model already produces. Recent work therefore seeks RLVR's gains without needing reward signals, by sampling from the power distribution $π_α\propto π_{\text{base}}^α$ via Markov chain Monte Carlo or sequential Monte Carlo. We show that these samplers fail to converge to $π_α$ under realistic compute budgets, and that their gains are largely recreated via simple Best-of-$N$ with appropriate grading . This suggests they succeed by selecting high-probability sequences, not by approximating $π_α$, raising a natural question: is the power distribution itself a worthwhile target? We test this hypothesis directly by fine-tuning the base model to match $π_α$, sidestepping sampler convergence issues entirely. Despite approximating the target far more faithfully than existing samplers, this strategy yields gains that are noisy and specific to certain models and sampling tasks. Together, our results suggest that the value of power sampling lies not in faithfully targeting $π_α$, but in the simpler goal of extracting sequences the base model already deems likely.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文质疑测试时用幂分布 π_α ∝ π_base^α 锐化 LLM 的做法：MCMC 与 SMC 采样器在现实算力预算下不收敛到 π_α，其收益用带合适评分的 Best-of-N 就能基本复现。直接微调基座模型去逼近 π_α 虽然忠实得多，收益却噪声大且只在特定模型与采样任务上出现，说明幂采样的价值在于抽取基座本就认为高概率的序列，而非逼近 π_α。
Motivation: RLVR 被认为主要做分布锐化，于是出现免奖励、靠采样 π_α 复现其收益的路线；但采样器是否真在逼近 π_α、以及 π_α 是否值得作为目标，此前没有被直接检验。
Method: 先在现实算力预算下检验 MCMC 与 SMC 幂采样器对 π_α 的收敛性，并用带合适评分的 Best-of-N 复现其收益；再直接微调基座模型使其输出匹配 π_α，绕开采样器收敛问题，作为对目标本身的忠实逼近检验。
Result: MCMC/SMC 采样器在现实算力预算下不收敛到 π_α，其增益可由带合适评分的 Best-of-N 大体复现；微调基座模型逼近 π_α 忠实度远高于现有采样器，但带来的收益噪声大、且只在特定模型与采样任务上成立。
Conclusion: 幂采样的价值不在忠实逼近 π_α，而在于更简单的目标：抽取基座模型本就认为高概率的序列；π_α 本身是否值得作为目标则存疑。

papers.title: Electron-Density-Informed Molecular Property Prediction Using Surrogate Functionals
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning methods are increasingly used to predict chemical properties directly from the molecular structure to bypass the often prohibitive cost of quantum mechanical calculations. Recent work has shown that including the ground-state electron density as input to the machine learning model can improve accuracy in this setting. This work employs the recent surrogate functional framework originally developed for orbital-free density functional theory and extends it to predicting molecular properties. We show that passing the ground-state density as input to the model, while simultaneously enforcing it to be the minimum of the surrogate functional, surpasses state-of-the-art performance for six out of seven extensive properties of the QM9 dataset. Additionally, the approach shows improved generalization to larger molecules taken from the QM40 dataset. On all extensive properties of both datasets, our approach outperforms models that are informed by the ground-state density but do not enforce the surrogate functional constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把轨道无关 DFT 的 surrogate functional 框架移植到分子性质预测：模型以基态电子密度为输入，同时强制该密度是 surrogate functional 的极小值。在 QM9 的 7 个性质中 6 个 extensive 性质上超过当前最优，且在两个数据集的全部 extensive 性质上都优于只喂密度、不加约束的模型。
Motivation: 直接从分子结构预测量子化学性质可绕开昂贵的量子力学计算，近期工作显示加入基态电子密度能提升精度，但仅把密度当输入并未强制其满足物理约束。
Method: 采用原为轨道无关密度函数理论 (orbital-free DFT) 开发的 surrogate functional 框架，把基态电子密度作为模型输入，并同时强制该密度为 surrogate functional 的极小值，用于预测分子性质。
Result: 在 QM9 数据集 7 个性质中的 6 个 extensive 性质上超过 state-of-the-art；在 QM40 的更大分子上泛化更好；在两个数据集的全部 extensive 性质上均优于以基态密度为输入但不施加 surrogate functional 约束的模型。
Conclusion: 把物理约束（密度须为泛函极小值）与密度输入一起施加，比单纯喂密度更能提升分子性质预测的精度与对更大分子的泛化。

papers.title: SelectArena: A Modern Benchmark for Feature Selection on Real-world Tabular Data
papers.abstract_en: Selecting a subset of features (columns) from a tabular dataset is a ubiquitous challenge in real-world applications. Industry experts seek to minimize model training costs, climate scientists require an interpretable subset of factors to understand extreme weather events, and clinicians need to choose among diagnostic tests due to financial and time constraints. When looking at the scientific literature to determine which feature selection method to use, practitioners across domains face an unrepresentative landscape of benchmarking. Despite extensive research, existing feature selection benchmarks provide limited guidance because they rely on outdated models, ad hoc evaluation protocols, or artificially generated data that do not reflect real-world problems. To close the gap between scientific benchmarking and real-world applications, we introduce SelectArena, a modern benchmark for feature selection. We compare 15 widely used feature selection methods on 71 manually curated real-world tabular datasets, covering classification and regression problems, using standardized evaluation protocols and state-of-the-art tabular (foundation) models. Our results reveal clear trade-offs across predictive performance, runtime, stability, and validity. Tree-based methods, CART and RFImportance, along with F-Test are Pareto-optimal when taking into account predictive performance and runtime. F-Test, information-theory-, and distance-based methods lead on stability and validity, with F-Test emerging as a balanced choice across our metrics. Search-based methods are slow, unstable and achieve low performance. SelectArena turns these findings into practical guidance and, as an extensible platform, supports future feature selection research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SelectArena 用 71 个人工整理的真实表格数据集、15 种特征选择方法和标准化协议加最新表格（foundation）模型做统一评测，结果显示预测性能与运行时间之间存在清晰权衡：CART、RFImportance 与 F-Test 在性能-运行时间维度上 Pareto 最优，F-Test 在稳定性与有效性上领先且是各指标的均衡选择，搜索类方法则慢、不稳、性能低。
Motivation: 现有特征选择基准依赖过时模型、临时评测协议或人工生成数据，跨领域实践者据此选方法得不到代表真实问题的指导。
Method: 在 71 个手工整理的真实世界表格数据集（含分类与回归）上比较 15 种广泛使用的特征选择方法，采用标准化评测协议和当前最先进表格（foundation）模型，从预测性能、运行时间、稳定性、有效性四个维度评估。
Result: CART、RFImportance 与 F-Test 在预测性能和运行时间上 Pareto 最优；F-Test、基于信息论与基于距离的方法在稳定性和有效性上领先，F-Test 是各指标上的均衡选择；搜索类方法运行慢、不稳定且性能低。
Conclusion: 特征选择方法应在性能、运行时间、稳定性与有效性之间权衡取舍，F-Test 是当前最均衡的选择；SelectArena 作为可扩展平台用于支撑后续特征选择研究。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Learning Size Independent Constraint Models from Input Data and Positive and Negative Example Solutions
papers.abstract_en: In this paper we describe a Constraint Acquisition Tool that generates size independent constraint programs from input data and positive and negative example solutions of multiple problem instances. The system finds size specific models based on typical constraint patterns over global and binary constraints, then generalizes the models to a size independent model that can be run on unseen input data. The system produces MiniZinc code as well as a textual description of the model. We evaluate the tool on the example problems of the PTHG21 Challenge and show the feasibility of the approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出约束获取工具：从多个问题实例的输入数据与正/负示例解中，先按全局约束与二元约束的典型模式找出特定规模的模型，再泛化为与规模无关的约束程序，并同时输出 MiniZinc 代码与文字描述。在 PTHG21 Challenge 的示例问题上验证了该方法的可行性。
Motivation: 约束获取通常只能针对固定规模的实例建模，换一个规模就要重新获取；目标是让学到的模型能直接运行在未见过的输入数据上。
Method: 系统从多个问题实例的输入数据和正/负示例解中挖掘全局约束与二元约束的典型模式，得到特定规模的模型，再将其泛化为规模无关模型，产出 MiniZinc 代码和文字描述。
Result: 在 PTHG21 Challenge 的示例问题上评估，展示了该方法的可行性；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 从示例解中学习规模无关的约束模型是可行的，学到的模型可迁移到未见过的输入数据规模。

summary_sections.method: 系统从多个问题实例的输入数据和正/负示例解中挖掘全局约束与二元约束的典型模式，得到特定规模的模型，再将其泛化为规模无关模型，产出 MiniZinc 代码和文字描述。
summary_sections.result: 在 PTHG21 Challenge 的示例问题上评估，展示了该方法的可行性；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 从示例解中学习规模无关的约束模型是可行的，学到的模型可迁移到未见过的输入数据规模。

papers.title: Model-agnostic Knowledge Augmented Machine Learning for Weakly Annotated Bioimaging Data
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models are increasingly used for automated feature extraction from weakly annotated bioimaging data, such as microscopy and cytomorphology images. Due to the sole dependency of automated feature extraction, existing methods yield inconsistent classification performance across weakly annotated datasets. Here, we propose a model-agnostic knowledge augmentation method that enables ML models to exploit domain knowledge beyond what automated feature extraction can capture. The proposed approach improves classification performance across seven ML architectures. When integrated with masked autoencoder-based self-supervised learning, our method achieves the strongest overall performance, improving precision by 2.9% over the next-best method on three in-house microscopy datasets and by an average of 6.8% across three public cytomorphology benchmarks. We perform nucleus-level classification based on mislocalization of TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) from the nucleus to the cytoplasm, a phenotype linked to Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS), using three independent microscopy datasets of motor neurons derived from human induced pluripotent stem cells. Accurate quantification of this phenotype at scale remains challenging and may contribute to inconsistencies across studies. Application of the best-performing model to these microscopy datasets reveals biological interpretations related to ALS, including dose-dependent effects of the proteasomal stressor, MG132, and the oxidative stressor, sodium arsenite (SA), on TDP-43 mislocalization, variable pathology in motor neurons from sporadic and familial ALS donors, and a lack of protection of the pharmacological compounds, edaravone and niclosamide, against SA-induced TDP-43 mislocalization. Together, our pipeline enables in-vitro cellular image analysis to advance understanding of ALS-associated pathology and potential treatments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出模型无关的知识增强方法，让 ML 模型在自动特征提取之外利用领域知识，改善弱标注生物成像数据的分类一致性。与基于 masked autoencoder 的自监督学习结合时效果最强：在三个自建显微数据集上 precision 比次优方法高 2.9%，在三个公开细胞形态学基准上平均高 6.8%。
Motivation: 弱标注生物成像数据（显微镜、细胞形态学图像）的自动特征提取完全依赖标注质量，导致现有方法在不同弱标注数据集上分类性能不一致。
Method: 提出模型无关的知识增强方法，跨七种 ML 架构提升分类性能；与 masked autoencoder 自监督学习集成构成完整 pipeline，用于基于 TDP-43 从细胞核错位到细胞质的运动神经元核级分类。
Result: 跨七种 ML 架构均提升分类性能；与 MAE 自监督结合时，在三个自建显微数据集上 precision 比次优方法高 2.9%，在三个公开细胞形态学基准上平均高 6.8%。应用于人 iPSC 来源运动神经元的三个独立显微数据集，揭示 MG132 与 sodium arsenite 对 TDP-43 错位的剂量依赖效应、散发与家族 ALS 供体运动神经元的病理差异，以及 edaravone 和 niclosamide 对 SA 诱导的 TDP-43 错位无保护作用。
Conclusion: 知识增强加自监督学习的 pipeline 能在弱标注生物成像数据上稳定提升分类并支持 ALS 相关病理与药物的规模化体外图像分析。
