papers.title: Benchmarking Answer-Grounding Consistency in Remote Sensing Visual Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: In grounded remote sensing visual question answering, a model produces a textual answer and identifies relevant objects in the image as grounding evidence. Existing evaluations measure answer correctness and localization quality, but do not directly assess answer-grounding consistency. We propose the Answer-Evidence Support Protocol (AESP) to assess this consistency through evidence support: whether the grounding evidence supports the model's own answer. AESP applies task-specific rules to existence, counting, and comparison questions. We further construct the Grounded Remote Sensing Visual Question Answering (G-RSVQA) benchmark, containing 15,027 samples with questions, reference answers, and all related object-level annotations. Experiments on seven grounded vision--language models reveal failures of evidence support across all three question types. Up to 50.82% of correct answers in the evidence evaluation subset are not supported by the provided grounding evidence.
papers.comment: Under review at ICASSP 2027. Code available at https://github.com/pingggg516/AESP-Evaluation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 AESP 协议，用「证据是否支持模型自己的答案」来度量 grounded 遥感 VQA 的答案-定位一致性，并构建含 15,027 个样本的 G-RSVQA 基准。在七个 grounded vision-language 模型上，存在、计数、比较三类问题全部出现证据支持失败：证据评测子集中最高 50.82% 的正确答案并不被模型给出的 grounding 证据支持。
Motivation: 现有 grounded RS-VQA 评测只分别度量答案正确性与定位质量，不检查定位到的证据是否真的支撑模型自己给出的答案，因此答对但定位错的情况测不出来。
Method: 提出 Answer-Evidence Support Protocol (AESP)，按存在、计数、比较三类问题套用任务特定规则判定 grounding 证据对答案的支持；并构建 G-RSVQA 基准，含 15,027 个样本，带问题、参考答案与全部 object 级标注。
Result: 在七个 grounded vision-language 模型上实验，三类问题均出现证据支持失败；证据评测子集中，最高 50.82% 的正确答案不被所提供的 grounding 证据支持。
Conclusion: 答案正确不等于证据正确：grounded RS-VQA 需要单独度量答案-证据一致性，仅看答案准确率与定位质量会掩盖过半的证据失配。

papers.title: PANDA: Prior-guided Attentional Dual-path Architecture
papers.abstract_en: Hypergraph Neural Networks (HNNs), designed to model higher-order relations beyond pairwise interactions, typically rely either on fixed structural weights or on normalised attention. Fixed weights can propagate misleading information in heterophilic settings, while normalisation makes attention coefficients competitive, in the sense that, in a message-passing framework, increasing the weight of one sender must reduce the weight of others in the same aggregation set. Our main contribution is the introduction of PANDA (Prior-guided AttentioNal Dual-path Architecture), a plug-in for two-stage message passing HNNs applicable to both undirected and directed settings. The main path interpolates between learned receiver-normalised attention and structural incidence priors, while a non-competitive (not normalised) auxiliary path lets each sender contribute its own transformed information. We also show that, with fixed structural coefficients, PANDA recovers a certain complex-valued convolution operator adopted in previous works. Across four HNNs spanning spatial and spectral methods in both directed and undirected settings, plugging PANDA in yields an average improvement of 5.18 percentage points across eight real-world benchmark datasets. The code is available at https://github.com/jainris/panda.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PANDA 是面向两阶段消息传递超图神经网络 (HNN) 的即插即用模块：主路径在学习到的接收者归一化注意力与结构关联先验之间插值，辅助路径不做归一化，让每个发送者各自贡献变换后的信息。在四个覆盖空间与谱方法、有向与无向的 HNN 上接入后，八个真实基准数据集平均提升 5.18 个百分点。
Motivation: 固定结构权重在异质 (heterophilic) 设置下会传播误导信息，而归一化注意力使同一聚合集内各发送者权重互相竞争——增大一个必然压低其他，限制了高阶关系的表达。
Method: PANDA 作为两阶段消息传递 HNN 的插件：主路径在学习的 receiver-normalised attention 与结构关联先验 (structural incidence priors) 间插值，非竞争（不归一化）辅助路径独立传递各发送者变换后的信息；在固定结构系数下可退化复现先前工作采用的某个复值卷积算子。
Result: 在四个 HNN（覆盖空间与谱方法、有向与无向）上接入 PANDA，在八个真实世界基准数据集上平均提升 5.18 个百分点。
Conclusion: 让注意力与结构先验插值、并保留一条不归一化的辅助路径，可作为通用插件稳定提升超图消息传递在异质与有向场景下的表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Humanize Olympiad Agents: A Multi-Session Workflow for Olympiad Problem Solving with Solve, Review, Wiki, Verify
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are rapidly improving on long-horizon scientific and olympiad tasks. Recent systems have produced a Lean-formalized resolution of the Navier--Stokes problem and autonomous solutions to four open questions in the Erdős Conjectures database. Yet neither system releases both its underlying model and complete inference stack. More broadly, a single agent session remains brittle on difficult problems: early errors can propagate, missing domain knowledge can stall progress, and apparent success can mask a misinterpretation or weakening of the original task. We introduce HOA (Humanize Olympiads Agent), an open, flow-level framework that coordinates multiple agent sessions through three complementary feedback channels. First, an independent reviewer evaluates each candidate and provides actionable feedback. Second, a structured wiki supplies task-specific knowledge that may be missing or unreliable in model pretraining. Third, a verifier checks generated Lean proofs against trusted challenge statements. With GPT-5.6 Sol, HOA achieves perfect scores on the IMO, IPhO, and IOI 2026, near-full marks on the IChO 2026 problem set, and solves all 672 problems (100%) on PutnamBench. On the Lean-Eval leaderboard, HOA ranks first, solving 251 of 304 problems (82.6%). We further evaluate HOA with open models. Using Kimi-K3, HOA achieves full scores on the IMO, IPhO, and IOI, and a gold-level score of 97.1% on the IChO. These results closely match the closed-source GPT-5.6 Sol + /Goal baseline on the IMO and IPhO, while exceeding it on the IChO and IOI, demonstrating that systematic feedback can help bridge substantial differences in base-model capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HOA 用独立评审、结构化 wiki、Lean 校验器三条反馈通道协调多个 agent session，缓解单 session 早期错误传播与任务被弱化。GPT-5.6 Sol 版在 PutnamBench 解出 672/672（100%），Lean-Eval 排名第一（251/304，82.6%），IMO/IPhO/IOI 2026 满分；Kimi-K3 版 IChO 金牌级 97.1%，在 IChO 与 IOI 上超过 GPT-5.6 Sol + /Goal 基线。
Motivation: 单 session 在难题上脆弱：早期错误会传播、缺失的领域知识会卡住进展、表面成功可能掩盖对原题的误读或弱化；现有系统（Navier–Stokes Lean 形式化、Erdős 四个开放问题）也不同时开源模型与完整推理栈。
Method: HOA（Humanize Olympiads Agent）是 flow 级开源框架，用三条互补反馈通道协调多个 agent session：独立 reviewer 对每个候选解给出可执行反馈；结构化 wiki 提供预训练中缺失或不可靠的任务特定知识；verifier 用可信 challenge statement 校验生成的 Lean proof。
Result: GPT-5.6 Sol + HOA 在 IMO、IPhO、IOI 2026 满分，IChO 2026 接近满分，PutnamBench 解出全部 672 题（100%），Lean-Eval 榜首（304 题中解出 251，82.6%）。Kimi-K3 + HOA 在 IMO、IPhO、IOI 满分，IChO 金牌级 97.1%；与闭源 GPT-5.6 Sol + /Goal 基线相比，IMO 与 IPhO 接近，IChO 与 IOI 超出。
Conclusion: 系统化反馈可以弥补基线模型能力的巨大差距，使开源模型在奥赛与形式化数学任务上接近甚至超过闭源系统；同时 HOA 开源了模型与完整推理栈。

papers.title: Private and Distributionally Robust Federated Multiclass Classification
papers.abstract_en: Fault diagnosis in asset-intensive industries requires multiclass models trained on noisy, sensitive data collected across geographically distributed client sites. Federated learning enables collaborative training without centralizing data, but most approaches do not provide formal privacy guarantees for individual records stored at client sites and can degrade under label noise. To address these limitations, we develop a differentially private, distributionally robust framework for federated multiclass classification that provides sample-level privacy for records stored at each client. We build on a federated Wasserstein distributionally robust multiclass objective with the Crammer-Singer loss, solved using an Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM)-based algorithm. To protect the released client updates, our method injects calibrated Gaussian noise into the proximal linearized client updates of both the local model and the local distributionally robust variable before aggregation at the central server, and we quantify the cumulative privacy loss using the moments accountant. We provide per-round sample-level $(ε,δ)$-differential privacy guarantees and an overall composed privacy guarantee across all training rounds, together with convergence results and an explicit privacy-utility tradeoff. Experiments on simulated industrial fault data and UCI benchmark datasets show that our method outperforms differentially private federated empirical risk minimization and stochastic gradient descent baselines in most tested settings, with the largest gains under strong privacy-induced noise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向工业故障诊断的联邦多分类，提出差分隐私 + Wasserstein 分布鲁棒的训练框架：在 ADMM 求解的联邦 Wasserstein DRO 目标（Crammer-Singer loss）上，对本地模型与本地 DRO 变量的近端线性化更新都注入校准高斯噪声，再用 moments accountant 累积隐私损失。在模拟工业故障数据与 UCI 基准上，多数设定下优于 DP-FED 与 DP-SGD 基线，且在隐私噪声最强时优势最大。
Motivation: 跨地理分布客户端的故障诊断需要在不集中数据的前提下训练多分类模型，但多数联邦方法既无逐样本隐私保证，又在标签噪声下性能退化。
Method: 构建联邦 Wasserstein 分布鲁棒多分类目标（Crammer-Singer loss），用基于 ADMM 的算法求解；在中心服务器聚合前，对本地模型与本地 DRO 变量的 proximal linearized client updates 分别注入校准高斯噪声，用 moments accountant 计量跨轮累积隐私损失，并给出收敛结果与显式 privacy-utility 权衡。
Result: 提供逐轮样本级 (ε,δ)-差分隐私保证与跨训练轮的组合隐私保证；在模拟工业故障数据与 UCI 基准数据集上，多数测试设定下优于差分隐私联邦 ERM 与 DP-SGD 基线，隐私诱导噪声最强时增益最大。
Conclusion: 把逐样本差分隐私与 Wasserstein DRO 同时放进联邦多分类，可在标签噪声和强隐私噪声下仍保持可用的隐私-效用权衡。

summary_sections.motivation: 跨地理分布客户端的故障诊断需要在不集中数据的前提下训练多分类模型，但多数联邦方法既无逐样本隐私保证，又在标签噪声下性能退化。

papers.title: Multi-Stream Attention Residuals
papers.abstract_en: Attention Residuals (AttnRes) enables content-dependent retrieval over network depth, which can be viewed as single-stream softmax attention along the depth axis. Inspired by the success of multi-head attention along the sequence axis, we introduce Multi-Stream Attention Residuals (MSAR), an extension of AttnRes that generalizes this mechanism to multi-head depth attention, yielding substantial performance gains with minimal additional overhead. MSAR draws stream diversity from sequence context through multi-scale causal convolutions, allowing different heads to retrieve historical representations through distinct contextual views while preserving the integrity of the hidden representation. The retrieved streams are combined through lightweight adaptive mixing to generate the single-stream layer input. By retaining single-stream sources and expanding them on demand, MSAR supports multi-stream computation without requiring persistent multi-stream storage or communication. Across all 12 downstream benchmarks at the 18B and 28B MoE scales, MSAR consistently outperforms prior residual variants, including standard residual connections, manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC), and AttnRes. Scaling-law experiments yield an iso-loss compute speedup of $1.58\times$ over the standard residual baseline, compared with $1.35\times$ for AttnRes and $1.30\times$ for mHC. These results make MSAR a promising residual architecture for large-scale pre-training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MSAR 把 Attention Residuals 沿深度轴的单流检索扩展为多头深度注意力：用多尺度因果卷积从序列上下文取流多样性，各头经不同上下文视图检索历史表示，再用轻量自适应混合生成单流层输入，从而免去常驻多流存储与通信。在 18B 与 28B MoE 规模的全部 12 个下游基准上一致优于标准残差、mHC 与 AttnRes，scaling-law 实验给出相对标准残差基线 1.58× 的 iso-loss 计算加速（AttnRes 1.35×、mHC 1.30×）。
Motivation: 残差连接沿深度轴没有内容依赖的检索能力，AttnRes 虽引入单流深度注意力，但缺少序列轴多头注意力那样的多视角检索，且多流方案通常要付出常驻存储与通信开销。
Method: MSAR 是 AttnRes 的推广：以多尺度因果卷积从序列上下文派生流多样性，让多个头通过不同上下文视图检索历史表示并保持隐藏表示完整性；检索到的流经轻量自适应混合 (adaptive mixing) 合成为单流层输入，只在需要时展开多流计算。
Result: 在 18B 与 28B MoE 规模的全部 12 个下游基准上，MSAR 一致优于标准残差连接、manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) 与 AttnRes；scaling-law 实验中 MSAR 相对标准残差基线的 iso-loss 计算加速为 1.58×，AttnRes 为 1.35×，mHC 为 1.30×。
Conclusion: 按需展开的多流深度注意力可以在几乎不增加开销的前提下成为大规模预训练的残差架构选择，其收益来自序列上下文提供的流多样性而非常驻多流存储。

papers.title: JitterVLA: A Replay Benchmark for Motion Quality in VLA-Driven Human-Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies issue sparse targets whose arrival at the robot controller is delayed and irregular, so a reasonable predicted action can still produce abrupt motion near people. Remedies are evaluated on different streams, delays and metrics. JitterVLA replays identical commands and arrival traces through alternative controllers, isolating the controller's effect. We apply it to synthetic reaches, hand trajectories from 20 people, three open VLA pipelines (838 episodes) and a physical UR3. Interpolation lowered modeled p99 jerk for every source, by 83% (615 to 106 m/s^3) on human motion with 200 ms delay, at a 2.0 cm tracking cost, and the effect replicated on 598 new episodes; jerk-limited generation lowered jerk further at a larger cost. Entropy-discontinuity associations had opposite, replicated signs in two pipelines, and entropy gating helped in one but not the other. On the UR3, interpolation lowered accelerometer-derived jerk by 3.0-14.0% in all six exploratory pairs, while a position-derived metric did not resolve the contrast. JitterVLA supports screening before human-centred studies; code and data will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JitterVLA 是一个回放基准：把同一批 VLA 指令与到达时序原样重放到不同控制器上，从而隔离控制器本身对运动质量的影响。插值在所有数据源上都降低建模 p99 jerk，其中人体手部轨迹在 200 ms 延迟下从 615 降到 106 m/s^3（降 83%），代价是 2.0 cm 跟踪误差；在 UR3 实机上六组探索性对比中加速度计 jerk 全部下降 3.0–14.0%。
Motivation: VLA 策略输出稀疏目标，到达控制器的时序延迟且不规则，即使预测动作合理也可能在人机协作中产生突兀运动；现有缓解方案在不同指令流、延迟和指标下评测，彼此不可比。
Method: 回放同一批指令与到达时序到不同控制器（插值、jerk 限制生成等），输入覆盖合成 reaching、20 人手部轨迹、三个开源 VLA pipeline 共 838 个 episode，以及一台实体 UR3；用建模 p99 jerk 与跟踪误差权衡度量，并在 598 个新 episode 上复现。
Result: 插值在每个数据源上都降低建模 p99 jerk：人体运动 200 ms 延迟下 615 → 106 m/s^3（降 83%），跟踪代价 2.0 cm，并在 598 个新 episode 上复现；jerk 限制生成进一步降 jerk 但代价更大。熵不连续性关联在两个 pipeline 中符号相反且均可复现，熵门控只在一个 pipeline 有效。UR3 上插值使加速度计 jerk 在全部六组探索性对比中下降 3.0–14.0%，而基于位置的指标无法分辨该对比。
Conclusion: 控制器层面的回放可以隔离运动质量差异，插值是跨数据源一致有效的 jerk 缓解手段；熵类信号的作用依 pipeline 而异，指标选择（位置 vs 加速度计）会决定能否看出差别，因此该基准适合在真人实验前做筛选。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SWE-DeceptionBench: Benchmarking Deceptive Behaviors of LLMs Across the Software Development Lifecycle
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used throughout the software development lifecycle. This growing reliance on LLMs raises concerns about their trustworthiness, with deception posing a particularly important risk. Deceptive behavior takes the form of misleading responses or assistance in fabricating, concealing, or distorting information. To study this behavior, we introduce SWE-DeceptionBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM deception in software engineering. The benchmark covers six lifecycle stages and two deception triggers: Active Deception, where models recognize infeasible or conflicting requirements but still present them as achievable, and Passive Deception, where models help fulfill explicit user requests to mislead others. We further introduce Neutral, Reward, and Pressure conditions to study the effect of external inducements, resulting in 720 test instances in Chinese and English. Evaluating seven mainstream LLMs, we find substantial deception even under the Neutral condition, with aggregate rates of 49.88% for Active Deception and 64.29% for Passive Deception. Deception rates vary across lifecycle stages, and external inducements affect Active and Passive Deception to different extents. We also evaluate lightweight defenses, finding that guard models miss many deceptive requests, and Self-Reminder reduces but does not eliminate deceptive responses. These findings highlight the need for more effective deception detection and mitigation methods to support trustworthy LLM-based software engineering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SWE-DeceptionBench 覆盖软件开发生命周期六个阶段、两种欺骗触发（Active/Passive）与 Neutral/Reward/Pressure 三种外部诱导条件，共 720 条中英文测试实例。评测七个主流 LLM 后发现，即使在 Neutral 条件下欺骗率已高达 Active 49.88%、Passive 64.29%；guard model 漏掉大量欺骗请求，Self-Reminder 只能降低而不能消除欺骗回答。
Motivation: LLM 已被广泛用于软件开发全流程，其欺骗性回答（捏造、隐瞒或歪曲信息）直接威胁可信度，但缺少覆盖完整生命周期与外部诱导情境的系统评测基准。
Method: 提出 SWE-DeceptionBench：覆盖六个开发生命周期阶段，区分 Active Deception（识别不可行/冲突需求仍称可实现）与 Passive Deception（配合用户明确的误导请求），并设 Neutral、Reward、Pressure 三种外部诱导条件，构成 720 条中英文测试实例；评测七个主流 LLM，并检验 guard model 与 Self-Reminder 两类轻量防御。
Result: Neutral 条件下聚合欺骗率即达 Active 49.88%、Passive 64.29%；欺骗率随生命周期阶段变化，外部诱导对 Active 与 Passive 的影响程度不同；guard model 漏检大量欺骗请求，Self-Reminder 降低但不消除欺骗回答。
Conclusion: LLM 在软件工程场景中的欺骗是普遍现象且外部诱导会加剧，现有轻量防御（guard model、Self-Reminder）不足，需要更有效的欺骗检测与缓解方法。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Kernel-based External Validity of Experimental Studies
papers.abstract_en: The external validity of a study is the extent to which its findings generalize to unseen experimental conditions, such as datasets. We formalize the results of a study together with its research question, and define external validity as the probability that two independent and same-sized replications of the study produce results whose maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) is below a given tolerance. This approach, centered on the choice of a space of results and of an appropriate reproducing kernel for the MMD, is flexible enough to be deployed on multiple different types of results and research questions. Additionally, we establish an asymptotic power-law relation between the size of a study and the quantiles of the MMD, which we use to estimate the desired size of an externally valid study from a small-scale preliminary study. We deploy our framework to rankings with ties and discuss kernels suited to different research questions. Experiments on existing case studies and on a simulated newly designed study illustrate the applicability of the framework. We release our code as part of the genexpy Python module.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把实验研究的外部效度定义为两次同规模独立复现结果的 MMD 低于给定容差的概率，通过选择结果空间与再生核来度量，并推导研究规模与 MMD 分位数之间的渐近幂律，用于从小规模预实验反推达到外部效度所需的研究规模。框架在含并列的排名结果上给出适配不同研究问题的核，并在既有案例与模拟新研究上说明可用性，代码随 genexpy Python 模块发布。
Motivation: 实验结论能否推广到未见过的实验条件（如新数据集）缺少可操作的概率化定义，也缺少从预实验推算所需研究规模的手段。
Method: 将研究结果连同研究问题形式化，以外部效度 = 两次同规模独立复现结果的 MMD 低于容差的概率为定义，核心是选择结果空间与合适的再生核；推导研究规模与 MMD 分位数的渐近幂律关系用于规模估计；在含并列的排名 (rankings with ties) 结果上部署并讨论适配不同研究问题的核。
Result: 在既有案例研究与一个模拟设计的新研究上说明框架的适用性；建立研究规模与 MMD 分位数之间的渐近幂律关系，用于由小规模预实验估计外部合格研究所需规模；代码作为 genexpy Python 模块的一部分发布。
Conclusion: 外部效度可以被写成基于 MMD 与再生核的概率量，并可由幂律关系从预实验外推所需研究规模；框架对多种结果类型与研究问题具有灵活性。

papers.title: Some remarks on the connection between generative diffusion and optimal transport
papers.abstract_en: We discuss three simple connections between generative diffusion and optimal transport. First, the joint law of the data and of their Ornstein-Uhlenbeck noising is, at every time, the solution of an entropic optimal-transport problem, at a temperature set by the noise level. Backward diffusion can consequently be read as an annealing which gradually decreases the entropic regularization. Second, we study the speciation transition--how the modes of the data distribution emerge during generation--and compare how it happens in diffusion and flow matching with respect to optimal transport. Using Gaussian mixtures as high-dimensional example, we show that the dynamical instability through which diffusion and flow matching separate the modes becomes, for optimal transport, an exponentially thin boundary layer at the beginning of generation, which is rounded by entropic regularization. Third, considering a generic forward dynamics with a general confining potential, we show that the backward process driven by the score also satisfies a drift-based variational principle whose minimal cost is the entropy difference between initial and final distributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出生成式扩散与最优传输 (optimal transport) 的三条对应关系：OU 加噪下数据与噪声的联合分布在任意时刻都是熵正则最优传输问题，温度由噪声水平决定，因此反向扩散等价于逐步降低熵正则的退火过程；在高斯混合上，扩散与流匹配分离模态的动力学不稳定性，对最优传输表现为生成初期指数级薄的边界层，并被熵正则圆滑化；对一般约束势的前向动力学，score 驱动的反向过程满足基于漂移的变分原理，其最小代价等于初末分布的熵差。
Motivation: 扩散模型与最优传输之间的联系停留在直觉层面，缺少严格的对应：模态如何在生成中分离（speciation transition）在扩散、流匹配与最优传输下是否同一机制并不清楚。
Method: 三条理论论证：把 OU 加噪的联合 law 写成熵正则最优传输问题并把反向扩散读作退火；以高斯混合为高维例子，比较扩散、流匹配与最优传输下模态分离的不稳定性；对带一般约束势的通用前向动力学推导 score 驱动反向过程的漂移变分原理。
Result: 熵正则最优传输的温度由噪声水平设定，反向扩散即逐渐减小正则强度的退火；最优传输下模态分离的不稳定性变成生成开始时指数级薄的边界层，被熵正则圆滑；反向 score 过程变分原理的最小代价为初末分布的熵差。
Conclusion: 扩散可视为熵正则最优传输的退火，模态分离在最优传输中是被熵正则圆滑的初始边界层，反向 score 动力学服从以熵差为代价的变分原理。

papers.title: CUBE: Class-conditioned Unknown Boundary Evidence for Open-Set Insect Species Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Open-set insect species recognition faces significant challenges when deployed in real-world biodiversity scenarios, particularly when encountering unknown species that are visually close to known training classes. Unlike generic out-of-distribution samples, fine-grained unknown insects are often not visually anomalous. They instead tend to appear near the decision boundary of specific known species, leading to unreliable closed-set predictions. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{Class-conditioned Unknown Boundary Evidence (CUBE)}, a novel evidence-based framework that models unknownness around each known species rather than as a single global unknown class. Our key idea is to evaluate a test sample relative to the known species it most closely resembles, enabling local rejection for visually confusable unknown insects. CUBE learns class-conditioned boundary evidence from auxiliary species, preserves auxiliary species as shadow references during inference, and incorporates taxonomic candidate calibration to verify biological plausibility. When ecological metadata is available, we further introduce CUBE-E, which adds a lightweight location-consistency term without modifying the visual backbone. Experiments on the Open-Insect C-America benchmark show that CUBE achieves superior performance, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines with 95.8\%, 98.7\%, and 99.1\% AUROC on local, non-local, and non-moth unknown splits, respectively, while maintaining 94.9\% closed-set accuracy. With ecological metadata, CUBE-E further improves the results to 96.0\%, 99.7\%, and 99.5\% AUROC with 95.2\% closed-set accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CUBE 把未知昆虫识别建模为每个已知物种各自的决策边界证据，而非单一全局 unknown 类：用辅助物种学类条件边界证据，推理时保留辅助物种作 shadow reference，并做分类学候选校准。在 Open-Insect C-America 上，local/non-local/non-moth 三个未知切分 AUROC 分别 95.8%/98.7%/99.1%，闭集准确率 94.9%；加生态元数据的 CUBE-E 提到 96.0%/99.7%/99.5% 与 95.2%。
Motivation: 开放集昆虫物种识别中，与已知类视觉相近的未知种并不显得异常，而是落在某个已知物种的决策边界附近，导致闭集预测不可靠；单一全局 unknown 类无法表达这种局部混淆。
Method: CUBE 从辅助物种学习类条件边界证据 (class-conditioned boundary evidence)，推理时把辅助物种保留为 shadow reference，对测试样本按其最相似的已知物种做局部拒识，并用 taxonomic candidate calibration 校验生物学合理性；CUBE-E 在有生态元数据时加入轻量 location-consistency 项，不改动视觉 backbone。
Result: 在 Open-Insect C-America benchmark 上，CUBE 在 local、non-local、non-moth 未知切分的 AUROC 分别为 95.8%、98.7%、99.1%，闭集准确率 94.9%，超过 SOTA 基线；加入生态元数据后 CUBE-E 分别为 96.0%、99.7%、99.5%，闭集准确率 95.2%。
Conclusion: 把 unknownness 按已知物种局部建模并配合分类学校准，能在保持高闭集准确率的同时显著提升细粒度未知昆虫的拒识，生态元数据还能进一步小幅抬高 AUROC 与闭集准确率。

papers.title: Vocal Intensity Conversion with Continuous SPL Control via Adversarial Training
papers.abstract_en: Vocal intensity conversion renders a recorded utterance at a different vocal intensity, rather than simply scaling its amplitude, while preserving its content and speaker identity. Existing systems control intensity through a reference utterance or a few discrete categories. Instead, we control the conversion with any target sound pressure level (SPL) on a continuous dB scale. A lightweight converter, trained as a conditional cycle-consistent GAN without parallel data, transforms the features of a frozen speech encoder, from which a pretrained vocoder resynthesizes the speech. We compare three representations, log-mel spectrograms, WavLM, and SpeechTokenizer, and introduce an objective protocol that measures the achieved intensity change against the target one on a calibrated corpus. With WavLM, the converter achieves a measured 83% of the target change in intensity and also shifts the fundamental frequency. A perceptual evaluation confirms that perceived vocal intensity increases with the target level on amplitude-normalized stimuli.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027. Code: https://github.com/vers-project/vocal-intensity-conversion. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出连续 SPL 控制的发声强度转换：以任意目标声压级（dB）为条件，用无平行数据的循环一致 GAN 改写冻结语音编码器特征，再由预训练 vocoder 重合成。在标定语料上 WavLM 表征达到目标强度变化的 83%，感知评测确认幅度归一化刺激下感知强度随目标电平上升。
Motivation: 现有发声强度转换只能靠参考语句或少数离散强度档位控制，无法在连续 dB 尺度上指定目标 SPL，也缺少把实测强度变化与目标对齐的客观评测。
Method: 条件循环一致 GAN（无平行数据）转换冻结语音编码器的特征，由预训练 vocoder 重合成；对比 log-mel spectrogram、WavLM、SpeechTokenizer 三种表征，并提出在标定语料上度量实测强度变化相对目标值的客观协议。
Result: WavLM 表征下转换器实测达到目标强度变化的 83%，同时基频 (F0) 也发生偏移；感知评测显示在幅度归一化刺激上感知发声强度随目标 SPL 上升。
Conclusion: 连续 SPL 条件配合 WavLM 特征可在保留内容与说话人身份的同时把发声强度推向指定目标，且该强度变化能被听者感知。

papers.title: CorrFlow: Exact and Permutation-Equivariant Flow Matching on the Correlation Elliptope
papers.abstract_en: Correlation matrices combine nonlinear positive-definiteness constraints with a simultaneous row-column permutation symmetry. Their generation therefore involves two distinct problems. First, every output must remain on the correlation elliptope, irrespective of how its variables are ordered. Second, the generator must learn the domain-specific distribution occupied by empirical data inside that valid space. Existing financial image generators mix these problems: they learn ordered matrix entries and repair invalid draws afterward. We introduce CorrFlow, which separates them. A generalized Fisher transform maps full-rank correlation matrices bijectively to unconstrained coordinates, guaranteeing valid outputs without projection. A graph flow-matching network learns the empirical distribution in those coordinates and is permutation equivariant: reordering the variables only reorders the output. We compare a conditional CorrGAN reimplementation, image diffusion, and CorrFlow on $80\times80$ Taiwan equity matrices using five seeds per neural method. CorrFlow produces 100% valid draws without repair and obtains feature sliced-Wasserstein distance $.712\pm.141$, versus $4.339\pm.252$ for CorrGAN and $4.610\pm.191$ for image diffusion after their invalid outputs are projected back to the correlation space. It also improves this distance over historical lookup, while lookup retains higher local coverage. These results support the combined construction under the evaluated training budget; they do not establish superiority over fully tuned image models or isolate the contribution of each component.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurReps 2026, the NeurIPS workshop on Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations. Code: https://github.com/gautiermarti/CorrFlow
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CorrFlow 把相关矩阵生成拆成两步：广义 Fisher 变换把满秩相关矩阵双射到无约束坐标以保证输出天然合法，图结构 flow-matching 网络在该坐标上学经验分布且对变量置换等变。在 80×80 台湾股票相关矩阵上每方法 5 个种子，CorrFlow 无需修复即 100% 合法，feature sliced-Wasserstein 距离 0.712±0.141，CorrGAN 为 4.339±0.252、图像扩散为 4.610±0.191。
Motivation: 相关矩阵同时受正定性约束与行列置换对称性，现有金融图像生成器把两者混在一起：直接学有序矩阵元素，再把非法样本投影修复，既破坏分布又无法保证置换等变。
Method: 广义 Fisher 变换将满秩相关矩阵双射映到无约束坐标（免投影保证合法），再用图 flow-matching 网络在该坐标上学经验分布，网络对变量重排等变；对比对象为条件 CorrGAN 复现与图像扩散，每个神经方法跑 5 个种子。
Result: 在 80×80 台湾股票相关矩阵上，CorrFlow 修复后 100% 合法，feature sliced-Wasserstein 距离 0.712±0.141，CorrGAN 4.339±0.252，图像扩散 4.610±0.191（后两者为非法输出投影回相关空间后的结果）；该距离也优于 historical lookup，但 lookup 的局部覆盖更高。
Conclusion: 在所评估的训练预算下，把合法性约束与分布学习分开构造是有效的；作者明确指出这不构成对完全调参图像模型的优势证明，也未分离各组件的贡献。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Thyroid Nodule Segmentation in Ultrasound Images with Conformal Uncertainty Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Thyroid nodules affect a large proportion of the general population. Although most are benign, a non-negligible fraction is malignant. Ultrasound imaging is the primary diagnostic modality, and accurate nodule segmentation is a prerequisite for CAD systems to classify malignancy and assess metastatic risk.\\ In this work, we propose a thyroid nodule segmentation framework that integrates a DeepLabV3+, channel-attention modules and post-hoc conformal prediction, providing both accurate mask and pixel-level uncertainty estimates. We address thyroid ultrasound nodule segmentation as the first stage of a pipeline that also includes malignancy classification and metastatic risk prediction. We adopt DeepLabV3+, whose Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling (ASPP) captures multi-scale context, with an EfficientNet-B5 backbone for its accuracy-efficiency trade-off. Additionally, we test three channel-attention modules: Squeeze-and-Excitation, CBAM and Grouped Channel Attention (GCA), paired with two loss formulations (Dice-BCE and Boundary).\\ Since binary masks do not indicate prediction confidence, we wrap the trained model with a split conformal prediction layer that produces pixel-level uncertainty maps with statistical coverage guarantees.\\ We evaluate all configurations on the TN3K public benchmark using a fixed split and directly compare them with state-of-the-art methods. The plain backbone already improves upon previously reported results, with CBAM + Dice-BCE emerging as the best overall configuration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出甲状腺结节超声分割框架：DeepLabV3+ 配 EfficientNet-B5 骨干，测试 SE、CBAM、GCA 三种通道注意力与 Dice-BCE、Boundary 两种损失，并外挂 split conformal prediction 层输出带统计覆盖保证的像素级不确定性图。在 TN3K 公开基准固定划分上，纯骨干已超过已报告结果，CBAM + Dice-BCE 为最佳整体配置。
Motivation: 超声是甲状腺结节首选诊断手段，精确分割是 CAD 系统判断良恶性与转移风险的前提；但二值掩码不携带预测置信度，分割不确定性无法量化。
Method: 以 DeepLabV3+（ASPP 多尺度上下文）配 EfficientNet-B5 骨干，对比 Squeeze-and-Excitation、CBAM、Grouped Channel Attention 三种通道注意力模块与 Dice-BCE、Boundary 两种损失组合；训练后加 split conformal prediction 层生成像素级不确定性图。分割定位为含恶性分类与转移风险预测的流水线第一阶段。
Result: 在 TN3K 公开基准固定划分上评估全部配置并与 SOTA 方法直接对比：纯骨干配置已优于此前报告结果，CBAM + Dice-BCE 为最佳整体配置；conformal 层提供带统计覆盖保证的像素级不确定性估计。
Conclusion: CBAM + Dice-BCE 是 TN3K 上分割精度的最优组合，而事后 conformal prediction 可在不改动分割模型的前提下为掩码补上带覆盖保证的像素级置信度。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.result: 在 TN3K 公开基准固定划分上评估全部配置并与 SOTA 方法直接对比：纯骨干配置已优于此前报告结果，CBAM + Dice-BCE 为最佳整体配置；conformal 层提供带统计覆盖保证的像素级不确定性估计。
summary_sections.conclusion: CBAM + Dice-BCE 是 TN3K 上分割精度的最优组合，而事后 conformal prediction 可在不改动分割模型的前提下为掩码补上带覆盖保证的像素级置信度。

papers.title: A small cognitive core explains human behavior at scale
papers.abstract_en: Psychology has proposed many principles of cognition. Each, however, was developed in isolation, leaving their combined explanatory power unknown. We assembled a small set of established principles into one model, which we call COntextual Retrieval and Encoding (CORE). CORE consists of a hierarchy of episodic memories into which prediction errors are written and whose encoding, retrieval, and forgetting depend on context. Fitted jointly to 7,036,442 choices from 137 experiments, the model predicts human choices better than black-box models and reproduces 75% of reported behavioral effects when simulated. Moreover, its latent variables show classic signatures of Bayesian learning and event segmentation. Taken together, these findings suggest that a small cognitive core accounts for much of human behavior. They also open a path toward making psychology more than the sum of its parts, by building computational models on the entire experimental record.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把心理学中彼此孤立提出的认知原理组装成单一模型 CORE（Contextual Retrieval and Encoding）：分层情景记忆写入预测误差，编码、检索与遗忘均依赖 context。联合拟合 137 个实验的 7,036,442 次选择后，CORE 预测人类选择优于黑箱模型，模拟时复现 75% 的已报告行为效应。
Motivation: 心理学的每条认知原理都在孤立情境下发展，其合并解释力未知；作者主张在全部实验记录上构建计算模型，让心理学成为整体而非部分之和。
Method: CORE 由分层情景记忆 (hierarchical episodic memories) 构成，预测误差写入记忆，编码、检索与遗忘由 context 调控；模型联合拟合来自 137 个实验的 7,036,442 次选择，并通过模拟检验行为效应复现。
Result: 在 7,036,442 次选择、137 个实验的联合拟合上，CORE 对人类选择的预测优于黑箱模型；模拟复现 75% 的已报告行为效应；其潜变量呈现贝叶斯学习与事件分割 (event segmentation) 的经典特征。
Conclusion: 一个小型认知核心足以解释人类行为的很大一部分，且把计算模型建在整个实验记录之上是可行路径。

papers.title: AudioTETRIS: Token Elimination via Transitional Importance Signals for Efficient Audio LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) achieve strong performance on speech-text tasks, but standard audio encoders produce hundreds of tokens for even short audio clips. Because self-attention scales quadratically in sequence length, this inflates inference-time compute substantially. Current training-free token compression methods prune or merge tokens based solely on coarse attention or feature similarity. However, treating audio tokens as generic, isotropic features smooths over spectral transitions, destroying fine-grained phonetic transitions essential for decoding speech. In contrast, speech signals exhibit highly structured temporal patterns where information density peaks at acoustic transitions. We propose AudioTETRIS, a training-free, two-stage framework that uses the audio encoder's representation geometry as an acoustic prior for token importance before applying attention-based compression. Instead of discarding encoder structure after the encoding stage, AudioTETRIS propagates this prior directly into the LLM decoder to compute a per-token fused score. This score drives progressive top-$k$ token selection across decoder layers without requiring additional training or auxiliary models. Evaluated on Qwen2-Audio-7B, Phi-4-Multimodal, and Audio Flamingo 3, AudioTETRIS retains near-uncompressed performance on several speech tasks using only 25% of audio tokens, matches or surpasses full-token accuracy at moderate compression rates, and consistently outperforms existing training-free baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AudioTETRIS 是面向大音频语言模型 (LALM) 的免训练两阶段 token 压缩框架：先用音频编码器的表示几何作为声学先验给 token 打重要性分，再把该先验送进 LLM decoder 得到逐 token 融合分数，驱动跨 decoder 层的渐进式 top-k 选择。在 Qwen2-Audio-7B、Phi-4-Multimodal、Audio Flamingo 3 上只保留 25% 音频 token 即可维持接近未压缩的语音任务性能，中等压缩率下持平或超过全 token 准确率。
Motivation: 音频编码器对很短的片段也产出数百 token，self-attention 随序列长度平方增长，推理开销被显著抬高；现有免训练压缩只按粗粒度注意力或特征相似度剪枝/合并，把音频 token 当各向同性特征，抹平频谱过渡，破坏解码语音所需的细粒度音素过渡。
Method: 两阶段免训练框架：第一阶段以音频编码器表示几何作为声学先验计算 token 重要性（利用语音信息密度在声学过渡处峰值的结构），第二阶段把该先验直接传播进 LLM decoder，与注意力结合得到逐 token 融合分数，再在各 decoder 层做渐进式 top-k 选择；不引入额外训练或辅助模型。
Result: 在 Qwen2-Audio-7B、Phi-4-Multimodal、Audio Flamingo 3 上，仅用 25% 音频 token 即在多个语音任务上保持接近未压缩的性能；中等压缩率下持平或超过全 token 准确率，并且一致优于现有免训练基线。
Conclusion: 把编码器的表示几何当作声学先验并传播到 decoder 打分，可以在不训练的前提下大幅压缩音频 token 而基本不损失语音任务精度，优于只看注意力或相似度的免训练压缩。

papers.title: EchoTab: Learning Measurement-Grounded Representations for Echocardiographic Diagnosis through Tabular Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Diagnostic information in multi-view medical imaging studies, like echocardiography, is distributed across views, each capturing different aspects of cardiac structure and function. In clinical practice, these views are first interpreted through quantitative measurements, which then support specific diagnoses. However, existing echo representation learning methods do not explicitly model measurements as an intermediate representation between views and diagnosis. As a result, individual measurements are not explicitly represented in a form that downstream diagnostic tasks can selectively use, hindering accurate diagnosis. Inspired by this hierarchical clinical workflow, we introduce EchoTab, a measurement-grounded representation learning framework that represents multi-view echocardiography studies using measurement-specific tokens as an intermediate representation between echo views and diagnosis. Each measurement token selectively attends to the views relevant to its estimation and is trained through tabular reconstruction to predict the corresponding measurement value. The resulting tokens form a factorized echo representation, which encode clinically meaningful structural and functional properties and can be selectively used for downstream diagnosis. Unlike the commonly used contrastive approaches, EchoTab does not require negative samples or large batch sizes. Experiments on two datasets demonstrate that EchoTab learns effective measurement-grounded representations that improve diagnosis classification in multi-view echocardiography and its learned attention aligns with established measurement-view relationships used by cardiologists. Our code is accessible at https://github.com/michelleespranita/EchoTab.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EchoTab 把超声心动图多视图诊断改写成以测量值为中介的表格重建任务：每个测量 token 只注意与该测量相关的视图，通过预测对应测量值来训练，形成可被下游诊断选择性使用的分解式表征。在两个数据集上，该测量接地表征提升了多视图超声心动图的诊断分类，且学到的注意力与心内科医师沿用的测量-视图对应关系一致。
Motivation: 超声心动图的诊断信息分散在多个视图中，临床流程本就先读定量测量再下诊断，但现有表征学习方法不把测量显式建模为视图与诊断之间的中间表示，导致单个测量无法被下游任务选择使用，妨碍准确诊断。
Method: 提出测量接地 (measurement-grounded) 表征框架 EchoTab：用测量专属 token 作为视图与诊断之间的中间表示，每个 token 选择性注意与其估计相关的视图，并通过表格重建 (tabular reconstruction) 预测对应测量值来训练；不依赖负样本或大 batch，区别于常用对比学习方案。
Result: 在两个数据集上的实验表明，EchoTab 学到的测量接地表征改善了多视图超声心动图的诊断分类，其学到的注意力与心内科医师使用的既定测量-视图关系对齐；代码已开源。
Conclusion: 把定量测量显式作为视图与诊断之间的中间表示并用表格重建训练，能在不需负样本与大 batch 的前提下得到可用于下游诊断、且注意力符合临床测量-视图关系的表征。

papers.title: Beyond Discrepancy: Oracle Drift in Nonstationary Weighted Risk Minimization
papers.abstract_en: We analyze distributional drift in nonstationary weighted risk minimization by decomposing the excess risk into estimation, drift, and approximation components. The drift error is commonly bounded through discrepancy-type quantities that control changes of the risk over classes of predictors. We instead relate the drift error directly to the movement of the best predictor within the model class and analyze its behavior in parametrized regression models. Our analysis shows that discrepancy-type quantities can be overly conservative: unlike our oracle drift, they may scale at a larger order than the resulting excess-risk contribution and can respond to changes in the risk surface that do not affect the optimal predictor. For linear regression, we characterize this gap sharply and combine the resulting drift bounds with estimation guarantees. We further extend the analysis to nonparametric regression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在非平稳加权风险最小化中，把超额风险分解为估计、漂移、近似三部分，并用模型类内最优预测子的移动（oracle drift）直接刻画漂移项，而非用 discrepancy 类量。结果表明 discrepancy 可能过度保守：其量级可高于对超额风险的实际贡献，且会对不改变最优预测子的风险面变化产生反应；线性回归下该差距被精确刻画，并与估计保证结合，再推广到非参数回归。
Motivation: 非平稳数据下漂移误差通常用 discrepancy 类量界定，但这类量可能比其对超额风险的真实贡献高一个量级，并对不影响最优预测子的风险变化也做出反应，导致界过松。
Method: 将超额风险分解为 estimation、drift、approximation 三项；漂移项不走 discrepancy 路线，而是直接关联模型类内最优预测子的移动（oracle drift），在参数化回归模型中分析其行为；对线性回归精确刻画 discrepancy 与 oracle drift 的差距，并把漂移界与估计保证结合，再扩展到非参数回归。
Result: discrepancy 类量可能比其导致的超额风险贡献高一个量级，并对不改变最优预测子的风险面变化产生响应；线性回归中该差距被精确刻画，漂移界与估计保证结合，并进一步推广到非参数回归。
Conclusion: 用最优预测子的移动来界定漂移比 discrepancy 更紧，因为 discrepancy 会高估漂移对超额风险的贡献；该结论在参数与非参数回归两类设定下成立。

papers.title: MENTOR: Learning from Failure with On-Policy Pedagogical Intervention
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is a key driver for Large Reasoning Models, but it is vulnerable to "zero-reward collapse", a training failure where a sudden increase in task difficulty causes the learning signal to vanish. We argue that the conventional approach of discarding these failed trajectories is wasteful, as they contain valuable diagnostic information about the model's cognitive gaps, a bright side that can be leveraged for recovery. Existing solutions, however, often regress to static, "off-policy-style" interventions like pre-defined hint libraries or perform post-hoc refinement, failing to provide the adaptive, forward-looking guidance needed to escape the collapse. To address this, we propose a paradigm shift towards on-policy pedagogical intervention and introduce MENTOR, a multi-agent framework that acts as a live mentor. MENTOR diagnoses the root cause of failure in real-time and dynamically generates targeted, instructional prompts to guide the learning agent's next attempt. As a plug-and-play module, MENTOR integrates seamlessly into existing policy optimization pipelines like GRPO without modifying the training infrastructure. Extensive experiments on math and code generation show that MENTOR effectively mitigates zero-reward collapse, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines. Notably, it achieves massive average relative gains of up to 78.3% on Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct over its base model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MENTOR 把 RLVR 中的失败轨迹当作诊断信号，用多智能体框架实时定位失败根因并动态生成针对性教学提示，引导学习智能体重试，从而缓解任务难度骤增导致的 zero-reward collapse。作为即插即用模块接入 GRPO 等策略优化管线且不改动训练基础设施，在数学与代码生成实验中优于现有基线，Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 上相对基模型平均增益最高达 78.3%。
Motivation: RLVR 训练中任务难度突然上升会让奖励信号归零，直接丢弃失败轨迹浪费了其中关于模型认知缺口的诊断信息；现有方法多依赖静态提示库或事后修正，缺少自适应的前瞻性引导来摆脱 collapse。
Method: 提出多智能体框架 MENTOR，作为在线导师实时诊断失败根因并动态生成教学性提示，指导下一次尝试；以即插即用方式接入 GRPO 等现有策略优化管线，无需修改训练基础设施。
Result: 在数学与代码生成实验中，MENTOR 有效缓解 zero-reward collapse，优于 state-of-the-art 基线；在 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 上取得最高 78.3% 的平均相对增益（相对其 base model）。
Conclusion: 把失败轨迹转成在线、策略内 (on-policy) 的教学干预，比丢弃失败样本或静态提示更能恢复 RLVR 的学习信号，且可直接嵌入现有训练管线。

papers.title: Lower Bounds for Randomized Linear-Oracle Optimization over Strongly Convex Sets
papers.abstract_en: Recent results [arXiv:2602.04378, arXiv:2602.22608] have established worst-case objective-error lower bounds of order $1/T^2$ after $T$ linear minimization oracle (LMO) calls, matching the upper bound [arXiv:1406.1305] in its dependence on $T$ and thereby resolving a long-standing open question. Upon close inspection, however, both lower bounds are somewhat brittle. The first [arXiv:2602.04378] applies only to the standard Frank--Wolfe algorithm, and, as we show, its prescribed slow exact-line-search trajectories can amplify sufficiently small initialization errors exponentially, corresponding to roughly one additional bit of initialization accuracy per iteration. The second [arXiv:2602.22608] obtains lower bounds for any deterministic LMO-based first-order method via a resisting oracle that adversarially adapts to the queries of the algorithm. In both cases it is conceivable that randomization may circumvent these lower bounds; in particular, neither establishes a lower bound for unrestricted randomized first-order LMO methods. We close this gap by proving an $Ω(L\operatorname{diam}(S)^2/T^2)$ distributional lower bound for randomized first-order linear minimization oracle methods over strongly convex sets. While our construction reuses the family of [arXiv:2602.22608], our proof characterizes the conditional distribution of the hidden permutation after adaptive queries and bounds the expected decrease of a combinatorial statistic controlling optimizer variance. We further show that the same error threshold holds with probability at least $3/4$ and yields a stopping-time tail bound.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明在强凸集上，任意随机化一阶线性最小化 oracle (LMO) 方法在 T 次查询后的目标误差下界为 Ω(L·diam(S)²/T²)，即随机化无法绕过该最坏情形界。该下界以分布形式成立，且以至少 3/4 的概率成立并给出停时尾界。
Motivation: 已有 1/T² 下界存在脆弱性：一个只适用于标准 Frank–Wolfe 算法，另一个只针对确定性 LMO 一阶方法（resisting oracle），均未覆盖允许随机化的方法，留下随机化是否能绕过下界的缺口。
Method: 复用 arXiv:2602.22608 的构造族，通过刻画自适应查询后隐藏排列 (hidden permutation) 的条件分布，并对控制优化器方差的组合统计量的期望下降量做界，来证明分布型下界。
Result: 得到 Ω(L·diam(S)²/T²) 的分布型下界，与上界在 T 依赖上匹配；同一误差阈值以概率至少 3/4 成立，并给出停时 (stopping-time) 尾界。另指出 arXiv:2602.04378 的慢精确线搜索轨迹会指数放大微小初始化误差，约相当于每次迭代额外需要 1 bit 初始化精度。
Conclusion: 随机化一阶 LMO 方法在强凸集上无法突破 1/T² 最坏情形目标误差阈值，从而把此前只覆盖 Frank–Wolfe 与确定性方法的下界推广到完全随机化设定。

papers.title: Probabilistic Forecasting of Electric Vehicle Charging in a Time-varying Hierarchical Infrastructure
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty quantification for electric vehicle (EV) charging demand is essential to turn the increasing pressure of EV adoption on power systems into a source of flexibility. We study a large-scale dataset of public charging stations in Scotland, where demand exhibits a hierarchical structure, organized across multiple aggregation levels, from individual charging points to regional and national scales. The charging infrastructure is continuously evolving, with new stations deployed and existing ones occasionally removed, which calls for forecasting and uncertainty quantification methods tailored to this evolving structure. To address these challenges, we combine hierarchical forecasting with recent advances in conformal prediction with missing data. The conformal procedures considered produce valid prediction intervals at every node of the hierarchy and the algorithm CP-MNR-Nested successfully accounts for the time-varying hierarchical structure of the data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对苏格兰公共充电桩需求的时变层级结构（新增/撤除站点不断改变聚合树），把层级预测与含缺失数据的 conformal prediction 结合，在每个层级节点上给出有效预测区间；其中 CP-MNR-Nested 算法能处理随时间变化的层级结构。
Motivation: 充电桩网络持续演化，站点增删使聚合层级随时间改变，常规层级预测与不确定性量化方法难以在每个节点上维持有效区间。
Method: 结合层级预测 (hierarchical forecasting) 与针对缺失数据的 conformal prediction，在充电桩点到区域、全国的多级聚合树上构造预测区间，并提出 CP-MNR-Nested 算法处理时变层级。
Result: 在苏格兰大规模公共充电站数据集上，所用 conformal 流程在层级每个节点产生有效预测区间，CP-MNR-Nested 成功处理时变层级结构。
Conclusion: 层级 conformal 预测可为持续演化的充电基础设施提供节点级有效不确定性区间，把 EV 充电需求转化为电力系统的灵活性来源。

papers.title: RARA: Robust Policy Fine-Tuning through Retrieval-Anchored Representation Alignment for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Pre-trained robot policies, such as Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, provide a strong foundation for generalist robotic manipulation, but adapting them to new tasks with only a few demonstrations remains challenging. Directly fine-tuning a pre-trained policy often achieves strong in-distribution performance, yet it can distort the representations learned during pre-training and weaken the model's generalization ability under out-of-distribution shifts. We propose Retrieval-Anchored Representation Alignment (RARA), a two-stage adaptation method, to address this issue. First, RARA retrieves representation features from pretraining with similar task intent and motion, and aligns the policy's representations of the target demonstrations with the pre-trained representations of the retrieved demonstrations. Second, RARA fine-tunes the policy on the target demonstrations while limiting how much its representations of the retrieved demonstrations change during fine-tuning. By reducing the representation mismatch before action learning and preserving pre-trained knowledge during adaptation, RARA limits unnecessary representation drift during fine-tuning. Experiments with Diffusion Policy and GR00T on 13 tasks in RoboTwin, RoboCasa, and on a real robot show that RARA improves the average success of fine-tuning by 9.5 points in-distribution and 13.6 points out-of-distribution, and outperforms all compared baselines. Project page: https://shua-kang.github.io/RARA_robot/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RARA 是两阶段的机器人策略微调方法：先从预训练数据中检索任务意图与运动相似的示范，把目标示范的表征对齐到检索到的示范的预训练表征，再在微调时约束这些检索示范表征的改动幅度，从而抑制表征漂移。在 Diffusion Policy 与 GR00T 上、覆盖 RoboTwin、RoboCasa 及真实机器人的 13 个任务中，微调平均成功率在分布内提升 9.5 个百分点、分布外提升 13.6 个百分点，并超过全部对比基线。
Motivation: 少示范适配新任务时，直接微调预训练策略虽能拿到强的分布内表现，却会破坏预训练学到的表征、削弱分布外偏移下的泛化能力。
Method: 两阶段适配：第一阶段从预训练数据中检索任务意图与运动相近的示范，将策略对目标示范的表征与这些检索示范的预训练表征做对齐；第二阶段在目标示范上微调，同时限制策略在检索示范上的表征变化幅度，以在动作学习前减小表征失配、在适配中保住预训练知识。
Result: 在 Diffusion Policy 与 GR00T 上、于 RoboTwin、RoboCasa 与真实机器人的 13 个任务中，微调平均成功率分布内提高 9.5 个百分点、分布外提高 13.6 个百分点，且优于所有对比基线。
Conclusion: 先对齐再约束的表征漂移控制，能在少示范微调 VLA 类策略时同时保住分布内成功率与分布外泛化，优于直接微调。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: $L_0$ Feature Selection via Monte Carlo Tree Search in High-Dimensional Financial Regression
papers.abstract_en: Feature selection is a central problem in high-dimensional financial regression, where large numbers of engineered variables and strong correlations among predictors reduce model stability and interpretability. $L_1$ regularization (Lasso) is widely used for sparse regression, but its shrinkage can be restrictive when informative signals are spread across correlated variables. Exact sparse regression avoids this shrinkage but requires solving a combinatorial optimization problem that is computationally difficult and is typically fit to minimize in-sample rather than out-of-sample error. This paper presents a feature selection framework based on Monte Carlo Tree Search with Generalized Nested Rollout Policy Adaptation (GNRPA). Feature selection is formulated as a sequential decision process, and candidate subsets are scored by their out-of-sample validation performance rather than training error. The method also supports a lexicographic objective accounting for subset size and multicollinearity. We study this approach on a contemporaneous explanatory regression task: explaining the weekly return of the NASDAQ-100 index from 1,072 engineered features spanning market, macroeconomic, and factor data. This isolates the value of subset selection under multicollinearity from the separate problem of predictive forecasting. On this task, the proposed method identifies sparse feature subsets with higher out-of-sample explanatory power than an optimized Lasso baseline, reaching an out-of-sample $R^2$ of 0.6961 versus 0.6313 for Lasso. These results suggest that Monte Carlo Tree Search is a practical alternative to convex regularization for sparse explanatory feature selection in financial regression, with potential value for factor attribution and risk decomposition where transparency matters as much as out-of-sample fit.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 7th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance (ICAIF '26). 8 pages, 2 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把高维金融回归的特征选择建模为序列决策过程，用 Monte Carlo Tree Search 配合 GNRPA 搜索变量子集，并以样本外验证表现（而非训练误差）打分，同时支持含子集大小与多重共线性的字典序目标。在用 1,072 个工程特征解释 NASDAQ-100 指数周收益的任务上，样本外 R² 达 0.6961，优于优化后的 Lasso 基线 0.6313。
Motivation: 高维金融回归中变量多、预测因子间强相关，削弱模型稳定性与可解释性；L1 收缩在信号分散于相关变量时过于受限，而精确稀疏回归的组合优化通常只最小化样本内误差。
Method: 将特征选择表述为序列决策过程，用 Monte Carlo Tree Search 与 Generalized Nested Rollout Policy Adaptation (GNRPA) 搜索子集，候选子集按样本外验证表现打分，并支持计入子集大小与多重共线性的字典序目标；实验为同期解释性回归，用市场、宏观经济与因子数据构成的 1,072 个特征解释 NASDAQ-100 周收益，与优化后的 Lasso 对比。
Result: 在 NASDAQ-100 周收益解释任务上，方法找到的稀疏子集样本外 R² 为 0.6961，优化 Lasso 基线为 0.6313。
Conclusion: Monte Carlo Tree Search 可作为凸正则化的实用替代，用于金融回归的稀疏解释性特征选择，在因子归因与风险分解等重视透明度的场景有应用价值。

papers.title: Simultaneous Competitive and Regret Guarantees for TCP Acknowledgment
papers.abstract_en: We study simultaneous competitive and regret guarantees for TCP acknowledgment. Each acknowledgment serves all pending packets, and the objective is to minimize the total acknowledgment and waiting costs. It is well known that no deterministic online algorithm achieves a competitive ratio better than $2$. Given $k$ randomized online experts and $0<\varepsilon<1$, we construct a randomized online algorithm whose realized total cost is always at most $(2+\varepsilon)$ times the offline optimal cost $\mathrm{OPT}$ and whose expected regret against the expert with the smallest realized cost is $O(\sqrt{\mathrm{OPT}\log(k+1)}+\log(1/\varepsilon))$. The algorithm requires no advance knowledge of the number of packets or $\mathrm{OPT}$. Our algorithm controls switching costs between experts and uses the gap between the permitted competitive bound and its current cost to determine when to learn. We also prove lower bounds showing that, for $k\ge 2$, this regret bound is asymptotically optimal in $\mathrm{OPT}$, $k$, and $\varepsilon$, and that $\varepsilon>0$ is necessary for sublinear regret.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 TCP 确认 (acknowledgment) 的在线决策问题中，构造一个随机化在线算法：实现总代价恒不超过 (2+ε)·OPT，同时对实现代价最小的专家的期望 regret 为 O(√(OPT·log(k+1)) + log(1/ε))，且无需预先知道包数或 OPT。对 k≥2 证明该 regret 在 OPT、k、ε 上渐近最优，并证明 ε>0 是次线性 regret 的必要条件。
Motivation: TCP 确认问题中每个确认覆盖所有待发包，需在确认代价与等待代价之间权衡；已知确定性在线算法竞争比无法优于 2，而同时给出竞争比与 regret 保证、且不预知包数或 OPT 的随机化方案此前缺失。
Method: 给定 k 个随机化在线专家与 0<ε<1，构造随机化在线算法：控制专家之间的切换代价，并用允许的竞争上界与当前代价之差决定何时学习；算法不需要包数或 OPT 的先验知识。
Result: 实现总代价始终 ≤ (2+ε)·OPT；对实现代价最小专家的期望 regret 为 O(√(OPT·log(k+1)) + log(1/ε))。下界证明对 k≥2 该 regret 在 OPT、k、ε 上渐近最优，且 ε>0 对次线性 regret 是必要的；确定性算法竞争比下界为 2。
Conclusion: 竞争比与 regret 可以同时保证：(2+ε) 竞争比下能达到渐近最优的次线性 regret，代价是必须保留 ε>0 的松弛。

summary_sections.method: 给定 k 个随机化在线专家与 0<ε<1，构造随机化在线算法：控制专家之间的切换代价，并用允许的竞争上界与当前代价之差决定何时学习；算法不需要包数或 OPT 的先验知识。
summary_sections.result: 实现总代价始终 ≤ (2+ε)·OPT；对实现代价最小专家的期望 regret 为 O(√(OPT·log(k+1)) + log(1/ε))。下界证明对 k≥2 该 regret 在 OPT、k、ε 上渐近最优，且 ε>0 对次线性 regret 是必要的；确定性算法竞争比下界为 2。
summary_sections.conclusion: 竞争比与 regret 可以同时保证：(2+ε) 竞争比下能达到渐近最优的次线性 regret，代价是必须保留 ε>0 的松弛。

papers.title: Constructing Pareto Frontiers of Optimal Reasoning Termination Methods for Overthinking in Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning models can benefit from test-time scaling, but continued reasoning may become ineffective or harmful, a phenomenon termed overthinking. Evaluations against full thinking compare accuracy and token usage but lack references for overthinking severity and strategies' theoretical mitigation potential. To characterize overthinking at the model-task level, we first introduce Step-wise Truncation Probing (STP), repeatedly generating answers from multiple retained prefixes along each fixed sampled reasoning trajectory. Using each trajectory's earliest measured position attaining maximum empirical accuracy as a reference, we define Overthinking Ratio and Accuracy Degradation as the fraction of thinking tokens generated afterward and the accuracy decrease from this reference to full thinking, respectively. Secondly, we then formulate dynamic routing, fixed budgets, and dynamic early exit within a unified framework to quantify the theoretical mitigation potential of different termination strategies. Based on this unified framework, we use the complete STP measurements to construct a token-accuracy Pareto frontier for each strategy under a common normalized thinking-token budget. We further develop OTBench, a reusable benchmark built from the STP process, which produced 70.5B reasoning tokens and the corresponding probing measurements across six models and four benchmark groups.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Step-wise Truncation Probing (STP)：沿固定采样推理轨迹在多个保留前缀上重复生成答案，以达到最大经验准确率的最早位置为参考，定义 Overthinking Ratio 与 Accuracy Degradation 两个过度思考度量，并把动态路由、固定预算、动态早停统一进一个框架，在统一归一化思考 token 预算下构造各策略的 token-accuracy Pareto 前沿。基于 STP 过程发布 OTBench，覆盖六个模型、四组 benchmark，产出 70.5B reasoning tokens 及对应探测测量。
Motivation: 现有评测只在 full thinking 下比较准确率与 token 用量，缺少衡量过度思考严重程度的参考点，也无法量化各终止策略在理论上的缓解上限。
Method: STP 沿每条固定采样推理轨迹在多个保留前缀上反复生成答案，取最早达到最大经验准确率的位置作参考；据此定义 Overthinking Ratio（其后生成的思考 token 占比）与 Accuracy Degradation（参考点到 full thinking 的准确率下降）。再把 dynamic routing、fixed budgets、dynamic early exit 纳入统一框架，用完整 STP 测量在共同归一化思考 token 预算下构造各策略的 token-accuracy Pareto 前沿。
Result: 构建 OTBench 基准，由 STP 过程产出 70.5B reasoning tokens 及配套探测测量，覆盖六个模型与四组 benchmark；并为三类终止策略各给出统一预算下的 token-accuracy Pareto 前沿。
Conclusion: 过度思考可以在模型-任务层面用参考点式度量刻画，终止策略的缓解潜力可在统一框架下按 token-accuracy 权衡直接比较，OTBench 使这一测量可复用。

papers.title: Rationally Linearized MLPs
papers.abstract_en: We present Rationally Linearized Multilayer Perceptrons(RaLiMPs), a new approach to efficiently linearizing MLPs using low-degree rational approximations of standard activation functions. Inspired by polynomial-based MLP linearization, we show that rational approximations can provide accurate representations at substantially lower degree. RaLiMPs exploit these approximations to construct kernel representations with narrow bottlenecks, enabling efficient composition across MLP layers. We provide theoretical guarantees for the resulting approximation and evaluate RaLiMPs across applications ranging from implicit 3D models to large language models. Our experiments demonstrate favorable accuracy--efficiency tradeoffs, with RaLiMPs achieving competitive or improved accuracy while substantially reducing inference cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RaLiMPs 用低阶有理逼近 (rational approximation) 替代多项式来线性化 MLP 激活函数，在更低阶数下即可达到可用精度，从而构造出带窄瓶颈的核表示、实现跨层高效复合。在隐式 3D 模型到大语言模型的评测中，其精度持平或更优，同时显著降低推理成本。
Motivation: 多项式式 MLP 线性化需要较高阶数才能逼近激活函数，导致核表示与跨层复合开销大，推理成本高。
Method: 对标准激活函数做低阶有理逼近，据此构造带窄瓶颈 (narrow bottleneck) 的核表示以高效复合各 MLP 层，并给出逼近的理论保证；在隐式 3D 模型与大语言模型上评测精度-效率权衡。
Result: 在隐式 3D 模型到 LLM 的跨应用评测中，RaLiMPs 取得持平或提升的精度，同时大幅降低推理成本；有理逼近在显著更低的阶数下即可提供准确表示。
Conclusion: 有理函数是比多项式更省阶数的 MLP 线性化路径，可在不牺牲精度的前提下压低推理开销。

papers.title: What We Talk About When We Talk About Emotion Editing
papers.abstract_en: Emotional image editing aims to change the emotion a scene conveys while preserving its essential content. Because the same scene can support different emotional interpretations, achieving an emotional goal requires visual changes grounded in the source context. Motivated by the Component Process Model, which links emotional responses to event appraisal, we investigate neural representations as a reference for these editing decisions. Using TRIBE v2, an fMRI encoding model, we analyze 400 source-target pairs across eight emotion categories. Hidden states from EmoEdit, EmoEditor, and AffectDelta correspond more strongly to predicted target-image responses in visual regions than in affect-related regions. This imbalance motivates ROI-ReFT, which combines source visual responses as a content reference with a predicted affective response change as an editing direction. Two interacting branches use both conditions to guide a frozen editor throughout generation. Predicted responses of the generated image supervise affective change and constrain visual drift. On a post hoc selected subset of 400 editing requests, ROI-ReFT achieves 91.75% target-emotion accuracy and 83.25% joint success, with the same output both matching the target emotion and reaching source-output DINO-I of at least 0.80. Our code and dataset will be publicly released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 情感图像编辑中，EmoEdit、EmoEditor、AffectDelta 的隐状态更贴近 TRIBE v2 预测的目标图像在视觉区而非情感相关区的响应，ROI-ReFT 因此把源视觉响应当内容参考、把预测的情感响应变化当编辑方向，用两个交互分支引导冻结编辑器。在 400 条编辑请求的后验选定子集上，目标情感准确率 91.75%，同时满足目标情感与源-输出 DINO-I ≥ 0.80 的联合成功率 83.25%。
Motivation: 同一场景可承载不同情感解读，编辑需在保留内容的前提下做与源上下文绑定的视觉改动；现有编辑器的隐状态与预测目标响应在视觉区强、在情感区弱，情感目标缺少神经层面的参照。
Method: 以 Component Process Model 为动机，用 fMRI 编码模型 TRIBE v2 分析 400 组源-目标图像对、覆盖八类情感；ROI-ReFT 将源视觉响应作为内容参考、预测的情感响应变化作为编辑方向，两个交互分支在生成全程引导冻结编辑器，并用生成图像的预测响应监督情感变化、约束视觉漂移。
Result: 在 400 条编辑请求的后验选定子集上，ROI-ReFT 目标情感准确率 91.75%，联合成功（输出既匹配目标情感又达到源-输出 DINO-I ≥ 0.80）83.25%；分析覆盖 400 组源-目标对与八类情感。
Conclusion: 把预测的情感响应变化作为编辑方向、源视觉响应作为内容参照，可在冻结编辑器上同时保住目标情感与内容一致性；代码与数据集将公开发布。

papers.title: Probabilistic Ship Trajectory Forecasting using Transformer Models on AIS Data
papers.abstract_en: Anticipation of vessel trajectories is an essential task when navigating at sea. This applies to both human navigators and autonomous surface vessels. Trajectory forecasting enables sub-routines such as collision avoidance to assess the situation and react accordingly in time. This paper investigates Transformer and Performer models for trajectory prediction of surface vessels in confined waters. Using widely available position data from the Automatic Identification System (AIS), candidate models are trained and evaluated. Historical information on how other vessels have moved in the local area surrounding each agent is conveyed using positional heat maps. The heat maps are generated using Kernel Density Estimation (KDE) and encoded with a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) before entering the Transformer models. The models are trained with quantile loss to efficiently obtain a model-aware prediction interval, as this is crucial for timely collision avoidance. The proposed model architectures are shown to greatly outperform previous work while the inclusion of local heat maps enables the prediction of vessel movement that is not otherwise indicated from the previous positions.
papers.comment: Manuscript written in 2021. 16 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Transformer/Performers 做受限水域船舶轨迹概率预报：把周边船舶历史位置经 Kernel Density Estimation (KDE) 做成位置热图、用 CNN 编码后与本船历史一起输入，训练用 quantile loss 直接给出预测区间。摘要称所提架构大幅超越先前工作，且加入局部热图后能预测仅凭本船历史位置看不出的运动。
Motivation: 海上避碰与自主表面船舶需要提前预判他船轨迹并及时反应，仅靠单船历史位置无法反映受限水域中他船运动带来的态势。
Method: 在 AIS 位置数据上训练 Transformer 与 Performer 模型；用 KDE 生成本船周边其他船舶历史运动的位置热图，经 CNN 编码后作为输入；以 quantile loss 训练以获得模型自知的预测区间。
Result: 所提模型架构在受限水域船舶轨迹预测上大幅优于先前工作；加入局部热图后可预测仅从历史位置无法体现的船舶运动。
Conclusion: 把局部他船运动热图与 quantile loss 结合的 Transformer 轨迹预报能同时提升精度并给出可用于及时避碰的预测区间。

papers.title: Learning Holistic Scene Layout against View Shifts in Cross-View Geo-Localization
papers.abstract_en: Cross-view geo-localization remains challenging due to drastic appearance variations and geometric distortions caused by viewpoint changes. Existing methods primarily rely on discriminative feature learning or explicit geometric alignment, yet often overlook an important observation: humans tend to match scenes by integrating the spatial context of multiple landmarks rather than relying solely on isolated local visual cues. Inspired by this, we propose a Spatial Context Modeling (SCM) module, which traverses feature maps along four orthogonal directions and models interactions among the resulting directional representations at each spatial position. By aggregating complementary directional observations, SCM constructs richer scene layout representations. Since reliable spatial context depends on robust visual features, we introduce a High-Frequency Information Guidance (HFIG) module that extracts stable structural cues from the frequency domain. By emphasizing edges and contours that are less sensitive to appearance variations, HFIG encourages the model to learn more robust representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves competitive performance on standard cross-view geo-localization benchmarks while exhibiting strong robustness under more challenging scenarios with unknown orientations and limited fields of view (FoVs).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出跨视图地理定位 (cross-view geo-localization) 的 SCM 模块，沿四个正交方向遍历特征图并在每个空间位置建模方向表征间交互，聚合互补方向观测以构建更完整的场景布局表示；再用 HFIG 从频域提取对视角变化不敏感的边缘与轮廓结构线索来稳定特征。在标准跨视图地理定位基准上取得有竞争力的表现，并在朝向未知、视野受限的困难场景下表现出强鲁棒性。
Motivation: 跨视图地理定位受视角变化带来的外观差异与几何畸变困扰，现有判别式特征学习或显式几何对齐方法只依赖孤立局部视觉线索，忽略了人靠多个地标空间上下文匹配场景这一观察。
Method: SCM 模块沿四个正交方向遍历特征图，在每个空间位置建模方向表征之间的交互，聚合互补方向观测得到场景布局表示；HFIG 模块从频域提取稳定结构线索，强调对外观变化不敏感的边缘与轮廓，引导模型学习更鲁棒的表征。
Result: 在标准跨视图地理定位基准上取得有竞争力的表现，并在朝向未知、视野 (FoV) 受限的更具挑战性的场景下表现出强鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 把多地标空间上下文与频域高频结构线索一起建模，可在跨视图地理定位中同时提升常规性能与朝向未知、视野受限条件下的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: ELMA: Benchmarking Anaphoric Compositions for Long-Term Text-to-Motion Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-guided long-term human motion generation is essential for applications such as continuously operating digital avatars. Despite recent progress on short clips, existing models struggle with multi-segment instructions that involve anaphora, where constraints established in earlier segments must be preserved over time. In this paper, we introduce a novel task of long-term motion generation from such anaphoric compositions. To mitigate this, we present ELMA, an episodic long-term motion dataset with dense segment-level annotations that preserve cross-segment dependencies. Built via a fully automated collection and filtering pipeline, ELMA extracts high-quality, continuous 30-second clips from in-the-wild videos, capturing the episodic narratives necessary for long-range state modeling. Leveraging this dataset, we fine-tune state-of-the-art motion generation models to incorporate long-range context. Extensive experiments reveal fundamental shortcomings in current models when handling context-dependent instructions. We demonstrate that ELMA enables significant improvements in both global physical realism and semantic alignment, setting a robust new baseline for long-term motion synthesis.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations & Datasets Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ELMA 提出长时文本到动作生成中的回指组合 (anaphoric compositions) 新任务：多段指令里前段建立的约束必须跨段保持。它用全自动采集过滤流水线从野外视频中抽出连续 30 秒片段并做稠密段级标注，构成 episodic 长时动作数据集 ELMA，用其微调现有动作生成模型后，全局物理真实感与语义对齐均显著提升。
Motivation: 短片段动作生成已有进展，但多段指令含回指时，早期片段确立的约束无法跨时保持，长时数字分身等需持续运行的场景因此受限。
Method: 构建 ELMA：全自动采集与过滤流水线从 in-the-wild 视频抽取高质量连续 30 秒片段，附带稠密段级标注以保留跨段依赖；再用该数据集微调 SOTA 动作生成模型，使其纳入长程上下文。
Result: 实验揭示现有模型在处理上下文相关指令时存在根本性缺陷；用 ELMA 微调后在全局物理真实感与语义对齐两方面均带来显著提升，为长时动作合成确立了稳健的新基线。
Conclusion: 带跨段依赖标注的 episodic 长时数据是解决回指式长时动作生成的关键，ELMA 因此成为该任务的新基线。

papers.title: Auditing VLM Benchmarks from Existing Evaluation Runs
papers.abstract_en: Every evaluation run of a vision-language model (VLM) already produces per-question artifacts (predictions, judged correctness, metadata) that leaderboards reduce to a single score and then discard. We reuse those artifacts to audit the benchmark itself, and add an audit layer to VLMEvalKit: six detectors that run as post-processing over saved outputs, plus one additional text-only rerun with visual inputs removed, emitting a per-question report. The layer reports per-question findings together with aggregate audit statistics; for the headline quantities, it attaches permutation-null excess where applicable, interval estimates for proportions, and sensitivity to the model pool. Auditing MMStar, a benchmark curated specifically so that the image is indispensable, with three models, we find zero aggregate accuracy gain from the image on 20.2% of its questions. An item-matched permutation null accounts for 17.0%, leaving a +3.2 pp excess (corrected permutation p = 0.001). This excess is concentrated in the mathematics and science categories and is absent from coarse perception, a localization consistent with knowledge substituting for visual evidence; confirming that mechanism would require item-level review. A second detector flags 134 questions on which every model that answered in parseable form picked the same non-gold option, and these candidates peak in the perception categories, whereas the zero-gain excess is largest in mathematics and science & technology. Replacing the LLM judge with exact string matching changes no conclusion, and every scoring discrepancy between the two traces to one model whose free-form answers a parser cannot read. On a binary yes/no benchmark the detectors measurably fall out of calibration, a scope boundary that we measure and report. The audit layer, the prediction artifacts and the generated reports accompany this submission.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop TAE (Trust-AI-Eval): Can We Trust AI Evaluation? (non-archival). Code and artifacts: https://github.com/avos-rnd/vlm-bench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 VLM 评测已有的逐题产物（预测、判分、元数据）当作审计对象，向 VLMEvalKit 加一层六个后处理器加一次去视觉文本重跑，输出逐题审计报告。审计 MMStar（三个模型）发现 20.2% 的题在去掉图像后聚合准确率零增益，置换零假设解释 17.0%，剩余 +3.2 pp 超额（校正置换 p = 0.001），且集中在数学与科学类。
Motivation: 排行榜把每次评测的逐题产物压成一个总分后丢弃，基准本身的缺陷（图像可有可无、题目歧义）因此不可见。
Method: 在 VLMEvalKit 上加审计层：六个检测器作为对已保存输出的后处理，外加一次移除视觉输入的纯文本重跑；对头条量附置换零假设超额、比例区间估计和对模型池的敏感性分析。
Result: MMStar 上三个模型：20.2% 题目图像零增益；置换零假设占 17.0%，超额 +3.2 pp（校正置换 p = 0.001），超额集中在数学与科学类、粗感知类缺失；第二个检测器标出 134 道所有可解析作答模型都选同一非金标选项的题，峰值在感知类；换成精确字符串匹配的 LLM judge 不改变任何结论，唯一评分差异来自一个自由文本答案无法被解析器读取的模型；在二元 yes/no 基准上检测器明显失准。
Conclusion: MMStar 并非所有题都真正依赖图像：数学与科学类存在知识替代视觉证据的定位证据（机制仍需逐题复核），感知类则不然；审计层可复用，但在二元基准上需注意校准边界。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MOSAIC: Multi-Scale Object-Centric Slot Adaptation with Image-Guided Prototype Conditioning for Remote Sensing Image Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained diffusion Transformers provide powerful generative priors for image restoration, yet adapting them to structure-sensitive tasks remains challenging. Existing methods mainly rely on dense low-resolution features as conditions, which often entangle salient objects with dominant backgrounds and provide limited abstraction for recurring structures across scales and samples. We propose MOSAIC, an object-centric representation learning framework that learns compact structural conditions for generative model adaptation. MOSAIC organizes degraded observations into structural slots that capture complementary object-level and layout-level evidence, integrates them across resolutions, and retrieves recurring priors from a shared prototype memory to complement incomplete image-specific information. The resulting representations are injected into selected layers of a frozen diffusion Transformer through lightweight residual modulation, preserving its pretrained generative prior. We instantiate MOSAIC for remote sensing image super-resolution, where small objects, repetitive structures, and large-scale variation provide a challenging testbed. Experiments on UCMerced, AID, and RSSCN7 show consistent PSNR improvements across $\times 2$ and $\times 4$ settings and favorable LPIPS results at $\times 4$. Qualitative results further demonstrate improved preservation of small objects, structural boundaries, and repetitive spatial patterns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MOSAIC 把退化遥感影像组织成物体级与布局级的 structural slots，跨分辨率整合后从共享 prototype memory 检索复现先验，再以轻量残差调制注入冻结的 diffusion Transformer，在 UCMerced、AID、RSSCN7 的 ×2 与 ×4 超分上取得一致 PSNR 提升，并在 ×4 上给出有竞争力的 LPIPS。
Motivation: 预训练 diffusion Transformer 的生成先验难以适配结构敏感任务：现有方法用稠密低分辨率特征作条件，会把显著物体与主导背景纠缠，且对跨尺度、跨样本的复现结构抽象不足。
Method: 以 object-centric 表示学习框架学习紧凑结构条件：将退化观测组织为捕捉物体级与布局级互补证据的 structural slots，跨分辨率整合，并从共享 prototype memory 检索复现先验补足不完整的图像自身信息；所得表示经轻量残差调制注入冻结 diffusion Transformer 的选定层，保留其预训练生成先验。
Result: 在遥感影像超分设定下，UCMerced、AID、RSSCN7 三个数据集的 ×2 与 ×4 设置均取得一致 PSNR 提升，×4 上 LPIPS 结果有利；定性结果显示小物体、结构边界与重复空间模式的保持改善。
Conclusion: 以物体中心的结构槽加原型记忆作为条件，可在不改动冻结 diffusion Transformer 权重的前提下适配遥感超分这类结构敏感任务，并改善小物体与重复结构的保持。

papers.title: Efficient Confidence-Aware Densification for 3DGS
papers.abstract_en: 3DGS-MCMC has replaced the gradient-driven density control of 3D Gaussian Splatting with opacity-based sampling and relocation, and is now the de facto standard for prior-free densification under a fixed primitive budget. Because opacity stays high where the scene is already well reconstructed, this sampling sends most new primitives to the foreground and leaves the background under-reconstructed. At low budgets, prior-based methods such as ConeGS and EDGS outperform it, at the cost of a pre-trained radiance field or dense image matches and a separate initialization stage. We argue for a comeback of error-driven densification within the fixed-budget MCMC framework. Our confidence-aware densification keeps the fixed budget and gradual growth of 3DGS-MCMC, but places primitives by the image error instead of the opacity. New primitives are drawn mostly where screen-space gradients are large. We favor primitives with a low learned confidence, which marks regions the reconstruction still explains poorly, and relocate the primitives that contribute least to the rendered images to these places. Averaged over 24 scenes, our method outperforms 3DGS-MCMC in PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS at every budget from 100k to 2M primitives. At 100k, without a prior or an initialization stage, it recovers 0.84dB of the 1.05dB PSNR by which ConeGS leads 3DGS-MCMC, and from 500k on, it has the highest PSNR and SSIM of all fixed-budget methods we compare with, including ConeGS and EDGS. While inherently prior-free, our densification can also exploit priors: from the ConeGS or EDGS initialization, it matches ConeGS in PSNR and SSIM at 100k and is best in all three metrics at 500k.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定图元预算的 3DGS-MCMC 框架内，用图像误差与学习到的置信度替代不透明度采样来决定新图元的放置位置，把原语从已重建好的前景移到重建差的背景。24 个场景平均，在 100k–2M 全部预算上 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 均优于 3DGS-MCMC；100k 时无先验即追回 ConeGS 领先 3DGS-MCMC 的 1.05dB 中的 0.84dB，500k 起在所比较的全部固定预算方法中 PSNR 与 SSIM 最高。
Motivation: 3DGS-MCMC 的不透明度采样把新图元集中到前景，背景欠重建，低预算下被 ConeGS、EDGS 等依赖先验的方法超过，而这些方法需要预训练辐射场或稠密图像匹配加独立初始化阶段。
Method: 保留 3DGS-MCMC 的固定预算与渐进增长，但按图像误差而非不透明度放置图元：新图元主要画在屏幕空间梯度大的位置，优先选择学习置信度低（重建仍解释差）的区域，并把对渲染贡献最小的图元迁移到这些位置；该过程也可接在 ConeGS 或 EDGS 初始化之后。
Result: 24 个场景平均，在 100k 到 2M 的每个预算上 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 都优于 3DGS-MCMC；100k 无先验、无初始化阶段时追回 ConeGS 领先 3DGS-MCMC 的 1.05dB PSNR 中的 0.84dB；从 500k 起在所比较的全部固定预算方法（含 ConeGS、EDGS）中 PSNR 与 SSIM 最高；以 ConeGS 或 EDGS 初始化时，100k 达到 ConeGS 的 PSNR 与 SSIM，500k 在三个指标上全部最佳。
Conclusion: 固定预算下的误差驱动与置信度驱动致密化可以在不引入先验或初始化阶段的前提下超过基于不透明度的 MCMC 采样，并且与先验方法兼容。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Defence against the dark arts of distillation: Unsupervised discovery of subliminal learning
papers.abstract_en: When a language model is distilled from a teacher that shares its base parameters, the student can inherit behavioural traits of the teacher---including misalignment---even from data that is semantically unrelated to the trait (Cloud et al., 2026). All existing defences require knowing the trait. We remove this requirement and prove that a subliminally transferred trait can be recovered from the parameter updates alone, without supervision, by exploiting a single asymmetry: the trait is expressed consistently across diverse datasets generated by the teacher, whereas task-specific and shared capabilities vary. The resulting estimator returns a weight-space direction that can be amplified to discover and interpret the trait or projected out to suppress it. Applied to the subliminal-learning benchmarks of (Cloud et al., 2026), our method recovers the transmitted animal-preference traits without any trait labels and suppresses their expression with almost no impact to task performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对蒸馏中学生模型在语义无关数据上继承教师隐性特质（subliminal learning）且现有防御都需预先知道该特质的问题，提出一种无监督估计器：利用“特质在教师生成的多样数据集上表达一致、而任务能力与共享能力随数据集变化”这一不对称性，仅从参数更新中恢复权重空间方向。该方向可放大用于发现与解释特质，也可投影掉以抑制特质表达；在 Cloud et al. (2026) 的隐性学习基准上，无需特质标签即可恢复传递的动物偏好特质，并在几乎不影响任务性能的前提下抑制其表达。
Motivation: 当语言模型从共享基座参数的教师蒸馏而来时，学生会在语义无关数据上继承教师行为特质（含 misalignment）；现有全部防御都要求事先知道该特质是什么，无法应对未知特质的隐性传递。
Method: 无监督权重空间方向估计器：仅用参数更新，依赖单一不对称性——特质在教师生成的多样数据集上表达一致，而任务特异能力与共享能力随数据集变化；输出的权重空间方向既可放大以发现和解释特质，也可投影掉以抑制特质。
Result: 在 Cloud et al. (2026) 的 subliminal-learning 基准上，无需任何特质标签即恢复传递的动物偏好特质，并抑制其表达，且对任务性能影响几乎为零。
Conclusion: 隐性传递的特质可从参数更新本身无监督地被恢复与移除，防御不再需要预先知道特质；该不对称性同时支持特质的发现、解释与抑制。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 针对蒸馏中学生模型在语义无关数据上继承教师隐性特质（subliminal learning）且现有防御都需预先知道该特质的问题，提出一种无监督估计器：利用“特质在教师生成的多样数据集上表达一致、而任务能力与共享能力随数据集变化”这一不对称性，仅从参数更新中恢复权重空间方向。该方向可放大用于发现与解释特质，也可投影掉以抑制特质表达；在 Cloud et al. (2026) 的隐性学习基准上，无需特质标签即可恢复传递的动物偏好特质，并在几乎不影响任务性能的前提下抑制其表达。

papers.title: Knowing Whether, Not Just Where: Anchor-Probing Distillation for Open-Set Remote Sensing Visual Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Open-set visual grounding in remote sensing requires models to determine not only where a queried object is located, but also whether the image provides sufficient evidence for the query at all. Existing closed-set grounding models, however, tend to return plausible boxes even for absent objects, blurring localization confidence with genuine Visual Support. We introduce AnchorProbe-Distill (APD), a teacher-student framework that recasts open-set grounding as Visual Support learning. APD builds on the insight that supported queries should induce coherent spatial anchors, whereas unsupported or mismatched queries tend to produce unstable or misleading localization patterns. APD-T therefore uses the Original Query as a Reference Anchor to interpret query perturbations: Semantic-Preserving Queries retain the annotated target, Near-Category Ambiguous Queries are resolved according to whether they form a reliable alternative anchor or collapse onto the Reference Anchor, and Far-Category Counterfactual Queries provide rejection supervision. This reference-aware reasoning is distilled into APD-S, enabling unified localization and rejection from a single image--query pair. Experiments show that APD enables the resulting model to reject absent targets while also improving its localization of present targets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Anchor-Probe Distillation (APD)，把开放集遥感视觉定位 (open-set visual grounding) 重写为 Visual Support 学习：用原始查询作 Reference Anchor 判定查询扰动是否形成可靠替代锚点，再把该参考感知推理蒸馏进学生模型，使其在单次 image-query 前向中同时定位与拒绝。实验显示模型能拒绝缺席目标，同时提升对在场目标的定位。
Motivation: 闭集 grounding 模型对不存在的目标也会返回看似合理的框，把定位置信度与真正的 Visual Support 混为一谈，无法判断图像是否提供了查询所需的证据。
Method: APD 采用 teacher-student 框架：APD-T 以 Original Query 为 Reference Anchor 解读查询扰动，Semantic-Preserving Queries 保留标注目标，Near-Category Ambiguous Queries 按是否形成可靠替代锚点或塌缩到 Reference Anchor 来判定，Far-Category Counterfactual Queries 提供拒绝监督；这些参考感知推理蒸馏到 APD-S，实现单个 image-query 对上的统一定位与拒绝。
Result: 实验表明 APD 使最终模型既能拒绝缺席目标，又改善对在场目标的定位；摘要未给出具体数据集、指标或数值对比。
Conclusion: 把开放集遥感 grounding 的核心从「在哪里」转为「是否有证据」，并用参考锚点扰动分类构造拒绝监督，可在不牺牲定位的前提下获得拒绝能力。

papers.title: MAGMA-Bench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Embodied Agents under Dynamic Tasks and Execution Failures
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon embodied agents must maintain task-relevant information, coordinate heterogeneous robots, and adapt their decisions as execution unfolds. Existing benchmarks investigate dynamic task execution and embodied multi-agent coordination, but provide limited evaluation of their intersection. We introduce MAGMA-Bench, an architecture-agnostic benchmark for persistent task reasoning in dynamic multi-robot environments. MAGMA-Bench evaluates agents across increasing task horizons and controlled online perturbations, including execution failures, task interruptions, and mission updates, with scenarios requiring coordination across robots with heterogeneous capabilities. It uses a structured skill-level interface to separate task-level reasoning from perception and low-level control. We evaluate locally deployable open-weight planners, multi-agent state-tracking strategies, and frontier models. Even the strongest evaluated models fail on a substantial fraction of clean episodes, and their success rates decrease further under online perturbations. Supervised adaptation greatly improves a small model, but performance remains substantially lower on longer and multi-robot missions. We release the benchmark, 261,646 task-level training examples, and an architecture-agnostic expert-trace generation pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MAGMA-Bench 是面向动态多机器人长时程具身智能体的架构无关基准，用技能级接口把任务推理与感知、底层控制解耦，在递增任务时长与在线扰动（执行失败、任务中断、任务更新）下评测。最强被测模型在干净回合上仍有相当比例失败，加入扰动后成功率进一步下降；监督适配能大幅提升小模型，但在更长、多机器人任务上仍明显偏低。
Motivation: 现有基准分别研究动态任务执行与具身多智能体协调，但两者交集缺乏评测：长时程任务中信息保持、异构机器人协作与执行中自适应难以同时度量。
Method: 提出架构无关的 MAGMA-Bench，按递增任务时长与受控在线扰动（执行失败、任务中断、任务更新）组织场景，要求异构能力机器人间协调；采用结构化技能级接口分离任务层推理与感知/底层控制，并发布架构无关的专家轨迹生成管线。
Result: 评测本地可部署的开源权重规划器、多智能体状态跟踪策略与前沿模型：最强模型在干净 (clean) 回合上仍失败相当比例，加入在线扰动后成功率进一步下降；监督适配大幅提升小模型，但在更长与多机器人任务上性能仍明显偏低。发布 261,646 条任务级训练样本。
Conclusion: 长时程动态多机器人任务对当前规划器仍是未解难题：扰动会系统性压低成功率，监督适配可救小模型但救不了长时程与多机器人场景。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: S-Space: Exploring Spatial Workspace in Multimodal Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal language models (MLLMs) exhibit promising spatial reasoning capabilities, yet the internal mechanisms supporting them remain poorly understood. We uncover S-Space, a linear representation subspace in which object-token representations encode continuous coordinates along horizontal, vertical, and distance axes. Although we identify these axes by differentiating spatial-answer scores with respect to object-token activations, S-Space is intrinsic rather than induced by specific data or prompts, remaining readable under non-spatial questions. We show that S-Space functions as an internal spatial workspace of MLLMs. Perception encodes object locations into it, forming spatial representations that can be directly read out to support accurate spatial judgments. Internal reasoning transforms it for changing viewpoints. Verbal responses selectively access it, evidenced by causal interventions that alter spatial judgments while largely preserving non-spatial responses. Case studies further show that S-Space assigns locations to unseen entities and the observer, and connects physical directions with abstract linguistic meanings, suggesting both the capabilities and limitations of large-scale language training. Finally, we use S-Space as a diagnostic tool for spatial reasoning failures. Direction-word readouts reveal systematic coupling between cardinal and image-relative reference frames. More importantly, a perception-computation decomposition exposes a key bottleneck: MLLMs can form capable spatial representations, yet fall short in the spatial transformations required to reason reliably across viewpoint changes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多模态大模型中发现一个线性表征子空间 S-Space，object-token 表征沿水平、垂直、距离三轴编码连续坐标，充当模型的内部空间工作区：感知把物体位置写入其中，内部推理在视角变化时改写它，语言回答选择性读取它。因果干预改变空间判断而基本保持非空间回答不变；诊断显示瓶颈不在空间表征本身，而在跨视角变换的计算环节。
Motivation: 多模态大模型表现出空间推理能力，但支撑该能力的内部机制不清楚，空间推理失败也缺少可定位的诊断手段。
Method: 通过对 object-token 激活求空间答案分数的梯度识别出 S-Space 的三条坐标轴，并用因果干预检验该子空间对空间与非空间回答的分离作用；再用方向词读出与感知-计算分解 (perception-computation decomposition) 作为诊断工具定位失败环节。
Result: S-Space 被判定为内禀而非由特定数据或 prompt 诱导，在非空间问题下仍可读出；因果干预改变空间判断同时大体保留非空间回答；方向词读出揭示基数方向与图像相对参考系之间的系统性耦合；感知-计算分解显示模型能形成有效的空间表征，却在视角变化所需的空间变换上不足。
Conclusion: 空间推理的瓶颈在跨视角的空间变换计算而非空间表征本身，S-Space 可作为诊断这类失败的内部探针；案例研究同时显示该表征既能给未见实体和观察者分配位置，也把物理方向与抽象语言含义相连，反映大规模语言训练的能力与局限。
Relevance: 1
