papers.title: Simulating Training Spikes of Deep Neural Networks by Layer-wise Random Feature Models
papers.abstract_en: Intermittent ``spikes'' in loss, during the pre-training of Large Language Models (LLMs), remains a mysterious phenomenon both theoretically and empirically. In this paper, we show that simple quadratic models with heavy-tailed, power-law distributed inputs can replicate these spikes. We introduce a theoretical framework and simulation algorithm to model per-layer training dynamics of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs), using such quadratic models. In a case study on an Adam hyperparameter configuration (where $β_2$ is set close to $1$) known to induce spikes in Transformer LMs, our simulation successfully predicts bumps indicating spiky behavior from a given checkpoint. Furthermore, we derive an appropriate $β_2$ schedule from observed metrics, which empirically improves performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用逐层随机特征模型（layer-wise random feature model）的重尾幂律输入二次型模型复现 LLM 预训练中的 loss spike，并给出可从 checkpoint 预测尖峰、可反推 β2 调度的仿真流程。在 β2 接近 1 的 Adam 配置（已知会诱发 Transformer LM 尖峰）案例中，仿真从给定 checkpoint 成功预测出指示尖峰行为的 bump，并由观测指标导出 β2 schedule，经验上提升了性能。
Motivation: LLM 预训练中 loss 出现间歇性 spike，理论上和经验上都仍是未解现象，缺少能逐层刻画训练动力学并预测尖峰的可操作模型。
Method: 以重尾幂律分布输入的简单二次型模型复现尖峰，提出建模 DNN 逐层训练动力学的理论框架与仿真算法；案例研究针对已知诱发 Transformer LM 尖峰的 Adam 超参配置（β2 接近 1），并从观测指标反推 β2 调度。
Result: 在 β2 接近 1 的 Adam 配置案例中，仿真从给定 checkpoint 成功预测出指示尖峰行为的 bumps；由观测指标导出的 β2 schedule 经验上改善了性能。
Conclusion: 重尾幂律输入的二次型逐层模型足以复现并预测 LLM 训练尖峰，且据此导出的 β2 调度可经验性提升性能。

papers.title: Beyond Successful Robot Demonstrations: Learning from Human Interactions and Modeling Failure Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Action-conditioned world models offer a promising foundation for generalist robotic intelligence by predicting the consequences of actions. However, existing robotic datasets provide limited coverage of the diverse interaction dynamics required for generalizable world modeling. Large-scale egocentric human videos offer complementary interaction experience, yet the embodiment gap between human hands and robotic manipulators hinders effective cross-embodiment learning. Meanwhile, the predominance of successful demonstrations leaves failure dynamics substantially underrepresented, limiting the ability of world models to anticipate unsuccessful executions. To address these limitations, we introduce HF-WM, an action-conditioned world model that combines Human interaction learning with Failure-aware post-training. To bridge the embodiment gap, we develop a dual-branch framework that couples video generation with auxiliary pointflow prediction, using stabilized pointflow as a unified motion representation across human and robot interactions while suppressing egocentric camera motion. To improve failure modeling, we further perform Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) post-training on perturbed actions derived from successful demonstrations, guided by action alignment and physical plausibility rewards, enabling the model to learn plausible failure dynamics without paired ground-truth videos. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HF-WM achieves state-of-the-art performance in action-conditioned video generation and exhibits strong utility for policy evaluation in downstream robotic tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 HF-WM，把大规模第一人称人类视频与失败感知后训练结合进动作条件世界模型：用视频生成加辅助 pointflow 预测的双分支框架，以稳定的 pointflow 作为跨人手与机械臂的统一运动表示并抑制第一人称相机运动；再对成功演示施加扰动动作，用 GRPO 配合动作对齐与物理合理性奖励做后训练，使模型在没有配对失败真值视频的条件下学到合理的失败动力学。
Motivation: 机器人数据集覆盖的动作条件动力学有限，人类视频虽互补但存在人手与机械臂的具身鸿沟；演示以成功为主，失败动力学严重欠表示，世界模型难以预判执行失败。
Method: HF-WM 采用双分支框架，将视频生成与辅助 pointflow 预测耦合，用 stabilized pointflow 作为人与机器人交互的统一运动表示并抑制 egocentric camera motion；随后对由成功演示派生的扰动动作做 GRPO 后训练，奖励为 action alignment 与 physical plausibility，无需配对的失败真值视频。
Result: 在动作条件视频生成上达到 state-of-the-art 表现，并在下游机器人任务中表现出对 policy evaluation 的强效用（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 跨具身学习与失败感知后训练结合，可在缺少配对失败数据的情况下让世界模型同时覆盖人类交互经验和失败动力学，并支撑下游策略评估。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.motivation: 机器人数据集覆盖的动作条件动力学有限，人类视频虽互补但存在人手与机械臂的具身鸿沟；演示以成功为主，失败动力学严重欠表示，世界模型难以预判执行失败。

papers.title: Beyond Domain-Routed Supervision: Cross-Teacher Guarding for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) extends on-policy distillation (OPD) by routing domain-specific data to specialized teachers, integrating their capabilities through dense token-level supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, domain routing only distinguishes the supervision sources for different domains; updates from all domains still act on shared parameters. When teachers differ substantially in response style and domain expertise, supervision that is effective in isolation may still lead to persistent gradient conflicts and capability degradation during joint optimization. To address this challenge, we propose Cross-Teacher Guarding for MOPD (Road MOPD), which introduces non-routed teachers as auxiliary cross-domain critics on the same student trajectories and coordinates multi-teacher supervision through token-level credit assignment and gradient updates. Specifically, cross-teacher-guided credit assignment uses teacher agreement to strengthen token-level corrections jointly supported by the teachers and attenuate conflicting signals; preventive multi-teacher gradient projection uses auxiliary gradients from the same trajectories to constrain potentially conflicting updates and adaptively controls projection strength to retain target-domain learning signals. In experiments, Road MOPD mitigates degradation in the disadvantaged domain, gains over 5 percentage points under high conflict, and improves overall performance in low-conflict and three-domain settings.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 9 figures, 10 tables, including references and appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多教师在线策略蒸馏 (MOPD) 中，按域路由只区分监督来源，各域更新仍作用于共享参数，教师风格与专长差异大时会产生持续梯度冲突并导致能力退化。Road MOPD 引入非路由教师作为同一学生轨迹上的跨域 critic，用教师一致性做 token 级信用分配、以预防式多教师梯度投影约束冲突更新并自适应控制投影强度；高冲突设置下提升超过 5 个百分点。
Motivation: 按域路由的多教师 OPD 中，各域梯度仍更新共享参数，教师在响应风格与领域专长上差异大时，单独有效的监督在联合优化中会造成持续梯度冲突与弱势域能力退化。
Method: 提出 Road MOPD：把非路由教师作为同一学生轨迹上的跨域 critic；跨教师信用分配依据教师一致性强化各教师共同支持的 token 级修正、衰减冲突信号；预防式多教师梯度投影用同轨迹上的辅助梯度约束潜在冲突更新，并自适应控制投影强度以保留目标域学习信号。
Result: 在高冲突设置下提升超过 5 个百分点，缓解弱势域的能力退化；在低冲突与三域设置上提升整体性能。
Conclusion: 仅靠域路由不足以处理共享参数上的跨域梯度冲突，引入非路由教师做跨域 critic 并协调信用分配与梯度投影，才能在多域联合优化中同时保住弱势域与整体性能。

papers.title: Causal Effect Identifiability in Causal Abstractions: A Strict Hierarchy of Criteria
papers.abstract_en: Identifying causal effects from observational data typically requires a fully specified causal graph, an assumption that is often unrealistic in complex or high-dimensional settings. Causal abstractions address this limitation by retaining only partial causal information, thereby defining equivalence classes of compatible causal graphs. In this paper, we study causal effect identifiability directly at the level of these graph collections, rather than at the level of individual causal diagrams. We formalize several notions of identifiability in this setting and organize them into a hierarchy that clarifies their relationships and differences. In particular, we establish that a causal effect may be identified over a collection of graphs without admitting a single causal derivation that holds uniformly across all compatible graphs. These results help reveal gaps and clarify ambiguities in the existing literature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在因果抽象（causal abstractions）只保留部分因果信息、因而对应一族兼容因果图的设定下，把因果效应可识别性直接定义在图集合层面并形式化多种概念，整理成严格层级。核心结论是：一个因果效应可以在整个图集合上被识别，却不存在一个对所有兼容图一致成立的单一因果推导。
Motivation: 从观测数据识别因果效应通常要求完全指定因果图，这在复杂或高维设定中往往不现实；而既有文献对可识别性的多种定义关系不清、存在歧义。
Method: 在因果抽象给出的图集合（而非单个因果图）层面形式化若干可识别性概念，并将它们组织成一个阐明相互关系与差异的层级；据此证明图集合层面的识别与跨全部兼容图一致的单一推导之间的分离。
Result: 建立了一个因果效应可以在一族兼容图上被识别、却不承认任何在所有兼容图上统一成立的因果推导的分离结果，并据此揭示既有文献中的缺口与歧义。
Conclusion: 图集合层面的可识别性严格强于存在统一因果推导，二者不可混同；既有文献中若干可识别性定义的边界由此被厘清。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Asymptotic Analysis of Discrete-Time Self-Attention Dynamics in Transformers
papers.abstract_en: In machine learning, a self-attention dynamics describes the attention mechanism of transformers, and is obtained treating the layer index of a transformer as time index. Even though naturally discrete-time, this dynamical system is most often studied in continuous-time. Scope of this paper is to provide a thorough investigation of the discrete-time version of the self-attention dynamics: a complete classification of its equilibria is given, and their stability properties are studied, in both the single-head and the multihead case. We show that in both cases the main attractor of the dynamics is a consensus equilibrium aligned with the principal eigenvector of the value matrix (in the single-head case, a corresponding matrix of weights in the multihead case), even though other locally asymptotically stable bipartite equilibria can be show to exist at least in the single-head situation. The behavior is confirmed by looking at the learned weight matrices of a real transformer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Transformer 的层索引当作时间索引，对离散时间 self-attention 动力学给出平衡点完整分类及稳定性分析（单头与多头）。主吸引子是与 value 矩阵主特征向量对齐的 consensus 平衡，单头情形还存在其他局部渐近稳定的 bipartite 平衡；在真实 Transformer 的学到的权重矩阵上确认了该行为。
Motivation: self-attention 动力学天然离散，但通常被放到连续时间框架下研究，离散时间版本的平衡点分类与稳定性缺少系统刻画。
Method: 将层索引视为时间索引，建立离散时间 self-attention 动力学系统，对单头与多头两种情形分类全部平衡点并研究其稳定性；再用真实 Transformer 学到的权重矩阵做对照检验。
Result: 单头与多头情形的主吸引子均为与 value 矩阵主特征向量对齐的 consensus 平衡（多头情形对应一组权重矩阵）；单头情形还存在至少一类局部渐近稳定的 bipartite 平衡。该行为在真实 Transformer 的学到的权重矩阵上得到确认。
Conclusion: 离散时间 self-attention 动力学的长期行为由 consensus 平衡主导并由 value 矩阵主特征向量决定，但单头情形的平衡结构不止一个吸引子。

papers.title: The Hydrological Cycle and Circulation of Tidally-Locked Planets with a Finite Moisture Inventory
papers.abstract_en: Tidally-locked planets express a range of climate regimes distinct from those found in our solar system. Their atmospheres are often dominated by planetary-wide overturning circulations and super- rotating jets. In this paper we explore the hydrological cycle of such planets and how it might depend on the total inventory of condensate. To this end we use a set of idealised GCM simulations to probe the response of the hydrological cycle to the surface moisture budget in their atmospheres. We find that for low moisture inventories the climate quickly develops a barren day side and a moist night side where the moisture is trapped, as might be expected. For higher moisture inventories the drying of the day side is significantly delayed by the development of a substellar lake just east of the substellar point, which is sustained by the presence of a local thunderstorm-like convective system that persists even after the lake disappears. The timescales for the lake to disappear are millennia, suggesting that even a weak transfer of moisture through surface processes could maintain a moist day side. We also find that adjusting the threshold at which the evaporative rate becomes constrained by the remaining surface liquid depth modifies the longevity of the lake and surrounding day side conditions. These findings have implications for understanding a diverse range of planetary climates and habitability, given the distribution of moisture and presence of a substellar lake.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用理想化 GCM 扫描潮汐锁定行星的总凝结物储量，发现低储量时白天面迅速变干、水汽被困在夜半球；高储量时 substellar point 东侧形成 substellar lake，其上维持局地雷暴式对流，使白天面干燥被显著推迟，湖泊消失需千年量级。蒸发速率随剩余液体深度受限的阈值会改变湖泊与周边白天面条件的寿命。
Motivation: 潮汐锁定行星的气候体制由行星尺度翻转环流与超旋转急流主导，其水循环如何随大气总凝结物储量变化、白天面能否保持湿润，此前缺少系统刻画。
Method: 用一组理想化 GCM 模拟探测水循环对地表 moisture budget 的响应，扫描总凝结物储量，并调整蒸发速率转为受剩余地表液体深度限制的阈值。
Result: 低 moisture inventory 下气候迅速形成 barren day side 与 moist night side；高 inventory 下 substellar point 东侧出现 substellar lake，白天面干燥被显著延迟，湖泊消失时间尺度为千年量级；调整蒸发受限阈值会改变湖泊及周边白天面条件的寿命。
Conclusion: 即便很弱的地表水汽传输也足以维持湿润白天面，substellar lake 与其上持续的对流系统是决定潮汐锁定行星气候与宜居性的关键环节。

papers.title: RESCUE: Is This Alarm Worth Acting On? Counterfactual Evaluation of VLA Runtime Monitors
papers.abstract_en: Runtime failure monitors for robot policies are typically evaluated by how accurately they distinguish failed from successful executions. Yet an accurate alarm may arrive too late for recovery, while an unnecessary intervention may disrupt an execution that would otherwise succeed. We introduce RESCUE, a counterfactual framework for evaluating whether a monitor's alarms enable useful interventions. By restoring simulator and policy states at execution checkpoints, RESCUE compares alternative actions, identifies the latest checkpoint satisfying a specified recovery criterion, and evaluates whether acting on alarms reduces expected task-completion cost. We evaluate RESCUE with OpenVLA-OFT and $π_{0.5}$ over LIBERO-Spatial and LIBERO-Plus using 128,340 counterfactual branches. Recoverability depends on the state--intervention pair rather than on robot state alone: at $τ=0.5$, 14 of 66 OpenVLA-OFT/LIBERO-Plus failures contain a recoverable checkpoint under continuation, compared with 34 of 66 under continuation or scripted recovery, while recovery reduces recoverability in other conditions. On the primary strong-policy conditions, favourable detection scores do not establish lower intervention cost. Under the evaluated stop-and-reset model, even an idealised detector can afford only a 2.0--3.3% false-alarm rate before unnecessary resets outweigh the savings from stopping failures early. These results show that monitor value depends jointly on the intervention available and the workload in which it is deployed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RESCUE 用反事实分支评估机器人策略的运行时报警是否值得响应：在检查点恢复仿真与策略状态，比较不同动作并找出满足恢复准则的最晚检查点。在 OpenVLA-OFT 与 π0.5、LIBERO-Spatial 与 LIBERO-Plus 共 128,340 条反事实分支上，τ=0.5 时 OpenVLA-OFT/LIBERO-Plus 的 66 个失败中仅 14 个在继续执行下含可恢复检查点，加入脚本恢复后升至 34 个；理想检测器也只能容忍 2.0–3.3% 的误报率，超过后多余重置就抵消提前止损的收益。
Motivation: 运行时失效监控通常只按区分成败的准确度评估，但报警可能来得太晚而无法恢复，或不必要地打断本会成功的执行，因此准确度并不等于干预价值。
Method: RESCUE 在执行检查点恢复仿真器与策略状态，枚举替代动作构成反事实分支，定位满足给定恢复准则的最晚检查点，并比较按报警干预与不干预的期望任务完成代价；评测用 OpenVLA-OFT 与 π0.5 策略、LIBERO-Spatial 与 LIBERO-Plus 基准，共 128,340 条反事实分支，采用 stop-and-reset 干预模型。
Result: τ=0.5 时 OpenVLA-OFT/LIBERO-Plus 的 66 个失败中 14 个在继续执行下含可恢复检查点，改为继续或脚本恢复则为 34/66，且在其他条件下恢复反而降低可恢复性；在主要强策略条件下，良好的检测分数并不能推出更低的干预代价；在所评估的 stop-and-reset 模型下，理想化检测器的误报率上限仅 2.0–3.3%。
Conclusion: 监控的价值取决于可用的干预方式与部署工作负载，单看检测准确度会误导；可恢复性由状态-干预对共同决定，而非仅由机器人状态决定。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: RESCUE 用反事实分支评估机器人策略的运行时报警是否值得响应：在检查点恢复仿真与策略状态，比较不同动作并找出满足恢复准则的最晚检查点。在 OpenVLA-OFT 与 π0.5、LIBERO-Spatial 与 LIBERO-Plus 共 128,340 条反事实分支上，τ=0.5 时 OpenVLA-OFT/LIBERO-Plus 的 66 个失败中仅 14 个在继续执行下含可恢复检查点，加入脚本恢复后升至 34 个；理想检测器也只能容忍 2.0–3.3% 的误报率，超过后多余重置就抵消提前止损的收益。
summary_sections.motivation: 运行时失效监控通常只按区分成败的准确度评估，但报警可能来得太晚而无法恢复，或不必要地打断本会成功的执行，因此准确度并不等于干预价值。
summary_sections.method: RESCUE 在执行检查点恢复仿真器与策略状态，枚举替代动作构成反事实分支，定位满足给定恢复准则的最晚检查点，并比较按报警干预与不干预的期望任务完成代价；评测用 OpenVLA-OFT 与 π0.5 策略、LIBERO-Spatial 与 LIBERO-Plus 基准，共 128,340 条反事实分支，采用 stop-and-reset 干预模型。

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Multimodal Language Model with Heterogeneous Evidence Integration for Clinical Prognosis
papers.abstract_en: Clinical prognosis requires integrating structured measurements, physiological waveforms, longitudinal history, and population context. We introduce PRISM (Population-Retrieved Inference for Structured Multimodal Prognosis), a multimodal language model that combines per-feature numerical tokenization, recency-weighted aggregation of longitudinal ECGs, and a dual-modality population memory bank. Retrieval operates in representation space: the model receives mean-pooled embeddings of similar training-cohort encounters, while no individual retrieved record enters the prompt. On the 1,443-task MDS-ED benchmark, PRISM achieves AUROCs of 86.2% for diagnosis, 93.1% for deterioration, 91.8% for ICU admission, and 92.8% for mortality. These results use a 96-hour pre-arrival window unavailable to reported baselines. With benchmark-window inputs only, PRISM reaches 0.8895 AUROC, compared with 0.8937 for UniPACT and 0.8889 for MDS-ED. A matched-input compact fusion model using the same five evidence streams and frozen encoders reaches 0.7652 AUROC, versus 0.9092 for PRISM. Replacing numerical EHR encoding with text serialization reduces AUROC by 3.66 points; removing pre-arrival history reduces it by 1.97 points; and zeroing retrieval reduces it by 0.99 points. Genuine retrieval outperforms random-neighbor retrieval by 0.97 macro-average points, although a paired task-level sign test does not establish a uniform advantage (p=0.067). On the external MC-MED cohort, supervised fine-tuning reaches 0.8611 AUROC, compared with 0.8227 for locally trained gradient boosting and 0.7841 for source-only PRISM. These results support structure-aware multimodal integration and supervised external adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PRISM 用逐特征数值 tokenization、纵向 ECG 的近因加权聚合和双模态 population memory bank 做临床预后，检索只在表示空间进行，只把相似就诊的均值池化 embedding 交给模型，个体记录不进 prompt。在 1,443 任务的 MDS-ED 上诊断/恶化/ICU 收治/死亡 AUROC 分别为 86.2%、93.1%、91.8%、92.8%；消融显示数值 EHR 编码贡献最大（换成文本序列化降 3.66 点），外部 MC-MED 上监督微调 0.8611 高于本地梯度提升 0.8227。
Motivation: 临床预后要同时吃结构化测量、生理波形、纵向历史与人群背景，而检索增强通常把个体记录塞进 prompt，既难融合异质证据又涉及隐私。
Method: PRISM（Population-Retrieved Inference for Structured Multimodal Prognosis）做逐特征数值 tokenization，对纵向 ECG 做 recency-weighted 聚合，配双模态 population memory bank；检索在表示空间完成，只输入训练队列相似就诊的 mean-pooled embedding。对照包括同五路证据流、冻结编码器的 matched-input 紧凑融合模型，以及随机邻居检索。
Result: MDS-ED（1,443 任务）AUROC：诊断 86.2%、恶化 93.1%、ICU 收治 91.8%、死亡 92.8%（含基线不可用的 96 小时 pre-arrival 窗口）；仅用 benchmark 窗口输入时 0.8895，对比 UniPACT 0.8937、MDS-ED 0.8889。同输入紧凑融合模型 0.7652 vs PRISM 0.9092。消融：数值 EHR 改文本序列化 −3.66 点，去掉 pre-arrival 历史 −1.97 点，置零检索 −0.99 点；真实检索比随机邻居高 0.97 个 macro-average 点，但配对任务级符号检验未确立一致优势（p=0.067）。外部 MC-MED：监督微调 0.8611，本地梯度提升 0.8227，source-only PRISM 0.7841。
Conclusion: 结构感知的多模态整合加监督外部适配有效：数值化编码与就诊前历史是主要增益来源，检索增益存在但任务间不一致，外部部署需要监督微调。

papers.title: FedPCD: Priority-Constrained Federated Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) seeks to optimize a shared global model from decentralized client data. While effective for average performance, this process can produce unfair performance across clients, particularly under statistically heterogeneous data distributions. Existing fairness-aware and multi-objective FL methods address this through client re-weighting, gradient correction, or common-descent formulations, but often change the global optimization direction or treat client objectives symmetrically. We propose FedPCD, a priority-constrained federated optimization framework that separates the global optimization objective from client protection. FedPCD preserves the conventional federated aggregate as the primary objective, while allowing only the minimum correction necessary to meet client performance constraints. Across heterogeneous FL benchmarks, FedPCD consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving the highest global accuracy across all configurations and leading worst-10% client accuracy in nearly all. FedPCD further preserves competitive trade-offs between global accuracy and client performance variability. Beyond this trade-off, FedPCD demonstrates faster empirical convergence, reaching matching or superior performance in substantially fewer communication rounds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedPCD 把联邦聚合的全局目标与客户端保护解耦：保留常规联邦聚合为主目标，只施加满足客户端性能约束所需的最小修正，从而在统计异构数据下同时保住全局精度与最差客户端表现。在异构 FL 基准上，它在所有配置中取得最高全局精度，并在几乎所有配置中领先最差 10% 客户端精度，且用明显更少的通信轮数达到匹配或更优性能。
Motivation: 联邦学习在统计异构数据下客户端间性能不公平，现有公平感知与多目标 FL 方法通过客户端重加权、梯度修正或共同下降公式处理，但往往改变全局优化方向或把客户端目标对称对待。
Method: 提出优先级约束联邦优化框架 FedPCD：以常规联邦聚合为主目标，仅施加满足客户端性能约束所需的最小修正，把全局优化目标与客户端保护分离。
Result: 在异构 FL 基准上，FedPCD 在所有配置中取得最高全局精度，并在几乎所有配置中领先最差 10% 客户端精度；在全局精度与客户端性能变异性之间保持有竞争力的折中，并表现出更快的经验收敛，用 substantially 更少的通信轮数达到匹配或更优性能。
Conclusion: 把客户端保护写成约束而非改动聚合方向，可以在不牺牲全局精度的前提下改善最差客户端表现并加速收敛。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond Temporal Proximity: Explanatory World Models for Credit Assignment in Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Generative Recommenders increasingly use Reinforcement Learning (RL) to optimize outcomes that may appear hundreds or thousands of interactions after a decision. Standard RL propagates reward according to temporal proximity rather than explicit relevance, attenuating the signal assigned to distant but important actions and creating a source of sample inefficiency. We introduce Explanatory World Models (EWM), an attribution framework that uses explanations to identify the earlier events that plausibly contributed to a realized outcome. We instantiate EWM with a frontier language model and use its explanations as learning signals using a conservative hierarchical operator that recursively redistributes reward while preserving the undiscounted episode return. To investigate what constitutes a useful explanation, we operationalize three complementary variants inspired by Halpern's actual causation, Lombrozo's explanatory simplicity, and Deutsch's hard-to-vary explanations. We evaluate EWM on two controlled long-horizon RL benchmarks, a public sequential-recommendation benchmark, and an industry-scale generative recommender. On Crafter and WordCraft, EWM substantially outperforms PPO and LaRe, with its largest gains when rewards are most delayed. On KuaiRand, EWM outperforms SFT and LaRe offline and A2C online. Finally, in an offline evaluation of an industry generative recommender, EWM considerably improves Recall and increases behavioral proxies. These results suggest that explanations can provide structured and reusable credit for learning from delayed outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Explanatory World Models (EWM)：用前沿语言模型生成解释来识别真正导致结果的早期事件，再通过保守的层级算子递归重分配奖励，且保持未折扣的 episode return 不变。在 Crafter、WordCraft、KuaiRand 及工业级生成式推荐器上，EWM 在奖励延迟最长时相对 PPO 与 LaRe 提升最大。
Motivation: 生成式推荐器中决策与结果常相隔成百上千次交互，标准 RL 按时间邻近而非显式相关性传播奖励，削弱远距离但重要动作的信号，造成样本低效。
Method: EWM 用前沿语言模型生成解释，判断哪些早期事件可能促成已实现结果，并把解释作为学习信号；通过保守的层级算子 (conservative hierarchical operator) 递归重分配奖励，保持未折扣 episode return 不变。作者实例化三个变体，分别借鉴 Halpern 的实际因果 (actual causation)、Lombrozo 的解释简洁性 (explanatory simplicity) 与 Deutsch 的难证伪解释 (hard-to-vary explanations)。
Result: 在 Crafter 与 WordCraft 两个长时程 RL 基准上，EWM 明显优于 PPO 与 LaRe，且奖励延迟越大增益越大；在公开序列推荐基准 KuaiRand 上，离线优于 SFT 与 LaRe，在线优于 A2C；在工业级生成式推荐器的离线评估中，EWM 显著提升 Recall 并提高行为代理指标。
Conclusion: 解释可以为延迟结果的学习提供结构化且可复用的 credit，从而替代单纯按时间邻近的奖励传播。

papers.title: SplatQ: Interaction-Aware Pruning of 3D Gaussian Splatting via Quadratic Selection
papers.abstract_en: Existing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) pruning methods primarily rely on global Top-K selection based on independent importance scores, lacking regional budget control and ignoring joint deletion effects. Consequently, they cannot ensure balanced reconstruction quality across a scene. We propose SplatQ, a combinatorial pruning algorithm that coordinates regional budget allocation and joint Gaussian selection under a fixed budget. SplatQ partitions Gaussians by spatial proximity and appearance similarity into size-limited blocks, decomposing global selection into subproblems of a specific size. It then smooths importance-based block retention quotas to prevent excessive budget concentration. Finally, it constructs a quadratic approximation of joint deletion effects using the responses of representative pixel colors to changes in Gaussian opacity. Individual responses, pairwise interactions, and quota penalties are incorporated into a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) objective, solved using simulated annealing (SA) or a coherent Ising machine (CIM) to jointly select Gaussians. Experiments on 5 benchmarks demonstrate that SplatQ outperforms state-of-the-art pruning methods in aggregate reconstruction quality, spatial quality balance, and rendering speed. Ablations confirm that budget smoothing improves local detail reconstruction, while interaction modeling improves Gaussian selection quality under a fixed budget.
papers.comment: Under review at ICLR 2027 (main paper 9 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables; appendix included)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SplatQ 把 3DGS 剪枝改写成带区域预算的二次无约束二值优化 (QUBO)：按空间邻近与外观相似分块、平滑各块保留配额，再用代表像素颜色对不透明度变化的响应构造个体重要性、成对交互与配额惩罚项，由模拟退火 (SA) 或相干伊辛机 (CIM) 联合选高斯。在 5 个基准上，聚合重建质量、空间质量均衡与渲染速度均超过现有剪枝方法。
Motivation: 现有 3DGS 剪枝依赖独立重要性分数的全局 Top-K，既无区域预算控制，也忽略联合删除效应，导致场景内重建质量不均衡。
Method: 先按空间邻近与外观相似把高斯切成尺寸受限的 block，把全局选择分解为定长子问题；再平滑基于重要性的块保留配额防止预算过度集中；最后用代表像素颜色对高斯不透明度变化的响应构造联合删除效应的二次近似，将个体响应、成对交互与配额惩罚并入 QUBO 目标，用 SA 或 CIM 求解。
Result: 在 5 个 benchmark 上，聚合重建质量、空间质量均衡与渲染速度三项均优于 SOTA 剪枝方法；消融显示预算平滑改善局部细节重建，交互建模在固定预算下提升高斯选择质量。
Conclusion: 把剪枝当作带区域预算与交互项的组合优化问题，可在固定预算下同时改善重建质量的均衡性与渲染速度。

papers.title: Stride: Scale-Aware Multi-Agent Evolutionary Refinement for Infographic Generation
papers.abstract_en: Infographic generation challenges text-to-image models because a single image must satisfy numerous visual, textual, and semantic constraints. Iterative agentic refinement with a multimodal verifier is a natural remedy, but existing methods face a scale mismatch: local edits cannot correct global composition errors, while full regeneration may destroy already-correct regions. We introduce Stride, a constraint-grounded multi-agent framework that treats refinement over any frozen generator as a history-aware evolution strategy. Stride separates constraint evaluation - whether each requirement is satisfied - from visual grounding - where and how it is violated. It then routes global revisions to a composer subagent and local corrections to a retoucher subagent. Each subagent conducts internal planning and generates multiple candidates, while Stride accepts a candidate only when it improves the verifier score, reducing regression across iterations. Because stochastic generators and imperfect verifiers make any single step unreliable, it is this combination of scale-aware routing, per-step redundancy, and monotonic acceptance that yields stable improvement across iterations. With fully open-weight generator-verifier systems, Stride outperforms proprietary systems including Nano-Banana-2.0 and Seedream-5.0-Pro on BizGenEval, matches GPT-Image-2.0 and surpasses Seedream-5.0-Pro on IGenBench, and achieves a new state-of-the-art score on WISE, while substantially outperforming existing agentic methods across all evaluated benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Stride 是面向信息图生成的约束驱动多智能体迭代精修框架：把约束评估与视觉定位解耦，全局重排交给 composer、局部修正交给 retoucher，各子智能体内部规划并生成多个候选，只有验证器分数提升才接受该候选。在全开放权重的生成器-验证器组合下，它在 BizGenEval 上超过 Nano-Banana-2.0 与 Seedream-5.0-Pro，在 IGenBench 上追平 GPT-Image-2.0 并超过 Seedream-5.0-Pro，在 WISE 上取得新的 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 信息图一张图要同时满足大量视觉、文字与语义约束；现有迭代式智能体精修存在尺度错配：局部编辑改不动全局构图错误，整图重生成又会破坏已经正确的区域。
Method: 把精修建模为作用在任意冻结生成器之上的 history-aware 进化策略；约束评估（每条要求是否满足）与视觉定位（在何处、以何种方式被违反）分开处理，再按尺度路由：全局改动给 composer 子智能体，局部修正给 retoucher 子智能体；每个子智能体内部规划并产出多个候选，采用单调接受准则，仅当候选提升验证器分数才采纳，以抑制跨迭代回退。
Result: 在全开放权重的生成器-验证器系统上，BizGenEval 超过专有系统 Nano-Banana-2.0 与 Seedream-5.0-Pro；IGenBench 上与 GPT-Image-2.0 持平并超过 Seedream-5.0-Pro；WISE 上取得新的 state-of-the-art 分数；在全部被评测基准上大幅超过已有智能体精修方法。
Conclusion: 尺度感知路由、逐步冗余候选与单调接受三者结合，是随机生成器与不完美验证器条件下迭代精修能稳定提升的原因；开放权重系统可以胜过专有系统。

papers.title: Humanize MLE Agents: Multi-Agent Session Alternation Beyond Single-Agent Limits
papers.abstract_en: Existing LLM-based agent approaches for long-horizon machine learning engineering (MLE) often use context engineering, implemented through custom harnesses that manage tools, skills, and accumulated experience. However, we find that as single-session execution lengthens, the agent's reasoning intensity declines alongside slowing progress, summarized as long-horizon deceleration, and the benefits of these custom harnesses vanish as the underlying model improves, summarized as harness staleness. These findings suggest that their benefits may not persist across versions, which motivates a workflow-level approach in which agents build on one another's work across sessions. We model these alternating agent sessions as a context-reset semi-Markov decision process (CR-SMDP) and establish sufficient conditions for alternation to exceed single-agent reference limits, derive an explicit experiment-budget bound, and characterize when session caps preserve this advantage. Guided by this analysis, we introduce Humanize MLE Agents (HMA), which alternates two agents on a shared workspace, limits each session to at most k experiments and resets the context between sessions, without additional task-specific harness or prior knowledge supplements. Across 75 Kaggle tasks in MLE-bench, HMA reaches a state-of-the-art any-medal rate of 78.2%, exceeding the strongest open-source baseline by 8.0 points with a quarter of its time budget. Moreover, among six configurations spanning five heterogeneous agent pairs, HMA improves any-medal rate over the constituent baselines by 6.4 points on average, demonstrating cross-pair generality. A supplementary case on kernel optimization reaches 878 cycles, within 1.6% of the community leaderboard leader, demonstrating applicability beyond MLE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HMA 把长程 MLE 任务改成两个 agent 在共享工作区交替开新会话，每次会话最多跑 k 个实验后重置上下文，以绕开单会话的长程减速 (long-horizon deceleration) 与 harness 失效 (harness staleness)。在 MLE-bench 的 75 个 Kaggle 任务上 any-medal 率达 78.2%，比最强开源基线高 8.0 个百分点且只用其四分之一时间预算。
Motivation: 单会话执行越长，agent 推理强度与推进速度同步下降，且自定义 harness 的收益随底座模型变强而消失，跨版本不可持续。
Method: 把交替会话建模为 context-reset 半马尔可夫决策过程 (CR-SMDP)，给出交替超过单 agent 参考上限的充分条件、显式实验预算界与会话上限保持优势的条件；据此设计 HMA：两 agent 共享工作区、每会话至多 k 个实验、会话间重置上下文，不加任务专用 harness 或先验知识。
Result: MLE-bench 75 个 Kaggle 任务上 any-medal 率 78.2%（SOTA），超最强开源基线 8.0 个百分点、时间预算为其 1/4；跨 5 类异构 agent 对的 6 种配置平均超各自基线 6.4 个百分点；kernel optimization 案例达 878 cycles，距社区榜首位 1.6% 以内。
Conclusion: 跨会话交替而非更长单会话或更强 harness，是提升长程 MLE agent 表现且不随模型版本失效的路径，且可迁移到 kernel 优化这类 MLE 之外的任务。

papers.title: Branching On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories, but a single trajectory realizes only one continuation at each decision, limiting supervision coverage under a finite sampling budget. We propose BranchOPD (Branching On-Policy Distillation), which selects informative decision points using student uncertainty and teacher-student disagreement, resamples student-policy continuations from shared prefixes, and applies token-level teacher supervision to both main trajectories and branches. BranchOPD operates at token-level decisions in mathematics and within-turn decisions in agent tasks. Shared-prefix reuse reduces student-generated token costs by approximately 19% on ALFWorld and 31% on WebShop relative to seven independent trajectories. We also introduce protocol-boundary repair (PBR), which uses targeted supervision under protocol constraints to mitigate repetition and wasted generation. BranchOPD outperforms Vanilla OPD and Multi-Rollout OPD (n=7) across all evaluated benchmarks, with gains over Vanilla OPD of 18.55 percentage points in mean mathematics accuracy over 16 sampled answers (avg@16) and 13.8 points in mean ALFWorld ID/OOD success. Mechanistic analyses and selection ablations show that branching at uncertain decisions expands subsequent behavior coverage and outperforms random selection and turn-initial branching.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BranchOPD 在学生轨迹的高不确定、师生分歧大的决策点上从共享前缀重采样多条续写，并对主轨迹与分支同时施加 token 级教师监督，从而在有限采样预算下扩大监督覆盖。相比七条独立轨迹，共享前缀复用在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上分别省下约 19% 与 31% 的学生生成 token；相对 Vanilla OPD，16 次采样的数学平均准确率 (avg@16) 提升 18.55 个百分点，ALFWorld ID/OOD 成功率平均提升 13.8 点。
Motivation: On-policy distillation 中单条轨迹在每个决策点只实现一种续写，在有限采样预算下监督覆盖不足，学生难以看到其他可能的行为分支。
Method: BranchOPD 用学生不确定性与师生分歧挑选信息量大的决策点，从共享前缀重采样学生策略的多条续写，对主轨迹与分支都施加 token 级教师监督；作用粒度在数学任务上是 token 级决策、在 agent 任务上是轮内 (within-turn) 决策。另提出 protocol-boundary repair (PBR)，在协议约束下做定向监督以抑制重复与浪费生成。
Result: 共享前缀复用相对七条独立轨迹在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上分别降低约 19% 与 31% 的学生生成 token 成本；相对 Vanilla OPD，16 次采样的数学平均准确率 (avg@16) 提升 18.55 个百分点，ALFWorld ID/OOD 平均成功率提升 13.8 点；在全部评测基准上优于 Vanilla OPD 与 Multi-Rollout OPD (n=7)。机制分析与选择消融显示在不确定决策处分叉优于随机选择与轮首分叉。
Conclusion: 在不确定决策处分叉并共享前缀，是比多条独立 rollout 更省采样预算、监督覆盖更广的 on-policy 蒸馏方式；PBR 用于缓解协议边界处的重复生成。

papers.title: A Scalable Learned Iterative Solver for Nonlinear MPC via Temporal Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) can be applied to large nonlinear systems with complex objectives while enforcing constraints, but the cost of solving the underlying optimization problems limits real-time application for systems with fast dynamics or many states. Neural networks can reduce this online cost by approximating the control law, but may violate constraints and typically require many precomputed optimizer solutions for training. The learning-based iterative solver for constrained optimization (LISCO) instead learns to predict primal-dual steps toward satisfaction of the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions through self-supervised training without precomputed solutions, but its dense, monolithic architecture grows with the prediction horizon. We remove this horizon dependence by exploiting the temporal structure of the problem in the solver architecture, which makes the network size independent of the horizon while leaving the training loss and the solver iteration unchanged. A closed-loop resampling strategy further aligns the training distribution with closed-loop operation at no additional sampling cost. On an economic NMPC benchmark of a CSTR cascade, the proposed solver scales to larger problems than monolithic LISCO and achieves median speedups of up to a factor of four over IPOPT. In closed loop, it achieves comparable control performance to IPOPT with no observed constraint violations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LISCO 这类自监督学习迭代求解器按时间维度分解，使网络规模与预测步长无关，同时保持训练损失与求解迭代不变，并用闭环重采样让训练分布对齐闭环运行。在 CSTR 串联的经济 NMPC 基准上，该求解器能处理比单体 LISCO 更大的问题，相对 IPOPT 中位加速最高 4 倍，闭环控制性能与 IPOPT 相当且未观察到约束违反。
Motivation: NMPC 在线求解非线性优化的开销限制了快动态或高维系统的实时应用；用神经网络近似控制律又易违反约束、且通常需要大量预计算解，而单体结构的 LISCO 网络随预测步长增长。
Method: 在 LISCO 的 primal-dual 步预测架构中引入时间分解 (temporal decomposition)，利用问题的时间结构使网络规模与预测步长解耦，训练损失与求解迭代保持不变；训练为自监督、无需预计算解，并加入闭环重采样策略使训练分布与闭环运行对齐且不增加采样成本。
Result: 在 CSTR 串联经济 NMPC 基准上，相对 IPOPT 中位加速最高达 4 倍；可扩展到比单体 LISCO 更大的问题；闭环中控制性能与 IPOPT 相当，且未观察到约束违反。
Conclusion: 按时间结构分解求解器架构可以在不改动损失与迭代的前提下解除网络对预测步长的依赖，使学习型 NMPC 求解器在保持约束满足的同时获得可观在线加速。

papers.title: A Local Agentic AI Framework to Generate Edge Case Scenarios for Safety Assurance
papers.abstract_en: Generating edge case scenarios is crucial for training, testing and safety assuring autonomous systems. This identifies hazardous failures to increase system reliability and robustness, ensures the system can still function safely on the boundaries of its operational design domain and learns the expected system behaviour for these edge cases. The rapid advancement in the generation and analysis capabilities of language models (LMs) has expanded their applicability and recent work has investigated LM scenario generation. However, many recent approaches rely on human-in-the-loop or rule-based strategies. This restricts the LM's ability to generate diverse and edge case scenarios; the long tail of the distribution. Our work uses local LMs in a laptop-based agentic AI framework for adaptive scenario generation. This is cheap, fully-controlled, ensures data privacy and security. It uses think, act, observe, update, and continue loops with lightweight JSON encoding to generate scenarios. We use the system requirements, system description and environment description as knowledge bases in contextual prompts for an LM to ensure scenario realism. A second, independent LM critiques each scenario using domain specific criteria so it can be refined. The refined scenarios are run in simulation and evaluation metrics collected. These metric scores are analysed and similar scenarios are created for edge cases (exploitation) or novel scenarios are generated to explore the scenario space. Post-hoc clustering using metric scores and thematic-type analysis of the rich-text scenario descriptions produced by the LM pinpoints functional gaps and their triggering conditions. This creates traceable evidence for the safety assurance case. Our work highlights the potential of a flexible and adaptive local agentic AI framework for automating edge case generation and producing traceable safety assurance evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于笔记本本地 LM 的 agentic AI 框架，用 think-act-observe-update-continue 循环加轻量 JSON 编码自动生成自动驾驶边缘场景：一个 LM 依据系统需求/系统描述/环境描述知识库生成场景，第二个独立 LM 按领域准则批判并精炼，精炼场景送入仿真采集指标分数，再据此做 exploitation 或 novelty 扩展，事后聚类与主题分析定位功能缺口及其触发条件，产出可追溯的安全保障证据。
Motivation: 现有 LM 场景生成多依赖 human-in-the-loop 或规则策略，限制了对分布长尾（long tail）多样边缘场景的覆盖，而边缘场景正是识别危险失效、验证运行设计域边界安全的关键。
Method: 本地 LM 驱动的 agentic 循环（think, act, observe, update, continue）配 JSON 编码；以系统需求、系统描述、环境描述作为 contextual prompt 的知识库保证场景真实性；第二个独立 LM 用领域准则批判每个场景以供精炼；精炼场景在仿真中运行并采集评估指标，按指标分数决定做 exploitation（相似场景）还是生成新场景探索空间；事后对指标分数聚类并对富文本场景描述做 thematic-type analysis。
Result: 框架在笔记本上以本地 LM 运行，实现低成本、完全可控、数据隐私与安全；产出可追溯的安全保障证据，事后聚类与主题分析能定位功能缺口及其触发条件。
Conclusion: 灵活自适应的本地 agentic AI 框架可自动化边缘场景生成并产出可追溯的安全保障证据，摆脱 human-in-the-loop 与规则策略对场景多样性的限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Harmonic analysis and circuit approximation of Sobolev functions on quantum input spaces
papers.abstract_en: We derive approximation rates for Sobolev functions defined on the complex unit sphere and complex projective space, representing quantum states, and on the special and projective unitary groups, representing quantum unitary operations. By using harmonic analysis on compact groups and compact homogeneous spaces, we characterize the corresponding Peter--Weyl decompositions and Sobolev spaces via irreducible representations and the Laplace--Beltrami operator. Combining spectral truncation with finite-depth quantum-circuit approximation, invoking the Solovay--Kitaev theorem, we establish quantitative rates that separate the spectral truncation error from the circuit approximation error.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对定义在复球面、复射影空间（量子态）与特殊/射影酉群（量子酉操作）上的 Sobolev 函数，用紧群上调和分析给出逼近速率：Peter–Weyl 分解刻画 Sobolev 空间，谱截断与有限深度量子线路逼近结合，并调用 Solovay–Kitaev 定理，把谱截断误差与线路逼近误差分开定量。
Motivation: 量子态与量子酉操作所在的齐性空间上，Sobolev 函数的函数逼近误差与把它编译成有限深度量子线路的误差此前混在一起，缺少可分别核算的定量速率。
Method: 在紧群与紧齐性空间上做调和分析，用不可约表示与 Laplace–Beltrami 算子刻画 Peter–Weyl 分解和 Sobolev 空间；将谱截断与有限深度量子线路逼近组合，并援引 Solovay–Kitaev 定理得到速率。
Result: 建立的定量速率把谱截断误差与线路逼近误差分离开来；摘要给出的是推导结果，未列具体数值。
Conclusion: 量子态与酉操作上的 Sobolev 逼近可以按“谱截断 + 线路编译”两段分别核算误差，Solovay–Kitaev 负责把函数逼近转成线路深度代价。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GraftOOD: Grafting Out-of-Distribution Exemplars into Advantage-Weighted Rectification for Video Reward Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Video reward optimization can increase proxy rewards while reducing video dynamics, a mismatch we identify as \emph{motion collapse}, including under a video-level motion-quality reward. We propose \textbf{GraftOOD}, which replaces part of the online rollouts in selected prompt groups with out-of-distribution video exemplars. A shared velocity-regression objective combines group-relative reward rectification with sequence-level exemplar supervision, requiring neither exemplar generation trajectories nor an additional supervised-loss coefficient. We characterize its pointwise optimal field as a source-posterior-weighted combination of the two source-specific target fields. We construct \textbf{GraftSet-Video}, containing 9,588 format-matched exemplars for 2,397 prompts, to supply external supervision. On Wan2.1-1.3B, GraftOOD raises Dynamic Degree from 4.86 to 44.41 relative to reward-only FlowAWR, while HPSv3 decreases from 8.10 to 7.32 and VisionReward remains close. At the main setting, GraftOOD leads nine of ten metrics among three exemplar-augmented methods. Ablations of exemplar frequency and within-group count reveal dynamics--reward trade-offs rather than uniform gains from increasing exemplar usage. These results support external exemplar supervision as a complement to scalar reward feedback, without equating higher measured dynamics with coherent, visually plausible motion in the generated videos. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/Fuzm7/FlowAWR}{GraftOOD}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GraftOOD 用分布外 (OOD) 视频示例替换部分在线 rollout，配合共享速度回归目标做视频奖励优化，把 Wan2.1-1.3B 上的 Dynamic Degree 从 4.86 拉到 44.41，但 HPSv3 同时从 8.10 降到 7.32。示例用量的消融显示这是动力学与奖励的权衡而非单调增益，且测得的动力学升高不等于运动连贯可信。
Motivation: 视频奖励优化在推高代理奖励的同时会压低视频动力学，作者把这种错配命名为 motion collapse，即便使用视频级运动质量奖励也存在；纯标量奖励反馈不足以约束外部运动监督。
Method: 在选定 prompt 组内把部分在线 rollout 换成 OOD 视频示例，用共享速度回归目标同时承载组相对奖励校正与序列级示例监督，不需要示例生成轨迹也不需要额外的监督损失系数；作者把最优点态场刻画为两个来源各自目标场按 source posterior 加权的组合，并构造 GraftSet-Video（2,397 个 prompt、9,588 条格式对齐示例）提供外部监督。
Result: 在 Wan2.1-1.3B 上，相对仅用奖励的 FlowAWR，GraftOOD 的 Dynamic Degree 从 4.86 升到 44.41，HPSv3 从 8.10 降到 7.32，VisionReward 基本持平；在主设置下于三个示例增强方法中的十项指标里拿下九项。示例频率与组内条数的消融呈现动力学—奖励权衡，而非增加示例用量带来一致提升。
Conclusion: 外部示例监督可以作为标量奖励反馈的补充来缓解 motion collapse，但更高的测得动力学并不等同于生成视频中连贯、视觉可信的运动。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Real-World CAD Segmentation Benchmark: Comparing Rule-Based and Learning-Based Approaches through Hole Detection
papers.abstract_en: CAD segmentation datasets are predominantly synthetic or automatically labelled, leaving it unclear how well existing methods transfer to real-world engineering tasks. Fastener-relevant hole detection represents one such task, requiring human annotation and exhibiting greater geometric complexity than commonly used benchmarks. We address this gap through three main contributions. First, we develop two task-specific rule-based methods, one graph-wire-search and one multi-view based, and complement them with a human-annotated benchmark dataset derived from engineering CAD data that also enables training of UV-Net and AAGNet, representative learning-based approaches for B-Rep segmentation. Second, we conduct an extensive experimental study including parameter optimisation, evaluation on our benchmark dataset, cross-domain generalisation on a synthetic dataset, and an assessment of the feasibility of the approaches at varying dataset sizes and IoU thresholds. Third, we provide evidence-based insights into the strengths and limitations of different approaches: rule-based methods generalise well without training data, with the graph-wire-search method favouring recall and the multi-view method favouring precision, whereas learning-based methods achieve strong performance with sufficient annotations but exhibit reduced robustness under domain shift. These findings highlight trade-offs between data requirements, and robustness, and provide guidance not only for hole detection, but more broadly for real-world CAD segmentation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对真实工程 CAD 中紧固件孔位检测（hole detection），提出两种规则方法（graph-wire-search 与 multi-view）并配人工标注 B-Rep 基准，用于训练 UV-Net、AAGNet 等学习式分割方法。规则方法无需训练数据即可良好泛化，graph-wire-search 偏召回、multi-view 偏精度；学习式方法在标注充足时表现强，但在 domain shift 下鲁棒性下降。
Motivation: 现有 CAD 分割数据集多为合成或自动标注，方法能否迁移到真实工程任务（需人工标注、几何更复杂）尚不清楚。
Method: 构建两条规则路径：graph-wire-search 与 multi-view 方法；同时提供人工标注的工程 CAD 基准数据集，训练 UV-Net 与 AAGNet 两类 B-Rep 分割模型；实验含参数优化、基准评测、合成数据上的跨域泛化，以及不同数据规模与 IoU 阈值下的可行性评估。
Result: 规则方法无需训练数据即可良好泛化，graph-wire-search 偏向召回、multi-view 偏向精度；学习式方法在标注充足时达到强性能，但在 domain shift 下鲁棒性下降。
Conclusion: 真实 CAD 孔位检测中，规则方法与学习式方法在数据需求和鲁棒性上存在权衡：标注不足或域偏移明显时规则方法更稳，标注充足时学习式方法更强。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: When MLLMs miss what humans read: diagnosing and learning to read squint text
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal LLMs can fail to read text embedded in an image's coarse structure (text a human recovers by squinting) and report that no text is present. We name this class Squint Text and study it as a recognition deficiency, motivated by cases from a production moderation pipeline. We introduce SquintBench, comprising 1076 production-derived moderation images, and SquintCtrl, a controlled synthetic suite for mechanism diagnosis. Frozen-weight analysis shows that hidden text leaves a coarse signal while glyph identity is weakly represented; identity becomes substantially more accessible when the correct spatial regions are supplied, implicating spatial selection as a major bottleneck. Suppressing high-frequency content also improves reading at a fixed visual-token budget, while visual token count may also contribute. These findings motivate Squint OPSD: a frozen teacher receives a downscaled view and the ground-truth transcription as privileged context, and its token-level distributions supervise a student along on-policy trajectories. At inference, the student reads the original image alone. Squint OPSD reaches 88.61 ANLS on SquintBench, versus 26.50 for the unadapted backbone, 24.44 for the best general-purpose model on the original view, and 68.60 at best for an off-the-shelf model under a downscaled view. These results substantially narrow the gap between available visual evidence and its generated read-out without auxiliary views at inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 MLLM 在粗结构中肉眼需眯眼才能读出的文字命名为 Squint Text，并诊断出瓶颈在空间选择而非高频细节：隐藏字形的粗尺度信号存在，但字形身份表征弱，一旦给出正确空间区域其可读性显著提升。据此提出 Squint OPSD：冻结教师以降采样视图加真值转写作特权上下文，用 token 级分布监督学生沿 on-policy 轨迹学习，推理时学生只读原图。在 1076 张生产审核图构成的 SquintBench 上 ANLS 达 88.61，未适配骨干仅 26.50。
Motivation: 多模态 LLM 会把藏在图像粗结构里的文字直接判为无文字，源于生产内容审核管线中的真实失败案例；这类识别缺陷此前没有命名、基准与机制诊断手段。
Method: 构建 SquintBench（1076 张生产审核图）与受控合成套件 SquintCtrl 做机制诊断；用冻结权重分析定位空间选择瓶颈，并发现抑制高频内容可在固定 visual-token 预算下改善读取。训练用 Squint OPSD：冻结教师接收降采样视图与真值转写作为特权上下文，其 token 级分布监督学生在 on-policy 轨迹上学习，推理时学生仅看原图。
Result: Squint OPSD 在 SquintBench 上 ANLS 88.61，未适配骨干 26.50，原视图下最强通用模型 24.44，现成模型在降采样视图下最好 68.60。冻结权重分析显示隐藏文字留下粗尺度信号而字形身份表征弱，提供正确空间区域后身份显著更可读；固定 visual-token 预算下抑制高频内容也改善读取。
Conclusion: Squint Text 的主要瓶颈是空间选择而非高频信息缺失，因此用特权上下文蒸馏可在推理不加辅助视图的条件下大幅缩小视觉证据与生成读出之间的差距。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Gaussian BROJA Partial Information Decomposition in Closed Form
papers.abstract_en: The BROJA partial information decomposition provides an operationally motivated way to separate the information that two sources carry about a target into unique, redundant, and synergistic components. For continuous and high-dimensional variables, however, computing the BROJA decomposition requires solving a difficult optimization problem. Previous work showed that, when each source-target pair is jointly Gaussian, the problem can be reduced to finite-dimensional numerical optimization. Here, we derive a closed-form solution to this optimization problem, enabling direct computation of the BROJA decomposition in the general multivariate Gaussian setting. The resulting closed-form expression enables speedups exceeding two orders of magnitude for high-dimensional Gaussian BROJA PID. Code is available at https://github.com/brainsandmachines/Eigen_PID.
papers.comment: 28 pages total, including 10 pages of main text, 2 main figures, 5 supplementary sections, and 5 supplementary figures

papers.title: SqueezeBench: Saturation-Resilient Evaluation of Mathematical Capability
papers.abstract_en: AI systems are making rapid progress in mathematics, but this progress is hard to measure. Benchmarks of solved problems saturate, and in benchmarks of open problems each problem can be resolved for the first time only once. We present SqueezeBench, a benchmark that is resilient to saturation: a success raises the bar instead of removing the problem. Each problem fixes an integer function $f(n)$ whose values are known only for small $n$, and the benchmark keeps a lower and an upper record on it. A record is a computable Lean function with a machine-checked proof that it bounds $f$. A submission proposes a new function and proves that it bounds $f$, that it is no worse than the current record at any $n$, and that it is strictly better at some $n$. Once accepted, it becomes the record that the next submission has to beat. The system thus chooses the bound as well as its proof, and it may improve the record at a single $n$ or its growth rate. At every $n$, the gap between the two records shows how far the certified bounds are from determining $f(n)$. Every proof is checked by two independent Lean kernels, so no referee needs to check the mathematics. The checks also reject a function that computes $f$ by exhaustive search at small $n$, and a maintainer only reads the submitter's report and looks for such a search at larger $n$. We release ten problems from extremal combinatorics with twenty proved initial records and the admission tools. As a baseline, agents based on a frontier language model, with at most one hour per record, had 82 submissions accepted and improved every record, without going beyond the published literature. Agents based on two newer models then started from these records, had 60 more submissions accepted and improved 19 of the 20 records again. For eight of the ten problems, at least one record is still asymptotically behind the best published bound.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SqueezeBench 是一个抗饱和的数学能力基准：每道题固定一个整数函数 f(n)，只维护上下两条记录（可计算的 Lean 函数加机器校验证明），新提交必须在所有 n 上不劣于现记录且在某个 n 上严格更优，成功不会让题目消失而是抬高门槛。基于前沿模型的 agent 在每条记录至多一小时内有 82 次提交被接受并改进了全部记录，两个更新模型的 agent 又有 60 次被接受、再次改进 20 条记录中的 19 条，但十个问题中仍有八个的某条记录在渐近意义上落后于已发表最优界。
Motivation: 已解问题的基准会饱和，开放问题基准中每道题又只能被首次解决一次，两者都无法持续度量 AI 数学能力的进展。
Method: 每道题给出只在小 n 上已知取值的整数函数 f(n)，系统同时维护上下界记录；提交需给出新 Lean 函数并证明其为 f 的界、在任意 n 上不劣于现记录、且在某个 n 上严格更优，接受后即成为新记录。每份证明由两个独立 Lean kernel 校验，检查会拒绝在小 n 上靠穷举搜索算出 f 的函数。发布内容为极值组合学方向的十道题、二十条已证明初始记录与准入工具。
Result: 以前沿语言模型为基底、每条记录至多一小时的 agent 有 82 次提交被接受，改进了全部记录，但未超出已发表文献水平；两个更新模型的 agent 从这些记录出发又有 60 次提交被接受，再次改进 20 条记录中的 19 条。十个问题中有八个至少一条记录在渐近意义上仍落后于已发表最优界。
Conclusion: 把基准设计成记录竞赛可以让每次成功都抬高门槛而非消耗题目，agent 能持续改进记录但尚未追平已发表的渐近界。

papers.title: Agentic Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have taken the world by storm. Their ability to communicate with us in our own language, and to reason about our world, has made them a favorite tool for writing, answering questions, and much more. Their answers already influence our decisions and our actions. What would happen if LLMs themselves could act in the world directly? What would happen if LLMs could interact with each other? Agentic LLMs combine the power of large language models with the ability to act in the real world. In this book we will discuss how agentic LLMs work, how they act, how they interact, and what this means for us, as users.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一本 472 页的教材，系统讲解 agentic LLM：把大语言模型的推理与语言能力同在真实世界中行动、多智能体间交互的能力结合起来，覆盖其工作原理、行动机制、交互方式以及对用户的影响。核心论断是 LLM 已在影响人的决策与行动，而具备行动与交互能力的 agentic LLM 会把这种影响从回答问题扩展到直接作用于世界。
Motivation: LLM 的回答已经在影响人的决策与行动，但当前用法仍限于写作与问答；若 LLM 能直接在世界中行动、并彼此交互，其作用方式与对用户的影响都会改变，需要一本教材系统梳理这一转变。
Method: 以教材形式组织：先讲 agentic LLM 的工作机制（如何推理与决策），再讲行动模块（如何在真实世界执行动作），然后讲多智能体之间的交互，最后讨论对用户层面的影响。
Result: 全书 472 页，定位为 textbook；摘要给出的定性论断是 LLM 的回答已经影响人的决策与行动，agentic LLM 将语言模型能力与在真实世界中行动的能力结合。
Conclusion: agentic LLM 的关键不只是回答问题，而是直接在世界中行动并与其他 LLM 交互，因此其对用户的意义需要从交互设计层面整体理解。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Learning by Compression: Risk Estimates Attain the Law-of-Large-Numbers Rate
papers.abstract_en: Compression schemes provide a general framework for deriving data-dependent risk bounds for learning algorithms. For learning rules based on preferent compression, existing results upper-bound the risk in terms of a sample-dependent complexity $\boldsymbol{k}$, defined as the cardinality of the compression augmented by the training examples on which the reconstructed hypothesis is inappropriate. These results, however, yield a margin of order $O(\sqrt{\ln N/N})$ above $\boldsymbol{k}/N$. In this paper, we establish that the logarithmic factor is not intrinsic. We prove that, for every fixed confidence level $1-δ$, the risk is bounded with probability at least $1-δ$ by $$ \frac{\boldsymbol{k}}{N} + O\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{N}}\right), $$ uniformly over all possible values of $\boldsymbol{k}$. Thus, risk estimates for learning algorithms based on preferent compression attain the same law-of-large-numbers rate as the empirical estimate of the probability of a fixed event. We also show that the leading term $\boldsymbol{k}/N$ is necessary and investigate its relation to the empirical risk. In particular, we identify regimes in which the empirical risk retains the $O(1/\sqrt{N})$ convergence rate, as well as regimes in which it converges more slowly or ceases to be consistent, while the complexity-based estimator preserves the $O(1/\sqrt{N})$ rate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明基于偏好压缩 (preferent compression) 的学习算法风险上界可去掉对数因子：固定置信水平 1−δ 下，风险以至少 1−δ 的概率被 k/N + O(1/√N) 界住，且对所有 k 一致成立，达到与固定事件经验概率估计相同的大数律速率。同时指出 k/N 主项是必要的，并刻画经验风险保留 O(1/√N) 速率、变慢乃至不再一致的若干情形，此时基于复杂度的估计量仍保持 O(1/√N)。
Motivation: 既有压缩型风险界在 k/N 之上留下 O(√(ln N/N)) 的裕量，多出的对数因子是否本质未知，限制了数据依赖风险估计的紧性。
Method: 针对 preferent compression 学习规则，以样本依赖复杂度 k（压缩集加上重建假设不合适的训练样本的基数）为出发点，证明对每个固定置信水平 1−δ 的一致风险上界，并分析 k/N 主项的必要性及其与经验风险的关系。
Result: 风险以概率至少 1−δ 被 k/N + O(1/√N) 界住，对所有 k 一致，去掉了既有结果中的 √(ln N/N) 对数因子；证明 k/N 主项必要；识别出经验风险保持 O(1/√N)、收敛更慢或不再一致的若干情形，而复杂度估计量仍保持 O(1/√N)。
Conclusion: 压缩型风险估计中的对数因子并非内在，可达到与固定事件经验估计相同的大数律速率；在经验风险失效的区域，基于复杂度的估计量更可靠。

papers.title: Revisiting Accent Classification with DistilHuBERT: Speaker-Disjoint Evaluation and Cross-Corpus Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Recent accent classification systems can achieve high accuracy in standard in-corpus evaluations. However, when speakers overlap between the training and test sets, such results may overestimate model robustness compared with real-world deployment scenarios. This study revisits the robustness of DistilHuBERT-based accent classification by using L2-ARCTIC and multiple external English accent datasets. The comparison covers file-level and speaker-disjoint splits, along with balanced external-data training and teacher-student pseudo-labeling. The large performance gap between in-corpus and external evaluations suggests that file-level evaluation substantially overestimates performance, while speaker-disjoint evaluation can provide a more realistic estimate of the generalization to unseen speakers. In this study, models trained on external data alone do not reliably generalize to L2-ARCTIC. Among the tested configurations, balanced external-data training offers the most promising supervised setting. The pseudo-labeling experiments further indicate that confidence-based filtering alone is insufficient under domain mismatch. Overall, this study suggests that robust accent classification evaluation should simultaneously include speaker-disjoint evaluation and cross-corpus testing.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables. Presented at the 9th International Conference on Natural Language and Speech Processing (ICNLSP 2026), University of Trento, Trento, Italy, September 25-26, 2026. Proceedings to appear in the ACL Anthology
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 口音分类在文件级划分下因说话人重叠而高估鲁棒性；改用说话人不相交 (speaker-disjoint) 划分与跨语料测试后性能大幅下降，仅用外部数据训练的模型无法可靠迁移到 L2-ARCTIC。作者主张口音分类评测必须同时包含说话人不相交划分与跨语料测试。
Motivation: 标准语料内评测中训练集与测试集说话人重叠，得到的高准确率会高估模型在真实部署中对未见说话人的泛化能力。
Method: 以 DistilHuBERT 为基础做口音分类，使用 L2-ARCTIC 及多个外部英语口音数据集，对比文件级划分与说话人不相交划分，并测试均衡外部数据训练 (balanced external-data training) 与教师-学生伪标签 (teacher-student pseudo-labeling) 两种设置。
Result: 语料内与外部评测之间存在很大性能差距，说明文件级划分显著高估性能；仅用外部数据训练的模型不能可靠泛化到 L2-ARCTIC；在受测配置中均衡外部数据训练是最有前景的监督设置；伪标签实验显示仅靠置信度过滤在域不匹配下不够。
Conclusion: 口音分类的鲁棒性评测应同时纳入说话人不相交划分与跨语料测试，单靠语料内文件级划分不足以反映真实泛化。

papers.title: Collective Autonomous Vehicle Routing Needs Social Awareness for Coexistence with Human Drivers
papers.abstract_en: Collective Autonomous Vehicle (AV) route choices in real-world traffic networks can create externalities for Human-Driven Vehicles (HDVs), as routes that benefit AVs may increase travel times for other road users. To address this, we introduce a social component, the marginal cost, to the selfish travel time AV reward. Marginal cost captures an AV's impact on other road users by comparing their travel times with those in a counterfactual simulation in which the AV is removed. We study AV route choice in mixed-autonomy traffic settings using Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), where AVs learn routing policies through repeated interactions with the traffic environment. Experiments on the real-world networks of Ingolstadt and Provins show that incorporating marginal cost into the AV reward not only limits the increase in HDV travel times and shortens AV travel times relative to selfish AV routing, but also improves overall system performance. In Ingolstadt, selfish routing of 40\% AVs increases the travel times of other vehicles by 1.7\%, and this drops to 1.1\% when the social reward is included. Interestingly, not only does overall system performance improve, but the AVs are also better off when acting socially.This effect is consistent across tested cities, penetration rates, and replications, yet when the weight of the social component in the reward increases, the system fails to reach the desired performance. For a more scalable approach to social AV routing in mixed-autonomy traffic, we compute the marginal cost only for the AVs whose route choices most affect the traffic system. This reduces the number of counterfactual simulations and achieves similar performance at a significantly lower computational cost. Our results suggest that AV routing should go beyond selfish rewards and, for the benefit of all traffic participants, include a social component in its objective.

TL;DR: 在混合交通中用 MARL 做自动驾驶车辆 (AV) 路由时，把边际成本 (marginal cost) 作为社会项加入原本自私的行程时间奖励，可同时降低人类驾驶车辆 (HDV) 的额外行程时间并缩短 AV 自身行程时间。Ingolstadt 中 40% AV 自私路由使其他车辆行程时间上升 1.7%，加入社会奖励后降到 1.1%；但社会项权重过大会使系统无法达到预期性能。
Motivation: AV 集体路由的自私最优会把出行成本外部化给 HDV，使其他道路使用者行程时间变差；需要在不牺牲 AV 自身利益的前提下让路由策略对系统负责。
Method: 在 Ingolstadt 与 Provins 真实路网上做混合自主交通的多智能体强化学习 (MARL) 实验：AV 奖励由自私行程时间加社会项（边际成本）构成，边际成本通过移除该 AV 的反事实仿真与其他车辆行程时间对比得到；为降低开销，只对最影响系统的 AV 计算边际成本。
Result: Ingolstadt 中 40% AV 自私路由使其他车辆行程时间增加 1.7%，加入社会奖励后增幅降到 1.1%，同时 AV 行程时间也缩短、系统整体性能提升；该效应在所测城市、渗透率与重复实验中一致。社会项权重增大时系统无法达到预期性能。仅对关键 AV 计算边际成本可减少反事实仿真次数，在显著更低的计算开销下取得相近性能。

papers.title: Rollout-Time Intervention: Unlocking Agentic Reinforcement Learning Beyond Policy Limits
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a key paradigm for improving large language model (LLM) agents, enabling stronger reasoning, planning, and tool-use in interactive environments. However, existing agent RL methods remain fundamentally constrained by an on-policy reasoning bottleneck: when tasks exceed the model's current capability boundary, effective trajectories become extremely sparse and training often collapses. We introduce Rollout-Time Intervention (RTI), a technique designed to elicit successful trajectories beyond the policy's intrinsic exploration capacity. RTI operates by leveraging reward-side evidence (i.e., evaluation rubrics) during rollout to convert erroneous trajectories into successful ones, providing effective learning signals for tasks that the policy rarely solves on its own. Although intervention trajectories are inherently off-policy, we find that they can effectively guide policy optimization when trajectories with excessive distributional shifts are filtered out. Extensive experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate that RTI consistently outperforms RL baselines, enabling the post-trained policy to approach the performance of substantially stronger contemporary LLMs and, more importantly, transcend its original capability boundary. The code is available at https://github.com/Alibaba-NLP/qqr.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Rollout-Time Intervention (RTI)：在 rollout 阶段用奖励侧证据（evaluation rubrics）把错误轨迹改写成成功轨迹，从而为策略自身几乎解不出的任务提供学习信号；再过滤掉分布偏移过大的干预轨迹，使 off-policy 的干预轨迹仍能有效引导策略优化。在五个 benchmark 上 RTI 稳定超过 RL 基线，后训练策略逼近明显更强的当代 LLM，并越过其原有能力边界。
Motivation: 智能体 RL 受 on-policy 推理瓶颈约束：任务超出模型当前能力边界时有效轨迹极稀疏，训练常崩溃。
Method: RTI 在 rollout 时利用 reward 侧的 evaluation rubrics 将错误轨迹转为成功轨迹，注入策略自身探索能力之外的任务；干预轨迹虽为 off-policy，但先过滤掉分布偏移过大的样本再用于策略优化。
Result: 在五个 benchmark 上 RTI 一致优于 RL 基线，使后训练后的策略接近明显更强的当代 LLM 表现，并越过其原始能力边界；代码发布于 github.com/Alibaba-NLP/qqr。
Conclusion: 在 rollout 时用评分规则干预轨迹并过滤过度偏移的样本，可以让策略学到超出其原生探索能力的任务，突破 on-policy 稀疏成功信号导致的训练崩溃。

papers.title: Local Diagnostics of Learned Event Representations for Anomaly Detection at the HL-LHC
papers.abstract_en: Anomaly detection, the identification of collision events that deviate from Standard Model expectations, is one of the most promising model-agnostic strategies for new-physics searches at the Large Hadron Collider. Searching for rare events in learned low-dimensional representations removes the need to commit to hand-crafted observables a priori, but sacrifices the immediate physical interpretation those observables provide. For anomaly detection to enter a discovery pipeline, flagged events must therefore be diagnosed locally, both to distinguish potential new physics from mismodeling or detector effects and to identify observables for targeted follow-up searches. We evaluate supervised and self-supervised neural embedding strategies on COLLIDE-2V, a 750-million-event dataset simulated under realistic High-Luminosity LHC conditions, using the reconstruction error of an autoencoder trained in the learned latent space as the anomaly score. Across the configurations and benchmark signals considered, supervised objectives, which exploit simulation process labels during training, generally outperform their self-supervised counterparts and, in their best configurations, improve on an autoencoder trained directly on kinematic features, raising the signal efficiency at 10% background acceptance on all held-out processes. We further introduce a local diagnostic pipeline that fits a Gaussian Mixture Model to the SM latent space, profiles each component through high-level observables without process labels, localizes the flagged events, and ranks observables by their local discriminating power. The ranking recovers the defining kinematics of the held-out processes, while correlating the anomaly score with the same observables quantifies how closely the score tracks them, revealing cases where the most discriminating observable is not the one the score follows most closely.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 HL-LHC 高亮度碰撞数据上，用学到的低维表示做异常检测会丢失物理可解释性；本文提出一条局部诊断流水线：对 SM 潜空间拟合高斯混合模型 (GMM)，用高层运动学观测量对每个分量做无过程标签的剖析，定位被标记事件并按局部判别力给观测量排序。结果表明监督式神经嵌入总体优于自监督版本，并在所有留出过程上把 10% 背景接受度下的信号效率抬高于直接在运动学特征上训练的自编码器；排序能复现留出过程的定义性运动学，同时暴露出判别力最强的观测量未必是异常分数最紧密跟随的那一个。
Motivation: 在学习到的低维表示中搜稀有事件可以免于先验地手工挑选观测量，但代价是失去即时的物理解释；异常检测要进入发现流程，被标记的事件必须能被局部诊断，以区分潜在新物理与建模失配或探测器效应。
Method: 在 COLLIDE-2V（7.5 亿事件、按真实 HL-LHC 条件模拟）上评估监督式与自监督神经嵌入策略，以在潜空间中训练的自编码器重构误差作为异常分数；再引入局部诊断流水线：对 SM 潜空间拟合 GMM，用高层观测量（不使用过程标签）剖析各分量、定位被标记事件，并按局部判别力排序观测量，同时把异常分数与这些观测量做相关分析。
Result: 在所考察的配置与基准信号范围内，利用模拟过程标签的监督目标总体优于自监督目标；其最佳配置相对直接在运动学特征上训练的自编码器有提升，在全部留出过程上都提高了 10% 背景接受度下的信号效率。观测量排序复现了留出过程的定义性运动学；异常分数与同一组观测量的相关分析显示，判别力最强的观测量并不总是分数最紧密跟随的那一个。
Conclusion: 作者主张：要让基于学习表示的异常检测进入发现流程，被标记事件需要局部诊断来区分新物理与失配，并为定向后续搜索指认观测量；监督式嵌入在该设置下是更有效的表示学习选择。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PPG-Bench: A Unified Benchmark for PPG Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Photoplethysmography (PPG) is increasingly recorded by wearable and clinical devices at enormous scale, and a growing number of PPG foundation models (FMs) have been developed to compute reusable representations for various downstream tasks. These models are difficult to compare: different evaluations use different datasets, task definitions, preprocessing, downstream heads, hyperparameter tuning, and baselines. We present PPG-Bench, a unifying open-source benchmark evaluating five public PPG FMs across nine open-access datasets and 26 tasks spanning cardiovascular state estimation, activity, sleep, screening, and identification. We evaluate models under four downstream regimes of increasing adaptability (linear probing, random forests, frozen MLP probes, and end-to-end finetuning), with model-specific hyperparameter optimization and subject-disjoint cross-validation. We also evaluate against three controls: random/constant baseline, a deterministic pulse-rate-variability (PRV) feature set, and a generic time-series FM (MOMENT). Across all 68 task-regime combinations, 35.3% show no meaningful FM advantage over the random/constant baseline, and in 83.8% no PPG-specific FM outperforms both PRV and MOMENT. We also find that added downstream head capacity generally improves performance, but can cause significant degradation if the model is performing at chance/constant level. Current PPG FMs therefore cannot yet claim to provide generalised and transferrable representations of PPG signals, and future evaluation in this field should include checks against simple, non-learned controls. Code for the benchmark and instructions to evaluate more models can be found here - https://github.com/mannas-ai/ppg-bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PPG-Bench 统一评测 5 个 PPG 基础模型在 9 个公开数据集、26 个任务、4 种下游适配方式下的表现，并对照随机/常数基线、确定性 PRV 特征与时序基础模型 MOMENT。在全部 68 个任务-范式组合中，35.3% 显示 FM 相对随机/常数基线无实质优势，83.8% 中没有任何 PPG 专用 FM 同时胜过 PRV 与 MOMENT。
Motivation: PPG 基础模型的评测在数据集、任务定义、预处理、下游头、超参搜索与基线上各行其是，导致模型之间无法比较，也无法判断 FM 表征是否真的可迁移。
Method: PPG-Bench 开源统一评测 5 个公开 PPG FM，覆盖 9 个开放数据集、26 个任务（心血管状态估计、活动、睡眠、筛查、身份识别），采用 4 种下游范式（linear probing、随机森林、frozen MLP probe、端到端 finetuning），配合模型专属超参优化与 subject-disjoint 交叉验证，并设三类对照：随机/常数基线、确定性 pulse-rate-variability (PRV) 特征集、通用时序 FM MOMENT。
Result: 68 个任务-范式组合中 35.3% 无 FM 相对随机/常数基线的实质优势；83.8% 中无 PPG 专用 FM 同时优于 PRV 与 MOMENT。增加下游头容量通常提升性能，但当模型本身处于 chance/constant 水平时会造成显著退化。
Conclusion: 当前 PPG 基础模型尚不能声称对 PPG 信号给出可泛化、可迁移的表征；该领域未来评测应强制加入对简单非学习对照的检查。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: CNN-Transformer with Sigmoid Label for High-Resolution Sub-Degree DOA Estimation
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses the grid quantization error of deep-learning (DL)-based direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation. Classification- based DOA methods discretize the continuous angular space into a grid, so that with a peak-based read-out, the accuracy and resolution are limited by the grid step and by the width of the label peak. To address this issue, we propose a sigmoid label that encodes the sources' DOAs as the sum of angle-shifted monotonic sigmoid functions. Differentiating the output of a CNN-Transformer network trained with the sigmoid label produces sharp spectral peaks at the source DOAs. Combined with a moderately refined grid step of 0.25 degrees, the CNN-Transformer with the proposed sigmoid label attains sub-degree accuracy and a 1-degree resolution, breaking the limit of the grid quantization error. Under the unified CNN-Transformer backbone, we compare the proposed Sigmoid label with the Gaussian label, the 0-1 hard label, and the binary cross-entropy (BCE) baseline. Numerical results demonstrate that the Sigmoid label attains the highest accuracy and superior resolution compared to other labels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对基于深度学习的 DOA 估计中分类网格量化误差，提出 sigmoid label：把信源 DOA 编码为多个角度平移的单调 sigmoid 函数之和，训练 CNN-Transformer 后对输出求导得到尖锐谱峰。配合 0.25 度细化网格，达到亚度精度与 1 度分辨率，突破网格量化误差限制。
Motivation: 分类式 DOA 方法把连续角度空间离散成网格，峰值读出的精度与分辨率受网格步长和标签峰宽限制，难以做到亚度精度。
Method: 构造 sigmoid label（角度平移单调 sigmoid 函数之和）作为训练目标，用统一的 CNN-Transformer 主干网络学习，推理时对网络输出求导产生尖锐谱峰；网格步长细化到 0.25 度，并与 Gaussian label、0-1 hard label、BCE baseline 在同一主干下对比。
Result: 在统一 CNN-Transformer 主干下，Sigmoid label 相比 Gaussian label、0-1 hard label 与 BCE baseline 取得最高精度与更优分辨率；配合 0.25 度网格步长达到亚度精度和 1 度分辨率，突破网格量化误差限制。

papers.title: Does Financial Speech Need Continual Learning Regularization? A Study of EWC and mini-KFAC on Earnings Call ASR
papers.abstract_en: Earnings call transcription presents a realistic continual learning scenario where Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems are updated with new recordings but risk catastrophic forgetting of previously learned financial speech patterns. Adapting Whisper-small from a general-domain speech corpus to the Earnings22 benchmark reveals the opposite: all evaluated methods exhibit improvement on held-out financial speech from the same domain during adaptation rather than forgetting. This task complementarity makes regularization counterproductive. Nevertheless, when regularization is warranted, a layer-wise mini-Kronecker-Factored Approximate Curvature (mini-KFAC) approximation seems to achieve lower word error rates (WERs) and more stable optimization than standard diagonal Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC). The results suggest that task complementarity should be assessed before applying continual learning constraints, and prefer mini-KFAC EWC over diagonal EWC when needed.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Presented at the 9th International Conference on Natural Language and Speech Processing (ICNLSP 2026), University of Trento, Trento, Italy, September 25-26, 2026. Proceedings to appear in the ACL Anthology
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在财报电话会议 ASR 的持续学习设定中，把 Whisper-small 从通用语音语料适配到 Earnings22 时出现的是任务互补而非灾难性遗忘：所有被评估方法在同域留出金融语音上都提升，因此正则化反而有害。只有在确需正则化时，逐层 mini-KFAC 近似比标准对角 EWC 得到更低 WER 和更稳定的优化；作者建议先评估任务互补性再施加持续学习约束，需要时选 mini-KFAC EWC。
Motivation: 财报转写被视为持续学习场景，更新 ASR 时担心灾难性遗忘已学的金融语音模式，但通用语料到 Earnings22 的适配可能并不产生遗忘，盲目加正则会适得其反。
Method: 以 Whisper-small 为基座，从通用语音语料适配到 Earnings22 基准，对比持续学习正则化方法：标准对角 Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) 与逐层 mini-Kronecker-Factored Approximate Curvature (mini-KFAC) 近似，共评估多种方法在留出金融语音上的表现。
Result: 所有被评估方法在适配期间于同域留出金融语音上均表现为提升而非遗忘，使正则化适得其反；在需要正则化时，逐层 mini-KFAC 相对标准对角 EWC 取得更低的词错误率 (WER) 和更稳定的优化。
Conclusion: 应用持续学习约束前应先评估任务互补性；若确需正则化，优先选 mini-KFAC EWC 而非对角 EWC。

papers.title: One Thing Leads to Another: The Essentials of Time Series Causal Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Time series causal discovery --- the process of detecting causation between time series --- has its roots in signal processing research from over a half century ago. It has since received active and widespread interest, evolving into different forms across domains such as statistics, dynamical systems and machine learning. Entering this fragmented and constantly evolving research landscape can be daunting. This tutorial provides a unified overview of time series causal discovery across research communities. We introduce the key principles invoked by modern discovery methods, and we discuss their limitations and assumptions. We also discuss how discovery methods are evaluated, benchmarked and fine-tuned. We further discuss how causal discovery for time series is becoming crucial for downstream tasks in agriculture and Earth science, in healthcare, and in artificial intelligence systems. We believe that this tutorial will serve as a valuable resource in navigating the deluge of recent causality research, as well as an invitation to signal processing audiences to contribute to causal problems. To further help readers, we host a companion repository to link to useful code packages and resources at https://github.com/CHAI-UK/Awesome-Time-Series-Causal-Discovery.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, accepted for publication in the IEEE Signal Processing Magazine
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇时间序列因果发现 (time series causal discovery) 的统一教程，跨统计、动力系统与机器学习社区梳理现代发现方法的核心原理、假设与局限，并讨论评测、基准与调参方式。作者指出因果发现正成为农业与地球科学、医疗健康、AI 系统等下游任务的关键环节，并配套维护代码资源仓库。
Motivation: 时间序列因果发现源自半个多世纪前的信号处理研究，如今在统计、动力系统、机器学习等社区演化出多种割裂形态，新人进入这一快速膨胀且不断变化的领域门槛很高。
Method: 教程形式：统一介绍现代因果发现方法所依赖的关键原理，讨论其局限与假设，并梳理这些方法如何被评测、基准化与微调；配套 Awesome-Time-Series-Causal-Discovery 仓库链接代码包与资源。
Result: 无实验数字；给出的是跨社区的统一原理综述、方法假设与局限分析、评测与基准方法讨论，以及在农业与地球科学、医疗健康、AI 系统等下游任务中的角色定位。
Conclusion: 时间序列因果发现需要一份跨社区的统一入门资源来应对方法碎片化与文献洪流，且其价值正从纯方法研究转向支撑下游应用。

papers.title: SADL: A Size-Adaptive Decision Layer for Chronic Stroke Lesion Segmentation in ISLES 2026
papers.abstract_en: Chronic ischemic stroke lesions are difficult to segment on T1-weighted MRI. Their appearance overlaps with healthy tissue, and their volumes span four orders of magnitude, so voxel-level and lesion level metrics often disagree. We build an eleven-member nnU-Net ensemble that covers five design axes: a baseline dice + top-K loss, heavy augmentation, per-lesion volume loss re-weighting, stochastic weight averaging, and a sampling-and-architecture block that pairs cohort-balanced sampling with a residual-encoder backbone. Weighted soft-map fusion of the members feeds a tuned decision layer, SADL, that estimates lesion volume, applies an adaptive per-lesion-size threshold, prunes components by voxel count and peak probability, and adds a never-empty rescue. All fusion weights and per-bucket parameters are fitted on out-of-fold (OOF) predictions, so tuning never touches the held-out test set. On a site-disjoint 91-case holdout, SADL reaches Dice 0.7322, lesion-F1 0.7461 and PR-AUC 0.8430 when scored online with the challenge's released evaluation code. A paired non-parametric bootstrap against a reference single ensemble member confirms the lesion-F1 gain at p=0.024, and the gain is largest in the small-lesion regime, where the rescue step recovers cases that a fixed threshold would silently discard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对慢性缺血性卒中病灶体积跨越四个数量级、体素级与病灶级指标常互相矛盾的问题，提出 SADL 决策层：在 11 个 nnU-Net 成员的加权软图融合之上，按估计病灶体积施加自适应阈值，并用体素数与峰值概率剪枝加 never-empty rescue 兜底。在 ISLES 2026 站点不相交的 91 例留出集上 Dice 0.7322、lesion-F1 0.7461、PR-AUC 0.8430，相对单成员基线的 lesion-F1 提升经配对 bootstrap 达 p=0.024，且小病灶上提升最大。
Motivation: 慢性卒中病灶在 T1 加权 MRI 上与健康组织外观重叠，体积跨度达四个数量级，固定阈值会静默丢弃小病灶，导致体素级 Dice 与病灶级 F1 结论不一致。
Method: 构建 11 成员 nnU-Net 集成，覆盖五条设计轴：基线 dice + top-K 损失、重度增强、按病灶体积重加权的损失、随机权重平均 (stochastic weight averaging)、以及队列均衡采样配残差编码器骨干的采样-架构组合。成员输出经加权软图融合送入 SADL 决策层：估计病灶体积、按病灶大小自适应选阈值、按体素数与峰值概率剪枝连通域、再加 never-empty rescue；所有融合权重与分桶参数在 out-of-fold (OOF) 预测上拟合，不触碰留出测试集。
Result: 站点不相交的 91 例留出集上，用挑战赛官方评测代码在线评分：Dice 0.7322、lesion-F1 0.7461、PR-AUC 0.8430。与参考单集成成员的配对非参数 bootstrap 确认 lesion-F1 提升显著 (p=0.024)，提升在小病灶区间最大，rescue 步骤找回了固定阈值会丢弃的病例。
Conclusion: 按病灶大小自适应的决策层能在不接触测试集的前提下同时改善体素级与病灶级指标，小病灶的召回是固定阈值方法的主要损失来源。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Web$hell: A Unified Interface for Agentic Web Access
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are becoming direct users of the open web. As they take on increasingly complex and information-intensive tasks, effective web access is becoming a core capability for agentic problem solving. Existing approaches have advanced agentic web access through different access models, including search-augmented agents, browser-based agents, and, more recently, filesystem-based agents. Nevertheless, as users expect agents to complete long-horizon, end-to-end tasks, they increasingly need to conduct broad information gathering, perform browser actions, and revisit acquired evidence within a single trajectory. Yet our preliminary analyses reveal that existing access models struggle to meet these demands. They primarily support either information gathering or browser interaction, while combining their capabilities can involve substantial costs or performance trade-offs. To this end, we present Web\$hell, an interface that unifies web access under a single access model. Using a common schema defined by WebContract, WebCompiler compiles live webpages into addressable information and action objects. These objects are maintained in WebCache and handled through a shared set of operations, providing agents with consistent, operable, and persistent web access. Through extensive experiments across web search, web navigation, and deep research benchmarks, we show that Web\$hell achieves strong task performance at lower cost. Our results further indicate the importance of interface design for effective web access, with Web\$hell opening new possibilities for more capable and efficient LLM agents on the web.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Web$hell 把搜索增强、浏览器与文件系统三类 agentic web access 统一到单一访问模型：WebContract 定义公共 schema，WebCompiler 把实时网页编译成可寻址的信息与动作对象，存入 WebCache 并用统一操作集处理。在 web search、web navigation 与 deep research 基准上以更低成本取得强任务性能。
Motivation: 长时程端到端任务要求 agent 在单条轨迹内广泛收集信息、执行浏览器操作并回访已有证据，而现有访问模型多只支持信息收集或浏览器交互之一，合并两者会带来显著成本或性能取舍。
Method: WebContract 定义统一 schema；WebCompiler 将实时网页编译为可寻址的信息对象与动作对象；对象持久保存在 WebCache 中，通过一组共享操作被 agent 调用，从而提供一致、可操作、可持久的 web access。
Result: 在 web search、web navigation 与 deep research 三类基准上的实验显示，Web$hell 以更低成本取得强任务性能；作者的初步分析指出既有访问模型难以同时满足广度信息收集与浏览器交互的需求。
Conclusion: 接口设计本身是有效 web access 的关键：统一的可寻址对象加共享操作，能让 LLM agent 在单条轨迹内兼顾信息收集与浏览器交互而不必付出合并多模型的成本。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: TextVBench: Evaluating Text Rendering and Preservation in Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Modern video generators can synthesize convincing scenes while rendering a few characters incorrectly, omitting requested text, or changing it across frames. Measuring these failures is harder than applying OCR independently to each frame: when a scene contains multiple text targets and multiple noisy OCR regions, the evaluator must first determine which observation belongs to which intended text. We introduce TextVBench, a benchmark and evaluation framework that formulates visual-text evaluation as a multi-target, multi-instance spatiotemporal correspondence problem. TextVBench contains two complementary tracks: TextVBench-T2V measures the creation and maintenance of prompt-specified text, while TextVBench-Ref2V measures preservation of text from reference images. Both tracks use target-conditioned candidate selection rather than unconstrained VLM transcription, support one target mapping to multiple OCR regions, and separate frame-level spatial fidelity from cross-frame temporal fidelity. A length-weighted harmonic score summarizes these factors, while extra-text diagnostics expose failure modes hidden by a single OCR score. The benchmark is organized around controlled text, layout, carrier, and motion attributes so that aggregate scores can be traced back to specific capability limits. Across the evaluated model runs, MiniMax-H3 reaches a T2V TextVScore of 68.32, while the strongest Ref2V score is 56.51; attribute slices reveal a pronounced drop as the number of simultaneous reference text regions increases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TextVBench 把视频生成中的文字渲染与保持评测形式化为多目标、多实例的时空对应问题，而非逐帧独立 OCR。它含 TextVBench-T2V（prompt 指定文字的生成与维持）与 TextVBench-Ref2V（参考图文字保持）两条赛道，用目标条件候选选择、长度加权调和分汇总空间与跨帧时间保真。评测中 MiniMax-H3 的 T2V TextVScore 达 68.32，Ref2V 最强为 56.51，且随同时参考文字区域数增加分数明显下降。
Motivation: 视频生成器会渲染错字符、漏掉要求的文字或跨帧改动文字，而逐帧独立 OCR 无法判定场景中多个文字目标与多个含噪 OCR 区域的对应关系，难以度量这类失败。
Method: TextVBench 分为 TextVBench-T2V 与 TextVBench-Ref2V 两条赛道，均采用目标条件候选选择 (target-conditioned candidate selection) 而非无约束 VLM 转写，允许一个目标映射到多个 OCR 区域，并把帧级空间保真与跨帧时间保真分开；用长度加权调和分 (length-weighted harmonic score) 汇总，并输出额外文字诊断以暴露单一 OCR 分掩盖的失败模式，评测围绕受控的文字、布局、载体与运动属性组织。
Result: 在所评测的模型运行中，MiniMax-H3 的 T2V TextVScore 为 68.32，Ref2V 最高分为 56.51；属性切片显示随同时参考文字区域数量增加分数明显下降。
Conclusion: 视频文字评测必须显式建模目标与 OCR 区域的时空对应并分离空间与时间保真，聚合分数才能追溯到具体能力短板；多参考文字区域是当前模型的明显瓶颈。
Relevance: 2
