papers.title: In-Context Learning for System Identification: Probabilistic Formulation, Long-Sequence Handling, and Benchmark Validation
papers.abstract_en: Traditional system identification typically involves two steps: initially, training data is processed to estimate a model of the system of interest; then, the model is used to predict outputs for new input queries. In contrast, recent in-context learning approaches learn a meta model that maps directly from training data and query inputs to outputs in a zero-shot fashion, bypassing explicit model estimation. This approach leverages a meta model trained offline, on large sets of synthetically generated data, to emulate the behavior of a system identification algorithm. In this work, we advance this meta-learning framework for system identification in three directions. First, we develop a unified probabilistic meta-identification architecture that combines a Transformer-based encoder-decoder with tailored mechanisms for handling long training sequences, enabling calibrated predictions over long horizons. Second, we show how a pre-trained meta model can act as an uncertainty-aware synthetic data generator for classical system identification, providing task-specific data that regularize parametric models when real data are scarce. Third, we systematically evaluate the framework on standard nonlinear system identification benchmarks and on a challenging out-of-distribution scenario, demonstrating competitive accuracy with state-of-the-art methods and strong generalization, including cases where input-only adaptation is sufficient to handle significant distribution shifts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把系统辨识改写成 in-context learning：Transformer 编解码器直接从训练数据与查询输入零样本出预测，并加入长训练序列机制与概率输出，使长时域预测校准。预训练元模型还能当不确定性感知的合成数据生成器，在真实数据稀缺时正则化参数化模型；在标准非线性系统辨识基准与 OOD 场景上达到与 SOTA 竞争的精度，部分分布偏移只需 input-only adaptation。
Motivation: 传统系统辨识要先估参再预测，两步分离；真实数据稀缺或分布偏移时参数模型易过拟合，且难以给出校准的不确定性。
Method: 统一的概率元辨识架构：Transformer encoder-decoder 加专门的长训练序列处理机制，输出校准的长时域预测；预训练元模型作为不确定性感知的合成数据生成器，为经典参数化系统辨识提供任务相关数据做正则。
Result: 在标准非线性系统辨识基准与一个有挑战的 out-of-distribution 场景上系统评估，展示出与 state-of-the-art 方法竞争的精度和强泛化，包括仅用 input-only adaptation 即可应对显著分布偏移的情形。
Conclusion: in-context 元辨识可绕过显式模型估计，同时充当数据生成器补足稀缺真实数据；显著分布偏移下仅调整输入侧即可保持泛化。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Accelerating Linear Bandits with Persistent Candidate Sets
papers.abstract_en: Exhaustive optimistic scoring can make action selection costly in linear bandits with a large fixed set of $K$ actions, requiring $\mathcal{O}(K)$ score evaluations per round. We introduce Persistent Candidate LinUCB (\textsc{PC-LinUCB}), which maintains $k$ active actions and samples $q$ challengers uniformly from the remaining $K-k$ actions at each round. By scoring only these $k+q$ candidates, \textsc{PC-LinUCB} reduces the number of score evaluations per round to $\mathcal{O}(k+q)$. We establish problem-independent and problem-dependent high-probability regret bounds consisting of a standard linear-bandit learning term and an additive discovery cost of order $\mathcal{O}\left((K-k)\log(K-k)/q\right)$ at fixed confidence. Notably, this additional cost does not grow with the horizon. For fixed gaps and sufficiently long horizons, we establish an $Ω\left((K-k)/q\right)$ regret lower bound under uniform challenger sampling, showing that partial candidate access itself imposes an unavoidable regret cost. Experiments show that \textsc{PC-LinUCB} substantially accelerates LinUCB while maintaining comparable regret, and that the persistent candidate mechanism can extend beyond LinUCB.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PC-LinUCB 在固定 K 个动作的线性 bandit 中只维护 k 个活跃动作并每轮均匀采样 q 个挑战者，把每轮乐观打分从 O(K) 降到 O(k+q)。高概率 regret 上界由标准线性学习项加 O((K-k)log(K-k)/q) 的发现成本构成，该成本不随时域增长；实验显示它显著加速 LinUCB 而 regret 相当。
Motivation: 固定大动作集 K 下，LinUCB 每轮要对全部 K 个动作做乐观打分，动作选择开销随 K 线性增长，成为计算瓶颈。
Method: Persistent Candidate LinUCB (PC-LinUCB)：维护 k 个活跃动作，每轮从其余 K-k 个动作中均匀采样 q 个 challenger，只对 k+q 个候选打分；给出问题无关与问题相关的高概率 regret 界，并对均匀 challenger 采样推导下界。
Result: 每轮打分复杂度 O(K) → O(k+q)；regret 上界含发现成本 O((K-k)log(K-k)/q)（固定置信度，不随 horizon 增长）；固定 gap、足够长 horizon 下给出 Ω((K-k)/q) 的 regret 下界；实验中 PC-LinUCB 显著加速 LinUCB 且 regret 相当，并可扩展到 LinUCB 之外。
Conclusion: 部分候选访问本身带来不可回避的 regret 代价，但持久候选集机制能在可接受的发现成本内把线性 bandit 的动作选择开销从 O(K) 压到 O(k+q)。

papers.title: Desertification Forecasting in Semi-Arid Regions: Using Deep Learning to Probe the Observability Limits of Land Degradation Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Forecasting desertification has received far less attention than mapping it. We use a convolutional LSTM (ConvLSTM) trained on ten annual Earth Observation (EO) variables (2000-2023) over the semi-arid state of Ceará, Brazil, on a 256x206 grid at roughly 2.2 km resolution, to measure how much of the year-to-year evolution of a MapBiomas-derived degradation index (IDV) can be predicted from satellite data. The network predicts a bounded change on top of the last observed state, is trained in two stages (single-step, then recursive rollout) and is evaluated on a contiguous spatial and temporal holdout. State-wide mean IDV rose from 0.238 to 0.350 between 2000 and 2023, about 0.005 per year, but cell-level change is dominated by year-to-year jumps, and a gradient-boosting model given all channels explains only 4.7% of its variance. Against this ceiling, the ConvLSTM lowers RMSE relative to persistence by 1.6% one year ahead and 4.4% four years ahead in a held-out southern band (p < 0.001), beats persistence with a constant drift and reproduces 53-69% of the regional drift. Drift-aware baselines only help from the third year onward, by up to 4.4% in RMSE at six years. An earlier formulation that redrew the whole field each year predicted changes unrelated to the observed ones (correlation -0.06) and produced a spurious decline when run recursively. Channel knockouts suggest that elevation and EVI degrade the forecast, while slope and aspect have no measurable effect. Monte Carlo dropout and stochastic scenario maps convey the uncertainty that the expected-value forecast hides. Under climatological forcing, mean IDV rises from 0.350 in 2023 to 0.370 in 2030. EO-based desertification forecasting is therefore reliable for the regional trend, not for individual cells.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 ConvLSTM 在 Ceará 州 256x206、约 2.2 km 网格上，以 2000–2023 年十个年度 EO 变量预测 MapBiomas 退化指数 (IDV) 的逐年变化。相对 persistence 基线，1 年提前 RMSE 仅降 1.6%、4 年降 4.4%（p<0.001），能复现 53–69% 的区域漂移，但格点级变化由年际跳变主导、可预报性极低；结论是 EO 驱动的荒漠化预报只在区域趋势上可靠，不适用于单个格点。
Motivation: 荒漠化研究集中在制图而非预报；IDV 的格点级年际变化被跳变主导，即使给梯度提升模型全部通道也只解释 4.7% 的方差，需要量化卫星数据对退化动力学的可预报上限。
Method: ConvLSTM 吃十个年度 EO 变量（2000–2023），预测在最后观测状态之上的有界变化量；两阶段训练（单步，再递归 rollout），在连续的空间与时间留出集上评估；对照 persistence、带常数漂移的 persistence 与 drift-aware 基线，并做通道消融、Monte Carlo dropout 不确定性与情景图。
Result: 全州 IDV 均值 2000–2023 从 0.238 升至 0.350（约 0.005/年）；梯度提升用全部通道仅解释格点变化 4.7% 的方差。南部留出带上 ConvLSTM 相对 persistence 的 RMSE 降幅为 1 年 1.6%、4 年 4.4%（p<0.001），复现 53–69% 的区域漂移；drift-aware 基线仅从第 3 年起有效，6 年时 RMSE 最多降 4.4%。早期整场重绘的版本与观测变化相关系数为 −0.06，递归运行产生虚假下降。通道消融显示 elevation 与 EVI 使预报变差，slope 与 aspect 无可观测影响。气候强迫下均值 IDV 从 2023 年 0.350 升至 2030 年 0.370。
Conclusion: EO 驱动的荒漠化预报在区域趋势上可靠、在单格点上不可靠；可预报性上限来自格点级年际跳变，且 elevation 与 EVI 通道应剔除。

papers.title: Why Linear Models Can Still Work in a Complex and Changing World
papers.abstract_en: Linear models can predict well in complex domains even when underlying mechanisms are nonlinear. We argue that this can occur because the complexity of the world exceeds the complexity that can be learned reliably from finite, partially observed data. Flexible models can exploit curvature, thresholds, and interactions that fit one hospital, period, population, policy setting, or measurement process but fail elsewhere. When this instability lies mainly in the nonlinear component, omitting it can give linear models lower prediction error in a new environment. We connect this claim to work on simple linear rules, bias and variance, regularization, best linear prediction, measurement error, distribution shift, invariance, Rashomon sets, and underspecification. Proposition 1 gives a simple squared-error case in which a nonlinear rule learned in the training environment raises target error because it transfers too weakly; finite-sample estimation error can strengthen this result. Partial observation alone is not enough: the link between observed variables and unobserved factors must vary across environments. Stable nonlinear structure favors flexible models, and linear models remain vulnerable to linear spurious relationships. Model complexity should therefore be chosen by cross-environment stability as well as training-data accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文论证：当世界的复杂度超过有限、部分观测数据能可靠学到的复杂度时，线性模型在新环境中反而比灵活的非线性模型预测误差更低，因为后者学到的曲率、阈值与交互只在单一环境成立。Proposition 1 给出一个平方误差反例：训练环境学到的非线性规则因迁移过弱而抬高目标环境误差，有限样本估计误差会强化该结论。作者主张按跨环境稳定性（而不只是训练精度）选择模型复杂度。
Motivation: 灵活模型会拟合某个医院、时期、人群、政策或测量过程特有的非线性结构，换环境即失效；当不稳定主要来自非线性分量时，省略它反而降低新环境预测误差，但这一机制此前缺少形式化刻画。
Method: 以命题 1 的平方误差特例形式化：训练环境学到的非线性规则因跨环境迁移过弱而抬高目标环境误差，并说明有限样本估计误差会加强该结论；论证串联 bias-variance、正则化、best linear prediction、测量误差、分布偏移、invariance、Rashomon set 与 underspecification 等已有框架。
Result: 命题 1 证明存在平方误差情形，其中训练环境学到的非线性规则提高目标环境误差，且有限样本估计误差会强化该结果；同时给出两个边界条件：仅有部分观测不够，观测变量与未观测因子的关联必须跨环境变化；稳定非线性结构下灵活模型更有利，线性模型仍受线性伪相关影响。
Conclusion: 模型复杂度应由跨环境稳定性与训练数据精度共同决定：非线性不稳定主导时线性模型更稳，而环境间稳定的非线性结构或线性伪关系仍需灵活或结构化处理。

summary_sections.motivation: 灵活模型会拟合某个医院、时期、人群、政策或测量过程特有的非线性结构，换环境即失效；当不稳定主要来自非线性分量时，省略它反而降低新环境预测误差，但这一机制此前缺少形式化刻画。
summary_sections.method: 以命题 1 的平方误差特例形式化：训练环境学到的非线性规则因跨环境迁移过弱而抬高目标环境误差，并说明有限样本估计误差会加强该结论；论证串联 bias-variance、正则化、best linear prediction、测量误差、分布偏移、invariance、Rashomon set 与 underspecification 等已有框架。
summary_sections.result: 命题 1 证明存在平方误差情形，其中训练环境学到的非线性规则提高目标环境误差，且有限样本估计误差会强化该结果；同时给出两个边界条件：仅有部分观测不够，观测变量与未观测因子的关联必须跨环境变化；稳定非线性结构下灵活模型更有利，线性模型仍受线性伪相关影响。
summary_sections.conclusion: 模型复杂度应由跨环境稳定性与训练数据精度共同决定：非线性不稳定主导时线性模型更稳，而环境间稳定的非线性结构或线性伪关系仍需灵活或结构化处理。

papers.title: RegulaTutor: A Theory-Informed Framework for Long-Term Personalized Learning
papers.abstract_en: Long-term personalized tutoring requires language models to translate a learner's evolving history into appropriate instructional support. Existing LLM-based tutoring systems use memory and retrieval to personalize responses, but the pedagogical rationale linking historical evidence to teaching strategies is not always explicit. We introduce RegulaTutor, a theory-informed framework for long-term personalized tutoring that connects historical evidence, learner interpretation, and learner-facing instruction. Guided by self-regulated learning (SRL) research, its tutoring harness operationalizes a cognitive, affective, metacognitive, and motivational (CAMM) framework for deriving evidence-supported learner interpretations and teaching policies. The resulting policies retain links to their supporting evidence and are updated as new observations arrive. This staged workflow also supports systematic refinement through PairRoute, an offline procedure that uses intermediate execution records to distinguish harness, model, and mixed failures. PairRoute proposes and evaluates targeted harness revisions, then constructs reviewed stage-level supervision for confirmed model failures remaining under the selected harness. We focus this refinement on historical evidence acquisition, which underpins personalized instruction and allows outputs to be checked against learning records and reference answers. RegulaTutor improves historical-evidence accuracy, learner diagnosis, and judged teaching quality on average across evaluated model configurations. PairRoute results show an endpoint improvement in standalone-model historical-evidence accuracy over the refinement trajectory. Together, these results highlight RegulaTutor's potential to support lifelong personalized education through instructional policies that evolve with learner histories and targeted improvements to the tutoring system.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RegulaTutor 是面向长期个性化辅导的理论驱动框架，用自调节学习 (SRL) 的 CAMM（认知、情感、元认知、动机）框架把历史证据、学习者解读与教学策略显式串联，教学策略保留证据链并随新观测更新。配套的 PairRoute 离线精化流程用中间执行记录区分 harness、模型与混合失败，针对性修订 harness 并为确认的模型失败构造阶段级监督；在所评测的模型配置上平均提升历史证据准确性、学习者诊断与教学判断质量。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 辅导系统靠记忆与检索个性化回复，但把历史证据映射到教学策略的教学法依据不显式，难以核验与系统改进。
Method: 以 SRL 研究为指导，tutoring harness 按 CAMM 框架推导有证据支撑的学习者解读与教学策略，策略随新观测更新；PairRoute 用中间执行记录定位失败来源，提出并评估针对性 harness 修订，再为选定 harness 下仍存在的模型失败构造经审阅的阶段级监督，精化聚焦于历史证据获取环节（可对照学习记录与参考答案核验）。
Result: 在所评测的模型配置上，RegulaTutor 平均提升历史证据准确性、学习者诊断与判定的教学质量；PairRoute 结果显示在精化轨迹终点，独立模型的历史证据准确性相对起点有提升。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把教学法理论显式编码进 harness 并配合可区分失败来源的离线精化流程，可让个性化教学策略随学习者历史演化并获得可核验的改进。

papers.title: Model-free Bayesian Clustering and Multimodal Posterior Summarisation
papers.abstract_en: We develop a model-free, noise-aware Bayesian clustering framework that constructs a martingale posterior over clusterings from a predictive Bayesian perspective. This avoids explicit likelihood-prior model specification, expensive MCMC sampling, and mode-seeking variational approximations, while accommodating irregular cluster shapes and enabling parallel generation of posterior draws. To interpret the posterior over high-dimensional, noise-aware clusterings, we introduce a Wasserstein-type summarization method. Using a novel noise-aware loss, this approach compresses the large collection of posterior draws into a small set of weighted representatives, capturing distinct cluster structures and noise assignments. Further, we marginalise the uncertainty in the density level, avoiding reliance on a specific choice. We establish theoretical properties of the proposed loss and guarantees for the level-marginal posterior approximation. Results demonstrate the framework's effectiveness in capturing clustering and noise uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出无模型、噪声感知的贝叶斯聚类框架，从预测贝叶斯视角构造聚类上的 martingale posterior，绕开显式似然-先验设定、MCMC 与均值推断式变分近似，并支持后验样本并行生成；再用基于新型噪声感知损失的 Wasserstein 型摘要把大量后验样本压缩成少量加权代表，同时对密度水平边缘化其不确定性。
Motivation: 高维含噪聚类中，显式似然-先验建模与 MCMC 代价高、变分近似易陷入 mode-seeking，且后验样本量大难以解释，密度水平的选择也常被人为固定。
Method: 从预测贝叶斯视角构造聚类上的 martingale posterior，不写显式似然-先验；提出噪声感知损失并给出其理论性质，配合 Wasserstein 型摘要把后验样本压成少量加权代表，同时对密度水平做边缘化并给出 level-marginal 后验近似保证。
Result: 结果展示了该框架在捕捉聚类不确定性与噪声归属不确定性上的有效性；摘要给出的定量性内容为所提损失的理论性质与 level-marginal 后验近似保证，未列出数据集或指标数值。
Conclusion: 不指定似然-先验也能构造带噪声感知的聚类后验并给出可解释的少量代表，密度水平可被边缘化而非固定选取。

papers.title: ProgramGym: Scaling Training Environments for Long-Horizon Program Reproduction Agents
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents are increasingly used to build programs from scratch as software engineers do rather than to resolve issues within a repository or to generate a repository from a given requirements document. However, scalable verifiable training environments that force agents to discover what is required and to decide how the system should be designed remain scarce. Moreover, existing agent workflows also cannot sustain long-horizon development in which the agent explores the reference program before implementation. To address these challenges, we introduce ProgramGym, a framework consisting of Program-Env and Program-Agent for scalable training environments of long-horizon program reproduction agents. Specifically, Program-Env constructs verifiable training environments from repositories through a feedback-driven loop that repairs runtime sandbox builds and the quality of black-box tests. Using this novel pipeline, we obtain 1,648 training environments spanning C, C++, Go, and Rust. Program-Agent combines a role-isolated workflow of analysis, implementation, and review with revision management for compilation checks and failure recovery. Experiments on ProgramBench show that both Program-Env and Program-Agent improve performance on program reproduction. Fine-tuning on trajectories with these constructed environments raises the performance of Qwen3.8-27B from 34.87% to 42.84%. Program-Agent further raises the base and SFT models to 55.71% and 56.25%, both exceeding some flagship models. We will release the ProgramGym to support further research on coding agents that build programs from scratch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProgramGym 为「从零复现程序」的长程编程智能体提供可扩展、可验证的训练环境与角色隔离工作流：Program-Env 用反馈回路修复运行时沙箱构建与黑盒测试质量，从仓库造出 1,648 个 C/C++/Go/Rust 环境；Program-Agent 把分析、实现、评审分角色并加修订管理。在 ProgramBench 上，用这些环境微调 Qwen3.8-27B 从 34.87% 升到 42.84%，Program-Agent 再把 base 与 SFT 模型推到 55.71% 和 56.25%。
Motivation: 可验证且能强制智能体自行推断需求与系统设计的训练环境稀缺，现有工作流也撑不住「先探索参考程序再实现」的长程开发。
Method: Program-Env 通过反馈驱动回路从仓库构建可验证环境，持续修复 runtime sandbox build 与黑盒测试质量，产出 1,648 个跨 C、C++、Go、Rust 的环境；Program-Agent 采用分析/实现/评审角色隔离工作流，配合修订管理做编译检查与失败恢复，并在这些轨迹上做微调。
Result: 在 ProgramBench 上，用构造环境微调 Qwen3.8-27B 使程序复现性能从 34.87% 提升到 42.84%；Program-Agent 进一步把 base 与 SFT 模型分别提到 55.71% 和 56.25%，两者均超过部分旗舰模型。
Conclusion: 可验证环境构造与角色隔离工作流能同时抬高从零复现程序的成功率，且 ProgramGym 将开源以支持 coding agent 研究。

papers.title: PlacePulse: Learning Transferable Place Representations from Structural Geographic Data
papers.abstract_en: Geospatial machine learning often depends on task-specific feature engineering over large collections of sociodemographic, business, and environmental variables. Geospatial foundation models offer reusable representations of place, but leading approaches typically encode dynamic signals, such as mobility and search activity, or visual signals from satellite imagery. Few models represent the static structural composition of places (who lives and works there, which businesses operate there, and which risks they face) as transferable embeddings at fine spatial resolution. We introduce PlacePulse, a structural geospatial foundation model that compresses 572 attributes, expanded to 2,288 inputs through H3 neighborhood aggregates, into 256-dimensional unit-norm embeddings for 1,055,537 H3 resolution-7 cells in the United States. We also introduce a reusable two-axis benchmark that separates intrinsic representation quality from downstream predictive utility across multiple targets and spatial supports. Intrinsically, the embeddings reconstruct standardized inputs with mean $R^2 = 0.853$, use 251 of 256 approximately decorrelated dimensions, and show strong spatial organization, with Moran's $I = 0.93$ on the leading principal component and autocorrelation persisting beyond the input radius. Extrinsically, across 74 held-out targets from 12 external sources and four spatial supports, PlacePulse outperforms a dimensionality-matched feature-selection baseline on targets unrelated to the training inputs and is competitive with Google's Population Dynamics Foundation Model, leading on health, economic, election, economic-mobility and social-vulnerability outcomes, with relative strengths that vary by domain. These findings position structural composition as a distinct and complementary modality for geospatial foundation models, not simply a fallback where behavioral or imagery data are unavailable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PlacePulse 把地点的静态结构构成（人口、企业、风险等 572 项属性，经 H3 邻域聚合扩到 2,288 维输入）压成 256 维单位范数嵌入，覆盖美国 1,055,537 个 H3 resolution-7 网格。内在重建 mean R²=0.853、256 维中用到 251 维，主成分 Moran's I=0.93；外在评测在 74 个留出目标上于与训练输入无关的目标超过同维数特征选择基线，并在健康、经济、选举等结果上领先 Google Population Dynamics Foundation Model。结论是结构构成应作为与行为、影像并列的独立模态，而非数据缺失时的退路。
Motivation: 现有地理基础模型主要编码流动性、搜索活动等动态信号或卫星影像等视觉信号，缺少在细空间分辨率上把地点静态结构组成（谁居住与工作、有哪些企业、面临哪些风险）表示为可迁移嵌入的模型，导致下游任务仍需针对社会人口、商业、环境变量做任务特定特征工程。
Method: 以 572 项结构属性为输入，经 H3 邻域聚合 (neighborhood aggregates) 扩展为 2,288 维，编码为 256 维单位范数嵌入，覆盖美国 1,055,537 个 H3 resolution-7 单元；配套提出两轴基准，把表征内在质量与下游预测效用分开评测，覆盖多个目标与四种空间支撑 (spatial supports)，并与同维数特征选择基线及 Google Population Dynamics Foundation Model 对比。
Result: 内在：重建标准化输入 mean R²=0.853，256 维中使用 251 个近似去相关维度，首主成分 Moran's I=0.93，自相关在输入半径之外仍然延续。外在：在 74 个留出目标（来自 12 个外部数据源、4 种空间支撑）上，对与训练输入无关的目标优于同维数特征选择基线，并与 Google Population Dynamics Foundation Model 相当，在健康、经济、选举、经济-流动性与社会脆弱性结果上领先，且各领域相对优势不同。
Conclusion: 地点的静态结构构成是地理基础模型中一种独立且互补的模态，可作为可迁移的细分辨率表征，而不只是行为或影像数据不可得时的替代。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Radiomics-Based Thyroid Nodule Classification with Label-Conditional Conformal Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Thyroid nodule malignancy assessment relies on ultrasound imaging, yet current risk stratification systems suffer from substantial interobserver variability, contributing to a high rate of unnecessary biopsies. We propose a radiomics-based framework combining quantitative feature extraction via PyRadiomics with a Generalized Additive Model (GAM) classifier, selected among six candidates for its favorable trade-off between discriminative performance and interpretability. To complement point predictions with uncertainty estimates, Cross-Conformal Prediction with label-conditional guarantees is applied, flagging ambiguous cases for clinical review rather than forcing a binary decision. Experiments are conducted on TN5000, a publicly available ultrasound dataset of thyroid nodules. After Spearman correlation filtering, 36 features are retained and the GAM achieves an AUC of $0.89$, a sensitivity of $0.83$, and a specificity of $0.82$ on the validation set. At a significance level $ε=0.09$, selected to ensure empirical coverage guarantees on both classes, 63\% of nodules on the test set receive a certain (i.e., single-label) prediction, with conditional precision of $0.94$ for certain malignant and conditional Negative Predictive Value (NPV) of $0.73$ for certain benign cases, while the remaining 37\% are referred to the clinician.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 TN5000 甲状腺超声数据集上，用 PyRadiomics 特征加 GAM 分类器并套标签条件交叉共形预测 (label-conditional conformal prediction)，把不确定样本转交临床复核而非强行二分类。Spearman 过滤后保留 36 个特征，验证集 AUC 0.89、敏感度 0.83、特异度 0.82；ε=0.09 时测试集 63% 结节得到确定单标签预测，其余 37% 转诊临床。
Motivation: 甲状腺结节良恶性评估依赖超声，现有风险分层系统存在显著观察者间差异，导致大量不必要的穿刺活检；点预测本身无法表达不确定性。
Method: 用 PyRadiomics 提取定量影像组学特征，经 Spearman 相关性过滤保留 36 个，送入在六个候选模型中按判别性能与可解释性权衡选出的 Generalized Additive Model (GAM)；再叠加带标签条件保证的 Cross-Conformal Prediction，为点预测补充不确定性区间并标记模糊样本。
Result: 在 TN5000 公开甲状腺超声数据集上，验证集 AUC 0.89、敏感度 0.83、特异度 0.82。显著性水平 ε=0.09（为保证两类的经验覆盖）时，测试集 63% 结节获得确定单标签预测，其中恶性确定预测的条件精度 0.94、良性确定预测的条件 NPV 0.73，其余 37% 转交临床医生。
Conclusion: 影像组学 GAM 加标签条件共形预测可在保留可解释性的同时给出有覆盖保证的确定性预测，把约三分之一的模糊病例交给临床复核，从而减少强行二分类带来的不必要决策。

papers.title: BLOKS: Scaling Kernel Solvers with Sketched Block Preconditioning
papers.abstract_en: Kernel Ridge Regression (KRR) is a theoretically sound algorithm for nonparametric learning, which is also often used to investigate properties of deep learning. However, the exact KRR formulation incurs time and memory costs preventing applicability to large datasets, motivating the development of approximate solvers. These algorithms rely on (i) iterative methods, to avoid the computational burden of direct solutions; (ii) sketching or batching, to reduce the problem size; and (iii) preconditioning, to accelerate convergence. While crucial for fast convergence, preconditioning incurs memory costs that can be managed by lowering the number of free parameters of the model, potentially at the expense of expressivity and hence accuracy. To address this challenge, we propose BLOKS, a Conjugate Gradient-based solver for Nyström-sketched KRR built around a novel preconditioner that combines a block Jacobi approximation with sketching. The BLOKS preconditioner has memory cost independent of both the dataset size and the number of parameters, allowing scaling to large models. We provide a memory-efficient, GPU-accelerated implementation and show that BLOKS achieves excellent accuracy while retaining favorable time/memory complexity. Indeed, on standard large-scale datasets used to benchmark kernel solvers, BLOKS achieves comparable or better performances than state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BLOKS 是面向 Nyström 草图化核岭回归 (KRR) 的共轭梯度求解器，其新预条件子把块 Jacobi 近似与 sketching 结合，内存开销与数据集规模和模型参数量都无关，从而可在大模型上扩展。在标准大规模核求解器基准数据集上，BLOKS 达到与最先进方法相当或更好的精度，同时保持有利的时间/内存复杂度。
Motivation: 精确 KRR 的时间与内存开销使其无法用于大规模数据；现有近似求解器依赖预条件加速收敛，但预条件子的内存成本往往迫使减少模型自由参数，牺牲表达力与精度。
Method: BLOKS 基于共轭梯度 (Conjugate Gradient) 求解 Nyström-sketched KRR，核心是将块 Jacobi (block Jacobi) 近似与 sketching 结合的新预条件子；配套提供内存高效、GPU 加速的实现。
Result: 在用于基准核求解器的标准大规模数据集上，BLOKS 取得与最先进方法相当或更好的性能表现，同时保持有利的时间与内存复杂度；预条件子内存开销与数据集大小和参数量均无关。
Conclusion: 把块 Jacobi 与 sketching 融合进预条件子，可以在不增加内存随规模增长的前提下，让 KRR 求解器扩展到大模型并保持竞争力精度。

papers.title: Overcoming Data Imbalances with Expert Selection Biases
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have become the standard architecture for frontier LLMs. The multiple parallel experts in each transformer block theoretically enable expert specialization according to categories such as domains, languages, or modalities during pretraining. However, when data is imbalanced across categories, minority categories can become concentrated in a small fraction of the expert pool or spread inefficiently across them, effectively limiting their available capacity. In this work, we demonstrate that category-conditioned expert-selection biases can preferentially route tokens from different categories toward specialized expert pools. By applying biases based on input category, we provide a simple way to induce soft category-aligned specialization. This intervention encourages categories toward distinct expert subsets while retaining cross-category sharing when useful. More importantly, it enables the over-allocation of expert capacity to categories that would otherwise be disadvantaged by data scarcity. We observe performance improvements across modalities, low-resource languages, and code in models up to 10.6B parameters. At our smallest and largest model scales, these gains are equivalent to allocating 18.5% and 2.7% additional baseline training tokens, respectively. Overall, our results show that expert biases can serve as a lightweight control for category-level expert allocation, making room for low-resource categories while retaining standard MoE inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在数据类别不平衡的 MoE 大模型中，按输入类别给专家路由加偏置 (category-conditioned expert-selection biases)，把少数类 token 优先导向专属专家池，从而腾出专家容量。在多模态、低资源语言和代码上，最大 10.6B 参数模型均见性能提升，最小与最大规模的增益分别相当于额外 18.5% 与 2.7% 的基线训练 token。
Motivation: MoE 的并行专家本可按领域、语言或模态专门化，但跨类别数据不平衡会让少数类要么挤在少数专家里、要么被摊薄，实际可用容量受限。
Method: 在 Transformer 块的专家选择上加入基于输入类别的偏置，诱导软的类别对齐专门化：把各类 token 推向不同专家子集，同时在有用时保留跨类别共享，并对数据稀缺类别超额分配专家容量，推理流程保持标准 MoE。
Result: 在多模态、低资源语言与代码上，最大至 10.6B 参数的模型均观察到性能提升；最小与最大模型规模上的增益分别等价于额外 18.5% 与 2.7% 的基线训练 token。
Conclusion: 专家偏置可作为类别级专家容量分配的轻量控制手段，为低资源类别腾出容量，同时保持标准 MoE 推理；该收益随模型规模增大而缩小（18.5% → 2.7%）。

papers.title: Opening the Black Box of Classifier-Free Guidance via Information Bottleneck
papers.abstract_en: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) is a standard technique for improving conditional generation in diffusion models, yet its activation schedule is usually selected heuristically. In practice, most existing CFG-based methods rely on a pre-defined activation policy throughout inference, while recent dynamic variants often depend on hand-designed schedules without a principled theoretical explanation of when conditional information is most useful. In order to understand how the informational relevance between conditioning inputs and the score function evolves over the course of generation, we explore when guidance should be activated from an information-theoretic perspective. In this work, we formulate the diffusion trajectory as a time-dependent information bottleneck and show that the effectiveness of conditional information is not uniform throughout sampling, but becomes significantly stronger after a critical stage characterized by a Fisher-information balance condition. Motivated by this insight, we propose a training-free dynamic CFG strategy for inference. Rather than prescribing a fixed schedule in advance, our method constructs a stochastic process from conditional and unconditional score statistics and activates guidance when the estimated guidance gain crosses a prescribed threshold. This yields an adaptive activation rule that aligns condition injection with the underlying generation dynamics, while also recovering interval-based guidance as a limiting special case. Extensive experiments across diverse architectures and tasks, demonstrate that our method is effective, robust, and broadly applicable. Beyond empirical improvements, our framework provides an interpretation of dynamic guidance methods and a principled foundation for inference-time control in conditional diffusion models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把扩散采样轨迹形式化为时变信息瓶颈 (time-dependent information bottleneck)，证明条件信息的作用在采样中并不均匀，而是在一个由 Fisher 信息平衡条件刻画的临界阶段之后显著增强。据此提出免训练的动态 CFG：由条件与无条件 score 统计量构造随机过程，当估计的 guidance gain 越过阈值时才激活引导，并把区间式引导 (interval-based guidance) 恢复为极限特例。
Motivation: 现有 CFG 方法要么全程用预先设定的激活策略，要么依赖手工设计的动态调度表，缺少关于条件信息在生成过程中何时最有用的原则性理论解释。
Method: 将扩散轨迹建模为时变信息瓶颈，从信息论角度推导条件输入与 score 函数的相关性演化，并给出 Fisher 信息平衡的临界阶段判据；推理时用条件与无条件 score 统计量构造随机过程，按 guidance gain 阈值自适应触发引导，无需训练。
Result: 在多种架构与任务上的实验显示该方法有效、稳健且广泛适用，并带来经验性能提升；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 条件信息的效用在临界阶段后才显著增强，因此按生成动态自适应注入条件比固定或手工调度更合理；该框架同时为动态引导方法提供了统一解释和推理时控制的原则性基础。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: AgentSWE: Can Coding Agents Build the Agent You Actually Want?
papers.abstract_en: As the production of software passes into the hands of software itself, coding agents are increasingly commissioned to build agents fitted to their users' own workflows. This delegation carries a quiet assumption, that the delivered agent will faithfully serve the requirement it was built for, rather than merely appear to. No existing benchmark tests that assumption. We introduce AgentSWE, a benchmark for agent software engineering spanning three stages of the agent development lifecycle: Creation of a complete agent from a natural-language requirement, Editing of production agent codebases, and Optimization toward a measurable target. Each of its 25 tasks is framed as a commission rather than an exam: the builder iterates against a handful of illustrative cases, while acceptance exercises the frozen submission on held-out cases designed to span the full requirement, grading behavior against requirement-derived rubrics under hard pass/fail gates or, for Optimization, against the source benchmark's own objective. Evaluating a range of coding agents across models and harnesses, we find that none comes close to delivering what a requirement asks for: the gap between what a builder demonstrates and what it delivers is the norm, not the corner case. An accompanying empirical analysis of the failure trajectories identifies recurring failure modes, among them overfitting to the visible cases, hollow runtimes behind code that looks complete, and unsupported claims of completion, each a signal by which coding agents can learn to build the agents they are asked for.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentSWE 是一个覆盖 agent 开发生命周期三阶段（Creation、Editing、Optimization）的基准，共 25 个任务，每个任务按「委托」而非考试来设计：构建者只对着少量示例迭代，验收则在 held-out 用例上按需求派生的 rubric 打硬性 pass/fail 门。跨模型与 harness 评测多种 coding agent 后发现，没有一个能接近交付需求真正要求的东西，构建者演示出的行为与最终交付之间的落差是常态而非个例。
Motivation: 把软件交给软件自己去写时，默认交付的 agent 会忠实满足它被构建的需求而非只是看起来满足，但现有基准都不检验这一假设。
Method: 基准含 25 个任务，分 Creation（从自然语言需求造完整 agent）、Editing（改生产级 agent 代码库）、Optimization（朝可测目标优化）三阶段；构建者仅对少量 illustrative cases 迭代，验收在 held-out 用例上按需求派生 rubric 以硬性 pass/fail 门评分，Optimization 则用源基准自身目标；对多种 coding agent 跨模型与 harness 评测，并配套分析失败轨迹。
Result: 25 个任务、三阶段生命周期；评测结果是没有一个 coding agent 接近交付需求所要求的内容，演示与交付之间的差距是常态；识别出的反复失败模式包括对可见用例过拟合、看似完整的代码背后是空洞的 runtime、以及无依据的完成声明。
Conclusion: coding agent 目前无法可靠交付真正符合需求的 agent，这些可复现的失败轨迹正是它们学会按需求构建所需 agent 的信号。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.conclusion: coding agent 目前无法可靠交付真正符合需求的 agent，这些可复现的失败轨迹正是它们学会按需求构建所需 agent 的信号。

papers.title: ECGWmark: Deep Watermarking for Electrocardiogram Signals
papers.abstract_en: Secure transmission of electrocardiogram (ECG) signals remains a major challenge in telecardiology. While traditional mathematical watermarking can embed patient metadata directly into ECG signals, it is highly fragile against temporal desynchronization such as circular phase shifts. In contrast, existing deep watermarking approaches for temporal signals, such as audio, typically rely on lossy quantization, which compromises the high-frequency micro-morphological details critical for clinical diagnosis. To bridge this gap, we propose ECGWmark, a fully convolutional and quantization-free deep watermarking framework for medical time-series. ECGWmark operates in a continuous, full-resolution latent space and utilizes a localized frame-level mechanism to improve the robustness to severe desynchronization. Crucially, we introduce a differentiable Physiological Loss guided by a clinical classifier to preserve diagnostic semantics. Experiments on the benchmark MIT-BIH database show that ECGWmark maintains channel-bit extraction accuracy above 90% under the evaluated circular temporal shifts. Furthermore, under a rigorous inter-patient diagnostic evaluation, Class-V sensitivity changes from 71.97% to 76.50%, whereas Macro-F1 changes from 35.25% to 34.71% and Class-S sensitivity from 8.89% to 1.39%; these results indicate mixed class-level effects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ECGWmark 是面向 ECG 信号的全卷积、免量化深度水印框架，在连续全分辨率 latent 空间中用帧级局部机制嵌入信息，并以临床分类器引导的可微 Physiological Loss 保住诊断语义。在 MIT-BIH 上，所评估的循环时间移位下信道比特提取准确率保持在 90% 以上；跨患者诊断评估中 Class-V sensitivity 从 71.97% 升到 76.50%，但 Macro-F1 从 35.25% 降到 34.71%、Class-S sensitivity 从 8.89% 降到 1.39%，类别层面效果混合。
Motivation: 传统数学水印能嵌入患者元数据，却对循环相位移这类时间去同步很脆弱；现有面向音频等时序信号的深度水印依赖有损量化，会损伤临床诊断所需的高频微形态细节。
Method: ECGWmark 采用全卷积、免量化架构，在连续全分辨率 latent 空间操作，用帧级局部化机制抵抗严重时间去同步；并引入由临床分类器引导的可微 Physiological Loss 来保持诊断语义。
Result: 在 MIT-BIH 基准上，所评估的循环时间移位下信道比特提取准确率保持在 90% 以上；跨患者诊断评估中 Class-V sensitivity 由 71.97% 变为 76.50%，Macro-F1 由 35.25% 变为 34.71%，Class-S sensitivity 由 8.89% 变为 1.39%，呈混合的类别级效果。
Conclusion: 免量化加生理约束的水印能在强时间去同步下保住 ECG 比特提取，但诊断指标的类别级影响是混合的，不能只看单一 sensitivity 的提升。

papers.title: SWE-Critix: Post-Training Generalist Verifiers for Assessing Coding-Agent Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents are increasingly deployed for end-to-end software engineering tasks, where a readily available oracle evaluator that defines the success criteria is often absent. This motivates verifications for coding agents that can reliably judge and explain their behavior. However, verification is non-trivial as coding agents are increasingly capable of solving long-horizon software engineering tasks. Their execution trajectories can be extremely long, containing hundreds of iterative interactions with code repositories and external tools. Existing verifiers either rely on general-purpose LLMs without specialized training or train dedicated critics that predominantly focus on producing scalar rewards, highlighting the relatively limited exploration of training-based generalist verification. We introduce SWE-Critix, a post-training pipeline for training generalist verifiers of coding-agent trajectories. Given a task and its execution trajectory, the learned verifier predicts the completion label and generates a natural-language analysis that explains its judgment. Our pipeline combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with reinforcement learning (RL) and trains a series of 30B models on trajectories from CodeForge-Preview. On a held-out test set, SWE-Critix improves classification accuracy from 57% for the base Qwen3-30B-A3B reasoning model to 66% after SFT and 78% after RL. We release our models, datasets, and training code to facilitate further research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SWE-Critix 是一条后训练 (post-training) 流水线，用 SFT 加 RL 训练 30B 级通用验证器，对 coding agent 的长程执行轨迹同时输出完成标签和自然语言分析。在 CodeForge-Preview 轨迹的留出测试集上，分类准确率从基座 Qwen3-30B-A3B 的 57% 提到 SFT 后 66%、RL 后 78%。
Motivation: 端到端软件工程任务缺少现成的 oracle 评估器，而 coding agent 的轨迹可含数百次与代码库和外部工具的迭代交互、极难人工判定；现有验证器要么直接用未经专门训练的通用 LLM，要么只训出标量 reward 的专用 critic，基于训练的通用验证器探索不足。
Method: 后训练流水线结合 supervised fine-tuning (SFT) 与 reinforcement learning (RL)，在 CodeForge-Preview 的执行轨迹上训练一系列 30B 模型；给定任务与轨迹，验证器预测完成标签并生成解释判断的自然语言分析。
Result: 在留出测试集上，分类准确率从基座 Qwen3-30B-A3B 推理模型的 57% 提升到 SFT 后 66%，再经 RL 提升到 78%。
Conclusion: 对长程 coding-agent 轨迹做 SFT+RL 后训练能同时拿到判别标签与可读解释，作者据此开源模型、数据集与训练代码。

papers.title: AlphaNIST: Emergent Assembly Skills from Binary Task Rewards
papers.abstract_en: The NIST Assembly Task Board #1 remains a challenging benchmark for learning-based methods in robotic manipulation. Over short horizons, it demands precise, contact-rich control of small, tight-fitting parts. Over long horizons, it requires recovery and coordination across extended action sequences. Demonstrations, task decomposition, and dense progress rewards have enabled research advances by providing guidance on how to assemble. But how much of the strategy must be specified? The progression from AlphaGo to AlphaGo Zero showed that RL at scale can discover superhuman strategies without prescribing how to win. AlphaNIST asks whether a sparse binary task reward and task diversity admitted by this task-agnostic reward can similarly let a robot discover how to assemble. In simulation, we train a single policy from scratch across all 20 assembly tasks on the NIST Assembly Task Board #1, reaching 98.2% overall training success without demonstrations, progress shaping, scripted primitives, or per-task tuning. The framework also trains policies to complete ten assembly pairs in a single episode without a prescribed order, with task success rewarded only when all ten pairs are simultaneously complete. The learned policies discover dexterous and planning-like behaviors: choosing grasps for later assembly, using surrounding geometry to reorient parts, and preparing one part, assembling another, then returning to finish the first without an explicit planner. For videos, see our website: https://alpha-nist.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AlphaNIST 用单一稀疏二元任务奖励在仿真中从零训练一个策略，覆盖 NIST Assembly Task Board #1 全部 20 项装配任务，训练总成功率 98.2%，不使用演示、进度塑形、脚本化原语或逐任务调参。策略还学会在单个 episode 内完成 10 对装配且不规定顺序，仅在 10 对同时完成时给奖励，并涌现出为后续装配先选抓取、借周围几何翻转零件、先备一件再装另一件再回头收尾这类类规划行为。
Motivation: NIST Assembly Task Board #1 对学习类机器人操作方法仍是难点：短程要接触密集的精密配合，长程要跨长动作序列恢复与协调。现有进展依赖演示、任务分解和稠密进度奖励，但装配策略究竟需要被指定到什么程度并不清楚。
Method: 在仿真中用任务无关的稀疏二元任务奖励加任务多样性，从零训练单一策略覆盖全部 20 项装配任务；对照 AlphaGo 到 AlphaGo Zero 的思路，不给演示、进度塑形、脚本化原语或逐任务调参。另设单 episode 完成 10 对装配的设置，仅在 10 对同时完成时给成功奖励，不规定装配顺序。
Result: 仿真中单一策略在全部 20 项 NIST Assembly Task Board #1 任务上达到 98.2% 总训练成功率；在 10 对单 episode 设置下策略可完成任务并涌现出抓取选择、借几何翻转零件、跨任务交替推进等类规划行为。
Conclusion: 稀疏二元任务奖励配合任务多样性，足以让机器人在该装配基准上自行发现装配策略，无需被指定演示、进度信号或执行顺序。

papers.title: EmoGavel: Grounding-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards for Multimodal Emotion Preference Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal emotion preference learning uses pairwise comparisons to identify which open-ended emotion descriptions align more closely with human judgments. However, existing methods primarily focus on the final preference decision and provide little explicit supervision for localizing and correcting erroneous content. To address this limitation, we propose EmoGavel, a Grounding-Aware reinforcement learning framework with Verifiable rewards for multimodal Emotion preference Learning. We first introduce grounded supervised fine-tuning (Grounded SFT), which exploits controlled-error construction information to jointly learn preference prediction, error localization, repair, and missing-evidence recovery. We then optimize these verifiable outcomes with grounding-aware group relative policy optimization (GA-GRPO), combining preference-gated grounding rewards with dynamic zero-variance rescue to prioritize preference correctness and recover learning signals from all-wrong groups. Experiments on EmoPrefer and controlled-error evaluation sets show that EmoGavel improves both natural preference prediction and controlled-error discrimination while maintaining strong error-grounding performance. Our code and model checkpoints will be released once the paper is accepted.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EmoGavel 把多模态情感偏好学习从只监督最终偏好判断，改为同时监督错误定位与修复：Grounded SFT 借助受控错误构造信息联合学习偏好预测、错误定位、修复与缺失证据恢复，GA-GRPO 用偏好门控的 grounding 奖励加动态零方差救援优化这些可验证结果。在 EmoPrefer 与受控错误评测集上，自然偏好预测与受控错误判别同时提升，且保持强错误 grounding 表现。
Motivation: 现有方法只关注最终偏好决策，对定位和纠正描述中的错误内容几乎没有显式监督，导致模型能选对却说不清错在哪。
Method: 两阶段：Grounded SFT 利用受控错误构造信息，联合训练偏好预测、错误定位、修复与缺失证据恢复；随后用 grounding-aware GRPO (GA-GRPO) 优化，奖励由偏好门控的 grounding 奖励构成，并加入动态零方差救援以在全错组中恢复学习信号。
Result: 在 EmoPrefer 与受控错误评测集上，EmoGavel 同时改善自然偏好预测与受控错误判别，并保持较强的错误 grounding 表现。
Conclusion: 把可验证的错误定位与修复信号纳入偏好优化，可以在不牺牲偏好的前提下让多模态情感模型给出可核对的错误依据；代码与检查点将在论文接收后发布。

papers.title: Hidden Data Challenges in Clinical Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Widely reused preprocessing pipelines for electronic health records can encode assumptions about when information became available, what clinical episode a label represents, and what missingness means. These assumptions are rarely audited systematically and may propagate across subsequent studies when preprocessing pipelines are reused or adapted. Using MIMIC-IV as a case study, we identify and quantify violations of three complementary forms of preprocessing alignment, i.e., temporal, semantic, and population alignment, which manifest as temporal leakage, feature-task misalignment, and biased imputation. We show how ambiguities in timestamp semantics, episode definitions, endpoint construction, modality selection, and missingness handling can alter the information available to a model and affect the interpretation of its predictions. Through analyses of MIMIC-IV data and empirical case studies, we demonstrate that such choices may remain largely invisible in aggregate predictive performance while changing the signals on which models rely. We derive practical recommendations for temporally valid, clinically aligned, and reproducible preprocessing of MIMIC-IV and related electronic health record datasets. The code for our experiments, including our proposed preprocessing, is available at: https://github.com/m2l-lab/mimic-iv-preprocess.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 电子健康记录 (EHR) 预处理管线会隐式编码「信息何时可用、标签代表哪段临床事件、缺失意味着什么」三类假设，且随管线复用在后续研究中传播。以 MIMIC-IV 为案例，作者量化了时间、语义、群体三种预处理对齐的违背，分别表现为时间泄漏、特征-任务错配与有偏插补；这些选择在总体预测性能上几乎不可见，却改变了模型所依赖的信号。
Motivation: 广泛复用的 EHR 预处理管线很少被系统审计，其隐含的时间戳语义、事件定义与缺失机制假设会跨研究传播，使模型预测的解释失真。
Method: 在 MIMIC-IV 上识别并量化三类预处理对齐违背（temporal / semantic / population alignment），通过数据分析与实证案例考察时间戳语义、事件定义、终点构建、模态选择与缺失处理如何改变模型可用信息，并开源预处理代码（github.com/m2l-lab/mimic-iv-preprocess）。
Result: 在 MIMIC-IV 数据分析与实证案例研究中，这些预处理选择在总体预测性能指标上基本不可见，但会改变模型依赖的信号；三类违背分别对应时间泄漏、特征-任务错配与有偏插补。
Conclusion: EHR 预处理选择会静默改变模型所学信号，因此 MIMIC-IV 及同类数据集需要时间有效、临床对齐且可复现的预处理规范。

summary_sections.motivation: 广泛复用的 EHR 预处理管线很少被系统审计，其隐含的时间戳语义、事件定义与缺失机制假设会跨研究传播，使模型预测的解释失真。
summary_sections.method: 在 MIMIC-IV 上识别并量化三类预处理对齐违背（temporal / semantic / population alignment），通过数据分析与实证案例考察时间戳语义、事件定义、终点构建、模态选择与缺失处理如何改变模型可用信息，并开源预处理代码（github.com/m2l-lab/mimic-iv-preprocess）。
summary_sections.result: 在 MIMIC-IV 数据分析与实证案例研究中，这些预处理选择在总体预测性能指标上基本不可见，但会改变模型依赖的信号；三类违背分别对应时间泄漏、特征-任务错配与有偏插补。
summary_sections.conclusion: EHR 预处理选择会静默改变模型所学信号，因此 MIMIC-IV 及同类数据集需要时间有效、临床对齐且可复现的预处理规范。

papers.title: Why DiT Models Underperform as Representation Learners without Long Skip Connections
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion feature, i.e., intermediate activations extracted from diffusion model backbones, has emerged as a promising approach for unifying generation and vision understanding (discrimination). Despite the advancement of diffusion backbones into Diffusion Transformers (DiT), it has been found in previous literature that DiT models tend to yield weaker features despite their stronger generation capability. This poses a threat to good generation-understanding unification. In this work, we show via controlled from-scratch training that long skip connections (LSCs) affect feature quality: a DiT with LSCs can produce better features. Furthermore, through detailed diagnosis, we reveal the mechanism causing this effect. Specifically, the input to a diffusion backbone contains both the latent image and the diffusion noise, where the diffusion noise, though appearing in the form of noises, actually reflects the information of the diffusion trajectory. To make the final prediction of a noisy variable ($v$ or $ε$), the diffusion backbone needs both signals. However, carrying both signals through the main backbone effectively "pollutes" the image signal with noises, leading to poor feature quality. In comparison, LSCs can shortcut diffusion noises directly to where they are needed, leaving much weaker noise signals in the main backbone, thus improving feature quality. To name the broader impact, this reveals that LSCs are not a mere trick but closely related to the diffusion objective. The code is at https://github.com/Darkbblue/dit-lsc.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DiT 缺少长跳跃连接 (LSC) 时特征质量变差，因为主干必须同时承载隐图像与扩散噪声两路信号，噪声把图像信号污染。带 LSC 的 DiT 可把扩散噪声直接旁路到预测 v 或 ε 所需的位置，主干中残留的噪声信号弱得多，从而在从零训练的受控对比中产出更好的 diffusion feature。
Motivation: DiT 生成能力更强但中间特征更弱，威胁生成与视觉判别任务的统一表示学习。
Method: 用受控的 from-scratch 训练对比带与不带 LSC 的 DiT，并做机制诊断：分析输入中隐图像与扩散噪声两路信号在主干中的传播，以及 LSC 如何把噪声旁路到预测 v 或 ε 的位置。
Result: 受控从零训练显示带 LSC 的 DiT 产出更好的特征；诊断给出机制解释，即主干同时搬运两路信号会用噪声污染图像信号，而 LSC 使主干中残留的噪声信号弱得多。
Conclusion: 长跳跃连接不是单纯的工程技巧，而是与扩散目标本身紧密相关的设计要素。

papers.title: Understanding Mamba-3 Through Oscillatory Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Mamba-3 introduces input-dependent rotations into recurrent state updates, but their contribution beyond state retention remains unclear. We interpret these ro- tations as underdamped second-order dynamics, providing a framework for in- vestigating the role of oscillation in sequence modeling. Controlled comparisons show that underdamped dynamics outperform non-oscillatory damping regimes on state-tracking tasks, while language-model pretraining demonstrates benefits for long-context prediction and length generalization. Interventions in pretrained models further establish the importance of learned phase, and state analysis sug- gests that rotation regulates how retained information combines with incoming up- dates. Taken together, these findings identify underdamped dynamics as a useful mechanism for recurrent computation and suggest that oscillation supports long- context processing by regulating how information accumulates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Mamba-3 中输入依赖的状态旋转解释为欠阻尼 (underdamped) 二阶动力学，并通过受控对比证明该振荡机制在状态追踪任务上优于非振荡的阻尼机制，且在语言模型预训练中带来长上下文预测与长度泛化收益。
Motivation: Mamba-3 在循环状态更新中引入输入依赖的旋转，但这些旋转除状态保持之外的作用尚不清楚，缺少机制层面的解释框架。
Method: 将状态旋转解释为欠阻尼二阶动力学，设计受控对比区分振荡与非振荡阻尼机制；在预训练模型上做干预实验验证学到的相位作用，并分析状态以考察旋转如何调节保留信息与新输入的结合。
Result: 受控对比显示欠阻尼动力学在状态追踪 (state-tracking) 任务上优于非振荡阻尼机制；语言模型预训练显示其对长上下文预测和长度泛化 (length generalization) 有收益；干预实验确立了学到的相位的重要性。
Conclusion: 欠阻尼动力学是循环计算的一种有用机制，振荡通过调节信息累积方式支持长上下文处理。

papers.title: VideoAWR: Reinforcing Video Flow Models with Decoupled-Timestep Advantage-Weighted Rectification
papers.abstract_en: Regression-based RL for flow models mandates sampling \emph{without} classifier-free guidance (CFG) to align the rectification target with the reference marginal velocity. Extending Advantage-Weighted Rectification (AWR), which dynamically scales this regression target based on reward, to video generation encounters a cold-start pathology: unguided rollouts collapse into low-fidelity regions where intra-group reward gaps remain wide but no longer track perceptual quality, rendering the optimization target arbitrary. Conversely, utilizing guided rollouts to restore fidelity, while keeping the regression target tied to the guided sampling distribution, provably triggers a geometric guidance blow-up under exponential-moving-average (EMA) updates. We propose \textbf{VideoAWR}, which resolves this tension by untying sampling from the optimization anchor. An EMA reference policy generates \emph{guided} rollouts to restore reward separability, while the trainable policy is rectified against the \emph{unguided} conditional anchor. We prove this decoupled objective is mathematically exact: the centered advantage cancels the anchor in expectation, filtering out the reward-neutral guidance offset and retaining only the reward-correlated covariance increment. Consequently, inference runs single-branch and CFG-free, yet inference-time CFG preserves its original semantics. Furthermore, we introduce \emph{Decoupled Timestep Rectification}, supervising each rollout at an independently sampled timestep without bias to improve sample efficiency. Experiments on Wan2.1-1.3B and 14B demonstrate stable optimization and superior visual and motion quality in \emph{both} CFG-free and CFG-enabled regimes. Code is available at \pdfstartlink attr{/Border [0 0 0]} user{/Subtype /Link /A << /S /URI /URI (https://github.com/Fuzm7/FlowAWR) >>}% \textcolor{pearDark}{VideoAWR}\pdfendlink.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VideoAWR 把视频流模型的回归式 RL 中「采样」与「优化锚点」解耦：用 EMA 参考策略做带 CFG 的 rollout 恢复奖励可分性，而可训练策略仍对无 CFG 的条件锚点做 rectification，从而在数学上精确抵消 guidance 偏移。配合 Decoupled Timestep Rectification（每条 rollout 独立采样时间步、无偏监督），在 Wan2.1-1.3B 与 14B 上实现稳定优化，并在无 CFG 与有 CFG 两种推理下都取得更好的视觉与运动质量。
Motivation: 回归式 RL 要求无 CFG 采样才能让 rectification 目标对齐参考边缘速度，但无引导 rollout 会塌到低保真区、组内奖励差不再反映感知质量；改用有引导 rollout 又会在 EMA 更新下触发几何式 guidance 爆炸。
Method: VideoAWR 解耦采样与优化锚点：EMA 参考策略生成 guided rollout，可训练策略对 unguided conditional anchor 做 advantage-weighted rectification；证明 centered advantage 在期望下消去锚点，只保留与奖励相关的 covariance increment。另加 Decoupled Timestep Rectification，对每条 rollout 独立采样时间步做无偏监督。
Result: 在 Wan2.1-1.3B 与 14B 上实验，优化保持稳定，且在 CFG-free 与 CFG-enabled 两种推理 regime 下视觉与运动质量均更优；推理为单分支、免 CFG，同时保留推理时 CFG 的原始语义。
Conclusion: 把采样分布与回归锚点分开，可以在不牺牲 CFG 语义的前提下消除冷启动与 guidance 爆炸，使视频流模型的回归式 RL 同时稳定且高质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Exploring Attention Sinks in Text-to-Image Transformers from Diffusion and Autoregressive Models
papers.abstract_en: Attention sinks are tokens or positions that consistently receive disproportionate attention mass, often beyond what their semantic content would suggest. Despite extensive study in large language models, their behavior and functional relevance in text-to-image (T2I) Transformers remain largely unexplored. To fill this gap and better understand how text-to-image Transformers allocate and route attention, we explore this phenomenon of text-to-image transformers across bidirectional diffusion models and causal autoregressive models. Specifically, we explore whether attention sinks exist, where they emerge, and how they functionally influence generation. Through systematic attention analysis and targeted interventions, we identify that attention sinks emerge in both bidirectional diffusion and autoregressive models but exhibit distinct patterns. The autoregressive model concentrates attention on the first and global-scale tokens, whereas the bidirectional models develop sinks near modality boundaries, within text regions, and at spatial corners. Moreover, these patterns vary across generation stages and are localized to a sparse subset of layers and heads. To assess their functional relevance, we perturb sink-related heads and token positions. It turns out that perturbing sink-ranked heads produces larger average changes than non-sink comparisons, while some sink-position perturbations have limited effects on bidirectional model scores. We further introduce register tokens to redistribute attention sinks and find that several configurations preserve or modestly improve generation performance. Overall, attention sinks are architecture-, inference-stage-, and component-dependent phenomena, providing a basis for mechanistic analysis and principled attention design in text-to-image transformers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统考察文本到图像 Transformer 中的 attention sink：双向扩散模型的 sink 出现在模态边界、文本区域与空间角落，自回归模型则集中在首 token 与全局尺度 token，且随生成阶段变化、只集中在稀疏的层与头上。扰动 sink 排名靠前的头带来的平均变化大于非 sink 对照，而部分 sink 位置扰动对双向模型分数影响有限；引入 register token 重分配 sink 后，若干配置能保持或小幅提升生成性能。
Motivation: attention sink 在大语言模型中已被广泛研究，但在文本到图像 Transformer 中如何分配与路由注意力仍不清楚，缺少机制层面的定位与功能验证。
Method: 在双向扩散模型与因果自回归两类 T2I Transformer 上做系统注意力分析与定向干预：先定位 sink 出现的层、头与 token 位置，再扰动 sink 相关的头与位置，并引入 register token 重分配注意力。
Result: 两类模型都出现 attention sink 但模式不同：自回归模型集中在首 token 与全局尺度 token，双向模型出现在模态边界、文本区域与空间角落；模式随生成阶段变化且局限于稀疏的层与头。扰动 sink 排名靠前的头产生比非 sink 对照更大的平均变化，部分 sink 位置扰动对双向模型分数影响有限；若干 register token 配置保持或小幅提升生成性能。
Conclusion: attention sink 是依赖架构、推理阶段与组件的现象，可作为文本到图像 Transformer 机制分析与注意力设计的依据。

papers.title: AgentTune: A Unified Training Lifecycle for Tool-Using LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using agents increasingly require a common substrate for building, training, evaluating, distilling, and maintaining agentic systems, yet existing tooling typically addresses these stages in isolation. We present AgentTune, a source-available Python library that provides a unified framework for developing and optimizing tool-using agents. At its core, AgentTune introduces a two-tier EventLog representation that preserves agent trajectories while supporting consistent projections for training, evaluation, and auditing. Building on this substrate, the library provides a shared agent runtime, tool-calling reinforcement learning, agentic distillation, retrieval-augmented generation, decision workflows, evaluation utilities, and a designed path toward self-healing agents. These components are exposed through composable interfaces so that agent strategies, training methods, evaluation procedures, and recovery mechanisms can be combined without requiring separate representations or pipelines. We demonstrate the framework across agentic tasks including legal contract search and domain-specific applications, illustrating its use for trajectory-based optimization, tool-use evaluation, and cross-task agent development. AgentTune is released as a source-available library at https://github.com/Lexsi-Labs/AgentTune
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentTune 是一个面向工具调用 LLM agent 的源码开放 Python 库，用双层 EventLog 表示统一承载构建、训练、评估、蒸馏与维护各阶段，使策略、训练方法、评估流程与恢复机制可组合复用同一份轨迹数据。它在法律合同检索等领域任务上演示基于轨迹的优化、工具调用评估与跨任务 agent 开发。
Motivation: 现有 agent 工具链把构建、训练、评估、蒸馏、维护各阶段割裂处理，每换一个阶段就要换一套表示和流水线，跨阶段复用轨迹数据困难。
Method: 核心是双层 EventLog 表示：保留完整 agent 轨迹，同时提供面向训练、评估与审计的一致投影。其上提供共享 agent runtime、工具调用强化学习 (tool-calling RL)、agentic distillation、检索增强生成 (RAG)、决策工作流、评估工具与自愈 agent (self-healing agents) 的设计路径，全部以可组合接口暴露。
Result: 在法律合同检索与领域特定应用等 agentic 任务上演示了基于轨迹的优化、工具调用评估与跨任务 agent 开发；摘要未给出定量指标。
Conclusion: 统一的轨迹表示加可组合接口，可以让 agent 的训练、评估与恢复机制共用一套表示和流水线，而不必为每个阶段另建管线。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: 核心是双层 EventLog 表示：保留完整 agent 轨迹，同时提供面向训练、评估与审计的一致投影。其上提供共享 agent runtime、工具调用强化学习 (tool-calling RL)、agentic distillation、检索增强生成 (RAG)、决策工作流、评估工具与自愈 agent (self-healing agents) 的设计路径，全部以可组合接口暴露。
summary_sections.result: 在法律合同检索与领域特定应用等 agentic 任务上演示了基于轨迹的优化、工具调用评估与跨任务 agent 开发；摘要未给出定量指标。
summary_sections.conclusion: 统一的轨迹表示加可组合接口，可以让 agent 的训练、评估与恢复机制共用一套表示和流水线，而不必为每个阶段另建管线。

papers.title: PDE-PFN: Prior-Data Fitted Neural PDE Solver
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by the success of large language models (LLMs) with broad generalizability and robustness to noisy or unreliable pre-training data, we explore in-context prediction of PDE solution fields using approximate pre-training data. In addition, inspired by the posterior predictive mean-based inference mechanism of the in-context learning in prior-data fitted networks (PFNs), we propose PDE-PFN, a prior-data fitted neural solver that approximates the posterior predictive mean of PDE solutions via in-context learning. PDE-PFN builds on a PFN architecture with self- and cross-attention mechanisms of Transformer and is pre-trained on noisy approximate solutions generated by physics-informed neural networks, serving as diverse but not necessarily exact priors. Through experiments on a range of two-dimensional PDEs, we demonstrate that PDE-PFN achieves empirical generalization across heterogeneous equations, robustness under noisy priors, and zero-gradient-update in-context inference capability. PDE-PFN achieves competitive or improved predictive accuracy relative to the evaluated baselines while supporting flexible context and query representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PDE-PFN 把 prior-data fitted network (PFN) 的后验预测均值推理搬到 PDE 求解上：用 physics-informed neural network (PINN) 生成的含噪近似解作为先验做上下文预训练，推理时零梯度更新即可给出二维 PDE 解场。在一系列二维 PDE 上表现出跨方程的经验泛化与对含噪先验的鲁棒性，预测精度相对所评估基线持平或更优。
Motivation: LLM 式 in-context 学习依赖海量预训练数据，而 PDE 精确解数据昂贵；如何用近似、含噪的解场作为先验，让网络像 PFN 那样直接从上下文推断解场，是本文要打通的缺口。
Method: 基于 PFN 架构，用 Transformer 的 self-attention 与 cross-attention 处理上下文（含噪先验解）与查询点；预训练数据由 physics-informed neural network 生成的近似解构成，作为多样但不必精确的先验；推理时近似后验预测均值，无需梯度更新。
Result: 在一系列二维 PDE 上展示跨异质方程的经验泛化、对含噪先验的鲁棒性，以及 zero-gradient-update 的上下文推理能力；相对所评估基线预测精度持平或更优，并支持灵活的上下文与查询表示。
Conclusion: 把 PINN 产出的含噪近似解当作先验来预训练 PFN，可以在不更新梯度的前提下求解二维 PDE，且对先验噪声不敏感；该路径把 in-context 推广到数值 PDE 求解。
Relevance: 37

papers.title: LETHE: Defending against Unauthorized Image-to-Video Generation via Value Diversity Collapse
papers.abstract_en: Image-to-video (I2V) diffusion models can animate a single reference image into high-quality, subject-consistent videos, posing threats of misuse as anyone can turn personal photos into fabricated videos without consent. A promising solution is to proactively add an adversarial perturbation to the image before release, such that videos generated from it would be unfaithful or visually corrupted. However, due to an insufficient understanding of what governs how subsequent frames read the reference image in modern I2V models, existing protections struggle to offer strong protection under common perturbation budgets. In this paper, we approach the problem by exploring this underlying reading mechanism. Through a convex geometric analysis, we theoretically identify the spread of the reference value vectors as a key factor governing this reading process, and empirically find that even a mild contraction of this spread can severely degrade the generated video, making it an efficient lever for protection. Guided by this insight, we propose LETHE, a novel protection method that directly disrupts this reading process. LETHE pairs two complementary objectives, where a value collapse objective drives the reference value vectors toward uniformity, while an attention attraction objective draws subsequent frames toward these collapsed tokens to amplify corruption. We further construct two human-centric I2V protection benchmarks and conduct extensive experiments with multiple modern I2V models, which demonstrate the state-of-the-art protection performance and versatility of LETHE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LETHE 针对未经授权的图生视频 (I2V) 生成，通过凸几何分析指出参考图像 value 向量的离散度 (spread) 决定后续帧如何读取参考图，并提出双目标防护：value collapse 使参考 value 向量趋于均匀，attention attraction 把后续帧拉向这些坍缩 token 以放大画面破坏。在多个现代 I2V 模型上构建了两个人像中心防护基准，展示 SOTA 防护性能与通用性。
Motivation: I2V 扩散模型可把任意个人照片动画化为高一致性视频，存在未经同意伪造的滥用风险；现有基于预加对抗扰动的防护在常见扰动预算下保护强度不足，根因是对现代 I2V 模型读取参考图机制理解不够。
Method: 先用凸几何分析定位参考 value 向量的 spread 是读取过程的关键因素；LETHE 组合两个互补目标——value collapse 把参考 value 向量推向均匀，attention attraction 把后续帧注意力拉向坍缩 token 以放大破坏；并构建两个人像中心 I2V 防护基准。
Result: 实证发现参考 value 向量 spread 的轻微收缩即可严重劣化生成视频；在多个现代 I2V 模型上的实验显示 LETHE 达到 SOTA 防护性能与通用性（摘要未给出具体数值指标）。
Conclusion: 干扰 I2V 模型读取参考图的注意力机制（坍缩 value 向量并吸引后续帧注意力）是在常见扰动预算下实现强防护的有效杠杆。

papers.title: Masked Diffusion Language Agents for Tool-Integrated Chemical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Designing tool-integrated reasoning agent systems for complex chemical tasks remains a fundamental challenge. Although recent chemical agents have demonstrated promising performance through the integration of external tools, they are still built on the autoregressive paradigm, which is inherently constrained by causal attention and left-to-right generation. As a result, they often struggle with bidirectional molecular understanding, global coordinated tool planning and multi-source evidence integration. To address this challenge, we introduce ChemDiffAgent, the first masked diffusion language agent for tool-integrated chemical reasoning. It reformulates chemical reasoning as iterative denoising over interleaved reasoning and tool-use trajectories, enabling tool-use decisions to be jointly determined under full-trajectory context and thereby better aligning the agent's decision boundary with its knowledge boundary. We further analyze how this paradigm benefits agentic reasoning through harder infilling subproblems during training and flexible arbitrary-order decoding during inference. Then we develop a two-stage post-training framework, comprising agentic supervised fine-tuning and variance-reduced preference optimization, to enhance tool-use and reasoning capabilities. We also construct a comprehensive benchmark covering six chemistry tasks across both single-turn and multi-turn tool-use scenarios. Under matched budgets and evaluation, ChemDiffAgent consistently outperforms autoregressive agents, achieving an overall improvement of approximately 20%. Notably, our 8B model achieves performance comparable to, in some cases surpassing, significantly larger frontier models, such as GPT 5.5 and Claude Opus 4.7. Code is available at https://github.com/bilemond/ChemDiffAgent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ChemDiffAgent 把化学工具调用推理改写为对交错的推理与工具轨迹做迭代去噪的掩码扩散语言智能体，工具决策在全轨迹上下文中联合确定。两阶段后训练（agentic SFT + 方差缩减偏好优化）后，在自建的六任务化学基准上、匹配预算与评测下整体比自回归智能体提升约 20%，8B 模型在部分任务上追平甚至超过 GPT 5.5 与 Claude Opus 4.7。
Motivation: 现有化学智能体建立在自回归范式上，受因果注意力与从左到右生成限制，难以做双向分子理解、全局协同的工具规划与多源证据整合。
Method: 将化学推理重构为对交错的 reasoning 与 tool-use 轨迹的迭代去噪（masked diffusion），使工具使用决策在全轨迹上下文下联合决定；训练用更难的 infilling 子问题，推理支持任意顺序解码。后训练为两阶段：agentic 监督微调 (SFT) 加方差缩减偏好优化 (variance-reduced preference optimization)。
Result: 自建覆盖六项化学任务、含单轮与多轮工具使用场景的基准上，在匹配预算与评测条件下整体比自回归智能体提升约 20%；8B 模型在部分任务上与 GPT 5.5、Claude Opus 4.7 等更大前沿模型相当甚至超过。
Conclusion: 掩码扩散范式可作为工具集成化学推理的自回归替代，全轨迹联合决策让智能体的决策边界更贴近其知识边界。

papers.title: DuoRate: Two-Rate Per-Expert Precision Allocation for Mixture-of-Experts Serving
papers.abstract_en: Serving a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model pays for expert precision twice: the resident footprint pays for every expert the router can reach, while each batch-one decode step pays only for the experts it selects. These are two different rate functionals over the same per-expert widths, yet published per-expert MoE allocators constrain only the first. We call the difference the store-read gap; in the released BitsMoE checkpoint, 2.54 bits per weight (bpw) of storage become 7.50 bpw of decode traffic. We propose DuoRate, which stores once and reads per workload. Offline, it stores one uniform tier of a prefix-readable weight stream and bakes a distortion tensor. Online, it profiles a workload's own prefill without labels and solves a Lagrangian rate-distortion allocation under the decode functional; routing frequency provably cancels from every per-expert decision, and the solve costs one dot product per expert and a bisection. A deployment therefore keeps a single artifact that prefill reads at the stored rate and decode reads at the workload's own rate. On Qwen3-30B-A3B, DuoRate reading 2.3 bpw exceeds every 2-bit-class baseline by 6.3 to 47.0 points of average accuracy, and at 2.9 bpw it matches 4-bit formats that read 1.4-1.6 bpw more. The advantage is largest under long decoding: on GSM8K, DuoRate at 2.9 bpw matches or exceeds every 4-bit format and trails BF16 by only 0.25 points, and at 2.6 bpw it still matches or exceeds the 4.5-bit NF4 and FP4. Against controls in its own format, the allocation alone is worth 0.07-0.11 bpw of read rate. Code will be released upon publication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DuoRate 把 MoE 每专家位宽分配拆成存储与解码两个速率泛函（store-read gap）：离线统一存一档前缀可读权重流并烘焙失真张量，在线无标签剖析自身 prefill 后在解码泛函下解 Lagrangian 率失真分配，路由频率在每个专家决策中可证明消去。Qwen3-30B-A3B 上以 2.3 bpw 读取时平均精度超所有 2-bit 类基线 6.3 至 47.0 点，2.9 bpw 追平多读 1.4–1.6 bpw 的 4-bit 格式。
Motivation: 已有的 per-expert MoE 位宽分配器只约束常驻存储这一速率泛函，忽略 batch-one decode 每步只为被选专家付费的另一泛函；BitsMoE 检查点中 2.54 bpw 存储对应 7.50 bpw 解码流量，两者被混为一谈。
Method: 离线阶段存储单一统一分档的前缀可读权重流并烘焙失真张量；在线阶段无标签剖析工作负载自身的 prefill，在解码速率泛函下解 Lagrangian 率失真分配，每个专家只需一次点积加一次二分求解，路由频率从决策中消去；部署只保留一个工件，prefill 按存储速率读、decode 按工作负载自身速率读。
Result: 在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上，DuoRate 以 2.3 bpw 读取时平均精度超所有 2-bit 类基线 6.3 至 47.0 点；2.9 bpw 时追平多读 1.4–1.6 bpw 的 4-bit 格式。长解码优势最大：GSM8K 上 2.9 bpw 追平或超过所有 4-bit 格式、距 BF16 仅 0.25 点，2.6 bpw 仍追平或超过 4.5-bit 的 NF4 与 FP4。与同格式对照相比，仅分配本身值 0.07–0.11 bpw 的读取速率。
Conclusion: 存储与解码应按各自速率泛函分别定价：一次存储、按工作负载读取的双速率分配能在同一位宽下显著抬高 MoE 平均精度，长解码场景收益最大。

papers.title: Taking Tokenization off the Host for Agentic LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: Agentic workloads resend long contexts that barely change between calls. Prefix caching now skips most of their prefill, yet every request must still be tokenized in full before the cache can even be consulted. Tokenization, a CPU stage long treated as negligible, becomes the largest part of time-to-first-token (TTFT), and a frontend that tokenizes for a whole GPU fleet limits how many GPUs it can feed. We present GraphTok, a GPU tokenizer that runs the entire encoding pipeline, from pre-tokenization through byte-pair encoding (BPE) merging to token-ID assembly, as one replayable CUDA graph. GraphTok reproduces the reference token IDs bit-for-bit on GPT-2, Llama 3, Qwen 2.5, DeepSeek-V3, and Gemma 3, hands short inputs to a CPU engine where the GPU cannot win, and plugs into unmodified vLLM and NVIDIA Dynamo. GraphTok encodes one million GPT-2 tokens in 1.7-3.2 ms including data transfers, and on Llama 3 it is 4.7-6.0x faster than gigatoken, the strongest CPU tokenizer. On TokTier's own single-request benchmark, it is 2.6-3.9x faster than gigatoken and up to 18.1x faster than TokTier. In vLLM with a cached prefix, it lowers mean TTFT by 2.1-2.4x. The largest gain is capacity. Within a 2 s P99 target, one Dynamo frontend with GraphTok sustains 518 requests/s of 121k-token traffic, the busiest-hour load of 56 GPUs, against 296 with gigatoken and 18.5 with the default tokenizer. Across 121k to one million tokens, this is 1.75-2.5x the load gigatoken sustains, with a P99 up to 64x lower where gigatoken's tail breaks.

papers.title: CoVA: Composing VAE Representations for Generative Learning
papers.abstract_en: Representation alignment with pretrained visual encoders improves diffusion transformer training but requires auxiliary encoders and extra training overhead. Recent approaches instead exploit representations from the generative model's own variational autoencoder (VAE). However, reconstruction-oriented VAE features are not optimized for the semantic discrimination and spatial structure needed for generative learning. We introduce \textbf{CoVA} (\textbf{Co}mposed \textbf{VA}E Representations), a lightweight framework that composes VAE features online into stage-wise guidance for flow-matching training. A small latent composer is jointly trained with class supervision, masked latent reconstruction, and horizontal-flip consistency, yielding semantically discriminative, spatially structured dense features and sample-dependent class posteriors. CoVA aligns intermediate SiT features with the composed representations early in training, then removes the increasingly detrimental alignment and reuses detached composer posteriors for sample-dependent soft label conditioning. We further uncover a hidden confound in soft label conditioning: averaging class embeddings attenuates their magnitude, coupling semantic interpolation with conditioning strength. This attenuation alone can substantially improve FID while degrading Recall, revealing a non-semantic source of the apparent gain. CoVA corrects this confound by restoring the hard-label magnitude, isolating posterior-dependent directional semantics. CoVA adds only 8.5M training-only auxiliary parameters (1.3\% of SiT-XL/2) and introduces no inference-time overhead. On ImageNet 256$\times$256, CoVA reduces SiT-XL/2 FID from 17.2 to 7.4 (\textbf{57\%}) in 400K steps. With classifier-free guidance, it achieves an FID of \textbf{2.03} in only 400 epochs, versus 2.06 after 1,400 epochs for vanilla SiT-XL/2.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoVA 把生成模型自身 VAE 的重建特征在线组合成分阶段的 flow-matching 训练引导：小 latent composer 用类别监督、masked latent reconstruction 与水平翻转一致性联合训练，先对齐 SiT 中间特征，训练后期移除对齐并复用其 posterior 做样本相关软标签条件。在 ImageNet 256×256 上 400K 步把 SiT-XL/2 的 FID 从 17.2 降到 7.4（57%），加 classifier-free guidance 后 400 epoch 即达 FID 2.03，而 vanilla SiT-XL/2 需 1400 epoch 才到 2.06。
Motivation: 用预训练视觉编码器做表征对齐能改善 diffusion transformer 训练，但要额外编码器与训练开销；直接用生成模型自身 VAE 特征时，重建导向的特征缺少生成学习所需的语义判别性与空间结构。
Method: 轻量 latent composer 在线组合 VAE 特征为分阶段引导，联合训练目标为类别监督、masked latent reconstruction 与 horizontal-flip consistency；训练早期对齐 SiT 中间特征，随后移除对齐并复用 detached composer posterior 做样本相关软标签条件；同时纠正软标签条件中类别嵌入取平均导致的幅度衰减混杂，恢复 hard-label 幅度。
Result: 仅增加 8.5M 训练期辅助参数（占 SiT-XL/2 的 1.3%），推理期零开销；ImageNet 256×256 上 400K 步 FID 17.2 → 7.4（降 57%）；配 classifier-free guidance 时 400 epoch 达 FID 2.03，vanilla SiT-XL/2 需 1400 epoch 才到 2.06。仅幅度衰减这一非语义因素就可明显改善 FID 同时损害 Recall。
Conclusion: VAE 特征经组合与条件化处理即可替代外部编码器做生成学习引导，且软标签条件的表观增益部分来自幅度衰减而非语义插值，须恢复 hard-label 幅度才能隔离真正的后验方向语义。

papers.title: SBNO : Schrödinger Bridge Neural Operator for the Forward and Inverse Problems under Missing Information
papers.abstract_en: Partial differential equation (PDE) surrogate modeling often relies on either dense observations or access to governing equations/physics constraints. In practice, observations can be sparse and partial, and the underlying physics may be partially specified or unavailable. We introduce SBNO, an equation-free paired-data diffusion bridge matching framework that learns conditional operators for both forward and inverse PDE problems under partial observations. SBNO uses diffusion Schrödinger bridge matching to learn a pair of time-dependent drifts from a mask-aware endpoint coupling that preserves empirical input-solution pairing during training and supports both PDE-task directions within a single framework. At inference time, SBNO produces a deterministic point reconstruction by integrating the probability-flow ODE constructed from the learned drift pair, without inference-time observation or PDE guidance-weight tuning. On five PDE benchmarks with 5% observations, SBNO achieves superior or comparable accuracy to baselines while demonstrating lower test-instance error dispersion. Furthermore, SBNO is at least $9.7 \times$ faster and reduces GPU memory by at least $4.3 \times$ compared to guided-diffusion baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SBNO 用扩散 Schrödinger bridge 匹配在配对数据上学条件算子，单框架同时处理观测稀疏部分给定下的 PDE 正问题与反问题。五个 PDE 基准、5% 观测下精度达到或优于基线且测试误差离散度更低，推理时无需调观测或 PDE 引导权重，比 guided-diffusion 基线至少快 9.7 倍、显存省 4.3 倍。
Motivation: PDE 代理建模通常要么依赖稠密观测、要么需要完整控制方程与物理约束，而实际中观测稀疏且部分缺失、物理可能只部分已知或不可得。
Method: SBNO 是 equation-free 的 paired-data diffusion bridge matching 框架：用 mask-aware endpoint coupling 保留经验输入-解配对，通过 diffusion Schrödinger bridge matching 学一对含时 drift；推理时沿 drift 对构造的 probability-flow ODE 积分得到确定性点重建，不做推理期观测或 PDE 引导权重调节。
Result: 在五个 PDE 基准、5% 观测设置下，精度相对基线达到 superior 或 comparable，且测试实例误差离散度更低；相对 guided-diffusion 基线至少加速 9.7 倍、GPU 显存至少降低 4.3 倍。
Conclusion: 在观测稀疏、物理部分未知的条件下，配对数据上的 Schrödinger bridge 匹配可在一个框架内覆盖 PDE 正反两类任务，并免去推理期引导权重调参。

papers.title: ThinkDrag: Semantic Drag-Based Image Editing with Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Drag-based image editing provides an intuitive interface for spatially controlled image manipulation by allowing users to specify handle and target points. Existing methods have made substantial progress through optimization-based, one-step, and feed-forward formulations, but they often interpret drag instructions as geometric displacements. This limits their effectiveness when the desired edit depends on interpreting image content and inferring a plausible semantic transformation from sparse point constraints. We introduce ThinkDrag, a unified multimodal framework for drag-based image editing with visual reasoning. ThinkDrag is trained to associate point constraints with meaningful object- and scene-level transformations, and can optionally produce an explicit reasoning trace that interprets the intended edit before image generation. This reasoning trace improves interpretability, particularly for ambiguous drags. Drag Endpoint Markers, motivated by an analysis of cross-image attention, provide an explicit correspondence signal that grounds each drag in image space. To support this framework, we construct a supervised dataset of semantic drag transformations paired with reasoning traces and introduce DragBench++, a benchmark targeting challenging drag-based editing scenarios with reference edit solutions. Experiments show that ThinkDrag achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving generation quality and plausibility while maintaining competitive point-following precision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ThinkDrag 把拖拽编辑从几何位移升级为语义变换：模型把 handle/target 点约束关联到对象级与场景级变换，并可先生成显式推理链再生成图像，Drag Endpoint Markers 借跨图注意力提供落点对应信号。配套构建带推理链的监督数据集与 DragBench++ 基准，实验达到 SOTA 的生成质量与合理性，同时保持有竞争力的点跟随精度。
Motivation: 现有优化式、单步与前馈拖拽编辑把指令当成几何位移，遇到需要理解图像内容、从稀疏点推断合理语义变换的编辑就失效。
Method: 统一多模态框架 ThinkDrag：训练时把点约束与对象/场景级语义变换对齐，可选地在生成前输出显式推理链；由跨图注意力分析导出的 Drag Endpoint Markers 提供把每次拖拽锚定到图像空间的对应信号；并构建配推理链的语义拖拽监督数据集与含参考编辑解的 DragBench++ 基准。
Result: 实验显示 ThinkDrag 达到 state-of-the-art，生成质量与合理性提升，同时保持有竞争力的点跟随精度；评测在新构建的 DragBench++ 上进行，该基准针对高难度拖拽编辑场景并给出参考编辑解。
Conclusion: 把拖拽指令当作需要视觉推理的语义变换而非几何位移，配合显式对应信号，可以在不牺牲点跟随精度的前提下提高编辑质量与合理性。

papers.title: JEPA-kMMVAE: CSI Prediction for Time-Varying Wireless Channels
papers.abstract_en: This paper considers channel state information (CSI) prediction using neural networks for time-varying multi-antenna channels from noisy historical observations. The main challenge is to exploit temporal correlation while distinguishing channel evolution from observation noise. We propose JEPA-kMMVAE, which combines a joint-embedding predictive architecture with a k-memory Markov variational autoencoder to predict future CSI through temporally structured latent representations. The framework supports direct prediction and residual corrections relative to the latest latent state and noisy CSI observation. Simulation results show that the residual configuration outperforms the evaluated baselines at moderate and high input CSI signal-to-noise ratios, while sequence baselines remain more accurate under stronger noise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向时变多天线无线信道的 CSI 预测，把 joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) 与 k-memory Markov VAE 结合，在时序结构化隐空间中预测未来 CSI，并支持相对最新隐状态与含噪观测的残差修正。仿真中残差配置在中高输入 CSI 信噪比下优于所评估基线，而在更强噪声下序列基线更准。
Motivation: 从含噪历史观测预测时变多天线信道，核心难点是利用时间相关性的同时把真实信道演化与观测噪声区分开。
Method: 提出 JEPA-kMMVAE：用 joint-embedding predictive architecture 配合 k-memory Markov 变分自编码器，在时序结构化隐表示上预测未来 CSI；框架支持直接预测与相对最新隐状态、含噪 CSI 观测的残差修正两种模式。
Result: 仿真结果显示，残差配置在中等与较高输入 CSI 信噪比下优于所评估的基线；在更强噪声条件下，序列基线仍更准确。
Conclusion: 残差式隐空间预测在中高信噪比下是更优的 CSI 预测形式，但强噪声时优势反转，序列基线更可靠。

papers.title: NovaSplat: Model-Free 6D Object Pose Estimation via 3D Gaussian Splatting Onboarding and Refinement
papers.abstract_en: 6D pose estimation of novel objects without CAD models remains an open challenge: model-free methods must build the object representation from scratch during onboarding and have long trailed their model-based counterparts. We present NovaSplat, a model-free pipeline that closes this gap. From a short smartphone video captured at onboarding, we train a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) model that serves both as a template source for detection and coarse pose estimation and as a differentiable backbone for pose refinement. Our refiner optimizes the object-to-camera pose with combined photometric and geometric losses under a continuous rotation parametrization free of gradient singularities. On a household-object benchmark, NovaSplat surpasses all model-based methods. On a challenging industrial benchmark with textureless and specular surfaces, it outperforms all model-free competitors while substantially narrowing the gap to model-based ones. We further introduce NovaSplat-Lite, an inference variant that is $3.1\times$ faster at negligible accuracy cost. TL;DR: NovaSplat 是无 CAD 模型的 6D 位姿估计流水线：用入位时拍摄的短视频训练 3D Gaussian Splatting，同一模型既作检测与粗位姿的模板源，又作可微位姿精修骨干，配合光度+几何损失与无梯度奇异点的连续旋转参数化。在家庭物体基准上超过全部 model-based 方法，在无纹理与镜面工业基准上超过全部 model-free 竞品并大幅逼近 model-based；NovaSplat-Lite 推理快 3.1 倍而精度损失可忽略。
Motivation: 无 CAD 模型的新物体 6D 位姿估计需要在 onboarding 阶段从零构建物体表示，长期落后于依赖已知模型的方法，尤其在无纹理、镜面等工业表面上。
Method: 从一段智能手机短视频训练 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)，其输出同时充当检测与粗位姿的模板源和位姿精修的可微骨干；精修器在连续旋转参数化（无梯度奇异点）下联合优化光度与几何损失，最小化物体到相机位姿；另提供推理变体 NovaSplat-Lite。
Result: 在家庭物体基准上超过所有 model-based 方法；在含无纹理与镜面表面的挑战性工业基准上超过所有 model-free 竞品并显著缩小与 model-based 的差距；NovaSplat-Lite 推理速度提升 3.1 倍，精度损失可忽略。
Conclusion: 短视频训练的 3DGS 可以同时充当模板与可微精修骨干，使无模型 6D 位姿估计在家庭与工业基准上追平甚至超过依赖 CAD 模型的路线。

papers.title: Sustainable Cloud-Fog-Edge Systems for Smart Buildings: Algorithmic Adaptation under Memory Constraints and Dynamic Orchestration Strategies
papers.abstract_en: The escalating environmental footprint of the Information and Communication Technol- ogy (ICT) sectorwith global Data Center electric- ity usage potentially reaching 3% by 2030 and the imperative for real-time responsiveness in smart buildings demand a foundational shift towards Edge Computing. This article proposes a holis- tic architectural and algorithmic approach for cre- ating autonomous, resilient, and privacy-preserving learning systems within smart buildings, advancing the core concept of the building itself as the data center. Our contributions, demonstrating originality compared to conventional centralized systems, are structured around three main pillars: 1) Validation of resilient data acquisition chains using the af- fordable Arduino ecosystem (Uno R4 WiFi/BME280) and secure persistence solutions including centralized archiving (Node-RED/MySQL) and secure remote transfer (Python/rsync/SSH). 2). The proposal of a lightweight, KOptim orchestration framework, inter- operable with the FIWARE standard, for the dynamic management of Service Level Agreements (SLA). 3) The adaptation and experimental valida- tion of the Generalized Hebbian Algorithm (GHA) for Principal Component Analysis (PCA) on low- power microcontrollers,We introduce and compare an iterative learning strategy using data buffers, featuring sorting and explicit preservation of extreme samples to maintain diversity. Experimental results on the high-dimensional Tour Perret sensor data confirm that this novel method, despite introducing a necessary temporal complexity of O(W log W ) due to sorting, achieves convergence and final result quality that is visually equivalent to processing the entire dataset in full memory, reliably identifying two distinct operational states.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向智慧楼宇的云-雾-边缘系统，把建筑本身当数据中心：用 Arduino 传感链与 Node-RED/MySQL 持久化采集数据，KOptim 框架按 SLA 动态编排服务，并把 GHA-PCA 改造成可在低功耗 MCU 上用数据缓冲区（排序并显式保留极值样本）迭代学习。在高维 Tour Perret 传感器数据上，该方法引入 O(W log W) 排序时间复杂度，但收敛与最终结果质量在视觉上等同于全内存处理整个数据集，并可靠识别出两个不同运行状态。
Motivation: ICT 部门全球数据中心用电量到 2030 年可能达 3%，集中式系统难以同时满足智慧楼宇的实时响应、韧性与隐私要求，需要把计算与学习下沉到边缘。
Method: 三条支柱：Arduino Uno R4 WiFi/BME280 传感链加 Node-RED/MySQL 集中归档与 Python/rsync/SSH 安全远程传输；与 FIWARE 标准互操作的轻量 KOptim 编排框架，动态管理 SLA；把用于 PCA 的 Generalized Hebbian Algorithm (GHA) 适配到低功耗 MCU，采用带数据缓冲区的迭代学习策略，排序并显式保留极值样本以维持多样性。
Result: 在高维 Tour Perret 传感器数据上实验验证：新方法收敛且最终结果质量在视觉上等同于全内存处理整个数据集，可靠识别出两个不同运行状态；排序引入 O(W log W) 的时间复杂度。
Conclusion: 在内存受限的 MCU 上，用排序加极值保留的缓冲式 GHA-PCA 可以逼近全内存 PCA 的质量，使建筑内自治学习在算力与内存约束下可行。
Relevance: 2
