papers.title: Structure-Aware Numerical Stabilization for Half-Precision Proximal Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Local online training on resource-constrained platforms requires low computational and training-state overhead. We study the numerical stability and computational efficiency of half-precision proximal policy optimization (PPO) on commodity GPUs. Directly converting PPO training to FP16 is unreliable because numerical errors feed back through policy updates and subsequent data collection, while PPO repeatedly compares a current policy with a fixed behavior policy. We propose PPO-FP16 with three structure-aware modules. Global scalar protection stabilizes statistics shared across a minibatch or parameter update. Policy-change residual protection extracts and preserves small differences between the current and behavior policies. Efficient persistent-update protection stabilizes optimizer state and parameter writeback while reducing state storage. These changes preserve the PPO objective, hyperparameters, and training budget. Across six continuous-control tasks and five seeds, PPO-FP16 achieves the lowest mean return-AUC rank (1.90) among the four methods and ranks first in 17 of 30 environment-seed comparisons. Eight of nine performance configurations yield PPO update speedups ranging from 1.16 to 2.03 times. Relative to Full FP32 Adam, optimizer-state memory is reduced by 71.7 to 74.9 percent, and peak allocated GPU memory is reduced by up to 44.5 percent. The results show that protecting a small set of structurally important quantities can deliver stable, efficient FP16 PPO without retuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PPO-FP16 用三个结构感知模块把半精度 PPO 训练做稳：全局标量保护、策略-行为策略差值残差保护、以及持久化更新保护优化器状态与参数回写。在六个连续控制任务、五个种子上，其 mean return-AUC 平均排名 1.90 为四方法最低，30 组环境-种子比较中 17 次排第一，更新加速 1.16–2.03 倍，优化器状态显存省 71.7–74.9%，峰值 GPU 显存最多降 44.5%，且无需重调超参。
Motivation: 资源受限平台上的本地在线训练要求低计算与低训练态开销，但直接把 PPO 转成 FP16 不可靠：数值误差会经策略更新与后续数据收集回灌，而 PPO 又反复比较当前策略与固定行为策略。
Method: 提出 PPO-FP16，含三个结构感知模块：global scalar protection 稳定跨 minibatch/参数更新共享的统计量；policy-change residual protection 提取并保留当前策略与行为策略间的小差值；efficient persistent-update protection 稳定优化器状态与参数回写同时压缩状态存储。改动保持 PPO 目标、超参数与训练预算不变。
Result: 在六个连续控制任务、五个种子上，PPO-FP16 的 mean return-AUC 平均排名 1.90，为四个方法中最低，并在 30 个环境-种子比较中 17 次排第一；九个性能配置中八个给出 1.16 至 2.03 倍的 PPO 更新加速；相对 Full FP32 Adam，优化器状态显存减少 71.7% 至 74.9%，峰值分配 GPU 显存最多减少 44.5%。
Conclusion: 只需保护一小集结构上关键的量，就能在不重调超参数的前提下得到稳定且高效的 FP16 PPO。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MORAD: Reinforcement Learning with Multi-Objective Rewards for RNA Inverse Design
papers.abstract_en: We introduce MORAD, an online reinforcement learning framework for backbone-conditioned RNA diffusion models that trains a single shared policy across diverse target backbones. Structure-conditioned RNA inverse design seeks nucleotide sequences compatible with a target three-dimensional backbone, yet existing reinforcement learning approaches either optimize a separate policy for each target backbone or rely on offline preference optimization, leaving online post-training of a reusable backbone-conditioned model largely unexplored. MORAD combines backbone-conditioned group sampling, group-relative reward normalization, and a forward-process diffusion objective. Beyond existing RL rewards that primarily target tertiary structural quality, MORAD jointly optimizes six measurements spanning tertiary geometry, base pairing, ensemble behavior, and sequence composition. To aggregate these heterogeneous objectives despite differences in scale and optimization direction, MORAD maps each measurement to a bounded desirability score and combines them with a weighted geometric mean. Compared with a tertiary-structure-only reward, this multi-objective formulation improves 10 of the 11 evaluation metrics that have a preferred direction. Applied to pretrained RIDE, MORAD improves GDT-TS by 16.0% (from 0.3300 to 0.3827) and pairing MCC by 19.4% (from 0.6110 to 0.7295), while reducing normalized ensemble defect by 27.5% (from 0.3906 to 0.2830). On the test set, MORAD outperforms RiboDiffusion, gRNAde, and RDesign across tertiary structural accuracy, secondary-structure pairing, and thermodynamic quality, establishing a new state of the art in structure-conditioned RNA inverse design.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 5 figures. Jixin Tang and Ji Guo contributed equally. Project page: https://gabrile166.github.io/MORAD/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MORAD 是面向骨架条件 RNA 扩散模型的在线强化学习后训练框架，用单一共享策略覆盖不同目标骨架，把三级几何、碱基配对、系综行为、序列组成六项测量各自映射为有界 desirability 分数后以加权几何平均聚合。在预训练 RIDE 上，GDT-TS 从 0.3300 提到 0.3827（+16.0%），配对 MCC 从 0.6110 提到 0.7295（+19.4%），归一化系综缺陷从 0.3906 降到 0.2830（−27.5%）。
Motivation: 结构条件 RNA 逆向设计中，现有 RL 方案要么为每个目标骨架单独训练一个策略，要么依赖离线偏好优化，可复用骨架条件模型的在线后训练基本空白；且既有奖励只盯三级结构质量。
Method: MORAD 结合骨架条件组采样 (backbone-conditioned group sampling)、组相对奖励归一化 (group-relative reward normalization) 与前向过程扩散目标 (forward-process diffusion objective)，在单一共享策略上在线优化；六项测量先各自转成有界 desirability 分数，再用加权几何平均聚合，以处理量纲与优化方向不一致。
Result: 相对仅用三级结构奖励的方案，多目标形式在 11 项有偏好方向的评估指标中改善 10 项；在预训练 RIDE 上 GDT-TS 提升 16.0%（0.3300 → 0.3827），配对 MCC 提升 19.4%（0.6110 → 0.7295），归一化系综缺陷降低 27.5%（0.3906 → 0.2830）；测试集上在三级结构精度、二级结构配对与热力学质量三方面超过 RiboDiffusion、gRNAde 与 RDesign。
Conclusion: 多目标在线 RL 后训练能让一个骨架条件 RNA 扩散策略同时兼顾结构、配对与系综质量，并在结构条件 RNA 逆向设计上达到新的 state of the art。

papers.title: DAG Structure Learning with Node-Varying Heavy-Tailed Disturbances
papers.abstract_en: DAG structures can be learned from observations by incorporating acyclicity via smooth constraints, such as DAGMA's log-determinant function. Typically, observations and the underlying DAG are related through linear structural equation models, with Gaussianity assumption on the disturbances at each node. Extending DAG learning methods that account for scale and tail behavior of disturbances that vary across nodes remains a challenge. We propose a node-varying Student-$t$ DAGMA that jointly estimates the graph structure, node-specific disturbance scales, and the degrees-of-freedom parameter. A Gaussian scale-mixture representation yields an iteratively reweighted formulation that down-weights large standardized residuals. Building on existing results, we also establish identifiability of the graph and disturbance parameters. Synthetic experiments demonstrate improved structural recovery under heterogeneous heavy-tailed disturbances, and experiments on real finance data show that the proposed method yields lower test negative log-likelihood than the evaluated baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 node-varying Student-t DAGMA：在 DAGMA 的 log-determinant 无环约束下，联合估计图结构、逐节点扰动尺度和自由度参数，用 Gaussian scale-mixture 得到迭代重加权形式，压低标准化残差大的样本权重。合成实验显示在异质重尾扰动下结构恢复更优，真实金融数据上测试负对数似然低于所评估基线。
Motivation: 现有 DAG 结构学习多假设各节点扰动同方差且服从高斯，难以处理尺度与尾部行为随节点变化的情形；扩展这类方法仍是挑战。
Method: 把 DAGMA 的平滑无环约束与逐节点 Student-t 扰动结合，联合估计图结构、节点特异尺度与自由度；由 Gaussian scale-mixture 表示导出迭代重加权算法，并在已有结果基础上建立图与扰动参数的可辨识性。
Result: 合成实验中，在异质重尾扰动下结构恢复优于对比方法；真实金融数据上，测试负对数似然低于所评估基线。
Conclusion: 把节点间异质的重尾扰动显式建模进无环约束框架，可在重尾设定下改善 DAG 结构恢复并提升金融数据上的似然。

papers.title: Agreement Without Alignment: Label-Free Rubric Clarification Increases LLM-Judge Consensus but Not Agreement with Humans
papers.abstract_en: LLM judges are increasingly deployed as panels, and disagreement among panel members is often read as a symptom of an unclear rubric. We test a label-free procedure that turns this disagreement into rubric repairs. The procedure decomposes each rubric into sub-criteria, ranks them by cross-judge disagreement on a development split, and has an editor model rewrite only the most contested ones. An additional stage that moves text-checkable sub-criteria to deterministic checkers transferred none in our evaluation. Human labels are never used to select or edit clauses; they are used only to evaluate the outcome. We pre-specified four hypotheses in a version-controlled protocol and evaluated six rubric conditions with a panel of five judges from three providers on SummEval, the HealthBench meta-evaluation, and USR Topical-Chat, for a total of 129,770 judge requests, excluding retries. On SummEval, the procedure raised inter-judge Krippendorff's $α$ by 0.069 (95% CI 0.046 to 0.092) over the original rubric and by 0.074 over a control that applied the same edits to an equal number of randomly chosen clauses that were not selected. Agreement with expert ratings showed no detectable change (Kendall $τ$ difference -0.007, 95% CI -0.037 to 0.021). On HealthBench and USR, neither inter-judge agreement nor human agreement met the preregistered effect criteria. In a preregistered secondary comparison, human agreement after editing the contested clauses was lower than after editing the control clauses on all three datasets in point estimate, although no interval excluded zero. Selecting clauses by disagreement makes judges agree with each other more than editing arbitrary clauses does, but in our setting the added consensus did not bring the judges closer to human annotators. We will release code, frozen rubrics, item identifiers, and judge scores.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种无标签的 rubric 修订流程：把评分细则拆成子标准，按跨 judge 分歧排序，只让编辑模型重写分歧最大的条款，从而提升 LLM 评审团内部一致性。在 SummEval 上把 judge 间 Krippendorff's α 提高 0.069（95% CI 0.046–0.092），但与专家评分的一致性无可检测变化（Kendall τ 差 -0.007，95% CI -0.037–0.021）。
Motivation: LLM 评审团的分歧常被当作 rubric 不清晰的症状，但尚不清楚按分歧修订 rubric 能否在不使用人工标签的前提下同时提升 judge 间共识与对人类标注的对齐。
Method: 将 rubric 分解为子标准，在开发集上按跨 judge 分歧排序，仅由编辑模型重写争议最大的条款；另有一阶段把可文本核验的子标准迁移到确定性 checker。人工标签不参与条款选择或编辑，仅用于评估。预注册四个假设与版本受控协议，评测六种 rubric 条件，评审团为来自三家供应商的五个 judge。
Result: 在 SummEval 上，该流程使 judge 间 Krippendorff's α 相对原始 rubric 提高 0.069（95% CI 0.046–0.092），相对随机选条款做同样编辑的对照提高 0.074；与专家评分的一致性无可检测变化（Kendall τ 差 -0.007，95% CI -0.037–0.021）。在 HealthBench 与 USR Topical-Chat 上，judge 间一致性与人类一致性均未达到预注册效应标准。预注册次要比较中，三个数据集上编辑争议条款后的人类一致性点估计均低于编辑对照条款，但无区间排除零。共发出 129,770 次 judge 请求（不含重试）。
Conclusion: 按分歧选择条款确实比随机编辑更能提升 judge 间共识，但在该设置下这种共识并未使 judge 更接近人类标注者；把可核验条款迁移到确定性 checker 在本次评测中零迁移。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: PAGE: Parts-Aware Guidance for Co-Speech Gesture Portrait Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Co-speech gesture video generation aims to synthesize realistic, audio-driven portrait videos from a single reference image and a speech signal. Despite advances in visual quality, diffusion-based approaches still suffer from degraded local details and imperfect audio-visual alignment. We present PAGE (Parts-Aware GuidancE), a general, backbone-agnostic optimization framework for diffusion-based generation that enhances local spatial fidelity and global audio-visual consistency at both the training-objective and denoising-trajectory levels. During training, we propose Parts-Specific Reweighting (PSR), which adaptively increases supervision in semantically important regions such as lips, eyes, and hands, improving visual fidelity in perceptually critical areas. During inference, we introduce Consistency Classifier Guidance (CCG), an audio-conditioned latent classifier that identifies and corrects audio-visual inconsistencies in the generated video. We further design Differential Guidance (DG), an efficient inference strategy that refines facial and body motion separately while avoiding cross-region interference. To enable large-scale evaluation, we construct the Chinese Announcer Speech (CAS) dataset, the first comprehensive Chinese benchmark for co-speech gesture portrait video generation. Compared with the widely used PATS dataset, CAS includes substantially more identities, video clips, and scene diversity. Extensive experiments on both PATS and CAS demonstrate that PAGE achieves state-of-the-art performance in perceptual quality, gesture diversity, and audio-visual alignment. Project page: https://aigc-explorer.github.io/PAGE/.
papers.comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology (TCSVT) 2026. Project page: https://aigc-explorer.github.io/PAGE/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PAGE 是面向语音驱动人像视频生成的通用、backbone-agnostic 优化框架，在训练端用 Parts-Specific Reweighting (PSR) 对嘴唇、眼睛、手等语义关键区域加权监督，在推理端用音频条件的 Consistency Classifier Guidance (CCG) 纠正音画不一致，并以 Differential Guidance (DG) 分别精修面部与身体运动以避免跨区干扰。在 PATS 与新构建的中文 Announcer Speech (CAS) 数据集上，PAGE 在感知质量、手势多样性与音画对齐上达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 扩散式语音驱动人像视频生成虽已提升画质，但局部细节退化、音画对齐不完美仍然存在，且缺少面向中文的综合评测基准。
Method: 训练阶段提出 PSR，对嘴唇、眼睛、手部等感知关键区域自适应提高监督权重；推理阶段提出 CCG，一个音频条件的 latent 分类器用于识别并纠正生成视频中的音画不一致，再配合 DG 分别精修面部与身体运动。框架 backbone-agnostic，同时作用于训练目标与去噪轨迹两个层面。
Result: 构建了首个中文语音驱动人像手势视频生成综合基准 Chinese Announcer Speech (CAS)，相比广泛使用的 PATS 数据集包含更多身份、视频片段与场景多样性；在 PATS 与 CAS 上的大量实验表明 PAGE 在感知质量、手势多样性与音画对齐上达到 state-of-the-art。
Conclusion: 在训练目标与去噪轨迹两个层面同时做区域感知的监督加权与音频条件一致性引导，可以同时改善语音驱动人像视频的局部保真度与全局音画一致性。

papers.title: Sonic-AMG: Streaming Human Motion Generation from Spatial Audio
papers.abstract_en: Modeling human reactions to spatial audio requires understanding both what is heard and where it comes from. Prior work generates motion offline from complete acoustic and spatial input sequences. Humans, however, react to sounds without knowing what they will hear next. We present Sonic-AMG, to our knowledge the first framework for streaming human motion generation from spatial audio. The model encodes acoustic content and body-relative source geometry as separate tokens. Conditioned on these tokens, a causal transformer with a flow head generates continuous motion latents, from which a causal decoder reconstructs motion segments. Standard teacher-forced training derives motion histories and body-relative source locations from ground-truth motion, whereas streaming inference relies on generated motion for both, resulting in a training-inference mismatch. To reduce this history discrepancy, we introduce rehearsal training, which combines full-sequence teacher-forced supervision with supervised prediction along short autoregressive self-rollouts. To keep spatial conditioning consistent with generated motion, we propose spatial feedback, which recomputes body-relative source locations from generated root poses during both rehearsal training and inference. On SAM, Sonic-AMG achieves state-of-the-art FID and R-precision. It further supports real-time online generation of coherent reactions across sound events and source locations. Project page: https://jingchengni.com/sonic-amg/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Sonic-AMG 是首个从空间音频流式生成人体动作的框架：把声学内容与身体相对源几何编码为独立 token，用因果 transformer 加 flow head 生成连续动作 latent，再由因果解码器重建动作片段。针对训练用真值历史、推理用生成历史的不匹配，提出 rehearsal training（全序列 teacher-forced 监督叠加短自回滚的有监督预测）与 spatial feedback（用生成的 root pose 重算身体相对源位置）。在 SAM 数据集上取得 SOTA 的 FID 与 R-precision，并支持跨声音事件与源位置的实时在线反应生成。
Motivation: 既往工作从完整的声学与空间输入序列离线生成动作，而人是在不知道接下来会听到什么的情况下对声音做出反应，离线设定与流式反应的真实条件不符。
Method: 将声学内容与身体相对源几何 (body-relative source geometry) 编码为分离 token，条件化的 causal transformer 配 flow head 生成连续动作 latent，causal decoder 重建动作片段；训练上以 rehearsal training 结合全序列 teacher-forced 监督与沿短 autoregressive self-rollout 的有监督预测，并用 spatial feedback 在训练与推理中都从生成的 root pose 重算身体相对源位置以保持空间条件一致。
Result: 在 SAM 数据集上取得 state-of-the-art 的 FID 与 R-precision，并支持实时在线生成跨声音事件与源位置的连贯反应。
Conclusion: 流式空间音频到人体动作的生成可行，关键是用 rehearsal training 缩小训练-推理历史差异、用 spatial feedback 让空间条件跟随生成的 root pose 而非真值。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Decoding Register Tokens Preserves Global Scene Details
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained vision transformers learn structured image representations spanning spatial patch tokens and non-spatial tokens. Recent analyses suggest that non-spatial register tokens encode global scene properties such as illumination, blur, and style. Yet patch-based image decoders discard these outputs, leaving the decoder to recover image appearance from patches alone. We investigate whether retaining register features improves decoding when the complete spatial patch representation is already available. We study this question using representation autoencoders (RAEs) with frozen register-equipped encoders. Our decoder processes four register tokens together with all patch tokens through joint self-attention. Appearance probes, paired reconstruction-error analysis, and fixed-decoder register substitutions examine which global image properties are accessible from registers and how their values affect reconstructed pixels. For generation, we train a multi-head attention pooling (MHAP) predictor to recover register features from sampled patches, keeping the pretrained diffusion model and its samples unchanged. On ImageNet-1K, our ViT-B decoders achieve mean reconstruction FIDs of 0.472 with DINOv2 and 0.442 with DINOv3, reductions of 9.5% and 5.2% relative to their respective patch-only baselines. The corresponding PSNRs are 19.73 and 20.54 dB. For generation, our DINOv2 models achieve a mean FID of 1.641, 9.8% below the patch-only baseline on identical sampled patches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在冻结的 register-equipped ViT 编码器上做 representation autoencoder (RAE)，解码器把 4 个 register token 与全部 patch token 一起送入 joint self-attention，从而在补丁表征已完整时仍利用 register 携带的全局场景信息。ImageNet-1K 上 ViT-B 解码器的平均重建 FID 为 0.472（DINOv2）与 0.442（DINOv3），较各自 patch-only 基线分别降 9.5% 与 5.2%，PSNR 为 19.73 与 20.54 dB；生成侧用 MHAP 从采样 patch 预测 register 特征，DINOv2 平均 FID 1.641，比 patch-only 基线低 9.8%。
Motivation: 近期分析表明非空间 register token 编码光照、模糊、风格等全局场景属性，但基于 patch 的图像解码器丢弃这些输出，只能从 patch 恢复图像外观。
Method: 用冻结的 register-equipped 编码器构建 RAE，解码器通过 joint self-attention 同时处理 4 个 register token 与全部 patch token；用 appearance probes、配对重建误差分析与固定解码器的 register 替换实验定位全局属性及其对像素的影响。生成任务上训练 multi-head attention pooling (MHAP) 预测器从采样 patch 恢复 register 特征，预训练扩散模型与其采样保持不变。
Result: ImageNet-1K 上 ViT-B 解码器平均重建 FID：DINOv2 为 0.472（较 patch-only 基线降 9.5%），DINOv3 为 0.442（降 5.2%），对应 PSNR 分别为 19.73 dB 与 20.54 dB。生成任务中 DINOv2 模型在相同采样 patch 上平均 FID 为 1.641，比 patch-only 基线低 9.8%。
Conclusion: 保留 register 特征做解码能改善重建与生成质量，且在 patch 表征已完整可用时仍带来增益；生成侧无需改动预训练扩散模型，只需从采样 patch 恢复 register 特征。

papers.title: Multi-Source and Multi-Dimensional Information Fusion in Resource-Constrained Edge Networks
papers.abstract_en: Multi-source semantic information fusion enables edge networks to support global inference using observations collected by distributed terminals. However, limited communication and computation resources restrict semantic uploading, leaving the edge server with incomplete tokens that differ in modality, semantic granularity, arrival time, and channel condition. The value of these tokens also depends on the complementary or redundant information provided by other terminals. In this paper, we propose a multi-source and multi-dimensional semantic information fusion framework that coordinates terminal uploading and edge-side fusion under resource constraints. We develop Hyper-Slot to combine semantic content with available token attributes through iterative token-to-slot assignment and slot-to-token feedback, producing a compact representation for global inference. To encourage useful semantic uploading, we further design a contribution-based incentive mechanism that uses Hyper-Slot assignments to evaluate information coverage and cross-type complementarity. A bi-level Stackelberg-Nash game determines the server reward pool and terminal transmission-quality strategies while accounting for computation and communication energy costs. Experiments on a tri-modal extension of COCO2014 and image-text retrieval on Flickr30K show that Hyper-Slot improves mAP by 3.66 percentage points and RSum by 15.9 points over the strongest evaluated baselines, respectively, while reducing the number of parameters by more than 80% compared with a naive concatenation-based fusion baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在通信与算力受限的边缘网络中，提出语义融合框架 Hyper-Slot：通过 token-to-slot 迭代分配与 slot-to-token 反馈，把模态、粒度、到达时间与信道条件各异的不完整 token 压成紧凑全局表征，并用基于贡献的激励机制（双层 Stackelberg-Nash 博弈）决定奖励池与终端传输质量策略。在 COCO2014 三模态扩展上 mAP 比最强基线高 3.66 个百分点，Flickr30K 图文检索 RSum 高 15.9 分，参数量比朴素拼接融合少 80% 以上。
Motivation: 分布式终端的语义上传受通信与算力预算限制，边缘服务器只能拿到不完整且异构的 token，其价值还取决于其他终端提供的互补或冗余信息，缺少协调上传与融合的机制。
Method: 提出多源多维语义信息融合框架：Hyper-Slot 用迭代 token-to-slot 分配与 slot-to-token 反馈，将语义内容与 token 属性（模态、粒度、到达时间、信道状况）结合成紧凑表征；再设计基于贡献的激励机制，用 Hyper-Slot 分配评估信息覆盖与跨类型互补性，以双层 Stackelberg-Nash 博弈确定服务器奖励池与终端传输质量策略，并计入计算与通信能耗成本。
Result: 在 COCO2014 三模态扩展上 Hyper-Slot 的 mAP 比最强评估基线提高 3.66 个百分点；在 Flickr30K 图文检索上 RSum 提高 15.9 分；相比朴素拼接 (naive concatenation) 融合基线参数量减少 80% 以上。
Conclusion: 在资源受限边缘网络中，把 token 属性与语义内容一起做 slot 级分配、并用贡献度激励终端上传，可以在大幅压缩参数的同时提升多源全局推理与图文检索效果。

papers.title: PRIME: Pre-Retrieval Index Modeling Enhancement for Structured Document Retrieval-Real
papers.abstract_en: High-precision retrieval over external knowledge bases is essential for LLM agents to operate effectively. However, existing Information Retrieval (IR) research primarily optimizes query-side retrievers (e.g., ColBERT, BGE) and generators (e.g., Self-RAG, GraphRAG), while reducing corpus-side representation to chunking. This leaves index-side quality an underexplored lever. We propose Pre-Retrieval Index Modeling & Enhancement (PRIME), an index-side optimization framework built on two complementary tracks: an LLM-driven Semantic Restructuring (SR) track that transforms long documents into structured, information-dense sections, and a deterministic Metadata Synthesis (MS) and Hierarchical Retrieval (HR) track that extracts semantic anchors and heading structure for coarse-to-fine section retrieval. Our evaluations show that deterministic metadata matches structure-aware chunking's retrieval quality while cutting embedding computation by 45.8 $\times$ and index vector count by 22.4 $\times$. On top of these gains, Semantic Restructuring (SR) further improves Answer-F1 by 13.7% in full deployment, with characterized quality-fidelity-cost trade-offs. Across QASPER, BRIGHT, and NFCorpus, we further characterize three qualitative regimes that determine whether index-side optimization helps or degrades retrieval, while showing that these index-side effects are neutralized under a strong reranker.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 2 figures. Manuscript completed July 2026. Supplementary material will be added in a future version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PRIME 是面向外部知识库检索的索引侧优化框架，用 LLM 语义重构 (SR) 把长文档改写成信息密集的结构化小节，配合确定性元数据合成 (MS) 与层级检索 (HR) 做由粗到细的小节检索。确定性元数据达到与结构感知分块相当的检索质量，同时嵌入计算量降 45.8×、索引向量数降 22.4×；在此之上 SR 在完整部署中把 Answer-F1 再提高 13.7%。
Motivation: 现有 IR 研究主要优化查询侧检索器 (ColBERT、BGE) 与生成器 (Self-RAG、GraphRAG)，语料侧表示被简化为分块，索引侧质量是未被充分挖掘的杠杆。
Method: 两条互补轨道：LLM 驱动的 Semantic Restructuring 把长文档转成结构化、信息密集的小节；确定性的 Metadata Synthesis 与 Hierarchical Retrieval 抽取语义锚点与标题结构，支持由粗到细的小节检索。在 QASPER、BRIGHT、NFCorpus 上评测。
Result: 确定性元数据匹配结构感知分块的检索质量，嵌入计算量减少 45.8×，索引向量数减少 22.4×；SR 在完整部署中使 Answer-F1 提升 13.7%，并给出质量-保真-成本权衡。三个数据集上刻画出决定索引侧优化是增益还是劣化的三种定性 regime，且这些索引侧效应在强重排器 (reranker) 下被中和。
Conclusion: 索引侧优化在特定 regime 下能同时大幅降本并提升 Answer-F1，但其收益取决于数据集 regime，且强 reranker 会抹平这些效应。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Recovering Irreducible Three-Body Interactions with Lagrangian Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Lagrangian Neural Networks (LNNs) learn mechanical systems from trajectory data by parameterizing a scalar Lagrangian and deriving the dynamics through the Euler-Lagrange equations, biasing the model toward motion that respects the variational structure of mechanics. The interactions studied so far have been pairwise-additive, leaving open whether LNNs can recover an irreducible many-body interaction from motion alone. We address this using the Axilrod-Teller triple-dipole interaction, the leading three-body dispersion term, whose dependence on the collective geometry of three particles cannot be represented by any sum of pairwise terms. We prescribe the kinetic energy exactly and learn only the potential, as a function of interparticle distances and angles. Combined with a signal-aware sampling strategy that concentrates training data where the three-body signal is strongest while preserving broad coverage of configuration space, this recovers the interaction from accelerations alone. The learned potential reproduces the radial scaling, angular dependence, and characteristic sign reversal of the Axilrod-Teller interaction, and generates stable trajectories. Embedding it within a pairwise Lennard-Jones potential lets us examine its observability: the three-body term is recovered once its dynamical signature exceeds the residual modeling error, which it does cleanly at amplified coupling but not at the coupling of a real noble gas, bracketing the transition between the two. Finally, symbolic regression on the trained potential, with no assumed functional form, returns the Axilrod-Teller expression with angular numerator, radial law, and coupling constant intact. An LNN with domain-specific structure can thus recover an irreducible three-body interaction from trajectories as a closed-form law, pointing toward learning interaction laws whose structure is not known a priori.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Lagrangian Neural Networks 从轨迹加速度中恢复不可约三体相互作用：精确给定动能、只学势能函数，并用信号感知采样把训练数据集中在三体信号最强的构型区。在 Axilrod-Teller 三偶极色散项上，学到的势复现其径向标度、角度依赖与特征性符号反转，符号回归在无预设函数形式下原样返回 Axilrod-Teller 表达式；但三体项只有在其动力学特征超过残差建模误差时才可观测——放大耦合下干净恢复，真实稀有气体耦合下则不能。
Motivation: 现有 LNN 只处理成对可加的相互作用，尚不清楚它能否仅凭运动数据恢复任何成对项之和都无法表示的不可约多体相互作用。
Method: 以 Axilrod-Teller 三偶极相互作用为目标，精确给定动能、只把势能参数化为粒子间距与角度的函数，通过 Euler-Lagrange 方程导出动力学；配合信号感知采样 (signal-aware sampling) 在三体信号最强处集中训练数据同时保持构型空间广覆盖，仅从加速度恢复相互作用；再把三体项嵌入成对 Lennard-Jones 势考察可观测性，并对训练所得势做无预设形式的符号回归。
Result: 学到的势复现 Axilrod-Teller 相互作用的径向标度、角度依赖与特征性符号反转，并生成稳定轨迹；三体项在放大耦合下当其动力学特征超过残差建模误差时被干净恢复，在真实稀有气体耦合下则不能，两者之间的转变被夹定出来；符号回归返回含角度分子、径向律与耦合常数的完整 Axilrod-Teller 表达式。
Conclusion: 带领域结构的 LNN 能把不可约三体相互作用从轨迹中恢复为闭式定律，指向学习先验未知结构的相互作用定律这一方向；可观测性受耦合强度与残差建模误差之比限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Do Prompt Optimizers Break Requirements They Are Not Scored On? A Preregistered Study
papers.abstract_en: Prompt optimizers rewrite a prompt to raise one target metric, but prompts also state requirements the metric does not score, such as an output format, citations, or abstention. In a preregistered study, we run GEPA, MIPROv2, and TextGrad on HotpotQA, SQuAD 2.0, and IFEval and count per-item violations of unscored requirements with deterministic checks. By the preregistered criterion, all three optimizers produce regressions, substantially on HotpotQA, where net regression in citation validity reaches 10.7 to 41.6 points while exact match rises by 21 to 34 points. A post-hoc decomposition changes this reading. The optimized prompts elicit reasoning before the required JSON object, and under the 200-token output cap used throughout, 13.9% to 47.0% of responses end before any answer appears. Among parseable outputs, net regression is within 3 points of zero. With a 1,024-token cap, extraction failures disappear, content regression stays below 1 point, and exact match rises further. Two simple gates fail the preregistered criterion. The side effect is narrower than hypothesized: optimized prompts are more accurate and break an explicit output contract, and a lenient target metric does not show the cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 预注册研究检验 prompt 优化器 (GEPA、MIPROv2、TextGrad) 在只优化单一指标时是否破坏未被评分的显式要求：在 HotpotQA 上引用有效性净回退达 10.7 至 41.6 点，同时 exact match 上升 21 至 34 点。事后分解显示回退主要来自优化后提示先输出推理再给 JSON，在 200 token 输出上限下 13.9% 至 47.0% 的回答在给出答案前就被截断；把上限放宽到 1024 token 后抽取失败消失、内容回退降到 1 点以下且 exact match 进一步上升。
Motivation: prompt 优化器只针对一个目标指标改写提示，但提示还写有指标不评分的约束（输出格式、引用、拒答），这些约束被破坏的代价无法从目标指标读出。
Method: 预注册设计下运行 GEPA、MIPROv2、TextGrad 三个优化器，数据集为 HotpotQA、SQuAD 2.0、IFEval，用确定性检查逐条统计未被评分要求的违反次数，并按预注册判据判定回退；随后做事后分解，区分内容回退与输出截断导致的抽取失败，并比较 200 与 1024 token 两种输出上限。
Result: 按预注册判据三个优化器都产生回退，HotpotQA 上引用有效性净回退 10.7 至 41.6 点，同时 exact match 上升 21 至 34 点；200 token 上限下 13.9% 至 47.0% 的回答在任何答案出现前结束，可解析输出中的净回退在零的 3 点以内；1024 token 上限时抽取失败消失、内容回退低于 1 点、exact match 进一步提高。两个简单门控 (gate) 均未通过预注册判据。
Conclusion: 副作用比假设的更窄：优化后的提示确实更准确，破坏的是显式输出契约而非内容本身，而宽松的目标指标不会暴露这一代价。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: BoundaryEvo: Data-Model Co-Evolution at the Capability Boundary for Long-Chain Reasoning Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Distilling long-chain reasoning trajectories from large teacher models provides an effective way to improve the reasoning ability of small language models. However, existing methods typically select a fixed training set before distillation, overlooking that the usefulness of a reasoning example changes as the student evolves. This mismatch becomes especially costly when only a small number of teacher trajectories can be used for training. Besides, examples already mastered provide little new supervision, while examples far beyond the capability of student may be difficult to learn from. Training data should therefore adapt as model capability evolves, yet reliable data selection is difficult when the student is initially weak. To address these challenges, our key idea is to first establish the basic reasoning capability and then adapt the training data to the evolving capability boundary of the student. We propose BoundaryEvo, a two-stage data--model co-evolution framework. In Capability Priming, we directly distill a small set of teacher-generated long reasoning trajectories without using a separate model to judge and filter them, allowing the student to acquire an initial reasoning capability before capability-aware data selection. In Capability-Boundary Co-Evolution, we repeatedly select questions that the current student has not mastered but the expert can reliably solve, and update the training data as the student evolves. With only 1,000 training examples, BoundaryEvo consistently outperforms static and dynamic data selection baselines across 11 reasoning benchmarks, raising the original Qwen3.5-4B accuracy from 62.9 to 75.3 on IMO-AnswerBench and from 26.8 to 46.0 on AMO-Bench. The code and data will be made publicly available.

papers.title: QCLR: A Plug-in Robustification Module via Quantization for Contrastive Learning in Self-Supervised Skeleton-Based Human Action Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Skeleton-based human action recognition has gained increasing attention due to the stability of skeleton data across diverse environments and advances in motion capture technologies. Following the success of supervised learning approaches, self-supervised learning approaches, particularly contrastive learning ones, have achieved impressive performance. However, they remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks. In this work, we propose a plug-in robustification module via quantization for contrastive learning in self-supervised skeleton-based human action recognition (QCLR), which enhances the robustness of representations against adversarial attacks while preserving their representational capability. Specifically, we employ a dual-level quantization scheme across the encoding pipeline, which breaks the gradient propagation and absorbs small adversarial perturbations within the quantization bins. To mitigate the impact of inevitable quantization error, we further design an attention-guided multi-faceted quantization strategy to maintain the representation quality. Experiments on several benchmark datasets demonstrate that integrating QCLR into a progressive lineage of mainstream contrastive learning models substantially improves robustness against both gradient-based white-box and gradient-free black-box adversarial attacks, while preserving highly competitive classification accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QCLR 是一个可插拔的量化模块，插进自监督骨架动作识别的对比学习管线后，用双层量化打断梯度传播并把小幅对抗扰动吸收进量化区间，从而提升对抗鲁棒性。在多个基准数据集上，接入 QCLR 的主流对比学习模型对白盒梯度攻击与无梯度黑盒攻击的鲁棒性均显著提升，同时分类精度保持竞争力。
Motivation: 骨架数据虽跨环境稳定，自监督对比学习方法在动作识别上表现好，但对对抗攻击仍然脆弱，需要在不牺牲表征能力的前提下增强鲁棒性。
Method: 提出 QCLR：在编码管线中部署双层量化 (dual-level quantization) 以切断梯度传播并吸收小扰动；再用注意力引导的多面量化策略 (attention-guided multi-faceted quantization) 补偿量化误差，作为即插即用模块接入一系列渐进的主流对比学习模型。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上，接入 QCLR 后的模型对基于梯度的白盒攻击与无梯度黑盒攻击的鲁棒性均大幅提升，同时分类精度保持高度竞争力；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 量化可以作为对比学习的即插即用鲁棒化手段：既阻断对抗扰动的梯度通路，又能靠注意力引导的多面量化把表征质量损失控制在可接受范围。

papers.title: MHR-Router: Multimodal Heterogeneous Retrieval-Enhanced Adaptive Routing for VLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit complementary capabilities, yet selecting the most suitable expert for a given image-question query remains challenging due to heterogeneous multimodal inputs and varying expert strengths. Existing routing approaches rely on text-based cues or static model profiles, failing to capture fine-grained visual evidence and expert-specific failure patterns. To address this, we propose MHR-Router, a multimodal heterogeneous retrieval-enhanced adaptive routing framework for VLM inference. It accurately dispatches each multimodal query to the most suitable VLM expert via local retrieval evidence. MHR-Router consists of two stages: (1) Multimodal Routing Representation, which fuses frozen multimodal features into a comprehensive query representation; and (2) Heterogeneous Retrieval-Enhanced Adaptive Routing, which retrieves expert-specific success and failure memories as local evidence and employs a shared scorer to adaptively select the optimal expert. Experiments show that MHR-Router effectively achieves heterogeneous modality routing and consistently improves accuracy over traditional baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MHR-Router 为 VLM 推理提出两阶段路由：先融合冻结的多模态特征得到统一查询表示，再检索各专家的成功/失败记忆作为局部证据，用共享 scorer 自适应选出最合适的 VLM 专家。实验显示其能实现异构模态路由，并在传统基线上一致提升准确率。
Motivation: 多模态查询异构、各 VLM 专家强项不同，现有路由只依赖文本线索或静态模型画像，抓不住细粒度视觉证据与专家特有的失败模式。
Method: 两阶段框架：Multimodal Routing Representation 将冻结的多模态特征融合为综合查询表示；Heterogeneous Retrieval-Enhanced Adaptive Routing 检索专家级成功与失败记忆作为局部证据，由共享 scorer 自适应选择最优专家。
Result: 实验表明 MHR-Router 实现了异构模态路由，并相对传统基线一致提升准确率。
Conclusion: 以检索到的专家成败记忆作为局部证据做自适应路由，可在 VLM 推理中稳定优于依赖文本线索或静态画像的传统路由。

papers.title: CopRoute: Dependence-Aware Conformal Routing for Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Set-based language model routing aims to increase the coverage of the event where at least one model answers a query correctly while controlling the number of inference calls made. Existing risk-controlled routing policies bound the all-miss risk (the probability that every model in the selected set fails) by calibrating a single conformal threshold and applying it to a nested family of model sets. Because each model is scored in isolation, these policies ignore the dependence structure of model failures. Models that share training data or architecture tend to fail on the same queries, so two individually strong models can be jointly redundant while a weaker but complementary model covers the queries that the others miss. To account for this dependence, which existing risk-controlled policies ignore, we propose CopRoute, which orders models by how many new queries each one answers correctly beyond those already selected, decides per query how far down that order to go, and then picks the smallest cutoff that still meets the target risk. We show that CopRoute's ordering attains, on the design data, the best guarantee any efficient fixed-ordering algorithm can give for the average number of calls to the first correct model, and that a separate calibration step certifies the all-miss risk of the deployed sets. On RouterBench and RouterEval, CopRoute attains the fewest certified calls on nine of ten datasets at a target risk of 0.05 and on eight of ten at 0.10, making up to 79 percent fewer calls (median 24 percent) than the state-of-the-art risk-controlled policy at the same certified all-miss risk.
papers.comment: 41 pages, 6 figures, 20 tables, accepted for poster presentation at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on On-Device Intelligence: Foundation Models under Real-World Constraints (ODI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CopRoute 针对多模型路由中「按单模型独立打分」忽略失败相关性的问题，按每个模型在已选集合之外新增答对的查询数排序，逐查询决定沿该排序下探多远，再取仍满足目标风险的最小截断。在 RouterBench 与 RouterEval 的十个数据集上，目标 all-miss 风险 0.05 时九个数据集、0.10 时八个数据集取得最少的认证调用数，最多比 SOTA 风险受控策略少 79% 调用（中位数 24%）。
Motivation: 现有风险受控路由用单一 conformal 阈值作用于嵌套模型集，逐个模型独立打分，忽略共享训练数据或架构导致的失败相关性：两个单独很强的模型可能联合冗余，而较弱但互补的模型反而覆盖它们漏掉的查询。
Method: CopRoute 按「新增答对查询数」对模型排序，逐查询决定沿排序下探的深度，再取仍满足目标风险的最小 cutoff；排序在设计数据上取得高效固定排序算法对「首个正确模型的平均调用数」的最优保证，另有一个独立校准步骤认证部署集合的 all-miss 风险。
Result: 在 RouterBench 与 RouterEval 上，目标风险 0.05 时十数据集中的九个、0.10 时十个中的八个取得最少认证调用数；在相同认证 all-miss 风险下，比 SOTA 风险受控策略最多减少 79% 调用，中位数减少 24%。
Conclusion: 把模型间失败相关性显式纳入排序与截断选择，可以在同一 all-miss 风险保证下显著压低达到首个正确答案的推理调用数。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Agent4Spec: An LLM-based Agentic System to Optimize API Specifications through Automated Validation and Market Analysis
papers.abstract_en: API specifications serve as critical documentation for modern software development, directly impacting integration efficiency and client code generation. While recent advancements have leveraged Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate initial specifications from source code, existing approaches treat this process as a one-time event - overlooking the needs for continuous validation, long-term maintenance, and market-driven evolution of these artifacts. To address this issue, we present Agent4Spec, an autonomous multi-agent framework featuring two distinct pipelines: (1) a validation pipeline that detects and self-corrects OpenAPI syntax errors, and (2) a market analysis pipeline that conducts competitive research, identifies functional gaps against industry leaders, and automatically generates missing API-spec functionalities. We evaluate Agent4Spec on two curated datasets of API specifications spanning both general-purpose and industrial scenarios. Among 9 SOTA LLMs, the top-performer achieves 100% syntax error detection rates and over 95% implementation success for proposed corrections, while securing over 50% adoption rates for suggested endpoint improvements, representing a practical tool for API development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Agent4Spec 是面向 API 规范 (OpenAPI) 的多智能体系统，用验证流水线检测并自纠正语法错误，用市场分析流水线对标行业领先者、找出功能缺口并自动生成缺失的 API 功能。在两个 API 规范数据集上评测 9 个 SOTA LLM，最优者语法错误检测率 100%、所提纠正的实现成功率超 95%、建议的 endpoint 改进采纳率超 50%。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 生成 API 规范的做法把生成当作一次性事件，缺少持续验证、长期维护与市场驱动的演进，导致规范随代码和竞争格局变化而失效。
Method: 自主多智能体框架含两条流水线：验证流水线检测并自纠正 OpenAPI 语法错误；市场分析流水线做竞品调研、对标行业领先者识别功能缺口，并自动生成缺失的 API 规范功能。评测覆盖通用与工业两类场景的两个 API 规范数据集，比较 9 个 SOTA LLM。
Result: 在 9 个 SOTA LLM 中，最优模型语法错误检测率达 100%，所提纠正方案的实现成功率超过 95%，建议的 endpoint 改进采纳率超过 50%；评测基于两个覆盖通用与工业场景的 API 规范数据集。
Conclusion: 把 API 规范生成从一次性事件转为持续验证加市场驱动演进的多智能体流程是可行的，最优 LLM 已能支撑接近实用的检测、纠正与改进采纳。

papers.title: OWLET: On-Policy Weighted Learning via Evidence Transfer for Video Large Language Model Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Post-training has become a key stage for eliciting reasoning capabilities in Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs). Existing post-training methods mainly follow two paradigms: reinforcement learning (RL) and on-policy distillation (OPD). However, they do not fully exploit visual evidence for effective training. RL supervises the policy with a single trajectory-level reward, which is too coarse-grained for video reasoning: the same response-level advantage is applied to every generated token, disregarding that the tokens of a video response are grounded in the visual stream to very different degrees. OPD provides token-level supervision through output-distribution matching, but lacks direct supervision of the spatiotemporal representations that produce those outputs. We observe across extensive experiments that the same model reasons more accurately when its video view combines global temporal context with question-relevant details. Comparing the same student-generated response under this view and uniform sampling reveals changes in token likelihoods and internal representations, providing a training signal for evidence use. Building on this observation, we propose OWLET, an evidence-privileged RL method that derives training signals from a richer teacher view. This view couples uniform global context with question-conditioned local windows, providing visual evidence without requiring a larger model. To better exploit this privileged visual evidence, OWLET introduces (i) \textbf{evidence-aware credit redistribution}, which compares token likelihoods across the two views and redistributes positive response-level advantages according to their relative evidence support; and (ii) \textbf{spatiotemporal state alignment}, which aligns the two views' hidden states on verifier-accepted responses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OWLET 是面向 Video-LLM 后训练的证据特权 RL 方法：用「均匀全局上下文 + 问题相关局部窗口」的富视图作为 teacher，对比同一学生响应在两种视图下的 token 似然与内部表征，把正的响应级优势按证据支持度重新分配，并在 verifier 接受的响应上对齐两视图隐状态。它针对 RL 的粗粒度奖励与 OPD 缺少时空表征监督这两个缺口。
Motivation: RL 只给单一轨迹级奖励，同一 advantage 施加到每个 token，忽略视频响应各 token 落在视觉流上的程度差异；OPD 虽有 token 级输出分布匹配，却不直接监督产生这些输出的时空表征。
Method: 构建耦合均匀全局上下文与问题条件局部窗口的富视图（无需更大模型）作为特权视觉证据来源；(i) evidence-aware credit redistribution：比较两视图下 token 似然，按相对证据支持重新分配正的响应级优势；(ii) spatiotemporal state alignment：在 verifier 接受的响应上对齐两视图隐状态。
Result: 作者观察到：当视频视图同时包含全局时间上下文与问题相关细节时，同一模型推理更准确；同一学生生成响应在该视图与均匀采样下的对比会带来 token 似然与内部表征的变化，从而构成证据使用的训练信号。
Conclusion: 把更丰富的视觉视图作为特权证据、在 token 与时空表征两个层面分配监督，可弥补 RL 粗粒度奖励与 OPD 缺失表征监督的不足，且无需引入更大的模型。

papers.title: ConClick: Element-Wise Contrastive Learning Improves GUI Grounding
papers.abstract_en: GUI grounding, the task of locating the interface element specified by a user instruction, is a fundamental capability of GUI agents. However, existing grounding models remain error-prone, often causing downstream task failures. We systematically evaluate 10 grounding models across five datasets and identify a major error pattern: most incorrect clicks hit non-target interface elements rather than the background, with different models repeatedly selecting the same distractors. Motivated by these findings, we propose ConClick, a contrastive learning framework that teaches models to distinguish the target element from plausible distractors. We construct ConClick-Data, a dataset containing 4,292 challenging target-distractor pairs, and train the model using complementary listwise ranking and pairwise margin objectives. ConClick improves the grounding accuracy of Qwen3-VL-8B from 54.71% to 66.03% on ScreenSpot-Pro, from 83.72% to 86.28% on MMBench-GUI L2, and from 63.33% to 70.20% on OSWorld-G, outperforming prior methods built on the same or similarly sized backbones. We further introduce ReClick, an inference-time strategy that revisits promising regions and compares predictions across competing candidates, yielding an additional 2.96 percentage-point improvement in average accuracy across the three benchmarks. Together, our analysis, dataset, and methods provide both empirical insights and practical tools for building more reliable GUI agents. Data and code are available at https://github.com/zhangruotian/ConClick.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 10 figures, including references and appendices. Code and data: https://github.com/zhangruotian/ConClick
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GUI grounding 的主要错误不是点到空白，而是点到相似的干扰元素，且不同模型反复选中同一批 distractor。ConClick 用元素级对比学习（listwise ranking + pairwise margin 双目标）在 4,292 对 target-distractor 上训练，把 Qwen3-VL-8B 在 ScreenSpot-Pro 上的准确率从 54.71% 提到 66.03%；推理时的 ReClick 再平均提升 2.96 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有 grounding 模型仍频繁点错，错误会直接导致 GUI agent 下游任务失败；系统评估 10 个模型、5 个数据集后发现错误集中在误选干扰元素而非背景，且不同模型选中相同 distractor，这一模式此前缺少针对性处理。
Method: 提出 ConClick 对比学习框架：先构建 ConClick-Data（4,292 个有挑战性的 target-distractor 对），再用互补的 listwise ranking 与 pairwise margin 两个目标训练模型区分目标与干扰元素；另提出推理时策略 ReClick，回访有希望的区域并在竞争候选之间比较预测。
Result: 在五个数据集上评估 10 个 grounding 模型后，ConClick 使 Qwen3-VL-8B 的 grounding 准确率在 ScreenSpot-Pro 上从 54.71% 升至 66.03%，在 MMBench-GUI L2 上从 83.72% 升至 86.28%，在 OSWorld-G 上从 63.33% 升至 70.20%，超过同规模或相近规模 backbone 上的已有方法；ReClick 在这三个 benchmark 上再带来平均 2.96 个百分点的准确率提升。
Conclusion: 把错误归因到 distractor 而非背景后，用元素级对比目标加推理时候选复核即可显著提升 grounding 可靠性，且在同规模 backbone 上优于既有方法。

papers.title: Forgetting is Not Always Bad: A Neuro-Inspired Memory Repair Mechanism for Poisoned LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are highly vulnerable to memory-poisoning attacks. Existing defenses primarily rely on external modules for either static memory isolation or continuous online auditing, resulting in low memory efficiency and high computational overhead. To address these limitations, inspired by neuroscientific mechanisms that weak reactivation can destabilize memories and induce decay in the absence of reinforcement, we propose an agent-intrinsic training-free memory repair framework, DREAM (Dynamic Reactivation for Engram Attenuation in Memory), that enables selective functional forgetting of poisoned memories. Specifically, DREAM implements a three-stage pipeline: perturbation-induced implicit reactivation to reveal the structural fragility of malicious memories, adaptive anomaly diagnosis based on multi-dimensional activation patterns to detect topological anomalies, and a dynamic memory repair module that selectively suppresses harmful memories while reinforcing benign ones. Extensive experiments across diverse attackers and real-world tasks demonstrate that DREAM reduces attack success rates by over 95\% against backdoor poisoning while preserving strong benign utility. DREAM also achieves competitive robustness against injection attacks. In terms of runtime and token consumption, DREAM achieves up to a 2.13$\times$ speedup and a 37.7\% reduction in token consumption compared with A-MemGuard. Furthermore, DREAM also achieves a task success rate of 92.96\% on poisoned multi-agent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DREAM 用三阶段训练内生的记忆修复让 LLM agent 选择性遗忘被投毒的记忆：先用扰动诱导隐式再激活暴露恶意记忆的结构脆弱性，再按多维激活模式诊断拓扑异常，最后动态抑制有害记忆并强化良性记忆。后门投毒攻击成功率下降超过 95%，相对 A-MemGuard 最高 2.13× 加速、token 消耗降 37.7%，投毒多智能体系统任务成功率 92.96%。
Motivation: LLM agent 的外部记忆极易被投毒，而现有防御依赖外部模块做静态隔离或持续在线审计，内存效率低、计算开销高。
Method: 提出免训练框架 DREAM（Dynamic Reactivation for Engram Attenuation in Memory），三阶段流水线：扰动诱导的隐式再激活、基于多维激活模式的自适应异常诊断（检测拓扑异常）、动态记忆修复模块选择性抑制有害记忆并强化良性记忆，灵感来自弱再激活在无强化时使记忆失稳衰减的神经科学机制。
Result: 在多种攻击者与真实任务上，对后门投毒的攻击成功率降低超过 95%，同时保持较强的良性效用；对注入攻击也取得有竞争力的鲁棒性；相对 A-MemGuard 最高 2.13× 加速、token 消耗减少 37.7%；在投毒多智能体系统上任务成功率 92.96%。
Conclusion: 让 agent 自己选择性遗忘被投毒记忆，可以在不引入外部审计模块的情况下同时压低攻击成功率并保住良性效用与运行效率。

papers.title: CV-OPD: Contrastive Vision On-policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) reveals versatility and convenience during VLM post-training, providing dense supervision for student from teacher. However, we observed an anomaly that the distilled VLM could still answer the questions accurately even when the related visual regions were masked or replaced with noise. Building on this observation, our quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that OPD, which uses the answer as a hint, has failed to teach students to genuinely seek out and rely on visual evidence. Our theoretical analysis suggests that this failure arises from a shortcut enabled by the lack of visual constraints during distillation. To address the issue, we introduce Contrastive Vision On-policy Distillation (CV-OPD), which compares teacher distributions induced by positive and negative crops while conditioning on the same student prefix and augments optimization with a margin-based contrastive constraint, which is modulated with discrepancy gating across token and sample level. Specifically, CV-OPD first introduces a negative teacher unrelated to the answer and designs a Contrastive Divergence Loss (CDL) that constrains the feature distribution of student by contrasting the positive and negative teachers, correcting how the student exploits visual regions. The CV-OPD introduces a Discrepancy Aware Gate (DAG) that uses token-level and sample-level discrepancies to select visually relevant tokens for optimization, directing the student's attention toward visual content. Extensive experiments across a broad range of fine-grained visual benchmarks demonstrate that CV-OPD substantially alleviates shortcut and consistently improves the visual reasoning capabilities of existing VLMs.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 7 figures, contrastive learning for on-policy distillation of VLMs. Computer Vision. Post-training. VLM. LLM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CV-OPD 指出 on-policy distillation (OPD) 用答案作提示会让学生 VLM 走捷径：即使遮蔽或用噪声替换相关视觉区域，蒸馏后的模型仍能答对问题。它用正/负 crop 诱导的教师分布对比加 margin 约束（Contrastive Divergence Loss），再用 token 与样本两级差异门控 (Discrepancy Aware Gate) 选视觉相关 token，从而把学生注意力拉回视觉证据。
Motivation: VLM 后训练中 OPD 提供稠密监督，但缺少视觉约束使学生可以绕过图像直接从答案提示推出回答，视觉证据并未被真正学会。
Method: 在相同学生前缀条件下比较正、负 crop 诱导的教师分布，引入与答案无关的负教师并设计 Contrastive Divergence Loss (CDL) 约束学生特征分布；再用 Discrepancy Aware Gate (DAG) 依据 token 级与样本级差异筛选视觉相关 token 施加 margin 式对比约束。
Result: 在广泛的细粒度视觉基准上，CV-OPD 显著缓解捷径行为并持续提升现有 VLM 的视觉推理能力；摘要以遮蔽/加噪视觉区域仍答对的异常现象作为 OPD 失败的定量与定性证据，未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: OPD 的失败源于蒸馏时缺少视觉约束这一捷径，加入对比视觉约束与差异门控才能让学生真正依赖视觉证据。

papers.title: SheafPrune: Sheaf-Guided Graph Propagation for Visual Token Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models process the complete visual token sequence, increasing prefill cost even when many tokens are irrelevant to the instruction. Token-wise saliency captures limited inter-token dependence; graph-based selection instead depends on how relations govern importance propagation and ranking. We study support-constrained propagation with node-degree correction. Inspired by sheaf geometry, SheafPrune uses modality-specific maps and a sparse text--visual graph to transfer relevance, then propagates scores on a separate visual graph and corrects them for degree. It retains a hard top-$k$ subset once before the frozen language model. The selector has about $4.5$M parameters and is trained end-to-end through the frozen LLaVA-NeXT-8B backbone using only the language-modeling objective. Explicit retention-ratio conditioning lets one checkpoint serve every budget. Across four backbones, ten benchmarks and seven pruning ratios, with all baselines re-implemented under one protocol, SheafPrune achieves the best retention at $22$ of $28$ backbone--budget settings, with monotonically growing margins in the moderate-to-aggressive regime. On LLaVA-NeXT, retaining $10\%$ of visual tokens yields a $5.15\times$ net prefill speedup and an $84.0\%$ end-to-end FLOPs reduction. Together with component ablations, these results support graph-constrained importance propagation and degree correction as a design for visual token selection across the evaluated backbones and tokenization schemes, improving the trade-off between accuracy retention and inference cost. code:https://github.com/Bob0817912/SheafPrune_ICLR_2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SheafPrune 用 sheaf 几何启发的图传播做多模态大模型视觉 token 剪枝：模态特定映射加稀疏 text–visual 图转移相关性，再在独立视觉图上传播分数并做节点度校正，在冻结 LLaVA-NeXT-8B 前一次性保留硬 top-k 子集。在 4 个 backbone、10 个 benchmark、7 个剪枝比例的统一协议下，28 个 backbone–budget 组合中 22 个取得最佳保留率；LLaVA-NeXT 上保留 10% 视觉 token 带来 5.15× 净 prefill 加速与 84.0% 端到端 FLOPs 下降。
Motivation: 多模态大模型要处理完整视觉 token 序列，即使大量 token 与指令无关也推高 prefill 成本；而逐 token 显著性只能捕捉有限的 token 间依赖，图方法的关键在于关系如何决定重要性传播与排序。
Method: 选择器约 4.5M 参数，用模态特定映射与稀疏 text–visual 图转移相关性，再在独立视觉图上做带节点度校正的支撑受限传播 (support-constrained propagation)，通过显式保留率条件化让单个 checkpoint 覆盖所有预算；在冻结 LLaVA-NeXT-8B backbone 上以纯语言建模目标端到端训练，所有基线在同一协议下重实现。
Result: 在 4 个 backbone、10 个 benchmark、7 个剪枝比例共 28 个 backbone–budget 设置中，22 个取得最佳保留率，且在中等到激进剪枝区间优势单调扩大；LLaVA-NeXT 上保留 10% 视觉 token 获得 5.15× 净 prefill 加速与 84.0% 端到端 FLOPs 降低。
Conclusion: 图约束的重要性传播加度校正可作为跨所评测 backbone 与 tokenization 方案的视觉 token 选择设计，改善准确率保留与推理成本的权衡。

summary_sections.motivation: 多模态大模型要处理完整视觉 token 序列，即使大量 token 与指令无关也推高 prefill 成本；而逐 token 显著性只能捕捉有限的 token 间依赖，图方法的关键在于关系如何决定重要性传播与排序。
summary_sections.method: 选择器约 4.5M 参数，用模态特定映射与稀疏 text–visual 图转移相关性，再在独立视觉图上做带节点度校正的支撑受限传播 (support-constrained propagation)，通过显式保留率条件化让单个 checkpoint 覆盖所有预算；在冻结 LLaVA-NeXT-8B backbone 上以纯语言建模目标端到端训练，所有基线在同一协议下重实现。

summary_sections.conclusion: 图约束的重要性传播加度校正可作为跨所评测 backbone 与 tokenization 方案的视觉 token 选择设计，改善准确率保留与推理成本的权衡。

papers.title: Dual-Stream Memory for Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract_en: Memory-dependent manipulation requires a policy to track execution state and recover visual evidence that is no longer observable. We propose dual-stream memory for vision-language-action policies, assigning these requirements to complementary representations. A task-agnostic Gated DeltaNet compresses history into one temporal token, supervised by progress prediction and action-conditioned feature reconstruction. A task-conditioned retriever retains frames above a fixed relevance threshold; linear multi-scale fusion encodes each frame into sixteen spatial tokens. We then freeze the temporal compressor and jointly optimize retrieval and policy learning. Across sixteen RoboMME tasks, the complete model achieves 49.22% mean success versus 44.51% for the published FrameSamp+Modul reference, improving fourteen tasks and all four suite means. On four real-robot tasks, mean success reaches 62.5% versus 37.5%, with the largest gains on repeated actions requiring execution-stage discrimination. These results support combining execution context with selective visual access, while failures under cup swaps expose persistent identity tracking as an unresolved requirement.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Evaluated on 16 RoboMME tasks and 4 real-world robotic manipulation tasks
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向记忆依赖操作的 VLA 策略提出双流记忆：任务无关的 Gated DeltaNet 把历史压成单个时间 token，任务条件检索器按相关阈值保留关键帧并用线性多尺度融合编码为每帧 16 个空间 token。在 16 个 RoboMME 任务上平均成功率 49.22%，高于 FrameSamp+Modul 参考的 44.51%，4 个真机任务上 62.5% 对 37.5%，增益集中在需要执行阶段判别的重复动作。
Motivation: 记忆依赖操作要求策略跟踪执行状态并找回已不可观测的视觉证据，单一历史表示难以同时满足这两点。
Method: 双流记忆：任务无关 Gated DeltaNet 将历史压缩为单个时间 token，由进度预测与动作条件特征重建监督；任务条件检索器保留高于固定相关阈值的帧，线性多尺度融合把每帧编码为 16 个空间 token；随后冻结时间压缩器，联合优化检索与策略学习。
Result: 在 16 个 RoboMME 任务上完整模型平均成功率 49.22%，对比已发布 FrameSamp+Modul 参考的 44.51%，在 14 个任务和全部 4 个套件均值上提升；4 个真实机器人操作任务上平均成功率 62.5% 对 37.5%，最大增益出现在需要执行阶段判别的重复动作。
Conclusion: 执行上下文与选择性视觉访问结合有效，但杯子互换场景下的失败表明持久身份跟踪仍是未解决需求。

papers.title: Data-Adaptive Mahalanobis Metric Learning for Cross-Head Attention in Transformers
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose Data-Adaptive Mahalanobis Cross-Head Attention (DAMCHA), a simple and effective attention mechanism that generalizes Multi-Head Attention (MHA) through the lens of metric learning. Standard MHA implicitly learns a static, head-wise Euclidean similarity corresponding to the diagonal blocks of a unified cross-head metric matrix, discarding all off-diagonal interactions across heads. DAMCHA addresses this limitation via two key innovations. First, it learns the full cross-head metric matrix, inducing a Mahalanobis-like similarity that explicitly captures inter-head interactions beyond the restricted block-diagonal structure of MHA. Second, it parameterizes the metric matrix as an input-dependent function, enabling the attention geometry to dynamically adapt to the intrinsic manifold structure of the data rather than remaining fixed after training. We further introduce principled regularization strategies, most notably stack-wise parameter sharing, to ensure computational efficiency and stable optimization. DAMCHA serves as a drop-in replacement for MHA and its variants in various Transformer architectures, delivering superior expressive power and learning performance with comparable or reduced computational overhead. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DAMCHA-based Transformers consistently outperform competing baselines across a range of benchmark tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/erwinmsmith/DAMCHA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DAMCHA：把 Multi-Head Attention 重写为度量学习，学习完整的跨头 Mahalanobis 度量矩阵并使其随输入变化，从而引入 MHA 块对角结构丢掉的跨头交互。作为 MHA 的即插即用替换，在多类 Transformer 基准任务上一致优于对比基线，计算开销相当或更低。
Motivation: 标准 MHA 隐含的是静态的、按头独立的欧氏相似度，等价于统一跨头度量矩阵的对角块，所有跨头非对角交互被丢弃，表达能力受限。
Method: DAMCHA 学习完整的跨头度量矩阵，诱导 Mahalanobis 相似度；并把该矩阵参数化为输入的函数，使注意力几何随数据内在流形结构动态调整。配套引入正则策略，最主要的是 stack-wise parameter sharing，以保证计算效率与优化稳定。
Result: 在一系列基准任务上，基于 DAMCHA 的 Transformer 一致优于竞争基线，计算开销相当或更低；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把注意力相似度从静态块对角欧氏度量换成输入自适应的完整跨头 Mahalanobis 度量，可以在不增加（甚至降低）开销的前提下提升 Transformer 的表达与学习能力。

papers.title: Beyond a Single Crop: Contextualized Embeddings for Player Re-Identification
papers.abstract_en: Person re-identification is typically addressed by learning identity-discriminative embeddings from individual person crops. However, player re-identification in broadcast sports videos presents a unique challenge: players from the same team often share similar appearances, while video sequences provide repeated observations of the same players under different viewpoints and surrounding contexts. Existing crop-based approaches largely ignore this contextual information, which can be critical for resolving visually similar identities. Here, we propose ContextReID, a contextualized embedding framework that represents a player by jointly considering other players in the same frame and observations from different frames of the broadcast sequence. By incorporating both co-occurring players and cross-frame observations, the model learns identity features relative to the surrounding visual context rather than relying only on isolated appearance cues. We implement this framework with a vision-language model that takes sets of player crops as input and generates context-aware embeddings for individual players. A combined contextual learning and retrieval objective encourages the model to capture cross-frame identity relationships while maintaining discriminative embeddings for player matching. Experiments across three multi-object tracking benchmarks show that ContextReID improves player retrieval over conventional single-crop embedding approaches in both Rank-1 and mAP. These results highlight the utility of spatial and temporal context for reliable player identification in broadcast sports videos.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ContextReID 把球员重识别从单人 crop 嵌入改为联合同帧其他球员与跨帧观测的情境化嵌入，用视觉-语言模型吃球员 crop 集合输出上下文感知嵌入，并以情境学习与检索的联合目标训练。在三个多目标跟踪基准上，其球员检索的 Rank-1 与 mAP 均高于常规单 crop 嵌入方法。
Motivation: 转播体育视频中同队球员外观高度相似，单 crop 嵌入丢掉了同帧与跨帧的上下文线索，难以区分视觉上相近的身份。
Method: 以视觉-语言模型为实现，输入同一帧内的一组球员 crop，联合同帧共现球员与广播序列中不同帧的观测生成个体球员的上下文感知嵌入；训练采用情境学习与检索的组合目标，兼顾跨帧身份关系与判别性匹配。
Result: 在三个多目标跟踪基准上的实验显示，ContextReID 在 Rank-1 与 mAP 两项球员检索指标上均优于常规单 crop 嵌入方法。
Conclusion: 空间与时间上下文对转播体育视频中的可靠球员识别有用，身份特征应相对周围视觉情境而非孤立外观来学习。

papers.title: Neural Surrogate Modeling of Ultrasonic Wave Propagation in Heterogeneous Media
papers.abstract_en: Neural surrogates provide computationally efficient auto-regressive modeling of wave propagation, enabling e.g. fast inverse solutions. Despite recent progress, the current surrogates are not yet sufficient for the needs of ultrasonic sensing, characterized by high frequency and heterogeneous propagation media. We show how methods building on Fourier Neural Operators (FNO) fail to capture essential signal features, such as reflections, whereas U-Net -based methods learn the wave fields well but lack the ability to transfer information across different spatial scales. We then propose a new surrogate that captures the best of the two worlds, by integrating FNOs and local-integral resampling into a U-Net architecture. We show it can be trained on limited data, and that the predictions are robust to input noise and work across spatial scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对超声波在非均匀介质中高频传播的神经代理模型，指出纯 FNO 类方法抓不住反射等关键信号特征，纯 U-Net 能学好波场但无法跨空间尺度传递信息；提出的混合架构把 FNO 与局部积分重采样 (local-integral resampling) 集成进 U-Net，可在有限数据上训练，预测对输入噪声鲁棒并跨尺度工作。
Motivation: 超声传感要求高频、非均匀介质下的波传播建模，现有神经代理模型要么丢失反射等关键特征，要么无法在不同空间尺度间传递信息，不足以支撑快速反演求解。
Method: 先分析基于 Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) 的方法与 U-Net 类方法各自的失效模式，再提出新代理：在 U-Net 架构中集成 FNO 与局部积分重采样 (local-integral resampling)，以自回归方式建模波场。
Result: 定性发现：FNO 类方法无法捕捉反射等关键信号特征；U-Net 类方法能很好学习波场但缺乏跨空间尺度传递信息的能力；所提模型可在有限数据上训练，预测对输入噪声鲁棒并跨空间尺度工作。
Conclusion: 把 FNO 的全局谱建模与 U-Net 的局部细节结合，可同时获得反射保真与跨尺度泛化，使神经代理适用于高频非均匀介质的超声传感与快速反演。

papers.title: CAST: Credit Alignment for Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Cross-tokenizer on-policy distillation (OPD) requires aligning teacher and student sequences before their scores can be compared. Decoded-text alignment provides such correspondence at the chunk level, but leaves a distinct problem unresolved: credit alignment. A chunk-level signal specifies how much a span should change, but not how that signal should be distributed across student tokens, while tokens without teacher correspondence remain unconstrained. We propose CAST (Chunk-aware credit Assignment with Selective Token Anchoring), a shift-or-stay framework that addresses both issues. For aligned chunks, CAST redistributes each chunk's advantage across student tokens using predictive uncertainty and local teacher-signal smoothness, emphasizing learning opportunities supported by locally consistent teacher feedback while preserving the chunk's total advantage. The resulting weights exactly solve a KL-regularized credit-allocation problem. For unaligned positions, CAST selectively anchors the student to its initial policy through a KL penalty, limiting drift where teacher supervision is unavailable. Because credit assignment is separated from chunk construction, CAST also applies to punctuation-defined or fixed-length chunks under shared tokenization. Across six mathematics, science, and code benchmarks, CAST improves the average over the strongest evaluated baseline by $2.45$ and $1.32$ points for cross-tokenizer transfer from Qwen3-8B to Mistral-7B and Llama-3.1-8B, respectively, and by $2.10$ points for shared-tokenizer transfer to Qwen3-1.7B.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CAST 解决跨 tokenizer 在线策略蒸馏 (cross-tokenizer OPD) 中的 credit 对齐问题：对已对齐 chunk，用预测不确定性和局部教师信号平滑度把 chunk 级 advantage 重新分配到学生 token 上（精确求解 KL 正则的 credit 分配问题），对无教师对应的 token 用 KL 惩罚锚定初始策略。在六个数学、科学与代码基准上，Qwen3-8B→Mistral-7B 平均提升 2.45 分，→Llama-3.1-8B 提升 1.32 分，共享 tokenizer 迁移到 Qwen3-1.7B 提升 2.10 分。
Motivation: 跨 tokenizer OPD 需先对齐师生序列才能比较打分，但 chunk 级信号只说明一段该变多少，无法决定如何分摊到各学生 token，且无教师对应的 token 完全不受约束。
Method: CAST 是 shift-or-stay 框架：对齐 chunk 内按预测不确定性和局部教师信号平滑度重分配 advantage，保持 chunk 总 advantage 不变，所得权重精确求解 KL 正则的 credit 分配问题；未对齐位置用 KL 惩罚锚定初始策略。credit 分配与 chunk 构造解耦，因此也适用于共享 tokenizer 下的标点或定长 chunk。
Result: 六个数学、科学与代码基准上，相对最强被评估基线的平均提升：Qwen3-8B→Mistral-7B 跨 tokenizer 迁移 +2.45 分，→Llama-3.1-8B +1.32 分，共享 tokenizer 迁移到 Qwen3-1.7B +2.10 分。
Conclusion: 把 credit 分配与 chunk 构造分离后，chunk 级 OPD 信号可以被一致地分摊到 token 级，并在跨 tokenizer 与共享 tokenizer 两种迁移设置下都带来稳定增益。

summary_sections.method: CAST 是 shift-or-stay 框架：对齐 chunk 内按预测不确定性和局部教师信号平滑度重分配 advantage，保持 chunk 总 advantage 不变，所得权重精确求解 KL 正则的 credit 分配问题；未对齐位置用 KL 惩罚锚定初始策略。credit 分配与 chunk 构造解耦，因此也适用于共享 tokenizer 下的标点或定长 chunk。
summary_sections.result: 六个数学、科学与代码基准上，相对最强被评估基线的平均提升：Qwen3-8B→Mistral-7B 跨 tokenizer 迁移 +2.45 分，→Llama-3.1-8B +1.32 分，共享 tokenizer 迁移到 Qwen3-1.7B +2.10 分。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把 credit 分配与 chunk 构造分离后，chunk 级 OPD 信号可以被一致地分摊到 token 级，并在跨 tokenizer 与共享 tokenizer 两种迁移设置下都带来稳定增益。

papers.title: Tabular Foundation Models Are Effectively Shallow
papers.abstract_en: In-context-learning Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) are uniquely suited to scenarios with limited resources or privacy constraints, as they solve new tasks without additional training. However, their architecture consists of multiple transformer blocks, resulting in high computational and memory footprints. Meanwhile, traditional alternatives like Gradient-Boosted Decision Trees (GBDTs) remain highly competitive and run efficiently on CPUs, suggesting that tabular tasks may not inherently require deep architectures. This contrast raises a fundamental question: can TFMs be simplified by removing architectural redundancies without sacrificing performance? To answer this, we introduce a closed-form, label-free affine translator that replaces a contiguous window of up to 96% of the blocks, leaving the rest unchanged. Evaluating eight frontier TFMs on 171 classification datasets, we reveal that tabular transformers are vastly overparameterized: replacing half of a model's blocks costs at most $0.002$ median AUROC across all architectures, with the half-depth TabFM still outperforming every other full-depth TFMs and tuned GBDTs. Furthermore, different model families are overparameterized in different ways: TabPFN-3 relies on its encoders, maintaining performance regardless of which single block is retained. Other single-axis models spread computation thinly, needing only their first block, while dual-axis models concentrate it in one critical block. Ultimately, removing depth saves up to 1.5B parameters, speeds up GPU inference by up to $6\times$ at a median cost of $0.03$ AUROC, while a single-block TabPFN-3 serves cached queries $2.4\times$ faster using $6\times$ less memory at negligible cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 表格基础模型 (Tabular Foundation Model) 的深度存在大量冗余：用一个闭式、无标签的 affine translator 替换最多 96% 的连续 transformer block，其余保持不变，性能几乎不掉。在 8 个前沿 TFM、171 个分类数据集上，替换一半 block 的 AUROC 中位数损失至多 0.002，半深度模型仍优于所有全深度 TFM 与调参后的 GBDT；删除深度最多省 1.5B 参数、GPU 推理提速至多 6×（中位代价 0.03 AUROC），单 block 的 TabPFN-3 服务缓存查询快 2.4×、内存省 6×。
Motivation: TFM 依赖 in-context learning 免训练解决新任务，适合资源受限或隐私约束场景，但多层 transformer block 带来高计算与内存开销；与此同时 GBDT 在 CPU 上依然高效且有竞争力，说明表格任务未必真正需要深度架构。
Method: 提出闭式、无标签的 affine translator，替换模型中一段连续的 block 窗口（最多 96%），其余 block 不动；在 8 个前沿 TFM、171 个分类数据集上评估，并按 encoder 依赖、单轴/双轴等结构差异分析各模型家族的过参数化方式。
Result: 替换一半 block 在所有架构上的 AUROC 中位数损失至多 0.002；半深度 TabFM 仍优于全部全深度 TFM 和调参 GBDT。TabPFN-3 依赖 encoder，保留任意单个 block 都能维持性能；单轴模型只需第一个 block，双轴模型把计算集中在单个关键 block。删除深度最多省 1.5B 参数、GPU 推理提速至多 6×（中位代价 0.03 AUROC）；单 block TabPFN-3 服务缓存查询快 2.4×、内存省 6×，代价可忽略。
Conclusion: 表格 transformer 严重过参数化，且不同模型家族的冗余分布不同；用闭式 affine translator 做深度剪枝可以在几乎不损 AUROC 的前提下大幅降低 TFM 的参数量、显存与推理延迟。

papers.title: Vision Transformers Learn Word Meaning from Images Alone
papers.abstract_en: Can a vision model learn what words mean from pixels alone? We show that the two largest DINOv3 vision transformers organize words rendered in images by word meaning, despite being pretrained using self-supervision on images only, without paired captions, class labels, or other language supervision. We derive word representations from embedding differences between word images and matched controls, then test whether semantically related words are neighbors within each model's embedding space, while controlling for spelling similarity. We find that brand names in the same industry group together, as do nouns from the same semantic domain. Country-capital pairs exhibit consistent vector offsets, similarly to word embeddings trained on text. These word representations also align with the representations of the visual object categories they name. DINOv3-H and DINOv3-7B are, to our knowledge, the first self-supervised vision models to show substantial semantic structure for rendered words. Comparisons with text and speech encoders reveal shared structure among representations of the same words. Contrastive alignment with either encoder further strengthened DINOv3-H's word-level semantic structure, while leaving the other finetuned vision models largely unchanged. Image-only training can therefore teach vision models not just what words look like, but also how their meanings relate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DINOv3-H 与 DINOv3-7B 两个纯图像自监督 ViT 在渲染文字的图像嵌入空间里组织出词义结构：同行业品牌、同语义域名词各自聚拢，国家-首都呈现一致向量偏移，且与所指视觉类别对齐；控制拼写相似度后仍成立。与文本或语音编码器做对比对齐 (contrastive alignment) 进一步强化 DINOv3-H 的词级语义结构，而其他微调视觉模型基本不变。
Motivation: 视觉模型通常靠配对 caption、类标签等语言监督获得词义；本文追问仅靠像素的自监督预训练能否让渲染词的嵌入按意义而非字形组织。
Method: 从词图像与其匹配控制图像的嵌入差 (embedding differences) 导出词表示，在模型嵌入空间中检验语义相近词是否互为邻居并控制拼写相似度；再与文本、语音编码器比较，并做对比对齐微调。
Result: 两个最大的 DINOv3 ViT（DINOv3-H、DINOv3-7B）中，同行业品牌与同语义域名词分别聚类，国家-首都对呈现一致向量偏移（类似文本词向量），词表示还与所指视觉类别表示对齐；对比对齐强化 DINOv3-H 的词级语义结构，其他微调视觉模型基本不变。
Conclusion: 图像-only 训练足以让视觉模型学到词的含义及其相互关系，而不只是词的外形；据作者所知 DINOv3-H 与 DINOv3-7B 是首批展现渲染词显著语义结构的自监督视觉模型。

papers.title: Deep Learning Approach for RealTime Contraction Detection in Laboring Dairy Cattle
papers.abstract_en: Currently, the animal production sector is undergoing rapid development of techniques that allow automatic monitoring of animal behaviour and health. This paper presents a computer vision-based approach for the automatic recognition of labor contractions in cows. During the course of the study, videos depicting 100 cow births were collected. From the obtained videos, 8500 cow contraction actions and about 25 000 non-contraction sequences were extracted which constituted the dataset. Leveraging image processing techniques and deep learning algorithms like Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs), our methodology extracts relevant features from video frames to detect and classify contractions. Our study demonstrates a high accuracy rate of over 95% in detecting labor contractions. This automated system has the potential to enhance productivity and animal welfare in the dairy industry by providing real-time monitoring and facilitating timely intervention during difficult calvings. The video demonstration of the system can be found at the following URL: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8fTSG5D7dZ0
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用计算机视觉自动识别奶牛分娩宫缩：从 100 头奶牛分娩视频中提取 8500 个宫缩动作与约 25000 个非宫缩片段，用 CNN 与 Vision Transformer (ViT) 从视频帧提取特征做实时检测分类，检测准确率超过 95%。该系统用于难产的实时监测与及时干预。
Motivation: 畜牧生产环节正快速引入行为与健康自动监测技术，而奶牛分娩宫缩此前依赖人工观察，难产时缺少实时、可及时干预的自动识别手段。
Method: 采集 100 头奶牛分娩视频，从中切出 8500 个宫缩动作片段与约 25000 个非宫缩片段构成数据集；用图像处理结合 CNN 与 ViT 从视频帧提取特征，对宫缩做检测与分类。
Result: 在该数据集上，宫缩检测准确率超过 95%；数据规模为 100 场分娩、8500 个正样本动作、约 25000 个负样本片段。
Conclusion: 基于 CNN/ViT 的视觉系统可实时自动识别奶牛分娩宫缩，为难产监测与及时干预提供手段，从而提升奶业生产效率与动物福利。

papers.title: Jag: Direct Box Prediction for Efficient Visual Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Visual grounding combines image--language understanding with geometric prediction, yet autoregressive multimodal models often express a box as a coordinate sequence. Sequential decoding adds computation to the multimodal processing needed for localization. Adapting these representations to box geometry offers a route to direct prediction. We present Jag, which adapts a compact pretrained multimodal model for direct continuous box prediction. A lightweight regression head reads the last valid input-token state, conditioned on the image and referring expression, and predicts all four box coordinates together. Geometric supervision jointly adapts the language backbone, visual merger, and regression head, allowing localization losses to shape both the multimodal representations and the coordinate mapping. Inference retains image--language processing and returns the box in one forward pass, without coordinate generation or text parsing. Across benchmarks, Jag consistently improves grounding accuracy over its base model across the observed target sizes and expression groups. Component ablation show that jointly adapting the representations and head substantially improves accuracy over training the head alone. Against existing specialized grounding models, it achieves competitive accuracy with lower single-request latency and GPU memory use. These results show how supervision tailored to the geometric answer can specialize a compact pretrained multimodal model for accurate grounding and efficient direct prediction. Project page: https://xyzzzh.github.io/Jag/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Jag 把紧凑预训练多模态模型改成一次前向直接回归 4 个连续框坐标：轻量回归头读最后一个有效输入 token 状态，联合微调语言主干、视觉 merger 与回归头。在各目标尺寸与指代表达分组上一致提升 grounding 精度，且单请求延迟与 GPU 显存低于现有专用 grounding 模型。
Motivation: 自回归多模态模型把框表示成坐标 token 序列，顺序解码为定位额外增加计算，坐标序列化也与框的几何本质不匹配。
Method: 轻量回归头读取最后一个有效输入 token 状态，在图像与指代表达条件下一次输出全部 4 个框坐标；几何监督联合适配语言主干、视觉 merger 与回归头，推理保留图文处理但不做坐标生成与文本解析。
Result: 在各观测目标尺寸与表达分组上，Jag 相对其 base model 一致提升 grounding 精度；消融显示联合适配表征与头比只训头显著更准；对比现有专用 grounding 模型达到有竞争力的精度，同时单请求延迟与 GPU 显存更低。
Conclusion: 针对几何答案定制的监督可以把紧凑预训练多模态模型特化为既准又高效的直接框预测，联合适配表征是精度提升的关键。

papers.title: State-OPD: State-Grounded On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents
papers.abstract_en: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for transferring reasoning capabilities from frontier models to smaller models, while extending its success to multi-turn agentic environments remains challenging. We study agentic OPD through interaction states, distinguishing the objective task and executed action-observation record from the internal semantic trajectory of student reasoning. Through this lens, we identify two roles of student reasoning in multi-turn OPD: prior reasoning distorts teacher supervision, while current reasoning shapes the action alternatives sampled at the same state. Specifically, at matched interaction states, removing prior student reasoning improves teacher continuation success and changes the teacher's token-level targets, with larger continuation gains at later turns. Meanwhile, resampling complete reasoning-action responses yields greater action diversity at the same state than resampling actions under a fixed reasoning trace. We introduce State-Grounded On-Policy Distillation, a framework that grounds teacher supervision in interaction states and reallocates the sampling budget to generate multiple complete reasoning-action responses at states with high response entropy, while retaining full-history student generation. Comprehensive evaluations across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld and WebShop demonstrate that State-OPD achieves the highest macro-average success rate among the evaluated methods for both Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B students. Notably, for Qwen3-4B, State-OPD raises macro-average success from 26.07\% with the strongest baseline to 31.74\% and surpasses its Qwen3-32B teacher on ALFWorld Seen. Further analyses reveal that State-OPD achieves higher task success with fewer supervised turn responses and substantially reduces persistent failed-action repetition; qualitative traces illustrate decision revision based on interaction feedback.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: State-OPD 把多轮 agent 的 on-policy distillation 锚定在交互状态上：剥离学生先前推理后教师续写成功率更高，且在高响应熵状态把采样预算重分配给完整推理-动作响应重采样。在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop 上，Qwen3-4B 学生的宏平均成功率从最强基线 26.07% 提到 31.74%，并在 ALFWorld Seen 上超过其 Qwen3-32B 教师。
Motivation: 多轮 agentic 环境里，学生先前推理既扭曲教师监督信号，又限制同一状态下可采样的动作空间，直接套用单轮 OPD 会失效。
Method: State-Grounded On-Policy Distillation：把教师监督锚定在交互状态（剥离先前学生推理以获得教师续写目标），并按响应熵把采样预算重分配到生成多条完整推理-动作响应，同时保留全历史学生生成。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop 上，State-OPD 对 Qwen3-1.7B 与 Qwen3-4B 学生均取得所评估方法中最高宏平均成功率；Qwen3-4B 从最强基线 26.07% 升至 31.74%，并在 ALFWorld Seen 超过 Qwen3-32B 教师。附加分析显示其用更少的被监督轮次响应达到更高任务成功率，并显著减少持续性失败动作重复。
Conclusion: 多轮 OPD 的监督应以交互状态而非学生语义轨迹为基准，采样预算应投向高熵状态的完整推理-动作重采样，从而以更少监督轮次换取更高成功率。

papers.title: The Predictability Bias of Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning in Medical Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn by predicting teacher representations of masked regions from visible context. Point prediction summarizes the conditional target distribution and cannot reproduce variation that the context does not resolve. We call this constraint predictability bias. In computed tomography (CT), recurrent anatomy is predictable from context, whereas the sporadic, localized pathology that determines clinical interpretation often is not. We introduce TAP-JEPA, a ViT-B/3D trained on 113,611 CT volumes that is competitive with state-of-the-art encoders (COLIPRI, Merlin, VoxelFM) in scan-level classification. We then audit the learned predictive pathway by replaying the exact masking, teacher, and predictor computations used during training. Prediction lowers the mean Skill (prevalence-normalized average precision) from 0.388 to 0.271 for pathology, but only from 0.921 to 0.873 for anatomy. Along the teacher direction, separating pathology from matched control regions in the same organ, prediction moves pathology 34.7% toward the controls and controls 13.6% toward pathology, with larger shifts farther from visible context. Replacing visible matched-control representations increases surrounding-target prediction loss more than fully replacing pathology representations across four pathology categories. Downstream, removing all final-layer pathology tokens reduces the decision margin by at most 0.45% in four of seven scan-level probes. Together, these results show that contextual predictability is not a sufficient proxy for clinical relevance in medical representation learning. Training objectives should therefore retain diagnostic features regardless of their predictability from surrounding anatomy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TAP-JEPA（ViT-B/3D，113,611 例 CT 体数据训练）通过回放训练时的掩码、teacher 与 predictor 计算，证明 JEPA 的点预测会系统性抹掉不可从上下文预测的临床特征：病理的 mean Skill（prevalence-normalized AP）从 0.388 降到 0.271，而解剖结构仅从 0.921 降到 0.873。沿 teacher 方向，病理表征被推向匹配对照 34.7%，对照仅被推向病理 13.6%。作者据此主张训练目标必须保留诊断特征，无论其能否从周围解剖预测。
Motivation: JEPA 用可见上下文预测被掩码区域的 teacher 表征，但点预测只能给出条件分布的均值，无法复现上下文无法解析的变异。在 CT 中，反复出现的解剖结构可预测，而决定临床判读的局灶性病理往往不可预测，这使 JEPA 的学习信号与临床价值系统性错位。
Method: 提出 TAP-JEPA：ViT-B/3D，在 113,611 例 CT 体数据上按 JEPA 目标训练。训练后回放训练时完全相同的掩码、teacher 与 predictor 计算，审计预测通路；沿 teacher 方向比较病理区域与同器官匹配对照区域的表征位移；并做替换实验（替换可见匹配对照表征 vs 替换全部病理表征）与下游扫描级探针（移除末层病理 token）。
Result: 扫描级分类与 SOTA 编码器 COLIPRI、Merlin、VoxelFM 竞争。预测使病理 mean Skill（prevalence-normalized AP）从 0.388 降至 0.271，解剖仅从 0.921 降至 0.873。沿 teacher 方向，病理向匹配对照移动 34.7%，对照向病理移动 13.6%，且离可见上下文越远位移越大。替换可见匹配对照表征比完全替换病理表征更显著提高周围目标的预测损失（覆盖四类病理）。移除全部末层病理 token，在七个扫描级探针中的四个里决策边界 (decision margin) 至多下降 0.45%。
Conclusion: 上下文可预测性 (contextual predictability) 不是医学表征学习中临床相关性的充分代理；训练目标应保留诊断特征，无论其能否从周围解剖预测。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: How Reliable are AMR Parser Outputs? Uncertainty Estimation for AMR Parsing
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances have significantly improved the performance of Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR) parsers, yet determining when their outputs can be trusted remains largely unexplored. This work presents the first study of uncertainty estimation for AMR parsers in a black-box setting using top-k beam-search candidates. Uncertainty is estimated from pairwise candidate similarities and evaluated using the Prediction Rejection Ratio. This work characterises the relationship between parsing performance and uncertainty, evaluates the reliability of beam candidate distributions, analyses the effect of evaluation metrics on uncertainty assessment, and identifies parsers that provide the strongest balance between performance and reliability. Experimental results show the value of uncertainty estimation as a complementary dimension for evaluating AMR parsers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 首次在黑盒设定下用 top-k beam-search 候选做 AMR 解析器的不确定性估计：由候选间成对相似度度量不确定性，并用 Prediction Rejection Ratio 评测。结果表明不确定性估计可作为评价 AMR 解析器的互补维度，并能识别性能与可靠性平衡最好的解析器。
Motivation: AMR 解析器性能虽已显著提升，但判断其输出何时可信基本未被研究，缺少黑盒条件下可操作的可靠性度量。
Method: 黑盒设定下取每个解析器的 top-k beam-search 候选，用候选间 pairwise similarity 计算不确定性，以 Prediction Rejection Ratio 评测；并分析解析性能与不确定性的关系、beam 候选分布的可靠性，以及评测指标对不确定性评估的影响。
Result: 实验显示不确定性估计作为评价 AMR 解析器的互补维度具有价值，并识别出在性能与可靠性之间平衡最强的解析器；摘要给出的是上述定性结论与评测框架。
Conclusion: AMR 解析质量应与不确定性一起看：黑盒 beam 候选相似度加 Prediction Rejection Ratio 足以刻画可靠性，且评测指标的选择会改变不确定性评估结论。
