papers.title: Learning Schwarzschild Geodesic Motion with Lagrangian Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Lagrangian Neural Networks (LNNs) learn dynamics from trajectory data by parameterizing a scalar Lagrangian and deriving accelerations through the Euler--Lagrange equation, providing a variational inductive bias that improves physical consistency over purely data-driven models. LNNs have recently been extended to general relativistic settings, leaving Schwarzschild geodesics as an open challenge. Training on complex relativistic systems is hindered by the diversity of the dynamics, as well as numerical instabilities and the difficulty of adequately sampling physically relevant, diverse orbital regimes. We introduce two coordinated improvements: a decoupled position--velocity normalization scheme that independently rescales each coordinate and its time derivatives, reweighting acceleration targets to balance contributions across all channels; and an energy-constrained log-uniformly sampled dataset generation strategy informed by the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO) structure. With these improvements, our model accurately reproduces perihelion precession and relativistic time dilation, conserves energy and angular momentum to within a few percent even after completing multiple orbits around the central mass and predicts orbital trajectories across eight orbital scenarios in close, medium, and far-field regimes. These results establish that LNNs, augmented with physically motivated normalization and sampling, can reliably learn geodesic dynamics in curved spacetime. Our work also represents the first successful training of LNNs on Schwarzschild geodesics and offers a promising direction for data-driven modeling of complex relativistic systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 首次把 Lagrangian Neural Network (LNN) 训练到 Schwarzschild 测地线上：用解耦的位置-速度归一化（各坐标及其时间导数独立缩放，并对加速度目标重加权以平衡各通道）配合由 ISCO 结构引导的能量约束对数均匀采样，克服相对论轨道动力学多样性和数值不稳定。模型复现近日点进动与相对论时间膨胀，在绕中心质量多圈后能量与角动量守恒偏差在百分之几以内，并覆盖近场、中场、远场共八种轨道场景。
Motivation: LNN 已被推广到广义相对论设定，但 Schwarzschild 测地线仍是未解难题：相对论系统动力学多样、数值不稳定，且难以充分采样物理相关且多样的轨道区间。
Method: 两项配套改进：解耦的位置-速度归一化方案，对每个坐标及其时间导数独立重缩放，并对加速度目标重加权以平衡各通道贡献；由最内层稳定圆轨道 (ISCO) 结构引导的能量约束对数均匀采样数据生成策略。
Result: 模型准确复现近日点进动 (perihelion precession) 与相对论时间膨胀；绕中心质量完成多圈后能量与角动量守恒在百分之几以内；在近场、中场、远场共八种轨道场景上预测轨道轨迹。
Conclusion: 加上物理动机的归一化与采样后，LNN 可以可靠学习弯曲时空中的测地线动力学；这是 LNN 首次成功训练于 Schwarzschild 测地线，为复杂相对论系统的数据驱动建模指出方向。

papers.title: FPD-Drive: Future Policy Distillation for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end autonomous driving models are typically trained on real-world driving logs, which record only the trajectory actually executed in each scene. This provides limited supervision for learning alternative valid behaviors. Multi-target supervision can mitigate this limitation, but broader trajectory coverage makes safe candidate selection more challenging. We propose FPD-Drive, an end-to-end planner that distills privileged future knowledge into a visual driving policy to improve both multi-trajectory supervision and safety selection. Specifically, we introduce Future-Privileged Multi-Target Distillation to transfer diverse, high-quality trajectory targets from a teacher with access to recorded future observations to the student. These targets extend supervision beyond the single recorded human trajectory. For candidate selection, we further introduce Safety-Aware Score Correction to correct ranking errors between nearby safe and unsafe candidates and raise underestimated safety scores of safe candidates. At deployment, the student requires neither future observations nor teacher inference. Our base model achieves 94.9 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 navtest and 55.9 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 navhard. The scaled FPD-Drive-Pro improves these scores to 95.5 PDMS and 58.1 EPDMS, respectively, achieving SOTA performance among the compared methods on both benchmarks. Zero-shot closed-loop evaluation on HUGSIM further yields an HD-Score of 45.1 and RC of 55.3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FPD-Drive 把能看见未来观测的 teacher 轨迹蒸馏给视觉 student 策略，用 Future-Privileged Multi-Target Distillation 扩展多轨迹监督，并用 Safety-Aware Score Correction 修正近邻安全/不安全候选的排序错误。部署时 student 既不需要未来观测也不需要 teacher 推理；在 NAVSIM v1 navtest 上 base 模型 94.9 PDMS、FPD-Drive-Pro 95.5 PDMS，NAVSIM v2 navhard 上 55.9 → 58.1 EPDMS，均为对比方法中的 SOTA。
Motivation: 端到端驾驶模型只用真实行车日志里实际执行的那一条轨迹训练，对其他合法行为的监督不足；改用多目标监督后轨迹覆盖变宽，安全候选的挑选反而更难。
Method: Future-Privileged Multi-Target Distillation：让能访问已记录未来观测的 teacher 把多样、高质量的轨迹目标蒸馏给 student，使监督超出单条人类轨迹；候选选择阶段用 Safety-Aware Score Correction 修正近邻安全与不安全候选的排序错误，并抬高被低估的安全分数。部署时 student 不需要未来观测或 teacher 推理。
Result: base 模型在 NAVSIM v1 navtest 达 94.9 PDMS，NAVSIM v2 navhard 达 55.9 EPDMS；scaled 版 FPD-Drive-Pro 分别提升到 95.5 PDMS 与 58.1 EPDMS，在两个 benchmark 上均为所比方法中的 SOTA；HUGSIM 上零样本闭环评测 HD-Score 45.1、RC 55.3。
Conclusion: 把未来特权信息蒸馏进视觉策略并配合安全感知的分数修正，可以在不增加部署侧输入的前提下同时改善多轨迹监督与安全候选选择，在 NAVSIM 与 HUGSIM 上取得所比方法中的最优表现。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 把未来特权信息蒸馏进视觉策略并配合安全感知的分数修正，可以在不增加部署侧输入的前提下同时改善多轨迹监督与安全候选选择，在 NAVSIM 与 HUGSIM 上取得所比方法中的最优表现。

papers.title: ReSFlow: Rectifying Categorical Flows on Statistical Manifolds for One-Step Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generative modeling for discrete data has been significantly advanced by learning continuous vector fields on the statistical manifolds to transport simple priors to target discrete distributions. However, because these continuous-time flows are not constrained to follow geodesics on the statistical manifold, thereby requiring multi-step numerical integration for simulation and leading to substantial computational costs during inference. In this work, drawing inspiration from the "straight and fast" properties of Rectified Flow in continuous Euclidean space, we propose the Rectified Statistical Flow (ReSFlow) model, which enables one-step categorical generation on statistical manifolds by explicitly learning geodesic trajectories that adhere to the intrinsic Riemannian geometry. By rectifying the flow on the statistical manifold, we theoretically guarantee that trajectories between prior and target distributions approximate geodesics. This rectification significantly reduces the transport cost by aligning the learned trajectories directly along geodesics on the statistical manifold, allowing the model to map pure noise to target discrete data in a single step. Through extensive experiments on diverse real-world generative tasks, ranging from image and text to biological domains, we demonstrate ReSFlow's superior one-step generation quality, which truly embodies geodesically optimal and rapid categorical generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/xiaohuanjia/ReSFlow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReSFlow 在统计流形上对离散数据的连续向量场做 rectification，显式学习贴合内蕴 Riemann 几何的测地轨迹，从而把多步数值积分的离散生成压成单步 categorical 生成。理论上保证先验与目标分布之间的轨迹逼近测地线，降低传输成本；在图像、文本与生物领域的生成任务上展示出更优的单步生成质量。
Motivation: 离散数据生成靠在统计流形上学连续向量场来搬运先验，但这些连续时间流不受测地线约束，仿真需要多步数值积分，推理计算代价高。
Method: 借鉴连续欧氏空间 Rectified Flow 的 straight and fast 性质，提出 Rectified Statistical Flow (ReSFlow)：在统计流形上对流做 rectification，显式学习遵循内蕴 Riemann 几何的测地轨迹，使纯噪声到目标离散数据的映射可在单步完成。
Result: 理论结果：rectification 保证先验到目标分布的轨迹逼近测地线，显著降低 transport cost。实验覆盖图像、文本与生物等多个真实生成任务，展示 ReSFlow 在单步生成质量上的优势；代码发布于 github.com/xiaohuanjia/ReSFlow。
Conclusion: 把 rectification 移到统计流形并按内蕴几何对齐轨迹，可以让离散数据的 categorical 生成既保持测地最优又只需一步采样。

papers.title: Automated Detection and Encoding of Cartographic Signs in Historical Maps
papers.abstract_en: Symbols and icons in archival maps represent an expansive source of evidence for historical geography. In this paper, we present a two-stage framework for (1) detecting cartographic signs in historical maps and (2) generating interpretable sign embeddings that capture both semantics and stylistic variations. We also introduce CaSiDD, an open benchmark dataset spanning multiple sign categories and diverse cartographic styles, designed for generic sign detection. Using YOLOv10-X, we demonstrate the practicality of automated sign detection on historical maps. We then present strategies for creating contrasted, informative embeddings of cartographic signs. We approach embedding design systematically, maximizing expressiveness while suppressing digitization or background material confounders. Our final method, based on an adapted RADIOv4 backbone, effectively encodes both sign form and semantics, while producing interpretable representations. This work lays a foundation for scalable evidence extraction for the comparative study of map signs within cartographic culture and geohistorical research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出两阶段框架：先用 YOLOv10-X 在历史地图上检测制图符号，再用改造的 RADIOv4 backbone 生成同时编码符号形态与语义、且可解释的嵌入，并发布跨类别、跨制图风格的开放基准 CaSiDD。嵌入设计上系统性最大化表达力、抑制数字化与背景材质混淆因素，为制图文化与地历史研究中的符号比较提供可扩展的证据抽取路径。
Motivation: 档案地图中的符号与图标是历史地理的重要证据来源，但缺乏通用的符号检测基准，且嵌入易受数字化过程与背景材质混淆，难以规模化比较不同制图风格中的符号。
Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段用 YOLOv10-X 做通用符号检测，配套发布跨符号类别与多样制图风格的开放基准 CaSiDD；第二阶段设计对比性符号嵌入，最终采用改造的 RADIOv4 backbone，系统性最大化表达力并抑制数字化/背景混淆因素。
Result: 在历史地图上验证了自动符号检测的实用性（YOLOv10-X）；最终的 RADIOv4 改造方法能同时编码符号形态与语义并产生可解释表示。摘要未给出具体精度或对比数值。
Conclusion: 检测加可解释嵌入的两阶段流程可为制图文化与地历史研究中的符号比较提供可扩展的证据抽取基础，前提是嵌入阶段显式抑制数字化与背景混淆。

papers.title: Tensor-based Fusion of Multi-modal Data for Predicting Cancer Risk Levels
papers.abstract_en: Cancer diagnosis and treatment increasingly rely on multi-modal diagnostic technologies that generate high-dimensional datasets. Although these datasets are rich in pathological information, they pose considerable challenges in interpretation, dimensionality reduction, and clinical applicability. Conventional machine learning approaches often fail to extract meaningful cross-modal features, thereby limiting predictive accuracy in patient risk stratification. To address these limitations, this paper proposes an unsupervised machine learning framework that integrates feature extraction, tensor decomposition, and clustering to improve cancer risk prediction. The framework employs tensor decomposition to fuse heterogeneous genomic and clinical data, enabling the extraction of latent, biologically meaningful features that outperform unimodal feature sets. Multiple feature extraction strategies are investigated, and the resulting features are subsequently clustered using a range of clustering algorithms. Comparative evaluations based on internal and external metrics are then used to identify the most effective configurations. The framework is validated on LinkedOmics data comprising 11,158 patients across 32 cancer types. For patient risk stratification, clinically relevant attributes such as tumor purity, pathological stage, and survival outcomes serve as ground-truth indicators. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of tSVD+GMM, which consistently outperforms other configurations across clinical benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于张量分解的多模态融合框架，把基因组与临床数据张量化后用 tSVD 提取跨模态潜特征，再用 GMM 等聚类算法做癌症患者风险分层。在 LinkedOmics 的 11,158 例、32 种癌症数据上，以肿瘤纯度、病理分期和生存结局为真值，tSVD+GMM 在内部与外部指标上稳定优于其他特征提取与聚类组合。
Motivation: 多模态癌症诊断数据维度高、异构，常规机器学习难以提取有意义的跨模态特征，限制了患者风险分层的预测精度。
Method: 无监督框架，依次做特征提取、张量分解 (tensor decomposition) 融合异构基因组与临床数据、再聚类；比较多种特征提取策略与多种聚类算法的组合，用内部与外部指标选出最优配置。
Result: 在 LinkedOmics 数据集（11,158 名患者、32 种癌症类型）上验证，以肿瘤纯度、病理分期、生存结局为真值指标；tSVD+GMM 在各项临床基准上持续优于其他配置，张量融合特征优于单模态特征集。
Conclusion: 张量分解融合多模态数据能提取出生物学上有意义的潜特征，tSVD 配 GMM 是该框架下癌症风险分层的最佳配置。

papers.title: Multi-Modal Graph Neural Network-Inspired Vessel Identification and Tracking for UAV-Based Maritime Surveillance
papers.abstract_en: The unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-based maritime surveillance is becoming an important part of maritime Internet of Things (IoT) and intelligent transportation systems. It provides a flexible and cost-effective way to large-scale maritime traffic monitoring. However, achieving robust situational awareness remains challenging in practical maritime environments. The main challenges arise from heterogeneous sensing modalities, adverse imaging conditions, and spatial misalignment caused by UAV motion. To address these problems, this paper proposes an airborne multi-modal graph learning-driven framework, termed AMGT, for vessel identification and tracking in UAV-assisted maritime IoT. Specifically, visible and infrared images are first aligned and fused through a multi-parameter perspective transformation model. This improves visual perception under low visibility and complex illumination conditions. Automatic identification system (AIS) messages are then temporally synchronized using interpolation and linear prediction. To detect small and oriented vessels, we develop a mixed-modality MAir-YOLOv8-OBB detector, followed by the MAir-SORT algorithm for stable vessel tracking. We further design a graph learning-driven association network to model temporal dynamics and spatial dependencies among vessels and between vessels and UAVs. A motion-aware coordinate unification (MCU) strategy is also introduced to reduce nonlinear misalignment caused by UAV motion. Experiments on the MAP-M2UAV50 dataset show that AMGT achieves high accuracy and efficiency. The results demonstrate its potential for UAV-assisted maritime IoT applications, including vessel monitoring, traffic situational awareness, and intelligent maritime transportation services. The dataset and code will be available at https://github.com/MAPGroup/AMGT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 UAV 海事监视多模态图学习框架 AMGT：可见光与红外图像经多参数透视变换对齐融合，AIS 消息用插值与线性预测做时间同步，再由混合模态检测器 MAir-YOLOv8-OBB 检出小而有向的船只，配合 MAir-SORT 与图学习关联网络完成跟踪，并用运动感知坐标统一 (MCU) 策略消除 UAV 运动带来的非线性错位。在 MAP-M2UAV50 数据集上取得高精度与高效率。
Motivation: UAV 海事监视受异构成像模态、恶劣成像条件与 UAV 运动引起的空间错位三重制约，难以在实际海洋环境中获得稳健的态势感知。
Method: AMGT 流水线：多参数透视变换模型先对齐并融合可见光与红外图像；AIS 消息经插值与线性预测做时间同步；混合模态 MAir-YOLOv8-OBB 检测小目标与有向框，接 MAir-SORT 跟踪；图学习关联网络建模船只之间、船只与 UAV 之间的时序动态与空间依赖；MCU 策略统一坐标以抑制 UAV 运动造成的非线性错位。
Result: 在 MAP-M2UAV50 数据集上，AMGT 在船只识别与跟踪任务中取得高精度与高效率；数据集与代码发布于 github.com/MAPGroup/AMGT。
Conclusion: 多模态对齐融合、AIS 时间同步与图学习关联结合运动补偿，可支撑 UAV 辅助海事 IoT 的船只监控与交通态势感知。

papers.title: Complexity-Calibrated Reconstruction Discrepancy for No-Reference Point Cloud Quality Assessment
papers.abstract_en: The discrepancy induced by surface reconstruction in a distorted point cloud is jointly influenced by its intrinsic structural complexity and signal degradation. This observation motivates a referencefree point cloud quality assessment (PCQA) strategy that estimates and compensates for the complexity-induced component. We implement this strategy through successive reconstruction. Specifically, reconstructing the distorted point cloud produces an input-toreconstruction discrepancy that combines the effects of signal degradation and content complexity. Reapplying the reconstruction operator with stronger smoothing produces a discrepancy between successive reconstructions, which serves as a proxy for the complexityinduced component. This proxy is then used to calibrate the inputto-reconstruction discrepancy. We apply the same strategy to 3D geometry patches and their aligned 2D regions, enabling local comparison of the resulting discrepancies. The calibrated geometric and projected-view discrepancies are then fused into a final degradation score. For both branches, the discrepancies are measured using frozen pretrained perceptual representations. Our method does not require PCQA-specific training or fine-tuning. Experiments on three public databases show that the proposed method consistently outperforms most generic baselines and achieves performance comparable to several full-reference metrics.The code is available at https://github.com/HC-W-whc/CCRD-NR-PCQA.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出无参考点云质量评价方法 CCRD：用两次连续重建把输入-重建差异拆成信号退化与结构复杂度两部分，以更强平滑下的重建间差异作为复杂度分量的代理去校准，再把 3D 几何块与对齐 2D 投影区域的校准差异融合成退化分数，全程用冻结的预训练感知表征度量差异，无需 PCQA 专用训练或微调。
Motivation: 失真点云的表面重建差异同时受固有结构复杂度与信号退化影响，直接把该差异当质量分数会把复杂内容误判为高质量，需要把复杂度诱导的分量估计并补偿掉。
Method: 对失真点云做一次重建得到输入-重建差异，再用更强平滑重复同一重建算子得到连续重建间差异作为复杂度代理，用它校准前者；同一策略施加到 3D 几何块及其对齐的 2D 区域上做局部比较，最后融合几何与投影视图两支的校准差异，差异均用冻结的预训练感知表征度量。
Result: 在三个公开数据库上，该方法一致优于多数通用（generic）基线，性能与若干全参考（full-reference）指标相当；方法不需要 PCQA 专用训练或微调，代码已公开。
Conclusion: 把重建差异中的复杂度分量显式估计并补偿，可以在无参考、免训练的设定下把点云质量评价做到接近全参考指标的水平。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.conclusion: 把重建差异中的复杂度分量显式估计并补偿，可以在无参考、免训练的设定下把点云质量评价做到接近全参考指标的水平。

papers.title: Golden Anchor for Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Video generation supports digital content creation, with applications in virtual avatars, AI-driven filmmaking, interactive game engines, and world models. State-of-the-art systems achieve controllability primarily through image-to-video (I2V) generation, in which an injected anchor image determines the identity, composition, and style of the resulting video. In modern pipelines, this anchor is synthesized by a text-to-image (T2I) generator. This raises a largely overlooked question: Are images obtained directly from the T2I model truly suitable for current video models? Our analysis shows that anchor aesthetic and quality scores are weakly correlated with downstream video quality. The structure-and-texture score is negatively correlated with I2V video quality in both the visual and motion dimensions. Fine-tuning the T2I model on an image reward accordingly yields anchors with visibly denser structural and character detail: they score higher on image metrics, yet lower the video reward on every I2V model we test and change downstream motion unpredictably. We therefore introduce Golden Anchor Learning (GAL), to our knowledge the first framework for learning golden anchors by optimizing a T2I generator with downstream video feedback. GAL evaluates candidate anchors through the videos they induce under a frozen I2V model and converts video rewards into image-level preferences for DPO fine-tuning of the T2I generator. On all four I2V models, GAL raises the VBench average by $2.97\%$--$8.46\%$ over the untuned generator. The rendered clips also score higher under VideoReward-Overall, and their extracted frames under HPSv3 and UniPercept. GAL yields consistent motion gains across all four I2V models, as measured by a $5.62\%$--$38.24\%$ increase in VBench dynamic degree. Although GAL is trained only on HunyuanVideo-1.5 renders, these gains extend to the other three I2V models.
papers.comment: 22 pages (including references and appendices), 3 figures, 8 tables

papers.title: Monarch-MoE: Structured Experts for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Learning new tasks in multimodal continual instruction tuning can cause catastrophic forgetting of previously acquired knowledge. Although multi-expert LoRA distributes learning across experts, updates to a dense low-rank expert can still affect many output features. We introduce Monarch-MoE, which replaces the dense factors in LoRA experts with block-diagonal factors connected by a fixed permutation. This structure provides blockwise gradient isolation: individual block-pair updates affect only one output block, while connections between all input and output blocks are maintained. To make these compact experts practical on memory-limited hardware, we combine batched computation, fused forward operators, and an optimized backward pass. Across three continual-learning methods evaluated on MLLM-DCL and UCIT with LLaVA-1.5-7B, Monarch-MoE improves first-task retention while reducing adapter parameters by approximately 75% and 50%, respectively. In the main comparison, first-task forgetting is as low as 0.52 percentage points on MLLM-DCL and 0.10 on UCIT, with method-dependent trade-offs in final performance. Our implementation supports fine-tuning and inference on a single 24 GB RTX 4090, with lower measured memory use and competitive runtime in the evaluated settings. Together, these algorithmic and systems improvements make structured experts a practical option for continual adaptation on memory-limited hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Monarch-MoE 把多专家 LoRA 中的稠密低秩因子换成块对角因子加固定置换，实现块级梯度隔离：单个块对更新只影响一个输出块，同时保留全部输入输出块之间的连接。在 MLLM-DCL 与 UCIT 上用 LLaVA-1.5-7B 跨三种持续学习方法评测，首任务遗忘分别低至 0.52 与 0.10 个百分点，适配器参数量约减少 75% 与 50%，可在单张 24 GB RTX 4090 上微调与推理。
Motivation: 多模态持续指令微调会灾难性遗忘已学知识；多专家 LoRA 虽把学习分散到各专家，但稠密低秩专家的一次更新仍会影响大量输出特征。
Method: 用块对角因子加固定置换替换 LoRA 专家中的稠密因子，获得块级梯度隔离；配合批量计算、融合前向算子与优化的反向传播，使紧凑专家能在显存受限硬件上运行。
Result: 在 MLLM-DCL 与 UCIT（LLaVA-1.5-7B、三种持续学习方法）上，首任务遗忘分别低至 0.52 与 0.10 个百分点，适配器参数量约减少 75% 与 50%；最终性能存在方法依赖的取舍。实现可在单张 24 GB RTX 4090 上完成微调与推理，实测显存更低、运行时间有竞争力。
Conclusion: 结构化专家（块对角 + 固定置换）连同算子级优化，使持续适应在显存受限硬件上成为可行选项，代价是最终性能随所选持续学习方法而异。

papers.title: Beyond Actions: Learning Future Operation Targets for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Actions specify what a robot should execute, but do not describe what those commands will achieve. Vision-language-action (VLA) policies nevertheless learn primarily by predicting action chunks from images, language, and state. We introduce Action--Future Coupled Effect Learning (AFCE), which makes a future-grounded physical Effect the policy's primary prediction target. An offline tokenizer constructs temporally ordered Effect tokens from demonstrated actions, realized robot responses, and sparse visual transitions. Reconstruction objectives encourage the representation to retain executable detail and observed physical change. A flow-matching VLA predicts Effects from current images, instruction, and robot state, while a state-conditioned decoder converts them into action chunks. Embodiment-specific interfaces allow single- and dual-arm tasks to share the Effect model. On DexJoCo, AFCE achieves $50.97\%$ overall success, improving over $π_{0.5}$ and UVT by 11.82 and 15.21 percentage points, respectively. It leads on all five bimanual tasks, highlighting the value of Effect supervision for coordinated dexterous manipulation. The project page is available at https://afceproject.github.io/AFCE-Web/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AFCE 把未来物理 Effect 而非动作块作为 VLA 的主预测目标：离线 tokenizer 从演示动作、机器人响应与稀疏视觉过渡构造时序 Effect token，flow-matching 模型预测 Effect 后由状态条件解码器还原动作块。在 DexJoCo 上整体成功率 50.97%，比 π₀.₅ 和 UVT 分别高 11.82 与 15.21 个百分点，并在全部五项双臂任务上领先。
Motivation: 动作只说明机器人执行什么，不说明这些指令会达成什么；VLA 却主要靠从图像、语言和状态回归动作块来学，缺少对执行结果的直接监督。
Method: 离线 tokenizer 从演示动作、实现的机器人响应和稀疏视觉过渡中构造时序有序的 Effect token，并用重构目标保留可执行细节与观测到的物理变化；flow-matching VLA 从当前图像、指令和机器人状态预测 Effect，状态条件解码器再把 Effect 转成动作块；通过 embodiment-specific 接口让单臂与双臂任务共享同一 Effect 模型。
Result: 在 DexJoCo 上 AFCE 整体成功率 50.97%，较 π₀.₅ 高 11.82 个百分点、较 UVT 高 15.21 个百分点；在五项双臂 (bimanual) 任务上全部领先。
Conclusion: 以 Effect 作为主监督目标能提升协调灵巧操作，双臂任务上的全面领先说明 Effect 监督对协同操作的价值。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Verifiable Sampling for Delegated Generative Quantum Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Generative machine learning has shown remarkable results across a wide range of interdisciplinary tasks, motivating significant efforts toward Quantum Generative Models as a path to beyond-classical performance, given their capability of generating classically intractable distributions. However, comparatively little attention has been paid to securely delegating such computations to a powerful remote quantum server. In this work, we propose a blind and verifiable protocol for sampling that can be used for the inference phase of such quantum models. Such a protocol inherits blindness from Universal Blind Quantum Computing and achieves verifiability by exploiting known approaches based on trapification schemes. Alongside, to delegate the training phase, we discuss an extension of the previously proposed verifiable end-to-end Delegated Variational Quantum Algorithms (Inajetovic et al., Phys. Rev. Research, 2026). Beyond the usual Accept/Abort outcome characterizing verification protocols, the sampling protocol for inference also provides, even against a malicious server, an estimation of the amount of corrupted generated samples, i.e., a fine-grained feature describing the quality of the outcome connecting verification protocols and application-level benchmarking.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Quantum Artificial Intelligence (QAI 2026). \c{opyright} 2026 IEEE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个用于量子生成模型推理阶段的盲且可验证的采样委托协议：盲性继承自 Universal Blind Quantum Computing，可验证性来自 trapification 方案，并给出训练阶段的可验证端到端委托变分量子算法扩展。协议除常规 Accept/Abort 外，即使面对恶意服务器也能估计被污染生成样本的数量，把验证协议与应用级质量度量连起来。
Motivation: 量子生成模型被寄望于产生经典难解分布，但把这类计算安全地委托给强大的远程量子服务器几乎无人处理，推理与训练阶段都缺少既盲又可验证的委托手段。
Method: 推理阶段用继承 Universal Blind Quantum Computing 盲性的采样协议，配合已有的 trapification 方案实现可验证性；训练阶段讨论对 Inajetovic 等人 (Phys. Rev. Research, 2026) 已提出的可验证端到端 Delegated Variational Quantum Algorithms 的扩展。
Result: 协议在恶意服务器下除 Accept/Abort 外还输出被污染生成样本数量的估计，作为一个细粒度质量特征，把验证协议与应用级 benchmarking 连接起来；论文为 6 页、1 图、1 表，发表于 IEEE QAI 2026。
Conclusion: 委托量子生成模型的推理与训练可以同时做到盲与可验证，且验证结果能从二值判定升级为对输出样本损坏程度的量化估计。

papers.title: How Much Computation Does Every Forecast Need? Structured Block Skipping in Two Time-Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Time-series foundation models use the same network depth for every input, although forecasting windows differ in structure and difficulty. We test whether whole Transformer blocks can be removed at inference time in two pretrained models: Chronos-Bolt and TimesFM 2.5. Our bypasses avoid the original block computation and preserve the dense model exactly when all blocks are enabled. Masks are selected only on calibration windows and evaluated on 1,088 held-out windows from ETTh1, Traffic, Weather, and Exchange. At moderate sparsity, Chronos-Bolt with 7/11 candidate blocks and TimesFM with 16/20 blocks show little change in mean relative forecasting quality across datasets while reducing median A100 batch-1 latency by 11.2% and 13.4%. More aggressive TimesFM skipping accelerates inference further but substantially harms Traffic and Weather. Across both models, different equal-budget masks win on different windows, and a retrospective oracle significantly improves over the best static mask on every dataset. However, dataset-specific masks transfer inconsistently, and Chronos representations do not support reliable unseen-domain routing. These results establish cross-architecture structured redundancy and input-dependent opportunity, but not a deployable dynamic inference method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Chronos-Bolt 与 TimesFM 2.5 两个时序基础模型上测试推理期整块跳过 (structured block skipping)：旁路在全开时精确还原稠密模型，掩码只在校准窗口上选择。中等稀疏度下（Chronos-Bolt 7/11、TimesFM 16/20 候选块）各数据集平均相对预报质量几乎不变，A100 batch-1 中位延迟分别降 11.2% 与 13.4%；更激进的 TimesFM 跳过加速更多但明显损害 Traffic 与 Weather。
Motivation: 时序基础模型对每个输入用相同网络深度，而预报窗口的结构与难度差异很大，固定深度意味着大量算力被浪费在简单窗口上。
Method: 对两个预训练模型 Chronos-Bolt 与 TimesFM 2.5 做推理期整块旁路，旁路绕开原块计算且全开时与稠密模型完全一致；掩码仅在校准窗口上选择，再在 1,088 个留出窗口上评测，覆盖 ETTh1、Traffic、Weather、Exchange 四个数据集。
Result: 中等稀疏度下 Chronos-Bolt 用 7/11 候选块、TimesFM 用 16/20 块，各数据集平均相对预报质量变化很小，同时 A100 batch-1 中位延迟分别降低 11.2% 与 13.4%；更激进的 TimesFM 跳过进一步加速但显著损害 Traffic 与 Weather。两个模型上不同等预算掩码在不同窗口胜出，回溯 oracle 在每个数据集上都显著优于最佳静态掩码；数据集特定掩码迁移不一致，Chronos 表示无法支撑可靠的未见域路由。
Conclusion: 跨架构存在结构冗余且跳过收益随输入而变，但现有证据只支持静态掩码与输入依赖机会，尚不构成可部署的动态推理方法。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Rethinking Relative Policy Differences Transfer of On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a target policy on its own rollouts using token-level supervision from a stronger teacher, but typically relies on the teacher being substantially more capable than the target. Recent work relaxes this requirement by transferring the relative policy difference between an expert and a reference policy rather than the expert's absolute distribution. Yet it remains unclear which differences provide useful supervision and which targets can benefit from them. We develop a unified view in which the log-probability ratio between a proxy expert and a proxy reference defines an implicit reward for KL-regularized policy optimization. This formulation induces an on-policy update for the target, recovers conventional OPD as a special case, and enables any-to-any transfer across models that differ in scale, training stage or generation. Our systematic experiments yield three findings. First, a stronger expert is not necessarily a better source of supervision: differences induced by task-specific training, including reinforcement learning and supervised fine-tuning, transfer consistently, whereas those arising from model scale alone transfer weakly or not at all. Second, the expert and reference serve complementary roles: the expert provides the capability to be transferred, while the reference filters out shared behavior and isolates the relevant residual. Third, even a useful difference does not transfer to every target: success requires the induced update to move the target toward the expert and generalize beyond sampled rollouts. Raw policy distance does not predict transferability, whereas an appropriate reference can rescue otherwise unsuccessful transfer. These results characterize when relative policy differences provide effective supervision for OPD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 on-policy distillation 中代理专家与代理参考之间的对数概率比解释为 KL 正则策略优化的隐式奖励，由此得到可跨规模、跨训练阶段、跨生成方式的 any-to-any 蒸馏更新，并把常规 OPD 作为特例。系统实验给出三条判据：由任务特定训练（RL、SFT）诱导的策略差异能稳定迁移，仅由模型规模诱导的差异迁移很弱或不迁移；合适的参考可以挽救原本失败的迁移，而原始策略距离不能预测可迁移性。
Motivation: 现有 on-policy distillation 通常要求教师显著强于目标，而近期转述相对策略差异的做法尚不清楚哪些差异能提供有用监督、哪些目标能从中受益。
Method: 以代理专家与代理参考之间的 log-probability ratio 定义 KL 正则策略优化下的隐式奖励，诱导出目标的 on-policy 更新，把常规 OPD 收为特例，从而支持跨规模、跨训练阶段、跨生成方式的 any-to-any 迁移；并用系统实验比较由 RL、SFT、模型规模等不同来源诱导的策略差异。
Result: 三条发现：任务特定训练（RL 与 SFT）诱导的差异迁移一致，仅由模型规模诱导的差异迁移弱或不迁移；专家提供被迁移的能力、参考滤除共享行为并隔离残差；有用差异也并非对所有目标可迁移，成功要求诱导更新把目标推向专家且能泛化到采样 rollout 之外，原始策略距离不预测可迁移性，而合适的参考可挽救原本失败的迁移。
Conclusion: 相对策略差异能否作为 OPD 监督取决于差异来源与参考的选择，而非专家与目标之间的原始距离；选参考时应看它能否隔离出推动目标向专家靠拢并可泛化的残差。

papers.title: S$^3$R: Fast and Faithful RL Rollouts via Self-Sparse Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Fast rollout generation for long-context reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) requires reducing KV-cache traffic without changing the response groups used for policy optimization. In our profiled RLVR workloads, attention accounts for 72--76\% of autoregressive decoding kernel time. Sparse attention reduces these reads, but sampling directly from a sparse policy changes the response groups used for learning. For group-relative optimization, we show that even exact response-wise reweighting does not generally recover the expected dense-policy update because the advantage of each response depends on the rewards of other group members. We propose Self-Sparse Speculative Rollouts (S$^3$R). It uses sparse attention to propose tokens, then generates responses through full-attention verification and exact speculative sampling. Drafting and verification share the same policy parameter, eliminating the need to train or update a separate drafter. The resulting response groups follow the dense-policy distribution. Under S$^3$R, we characterize speedup conditions and the costs of drafting and verification. We found that dense verification still requires the complete historical KV cache. A KV-aware scheduler therefore limits KV-cache repeated offloading and restoration while maintaining rollout parallelism. % OR thrashing In a matched ablation with an aggressive sparse drafting budget, S$^3$R maintains stable training while direct sparse sampling with training-side correction becomes unstable. On long-context mathematical reasoning, S$^3$R achieves $1.39\times~1.35\times$ the end-to-end training throughput of autoregressive rollouts on Qwen3 model, with comparable task performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: S$^3$R 用稀疏注意力起草、全注意力验证加精确投机采样做 RLVR rollout，使响应组严格服从 dense-policy 分布，从而不改变 group-relative 优化所用的响应组。在长上下文数学推理上，Qwen3 端到端训练吞吐达到自回归 rollout 的 1.39×~1.35×，任务性能相当；激进稀疏预算下训练稳定，而直接稀疏采样加训练侧修正会不稳定。
Motivation: 长上下文 RLVR 的瓶颈在 KV-cache 流量：attention 占自回归解码 kernel 时间的 72–76%。但直接从稀疏策略采样会改变 group-relative 优化依赖的响应组，且逐响应精确重加权也无法还原 dense-policy 更新，因为每条响应的 advantage 取决于组内其他成员的奖励。
Method: Self-Sparse Speculative Rollouts (S$^3$R)：稀疏注意力提出 token，再用全注意力验证与精确投机采样生成响应；起草与验证共享同一策略参数，无需训练独立 drafter。另配 KV-aware 调度器，限制 KV-cache 反复 offload 与恢复，同时保持 rollout 并行度。
Result: profiled RLVR 负载中 attention 占自回归解码 kernel 时间 72–76%。长上下文数学推理上，Qwen3 端到端训练吞吐为自回归 rollout 的 1.39×~1.35×，任务性能相当。匹配消融中，激进稀疏起草预算下 S$^3$R 训练稳定，而直接稀疏采样加训练侧修正不稳定。
Conclusion: 在稀疏起草与全注意力验证之间共享同一策略参数，可以在不改变 dense-policy 响应组的前提下加速 RLVR rollout；但 dense 验证仍需完整历史 KV cache，必须靠 KV-aware 调度控制 offload 开销。

papers.title: Does Learning Recurrent Networks Matter in Partially Observable RL?
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) under partial observability typically re- lies on recurrent networks to encode temporal information, with the recurrent module trained jointly with the policy or value function. This raises a natural question: is learning the recurrent network actually necessary? In this paper, we investigate whether a frozen recurrent network can provide sufficient memory for solving par- tially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs). Motivated by the theoretical foundations of Reservoir Computing (RC) and Generalized Reservoir Computing (GRC), we study a simple archi- tecture that combines a fixed recurrent network with a trainable nonlinear output module. We evaluate this approach across tasks with varying memory demands, observation modalities, and action spaces. Surprisingly, frozen recurrent networks support recall over hundreds of steps and achieve competitive control performance across diverse POMDPs, while using less than half the number of trainable parameters required by their fully trainable counterparts. These results suggest that learning the recurrent memory module is not always necessary for solving POMDPs. Frozen recurrent networks therefore provide a simple, parameter-efficient, and sur- prisingly strong baseline for partially observable RL. Our source code is available at https://github.com/Aphlios/FRN-POMDP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在部分可观测 RL (POMDP) 中，把循环记忆网络整体冻结、只训练非线性输出模块（受 Reservoir Computing / GRC 启发），仍能支持数百步的记忆回溯，并在多种 POMDP 上取得与全可训练循环网络相当的控制性能，可训练参数不到后者的一半。结论是：学习循环记忆模块对解 POMDP 并非总是必要。
Motivation: 部分可观测 RL 通常把循环模块与策略/值函数联合训练，训练成本高且参数多；作者追问冻结的循环网络是否已提供足够记忆，以判断学习记忆模块本身是否必要。
Method: 采用固定随机初始化的循环网络 + 可训练非线性输出模块的架构，理论动机来自 Reservoir Computing (RC) 与 Generalized Reservoir Computing (GRC)；在记忆需求、观测模态、动作空间各不相同的多类 POMDP 任务上评测，并与完全可训练的循环网络对照可训练参数量。
Result: 冻结循环网络支持跨越数百步 (hundreds of steps) 的记忆回溯，在多样 POMDP 上达到有竞争力的控制性能，同时可训练参数量不到完全可训练对应模型的一半 (less than half)。
Conclusion: 学习循环记忆模块并非解 POMDP 的必要条件，冻结循环网络可作为部分可观测 RL 中简单、参数高效且表现强劲的基线。

papers.title: JANUS: Enhancing Long-Horizon Autonomous Research with Co-Evolving World Models
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon autonomous research has shown promise in accelerating scientific progress through sustained cycles of hypothesis generation, implementation, and validation. However, this Generate-Execute-Feedback paradigm relies on reactive trial-and-error, where costly and time-consuming executions introduce severe feedback delays, throttling evolutionary progress under explosively expanding search space. To address this challenge, we propose JANUS, a framework that unifies future outcomes forecasting and past experience reflection through a Predict-Verify-Evolve loop driven by a co-evolving world model. Within an evolving graph, the research agent proposes candidates while world model scores them by forecasting value improvement, information gain, and exploration utility, then accordingly selects, refines, or prunes branches prior to execution. After receiving ground-truth feedback, JANUS distills experience into evolving skills: hierarchical skills for research agent, exploration-strategy skills for world model, and their coordination protocols. This mechanism enables continual co-evolution: the research agent sharpens candidate generation while the world model refines its predictive judgment over extended horizons. Extensive evaluations on MLS-Bench-Lite and real research tasks demonstrate that JANUS significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving both higher evolving efficiency and ceiling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JANUS 用协同演化的世界模型把长周期自主科研从「生成-执行-反馈」的被动试错改为 Predict-Verify-Evolve 循环：世界模型在执行前按价值提升、信息增益与探索效用给候选打分，据此选择、精炼或剪枝分支，执行后再把经验蒸馏成分层技能与探索策略技能。在 MLS-Bench-Lite 与真实科研任务上，该框架相对最先进基线同时取得更高的演化效率与演化上限。
Motivation: 长周期自主科研依赖昂贵且滞后的执行反馈，试错式 Generate-Execute-Feedback 在搜索空间爆炸式扩张时演化进展被反馈延迟拖慢。
Method: JANUS 在演化图 (evolving graph) 上运行 Predict-Verify-Evolve 循环：科研 agent 提出候选，世界模型预测其价值提升、信息增益与探索效用来打分并决定选择/精炼/剪枝；拿到真实反馈后把经验蒸馏为三类演化技能——科研 agent 的分层技能、世界模型的探索策略技能，以及两者的协调协议，使双方持续协同演化。
Result: 在 MLS-Bench-Lite 与真实科研任务上的评测中，JANUS 显著优于最先进基线，同时取得更高的演化效率 (evolving efficiency) 与演化上限 (evolving ceiling)。
Conclusion: 用可预测执行结果的世界模型在执行前筛选分支、并把反馈蒸馏为技能，能让科研 agent 与世界模型协同演化，从而突破被动试错的效率与上限瓶颈。

papers.title: Prediction-Informed Landing Window Planning for UAV Landing on USV in High Sea States
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous landing of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) on unmanned surface vehicle (USV) is difficult in high sea states. Existing hierarchical landing methods often infer future USV motion only implicitly from short observation histories, which limits their ability to adapt to severe and rapidly changing sea conditions. This paper presents a prediction-informed hierarchical control framework. A pretrained model is developed to explicitly predict the USV attitude during high-level landing decisions. The prediction helps identify suitable landing windows and choose the right touchdown time, while a conventional low-level flight controller maintains UAV stability and tracks motion commands. To evaluate the framework under realistic disturbances, a real-sim validation setup is constructed in which USV-motion data collected in real sea conditions are transferred to a MuJoCo USV. The experiments demonstrate the feasibility of using explicit attitude prediction to improve landing-window selection and support timing-aware UAV landing planning in rapidly varying marine environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出预测引导的分层着陆框架：用预训练模型显式预测高海况下 USV 的姿态，据此挑选着陆窗口与触地时刻，底层常规飞控负责稳定与跟踪。real-sim 验证把真实海况采集的 USV 运动数据迁移到 MuJoCo USV，实验表明显式姿态预测可改进着陆窗口选择、支撑时序感知的着陆规划。
Motivation: 现有分层着陆方法只从短观测历史隐式推断 USV 未来运动，难以适应剧烈且快速变化的海况，高海况下 UAV 在 USV 上自主着陆因此受限。
Method: 分层控制框架：高层用预训练模型显式预测 USV 姿态以确定合适着陆窗口与触地时间，底层用常规飞行控制器维持 UAV 稳定并跟踪运动指令；评估采用 real-sim 设置，把真实海况采集的 USV 运动数据迁移到 MuJoCo USV 上施加 realistic disturbances。
Result: 实验表明显式姿态预测可用于改进着陆窗口选择，并支持快速变化海洋环境下的时序感知 UAV 着陆规划；评估在迁移了真实海况 USV 运动数据的 MuJoCo USV 上进行。
Conclusion: 把 USV 姿态预测显式接入高层着陆决策，是高海况下可行的时序感知着陆规划路径，底层仍由常规飞控保证稳定。

papers.title: Destination-Conditioned Adaptation with Semantic-Geometric Alignment for Generative Inbetweening
papers.abstract_en: Generative inbetweening aims to synthesize temporally coherent intermediate frames between a start frame and a target frame. Although pretrained image-to-video diffusion models provide strong priors for large-motion inbetweening, they are not explicitly designed to reach a specified target frame. They may therefore generate realistic individual frames while drifting from the target or producing unstable motion under large displacements and non-rigid dynamics. We propose DSG-GI, a framework that adapts pretrained latent video diffusion models through \textbf{D}estination-Conditioned Adaptation and \textbf{S}emantic-\textbf{G}eometric Alignment. Destination-Conditioned Adaptation treats the target frame as the destination of the sequence and provides temporally progressive guidance along the generated trajectory. Semantic-Geometric Alignment aligns the token-wise spatio-temporal relational geometry of backbone features with that of a frozen video foundation encoder and applies a flow-matching-aware latent flow constraint to samples near the data endpoint of the probability path. Together, these components strengthen destination guidance and preserve coherent semantic-geometric motion structure. Extensive experiments on standard and large-motion inbetweening benchmarks demonstrate improvements in temporal stability, target-frame faithfulness, and perceptual quality. Our code will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DSG-GI 用目标帧条件化适配预训练 latent video diffusion 模型做生成式中间帧插值 (generative inbetweening)：把目标帧当作序列终点给出沿轨迹渐进的时间引导，并用语义-几何对齐把 backbone 特征的 token 级时空关系几何对齐到冻结的 video foundation encoder，再加 flow-matching-aware 潜空间流约束。在标准与大位移 inbetweening benchmark 上提升了时间稳定性、目标帧忠实度与感知质量。
Motivation: 预训练 image-to-video diffusion 模型有强先验但未被显式设计为到达指定目标帧，大位移与非刚性运动下容易偏离目标或产生不稳定运动。
Method: Destination-Conditioned Adaptation 把目标帧作为序列终点，沿生成轨迹提供时间渐进引导；Semantic-Geometric Alignment 对齐 backbone 特征与冻结 video foundation encoder 的 token 级时空关系几何，并对概率路径数据端附近的样本施加 flow-matching-aware latent flow 约束。
Result: 在标准与大位移 (large-motion) inbetweening benchmark 上，时间稳定性、目标帧忠实度与感知质量均有提升；代码将公开。
Conclusion: 把目标帧当作终点做条件化适配并同时约束语义-几何结构，可缓解视频扩散插帧偏离目标与运动不稳的问题。

papers.title: WaSA: Wavelet Scattering Autoencoders for Unsupervised Offline Detection of Malicious Clients in Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative model training without exposing raw data, yet remains vulnerable to malicious clients injecting poisoned datasets. Existing defenses are typically reactive (operating during training) or supervised (requiring prior knowledge of attack types) - assumptions that rarely hold in open-ended IoT deployments. We propose WaSA, a fully unsupervised, offline framework for malicious client detection. Before training, each client transmits a single, privacy-preserving spectral summary of its data to the server. A denoising autoencoder, trained solely on clean auxiliary data, scores clients based on their deviation from the learned benign manifold, identifying corruptions regardless of the attack type. WaSA requires no attack labels, generalizes to unseen anomalies, and introduces a Boltzmann sampling strategy for client selection that smoothly interpolates between hard exclusion and standard aggregation. Experiments on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100 under diverse attack scenarios (up to 90 % malicious clients) demonstrate consistent improvements over supervised baselines and robust aggregation methods, with negligible communication overhead. Code is available at https://github.com/alelicciardi99/wavelet_autoencoders_malicious.
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE International Conference on Omni-Layer Intelligent Systems (COINS) 2026, Bologna, Italy; September 7-9, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WaSA 在联邦学习训练前，让每个客户端只上传一份隐私保护的频谱摘要，用仅在干净辅助数据上训练的去噪自编码器按偏离良性流形的程度给客户端打分，从而无监督、离线地检出投毒客户端。在 MNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 上最多 90% 恶意客户端的多种攻击场景中，一致优于有监督基线与鲁棒聚合方法，通信开销可忽略。
Motivation: 联邦学习易受恶意客户端注入投毒数据攻击，而现有防御要么在训练中被动响应，要么需要攻击类型先验知识，这在开放式 IoT 部署中很少成立。
Method: 训练前每个客户端向服务器发送单份隐私保护的频谱摘要；用仅在干净辅助数据上训练的去噪自编码器 (denoising autoencoder)，按样本偏离学到的良性流形的程度给客户端打分，不依赖攻击标签；另引入 Boltzmann 采样策略选择客户端，在硬排除与标准聚合之间平滑插值。
Result: 在 MNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 上、恶意客户端比例最高达 90% 的多种攻击场景中，一致优于有监督基线与鲁棒聚合方法，通信开销可忽略；无需攻击标签并能泛化到未见过的异常。
Conclusion: 训练前的单次频谱摘要加无监督流形偏离打分，足以在不预知攻击类型的情况下检出投毒客户端，且通信代价可忽略。

papers.title: AdaC-GRPO: Towards Mastering Long-Horizon Visual Sudoku Puzzles via Adaptive Curriculum Learning
papers.abstract_en: While reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR) enhances reasoning in large language models, its efficacy in long-horizon multimodal tasks remains underexplored. Visual Sudoku puzzles pose a representative challenge, requiring multi-step deductive reasoning over both local constraints and global dependency chains. To this end, we introduce FG-Sudoku, a fine-grained benchmark categorized by grid size and required deductive steps. Evaluations reveal that frontier MLLMs fail on complex long-range dependencies (e.g., 9*9 puzzles). During post-training, this near-zero success rate causes severe reward sparsity, halting standard RLVR. We propose Adaptive Curriculum Group Relative Policy Optimization (AdaC-GRPO) to overcome this. Unlike rigid or prior-based schedules, AdaC-GRPO dynamically constructs training batches by tracking the model's "Zone of Proximal Development" via online rollout accuracy. Experiments demonstrate that AdaC-GRPO enables Qwen2.5-VL-7B to approach the performance of Gemini-2.5-Flash while bridging 62.2% of the overall accuracy gap to Gemini-2.5-Pro, with its generalizability further validated across InternVL-3.5 and Qwen3-VL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdaC-GRPO 用在线 rollout 准确率追踪模型的“最近发展区”动态构造训练批次，缓解长时程视觉数独上 RLVR 因近零成功率导致的奖励稀疏。Qwen2.5-VL-7B 训练后接近 Gemini-2.5-Flash，并弥合了与 Gemini-2.5-Pro 整体准确率差距的 62.2%。
Motivation: RLVR 在长时程多模态任务上效果未充分验证：FG-Sudoku 上 9×9 等复杂长程依赖使前沿 MLLM 成功率近零，奖励稀疏让标准 RLVR 训练停滞。
Method: 提出 AdaC-GRPO：不同于固定或基于先验的课程调度，按在线 rollout 准确率跟踪“最近发展区”动态构造训练批次；配套发布按网格规模与所需演绎步数分级的 FG-Sudoku 基准，并在 InternVL-3.5 与 Qwen3-VL 上验证泛化性。
Result: FG-Sudoku 评测显示前沿 MLLM 在 9×9 等复杂长程依赖上失败，后训练成功率近零导致奖励稀疏；AdaC-GRPO 使 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 接近 Gemini-2.5-Flash，并弥合与 Gemini-2.5-Pro 整体准确率差距的 62.2%，泛化性在 InternVL-3.5 与 Qwen3-VL 上得到验证。
Conclusion: 按最近发展区自适应排课可让 7B 级 MLLM 在长时程视觉演绎任务上跨过奖励稀疏门槛，逼近更大闭源模型。

papers.title: MixTok: Adaptive Visual Tokenization with Global 1D Tokens and Sparse 2D Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Efficient visual tokenization requires balancing representation compactness with the preservation of fine-grained image content. Conventional grid-based tokenizers allocate tokens uniformly across spatial locations despite non-uniform visual complexity, whereas compact 1D tokenizers aggregate global information but can struggle to preserve local details. We introduce MixTok, a hybrid visual tokenizer that combines a compact 1D global representation with sparse 2D tokens for local refinement. A content-adaptive router ranks candidate locations by refinement priority and determines the number of 2D tokens for each image under a target average token budget. At the highest-scoring locations, 2D token features replace the spatial features recovered from the 1D representation, and a shared decoder reconstructs the image from the resulting mixed features. On ImageNet 256 x 256, MixTok achieves highly competitive reconstruction and generation performance, with an rFID of 1.195 and a gFID of 1.95 at respective average budgets of approximately 128 and 131 content tokens per image.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MixTok 提出混合视觉 tokenizer：用紧凑 1D 全局 token 承载整图信息，再由内容自适应路由器按精修优先级排序候选位置、在目标平均 token 预算下决定每图 2D token 数量，用稀疏 2D token 在最高分位置替换从 1D 表示恢复的空间特征，最后共享解码器重建。在 ImageNet 256×256 上以约 128 与 131 个内容 token 的平均预算取得 rFID 1.195、gFID 1.95。
Motivation: 网格 tokenizer 在视觉复杂度非均匀时仍均匀分配 token，浪费预算；紧凑 1D tokenizer 压缩率高却难以保留局部细节，需要在紧凑性与细粒度内容之间做内容自适应的取舍。
Method: 混合结构：1D 全局表示 + 稀疏 2D 局部精修 token；内容自适应路由器 (content-adaptive router) 按精修优先级对候选位置排序，并在目标平均 token 预算下决定每图 2D token 数；在最高分位置用 2D token 特征替换由 1D 表示恢复的空间特征，共享解码器从混合特征重建图像。
Result: 在 ImageNet 256×256 上，平均预算约 128 个内容 token 时 rFID 为 1.195，平均预算约 131 个内容 token 时 gFID 为 1.95，重建与生成性能被评为 highly competitive。
Conclusion: 把全局 1D 压缩与按内容分配的稀疏 2D 精修结合，可在约 128–131 token 的低预算下同时保住重建与生成质量，token 分配应随图像内容而非固定网格走。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: High-Throughput Generative Video Super-Resolution on a Single Consumer GPU
papers.abstract_en: Generative video super-resolution (VSR) can recover visually compelling high-frequency detail by leveraging diffusion priors, but iterative sampling and heavy spatio-temporal coupling make practical deployments difficult. We study a different operating point: practical HD generative VSR on a single high-end consumer GPU without end-to-end retraining. To this end, we present a zero-shot framework built entirely from pretrained components. The proposed system decouples spatial enhancement from temporal stabilization. A time-distilled one-step diffusion backbone handles spatial upscaling, while temporal coherence is promoted by a lightweight pretrained flow-based interpolator that synthesizes intermediate frames between super-resolved keyframes. To further improve scalability, we introduce a resolution-aware hybrid attention scheme that, in a zero-shot manner, replaces selected high-resolution global-attention layers with neighborhood attention while preserving global attention in semantically critical low-resolution layers, while also improving temporal consistency. Experiments show that the proposed framework reaches up to ~32 FPS at 720p resolution under interleaved inference on a single NVIDIA RTX 4090. At 4K, the proposed attention substitution can yield up to a 44% speedup over the original attention implementation. Across standard VSR benchmarks, the method consistently shifts the speed-quality trade-off decisively toward runtime efficiency, trading reconstruction fidelity for strong no-reference perceptual quality, while remaining reasonably competitive against generative approaches in temporal consistency. It also exposes clear limitations in handling more challenging motion, which a simple motion gate partially mitigates. Code will be released upon acceptance.

papers.title: CompactSplat: Spatially Adaptive Gaussian Distribution for Feedforward Scene Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing 3D scenes from sparse views without per-scene optimization remains highly challenging, especially for recovering accurate geometry and fine textures. While recent feedforward approaches leverage generalizable 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) for scene generation, they typically assign one or multiple Gaussians to each pixel. Such uniform allocation not only produces highly redundant representations by wasting primitives in homogeneous areas, but also fails to exploit the inherent geometric priors of planar surfaces, often resulting in sub-optimal structural modeling. To address these limitations, we present CompactSplat, a novel feedforward framework that enables a content-aware allocation of 3D Gaussians. By integrating texture-guided spatial partitioning with hierarchical sampling, CompactSplat adaptively distributes primitives - concentrating dense Gaussians in complex regions while tiling flat areas with expanded, scale-modulated primitives. Moreover, our framework inherently supports dynamic sparsity control at inference time, enabling seamless trade-offs between rendering fidelity and memory footprint without requiring network retraining. Extensive experiments on RealEstate10K, DL3DV, and ScanNet demonstrate that CompactSplat consistently outperforms prior methods on both standard metrics and high-resolution rendering consistency, achieving high-fidelity reconstructions with significantly fewer primitives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CompactSplat 把前馈 3D Gaussian Splatting 的逐像素均匀高斯分配改成内容感知分配：复杂区域密集布点，平坦区域用放大的尺度调制高斯铺面。在 RealEstate10K、DL3DV、ScanNet 上以显著更少的 primitive 持续超过既有方法，并可在推理时动态调节稀疏度，无需重训网络即可在渲染保真度与显存占用之间取舍。
Motivation: 稀疏视角前馈重建中逐像素（或每像素多个）高斯既在同质区域浪费 primitive，又用不上平面几何先验，导致结构建模次优、表示冗余。
Method: CompactSplat 框架由纹理引导的空间划分 (texture-guided spatial partitioning) 与分层采样 (hierarchical sampling) 组成，自适应分配 3D 高斯：复杂区域集中密集高斯，平坦区域用放大的尺度调制 primitive 铺面；推理期支持动态稀疏度控制，无需重训网络。
Result: 在 RealEstate10K、DL3DV、ScanNet 上，标准指标与高分辨率渲染一致性均持续优于先前方法，同时以显著更少的 primitive 达到高保真重建；推理时可在渲染保真度与显存占用之间平滑取舍。
Conclusion: 把高斯分配从逐像素均匀改为按内容与平面几何先验自适应，是前馈稀疏视角重建同时压缩 primitive 数量与保持保真度的有效路径。

papers.title: Fix the Match, Not the Solver: STITCH -- a Self-Supervised Compatibility Measure for Eroded Visual Puzzles
papers.abstract_en: Unlike the clean and pixel-aligned complete pieces of standard jigsaw benchmarks, real-world puzzle fragments lose their boundary regions to erosion, destroying the signal that classical compatibility measures (CMs) rely on. We first re-establish, via oracle experiments, that the CM, not the solver, is the performance bottleneck: with a perfect CM, even a simple greedy solver achieves perfect reconstruction. This motivates STITCH, a self-supervised CM that sidesteps missing boundaries by comparing frozen ViT patch tokens from piece interiors via a lightweight cross-attention head (~249K trainable parameters), trained without manual annotation. Plugged into unchanged compatibility-based solvers, STITCH reaches .992/.954 Abs/Perf on JPwLEG-5 (+.629 Perf over the best prior method), nearly saturating the benchmark. On a new ImageNet 7x7 benchmark, it outperforms all alternatives, including inpaint-then-match pipelines built on modern generative models. Importantly, performance remains robust across erosion levels and generalizes to puzzles with over 40% missing pieces without retraining. Trained on the recent GAP datasets of irregular, heavily eroded fragments, the same CM recipe enables compatibility-based solvers to surpass recent learning-based solvers on GAP-3 and GAP-5. Since this leap in performance is achieved by a pluggable CM module, the takeaway is clear: fix the match, not the solver.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STITCH 是一个自监督的拼图兼容性度量 (compatibility measure)，用冻结 ViT 的碎片内部 patch token 加轻量 cross-attention 头替代依赖完整边界的匹配信号，可直接插入现有兼容性求解器。在 JPwLEG-5 上达到 .992/.954 Abs/Perf，Perf 比此前最佳方法高 +.629；在 GAP-3 与 GAP-5 上使兼容性求解器超过近期基于学习的求解器。
Motivation: 真实拼图碎片会因侵蚀丢失边界区域，经典兼容性度量 (CM) 依赖的对齐信号被破坏；oracle 实验表明瓶颈在 CM 而非求解器——CM 完美时简单贪心求解器即可完美重建。
Method: STITCH 用冻结 ViT 的碎片内部 patch token 做比较，通过一个约 249K 可训练参数的轻量 cross-attention 头输出兼容性分数，自监督训练、无需人工标注；随后作为可插拔模块接入不改动的兼容性求解器。
Result: 在 JPwLEG-5 上 .992/.954 Abs/Perf，Perf 较最佳既有方法 +.629，接近饱和；在新建的 ImageNet 7x7 基准上优于所有替代方案，包括基于现代生成模型的 inpaint-then-match 流水线；性能在不同侵蚀程度下保持稳健，并可泛化到缺失碎片超过 40% 的拼图而无需重训练；在 GAP-3 与 GAP-5 上，同一 CM 配方使兼容性求解器超过近期基于学习的求解器。
Conclusion: 性能跃升来自可插拔的 CM 模块而非求解器改造：修复匹配本身，而不是修求解器 (fix the match, not the solver)。

papers.title: PreCoG: Preview-Edit for Efficient Video Correction in Generation-Time
papers.abstract_en: Iterative text-to-video generation relies on feedback to correct compositional and temporal failures. However, existing methods typically require another full generation run for each correction, repeating computation and potentially disrupting already correct content. We introduce PreCoG, an iterative framework for correcting semantic failures during video generation. PreQA diagnoses failures from low-cost previews and constructs corrective conditions, while PreEdit edits cached generation trajectories under these conditions, attenuating orthogonal changes to limit disruption of already correct content. PreCoG completes generation only for the selected candidate, reusing its cached trajectory to reduce redundant computation and help preserve semantic consistency between the preview and the final video. Experiments show that PreCoG achieves the highest VBench and T2V-CompBench scores and approaches VSR's leading VS2 score at $0.56\times$ its inference time. It also outperforms GENMAC on all three quality and alignment metrics at $0.86\times$ its inference time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PreCoG 在文本到视频生成过程中用低成本预览诊断语义与时序失败，再在缓存的生成轨迹上做编辑式修正，只对选中的候选完成完整生成。它在 VBench 与 T2V-CompBench 上取得最高分，并以 VSR 0.56× 的推理时间接近其 VS2 领先水平，同时以 GENMAC 0.86× 的推理时间在三项质量与对齐指标上全部胜出。
Motivation: 迭代式文生视频的纠错通常要为每次修正重跑一遍完整生成，既重复计算，又可能破坏已经正确的内容。
Method: PreCoG 分两步：PreQA 从低成本 preview 诊断失败并构造纠正条件；PreEdit 在这些条件下编辑已缓存的生成轨迹，衰减正交变化以减少对正确内容的扰动，最后只对选中的候选完成生成并复用其缓存轨迹。
Result: 在 VBench 与 T2V-CompBench 上取得最高分；以 VSR 0.56× 的推理时间接近其领先的 VS2 分数；在三项质量与对齐指标上全部超过 GENMAC，推理时间为后者的 0.86×。
Conclusion: 在生成期用预览诊断加轨迹编辑来纠错，可以在保住语义一致性的同时省掉重复的完整生成开销。

papers.title: RoleWorld: Knowledge Transfer in World Modeling with Functional Role Abstractions
papers.abstract_en: World models enable large language model (LLM) agents to anticipate action effects and make informed decisions. For generalization, it is desirable for such world models to transfer efficiently to new environments with similar interaction structure and underlying dynamics. Recent approaches encode world dynamics as symbolic rules or executable programs, whose compositional structure in principle affords transfer, but still organize such knowledge around environment-specific objects. To address this limitation, we introduce RoleWorld, a symbolic world modeling approach which uses reusable prototypes and environment-specific parameter values as functional role abstractions to represent how objects behave in interactions. From interaction trajectories, a teacher LLM extracts role prototypes and executable transition rules defined over role instances, together with a skill that guides the actor LLM to use role information in decision making. In a target world, without the teacher, the actor uses this skill together with its current role assignments and parameter estimates, and actively tests a role instance hypothesis through interaction when its uncertainty affects the current decision. Feedback from each action refines role assignments and estimates parameter values online, with no LLM parameter updates and the transition rules held fixed. Experiments on MARS benchmark show that RoleWorld enables robust generalization across environments with significantly altered object behavior, suggesting that functional role abstractions can serve as an effective component for knowledge transfer in world modeling. Project Page: https://future-item.github.io/RoleWorld.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoleWorld 用功能角色抽象（可复用原型 + 环境相关参数值）替代以具体物体为中心的符号世界模型，使 LLM agent 在物体行为被显著改动的新环境中仍能迁移。教师 LLM 从交互轨迹抽取角色原型与可执行转移规则并生成决策技能，目标环境中 actor 无需教师、不更新 LLM 参数，靠交互在线精化角色分配与参数估计，必要时主动测试角色假设。
Motivation: 现有符号规则/程序化世界模型虽具组合结构，但知识仍绑定环境特有物体，迁移到交互结构相似而物体行为不同的新环境时效率低。
Method: 教师 LLM 从交互轨迹抽取角色原型与定义在角色实例上的可执行转移规则，并产出指导 actor 使用角色信息的技能；目标环境中 actor 结合当前角色分配与参数估计决策，当不确定性影响当前决策时主动交互测试角色假设，反馈在线更新分配与参数，转移规则固定且不更新 LLM 参数。
Result: 在 MARS benchmark 上，RoleWorld 在物体行为被显著改动的跨环境设置中实现稳健泛化。
Conclusion: 功能角色抽象可作为世界模型知识迁移的有效组件，通过在线交互精化即可跨环境泛化，无需教师或参数更新。

papers.title: Morphology-based retrieval of local wave parameters and phase shifts in satellite-observed atmospheric disturbances
papers.abstract_en: Currently available methods for processing atmospheric wave disturbances are often based on integral wavelet transform techniques, which efficiently estimate spectral data but are fundamentally limited by the uncertainty principle. To address this limitation, this work proposes a novel morphological approach based on partitioning spatial disturbance profiles into separate, well-defined wave segments. By focusing exclusively on the local waveform morphology of a central half-wave and its two adjacent out-of-phase counterparts, and taking the modified Morlet wavelet as a primary example of a model wave packet, we successfully reconstruct the complete set of local wave parameters directly from the amplitudes and positions of these three dominant half-waves. Consequently, the theory demonstrates good agreement with observations, confirming the high accuracy of the proposed waveform morphology approach in reconstructing the localized structure of atmospheric disturbances. When applied to evaluating the phase shift between different wave field components, the method reveals that this shift is a weighted combination of the classical monochromatic phase difference and a morphological one determined by the internal symmetry of the underlying wave packets. Although the classical factor yields the dominant contribution, the symmetry-related factor provides a moderate correction to it. The applicability and accuracy of the approach are verified using observational data gathered over several orbits of the low-Earth-orbit satellite Dynamic Explorer 2 as it passed over Earth's polar caps. The obtained results confirm that the observed disturbances correspond to medium-scale acoustic-gravity waves propagating at a small angle to the horizontal plane, demonstrating the broader methodological potential of the proposed technique for analyzing a wide range of wave phenomena.

papers.title: From Glance to Focus: Mitigating Recognition Laziness in MLLMs for Fine-Grained Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) generally fall short of expectations in Fine-Grained Visual Recognition (FGVR), although they exhibit promising FGVR foundations, i.e., visual perception and broad category knowledge. Most existing studies seek to remedy this deficiency by adopting domain-specific post-training, at the risk of compromising generalization to unseen domains. Different from these efforts, in this paper, we revisit the FGVR mechanism underlying MLLMs from both the empirical and theoretical perspectives and uncover an inference-time phenomenon termed FGVR Laziness. In brief, FGVR Laziness refers to the insufficient association between visual cues and category concepts under certain candidate category lists and recognition guidance, leaving the FGVR foundations of MLLMs largely under-utilized. To mitigate FGVR Laziness, we propose Laziness-resIstant Visual rEcognition (LIVE), a training-free framework which jointly refines candidate lists and recognition guidance to elicit the latent FGVR capability of MLLMs. Specifically, LIVE first performs query-adaptive candidate inference to derive a compact yet reliable candidate list. Meanwhile, LIVE constructs category-specific FGVR skills by mining the intra-category characteristics and inter-category differences. Finally, LIVE selectively invokes detailed skill guidance according to recognition uncertainty and category confusion, shifting MLLM-based FGVR from a cursory glance to a focus on associating discriminative visual cues with category concepts. Extensive experiments on 13 benchmarks against 24 state-of-the-art methods spanning fine-grained category recognition, action recognition, and general category recognition, verify the effectiveness and generalizability of LIVE across different MLLM backbones. The code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 18 figures, 5 tables. Includes supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出训练无关 (training-free) 框架 LIVE，通过查询自适应候选推断压缩候选列表、挖掘类内特征与类间差异构建类别专属 FGVR 技能，并按识别不确定性与类别混淆选择性注入技能引导，缓解 MLLM 的「FGVR Laziness」（视觉线索与类别概念关联不足）。在 13 个基准、对比 24 个 SOTA 方法上验证有效性与跨 MLLM backbone 的泛化性。
Motivation: MLLLM 在细粒度视觉识别 (FGVR) 上表现不及预期，主流补救依赖领域特定后训练，会牺牲对未见域的泛化能力。
Method: LIVE 为训练无关框架：先做查询自适应候选推断得到紧凑可靠的候选列表；再挖掘类内特征与类间差异构建类别专属 FGVR 技能；最后依据识别不确定性与类别混淆选择性调用详细技能引导。

papers.title: Quality, Not Just Outcome: A Structural Scoring Framework for Selecting Coding-Agent Trajectories for Supervised Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Open coding agents are commonly trained through supervised fine-tuning on interaction trajectories whose final patches pass the benchmark test suite. However, this outcome-level filtering criterion ignores process quality: trajectories that eventually succeed may still contain inefficient interaction patterns such as repetitive file inspection, unstable tool usage, or delayed modification behavior, all of which become part of the imitation target. We propose TQS (Trajectory Quality Score), a structural scoring framework for coding-agent trajectories that operates directly on trajectory structure, requires no LLM judge, and runs in linear time. TQS characterizes trajectory quality through structural signals organized around structured convergence: information focus, intent--action alignment, and policy dynamics. Using 155,144 successful trajectories from a public open-license corpus, we rank trajectories by TQS and fine-tune coding agents on filtered subsets. Models trained on top-ranked trajectories consistently outperform those trained on random or bottom-ranked subsets on SWE-Bench-Verified. Our results suggest that process-level trajectory quality is an important factor in coding-agent supervision and that structural trajectory filtering provides an effective and scalable alternative to LLM-based data selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TQS (Trajectory Quality Score) 直接按轨迹结构给编码智能体的成功轨迹打分，无需 LLM judge、线性时间运行，用它筛选 SFT 数据可稳定优于随机或低分筛选。基于 155,144 条公开许可语料中的成功轨迹排序后微调，top 子集训练的模型在 SWE-Bench-Verified 上一致超过随机与 bottom 子集。
Motivation: 现有编码智能体 SFT 只按最终 patch 是否通过测试筛选轨迹，忽略过程质量，重复查文件、工具调用不稳、修改滞后等低效交互模式被一并当作模仿目标。
Method: TQS 围绕 structured convergence 组织结构信号：information focus、intent-action alignment、policy dynamics，直接作用于轨迹结构、无需 LLM judge、线性时间；用 155,144 条公开开放许可语料的成功轨迹按 TQS 排序，再在筛选后的子集上微调编码智能体。
Result: 在 SWE-Bench-Verified 上，用 top-ranked 轨迹训练的模型一致优于 random 与 bottom-ranked 子集训练的模型；数据规模为 155,144 条成功轨迹。
Conclusion: 过程级轨迹质量是编码智能体监督的重要因素，结构化轨迹筛选可作为 LLM-based 数据选择的可扩展替代。

papers.title: VIGOR: Verifiable Industrial Geometry Optimization and Repair in Scene Programs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly generate structured layouts and executable scene programs from natural-language instructions. However, executability does not imply engineering feasibility: an industrial scene program may execute successfully while its final state still violates coupled boundary, collision, clearance, aisle, or structural constraints. We identify this mismatch as the executability-engineering-feasibility gap, where locally plausible placements can remain globally infeasible because corrections to one device may introduce violations elsewhere. To make this gap measurable in a controlled setting, we construct an execution-grounded industrial scene-program dataset with 1,749 constructible scenarios, complete executable programs, and 94 final-state geometric checks per scenario. We further propose VIGOR, which combines supervised scene-program generation with execution-grounded verification and staged geometric refinement. Supervised fine-tuning establishes complete program generation, local projection resolves independently correctable violations, and joint conflict-graph repair coordinates residual multi-object conflicts while preserving structural relations. Experiments show that VIGOR achieves 96.86% Complete Feasibility and an Overall score of 91.20, outperforming the strongest evaluated baseline by 10.42 points in Overall. These results show that, under controlled industrial layout conditions, reliable scene-program generation requires not only executable programs, but also explicit verification and coordinated resolution of coupled engineering constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VIGOR 针对 LLM 生成工业场景程序时「可执行但工程不可行」的缺口，用监督微调生成完整程序、局部投影修复可独立纠正的违规，再用冲突图联合修复残余的多目标耦合冲突。在自建的 1,749 个可构建场景数据集（每场景 94 项最终状态几何检查）上，Complete Feasibility 达 96.86%、Overall 91.20，比最强评估基线高 10.42 分。
Motivation: LLM 生成的场景程序能执行成功，但最终状态仍可能违反边界、碰撞、间距、通道与结构等耦合工程约束；对单个设备的修正又会引入别处违规，使局部看似合理的布局整体不可行。
Method: 构建执行落地的工业场景程序数据集（1,749 个可构建场景、完整可执行程序、每场景 94 项几何检查）；VIGOR 三阶段：监督微调保证完整程序生成，局部投影 (local projection) 解决可独立纠正的违规，冲突图联合修复 (conflict-graph repair) 协调残余多目标冲突并保持结构关系。
Result: 在该数据集上 VIGOR 的 Complete Feasibility 为 96.86%，Overall 得分 91.20，比最强评估基线 Overall 高 10.42 分。
Conclusion: 在受控工业布局条件下，可靠的场景程序生成不仅需要可执行程序，还需要显式验证与对耦合工程约束的协同消解。

papers.title: Competence-Aware Orchestration for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have emerged as a promising paradigm for enhancing complex reasoning through role specialization and collaboration, yet a key challenge remains: how can collaboration be adapted to a backbone's competence on the current query? This problem matters because more collaboration is not always better--richer coordination may help on difficult cases, but it also incurs additional token cost and redundant interactions. We propose a two-stage competence-aware framework for automatic MAS orchestration. It first models the LLM backbone's task-conditioned competence for the current query, and then uses this signal to adapt role activation and the communication graph. Across six benchmarks, our method achieves an average score of 93.81%. Experiments with six LLM backbones of varying competence levels further show that our method adjusts collaboration according to the inferred competence: for higher-competence backbones, it improves average accuracy from 87.22 to 89.97 while reducing token cost by 36.26%; for lower-competence backbones, it yields a further average gain of 4.58 points over existing methods. The same trend also holds on unseen backbones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出两阶段的 competence-aware MAS 编排框架：先估计 LLM backbone 对当前 query 的任务条件化能力，再据此调节角色激活与通信图。在六个 benchmark 上平均分 93.81%；对高能力 backbone 平均准确率 87.22→89.97 且 token 成本降 36.26%，对低能力 backbone 比现有方法再高 4.58 点，未见过的 backbone 上趋势一致。
Motivation: LLM 多智能体协作的强度并非越多越好：更细的协调能帮上难题，却带来额外 token 成本与冗余交互，而现有编排方式不随 backbone 对当前查询的能力自适应。
Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段建模 backbone 的任务条件化 competence，第二阶段用该信号驱动角色激活与通信图的调整，从而自动决定协作结构与强度。
Result: 六个 benchmark 上平均分 93.81%；六个不同能力水平的 LLM backbone 实验中，高能力者平均准确率 87.22→89.97 且 token 成本降低 36.26%，低能力者相对现有方法平均再提升 4.58 点；未见过的 backbone 上同样保持该趋势。
Conclusion: 按推断出的 backbone 能力来调节协作强度，可以在提升准确率的同时压低 token 成本，且该策略对未见过的 backbone 依然成立。

papers.title: Measurable Semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting with Joint Region and Depth Supervision for Interactive Building Inspection
papers.abstract_en: Image-based 3D reconstruction provides a scalable representation for building inspection and maintenance. However, photorealistic reconstruction alone does not fully provide the geometric measurability, semantic structure, and interactive information access required for engineering applications. This study proposes a measurable semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) framework with region and depth supervision for interactive building inspection from multi-view imagery. Mask-based region supervision suppresses irrelevant backgrounds and focuses optimization on target regions. Point-wise depth supervision guides Gaussian centers toward physical surfaces using reference geometry derived from multi-view stereo (MVS) point clouds, providing geometric anchors for measuring physical dimensions and areas. A semantic Gaussian field associates learnable class features with individual Gaussian primitives, enabling semantic rendering and component-level inspection. These capabilities are operationalized through AEC-SplatTwin, an interactive building inspection platform supporting real-time visualization, semantic analysis, quantitative measurement, and multimodal large language model (MLLM)-assisted interaction. On the synthetic UAV-inspection QuakeCity and smartphone-captured HKUPB datasets, the framework reduces Gaussian-center depth MAE by 58.1% and 86.8%, while its semantic field achieves mIoU values of 0.8529 and 0.8642. On HKUPB, the mean relative errors for height, width, and area measurements are 0.33%, 1.07%, and 0.60%. These results show that the proposed framework extends 3DGS beyond visual reconstruction into a measurable, semantically structured, and interactive engineering representation for building inspection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出带区域与深度联合监督的可测量语义 3D Gaussian Splatting 框架，用于多视角影像的交互式建筑检测：掩码区域监督抑制无关背景，MVS 点云派生的参考几何做逐点深度监督约束高斯中心贴近真实表面，语义高斯场为每个高斯原语挂上可学习类别特征。在合成 UAV 数据集 QuakeCity 与手机采集的 HKUPB 上，高斯中心深度 MAE 分别降低 58.1% 与 86.8%，语义场 mIoU 达 0.8529 与 0.8642；HKUPB 上高度、宽度、面积测量的平均相对误差为 0.33%、1.07%、0.60%。
Motivation: 面向建筑检测与维护的图像三维重建中，仅有照片级真实感不足以支撑工程应用所需的几何可测量性、语义结构与交互式信息访问。
Method: 在 3DGS 上叠加两类监督：掩码区域监督把优化聚焦到目标区域并压制背景；以多视角立体 (MVS) 点云为参考几何做逐点深度监督，把高斯中心锚定到物理表面；同时引入语义高斯场，将可学习类别特征关联到每个高斯原语以支持语义渲染与构件级检查。能力落地为交互平台 AEC-SplatTwin，支持实时可视化、语义分析、定量测量与多模态大模型 (MLLM) 辅助交互。
Result: 在合成 UAV 检测数据集 QuakeCity 与手机拍摄的 HKUPB 上，高斯中心深度 MAE 分别降低 58.1% 与 86.8%；语义场 mIoU 分别为 0.8529 与 0.8642。在 HKUPB 上，高度、宽度、面积测量的平均相对误差分别为 0.33%、1.07%、0.60%。
Conclusion: 把区域与深度监督以及语义高斯场加入 3DGS，可把视觉重建扩展为可测量、语义结构化、可交互的工程表示，用于建筑检测。

papers.title: Neurograf v1: An End-to-End Romanian-First Language Model Family
papers.abstract_en: We present Neurograf v1, an experimental end-to-end Romanian-first language-model pipeline developed to investigate the feasibility of training language models from scratch for a lower-resource European language. The pipeline comprises RoSfera, a 635 GB Romanian corpus containing 175.7 million documents; an 80k byte-level BPE tokenizer; five decoder-only models ranging from 160M to 6B parameters, trained on 131 billion tokens; three instruction-tuned assistants; and two contrastively trained embedding models. Training and evaluation were conducted using computing infrastructure at ELI-NP/IFIN-HH. The model family exhibits consistent scaling of validation loss and increasing Romanian factual and cultural knowledge with model size. On the 1,000-question WWTBM benchmark, Neurograf-6B achieves 69.89% accuracy on Romanian-context questions, while Neurograf-3.2B reaches 67.38%. Compute-optimal analysis yields a parameter-scaling exponent of approximately 0.423. Neurograf v1 serves as an experimental demonstrator rather than a production system. The study identifies practical challenges involving diacritic preservation, corpus quality, data composition, and tokenization efficiency, while demonstrating the feasibility of developing Romanian-first base models, instruction-following assistants, and semantic embedding models within a unified training pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Neurograf v1 是一套端到端的罗马尼亚语优先语言模型训练管线，包含 635 GB 的 RoSfera 语料（175.7 百万文档）、80k byte-level BPE 分词器，以及 160M 到 6B 的五个 decoder-only 模型（共训练 131B tokens）。验证损失随规模一致下降，Neurograf-6B 在 1,000 题 WWTBM 罗马尼亚语境问答上达 69.89% 准确率，参数-规模指数约 0.423，证明低资源欧洲语言可从零训练出可用的基座、指令与嵌入模型。
Motivation: 低资源欧洲语言缺少从零训练的端到端语言模型管线，语料质量、变音符号 (diacritic) 保留与分词效率等实践障碍未被系统检验。
Method: 构建 RoSfera 罗马尼亚语语料（635 GB、175.7M 文档）与 80k byte-level BPE 分词器，训练五个 160M–6B decoder-only 模型（131B tokens）、三个指令微调助手与两个对比学习嵌入模型；训练与评估在 ELI-NP/IFIN-HH 计算设施上完成，并做 compute-optimal 分析。
Result: 验证损失随模型规模一致下降，罗马尼亚事实与文化知识随规模提升；WVTBM（1,000 题）上 Neurograf-6B 准确率 69.89%，Neurograf-3.2B 为 67.38%；compute-optimal 分析给出参数-规模指数约 0.423。
Conclusion: 在统一训练管线内开发罗马尼亚语基座模型、指令助手与语义嵌入模型是可行的，但该系统定位为实验性演示而非生产系统，并暴露变音符号、语料质量、数据构成与分词效率的实际挑战。

papers.title: DP-MIND: Differentially private memory-guided Long context Inference
papers.abstract_en: LLM-as-a-Service has become a dominant paradigm for accessing large language models without requiring local deployment. However, the process raises severe privacy concerns when user queries may include sensitive or confidential contexts. Differential privacy (DP) provides a principled approach to protecting such inputs, but existing DP inference methods are primarily designed for short- or moderate-context settings and struggle with million-token-scale inputs due to limited context capacity and severe utility degradation under DP perturbation. In this paper, we propose DP-MIND, a memory-guided framework that scales differentially private inference to million-token contexts. DP-MIND enables private long-context inference by locally perturbing the input and processing it chunk by chunk with a compact memory that preserves task-relevant information across the sequence. To make this memory robust to DP noise, we optimize the memory construction policy directly on perturbed inputs using reinforcement learning, guided by both final answer correctness and memory consistency. We further recover perturbation-corrupted answer spans through a local denoising module without exposing the original context to the external model. We provide theoretical privacy analysis of DP-MIND and further conduct extensive empirical analysis across multiple long-context benchmarks with context lengths up to the million-token scale, demonstrating that DP-MIND consistently outperforms existing DP and long-context inference baselines in both scalability and utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DP-MIND 把差分隐私推理从短中上下文推到百万 token 级：本地扰动输入后分块处理，用紧凑 memory 跨块保留任务相关信息，并用强化学习在已扰动输入上直接优化 memory 构建策略（奖励为最终答案正确性与 memory 一致性），再用本地去噪模块修复被 DP 噪声破坏的答案片段。在多个长上下文基准（上下文长度达百万 token 级）上，其可扩展性与效用均稳定超过已有 DP 与长上下文推理基线。
Motivation: LLM-as-a-Service 中用户查询可能含敏感上下文，而现有 DP 推理方法面向短/中等上下文，面对百万 token 输入时上下文容量受限且 DP 扰动导致效用严重下降。
Method: 本地对输入做 DP 扰动，逐块 (chunk by chunk) 处理并维护紧凑 memory 跨序列保留任务相关信息；用强化学习在扰动后的输入上直接优化 memory 构建策略，奖励同时包含最终答案正确性与 memory 一致性；另设本地去噪模块恢复被扰动破坏的答案片段，全程不向外部模型暴露原始上下文；并给出 DP-MIND 的理论隐私分析。
Result: 在多个长上下文基准、上下文长度达百万 token 规模上，DP-MIND 在可扩展性与效用两方面持续优于已有 DP 推理基线与长上下文推理基线；摘要另给出理论隐私分析，但未列出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 把 DP 扰动前移到本地并让 memory 策略在噪声上训练、配合本地答案去噪，是把差分隐私推理扩展到百万 token 上下文且不牺牲效用的可行路径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Looking Ahead and Back: Anticipatory Generative Modeling for Road-Network Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Trajectory generation underpins urban applications such as traffic management and urban planning. Within road networks, vehicle movement along road segments is largely deterministic, whereas transitions at intersections are critical--multiple outgoing paths may appear equally plausible, yet they can lead to substantially different downstream routes. Existing generative methods such as diffusion models simulate location sequences and fail short of next transition selection, even producing trajectories that drift off the road network. To fill this gap, we advocate a fundamental shift: moving beyond location simulation toward behavior modeling on the road network. In this paper, we revisit trajectory generation through the lens of generative route planning, and introduce a new graph-constrained generative paradigm, Anticipatory Generative Modeling, which resolves next transition selection by incorporating the Anticipation of how the future route may unfold toward the destination. Concretely, we propose a novel generative model named Foresight that formulates a probabilistic model for an "anticipate--select--update--re-anticipate" loop that enables longer-term foresight while continuing sequential generation along the historical trajectory. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Foresight wins state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出图约束生成范式 Anticipatory Generative Modeling 与模型 Foresight，把路网轨迹生成从位置序列模拟转为路口转移选择：用 anticipate–select–update–re-anticipate 概率循环，在沿历史轨迹逐步生成时持续预判未来路线如何展开到终点，从而避免扩散类方法漂出路网。摘要称其在实验中胜过 SOTA 基线，但未给出具体数值。
Motivation: 路网中沿路段的行驶基本确定，而路口转移存在多条看似等价却通向截然不同下游路线的分支；现有扩散类生成方法模拟位置序列，在下一步转移选择上失效，甚至生成漂出路网的轨迹。
Method: 将轨迹生成重构为生成式路径规划 (generative route planning)，提出 Foresight 模型：对 anticipate–select–update–re-anticipate 循环建立概率模型，在沿历史轨迹顺序生成的同时获得更长程的前瞻 (foresight)，以约束在路网图上选择下一转移。
Result: 大量实验表明 Foresight 胜过 SOTA 基线；摘要未给出数据集名称、指标或数值。
Conclusion: 路网轨迹生成应从位置模拟转向基于前瞻的行为建模，把路口转移选择显式纳入概率生成循环，才能既贴合路网又兼顾长程路线一致性。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Fast Gradient-Based Approximation of Continuous Dynamic Time Warping
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) is a common choice for measuring the discrepancy between time series. It proceeds by finding an optimal warping between timestamps through dynamic programming, which can be slow and is not differentiable. Consequently, several variants have been proposed. Among them, Soft-DTW proposes a smooth formulation of DTW, amenable to gradient computation, while Continuous-DTW (CDTW) introduces a continuous formulation through parametrizable warping functions. Yet, computational costs remain high for both methods and impractical for large datasets in modern machine learning pipelines. This paper revisits CDTW in several ways. After establishing its differentiability under mild conditions, we introduce FastCDTW, which is an efficient approximate solver with two different computational strategies: an exact closed-form scheme for piecewise-linear warping functions, and an unbiased Monte Carlo estimator for smooth ones, such as implicit neural networks. Both strategies provide gradients with respect to the warping function and the input time series, and the resulting algorithm is GPU-friendly. We demonstrate its benefits through its integration into more complex learning problems, including time series averaging, classification and deep domain adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文重做 Continuous-DTW (CDTW) 的可微近似求解，提出 FastCDTW：对分段线性 warping 函数用精确闭式方案，对光滑 warping（如隐式神经网络）用无偏 Monte Carlo 估计，两种策略都对 warping 函数与输入时间序列给出梯度且 GPU-friendly。它把 CDTW 的计算成本压到可用于大规模机器学习流水线，并在时间序列平均、分类与深度域适应三类学习任务中展示了集成效果。
Motivation: DTW 需要动态规划求最优对齐，既慢又不可微；Soft-DTW 与 CDTW 虽可微，计算成本对现代机器学习流水线中的大数据集仍然过高。
Method: 先在温和条件下建立 CDTW 的可微性，再提出 FastCDTW 近似求解器，含两条计算路线：对分段线性 warping 函数走精确闭式方案，对光滑 warping（如隐式神经网络）走无偏 Monte Carlo 估计；两者都对 warping 函数与输入时间序列反传梯度，实现 GPU-friendly。
Result: 在时间序列平均、分类与深度域适应三类更复杂的学习问题中集成 FastCDTW 并展示其收益；摘要给出的算法性质为分段线性情形的精确闭式解与光滑情形的无偏 Monte Carlo 估计。
Conclusion: CDTW 在温和条件下可微，且能用闭式或无偏 Monte Carlo 两种 GPU 友好的近似求解器大幅降低计算成本，从而进入大规模机器学习流水线。
Relevance: 18
