summary_sections.result: 在时间序列平均、分类与深度域适应三类更复杂的学习问题中集成 FastCDTW 并展示其收益；摘要给出的算法性质为分段线性情形的精确闭式解与光滑情形的无偏 Monte Carlo 估计。
summary_sections.conclusion: CDTW 在温和条件下可微，且能用闭式或无偏 Monte Carlo 两种 GPU 友好的近似求解器大幅降低计算成本，从而进入大规模机器学习流水线。

papers.title: Locate, Judge, Read: Role-Specialized Tool Agents over a Knowledge-Point Index for Open-Domain Multimodal Document QA
papers.abstract_en: Question answering over large heterogeneous document collections requires first finding the right passages and then reading them, yet current retrieval-augmented agents give one model both kinds of tools and let it schedule itself. We present KnowForge, a pipeline separated by job: a hybrid-retrieval knowledge-point index; a Locator agent that can only search; a code-scheduled bridge judge that forces the missing second hop; a typed, size-bounded evidence pool that merges every search's ranking; a Deep Reader agent that can only read text, images and tables; and a synthesizer with a format checker. With a self-hosted Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (3B active), KnowForge reaches F1 47.5 on the full open-domain M3DocVQA (2,441 questions, 3,368 PDFs), +11.0 over the published M3DocRAG system and +7.1 over one-shot retrieve-and-answer on the same index and model, and 53.5 with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. On MultiHop-RAG it reaches 73.5 accuracy, above the strongest published RAG and GraphRAG results (71.2); on the single-document MMLongBench-Doc it lifts the same model from 34.8 to 47.0, level with GPT-4o reading page images (46.3). Per-job ablations on the full benchmarks attribute the gain: the Deep Reader is worth 3.8, 9.8 and 0 points on the three corpora, tracking how visual each is; merging both agents into one with all tools and twice the rounds loses 1.9 F1 because it keeps searching instead of reading; a round-budget sweep shows a step at four Locator rounds and a plateau beyond; query latency scales with model calls rather than corpus size. We serve the three indexed benchmarks as read-only knowledge bases (free registration) and release all prompts and the runner code: https://github.com/metask-ai/knowforge-bench
papers.comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables. Code, prompts and benchmark runner: https://github.com/metask-ai/knowforge-bench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 KnowForge：把多模态文档问答拆成只检索的 Locator、强制补上第二跳的 code-scheduled bridge judge、只读文本/图像/表格的 Deep Reader 与带格式检查的 synthesizer，各角色分工而非让单一模型自调度。在 M3DocVQA 全量（2,441 题、3,368 PDF）上 F1 47.5，比已发表 M3DocRAG 高 11.0、比同索引同模型的 one-shot 检索问答高 7.1；把两个 agent 合并成一个全能 agent 反而丢 1.9 F1，因为它一直检索而不去读。
Motivation: 现有 RAG agent 把检索和阅读两类工具交给同一个模型自行调度，导致它倾向于继续搜索而不去读取证据，多跳与视觉重的文档集合上表现受限。
Method: 混合检索的知识点索引；只能搜索的 Locator agent；由代码调度的 bridge judge 强制补上缺失的第二跳；带类型与大小上限的 evidence pool 合并每次搜索的排序；只能读文本、图像、表格的 Deep Reader；最后由 synthesizer 加格式检查器输出。自托管 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B（3B 激活参数），另测 DeepSeek-V4-Flash。
Result: M3DocVQA 全量 F1 47.5（较 M3DocRAG +11.0，较同索引同模型 one-shot +7.1），DeepSeek-V4-Flash 下 53.5；MultiHop-RAG 准确率 73.5，高于最强已发表 RAG 与 GraphRAG 的 71.2；单文档 MMLongBench-Doc 上同模型从 34.8 提到 47.0，与 GPT-4o 读页面图像的 46.3 持平。逐任务消融：Deep Reader 在三个语料上分别值 3.8、9.8、0 点，随视觉程度变化；合并两 agent 并加倍轮次损失 1.9 F1；Locator 轮次在 4 轮处出现台阶、之后平台；查询延迟随模型调用次数而非语料规模增长。

papers.title: Why Heavy-Tailed Weight Spectra Predict Model Quality
papers.abstract_en: A solid understanding of the predictive success of deep neural networks (DNNs) remains elusive. For example, while many data-dependent metrics exist that seek to predict model quality of DNNs, these metrics may be expensive to compute for large datasets and/or may be impossible to compute when training datasets are not released. A practical and effective predictor of model quality involves analyzing DNN weight matrices, as prior work has established that heavy-tailed spectral distributions in trained weight matrices can be strongly predictive of model quality. However, such metrics lack a rigorous statistical justification. In this work, we aim to understand why these metrics perform well, from a statistical perspective. To do so, we employ a probabilistic framework to derive the marginal likelihood for a DNN, evaluated using only the final layer weights. Across large-scale convolutional DNNs and LLMs, we find that this marginal likelihood predicts model quality. To understand the role heavy-tailed spectra play in predictive performance, we derive the limiting log-marginal likelihood for spectra that follow the (heavy-tailed) High-Temperature Marchenko-Pastur (HTMP) distribution. We show that this limiting quantity is convex in a heaviness parameter, and we derive an optimal heaviness that empirically predicts over-fitting for large-scale DNNs.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 34 pages, 11 figures, 4 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文用概率框架为深度网络权重矩阵的重尾谱指标给出统计解释：只用最后一层权重推导 DNN 的边际似然，该量在大规模卷积网络与 LLM 上能预测模型质量。对服从 High-Temperature Marchenko-Pastur (HTMP) 分布的谱推导极限对数边际似然，证明其关于 heaviness 参数凸，并给出最优 heaviness，该值在大规模 DNN 上经验性地预测过拟合。
Motivation: 预测 DNN 模型质量的现有指标要么在大数据集上计算昂贵，要么在训练数据未发布时无法计算；权重谱重尾指标虽被证明强预测模型质量，却缺少严格的统计学依据。
Method: 构建概率框架，仅用最后一层权重推导 DNN 的边际似然；再对谱服从 HTMP 分布的情形推导极限对数边际似然，分析其关于 heaviness 参数的凸性并解析给出最优 heaviness，检验对象覆盖大规模卷积 DNN 与 LLM。
Result: 仅用最后一层权重的边际似然在大规模卷积 DNN 和 LLM 上能预测模型质量；极限对数边际似然对 heaviness 参数为凸；导出的最优 heaviness 在大规模 DNN 上经验性地预测过拟合。
Conclusion: 重尾权重谱之所以能预测模型质量，是因为它对应可推导的边际似然，且最优 heaviness 给出了判断过拟合的统计量。

papers.title: GuidedNav: Shaping Vision-Language Navigation Representations through Pre-action Attention and Spatial Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Vision-and-language navigation (VLN) requires an agent to track progress through an extended instruction, identify landmarks relevant to its current objective, and understand the surrounding spatial structure to act. End-to-end navigation policies typically rely on action supervision to implicitly learn these capabilities. Without explicit guidance on the evidence underlying each decision, however, policies can overfit to correlations predictive of training actions rather than learn the task-relevant grounding and geometry needed for generalization. Our insight is to guide the representations that connect instructions to actions: identifying what remains to be done determines which visual evidence matters, while understanding the geometry around that evidence informs how to move. We introduce GuidedNav, a unified framework that explicitly shapes these representations through training-time guidance. Subtask and landmark guidance steer native pre-action attention toward the active instruction segment and relevant visual regions, grounding action prediction in the current objective. Spatial guidance aligns the policy's internal representations with geometric features that capture long-horizon context and local spatial structure. Together, these objectives strengthen navigation capabilities while avoiding the inference overhead of intermediate textual reasoning and online geometric encoding. We also introduce Guided-R2R and Guided-RxR, two annotation-enriched navigation datasets that support more interpretable VLN research. GuidedNav establishes state-of-the-art performance among the compared monocular RGB policies, improving success rates by 8.1% and 13.1% relative to the strongest prior results on R2R-CE and RxR-CE val-unseen, respectively, while achieving faster inference. Extensive experiments further demonstrate the effectiveness and real-world transferability of our approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GuidedNav 在视觉-语言导航 (VLN) 中用训练期引导直接塑形「指令到动作」的表征：子任务与地标引导把 pre-action attention 拉向当前指令片段和相关视觉区域，空间引导把策略内部表征对齐到含长程上下文与局部结构的几何特征。在单目 RGB 策略中，R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE val-unseen 成功率相对最强已有结果分别提升 8.1% 和 13.1%，推理更快。
Motivation: 端到端导航策略只靠动作监督隐式学习进度跟踪、地标识别与空间理解，容易过拟合到与训练动作相关的表面关联，而不是任务所需的语义落地与几何，泛化受限。
Method: GuidedNav 以训练期引导塑形表征：子任务与地标引导约束 pre-action attention 聚焦当前活跃指令段与相关视觉区域；空间引导对齐策略内部表征与几何特征（长程上下文 + 局部空间结构）；推理时不引入中间文本推理或在线几何编码。同时发布标注增强数据集 Guided-R2R 与 Guided-RxR。
Result: 在所比较的单目 RGB 策略中达到 state-of-the-art：R2R-CE val-unseen 成功率相对最强已有结果提升 8.1%，RxR-CE val-unseen 提升 13.1%，且推理更快；作者称实验还展示了方法的有效性与真实世界可迁移性。
Conclusion: 显式引导连接指令与动作的中间表征（当前目标决定看哪里、几何决定怎么走），比纯动作监督更能提升 VLN 泛化，同时避免中间推理带来的推理开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Replaying the Movie in Your Mind Decoding Dynamic Visual Perception and Recall from EEG
papers.abstract_en: Decoding dynamic visual content from EEG has advanced rapidly for visual perception, yet it remains unclear which aspects of neural representations are preserved when people internally replay dynamic scenes. We introduce PAIR, an EEG benchmark collected from 20 participants using an interleaved, clip-wise paradigm that pairs naturalistic video viewing with immediate visual recall. This design enables a comparison between externally driven perception and internally generated recall for the same stimulus content within a fixed trial sequence. We benchmark multiple decoding models on hierarchical semantic classification at both fine-grained and coarse-grained levels, meta-feature decoding tasks covering motion, color, object number, face, and human presence, and a state-decoding task that discriminates perception from recall. Within-subject validation results show numerically similar performance for several model--task combinations, alongside higher perception accuracy in two coarse-grained comparisons after multiple-comparison correction. In contrast, perception and recall are highly separable at the state level under the present validation protocol. State accuracy remains high after alpha-band ablation, although this does not exclude ocular or other task-related contributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PAIR 是一个 20 名被试的 EEG 基准，用交错的 clip 级范式把同一段自然视频的观看与即时回忆配对，从而在固定试次序列内直接比较外部驱动的感知与内部生成的回忆。结果显示多个模型-任务组合的感知与回忆解码精度数值相近，两个粗粒度比较在校正后感知更高，而状态层面（区分感知 vs 回忆）高度可分，且 alpha 波段消融后状态精度仍高。
Motivation: 动态视觉内容的 EEG 解码进展很快，但人们内部回放动态场景时神经表征究竟保留了哪些成分仍不清楚；缺少同一刺激下感知与回忆可直接对照的数据与基准。
Method: 提出 PAIR 基准：20 名被试、clip 级交错范式，把自然视频观看与即时视觉回忆配对，固定试次序列内实现同内容的感知-回忆对照。评测三类任务：细粒度与粗粒度的层级语义分类、覆盖运动/颜色/物体数量/人脸/人存在的 meta-feature 解码，以及区分感知与回忆的状态解码；在被试内做验证并进行多重比较校正，另做 alpha 波段消融。
Result: 多个模型-任务组合上感知与回忆的被试内验证精度数值相近；两个粗粒度比较在校正后感知精度更高。状态层面感知与回忆高度可分；alpha 波段消融后状态精度仍保持较高，但作者指出这不能排除眼动或其他任务相关成分的贡献。
Conclusion: 在该验证协议下，感知与回忆在语义与 meta-feature 层面保留了相近的可解码信息，但在状态层面高度可分，且这种可分性不依赖 alpha 波段。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: DRYLAB-Bench: Benchmarking the Biosecurity Risk of Agentic LLM Mutation Design
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) acquire advanced biological design capabilities, they offer substantial research benefits but simultaneously introduce severe dual-use risks, such as engineering enhanced pathogens or drug-resistant bacteria. While biosecurity frameworks recognize these threats, the actual risk of LLMs executing dangerous biological modifications remains unquantified, particularly when augmented with specialized biological design tools (BDTs). Existing evaluations primarily assess hazardous knowledge possession rather than practical application, overlook risk amplification from BDTs, and rely on unreliable, expensive, or hazardous validation methods. To address these gaps, we introduce DRYLAB-Bench (Design Risk Yielded by LLM Agent in Biodesign), the first comprehensive benchmark evaluating the high-risk biological mutation design capabilities of LLM agents. Moving beyond basic question-answering, DRYLAB-Bench tasks agents with 30 genuinely hazardous mutation-design scenarios distilled from biosecurity guidelines. It evaluates models in a multi-round, tool-augmented environment where LLMs orchestrate BDTs to iteratively refine candidates. Crucially, it scores designs directly against 187,695 empirical wet-lab measurements from ProteinGym and ViroGym using our proposed Biosecurity Risk Score (BRS), quantifying risk-associated effects while enabling scalable and safe ground-truth verification. Evaluations of 15 frontier models reveal substantial baseline threats: without tools, 67.6% of one-shot designs exceed the average measured variant, and 21.4% reach the highest-risk decile. Equipping models with BDTs significantly amplifies this risk, raising the pooled risk by \(ΔBRS=+0.116\) and the top-decile share to 23.5%. Code: https://github.com/drylab-bio/DRYLAB-Bench

papers.title: Continually Post-training Small Models via Synthetic Self-distillation
papers.abstract_en: Continual post-training faces a dual challenge of acquisition and retention: models must learn new capabilities while preserving prior knowledge. While Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT) mitigates this using self-supervision with in-context demonstrations, it relies on strong in-context learning and instruction-following abilities. Consequently, SDFT fails on smaller models critical for low-latency, on-device use. To enable continual learning at smaller scales, we first identify the root cause of failure. We show that poor acquisition and forgetting correlate linearly with the post-trained model's distribution shift, revealing the necessity of in-distribution learning. We thus introduce Synthetic Self-Distillation (SynthSelf), imitating SDFT's in-distribution rewrite by outsourcing the task to a minimally larger, same-family aligner. Coupled with off-policy supervision and rejection sampling, this provides the high-quality supervision small models require without breaking their original distribution. Evaluations spanning 4 acquisition datasets (including a mixture) and 14 retention benchmarks show SynthSelf consistently outperforms 6 methods (including off- and on-policy distillation) across 3 small model scales. Extensive further analyses confirm SynthSelf paves the way toward effective small-model continual learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Synthetic Self-Distillation (SynthSelf) 用同家族中略大的 aligner 代替小模型自身的 in-context 重写，配合 off-policy 监督与 rejection sampling，为小模型的持续后训练提供不破坏原分布的高质量监督。在 4 个 acquisition 数据集（含一个 mixture）与 14 个 retention 基准上，跨 3 个小模型规模一致优于 6 种方法（含 off-policy 与 on-policy 蒸馏）。
Motivation: 持续后训练要兼顾习得新能力与保留旧知识，但 Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT) 依赖强 in-context learning 与指令跟随能力，在低延迟端侧所需的小模型上失效。
Method: 先诊断失败根因：习得差与遗忘程度同后训练模型的分布偏移线性相关，故需 in-distribution learning。SynthSelf 把 SDFT 的 in-distribution 重写外包给同家族、仅略大的 aligner，并结合 off-policy 监督与 rejection sampling 构造监督信号。
Result: 在 4 个 acquisition 数据集（含 mixture）与 14 个 retention 基准上，SynthSelf 跨 3 个小模型规模一致优于 6 种对比方法（含 off-policy 与 on-policy 蒸馏）；习得与遗忘同分布偏移呈线性相关。
Conclusion: 小模型持续学习的瓶颈是分布偏移而非自蒸馏机制本身，把重写外包给略大的同家族 aligner 即可在小规模上恢复有效的持续后训练。

papers.title: Does Location Matter? A Black-Box Causal Audit Reveals Model-Dependent Audio Grounding in LALM Hallucination
papers.abstract_en: Large audio-language models (LALMs) frequently exhibit object hallucination, affirming absent sounds. The dominant mitigation, Audio-Aware Decoding (AAD), contrasts logits under real audio against an all-zero "blank" waveform, flagged by prior review as out-of-distribution. We introduce a black-box causal test that isolates the claimed evidence itself: localize a claim's evidence region via CLAP similarity, remove it by spectral gating, and compare against a random-window control across a 2x2x2 grid on three LALMs. On Qwen2-Audio-7B, localized ablation's raw AUROC trails blank's (0.613 vs. 0.721); this is a duration confound, not a localization failure, since blank removes the entire clip versus the grid's 2-4 s. Holding duration fixed, localization beats random removal at every cell on both models. Raw detection value remains model-dependent, especially on Audio Flamingo 3. The same evidence corrects decoding: contrastive decoding combining blank and language-prior contrasts, gated and ensembled, raises Qwen2-Audio accuracy from 57.1% to 71.9%, beating AAD alone. A unified causal-grounding profile does not transfer between models, indicating different grounding regimes. The source code and a detailed report of our findings, including identified limitations, are available at https://github.com/khalooei/causa.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 1 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对音频语言模型 (LALM) 的物体幻觉做黑盒因果审计：用 CLAP 相似度定位声明的证据区间，谱门控 (spectral gating) 移除后与随机窗口对照比较。定位移除在时长对齐后在两个模型的每个网格单元都胜过随机移除，但原始检测 AUROC 因模型而异（Qwen2-Audio-7B 上定位 0.613 低于 blank 0.721，属时长混淆）；同一证据用于解码时，blank 与语言先验对比的门控集成把 Qwen2-Audio 准确率从 57.1% 提到 71.9%，超过单独 AAD。
Motivation: 主流缓解方法 Audio-Aware Decoding (AAD) 用真实音频与全零 blank 波形的 logits 对比，已被审阅指出 blank 属分布外输入；缺少能隔离「证据本身」是否真被定位的因果检验。
Method: 提出黑盒因果测试：以 CLAP 相似度定位声明的证据区间，谱门控移除该区间，与随机窗口移除对照，在 2x2x2 网格上对三个 LALM 做检验；并把 blank 对比与语言先验对比门控集成后用于对比解码。
Result: Qwen2-Audio-7B 上定位移除的原始 AUROC 0.613，低于 blank 的 0.721，作者归因为 blank 移除整段而网格只移除 2-4 秒的时长混淆；固定时长后定位在两个模型的每个网格单元都胜过随机移除。原始检测价值仍模型依赖，Audio Flamingo 3 上尤其明显。解码侧，门控集成的对比解码把 Qwen2-Audio 准确率从 57.1% 提升到 71.9%，优于单独 AAD。
Conclusion: 统一的因果 grounding 剖面不能在模型间迁移，说明不同 LALM 处于不同的 grounding 机制；blank 的检测优势部分来自时长而非定位质量。

papers.title: What Do Visual-Head Discovery Scores Actually Find? Attention Source, Necessity, and Random-Control Pitfalls in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Attention heads that attend to image regions relevant to a question are increasingly used to steer, ground and interpret vision-language models (VLMs) and to reduce their hallucinations. They are mostly found by ranking heads with an attention- pattern score and validated by steering or masking them. We ask how the choices inside such a discovery score shape the heads it returns, and which of the two validations identifies them. On Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct we vary the query type, the discovery corpus and the token positions whose attention is read (the attention source) in a full 2 x 3 x 2 design, and test all 12 head-sets for steerability (CERS: Contrastive Evidence-Region Steering score) and necessity (NCS: Necessity Con- trast Score) against layer-matched random head-sets. (1) The attention source and the query type reshape the selected heads far more than the corpus: changing the source keeps a median of 49 of the top-100 heads, the query 55 and the cor- pus 84, while two halves of the same data share 96-99. (2) Necessity follows the attention source: head-sets discovered from query-span attention are more nec- essary than last-token ones (difference 0.083, p=6 x 10^-10), and the two re- ferring + query-span sets lie 17-19 standard deviations above 250 layer-matched random sets (Holm-adjusted p=0.048). The referring + query-span effect re- plicates on several recent VLMs. (3) Steerability is not specific to the discovered heads: no discovered head-set steers better than its layer-matched random sets (rank p >= 0.14), and random sets drawn from the same or from any layer span the discovered sets' scores. Necessity therefore separates the discovery settings, while steering at this strength does not. We turn these findings into a protocol for reporting visual-head discoveries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 上做 2×3×2 全因子设计，发现视觉头发现分数选出的头主要由 attention source 与 query type 决定而非语料：换 source 只保留 top-100 中位数 49 个头，换 query 55 个，换语料 84 个，同一数据对半分则共享 96–99 个。必要性 (NCS) 随 source 变化（query-span 比 last-token 高 0.083，p=6×10⁻¹⁰，referring+query-span 比 250 个层匹配随机头集高 17–19 个标准差），而可操纵性 (CERS) 无一发现头集优于随机（rank p≥0.14），因此报告视觉头发现必须用必要性而非 steering 作判据。
Motivation: 用 attention 模式分数排序并以 steering/masking 验证的视觉头发现流程，其分数内部选择（query 类型、语料、attention source）如何影响返回的头、以及两种验证哪一种真正识别出这些头，此前没有被系统检验。
Method: 在 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 上做 2×3×2 全因子设计，改变 query type、discovery corpus 与被读取的 token 位置 (attention source)，得到 12 组头集；每组用 CERS (Contrastive Evidence-Region Steering) 测可操纵性、用 NCS (Necessity Contrast Score) 测必要性，并与层匹配的随机头集对比（含 250 个随机集、Holm 校正）。
Result: 换 attention source 保留 top-100 中位数 49 个头，换 query type 55 个，换 corpus 84 个，同一数据对半分共享 96–99 个；query-span 头集比 last-token 更必要（差 0.083，p=6×10⁻¹⁰），referring+query-span 两组高出 250 个层匹配随机集 17–19 个标准差（Holm 校正 p=0.048），且该效应在多个近期 VLM 上复现；可操纵性上没有任何发现头集优于其层匹配随机集（rank p≥0.14），随机集分数覆盖发现头集。
Conclusion: 必要性能区分视觉头发现的不同设置，而该强度的 steering 不能；作者据此给出一套视觉头发现的报告协议。

papers.title: Scaling RNA Foundation Models through Iterative Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Biological function in RNA is encoded across scales, from local sequence motifs to long-range structural dependencies. Conventional RNA foundation models couple parameter capacity and inference depth within a fixed architecture, prescribing a fixed computation graph for each inference. Here we present Eco-RNA, an 80M-parameter RNA foundation model that makes inference depth adjustable through learned iterative refinement. Its shared, input-conditioned Transformer core refines sequence representations through repeated application. The iteration count is selected after training and controls effective depth at fixed model parameters. We train across recurrent depths with masked reconstruction, state regularization, and a one-sided loss that anchors deeper reconstruction to a shallow reference. On the 70-assay RNAGym fitness benchmark, increasing refinement from one to four iterations raises aggregate absolute Spearman correlation from 0.242 to 0.286, with the gain retained through eight iterations. At four iterations, Eco-RNA surpasses the current SOTA Evo 2 40B on all three aggregate fitness metrics despite 500x fewer parameters. Its iteration configurations advance the compute-performance Pareto frontier among the evaluated models. It also outperforms the evaluated baselines in non-coding RNA family classification, RNA secondary-structure prediction, and chemical probing profile prediction. These results establish internal inference computation as an effective scaling dimension for RNA foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Eco-RNA 用共享的、输入条件化的 Transformer 核心反复迭代精炼序列表示，把推理深度变成训练后可调的迭代次数，从而在参数量固定时扩展有效深度。在 RNAGym 70-assay fitness 基准上，迭代从 1 次增到 4 次使聚合绝对 Spearman 从 0.242 升到 0.286，且增益保持到 8 次；4 次迭代时以少 500 倍参数超过 Evo 2 40B。
Motivation: 常规 RNA foundation model 把参数规模和推理深度绑死在固定架构里，每次推理的计算图固定，无法在参数不变时调节计算量。
Method: Eco-RNA 是 80M 参数模型：共享且输入条件化的 Transformer 核心被重复应用以精炼序列表示，迭代次数在训练后选定以控制有效深度；训练跨多个 recurrent depth 进行，损失包含 masked reconstruction、state regularization，以及把深层重建锚定到浅层参考的 one-sided loss。

Conclusion: 内部推理计算量可作为 RNA foundation model 的一个独立扩展维度，与参数规模解耦。

papers.title: Can Failed Trajectories Reveal Where Agents Go Wrong? Agentic Failure Attribution Without Step-Level Labels
papers.abstract_en: Failure attribution for LLM agents aims to identify decisive steps responsible for task failure, which is critical for debugging and improving agentic systems. Existing methods rely on costly LLM prompting, step-level error annotations, or verified successful trajectories that lack failure signals for assistance. In this paper, we study failure attribution from step-unlabeled failure trajectories, where each trajectory is known to have failed but its decisive step is unknown. We propose SOAP (Spectral scOring with Attention-guided Propagation), an effective framework requiring neither step-level training labels nor a separate success-only reference set. SOAP first constructs a spectral reference space from LLM representations and assigns each step a base error score according to its projection behavior. Importantly, later steps may exhibit stronger failure signals because they inherit an earlier mistake, causing independent scorers to favor downstream consequences over the decisive error. To address this downstream contamination, SOAP derives soft step dependencies from attention patterns and propagates downstream error evidence toward its likely upstream sources. Extensive experiments show that SOAP consistently improves attribution performance over competitive baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SOAP 在只有失败轨迹、没有步级标注的情况下做 LLM agent 失败归因：先用 LLM 表示构建谱参考空间 (spectral reference space)，按每步的投影行为给基础错误分，再从 attention 模式导出软步依赖，把下游继承来的错误证据向其上游源头传播，避免打分偏向下游后果。实验显示 SOAP 在归因性能上稳定优于竞争基线。
Motivation: 现有失败归因依赖昂贵的 LLM 提示、步级错误标注或已验证的成功轨迹，这些成功轨迹本身缺少失败信号，难以用于定位决定性出错步。
Method: SOAP (Spectral scOring with Attention-guided Propagation)：从 LLM 表示构造谱参考空间，按每步投影行为给基础错误分；再从 attention 模式导出软步依赖，把下游错误证据向可能的上游来源传播，既不需要步级训练标签也不需要单独的成功参考集。
Result: 在步级无标注的失败轨迹上，SOAP 的归因性能在实验中持续优于有竞争力的基线。
Conclusion: 失败轨迹本身携带足够信号：结合谱打分与 attention 引导的上游传播，可以在没有步级标签和成功参考集的条件下定位决定性出错步。

papers.title: Robust Vision-Language Navigation with Awareness of Instruction-Execution Progress
papers.abstract_en: In Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) tasks involving multi-step instructions as guidance, an agent must associate its observations with the relevant instruction content at each decision point. Most graph-based methods commonly match candidate trajectories with the entire instruction, allowing already executed content to interfere with subsequent decisions. Although instruction-execution progress provides a direct cue for separating executed and pending content, existing progress estimation approaches often rely on explicit progress supervision, sophisticated progress-learning stages, or costly online reasoning with LLMs. In this paper, we propose a robust VLN framework with Awareness of Instruction-Execution Progress (VLN-AIEP), which couples progress estimation with navigation decision-making. VLN-AIEP associates the visited trajectory with the instruction to suppress embeddings corresponding to executed content, and then matches candidate locations with the pending content. This coupling makes correct navigation decisions depend on accurate progress estimation, allowing the progress estimator to learn directly from navigation decision labels without explicit progress annotations. To support progress estimation, we construct a landmark-anchored trajectory representation that encodes the semantic labels and viewpoint-relative geometry of instruction-referred landmarks. These landmarks serve as spatial references for associating the visited trajectory with executed instruction content. Extensive experiments on R2R, RxR, CVDN, and R2R-CE demonstrate that the proposed method achieves favorable performance across multiple metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLN-AIEP 把指令执行进度估计与导航决策耦合：先用已走轨迹抑制指令中已执行部分的嵌入，再让候选位置只与待执行内容匹配，使进度估计器可直接从导航决策标签学习、无需显式进度标注。在 R2R、RxR、CVDN、R2R-CE 上实验，多指标表现良好。
Motivation: 图方法常把候选轨迹与整条指令匹配，已执行内容会干扰后续决策；现有进度估计又依赖显式进度监督、多阶段进度学习或 LLM 在线推理，成本高。
Method: VLN-AIEP 耦合进度估计与导航决策：用 landmark-anchored 轨迹表示编码指令所指地标语义标签与视角相对几何，作为已执行内容的空间参照；耦合设计让决策正确性依赖进度估计，从而用导航决策标签替代进度标注训练。
Result: 在 R2R、RxR、CVDN、R2R-CE 四个基准上实验，摘要称在多个指标上取得有利表现（未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把进度估计与决策绑定，可在无显式进度标注下同时学好进度与导航，且不依赖 LLM 在线推理。

papers.title: VETR: Execution-Grounded Self-Improving Agent for Symbolic Graphics Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Visual agents for symbolic graphics reasoning depend on executable world representations, yet continued improvement remains bottlenecked by ambiguous supervision from final renders. Recent agentic systems refine scenes through repeated interaction, but they lack mechanisms to recursively extract actionable evidence from execution traces, overlooking which proposed symbolic edits survived, disappeared, or interfered during program execution. To address this, we propose VETR (Verified Execution Trajectories for Refinement), a framework that enables agentic recursive self-improvement over executable world representations for symbolic graphics reasoning. Within each task, VETR retains aligned program/render records with bounded runtime observations and introduces an execution refiner that compiles observed writes and state changes into constrained alternative programs. The refiner validates their endpoints and preservation conditions against captured runtime state; the ordinary visual verifier then assesses goal relevance. Repair construction makes no additional language-model calls, but can require additional executions. Evaluations on BlenderGym (280 tasks) and BlenderBench (27 released tasks) with GPT-5.6-luna and Qwen3.8-27B show that VETR consistently outperforms existing refinement strategies, including BlenderAlchemy and VIGA. Controlled ablations evaluate the contributions of execution refinement and role-asymmetric evidence organization under fixed generator-interaction caps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VETR 让符号图形推理智能体从程序执行轨迹中递归自我改进：保留程序/渲染对齐记录，用 execution refiner 把观测到的写入与状态变化编译成受约束的备选程序，再校验其端点与保持条件。在 BlenderGym（280 任务）与 BlenderBench（27 个已发布任务）上用 GPT-5.6-luna 和 Qwen3.8-27B 评测，持续优于 BlenderAlchemy、VIGA 等已有精化策略。
Motivation: 符号图形推理的视觉智能体依赖可执行的世界表示，但只靠最终渲染做监督信号含糊，反复交互的精化系统也无法从执行痕迹中递归提取可操作证据，不知道哪些符号编辑在执行中存活、消失或相互干扰。
Method: VETR（Verified Execution Trajectories for Refinement）在单个任务内保留对齐的 program/render 记录并附带有限运行时观测；execution refiner 把观测到的写入与状态变化编译成受约束的备选程序，校验端点与保持条件，再由普通 visual verifier 判定目标相关性。修复构造不再调用语言模型，但可能需要额外执行；另有固定生成器交互上限下的角色不对称证据组织消融。
Result: 在 BlenderGym（280 任务）与 BlenderBench（27 个已发布任务）上，配合 GPT-5.6-luna 与 Qwen3.8-27B，VETR 一致优于包括 BlenderAlchemy 和 VIGA 在内的已有精化策略；受控消融在固定交互上限下评估了执行精化与角色不对称证据组织的贡献。
Conclusion: 把执行痕迹编译成受约束的备选程序并校验其保持条件，可以在不增加语言模型调用的前提下让符号图形推理智能体持续自我改进。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stochastic Finite-Transition Learning and Exploration for Accelerated MRI Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Generative MRI reconstruction maps an initial source distribution to the target image distribution along a learned recovery trajectory. Common generative methods, such as diffusion and flow, typically learn fine-grained local dynamics whose integration defines this global mapping, hence requiring many network evaluations at inference. Existing few-step sampling approaches can lower computational burden by approximating large transformations from local dynamics, albeit at the expense of reconstruction fidelity. FLEX-MRI instead partitions recovery into a small number of finite intervals between retained states defined by progressive changes in k-space support, and directly learns the reconstruction change across each interval. Because such finite transitions can admit multiple plausible outcomes, FLEX-MRI combines support-relaxed finite-transition learning with stochastic exploration. During training, randomized k-space sampling masks define finite-transition targets with varying support, while the prediction loss remains unrestricted by each individual mask. At inference, FLEX-MRI perturbs a random subset of currently estimated k-space coefficients, allowing the learned predictor to stochastically explore alternative transition paths. Each predicted state is then reconciled with the acquired measurements through data consistency. We theoretically show that this stochastic exploration induces nonzero transition-level variation through the learned recovery map and data consistency without requiring an auxiliary generative sampler. Experiments on multi-coil MRI datasets show that FLEX-MRI outperforms competing methods while maintaining computational efficiency comparable to few-step baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FLEX-MRI 把生成式 MRI 重建的恢复轨迹切成少量有限区间，直接学习每个区间上的整体变换，而非扩散/流模型的细粒度局部动力学积分。训练时用随机化 k-space 采样掩码定义支持可变的转移目标，推理时扰动部分已估 k-space 系数做随机探索，再用 data consistency 与实测数据调和。在多线圈 MRI 数据集上以与 few-step 基线相当的计算量超越对比方法。
Motivation: 扩散与流类生成重建需在推理时积分大量局部动力学，网络评估次数多；现有 few-step 采样虽降算力，却以重建保真度为代价。
Method: FLEX-MRI 将恢复过程划分为由 k-space 支持渐进变化定义的少量保留状态之间的有限区间，直接学习每个区间上的重建变化。训练阶段用随机化 k-space 采样掩码构造支持各异的转移目标，而预测损失不受单个掩码限制；推理阶段扰动当前估计 k-space 系数的一个随机子集以随机探索替代转移路径，每个预测状态再经 data consistency 与实测数据调和。理论上证明该随机探索在无需辅助生成采样器的情况下，通过学习到的恢复映射与 data consistency 产生非零的转移级变化。
Result: 在多线圈 MRI 数据集上，FLEX-MRI 在重建质量上优于对比方法，同时计算效率与 few-step 基线相当；理论结果给出转移级变化非零的保证。
Conclusion: 用有限区间上的整体转移学习加随机探索，可以在不引入辅助采样器的前提下兼顾生成式 MRI 重建的保真度与少步推理的算力开销。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: When Faster Decisions Do Not Make Better Agents: An Empirical Study of Jev in Agent Workflows
papers.abstract_en: AI agents depend on repeated decisions to accomplish tasks, with large language models (LLMs) commonly serving as their core decision makers. The recent emergence of Jev offers an opportunity to make these decisions faster and at lower cost. However, it remains unclear whether such local savings can be translated into efficient and reliable task completion. In this paper, we investigate this efficiency transfer across five agents in two representative application settings, embodied tasks in ALFWorld and mobile app use in AndroidWorld. Across 4,500 task executions, we jointly evaluate task effectiveness, decision-level and task-level resource use, and execution behavior. Experimental results show that Jev integration substantially reduces decision cost and latency across all five agents, with task-level gains varying by workflow. Task success remains close to baseline levels on ALFWorld and declines more substantially in two mobile agents. Auxiliary reasoning and additional interactions absorb decision savings, while failed recovery and premature completion limit successful delivery. Mean cost per successful outcome increases in one agent even as spending per attempt falls. These findings highlight the importance of preserving progress, supporting recovery, and verifying completion when integrating efficient decision models into agent workflows. Their practical value should be assessed through successful task delivery, recovery behavior, and resources per delivered outcome.
papers.summary_zh:

Method: 在 ALFWorld 具身任务与 AndroidWorld 移动应用两个场景、五个 agent 上集成 Jev，跨 4,500 次任务执行，联合评估任务有效性、决策级与任务级资源使用以及执行行为。

papers.title: Volume Rendering with Metric--Phase Fields for Thin Structures and Sign-Ambiguous Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Neural implicit surface methods that couple volume rendering with signed distance functions (SDFs), such as VolSDF and NeuS, achieve high-quality multi-view reconstruction for watertight objects. However, these approaches rely on a globally consistent inside-outside partition of space. This assumption becomes fragile for thin structures (e.g., sheets, tubes, and thin walls) and can break down for sign-ambiguous geometry (e.g., surfaces with boundary, non-manifold junctions, and closely spaced surface components), often resulting in spurious closures or loss of fine structures. Unsigned distance field (UDF) formulations relax the global sign requirement and better support non-watertight geometry, but are substantially harder to optimize. We propose PhaseSurf, a neural volume rendering framework built on Metric-Phase Fields (MPFs). MPFs decompose geometry into a nonnegative metric field capturing unsigned proximity and a continuous phase field providing a soft sign cue. By coupling the two through residual phase injection, MPFs yield a signed composite implicit function with stable near-surface gradients while retaining UDF-like robustness in sign-ambiguous regions. This design enables direct iso-surface extraction using standard Marching Cubes and avoids the failure modes of both pure SDF- and UDF-based formulations. We further introduce MPF-specific training losses that enforce metric consistency, stabilize phase transitions near the interface, and suppress spurious geometry in free space. Experiments on multi-view datasets with thin structures and sign-ambiguous geometry show that PhaseSurf produces more stable reconstructions and higher-quality geometry than UDF-based methods and recent 3DGS pipelines, while avoiding artifacts typical of SDF-based approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 PhaseSurf：用 Metric-Phase Fields (MPF) 把几何拆成非负 metric field（无符号邻近度）与连续 phase field（软符号提示），经 residual phase injection 耦合出带稳定近表面梯度的有符号复合隐函数。对薄片、细管、薄墙及带边界/非流形结/紧邻面片等符号歧义几何，它保留 UDF 式鲁棒性并可用 Marching Cubes 直接抽面，避免 SDF 的伪闭合与细节丢失。
Motivation: VolSDF、NeuS 等 SDF+体渲染方法依赖全局一致的内外划分，对薄结构和符号歧义几何易产生伪闭合或丢失细节；UDF 免去全局符号要求却更难优化。
Method: PhaseSurf 以 MPF 构建神经体渲染框架：非负 metric field 捕获无符号邻近度，连续 phase field 提供软符号，二者经 residual phase injection 耦合得到有符号复合隐函数；另加 MPF 专用训练损失，约束 metric 一致性、稳定界面附近相位过渡并抑制自由空间伪几何；用标准 Marching Cubes 直接抽面。
Result: 在含薄结构与符号歧义几何的多视角数据集上，PhaseSurf 比 UDF 类方法与近期 3DGS 流水线重建更稳定、几何质量更高，同时避免 SDF 类方法的典型伪影；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 把无符号度量与软符号相位解耦再耦合，可在不牺牲 UDF 鲁棒性的前提下恢复 SDF 式的稳定近表面梯度与直接等值面提取，绕开纯 SDF 与纯 UDF 两类方法各自的失效模式。

papers.title: The Limits of Query Monitoring against Distributed Model Extraction
papers.abstract_en: Model providers now face distillation campaigns run through thousands of accounts, each of which looks like an ordinary user. When network and payment metadata cannot link those accounts, the only evidence left is what they ask. We study what a provider can and cannot learn from those queries alone, using one million real chat turns for development and 17 later weeks that no design choice touched for a single frozen evaluation. The answer is set less by anything specific to extraction than by benign coordination: a campaign is visible only if it is more distinctive than the most distinctive group of ordinary users in the same week. We make this precise, show that a small but positive difference between campaign and users buys a detection time rather than detectability, and identify the campaign that is hardest to detect. Empirically, a calibrated monitor catches naive distributed extraction that per-account monitors miss (0.86-1.00 of weeks), and one variant - selecting accounts that move together after discounting how topical each one is - still catches campaigns padded with natural text (0.50-0.96 of weeks) where the other two spectral detectors catch none. Distilling each campaign into a small student shows that, in our testbed, campaigns that evaded every detector kept at most 42% of the capability of a detectable one. The limits are equally concrete: a campaign that ramps up slowly poisons every detector's calibration, benign evaluation pipelines look exactly like distillation, we found no deployable detector at colluder shares of 2.5% or below, and campaigns that relay real users' requests may be invisible to any query-only monitor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究在无法用网络与支付元数据关联账号时，仅凭查询内容能否检测分布式模型抽取（distillation campaign）。校准后的监控能抓到朴素分布式抽取（0.86–1.00 的周），其中「折扣话题性后仍协同变动的账号」这一谱方法变体还能抓到掺入自然文本的活动（0.50–0.96 的周），而另两种谱检测器为零；但慢速爬升会破坏所有检测器的校准，同谋份额 ≤2.5% 时未找到可部署检测器。
Motivation: 蒸馏活动通过数千个看似普通用户的账号发起，网络与支付元数据无法关联它们时，提供方只剩查询内容这一证据，需要明确仅凭查询能学到什么、不能学到什么。
Method: 用一百万条真实对话轮次做开发集，另留 17 个后续周作为设计选择完全未触碰的冻结评估；比较逐账号监控与校准后的查询监控，含三种谱检测器（其中一种在折扣每个账号的话题性后捕捉协同变动），并把每个活动蒸馏成小学生模型以衡量能力保留。
Result: 校准监控抓到朴素分布式抽取的比例为 0.86–1.00 的周，逐账号监控抓不到；折扣话题性后看协同变动的谱检测器在掺自然文本的活动上抓到 0.50–0.96 的周，另两种谱检测器为零。规避所有检测器的活动其小学生模型最多保留可检测活动 42% 的能力。慢速爬升活动破坏所有检测器校准；同谋份额 2.5% 及以下未找到可部署检测器；转发真实用户请求的活动对任何仅查询监控可能不可见。
Conclusion: 可检测性由活动相对当周最独特普通用户群的独特程度决定，小幅正差异买到的是检测时间而非可检测性；规避代价是能力损失，但慢速爬升、良性评估流水线与请求转发构成硬性边界。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Human and LLM Facilitation in Collaborative Design Meetings: A Computational Behavioral Comparison
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored as facilitators of group discussion and collaborative work, but the behavioral differences between LLM-generated and human facilitation remain insufficiently characterized. We compare human Project Manager facilitation turns from scenario-based collaborative design meetings with Llama 3.1 8B Instruct responses across 199 paired contexts from the AMI Meeting Corpus. The analysis covers five confirmatory dimensions: contextual semantic distance, a lexical elaboration proxy, empathyand-hedge lexical density, topic divergence, and phase-vocabulary alignment. An exploratory directiveness measure failed domain validation and is not interpreted. The sampled human Project Manager turns were higher on contextual semantic distance (r = 0.644) and on empathyand-hedge lexical density (r = 0.203). The second contrast is carried mainly by hedge terms, so we read it as lexical hedging rather than psychological empathy. Llama-generated facilitation was higher on topic divergence (r = 0.703), the lexical elaboration proxy (r = 0.288; lengthconfounded), and instruction-conditioned phase-vocabulary alignment (r = 0.382). A secondary no-phase check left the Llama-higher phase contrast in place. The system prompt still requested a facilitation move, so that check is not evidence of spontaneous phase awareness. These differences should not be interpreted as a ranking of facilitation quality. The resulting behavioral profile provides a reference point for later comparisons of LLM facilitators, human facilitators, prompts, models, and collaborative settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 AMI Meeting Corpus 的 199 组配对语境，对比人类 Project Manager 的引导发言与 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct 生成的引导发言，发现人类在上下文语义距离 (r=0.644) 和共情-对冲词密度 (r=0.203) 上更高，而 Llama 在话题发散 (r=0.703)、词汇细化代理 (r=0.288，受长度混淆) 和阶段词汇对齐 (r=0.382) 上更高。作者强调这是行为画像差异而非引导质量排名。
Motivation: LLM 被越来越多地用作讨论引导者，但 LLM 生成的引导发言与人类引导发言在行为维度上的差异尚未被系统刻画，缺少可作为后续比较基准的参照。
Method: 在 AMI Meeting Corpus 的 199 组配对语境上，将人类 Project Manager 引导发言与 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct 回复对比，沿五个确证维度分析：上下文语义距离、词汇细化代理、共情-对冲词密度、话题发散、阶段词汇对齐；另有一个探索性直接性指标因未通过领域验证而不解读。
Result: 人类发言在上下文语义距离 (r=0.644) 与共情-对冲词密度 (r=0.203) 上更高，且后者主要由 hedge 词贡献；Llama 在话题发散 (r=0.703)、词汇细化代理 (r=0.288，受长度混淆) 和指令条件下的阶段词汇对齐 (r=0.382) 上更高。无阶段对照保留了 Llama 更高的阶段对比，但系统提示仍要求执行引导动作，故不构成自发阶段意识的证据。
Conclusion: 人类与 LLM 引导发言在语义距离、对冲、话题发散和阶段词汇上形成可区分的行为画像，可作为后续比较不同 LLM 引导者、人类引导者、提示、模型与协作场景的参照点，但不应读作引导质量的排名。

papers.title: SWEAR: Section-Wise Efficient Audio Reasoning via Self-Rated Difficulty
papers.abstract_en: Recent work on large audio-language models (LALMs) explores adaptive reasoning to balance accuracy and efficiency. However, existing approaches often rely on coarse-grained difficulty estimation, overlooking the diverse factors that determine reasoning effort. We address this limitation by deriving five-dimensional difficulty scores and compressed reasoning traces from complementary offline assessments. Based on this characterization, we propose SWEAR, a difficulty-aware reasoning framework that learns difficulty signals during supervised fine-tuning and uses reinforcement learning to adapt reasoning allocation across reasoning stages. Experiments on MMAU-test-mini and MMAR show that SWEAR improves accuracy while substantially reducing generated tokens, shortening reasoning for easy instances without sacrificing performance on difficult ones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SWEAR 为大音频语言模型 (LALM) 做分段式高效推理：用离线互补评估导出五维难度分与压缩推理轨迹，SFT 阶段学难度信号，RL 阶段按难度在各推理段之间分配推理预算。在 MMAU-test-mini 与 MMAR 上同时提高准确率并大幅减少生成 token，简单样本推理变短、困难样本性能不掉。
Motivation: 现有 LALM 自适应推理的难度估计过于粗糙，忽略了决定推理开销的多种因素，难以在准确率与生成长度之间做细粒度权衡。
Method: 先用互补的离线评估导出五维难度分数和压缩推理轨迹；监督微调 (SFT) 让模型学习这些难度信号，再用强化学习 (RL) 在推理各阶段之间自适应分配推理量。
Result: 在 MMAU-test-mini 与 MMAR 两个音频推理基准上，SWEAR 提升准确率的同时显著减少生成 token 数；简单样本的推理被缩短，困难样本上性能不下降。
Conclusion: 把难度估计做成多维信号并分阶段用 RL 分配推理预算，可以在音频推理任务上同时拿到更准和更省 token，而非以牺牲难题表现为代价。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: SWEAR 为大音频语言模型 (LALM) 做分段式高效推理：用离线互补评估导出五维难度分与压缩推理轨迹，SFT 阶段学难度信号，RL 阶段按难度在各推理段之间分配推理预算。在 MMAU-test-mini 与 MMAR 上同时提高准确率并大幅减少生成 token，简单样本推理变短、困难样本性能不掉。

summary_sections.method: 先用互补的离线评估导出五维难度分数和压缩推理轨迹；监督微调 (SFT) 让模型学习这些难度信号，再用强化学习 (RL) 在推理各阶段之间自适应分配推理量。

summary_sections.conclusion: 把难度估计做成多维信号并分阶段用 RL 分配推理预算，可以在音频推理任务上同时拿到更准和更省 token，而非以牺牲难题表现为代价。

papers.title: Attention Sees, MLP Refuses: Tracing the Attention-to-MLP Safety Pathway in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Safety-aligned large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreaks and can over-refuse benign requests. Understanding these failures requires distinguishing harmfulness recognition from the computation that writes refusal. We reframe this as a pathway question and make it measurable on residual-stream updates in decoder-only Transformers, separating the harmfulness information a module update exposes from the change it produces in readable refusal evidence. Across 18 Base-Instruct pairs spanning Qwen, Llama, and Gemma, harmfulness is decoded more readily from attention updates, particularly in early layers, whereas MLP updates contribute more strongly to harm-selective refusal writing in aligned models. Post-training strengthens MLP refusal writing in all 18 pairs without systematically improving harmfulness decodability, while positive MLP writing becomes more concentrated in deeper layers after post-training. Across six reasoning-enabled models, harmfulness remains decodable during reasoning while strong refusal writing concentrates at answer onset, a pattern that persists with reasoning disabled. Causal interventions further support this pathway: resetting downstream MLP updates to their clean values substantially reduces the refusal shift caused by upstream attention interventions. Building on these findings, we introduce Sentinel, which combines an attention-derived perception score P with an MLP-derived decision score D. Their joint profiles characterize jailbreaks and over-refusals, and conditional routing with both signals achieves a lower aggregate error rate than single-signal routing and evaluated fixed reminders across eight models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 decoder-only Transformer 的残差流更新拆成“有害性可读出”与“拒绝证据写入”两个可测通道，发现 attention 更新主要携带有害性信息（早期层最强），MLP 更新主要负责写入拒绝。后训练在全部 18 对 Base-Instruct 模型中都强化 MLP 拒绝写入却不系统提升有害性可解码性；重置下游 MLP 更新到 clean 值会大幅削弱上游 attention 干预造成的拒绝偏移。据此提出 Sentinel，用 attention 感知分 P 与 MLP 决策分 D 做条件路由，在八个模型上聚合错误率低于单信号路由与固定提醒。
Motivation: 安全对齐 LLM 同时存在越狱与过度拒绝，而现有分析难以把“识别有害”与“写出拒绝”这两个环节分开，无法定位失败发生在哪一层、哪个模块。
Method: 在残差流更新上定义通路度量，分离模块更新暴露的有害性信息与它对可读拒绝证据的改变；在 18 对 Base-Instruct（Qwen、Llama、Gemma）上解码比较 attention 与 MLP 更新，并用因果干预（把下游 MLP 更新重置为 clean 值）验证方向；再以 attention 感知分 P 与 MLP 决策分 D 组合成 Sentinel 做条件路由。
Result: 18 对模型中 attention 更新更易解码出有害性（早期层尤甚），MLP 更新在对齐模型中更强地写入伤害选择性拒绝；后训练强化全部 18 对的 MLP 拒绝写入但不系统提升有害性可解码性，且正向 MLP 写入向深层集中。六个推理模型中推理期间有害性仍可解码、强拒绝写入集中在答案起始处，关闭推理后模式依旧。重置下游 MLP 更新为 clean 值显著降低上游 attention 干预引起的拒绝偏移；Sentinel 的双信号条件路由在八个模型上聚合错误率低于单信号路由与所评测的固定提醒。
Conclusion: 安全失败可按通路定位：有害性感知走 attention、拒绝写入走 MLP，且两者可被独立操纵，因此用 P/D 双信号联合路由比单一信号或固定提醒更有效。

papers.title: LongHarness: Advancing Agentic Reasoning over 100M-Token Corpora via Stateful Evidence Management
papers.abstract_en: Corpus-level long-context reasoning requires agents to acquire and integrate evidence across document collections that exceed their context windows. Existing agent harnesses enable incremental access to these corpora, but acquired evidence and evolving conclusions often remain entangled in a growing interaction history. This implicit state management can lead to two coupled failure modes: unbounded exploration, where retrieval expands the interaction history without resolving decision-relevant information gaps, and evidence-state drift, where previously acquired evidence or subsequent corrections fail to inform the current conclusion. We present LongHarness, a model-agnostic harness that makes the interaction between acquired evidence and evolving conclusions explicit. Its core mechanism, Evidence-Conclusion Coevolution, uses unresolved conclusions to guide exploration toward missing information, while newly acquired evidence strengthens or revises the conclusions that directed the search. LongHarness couples this process with Evidence Lifecycle Management, which keeps accumulated evidence current and traceable throughout the interaction. Together, these mechanisms focus retrieval on remaining information needs and keep conclusions aligned with current evidence. We evaluate LongHarness on OfficeQA Pro V1 and V2, AA-LCR, and LongBench v2 using GLM-5.3-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash. Compared with direct reasoning using the same backbone, LongHarness improves GLM-5.3-Flash exact match on OfficeQA Pro from 15.8% to 60.2% on V1 and from 4.4% to 61.1% on V2. Against state-of-the-art agent harnesses, it surpasses Claude Code by 12.0 percentage points on V1 and Codex by 18.9 points on V2. With Qwen3.8-Flash, LongHarness reaches 61.7% on V1, outperforming Claude Code by 8.3 points and Codex by 12.0 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LongHarness 把智能体在超长文档语料上的「已获取证据」与「演化中的结论」显式分离并协同更新：用未解决的结论引导检索去补信息缺口，新证据再强化或修正结论，同时用 Evidence Lifecycle Management 保持证据可追溯。在 OfficeQA Pro V1/V2 上，同一 GLM-5.3-Flash 骨干的 exact match 从 15.8% 提到 60.2%（V1）、从 4.4% 提到 61.1%（V2），并分别超出 Claude Code 12.0 个百分点、Codex 18.9 个百分点。
Motivation: 语料超过上下文窗口时，已有 agent harness 虽支持增量访问，但证据与结论纠缠在不断增长的交互历史里，导致无界探索（检索只膨胀历史而不填补决策相关的信息缺口）与证据状态漂移（旧证据和后续修正不再影响当前结论）。
Method: 模型无关的 harness，核心是 Evidence-Conclusion Coevolution：以未解决的结论驱动探索方向，新获取的证据反过来强化或修订曾引导搜索的结论；外加 Evidence Lifecycle Management 维护累积证据的时效性与可追溯性。评测用 GLM-5.3-Flash 与 Qwen3.8-Flash 两个骨干，任务为 OfficeQA Pro V1/V2、AA-LCR、LongBench v2，指标为 exact match。
Result: GLM-5.3-Flash 直接推理 vs LongHarness：OfficeQA Pro V1 exact match 15.8% → 60.2%，V2 4.4% → 61.1%。对比 SOTA agent harness：V1 超 Claude Code 12.0 个百分点，V2 超 Codex 18.9 个百分点。Qwen3.8-Flash 上 LongHarness 达 61.7%（V1），超 Claude Code 8.3 个百分点、超 Codex 12.0 个百分点。
Conclusion: 把证据与结论的耦合关系显式化并管理其生命周期，可让同一骨干在百万 token 级语料问答上把 exact match 提升数倍，并在 OfficeQA Pro 上超过 Claude Code 与 Codex 这类现成 agent harness。

papers.title: Double-Take: Improving Capacity, Binding, and Selectivity In Long-Context Within Bidirectional Memory
papers.abstract_en: Processing a long sequence does not guarantee that distant information remains usable. As context grows, a fixed-size memory must retain many associations, connect information across positions, and preserve relevant structure without being overwhelmed by everything it observes. These are distinct requirements: a memory may store more information without representing the relationships needed for retrieval, and it may transport those relationships without preserving the ones that matter. Thus, the challenge is not simply extending context length, but constructing a memory that remains usable as context grows. We study this problem in large-chunk test-time training (TTT) and identify two basic failures: single-step writes accumulate interference, limiting capacity, while self-associative writes cannot form cross-position bindings. We introduce Double-Take (DT), which repairs these failures with multi-step unpinned updates and cross-position mixing, and adds bidirectional change-sensitive writes for selective retention. Capacity alone leaves end-to-end recall at the $0.10$ chance floor; adding binding raises it to $0.92$. Trained only on $32\,\mathrm{kb}$ genomic contexts, DT reaches $0.927$ AUROC at $131\,\mathrm{kb}$ and $0.856$ near $1\,\mathrm{Mb}$, while transferring zero-shot from human to mouse. Together, these results identify capacity, binding, and selectivity as three requirements for usable long-range memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在大块测试时训练 (large-chunk TTT) 中，Double-Take 用多步非固定 (unpinned) 写入加跨位置混合修复单步写入的干扰累积与自联想无法形成跨位置绑定的问题，并以双向变化敏感写入实现选择性保留。容量单独只能让端到端回忆停在 0.10 的随机水平，加上绑定后升到 0.92；仅在 32 kb 基因组上下文上训练，131 kb 上达 0.927 AUROC，接近 1 Mb 时 0.856，并可从人零样本迁移到小鼠。
Motivation: 固定大小记忆在上下文变长时要同时存更多信息、跨位置关联并保留关键结构，这三件事彼此独立：能存不代表能检索，能传不代表保留了对的部分。
Method: 在 TTT 框架下识别两类失败（单步写入干扰累积限制容量、自联想写入无法形成跨位置绑定），提出 Double-Take：多步 unpinned 更新、跨位置混合、双向变化敏感写入；训练数据为 32 kb 基因组上下文。
Result: 容量单独时端到端回忆为 0.10 的机会下限，加入绑定后升至 0.92；仅用 32 kb 训练，在 131 kb 上 0.927 AUROC，接近 1 Mb 时 0.856，并从人零样本迁移到小鼠。
Conclusion: 可用的长程记忆需要容量、绑定、选择性三项要求同时满足，缺绑定时容量再大也读不出信息。

papers.title: AV-FlowEdit: Training-Free Prompt-Driven Audio-Visual Editing with Event-Aware Spectral Trajectory Preservation
papers.abstract_en: Joint audio-video diffusion models generate synchronized content, but editing existing clips requires target changes without disrupting non-target structure or cross-modal correspondence. We present AV-FlowEdit, a training-free and inversion-free framework for prompt-driven audio-video editing. Our key insight is that source--target flow differences provide both cross-modal editing directions and preservation cues. Under shared perturbations, they jointly update the video and audio branches, supporting visual-only, audio-only, and joint edits while retaining pretrained cross-modal interactions. To suppress drift accumulated during sampling, Cross-Modal Event-Aware Spectral Trajectory Preservation combines flow saliency, aligned audio activity, multiscale low-frequency displacement, and diffusion-stage scheduling. This adaptively preserves unsupported regions while allowing intended audio-visual events. AV-FlowEdit requires no model training, external masks, or optimization-based inversion. Experiments show strong prompt alignment and temporal consistency, together with competitive audio quality and cross-modal coherence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AV-FlowEdit 是一个免训练、免反演的音视频联合扩散编辑框架：把源-目标 flow 差异同时当作跨模态编辑方向和保持线索，在共享扰动下联合更新视频与音频分支，并用 Cross-Modal Event-Aware Spectral Trajectory Preservation 抑制采样过程中的漂移。实验显示其 prompt 对齐与时间一致性较强，音频质量与跨模态一致性具有竞争力。
Motivation: 对已有音视频片段做 prompt 驱动编辑时，需要只改动目标内容而不破坏非目标结构与音画对应关系；现有联合扩散模型的编辑路径容易在采样中累积漂移。
Method: 免训练、免反演：利用源-目标 flow 差异提供跨模态编辑方向与保持线索，在共享扰动下同时更新视频与音频分支，支持仅视觉、仅音频与联合编辑并保留预训练跨模态交互；用 Cross-Modal Event-Aware Spectral Trajectory Preservation 组合 flow saliency、对齐的音频活动、多尺度低频位移与 diffusion-stage 调度，自适应保持无支撑区域、放行预期音画事件。
Result: 实验显示较强的 prompt 对齐与时间一致性，以及有竞争力的音频质量和跨模态一致性；无需模型训练、外部掩码或基于优化的反演。
Conclusion: 源-目标 flow 差异本身足以同时给出编辑方向与保持信号，配合事件感知的谱轨迹保持即可在免训练免反演设定下完成音视频编辑。

papers.title: Evolving Creatives with Clicks: CTR-Driven Advertising image Editing via Attribute Disentanglement and Preference Alignment
papers.abstract_en: The optimization objective for e-commerce advertising creatives has shifted from aesthetic quality to online business metrics like click-through rate (CTR). Recent methods generate appealing ad images from product images by constructing CTR-based reward signals and refining prompt generation via Reinforcement Learning. Such paradigms equally penalize all attributes within an underperforming image, even though some are actually beneficial to clicks. In this work, we propose Evolving Creatives with Clicks (ECC), which reformulates creative optimization as fine-grained editing rather than generation from scratch. ECC selectively refines attributes that hurt CTR while preserving those that contribute positively. Specifically, faced with a rich attribute space across massive images, ECC first identifies 28 attributes significantly correlated with CTR via ANOVA and Random Forest regression. Based on attribute contrasts between images with disparate CTRs, we instruction-tune a prompt model to generate editing suggestions, then refine it with real click preferences since reference-derived suggestions are not uniformly beneficial. Furthermore, we introduce Consistent Preference Optimization (CPO) as ECC's preference optimization strategy, which enforces consistency across semantically equivalent shuffled suggestions to mitigate DPO overfitting and improve preference generalization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ECC significantly improves the CTR of ad images, outperforming state-of-the-art models by a substantial margin. The complete data pipeline, including attribute extraction and analysis, the resulting dataset, and source code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ECC 把电商广告图优化从整图重生成改为细粒度编辑：先用 ANOVA 与 Random Forest 回归筛出与 CTR 显著相关的 28 个属性，只改伤害 CTR 的属性、保留正贡献属性，再用 Consistent Preference Optimization (CPO) 在语义等价的打乱建议上施加一致性约束以缓解 DPO 过拟合。实验显示 ECC 显著提升广告图 CTR，大幅超越现有最优模型。
Motivation: 现有 CTR 驱动的广告图生成用强化学习构造奖励并对图内所有属性一视同仁地惩罚，即使部分属性实际有利于点击，导致优化信号粗糙、无法定向修改。
Method: ECC 将创意优化重构为细粒度编辑：先用 ANOVA 与 Random Forest 回归从海量图片属性空间中筛出 28 个与 CTR 显著相关的属性；基于高/低 CTR 图片的属性对比，指令微调 prompt 模型生成编辑建议，再用真实点击偏好精修；最后提出 Consistent Preference Optimization (CPO)，对语义等价的打乱建议强制一致以抑制 DPO 过拟合。
Result: 在广告图 CTR 上 ECC 显著优于 state-of-the-art 模型并以较大差距领先；属性分析得到 28 个与 CTR 显著相关的属性。摘要未给出具体 CTR 数值。
Conclusion: 只编辑拖累 CTR 的属性并保留正贡献属性，配合一致性偏好优化，比整图重生成更能提升广告点击率；数据管线、属性数据集与源码计划在接收后开源。

papers.title: CB-Orchestrator: Adaptive Workflow Optimization for LLM Agents via Contextual Bandits
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in tackling complex tasks through agentic workflows. However, manually designing these workflows is labor-intensive and lacks flexibility to adapt to diverse queries. While automated workflow optimization is a promising direction, existing methods often incur expensive API costs during training-phase feedback collection. Furthermore, they fail to adaptively reuse high-quality workflows, which creates a bottleneck for both performance and cost-effectiveness. To address these limitations, we propose CB-Orchestrator, an adaptive framework that decouples workflow generation from selection. In the first stage, we construct a diverse pool of candidate workflows via evolutionary search. In the second stage, we formulate workflow selection as a Contextual Bandit problem, which enables sample-efficient learning by balancing exploration and exploitation, thereby significantly reducing the feedback required for training. During inference, the model adaptively selects the optimal workflow tailored to each query. Evaluations across five diverse benchmarks demonstrate that CB-Orchestrator consistently outperforms all baselines. Notably, on the MATH dataset, CB-Orchestrator achieves better performance than strong recent baselines while reducing training-phase API token overhead by no less than 40.55% and total end-to-end training (including workflow pool generation) token overhead by no less than 29.73%.
papers.comment: Presented at ICML 2026 Workshop on Compositional Learning: Safety, Interpretability, and Agents
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CB-Orchestrator 把 LLM agent 工作流优化拆成两阶段：进化搜索生成候选工作流池，再把按 query 选工作流建模为 Contextual Bandit，推理时为每条 query 自适应挑选最优工作流。在五个基准上一致优于全部基线，MATH 数据集上以不低于 40.55% 的训练期 API token 开销和不低于 29.73% 的端到端训练 token 开销取得更好性能。
Motivation: 手工设计 agentic workflow 费力且难以适配多样 query；已有自动优化方法在训练期收集反馈时 API 成本高，且不能复用高质量工作流，性能与成本都受限。
Method: 两阶段解耦框架：第一阶段用进化搜索 (evolutionary search) 构造多样候选工作流池；第二阶段把工作流选择形式化为 Contextual Bandit，通过探索-利用平衡实现样本高效学习，减少训练所需反馈；推理时按 query 自适应选择工作流。
Result: 在五个多样基准上一致优于所有基线；MATH 数据集上性能超过强近期基线，同时训练期 API token 开销降低不低于 40.55%，含工作流池生成的端到端训练 token 开销降低不低于 29.73%。
Conclusion: 把工作流生成与选择解耦、用 Contextual Bandit 做选择，可以在保持或提升 LLM agent 性能的同时大幅压低训练期 token 成本。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Travel Back To Move Forward: Retrospective Exploration and Evolving for Long Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents increasingly operate in long-horizon environments where early mistakes can trigger cascading failures and trap agents in dead-end trajectories. Agents must therefore be able to proactively recover from such states and turn their exploratory experience into guidance for subsequent decisions. We introduce ReTRAIL, a framework that enables agents to rewind the environment to earlier states while preserving valid progress and carrying forward knowledge learned from abandoned exploration. The environment state moves backward while the agent's knowledge continues to move forward. ReTRAIL trains a shared policy with two complementary signals: State-Anchored GRPO compares alternative continuations from revisited states to improve execution, while a branch-advancement reward guides reflection through the progress of subsequent exploration. Experiments across four interactive benchmark MineSweeper, Sokoban, ALFWorld and ScienceWorld show that simply adding a rewind primitive provides limited benefit and can even degrade performance. In contrast, ReTRAIL enables agents to rewind from unproductive states and use insights from abandoned branches to guide subsequent exploration. These results demonstrate the value of coupling environment rewinding with experience reuse within an ongoing task for long-horizon task solving. The code is available at https://github.com/whi497/ReTRAIL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReTRAIL 让 LLM agent 把环境回退到早期状态并保留已获进展，同时把废弃分支中学到的知识带入后续决策：用 State-Anchored GRPO 比较回溯状态下的备选续接来改进执行，用 branch-advancement reward 借后续探索进度引导反思。在 MineSweeper、Sokoban、ALFWorld、ScienceWorld 四个交互基准上，仅加入 rewind 原语收益有限甚至降低性能，而耦合回溯与经验复用的 ReTRAIL 能从无产出状态回退并利用废弃分支的洞见。
Motivation: 长时程任务中早期错误会级联并把 agent 困在死路轨迹里，现有 agent 缺少主动回退并把探索经验转成后续决策依据的机制。
Method: ReTRAIL 训练一个共享策略，携带两路互补信号：State-Anchored GRPO 在回溯到的状态上比较不同续接以改进执行；branch-advancement reward 用后续探索的推进程度来监督反思。环境状态向后走，agent 的知识向前走。
Result: 在四个交互基准 MineSweeper、Sokoban、ALFWorld、ScienceWorld 上，单纯加入 rewind 原语收益有限、甚至降低性能；ReTRAIL 则能从无产出状态回退并用废弃分支的洞见引导后续探索。
Conclusion: 在持续任务内把环境回溯与经验复用耦合起来，对长时程任务求解有价值；单独提供回退能力并不足够。

papers.title: CoBe: A Benchmark For Conversational Counterfactual Text Editing
papers.abstract_en: Counterfactual text editing is the ability to revise a given text in light of a hypothetical change while preserving facts not causally affected by that change. When asked what would have happened if a doctor had not recommended surgery, the model output should retain the patient's medical history and modify only the consequences of the decision. This requires causal understanding: a model must determine, without being explicitly instructed to, what events are affected by the hypothetical change and what should remain fixed. This skill is central to human reasoning, especially in safety-critical domains like healthcare or law. By contrast, the task of associational text generation merely generates text statistically associated with the altered condition. In the medical example, an associational response might make the patient's symptoms less severe because milder cases correlate with no surgery. Such responses produce a plausible scenario, but not the counterfactual version of the given one. Prior counterfactual-text datasets do not clearly separate these modes of reasoning. We introduce the Counterfactual Benchmark (CoBe), a testbed for models' zero-shot ability to counterfactually edit a given textual scenario when prompted to do so in a conversationally natural way. CoBe contains 2000 questions spanning healthcare, science and engineering, business, and everyday scenarios. We test a suite of frontier and smaller models, with frontier systems achieving an average score of $58.05\%$. Our findings indicate that models frequently default to associational generation rather than preserving the causal structure of the original scenario. Moreover, performance does not scale consistently with either model size or output token length, suggesting that the failure may reflect model training objectives rather than insufficient model capacity.
papers.comment: accepted to NeurIPS'26 workshops on Trustworthy AI For Good (AI4GOOD) and Trustworthy AI Evaluations (TAE)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoBe 是一个零样本评测集，检验对话式提示下模型能否只改写假设变化的后果、保留未受因果影响的事实。含 2000 道覆盖医疗、科学工程、商业与日常场景的题目，前沿模型平均得分 58.05%，且多数回答退化为关联式生成而非保持原场景因果结构。
Motivation: 既有反事实文本数据集不区分反事实编辑与关联式生成两种推理模式，无法衡量模型是否真正保留原场景的因果结构。
Method: 提出 Counterfactual Benchmark (CoBe)：以对话式自然提示、零样本方式评测模型对给定文本场景做反事实编辑的能力，题目覆盖 healthcare、science and engineering、business 与日常场景，共 2000 题；对一组前沿与较小规模模型进行测试。
Result: CoBe 含 2000 道题；前沿模型平均得分 58.05%；模型频繁退回到关联式生成而非保持原场景因果结构；表现不随模型规模或输出 token 长度一致提升。
Conclusion: 反事实编辑的失败更可能源于训练目标而非模型容量不足，即模型倾向生成与改写条件统计相关而非因果一致的文本。

papers.title: A4-MR: Abnormality-aware Anatomical Alignment for MR
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large-scale foundation models have enabled strong generalization across a wide range of clinical and research tasks in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). However, existing vision-language MRI models remain limited in anatomy-specific localization and pathology-aware representation, particularly in real-world settings. We introduce A4-MR, a 3D vision-language foundation model trained on approximately 50,000 MRI studies comprising 491,000 series, roughly half of which are paired with radiology reports. A4-MR is designed to: (1) learn anatomy localization through large-scale pretraining with noisy labels; (2) align image and text representations at the anatomical level; and (3) learn distinct representations of healthy and abnormal anatomy. Across a diverse set of downstream tasks, A4-MR outperforms existing foundation models, including a +1.7 AUROC improvement over MedSigLIP for abnormality detection. Using a frozen encoder, A4-MR also surpasses an end-to-end task-specific MedNeXt model for knee segmentation by +1.4 Dice and performs comparably to the best task-specific model for abdominal organ segmentation on AMOS, within 0.4 Dice. Finally, without anatomical prompts, A4-MR localizes 3D anatomy comparably to MedSAM2 provided with ground-truth bounding boxes. Together, these results demonstrate that anatomy-level multimodal alignment and abnormality-aware representation learning can enable a single MRI foundation model to support localization, segmentation, and pathology-related tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: A4-MR 是一个 3D 视觉-语言 MRI 基础模型，在约 50,000 项 MRI 研究、491,000 个序列（约一半与放射报告配对）上做解剖层级图文对齐与健康/异常解剖的区分表征。在多项下游任务上超过现有基础模型：异常检测 AUROC 比 MedSigLIP 高 1.7，冻结编码器的膝部分割 Dice 比端到端 MedNeXt 高 1.4，AMOS 腹部器官分割与最优专用模型差距在 0.4 Dice 以内。
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言 MRI 模型在解剖特异性定位和病理感知表征上仍然受限，尤其在真实临床场景中难以用单一模型同时支撑定位、分割与病理相关任务。
Method: A4-MR 通过大规模带噪声标签的预训练学习解剖定位，在解剖层级对齐图像与文本表征，并学习健康与异常解剖的区分表征；训练数据为约 50,000 项 MRI 研究、491,000 个序列，其中约一半与放射报告配对，下游任务可用冻结编码器。
Result: 异常检测 AUROC 相对 MedSigLIP 提升 +1.7；冻结编码器下膝部分割 Dice 超过端到端专用 MedNeXt +1.4；AMOS 腹部器官分割与最优专用模型差距在 0.4 Dice 以内；无解剖提示时 3D 解剖定位能力与给定 ground-truth bounding box 的 MedSAM2 相当。
Conclusion: 解剖层级多模态对齐与异常感知表征学习足以让单一 MRI 基础模型同时支撑定位、分割和病理相关任务，且冻结编码器即可接近或超过专用模型。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: UniMergeTrack: Hierarchical Model Merging for General RGB-X Visual Object Tracking
papers.abstract_en: RGB-X tracking leverages complementary modalities, such as thermal infrared, event, or depth, to improve robustness under challenging conditions. Existing general-purpose RGB-X trackers typically follow two paradigms: independent task-specific training and joint training across modality combinations. However, the former suffers from knowledge isolation and model redundancy, while the latter introduces optimization interference across heterogeneous tasks. In this work, we present UniMergeTrack, a new model merging paradigm that preserves task-specific optimization while enabling effective cross-task knowledge integration. UniMergeTrack first trains modality-specific trackers independently and then performs hierarchical model merging. Specifically, transferable backbones are merged across RGB-X tasks via high-pass-filtered merging, and complemented by lightweight task-specific experts that preserve modality-specific cues. Tracking heads are merged within each task using optimal transport-guided channel alignment to mitigate hidden channel mismatch. A subsequent distribution alignment fine-tuning stage further improves compatibility between the unified backbone and task-specific heads. Extensive experiments on the LasHeR, RGBT234, VisEvent, VOT-RGBD22, COESOT, and CDTB benchmarks demonstrate that UniMergeTrack achieves state-of-the-art or competitive performance across RGB-Thermal, RGB-Event, and RGB-Depth tracking tasks, while exhibiting strong generalization to unseen datasets. The source code will be released upon acceptance. The source code of this paper will be released on https://github.com/Event-AHU/OpenEvTracking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniMergeTrack 把 RGB-X 视觉目标跟踪从「联合训练」改为「先独立训练各模态跟踪器、再分层模型合并」：可迁移 backbone 用高通滤波合并 (high-pass-filtered merging)，配轻量任务专家保留模态线索，跟踪头在任务内用最优传输引导的通道对齐 (optimal transport-guided channel alignment) 合并，再做分布对齐微调。在 LasHeR、RGBT234、VisEvent、VOT-RGBD22、COESOT、CDTB 上跨 RGB-热红外、RGB-事件、RGB-深度取得 SOTA 或有竞争力的表现，并对未见数据集有较强泛化。
Motivation: 通用 RGB-X 跟踪器的两条主流路线各有硬伤：独立训练造成知识孤立与模型冗余，跨模态组合的联合训练则在异构任务间产生优化干扰。

Result: 在 LasHeR、RGBT234、VisEvent、VOT-RGBD22、COESOT、CDTB 六个基准上，跨 RGB-Thermal、RGB-Event、RGB-Depth 三类跟踪任务达到 state-of-the-art 或有竞争力的性能，并对未见数据集表现出强泛化。

papers.title: Space Over Statistic, Retraining Over Ranking: Auditing Training Labels Under Label-Only Backdoors
papers.abstract_en: Some backdoor attacks never touch an image. FLIP only changes labels: on CIFAR-10, flipping 3% of them makes a ResNet-32 send 99.7% of triggered source-class images to the attacker's class. The usual defenses look for the poison inside a model trained on those same labels. So when they struggle, is the problem the test they run, or the space they run it in? We answer with a controlled swap: we keep the test, the labels and the metric fixed, change only the feature space, and judge each defense by retraining the victim on what it keeps. The space decides. On dog$\to$cat the same nearest-neighbor check scores AUROC 0.546 on the poisoned model's features, 0.967 on frozen DINOv2 features that never saw a label, and 0.995 on the same network trained on clean labels, an oracle control rather than a defense. We reproduce SPECTRE, the defense FLIP's authors recommend, to 90.94 / 0.97 against its published 91.47 / 1.7, then price it: on truck$\to$deer it deletes 20% of every class, while a prototype audit on the frozen features deletes 6% for higher clean accuracy and lower attack success. On three harder pairs that audit leaves about a quarter of the attack standing. A count read off encoder geometry and clean labels, before any attack is run, separates the pair where the audit removes the attack from those where it only partly does, though on a single zero-count pair. Three results warn against the easy story. A better detection score does not mean a safer model: on two of four pairs Confident Learning scores the higher AUROC, and on dog$\to$cat leaves 2.6 times the attack success. The prototype family, our best static performer, is the first an adaptive attacker slips past. And past a point, catching more poisons stops reducing attack success. Check labels in a space that never learned them, and judge a defense by the retrained model, not by its detection score.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于 label-only 后门攻击防御审计的论文：FLIP 只翻转 3% 标签即可让 ResNet-32 在 CIFAR-10 上把 99.7% 的触发源类图像送入攻击者类，作者固定测试、标签与度量、只换特征空间，并用重训练后的受害者模型而非检测分数来评判防御。结论是：在从未学过标签的冻结 DINOv2 特征上做最近邻/原型审计，dog→cat 的 AUROC 从中毒模型特征的 0.546 升到 0.967（干净标签训练的 oracle 为 0.995），且比 SPECTRE 更少删样本；建议在未学过标签的空间里查标签、用重训练模型而非检测分数评判防御。
Motivation: 现有后门防御在与中毒标签相同的数据上训练的模型里找毒，检测分数与模型实际安全性脱钩；作者要区分问题出在检测测试本身还是它所处的特征空间。
Method: 受控替换实验：固定测试、标签与度量，只更换特征空间（中毒模型特征、冻结 DINOv2 特征、干净标签训练的 oracle），并以在防御所保留数据上重训练受害者模型作为评判标准；复现 SPECTRE 并加入原型审计 (prototype audit)、Confident Learning 等对比，另用攻击前可算的编码器几何与干净标签计数预测审计效果。
Result: FLIP 翻转 3% 标签使 ResNet-32 对触发源类图像的攻击成功率达 99.7%（CIFAR-10）。dog→cat 最近邻检测 AUROC：中毒特征 0.546、冻结 DINOv2 0.967、干净标签 oracle 0.995。SPECTRE 复现为 90.94 / 0.97（原文 91.47 / 1.7）；truck→deer 上 SPECTRE 删除每类 20% 样本，冻结特征上的原型审计仅删 6% 且干净精度更高、攻击成功率更低。三个更难的攻击对上原型审计仍留下约四分之一攻击；四个对中两个对上 Confident Learning 的 AUROC 更高，但在 dog→cat 上残留攻击成功率为 2.6 倍。
Conclusion: 检测分数高不等于模型更安全：应在从未学过标签的特征空间里查标签，并以重训练后的模型而非检测分数评判防御；原型家族虽是最佳静态防御，却最先被自适应攻击者绕过，且捕获更多毒药越过某点后不再降低攻击成功率。

papers.title: NOFACE3D: NOise-scheduled Focused Anchoring and Controlled Enhancement for 3D Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent image-to-3D models generate complete, high-quality assets from a single image, with global shape and appearance that are already convincing; what remains is the fine scale, where small, thin, elongated, or detail-rich regions are reconstructed softly and under-resolved. This gap can arise in generators with fixed-resolution spatial grids: the same spatial sampling density is used for a large, smooth, low-curvature surface and for a thin, high-curvature structure that carries most of the perceived detail. To this end, we introduce NOFACE3D, a training-free framework that refines these detail-critical regions while preserving the rest of the asset. Given a generated mesh, its input image, and a refinement box, NOFACE3D extracts the selected submesh, scales it up to fill the generator's input volume, and re-encodes it into the full-resolution latent grid. Conditioned on the image crop, it refines the region through flow-based sampling with a spatially varying noise schedule that anchors boundary latents. The refined region is then integrated back into the original asset, preserving the surrounding geometry and appearance. We implement NOFACE3D on TRELLIS.2 and its sparse voxel representation; all of it operates purely at inference time on the frozen pretrained generator. We evaluate NOFACE3D on PAniC-3D, TexVerse and BigDetail, a new benchmark of 339 assets with annotated detail-critical regions. On all three, it generates sharper geometry and finer texture detail than the baselines. Project page: https://idkcouscous.github.io/NoFACE3D/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NOFACE3D 是一个免训练的图像到 3D 细节精修框架：把用户框选的细小、细长、高曲率子网格放大填满生成器输入体积并重编码到全分辨率 latent grid，再用带空间可变噪声调度（锚定边界 latent）的 flow-based 采样在图像裁剪条件下精修该区域，最后拼回原资产。在 TRELLIS.2 上对 PAniC-3D、TexVerse 和新提出的 BigDetail（339 个带细节关键区域标注的资产）三个基准评估，几何更锐利、纹理细节更细。
Motivation: 单图生成 3D 的整体形状已足够好，但固定分辨率空间网格对大而平滑的表面和细而高曲率的结构使用同一采样密度，导致小、细、细长或细节丰富区域被软化、欠分辨。
Method: 免训练、纯推理时作用于冻结的预训练生成器：输入生成好的 mesh、原图和精修框，抽取子网格并放大填满生成器输入体积，重编码进全分辨率 latent grid；以图像裁剪为条件做 flow-based 采样，噪声调度随空间变化以锚定边界 latent；精修结果再集成回原资产，保留周边几何与外观。实现基于 TRELLIS.2 及其 sparse voxel representation。
Result: 在 PAniC-3D、TexVerse 和 BigDetail 三个基准上，生成的几何比基线更锐利、纹理细节更细；BigDetail 是作者新提出的基准，含 339 个带标注细节关键区域的资产。
Conclusion: 固定分辨率 latent 网格造成的细节欠分辨可以在不重训生成器的前提下，通过区域抽取、放大重编码与边界锚定的噪声调度在推理时局部修复，且不破坏周边几何与外观。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Redirecting Teacher Supervision: Temporal-Response-Guided Latent Distillation for Video-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers capabilities through teacher predictions on student-generated sequences, as studied by GKD and MiniLLM for language models and Video-OPD for video tasks. We ask how internal supervision can further support temporal learning. Direct hidden-state alignment does not explicitly use the student's temporal responses to choose a supervision direction. We propose Temporal-Response Guidance (TRG), which measures representation responses to local temporal perturbations, adds the teacher correction's projection onto their span back to the original correction, and restores its original norm. The projection is not normalized separately, and correction components outside the response space are retained. With an orthogonal tangent projector and a detached target, TRG changes the supervision direction while preserving the cosine-loss value and aligned-representation gradient norm at target construction. On TempCompass, Video-MME, MVBench, and Video-MMMU, TRG improves the 4B student's macro accuracy by 2.86 percentage points over the reported output-only OPD baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRG（Temporal-Response Guidance）在 on-policy 蒸馏中重定向隐层监督方向：测量学生表征对局部时间扰动的响应，把教师修正投影到该响应张成的空间并加回原修正、恢复原范数，从而在保持 cosine loss 数值与对齐表征梯度范数不变的前提下改变监督方向。在 TempCompass、Video-MME、MVBench、Video-MMMU 上，4B 学生的宏平均准确率较已报告的 output-only OPD 基线提升 2.86 个百分点。
Motivation: on-policy 蒸馏 (OPD) 只用教师对学生产出序列的预测做监督，隐层对齐又未利用学生自身的时间响应来决定监督方向，时间学习因此缺少显式的内部信号。
Method: TRG 计算学生表征对局部时间扰动的响应，把教师修正在该响应空间上的投影加回原修正并恢复原范数（投影不单独归一化，响应空间之外的修正分量保留）；配合 orthogonal tangent projector 与 detached target 构造目标，在构造目标时保持 cosine loss 数值和对齐表征的梯度范数不变。
Result: 在 TempCompass、Video-MME、MVBench、Video-MMMU 四个视频语言基准上，TRG 使 4B 学生的宏平均准确率比已报告的 output-only OPD 基线提高 2.86 个百分点。
Conclusion: 用学生的时间响应来定向隐层监督，可以在不改动损失数值与梯度范数的情况下改善视频语言模型的 on-policy 蒸馏效果。

papers.title: Lightweight Time-Frequency Vibration Sensing for Consumer Device Condition Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Consumer rotating devices, including washing machines, air conditioners, electric fans, robotic vacuum cleaners, and home fitness equipment, increasingly rely on vibration sensing for intelligent condition monitoring and predictive maintenance. Ensuring reliable operation in these resource-constrained appliances requires efficient, lightweight artificial intelligence (AI) solutions capable of processing non-stationary signals under real-world operational interference. This paper proposes a lightweight AI-assisted vibration sensing framework that employs continuous wavelet transform (CWT) and Hilbert-Huang transform (HHT) to convert one-dimensional (1-D) vibration time-series signals into two-dimensional (2-D) time-frequency representations. These representations are subsequently analyzed using lightweight deep learning architectures, specifically MobileNetV3-Small, ConvNeXt-Tiny, and the You Only Look Once version 11 classification model (YOLOv11-cls). Public bearing benchmark datasets, including Case Western Reserve University (CWRU), Paderborn University (PU), and Intelligent Maintenance Systems (IMS), are utilized as representative rotating components to investigate model generalization. The proposed framework is designed with eventual embedded deployment in consumer electronics in mind. Experimental results demonstrate that CWT combined with YOLOv11-cls achieves high diagnostic accuracy, while MobileNetV3-Small provides an attractive low-latency alternative for computationally constrained edge platforms. Conventional random splitting is also compared with dataset-specific structured isolation. The results highlight the importance of avoiding data leakage and quantify tradeoffs in classification accuracy, parameter count, floating-point operations (FLOPs), model footprint, preprocessing cost, and central processing unit (CPU) inference latency.

papers.title: Towards Easier-to-Tune Training Algorithms: New Results from AlgoPerf
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating deep learning optimizer is challenging because confounding factors such as hyperparameter tuning and optimizer-model co-design often obscure true algorithmic performance. We present results of the updated AlgoPerf V1 benchmark, in which we evaluate a new set of training algorithms on wall-clock time-to-target across nine workloads on fixed hardware. This report focuses on the results of the benchmark's self-tuning ruleset, which requires submissions to use a single configuration across all workloads. Out of the 13 submissions in PyTorch and JAX, Schedule-Free AdamW ranked first. In addition to the wall-clock scores, we also analyze the trade-offs between step efficiency and wall-clock execution, revealing that matrix-preconditioned and two-loop methods achieve good sample efficiency but require more aggressive computational optimizations to be competitive in runtime. Finally, our hyperparameter saliency and retention analyses show that the learning rate and momentum are highly sensitive across domains and algorithms, highlighting the need for methods that are more robust against hyperparameter tuning and can generalize well to new tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AlgoPerf V1 更新版基准在固定硬件上用 wall-clock time-to-target 评测九个 workload 的训练算法，自调节规则要求所有任务共用单一配置。13 个 PyTorch/JAX 提交中 Schedule-Free AdamW 排名第一；矩阵预条件与两循环方法样本效率好但运行时需更激进的计算优化，学习率和动量跨域跨算法高度敏感。
Motivation: 超参数调节与 optimizer-model 协同设计等混杂因素常掩盖训练算法的真实性能，需要在统一硬件与统一配置约束下比较。
Method: 更新版 AlgoPerf V1 基准：九个 workload、固定硬件、以 wall-clock time-to-target 为指标，采用 self-tuning ruleset（单一配置跨全部任务），共评测 13 个 PyTorch 与 JAX 提交；另做 step efficiency 与 wall-clock 执行的权衡分析，以及超参数 saliency 与 retention 分析。
Result: 自调节规则下 13 个提交中 Schedule-Free AdamW 排名第一；矩阵预条件与两循环方法样本效率好但运行时竞争力不足；学习率与动量在不同域和算法上高度敏感。
Conclusion: 训练算法评价必须在统一配置与 wall-clock 口径下进行，且需要对超参数调节更鲁棒、能泛化到新任务的方法。
