papers.title: GeoGR: Spatial-Semantic Token Compression and Group Routing for Efficient 3D VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multi-view representations enable pretrained image and video vision-language models to understand 3D scenes, but their long visual token sequences make inference costly. Redundancy arises both from repeated observations of the same scene regions across views and from processing all visual tokens at every LLM layer, regardless of their relevance to the current computation. We propose GeoGR, a two-stage framework that jointly compresses scene representations and visual computation. At the projector level, GeoSemZip consolidates cross-view observations into 3D voxel tokens and combines semantic saliency with spatial coverage to construct a compact scene representation. Unselected voxel features are aggregated into contextual anchors to retain scene information that would otherwise be discarded. At the LLM level, we identify an effective visual computation window and observe that query-conditioned token relevance remains locally stable but changes over longer layer intervals. Guided by these findings, GroupRoute combines late entry and early exit with recoverable group-wise skipping. Low-relevance tokens bypass complete LLM layers while retaining their hidden states and can rejoin the active group at subsequent anchor layers selected under a computation budget. For compression-aware post-training, we construct a compact dataset of 67K samples by retaining 30% of the original training pool. With this protocol, GeoGR retains 95.2% and 96.8% of the dense post-trained models' performance on LLaVA-OneVision-7B and Video-3D LLM-7B, respectively, while accelerating LLM prefill by $6.8\times$ and $6.1\times$. These results demonstrate the consistent effectiveness of GeoGR across 3D VLMs with and without explicit 3D spatial encoding, highlighting a favorable performance-efficiency trade-off. The code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/GeoGR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoGR 面向 3D 视觉语言模型的长视觉 token 序列，在投影层用 GeoSemZip 把跨视角观测合并为 3D voxel token（语义显著性 + 空间覆盖，未选特征聚合为 contextual anchors），在 LLM 层用 GroupRoute 做可恢复的分组跳层。压缩感知后训练仅保留原训练池 30%（67K 样本）后，在 LLaVA-OneVision-7B 与 Video-3D LLM-7B 上分别保住稠密模型 95.2% 与 96.8% 的性能，LLM prefill 加速 6.8× 与 6.1×。
Motivation: 多视角表征让预训练图像/视频 VLM 能理解 3D 场景，但视觉 token 序列过长导致推理昂贵：同一场景区域被跨视角重复观测，且每个 LLM 层都处理全部视觉 token 而不论其与当前计算的相关性。
Method: 两阶段框架：投影层的 GeoSemZip 将跨视角观测整合为 3D voxel token，用语义显著性加空间覆盖挑选紧凑表征，未选中的 voxel 特征聚合进 contextual anchors 保留信息；LLM 层的 GroupRoute 基于“query 条件下的 token 相关性在局部稳定、跨较长层区间变化”的观察，结合 late entry、early exit 与可恢复的分组跳过——低相关 token 绕过完整层但保留 hidden state，并在计算预算选定的 anchor 层重新加入活跃组。压缩感知后训练用保留原训练池 30% 构成的 67K 样本数据集。
Result: 在 LLaVA-OneVision-7B 上保住稠密后训练模型 95.2% 的性能，LLM prefill 加速 6.8×；在 Video-3D LLM-7B 上保住 96.8%，prefill 加速 6.1×；后训练数据为原训练池 30% 的 67K 样本。
Conclusion: 空间-语义 token 压缩与分组路由可在带与不带显式 3D 空间编码的 3D VLM 上一致地取得性能-效率的有利折中，代码已开源。

papers.title: Target-Constrained Pooling for Trajectory Extrapolation
papers.abstract_en: Trajectory extrapolation from a partial target trajectory is underdetermined, but completed related trajectories provide information about the unresolved continuation. We propose target-constrained pooling (TCP), which separates the finite-horizon endpoint from continuation shape and estimates that endpoint from two complementary source signals. Uniform pooling captures final response levels, while matched-increment pooling captures the remaining change after aligning source and target states. TCP selects representative sources, projects both endpoint estimates onto a target-consistent region, converts them into corrections of the free forecast, and controls their influence through strength calibration and degradation-aware weighting. Across 25,245 targets from five domains and both forecasting directions, TCP reduces mean RMSE by 35.8% to 42.1% for all ten target-only forecasters and improves all 100 forecaster, dataset, and direction comparisons. The two endpoint signals consistently outperform either alone, while representative selection remains within 0.64% to 1.02% of the full donor pool using 12.7x fewer donor inputs and 138.8x fewer matching distance computations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对部分目标轨迹外推的欠定问题，提出 target-constrained pooling (TCP)：把有限时域终点与延续形状分离，用 uniform pooling 与 matched-increment pooling 两条互补信号估计终点，再投影到目标一致区域并以强度校准和退化感知加权修正自由预报。在五个领域 25,245 个目标、双向设置上，TCP 使全部十个 target-only 预报器的平均 RMSE 下降 35.8%–42.1%，100 组预报器×数据集×方向比较全部提升。
Motivation: 从部分目标轨迹外推本身欠定，单靠目标自身历史无法确定未观测的后续；而已完成的相关轨迹含有未解析延续的信息，但如何把这种信息注入自由预报而不破坏目标一致性尚无办法。
Method: TCP 分离有限时域终点与延续形状：uniform pooling 捕获最终响应水平，matched-increment pooling 在对齐源与目标状态后捕获剩余变化；随后选取代表性源（representative selection），把两个终点估计投影到目标一致区域，转成对自由预报的修正，并用 strength calibration 与 degradation-aware weighting 控制修正强度。
Result: 在五个领域共 25,245 个目标、覆盖两个预报方向上，TCP 使全部十个 target-only 预报器的平均 RMSE 降低 35.8% 到 42.1%，并在全部 100 个预报器、数据集与方向组合的比较中取得提升；两个终点信号联用一致优于任一单独使用；代表性选择相对完整 donor pool 仅差 0.64% 到 1.02%，同时 donor 输入减少 12.7 倍、匹配距离计算减少 138.8 倍。
Conclusion: 把终点水平与剩余变化作为两条互补信号并约束到目标一致区域，可以在不遍历完整 donor pool 的情况下稳定降低轨迹外推误差，且该修正对不同预报器与方向普遍成立。

papers.title: Low-Rank Kolmogorov-Arnold Generator Flows for Interpretable Operator Learning
papers.abstract_en: Neural operators that learn physical laws from data should generalize beyond their training distribution and expose the learned law in closed form. The Kolmogorov-Arnold neural operator achieves both for position-dependent dynamics by learning a dense pseudo-differential symbol over all positions and frequencies, at a cost that grows with the square of the resolution and with closed forms that must be read out by hand. This dense symbol is unnecessary: a finite-order variable-coefficient differential operator has a symbol whose separation rank is bounded by the number of its coefficient functions, independently of the resolution, and the symbols that this network learns on its own benchmarks have rank two. We introduce the Kolmogorov-Arnold flow (KAFlow), which learns the generator of a physical operator as a low-rank symbol built from univariate Kolmogorov-Arnold functions, fixes the gauge of these functions so that every term has a unique place, integrates the dynamics with exact exponential integrators, and distills its closed form automatically. On the synthetic benchmarks of the Kolmogorov-Arnold neural operator, KAFlow lowers the out-of-distribution loss by 3.4 to 11 times and recovers every coefficient to within 10^-4 without symbolic templates, reaching the precision floor of the data. On long-horizon quantum dynamics, it lowers the state infidelity by up to 6 orders of magnitude, and by 30 times when trained only on position and momentum measurements. KAFlow also learns a variable-order fractional operator 15 times more accurately than existing operator networks and discovers nonlocal, fractional and non-polynomial dispersion relations on which sparse regression fails.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KAFlow 用低秩 variable-coefficient symbol 表示物理算子的 generator，替代 KAN 神经算子的稠密 pseudo-differential symbol：symbol 分离秩被系数函数个数界定、与分辨率无关，网络自带基准上学到的秩为 2。配合 gauge 固定与精确指数积分器，它自动蒸馏出闭式形式，在 KAN 合成基准上把分布外损失降低 3.4–11 倍、系数恢复到 10^-4 以内。
Motivation: KAN 神经算子用覆盖所有位置与频率的稠密 symbol 学位置相关动力学，代价随分辨率平方增长，且闭式形式要人工读出；而有限阶变系数微分算子的 symbol 分离秩本就有界，稠密表示是冗余的。
Method: KAFlow 以由一元 Kolmogorov-Arnold 函数拼成的低秩 symbol 学物理算子的 generator；固定这些函数的 gauge 使每一项有唯一位置；用精确指数积分器 (exact exponential integrators) 积分动力学，并自动蒸馏闭式形式。
Result: 在 KAN 神经算子的合成基准上，分布外 (OOD) 损失降低 3.4 至 11 倍，所有系数恢复到 10^-4 以内且无需符号模板，达到数据精度下限；长时域量子动力学中 state infidelity 最多降低 6 个数量级，仅用位置与动量测量训练时降低 30 倍；对变阶分数阶算子的学习精度比现有算子网络高 15 倍，并发现 sparse regression 失效的非局部、分数阶与非多项式色散关系。
Conclusion: 低秩 symbol 加 gauge 固定足以同时给出分布外泛化与可读的闭式物理规律，稠密全频 symbol 是不必要的；该框架还能发现 sparse regression 无法找到的非局部色散关系。
Relevance: 35

summary_sections.method: KAFlow 以由一元 Kolmogorov-Arnold 函数拼成的低秩 symbol 学物理算子的 generator；固定这些函数的 gauge 使每一项有唯一位置；用精确指数积分器 (exact exponential integrators) 积分动力学，并自动蒸馏闭式形式。
summary_sections.result: 在 KAN 神经算子的合成基准上，分布外 (OOD) 损失降低 3.4 至 11 倍，所有系数恢复到 10^-4 以内且无需符号模板，达到数据精度下限；长时域量子动力学中 state infidelity 最多降低 6 个数量级，仅用位置与动量测量训练时降低 30 倍；对变阶分数阶算子的学习精度比现有算子网络高 15 倍，并发现 sparse regression 失效的非局部、分数阶与非多项式色散关系。
summary_sections.conclusion: 低秩 symbol 加 gauge 固定足以同时给出分布外泛化与可读的闭式物理规律，稠密全频 symbol 是不必要的；该框架还能发现 sparse regression 无法找到的非局部色散关系。

papers.title: Dataset-Specific Encoding of Image Content Underlies Cross-Dataset Failure in Brain MRI Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Frozen features of brain MRI foundation models lose accuracy on new datasets, a failure usually blamed on the features encoding where each scan came from. We show that the failure lies elsewhere. Across 17 public datasets and eight frozen representations, every representation recognizes the MRI sequence within each dataset, yet most fail on an unseen one. The cause is neither dataset encoding nor a shift of each dataset: the content itself is encoded along different directions in each dataset. This explains which datasets fail, for the sequence and for sex, and why removing the dataset signal with INLP, LEACE, CORAL or adversarial training never improves sequence transfer. Only the broadly pretrained 3DINO and SAM-Med3D encode the sequence consistently enough to transfer; the brain-specific BrainIAC and BrainFM do no better than an untrained network. Code is available at https://github.com/BrainFM/brainfm-profiler/tree/main/representation_utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 脑 MRI 基础模型冻结特征跨数据集掉精度，通常被归因为特征编码了扫描来源；本文在 17 个公开数据集、8 种冻结表示上证明真正原因是内容本身在每个数据集沿不同方向编码。这解释了哪些数据集在序列与性别任务上失败，也解释了为何用 INLP、LEACE、CORAL 或对抗训练去除数据集信号始终不改善序列迁移；只有广泛预训练的 3DINO 与 SAM-Med3D 足够一致地编码序列而可迁移，脑特异的 BrainIAC、BrainFM 不比未训练网络好。
Motivation: 脑 MRI 基础模型的冻结特征换数据集就掉精度，主流解释是特征编码了扫描来源，据此的数据集去偏方法因此被寄予厚望，但迁移失败的真正机制未被厘清。
Method: 在 17 个公开脑 MRI 数据集上评测 8 种冻结表示，分别检查表示对 MRI 序列与性别的可解码性，并对比 INLP、LEACE、CORAL 与对抗训练四种去除数据集信号的干预对序列迁移的作用；对照组包括广泛预训练的 3DINO、SAM-Med3D 与脑特异的 BrainIAC、BrainFM 及未训练网络。
Result: 每个数据集内所有表示都能识别 MRI 序列，但多数在未见数据集上失败；失败既不来自数据集编码也不来自各数据集整体偏移，而来自内容沿不同方向编码。INLP、LEACE、CORAL 与对抗训练去除数据集信号后序列迁移从未改善。3DINO 与 SAM-Med3D 能一致编码序列并迁移，BrainIAC 与 BrainFM 与未训练网络表现相当。
Conclusion: 跨数据集失败的机制是内容的方向性重编码而非数据集身份泄露，因此去除数据集信号的去偏手段对序列迁移无效；只有预训练广度足以让序列表示跨数据集一致的模型才能迁移。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: What Visual Representations Do World Action Models Need?
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) inherit powerful priors from pretrained video generation models, but their variational autoencoder (VAE) representations are optimized for visual reconstruction rather than manipulation. External visual representations can improve manipulation, but existing methods couple representation choices with different integration mechanisms, obscuring their individual effects. We systematically compare visual representations, five integration mechanisms, and feature combinations under controlled settings. Our study yields three main findings. First, strong general-purpose visual representations provide broader robustness gains and can match or outperform representations pretrained for specific visual capabilities. Second, channel-wise joint prediction achieves the highest average success rate; further analyses suggest that future-feature prediction and the action expert's effective use of added visual information contribute to its gains. Third, additional sources should be selected for the task-relevant information they contribute beyond existing representations, as the same source can help one combination but harm another. However, even the best evaluated composition provides a smaller additional gain than the initial improvement from adding a strong general-purpose representation to the VAE-only baseline. We instantiate the resulting Representation Recipe as R$^2$-WAM. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on RoboCasa GR1 Tabletop with an 84.7% success rate and reaches 92.8% on RoboTwin 2.0, improving over the VAE-only baselines by 5.9 and 2.2 percentage points, respectively. Taken together, these findings suggest that future work should prioritize stronger general-purpose visual representations and more effective mechanisms for integrating them into WAMs, with feature composition serving as a supplementary route to improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 World Action Model 中系统对比视觉表征、五种集成机制与特征组合，发现强通用视觉表征带来的增益最大，channel-wise joint prediction 平均成功率最高。据此给出的 R²-WAM 在 RoboCasa GR1 Tabletop 达 84.7% 成功率、RoboTwin 2.0 达 92.8%，较 VAE-only 基线分别高 5.9 与 2.2 个百分点。作者主张未来应优先更强的通用表征与更有效的集成机制，特征组合作为补充路线。
Motivation: WAM 继承预训练视频生成模型的先验，但其 VAE 表征为视觉重建优化而非操作任务；现有方法把表征选择与集成机制耦合在一起，无法分辨各自的作用。
Method: 在受控设定下系统对比多种视觉表征、五种集成机制及特征组合，并做归因分析（future-feature prediction 与 action expert 对新增视觉信息的利用）；最终把结论固化为 Representation Recipe，实例化为 R²-WAM。
Result: channel-wise joint prediction 取得最高平均成功率；R²-WAM 在 RoboCasa GR1 Tabletop 上达到 84.7% 成功率（较 VAE-only 基线 +5.9 个百分点），在 RoboTwin 2.0 上达到 92.8%（+2.2 个百分点），为 state-of-the-art；即便最优组合带来的额外增益也小于最初加入强通用表征相对 VAE-only 的提升。
Conclusion: 强通用视觉表征是 WAM 性能的主要杠杆，集成机制次之，特征组合只是补充；额外信息源应按其在既有表征之外的任务相关信息来选，同一信息源可能对一种组合有益、对另一种有害。

papers.title: Unified Generative Video Compression with Autoregressive and Bidirectional Video Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Video diffusion models can reconstruct visually compelling content from severely compressed representations at ultra-low bitrates, but they impose a rigid deployment trade-off. Bidirectional (BI) models achieve high quality through dense full-sequence attention, yet require the entire sequence before reconstruction and incur substantial latency. Autoregressive (AR) models enable low-delay streaming, but their restricted temporal context reduces compression efficiency. This tension is particularly relevant when a video stream must be decoded in real time yet is also stored for later, quality-oriented playback, making AR and BI models natural choices for the live and replay stages, respectively. To support both stages, we present UniGVC, a Unified Generative Video Codec that supports two decoding modes from a single bitstream. UniGVC-BI employs a BI-DiT with dense attention for quality-oriented random-access decoding, whereas UniGVC-AR uses windowed AR-DiT for low-delay streaming. Both paths share a hierarchical latent codec that recurrently produces the same conditions with ultra-low bitrates, allowing UniGVC-BI to serve as a conditional teacher for single-step distillation of UniGVC-AR. A tiny conditional video decoder further reduces streaming latency while preserving most of the reconstruction quality. On standard 1080p benchmarks, UniGVC-BI achieves the best overall rate-distortion-perception trade-off among the evaluated methods and produces temporally stable video at rates as low as 0.0005 bits per pixel. Meanwhile, UniGVC-AR remains competitive while decoding 1080p video at 36.85 FPS, over $250\times$ faster than UniGVC-BI. Code and models will be released later.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniGVC 用单一码流同时支持两种解码模式：BI-DiT 稠密全序列注意力做高质量随机访问回放，窗口化 AR-DiT 做低延迟流式播放，两者共享分层 latent codec 产生的相同条件，BI 路径作为教师对 AR 路径做单步蒸馏。在标准 1080p 基准上 UniGVC-BI 以低至 0.0005 bits per pixel 的码率取得所评估方法中最好的率-失真-感知权衡，UniGVC-AR 以 36.85 FPS 解码 1080p、比 BI 快 250 倍以上。
Motivation: 视频扩散模型在超低码率下重建质量高，但 BI 模型需整段序列才能重建、延迟大，AR 模型低延迟却因时间上下文受限而压缩效率低；实时直播与事后高质量回放并存时，部署上被迫二选一。
Method: UniGVC 统一生成式视频编解码器：分层 latent codec 递归产生两种模式共享的相同条件；UniGVC-BI 用 BI-DiT 稠密注意力做随机访问解码，UniGVC-AR 用窗口化 AR-DiT 做流式解码；以 BI 为条件教师对 AR 做单步蒸馏，并加一个 tiny conditional video decoder 压低流式延迟。
Result: 在标准 1080p 基准上，UniGVC-BI 在所评估方法中取得最好的整体率-失真-感知 (rate-distortion-perception) 权衡，码率可低至 0.0005 bits per pixel 且视频时间稳定；UniGVC-AR 以 36.85 FPS 解码 1080p，比 UniGVC-BI 快 250 倍以上，同时保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 单一码流加共享条件与教师-学生蒸馏可以让 AR 与 BI 两条扩散解码路径共存，用一次编码同时覆盖实时直播与高质量回放两种部署需求。

papers.title: Don't Guess, Just Ask: Evaluating Interactive Requirement Clarification for Repository-Level Software Development
papers.abstract_en: As LLMs become increasingly capable of implementing software, a critical bottleneck emerges: whether they truly understand what users want. Users often begin with vague intent, leaving important requirements to be clarified through interaction. In repository-level development, misunderstandings can propagate and cause costly rework. However, existing benchmarks typically evaluate implementation from complete specifications or underspecified requests, overlooking pre-coding requirement clarification. Prior clarification studies mainly focus on function-level tasks. It therefore remains unclear how well LLMs can transform vague intent into clear requirements through interaction and how this capability affects subsequent code generation. We introduce ReqClarifyBench, an interactive requirement clarification benchmark for repository-level software development. It contains 341 tasks spanning game, miniapp, and web development, each with a vague user intent, a human-validated requirement document, and code evaluation artifacts. We employ LLM-based user simulators with diverse personas derived from real-world conversations. We evaluate six LLMs in terms of clarification effectiveness and generated requirement document quality. Results show that stronger clarification effectiveness does not necessarily translate into higher document quality, and performance varies substantially across user personas. We also find that coding-agent harnesses do not further improve requirement document quality compared with their base LLMs. These findings offer insights for building LLM-based end-to-end software development systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ReqClarifyBench：面向仓库级软件开发的交互式需求澄清基准，含 341 个任务（game、miniapp、web），每个任务给模糊用户意图、人工校验的需求文档与代码评测工件，并用源自真实对话的多 persona LLM 用户模拟器驱动。评测六个 LLM 后发现澄清有效性更高并不必然带来更高质量的需求文档，且编码 agent harness 相比其基座 LLM 并不进一步提升文档质量。
Motivation: 现有基准只测完整规格或欠规格请求下的实现，忽略编码前的需求澄清环节；已有澄清研究集中在函数级任务，仓库级开发中误解会传播并造成返工，LLM 能否通过交互把模糊意图转成清晰需求尚不清楚。
Method: 构建 ReqClarifyBench，含 341 个 game、miniapp、web 开发任务，每项配模糊意图、人工校验需求文档与代码评测工件；用从真实对话导出的多样化 persona 的 LLM 用户模拟器进行交互，从澄清有效性与生成需求文档质量两个维度评测六个 LLM。
Result: 在六个 LLM 上，澄清有效性更强不必然转化为更高的需求文档质量；表现随用户 persona 差异显著；编码 agent harness 生成的需求文档质量相比其基座 LLM 没有进一步提升。
Conclusion: 需求澄清能力与文档质量是两个应分开度量的维度，且换 harness 不解决文档质量问题；端到端 LLM 软件开发系统需要直接针对澄清质量本身做改进。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EmbodiedCLBench: Evaluating Continual Learning for Self-Evolving Embodied Agents
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning requires models to accumulate past experience and transfer it to new tasks. Despite substantial research on continual learning, existing work remains largely confined to non-embodied settings, without extending to embodied environments. To address this gap, we introduce EmbodiedCLBench, the first benchmark in embodied simulation for evaluating the continual learning capability of self-evolving agents. With compositional generalization as the core evaluation principle, our benchmark evaluates whether agents can first learn from basic tasks and then recombine the acquired skills to solve complex, unseen advanced tasks. Based on EmbodiedCLBench, we conduct extensive experiments across multiple agent harnesses and learning methods, revealing consistent limitations and distinctive behaviors. Our results show that while advanced tasks can be hardly solved under zero-shot setting, the experience from basic tasks enables consistent improvement. Such benefit from the experience remains stable even if the task complexity increases. However, this improvement does not scale accordingly with the number of learning samples, and current agents cannot extract meaningful information from additional experience. Collectively, our findings highlight continual learning as a fundamental yet underexplored capability, and our benchmark offers valuable resources for designing effective self-evolving agents in embodied environments. Our code and dataset are available at https://pku-value-lab.github.io/EmbodiedCLBench-homepage.

papers.title: Trajectory-Aware Policy Optimization: Closing the State Distribution Gap in Long-Horizon LLM RL
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a dominant paradigm for enhancing LLMs' reasoning capabilities. Yet long-horizon autoregressive rollouts introduce a fundamental limitation: local policy mismatch can compound into severe state distribution shift over trajectories. Existing LLM RL methods, such as GRPO and GSPO, control policy mismatch at the token or sequence level, but overlook this trajectory-induced shift, causing training instability and eventual collapse as the horizon grows. To close the state distribution gap, we propose Trajectory-Aware Policy Optimization (TAPO), a principled framework that theoretically derives the state-distribution correction from the off-policy policy gradient and incorporates it into the RL objective. TAPO further employs a geometric-mean estimator for variance reduction, together with a length-aware dynamic clipping that prevents overly deviated updates across the trajectory. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TAPO significantly surpasses existing LLM RL algorithms across eight competition-level benchmarks, achieving up to 48% and 12% improvement over GRPO on mathematical reasoning and algorithmic coding, with substantially enhanced training stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 长程自回归 rollout 中局部策略偏差会累积成轨迹级状态分布偏移，TAPO 从 off-policy policy gradient 推导出状态分布校正项并入 RL 目标，配合几何均值估计器降方差与长度感知动态裁剪。在八个竞赛级基准上，数学推理与算法代码相对 GRPO 最高提升 48% 与 12%，训练稳定性显著增强。
Motivation: GRPO、GSPO 只在 token 或序列层面控制策略偏差，忽略轨迹诱导的状态分布偏移，导致长 horizon 下训练不稳定并最终崩溃。
Method: 提出 Trajectory-Aware Policy Optimization (TAPO)：从 off-policy policy gradient 理论推导状态分布校正项并纳入 RL 目标；用几何均值估计器 (geometric-mean estimator) 降方差，并加入长度感知动态裁剪 (length-aware dynamic clipping) 防止轨迹上过度偏离的更新。
Result: 在八个竞赛级基准上显著超越现有 LLM RL 算法：相对 GRPO 在数学推理上最高提升 48%，在算法代码上最高提升 12%，训练稳定性大幅增强。
Conclusion: 把状态分布校正显式写进 RL 目标并配合降方差与裁剪，可在长 horizon LLM 强化学习中同时提升性能与训练稳定性。

papers.title: FlyHack: Stress-Testing Mechanistic Claims in a Connectome-Constrained Visual Model
papers.abstract_en: Connectome-constrained neural networks make biological components directly accessible to intervention, but their mechanistic conclusions can still depend on the comparison model, intervention, circuit representation and trained solution. We stress-test these dependencies in flyvis, a \emph{Drosophila} motion-vision model, using its 50-model ensemble, task-matched causal CNN controls and replicated interventions. At the level of model behaviour, three-level reverse-phi reversal in flyvis is strongly period- and velocity-dependent and also appears in task-matched CNNs; neither family reproduces the fly's stationary-sawtooth response. Adversarial direction reversal requires a perturbation bound of 0.21--0.27 times stimulus contrast in flyvis versus 0.13--0.25 in CNNs, but the gap over a parameter-matched CNN largely closes for larger CNNs. At the level of mechanism, matching attribution to the intervention matters: for held-out-mean replacement, first-order edge attribution patching reaches pooled AUROC 0.970 and Spearman 0.872, versus 0.933 and 0.126 when its zero-aligned score is evaluated against the same ground truth. Circuit conclusions also vary with representation and ensemble member. Greedy cell-type sets meet a model-relative T4/T5 tuning criterion in 25 of 50 models, while T4/T5 output silencing reduces the tested optic-flow behaviour to at most two of eight clips in 40. In six models where the cell-type search first succeeds, the corresponding connection sets can be pruned to 13--31 added classes; under an additional two-sided response-amplitude check, only two of those six first-success cell-type sets still meet the tuning threshold. These results support a narrower use of connectome-constrained models: they make mechanistic hypotheses directly testable, but the resulting claims must be scoped to the model family, intervention, representation and trained solution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlyHack 在 flyvis（果蝇运动视觉的 connectome-constrained 模型）上系统压力测试机制性结论，发现这些结论随比较模型、干预方式、电路表示与训练解变化：reverse-phi 反转在任务匹配 CNN 中同样出现，对抗性方向反转所需的扰动界差距在更大 CNN 上基本消失，归因方法与干预对齐与否使 AUROC 从 0.970 变到 0.933、Spearman 从 0.872 掉到 0.126。作者主张把 connectome-constrained 模型的机制结论严格限定在模型族、干预、表示与训练解的范围内。
Motivation: Connectome-constrained 网络让生物部件可直接干预，但其机制性结论可能依赖比较模型、干预、电路表示与训练解，结论的稳健性此前未被系统检验。
Method: 在 flyvis 的 50 模型 ensemble 上做压力测试，配任务匹配的 causal CNN 对照与复制干预；比较 held-out-mean replacement 下的一阶 edge attribution patching 及其 zero-aligned 打分，并对 cell-type 集合做贪心搜索、剪枝与双向响应幅度检查。
Result: flyvis 的三级 reverse-phi 反转强依赖周期与速度且也出现在任务匹配 CNN 中，两族模型都不复现果蝇的 stationary-sawtooth 响应；对抗方向反转所需扰动界为 flyvis 0.21–0.27 倍刺激对比度、CNN 0.13–0.25，但对参数匹配 CNN 的差距在更大 CNN 上基本消失。归因与干预对齐时 pooled AUROC 0.970、Spearman 0.872，用 zero-aligned 打分对同一真值则为 0.933 与 0.126。贪心 cell-type 集合在 50 个模型中 25 个满足模型相对的 T4/T5 调谐判据；T4/T5 输出沉默使受测光流行为在 40 个模型中最多只剩 8 段中的 2 段。六个首次搜索成功的模型中，连接集可剪到 13–31 个新增类别，但加上双向响应幅度检查后仅 2 个仍达阈值。
Conclusion: Connectome-constrained 模型的价值在于让机制假设可直接检验，但由此得到的结论必须限定在具体模型族、干预、表示与训练解上，不能外推为关于真实神经回路的普适主张。

papers.title: Generalized Proximal Policy Optimization: Unifying LLM RL Algorithms from the Perspective of Divergence
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has become the foundational paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of LLMs. Yet the dominant approach, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), relies on a geometrically degenerate clipping proxy that cannot adapt its resistance to policy shifts, leading to premature clipping and degraded exploration. Subsequent variants alleviate these issues through fragmented and heuristic modifications. We propose Generalized Proximal Policy Optimization (GPPO), a principled and unified framework for understanding and designing LLM RL algorithms through the lens of divergence. We establish a generalized $f$-divergence trust-region theory with a monotonic performance improvement guarantee, and show that different $f$-divergences induce distinct geometries and policy update dynamics. We further introduce novel estimator topologies that provide more faithful divergence estimates than the conventional single-sample Monte Carlo estimation. Under this framework, PPO and recent variants such as DAPO, DPPO, and RIPO emerge as special cases, establishing a principled two-dimensional design space of {Divergence $\times$ Estimator}. Extensive experiments on eight competition-level math and coding benchmarks show that both dimensions are critical. The best-performing GPPO instantiation surpasses standard GRPO by up to 50% and 14% on math and coding, delivering SOTA performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GPPO 用散度视角统一 LLM 强化学习算法：建立带单调性能改进保证的广义 f-divergence 信任域理论，指出 PPO 的几何退化裁剪代理无法随策略偏移自适应、导致过早裁剪与探索退化，并提出比单样本 Monte Carlo 更忠实的散度估计器拓扑。在八个竞赛级数学与编程基准上，{Divergence × Estimator} 两个维度都关键，最佳 GPPO 实例比标准 GRPO 在数学上最高提升 50%、编程上 14%。
Motivation: PPO 的裁剪代理几何退化、不能自适应抵抗策略偏移，后续变体只能做碎片化的启发式修补，缺少统一的设计原则。
Method: 提出 GPPO：广义 f-divergence 信任域理论并给出单调性能改进保证，说明不同 f-divergence 诱导不同几何与策略更新动力学；引入比常规单样本 Monte Carlo 估计更忠实的估计器拓扑；把 PPO、DAPO、DPPO、RIPO 归纳为 {Divergence × Estimator} 二维设计空间的特例。
Result: 在八个竞赛级数学与编程基准上，散度与估计器两个维度均关键；最佳 GPPO 实例超越标准 GRPO 数学最高 50%、编程 14%，达到 SOTA。
Conclusion: LLM RL 算法可由散度与估计器两个维度系统设计，PPO 及其近期变体只是该空间的特例。

papers.title: Evidential Multimodal Transformers with Dempster-Shafer Fusion for Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Softmax-based multimodal emotion recognition methods often assign high confidence even when sensor data are corrupted or contradictory, for example when facial expressions suggest positive valence while vocal prosody indicates negative arousal. We present an Evidential Multimodal Transformer with Dempster-Shafer Fusion (EMT-DS) that addresses this problem through formal uncertainty quantification. EMT-DS models predictions as Subjective Opinions (Dirichlet distributions), separating epistemic uncertainty (lack of evidence) from aleatoric uncertainty (sensor noise). Modality-specific transformer encoders produce belief mass distributions that are fused with Dempster's Rule of Combination, which normalizes the joint belief mass by a conflict coefficient 1/(1-c), so that contradictory evidence is explicitly quantified as conflict and the fused prediction becomes diffuse rather than being forced into an unjustified consensus. Under subject-independent and speaker-independent evaluation on four benchmarks, EMT-DS achieves 84.3% accuracy on IEMOCAP versus 81.7% for the best baseline (p < 0.01), 82.4% on DEAP under leave-one-subject-out evaluation versus 78.1%, and 96.8% on the highly imbalanced KEMDy20, and it improves accuracy on CMU-MOSEI by 2.4 points over the strongest evidential baseline. In controlled ablation, it reduces Expected Calibration Error from 0.153 (softmax transformer) to 0.042. It maintains 71.2% accuracy under severe Gaussian noise on audio features (sigma = 1.0), where attention baselines drop to 45.3%, and degrades gracefully when entire modalities are absent. The fusion step has O(MK^2) complexity, compared with O(M^2 d^2) for cross-modal attention. The learned conflict metric also flags likely errors: reviewing 20% of samples captures 80% of misclassifications, which supports selective prediction in clinical and safety-critical systems.
papers.comment: Accepted in IEEE Transactions on Affective Computing. 18 pages, 9 figures, plus 5 pages of supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EMT-DS 用 Subjective Opinions（Dirichlet 分布）建模多模态情感识别的预测，按 Dempster 组合规则归一化联合信念质量并显式量化冲突，使矛盾证据导致弥散输出而非强行共识。在四个基准的被试/说话人无关评测中 IEMOCAP 84.3%（最佳基线 81.7%，p<0.01）、DEAP 留一被试 82.4%（78.1%）、KEMDy20 96.8%，ECE 从 0.153 降到 0.042。
Motivation: Softmax 多模态情感识别在传感器数据损坏或模态矛盾时仍给出高置信度，缺乏可区分认知不确定性与偶然不确定性的形式化量化。
Method: 各模态 transformer 编码器输出信念质量分布，以 Subjective Opinions（Dirichlet）分离 epistemic 与 aleatoric 不确定性，再用 Dempster's Rule 归一化联合信念质量（冲突系数 1/(1-c)）融合；融合步复杂度 O(MK^2)，对比跨模态注意力的 O(M^2 d^2)。
Result: IEMOCAP 84.3% vs 81.7%（p<0.01）；DEAP 留一被试 82.4% vs 78.1%；KEMDy20 96.8%；CMU-MOSEI 比最强 evidential 基线高 2.4 个百分点；ECE 0.153→0.042；音频特征高斯噪声 sigma=1.0 下保持 71.2%（attention 基线跌至 45.3%）；审阅 20% 样本可捕获 80% 误分类。
Conclusion: 把冲突显式建模并让融合结果在证据矛盾时变弥散，可同时提升准确率与校准，学到的冲突度量可支撑临床与安全关键系统的 selective prediction。

papers.title: Learning Features, Not Layouts: Feature-Axis Attention as a Transfer Prior for Medical Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Natural-image-pretrained foundation models are increasingly adapted to medical imaging, yet transfer remains unreliable under domain shift, modality heterogeneity, and label scarcity. We trace part of this fragility to an overlooked design choice. Standard vision transformers place all global modeling on self-attention over spatial tokens, an object-layout prior well suited to natural scenes but not to medical images, where the discriminative signal lies in feature correlations and texture that recur across scanners while layout does not. We ask whether the axis of global attention, spatial versus feature, is itself a lever for transferable medical representations. Existing channel-aware hybrids confound this question, adding channel attention to a spatially-mixed backbone and leaving the axes coupled and the feature axis unmeasurable in isolation. We design FAD-ViT, a backbone that strictly decouples the two axes, making feature-axis attention the primary global operator and the attention axis a controlled variable. Evaluating comprehensively across 23 classification, segmentation, and low-data tasks under matched tokenization, capacity, and protocol, we find that shifting global attention from the spatial to the feature axis leaves from-scratch performance essentially unchanged, yet markedly strengthens transfer. Identical ImageNet pretraining yields up to roughly three times the transfer gain, with consistent improvements on every held-out segmentation task at up to a quarter the parameter count and far lower compute than standard and channel-attention baselines. The advantage is largest where texture rather than geometry is discriminative, tracking greater reuse of pretrained features. The axis of global attention is thus a design lever for medical transfer, and making it channel-primary is a simple, cheap, and principled choice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FAD-ViT 把全局注意力从空间轴移到特征轴并严格解耦两轴，在 23 个医学影像分类、分割与低数据任务上，从零训练性能基本不变，但迁移显著增强：相同 ImageNet 预训练下迁移增益最高约三倍，且在每个留出分割任务上以最多约四分之一参数量和远低于标准与通道注意力基线的算力取得一致提升。作者据此主张把全局注意力做成 channel-primary 是医学迁移的简单、廉价且有原则的设计选择。
Motivation: 自然图像预训练的基础模型迁移到医学影像时受域偏移、模态异构与标注稀缺影响而不稳定；标准 ViT 把全局建模全压在空间 token 自注意力这一物体布局先验上，而医学判别信号更多是跨扫描仪复现的特征相关与纹理，且现有通道感知混合骨干把两轴耦合，无法单独测量特征轴的作用。
Method: 提出 FAD-ViT 骨干，严格解耦空间轴与特征轴，把特征轴注意力 (feature-axis attention) 作为主要全局算子，并把注意力轴本身当作受控变量；在匹配的 tokenization、容量与协议下，于 23 个分类、分割与低数据任务上做综合评测，对照标准 ViT 与通道注意力基线。
Result: 在 23 个任务上，把全局注意力从空间轴移到特征轴后从零训练性能基本不变，而迁移显著增强：相同 ImageNet 预训练下迁移增益最高约三倍 (up to roughly three times)，每个留出分割任务上均有一致提升，参数量最多降至约四分之一，算力远低于标准与通道注意力基线；优势在纹理而非几何具判别力的任务上最大，并与预训练特征的更高复用率一致。
Conclusion: 全局注意力的轴向选择本身是决定医学迁移能力的设计杠杆，把全局注意力做成 channel-primary 是简单、廉价且有原则的选择，尤其适用于纹理判别为主的医学影像任务。

papers.title: Provenance-Aware Belief Updating in Human-AI Feedback Loops
papers.abstract_en: In repeated human-AI interaction, a single observation can be quoted, summarized, and returned to a model as multiple reports, making repetition look like independent corroboration. We study whether language models can use supplied report lineage to update according to evidence provenance rather than report count. We introduce Latent Quotient Evidence Training (LQET), a relational objective that combines sparse Bayesian supervision with constraints that encourage stable predictions when reports add no new evidence and consistent updates to the same new evidence across relay histories. On a controlled binary benchmark, LQET reduces new-evidence update RMSE by 41-44% and log-odds drift after eight relay steps by 89-91% relative to task-only training across Qwen3-4B and Phi-4-mini, with three paired training seeds per backbone. The gains extend to a closed-loop simulation in which model confidence controls how many relayed reports re-enter the model's context in later rounds. By grounding belief updates in supplied provenance, LQET offers a route toward dynamic human-AI systems in which influence follows new evidence, not the number of times the same evidence returns.
papers.comment: Accepted Oral at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Dynamic Alignment in Human-AI Coupled Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在人-AI 反馈闭环中，同一份观测被转述多次会被模型当成多份独立证据，导致信念更新随重复次数膨胀。提出 Latent Quotient Evidence Training (LQET)，用稀疏贝叶斯监督加两条约束——报告未带来新证据时预测保持稳定、同一新证据在不同转述历史下更新一致——让更新跟随证据来源而非报告计数。在 Qwen3-4B 与 Phi-4-mini 上，新证据更新 RMSE 相对仅任务训练下降 41–44%，八步转述后的 log-odds 漂移下降 89–91%。
Motivation: 重复人-AI 交互中，单个观测会被引用、摘要并作为多份报告返回模型，重复被误当作独立佐证，信念更新随报告计数而非证据本身膨胀。
Method: 提出 LQET：关系型目标，结合稀疏贝叶斯监督与两条约束——报告不增加新证据时预测稳定、同一新证据在不同转述历史下更新一致；在受控二元基准上训练，每个 backbone 配三个配对训练种子，并接入模型置信度决定后续轮次回灌报告数量的闭环仿真。
Result: 相对仅任务训练，新证据更新 RMSE 下降 41–44%，八步转述后的 log-odds 漂移下降 89–91%，覆盖 Qwen3-4B 与 Phi-4-mini 两个 backbone、各三个配对训练种子；增益延伸到闭环仿真（模型置信度控制回灌报告数量）。
Conclusion: 把信念更新锚定在提供的证据来源 (provenance) 上，可让影响随新证据而非同一证据的返回次数走，为动态 human-AI 系统提供一条路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scaling Empowered Agents
papers.abstract_en: Empowerment measures the capacity of an agent to actively control its environment. In this work, we explain the connection between skill learning and empowerment. While skill learning is not empowerment, we introduce a simple scalable recipe for empowerment maximization: empowerment corresponds to the number of executable skills from a state, so maximizing empowerment corresponds to reaching states that are good starting points for many skills. Our recipe applies to arbitrary underlying skill learning methods. Whereas most prior work on empowerment looks at tabular settings, this recipe enables us to study empowerment at a scale where we can realize theoretically-predicted but empirically-elusive properties of empowerment (e.g., gathering resources, environment modification, survival). Experiments show that empowerment maximization unlocks interesting emergent properties, such as building a house in Crafter. Website and code at \href{https://empowerment-geometry.github.io/scaling-empowerment/}{this https url}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 empowerment 定义为从某状态出发可执行技能的数量，从而把最大化 empowerment 转化为「到达适合大量技能起步的状态」，并给出一个可套用任意底层技能学习方法的通用配方。在 Crafter 等环境中该配方解锁了理论预言但此前难以实证的涌现性质，例如收集资源、改造环境、生存，以及建造房屋。
Motivation: 既有 empowerment 研究多停留在 tabular 设定，理论预言的性质（资源聚集、环境改造、生存）在实证上一直难以复现，缺少能规模化的方法。
Method: 提出一个与底层技能学习方法无关的通用配方：不直接优化 empowerment，而是优化「可执行技能数量」这一代理，使智能体到达适合多种技能起步的状态；在可规模化环境中训练以检验理论预言的性质。
Result: 实验显示 empowerment 最大化解锁涌现性质，具体包括在 Crafter 中建造房屋，以及理论预言的收集资源、环境改造与生存；摘要未给出定量指标或基线对比。
Conclusion: 技能学习与 empowerment 可以通过「状态的可执行技能数」这一视角打通，且该配方能将 tabular 中的 empowerment 性质推广到规模化实证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hindsight Structured Advice Distillation: Steering Executor Agents with Advisors Trained on Their Failures and Task Characteristics
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents are used for specialized work such as financial research, healthcare and law. Such agents are often capable enough for a task but still miss its details. In finance, for example, these details include which filing reports a figure or how a company discloses a metric. Retraining the agent to learn these details is expensive, and often impossible when the agent is a closed or shared system. Writing the missing know-how into the agent's prompt makes the prompt long and identical for every input, although different inputs need different guidance. We propose to learn to generate this guidance instead. A small advisor model reads each input and writes structured advice, which is appended to the prompt of a frozen executor. The advisor is trained with hindsight, following work on distillation with privileged information. On a training pool with graded answers, we analyse the executor's failures, run it under several strategies to see which one worked on each input, and let a teacher that sees the grades and the traces write the advice that would have helped. The advisor then learns, by supervised fine-tuning, to write that advice from the input alone. Because the student is a separate small model rather than the executor, it is cheap to train and adds little latency. We call this approach hindsight structured advice distillation (HSAD). On FrontierFinance, a public benchmark of expert-written financial research queries, an 8B advisor raises the qualification rate of Samaya's proprietary research agent, which already leads the benchmark's leaderboard, from 52.9% to 56.6%. This is above the agent's own high-effort configuration, at 37% lower cost per query. We study the generalization of the proposed approach, and in particular show that HSAD also improves results on WebShop, BIRD text-to-SQL and ExpertLongBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 HSAD (hindsight structured advice distillation)：用一个小型 advisor 模型读取每个输入并生成结构化建议，追加到冻结 executor 的 prompt 中，advisor 通过事后蒸馏从带评分的失败轨迹中学习。在 FrontierFinance 上，8B advisor 将 Samaya 专有研究 agent 的合格率从 52.9% 提升到 56.6%，且每查询成本降低 37%。
Motivation: 语言模型 agent 在金融、医疗、法律等专业任务中常因缺少任务细节而失败；重新训练 agent 成本高且对封闭系统不可行，而把知识写进 prompt 会让 prompt 冗长且对所有输入相同，但不同输入需要不同的指导。
Method: HSAD：小型 advisor 模型读取输入并生成结构化建议，追加到冻结 executor 的 prompt；训练采用事后蒸馏 (hindsight distillation)——在带评分答案的训练池上分析 executor 失败、运行多种策略观察哪种对每个输入有效，再由能看到评分和轨迹的 teacher 写出本应有帮助的建议，最后 advisor 通过监督微调 (SFT) 仅从输入学习生成该建议。
Result: 在 FrontierFinance（专家撰写的金融研究查询公开基准）上，8B advisor 将 Samaya 专有研究 agent（已在该基准 leaderboard 领先）的合格率从 52.9% 提升到 56.6%，超过该 agent 自身的高努力配置，且每查询成本降低 37%；HSAD 在 WebShop、BIRD text-to-SQL 和 ExpertLongBench 上同样带来提升。
Conclusion: 不重训 executor、而是用事后蒸馏训练的小 advisor 按输入生成结构化建议，可以在冻结的强 agent 上以更低成本提升任务合格率，并跨金融研究之外的任务泛化。

papers.title: Benchmarking Embedding Geometries and Clustering Algorithms for Unsupervised Patent Claim Classification
papers.abstract_en: Prior-art retrieval systems are structurally organized around classification codes, making cross-code discovery difficult. This paper asks if an unsupervised representation trained on patent text can recover relevant connections that code-restricted search cannot, and if hyperbolic space helps. We trained a hyperbolic and a matched Euclidean Variational Autoencoder (VAE) on 45,000 US patents (96 runs, 6 seeds). The hyperbolic model retrieves genuinely cross-category prior art 52% more often than the Euclidean model (18.76% vs. 12.34% of top-10 results, 3,000 queries). This represents a practical gain for the motivating search problem. The hyperbolic model agrees less with official classification (NMI 0.2392 vs. 0.3206), which we explain geometrically: the two measures capture different goals, and only one aligns with prior-art search needs. In a study of 10 technology domains (50,000 more patents), we find that a domain's classification breadth--the number of distinct CPC subgroups spanned--predicts approach performance (Pearson r=-0.642, p=0.045, N=10), and that patents per subgroup is an even stronger predictor (r=0.715, p=0.020). This provides a checkable signal for practitioners to determine where the method is most valuable. We report all findings with statistical transparency and release a complete, 91-test automated implementation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 45,000 件美国专利上训练双曲与欧氏 VAE（96 次运行、6 个种子），双曲模型在 3,000 条查询中跨分类检索到真正跨类先验技术的比例为 18.76%，比欧氏模型的 12.34% 高 52%。双曲模型与官方 CPC 分类的一致性更低（NMI 0.2392 vs 0.3206），作者认为这反映两者目标不同，跨类检索只需前者。
Motivation: 先验技术检索系统以分类码组织，跨码发现困难；需要判断无监督专利文本表示能否找回码内检索找不到的关联，以及双曲空间是否优于欧氏空间。
Method: 在 45,000 件美国专利上分别训练双曲 VAE 与匹配的欧氏 VAE（96 次运行、6 个种子），用 3,000 条查询比较 top-10 结果中的跨类先验技术比例，并以 NMI 度量与官方分类的一致性；另在 10 个技术领域、50,000 件专利上检验领域分类广度（覆盖 CPC 子组数）与每子组专利数对方法表现的预测力。
Result: 双曲模型跨类先验技术命中率 18.76% vs 欧氏 12.34%（top-10，3,000 条查询，高 52%）；NMI 0.2392 vs 0.3206；领域分类广度与表现 Pearson r=-0.642（p=0.045，N=10），每子组专利数 r=0.715（p=0.020）；发布含 91 项自动化测试的完整实现。

papers.title: What Should SFT Learn? Conditional Information Gain for Generalizable Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) remains a widely used approach for post-training large language models, because fixed demonstrations can directly introduce desired reasoning strategies and behavioral patterns. Yet forcing a model to imitate externally provided trajectories may also interfere with behaviors already supported by pretraining, limiting generalization beyond the training distribution. Recent dynamic SFT methods mitigate this issue by reweighting token-level supervision according to model-side signals such as predictive probability, prior support, or distributional compatibility. However, model compatibility is not equivalent to learning value: a token that is weakly supported by the current model may either be an undesirable mismatch or precisely the task-specific decision that the demonstration is intended to teach. We propose CIG-SFT, an information-theoretic framework that estimates the task-conditioned information carried by each demonstrated token. Under teacher forcing, we compare the token likelihood from a frozen reference model with and without access to the task input while keeping the gold solution prefix fixed. The resulting conditional information gain quantifies how much the task itself reduces uncertainty about the demonstrated decision. We then convert this information into a KL-regularized projection of the current policy and derive an equivalent scalar-weighted SFT objective whose logit gradient exactly matches that of the projected target. Across mathematical reasoning and code-generation benchmarks, CIG-SFT consistently outperforms standard SFT and recent adaptive fine-tuning baselines, with particularly strong improvements in generalization to challenging evaluation distributions, while requiring neither additional training data nor online rollouts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CIG-SFT 用任务条件信息增益给 SFT 的每个示范 token 加权：在 teacher forcing 下固定金标准解题前缀，比较冻结参考模型在有/无任务输入时的 token 似然，差值即该 token 携带的任务条件信息，再转成 KL 正则的策略投影与等价的标量加权 SFT 目标，其 logit 梯度与投影目标完全一致。在数学推理与代码生成基准上稳定超过标准 SFT 和近期自适应微调基线，尤其在更难的评测分布上泛化提升明显，且不需要额外训练数据或在线 rollout。
Motivation: 固定示范会让模型模仿外部轨迹、干扰预训练已支持的行为；现有动态 SFT 按模型侧信号（预测概率、先验支持、分布兼容性）重加权，但模型兼容性不等于学习价值——弱支持的 token 可能是不匹配，也可能是示范真正要教的任务决策。
Method: CIG-SFT：teacher forcing 下固定 gold solution 前缀，比较冻结参考模型在给定与不给定任务输入时的 token 似然，得到任务条件信息增益；据此构造当前策略的 KL 正则投影，并推导出与该投影目标 logit 梯度完全匹配的标量加权 SFT 目标。
Result: 在数学推理与代码生成基准上，CIG-SFT 一致优于标准 SFT 与近期 adaptive fine-tuning 基线，在向更具挑战性的评测分布泛化时提升尤其明显；训练不需要额外数据，也不需要在线 rollouts。
Conclusion: 示范 token 的价值应按其任务条件信息而非模型兼容性来加权，这样能在不引入新数据或 rollout 的前提下提升 SFT 的分布外泛化。

papers.title: Gaussian-Width Bounds for Offline-to-Online Linear Bandits
papers.abstract_en: We study how offline data can help online learning in stochastic linear bandits. We focus on partially covered offline data, where only $k$ of the $d$ feature directions are poorly covered. Existing analyses of algorithms based on phased elimination and optimism give regret bounds of order $\widetilde O(\sqrt{dkT})$ in this regime. We show that this dependence arises from loose control of the reward prediction error, and obtain tighter bounds using concentration of Lipschitz functions of Gaussian vectors. Based on this analysis, we develop a phased elimination algorithm with regret $\widetilde O(k\sqrt T)$. For the unit Euclidean ball, we prove a matching regret lower bound under partial coverage, as well as matching upper and lower bounds under uniform offline coverage. We also study pure exploration with offline data, providing algorithms and matching upper and lower bounds on simple regret for fixed-design algorithms and also for adaptive algorithms under partial and uniform coverage of offline data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线随机线性 bandit 中利用部分覆盖的离线数据时，已有 phased elimination 与 optimism 类算法的后悔界为 Õ(√(dkT))，作者指出这一 d 依赖来自对奖励预测误差的松控制，改用高斯向量上 Lipschitz 函数的集中不等式收紧后，给出 Õ(k√T) 的 phased elimination 算法。单位欧氏球上部分覆盖的匹配下界与均匀覆盖的匹配上下界一并证明，纯探索（simple regret）在固定设计与自适应算法上也给出匹配上下界。
Motivation: 离线数据只覆盖 d 个特征方向中的 k 个时，现有分析给出的 Õ(√(dkT)) 后悔界中 d 的依赖被认为是松的，需要判定真实难度。
Method: 基于高斯向量上 Lipschitz 函数的集中性 (concentration of Lipschitz functions of Gaussian vectors) 重新控制奖励预测误差，据此设计 phased elimination 算法；并对单位欧氏球在部分覆盖与均匀离线覆盖下证明匹配的上下界，纯探索部分给出固定设计与自适应算法的 simple regret 匹配界。
Result: 已有 phased elimination / optimism 算法在部分覆盖下后悔界为 Ó(√(dkT))；新 phased elimination 算法后悔为 Õ(k√T)；单位欧氏球上部分覆盖有匹配后悔下界，均匀离线覆盖有匹配上下界；纯探索在固定设计与部分/均匀覆盖的自适应算法上给出匹配 simple regret 上下界。
Conclusion: Õ(√(dkT)) 中的 d 依赖是分析松弛造成的，部分覆盖线性 bandit 的真实难度由 k 而非 d 主导，且在单位欧氏球上该结论由匹配下界钉住。

papers.title: Forecasting Corpus-Sampling Disagreement in Masked Text Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: If a second text corpus were collected from the same population, how much would a predictor's outputs change? We study this question for masked-text reconstruction using a smoothed predictor built from nearby token-pair counts and evaluated over the full 50,257-token GPT-2 vocabulary. Treating each source document as one observation, we derive a first-order formula for the expected disagreement between predictors fitted to two independent corpora. The formula accounts for variable document length, random context counts, and correlations across token offsets, and it can be evaluated from a separate reference corpus without access to either target corpus. On TinyStories, WikiText-103, and CNN/DailyMail, growing each corpus from 512 to 2,048 chunks of 64 tokens lowers disagreement by only 5--40\%, far short of the 75\% implied by $1/n$ scaling. The forecast tracks this slow decline, which we trace to smoothing of rarely seen contexts. Forecast accuracy depends less on how these correlations are modeled than on the size of the reference corpus: small references systematically underpredict disagreement. A source-split jackknife that uses only reference data reduces this calibration error by 57--59\%. After this correction, a simpler smoothed-multinomial approximation is most accurate when the reference corpus is smaller than the target corpus, and a nonlinear source bootstrap is most accurate when it is larger. Finally, small masked diffusion language models trained on the same corpora show that the count-based forecasts partly identify which inputs are most sensitive to the corpus, but miss the neural models' much faster decline in disagreement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文为掩码文本重建给出一阶公式，预测换一份同源语料时预测器输出的期望分歧，并在 TinyStories、WikiText-103、CNN/DailyMail 上检验：语料从 512 增到 2048 个 64-token 块，分歧只降 5–40%，远低于 1/n 标度隐含的 75%。用仅参考数据的 source-split jackknife 把校准误差降 57–59%；计数型预测能定位对语料最敏感的输入，但低估神经掩码扩散模型分歧的下降速度。
Motivation: 换一份同源语料时预测器输出会变多少，缺少可从独立参考语料计算的定量预报；朴素 1/n 标度在小语料上严重高估收敛速度。
Method: 以每篇源文档为一个观测，对基于邻近 token-pair 计数的平滑预测器（覆盖 GPT-2 全部 50,257 词表）推导两独立语料拟合结果的期望分歧一阶公式，纳入文档长度可变、随机上下文计数与 token 偏移间相关；公式可在独立参考语料上求值，无需接触目标语料，并用 source-split jackknife 做校准。
Result: 在 TinyStories、WikiText-103、CNN/DailyMail 上，语料由 512 增至 2048 个 64-token 块，分歧仅降 5–40%，而 1/n 标度对应 75%；参考语料过小会系统性低估分歧，source-split jackknife 将该校准误差降低 57–59%；校准后参考语料小于目标时 smoothed-multinomial 近似最准，更大时 nonlinear source bootstrap 最准；同语料训练的小型掩码扩散语言模型显示计数型预报漏掉神经模型更快的分歧下降。
Conclusion: 语料规模带来的分歧下降远慢于 1/n，且预报精度主要取决于参考语料大小而非相关建模方式；计数型预报可部分识别对语料最敏感的输入，但不能刻画神经掩码扩散模型的下降速度。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Scan-Parallel Variational Inference for event-driven Latent Jump Models
papers.abstract_en: Continuous-time latent state-space models are widely used for irregularly observed time series, typically representing uncertainty through a random initial state followed by smooth ordinary differential equation (ODE) dynamics, or Brownian perturbations accumulated by a stochastic differential equation (SDE). While these constructions are natural for smooth or diffusive systems, they do not directly encode a finite set of unobserved shocks whose timing, magnitude, and effect on memory are themselves uncertain. We instead introduce latent jump models (LJMs): the latent state follows closed-form deterministic dynamics between Poisson-driven event times and undergoes a learned instantaneous jump at each event, with state-dependent intensity and mark distributions. This defines a time-homogeneous Markov process whose jumps are intrinsic state transitions rather than numerical integration steps. For training, we derive a tractable event-augmented path-space evidence lower bound (ELBO) and introduce Scan-Parallel Variational Inference (SPVI): an observation-conditioned variational posterior samples the complete latent event configuration before the state recurrence is evaluated using triangular affine scans. This enables fast and scalable training for LJMs in logarithmic temporal depth. Across synthetic stochastic systems and real irregular time series, LJMs remain competitive with continuous-time latent baselines in forecast accuracy, often with fewer latent updates than numerical solver evaluations, while training one to two orders of magnitude faster than the sequential baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出潜变量跳跃模型 (Latent Jump Model, LJM)：潜状态在 Poisson 事件时刻之间走闭式确定性动力学，在事件处发生学习到的瞬时跳跃，跳跃强度与 mark 分布依赖状态。配套的 Scan-Parallel Variational Inference (SPVI) 先用观测条件化的变分后验采样完整事件配置，再用三角仿射扫描 (triangular affine scans) 并行求状态递推，训练比序列基线快一到两个数量级，预报精度与连续时间潜变量基线相当。
Motivation: 常规连续时间潜状态空间模型用随机初值加 ODE 或 SDE 的 Brownian 扰动表示不确定性，无法直接刻画有限个未观测冲击——其发生时刻、幅度以及对记忆的影响本身不确定。
Method: LJM 让潜状态在 Poisson 驱动的事件时刻之间按闭式确定性动力学演化，事件处施加学习到的瞬时跳跃，强度与 mark 分布均为状态依赖，构成时间齐次 Markov 过程，跳跃是内在状态转移而非数值积分步。训练上推导事件增广路径空间证据下界 (event-augmented path-space ELBO)，SPVI 的观测条件化变分后验先采样完整潜事件配置，再用三角仿射扫描在对数时间深度内完成状态递推。
Result: 在合成随机系统与真实不规则时间序列上，LJM 的预报精度与连续时间潜变量基线相当，所需潜更新次数常少于数值求解器评估次数，训练速度比序列基线快一到两个数量级。
Conclusion: 把未观测冲击显式建模为状态依赖的跳跃过程，并让变分推断先采事件配置再并行求状态，可以在不损失预报精度的前提下把不规则时间序列潜状态空间模型的训练加速一到两个数量级。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: NucleoNet: A Nuclear-Aware Determinant Ansatz for Multi-Geometry Neural Variational Monte Carlo
papers.abstract_en: Neural-network variational Monte Carlo provides an accurate route to solving the electronic Schrödinger equation, but many neural wavefunctions are optimized for a single nuclear geometry, requiring separate calculations to map out a potential energy surface. We introduce NucleoNet, a nuclear-aware determinant ansatz in which electrons and nuclei form a unified particle set propagated through a shared electron--nucleus backbone that jointly evolves one-particle and two-particle representations. Nuclei carry learned representations that evolve alongside the electronic representations and condition orbital construction, while antisymmetry is imposed only by electronic determinants. On equilibrium small-molecule benchmarks, NucleoNet achieves accuracy comparable to established neural-wavefunction baselines with substantially fewer parameters. For each molecular system, a single model optimized jointly across geometries describes the N$_2$ dissociation curve, Li displacement in LiCN, and the ethane and formamide minimum-energy paths for bond dissociation. Sparse-geometry training generalizes to unseen geometries for N$_2$ and LiCN without further optimization, and N$_2$ ablations show that nuclear streams substantially improve this interpolation. These results show that a compact wavefunction with jointly evolved nuclear representations can describe the geometries of a molecular system with a single set of parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NucleoNet 把原子核与电子放进同一粒子集，用共享的 electron–nucleus backbone 联合演化单体与两体表示，反交换性仍只由电子行列式施加。单个模型跨几何联合优化即可描述 N2 解离曲线、LiCN 中 Li 位移以及乙烷与甲酰胺最小能量路径，稀疏几何训练还能外推到未见几何，参数量明显少于既有神经波函数基线。
Motivation: 多数神经网络波函数只针对单一核构型优化，绘制势能面需对每个几何分别重算，成本高且无法跨构型泛化。
Method: NucleoNet 是 nuclear-aware determinant ansatz：核携带可学习表示并与电子表示一同演化、参与轨道构建，antisymmetry 仅由电子行列式施加；单个模型在多个几何上联合优化。
Result: 在平衡小分子基准上精度与既有神经波函数基线相当而参数量大幅减少；单模型跨几何给出 N2 解离曲线、LiCN 的 Li 位移、乙烷与甲酰胺最小能量路径；稀疏几何训练对 N2 与 LiCN 的未见几何可直接外推，N2 消融显示 nuclear streams 显著改善该插值。
Conclusion: 核表示与电子联合演化的紧凑波函数，可用一组参数覆盖一个分子体系的多个几何构型。

papers.title: Work2Skill: Capturing Human GUI Experience for Reusable Agent Skill Induction
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents can perform increasingly complex GUI tasks, yet unfamiliar software and workflows requiring human domain knowledge remain challenging. Human demonstrations convey procedural knowledge through the same GUI interaction space, but reuse requires interpreting actions in context and separating workflow rules from task-specific details. We thus introduce Work2Skill, a framework that captures human GUI experience for reusable agent skill induction. WorkRecorder provides the framework's infrastructure for collecting this experience, aligning screen recordings, mouse and keyboard events, and available accessibility-tree information. Using WorkRecorder, we construct WorkDemo-350, the first synchronized multimodal dataset of human desktop GUI demonstrations for reusable agent skill induction and downstream evaluation. Its 350 demonstrations are screened for completeness and task success. We then propose an agentic skill-induction method that inspects evidence on demand to produce reusable skills capturing workflow rules, step dependencies, and completion checks. When the same four execution models are equipped with skills induced by each method under shared execution settings, Work2Skill achieves the highest scores and success rates. Mean score improvements over the corresponding No Skill baseline are 4.67--10.54 points on MyPCBench Bounded Action and 3.11--7.50 points on a 286-task subset of OSWorld-Verified. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/china-qijizhifeng/Work2Skill.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Work2Skill 把人类 GUI 操作经验转成可复用 agent skill：WorkRecorder 对齐屏幕录像、鼠标键盘事件与 accessibility tree，构建含 350 条经完整性与任务成功筛选的桌面演示数据集 WorkDemo-350，再用按需检视证据的 skill 归纳方法抽出工作流规则、步骤依赖与完成校验。在相同四个执行模型与共享执行设置下，其得分与成功率最高，相对 No Skill 基线平均提升 4.67–10.54 分（MyPCBench Bounded Action）与 3.11–7.50 分（OSWorld-Verified 的 286 任务子集）。
Motivation: 陌生软件与需要领域知识的工作流仍是 computer-use agent 的短板；人类演示虽含流程知识，但直接复用需在上下文中解读动作并把工作流规则与任务细节分开。
Method: WorkRecorder 收集并对齐屏幕录像、鼠标键盘事件与 accessibility tree；据此构建 WorkDemo-350（350 条经完整性与任务成功筛选的桌面 GUI 演示）；再提出按需检视证据的 agentic skill 归纳方法，产出含工作流规则、步骤依赖与完成检查的可复用 skill。
Result: 在共享执行设置下、同样四个执行模型分别装配各方法归纳的 skill 时 Work2Skill 得分与成功率最高；相对对应 No Skill 基线的平均分提升为 MyPCBench Bounded Action 4.67–10.54 分、OSWorld-Verified 286 任务子集 3.11–7.50 分。
Conclusion: 把人类 GUI 演示结构化为含规则、依赖与完成检查的 skill，可在不改执行模型的前提下稳定抬高 computer-use agent 的任务得分与成功率。

papers.title: The Evidence Anchoring Boundary: Where Visual Interventions Matter and When They Help in Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Visual interventions provide a training-free way to reduce hallucinations in multimodal large language models. However, an intervention may have little leverage at some layers and may damage a correct answer even when it changes the output. We investigate where visual interventions retain leverage and when they improve predictions. First, we apply the same visual-residual edit at successive decoder layers, matching its RMS strength across depth. Across six checkpoints from three model families, we observe a persistent drop in intervention effect and define its operational onset for this edit as the \textbf{Evidence Anchoring Boundary (EAB)}. With boundaries fixed on calibration queries, held-out effects on disjoint evaluation queries before EAB are $13.78\times$--$26.10\times$ larger than those after it. Comparison with intermediate readouts shows that the edit can lose leverage before answer preferences stabilize. Second, we compare counterfactual subtraction across presence, attribute, and relation questions. Subtraction can correct a misleading preference, leave a decision unchanged, or remove a preference supporting the correct answer. Based on these observations, we develop calibrated selective routing, which preserves the original prediction unless calibration supports an intervention for the question type. It improves full-set attribute accuracy by $1.56$--$1.81$ percentage points across three checkpoints, while universal subtraction is neutral or harmful.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多模态大模型的视觉干预 (visual intervention) 存在一个深度边界：同一强度的 visual-residual 编辑在 decoder 早期层有效、越过 Evidence Anchoring Boundary (EAB) 后效应骤减，且可能删掉支撑正确答案的偏好。据此做按题型校准的选择性路由，attribute 题全集准确率提升 1.56–1.81 个百分点，而无差别 subtraction 中性或有害。
Motivation: 视觉干预是免训练的幻觉缓解手段，但在某些层几乎没有杠杆，甚至会把本来正确的答案改坏；缺少判断干预该在哪一层、哪类问题上施加的准则。
Method: 在三个模型家族共六个 checkpoint 上，把同一 visual-residual 编辑施加到逐层 decoder 位置并按 RMS 跨深度匹配强度，用校准查询固定边界、在不相交评估查询上测效应，定义 EAB；再对 presence、attribute、relation 三类问题做 counterfactual subtraction 对比，并据此设计按题型校准的选择性路由 (calibrated selective routing)，仅在校准支持时干预。
Result: EAB 之前的 held-out 干预效应比其之后大 13.78×–26.10×（六个 checkpoint，边界在校准查询上固定）；编辑可能在答案偏好稳定之前就失去杠杆。选择性路由使三个 checkpoint 的 attribute 全集准确率提高 1.56–1.81 个百分点，而 universal subtraction 中性或有害。
Conclusion: 视觉干预的效力由深度边界和问题类型共同决定：应在校准支持的题型与 EAB 之前的层施加干预，否则无差别干预不带来收益甚至损伤正确答案。

papers.title: Learning Representations to Guide Pixel Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Visual representations are largely developed for understanding, yet what makes them useful for generation remains unclear. We study this question in pixel diffusion transformers and uncover two key insights. First, better representation quality does not necessarily translate into greater generative utility, as externally aligned semantics can be progressively lost during pixel synthesis. Second, architectural separation with specialized pixel decoders mainly redistributes semantic and spatial modeling, without necessarily yielding representations better suited to generation. These insights suggest that a useful generative representation must be both properly formed and actively exploited. Motivated by these insights, we introduce Representation Guidance (RG), which directly forms and exploits internal representations while retaining a plain Transformer architecture. A low-dimensional bottleneck forces generation-relevant information into a compact representation, which is then explicitly used to guide decoder generation by modifying the flow-matching target according to its induced prediction offset. RG learns clearer semantic and spatial structure while scaling efficiently in both parameters and computation. On ImageNet 256x256, RG-L/16 with only 459M parameters outperforms substantially larger pixel diffusion transformers, while RG-XL/16 achieves an FID of 1.55. RG further reaches an FID of 1.74 at 512x512 and extends to text-to-image generation, achieving 0.89 on GenEval and 87.1 on DPG-Bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在像素扩散 Transformer 中提出 Representation Guidance (RG)：用低维瓶颈强制形成与生成相关的内部表征，再按该表征诱导的预测偏移修改 flow-matching 目标，显式引导解码器生成，且保持纯 Transformer 架构。在 ImageNet 256x256 上 RG-XL/16 达到 FID 1.55，RG-L/16 仅 459M 参数即胜过明显更大的像素扩散模型；512x512 上 FID 1.74，文生图 GenEval 0.89、DPG-Bench 87.1。
Motivation: 视觉表征多为理解任务设计，什么性质使其对生成有用尚不清楚：外部对齐的语义会在像素合成中逐步丢失，而分离式架构加专用像素解码器只是重新分配语义与空间建模，并不必然产出更适合生成的表征。
Method: Representation Guidance (RG) 在纯 Transformer 中同时形成并利用内部表征：低维瓶颈 (low-dimensional bottleneck) 把生成相关信息压进紧凑表征，随后按该表征诱导的预测偏移 (prediction offset) 修改 flow-matching 目标来显式引导解码器生成；模型变体为 RG-L/16 与 RG-XL/16。
Result: ImageNet 256x256 上 RG-XL/16 FID 1.55；RG-L/16 仅 459M 参数即优于明显更大的像素扩散 Transformer。512x512 上 FID 1.74；文生图上 GenEval 0.89、DPG-Bench 87.1。
Conclusion: 对生成有用的表征必须既被正确形成又被主动利用，仅提高表征质量或做架构分离都不够；RG 以紧凑瓶颈加目标调制实现这一点，并在参数与计算上高效扩展。

papers.title: Beyond Semantic IDs: Finite-Beam Reachability and Continuous-Query Generation in Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Generative recommendation (GR) of social media platforms commonly retrieves items by autoregressively decoding discrete Semantic IDs (SIDs) with finite-width beam search. This work examines how this output interface constrains whether held-out targets enter finite returned lists, while distinguishing catalog-wide scoreability from empirical top-K support. We introduce two continuous-query paradigms: CQG-Single generates one retrieval query in a single pass, and CQG-AR autoregressively generates continuous residual updates, retaining step-wise decoding while removing the SID item-token vocabulary, code lookup, and discrete beam expansion. These designs thereby eliminate the SID-specific reachability constraint induced by finite-beam decoding and avoid the technical challenge of aligning a discrete SID vocabulary with the pretrained backbone's vector space. Both methods make every encoded item directly scoreable through dense or approximate-nearest-neighbor retrieval. Under a unified protocol with valid-prefix constrained decoding, CQG-Single exceeds the TIGER-style baseline in all seven runs while using 55.3% as many trainable parameters. CQG-AR remains comparable on ML-1M and is numerically stronger on Beauty and Sports datasets. A controlled depth ablation further shows that additional continuous refinement does not monotonically improve shallow accuracy. These findings motivate decoupling output representation, autoregressive modeling, and retrieval budget when evaluating generative recommendation systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 生成式推荐用有限宽度 beam search 解码离散 Semantic ID，导致 held-out 目标可能根本进不了返回列表。提出 CQG-Single（单次生成连续检索 query）与 CQG-AR（自回归生成连续残差更新）两种连续 query 范式，消除 SID 的可达性约束；在统一协议下 CQG-Single 七次运行全部超过 TIGER 基线，且只用 55.3% 的可训练参数。
Motivation: 有限宽度 beam 解码在离散 SID 上引入可达性约束，且离散 SID 词表与预训练 backbone 向量空间难以对齐，限制生成式推荐的召回上限。
Method: CQG-Single 单次前向生成一个连续检索 query；CQG-AR 自回归生成连续残差更新，保留逐步解码但去掉 SID item-token 词表、code 查表与离散 beam 扩展；两者都用稠密或近似最近邻检索让所有编码条目可直接打分，评测采用 valid-prefix 约束解码的统一协议。

Conclusion: 消除有限 beam 的可达性约束后连续 query 生成能以更少参数超过 TIGER 式基线；评估生成式推荐时应把输出表示、自回归建模与检索预算三者解耦。

papers.title: Diffusion Precipitation Generation with Medium-range Weather Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Accurate daily precipitation forecasts are important for weather-sensitive decisions. Although recent Weather Foundation Models (WFMs) have achieved significant progress, they are trained on reanalysis data, which exhibit regional and intensity-dependent biases. Since retraining WFMs on observation-based targets is costly, we study Dynamics-Precipitation Decoupling, a plug-and-play framework that uses a separately trained generator to map non-precipitation forecasts from a frozen weather model to observation-aligned daily precipitation. Its key challenges are to capture heterogeneous rainfall distributions and align daily accumulations with atmospheric signals that evolve across space and time. To address them, we train a diffusion generator conditional on atmospheric states and satellite-gauge estimates of precipitation. A multi-scale recurrent encoder summarizes atmospheric evolution, while cross-attention aligns atmospheric and precipitation features during denoising. Extensive evaluation of various backbones, including Pangu-Weather, GraphCast, and HRES, on global and regional forecasting shows improved daily precipitation accuracy and event detection, with better representation of localized accumulation patterns. Global ensemble evaluation shows lower Brier scores than ENS and training-from-scratch GenCast at all reported lead times, with lower CRPS in most comparisons. Remarkably, a heavy-rainfall case study using 2,288 stations in China further supports improved daily accumulation patterns and event detection against ground observations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Dynamics-Precipitation Decoupling：在冻结的 Weather Foundation Model 之外单独训练一个 diffusion 生成器，把非降水预报量映射为与观测对齐的日降水，从而绕开在观测目标上重训 WFM 的高成本。以大气状态和卫星-雨量计估计为条件，多尺度循环编码器总结大气演变、cross-attention 在去噪中对齐特征；在 Pangu-Weather、GraphCast、HRES 等骨干上，全球集合评估在所有报告时效的 Brier score 均低于 ENS 与从零训练的 GenCast，多数对比 CRPS 更低，中国 2,288 站重个例也支持日累积与事件检测改善。
Motivation: Weather Foundation Model 都在再分析数据上训练，降水存在区域和强度相关偏差；在观测目标上重训整个 WFM 成本过高，需要一种不动骨干即可对齐观测的方案。
Method: 训练一个独立的 diffusion 生成器，以大气状态和卫星-雨量计降水估计为条件，把冻结天气模型的非降水预报映射为日降水；多尺度循环编码器 (multi-scale recurrent encoder) 汇总跨时空演变的大气信号，cross-attention 在去噪过程中对齐大气与降水特征，以处理异质降雨分布和日累积对齐。
Result: 在 Pangu-Weather、GraphCast、HRES 等骨干上的全球与区域评估显示日降水精度与事件检测提升，更好地再现局地累积形态；全球集合评估在所有报告时效上 Brier score 低于 ENS 和从零训练的 GenCast，多数对比中 CRPS 更低；用中国 2,288 个站点的重降雨个例对照地面观测，日累积形态与事件检测进一步改善。
Conclusion: 不动骨干、外挂一个观测对齐的 diffusion 降水生成器，即可在多个 WFM 上同时改善日降水精度、事件检测与集合评分，不必在观测目标上重训 WFM。

papers.title: SmartSalesBench: A Resistance-Aware Multi-Turn Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Sales Agents
papers.abstract_en: We present SmartSalesBench, the first multi-turn conversational benchmark explicitly designed to evaluate large language model (LLM) sales agents against psychologically grounded, resistant buyer personas. Existing task-oriented dialogue benchmarks assume cooperative users and measure task completion; SmartSalesBench inverts this assumption, placing agents against personas programmed to resist and challenge across conversations of up to twenty turns. The benchmark includes five agent profiles, twelve buyer personas, fifteen smartphone products across six price tiers, and four controlled experiments with 3 iterations totaling 13,680 sessions. Both sales-agent and buyer persona generations are grounded through retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). We introduce nine evaluation metrics grouped into three tiers: primary outcome metrics (CR, BRS, RIR), secondary quality metrics (SMS, PFS, ETI), and exploratory metrics planned for future reporting (ITS, ARI, SPI). Our evaluation combines automated LLM-as-judge scoring with internal human assessment (n = 50, \k{appa} = 0.71, Pearson r = 0.81 with BRS).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SmartSalesBench 把任务型对话基准的“用户配合”假设反转，用心理学基础的抗拒型买家 persona 在最多 20 轮对话中对抗 LLM 销售 agent。基准含 5 种 agent profile、12 种买家 persona、15 款智能手机（6 个价格档），4 组受控实验 × 3 次迭代共 13,680 场会话，agent 与 persona 均由 RAG 生成。评测用 LLM-as-judge 加人工评估（n = 50，κ = 0.71，与 BRS 的 Pearson r = 0.81），提出三层共 9 项指标。
Motivation: 现有任务型对话基准假设用户配合、只测任务完成率，无法衡量销售 agent 面对持续抗拒与质疑的买家时的表现。
Method: 构建 5 种 agent profile × 12 种抗拒型买家 persona × 15 款智能手机（6 个价格档）的多轮对话场景，对话最长 20 轮；agent 与 persona 生成均用检索增强生成 (RAG) 支撑。设三层共 9 项指标：主要结果指标 CR、BRS、RIR，次要质量指标 SMS、PFS、ETI，探索性指标 ITS、ARI、SPI；评测结合 LLM-as-judge 与内部人工评估。
Result: 共 4 组受控实验、每组 3 次迭代，合计 13,680 场会话；人工评估样本 n = 50，评分者一致性 κ = 0.71，与 BRS 的 Pearson r = 0.81。
Conclusion: 销售 agent 评测应把买家抗拒作为受控变量而非噪声，用分层指标加人工校验的 LLM-as-judge 来度量；ITS、ARI、SPI 被列为未来报告的探索性指标。

papers.title: Minions: A Dynamic and Distributed Virtual GPU Cloud Built on Idle Apple Silicon Devices
papers.abstract_en: The increasing demand for GPU-accelerated machine learning inference has exposed limitations in centralized GPU infrastructures, including high cost, limited elasticity, and long wait times under resource constraints. At the same time, modern Apple Silicon-based macOS devices are equipped with powerful GPUs that remain largely idle during normal usage. This paper presents Minions, a dynamic and distributed virtual GPU cloud that aggregates idle Apple Silicon GPUs across macOS devices to execute large-scale machine learning inference workloads. Minions enables teams to leverage existing hardware without requiring additional GPU procurement. The system provides flexible GPU inference task execution, fault tolerance, and efficient resource utilization. Our experience shows that idle macOS devices can be transformed into a practical distributed GPU inference platform in environments where centralized GPU resources are constrained.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Minions 把多台 macOS 设备上闲置的 Apple Silicon GPU 聚合成动态分布式虚拟 GPU 云，用于执行大规模机器学习推理任务，提供容错与灵活的任务调度。作者的经验表明，在集中式 GPU 资源受限的环境下，闲置 macOS 设备可以被改造成可用的分布式 GPU 推理平台。
Motivation: 集中式 GPU 基础设施成本高、弹性差、资源紧张时排队时间长，而日常使用的 Apple Silicon macOS 设备 GPU 大部分时间闲置。
Method: 聚合多台 macOS 设备的闲置 Apple Silicon GPU 组成动态分布式虚拟 GPU 云，支持灵活的 GPU 推理任务执行、容错与高效资源利用，团队可直接复用现有硬件而无需额外采购 GPU。
Result: 作者报告的是一套系统实现与使用经验：闲置 macOS 设备可被转化为实用的分布式 GPU 推理平台，适用于集中式 GPU 资源受限的环境。
Conclusion: 闲置消费级 Apple Silicon 设备在特定环境下足以支撑实用的分布式 GPU 推理，可作为集中式 GPU 采购之外的替代路径。

papers.title: Spatial Prediction with Guided Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Spatial prediction is a critically important task in data analyses that involve spatially or spatio-temporally-referenced data. It is commonly carried out using hierarchical models, which comprise a process model describing the latent process of interest, and a data model describing how the process is observed. The target quantity is the predictive distribution, which is the conditional distribution of the latent spatial process given the observed data. Unfortunately, the predictive distribution is rarely available in closed form and can be difficult to sample from. Here, we show how recent developments in guided diffusion modelling from machine learning can address a wide class of problems in spatial prediction when the likelihood function derived from the data model is known and differentiable, possibly after relaxation. To show the versatility of the approach, we apply it to both Gaussian and non-Gaussian process models and a variety of data models that describe direct partial observations, linear and areal aggregates, counts, right censoring, and area-exceedance functionals. Where possible, we validate the framework against exact and Markov-chain-Monte-Carlo (MCMC)-derived predictive distributions. We demonstrate our approach on several simulation studies and in a controlled experiment of methane-flux inversion over the UK and Ireland. We show that guided diffusion can sample from the correct predictive distribution in a variety of settings, that it can be applied to models where MCMC is intractable, and that it scales well with the dimensionality of the latent process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 guided diffusion 用于空间预测：在层级模型中，只要数据模型导出的似然已知且可微（必要时松弛），就能直接从潜空间过程的后验预测分布采样。在高斯与非高斯过程模型、直接/部分观测、线性与面积聚合、计数、右删失、面积超越泛函等数据模型上，采样结果与精确解或 MCMC 预测分布一致，并在英国与爱尔兰甲烷通量反演的受控实验中展示。
Motivation: 空间层级模型的预测分布（给定观测的潜过程条件分布）通常没有闭式解、也难以采样，尤其在 MCMC 不可行的观测模型下。
Method: 用 guided diffusion 采样预测分布：要求数据模型给出的似然已知且可微（必要时做松弛），覆盖高斯与非高斯过程模型，以及直接部分观测、线性与面积聚合、计数、右删失、面积超越泛函 (area-exceedance functionals) 等数据模型；在可能处与精确解和 MCMC 预测分布对照验证。
Result: 在多种设置下 guided diffusion 能采到正确的预测分布；可应用于 MCMC 不可行的模型；随潜过程维度扩展性良好。验证覆盖若干模拟研究与英国、爱尔兰甲烷通量反演的受控实验。
Conclusion: 只要似然已知可微，guided diffusion 可作为通用空间预测采样器，替代或绕开 MCMC，并在高维潜过程上保持可扩展。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: MotionCoach: Constructing Multimodal Guidance for Video Professional Motion Editing
papers.abstract_en: Video editing models achieve strong performance in modifying appearance, backgrounds, styles, and motions, empowered by large-scale training data. Beyond general scenarios, professional motions are significant in performance, sports, and martial arts. This paper focuses on professional motion editing, which involves fine-grained motion technique and temporal structure. Given professional motion names but lacking detailed descriptions, existing models often fail to generate professional motions, such as incorrectly lifting the front wheel under a Stoppie instruction. To address this challenge, we introduce MotionCoach, a trained multimodal agent that uses multi-turn tools and performs self-verification, producing a grounded prompt and a reference clip as reliable and sufficient multimodal guidance to inject external professional motion knowledge into video editing models. To supply training data, we build a data pipeline to construct trajectories. We cold-start the agent on MotionCoach-SFT-10k and apply Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on MotionCoach-RL-2k with rewards on the motion guidance prompt, the motion outcome video, and the format. For evaluation, we introduce VPMEBench, comprising 314 professional motion editing tasks with fine-grained references and annotations. Extensive experiments show that MotionCoach improves the overall score from 55.1 to 65.6 on Seedance 2.0 and from 51.2 to 64.5 on MiniMax-H3. Learning to construct multimodal guidance enables precise professional motion editing without retraining video editing models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MotionCoach 是一个多轮工具调用并自我验证的多模态 agent，为视频编辑模型生成带专业动作知识的 grounded prompt 与参考片段，从而在不重训视频编辑模型的前提下改出 Stoppie 这类细粒度专业动作。在 VPMEBench（314 个专业动作编辑任务）上，整体分从 55.1 提到 65.6（Seedance 2.0）、从 51.2 提到 64.5（MiniMax-H3）。
Motivation: 现有视频编辑模型只有动作名称、缺少细粒度描述时会生成错误动作（如 Stoppie 指令下错误抬起前轮），专业动作的技巧细节与时序结构难以注入。
Method: 构建数据 pipeline 生成轨迹，先在 MotionCoach-SFT-10k 上冷启动，再用 GRPO 在 MotionCoach-RL-2k 上强化，奖励覆盖动作引导 prompt、动作结果视频与格式三部分；agent 通过多轮工具与自我验证产出 grounded prompt 和参考片段作为多模态引导。
Result: 新建 VPMEBench，含 314 个带细粒度参考与标注的专业动作编辑任务；整体分在 Seedance 2.0 上由 55.1 升至 65.6，在 MiniMax-H3 上由 51.2 升至 64.5。
Conclusion: 让 agent 学会构造多模态引导即可实现精确的专业动作编辑，无需重训视频编辑模型。

papers.title: MVGraph: Benchmarking LVLMs on Evidence Composition across Multi-View Visual Graph
papers.abstract_en: We introduce MVGraph, a benchmark for evaluating large vision-language models (LVLMs) on multi-graph reasoning where the evidence required by a query is distributed across multiple interrelated visual graph views. Although such evidence commonly resides in source-specific graphs, temporal snapshots, or local observations, existing graph reasoning benchmarks remain confined to a single self-contained structure, assessing only graph perception and reasoning while leaving the alignment and composition of evidence across views underexplored. MVGraph comprises 8k instances spanning 8 \textit{graph-theoretic} tasks, abstracted from two multi-graph scenarios (partial and temporal graph views). Each problem is programmatically constructed and verified to be unsolvable from a single view. Beyond end-to-end evaluation, we decompose multi-graph reasoning into four complementary capabilities---Perception, Alignment, Composition, and Reasoning---and design 29 diagnostic tasks with 64k instances to probe each one, along with golden intermediate representations for evaluating the intermediate process. Across 15 LVLMs, we reveal the difficulty of multi-graph reasoning and identify cross-view edge alignment and relation-level composition as prominent bottlenecks through stage-oriented diagnostics. Meanwhile, temporal constraints and increasing view counts expose further capability boundaries. Code and data are available at https://github.com/AAAndy-Zhu/MVGraph.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MVGraph 是评测 LVLM 跨多视图视觉图组合理解的基准：8k 实例覆盖 8 个图论任务，每个实例被程序化构造并验证为单视图不可解，另有 29 个诊断任务、64k 实例拆解感知、对齐、组合、推理四能力。在 15 个 LVLM 上，跨视图边对齐与关系级组合是最突出瓶颈，时序约束与视图数增加进一步暴露能力边界。
Motivation: 现有图推理基准都局限于单一自包含图结构，只测图感知与推理，跨视图的证据对齐与组合作用长期未被考察，而真实证据常分布在源特定图、时序快照或局部观测中。
Method: 从两类多图场景（partial graph views 与 temporal graph views）抽象出 8k 实例、8 个图论任务，程序化构造并验证单视图不可解；另设计 29 个诊断任务、64k 实例，把多图推理拆成 Perception、Alignment、Composition、Reasoning 四能力并提供 golden intermediate representations 评测中间过程。
Result: 在 15 个 LVLM 上的阶段诊断显示跨视图边对齐 (cross-view edge alignment) 与关系级组合 (relation-level composition) 是突出瓶颈；时序约束与视图数增加进一步暴露能力边界。
Conclusion: 多图推理的难点不在单图感知，而在跨视图证据的对齐与组合，且随视图数和时序约束加重；基准与诊断任务、代码数据已公开于 GitHub。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: DataCupid: Stable Matching Repair for Training Data Acquisition with Delayed Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Matching repair after utility changes can reuse valid observations, but new evaluations must respect matching capacity and may return out of order. We study announced invalidations with bounded, possibly reward-dependent reporting delays and pending evaluations that do not occupy future matching capacity. Residualload repair (RLR) combines sound outcome certificates with batched matching schedules for unequal sample deficits. Its complete dyadic quota schedule admits a sharp issue-round bound with coefficient cb < 1.607 relative to the terminal residual endpoint load, together with separate delay and evidence-lifetime bounds. RLR-P monitors complete issue-order prefixes without changing the sampling plan before acceptance. With a deterministic pure oracle, a single-repair coupling from the same drained initial state guarantees no increase in certification time, issued observations, or time to a reusable checkpoint. We also derive an information-load lower bound. On fixed priority-star markets with unknown Bernoulli gaps, PrioritySearch attains the history-adjusted first-order constant for expected certification time as δ {\sim} 0, under hypothesis-independent linear history scaling and sublogarithmic reporting delays. Paired simulations and measured-feedback replay quantify the trade-offs: in the replay, RLR-P has lower mean capped update-certification time than a monitored width-based baseline, at higher oracle CPU cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DataCupid 针对带延迟反馈的训练数据采购，提出残余负载修复 (Residual Load Repair, RLR)：在效用变化后用结果证书加批量匹配日程复用仍有效的观测，且待评估样本不占用后续匹配容量。其完整二元配额日程给出 issue-round 上界，系数 cb < 1.607；RLR-P 在不改动采样计划的前提下监控前缀，确定性纯 oracle 下单次修复耦合保证认证时间、发出观测数与到达可复用检查点的时间均不增加。
Motivation: 训练数据采购中效用变化后需要修复匹配，但新评估可能乱序返回，且报告延迟有界并可能依赖奖励；既要复用有效观测，又不能让待评估样本挤占后续匹配容量。
Method: RLR 组合结果证书 (outcome certificates) 与面向不等样本缺口的批量匹配日程 (batched matching schedules)，给出完整二元配额日程的 issue-round 上界及延迟与证据存活期界；RLR-P 监控完整 issue-order 前缀且在验收前不改变采样计划；另推导信息负载下界，并在固定 priority-star 市场、未知 Bernoulli 缺口上分析 PrioritySearch。
Result: 完整二元配额日程的 issue-round 上界系数 cb < 1.607（相对终端残余端点负载），并有独立的延迟与证据存活期界；确定性纯 oracle 下单次修复耦合保证认证时间、发出观测数、到达可复用检查点时间均不增加；PrioritySearch 在 δ→0 下达到期望认证时间的历史调整一阶常数（条件为假设无关的线性历史标度与次对数报告延迟）；配对仿真与实测反馈回放中，RLR-P 的平均截断更新认证时间低于监控式宽度基线，但 oracle CPU 开销更高。
Conclusion: 带证书的批量匹配修复可以在不牺牲认证进度的前提下复用有效观测，代价是更高的 oracle 计算；延迟反馈下的认证时间在 δ→0 时可由 PrioritySearch 达到一阶最优常数。
Relevance: 0
