papers.title: Video Codec-Guided Training-Free Token Compression for Video Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Video large language models (VLLMs) rely on long visual token sequences to understand complex temporal content, which makes visual token compression important for efficient inference. Existing training-free compression methods mainly reduce the number of tokens sent to the language model, but the compression process itself can still require many visual feature comparisons, especially for intra-frame token protection and inter-frame temporal token merging. This paper proposes a video codec-guided training-free token compression method for VLLMs that uses coding information already available in compressed video as a low-cost search prior. The method aligns reference-frame dependencies, motion vectors, and residuals with the visual token grid. Residual information forms compact candidate pools for token protection, while motion information is propagated along reference-frame chains to construct localized candidates for temporal token merging between sparsely sampled frames. Local visual feature similarity comparison is then used within these candidates to make the final compression decisions, without modifying the base VLLM. Experiments on three representative VLLMs and four video-understanding benchmarks show that the proposed method achieves performance comparable to the state-of-the-art training-free baseline FlashVID, and in some settings surpasses it, while substantially reducing the feature comparisons required by token protection and temporal matching. These results demonstrate that codec information can effectively improve the accuracy-complexity tradeoff of video token compression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用视频编解码器已有信息（参考帧依赖、运动矢量、残差）替代昂贵视觉特征比较的免训练 VLLM 视觉 token 压缩方法：残差构成 token 保护候选池，运动信息沿参考帧链传播构造稀疏帧间时序合并的局部候选，再在候选内做局部相似度比较，不改动基座 VLLM。在三个 VLLM 与四个视频理解基准上达到与 SOTA 免训练基线 FlashVID 相当、部分设置更优的性能，同时大幅减少保护与时序匹配所需的特征比较次数。
Motivation: 免训练压缩方法虽减少送入 LLM 的 token 数，但压缩过程本身（帧内保护与帧间时序合并）仍需大量视觉特征比较，成为推理开销瓶颈。
Method: 把压缩视频中已有的编码信息对齐到视觉 token 网格：残差生成紧凑候选池用于 token 保护，运动矢量沿参考帧链传播生成稀疏采样帧间的局部候选用于时序合并，最后仅在候选内做局部视觉特征相似度比较决定压缩，不修改基座 VLLM。
Result: 在三个代表性 VLLM 和四个视频理解基准上，性能与 SOTA 免训练基线 FlashVID 相当、部分设置超越，同时大幅减少 token 保护与时序匹配所需的特征比较次数。
Conclusion: 编解码信息可作为低成本搜索先验，有效改善视频 token 压缩的精度-复杂度权衡。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: JoyInside-VLM-Agent: Product-Conditioned Multimodal Policy Learning for Embodied Agents
papers.abstract_en: Embodied agents must translate multimodal observations and user requests into executable actions while adapting to product constraints, changing goals, and execution feedback. We present JoyInside-VLM-Agent, a ReAct-style multimodal agent developed through product-conditioned trajectory construction and staged policy learning for robotic platforms and smart hardware. A closed-loop sandbox generates multimodal interaction trajectories covering goal revisions and failure recovery, which are checked against execution outcomes and semantic criteria. Supervised fine-tuning and multi-teacher on-policy distillation precede reinforcement learning with DPER (Dual-Source Privileged On-Policy Self-Distillation with Token-Level Evidence Routing). DPER routes token-level evidence between a frozen privileged teacher and a privileged student sharing the rollout policy's parameters, modulating reward-derived token advantages while preserving their signs. Training rewards combine generative process evaluation, multi-judge rankings, and task-queue consistency. JoyInside-VLM-Agent achieves a BFCL v4 overall score of 77.44, exceeding the evaluated baselines; results on the other public benchmarks are mixed. On JoyInside-Devices and JoyInside-Robotics, the evaluated system, which includes domain-specific skill refinement, leads the baselines on all reported metrics. Two real-world quadruped case studies illustrate visually grounded search, replanning after execution failure, and explicit failure reporting.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables; includes references and appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JoyInside-VLM-Agent 是面向机器人与智能硬件的 ReAct 式多模态智能体，通过产品条件化轨迹构建与分阶段策略学习（SFT、多教师 on-policy 蒸馏，再上 RL）训练，核心算法 DPER 在冻结特权教师与共享 rollout 参数的特权学生之间做 token 级证据路由，调节由奖励导出的 token advantage 但保持其符号。BFCL v4 总分 77.44，超过所评测基线；其他公开基准结果参差，而在 JoyInside-Devices 与 JoyInside-Robotics 上所评测系统在全部报告指标领先基线。
Motivation: 具身智能体要在产品约束、目标变更与执行反馈下把多模态观测转成可执行动作，而常规指令微调难以覆盖目标修订与失败恢复这类闭环交互。
Method: 闭环 sandbox 生成覆盖目标修订与失败恢复的多模态交互轨迹，并按执行结果与语义标准校验；训练依次为 SFT、多教师 on-policy 蒸馏，再进入带 DPER 的 RL，奖励由生成过程评估、多裁判排序与任务队列一致性组合而成。
Result: BFCL v4 总分 77.44，超过所评测基线；其他公开基准结果参差。在 JoyInside-Devices 与 JoyInside-Robotics 上，含领域技能精调的所评测系统在全部报告指标领先基线；另有两个真实四足机器人案例展示视觉引导搜索、执行失败后重规划与显式失败上报。
Conclusion: 分阶段策略学习加 token 级证据路由的 DPER 能把具身智能体推到 BFCL v4 77.44 并在自家设备与机器人基准全面领先，但跨公开基准的收益并不一致。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: BFCL v4 总分 77.44，超过所评测基线；其他公开基准结果参差。在 JoyInside-Devices 与 JoyInside-Robotics 上，含领域技能精调的所评测系统在全部报告指标领先基线；另有两个真实四足机器人案例展示视觉引导搜索、执行失败后重规划与显式失败上报。
summary_sections.conclusion: 分阶段策略学习加 token 级证据路由的 DPER 能把具身智能体推到 BFCL v4 77.44 并在自家设备与机器人基准全面领先，但跨公开基准的收益并不一致。

papers.title: MathVis: Can AI Reason through Drawing? A Benchmark for Mathematical Figure Generation
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces MathVis, a benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs' ability to visualize frontier mathematical problems and perform diagram-assisted reasoning. The benchmark consists of 512 tasks, each comprising a mathematical statement, a reference diagram, executable TikZ or SVG code, a Gold Intermediate Representation (IR), atomic rubrics, and error codes. Through rigorous evaluation, GPT-6-Astra, Claude Fable 5, and Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview achieve pass@1 scores of 31.25%, 26.56%, and 22.85%, respectively. We found that although the tasks require visualization, LLMs produce outputs dominated by formal languages, symbols, and graphics programs, rather than explicit diagram-mediated reasoning. Furthermore, while the solutions generated by LLMs may contain all the necessary elements, they are often visually confusing to humans. Ultimately, this benchmark aims to visualize mathematical problems and promote research on enabling LLMs to simplify their reasoning via visual diagrams.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MathVis 是一个评测 LLM 能否把前沿数学问题可视化并借助图示推理的基准，含 512 个任务，每个任务配数学陈述、参考图、可执行 TikZ/SVG 代码、Gold 中间表示 (IR)、原子评分 rubric 与错误码。GPT-6-Astra、Claude Fable 5、Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 的 pass@1 分别为 31.25%、26.56%、22.85%；模型输出以形式语言、符号和图形程序为主，而非显式的图示中介推理，且解法虽包含必要元素却常对人造成视觉混淆。
Motivation: 现有评测无法区分 LLM 是真的用图示辅助推理，还是只输出符号与绘图代码；数学问题的可视化推理能力缺少带可执行参考与细粒度评分标准的基准。
Method: 构建 512 个任务的 MathVis 基准，每题包含数学陈述、参考图、可执行 TikZ 或 SVG 代码、Gold IR、原子 rubric 与错误码，用以定位模型在可视化与图示推理各环节的具体失败。
Result: pass@1：GPT-6-Astra 31.25%，Claude Fable 5 26.56%，Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 22.85%。定性发现：即使任务要求可视化，LLM 输出仍以形式语言、符号和图形程序为主导，缺少显式的图示中介推理；生成解法常包含全部必要元素，但对人类读者视觉上混乱。
Conclusion: 当前 LLM 在数学可视化任务上主要靠符号与绘图代码而非图示推理作答，且生成图示对人不友好；MathVis 的 rubric 与错误码体系旨在推动让 LLM 借助视觉图示简化推理的研究。

papers.title: WaveMark: Robust Wavelet-Domain Image Watermarking for Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Image watermarking enables provenance tracing for photorealistic images generated by diffusion models. However, state-of-the-art (SOTA) removal attacks can suppress embedded signals with little perceptual degradation. This vulnerability limits the effectiveness of watermarks for intellectual property protection and misuse attribution. We propose WaveMark, a novel wavelet-domain watermarking method that embeds messages in a diffusion model's initial noise. To support robust recovery from perturbed carriers, WaveMark distributes keyed replicas of message bits across spatial positions, wavelet orientations, and scales. Each carrier groups coefficients from four latent channels and encodes a randomized bit through magnitude projection, providing an explicit decoding margin. We evaluate WaveMark with SD2.1 on SDP and MS-COCO Captions under 14 attacks. WaveMark achieves 100.0% bit accuracy (BA) without attacks, while maintaining image quality comparable to the evaluated baselines. Under SOTA MarkNull and MarkNull-A, it retains over 88% BA, outperforming all baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WaveMark 把水印消息嵌入扩散模型的初始噪声，在小波域按空间位置、方向和尺度分布带密钥的消息位副本，每个载体聚合四个 latent 通道系数并用幅度投影编码随机位以留出显式解码余量。在 SD2.1 上对 SDP 与 MS-COCO Captions 的 14 种攻击评测，无攻击时位准确率 (BA) 达 100.0%，在 SOTA MarkNull 与 MarkNull-A 攻击下仍保留 88% 以上 BA，超过全部基线。
Motivation: SOTA 移除攻击能在几乎不损失感知质量的前提下压制嵌入信号，使扩散模型图像水印难以承担知识产权保护与滥用溯源。
Method: WaveMark 在扩散模型初始噪声中嵌入消息：带密钥的消息位副本跨空间位置、小波方向与尺度分布；每个载体聚合四个 latent 通道的小波系数，用幅度投影 (magnitude projection) 编码随机位，给出显式解码余量。评测用 SD2.1，数据为 SDP 与 MS-COCO Captions，共 14 种攻击。
Result: 无攻击时位准确率 100.0%，图像质量与所评测基线相当；在 SOTA MarkNull 与 MarkNull-A 攻击下 BA 保持 88% 以上，优于全部基线。
Conclusion: 把消息位复制到小波域的多个自由度并用幅度投影留出解码余量，可让初始噪声水印在强移除攻击下仍可恢复，同时不牺牲画质。

papers.title: From Imbalance to Evidence: Deep Nonparametric Testing for Complex Data under Severe Sample Imbalance
papers.abstract_en: Comparing distributions under severe sample imbalance requires effectively using abundant majority observations while retaining sensitivity to differences involving the smaller sample. This challenge is particularly relevant for complex, non-Euclidean data, such as graphs, whose structural characteristics call for flexible testing procedures. Classifier two-sample tests (C2STs) provide such flexibility, but existing procedures are primarily designed for balanced or comparably sized samples. In this paper, we study C2STs in a highly imbalanced regime, and show that severe sample imbalance may substantially degrade testing performance. Different from conventional imbalanced learning approaches that treat sample imbalance merely as a nuisance for classifier training, we turn it into a source of repeated testing evidence. Building on this insight, we propose an Enhanced Imbalance-Aware Deep Classifier Two-Sample Test (EIAD-C2ST), a classifier-agnostic framework designed for sample imbalance that accommodates diverse data modalities by tailoring classifiers to data structure. For computationally expensive deep classifiers, we further develop a scalable representation-amortized implementation strategy. Theoretically, we establish rigorous guarantees on asymptotic size and characterize conditions for power consistency, allowing the imbalance ratio to diverge. We demonstrate the empirical gains using simulations and an application to blockchain forensics. The results reveal that the majority-sample surplus, when properly leveraged, can be organized into useful statistical evidence, rather than an obstacle, for distributional comparisons with complex data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 EIAD-C2ST：在严重样本不平衡下把多数类的富余样本转成重复检验证据，而非当作训练干扰。理论给出渐近水平保证与允许不平衡比发散的功效一致性条件，模拟与区块链取证应用显示经验增益。
Motivation: 分类器两样本检验 (C2ST) 现有流程面向平衡或等量样本，严重不平衡会显著劣化检验性能；而图等非欧数据又需要灵活的检验程序。
Method: 提出分类器无关的 Enhanced Imbalance-Aware Deep Classifier Two-Sample Test (EIAD-C2ST)，按数据结构定制分类器以适配多种模态；对计算昂贵的深度分类器另给可扩展的 representation-amortized 实现；理论上建立渐近水平保证并刻画允许不平衡比发散时的功效一致性条件。
Result: 模拟与区块链取证 (blockchain forensics) 应用展示了经验增益；结果表明多数类富余样本在被恰当利用时可组织成有用的统计证据，而非分布比较的障碍。
Conclusion: 严重样本不平衡可从检验性能的负担转为分布比较的证据来源，前提是检验流程显式利用多数类富余而非仅在分类器训练中处理不平衡。

papers.title: In-Context Learning Can Help Vision-Language Models Overcome Training Priors
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) learn strong statistical regularities during training, which can make them fail to properly respond to visual evidence when input images violate those regularities. It is challenging to disambiguate these prior-induced errors from errors caused by the model missing the underlying visual capabilities. In this work, we use controlled visual in-context learning to encourage the model to focus on the visual evidence, and demonstrate that this alone is frequently sufficient to correct the errors -- suggesting that the models in fact do possess the relevant visual capabilities. Specifically, we show that across five vision-centric tasks, demonstrations yield large gains on prior-conflicting counterfactual examples ($+27.2\%$ for Qwen3-VL 235B and $+15.1\%$ for Qwen3-VL 32B) while leaving accuracy on prior-aligned examples nearly unchanged. These findings generalize across five VLM families with gains from $+9.7\%$ to $+30.3\%$. We analyze visual representations and find that demonstrations indeed redirect attention toward grounding cues while reducing reliance on cues that support the learned prior. Finally, we find that in-context learning is limited when the underlying visual capability is weak or absent. Together, these results show that current VLMs possess visual grounding capabilities that standard evaluations may overlook, underscoring the need for controlled evaluation design in diagnosing and improving model capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用受控的视觉上下文学习 (visual in-context learning) 让 VLM 依据图像证据而非训练先验作答，在五个视觉任务的先验冲突反事实样本上，Qwen3-VL 235B 提升 +27.2%、32B 提升 +15.1%，而先验一致样本准确率几乎不变。跨五个 VLM 家族增益 +9.7% 到 +30.3%，说明模型本就具备相应视觉能力，只是标准评测掩盖了它。
Motivation: VLM 在训练中习得的统计先验会在图像违反该先验时压过视觉证据，而这类先验诱导错误与模型真正缺乏视觉能力难以区分，标准评测无法诊断。
Method: 用受控的视觉 in-context learning，通过示例引导模型聚焦视觉证据；在五个视觉中心任务上构造先验冲突的反事实样本与先验一致样本对照，并分析视觉表征中的注意力走向。
Result: 五个任务上示例带来大幅增益：Qwen3-VL 235B +27.2%、Qwen3-VL 32B +15.1%（先验冲突反事实样本），先验一致样本准确率几乎不变；跨五个 VLM 家族增益 +9.7% 到 +30.3%。表征分析显示示例把注意力转向 grounding 线索、减少对支持先验线索的依赖。
Conclusion: 当前 VLM 已具备标准评测会漏掉的视觉 grounding 能力，仅靠 in-context 示例即可纠正多数先验冲突错误；但当底层视觉能力本身薄弱或缺失时 in-context learning 失效，因此诊断模型能力需要受控评测设计。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: UniDeblur: Unified Motion Deblurring via Fourier Convolution Learning
papers.abstract_en: Image deblurring is a fundamental task in computer vision, yet existing methods mainly specialize in isolated scenarios. Consequently, the deblurring performance of these models drops significantly across scenarios with different cameras and image contents. This motivates the development of a unified motion deblurring framework that can handle diverse blur patterns. To this end, we construct a multi-source dataset and develop a data pruning and quality control pipeline. Then, to restore blur images with various motion blur kernels across different scenarios, we propose a unified motion deblurring framework via Fourier Convolution Learning. Existing deblurring networks usually rely on pixel-level mappings and overlook the convolutional nature of blur. Thus, the network mostly fits the image content itself rather than learning the convolution process, making it difficult to handle multi-source blur images. Instead of relying on spatial mapping, we perform blur-adaptive global filter learning in Fourier space, which avoids the limited spatial support of kernel estimation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our unified model effectively handles motion blurs across diverse sources and scenes, achieving competitive performance across both in-domain and OOD benchmarks. Code will be released at github.com/DeepMed-Lab-ECNU/Single-Image-Deblur.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniDeblur 用 Fourier Convolution Learning 在傅里叶空间做模糊自适应的全局滤波学习，绕开空间域核估计的有限支撑，把原本按场景各自训练的运动去模糊模型统一成一个跨相机、跨内容的模型。在自建多源数据与 in-domain、OOD 两类基准上取得有竞争力的去模糊表现，代码将发布于 github.com/DeepMed-Lab-ECNU/Single-Image-Deblur。
Motivation: 现有去模糊方法各自专精单一场景，换相机或换图像内容后性能显著下降，缺少能覆盖多种运动模糊模式的统一框架。
Method: 构建多源数据集并设计数据剪枝与质量控制管线；网络不学像素级映射，而是在傅里叶空间做 blur-adaptive 全局滤波学习，以对应模糊的卷积本质并摆脱空间核估计的支撑限制。
Result: 在 in-domain 与 OOD 两类基准上均取得有竞争力的性能，统一模型能处理来自不同来源与场景的运动模糊；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把去模糊当作傅里叶空间的卷积过程而非空间像素映射来学，是实现跨场景统一运动去模糊的可行路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Surfing the Activation Wave: Analyzing the Information and Geometry of LLM Hidden States for Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Decoder hidden states from different layers of large language models (LLMs) often encode complementary information. However, existing speculative decoding methods typically rely on a small set of target-model layers chosen using fixed, position-based heuristics. Selecting an optimal subset of layers is inherently a combinatorial problem, making exhaustive evaluation infeasible even for moderately deep models. In this work, we present a principled framework for multi-layer hidden-state selection for speculative decoding based on two complementary criteria: informativeness, measured through matrix-entropy analysis, and diversity, quantified using centered kernel alignment (CKA). We investigate layer-wise Shannon entropy, aggregate entropy under hidden-state concatenation, and pairwise CKA dynamics across depth, revealing distinct geometric and informational compartments within decoder representations. Motivated by these findings, we propose entropy and CKA-based layer selection algorithms that favor hidden-state sets that are both highly informative and minimally redundant. As part of this framework, we introduce token-entropy filtering, which removes hidden states associated with low predictive-entropy tokens, thereby improving the quality of layer-selection statistics. In EAGLE3-style speculative decoding, our selected sets outperform fixed baseline choices, including the default $[2, N//2, N-3]$ rule, while providing a clearer explanation of why some defaults can remain competitive. Our results provide a practical recipe for multi-layer hidden-state selection for speculative decoding, insights into the geometry and information in LLM decoder states, and a foundation for extending similar analysis to related applications.
papers.comment: Accepted at multiple Neurips Workshop: Axiom, GDDL, and PriGM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对投机解码 (speculative decoding) 中目标模型层选择依赖固定位置启发式的问题，提出以 matrix-entropy 度量信息量、以 CKA 度量多样性的多层隐状态选择框架，并加入 token-entropy filtering 剔除低预测熵 token 对应的隐状态。在 EAGLE3 式投机解码中，所选层集合优于默认 [2, N//2, N-3] 规则，同时解释了部分默认规则为何仍有竞争力。
Motivation: 现有投机解码只用固定位置启发式挑少量目标模型层，而最优层子集本质是组合问题，中等深度模型也无法穷举评估。
Method: 用逐层 Shannon 熵、隐状态拼接后的聚合熵与跨深度的两两 CKA 刻画信息量与几何冗余，据此设计熵与 CKA 联合的层选择算法；token-entropy filtering 移除低预测熵 token 的隐状态以改善选择统计量的质量。
Result: 在 EAGLE3 式投机解码中，所选层集合优于包括默认 [2, N//2, N-3] 规则在内的固定基线选择，并给出为何某些默认规则仍具竞争力的解释；分析揭示了 decoder 表示中可分的几何与信息 compartment。
Conclusion: 按信息量与冗余度联合选层是多层隐状态选择的实用配方，也说明固定位置启发式之所以有效源于其隐含的熵与 CKA 结构。

papers.title: Learning More by Training Less: Uncertainty-Guided Progressive Contraction for Efficient Reasoning Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have achieved remarkable advances in complex reasoning. However, scaling reasoning post-training with ever-larger corpora can substantially increase training cost without proportional performance gains. In this study, we therefore ask: how far can reasoning supervision be compressed without sacrificing capability? To this end, we propose an uncertainty-guided progressive contraction framework that concentrates supervision and optimization on the reasoning trajectories most valuable for learning. Specifically, rather than treating a teacher-generated chain-of-thought (CoT) as a single realized path, we construct uncertainty-profiled reasoning supervision by building Monte Carlo reasoning trees around intermediate reasoning states to expose process-level uncertainty. This uncertainty first contracts the original corpus into a compact teacher-informed pool. A second, learner-aware contraction then performs online routing during SFT, concentrating optimization according to the student's evolving learning state. Together, the two stages progressively contract both supervision and optimization, substantially reducing the student training budget. Experiments across diverse reasoning benchmarks and LLM families show that our method uses as little as 0.22% of the optimization budget of full-data SFT, over 450x less training exposure, while maintaining or improving reasoning performance. Notably, our framework generalizes well across heterogeneous student families, black-box teachers, and weak-to-strong transfer. This indicates that it is not only a way to accelerate training but can also enhance reasoning capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出不确定性引导的渐进收缩 (uncertainty-guided progressive contraction) 框架，用 Monte Carlo 推理树对中间推理状态做过程级不确定性刻画，先收缩教师 CoT 语料，再在 SFT 中按学生学习状态在线路由收缩优化。只需全量 SFT 优化预算的 0.22%、训练曝光量减少 450 倍以上，即可保持或提升推理性能。
Motivation: 扩大推理后训练语料会显著推高训练成本，但性能并不成比例提升，因此需要回答推理监督能压缩到什么程度而不损失能力。
Method: 把教师生成的 CoT 视为可分叉路径，在中间推理状态周围构建 Monte Carlo 推理树以暴露过程级不确定性；第一阶段据此把原始语料收缩为紧凑的教师信息池，第二阶段在 SFT 中按学生不断演化的学习状态做在线路由，集中优化。
Result: 在多种推理 benchmark 与 LLM 家族上，仅用全量 SFT 优化预算的 0.22%、训练曝光量少 450 倍以上，推理性能持平或提升；框架可跨异构学生家族、黑盒教师以及 weak-to-strong 迁移泛化。
Conclusion: 推理监督与优化可以被大幅收缩而不损失能力，该框架既加速训练，也能增强推理能力。

papers.title: Collaborative Learning and Reasoning over Model Slices
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) excel across diverse tasks, benefiting from knowledge priors, in-context reasoning, and test-time computation. Despite these strengths, single-model reasoning remains vulnerable to error propagation, as later steps depend on the model's earlier outputs, leaving reasoning blind spots difficult to independently reassess. To address this limitation, we develop \textit{collaborative learning}, encompassing the construction of heterogeneous collaborators and the learning of effective cross-model collaboration. Specifically, \textit{model slicing} replaces a large model with smaller, heterogeneous models under a comparable parameter budget, enabling prior reasoning to be reassessed across distinct model parameterizations. \textit{Pyramid supervision} combines protocol distillation with step-level supervision to refine reasoning and interaction decisions throughout collaboration. We evaluate our approach across four task categories: multi-hop question answering, mathematical reasoning, code generation, and open-ended constrained generation. The trained heterogeneous models achieve comparable or better task performance than the original large model and established multi-agent baselines, including reinforcement-learning-based methods, while also achieving higher inference efficiency than the multi-agent baselines and exhibiting differentiated collaboration patterns across tasks. These findings show that learned collaboration turns model heterogeneity into complementary reasoning capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出协作学习 (collaborative learning)：用 model slicing 把大模型替换为参数预算相当的异构小模型集合，使先前推理步骤能在不同参数化之间被重新审视，再用 Pyramid supervision（协议蒸馏 + 步级监督）训练协作与交互决策。在多跳问答、数学推理、代码生成、开放式约束生成四类任务上，训练后的异构模型达到与原大模型相当或更好的性能，同时推理效率高于多智能体基线（含基于强化学习的方法）。
Motivation: 单模型推理存在误差传播：后续步骤依赖模型自身的早期输出，推理盲点难以被独立重新评估。
Method: model slicing 以参数预算相当的更小异构模型替代大模型，让先验推理在不同参数化间被重新评估；Pyramid supervision 结合协议蒸馏 (protocol distillation) 与步级监督 (step-level supervision)，在协作全程优化推理与交互决策。
Result: 在四类任务（多跳问答、数学推理、代码生成、开放式约束生成）上，训练后的异构模型性能达到或优于原大模型与既有多智能体基线（含基于 RL 的方法），推理效率高于多智能体基线，并在不同任务上呈现差异化的协作模式。
Conclusion: 学习得到的协作可以把模型异构性转化为互补的推理能力，而非单纯的模型规模冗余。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What Egocentric Video Embeddings Encode and How to Combine Them with Inertial Sensors for Human Activity Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric video and body-worn inertial sensors are increasingly recorded together, and the video is usually encoded by pretrained models. What these embeddings represent when the camera sits on the head, and how they should be combined with inertial sensing, has received little attention. Across VideoMAEv2, CLIP, DINOv2 and the egocentric VC-1, the leading principal directions of the embedding are dominated by where the camera looks. Measured head orientation explains them on Ego-Exo4D for egocentric (R^2 0.49-0.70) but not exocentric cameras, and the scene layout explains them on WEAR. The part that the limbs' inertial signals predict separates activities across people. In a set-level probe, the rest separates exercise sets within a participant but not activities across people. This is consistent with separate roles: the video finds the clips of the same set, and the inertial classifier labels them. On WEAR, with temporal order removed and one random limb per one-second clip, we propagate inertial predictions over a within-participant video graph whose leading components are removed. This raises subject-wise cross-validated macro-F1 from 0.648 to 0.852. In our comparisons, propagation helps only over the video graph, and fusing the modalities in one classifier, or adding inertial edges to the graph, performs worse.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 11 figures, 11 tables. Solution to the 3rd WEAR Dataset Challenge @ HASCA 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 分析 VideoMAEv2、CLIP、DINOv2 与 VC-1 的头部佩戴视频嵌入主成分，发现其被相机朝向主导（Ego-Exo4D 上用头部姿态解释 R² 0.49–0.70，外视相机不成立），而惯性信号可跨人区分活动。在 WEAR 上去掉时序、每 1 秒片段只留随机一条肢体，把惯性预测沿去除主成分的被试内视频图传播，subject-wise 交叉验证 macro-F1 从 0.648 升到 0.852；但传播只在视频图上有效，单分类器融合或加惯性边反而更差。
Motivation: 头部佩戴相机下视频嵌入的主成分代表什么、以及如何与惯性传感结合，此前少有研究；这直接决定多模态人类活动识别 (HAR) 该怎么融合。
Method: 对四种预训练嵌入做主成分分析并用头部姿态与场景布局回归解释；用集合级探针 (set-level probe) 分离被试内与跨人变异；在 WEAR 上以去除主成分的被试内视频图做惯性预测传播，与单分类器融合、加惯性边两种方案对比，按 subject-wise 交叉验证评测。
Result: 头部姿态解释 Ego-Exo4D 自视相机嵌入主方向 R² 0.49–0.70（外视相机不成立），场景布局解释 WEAR 上的主方向；WEAR 上 macro-F1 从 0.648 提升到 0.852（时序顺序移除、每 1 秒片段一条随机肢体）；传播仅在视频图上有效，单分类器融合与添加惯性边均更差。
Conclusion: 视频嵌入找同一组动作的片段、惯性分类器负责贴标签，两者角色分工明确；提升来自在去除朝向/场景主成分的视频图上传播惯性预测，而非把两模态塞进一个分类器。

papers.title: Sparse Dictionary Learning for Measure-Valued Data via Linearized Optimal Transport: Efficient Algorithms and Sample Complexity
papers.abstract_en: We study dictionary learning for probability measure-valued data by embedding measures into Hilbert spaces using features derived from optimal transport geometry. We learn data-adapted dictionaries through sparse autoencoder parameterizations, producing fast, scalable representations of probability measures as sparse finite-dimensional codes. The resulting framework combines the rich, geometric structure of optimal transport with the interpretability and efficiency of sparse representation learning. We demonstrate its utility across diverse data modalities, including hyperspectral images, geometric point clouds, and document embeddings in large language model latent spaces. We also prove generalization bounds for sparse dictionary learning objectives on broad classes of $L^2$-valued measure embeddings, expressed in terms of the metric complexity of the atom class. For optimal transport and entropic transport map dictionaries, we derive new covering number bounds that yield explicit rates. Together, our computational and theoretical results support a new, scalable model for representation learning in the space of probability measures via embedding into Hilbert spaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把概率测度用最优传输几何导出的特征嵌入 Hilbert 空间，再用稀疏自编码器参数化学习数据自适应字典，得到稀疏有限维码表示。框架在超光谱图像、几何点云与 LLM 潜空间文档嵌入上展示用途，并对 L2 值测度嵌入上的稀疏字典学习目标证明泛化界。
Motivation: 概率测度值数据的表示学习需要同时保留最优传输的几何结构与稀疏表示的可解释性和效率，现有稀疏字典学习缺少针对此类嵌入的可扩展算法与样本复杂度理论。
Method: 用最优传输几何导出的特征把测度嵌入 Hilbert 空间，以稀疏自编码器参数化学习数据自适应字典，输出稀疏有限维码；理论部分对广泛 L2 值测度嵌入类给出以 atom 类 metric complexity 表达的泛化界，并为 optimal transport 与 entropic transport map 字典推导新的覆盖数界。
Result: 在超光谱图像、几何点云和 LLM 潜空间文档嵌入三类模态上展示框架用途；对稀疏字典学习目标证明以 atom 类 metric complexity 表达的泛化界，并为 optimal transport 与 entropic transport map 字典导出新的覆盖数界从而给出显式速率。
Conclusion: 把测度嵌入 Hilbert 空间后做稀疏字典学习，可同时获得可扩展的计算实现与显式样本复杂度速率，构成概率测度空间表示学习的新模型。

summary_sections.method: 用最优传输几何导出的特征把测度嵌入 Hilbert 空间，以稀疏自编码器参数化学习数据自适应字典，输出稀疏有限维码；理论部分对广泛 L2 值测度嵌入类给出以 atom 类 metric complexity 表达的泛化界，并为 optimal transport 与 entropic transport map 字典推导新的覆盖数界。
summary_sections.result: 在超光谱图像、几何点云和 LLM 潜空间文档嵌入三类模态上展示框架用途；对稀疏字典学习目标证明以 atom 类 metric complexity 表达的泛化界，并为 optimal transport 与 entropic transport map 字典导出新的覆盖数界从而给出显式速率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把测度嵌入 Hilbert 空间后做稀疏字典学习，可同时获得可扩展的计算实现与显式样本复杂度速率，构成概率测度空间表示学习的新模型。

papers.title: Teaching neural decoders with language
papers.abstract_en: Brain-computer interfaces decode neural activity, yet class-label supervision (CLS) leaves relationships among classes implicit. We propose Language as Supervision (LaS), which aligns neural features with natural-language class descriptions through learned projections and predicts classes using candidate text prototypes. We evaluate seven encoder architectures with independently trained models for visual, motor, and speech decoding from scalp and intracranial recordings. LaS improves speech-decoding accuracy by up to 17.15~pp over matched CLS baselines. Its representations support candidate-set reuse and label-supervised subject and session adaptation, while LaS enables conditional unseen-frequency decoding in steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) responses. Correct class-description correspondence supports this generalization, and dual-sided attribution visualization shows neural and textual contributions to the same class-matching score. These findings suggest that text descriptions can serve as general-purpose references for learning and interpretation in neural decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Language as Supervision (LaS)：用可学习投影把神经特征与自然语言类别描述对齐，靠候选文本原型而非纯类别标签做解码。在视觉、运动、语音解码（头皮与颅内记录、七种编码器架构）上，语音解码准确率比匹配的 CLS 基线最高提升 17.15 个百分点，并支持候选集复用与 SSVEP 未见频率的条件式解码。
Motivation: 脑机接口 (BCI) 中纯类别标签监督 (CLS) 把类别间关系当作彼此独立，类间语义结构被丢弃，跨被试/跨会话适应与新刺激泛化都受限。
Method: LaS 通过可学习投影将神经特征与自然语言类别描述对齐，用候选文本原型预测类别；在视觉、运动、语音三类解码任务上，对头皮与颅内记录分别训练独立模型，覆盖七种编码器架构；另用双侧归因可视化展示神经与文本对同一类别匹配分数的贡献。
Result: 语音解码准确率比匹配的 CLS 基线最高提升 17.15 个百分点；表征支持候选集复用与标签监督的被试/会话适应；在稳态视觉诱发电位 (SSVEP) 响应上实现条件式未见频率解码，且正确的类别描述对应关系是该泛化成立的条件。
Conclusion: 自然语言描述可以作为神经解码中通用的参考表示，同时服务于学习与可解释性，而不只是替代标签。

papers.title: Beyond Second-Order Information: Paid Logistic Regression with Noisy Features
papers.abstract_en: We consider online binary prediction with paid stochastic features, where the learner can spend resources to obtain better observations of the underlying features. This setting is motivated by applications such as medical testing, where additional cost can provide more precise measurements of patient's features for predicting a binary outcome. At each round, a latent feature is drawn i.i.d., the response is generated through a logistic model, and the learner chooses how much to pay before observing a noisy version of the feature. The goal of learner is to jointly control prediction loss and acquisition cost. In contrast to the former result on the online linear regression with paid features, covariance information alone is no longer sufficient: two noise distributions with the same covariance may induce different optimal logistic losses, and lower variance can even lead to higher loss. Under a structural ordering in which larger payments yield better observations by removing independent noise, we obtain $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T})$ regret when the noise structure is known and $\widetilde O(T^{2/3})$ regret when it is unknown, with matching lower bounds up to logarithmic factors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究带付费随机特征的在线二分类预测：每轮先决定花多少资源购买更精确的特征观测，再联合控制预测损失与获取成本。结论是二阶（协方差）信息在 logistic 模型下不再充分——两个协方差相同但噪声分布不同的观测可能给出不同的最优 logistic 损失，甚至方差更小反而损失更高；在「更大付费去除独立噪声」的结构序下，噪声结构已知时可得 Õ(√T) 遗憾，未知时为 Õ(T^{2/3})，两者在对数因子内匹配下界。
Motivation: 付费特征的既有结果基于在线线性回归，协方差信息足以刻画最优策略；但 logistic 损失非线性，协方差相同、噪声分布不同的观测会诱导不同的最优损失，甚至出现低方差高损失的反直觉情形，线性情形的分析工具直接失效。
Method: 设定为每轮潜变量 i.i.d. 抽样、响应由 logistic 模型生成、学习者在观测含噪特征前选择付费额度；在「更大付费去除独立噪声」的结构序下分析该设定，分别处理噪声结构已知与未知两种情形。
Result: 噪声结构已知时获得 Õ(√T) 遗憾，未知时获得 Õ(T^{2/3}) 遗憾，且两者在对数因子内与匹配的下界一致；同时证明协方差信息单独不足以决定最优 logistic 损失。
Conclusion: 在 logistic 付费特征问题中，仅靠二阶信息不足以设计最优付费策略，需要噪声结构本身；已知结构时可达到 √T 级遗憾，未知结构时 T^{2/3} 是紧的。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AI-Mediation in Retail Markets: Revenue Effects and Assortment Optimization
papers.abstract_en: AI shopping assistants increasingly influence which products consumers consider. We study retail assortment planning under AI mediation, where a retailer chooses a catalog, an AI intermediary forms a customer-facing shortlist, and the customer chooses from that shortlist according to a multinomial logit model. We consider both deterministic mediation, in which the AI follows a fixed segment-specific ranking, and stochastic mediation based on the Plackett-Luce model. Empirically, we construct a dataset of product rankings from leading AI models, estimate Plackett-Luce ranking models, and evaluate their predictive performance on held-out assortments. Combining these estimates with synthetic customer preferences, we find that accounting for AI mediation can materially change optimal assortments and revenue. Across the tested capacity configurations, ignoring mediation yields mean revenue losses between 2.52% and 11.37% relative to the PL optimum. A much simpler deterministic plug-in, based only on the ordering of fitted AI utilities, performs substantially better, with mean losses of at most 0.53%. Motivated by this performance, we study assortment optimization under deterministic mediation. We characterize its computational complexity and show that, for any fixed number of customer segments, the problem admits a fully polynomial-time approximation scheme.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 零售品类规划中引入 AI 中介（AI 先生成顾客短名单，顾客再按 MNL 从短名单选择）会实质改变最优品类与收入：忽略中介、按无中介最优解下单，平均收入损失 2.52%–11.37%。仅用拟合 AI 效用排序的确定性 plug-in 即可把平均损失压到至多 0.53%，因此作者转而研究确定性中介下的品类优化。
Motivation: AI 购物助手已决定顾客看到哪些商品，但传统品类规划假设顾客直接面对全目录；忽略这一中介环节会系统性错配目录并损失收入。
Method: 构建领先 AI 模型的商品排序数据集，估计 Plackett-Luce 排序模型并在留出品类上检验预测表现；将估计与合成顾客偏好结合，比较确定性中介（分群固定排序）与随机中介（Plackett-Luce）下的品类优化，并分析确定性中介问题的计算复杂度。
Result: 在测试的各容量配置下，忽略中介相对 PL 最优解的平均收入损失为 2.52%–11.37%；基于拟合 AI 效用排序的确定性 plug-in 平均损失至多 0.53%。
Conclusion: AI 中介必须进入品类优化目标，而确定性 plug-in 已足够接近最优；对任意固定顾客分群数，确定性中介下的品类优化存在完全多项式时间近似方案 (FPTAS)。

papers.title: DeFiRank: Federated Pairwise Ranking for Governance in Decentralized Financial Networks
papers.abstract_en: Existing governance approaches in decentralized financial networks rely on manual review processes conducted by human committees, which introduces subjective bias, creates a scalability bottleneck under high network volume, and fails to capture complex behavioural patterns and evolving network dynamics. To address these limitations, we propose \name, a federated learning-based pairwise ranking framework in which multiple institutions collaboratively train a ranking model without sharing their private transaction data. This collaborative learning enables the model to capture network-wide behavioural patterns that signify strong network participation and directly contribute to the network effect, including diversity of counterparties, usage of multiple applications, and frequency of transactions. The proposed system ranks providers based on the authenticity of their actions, promoting genuine contributors and demoting those exhibiting suspicious behaviour. We evaluate \name\ on a real-world blockchain transaction dataset. Results demonstrate that the federated approach achieves ranking performance modestly below the centralized baseline (NDCG@15: $\approx$0.87 vs.\ $\approx$0.92) while preserving data privacy and matching its ranking stability (Kendall $τ$: $\approx$0.70 for both regimes), producing reliable governance decisions, including provider promotion and demotion (648 and 39 unique providers, respectively), without requiring centralized access to sensitive transaction data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeFiRank 用联邦学习 (federated learning) 训练成对排序模型，让多家机构在不共享私有交易数据的前提下协作评估去中心化金融网络中的治理对象。在真实区块链交易数据集上，其 NDCG@15 约 0.87，略低于集中式基线的约 0.92，但排序稳定性持平（Kendall τ 约 0.70），并产出 648 个晋升、39 个降级的治理决策。
Motivation: 去中心化金融网络的治理依赖人工委员会审查，主观偏差大、在网络交易量高时形成扩展性瓶颈，也难以捕捉复杂行为模式与演化中的网络动态。
Method: 提出 DeFiRank：联邦成对排序 (federated pairwise ranking) 框架，多机构在不共享私有交易数据的情况下协作训练排序模型，学习能表征网络参与度与网络效应的行为特征，包括交易对手多样性、多应用使用和交易频率，按行为真实性对 provider 排序。
Result: 在真实世界区块链交易数据集上，联邦方法 NDCG@15 约 0.87，略低于集中式基线的约 0.92；Kendall τ 约 0.70，与集中式持平；产出 648 个晋升与 39 个降级的 provider 治理决策，全程无需集中访问敏感交易数据。
Conclusion: 联邦排序可以在保留数据隐私、无需集中访问敏感交易数据的条件下，达到接近集中式基线的排序质量与相同的排序稳定性，从而支撑可靠的治理决策。

papers.title: Controlled-Minimax: Stabilizing Adversarial Optimization via Control Theory
papers.abstract_en: Minimax optimization is fundamental to adversarial learning yet suffers from severe stability challenges, often manifesting as persistent limit cycles or divergence. This paper investigates these instabilities through the lens of continuous-time dynamical systems. By modeling training dynamics as a second-order Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE), we rigorously identify the root cause of non-convergence: the problematic eigenstructure of the loss function's Hessian near equilibrium points. To address this, we introduce Controlled-Minimax, a novel stabilization framework that reformulates the optimization trajectory as a controllable physical system. Unlike heuristic regularization techniques, our approach derives a specific feedback controller that provides theoretical guarantees of local exponential stability, regardless of the underlying Hessian spectrum. Consequently, our method stabilizes general minimax problems where traditional gradient descent-ascent methods fail. Extensive experiments on pathological benchmarks including the Dirac-GAN, 2D Gaussian mixtures, and Swiss Roll datasets, as well as high-resolution image synthesis with StyleGAN2-ada, demonstrate that Controlled-Minimax effectively suppresses oscillatory behavior while ensuring fast and robust convergence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 minimax 训练动力学建模为二阶 ODE，指出不收敛的根源是平衡点附近损失 Hessian 的病态特征结构，并据此设计一个反馈控制器，使优化轨迹成为可控物理系统。该控制器给出局部指数稳定的理论保证，且不依赖 Hessian 谱的具体形态，从而在传统梯度下降-上升法失效的一般 minimax 问题上抑制振荡、实现快速收敛。
Motivation: 对抗学习中的 minimax 优化常出现持续极限环或发散，作者把这一不稳定归因于平衡点附近 Hessian 的病态特征结构，而启发式正则方法无法给出稳定性保证。
Method: 将训练动力学建模为二阶 ODE，从连续时间动力系统视角定位不收敛的根因；再把优化轨迹重构为可控物理系统，推导出一个具体反馈控制器，理论上保证局部指数稳定，且不依赖底层 Hessian 谱。
Result: 在病态基准 Dirac-GAN、2D Gaussian mixtures、Swiss Roll 上，以及 StyleGAN2-ada 高分辨率图像合成上，实验显示 Controlled-Minimax 有效抑制振荡行为，同时保证快速且鲁棒的收敛；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 作者主张：以反馈控制而非启发式正则来稳定 minimax 优化，可以在 Hessian 谱任意的情况下获得局部指数稳定，从而在梯度下降-上升法失败的一般 minimax 问题上实现收敛。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: OGPO: Offline Goal-conditioned Policy Optimization for Recoverable Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong promise in robotic manipulation, yet their post-training still predominantly relies on trajectory-level supervised imitation over robot demonstrations. While effective for learning feasible actions, this paradigm supervises policies to reproduce expert actions at each step, biasing them toward demonstration-specific action paths and providing limited guidance for recovering toward task-progress states once execution deviates from demonstrated trajectories. To address this limitation, we propose OGPO, an Offline Goal-conditioned Policy Optimization framework for recoverable VLA post-training. Instead of treating offline demonstrations merely as step-wise action labels, OGPO adaptively relabels trajectories with semantic key states and constructs goal-conditioned process rewards to optimize the policy for reaching these task-progress states. In this way, OGPO shifts VLA post-training from trajectory-level action imitation to key-state reachability learning, enabling policies to acquire a more robust ability to complete goal states from feasible off-demonstration states without requiring additional online interaction. Experiments on LIBERO and MetaWorld show that OGPO consistently improves VLA policy performance over standard supervised fine-tuning. Moreover, evaluations on LIBERO-Plus and our proposed LIBERO-ReAct, a mid-execution perturbation benchmark, further demonstrate that OGPO achieves stronger robustness and goal-directed recoverability under distribution shifts and recoverable off-demonstration states.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OGPO 把 VLA 后训练从逐步动作模仿改成关键状态可达性学习：自适应重标注轨迹得到语义关键状态，构造目标条件过程奖励来优化策略回到任务进度状态，无需额外在线交互。在 LIBERO 与 MetaWorld 上一致优于标准监督微调，并在 LIBERO-Plus 与新提出的中段扰动基准 LIBERO-ReAct 上表现出更强的分布偏移鲁棒性与目标导向恢复能力。
Motivation: VLA 后训练仍以轨迹级监督模仿为主，逐步复现专家动作使策略偏向演示特定路径，执行偏离后缺少回到任务进度状态的引导。
Method: OGPO（Offline Goal-conditioned Policy Optimization）不把离线演示当作逐步动作标签，而是自适应地用语义关键状态重标注轨迹，构造 goal-conditioned process reward 来优化策略到达这些任务进度状态，把后训练从动作模仿转为 key-state reachability learning，全程不需要额外在线交互。
Result: 在 LIBERO 与 MetaWorld 上，OGPO 一致提升 VLA 策略性能，优于标准监督微调 (supervised fine-tuning)；在 LIBERO-Plus 与作者提出的中段扰动基准 LIBERO-ReAct 上，策略在分布偏移与可恢复的偏离演示状态下表现出更强的鲁棒性与目标导向恢复能力。
Conclusion: 把离线演示重标注为关键状态并用目标条件过程奖励优化，可让 VLA 策略在不加在线交互的前提下获得从偏离状态恢复到目标状态的能力。

papers.title: BLEND: Balancing Personalization vs. Generalization in Federated Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Federated vision-language models (FedVLMs) represent one of the emerging frontiers of machine learning, aiming to integrate federated learning within the fine-tuning pipelines of vision-language models (VLMs). In this work, we introduce BLEND, a new framework designed to jointly enhance the personalization and generalization capabilities of FedVLMs. BLEND proposes a selective VLM parameter fine-tuning and aggregation strategy that consists of (i) global vision and text adapters shared across clients, and (ii) a personalized vision projection adapter tailored to each client. BLEND further introduces a novel loss function that blends the outputs of the global and personalized adapters to achieve personalization, while simultaneously promoting generalization through a principled anchor design implemented via the projection heads of the zero-shot VLM. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BLEND consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, highlighting its ability to effectively balance personalization and generalization across diverse system settings. (Code is available at: https://github.com/payamsiabd/BLEND.git)
papers.comment: Accepted in Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BLEND 把联邦视觉-语言模型 (FedVLM) 的微调参数拆成全局共享的 vision/text adapter 与每客户端私有的 vision projection adapter，用混合两类 adapter 输出的损失函数做个性化，并借零样本 VLM 的 projection head 设计 anchor 来同时保住泛化。在多种系统设置下其表现一致优于现有最先进基线。
Motivation: 联邦学习接入 VLM 微调流水线时，个性化与泛化往往互相拉扯：客户端各自适配会损害全局泛化，统一聚合又丢失本地特性。
Method: 选择性参数微调与聚合策略：全局 vision/text adapter 跨客户端共享，个性化 vision projection adapter 按客户端独立；新损失函数混合全局与个性化 adapter 的输出实现个性化，同时通过零样本 VLM projection head 构造 anchor 促进泛化。
Result: 在多样系统设置下的广泛实验中，BLEND 一致优于 state-of-the-art 基线，同时体现个性化与泛化能力的平衡；代码已开源。
Conclusion: 把共享 adapter 与个性化 adapter 分工、并用零样本投影头做 anchor，可以在 FedVLM 中同时提升个性化与泛化，而不必二选一。

papers.title: GIST: Generator-state-Informed Supervision for Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) based on prior-data fitted networks typically use sampled hard query labels, leaving avoidable sampling variability in pretraining. A key observation is that intermediate generator states can reveal label uncertainty beyond a sampled outcome. We propose Generator-state-Informed Supervision for TFMs (GIST), which uses these states to average query losses over conditional label distributions. GIST jointly designs task generation and query supervision, using entropy-calibrated encodings to obtain tractable, input-consistent targets on supported label-dependent branches. We show that this averaging preserves the population objective and yields no larger gradient covariance at fixed parameters within each generating distribution. Under matched pretraining schedules, GIST improves mean rank across three architectures on both TabArena and TALENT without changing architecture or inference. Across these benchmarks and architectures, GIST wins 62.1% of paired dataset-level comparisons against the corresponding hard-label controls.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GIST 用生成器中间状态估计标签条件分布，把表格基础模型 (TFM) 预训练中的硬采样 query 标签换成对条件标签分布的损失平均，并用熵校准编码保证目标可解且输入一致。理论上该平均保持总体目标且在固定参数下梯度协方差不增大；在 TabArena 与 TALENT 三个架构上，GIST 在 62.1% 的配对数据集级比较中胜过硬标签对照。
Motivation: 基于 prior-data fitted network 的表格基础模型预训练用采样得到的硬 query 标签，带来可避免的采样变异性，而生成器中间状态本可揭示超出单次采样结果的标签不确定性。
Method: GIST 联合设计任务生成与 query 监督：从生成器中间状态得到条件标签分布，对 query 损失在该分布上取平均；用熵校准编码 (entropy-calibrated encodings) 在受支持的标签依赖分支上构造可解且输入一致的目标。预训练日程、架构与推理均保持不变。
Result: 理论上，损失平均保持总体目标，且在每个生成分布内固定参数下梯度协方差不大于硬标签。在匹配的预训练日程下，GIST 在 TabArena 与 TALENT 上跨三个架构提升平均排名，并在这些基准与架构上于 62.1% 的配对数据集级比较中胜过对应的硬标签对照。
Conclusion: 把生成器状态当作标签不确定性来源来平均监督信号，可以在不改架构与推理的前提下降低表格基础模型预训练的采样噪声并提升跨基准表现。

papers.title: JMT-YOLO: Multi-task Domain Adaptation via Segmentation-Guided Consistency Learning
papers.abstract_en: Domain adaptive object detection (DAOD) aims to reduce performance degradation due to distribution shifts between training (source) and testing (target) datasets. However, owing to insufficient modeling of fine-grained features and limited instance-level alignment, existing approaches become less effective under complex environmental conditions, such as extreme weather conditions and object occlusion. We overcome these challenges by proposing JMT-YOLO, a novel joint multi-task learning framework for DAOD. JMT-YOLO is based on the Mean Teacher architecture. It introduces an auxiliary semantic segmentation task and a masking mechanism to enhance the modeling of foreground-background semantic boundaries in the target domain. Specifically, fine-grained feature degradation is reduced by introducing a multiscale context-aware segmentation head equipped with a dense connection structure to effectively capture local and global contextual features. A mask-consistency loss is formulated by applying random masking operations to target images, thereby guiding the network to learn structural context and improving instance-level feature alignment. Extensive experiments on three benchmark domain adaptation tasks (Pascal VOC to Clipart1k, Cityscapes to Foggy Cityscapes, and KITTI to Cityscapes) demonstrate that JMT-YOLO achieves detection performances of 46.9%, 57.3%, and 61.0%, respectively. These results demonstrate superior performance over existing state-of-the-art and baseline methods, thereby validating the effectiveness and generalization of JMT-YOLO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JMT-YOLO 是面向域自适应目标检测 (DAOD) 的联合多任务框架：以 Mean Teacher 为骨架，加入多尺度上下文感知分割头与随机掩码驱动的 mask-consistency loss，抑制目标域细粒度特征退化并做实例级对齐。在 Pascal VOC→Clipart1k、Cityscapes→Foggy Cityscapes、KITTI→Cityscapes 三个迁移任务上分别取得 46.9%、57.3%、61.0% 的检测性能，优于现有 SOTA 与基线方法。
Motivation: 源域与目标域分布偏移导致检测性能下降，而现有 DAOD 方法对细粒度特征建模不足、实例级对齐有限，在极端天气与遮挡等复杂条件下尤其失效。
Method: 基于 Mean Teacher 架构的联合多任务学习：附加语义分割任务，用带 dense connection 的多尺度上下文感知分割头建模前景-背景语义边界；对目标域图像施加随机掩码构造 mask-consistency loss，引导网络学习结构上下文以增强实例级特征对齐。
Result: 在三个域自适应检测基准上取得 46.9%（Pascal VOC→Clipart1k）、57.3%（Cityscapes→Foggy Cityscapes）、61.0%（KITTI→Cityscapes）的检测性能，优于现有 state-of-the-art 与基线方法。
Conclusion: 把分割任务与掩码一致性约束联合进 Mean Teacher，可同时改善细粒度建模与实例级对齐，从而在跨域检测上取得更优且更泛化的性能。

papers.title: A Lightweight Velocity Correction Framework for Improving Instruction Following in Few-Step Text-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Few-step text-to-image generators produce high-quality images with few network forward passes, yet struggle with complex prompts involving multiple subjects, interactions, spatial relations, counting, and attribute binding. Can these errors be reduced without changing the generator's parameters or increasing its forward-pass count? We propose a lightweight correction framework for a frozen 6B-parameter generator. The generator predicts velocities that determine how its intermediate image representation is updated; a corrector with fewer than 20M parameters learns residual adjustments at selected sampling steps. Because earlier corrections change the states encountered at later steps, our On-Trajectory Flow-Bridge Supervision derives residual targets at the states actually reached during corrected generation. A single corrector is shared across selected steps and runs in parallel with the generator. Only the corrector is trained, requiring neither reward optimization nor re-distillation. To our knowledge, this is the first framework for lightweight velocity-residual adaptation of fully frozen few-step text-to-image generators that preserves their original sampling schedule and forward-pass count. On our target complex-scene distribution, the framework achieves a +17.60-percentage-point NetWin over frozen Z-Image-Turbo in pairwise instruction-following evaluation, with only 26.9 ms (0.84%) additional end-to-end latency per image and no increase in backbone evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对冻结的 6B 少步文生图模型 Z-Image-Turbo，用不到 20M 参数的 corrector 在选定采样步上学习速度残差 (velocity residual)，在不改生成器参数、不增前向次数的前提下修正多主体、空间关系、计数与属性绑定类复杂指令错误。在目标复杂场景分布的成对指令遵循评测中，相对冻结基线取得 +17.60 个百分点 NetWin，每图端到端延迟仅增 26.9 ms（0.84%），骨干评估次数不增。
Motivation: 少步文生图生成器在涉及多主体、交互、空间关系、计数和属性绑定的复杂提示上容易出错，而改生成器参数或增加前向次数的常规做法会牺牲少步推理的速度优势。
Method: 提出面向完全冻结生成器的轻量速度残差校正框架：corrector（参数量 <20M）在选定采样步上输出残差调整，与生成器并行运行且共享于各选定步；用 On-Trajectory Flow-Bridge Supervision 在校正后实际到达的状态上推导残差目标，以处理先前校正改变后续状态的问题。只训练 corrector，不需要 reward optimization 或重新蒸馏 (re-distillation)，保留原采样调度与前向次数。
Result: 在目标复杂场景分布的成对指令遵循评测 (pairwise instruction-following evaluation) 中，相对冻结 Z-Image-Turbo 取得 +17.60 个百分点 NetWin；每图端到端延迟仅增加 26.9 ms（占 0.84%），骨干网络评估次数 (backbone evaluations) 不增加。
Conclusion: 作者称这是首个在保留原采样调度与前向次数的同时、对完全冻结少步文生图生成器做轻量速度残差适配的框架，说明复杂提示的指令遵循错误可在不动生成器的前提下用小校正器修正。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rethinking the Roles of Diffusion and Decoding: Predictive-State Flows for Parallel Language Generation
papers.abstract_en: In continuous diffusion language models (DLMs), latents generated by the diffusion prior are mapped almost deterministically to tokens, either by a decoder or through a token embedding matrix. Unlike in image generation, where visual details can vary continuously, the diffusion prior must capture fine-grained discrete token choices in continuous space, which can make the joint latent distribution difficult to model. We argue that generative roles should instead be divided: the diffusion prior should generate high-level predictive information, while the decoder should resolve the remaining token-level choices. Based on this view, we introduce Predictive-State Flows (PSF), which partitions a sequence into blocks and associates each block with a predictive state computed solely from the preceding context. A rectified-flow prior generates the sequence of predictive states, after which a block-causal decoder generates all blocks in parallel, autoregressively only within each block. This design reduces diffusion from L token-level states to K << L predictive states and reduces token-level sequential depth to L/K. On unconditional OpenWebText generation, a 197M-parameter model with K=8 achieves a generative perplexity of 22.8 at entropy 5.16 using 0.31 TFLOPs per 1024-token document, versus 24.0 and 7.2 TFLOPs for ELF-B with 32 sampling steps. The corresponding measured operating points yield MAUVE@512 of 0.93 and 0.73, respectively. Controlled comparisons further show that content states, which additionally encode their own blocks, yield 8-16% higher generative perplexity than predictive states, and that replacing sampled predictive-state trajectories with a shared mean lowers MAUVE@512 by 0.11. These results suggest that latent design for continuous DLMs should consider not only how compactly text is represented, but also how generative roles are divided between the prior and the decoder.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Predictive-State Flows (PSF)：把序列切成块，每块只由前文算出一个 predictive state，rectified-flow prior 只生成 K 个状态，block-causal decoder 再并行解出全部块、块内自回归，把扩散从 L 个 token 级状态压到 K 个、序列深度降到 L/K。在 OpenWebText 上 197M、K=8 模型生成困惑度 22.8（熵 5.16），每 1024-token 文档仅 0.31 TFLOPs，对比 ELF-B 的 24.0 与 7.2 TFLOPs。
Motivation: 连续扩散语言模型里 diffusion prior 几乎确定性地把 latent 映射到 token，迫使连续空间承载细粒度离散选择，联合 latent 分布难建模；同时 token 级顺序解码深度高。
Method: PSF 把生成角色分工：prior 只生成高层 predictive state，decoder 解剩余 token 选择。序列分块，每块的 predictive state 仅由前文计算；rectified-flow prior 生成状态序列，block-causal decoder 并行生成所有块、仅块内自回归，扩散规模由 L 降到 K（K << L），顺序深度降到 L/K。
Result: OpenWebText 无条件生成上，197M 参数、K=8 模型生成困惑度 22.8（熵 5.16），耗 0.31 TFLOPs/1024-token 文档；ELF-B（32 采样步）为困惑度 24.0、7.2 TFLOPs，两者对应工作点 MAUVE@512 分别为 0.93 与 0.73。对照实验中，额外编码自身块的 content states 比 predictive states 的生成困惑度高 8–16%；把采样状态轨迹换成共享均值使 MAUVE@512 下降 0.11。
Conclusion: 连续 DLM 的 latent 设计既要考虑文本表示的紧凑程度，也要考虑 prior 与 decoder 之间的生成角色分工；只用 predictive state 而非 content state、并让 prior 采样状态轨迹，才能同时压低困惑度与算力。

papers.title: AD-SRF: Attack-Defense Semantic Reinforcement for Multi-Modal Image Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Existing image fusion methods struggle to balance visual quality and semantic attributes due to the inherent conflict between their optimization objectives. To address this challenge, we propose an attack-defense semantic reinforcement framework for multi-modal image fusion, termed AD-SRF. By decoupling the optimization of these two aspects and then losslessly reintegrating them, this framework injects rich semantic attributes into the fused image without compromising its visual quality. First, we develop a transformer-based restorative visual fusion network as a strong visual baseline. Equipped with the cross-modal retrieval module and the information restoration-fusion collaborative loss, it produces highly visible fused images even under degraded conditions. Second, we introduce an attack-defense game mechanism to strengthen the semantic attributes of the fused images. The attacker learns perturbation patterns that impair downstream segmentation, whereas the defender restores missing semantics from the original inputs and reintegrates them into the fused image through an imperceptible semantic map. Through iterative adversarial interaction, this mechanism drives the defender to continually strengthen the fused image's semantic attributes, boosting downstream segmentation performance without compromising visual quality. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AD-SRF achieves a win-win performance in both visual quality and semantic attributes. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/HaoZhang1018/AD-SRF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AD-SRF 把多模态图像融合中视觉质量与语义属性的冲突目标解耦后再无损重整合：先用基于 Transformer 的修复式视觉融合网络建立视觉基线，再用攻击-防御对抗博弈强化语义。攻击者学习破坏下游分割的扰动模式，防御者从原始输入恢复缺失语义并以不可感知语义图重新注入，使融合图像在不牺牲视觉质量的前提下提升下游分割性能。
Motivation: 现有图像融合方法的视觉质量与语义属性优化目标存在内在冲突，难以兼顾两者。
Method: 两阶段框架：一是基于 Transformer 的修复式视觉融合网络，配备跨模态检索模块与信息修复-融合协同损失，在退化条件下仍产出高可见度融合图像；二是攻击-防御博弈机制，攻击者学习损害下游分割的扰动模式，防御者从原始输入恢复语义并通过不可感知语义图重新注入，经迭代对抗强化语义属性。
Result: 大量实验显示 AD-SRF 在视觉质量与语义属性上同时取得 win-win 表现，并提升下游分割性能；代码已公开于 GitHub 仓库 HaoZhang1018/AD-SRF。
Conclusion: 把视觉与语义目标解耦后用对抗博弈重整合，可在不牺牲融合图像视觉质量的前提下增强其语义属性与下游分割表现。

papers.title: MeshBind: Point-to-Mesh Binding for Non-Rigid Scene Flow Automatic Annotation
papers.abstract_en: Scene flow estimation is essential for many autonomous driving (AD) and robotic applications, but obtaining ground-truth scene flow for non-rigid objects such as pedestrians is highly difficult. We present MeshBind, an automatic annotation method that uses mesh models to generate per-point scene flow for non-rigid objects. The novelty of this work is threefold: 1) developing a multi-view module that reconstructs an articulated mesh model from six surround cameras and registers it to the LiDAR frame; 2) developing a local-frame binding technique that attaches each point to the mesh via a per-triangle tangent-normal frame, invariant under rigid motion yet adaptive to articulated deformation; 3) developing a three-layer flow registration pipeline that combines ego-vehicle motion compensation, box binding, and mesh binding to produce full-scene per-point flow. We implement MeshBind in SF-Studio, an interactive annotation tool that visualises flow and allows human mesh corrections with automatic recomputation. We also release SFB (SUScape-Flow Benchmark), a large-scale benchmark built on the public SUScape dataset, covering 41k frames with per-point non-rigid pedestrian annotations and a Rigid/Semi-Rigid/Non-Rigid evaluation protocol. Experiments show that fine-tuning on SFB reduces three-way endpoint error (EPE) by 2-3x, and brings non-rigid EPE to the same level as rigid EPE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MeshBind 用六路环视相机重建可变形行人 mesh 并配准到 LiDAR 坐标系，通过逐三角形切线-法线局部坐标系把每个点绑定到 mesh，再叠加自车运动补偿、box 绑定与 mesh 绑定三层流程，自动生成非刚体场景流标注。基于 SUScape 构建的 SFB 基准含 41k 帧逐点行人标注，在其上微调使三方向端点误差 (EPE) 降低 2–3 倍，非刚体 EPE 降到与刚体 EPE 同一水平。
Motivation: 自动驾驶与机器人需要场景流，但行人这类非刚体目标缺少逐点真值场景流，标注成本极高，制约了相关模型的训练。
Method: 三个组件：多视模块从六个环视相机重建 articulated mesh 并配准到 LiDAR 坐标系；local-frame binding 用逐三角形 tangent-normal 坐标系把点绑定到 mesh，该坐标系对刚体运动不变、随关节变形自适应；三层 flow registration 串联自车运动补偿、box binding 与 mesh binding 得到全场景逐点流。实现为交互式标注工具 SF-Studio，支持可视化与人工 mesh 修正后自动重算。
Result: 发布 SFB (SUScape-Flow Benchmark)，基于公开 SUScape 数据集，覆盖 41k 帧逐点非刚体行人标注，并给出 Rigid/Semi-Rigid/Non-Rigid 三分类评测协议。在 SFB 上微调使三方向端点误差 (EPE) 降低 2–3 倍，非刚体 EPE 与刚体 EPE 达到同一水平。
Conclusion: 把点绑定到 articulated mesh 的局部坐标系可以自动生成非刚体逐点场景流真值，且这类标注训练出的模型能把非刚体误差压到刚体水平。

papers.title: Generalized Determinantal Point Processes for Attraction and Repulsion with Distinct Interaction Kernels
papers.abstract_en: Determinantal point processes (DPPs) model subset selection probability with repulsion, but many applications also exhibit attraction arising from pairwise relations or shared latent structures. Nonsymmetric DPPs (NDPPs) capture both effects, but their kernels are difficult to interpret and specify. We propose the determinant-ratio point process (DRPP), which models repulsion and attraction via a ratio of the determinants of two symmetric positive-definite kernels. This formulation preserves the feature-based interpretation of standard DPPs while allowing the two effects to be specified separately. Furthermore, we introduce an auxiliary-variable representation that enables efficient MCMC sampling and yields tractable expectation formulas for key statistics including the normalizing constant, which together facilitate maximum-likelihood learning. We theoretically characterize the interaction structures well suited to DRPPs: for clustered attraction with $C$ latent groups, DRPPs exactly realize the target pairwise interactions with an attraction rank $C$, whereas NDPPs can require a rank that grows with the number of items given the same repulsion component. Conversely, nontransitive pair-specific attraction may require compensation through the DRPP repulsion kernel. Experiments support these predictions, showing that DRPPs fit transitive attraction with substantially fewer parameters than NDPPs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出行列式比点过程 (DRPP)，用两个对称正定核的行列式之比同时表达排斥与吸引，保留标准 DPP 的特征可解释性并允许两类效应分开指定。对含 C 个隐类的簇状吸引，DRPP 以吸引秩 C 精确实现目标成对交互，而 NDPP 在相同排斥核下所需秩随物品数增长；实验显示 DRPP 拟合传递性吸引所需参数远少于 NDPP。
Motivation: DPP 只能建模排斥，非对称 DPP (NDPP) 虽能同时表达吸引与排斥，但其核难以解释和设定，且刻画簇状吸引时秩随物品数增长。
Method: DRPP 以两个对称正定核的行列式之比建模；引入辅助变量表示以支持高效 MCMC 采样，并给出归一化常数等关键统计量的可解期望公式，从而支持最大似然学习；理论上刻画适合 DRPP 的交互结构。
Result: 对含 C 个隐类的簇状吸引，DRPP 以吸引秩 C 精确实现目标成对交互，NDPP 在相同排斥核下所需秩随物品数增长；非传递的成对吸引可能需由 DRPP 排斥核补偿；实验中 DRPP 拟合传递性吸引所用参数显著少于 NDPP。
Conclusion: 行列式之比是表达吸引与排斥的可解释且参数高效的构造，适用于传递性（簇状）吸引；非传递成对吸引则需靠排斥核补偿。

papers.title: Win-Win Fusion: Multi-Modal Image Fusion with Visual-Semantic Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Existing multi-modal image fusion (MMIF) methods generally face an optimization gap between the visual and semantic domains, limiting the enhancement of perception capabilities. To overcome this long-standing barrier, this work proposes W2F, a new visual-semantic mutual reinforcing paradigm for MMIF. First, we reinforce the foundation for visual-semantic collaboration by amplifying feature complementarity through two targeted designs. Specifically, the segmentation-guided fusion loss introduces object-aware structural guidance into visual fusion, while the embedded information restoration prior strengthens the ability of visual fusion to provide reliable perceptual evidence for the semantic branch under degraded conditions. Then, we introduce a strong multi-modal information interaction mechanism composed of interactive gated mixed attention (IGM-Att) and progressive coupling attention (PC-Att). These modules ensure comprehensive scene representation from both local and global perspectives, providing informational support for visual-semantic collaboration. Finally, we construct a collaborative mechanism to couple visual fusion and semantic fusion. It employs a feature search module to extract complementary key features from both tasks, enriching the representational potential of visual and semantic information. Meanwhile, a gradient correction strategy ensures collaboration from the optimization perspective, enhancing performance for both visual and semantic fusion through consistency learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that W2F surpasses state-of-the-art methods in both visual appeal and decision accuracy. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/HaoZhang1018/W2F.

papers.title: Personalized Federated Direct Preference Optimization via LoRA Adapters
papers.abstract_en: Federated Direct Preference Optimization (FedDPO) enables privacy-preserving alignment of language models across distributed agents without centralizing sensitive preference data. However, existing FedDPO analysis assumes all clients converge to a single shared policy, which is fundamentally at odds with the heterogeneous preference distributions present in practice. We propose Personalized FedDPO (pFedDPO), in which each client maintains a small private LoRA adapter atop a shared global base model. In pFedDPO, the base model is synchronized via FedAvg each round, while LoRA adapters remain local and capture client-specific preference patterns. We prove that this decomposition replaces the gradient diversity $κ^2$ in the FedDPO bound with a residual heterogeneity $κ^2_{\mathrm{eff}}$, which is no larger than $κ^2$ when adapters absorb client-specific directions, at the cost of an additive adapter-bias term that vanishes as adapters converge. Experiments on preference datasets show that pFedDPO consistently attains a lower gradient norm than vanilla FedDPO while remaining competitive in training loss and per-client reward accuracy.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出个性化联邦直接偏好优化 (pFedDPO)：全局底座模型按 FedAvg 同步，各客户端保留私有 LoRA adapter 吸收本地偏好差异。理论上把 FedDPO 界中的梯度多样性 κ² 替换为不大于它的有效异质性 κ²_eff，代价是随 adapter 收敛而消失的 adapter-bias 加性项；实验中梯度范数持续低于 vanilla FedDPO，训练损失与逐客户端 reward accuracy 保持竞争力。
Motivation: 现有 FedDPO 分析假设所有客户端收敛到同一共享策略，与实践中客户端偏好分布异质的现实冲突。
Method: 每个客户端在共享全局底座模型之上维护小型私有 LoRA adapter；底座每轮用 FedAvg 同步，adapter 保持本地以捕捉客户端特有偏好模式。理论上证明该分解将 FedDPO 界中的梯度多样性 κ² 替换为有效异质性 κ²_eff。
Result: 在偏好数据集实验中，pFedDPO 的梯度范数持续低于 vanilla FedDPO，同时训练损失和逐客户端 reward accuracy 保持竞争力；理论结果给出 κ²_eff 不大于 κ²，且 adapter-bias 加性项随 adapter 收敛而消失。
Conclusion: 把客户端异质性隔离进本地 LoRA adapter、只同步底座模型，可以在不牺牲对齐质量的前提下收紧 FedDPO 的收敛界。

papers.title: CoGameReg: Cooperative-Game-Based Collaborative Semi-Supervised Regression for Seismic Reservoir Property Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate estimation of reservoir properties from seismic data remains challenging when well-log labels are sparse but three-dimensional seismic observations are abundant. We present CoGameReg, a cooperative-game-based semi-supervised regression framework that uses contribution-weighted predictions of heterogeneous regressors to construct shared pseudo-labels. This design makes each regressor's influence explicit in the learning targets generated for unlabeled seismic samples under sparse well control. The Tri-Game Shapley mechanism combines a rank-MSE performance game with a pairwise consistency game to estimate nonnegative regressor weights from labeled training data. These weights remain fixed during collaborative training and are reused for final prediction fusion. Candidate pseudo-labels are screened using a common local k-nearest-neighbor error-reduction criterion before retraining. We evaluate CoGameReg on 10 public regression datasets, a synthetic three-dimensional P-wave velocity prediction task, and a field water-saturation application. The benchmark advantage is most pronounced at the 2.5% labeled-data ratio and decreases as supervision increases. CoGameReg obtains the best blind-well metrics in the synthetic experiment. In the field application, predictions clipped to 0-100% yield a pooled coefficient of determination of 0.5942, a root mean square error of 5.7441 percentage points, and a Pearson correlation of 0.8265 across three blind wells. CoGameReg has the highest Pearson correlation among the four field methods. The results support the use of CoGameReg to integrate sparse well labels with dense seismic attributes, with performance varying across metrics and well locations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoGameReg 用合作博弈把多个异构回归器的贡献加权成共享伪标签，在测井标签稀疏而三维地震观测充足时做半监督储层属性回归。Tri-Game Shapley 机制以 rank-MSE 表现博弈加成对一致性博弈估计非负回归器权重，权重在协同训练中固定并复用于最终融合；在 2.5% 标注比例下基准优势最明显，随监督增加而减弱。
Motivation: 地震储层属性预测中测井标签极稀疏而三维地震观测密集，普通半监督回归无法说明各回归器对伪标签的贡献，稀疏测井控制下学习目标容易被个别弱回归器带偏。
Method: Tri-Game Shapley 机制在有标签训练数据上以 rank-MSE 表现博弈与成对一致性博弈估计非负回归器权重，权重在协同训练期间固定；用贡献加权预测生成无标签地震样本的共享伪标签，再以共同的局部 k 近邻误差下降准则筛选候选伪标签后重训练，最后按权重融合输出。
Result: 在 10 个公开回归数据集、合成三维 P 波速度预测任务与现场含水饱和度应用上评测；基准优势在 2.5% 标注比例处最显著，随标注增加而减小。合成实验中取得最佳盲井指标；现场应用中预测裁剪到 0–100% 后，三口盲井合并的决定系数 0.5942、RMSE 5.7441 个百分点、Pearson 相关 0.8265，且在四种现场方法中 Pearson 相关最高。
Conclusion: 合作博弈加权的共享伪标签能把稀疏测井标签与密集地震属性有效结合，但效果随指标与井位变化，且在低标注比例（2.5%）下收益最大。

papers.title: HART: Hybrid Attention-RWKV Time series Foundation Model
papers.abstract_en: Non-autoregressive multi-step forecasting (NAF) enables time series foundation models to predict an entire future horizon in a single forward pass. Despite its strong sequence modeling capabilities, RWKV-7 exhibits long-horizon degradation in our NAF experiments. In this setup, future patches are represented as missing inputs, requiring the recurrent state to evolve across the prediction horizon without new observations. Our analysis of RWKV-7's generalized delta rule suggests a mechanism we term Placeholder Idling Decay (PID): repeated state transitions can attenuate historical information when placeholder-driven writes provide insufficient compensation. Layer-wise analysis reveals reduced state-injection norms in most layers, while transition-matrix norms remain similar between historical and prediction regions, consistent with PID. Motivated by this analysis, we propose HART, a Hybrid Attention-RWKV Time-series Foundation Model that alternates attention and RWKV blocks, combining direct access to historical tokens with recurrent temporal modeling. Controlled experiments on GIFT-Eval and TIME-Benchmark show that HART improves over pure RWKV at medium and long horizons while maintaining comparable short-horizon performance, and achieves better aggregate performance than a comparably sized pure Transformer. With 36M parameters, HART achieves long-horizon MASE comparable to Toto-2.0-1B on GIFT-Eval (0.752 vs. 0.754), using approximately 1/28 of its parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HART 用注意力块与 RWKV 块交替的混合结构，解决非自回归多步预测 (NAF) 下 RWKV-7 的长时 horizon 退化：占位符写入不足导致重复状态转移衰减历史信息（Placeholder Idling Decay, PID）。在 GIFT-Eval 上 36M 参数的 HART 长时 horizon MASE 达 0.752，与 Toto-2.0-1B 的 0.754 相当，参数量约为其 1/28。
Motivation: NAF 让时序基础模型一次前向预测整个未来区间，但未来 patch 被当作缺失输入，递归状态要在没有新观测的情况下跨预测区间演化，RWKV-7 因此出现长时 horizon 退化。
Method: 先分析 RWKV-7 广义 delta rule，提出 Placeholder Idling Decay 机制并做逐层分析（多数层状态注入范数下降、转移矩阵范数在历史区与预测区相近）；据此提出 HART，交替堆叠注意力块与 RWKV 块，让模型既能直接访问历史 token 又保留递归时序建模。
Result: 在 GIFT-Eval 与 TIME-Benchmark 的受控实验中，HART 在中长时 horizon 上优于纯 RWKV，短时 horizon 性能相当，聚合性能优于同等规模的纯 Transformer；36M 参数下 GIFT-Eval 长时 horizon MASE 为 0.752，Toto-2.0-1B 为 0.754，参数量约为后者的 1/28。
Conclusion: 长时 horizon 退化源于占位符写入不足导致的历史信息衰减，用注意力块补上对历史 token 的直接访问即可在极小参数量下追平十亿级模型的长时 horizon MASE。

papers.title: Mind the Spatial Gap: A Benchmark for Geospatial Reasoning and Constrained Spatial Editing
papers.abstract_en: Understanding and manipulating spatial relations is fundamental to AI systems that reason about physical environments and construct grounded world models. However, existing evaluations of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for spatial reasoning rely predominantly on static question-answering (QA) over small-scale or synthetic scenes, rarely probing whether models can modify spatial configurations while satisfying explicit geometric constraints. We introduce GeoSpatialBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate an escalating progression of spatial cognition, ranging from spatial relation understanding and geometric reasoning to constrained spatial editing. Grounded in real-world urban data across six geographically diverse cities, GeoSpatialBench evaluates a comprehensive taxonomy of 28 topological, directional, metric, and ordering relations across structured GeoJSON and map image modalities, with ground-truth references and constraints verified via GIS operations. Our empirical evaluation across frontier MLLMs uncovers a stark spatial gap: structured GeoJSON consistently outperforms map images, with multimodal combinations offering no reliable gain over GeoJSON alone, and while models show reasonable competence on qualitative topological and ordering, performance drops on quantitative metric relations. Crucially, editing performance on ordering relations declines relative to QA, and most failed edits violate at least one specified spatial constraint. These results highlight a gap between passively recognizing spatial relations and actively manipulating geometric configurations. GeoSpatialBench provides an open, rigorous diagnostic testbed to benchmark these spatial limitations, laying essential empirical groundwork for physically grounded world models and embodied spatial AI.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Under Review at ICLR 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoSpatialBench 用六座真实城市的地理数据，把空间认知按“关系理解→几何推理→受约束空间编辑”递进评测，覆盖 28 类拓扑、方向、度量与顺序关系，同时提供 GeoJSON 与地图图像两种模态。对前沿 MLLM 的实测显示：结构化 GeoJSON 一致优于地图图像，多模态组合相对单用 GeoJSON 无稳定增益；模型在定性拓扑与顺序关系上尚可，度量关系上明显下滑，且编辑任务的顺序关系表现低于 QA，多数失败编辑至少违反一条给定空间约束。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 空间推理评测多为小规模或合成场景上的静态 QA，几乎不检验模型能否在满足显式几何约束的前提下修改空间配置，因而无法刻画“被动识别”与“主动操纵”之间的差距。
Method: 构建 GeoSpatialBench：以六座地理分布多样的真实城市数据为底座，建立涵盖 28 类拓扑、方向、度量、顺序关系的分类体系，覆盖结构化 GeoJSON 与地图图像两种模态，真值参考与约束由 GIS 操作校验；评测按关系理解、几何推理到受约束空间编辑的递进层级组织，对前沿 MLLM 做实证评估。
Result: 实证评测发现：GeoJSON 模态一致优于地图图像，多模态组合相对仅用 GeoJSON 没有可靠增益；模型在定性的拓扑与顺序关系上表现尚可，但在定量度量关系上性能下降；编辑任务中顺序关系的表现相对 QA 下降，且多数失败的编辑至少违反一条指定空间约束。
Conclusion: 前沿 MLLM 在被动识别空间关系与主动操纵几何配置之间存在明显落差，受约束空间编辑是当前短板；GeoSpatialBench 作为开放诊断测试床用于刻画这一局限。

summary_sections.method: 构建 GeoSpatialBench：以六座地理分布多样的真实城市数据为底座，建立涵盖 28 类拓扑、方向、度量、顺序关系的分类体系，覆盖结构化 GeoJSON 与地图图像两种模态，真值参考与约束由 GIS 操作校验；评测按关系理解、几何推理到受约束空间编辑的递进层级组织，对前沿 MLLM 做实证评估。
summary_sections.result: 实证评测发现：GeoJSON 模态一致优于地图图像，多模态组合相对仅用 GeoJSON 没有可靠增益；模型在定性的拓扑与顺序关系上表现尚可，但在定量度量关系上性能下降；编辑任务中顺序关系的表现相对 QA 下降，且多数失败的编辑至少违反一条指定空间约束。
summary_sections.conclusion: 前沿 MLLM 在被动识别空间关系与主动操纵几何配置之间存在明显落差，受约束空间编辑是当前短板；GeoSpatialBench 作为开放诊断测试床用于刻画这一局限。

papers.title: One-Step Text Generation by Seq-Drifting
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language models generate tokens in parallel, but still require multiple sampling steps to produce high-quality text. In this paper, we investigate whether a model can learn to generate an entire sequence in a single forward pass. We propose Seq-Drifting, a framework that applies drifting to sequences of continuous token representations and directly learns a map from Gaussian noise to text. Unlike existing DLMs that derive the supervision at each position directly from the observed token in a training sequence, Seq-Drifting builds a drift field whose position-wise targets adapt to the current generated context. At each position, attraction guides each output toward a set of contextually plausible token representations, while repulsion discourages collapse across samples and repetition within sequences. The generator learns from this drift field during training and produces all tokens jointly in one pass at inference. Empirically, Seq-Drifting achieves a generative perplexity of 36.01 on LM1B in one step and performs competitively in both unconditional and conditional generation. Experiments on translation, summarization, and reasoning further demonstrate the applicability of the framework beyond open-ended generation. These results suggest that drifting over token sequences offers a promising path toward effective one-step text generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/jyliu-ai/Seq-Drifting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Seq-Drifting 把 drifting 用到连续 token 表示序列上，直接学一个从高斯噪声到整段文本的映射，一次前向生成全部 token。其 drift field 的逐位置目标随当前生成上下文自适应：attraction 把输出拉向上下文合理的 token 表示，repulsion 抑制样本间塌缩与序列内重复。单步生成在 LM1B 上取得 36.01 的 generative perplexity。
Motivation: 扩散语言模型 (DLM) 虽并行出 token，仍需多步采样才能得到高质量文本；且现有 DLM 每个位置的监督直接取自训练序列中的观测 token，无法随生成上下文调整。
Method: 对连续 token 表示序列施加 drifting，构造逐位置目标随当前生成上下文自适应的 drift field：attraction 将各输出引向一组上下文合理的 token 表示，repulsion 防止样本间塌缩与序列内重复；生成器在训练中学习该 drift field，推理时一次前向联合产出全部 token。
Result: 在 LM1B 上单步生成取得 generative perplexity 36.01，且在无条件与有条件生成上表现具有竞争力；在翻译、摘要、推理任务上的实验显示该框架适用于开放式生成之外的场景。
Conclusion: 在 token 序列上做 drifting 是实现有效单步文本生成的一条有前景的路径，且可推广到翻译、摘要与推理等任务。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: When Solvers Get Moody: Quantifying and Predicting Performance Variability in Mixed Integer Programming
papers.abstract_en: Mixed-integer programming (MIP) solvers are widely used, yet their performance can vary substantially even under seemingly neutral perturbations. Such variability complicates benchmarking, and the interpretation of computational studies. We introduce the Weighted Variability Score (WVS), a robust multi-component metric that aggregates dispersion in normalized runtime, final optimality gap, LP iterations, and branch-and-bound nodes across repeated runs. On a large subset of MIPLIB 2017 instances, each solved in 100 randomized runs under a four-hour limit, WVS reveals a right-skewed distribution with a substantial upper tail: many instances are essentially stable, but some exhibit large variability that is not explained by basic properties alone. Notably, this experiment proved optimality for the open instance 'neos-5045105-creuse' in two SCIP runs. Using static descriptors and root-level features, a tree-based predictor with a gated tail uplift achieves a mean absolute error of 0.058 and Spearman rank correlation of 0.65 on a sealed test split. Feature-importance analysis highlights root degeneracy, matrix structure, coefficient ranges, and presolve reductions as the main drivers of high WVS. Because variability is systematic and partially predictable from inexpensive early-run features, our findings offer a practical tool for preemptive tuning and lay a foundation for fairer evaluation of new algorithms.
papers.comment: 21 pages, including a 3-page electronic companion. An earlier conference version appeared in the IOS 2026 proceedings. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19478202
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Weighted Variability Score (WVS)，把 MIP 求解器在重复随机运行下的归一化运行时间、最终最优性间隙、LP 迭代数与分支定界节点数的离散度聚合为一个多分量指标。在 MIPLIB 2017 大子集上每个实例跑 100 次随机化运行（4 小时上限），WVS 呈右偏长尾：多数实例稳定，少数变异极大且无法由基础实例属性解释。
Motivation: MIP 求解器在看似中性的扰动下性能差异显著，使基准测试与计算研究结论难以解释；需要一个稳健指标和可预测信号来区分稳定与高变异实例。
Method: WVS 聚合归一化运行时间、最终最优性间隙、LP 迭代数与分支定界节点数的离散度；用静态描述符与 root-level 特征训练带 gated tail uplift 的树模型预测 WVS，并做特征重要性分析。
Result: 在 MIPLIB 2017 大子集上每实例 100 次随机运行、4 小时上限，WVS 分布右偏且有可观上尾；树模型在密封测试集上 MAE 0.058、Spearman 秩相关 0.65；重要特征为 root degeneracy、矩阵结构、系数范围与 presolve reductions；两次 SCIP 运行证明了开放实例 neos-5045105-creuse 的最优性。
Conclusion: 求解器变异性是系统性且可由廉价早期运行特征部分预测的，因此 WVS 可用于预防性调参，并为新算法的公平评估提供基础。

papers.title: Collaborative Theory of Mind: Learning to Self-Revise by Anticipating User Responses
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong individual task performance, yet still struggle to collaborate with users over extended, multi-turn interactions, for example by attempting solutions before understanding the user's needs or by failing to revise mistaken assumptions after receiving feedback. We propose Collaborative Theory of Mind (CToM), a framework that addresses these challenges by explicitly training LLMs to anticipate user responses and to use those predictions to improve their own behavior. CToM drafts a response, predicts how the user will respond, and uses this prediction to guide internal revision before presenting a response. During training, the user's reply to each draft serves as the target for predicting the next turn, and we train the assistant to minimize the negative log-likelihood of that reply. We combine this prediction objective with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) to optimize both task performance and interaction efficiency. Across mathematical reasoning, coding, and writing tasks, CToM achieves higher collaborative task performance than all baselines; for example, on a collaborative mathematical reasoning task, it improves final accuracy from 74.1% to 79.6% compared with naive GRPO. Ablations show that predicting user responses also makes collaboration more efficient: under the same reward, adding prediction supervision reduces the number of user replies by 8% on coding and 17% on writing while improving task performance. Behavioral analyses of interaction trajectories show that user-response predictions become more accurate after training, and that more accurate predictions are associated with larger improvements in collaborative task performance through self-revision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Collaborative Theory of Mind (CToM)：让 LLM 在给出回答前先预测用户下一轮回复，并用该预测驱动内部自我修订，训练时以用户真实回复为下一回合预测目标（最小化 NLL），再与 GRPO 联合优化任务表现与交互效率。在数学推理、代码、写作三类协作任务上均高于全部基线，协作数学推理最终准确率从 74.1% 提到 79.6%（对比朴素 GRPO），同奖励下预测监督使用户回复次数在代码上减少 8%、写作上减少 17%。
Motivation: LLM 单轮任务表现强，但在多轮协作中常在理解用户需求前就动手，收到反馈后也不修正错误假设，导致反复往返、效率低。
Method: CToM 流程为起草回答、预测用户回应、据预测做内部修订再输出；训练时用每份草稿的真实用户回复作为预测下一回合的目标并最小化其 NLL，再与 group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) 结合，同时优化任务表现与交互效率。
Result: 在数学推理、代码、写作任务上 CToM 的协作任务表现高于所有基线：协作数学推理最终准确率 74.1% → 79.6%（对比 naive GRPO）。消融显示同奖励下加入预测监督使用户回复数在代码任务减少 8%、写作任务减少 17%，同时任务表现提升；行为分析显示训练后用户回复预测更准，且预测更准与自我修订带来的更大协作提升相关。
Conclusion: 显式训练模型预测用户回复，可同时提高多轮协作的任务准确率并减少所需用户往返次数；预测越准，自我修订带来的协作收益越大。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ROSETTA: Rotation Subspace Estimation for Training-free Transmodal Alignment
papers.abstract_en: When a query must be matched against a database built with a different sensor or processed by a different encoder, the independently trained encoders impose distinct coordinate systems on the feature space. No canonical reference frame exists to which all encoders can be aligned, and no single training procedure has fully closed this gap. We show that the relative transformation between any two such systems is a spatially preserving rotation in whitened feature space, whose angular velocity exhibits white-noise characteristics: large in norm, temporally uncorrelated, and unpredictable from the features themselves. However, the cross-covariance between encoder outputs has low effective rank, constraining only a small fraction of the rotation parameters, therefore local alignment is tractable. ROSETTA is a training-free calibration layer that estimates the local rotation via an expectation-maximization procedure, requiring no coobservation at query time. We validate ROSETTA on three public driving datasets spanning LiDAR, camera, thermal, and event modalities in cross-modal, cross-device, cross-representation, and cross-backbone settings, with milliseconds overhead per query.
papers.comment: 18 pages, including supplementary material. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Image Processing on March 1, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ROSETTA 是一个免训练的跨模态校准层：独立训练的编码器在白化特征空间中只相差一个保角旋转，其角速度呈白噪声特征（范数大、时间不相关、无法从特征预测），但编码器输出的互协方差有效秩低，只约束少量旋转参数，因此局部对齐可解。用 EM 过程在查询时估计局部旋转、无需共观测，在三个公开驾驶数据集（LiDAR、相机、热红外、事件相机）的跨模态/跨设备/跨表示/跨骨干设置下验证，每次查询仅毫秒级开销。
Motivation: 不同传感器或不同编码器独立训练出的特征空间坐标系互不相同，不存在可供所有编码器对齐的规范参考系，现有单一训练流程也无法完全弥合这一鸿沟。
Method: 证明任意两个编码器坐标系在白化特征空间中的相对变换是保角旋转，且角速度具白噪声特性；利用互协方差的低有效秩只约束少量旋转参数，用期望最大化 (EM) 过程估计局部旋转，构成免训练、查询时无需共观测的校准层。
Result: 在三个公开驾驶数据集上验证，覆盖 LiDAR、相机、热红外、事件四种模态，以及跨模态、跨设备、跨表示、跨骨干四类设置；每次查询的额外开销为毫秒级。
Conclusion: 跨编码器对齐可作为白化特征空间中的局部旋转估计问题求解，免训练、无需查询时共观测即可完成，且开销在毫秒量级。
