papers.title: DREAM: Dynamic Resolution Assignment For Multimodal Multi-agent Debate
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent debate (MAD) has emerged as an effective paradigm to improve the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and is increasingly being extended to multimodal settings. However, existing multimodal MAD frameworks typically expose agents to the same fixed visual input, ignoring substantial variation in the visual scale needed across samples and agents. In addition, these frameworks frequently suffer from groupthink, a phenomenon where agents prematurely abandon correct deductions to conform with confident but hallucinated peer responses. To address these bottlenecks, we introduce DREAM (Dynamic Resolution Assignment For Multimodal Multi-Agent Debate), which operates via two core components: (1) Dynamic Resolution Assignment, a zero-shot probe round where agents test multiple resolutions, quantify uncertainty using Average Normalized Log-Likelihood (ANLL), and use an adaptive threshold to assign each agent to its empirically optimal resolution; (2) Uncertainty-Guided Rollback Aggregation counters groupthink by tracking each agent's uncertainty over rounds and restoring early low-uncertainty answers overridden by group pressure. On six multimodal datasets, DREAM improves the accuracy-token trade-off over multi-agent debate baselines by 1.5-3.2% accuracy without dataset-specific tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DREAM 用零样本探测轮让每个 agent 试多个视觉分辨率、以 Average Normalized Log-Likelihood (ANLL) 量化不确定性并按自适应阈值分配各自最优分辨率，再用 Uncertainty-Guided Rollback Aggregation 在后续轮次中恢复被群体压力覆盖的早期低不确定性答案以对抗 groupthink。在六个多模态数据集上，它在不做数据集特定调参的情况下把 accuracy-token 权衡相对多智能体辩论基线提高 1.5–3.2%。
Motivation: 多模态多智能体辩论 (MAD) 让所有 agent 看同一份固定视觉输入，忽略样本与 agent 之间视觉尺度需求的巨大差异；同时辩论易出现 groupthink，agent 过早放弃正确推断去迎合自信但幻觉的同伴回答。
Method: 两个核心组件：Dynamic Resolution Assignment 做零样本探测轮，各 agent 测试多个分辨率、用 ANLL 量化不确定性，再经自适应阈值分配到经验最优分辨率；Uncertainty-Guided Rollback Aggregation 跨轮跟踪每个 agent 的不确定性，恢复早期低不确定性但被群体压力覆盖的答案。
Result: 在六个多模态数据集上，相对多智能体辩论基线 accuracy 提升 1.5–3.2%，同时改善 accuracy-token 权衡，且无需数据集特定调参。
Conclusion: 按 agent 动态分配视觉分辨率并用不确定性回滚抑制 groupthink，可以在不逐数据集调参的前提下提升多模态辩论的准确率与 token 效率。

papers.title: Green-Routed Neural Operators: Physics Determines Where the Network Reads
papers.abstract_en: We identify a mismatch between the physical role of transport fields in many PDEs and their usual role in neural operators: PDEs use them to select read coordinates, whereas neural operators typically treat them only as input values. We address this mismatch with the Green-Routed Neural Operator (GRNO), which uses the governing equation to determine where latent features are sampled. A parameter-free equation adapter evaluates the diagnostic relation and constructs a departure map whose values are the read coordinates. A multiscale encoder-decoder combines centered and routed reads of latent features to learn the complete finite-time update. Across five two- and three-dimensional PDE systems, GRNO achieves the lowest mean final relative $L^2$ error on four under 40-step autoregressive evaluation and remains competitive on Keller-Segel. Fixed-weight route interventions reveal strong dependence on direction and spatial alignment in four systems, with weak dependence in Keller-Segel. In independently trained ablations, GRNO achieves lower mean errors than variants that supply the transport field only as an input feature, substitute a learned displacement for the equation-specified route, or apply the route with a spatial misalignment, across all five systems. It also substantially outperforms directly advecting the physical state and learning the remaining update, indicating that equation-specified read coordinates provide an effective structural prior for long-horizon PDE forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GRNO 把 PDE 中输运场的角色从“输入数值”改成“读取坐标”：用控制方程经无参数 equation adapter 生成 departure map 作为 latent 特征的读取位置，再由 multiscale encoder-decoder 融合 centered 与 routed 读取学习完整有限时间更新。在五个二维/三维 PDE 系统的 40 步自回归评估中，GRNO 在四个系统上取得最低平均最终相对 L2 误差，Keller-Segel 上仍有竞争力；固定权重的 route 干预显示四个系统对方向与空间对齐强依赖，Keller-Segel 弱依赖。
Motivation: 输运场在 PDE 里决定解从哪里被读取，而神经算子通常只把它当输入值喂给网络，这一角色错位削弱了长时程预报的结构先验。
Method: GRNO 由三部分组成：无参数 equation adapter 求解诊断关系并构造取值即读取坐标的 departure map；multiscale encoder-decoder 同时做 centered reads 与 routed reads 以学习完整有限时间更新；另设固定权重 route 干预与独立训练的消融（仅把输运场当输入特征、用学习位移替代方程指定 route、route 空间错位、直接平流物理状态再学剩余更新）。
Result: 在五个二维/三维 PDE 系统的 40 步自回归评估中，GRNO 在四个系统上平均最终相对 L2 误差最低，Keller-Segel 上保持竞争力；固定权重 route 干预在四个系统显示对方向与空间对齐的强依赖、Keller-Segel 弱依赖；四类独立训练消融中 GRNO 在全部五个系统上平均误差更低，并显著优于直接平流物理状态再学剩余更新的方案。
Conclusion: 方程指定的读取坐标是长时程 PDE 预报的有效结构先验，其收益依赖于方向与空间对齐，且在 Keller-Segel 这类系统上作用较弱。

papers.title: Riemannian Shape Analysis of the Corpus Callosum in Kendall Space: Aging and Alzheimer's Disease
papers.abstract_en: The corpus callosum (CC) is a major white-matter structure and a well-established marker of brain aging, but most studies quantify it using scalar summaries that discard its boundary geometry. We present a Riemannian shape-space framework \cite{fletcher2013geodesic-regression} for analyzing age-related morphological change in the midsagittal CC, applied to the OASIS-1 cohort. Each contour is represented by $128$ landmarks and embedded into Kendall shape space, where translation, rotation, and scale are removed. We derive a multivariate geodesic regression with exact Riemannian gradients and use the fitted age-velocity field to localize age-related deformation to five anatomical sub-regions. In the cognitively normal cohort ($n = 252$), geodesic regression outperforms the Euclidean linear benchmark ($R^2 = 0.1355$ vs.\ $0.1216$). Regional energy is anterior-dominant: the Genu carries $46.1\%$ and the Anterior Body $23.3\%$ of total age-related shape change, together accounting for $\sim 69\%$ despite comprising only $\sim 41\%$ of landmarks. Signed projections confirm the ordering (Genu $r = 0.562$; Anterior Body $r = 0.507$). In contrast, age explains less than $0.5\%$ of shape variance in Alzheimer's disease ($n = 88$), indicating that the disease disrupts the healthy aging trajectory. A tangent-space classifier achieves an age-group AUC of $0.791$ from the 2D contour alone, exceeding a recent volumetric benchmark ($0.67$).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把胼胝体中矢状轮廓用 128 个 landmark 嵌入 Kendall 形状空间，做带精确 Riemann 梯度的多元测地回归，把年龄相关形变定位到五个解剖亚区。在 OASIS-1 认知正常组 (n=252) 上 R²=0.1355，高于欧氏线性基线 0.1216；形变能量前部主导，Genu 占 46.1%、Anterior Body 占 23.3%，合计约 69% 而仅占约 41% 的 landmark。AD 组 (n=88) 中年龄仅解释不到 0.5% 的形状方差，说明疾病打断了健康老化轨迹；仅用 2D 轮廓的切空间分类器年龄组 AUC=0.791，高于近期体积基线 0.67。
Motivation: 多数胼胝体研究用标量摘要（如体积）刻画其随年龄的变化，丢弃了边界几何，无法定位形变发生在哪些解剖亚区。
Method: 每个中矢状 CC 轮廓取 128 个 landmark，去除平移、旋转、尺度后嵌入 Kendall 形状空间；推导带精确 Riemann 梯度的多元测地回归 (multivariate geodesic regression)，用拟合得到的 age-velocity 场把年龄相关形变分配到五个解剖亚区，并用有符号投影与切空间分类器做验证。数据为 OASIS-1 队列。
Result: 认知正常组 (n=252) 测地回归 R²=0.1355，欧氏线性基线 0.1216；区域能量 Anterior-dominant：Genu 占总年龄相关形状变化的 46.1%，Anterior Body 占 23.3%，两者合计约 69%，而二者仅占约 41% 的 landmark；有符号投影相关系数 Genu r=0.562、Anterior Body r=0.507。AD 组 (n=88) 中年龄解释的形状方差不足 0.5%。仅用 2D 轮廓的切空间分类器年龄组 AUC=0.791，高于近期体积基线 0.67。
Conclusion: 健康老化在 CC 上呈前部主导的定向形变，而 Alzheimer's disease 使形状基本脱离这条健康老化轨迹，因此边界几何本身携带超出体积的年龄与疾病信息。

papers.title: ForeAct3D: Policy-Grounded Future World Modeling for VLA Policies
papers.abstract_en: Robots need to anticipate how their actions will change the world, since manipulation success hinges on the resulting contacts and object motions. However, existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies that predict future observations from shared features leave the forecast decoupled from the actions the policy will actually execute, and impose no physical constraints on how the scene may evolve. We introduce ForeAct3D, a framework for policy-grounded future world modeling within VLA policies. Learnable geometric queries decode depth, semantic segmentation, and camera pose from the policy representation into current and future semantic 3D scene states, and the future queries are conditioned on the policy-generated action chunk to ground the forecast in the planned interaction. A physical-consistency closure relates the two states through background staticity and instance-level rigidity, and anchors the wrist-camera pose to end-effector kinematics. These objectives shape the shared representation used for action generation during training, and no future prediction is required at inference. Without robot pretraining, ForeAct3D achieves 98.3% average success on LIBERO and an average task length of 3.73 on CALVIN, outperforming its base policy on every suite. Ablations show that semantic 3D supervision, physical consistency, and action conditioning each improve manipulation performance, and that action conditioning substantially improves future object localization. Real-world experiments on spatial placement, object insertion, and sequential manipulation further raise average success from 6.7% to 37.8% over the base policy. The project page and code are available at https://github.com/anthonytao80-crypto/ForeAct3D.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ForeAct3D 让 VLA 策略的未来观测预测直接以将要执行的 action chunk 为条件，并用背景静止、实例刚性与腕部相机位姿对末端运动学的物理一致性闭合来约束场景演化。无机器人预训练时在 LIBERO 上平均成功率 98.3%、CALVIN 平均任务长度 3.73，实机空间摆放、插入与顺序操作任务平均成功率从基线策略的 6.7% 升到 37.8%。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 策略从共享特征预测未来观测，但预测与策略实际要执行的动作脱节，且对场景如何演化不加任何物理约束，导致操作这类依赖接触与物体运动的任务难以受益于未来预测。
Method: 可学习的几何 query 从策略表征解码深度、语义分割与相机位姿，得到当前与未来语义 3D 场景状态；未来 query 以策略生成的 action chunk 为条件，把预测锚定到计划中的交互。物理一致性闭合用背景静止与实例级刚性关联两个状态，并把腕部相机位姿绑定到末端执行器运动学；这些目标在训练时塑造用于动作生成的共享表征，推理时不需要未来预测。
Result: 无机器人预训练时 ForeAct3D 在 LIBERO 上平均成功率 98.3%，CALVIN 平均任务长度 3.73，每个 suite 都超过其基线策略。消融显示语义 3D 监督、物理一致性与动作条件化各自都提升操作性能，其中动作条件化显著改善未来物体定位。真实实验（空间摆放、物体插入、顺序操作）上平均成功率由基线策略的 6.7% 提升到 37.8%。
Conclusion: 把未来预测锚定到计划动作并加物理一致性约束，可以在不牺牲推理成本的前提下提升 VLA 操作成功率，且该收益在仿真与真实机器人上都成立。

papers.title: Video2World: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Interactive World Modeling from Embodied Videos
papers.abstract_en: Building interactive simulators from real-world observations is a promising way to scale embodied data, but current pipelines still rely heavily on manual environment construction and calibration. We study whether frontier foundation models and coding agents can automate this process end to end. We formulate \emph{autonomous video-to-simulation} as a software engineering task in which an agent observes an embodied video, constructs the corresponding simulated environment and robot behavior, and iteratively refines the result through execution feedback. To evaluate this capability, we introduce \textbf{Video2World}, a benchmark comprising 222 reconstruction instances derived from 189 robot and human demonstration videos. Video2World measures reconstructed worlds along geometric fidelity, dynamic fidelity, and functional correctness, capturing spatial perception, physical reasoning, and executable interaction. Evaluating 9 frontier coding-agent systems reveals a sharp improvement in Task success beginning with Claude Opus 5, rising from below 5\% to over 15\%, while substantial gaps to human-assisted reconstruction remain. We further find that worlds that look better could work worse: better visual fidelity does not always lead to higher task success. This echoes the broader gap between perceptual realism and factual correctness observed in generative models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Video2World 把「从具身视频自动重建可交互仿真器」形式化为软件工程任务，让 coding agent 观看机器人/人类演示视频后自动搭建环境与机器人行为，并依据执行反馈迭代修正。基准含 222 个重建实例（源自 189 段演示视频），评测 9 个前沿 coding-agent 系统：任务成功率从 Claude Opus 5 起由不足 5% 升至超过 15%，但仍明显落后于人工辅助重建；且视觉保真度更高并不必然带来更高任务成功率。
Motivation: 从真实观测构建交互式仿真器仍高度依赖手工环境搭建与标定，规模化具身数据受限；需要判断前沿基础模型与 coding agent 能否端到端自动化这一流程，并有基准可度量其能力。
Method: 将 autonomous video-to-simulation 表述为软件工程任务：agent 观察具身视频，构建对应仿真环境与机器人行为，再通过执行反馈迭代细化。提出 Video2World 基准，含 222 个重建实例、源自 189 段机器人与人类演示视频，从几何保真度、动态保真度、功能正确性三个维度度量重建世界，覆盖空间感知、物理推理与可执行交互。
Result: 评测 9 个前沿 coding-agent 系统，任务成功率自 Claude Opus 5 起出现陡升，从低于 5% 提高到超过 15%；与人工辅助重建仍有较大差距。视觉保真度更好不总带来更高任务成功率，即外观更好看的世界可能实际更不好用。
Conclusion: 前沿 coding agent 已能端到端做视频到仿真的自动重建但成功率仍低，且感知层面的真实感与功能层面的正确性并不对齐——这与生成模型中感知真实感和事实正确性的普遍差距一致。

papers.title: AgroGround: Multi-Granularity Grounded Recognition in Agriculture
papers.abstract_en: Agricultural visual models are typically evaluated for either recognition or localization, but reliable diagnosis requires identifying what is present and localizing the evidence. Agricultural visual question answering (VQA) datasets carry rich semantic labels but rarely link them to image regions, and adding such annotations by hand is costly at scale. We introduce AgroGround, a large-scale dataset for grounded agricultural recognition: identifying plant diseases and other agricultural targets and localizing their image regions. An automated pipeline converts the labels of eight agricultural VQA datasets into annotations for disease lesions and whole objects, producing 794,850 instruction examples. Healthy images provide negative supervision for disease queries, teaching the model to return empty predictions. We fine-tune a shared vision-language model on known-target grounding instructions combined with instructions requiring both recognition and localization. We evaluate predicted identities, regions, joint correctness, and healthy-image abstention on 1,480 human-verified images disjoint from all training data. Grounding-only fine-tuning reduces recognition accuracy from 51.8\% to 29.1\%, while adding recognition-and-localization instructions raises it to 72.6\%. With images and annotations held fixed, combining the two formats raises joint accuracy from 19.2\% to 43.3\% at comparable grounding. Healthy negatives raise abstention on healthy images to 95.0\%, and reinforcement learning improves lesion-level grounding. The resulting 2B model exceeds its annotation teacher in grounding F1 on our benchmark and on the external PlantSeg test set. AgroGround establishes a benchmark for grounded agricultural recognition, measuring joint correctness of identity and localization along with abstention on healthy images. The code is available at https://github.com/AB-Abdulla/AgroGround.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgroGround 把八个农业 VQA 数据集的标签用自动流水线转成病斑与整目标的定位标注，得到 794,850 条指令样本，再在共享视觉-语言模型上混合“识别+定位”指令微调。只做 grounding 微调会把识别准确率从 51.8% 压到 29.1%，加上识别与定位双指令后升到 72.6%，联合准确率从 19.2% 提到 43.3%。
Motivation: 农业视觉模型的识别与定位被分开评测，而农业 VQA 数据集的语义标签很少绑定到图像区域，人工补这类标注在规模上代价过高，难以可靠诊断模型到底认出了什么、证据在哪。
Method: 自动流水线把八个农业 VQA 数据集的标签转换为病斑级与整目标级定位标注，健康图像作为疾病查询的负监督以学习空预测；在共享视觉-语言模型上用已知目标 grounding 指令与识别+定位混合指令微调，并用强化学习改进病斑级 grounding，最终得到 2B 模型。
Result: 产出 794,850 条指令样本，在 1,480 张与全部训练数据不相交的人工核验图像上评测：仅 grounding 微调使识别准确率 51.8% → 29.1%，加入识别+定位指令后升至 72.6%；图像与标注固定时两种格式合用使联合准确率 19.2% → 43.3%，grounding 相当；健康负样本使健康图像 abstention 达 95.0%。2B 模型在本基准与外部 PlantSeg test set 的 grounding F1 均超过其标注教师模型。
Conclusion: 识别与定位必须用混合指令一起训练，单靠 grounding 微调会损害识别；健康负监督加 abstention 评测能让模型在无病图像上可靠返回空预测。

papers.title: Solving VeriContest with a Lean-Backed Rust Verifier
papers.abstract_en: VeriContest is a benchmark of 1007 competitive-programming problems in Rust, each with a Verus specification, a judge-accepted solution, and a Verus proof. Its authors report that proof generation is the bottleneck for frontier models: given the specification and the code, the best model produces an accepted Verus proof for 13.95% of the problems on the first attempt. We report on solving the same proof-generation task with Rust-Prover, a verifier for Rust backed by Lean 4. The Verus specification and the Rust code are restated and translated into Lean, each specification becomes a theorem, and agents prove the theorems with Lean's kernel as the final check. All 1325 theorems of all 1007 problems were proved. 1259 of them were proved in one run of under 32 hours on Claude Opus 5.5, at a median of 3.2 minutes and $1.17 per proof, and 70% of them on the first iteration. The restated specifications were checked against the benchmark's test suites, and reviewed where no suite applies. None was wrong or weakened. The translated Lean programs were run on 21,413 of the benchmark's test cases and produced the same output as the Rust programs on every one. Across four Claude and four GPT models at five reasoning-effort settings, every current frontier model proves nearly all of a ten-theorem sample at every setting, and more effort raises the cost without raising the number of proofs. The cheapest Claude setting, Sonnet 5.5 at low effort, proves all of the 50 hardest theorems. We also rerun the benchmark's own Verus protocol with Claude Opus 5.5 on the 50 problems with the longest reference proofs. Opus 5.5 alone fails to prove one of them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VeriContest（1007 道 Rust 竞赛题、1325 条 Verus 定理）上，前沿模型最好成绩只有 13.95% 首次通过；改用 Lean 4 支撑的 Rust-Prover 后 1325 条定理全部证出，其中 1259 条由 Claude Opus 5.5 在 32 小时内单次跑完，中位每条 3.2 分钟、1.17 美元。提高推理档位只加成本不加产出，最便宜的 Sonnet 5.5 低档位即可证出最难的 50 条。
Motivation: VeriContest 作者报告证明生成是前沿模型的瓶颈：给定规格与代码，最好的模型首次尝试仅 13.95% 产出被接受的 Verus 证明。
Method: Rust-Prover 用 Lean 4 作为内核：把 Verus 规格与 Rust 代码重新表述并翻译成 Lean，每条规格变成一条定理，由 agent 证明、Lean 内核终检；重述的规格对照基准测试套件校验，无套件处人工审查；翻译后的 Lean 程序在 21,413 个测试用例上运行比对。
Result: 1007 题的全部 1325 条定理均被证出；1259 条由 Claude Opus 5.5 在一次 32 小时以内的运行中完成，中位 3.2 分钟、1.17 美元每条证明，70% 在首轮迭代内完成。规格无一错误或弱化；21,413 个测试用例上 Lean 与 Rust 输出全部一致。四个 Claude、四个 GPT 模型在五档推理档位下，每个当前前沿模型都能在十定理样本上几乎全证，提高档位只增成本不增证明数；Sonnet 5.5 低档位证出最难的 50 条定理。用 Claude Opus 5.5 重跑基准自带的 Verus 协议，在参考证明最长的 50 题上仅一条失败。
Conclusion: 把证明任务改写为 Lean 4 内核可检查的定理后，VeriContest 的证明瓶颈基本消失，且更高推理档位在该任务上不划算。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Evolving Hybrid Quantum-Classical Architectures for Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid quantum classical neural networks integrate parameterized quantum circuits (PQCs) with established deep learning architectures, but their performance depends strongly on the choice of quantum circuit architecture, a choice that remains largely manual. Most existing approaches rely on hand-designed or fixed circuit ansätze, requiring circuit structure, gate composition, and qubit connectivity to be specified in advance with no guarantee that they suit the task. This limitation is especially acute in image classification, where quantum circuits must transform features extracted by classical networks while remaining compact enough for practical training, requirements that generic, task-agnostic ansätze are unlikely to satisfy simultaneously. We extend EXAQC, an evolutionary framework for automated quantum circuit discovery, to image classification. EXAQC evolves PQCs as intermediate processing modules while retaining classical feature-extraction and prediction layers. On MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10, EXAQC achieves 98.42%, 90.62%, and 85.47% accuracy, respectively, while using comparable gate counts to other quantum architecture-search methods. Against classical networks, evolved hybrid models maintain comparable accuracy with substantially fewer trainable parameters, reaching 85.68% on CIFAR-10 with over 25$\times$ fewer parameters than a 10-layer CNN. Encoding choice also matters: rotation-based encodings (RX, RY, U3) outperform amplitude encoding by 22-25 points on CIFAR-10. These results demonstrate that automated circuit discovery yields compact quantum modules that can replace larger classical components in vision architectures while retaining competitive accuracy.

TL;DR: 把进化式量子电路自动搜索框架 EXAQC 扩展到图像分类，用进化算法自动演化作为中间处理模块的参数化量子电路 (PQC)，保留经典特征提取与预测层。在 MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10 上分别达到 98.42%、90.62%、85.47% 准确率，门数量与其他量子架构搜索方法相当；CIFAR-10 上以比 10 层 CNN 少 25 倍以上的可训练参数达到 85.68%，旋转编码 (RX/RY/U3) 比振幅编码高 22–25 个百分点。
Motivation: 混合量子-经典网络的性能强烈依赖量子电路结构，但现有方法多用手设计或固定 ansatz，电路结构、门组成与连通性需预先指定且不保证适配任务；在图像分类中电路既要变换经典网络提取的特征又要足够紧凑，通用、任务无关的 ansatz 难以同时满足。

Result: MNIST 98.42%、Fashion-MNIST 90.62%、CIFAR-10 85.47% 准确率，门数量与其他量子架构搜索方法相当；CIFAR-10 上进化混合模型达 85.68%，可训练参数比 10 层 CNN 少 25 倍以上；CIFAR-10 上旋转编码 (RX、RY、U3) 比振幅编码高 22–25 个百分点。

papers.title: Hamiltonian locality testing and certification do not achieve the Heisenberg limit
papers.abstract_en: We establish lower bounds for Hamiltonian property testing with access to the time-evolution operator but not its inverse. Each experiment may query the time-evolution operator multiple times, and distances between Hamiltonians are measured in the normalized Frobenius norm. In this model, we show that testing whether a Hamiltonian is $k$-local or $\varepsilon$-far from every $k$-local Hamiltonian requires $Ω(1/\varepsilon^2)$ total evolution time, matching the upper bound of Kallaugher and Liang (TQC'25). We also prove that testing whether an unknown Hamiltonian equals a target Hamiltonian or is $\varepsilon$-far from it requires $Ω(1/\varepsilon^2)$ total evolution time, matching the upper bound of Sinha and Tong (2025). These are the first lower bounds for natural problems in Hamiltonian learning and testing that rule out Heisenberg-limited scaling of $1/\varepsilon$. As a third result, we show that amplitude estimation to precision $\varepsilon$ requires $Ω(1/\varepsilon^2)$ total time evolution, recovering the result of Tang and Wright (QIP'26) in the continuous-time query model. All three results follow from the hardness of distinguishing the zero Hamiltonian from a suitably chosen ensemble of random Hamiltonians. We establish this hardness by adapting the continuous-time adversary method to forward Hamiltonian evolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在只能访问时间演化算符、不能访问其逆的模型下，Hamiltonian 的 k-local 性质测试、与目标 Hamiltonian 的相等性测试，以及幅度估计到精度 ε 都需要 Ω(1/ε²) 的总演化时间，因而排除了 1/ε 的 Heisenberg 极限标度。三条下界均由区分零 Hamiltonian 与特定随机 Hamiltonian 集成的困难性导出。
Motivation: Hamiltonian 学习与测试此前只有上界，缺少匹配的下界来判定 Heisenberg 极限的 1/ε 标度在只有正向演化的实际模型中能否达到。
Method: 把连续时间 adversary 方法改造到正向 Hamiltonian 演化上，证明区分零 Hamiltonian 与精心选取的随机 Hamiltonian 集成是困难的；Hamiltonian 之间的距离用归一化 Frobenius 范数度量，每次实验可多次查询时间演化算符。
Result: 判定 Hamiltonian 是否 k-local 或与所有 k-local Hamiltonian 相距 ε 需要 Ω(1/ε²) 总演化时间，匹配 Kallaugher and Liang (TQC'25) 的上界；判定未知 Hamiltonian 是否等于目标或与之相距 ε 同样需要 Ω(1/ε²)，匹配 Sinha and Tong (2025) 的上界；幅度估计到精度 ε 需要 Ω(1/ε²) 总时间演化，重现 Tang and Wright (QIP'26) 在连续时间查询模型中的结果。
Conclusion: 这是 Hamiltonian 学习与测试中首批排除 Heisenberg 极限 1/ε 标度的自然问题下界：在只有正向演化的访问模型下，精度 ε 的代价是 Ω(1/ε²) 而非 1/ε。

papers.title: Exploring More, Reasoning Better: Stepwise Risk-Sensitive GRPO for Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text by denoising a sequence or successive blocks, allowing several tokens to be revealed in parallel. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) reuses terminal feedback across these decisions, even as their conditioning context changes. We propose stepwise risk-sensitive GRPO (StepRS-GRPO), which varies the risk coefficient of the group-advantage transformation across denoising states while retaining the underlying trainer. For binary rewards, we show that this transformation is exactly a prompt- and state-dependent rescaling of centered outcome advantages. A capability-based calibration suggests a coefficient scale, while endpoint and interpolation ablations guide schedule selection. Across multiple dLLM backbones and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, StepRS-GRPO improves both pass@1 accuracy and pass@k coverage over centered GRPO, while increasing answer diversity. In our ablation studies, mass-matched controls support the contributions of state allocation and schedule direction, and the gains persist after matching the root mean square (RMS) of the advantages to that of centered GRPO. Reasoning-trace diagnostics further show that the diversity gains from StepRS-GRPO extend beyond final-answer strings.
papers.comment: 40 pages, 12 figures, 2 tables. The first two authors contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Stepwise Risk-Sensitive GRPO (StepRS-GRPO)：在扩散语言模型 (dLLM) 的 RLVR 训练中，让 group-advantage 变换的风险系数随去噪状态变化，同时保留原训练器。二元奖励下该变换被证明等价于随 prompt 与状态缩放的中心化 outcome advantage。在多个 dLLM backbone 与数学推理基准上，它同时提升 pass@1 精度与 pass@k 覆盖率，并提高答案多样性。
Motivation: dLLM 并行揭示多个 token，RLVR 需要在条件上下文不断变化的情况下复用终端反馈；固定风险系数的 group-advantage 变换无法按去噪阶段分配探索强度。
Method: StepRS-GRPO 沿去噪状态调度风险系数，系数尺度由基于能力的校准给出，端点与插值消融指导调度方向选择；训练器本身不变。
Result: 在多个 dLLM backbone 与数学推理基准上，pass@1 精度与 pass@k 覆盖率均优于 centered GRPO，答案多样性提升；mass-matched 对照支持状态分配与调度方向的贡献，且在将 advantage 的 RMS 与 centered GRPO 对齐后增益仍然保持；reasoning-trace 诊断显示多样性增益超出最终答案字符串本身。
Conclusion: 把风险系数按去噪状态调度，可以在不更换训练器的前提下同时改善 dLLM 数学推理的精度与多样性，且增益不是 advantage 尺度或答案表面变化造成的假象。

papers.title: Scale and Selection: What Makes Automatic Harness Evolution Work for Visual-Interface Robot Agents
papers.abstract_en: When an off-the-shelf coding agent is used directly as a robot policy, observing a browser-based 3D interface through screenshots and acting by posing a virtual target gripper through a few tools, the agent's harness, its prompts, tools, and control rules, largely determines success, and until now it has been written by hand. We show that this harness can be improved automatically by another coding agent, the optimizer agent, and report two findings about what makes it work. First, the number of rollouts the optimizer agent sees per round governs whether the evolved harness generalizes: with rounds fixed, held-out success rises as the training batch grows from 5 to 100 rollouts, while small batches overfit the training tasks. Second, the optimizer agent must not be given free rein. Accepting every revision it proposes degrades the harness within a few rounds; a simple Champion-Challenger rule that promotes a revision only if it beats the incumbent on the same fixed cases turns the same loop into one that raises held-out success on LIBERO tasks from 51% to 67% over 30 rounds. Combining the evolved harness with a pretrained policy, through one tool that hands it control, reaches 71.2% on the RoboCasa365 leaderboard benchmark, 13.1 points above the best published entry. Automatic harness evolution for visual-interface robot agents is thus feasible, but its gains hinge on the rollout scale behind each decision and on how the optimizer agent's revisions are selected.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把浏览器 3D 界面里的机器人策略交给另一个 coding agent 自动改写其 harness（prompt、工具、控制规则），并给出两条成败条件：每轮 rollout 数决定泛化，且必须用 Champion-Challenger 规则筛选修订。在 LIBERO 上 30 轮内 held-out 成功率从 51% 升到 67%，与预训练策略结合后在 RoboCasa365 榜单达 71.2%，高出已发表最佳 13.1 个百分点。
Motivation: 现成 coding agent 直接当机器人策略时，决定成败的 harness（prompt、工具、控制规则）一直靠手写，缺少自动改进的可行条件。
Method: 由 optimizer agent 逐轮改写 harness；每轮给它看的 rollout 数从 5 到 100 变化以考察泛化；修订接受用 Champion-Challenger 规则，只有在同一固定任务集上胜过 incumbent 才晋升；演化后的 harness 通过一个交接控制的工具与预训练策略组合。
Result: 训练 batch 从 5 增到 100 rollouts 时 held-out 成功率上升，小 batch 过拟合训练任务；接受全部修订会让 harness 在几轮内退化；Champion-Challenger 使 LIBERO held-out 成功率 30 轮内从 51% 升到 67%；组合预训练策略后在 RoboCasa365 榜单达 71.2%，比最佳已发表条目高 13.1 个百分点。
Conclusion: 视觉界面机器人 agent 的自动 harness 演化可行，但收益取决于每个决策背后的 rollout 规模以及修订的筛选方式，放任 optimizer agent 自由改写会适得其反。

papers.title: Making LLMs Say What They Think: Measuring and Improving CoT-Interpretability Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) traces often serve as a proxy for how Large Language Models (LLMs) arrive at their answers. However, growing evidence shows that models' CoT often fails to reflect their internal computations and can be changed without affecting their final answers. In this work, we measure and improve the alignment between the reasoning described in an LLM's CoT and what it computes internally. We propose CoT-Interpretability Alignment (CIA), a metric that measures the agreement between a model's CoT traces and its internal reasoning strategies as detected by interpretability tools. We evaluate CIA on three tasks (two-hop question answering, hint intervention, and integer multiplication) across three LLMs, finding that LLMs exhibit limited alignment across all tasks (44.8-75.9%). We then experiment with improving CIA via post-training, setting both the task accuracy and parametric faithfulness signals as a reward. Experiments show that we can substantially improve CoT parametric faithfulness while maintaining or improving the task accuracy. We provide rich analysis, such as their generalization patterns. Our work provides both a framework for auditing CoT parametric faithfulness and a pathway toward making models' explicit reasoning more trustworthy. Code and data are available at https://github.com/yihuaihong/CIA-minimal-repro.

Method: CIA 度量比较 CoT 文本与可解释性工具检出的内部推理策略的一致性；随后做后训练，奖励同时包含任务准确率信号与参数化忠实度信号，并给出泛化模式分析。
Result: 三个 LLM 在两跳问答、hint 干预、整数乘法上的 CoT-内部一致率仅 44.8–75.9%；双信号后训练显著提升 CoT 参数化忠实度，同时任务准确率保持或提升。

papers.title: MEMO: Multi-Level Entity-Aware Memory for Streaming Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Streaming video understanding requires models to process unbounded visual streams while preserving rich visual semantics across vast temporal horizons, posing a fundamental challenge for memory modeling. Existing approaches primarily focus on increasing memory capacity, either by compressing historical information into fixed-size representations or by extending storage beyond GPU memory. However, these methods largely rely on global or coarse-grained representations, inevitably losing fine-grained visual information. In this work, we argue that streaming video memory should explicitly encode structured and semantically meaningful representations, particularly at the entity level. To this end, we propose MEMO, a novel framework that models streaming video through multi-level, entity-aware structured memory. MEMO performs multi-level perception to jointly capture global semantics, entity dynamics, and spatial structures, partitioning streaming video into semantically coherent chunks. Each chunk is organized into a structured memory, where lightweight global and entity-level representations serve as retrieval indices, while the corresponding high-resolution visual content is retained separately for on-demand access. At inference time, MEMO performs query-specific retrieval over the structured memory and selectively recalls relevant visual evidence for downstream reasoning. Notably, MEMO is training-free and plug-and-play with existing multimodal large language models. Extensive experiments on StreamingBench and OVO-Bench demonstrate that MEMO consistently improves multiple base models and achieves state-of-the-art performance. The code is available at https://github.com/Cecilia384/MEMO .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MEMO 把流式视频切成语义一致的 chunk，用全局与实体级轻量表征做检索索引、高分辨率视觉内容单独存放，推理时按 query 定向召回证据。它 training-free、可即插即用接入现有 MLLM，在 StreamingBench 与 OVO-Bench 上一致提升多个基座模型并达到 SOTA。
Motivation: 流式视频理解要在无限视觉流上跨超长时间跨度保留细粒度语义，现有方法只追求扩容量（压成定长表征或溢出 GPU 存储），依赖全局或粗粒度表征，必然丢失细粒度视觉信息。
Method: 多层感知联合捕获全局语义、实体动态与空间结构，把流式视频划成语义一致的 chunk；每个 chunk 组织为结构化记忆，轻量全局与实体级表征作检索索引，高分辨率视觉内容另行保留供按需访问；推理时对结构化记忆做 query 定向检索并选择性召回相关视觉证据，training-free 且与现有 MLLM 即插即用。
Result: 在 StreamingBench 与 OVO-Bench 上，MEMO 一致提升多个基座模型并取得 state-of-the-art 表现。
Conclusion: 流式视频记忆应按实体级结构化编码而非单纯扩容，配合按需检索即可在不训练的情况下抬升多模态大模型的长时视频推理表现。

papers.title: Near-Minimax-Optimal Rates for Asynchronous TD Learning with Markovian Data
papers.abstract_en: We study the last iterate of standard importance-weighted temporal-difference (TD) learning from a single trajectory of a finite Markov decision process. The trajectory follows a behavior policy $b$ with an irreducible, possibly periodic state chain; a target policy $π$ covered by $b$ is evaluated with action importance ratios bounded by $\varrho$. Write $H=(1-γ)^{-1}$, with $μ_{\min}$ the minimum stationary probability and $\mathfrak h_\star$ the largest expected hitting time of the reverse behavior state chain. We prove that the last iterate achieves sup-norm error at most $\varepsilon$ with high probability after $\widetilde O(\varrho H^3/(μ_{\min}\varepsilon^2)+\mathfrak h_\star)$ transitions for $0<\varepsilon\le1$. The statistical term retains the cubic effective-horizon dependence of synchronous TD, while the initialization cost is additive in $\mathfrak h_\star$. Setting $b=π$ and $\varrho=1$ recovers the on-policy rate. For aperiodic behavior chains, $\mathfrak h_\star=\widetilde O(t_{\rm mix}/μ_{\min})$ recovers a mixing-time bound. The proof combines an anchored local Poisson equation in reverse time to control fluctuations without a mixing-time factor, a compensation argument for successive hitting costs, and an expected cumulative propagation mass bound for decreasing step sizes. Given the policy ratios and their bound, an empirical state-count rule attains the same rate without prior knowledge of model parameters. The framework covers nonnegative affine importance-weighted prediction updates, including successor features, transition-dependent discounting, and coupled finite-mode predictions. A perturbation estimate yields a time-uniform guarantee for online return-variance estimation. A three-state, two-action construction gives matching minimax lower bounds for both terms up to logarithmic factors on the considered parameter classes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对有限 MDP 单条轨迹上的重要性加权 TD 学习证明最后迭代的近极小极大收敛率：sup-norm 误差达到 ε 所需转移数为 Õ(ϱH³/(μ_min ε²)+h⋆)，统计项保留同步 TD 的三次有效视界依赖，初始化代价以 h⋆ 加性出现。b=π 且 ϱ=1 退化为 on-policy 率，非周期行为链下 h⋆=Õ(t_mix/μ_min) 恢复混合时间界；三状态两动作构造给出两项的匹配极小极大下界。
Motivation: 单轨迹、马尔可夫数据下的 TD 学习分析常被混合时间因子污染，且异步/重要性加权设定缺少与同步 TD 可比的近极小极大率刻画。
Method: 对标准重要性加权 TD 的最后迭代做高概率分析：反向时间上的锚定局部 Poisson 方程控制波动而不引入混合时间因子，补偿论证处理连续命中代价，递减步长下用累积传播质量界；另给出不需先验模型参数的状态计数规则，并把框架推广到 successor features、依赖转移的折扣与耦合有限模式预测等非负仿射更新。
Result: 达到 sup-norm 误差 ε 的转移数为 Õ(ϱH³/(μ_min ε²)+h⋆)（0<ε≤1，高概率）；b=π、ϱ=1 恢复 on-policy 率，非周期链下 h⋆=Õ(t_mix/μ_min) 恢复混合时间界；状态计数规则在已知策略比率及其界时达到同一速率；三状态两动作构造对两项给出匹配的极小极大下界（至多差对数因子）；扰动估计给出在线回报方差估计的时间一致保证。
Conclusion: 异步重要性加权 TD 的最后迭代在马尔可夫数据下可达与同步 TD 同阶的近极小极大率，初始化代价可与统计项加性分离，且该率在所考虑参数类上是紧的。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: OpenCollab: A Multi-Agent Coding Framework with Programmable Collaboration and Controllable Runtime
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent coding systems are designed to tackle complex software engineering tasks through collaboration. However, existing evaluations typically assume configured organizations are followed faithfully, whereas reality differs. This behavioral gap, combined with differences in underlying system components, prevents clear attribution of observed gains. To this end, we introduce OpenCollab, a multi-agent coding framework that provides a unified infrastructure for programmable collaboration and controllable runtime. Specifically, OpenCollab unifies organization design, enforces experimental control on a shared runtime, and tracks execution through fine-grained event streams. On this basis, we define Adherence to quantify whether the declared organization is actually realized. Our experiments reveal that agents collaborate very differently across configurations: changing any single dimension shifts Adherence, from 47.2% to as high as 97.2%. Furthermore, extensive agentic coding benchmarks show that OpenCollab (Duo) establishes new SOTA performance compared to the mainstream harnesses such as Mini-SWE-agent, OpenHands, Codex CLI, and Claude Code, showing that a well-designed organization can outperform strong existing harnesses, while OpenCollab's single-agent configuration uses the fewest tokens across all evaluated suites. OpenCollab establishes a unified multi-agent infrastructure for easy programmable collaboration and controlled causal evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OpenCollab 是一个可编程协作、可控运行时的多智能体编码框架，用统一事件流追踪执行并提出 Adherence 指标量化声明的组织结构是否真正落地。实验显示任一配置维度的改动都会移动 Adherence，范围从 47.2% 到最高 97.2%；其 Duo 配置在主流 harness 上取得新 SOTA，单智能体配置在所有评测套件上用 token 最少。
Motivation: 现有评测默认配置好的组织结构被忠实执行，但实际行为与之不符，加上底层系统组件差异，导致观测到的性能增益无法清晰归因。
Method: 统一组织设计、在共享运行时上施加实验控制，并通过细粒度事件流追踪执行；在此基础上定义 Adherence 指标衡量声明组织是否真正实现，并以受控因果评测方式比较不同配置。
Result: 改变任一单个维度都会移动 Adherence，范围从 47.2% 到最高 97.2%；在 agentic coding 基准上 OpenCollab (Duo) 相对 Mini-SWE-agent、OpenHands、Codex CLI、Claude Code 等主流 harness 建立新 SOTA；OpenCollab 单智能体配置在所有被评测套件上使用 token 最少。
Conclusion: 良好的组织设计可以让多智能体系统超越强 harness，而统一的多智能体基础设施使可编程协作与受控因果评测成为可能。

papers.title: Robust LassoNet: Enhancing Feature Selection in Neural Networks via Robust Loss Functions
papers.abstract_en: Feature selection in neural networks remains a challenging problem, particularly in the presence of noisy or contaminated data. LassoNet is a recent approach that addresses this issue by combining neural networks with hierarchical sparsity constraints, enabling simultaneous prediction and variable selection. However, its standard formulation relies on the mean squared error (MSE) loss, which is known to be highly sensitive to outliers. In this paper, we present Robust LassoNet, an extension of LassoNet that incorporates robust loss functions, such as Huber, Cauchy, Tukey's bisquare, and Nonnegative Garrote, to mitigate the effect of extreme observations. The proposed approach preserves the original optimization framework while improving stability under data contamination. Through experiments on synthetic and real datasets, we show that robust LassoNet significantly improves both predictive performance and feature selection accuracy in the presence of outliers or heavy tailed noise, while maintaining comparable performance in clean settings. These results highlight the importance of robustness in neural network based feature selection and suggest practical guidelines for choosing appropriate loss functions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Robust LassoNet 把 LassoNet 的 MSE 换成 Huber、Cauchy、Tukey bisquare、Nonnegative Garrote 等稳健损失，在保留层次稀疏约束与原优化框架的前提下抑制极端观测影响。在含离群点或重尾噪声的合成与真实数据上，预测性能与特征选择准确率均显著提升，干净数据下表现相当。
Motivation: LassoNet 用 MSE 损失做神经网络的层次稀疏变量选择，而 MSE 对离群点高度敏感，数据被污染时预测与变量选择都不稳。
Method: 将 LassoNet 的 MSE 损失替换为稳健损失族（Huber、Cauchy、Tukey's bisquare、Nonnegative Garrote），保留原有的层次稀疏约束与优化框架；在合成数据集与真实数据集上做实验。
Result: 在含离群点或重尾噪声的合成与真实数据上，稳健 LassoNet 的预测性能与特征选择准确率均显著提升；在干净数据设置下保持相当表现。
Conclusion: 神经网络特征选择需要按噪声形态选损失函数：污染或重尾数据用稳健损失，干净数据则可沿用原设定。

papers.title: EngiWorld: What Can Frontier Agents Deliver in Professional Engineering Environments?
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous agents have made rapid progress in general-purpose computer use, yet reliable automation of professional industrial engineering remains out of reach. Engineering workflows require reasoning over geometric and physical constraints and keeping dependencies consistent across software and design stages. We present EngiWorld, a benchmark designed around the capabilities that real engineering projects require, from operating a single application to solving engineering problems end to end. It contains 1,301 expert-curated tasks spanning six engineering domains (CAD, CAE, CAM, BIM, EDA, and DCC) and 26 professional software applications, with both GUI and CLI interfaces. The tasks are organized into six types, corresponding to capabilities that real engineering projects require. We further introduce an artifact-centric evaluation methodology built on a unified suite of domain verifiers. The verifiers programmatically check whether final and intermediate artifacts are geometrically valid, physically feasible, and compliant with design rules. Beyond binary success, they also score how well optimized designs meet their specifications. Evaluation of seven frontier models reveals a substantial capability gap: the strongest model scores only 44.7/100, and just 3.6% of runs on tasks that require cross-software coordination succeed. EngiWorld provides a rigorous foundation for measuring progress toward agents that operate professional engineering software end to end.

papers.title: AESOP: Asymmetric Human-Camera Generation with Translation-Intensity Control
papers.abstract_en: Human motion defines an action, while a camera trajectory determines how it is presented. Camera generation for a given human motion and joint human-camera generation are usually treated as separate tasks, although both share an asymmetric dependency: human motion can be generated independently, whereas the camera responds to the realized action. We introduce AESOP, a unified framework with an independent human pathway and a shared human-conditioned camera generator. Its asymmetric architecture serves both tasks while preserving the human output during camera generation. Although human context anchors the shot to the action and camera text describes its movement, translation intensity remains underspecified. We therefore construct trajectory pairs that differ in camera translation magnitude while sharing human motion and camera text, then use these pairs to learn an explicit intensity condition. Experiments on the PulpMotion dataset demonstrate strong camera distributional and framing quality in both tasks and effective control over camera translation intensity. Project page is available at https://ripemangobox.github.io/AESOP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AESOP 把人体运动生成与相机轨迹生成统一到一个非对称框架：人体通路独立生成，相机生成器以已实现的人体动作为条件，从而在生成相机时保留人体输出。针对文本只描述相机运动却未规定平移幅度的问题，作者构造共享人体动作与相机文本、仅平移量不同的轨迹对，从中学习显式强度条件，在 PulpMotion 数据集上同时展示两项任务的相机分布与构图质量以及对平移强度的有效控制。
Motivation: 给定人体运动的相机生成与人体-相机联合生成通常被当作两个独立任务，但两者共享非对称依赖：人体动作可独立生成，相机必须响应已发生的动作；同时相机文本无法约束平移幅度。
Method: 非对称统一框架 AESOP：独立人体通路 + 以人体为条件的共享相机生成器，生成相机时保持人体输出不变；再构造平移量不同、人体动作与相机文本相同的轨迹对，用这些配对学习一个显式平移强度条件。
Result: 在 PulpMotion 数据集上的实验展示了两项任务中较强的相机分布质量与构图质量，以及对相机平移强度的有效控制。
Conclusion: 人体-相机生成的非对称依赖可以用共享的人体条件相机生成器统一处理，而平移强度需要靠配对轨迹的显式条件来补足文本描述的欠定性。

papers.title: FACT: Fidelity-Aware Construction of Articulated Twins
papers.abstract_en: Visually plausible articulated assets may still fail during contact interactions or exhibit inaccurate motion. We present FACT (Fidelity-Aware Construction of Articulated Twins), an agentic framework that progressively constructs articulated twins to improve geometry, contact, and dynamic fidelity. The agent drives an evidence--diagnosis--revision loop on a shared editable representation, selecting measurements and model edits using quantitative feedback, while numerical tools execute and validate the updates. It reconstructs editable articulated geometry from images through feature planning, targeted measurements, and diagnostic refinement. On this reference, it repairs collision proxies through task-aware local repartitioning before fidelity-constrained compression. Finally, it constructs response models from passive-response videos, using simulation residuals to guide model revision and constrained physical parameter fitting. Experiments show that FACT improves geometric reconstruction over baselines, enables more reliable interaction with simpler collision proxies, and better reproduces held-out physical responses than direct parameter inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FACT 是一个把图像与被动响应视频转成可编辑关节体 (articulated twin) 的 agentic 框架，用证据-诊断-修订循环逐步提升几何、接触与动力学保真度。它在共享可编辑表示上做特征规划与定向测量来重建几何，用任务感知局部重划分修复碰撞代理后再做保真度约束压缩，并用仿真残差引导响应模型修订与物理参数拟合。实验显示其几何重建优于基线、用更简单的碰撞代理也能更可靠交互，并比直接参数推断更好地复现留出物理响应。
Motivation: 视觉上看似合理的关节资产在接触交互中会失效或产生不准确运动，几何、碰撞代理与动力学参数三者缺乏统一的可编辑载体与定量反馈闭环。
Method: FACT 以共享可编辑表示为载体驱动证据-诊断-修订循环，由 agent 选择测量与模型编辑、数值工具执行并校验。几何端从图像经特征规划、定向测量与诊断式修订重建可编辑关节几何；接触端先做任务感知局部重划分 (task-aware local repartitioning) 再做保真度约束压缩；动力学端从被动响应视频构建响应模型，用仿真残差引导修订并做受约束的物理参数拟合。
Result: 实验表明 FACT 的几何重建优于基线，能用更简单的碰撞代理实现更可靠交互，并比直接参数推断 (direct parameter inference) 更好地复现留出 (held-out) 物理响应。
Conclusion: 把几何、接触与动力学三类保真度放进同一个由定量反馈驱动的修订循环，比一次性直接推断参数更能产出可交互、可复现真实响应的关节孪生体。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MS-GLA: Multi-Scale Gated Linear Attention for Addressing Representational Bottlenecks via Multi-Temporal Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Gated Linear Attention (GLA) Transformers advance linear recurrent models through data-dependent gating, but face a core limitation: the fixed-capacity memory matrices across all heads operate at a single temporal resolution, where each token is processed individually, forcing them to simultaneously encode local syntactic patterns and long-range semantic structure, creating a representational bottleneck that gating alone is insufficient to resolve. We introduce Multi-Scale Gated Linear Attention (MS-GLA), which addresses this by distributing attention heads across multiple temporal resolutions. Coarser resolutions pool longer token spans naturally specializing toward long-range dependencies, while finer head groups retain sensitivity to local syntactic structure. A learnable, input-dependent fusion layer dynamically recombines head group outputs at each timestep, expanding effective memory capacity without increasing per-head state size. This multi-resolution decomposition draws on principles from Multi-Scale State-Space Models (MS-SSM), adapting them to the gated linear attention setting. We evaluate MS-GLA on language modeling, recall-intensive tasks, and long-context generalization. Across all settings, MS-GLA consistently achieves higher accuracy and lower perplexity than GLA at matched parameter counts, with up to 18.9% improvement on recall-intensive tasks and 9.5% lower average perplexity on language modeling benchmarks, validating multi-temporal resolution decomposition as a principled and effective extension of Gated Linear Attention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MS-GLA 把 GLA 的注意力头按多个时间分辨率分组：粗分辨率池化长 token 段专攻长程依赖，细分辨率组保留局部句法，再用可学习的输入依赖融合层在每步重组各组输出，在不增大单头状态的前提下扩大有效记忆容量。在匹配参数量下，相比 GLA 在召回密集任务上最高提升 18.9%，语言建模基准平均困惑度降低 9.5%。
Motivation: GLA 各头的固定容量记忆矩阵都在单一时间分辨率上逐 token 处理，必须同时编码局部句法与长程语义，形成仅靠 gating 无法解决的表示瓶颈。
Method: 将注意力头分布到多个时间分辨率（借鉴 Multi-Scale State-Space Models, MS-SSM 的多尺度分解并适配到 gated linear attention），粗组池化长跨度、细组保留局部结构；用可学习、输入依赖的融合层在每个时间步动态重组各头组输出，单头状态大小不变。评测覆盖语言建模、召回密集任务与长上下文泛化。
Result: 在匹配参数量下，MS-GLA 在所有设置中相对 GLA 均取得更高准确率与更低困惑度：召回密集任务最高提升 18.9%，语言建模基准平均困惑度降低 9.5%。
Conclusion: 多时间分辨率分解是扩展 Gated Linear Attention 的有效原则性做法，可在不增加单头状态容量的情况下缓解表示瓶颈。

papers.title: Graph World Models for Constrained Epidemic Policy Planning
papers.abstract_en: Epidemic policy planning often requires coordination between geographical regions, taking into account mobility-driven spillovers and how to make use of limited resources. Existing methods either lack action-conditioned models of coupled dynamics or cannot guarantee per-period feasibility. We present EpiMind, a graph world model framework for constrained epidemic policy planning across regions. A graph-factored recurrent state-space model generates joint policy-conditioned rollouts from regional latent beliefs, while graph-temporal ADMM optimizes regional interventions, enforces shared-resource feasibility through projection, and evaluates temporal specifications under the learned model. EpiMind reduces admission RMSE by 29% relative to graph-free dynamics modeling, plans within 1-5% of the best feasible constant policy with guaranteed shared-budget feasibility, and outperforms all deployable baselines across three resource budgets in real-context evaluation. These results demonstrate that graph-structured policy imagination with explicit constrained coordination supports effective epidemic interventions from learned dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EpiMind 用图世界模型 (graph world model) 做跨区域流行病策略规划：图分解循环状态空间模型从各区域隐状态生成受策略条件约束的联合 rollout，图-时间 ADMM 在共享预算下投影保证逐期可行。相对无图动力学建模 admission RMSE 降低 29%，规划落在最优可行常数策略的 1–5% 以内，且在三种资源预算的真实情境评估中胜过全部可部署基线。
Motivation: 跨区域流行病干预需要考虑人口流动带来的溢出与有限资源分配，现有方法要么缺少动作条件化的耦合动力学模型，要么无法保证每期策略满足共享资源约束。
Method: EpiMind 由两部分组成：图分解循环状态空间模型 (graph-factored recurrent state-space model) 从区域隐状态信念生成受策略条件约束的联合 rollout；图-时间 ADMM (graph-temporal ADMM) 优化各区域干预，通过投影强制共享资源可行，并在学到的模型下评估时序规格 (temporal specifications)。
Result: 相对无图 (graph-free) 动力学建模，admission RMSE 降低 29%；规划结果落在最佳可行常数策略的 1–5% 以内且保证共享预算可行；在三种资源预算下的 real-context 评估中优于所有可部署基线。
Conclusion: 带显式约束协调的图结构策略想象 (policy imagination) 能在学到的动力学上支撑有效的流行病干预，同时保住逐期资源可行性。

papers.title: Hyper Algorithm Design Agent: Evolving Learnable Optimizer from Zero
papers.abstract_en: Meta-Black-Box Optimization (MetaBBO) is one of the highlights in the recent AI for Optimization trend. This paradigm's bi-level workflow leverages the learnable algorithm design policy at meta level to ensure the performance and generalization improvement on the low-level optimization task. While MetaBBO helps advance the performance lower bound of the resulted optimization system, it is currently handcrafted and customized case by case to adapt different optimization problems, which inevitably introduces inherent subjectivity and hence restricts the performance upper bound and usability in practice. In this paper, we address this issue by regarding MetaBBO's design loop as coding task, where we could introduce openendedness into MetaBBO with recursive self-improvement capability of advanced coding agents. Specifically, we propose a dual-agent framework: i) a task agent continuously refines the codebase of a target MetaBBO approach through code evolution; ii) a hyper agent progressively modifies the task agent and itself to provide open-ended design behavior; iii) the evolved MetaBBO codebase is evaluated and all in-execution information is fed back to the agents for recursive self-referential improvement. As a result, given a naive MetaBBO template, our framework automates a design evolution and finds novel variants superior to up-to-date human-made MetaBBO baselines. Surprisingly, the experimental results also demonstrate that our framework supports fast adaption across different optimization domains. Solid interpretation analysis further reveals interesting design principles emerge in such open-ended process. This work serves as the first exploration on automating design of complex learning-assisted optimization algorithms.

papers.title: Advancing Wildlife Conservation through Multimodal Animal Re-Identification with Environmental Metadata
papers.abstract_en: Identifying individual animals is crucial for effective wildlife monitoring and conservation efforts. Recent advancements in computer vision have shown promise in animal re-identification (Animal ReID) by leveraging data from camera traps. However, existing Animal ReID datasets rely exclusively on visual data, overlooking environmental metadata that ecologists have identified as highly correlated with animal behavior and identity, such as temperature and circadian rhythms. Meanwhile, modern vision-language models (VLMs) offer rich multimodal reasoning capabilities, but existing resources underutilize their text-processing potential. To address these limitations, we propose MetaWild, a multimodal Animal ReID dataset comprising 20,890 images across six species, paired with environmental metadata extracted from embedded camera trap overlays and scene contexts. Additionally, to facilitate the use of metadata in existing ReID methods, we propose the Meta-Feature Adapter (MFA), a lightweight module that can be incorporated into existing VLM-based ReID methods, allowing ReID models to leverage both environmental metadata and visual information to improve ReID performance. Experiments on MetaWild show that combining baseline ReID models with MFA to incorporate metadata consistently improves performance compared to using visual information alone, validating the effectiveness of incorporating metadata in re-identification.

papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: ThinkNet: Evolutionary Deep Ensembles for Efficient Motor-Imagery EEG Classification
papers.abstract_en: Practical assistive and rehabilitative brain--computer interfaces require subject-independent motor-imagery EEG (MI-EEG) decoders that generalize to new users under limited target-user data and constrained compute. However, held-out-subject performance can be overstated when test-subject information influences preprocessing, model selection, or ensemble selection. We present \textit{ThinkNet}, a validation-controlled framework that combines train-only normalization, validation-guided evolutionary search, and validation-gated inference to identify compact decoders and inference policies for held-out subjects. We evaluate four-class BCI Competition IV-2a (session T) decoding with nine Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) folds, three seeds, seven fixed decoder entries, and a broader search over ten representative decoder families; the held-out subject is never used for normalization, hyperparameter, architecture, or ensemble-policy selection. In the fixed benchmark, the validation-selected compact decoder achieved 44.35$\pm$15.41\% accuracy with 4.9K parameters, 19 KB FP32 weights, and 0.99 ms batch-1 Orin CUDA inference. Across the broader search, compact models ($\leq$25K parameters) achieved higher mean held-out accuracy than mid-size and large alternatives after selected retraining (40.10\% vs. 35.09\% and 34.78\%). Validation-gated ensembling improved over validation-selected single-model inference, reaching 43.98$\pm$16.25\% in the fixed benchmark and 43.31$\pm$15.88\% for the compact six-family ensemble. A non-deployable oracle analysis revealed a 6.1-point family-selection gap and near-zero validation--test correlation, showing that validation reliability remains a key bottleneck under subject shift. Thus, ThinkNet is a validation-controlled framework for compact MI-EEG model and inference-policy selection, rather than a single-architecture benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ThinkNet 是面向被试外 (LOSO) 运动想象 EEG 解码的验证受控框架：训练集归一化、验证集引导的进化搜索、验证门控推理，三者共同决定紧凑解码器与集成策略，被试信息绝不进入归一化、超参、结构或集成选择。在 BCI Competition IV-2a 四分类上，验证选中的紧凑解码器 44.35±15.41%（4.9K 参数、19 KB FP32、Orin batch-1 0.99 ms），验证门控集成在固定基准达 43.98±16.25%；oracle 分析暴露 6.1 分的族选择差距与近零验证-测试相关，说明被试偏移下验证可靠性仍是瓶颈。
Motivation: 被试外 MI-EEG 解码要在目标用户数据与算力都受限时泛化到新用户，但若测试被试信息渗入预处理、模型选择或集成选择，留出被试性能会被高估。
Method: 三段式验证受控流程：train-only 归一化、验证集引导的进化搜索 (validation-guided evolutionary search)、验证门控推理 (validation-gated inference)；评测为 BCI Competition IV-2a 四分类 session T，9 个 LOSO 折、3 个随机种子、7 个固定解码器条目，并在 10 个代表性解码器族上做更广搜索，另做不可部署的 oracle 分析。
Result: 固定基准中验证选中的紧凑解码器 44.35±15.41% 准确率、4.9K 参数、19 KB FP32 权重、Orin CUDA batch-1 推理 0.99 ms；更广搜索中 ≤25K 参数模型经选定重训练后平均留出准确率 40.10%，高于中型 35.09% 与大型 34.78%；验证门控集成在固定基准 43.98±16.25%，紧凑六族集成 43.31±15.88%；oracle 分析给出 6.1 分的族选择差距与近零验证-测试相关。
Conclusion: ThinkNet 是用于选择紧凑 MI-EEG 模型与推理策略的验证受控框架，而非单一架构基准；在被试偏移下，验证可靠性本身是主要瓶颈，且小模型在该设置下比中大型更有优势。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: LLM4Trust: Exploring the Capabilities of Large Language Models for Trust Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Trust evaluation plays a critical role in cybersecurity by supporting risk mitigation and decision-making. A variety of trust evaluation methods have been proposed, with learning-based approaches offering high accuracy and automation. However, they often require substantial ground truth, suffer from low training efficiency, lack support for basic trust properties, and provide limited explainability. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a compelling alternative due to their strong zero-/few-shot reasoning abilities and broad knowledge. To this end, we propose LLM4Trust, the first benchmark framework that systematically explores the capabilities of LLMs for trust evaluation. We first construct diverse trust graphs to model five basic trust properties and design corresponding property understanding tasks. We then assess the ability of eight representative LLMs to understand these properties under nine prompt methods. Based on this exploration, we identify the most effective LLM-prompt combinations and apply them to five real-world datasets for validating LLMs' trust evaluation capability. During this process, we propose two strategies to extract key information from large-scale trust graphs, addressing the context window limitations of LLMs. Extensive experiments show that LLMs can effectively understand basic trust properties and have great potential for real-world trust evaluation, particularly under limited supervision. However, they remain vulnerable to attacks targeting trust graphs and demonstration examples used in few-shot prompting, and incur high inference costs. Accordingly, we propose a defense mechanism and batch inference to improve the robustness and efficiency of LLM-based trust evaluation. The source code of LLM4Trust is available at https://github.com/Jieerbobo/LLM4Trust
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM4Trust 是首个系统评估大语言模型信任评估能力的基准框架：构建覆盖五种基本信任属性的信任图并设计属性理解任务，用八个代表性 LLM 在九种提示方法下测试，再把最优 LLM-提示组合迁移到五个真实数据集。结果表明 LLM 在有限监督下能有效理解信任属性并具实用潜力，但对针对信任图与 few-shot 示例的攻击脆弱、推理成本高，作者据此提出防御机制与批推理。
Motivation: 现有基于学习的信任评估方法依赖大量标注真值、训练效率低、不支持基本信任属性且可解释性有限，而 LLM 的零/少样本推理能力提供了一条替代路径，但其能力边界此前未被系统刻画。
Method: 构建多样信任图建模五种基本信任属性并设计对应属性理解任务；用九种提示方法评估八个代表性 LLM 的属性理解能力，选出最有效的 LLM-提示组合后应用到五个真实数据集；针对信任图超出上下文窗口的问题提出两种大规模信任图关键信息抽取策略，并补充防御机制与批推理。
Result: 实验显示 LLM 能有效理解基本信任属性，在有限监督下对真实世界信任评估有较大潜力；同时暴露两类脆弱点——针对信任图的攻击与针对 few-shot demonstration 示例的攻击，以及较高的推理成本。
Conclusion: LLM 可作为信任评估的可行路径，但部署前提是同时加上针对信任图/示例的防御与批推理以换取鲁棒性和效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VaME: Exploring Variational Latent Reasoning for Multimodal Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Universal multimodal retrieval requires compact embeddings that preserve task-relevant semantic information across diverse modalities. Prior works have incorporated latent reasoning into multimodal embedding learning to refine this information before embedding extraction. However, most existing approaches remain confined to deterministic latent paths, without exploring alternative trajectories to discover better embeddings. Thus, we propose VaME (Variational Multimodal Embeddings), a framework that models latent reasoning as a learnable distribution over trajectories. Specifically, we first introduce Variational Latent Reasoning (VLR) to enable autoregressive exploration in latent space, guided by answer reconstruction through a lightweight decoder. Meanwhile, we augment the original embedding-token readout with a latent-fused embedding to facilitate exploration during subsequent reinforcement learning. Finally, we optimize latent reasoning over stochastic variational trajectories through reinforcement learning, using Semantic Decoding Reward (SDR) to favor semantically meaningful trajectories with interpretable decoded outcomes. On the 78-task MMEB-V2 benchmark, spanning image, video, and visual-document retrieval, VaME outperforms most explicit CoT-based models and all latent-reasoning baselines. VaME also demonstrates robust performance on reasoning-intensive benchmarks such as MRMR, with substantial gains after reinforcement learning. Importantly, VaME achieves these gains with at least a 4.25x inference speedup over the deterministic latent autoregressive baselines. The code will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VaME 把多模态检索中的隐层推理建模为可学习的轨迹分布，用变分隐空间自回归探索 (VLR) 加语义解码奖励 (SDR) 的强化学习挑选语义有效轨迹。在 78 任务的 MMEB-V2 上超过多数显式 CoT 模型与全部隐推理基线，并在 MRMR 上于强化学习后取得明显提升，同时相对确定性隐自回归基线至少 4.25 倍推理加速。
Motivation: 通用多模态检索需要紧凑且保留任务相关语义的嵌入，但既有隐推理方法局限于确定性隐路径，无法探索替代轨迹以发现更好的嵌入。
Method: VaME 三部分：Variational Latent Reasoning (VLR) 在隐空间做自回归探索，由轻量 decoder 的答案重建引导；在原 embedding-token 读出之外增加 latent-fused embedding 供后续强化学习探索；用 Semantic Decoding Reward (SDR) 在随机变分轨迹上做强化学习，奖励语义可解码的轨迹。
Result: 在 78 任务 MMEB-V2（图像、视频、视觉文档检索）上超过多数显式 CoT 模型与全部隐推理基线；在推理密集的 MRMR 上强化学习后有 substantial gains；相对确定性隐自回归基线推理加速至少 4.25 倍。
Conclusion: 把隐推理从确定性路径换成变分轨迹分布并用语义奖励做强化学习，可在多模态检索上同时拿到更好的嵌入与更快的推理。

summary_sections.conclusion: 把隐推理从确定性路径换成变分轨迹分布并用语义奖励做强化学习，可在多模态检索上同时拿到更好的嵌入与更快的推理。

papers.title: Benchmarking Attention for Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Tabular in-context learners such as TabPFN, Mitra, or ConTextTab rely on alternating row and column attention over 2D sequences of latent embeddings. These attention patterns differ markedly from the one-dimensional case in language models: row attention involves longer sequences while column attention operates on much shorter ones, and the strided memory layout of tabular data makes producing contiguous tensors costly. Moreover, the hidden dimensions used in current models are small compared to recent language models. Yet efficient attention has been studied mostly for one-dimensional sequences, leaving the two-dimensional tabular setting unexplored. To this end, we create a reproducible benchmarking setup and study the unique characteristics of tabular attention across several backends -- Torch SDPA (efficient and cuDNN), FlashAttention-2/3/4, and the inference-only backends vLLM and SageAttention -- measuring forward and backward throughput across realistic tabular shapes on three GPU generations (A100, H100, B200). We find that the optimal backend choice differs between column and row attention and varies across hardware as well as model specifics: While the FlashAttention implementations tailored for each GPU generation perform overall best, they are at times outperformed by CuDNN in the case of column attention at longer sequences with cross-over points depending on the head dimension. Among inference-only backends, SageAttention performs well for row attention and large sequences beyond 16\,k rows. Our reproducible benchmark lays the foundation for future improvements to table-native attention. The self-contained benchmarking and evaluation code is openly available at: https://github.com/SAP-samples/tabular-attention-benchmark
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 TabPFN、Mitra、ConTextTab 这类表格 in-context learner 的行列交替 attention，建立可复现的吞吐基准，覆盖 Torch SDPA（efficient/cuDNN）、FlashAttention-2/3/4、vLLM、SageAttention，在 A100/H100/B200 三代 GPU 上测前向与反向吞吐。结论是后端选择随 attention 类型而变：FlashAttention 总体最好，但列 attention 在长序列上常被 cuDNN 反超，交叉点取决于 head dimension；推理专用后端中 SageAttention 在超过 16k 行的行 attention 上表现好。
Motivation: 高效 attention 几乎都在一维语言序列上研究，而表格模型的行 attention 序列长、列 attention 序列短，且表格数据的 strided 内存布局使连续张量构造昂贵、hidden dimension 又偏小，二维表格设定此前无人系统测过。
Method: 搭建可复现基准，按真实表格形状分别测行 attention 与列 attention 的前向/反向吞吐，后端包括 Torch SDPA（efficient 与 cuDNN）、FlashAttention-2/3/4，以及仅推理的 vLLM 与 SageAttention；硬件覆盖 A100、H100、B200 三代 GPU。
Result: FlashAttention 各代实现总体吞吐最佳；列 attention 在较长序列上 cuDNN 时有反超，交叉点随 head dimension 变化；推理后端中 SageAttention 在行 attention 且行数超过 16k 时表现好；最优后端在列/行 attention 之间、不同硬件与模型细节之间均不同。
Conclusion: 表格 attention 的后端选择不能沿用一维语言模型的默认答案，需按列/行 attention、序列长度、head dimension 与 GPU 代际分别选；该基准与代码开源，用于支撑后续 table-native attention 改进。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Claim-Gated Source-Risk Auditing for Generative Search
papers.abstract_en: A generative search answer can cite a supported passage yet omit a source relationship that changes its interpretation. We specify a claim-gated audit of the query-source-answer tuple. An omission is resolved only when relationship evidence, answer adoption, materiality, and disclosure are all observed; incomplete evidence remains unresolved rather than being treated as independence. The specification separates this endpoint from citation support and review priority, and binds decisions to versioned evidence spans. A reference checker makes the record contract executable. On an exhaustive synthetic suite, it reproduces all 81 three-state predicate combinations and rejects 192 deliberately malformed records. Common-guard baselines and predicate ablations isolate endpoint logic from missing-evidence handling, while controlled transitions check support separation and evidence removal. These are finite contract-conformance results, not detector accuracy or evidence of improved user outcomes. We define the independent annotation, held-out evaluation, and paired utility tests still required to establish semantic validity and deployment benefit.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at IEEE AI2A 2026. Author accepted manuscript. Reproducibility artifact: https://zenodo.org/records/23180013
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对生成式搜索中「引用了支持性段落却遗漏改变含义的来源关系」这一漏洞，提出 claim-gated 来源风险审计：只有关系证据、答案采纳、实质性与披露四项同时观测到才判定遗漏已解决，证据不全则保持 unresolved 而非当作独立。在穷举合成套件上复现全部 81 个三态谓词组合、拒绝 192 条故意构造的畸形记录。
Motivation: 生成式搜索的答案可以给出有支撑的引用，却省略会改变解读的来源关系；现有做法把证据缺失与引用支持、审查优先级混在一起，无法区分「无关系」与「未观测到关系」。
Method: 把 query-source-answer 三元组的审计写成 claim-gated 规范，用关系证据、答案采纳、实质性、披露四个谓词的合取决定终点，并把判定绑定到带版本的证据 span；用 reference checker 让记录契约可执行，再用 common-guard 基线与谓词消融分离终点逻辑与缺证据处理，用受控状态转移检查支持分离与证据移除。
Result: 在穷举合成套件上复现全部 81 个三态谓词组合，拒绝 192 条故意构造的畸形记录；common-guard 基线与谓词消融隔离了终点逻辑与缺证据处理，受控转移检验了 support 分离与证据移除。作者明确这些是有限的契约一致性结果，不是检测器准确率或用户收益证据。
Conclusion: 来源关系遗漏必须按四谓词合取判定、缺证据保持 unresolved，才能与 citation support 和审查优先级分开；语义有效性与部署收益还需独立标注、留出集评估与配对效用检验来建立。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Useful to Whom? The Easy-versus-Coverage Boundary Moves with the Learner
papers.abstract_en: Is the same data equally useful to every learner? The question is whether the value of a training sample belongs to the sample or arises in its interaction with the learner. We test it with a selection experiment. Under a per-class budget, two kinds of samples compete for the slots: easy samples, which a short training run learns first, and coverage samples, which spread over the class in feature space. Easy samples win at small budgets and coverage samples at large ones, and the budget at which the winner flips, the crossover m0, can be measured. We ask whether m0 is set by the data or by the learner. To separate the two, we freeze the selected subsets and change only the learner that trains on them. On low-resolution ImageNet-100, doubling the width of a ResNet-18 moves the crossover from 57 to 85 samples per class on the same subsets. Enlarging the input grid from 32 to 64 pixels at fixed image information moves it from 85 to 57, and a single stride change reproduces or removes this shift. The grid shift shrinks as width grows. Under the native ImageNet-1k protocol, a 4x range of width moves the boundary by at most a few samples per class. On a Vision Transformer, coverage wins at every measured budget, even with easy subsets that work on the convolutional learner. The budget at which one kind of sample stops being the more useful kind therefore belongs to the learner, and the preferred regime of a selection strategy has to be read against the learner that will use the data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文用选择实验判定训练样本的价值属于学习器而非样本本身：在每类预算下让“易样本”（短训练先学会）与“覆盖样本”（在特征空间铺开）竞争名额，赢家翻转的预算 m0 可测且随学习器移动。在低分辨率 ImageNet-100 上，ResNet-18 宽度加倍把 m0 从每类 57 推到 85；输入网格从 32 像素扩到 64 像素（图像信息不变）把它从 85 拉回 57，单个 stride 改动即可复现或消除该移动，且网格效应随宽度增大而缩小。
Motivation: 数据选择策略通常假设样本价值是数据的固有属性，但同一子集在不同学习器下可能给出相反的“易样本 vs 覆盖样本”结论，导致选择策略的最优预算区间无法脱离使用者来谈。
Method: 在每类预算约束下做选择实验，让短训练先学会的易样本与在类内特征空间铺开的覆盖样本竞争名额，测出赢家翻转的交叉预算 m0；随后冻结已选子集、只更换训练学习器（ResNet-18 宽度、输入网格 32→64 像素、单个 stride 改动、Vision Transformer），观察 m0 移动。
Result: 低分辨率 ImageNet-100 上，ResNet-18 宽度加倍使 m0 从每类 57 移到 85；固定图像信息下输入网格从 32 扩到 64 像素使 m0 从 85 移回 57，单个 stride 改动可复现或消除该移动，网格移动量随宽度增大而缩小。原生 ImageNet-1k 协议下，4 倍宽度范围最多只把边界移动每类几个样本。在 Vision Transformer 上，覆盖样本在所有测得预算下都胜出，即使对应的易样本子集在卷积学习器上有效。
Conclusion: 一种样本何时从“更易”变为“更有用”取决于学习器，数据选择策略的偏好区间必须对照最终使用数据的学习器来解读，而非当作数据的固有属性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: JEV-as-a-Judge: Accept When Confident, Escalate When Unsure
papers.abstract_en: LLM-as-a-judge scales evaluation, but reasoning judges are slow and costly. We study JEV-as-a-Judge: evaluation with JEV, a decision-only judge that returns label probabilities instead of text, and whose confidence decides whether to accept its verdict or escalate to a reasoning judge. Against sixteen generative and reward-model judges, with blinded human adjudication, JEV comes within three points of GPT-6 wherever a verdict can be read off the text, at 0.36% of its fee and a 0.15-second median latency, and falls behind where the verdict must be derived, as in math, code, and logic. Its confidence marks this boundary. With a threshold frozen in advance, accepting confident verdicts and escalating the rest is 0.9 points more accurate than GPT-6 on 1,610 held-out pairs at 41% of its fee, and in a pre-specified live test on two new workloads the cascade matches GPT-6's accuracy exactly. Confidence routing weakens on style-adversarial pairs and reference-free prose; we close with a simple recipe for validating thresholds locally.
papers.comment: An open-source Jev's alternative comparison is added to appendix A
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 JEV-as-a-Judge：用只输出标签概率的 decision-only 判官 JEV 给评分，置信度高就直接采纳、置信度低才升级到 reasoning judge。在 1,610 对留出样本上，冻结阈值的级联比 GPT-6 准确率高 0.9 个百分点、费用为其 41%，在两个新工作负载的预设线上测试中准确率与 GPT-6 完全持平。
Motivation: LLM-as-a-judge 已能规模化评估，但 reasoning judge 又慢又贵；需要在可读出结论的任务上用便宜的判官替代，同时在需要推导的任务上保留推理判官。
Method: JEV 是 decision-only 判官，只返回标签概率而非文本；按其置信度决定接受判决或升级到 reasoning judge，阈值事先冻结。对照十六个生成式与 reward-model 判官，采用盲评人工裁决 (blinded human adjudication)，并做预设的线上测试。
Result: 在结论可直接从文本读出的任务上，JEV 与 GPT-6 差距在 3 个百分点以内，费用为 GPT-6 的 0.36%，中位延迟 0.15 秒；在需要推导的数学、代码、逻辑任务上落后。冻结阈值的接受/升级级联在 1,610 对留出样本上比 GPT-6 准确率高 0.9 个百分点、费用为其 41%；在两个新工作负载的预设线上测试中准确率与 GPT-6 完全一致。置信度路由在风格对抗样本 (style-adversarial pairs) 与无参考散文 (reference-free prose) 上变弱。
Conclusion: JEV 的置信度能标出它与 reasoning judge 的能力边界，按置信度做级联可用约四成费用达到 GPT-6 的准确率；阈值需在本地验证，且在风格对抗与无参考文本上要谨慎。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RLVR$^{2}$: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rubric-based Ranking
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is expanding from tasks with well-defined correctness signals, such as mathematics and code, toward multifaceted quality requirements specified by multi-dimensional rubrics. Since policy optimization consumes one scalar per rollout, rubric-based pipelines must map multiple criterion scores into a scalar reward. This aggregation is often treated as score scaling, but it implicitly determines how quality dimensions trade off during training. The prevailing practice, normalizing each criterion and taking a linear combination, assumes that cardinal score differences are comparable across criteria and that gains on one criterion compensate for failures on another; both assumptions are unreliable when criteria are semantically heterogeneous. We propose Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rubric-based Ranking (RLVR$^2$), a verifiable ranking paradigm for rubric-based RLVR. For each criterion, RLVR$^2$ converts rubric scores into criterion-specific within-group ordinal outcomes, recovers a latent utility from the resulting comparison matrix, and merges these utilities into one training signal. By retaining only within-group ordering and discarding raw score magnitudes, RLVR$^2$ avoids calibrating heterogeneous rubric scales. It further supports objective-preserving attribute adjustment: auxiliary attributes that correlate with observed rankings but are not training objectives can enter the estimation without expanding the rubric or rewarding them directly. Across three model scales and 16 benchmarks, RLVR$^2$ consistently outperforms representative rubric-based baselines, achieving the best overall performance on most benchmarks at every scale. Analysis shows it controls systematic effects tied to reasoning efficiency and response formatting while preserving the quality objective.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RLVR² 把多维 rubric 打分转成每个准则的组内序数结果，从比较矩阵恢复潜在效用再合并为单一训练信号，只保留组内排序、丢弃原始分数幅度，从而避开异构 rubric 尺度的校准问题。在三个模型规模、16 个 benchmark 上一致优于代表性 rubric 基线，并在多数 benchmark 上取得最佳整体表现。
Motivation: RLVR 正从数学、代码等有明确正确性信号的任务扩展到多维 rubric 描述的多面质量要求，但把多准则分数聚合成标量奖励的做法隐含决定了训练中各质量维度的权衡，逐准则归一化加线性组合依赖跨准则基数可比与维度间可补偿这两个不可靠假设。
Method: RLVR² 对每个准则把 rubric 分数转成准则内的组内序数结果 (within-group ordinal outcomes)，由得到的比较矩阵恢复潜在效用 (latent utility)，再把各准则效用合并为单一训练信号；只保留组内排序、丢弃原始分数幅度。同时支持目标保持的属性调整：与观测排序相关但非训练目标的辅助属性可进入估计，既不扩大 rubric 也不直接奖励它们。
Result: 在三个模型规模和 16 个 benchmark 上，RLVR² 一致优于代表性 rubric 基线，在每个规模的大多数 benchmark 上取得最佳整体表现；分析显示它在保持质量目标的同时，控制了与推理效率和回复格式相关的系统性效应。
Conclusion: 把 rubric 聚合从分数缩放改为可验证的排序范式，可以避免异构准则尺度校准，并在不奖励辅助属性的前提下抑制推理效率与格式带来的系统性偏差。

papers.title: Trust, but Validate the Instrument: Auditing AI-Generated RTL Verification Plans on Authored Security-Regression Proxies
papers.abstract_en: AI-generated RTL verification plans can satisfy a provider schema yet fail at the boundary to trusted execution. We present SecTB-RTL, an auditable framework covering 31 tasks and 124 authored hardware-security regressions. A deterministic non-AI baseline killed 36, 75, and 78 mutants at increasing resource limits. The first confirmatory run (C1-R2) failed before model execution because the provider rejected its response schema. After a schema-only repair made without viewing outcomes, a separately frozen follow-up run (C1-R3) completed 1,860 calls. The provider accepted 1,857 responses, but only nine passed the production semantic validator. The generation and execution rules did not match. We therefore preserve the run as an instrument-validation incident and report no prompt-effect estimate. This incident shows that provider or schema acceptance does not establish execution validity. Compilation and coverage are only diagnostics; the exact saved artifact must pass the full production path. A subsequent follow-up is excluded because it did not satisfy the preregistered evidence-completeness gate and is treated only as future work. We release the benchmark, failure-preserving contract, incident provenance, and governance controls needed to prevent infrastructure behavior from being misreported as model behavior.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 3 table. Accepted at IEEE Cyber-AI 2026. Author accepted manuscript. Reproducibility artifact: https://zenodo.org/records/23230656
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SecTB-RTL 把 AI 生成的 RTL 验证计划审计落到生产语义校验器上：31 个任务、124 条自撰硬件安全回归，1,860 次调用中 1,857 条被 provider 接受，但仅 9 条通过生产语义校验。作者把该次运行定性为仪器验证事故，不报告 prompt 效应估计，并主张 provider/schema 接受不等于执行有效。
Motivation: AI 生成的 RTL 验证计划可以满足 provider schema 却在通往可信执行的边界上失败；若把基础设施行为误报为模型行为，会污染对生成效果的判断。
Method: 提出可审计框架 SecTB-RTL，覆盖 31 个任务与 124 条自撰硬件安全回归；设确定性非 AI 基线并按资源上限递增运行；C1-R2 因 provider 拒绝响应 schema 在模型执行前失败，仅做不看结果的 schema 修复后冻结 C1-R3，完成 1,860 次调用，并保留失败现场、事故溯源与治理控制。
Result: 确定性非 AI 基线在递增资源上限下分别 kill 36、75、78 个 mutant；C1-R3 完成 1,860 次调用，provider 接受 1,857 条响应，仅 9 条通过生产语义校验器；作者不报告 prompt 效应估计，另一次后续运行因未满足预注册证据完备门槛被排除。
Conclusion: provider 或 schema 接受不能确立执行有效性，编译与覆盖率只是诊断，必须让保存的产物走完整生产路径；生成与执行规则不匹配时应保留为仪器验证事故而非模型结论。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A multimodal large language model for evidence-based autism spectrum disorder screening
papers.abstract_en: The clinical management of autism spectrum disorder (ASD) faces a bottleneck in early screening, mainly because trained specialists are scarce and conventional assessment tools are subjective. Here, we introduce ASDchat, a multimodal large language model designed for evidence-based ASD screening, which takes video, audio, and dialogue as input. ASDchat adopts a dual-branch architecture, where the decision branch generates screening probabilities and the evidence branch generates traceable, timestamped behavioral evidence aligned with the Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule (ADOS-2). The model was trained and evaluated on a dataset of 1,035 participants from 27 sites in China, which covered typically developing (TD) children, children with ASD, and children with other developmental disorders. For ASD versus TD, ASDchat reached an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.953 $\pm$ 0.021. On 6 held-out sites that were not used for training, the mean AUC was 0.961. Furthermore, unsupervised clustering of the behavioral dimensions split the ASD cases into six subtypes with different phenotypic profiles, and ASDchat suggests an intervention for each subtype. ASDchat provides a feasible path for large-scale, evidence-based ASD screening in clinical practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ASDchat：一个以视频、音频、对话为输入的多模态大语言模型，用双分支架构同时输出筛查概率和可追溯、带时间戳且对齐 ADOS-2 的行为证据。在中国 27 个站点 1,035 名受试者上，ASD 对典型发育 (TD) 的 AUC 为 0.953 ± 0.021，6 个未参与训练的留出站点平均 AUC 0.961。
Motivation: 自闭症谱系障碍 (ASD) 早期筛查受限于受训专业人员稀缺，且常规评估工具主观性强，难以大规模开展。
Method: ASDchat 采用双分支架构：决策分支生成筛查概率，证据分支生成可追溯、带时间戳、与 Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule (ADOS-2) 对齐的行为证据；输入为视频、音频与对话，在 27 个站点的 1,035 名受试者数据集上训练与评估，覆盖典型发育 (TD) 儿童、ASD 儿童及其他发育障碍儿童。
Result: ASD 对 TD 的 AUC 为 0.953 ± 0.021；在 6 个未用于训练的留出站点上平均 AUC 为 0.961。对行为维度做无监督聚类，将 ASD 病例分为 6 个表型不同的亚型，并为每个亚型推荐干预方案。
Conclusion: 证据驱动的多模态 LLM 可为临床大规模 ASD 筛查提供可行路径，同时给出可审查的行为证据与亚型层面的干预建议。

papers.title: IBBench-Light: A Paired Evaluation of Task-Conditioned Responses to External Directives
papers.abstract_en: An external record may contain a procedure to apply or text to read, depending on the user's request. IBBench-Light tests both uses against the same record. Twelve semantic bases yield 144 matched pairs per model; four quantized instruction models produced 1,152 archived greedy responses. Paired exact-contract accuracy (PECA) requires both members to satisfy their output contracts. Qwen succeeds on 132 execute and 109 process prompts, but only 97 complete pairs, showing what marginal averages omit. We audit literal-target exposure and case normalization, then add 1,722 logged CPU generations to test directive-absent controls, twelve additional semantic bases, within-base wording changes, and generation stopping. In the pinned Phi rerun, changing the end-of-sequence (EOS) set changes exact paired success from 0/144 to 62/144. A bounded IHEval comparison uses the same SmolLM2 checkpoint and output budget while preserving its published instruction roles and scorer. The benchmark measures conditional task and output-contract success. Its task margins and paired count need to be read together with the stopping policy.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 5 table. Accepted at IEEE ACAIT 2026. Author accepted manuscript. Reproducibility artifact: https://zenodo.org/records/23074369
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IBBench-Light 把同一外部记录的两种用法（按指令执行、按文本处理）配对测试，提出配对精确契约准确率 (PECA) 要求一对成员同时满足各自输出契约。四个量化指令模型共产生 1,152 条贪心存档响应，Qwen 在 132 条 execute 与 109 条 process 提示上成功，但完整配对仅 97/144，说明边际均值掩盖了配对失败；EOS 集合改动使精确配对成功从 0/144 变到 62/144，任务裕度必须与停止策略一起读。
Motivation: 外部记录既可能含待执行程序也可能含待读文本，现有评测按单一角色计分，边际平均掩盖同一记录上两种用法同时失败的情况。
Method: 以 12 个语义基构造每模型 144 个配对样本，对四个量化指令模型采 1,152 条贪心响应并存档；定义 PECA 要求配对两成员同时满足输出契约，审计字面目标暴露与大小写归一化，再加 1,722 条 CPU 日志生成测试指令缺失对照、12 个额外语义基、基内措辞变化与生成停止；并以同一 SmolLM2 checkpoint 与输出预算做有界的 IHEval 对比，保留其发布的指令角色与评分器。
Result: Qwen 在 132 条 execute 与 109 条 process 提示上成功，但完整配对仅 97/144；追加 1,722 条 CPU 生成；在固定 Phi 重跑中改变 EOS 集合使精确配对成功从 0/144 变为 62/144；共 12 个语义基、每模型 144 配对、4 个量化模型、1,152 条存档响应。
Conclusion: 任务裕度与配对计数必须连同停止策略一起解读，单看边际平均会高估条件任务与输出契约成功率。
