papers.title: Nonsmooth Optimization via Orthogonalized Momentum
papers.abstract_en: Modern real application problems involve matrix-valued parameters, yet conventional optimizers treat them as vectors, thereby motivating matrix-aware methods that exploit input-output geometry, such as Muon which orthogonalizes the momentum matrices before parameter updates. Its empirical success raises a conceptual question: can orthogonalized momentum remain effective beyond smooth optimization? This paper studies this question for locally Lipschitz functions using a generalized derivative framework compatible with backpropagation. Our first contribution is to identify a key limitation: for every fixed momentum factor $β\in[0,1)$, Muon can fail to approach the global optimal solution of a convex Lipschitz objective from almost every initialization, when step sizes adapt to the full gradient history. The failure can occur even along bounded iterates. Our example is inspired by the one of Parshakova et al. which only covers $β\in[0,\frac{1}{2})$. Then, we show that the obstruction lies in fixed momentum rather than orthogonalization. Indeed, when the momentum factor is adaptive and approaches 1 together with a vanishing step size, Muon recovers asymptotic convergence for nonconvex nonsmooth optimization under the boundedness and regularity conditions. Moreover, we propose MAGD, which combines orthogonalized momentum with gradient, weighted based on their relative progress. MAGD retains asymptotic convergence in nonconvex settings and achieves an $O(\min\{m,n\}ε^{-2})$ rate in convex settings. A lower bound shows the optimal dimension dependence. Experiments on synthetic problems, image classification, and LLM pretraining show MAGD is a simple and practical alternative to Muon. Together, our results characterize when orthogonalized momentum fails without smoothness and how it can be made reliable and we hope that the analysis may be useful more broadly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文在局部 Lipschitz（非光滑）框架下分析正交化动量优化器 Muon：对任意固定动量因子 β∈[0,1)，即使步长随完整梯度历史自适应、迭代点有界，Muon 也可能从几乎每个初始点都无法逼近凸 Lipschitz 目标的全局最优；障碍来自固定动量而非正交化本身。作者提出 MAGD，按相对进展加权融合正交化动量与梯度，在非光滑非凸下保持渐近收敛，凸情形达到 O(min{m,n}ε^{-2}) 速率，并给出匹配的维度下界。
Motivation: Muon 在实践中以正交化动量处理矩阵参数取得成功，但它在非光滑（局部 Lipschitz）目标上是否仍有效缺乏理论刻画；固定动量因子可能在有界迭代下系统性失败，需要区分失败来源是正交化还是动量机制。
Method: 在与反向传播兼容的广义导数 (generalized derivative) 框架下分析 Muon：构造反例说明固定 β∈[0,1) 的失败，并推广 Parshakova et al. 仅覆盖 β∈[0,1/2) 的例子；随后令动量因子自适应趋近 1、步长趋零以恢复非凸非光滑渐近收敛；再提出 MAGD，按相对进展对正交化动量与梯度加权融合。
Result: 固定 β∈[0,1) 时 Muon 可从几乎每个初始化不收敛到凸 Lipschitz 目标全局最优，且可在有界迭代下发生（推广 β∈[0,1/2) 的已知反例）；动量因子自适应趋 1 且步长趋零时 Muon 在有界性与正则性条件下恢复非凸非光滑渐近收敛；MAGD 在非凸情形保持渐近收敛，凸情形达 O(min{m,n}ε^{-2}) 速率，下界给出最优维度依赖；实验覆盖合成问题、图像分类与 LLM 预训练。
Conclusion: 正交化动量在缺少光滑性时的失效根源是固定动量而非正交化，通过自适应动量与梯度融合（MAGD）可以使其可靠，并给出最优维度依赖的收敛速率。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 论文在局部 Lipschitz（非光滑）框架下分析正交化动量优化器 Muon：对任意固定动量因子 β∈[0,1)，即使步长随完整梯度历史自适应、迭代点有界，Muon 也可能从几乎每个初始点都无法逼近凸 Lipschitz 目标的全局最优；障碍来自固定动量而非正交化本身。作者提出 MAGD，按相对进展加权融合正交化动量与梯度，在非光滑非凸下保持渐近收敛，凸情形达到 O(min{m,n}ε^{-2}) 速率，并给出匹配的维度下界。
summary_sections.motivation: Muon 在实践中以正交化动量处理矩阵参数取得成功，但它在非光滑（局部 Lipschitz）目标上是否仍有效缺乏理论刻画；固定动量因子可能在有界迭代下系统性失败，需要区分失败来源是正交化还是动量机制。
summary_sections.method: 在与反向传播兼容的广义导数 (generalized derivative) 框架下分析 Muon：构造反例说明固定 β∈[0,1) 的失败，并推广 Parshakova et al. 仅覆盖 β∈[0,1/2) 的例子；随后令动量因子自适应趋近 1、步长趋零以恢复非凸非光滑渐近收敛；再提出 MAGD，按相对进展对正交化动量与梯度加权融合。
summary_sections.result: 固定 β∈[0,1) 时 Muon 可从几乎每个初始化不收敛到凸 Lipschitz 目标全局最优，且可在有界迭代下发生（推广 β∈[0,1/2) 的已知反例）；动量因子自适应趋 1 且步长趋零时 Muon 在有界性与正则性条件下恢复非凸非光滑渐近收敛；MAGD 在非凸情形保持渐近收敛，凸情形达 O(min{m,n}ε^{-2}) 速率，下界给出最优维度依赖；实验覆盖合成问题、图像分类与 LLM 预训练。
summary_sections.conclusion: 正交化动量在缺少光滑性时的失效根源是固定动量而非正交化，通过自适应动量与梯度融合（MAGD）可以使其可靠，并给出最优维度依赖的收敛速率。

papers.title: The Convention Gap: Beyond Literal Content in Human-AI Cooperation
papers.abstract_en: Cooperative AI agents are often evaluated against other AIs, yet human cooperation is thought to rely on implicit conventions: shared rules for reading meaning beyond the literal message. We propose the convention gap as a diagnostic of such implicit communication. In the card game Hanabi, where hints are the only messages about one's own hand, the convention gap is the failure probability predicted exactly from the literal content of the hints and the visible cards, minus the observed failure rate of the cards played. We prove that the population gap (the value the gap approaches over many games) is zero when the partner's choices convey nothing beyond their literal content, given a fair shuffle and a player who uses only what was said and seen. A nonzero population gap thus indicates that partner choices conveyed more; it does not measure how much. The gap was +26.2 percentage points (pp) in public human-human games (+46 pp on plays of cards that no hint had pointed to), +16.4 pp for human plays with AI partners, and -0.6 pp in AI-AI games we simulated among rule-based agents. With three AI agents of a published human-AI study, the literal failure probability of the cards humans played was similar across partners (38-41%), yet human failure ranged from 14.4% to 34.4% and the gap from +24.1 to +6.2 pp, and the contrast between partners persisted within participants. Across five levels of Off-Belief Learning agents, trained so that the first level reads past actions only for their literal content and each higher level interprets more, the gap rose monotonically from +1.6 to +21.7 pp. These results argue for reporting the convention gap on human-partnered play, not only AI-AI performance, when evaluating agents intended for human partners.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出「惯例差 (convention gap)」作为人机隐式沟通的诊断量：在 Hanabi 中用提示字面内容与可见牌预测的失败概率减去实际出牌失败率，证明当伙伴选择不携带字面之外信息时总体差为零。公开人人对局差为 +26.2pp（未被提示指到的牌上 +46pp），人-AI 对局 +16.4pp，规则型 AI-AI 模拟仅 -0.6pp；五级 Off-Belief Learning 代理随解读层级升高从 +1.6pp 单调升到 +21.7pp。作者主张评估面向人类伙伴的代理时要报告人机对局的惯例差，而不只看 AI-AI 成绩。
Motivation: 面向人类的协作代理通常只用 AI-AI 对局评测，但人类协作依赖字面之外的隐式惯例，AI-AI 成绩无法反映代理是否真的读懂了人类伙伴的言外之意。
Method: 在 Hanabi（提示是唯一关于自己手牌的消息）中定义惯例差：由提示字面内容与可见牌预测的失败概率减去实际出牌失败率；证明在公平洗牌且玩家只用所言所见时，伙伴选择不含字面外信息则总体差为零。评测覆盖公开人人对局、人-AI 对局、规则型 AI-AI 模拟、一项已发表人机研究的三个 AI 代理，以及五级 Off-Belief Learning 代理（第一级只读动作字面内容，逐级解读更多）。
Result: 惯例差：公开人人对局 +26.2pp（未被提示指到的牌 +46pp），人出牌配 AI 伙伴 +16.4pp，规则型 AI-AI 模拟 -0.6pp。已发表人机研究中三个 AI 伙伴下人类所出牌的字面失败概率相近（38-41%），但人类实际失败率 14.4%-34.4%，惯例差从 +24.1pp 到 +6.2pp，且伙伴间差异在被试内部持续存在。五级 Off-Belief Learning 代理的惯例差从 +1.6pp 单调升至 +21.7pp。
Conclusion: 惯例差非零即表明伙伴选择传达了字面之外的信息（但不衡量其多少），因此面向人类伙伴的代理评测应报告人机对局的惯例差，而非只报 AI-AI 成绩。

papers.title: What Makes Adversarial Examples Transfer Across Deepfake Detectors?
papers.abstract_en: Deepfake detectors remain vulnerable to transfer-based black-box attacks, in which adversarial examples are generated on a source surrogate model and transferred to a target model, unknown to the attacker. Yet how source--target compatibility shapes attack success remains poorly understood. Prior studies evaluate limited detector pools and rarely disentangle architectural from training factors. We conduct a controlled evaluation of adversarial transferability across 60 detectors spanning six backbones, two pretraining regimes, and five training-data configurations, using two attack procedures: AutoAttack (AA) and the Carlini--Wagner attack with Expectation over Transformation (CW--EOT). Matched comparisons reveal significantly higher transfer when source and target share an exact backbone, architecture family, pretraining regime, or training data. This compatibility structure is attack-dependent: exact backbone compatibility has the largest effect under AA, whereas shared pretraining and training data have the largest effects under CW--EOT. When transfer is averaged across non-target sources, mean attack success rate (ASR) is $7.21\%$ under AA and $19.52\%$ under CW--EOT. By contrast, a multi-source oracle combining both attacks attains a \(64.48\%\) mean ASR after excluding exact backbone and training-data matches, showing that source averaging can substantially understate target vulnerability. We release 240,000 adversarially perturbed images, complete pairwise transfer results, detector configurations, and evaluation code. These findings establish source--target compatibility and source-model selection as central dimensions of credible transfer-based black-box robustness evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 60 个 deepfake 检测器做受控迁移性评估，发现源-目标共享精确 backbone、架构族、预训练机制或训练数据时对抗样本迁移成功率显著更高，且这种兼容性结构依赖攻击类型：AutoAttack 下精确 backbone 影响最大，CW--EOT 下共享预训练与训练数据影响最大。跨非目标源平均时 ASR 仅 7.21%（AA）与 19.52%（CW--EOT），但排除精确 backbone 与训练数据匹配后，融合两种攻击的多源 oracle 达到 64.48% 平均 ASR，说明源模型平均会严重低估目标脆弱性。
Motivation: 迁移式黑盒攻击中源-目标兼容性如何影响攻击成功率理解不足，且已有研究检测器池有限，很少把架构因素与训练因素解耦。
Method: 在 60 个检测器上做受控评估，覆盖 6 种 backbone、2 种预训练机制、5 种训练数据配置；使用 AutoAttack (AA) 与带 Expectation over Transformation 的 Carlini--Wagner (CW--EOT) 两种攻击过程，通过匹配对比分离架构与训练因素。
Result: 匹配对比显示共享精确 backbone、架构族、预训练机制或训练数据时迁移显著更高；AA 下精确 backbone 兼容性效应最大，CW--EOT 下共享预训练与训练数据效应最大。跨非目标源平均 ASR：AA 7.21%，CW--EOT 19.52%；排除精确 backbone 与训练数据匹配后，融合两种攻击的多源 oracle 平均 ASR 64.48%。发布 240,000 张对抗扰动图像、完整成对迁移结果、检测器配置与评估代码。
Conclusion: 源-目标兼容性与源模型选择是可信迁移式黑盒鲁棒性评估的核心维度，源模型平均会大幅低估目标真实脆弱性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SUN: Reaching for Novelty in Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Exploration in reinforcement learning (RL) remains a fundamental challenge. Recent goal-conditioned RL strategies (which select goals to encourage broader state coverage) have shown promising results, but none scores a goal by novelty and reachability jointly: the two signals are traded off by hand, applied in sequence, or one is neglected outright. In this paper, we introduce a reachability-aware goal-selection framework that explicitly integrates these two aspects, and that can be seamlessly incorporated into any off-policy RL algorithm. To this aim, we propose SUccessor-to-Novelty (SUN), an indicator derived from successor value functions to identify goals that are both novel and reachable. We prove that SUN is the value of a count-scaled goal-reaching reward, bounds short-horizon hitting probabilities, and rejects unreachable goals. We further present an adaptive goal-selection strategy that leverages these properties, along with an accurate yet lightweight pseudocount to avoid the overhead of classic methods. We back up all our claims with thorough benchmarks: SUN consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in standard and novel environments with unreachable or hard-to-reach states, irreversible transitions, obstacles, mazes, and unbounded spaces. Code at https://github.com/sparisi/rl-anvil
papers.comment: 39 pages. Accepted at the 19th European Workshop on Reinforcement Learning (EWRL 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SUN 把目标的新颖性与可达性用 successor value function 联合打分，取代手工权衡或串行处理的启发式；它被证明等价于计数缩放的目标到达奖励的价值，能拒绝不可达目标，并配套一个自适应目标选择策略与轻量 pseudocount。在含不可达/难达状态、不可逆转移、障碍、迷宫与无界空间的标准与新环境中，SUN 持续优于现有目标条件 RL 方法。
Motivation: 目标条件 RL 用选目标扩大状态覆盖，但现有方法没有同时对新颖性和可达性打分：两个信号要么手工权衡、要么按顺序应用、要么直接忽略其一，遇到不可达或难达状态时探索效率受限。
Method: 提出 SUccessor-to-Novelty (SUN) 指标，由 successor value functions 构造，同时度量新颖与可达；证明 SUN 是计数缩放目标到达奖励 (count-scaled goal-reaching reward) 的价值，并给出短时程命中概率的界与不可达目标的拒绝性质。配套自适应目标选择策略，用一个精确而轻量的 pseudocount 替代经典计数方法以避免开销，整体可嵌入任意 off-policy RL 算法。
Result: 在标准环境与新环境（含不可达或难达状态、不可逆转移、障碍、迷宫、无界空间）的 benchmark 上，SUN 持续优于 state-of-the-art 目标条件 RL 方法；理论结果包括 SUN 等于计数缩放目标到达奖励的价值、短时程命中概率的界、以及对不可达目标的拒绝。
Conclusion: 把新颖性与可达性放进同一个由 successor value function 导出的指标，可以在不引入经典计数开销的前提下稳定地做目标选择，并在含不可达状态的环境中持续胜过现有方法。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: SWE-Bench Pro Verified: A Reliable Benchmark for Software Engineering Agents
papers.abstract_en: SWE-Bench Pro has emerged as a standard benchmark for evaluating software engineering agents on challenging repository-level tasks. However, our analysis work show that its evaluation is undermined by two sources of unreliability: reward hacking, enabled by leakage of gold solutions or hidden evaluation information, and task quality issues, including misleading problem statements and improperly scoped tests. These issues can inflate benchmark performance and obscure agents' true coding ability. We present SWE-Bench Pro Verified, a verified version of SWE-Bench Pro that addresses both problems. Our approach combines anti-hacking safeguards that eliminate major leakage channels without disrupting normal agent functionality, with task refinement that minimally corrects inconsistencies within flawed instances. Evaluations on SWE-Bench Pro Verified reveal that some models perform substantially worse than previously evaluated, suggesting that existing results on SWE-Bench Pro may overestimate real software engineering capability. SWE-Bench Pro Verified offers a more trustworthy benchmark for assessing software engineering agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SWE-Bench Pro Verified 通过反作弊防护与任务精修双重手段修复 SWE-Bench Pro 的评测不可靠性：封堵金标解法与隐藏评测信息的泄漏通道，同时最小限度修正误导性问题描述与作用域不当的测试。在该验证版上重评后，部分模型表现比此前评测结果明显更差，说明原基准上的成绩可能高估了智能体的真实软件工程能力。
Motivation: SWE-Bench Pro 作为仓库级软件工程智能体的标准基准，存在两类不可靠来源：金标解法或隐藏评测信息泄漏导致的 reward hacking，以及问题描述误导、测试作用域不当等任务质量问题，二者会虚高成绩并掩盖智能体真实编码能力。
Method: 组合两部分：反作弊防护消除主要泄漏通道且不干扰智能体正常功能；任务精修对有缺陷的实例做最小限度的一致性修正。随后在 SWE-Bench Pro Verified 上重新评测模型。
Result: 重评显示部分模型表现比此前评测结果差得多，提示 SWE-Bench Pro 上的既有结果可能高估了真实的软件工程能力。
Conclusion: SWE-Bench Pro Verified 是更可信的软件工程智能体评测基准；既有 SWE-Bench Pro 成绩需谨慎对待，可能系统性偏高。

summary_sections.motivation: SWE-Bench Pro 作为仓库级软件工程智能体的标准基准，存在两类不可靠来源：金标解法或隐藏评测信息泄漏导致的 reward hacking，以及问题描述误导、测试作用域不当等任务质量问题，二者会虚高成绩并掩盖智能体真实编码能力。
summary_sections.method: 组合两部分：反作弊防护消除主要泄漏通道且不干扰智能体正常功能；任务精修对有缺陷的实例做最小限度的一致性修正。随后在 SWE-Bench Pro Verified 上重新评测模型。
summary_sections.result: 重评显示部分模型表现比此前评测结果差得多，提示 SWE-Bench Pro 上的既有结果可能高估了真实的软件工程能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: SWE-Bench Pro Verified 是更可信的软件工程智能体评测基准；既有 SWE-Bench Pro 成绩需谨慎对待，可能系统性偏高。

papers.title: TDDN: Text-aligned Diffused DINO Network for Puzzle Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Structured visual reasoning, such as image puzzles, demands fine-grained visual perception, which current Vision Language Models (VLMs) often lack. VLMs built on CLIP-based ViT backbones tend to trade fine-grained visual details for high-level semantics. We show that this deficit propagates downstream, affecting various vision and language tasks. To address this, we fuse DINOv3 and CleanDIFT representations into a perception encoder (DiffusedDINO), and align it with RoBERTa-L, yielding a text-aligned model (TDDN) that preserves this perceptual advantage: with frozen backbones and only ~590K alignment pairs, TDDN surpasses CLIP ViT-L/14 in image-text retrieval tasks: text-to-image on Flickr30K and both directions on MS-COCO-2014. TDDN more than triples CLIP's dense-prediction accuracy (ADE20K 5.20 -> 18.11 mIoU, COCO-Stuff 7.35 -> 24.44), despite CLIP's massive training corpus. TDDN leads on segmentation benchmarks among general-purpose contrastive encoders, including SigLIP 2. We further introduce PuzzlePerception, a segmentation and visual question answering dataset that probes fine-grained spatial understanding, on which TDDN doubles CLIP's segmentation accuracy (11.04 -> 22.51 mIoU). Our code and data are available at https://github.com/adityaSomak/TDDN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TDDN 把 DINOv3 与 CleanDIFT 表征融合成感知编码器 DiffusedDINO，再与 RoBERTa-L 做文本对齐，在冻结骨干、仅约 590K 对齐对的条件下保留细粒度感知优势：图像-文本检索超过 CLIP ViT-L/14，稠密预测 mIoU 从 5.20 提到 18.11（ADE20K），新提出的 PuzzlePerception 分割精度翻倍至 22.51 mIoU。
Motivation: 基于 CLIP 的 ViT 骨干为高层语义牺牲细粒度视觉细节，这一缺陷向下游视觉与语言任务传导，使 VLM 在图像谜题这类需要精细空间感知的结构化视觉推理上表现不足。
Method: 融合 DINOv3 与 CleanDIFT 表征构成感知编码器 DiffusedDINO，再与 RoBERTa-L 对齐得到文本对齐模型 TDDN；对齐阶段冻结骨干，仅用约 590K 图文对。同时提出 PuzzlePerception 数据集，含分割与 VQA 两部分，用于探测细粒度空间理解。
Result: 图像-文本检索在 Flickr30K 的 text-to-image 与 MS-COCO-2014 双向上超过 CLIP ViT-L/14。稠密预测精度超过 CLIP 三倍：ADE20K mIoU 5.20 → 18.11，COCO-Stuff 7.35 → 24.44。在通用对比编码器（含 SigLIP 2）中分割基准领先。PuzzlePerception 上分割精度翻倍：11.04 → 22.51 mIoU（对比 CLIP）。
Conclusion: CLIP 式语义优先的表征确实以细粒度感知为代价，而融合自监督视觉表征再做文本对齐可以在冻结骨干、小规模对齐对下同时保住检索与稠密预测能力。

papers.title: Protocol effects on feature-based hardware-Trojan detection across Trust-Hub families
papers.abstract_en: Trust-Hub reuses host circuits: several files differ mainly in the inserted Trojan. When gates from sibling variants enter both training and test folds, a detector can benefit from host logic it has already seen. We measure that effect instead of proposing another classifier. The corpus contains 49,124 gates from 16 netlists grouped into five host families. We left the parser, 36 gate features, class weighting, model settings, threshold, and family-level aggregation unchanged and altered one choice: the test boundary. The three settings draw test gates from the pooled corpus, withhold a complete netlist, or withhold every variant of one host. The choice matters. Random forest records F1/AP of 0.914/0.978 with pooled gates, 0.636/0.851 with one netlist held out, and 0.460/0.577 with a host family held out. XGBoost falls from 0.946/0.976 to 0.464/0.544 across the same comparison. Logistic regression loses AP, although its fixed-threshold F1 is not monotonic. Each family shows the same pooled-to-family direction. Feature removal, repeated model and simulator seeds, score normalization, parser-related exclusions, and a smaller sample change the size of the gap without reversing it. Aggregation also matters: a gate-weighted average is dominated by the larger ISCAS files, so the headline values give each host family one vote. Bootstrap and jackknife summaries keep the gap positive, but their folds reuse training families. We treat the five family rows as descriptive evidence rather than independent trials. Five host families are too few for a population claim, and the experiment says nothing about transfer to a new cell library or an industrial design. It supports a narrower conclusion: sibling benchmark variants can inflate apparent transfer. Benchmarks with several variants of one host circuit should report family-aware holdouts and all five family results beside pooled scores.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 3 table. Accepted at IEEE ICCSIE 2026. Author accepted manuscript. Reproducibility artifact: https://zenodo.org/records/23230179
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Trust-Hub 复用宿主电路导致同族变体同时进入训练与测试折，使硬件木马检测的迁移表现被高估。固定解析器、36 个门级特征与模型设置，仅改测试边界：随机森林 F1/AP 从 pooled 的 0.914/0.978 降到留出整宿主族的 0.460/0.577，XGBoost 从 0.946/0.976 降到 0.464/0.544。作者建议此类基准同时报告 family-aware holdout 与五个族的逐行结果。
Motivation: Trust-Hub 多个文件仅差插入的木马，同族门级样本泄漏进训练与测试折会让检测器吃到已见过的宿主逻辑，从而虚报跨设计迁移能力。
Method: 语料为 16 个 netlist、49,124 个门、五个宿主族；保持解析器、36 个门级特征、类别加权、模型设置、阈值与族级聚合不变，只改测试边界：pooled、留出整个 netlist、留出一个宿主的全部变体。模型含随机森林、XGBoost、逻辑回归，并做特征剔除、多种子、分数归一化、解析器相关排除与小样本检验，另用 bootstrap 与 jackknife 汇总。
Result: 随机森林 F1/AP：pooled 0.914/0.978，留出一个 netlist 0.636/0.851，留出宿主族 0.460/0.577；XGBoost 从 0.946/0.976 降到 0.464/0.544；逻辑回归丢 AP，但固定阈值 F1 非单调。五个族均呈 pooled 到 family 的同向下降；特征剔除、多种子、归一化、解析器排除与小样本只改变差距大小，不反转方向。门加权平均被较大的 ISCAS 文件主导，故头条值按宿主族各一票聚合；bootstrap 与 jackknife 保持差距为正，但其折仍复用训练族。
Conclusion: 同宿主的兄弟变体可虚增表面迁移表现；含多变体的基准应报告 family-aware holdout 并把五个族结果与 pooled 分数并列。五个族太少，不足以支撑总体性结论，实验也不涉及新 cell library 或工业设计的迁移。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Multi-Harness Reinforcement Learning for Coding Agents: Training Gains and Harness Dependence
papers.abstract_en: Recent systems train coding agents with reinforcement learning (RL) on trajectories collected through multiple execution harnesses. However, gains under the training harnesses leave open whether the improvements transfer to unseen interfaces and how they depend on reward normalization. We present a controlled study that measures RL gains under fixed harnesses and compares the same models across harnesses. We train two Qwen3-8B RL variants from the same supervised fine-tuning (SFT) checkpoint using identical replay data. They differ only in whether rewards for each task are normalized within each harness (Within) or across harnesses (Cross). On SWE-bench Verified, we identify three main findings: (i) Multi-harness RL yields modest gains over the SFT baseline under both normalization rules. Across the four training harnesses, the estimated mean improvements are +0.48 and +0.77 percentage points for Within and Cross, respectively. (ii) Cross increases the fraction of trajectories with nonzero advantage but provides no consistent advantage over Within on an unseen harness across training seeds and evaluation budgets; neither rule significantly improves over SFT on this harness. (iii) Performance varies substantially more across harnesses than with RL training. After averaging over model variants, the highest and lowest source-harness solve rates differ by 7.13 percentage points, far exceeding the estimated training gains. Even after multi-harness RL, the observed performance differences across execution interfaces remain substantially larger than either the gains from training or the differences between normalization rules.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多执行 harness 上做 RL 训练的 coding agent 研究显示：跨 harness 归一化 (Cross) 相对 SFT 基线在四个训练 harness 上平均提升 +0.77 个百分点，harness 内归一化 (Within) 为 +0.48，但两者在未见过的 harness 上都不显著优于 SFT。执行接口之间的求解率差异（最高与最低相差 7.13 个百分点）远大于训练增益，因此换 harness 比继续加 RL 训练更能改变成绩。
Motivation: 多 harness RL 训练的增益是否迁移到未见执行接口、以及对奖励归一化方式的依赖程度，此前缺少受控比较；这决定了训练投入能否换来跨接口的稳定收益。
Method: 从同一 SFT checkpoint 训练两个 Qwen3-8B RL 变体，使用完全相同的 replay 数据，唯一差别是奖励按任务在每个 harness 内归一化 (Within) 还是跨 harness 归一化 (Cross)；在 SWE-bench Verified 上跨四个训练 harness 与一个未见 harness、多个训练种子和评估预算做受控比较。
Result: 四个训练 harness 上相对 SFT 的估计平均提升为 Within +0.48、Cross +0.77 个百分点；Cross 提高了非零 advantage 轨迹的比例，但在未见 harness 上相对 Within 无一致优势，两者在该 harness 上均未显著优于 SFT；跨 harness 的最高与最低求解率相差 7.13 个百分点，远超训练增益。
Conclusion: 多 harness RL 只带来温和增益且对归一化规则不敏感，执行接口本身造成的性能差异才是主导项，跨接口迁移并未随训练显著改善。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Object Concepts Emerge from Motion
papers.abstract_en: Object-centric visual representations are important for physical-world perception, but existing visual pretraining methods often capture semantic categories without preserving the identity and coherence of individual instances. We present a biologically inspired framework that learns object-centric representations for single images from raw videos. Our approach uses motion boundaries as a source of object-level grouping: off-the-shelf optical flow and clustering produce pseudo-instance masks, which supervise a single-image encoder with pixel-level pairwise metric learning. The framework requires neither human annotations nor camera calibration. We first obtain 195 million pseudo-labeled frames from 7,163 hours of driving and web videos, then expand the supervision to 421 million frames with Motion-Verified Self-Training, which combines model proposals with motion evidence. We train encoders up to Swin-H and distill the learned representations into a family of Swin backbones. Across monocular depth estimation, 3D object detection, 3D occupancy prediction, and end-to-end planning, the resulting models achieve competitive or superior performance relative to supervised and self-supervised pretraining baselines, with particularly strong transfer on geometry- and instance-sensitive tasks. These results show that motion-derived supervision can teach static image encoders to represent visual instances, providing a complementary direction for scalable visual pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用运动边界从原始视频里造伪实例掩码，监督单图像编码器做像素级成对度量学习，从而让静态图像表征保留实例身份与一致性。伪标注规模从 7,163 小时视频得到的 1.95 亿帧扩到 Motion-Verified Self-Training 的 4.21 亿帧，训练到 Swin-H 再蒸馏到 Swin 系列。在单目深度估计、3D 目标检测、3D 占用预测和端到端规划上达到与有监督、自监督预训练基线相当或更优的性能，几何与实例敏感任务迁移尤其强。
Motivation: 现有视觉预训练多捕捉语义类别，丢掉单个实例的身份与连贯性，而这对物理世界感知是必需的。
Method: 以 off-the-shelf 光流加聚类得到运动边界伪实例掩码，用像素级成对度量学习 (pairwise metric learning) 监督单图像编码器，全程不用人工标注也不需相机标定；再用 Motion-Verified Self-Training 把模型自身提议与运动证据结合扩充监督，编码器训到 Swin-H 并蒸馏进 Swin 系列表征族。
Result: 从 7,163 小时驾驶与网络视频得到 1.95 亿伪标注帧，经 Motion-Verified Self-Training 扩到 4.21 亿帧；在单目深度估计、3D 目标检测、3D 占用预测与端到端规划上，相对有监督与自监督预训练基线达到相当或更优表现，几何与实例敏感任务迁移最强。
Conclusion: 运动导出的监督足以教静态图像编码器表征视觉实例，可作为可扩展视觉预训练的互补方向。

papers.title: Differentiable Hybrid Modelling for Learning and Optimising Chemical Transport Processes from Experimental Data
papers.abstract_en: Transport models underpin the design and optimisation of chemical processes, yet their constitutive laws are typically hand-picked, their experimental initial conditions are assumed exact, and their computational cost restricts optimisation to a handful of process variables. Here we introduce a differentiable hybrid modelling framework that embeds neural networks within a GPU-accelerated population balance equation solver to discover constitutive laws and assimilate initial conditions directly from experimental crystallisation data. Using thirteen real experiments with multi-dimensional size and shape measurements, we show that treating measured initial conditions as exact yields a physically inconsistent rate law despite improved predictive accuracy, whereas assimilating them recovers a physically consistent, non-linear law and reduces trajectory error sevenfold relative to conventional modelling. End-to-end differentiability further enables gradient-based optimisation of high-dimensional operating profiles, identifying a 300-variable temperature profile that reduces crystal aspect ratio by 25% at constant mass, facilitating superior product attributes. Our framework augments, rather than replaces, mechanistic modelling, offering a general route to learning transport models from data and optimising processes with them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可微分混合建模框架：把神经网络嵌入 GPU 加速的群体平衡方程 (population balance) 求解器，同时从结晶实验数据中学习本构律并同化初始条件。把测得的初始条件当作精确值会得到物理不一致的速率律，而同化后恢复物理一致的非线性律、轨迹误差降低七倍；端到端可微还支持梯度优化，找到 300 变量温度剖面使晶体长径比在恒定质量下下降 25%。
Motivation: 化学输运模型的本构律靠人工挑选、实验初始条件被当作精确已知，且计算成本限制优化只能调少数过程变量，导致速率律可能物理不一致、操作空间无法充分搜索。
Method: 在 GPU 加速的群体平衡方程求解器中嵌入神经网络，构成可微分混合模型：本构律由网络发现，初始条件作为可同化的变量直接从实验数据反演；端到端可微性使梯度能回传到高维操作剖面，用于基于梯度的过程优化。
Result: 在 13 组带多维尺寸与形状测量的真实结晶实验上：把测得初始条件当作精确值会得到物理不一致的速率律（尽管预测精度提高），同化初始条件则恢复物理一致的非线性律，并相对常规建模把轨迹误差降低七倍；梯度优化识别出 300 变量温度剖面，在恒定质量下使晶体长径比降低 25%。
Conclusion: 同化初始条件是得到物理一致速率律的前提，端到端可微使高维操作剖面优化可行；该框架是对机理建模的增强而非替代，可作为从数据学习输运模型并据此优化过程的通用路径。

papers.title: Defense-as-Skill: Evolving Runtime Guard Skill for Skill-Augmented Agents
papers.abstract_en: Skill-augmented agents load reusable skills as persistent runtime context, improving task performance but also giving malicious skills a durable channel for steering future actions. Such skills may leak secrets, corrupt code, bypass approvals, or stage data for exfiltration only after a concrete user task and workspace state make the unsafe action appear useful. This makes pre-install vetting insufficient and calls for runtime, task-conditioned protection. We propose Defense-as-Skill, a defense paradigm that implements the runtime guard itself as an installable, inspectable, and editable skill. Our guard, SkillSonar, runs alongside untrusted task skills and checks sensitive actions against the user's task boundary, routing each action to an allow, replan, or confirmation decision without modifying the underlying agent runtime. To study this setting, we construct SCOPE-R, a task-conditioned dataset covering 6 risk families and 21 sub-categories, with 206 attack-confirmed malicious instances and 43 benign tasks. We then improve SkillSonar on the SCOPE-R training subset using runtime guard-skill evolution, a Monte-Carlo Tree Search procedure that evolves the on-disk guard skill from feedback on the rollouts. Across Claude Code and OpenClaw, the evolved guard substantially reduces attack success while maintaining a favorable safety-utility trade-off; on repeated GLM-5 runs, ID ASR drops from 0.482 to 0.104 and OOD ASR from 0.606 to 0.115, with gains transferring across victim models, held-out risk families, and external benchmarks. These results show that runtime guards can be skill-native, transparent, and evolvable policy artifacts for skill-augmented agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Defense-as-Skill：把运行时防护本身做成可安装、可审查、可编辑的 skill（SkillSonar），用 MCTS 依据 rollout 反馈演化磁盘上的防护 skill。在 SCOPE-R 数据集上，GLM-5 重复运行中 ID ASR 从 0.482 降到 0.104，OOD ASR 从 0.606 降到 0.115。
Motivation: skill-augmented agent 把可复用 skill 作为持久运行时上下文，恶意 skill 因此获得操纵后续动作的持久通道，且往往在具体任务与工作区状态使其显得有用时才触发，仅靠安装前审查不足。
Method: SkillSonar 与不可信任务 skill 并行运行，按用户任务边界检查敏感动作并路由到 allow、replan 或 confirmation 三类决策，不修改底层 agent runtime；用 Monte-Carlo Tree Search 在 SCOPE-R 训练子集上依据 rollout 反馈演化防护 skill。
Result: 构建 SCOPE-R：覆盖 6 个风险族、21 个子类，含 206 个攻击确认的恶意实例与 43 个良性任务。在 Claude Code 与 OpenClaw 上，GLM-5 重复运行中 ID ASR 从 0.482 降至 0.104，OOD ASR 从 0.606 降至 0.115，且增益可跨受害模型、留出风险族与外部基准迁移。
Conclusion: 运行时防护可以做成 skill-native、透明、可演化的策略产物，在保持安全-效用权衡的同时显著降低攻击成功率。

papers.title: H2Table: Hierarchical Hypergraph-Enhanced Large Language Models for Complex Table Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Tables are ubiquitous across diverse domains, yet reasoning over them remains a significant challenge for modern large language models (LLMs). Current approaches typically linearize tables into sequences, inherently overlooking their intrinsic two-dimensional and hierarchical structure. To address this, we propose H2Table (Hierarchical Hypergraph-Enhanced Table Reasoning), a novel framework that represents complex tables as hierarchical nested hypergraphs. To process this representation, we design a tailored hypergraph encoder to facilitate message passing between hyperedges (headers) and nodes (cells), thereby perceiving the semantic entailment relationships between them within complex tables. Furthermore, we introduce a set of learnable query vectors acting as a lightweight bridge to extract representative structural embeddings from the encoder into the LLM. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach effectively handles complex table question answering tasks with hierarchical nested headers. Notably, on the HiTab dataset, H2Table achieves an average improvement of 22.88% over state-of-the-art baselines on highly complex tables with a nesting depth of four. Our code is available at: https://github.com/lila120/h2table.
papers.comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). Camera-ready version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: H2Table 把复杂表格表示为层次化嵌套超图 (hierarchical nested hypergraph)，用定制超图编码器在超边（表头）与节点（单元格）间做消息传递，再用一组可学习查询向量把结构嵌入注入 LLM。在 HiTab 数据集上，嵌套深度为四的高复杂度表格上平均比 SOTA 基线提升 22.88%。
Motivation: 现有表格推理方法把表格线性化成序列，丢掉了表格固有的二维与层次结构，导致嵌套表头的复杂表格问答表现差。
Method: 将复杂表格编码为层次化嵌套超图，超边对应表头、节点对应单元格；定制超图编码器在二者间做消息传递以捕捉语义蕴含关系；再引入一组可学习查询向量作为轻量桥接，把代表性结构嵌入抽取进 LLM。
Result: 在 HiTab 数据集上，对嵌套深度为四的高复杂度表格，H2Table 平均比 SOTA 基线提升 22.88%。
Conclusion: 保留表格的层次超图结构并显式注入 LLM，能有效处理带层次嵌套表头的复杂表格问答任务。

papers.title: Data-Driven Persona-Conditioned Agents for A/B Test Simulation
papers.abstract_en: A/B testing is the gold standard for evaluating product changes, but each experiment requires real user traffic, engineering effort, and weeks of measurement. We propose a simulation framework that predicts A/B test outcomes using LLM-powered agents conditioned on data-driven personas grounded in real user behavioral signals. Unlike prior work that relies on synthetic or rule-based personas, our agents are constructed from anonymized behavioral data - activity patterns, engagement signals, and inferred demographics - enabling more faithful population modeling. We frame A/B test simulation as a structured question task and systematically study (i) question design formats, (ii) the impact of persona data source and domain alignment, (iii) the trade-off between per-persona behavioral depth and population diversity, and (iv) efficient population subsampling. On a benchmark of 40 A/B tests spanning two metric types, our best configuration achieves 0.75-0.80 directional accuracy depending on the test metric, demonstrating that data-driven personas are a viable path toward fast, low-cost experiment pre-screening.
papers.comment: Work accepted at EMNLP 2026 Industry Track and EMNLP 2026 REALM Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用真实行为信号（活跃模式、互动信号、推断人口属性）构建数据驱动 persona 的 LLM agent 框架，把 A/B 测试模拟成结构化问答任务，用于实验前的低成本预筛。在覆盖两类指标的 40 个 A/B 测试基准上，最佳配置的方向性准确率达 0.75–0.80（随测试指标而变）。
Motivation: A/B 测试依赖真实流量、工程投入和数周测量周期；既往模拟工作用合成或规则生成的 persona，人群建模不够真实。
Method: 用匿名行为数据构建 persona 条件化的 LLM agent，将 A/B 测试模拟表述为结构化问答任务；系统研究问题设计格式、persona 数据源与领域对齐、单 persona 行为深度与人群多样性的权衡，以及高效人群子采样。
Result: 在 40 个 A/B 测试、覆盖两类指标的基准上，最佳配置取得 0.75–0.80 的方向性准确率（directional accuracy），具体数值随测试指标类型不同而变化。
Conclusion: 数据驱动 persona 是实现快速、低成本实验预筛的可行路径。

papers.title: DASC: Decay-Aware State Compression for Hybrid Linear-Attention Serving
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid linear-attention architectures have recently scaled to large open-weight models, offering quality competitive with full attention while substantially reducing key/value (KV) cache growth. However, their in-place recurrent-state updates complicate cache management: prefix reuse requires state checkpoints alongside full-attention KV, while storing state checkpoints in full increases memory pressure, leading to more evictions and repeated prefill. By analyzing the decay structure of Gated DeltaNet (GDN) and Kimi Delta Attention (KDA), we find that different heads and channels retain prefix information over markedly different timescales, which we term \emph{retention horizons}. This variation suggests substantial compression potential in persistent state checkpoints. Building on this observation, we introduce \emph{Decay-Aware State Compression} (DASC), which derives retention horizons from model weights, selects long-horizon state units, and packs them into a ragged state checkpoint layout. To integrate efficiently with tensor-parallel inference engines, DASC furtherly balances compressed state checkpoints across TP ranks. On reuse, DASC either zero-fills omitted units or refreshes them from a bounded suffix with additional compute cost. Across retrieval and end-to-end reasoning benchmarks on Kimi-Linear, conservative DASC configurations remain close to full caching while compressing KDA recurrent state checkpoints by $2.63\times$. Under fixed state checkpoint memory budgets, the resulting capacity gains reduce mean Time to First Token (TTFT) by 42.6\% and improve input throughput by 68.4\%. At larger compression ratio, suffix refresh recovers much of the accuracy lost to more aggressive omission, at the cost of additional replay computation. Qwen with GDN exhibits a similar quality--efficiency trend, showing that DASC extends from channel-wise KDA to head-wise GDN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DASC 从模型权重直接推导每个头/通道的 retention horizon，只保留长时程状态单元并打包成 ragged state checkpoint，在固定显存预算下把 KDA 循环状态检查点压缩 2.63×，mean TTFT 降 42.6%、输入吞吐升 68.4%，质量接近全量缓存。激进压缩时用 bounded suffix refresh 补回被省略单元，可换回大部分精度但要付额外 replay 计算。
Motivation: 混合线性注意力模型的 in-place 循环状态更新让 prefix 复用必须同时存全注意力 KV 与状态检查点，全量存状态又挤爆显存，导致更多 eviction 与重复 prefill。
Method: 分析 Gated DeltaNet (GDN) 与 Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) 的衰减结构，发现不同 head/channel 的 retention horizon 差异大；据此从权重选长时程状态单元、打包成 ragged 布局，并在 TP ranks 间均衡压缩后的检查点；复用时对省略单元 zero-fill 或从 bounded suffix 刷新。
Result: 在 Kimi-Linear 的检索与端到端推理基准上，保守配置在 2.63× 压缩下质量接近全量缓存；固定状态检查点显存预算下 mean TTFT 降 42.6%、输入吞吐升 68.4%；更大压缩比时 suffix refresh 恢复大部分精度但增加 replay 计算；Qwen (GDN) 呈现相同质量-效率趋势。
Conclusion: retention horizon 的头间/通道间不均是持久状态检查点的可压缩来源，DASC 可从通道级 KDA 推广到头级 GDN。

papers.title: Can escalation channels redirect reward hacking toward defect disclosure?
papers.abstract_en: When coding agents encounter defective test infrastructure they may reward-hack: hardcoding outputs or editing test files to pass tests they cannot legitimately satisfy, a pattern that has now appeared outside benchmarks, in a coordinated multi-agent intrusion of a major AI platform's production infrastructure. The same capability that lets an agent detect and exploit a defect could let it report one, given the right decision environment. We evaluate escalation channels, structured reporting tools available to the agent at the point of conflict, as a decision-environment intervention that both reduces reward hacking and surfaces the infrastructure defects that trigger it. A $2 \times 2$ factorial separates the contributions of an escalation tool, a standalone anti-reward-hacking policy, and their combination. Across 8 frontier models spanning 5 families, the combined intervention reduces reward hacking from 23.6% to 5.3% (mixed-effects logistic OR = 9.2, 95% CI 5.0--16.8, $p < 10^{-12}$) with no detectable cost or performance overhead, eliminating it entirely for 6 of 8 models. Escalation and hacking are near-perfectly mutually exclusive, with 98.7% of escalations involving no hacking (100% under the combined intervention). Beyond reduction, escalation channels function as diagnostic infrastructure: on top of monitoring, escalation adds +10.1 percentage points of defect detection coverage and is more accurate once it fires (99.4% vs 85.8%). Unlike containment-based approaches that risk outpacing growing model capabilities, escalation channels redirect capability toward disclosure rather than exploitation.

papers.title: Manifold4D: Denoising on Point Cloud Rendered Manifolds for Video Re-shooting
papers.abstract_en: Video re-shooting is the task of re-rendering a monocular video of a dynamic scene along a user-specified camera trajectory. A dominant paradigm explicitly provides the target geometry by lifting the source video into a 4D point cloud using per-frame depth, and rasterizing this representation along the target trajectory to obtain point-cloud renders as geometric conditions for trajectory-controlled generation. The point cloud render and source video may provide conflicting visual cues throughout denoising, as both are directly used as conditions. We refer to this conflict as a trust dilemma, which can compromise trajectory control, 3D consistency of dynamic content, and visual quality, particularly under distribution shifts. We argue that because a point-cloud render is pixel-aligned with the target view, it does not need to be continuously provided as a conditioning signal throughout denoising. We propose Manifold4D, which injects the render directly into the initial noise of flow matching, so that generation no longer departs from standard Gaussian noise but from a geometry-bearing noise distribution that we term the point cloud rendered manifold, leaving the source video as the only visual condition. The render is thus used exactly once, and the network is never asked to learn how to read it; in subsequent denoising steps the model can focus on the source video. In our experiments, Manifold4D attains the best camera-control accuracy on every metric, lowering rotation error by 25--27% and translation error by up to 32% over the strongest baseline, while matching it in video fidelity and attaining the best overall photometric quality and 3D consistency of dynamic content.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Manifold4D 把点云渲染直接注入 flow matching 的初始噪声，构造带几何的 point cloud rendered manifold，使源视频成为唯一视觉条件，从而化解渲染与源视频在去噪全程互相冲突的 trust dilemma。在视频重拍摄 (video re-shooting) 实验中，相机控制精度在所有指标上最优：相对最强基线旋转误差降低 25–27%、平移误差最高降低 32%，同时视频保真度持平，整体光度质量与动态内容 3D 一致性最佳。
Motivation: 按目标轨迹重渲染单目视频时，主流做法把逐帧深度提升成 4D 点云并沿目标轨迹光栅化，把点云渲染和源视频同时作为条件；两者在去噪全程给出冲突线索，导致轨迹控制、动态内容 3D 一致性和画质在分布偏移下退化。
Method: Manifold4D 用逐帧深度把源视频提升为 4D 点云，沿目标轨迹光栅化得到与目标视图像素对齐的点云渲染；该渲染不作为逐步条件，而是直接注入 flow matching 的初始噪声，形成 point cloud rendered manifold，使生成从带几何的噪声分布而非标准高斯出发，源视频是唯一视觉条件，渲染只被使用一次。
Result: 在视频重拍摄实验中，Manifold4D 每一项相机控制指标都取得最佳精度：相对最强基线旋转误差降低 25–27%，平移误差最高降低 32%；视频保真度与该基线持平，整体光度质量与动态内容 3D 一致性最佳。
Conclusion: 几何条件只需在生成起点注入一次，不必在去噪全程重复提供；把点云渲染做成初始噪声分布即可同时保住轨迹控制、动态 3D 一致性和画质。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GenCoord: Executable Commitments for Embodied LLM Agents under Private Information
papers.abstract_en: Embodied language-model agents must coordinate interdependent actions while each holds private task information. In dialogue-based coordination, models generate messages and interpret replies to decide what each agent should do, spending inference before the team acts. We propose GenCoord, a decentralized protocol that makes the division of work itself the message. A proposal pairs the sender's skill path with its partner's continuation in Short DSL, a compact language for expressing joint work. Compatible paths form commitments linking the sender's delivery to the partner's work after verified receipt. We check fulfillment separately from original-task success. Complete requests also let a deterministic receiver proceed without another model call. In Minecraft, trained local 0.8B agents match the task success of controlled free-form communication while reducing median commitment time by 68.2%. The same-field full-key JSON control approaches free-form output length and delay, indicating that the amount generated matters even when messages are structured. With the same prompted DeepSeek model, both protocols complete nearly all tasks, but dialogue generates 2.8 times as many output tokens. Multistep commitments improve held-out-template success from 91.3% to 98.1% with fewer decisions. These results point to a design principle for embodied cooperation: make the division of work the message, and spend inference on choosing and revising the work.
papers.comment: Junning Zhu and Peng He contributed equally. Corresponding author: Peng He. Paper source and compact evidence: https://github.com/JulianZJN/GenCoord
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 GenCoord：具身 LLM 智能体协作时把分工本身作为消息，用 Short DSL 把发送方技能路径与伙伴续接路径配对成可验证的 commitment。在 Minecraft 中，训练好的本地 0.8B 智能体达到与自由文本通信相当的任务成功率，中位 commitment 时间降低 68.2%；多步 commitment 把 held-out 模板成功率从 91.3% 提到 98.1%。
Motivation: 具身 LLM 智能体各自持有私有任务信息，需要在行动前通过对话协商分工，推理开销大且消息长度与延迟高。
Method: GenCoord 是去中心化协议：提案用 Short DSL 把发送方技能路径与伙伴续接路径配对，兼容路径构成 commitment，把发送方交付与伙伴收讫后的后续工作绑定；履约与原任务成功分开检验；完整请求允许确定性接收方无需再次调用模型即可继续。对照包括自由文本对话与同字段全键 JSON 控制。
Result: Minecraft 中训练好的本地 0.8B 智能体任务成功率与受控自由文本通信持平，中位 commitment 时间降低 68.2%；同字段全键 JSON 控制的输出长度与延迟接近自由文本，说明消息量本身是关键；同一 prompted DeepSeek 模型下两种协议几乎完成全部任务，但对话产生 2.8 倍输出 token；多步 commitment 使 held-out 模板成功率从 91.3% 升至 98.1%，且决策次数更少。
Conclusion: 把分工本身作为消息、把推理花在选择与修订工作上，是具身协作的设计原则：结构化消息只有在压缩生成量时才带来收益。

papers.title: SAGE-OR: Semi-supervised Adaptive Scene Graph Generation for Operating Rooms
papers.abstract_en: Current surgical scene graph generation methods depend on dense multi-modal supervision and specialized hardware (synchronized RGB-D sensors, calibration rigs), making dataset construction expensive and restricting all existing benchmarks to simulated environments. We propose SAGE-OR, a feature-centric framework that replaces the traditional detect-then-reason paradigm with a decoupled representation-reasoning paradigm in which localization is derived from frozen foundation models, encoded implicitly in pre-computed features, and used without any localization supervision, while a lightweight graph transformer performs relational reasoning over cached features. We employ a semi-supervised formulation with general-purpose segmentation prompts to eliminate localization supervision while enabling unsupervised context augmentation through additional prompt-driven entities, such as hands, which are absent from annotations. General-purpose prompts are used to induce near-perfect recall, while precision is delegated to downstream attention-based reasoning, enabling simple adaptation to new entities via prompt-level modification. This design enables a lightweight 15M-parameter graph transformer that trains in 1.4 hours and runs relational inference at $\sim$1ms per frame with peak memory under 2GB, suitable for edge hardware used in the operating room; feature extraction runs offline as a separate caching stage (4.27s per frame). On the 4D-OR benchmark, the core model achieves 76% F1, matching the fully supervised 4D-OR baseline while eliminating all localization annotations, and unsupervised hand augmentation raises this to 86%, within 4 points of state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods requiring dense multi-modal supervision, providing a practical pathway for adaptation to new surgical settings without annotation other than relationship and class labels.
papers.comment: Accepted at BMVC 2026. v2: corrected reference metadata and spelled out venue names in the reference list
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAGE-OR 用冻结基础模型的预计算特征替代 detect-then-reason 范式，配合 15M 参数轻量 graph transformer 做关系推理，完全去掉定位监督。在 4D-OR 上核心模型 76% F1，与需要全监督定位的 4D-OR 基线持平；加入无监督手部实体增强后升到 86%，距需稠密多模态监督的 SOTA 差 4 个百分点以内。
Motivation: 现有手术场景图生成依赖稠密多模态监督与同步 RGB-D、标定装置等专用硬件，数据集构建昂贵，且所有既有 benchmark 都限于仿真环境。
Method: 以 representation-reasoning 取代 detect-then-reason：定位由冻结基础模型给出并隐式编码进预计算特征，无需定位监督；轻量 graph transformer 在缓存特征上做关系推理。半监督形式用通用分割 prompt 消除定位标注，并通过 prompt 驱动的额外实体（如手）做无监督上下文增强；通用 prompt 保证近满召回，精度交给下游 attention 推理。特征抽取为离线缓存阶段。
Result: 4D-OR 上核心模型 76% F1，与全监督 4D-OR 基线持平且无需定位标注；无监督手部增强后 86% F1，距需稠密多模态监督的 SOTA 4 个百分点以内。graph transformer 15M 参数，训练 1.4 小时，关系推理约 1ms/帧，峰值内存低于 2GB，特征抽取离线 4.27s/帧。
Conclusion: 把定位交给冻结基础模型、只学关系推理，可以在手术场景图上以极少监督达到接近 SOTA 的水平，并靠 prompt 级修改快速适配新实体与新手术场景。

papers.title: Avatar-Forever: Decoupled Parallel Training for High-Quality Real-Time Infinite Avatars
papers.abstract_en: Existing streaming video systems often rely on sequential, distillation-centered training pipelines to enable few-step long-video generation. However, this paradigm suffers from two limitations. First, failures or distribution shifts introduced in earlier stages affect later optimization, complicating the training process to converge. Second, the distillation-centric objective favours short-term generation but is prone to quality degradation when autoregressive errors accumulate over long rollouts. We propose Avatar-Forever, a decoupled parallel training framework for high-quality real-time infinite interactive avatars. Instead of coupling generation efficiency and long-horizon robustness under a sequential distillation pipeline, we treat them as two independent capabilities that can be trained in parallel. One branch performs full-parameter distillation to train an efficient generator with high visual quality, while another trains a lightweight long-horizon adapter via Recovery-oriented Rollout Training (RRT), which improves generation robustness under long-horizon inference conditions. Our decoupled parallel training design simplifies the overall training process and avoids unnecessary objective conflicts between few-step generation and long-horizon adaptation. We further introduce ForeverCache, a chunk-wise feature caching mechanism to substantially reduce redundant history computation during streaming inference. Built upon a 22B video foundation model, Avatar-Forever supports unbounded audio-driven avatar generation while maintaining identity consistency, motion coherence, and visual fidelity, enabling an end-to-end throughput of high-resolution 768x512 videos at 27.2 FPS on a single H100 GPU and providing a practical path toward stable digital humans.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Avatar-Forever 把流式数字人生成的两个目标——少步生成效率与长时程鲁棒性——从串行蒸馏管线中拆开并行训练：一支做全参数蒸馏得到高效生成器，另一支用 Recovery-oriented Rollout Training (RRT) 训练轻量长时程适配器，再用 ForeverCache 分块特征缓存削减流式推理的历史冗余计算。基于 22B 视频基础模型，支持无界音频驱动数字人生成，在单张 H100 上以 768x512 高分辨率达到 27.2 FPS 端到端吞吐。
Motivation: 串行、以蒸馏为中心的训练管线有两个问题：前序阶段的失败或分布偏移会污染后续优化、使收敛变难；蒸馏目标偏爱短期生成，自回归误差在长 rollout 上累积导致质量退化。
Method: 解耦并行训练框架：一支做全参数蒸馏 (full-parameter distillation) 训练高质量少步生成器，另一支用 Recovery-oriented Rollout Training (RRT) 训练轻量长时程适配器以提升长时程推理鲁棒性；推理侧引入 ForeverCache 分块特征缓存机制，整体建立在 22B 视频基础模型之上。

Conclusion: 把生成效率与长时程鲁棒性当作可并行训练的独立能力，可简化训练过程并避免少步生成与长时程适配之间的目标冲突，为稳定数字人提供可行路径。

papers.title: STAIR: Effective Incident Response Using an End-to-End Agentic Planning Framework
papers.abstract_en: Incident response planning is critical for restoring compromised software systems. Existing AIOps methods automate fault diagnosis and remediation and adapt response using feedback, but lack a unified decision basis across planning and execution. This limits their ability to maintain incident state and align actions with evolving recovery objectives during long-horizon, multi-stage security incident response. We present STAIR, an end-to-end agentic response framework that organizes planning and execution around a shared incident state. STAIR maintains incident evidence, response actions, and execution feedback in Graph-as-State (GAS), using the latest state to determine the response stage and recovery objectives for stage-specialized planning. The framework retrieves effect-validated historical experience based on the current state and stage to guide action selection. An Execution Harness executes actions, returns feedback to update GAS, and validates action effects for future experience reuse. We construct STAIR-Bench, an executable incident response benchmark comprising 44 Docker-based cyber-range cases. On its held-out test cases, STAIR achieves an overall defense score of 0.95, improving over the strongest baseline by approximately 10.47%. In the independent CAGE4 environment with ongoing attacks and benign activity, STAIR reduces cumulative penalties by approximately 28.8% relative to the strongest baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STAIR 把安全事件响应的规划与执行统一到共享的 Graph-as-State (GAS) 事件状态上，按当前状态判定响应阶段与恢复目标做分阶段规划，并用 Execution Harness 执行动作、回填反馈、校验效果以供经验复用。在自建的 44 个 Docker 网络靶场案例基准 STAIR-Bench 留出测试集上，整体防御分 0.95，比最强基线高约 10.47%；在含持续攻击与良性流量的 CAGE4 环境中累计惩罚比最强基线低约 28.8%。
Motivation: 现有 AIOps 方法能自动诊断与修复并按反馈调整响应，但规划与执行之间缺少统一决策依据，难以在长时程、多阶段安全事件响应中维持事件状态并让动作持续对齐恢复目标。
Method: 以 Graph-as-State (GAS) 维护事件证据、响应动作与执行反馈，用最新状态判定响应阶段和恢复目标，驱动分阶段专用规划；按当前状态与阶段检索经效果验证的历史经验指导动作选择；Execution Harness 执行动作、回填 GAS 并校验动作效果供后续经验复用。
Result: 自建 STAIR-Bench（44 个 Docker 网络靶场案例）留出测试集上整体防御分 0.95，较最强基线提升约 10.47%；在独立 CAGE4 环境（持续攻击与良性活动并存）中累计惩罚较最强基线降低约 28.8%。
Conclusion: 以共享事件状态贯穿规划与执行、并用经效果验证的经验复用，能在长时程多阶段安全事件响应中同时提高防御得分并降低累计惩罚。

papers.title: Different Feedback, Different Updates: Selective Self-Learning from User Interactions for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: User feedback offers natural supervision for persistent LLM improvement, but a single message may support multiple behavioral changes with different scopes of generalization. We introduce SLIFT, a selective self-learning framework built on a task-relative view of user feedback. SLIFT decomposes each feedback message into atomic components and interprets each component relative to the original task as Fix, Spec, or Null: requirements for task validity, compatible condition-specific refinements, or content with no reliable positive update direction. To incorporate each change at the appropriate scope, SLIFT trains two complementary LoRA adapters on a shared frozen backbone: a Generalist that consolidates Fix requirements into default behavior through feedback-conditioned self-distillation, and a Specialist that observes only the task and Generalist response to supply residual guidance for applicable, unmet Spec refinements. Null components induce no positive update. Across backbones, SLIFT achieves strong performance on both MemoryBench and WildFB, with targeted analyses further examining its underlying mechanisms. We release our code at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SLIFT.
papers.comment: Corrected a typo in the author metadata
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SLIFT 把用户反馈拆成原子成分并按 Fix/Spec/Null 三类判定泛化范围，用两个互补的 LoRA 适配器分别吸收任务级修正与条件性细化。在 MemoryBench 与 WildFB 上跨多种 backbone 均取得强表现。
Motivation: 单条用户反馈往往同时包含多种作用域不同的行为改动，若用统一方式做自学习更新，会把条件性细化误当成默认行为，或把无可靠更新方向的内容当成正样本。
Method: SLIFT 先将每条反馈分解为原子成分并相对原任务标注为 Fix（任务有效性要求）、Spec（兼容的条件性细化）或 Null（无可靠正更新方向）；随后在共享冻结 backbone 上训练两个 LoRA 适配器：Generalist 通过 feedback-conditioned self-distillation 把 Fix 固化为默认行为，Specialist 只看任务与 Generalist 输出，对未满足的 Spec 提供残差引导，Null 不产生正向更新。
Result: 在 MemoryBench 与 WildFB 上跨多种 backbone 均取得强表现，并有针对性分析检验其内部机制；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 按反馈成分的作用域分别建模（Fix 进默认行为、Spec 由残差适配器按需补充、Null 不更新）比单一自学习更新更适配持续 LLM 改进。

papers.title: Low, High, and Semantic-Level Vision-Language Learning for AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: Driven by advances in diffusion models and autoregressive models, the fidelity and resolution of AI-generated images now rival those of real images. However, existing AI-generated image detection methods often downsample the images,inevitably overlooking critical low-level texture details in high-resolution AI-generated images, thereby limiting their detection performance. In addition, the continuous emergence of unknown generative models makes large-scale pre-training datasets inaccessible. To address these challenges, we propose a novel AI-generated image detector, termed LHSDet (Low-, High-, and Semantic-level Detection). Specifically, we formulate the AI-generated image detection task as a Visual Question Answering problem, leveraging a fine-tuned vision-language framework to fully exploit the complementary information between visual and textual modalities. Recognizing that the default visual encoder of existing vision-language models is not tailored for AI-generated image detection, we redesign a visual encoder to better capture both the low-level and high-level artifacts inherent in AI-generated images. Furthermore, we incorporate a semantic-level textual branch to enable multi-modal feature fusion and detection. Consequently, LHSDet employs a triple-branch architecture to extract complementary multi-modal features: a low-level visual branch that aggregates non-overlapping patches for local texture cues, a high-level visual branch based on SigLIP2 for global perception feature extraction,and a semantic-level textual branch that generates captions using BLIP-2. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that LHSDet achieves strong detection accuracy and robust performance across diverse generative models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LHSDet，把 AI 生成图像检测形式化为视觉问答 (VQA) 问题，用三分支架构同时抽取低层纹理、高层全局感知与语义级文本特征。低层视觉分支聚合非重叠 patch 保留高分辨率局部纹理，高层分支基于 SigLIP2，语义分支用 BLIP-2 生成 caption 做多模态融合检测，在多种生成模型上取得强检测精度与鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有检测方法常下采样图像，丢失高分辨率 AI 生成图像的关键低层纹理细节；同时未知生成模型不断出现，大规模预训练数据难以获取。
Method: 将检测任务形式化为 VQA 问题，微调视觉-语言框架做多模态融合检测；重新设计视觉器以同时捕捉低层与高层伪影。三分支架构：低层视觉分支聚合非重叠 patch 提取局部纹理线索，高层视觉分支基于 SigLIP2 提取全局感知特征，语义级文本分支用 BLIP-2 生成 caption。
Result: 实验结果显示 LHSDet 在多种生成模型上取得强检测精度与鲁棒性能；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 低层纹理、高层感知与语义文本三类互补特征融合可支撑对未见生成模型的鲁棒 AI 生成图像检测。

papers.title: ResidencyRL: Reinforcement Learning in Simulated Clinical Environments
papers.abstract_en: In medical education, physicians convert academic knowledge into clinical expertise through residency: years of training across thousands of encounters, with diverse sources of feedback and progressively greater autonomy. Much of clinical reasoning relies on the patient encounter, a dialogue in which a clinician elicits history, refines diagnostic hypotheses, and decides management under uncertainty. While large language models (LLMs) excel on static medical benchmarks, methods to optimize the full sequence of clinical decisions remain underdeveloped. We present ResidencyRL, a reinforcement learning (RL) method for training clinical artificial intelligence (AI) agents through simulated multi-turn clinical encounters (up to 60 dialogue turns and 8 tool calls per trajectory). ResidencyRL pairs the policy agent with LLM simulators capable of complex, adversarial behaviors, training against a structured reward aligned to diagnostic accuracy, management quality, communication, documentation, and safety. On held-out evaluations, the ResidencyRL agent improves diagnostic accuracy by 7.0% under adversarial conditions (88.0% vs. 81.0%) and reduces missed red flag rates by 31%, demonstrating rigorous mitigation of premature closure. Blinded expert clinicians validated these gains, preferring the trained agent in 87.6% of side-by-side comparisons. The procedural competencies transfer to unseen benchmarks: the agent outperforms the base model across all six clinical axes of the AMIE multi-visit benchmark, and shows consistent directional improvements on AgentClinic and CRAFT-MD. Our findings demonstrate that sequential clinical decision-making can be effectively learned through multi-turn RL in simulation, yielding robust, generalizable capabilities, paving the way towards clinical mastery. Prospective validation with real-world workflows remains necessary to establish clinical utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ResidencyRL 用强化学习在模拟多轮临床问诊中训练临床 AI agent：策略与具备对抗行为的 LLM 模拟器对练，按诊断准确性、管理质量、沟通、记录与安全的结构化奖励优化。在留出评估的对抗条件下诊断准确率从 81.0% 升到 88.0%（+7.0%），漏诊红旗率下降 31%，盲评专家在 87.6% 的成对比较中偏好该 agent。
Motivation: LLM 在静态医学基准上表现好，但优化完整临床决策序列（问诊、鉴别、处置）的方法仍不成熟；住院医师式训练正是靠数千次真实接诊与多源反馈积累临床能力。
Method: 把策略 agent 与可产生复杂对抗行为的 LLM 模拟器配对，进行多轮临床接诊 RL 训练，单条轨迹最多 60 轮对话与 8 次工具调用；奖励为结构化多目标，覆盖诊断准确性、管理质量、沟通、文档与安全。
Result: 留出评估中对抗条件下诊断准确率 88.0% vs 81.0%（提升 7.0%），漏诊红旗率降低 31%；盲评临床专家在 87.6% 的并排比较中偏好训练后 agent；在 AMIE multi-visit 基准的全部六个临床轴上均胜过 base model，并在 AgentClinic 与 CRAFT-MD 上呈一致方向改善。
Conclusion: 多轮模拟 RL 可以学出可迁移的序贯临床决策能力；作者同时指出仍需在真实工作流中做前瞻性验证以确立临床效用。

papers.title: GraphVerse: A Comprehensive Visual Graph Reasoning Benchmark for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress across diverse vision-language tasks, creating an urgent need for more challenging benchmarks. Yet existing evaluations still provide limited insight into whether these models can truly reason over structured visual information. Visual Graph Reasoning (VGR) offers a compelling testbed for this challenge, requiring models to integrate perception, structural understanding, and multi-step reasoning over graph-based visual inputs. However, prior VGR benchmarks often reduce the task to visual perception followed by text-based reasoning, restrict evaluation to single-image settings, rely on answer-only metrics, and underrepresent realistic graph-centric scenarios. To bridge the gap, we introduce GraphVerse, a unified benchmark that jointly evaluates perception, visual reasoning, and text-based graph reasoning in MLLMs under both single-image and paired-image settings. At its core is a suite of Graph-centric Image Editing (GIE) strategies that modify graph images while preserving their semantics, turning them into active tests of visual reasoning. We further propose VGR-Score, a process-sensitive metric that evaluates reasoning quality beyond final-answer accuracy. Extensive experiments reveal several key limitations of current MLLMs in VGR, while also validating the effectiveness of GIE strategies and the transferability of GraphVerse to broader multimodal reasoning capabilities. The code is available at https://github.com/sunyuanfu/GraphVerse.

papers.title: What Current AI Benchmarks Leave Unmeasured: Modality, Search, Citations, and Implications (for Safety Evaluations)
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) benchmark evaluations are routinely used to support claims about model safety, reliability, and deployment readiness. Yet most evaluations rely on a single access modality (model APIs), perform a single run per prompt, and report accuracy as the primary outcome metric, without accounting for conditions such as web search that may have effects on model behavior in deployment. We audit these assumptions for one of the most widely-used LLMs, comparing two modalities, ChatGPT's chat UI and OpenAI's API, with and without web search enabled. We use a stratified total sample of 401 prompts from two popular benchmarks, BBQ and SafetyBench, collecting 4,812 total responses across three repeated runs per prompt. Beyond standard performance measures, we evaluate model output dimensions including response consistency, response text similarity, citation grounding, and abstention behavior. For instance, chat UI responses were less accurate than API responses on both benchmarks with search disabled. Enabling web search reduced accuracy by up to 8 percentage points, and even reversed the direction of modality performance trends for one benchmark. Repeated runs of the same prompt produced inconsistent responses in up to 21\% of prompts. The two modalities also grounded answers in different citations, and abstention behavior was also inconsistent across both modalities. These results illustrate that, even within a model family, reporting only simple accuracy metrics can obscure important forms of model behavioral variation relevant to AI safety assessments. We argue that AI safety evaluations should systematically account for modality, multi-run consistency, search conditions, and response-level behaviors to better reflect how deployed AI systems behave in practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 LLM 安全基准的评测假设做审计：同一模型家族内比较 ChatGPT chat UI 与 OpenAI API 两种访问模态，并在开启/关闭 web search 下各跑三次重复。关闭搜索时 chat UI 在 BBQ 与 SafetyBench 上都比 API 准确率低；开启搜索使准确率最多下降 8 个百分点，且在一个基准上反转了模态优劣方向；同一 prompt 重复运行最多有 21% 的回答不一致。
Motivation: LLM 基准评测通常只用单一访问模态（API）、每个 prompt 只跑一次、只报准确率，忽略 web search 等部署中真实存在的条件，导致安全与部署就绪结论可能失真。
Method: 分层抽取 BBQ 与 SafetyBench 两个基准共 401 条 prompt，跨 chat UI 与 API 两种模态、搜索开/关两种条件、每条 prompt 三次重复，共收集 4,812 条回答；除常规性能外还测回答一致性、回答文本相似度、citation grounding（引用有据性）与 abstention（弃答）行为。
Result: 关闭搜索时 chat UI 在两个基准上均低于 API 准确率；开启 web search 使准确率最多下降 8 个百分点，并在一个基准上反转了模态性能趋势方向；同一 prompt 重复运行最多 21% 的回答不一致；两种模态 grounding 到不同的引用来源，弃答行为在两模态间也不一致。
Conclusion: 只报单一准确率会掩盖同一模型家族内与 AI 安全评估相关的行为差异，安全评测应系统纳入访问模态、多次运行一致性、搜索条件与回答层面行为，以贴近部署中的真实系统表现。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: CASCADE: An Agentic Regulatory Network Framework for Patient-Data-Validated Downstream Perturbation Prediction
papers.abstract_en: CASCADE is an agentic framework that predicts downstream transcriptional effects of gene perturbation from precomputed ARACNe regulatory networks, exposed via MCP. Prior work validates such tools by checking whether predicted genes are known cancer genes (membership); we instead test whether the predicted direction of change matches reality, using focal-gene copy-number amplification as a dosage-based proxy for the inverse of knockdown against real TCGA patient tumor data. For MYC, CASCADE's predicted knockdown targets show strong concordance with real amplified-vs-non-amplified tumor expression across three cancer types (BRCA: 90.0%, COAD: 72.0%, STAD: 85.7%; all p<=0.0013), well above permutation baselines, surviving a PAM50 subtype control and replicating in an independent cohort (METABRIC, 87.2%). Compared against curated MSigDB gene-set baselines via Fisher's exact test, CASCADE's accuracy is not shown to exceed existing public knowledge of MYC- or E2F-driven biology, though its gene-specific direction-calling clearly outperforms a naive uniform guess. Extending to fifteen additional genes, validation proves gene-specific rather than universal: proliferation-machinery regulators mostly replicate, while lineage-identity transcription factors and one cyclin-D paralog (CCND2) consistently fail, a pattern we discuss as a hedged, post-hoc hypothesis. We separately benchmark whether an LLM-based agent correctly grounds natural-language requests into CASCADE's real MCP tool calls. Across 35 queries, a documented local model reaches 71.4% exact match (85.7% for a larger model); schema and gene-alias failures are resolved by scale or server-side correction, but both models confidently default to the wrong perturbation type on ambiguous queries, a failure a targeted fix could not resolve because its trigger condition never occurs.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 2 figures. v3: corrected the aracne.networks reference; updated the RegNetAgents comparison to its v3; replaced OncoKB with IntOGen; updated data, licensing and code availability (software v1.5.0). Results unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CASCADE 用预计算 ARACNe 调控网络加 MCP 工具，让 LLM agent 预测基因扰动的下游转录效应，并以 TCGA 患者肿瘤中拷贝数扩增作为敲低的反向剂量代理来检验预测的变化方向。MYC 预测靶点与真实扩增-非扩增表达差异在 BRCA 90.0%、COAD 72.0%、STAD 85.7% 一致（p<=0.0013），METABRIC 独立队列复现 87.2%；但对 MSigDB 基因集基线的 Fisher 精确检验未显示其超越既有 MYC/E2F 生物学知识。
Motivation: 基因扰动工具的既有验证只查预测基因是否为已知癌基因（成员资格），不检验预测的变化方向是否与真实患者数据一致；且 LLM agent 能否正确把自然语言落到真实工具调用上缺少基准。
Method: CASCADE 从预计算 ARACNe 调控网络出发，经 MCP 暴露工具，由 LLM agent 预测扰动的下游转录效应；以焦点基因拷贝数扩增作为敲低反向的剂量代理，对照 TCGA 患者肿瘤真实表达，做 PAM50 亚型控制与置换基线，并用 Fisher 精确测试对比 MSigDB 基因集；另以 35 条自然语言查询评测 agent 的工具调用 grounding。
Result: MYC 敲低预测靶点与真实扩增 vs 非扩增肿瘤表达一致率 BRCA 90.0%、COAD 72.0%、STAD 85.7%（均 p<=0.0013），高于置换基线，通过 PAM50 亚型控制，并在 METABRIC 复现 87.2%；对 MSigDB 基线的 Fisher 检验未显示超越既有 MYC/E2F 知识，但方向判定明显优于均匀随机猜测。扩展到另外 15 个基因后，增殖机制调控因子多可复现，谱系身份转录因子与 CCND2 一致失败。工具 grounding 上 35 条查询中本地模型 71.4% 精确匹配，更大模型 85.7%。
Conclusion: CASCADE 的方向预测在增殖相关基因上可被真实患者数据验证，但这种验证是基因特异而非普适的，且其准确率未超过既有公共知识；agent 在歧义查询上会自信地选错扰动类型，该失败无法由针对性修复消除。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Enhancing Tabular Learners with Context-Aware Semantic Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: While modern tabular learners excel at capturing statistical patterns, they frequently operate in a semantic vacuum, treating textual features as discrete symbols, ignoring the rich semantics inherent in feature names or cell entries. We propose CASE (Context-Aware Semantic Embeddings), a novel framework that bridges the gap between the semantic understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) and the statistical capabilities of tabular learners. Unlike existing methods that embed rows in isolation, CASE utilizes a contextualization strategy: we pre-fill the KV cache of a custom-trained Gemma 3-based Tabular Language Model with a representative sample of rows to establish a persistent anchor of the dataset's semantics. This ensures that generated row embeddings are dynamically contextualized, resolving semantic ambiguities and anchoring representations in domain-specific context. Our experiments across several benchmarks (CARTE, TextTab, and TabArena) demonstrate that CASE substantially improves the performance of tabular learners on semantically rich datasets, particularly in low-data regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CASE 用自训练的 Gemma 3 表格语言模型，把数据集代表性行样本预填进 KV cache 作为语义锚点，再生成被上下文化 (contextualized) 的行嵌入喂给表格学习器。在 CARTE、TextTab、TabArena 多个基准上，CASE 在语义丰富数据集上显著提升表格学习器性能，低数据 (low-data) 环节提升尤其明显。
Motivation: 表格学习器把文本特征当离散符号处理，忽略特征名与单元格文本中的语义，处于语义真空；已有行级孤立嵌入方法无法利用数据集整体的领域上下文。
Method: CASE (Context-Aware Semantic Embeddings)：以自训练 Gemma 3-based Tabular Language Model 为核心，先用数据集代表性行样本预填 KV cache 建立持久语义锚点，再据此生成动态上下文化的行嵌入，用于消解语义歧义并把表示锚定到领域上下文，最后接入表格学习器。
Result: 在 CARTE、TextTab、TabArena 多个基准上，CASE 在语义丰富数据集上显著提升表格学习器性能，且在低数据 regime 提升尤为突出；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把 LLM 的语义理解通过 KV cache 锚点注入表格学习器，可在语义丰富、样本稀缺的表格任务上有效补足纯统计模型的短板。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DRIFT: Derailing Denoising Trajectories of Flow-Matching VLAs with Adversarial Patch Attack
papers.abstract_en: Flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) models such as pi0 generate robot actions by integrating a learned denoising velocity field, and have been reported to resist adversarial perturbations that readily fool autoregressive VLAs. We show that this robustness is largely illusory: it stems from prior attacks ignoring the multi-step denoising ODE. We introduce DRIFT (Denoising Redirection via Input perturbation of the Flow-matching Trajectory), a test-time universal adversarial patch placed on the robot's gripper that attacks the denoising velocity field of an off-the-shelf policy. Our central finding is counterintuitive: attacking only the first denoising step is both stronger and cheaper than attacking a wider window of steps, which we explain through a gradient conflict unique to input-space optimization and which is exactly opposite to the training-time backdoor regime. On pi0 and pi0.5 across four LIBERO suites, DRIFT breaks essentially all originally-solvable tasks with a small single patch, far exceeding action- and embedding-space attack baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DRIFT 提出贴在机器人夹爪上的测试时通用对抗 patch，直接攻击 flow-matching VLA（如 pi0）去噪速度场的去噪轨迹，证明其所谓对抗鲁棒性是假象。核心发现反直觉：只攻击第一步去噪比攻击更宽的步窗口更强也更省，作者归因于输入空间优化特有的梯度冲突，且与训练时后门机制方向相反。
Motivation: flow-matching VLA 被报告能抵抗轻易骗过自回归 VLA 的对抗扰动，但既有攻击忽略了多步去噪 ODE，这一鲁棒性可能是错觉。
Method: DRIFT（Denoising Redirection via Input perturbation of the Flow-matching Trajectory）在机器人夹爪上放置一个测试时通用对抗 patch，对现成策略的去噪速度场施加输入空间扰动；通过分析输入空间优化特有的梯度冲突解释为何只攻击第一步去噪更有效。
Result: 在 pi0 与 pi0.5 上、覆盖 LIBERO 四个 suite，DRIFT 用一个小 patch 基本破坏全部原本可解的任务，远超 action-space 与 embedding-space 攻击基线；攻击仅第一步去噪比攻击更宽步窗口更强且开销更低。
Conclusion: flow-matching VLA 的对抗鲁棒性很大程度是假象，源于既有攻击忽略多步去噪 ODE；去噪轨迹的首步是更有效的攻击面，其机制与训练时后门恰好相反。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Particle-based Generalised Stochastic Optimisation
papers.abstract_en: We develop a class of general diffusion-based stochastic particle optimisation methods for loss functions with intractable gradients. Specifically, we consider problems in which the loss gradient is an integral with respect to a parameter-dependent distribution, a structure that includes training generative models, fine-tuning, and learning latent-variable models. We introduce mean-field dynamics and its interacting-particle approximations, which contain several existing algorithms as special cases and provide a route to constructing new methods. Under well-posedness and joint contractivity assumptions, we prove exponential convergence and show that the continuous-time particle system admits a non-asymptotic error bound. We illustrate our framework by developing higher-order Langevin and momentum optimisers and evaluating them on maximum marginal-likelihood estimation and energy-based-model training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一类基于扩散的粒子随机优化框架，用于损失梯度是参数相关分布下积分、因而不可解析计算的问题；其均场动力学与交互粒子近似把若干已有算法收为特例。在适定性与联合压缩性假设下证明指数收敛，并给出连续时间粒子系统的非渐近误差界；据此构造的高阶 Langevin 与动量优化器在最大边际似然估计和能量基模型训练上得到检验。
Motivation: 生成模型训练、微调与潜变量学习中，损失梯度是参数相关分布下的积分，无法直接求值，常规梯度优化器失效；需要一类有收敛保证的粒子式替代方案。
Method: 以扩散过程构造随机粒子优化：建立均场动力学及其交互粒子近似，覆盖已有算法作为特例；在适定性与联合压缩性 (joint contractivity) 假设下分析收敛，并据此设计高阶 Langevin 优化器与带动量的优化器，用于最大边际似然估计与能量基模型 (energy-based model) 训练。
Result: 证明了指数收敛，并给出连续时间粒子系统的非渐近误差界 (non-asymptotic error bound)；框架在最大边际似然估计与能量基模型训练任务上用于说明所构造的高阶 Langevin 和动量优化器。
Conclusion: 把不可解析梯度的损失统一写成参数相关分布下的积分后，均场粒子动力学既涵盖已有算法，又能在压缩性条件下给出指数收敛与误差界，并支撑构造更高阶的优化器。

papers.title: Loop-Mamba: A Loop Mamba with Degradation-Aware and Shared Memory for Old Photo Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Old photographs often suffer from multiple coupled degradations, including scratches, cracks, fading, blur, noise, and missing regions, severely degrading both visual quality and semantic content. We propose Loop-Mamba, a lightweight loop-based state-space framework that formulates old photo restoration as progressive state evolution, where a persis- tent restoration state is continuously propagated and refined through iterative computation. Specifically, we introduce a Semantic-Guided Degradation Estimator (SGDE) to explicitly model heterogeneous degradations by jointly predicting local degradation maps and global degradation scores, providing degradation-aware guidance for state evolution. We further develop a Shared Structural Memory Mamba (S$^2$M- Mamba), which maintains a persistent restoration state across iterations, enabling persistent state evolution through shared structural memory for robust long-range structural reconstruction. Benefiting from first-order state recursion, Loop-Mamba propagates latent restoration states through recurrent tran- sitions instead of repeatedly stacking deep feature transformations, thereby alleviating gradient dilution while avoiding the computational overhead inherent in iterative CNN- and Transformer-based restoration frameworks. A lightweight multi-directional scanning strategy further enhances direc- tional information aggregation and preserves structural continuity. To better evaluate restoration quality, we introduce the task-oriented Old Photo Damage Recovery Score (ODRS), which jointly measures degradation recovery and structural reconstruction fidelity. Experimental results on the public SynOld benchmark demonstrate that Loop-Mamba consistently outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods across both conventional restoration metrics and the proposed ODRS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Loop-Mamba 把老照片修复表述为循环状态空间演化：持久修复状态经一阶递归在迭代间传播，由退化感知模块提供引导。在公开 SynOld 基准上，该方法在常规修复指标与新提出的 ODRS 上均超过此前 SOTA。
Motivation: 老照片同时存在划痕、裂纹、褪色、模糊、噪声与缺失区域等多种耦合退化，视觉质量与语义内容都严重受损；现有 CNN/Transformer 迭代修复框架计算开销大且存在梯度稀释。
Method: 提出轻量循环 Mamba 框架：Semantic-Guided Degradation Estimator (SGDE) 联合预测局部退化图与全局退化分，为状态演化提供退化感知引导；Shared Structural Memory Mamba (S²M-Mamba) 跨迭代维护持久修复状态，配合多方向扫描策略聚合方向信息；另提出面向任务的 Old Photo Damage Recovery Score (ODRS) 度量退化恢复与结构重建保真度。
Result: 在公开 SynOld 基准上，Loop-Mamba 在常规修复指标与所提 ODRS 上均一致优于此前 SOTA 方法；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 用一阶状态递归加共享结构记忆替代反复堆叠深层特征变换，可在保持轻量的同时缓解梯度稀释并改善长程结构重建。

papers.title: Preference Elicitation for Policy Optimization and Application to Aligning Heart Transplantation with Human Values
papers.abstract_en: Preference elicitation is essential for aligning AI systems with human values. Prior approaches (e.g., for organ allocation) often ask stakeholders to compare the decisions of an algorithm (e.g., patient A vs. patient B). Such a decision-level approach conflates the means with the ends. Instead, we elicit preferences directly over allocation outcomes to learn a utility function for policy optimization. We construct a novel preference elicitation algorithm for linear utilities that outperforms prior techniques in practice. Our algorithm has two phases. The first phase learns cutting planes through pairwise comparisons to rapidly shrink the space of possible attribute weights and warm-starts the second phase by eliminating dominated regions. The second phase then provably converges to the user's utility function. We apply our technique to heart transplant allocation, where a policy must balance competing objectives such as post-transplant outcomes, waitlist mortality, geographic ease, and equity. Using our algorithm, we conduct a user study to learn and aggregate a human-value-aligned utility function. We evaluate the linear representation against LLM-based methods supplied with users' natural language explanations, finding that none of these methods is more accurate than the learned linear utilities. We use the resulting utility function to optimize heart transplant policies that are significantly better aligned with human values. Compared to the hindsight optimum, the status quo policy achieves a competitive ratio of just 0.66, while our method is near-optimal with a competitive ratio of 0.95.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向线性效用的两阶段偏好 elicitation 算法：第一阶段用成对比较学习切割平面快速收缩属性权重空间并消除被支配区域，第二阶段可证明收敛到用户效用函数。在心脏移植分配的用户研究中，学得的线性效用比用自然语言解释喂给 LLM 的方法更准，据此优化的策略相对事后最优的 competitive ratio 达 0.95，而现状政策仅 0.66。
Motivation: 器官分配等对齐场景通常让人比较算法给出的两个具体决策（患者 A vs 患者 B），把手段与目的混在一起，难以直接学到反映人类价值的目标函数。
Method: 两阶段线性效用 elicitation：第一阶段通过 pairwise comparison 学习切割平面收缩属性权重空间并热启动、消除被支配区域；第二阶段保证收敛到用户效用。随后在心脏移植分配上做用户研究，学习并聚合人值对齐的效用函数，再用它优化分配策略。
Result: 线性表示与基于 LLM、输入用户自然语言解释的方法对比，没有任何 LLM 方法比学到的线性效用更准；用该效用优化的心脏移植政策相对事后最优的 competitive ratio 为 0.95，现状政策仅 0.66，且被描述为显著更符合人类价值。
Conclusion: 直接对分配结果做偏好 elicitation 学到的线性效用，足以支撑比现状政策更贴近人类价值的器官分配优化，且在准确度上不输给用自然语言解释的 LLM 方法。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Learning from All-Failed Groups via First-Visit Coverage in Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Group-based policy optimization has been increasingly used to train large language model (LLM) agents from sparse outcome rewards by comparing trajectories or steps within a group. However, on difficult long-horizon agentic tasks, we found this comparison suffers from a sampling imbalance: repeated or low-effect actions dominate the high-probability region of the policy, leaving useful state-changing actions under-sampled. This imbalance produces many all-failed rollout groups, where the relative advantages within such a group provide no direction for updating the policy. Consequently, the sampling imbalance and the all-failed groups collapse into a self-perpetuating credit trap: failure-dominated sampling yields no learning signal, allowing repeated low-effect actions to persist. To break this trap, we propose Coverage-conditioned Group Policy Optimization (CovGPO), which uses first-visit observation coverage only when all samples in a group receive zero outcome reward. Specifically, within such groups, CovGPO assigns higher relative advantages to state-exploring actions without corrupting the original reward signal, as reaching new observations is a prerequisite for task success. Experiments on two challenging agentic benchmarks, ALFWorld and WebShop, show that CovGPO consistently improves over group-based baselines, with particularly large gains on hard tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CovGPO 在组内全部样本奖励为零时才启用首次访问观测覆盖 (first-visit observation coverage)，给探索性动作更高相对优势，从而打破长程 agentic 任务中重复低效动作主导采样、组内无学习信号的 credit trap。在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上一致优于 group-based 基线，hard 任务提升尤其大。
Motivation: 长程 LLM agent 任务上，组内相对比较受采样失衡影响：重复或低效动作占据策略高概率区，产生大量 all-failed 组，组内相对优势无法为策略更新提供方向，形成自我强化的 credit trap。
Method: 提出 Coverage-conditioned Group Policy Optimization (CovGPO)：仅当组内所有样本的 outcome reward 为零时，用首次访问观测覆盖给状态探索动作分配更高相对优势，不改动原始奖励信号；其余情况沿用原有 group-based policy optimization。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 两个 agentic benchmark 上，CovGPO 一致优于 group-based 基线，在 hard 任务上提升尤其大。
Conclusion: 在 all-failed 组中以首次访问覆盖替代无信号的组内相对比较，可以在不污染 outcome reward 的前提下恢复长程任务的学习方向。

papers.title: Medical foundation models converge less under label supervision
papers.abstract_en: Diagnostic classifiers and imaging biomarkers are fitted on the embeddings of medical foundation models. These models are replaced as new versions appear. This practice assumes that different models represent images alike. We tested this assumption with more than 750,000 images from 14 datasets in 5 imaging modalities, 18 public models, and 101 models trained on chest radiographs and histopathology that differ in pretraining objective, label type, size, random seed, initialization, training patients, or training recipe. Agreement was measured as the mutual k-nearest-neighbor overlap, the share of an image's nearest neighbors common to two models. Two public models shared on average 0.091 of the 10 nearest neighbors of a chest radiograph. A randomly initialized network shared 0.036 with them. In the four other modalities, they shared at most 0.300. On chest radiographs, agreement depended more on the source dataset and the radiographic view than on the findings. It was not significantly associated with accuracy. A linear mapping between the embeddings of two models, fitted on 4,096 unlabeled radiographs, transferred classifiers for 14 chest findings with 0.987 of their original area under the receiver operating characteristic curve. Convergence depended on the pretraining objective. Label-supervised models converged least at both model sizes in chest radiography and histopathology. On chest radiographs, two label-supervised models that differed only in their random seed shared 0.062 to 0.100 of their nearest neighbors. Two models trained with self-distillation, masked image modeling, or contrastive pretraining shared 0.411 to 0.802. Developers can therefore choose convergence when they choose the pretraining objective. Before replacing a model, users could test on unlabeled images whether its successor returns the same nearest neighbors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 医学基础模型的嵌入空间并不像下游实践默认的那样彼此一致：在 75 万张影像、14 个数据集、5 种模态、18 个公开模型与 101 个胸片/病理模型上，两个公开模型对同一张胸片的 10 个最近邻平均只共享 0.091，随机初始化网络也有 0.036。收敛度主要由预训练目标决定——仅随机种子不同的两个标签监督模型只共享 0.062–0.100，而自蒸馏、掩码图像建模或对比预训练的模型共享 0.411–0.802。作者建议换模型前先用无标签影像检验最近邻是否一致。
Motivation: 诊断分类器和影像生物标志物普遍拟合在医学基础模型的嵌入上，模型又随新版本不断替换，但这一做法默认不同模型对图像的表示是相似的，该假设此前未经系统检验。
Method: 用 mutual k-nearest-neighbor overlap（两个模型共同的最近邻占比）度量嵌入一致性，覆盖 14 个数据集、5 种模态、18 个公开模型，以及在预训练目标、标签类型、规模、随机种子、初始化、训练患者和训练配方上变化的 101 个胸片与病理模型；另在 4,096 张无标签胸片上拟合两个模型嵌入间的线性映射来迁移分类器。
Result: 两个公开模型对一张胸片的 10 个最近邻平均共享 0.091，随机初始化网络与之共享 0.036；其余四种模态最多共享 0.300。胸片上一致性更取决于来源数据集与投照视角而非所见病变，且与准确率无显著关联。线性映射迁移 14 项胸片诊断分类器后保留原始 ROC AUC 的 0.987。标签监督模型在胸片与病理上、两种模型规模下收敛最差：仅随机种子不同的两个标签监督模型共享 0.062–0.100，自蒸馏/掩码图像建模/对比预训练的模型共享 0.411–0.802。
