papers.title: Planning with Transformers: Chain of Computation and Structured Context Windows
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have had a remarkable impact across many areas of machine learning. However, recent studies have shown that they struggle to reliably solve planning problems, particularly when compared with classical planners. Even with recent advances in reasoning-oriented models, the extent to which LLMs can genuinely perform planning remains an open question. At the same time, theoretical results have shown that transformers, the core architecture underlying modern LLMs, are Turing-complete. In this work, we investigate this apparent gap between the theoretical computational power of LLMs and their empirical planning performance. We propose Chain of Computation (COC), a computational architecture that places a transformer-based LM inside an iterative loop and leverages its strength as a pattern-matching system. COC uses a Structured Context Window (SCW) as external memory, allowing the model to access only the portion of the accumulated context required at each planning step and thereby maintain an approximately constant input size. Within this architecture, the LM learns the planning policy and world model and performs the arithmetic operations required during planning. We show that relatively small LMs trained from scratch can learn planning procedures from a small number of training instances and generalize to unseen problems, achieving success rates above 99\% on BlocksWorld and the Pancake puzzle. We further show that COC can be formulated as a pushdown automaton (PDA). This formulation can solve Tower of Hanoi (TOH) instances with up to 20 disks and enables the planner to execute the depth-first search (DFS) algorithm. Theoretically, we characterize how the accumulation of irrelevant context increases planning failure probability under the standard full-context setup and how the SCW mitigates this effect.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Chain of Computation (COC)：把基于 transformer 的 LM 放进迭代循环，用 Structured Context Window (SCW) 作为外部记忆，只读取当前规划步所需的上下文片段，使输入规模近似恒定。从零训练的小模型在少量训练实例上学会规划过程并泛化到未见问题，BlocksWorld 与 Pancake 成功率超过 99%；COC 可形式化为下推自动机 (PDA)，可解 20 层汉诺塔并执行深度优先搜索。
Motivation: LLM 在规划问题上难以稳定胜过经典规划器，而理论上 transformer 又是图灵完备的，这一理论能力与实证表现之间的落差需要解释和弥合。
Method: COC 架构把 LM 置于迭代循环中，SCW 作为外部记忆按需提供累积上下文的相关片段；LM 在循环内学习规划策略、世界模型并执行规划所需的算术运算。作者进一步把 COC 形式化为下推自动机 (PDA)，并从理论上刻画无关上下文累积如何提高标准全上下文设置下的规划失败概率。
Result: 从零训练的相对较小 LM 在少量训练实例上学习规划过程并泛化到未见问题，在 BlocksWorld 与 Pancake 谜题上成功率超过 99%；PDA 形式化可解多达 20 个盘的 Tower of Hanoi 实例并支持执行 DFS；理论上给出无关上下文累积导致规划失败概率上升的刻画及 SCW 的缓解机制。
Conclusion: 把 LM 当作模式匹配与算术执行单元嵌入带结构化外部记忆的迭代循环，小模型也能可靠执行规划并泛化，全上下文设置下的失败主要来自无关上下文的累积。

papers.title: Equality, Equity, and Causality in Fairness Research: A Commentary on Cheng (2026)
papers.abstract_en: This is an invited commentary on the Psychometrika focus article "Fairness Issues and Evaluation in Psychometrics and AI/ML: What Can We Learn from Each Field?" by Ying Cheng (2026, doi:10.1017/psy.2026.10110). Cheng offers a systematic comparison between long-standing test fairness and modern algorithmic fairness. Her mapping of the entire testing workflow onto the AI/ML fairness paradigm, rather than only the final selection stage, is a crucial contribution to interdisciplinary fairness research. This commentary extends her discussion by examining two conceptual issues: the distinction between equality and equity, and the role of causality in fairness research. The focus article and this commentary point to directions for future fairness research across the psychometrics and AI/ML communities.
papers.comment: Invited commentary on Cheng (2026), doi:10.1017/psy.2026.10110; accepted in Psychometrika
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇针对 Cheng (2026) 心理测量学与 AI/ML 公平性比较文章的受邀评论，肯定其把整个测试流程（而非仅最终选拔环节）映射到算法公平性框架的贡献，并进一步讨论两个概念问题：equality 与 equity 的区分，以及因果性 (causality) 在公平性研究中的作用。
Motivation: 心理测量学的测验公平与 AI/ML 的算法公平长期各自发展，Cheng (2026) 系统比较两者，但 equality/equity 之别与因果视角在跨领域讨论中仍待厘清。
Method: 作为 Psychometrika 焦点文章的受邀评论，围绕两个概念议题展开论述：辨析 equality 与 equity，并考察因果推断在公平性研究中的角色；属概念性评论而非实验研究。
Result: 评论确认 Cheng 将完整测试工作流映射到 AI/ML 公平性范式（而非仅最终选拔阶段）是跨学科公平性研究的关键贡献，并在此基础上扩展出 equality/equity 区分与因果性两个议题。
Conclusion: 心理测量与 AI/ML 两个社区的公平性研究可相互借鉴，未来方向在于把概念区分与因果框架纳入公平性评估。

papers.title: Robustness of Reinforcement Learning-Based Congestion Management in Low-Voltage Grids
papers.abstract_en: Increases in photovoltaic generation, charging of electric vehicles and heat-pump demand challenge operating limits in low-voltage distribution grids. This requires curative curtailment methods that can operate under sparse observability, noisy measurements, and imperfect grid models. Unlike prior end-to-end reinforcement-learning approaches for partially observable curtailment, this work decouples congestion detection and control by combining a random-forest violation pre-classifier with an actor-critic controller, and evaluates its robustness to measurement noise and grid-parameter mismatch. The framework is tested on a real low-voltage grid using synthetic future operating scenarios with low observability and controllability. With accurate grid parameters, the controller reduces total violation magnitude by 98.9%, and this performance remains nearly unchanged under the tested measurement-noise settings. Grid-model mismatch proves to be more challenging, but the controller still mitigates most violations under the tested mismatch assumptions.
papers.journal_ref: J. Hoppe, S. Bouchkati, et al., "Robustness of Reinforcement Learning-Based Congestion Management in Low-Voltage Grids," 2026 International Conference on Smart Energy Systems and Technologies (SEST), Ciudad Real, Spain, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 低压配电网拥塞管理中，把拥塞检测与控制解耦：随机森林做越限预分类，actor-critic 控制器做削减决策。在真实低压电网加合成未来运行场景、低可观测与低可控条件下，参数准确时总越限幅值下降 98.9%，且在所测测量噪声设置下几乎不变；网格模型失配更具挑战，但仍能缓解大部分越限。
Motivation: 光伏、电动车充电与热泵负荷推高低压配电网运行限值，需要在稀疏观测、含噪测量与不完美电网模型下仍可用的补救性削减方法；既有端到端强化学习方案在部分可观测削减场景中鲁棒性不足。
Method: 将拥塞检测与控制解耦：随机森林作为越限预分类器，actor-critic 控制器负责削减决策；在真实低压电网与合成未来运行场景上测试，系统性考察测量噪声与电网参数失配两类扰动。
Result: 电网参数准确时，控制器使总越限幅值降低 98.9%；在所测试的测量噪声设置下该性能几乎不变；在所测试的模型失配假设下仍能缓解大部分越限。
Conclusion: 检测与控制解耦的 RL 框架在低可观测低压电网中对测量噪声稳健，主要脆弱点是电网模型参数失配。

papers.title: Who&When Pro: Can LLMs Really Attribute Failures in AI Agents?
papers.abstract_en: Automated failure attribution uses LLMs to identify where and why agentic systems fail. As agents become more capable, their failures become subtler, making automated attribution increasingly important. We introduce Who&When Pro, a large-scale benchmark for automated failure attribution in agentic systems. Using a strictly controlled pipeline that injects a failure only after exactly replaying a successful prefix, we construct 12,326 failed trajectories with golden labels across 3 modalities and 26 benchmarks covering various scenarios. Beyond benchmarking, we conduct extensive experiments and analyses, revealing systematic patterns in how models attribute failures across modalities, protocols, and model families, and providing empirical guidance for future automated failure attribution systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Who&When Pro 是面向智能体 (agent) 自动失败归因的大规模基准：先严格重放成功前缀、再注入单点失败，构造带 golden label 的失败轨迹，用 LLM 判定失败发生在何处与为何。共 12,326 条失败轨迹、3 种模态、26 个 benchmark，实验揭示模型在不同模态、协议与模型家族上的归因模式差异。
Motivation: 随着智能体能力增强，其失败变得更细微，人工定位困难，自动失败归因因此愈发关键；但缺少受控构造、带金标的规模化评测基准。
Method: 采用严格受控的构造流水线：完整重放一条成功前缀后才注入一次失败，从而得到可定位的失败点；在此之上构建覆盖 3 种模态、26 个场景 benchmark 的 12,326 条带 golden label 的失败轨迹，并对多种模型做归因实验与分析。
Result: 构建了 12,326 条带 golden label 的失败轨迹，覆盖 3 种模态与 26 个 benchmark；实验揭示模型在模态、协议 (protocol) 与模型家族之间存在系统性的归因模式差异。
Conclusion: 受控注入失败的重放式构造能产出可归因的大规模评测集，模型的失败归因表现随模态、协议和模型家族系统变化，可为后续自动失败归因系统提供经验性指导。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Measuring Harness-Induced Belief Divergence in Multi-Step LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Software agents are becoming increasingly important in modern coding workflows, where they solve complex tasks through multi-step interaction with code repositories. A central component of these systems is the execution harness, which governs how the underlying LLM observes, acts on, and verifies its environment. We show that the harness can in turn shape the agent's evolving beliefs about the environment, even when the task, environment, and base LLM remain fixed. To reveal this effect, we introduce a belief-rollout diagnostic that traces how an agent's anticipated world state and future decisions evolve under alternative harnesses. We further separate immediate divergence introduced by the interface from divergence that develops over longer horizons. Across controlled coding tasks include HIBench-Code, SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench, we find substantial cross-harness belief divergence that is often invisible from terminal success alone and can propagate into different downstream actions. Building on this observation, we introduce \textbf{Belief-Invariant World-Modeling (BIWM)}, which exposes evidence hidden or compressed by harness execution and aligns the resulting belief trajectories across different harnesses. Our findings reveal that harness design can systematically shape how software agents understand and act on their environments, providing practical guidance for building and evaluating more reliable coding agents.

Result: 在受控编码任务 HIBench-Code、SWE-bench Verified 与 Terminal-Bench 上发现显著的跨 harness 信念分歧，该分歧常从终端成功指标上看不出来，并会传导为不同的下游动作。
Conclusion: harness 设计会系统性塑造软件智能体对环境的理解与行动，因此构建和评估更可靠的编码智能体时必须把 harness 作为变量来控制与对齐。

papers.title: Agent Step Value: Auditing Evaluation-Channel Sensitivity in Black-Box Agent Traces
papers.abstract_en: Reusing evaluator-derived step rewards across evaluation channels raises a measurement question: does the assigned direction remain stable? We define Agent Step Value (ASV) as a channel-indexed before/after target-margin gain and identify the state-by-channel interaction from a matched 2x2 design. Across frozen PubMed question-answering transitions, cross-channel gain signs disagree on 48.3% of comparisons, compared with 0.3% for same-channel retries. Transition interactions are nearly balanced in sign (median +0.014; 10% trimmed mean -0.033), but asymmetric negative magnitudes produce a positive direct mean and a negative generated-view mean under the empirical target mixture. Equal-target weighting preserves a negative mean interaction but not this strict mean reversal. Matched retrieval designs localize the negative component to the generated-view coordinate and retain its direction across three sign checks that vary readout and evaluator stack. In a matched 512-token source-contract follow-up, source-only generation restores the positive mean direction on artifact-bearing retrievals and removes parser-detected support claims from artifact-free before-state views. These results support an explanation in which generated support inflates the pre-retrieval baseline. The resulting audit can localize channel sensitivity and test an intervention before step rewards are reused.
papers.comment: Accepted at the REALM Workshop @ EMNLP 2026 (2nd Workshop for Research on Agent Language Models). 16 pages, 5 figures. The two authors contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 Agent Step Value (ASV)，把步骤级奖励定义为按评估通道索引的 before/after target-margin gain，并用配对 2x2 设计识别状态×通道交互。在冻结的 PubMed QA 转移上，跨通道增益符号在 48.3% 的比较中不一致，而同通道重试仅 0.3%；512-token source-contract 跟进中，仅源生成使带 artifact 检索的均值方向恢复为正。结论是生成式支持会抬高检索前基线，复用步骤奖励前应先做通道敏感性审计。
Motivation: 评估器导出的步骤级奖励被跨评估通道复用时，其方向是否稳定是一个未被检验的测量问题：若通道本身改变符号，奖励复用会系统性误导。
Method: 定义 ASV 为通道索引的 before/after target-margin gain，用配对 2x2 设计识别状态×通道交互；在冻结的 PubMed QA 转移上做匹配检索设计，并用三种改变读出与评估器栈的符号检查定位负向分量；另做 512-token source-contract 跟进，比较 source-only 生成对 artifact 有无的 before-state 视图的作用。
Result: 跨通道增益符号在 48.3% 的比较中不一致，同通道重试仅 0.3%；转移交互符号近似平衡（中位数 +0.014，10% 截尾均值 -0.033），但非对称负向幅度使经验目标混合下直接均值为正、generated-view 均值为负；等目标加权保留负的均值交互但不保留这一严格均值反转；匹配检索设计把负向分量定位到 generated-view 坐标，并在三种符号检查中保持方向；512-token 跟进中 source-only 生成使带 artifact 检索恢复正均值方向，并移除 parser 检出的、来自无 artifact before-state 视图的支持性声明。
Conclusion: 生成式支持会抬高检索前基线，导致跨通道步骤奖励方向翻转；因此复用步骤奖励前应先用该审计定位通道敏感性并检验干预。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Multimodal Fusion for Fine-Grained Classification of Breast Fibroadenoma and Phyllodes Tumors
papers.abstract_en: Breast fibroadenoma (FA) and phyllodes tumor (PT) are fibroepithelial breast lesions with highly overlapping appearances on B-mode ultrasound, making benign and borderline PT prone to being misclassified as FA and complicating preoperative decision-making. Existing computer-aided diagnosis methods commonly rely on single-modal imaging features and insufficiently exploit complementary clinical and textual information. To address this limitation, we construct the FAPT-M Dataset, a pathology-confirmed multimodal dataset comprising 910 patients with strictly reviewed ultrasound images, structured clinical attributes, and ultrasound diagnostic descriptions. Based on this dataset, we propose a clinically guided multimodal framework that integrates DenseNet-based visual encoding, CLIP-inspired text encoding, and lightweight clinical encoding, and further introduces clinical-conditioned adaptive modulation, cross-modal Transformer fusion, and dual-path representation learning to improve feature alignment and multimodal interaction. Under patient-level five-fold cross-validation, the proposed method achieves an accuracy of 77.64%, F1-score of 73.38%, and AUC of 89.74%, outperforming representative CNN-, Transformer-, and vision-language-based baselines. Ablation studies and class-balanced evaluations further confirm the contribution of three-modality fusion and the key architectural components. Overall, this work provides an effective multimodal approach for fine-grained FA-PT classification and establishes a high-quality benchmark for multimodal breast ultrasound analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 B 超下乳腺纤维腺瘤 (FA) 与叶状肿瘤 (PT) 影像高度重叠、良性与交界型 PT 易被误判为 FA 的问题，构建病理确诊的多模态数据集 FAPT-M（910 例患者，含超声图像、结构化临床属性与超声诊断描述），并提出临床引导的多模态框架：DenseNet 视觉编码 + CLIP 式文本编码 + 轻量临床编码，经临床条件自适应调制、跨模态 Transformer 融合与双路表示学习对齐。在患者级五折交叉验证下准确率 77.64%、F1 73.38%、AUC 89.74%，优于 CNN、Transformer 与视觉-语言基线。
Motivation: FA 与 PT 在 B 超上表现高度重叠，良性及交界型 PT 常被误判为 FA，影响术前决策；现有 CAD 方法多依赖单一影像特征，未充分利用互补的临床与文本信息。
Method: 基于自建的病理确诊多模态数据集 FAPT-M（910 例患者，严格复核的超声图像、结构化临床属性、超声诊断描述），框架融合 DenseNet 视觉编码、CLIP 启发的文本编码与轻量临床编码，并引入临床条件自适应调制 (clinical-conditioned adaptive modulation)、跨模态 Transformer 融合与双路表示学习 (dual-path representation learning)；采用患者级五折交叉验证，并做消融与类别平衡评测。
Result: 患者级五折交叉验证下准确率 77.64%、F1-score 73.38%、AUC 89.74%，在代表性 CNN、Transformer 与视觉-语言基线上均更优；消融与类别平衡评测确认三模态融合及各架构组件的贡献。
Conclusion: 三模态融合加临床引导的跨模态交互可有效提升 FA-PT 细粒度分类，FAPT-M 可作为乳腺超声多模态分析的高质量基准。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: H-OPD: Confidence Aware Heterogeneous Multi-Teacher Multimodal On-policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently emerged as an effective post-training paradigm by providing supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, existing OPD methods for multimodal reasoning usually rely on a static teacher routing, assigning each sample to a single teacher based on modality or task type. This ignores that visual grounding and abstract reasoning may dominate different decoding steps, making a single teacher insufficient for the full trajectory. To this end, H-OPD is proposed as a confidence-aware heterogeneous multi-teacher OPD framework for multimodal reasoning. By verifying the complementarity of heterogeneous teachers in the same reasoning process, H-OPD replaces task or sample level teacher routing with token-level teacher arbitration along the shared student trajectory. H-OPD employs vision-to-language description transfer to enable text-only teachers to access key visual semantics, and uses a confidence-aware arbitration mechanism to dynamically combine vision-language teacher and text-only teachers at each token. Extensive evaluations over 11 widely-used reasoning benchmarks showcase the superior performance of our method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: H-OPD 把多模态 on-policy distillation 的教师选择从任务/样本级路由改为沿学生轨迹的 token 级仲裁，用置信度在视觉-语言教师与纯文本教师之间动态加权，并通过 vision-to-language description transfer 让纯文本教师读到关键视觉语义。在 11 个常用推理基准上评测，性能优于所比较的方法。
Motivation: 现有 OPD 的静态教师路由按模态或任务把样本固定给单个教师，但视觉定位与抽象推理可能主导不同的解码步，单教师覆盖不了整条轨迹。
Method: H-OPD 在共享学生轨迹上做 token 级教师仲裁，取代任务/样本级路由；用 vision-to-language description transfer 把视觉语义转成文本供纯文本教师访问，再用 confidence-aware arbitration 在每个 token 上动态组合 vision-language 教师与 text-only 教师。
Result: 在 11 个广泛使用的多模态推理基准上评测，H-OPD 取得优于现有方法的表现（abstract 未列具体分数）。
Conclusion: 异构教师在同一推理过程内具有互补性，按 token 置信度仲裁比静态单教师路由更适合覆盖完整推理轨迹。

papers.title: Improving Certified Robustness via Adversarial Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Certified training aims to produce models whose predictions can be formally verified against adversarial perturbations, typically by optimising upper bounds on the worst-case loss over an allowed perturbation set. For neural networks, certified training methods based purely on tight relaxation bounds produce networks that are amenable to certification, but sacrifice standard accuracy. Conversely, adversarial training often yields stronger empirical robustness and standard accuracy, but the resulting models are generally difficult to certify with neural network verifiers. Recently, the literature has shown that better standard-certified accuracy trade-offs can be achieved by combining adversarial training objectives with loose over-approximations based on Interval Bound Propagation (IBP), effectively interpolating between lower and upper bounds of the worst-case loss. Building on this, we introduce AD-CERT, a certified training objective that combines adversarial distillation with an IBP upper bound. We show that distilling adversarial information over the logit space from an empirically robust teacher provides an effective lower bound surrogate for certified training, with AD-CERT achieving state-of-the-art certified performance on several robustness benchmarks for ReLU networks. Furthermore, in a unified setup, distilling adversarial information at the logit-level is shown to improve certified accuracy over a robust feature-space distillation objective by up to 5.40 percentage points. Our code has been made available at https://github.com/matteo-melis/ad-cert.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at BMVC 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AD-CERT 把对抗蒸馏 (adversarial distillation) 与 Interval Bound Propagation (IBP) 上界结合成认证训练目标：在 logit 空间从经验鲁棒的 teacher 蒸馏对抗信息，作为 worst-case loss 的下界代理，与 IBP 上界插值。在多个 ReLU 网络鲁棒性基准上达到 state-of-the-art 认证性能，logit 级蒸馏比鲁棒特征空间蒸馏最高提升 5.40 个百分点认证准确率。
Motivation: 纯紧松弛界的认证训练牺牲标准准确率，对抗训练经验鲁棒性强却难以被神经网络验证器认证；已有 IBP 松弛插值方法仍有标准-认证准确率权衡可改进。
Method: AD-CERT 认证训练目标 = 对抗蒸馏（teacher 为经验鲁棒模型，在 logit 空间蒸馏对抗信息，充当下界代理）+ IBP 上界，插值 worst-case loss 的上下界；与鲁棒特征空间蒸馏目标在统一设置下对比。
Result: 在多个 ReLU 网络鲁棒性基准上取得 state-of-the-art 认证性能；统一设置下 logit 级对抗信息蒸馏比鲁棒特征空间蒸馏目标的认证准确率最高提升 5.40 个百分点。
Conclusion: 把经验对抗鲁棒性经 logit 空间蒸馏转成认证训练的下界代理，配合 IBP 上界，可在不牺牲可认证性的前提下改善标准-认证准确率权衡。

summary_sections.result: 在多个 ReLU 网络鲁棒性基准上取得 state-of-the-art 认证性能；统一设置下 logit 级对抗信息蒸馏比鲁棒特征空间蒸馏目标的认证准确率最高提升 5.40 个百分点。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把经验对抗鲁棒性经 logit 空间蒸馏转成认证训练的下界代理，配合 IBP 上界，可在不牺牲可认证性的前提下改善标准-认证准确率权衡。

papers.title: FlowAWR: Online Adaptive Flow Reinforcement via Advantage-Weighted Rectification
papers.abstract_en: Aligning generative flow models on continuous spaces via online reinforcement learning is constrained by intractable trajectory likelihoods. Existing density-approximated policy gradient methods rely on stochastic SDE samplers to construct tractable transition kernels, which introduce training-inference inconsistencies and necessitates Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG). While implicit frameworks such as DiffusionNFT directly optimize forward-process velocity fields, its heuristic fixed-magnitude corrections prevent optimization strength from relative intra-group quality. We propose \textit{Flow Advantage-Weighted Rectification} (\textbf{FlowAWR}), a paradigm that recasts continuous generative policy optimization as supervised regression toward a theoretically optimal velocity field. Starting from the optimal policy of a KL-constrained reward maximization, FlowAWR derives the optimal velocity field that admits a magnitude-aware, advantage-weighted rectification form, yielding SDE-free optimization and CFG-free generation. In comparative evaluations on SD3.5-Medium, FlowAWR achieves improved alignment performance alongside a 2$\times$ to 5$\times$ convergence acceleration over DiffusionNFT (e.g., reaching a 24.12 PickScore in 1.2k steps, versus 23.82 in 2.0k steps for DiffusionNFT and 23.50 in $>$4k steps for FlowGRPO). Under multi-reward constraints, FlowAWR sustains generation quality, satisfying structural rules while maintaining stable out-of-domain performance. Code at \href{https://github.com/Fuzm7/FlowAWR}{FlowAWR}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlowAWR 把连续空间生成流模型的在线强化学习对齐改写成向理论最优速度场的监督回归：从 KL 约束奖励最大化出发推导出带幅度感知、优势加权的修正项，实现无 SDE 采样、无 CFG 的优化与生成。在 SD3.5-Medium 上相对 DiffusionNFT 收敛加速 2–5 倍，1.2k 步即达 PickScore 24.12。
Motivation: 连续空间生成流模型的在线 RL 对齐受制于轨迹似然不可解；现有密度近似策略梯度依赖随机 SDE 采样器构造可解转移核，带来训练-推理不一致并强制依赖 CFG，而 DiffusionNFT 的隐式前向速度场优化用固定幅度启发式修正，无法按组内相对质量调整优化强度。
Method: 从 KL 约束奖励最大化问题的最优策略出发，推导出可接受的最优速度场，其修正形式为幅度感知、优势加权 (advantage-weighted) 的 rectification；训练退化为向该速度场的监督回归，生成时无需 CFG，优化时无需 SDE 采样器。
Result: 在 SD3.5-Medium 上相对 DiffusionNFT 取得 2× 到 5× 的收敛加速：1.2k 步达到 PickScore 24.12，而 DiffusionNFT 需 2.0k 步达 23.82，FlowGRPO 需 >4k 步达 23.50。多奖励约束下保持生成质量，满足结构规则并维持稳定的 out-of-domain 表现。
Conclusion: 把连续生成策略优化重写为向优势加权最优速度场的监督回归，可以同时去掉 SDE 采样与 CFG，并显著加快对齐收敛；该范式在多奖励约束下仍保持质量与域外稳定性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hierarchical Experimentalist Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to act in the real world and augment human decision-making, yet most systems rely on parametric knowledge acquired through imitation, optionally improved by post-training, retrieval, or search over fixed data. This paradigm struggles in novel domains or on complex queries that require information unavailable from prior knowledge alone; knowing the laws of physics, for example, does not by itself enable reliable reasoning or long-horizon actions in a complex physical system. We argue that agents need active experimentation: the ability to gather targeted query-specific evidence, discover general principles of unseen environments, and convert interaction experience into reusable skills. We introduce Hierarchical Experimentalist Agents (HExA), an in-context, experiment-centric self-improvement framework that (1) iteratively designs and refines query-relevant experiments, (2) incrementally distills experience into reusable and composable skills that accelerate experimentation within and across tasks, and (3) integrates experimental evidence to act or answer queries. HExA can work with any LLM including frontier black-box models, and requires no external supervision, oracle solutions, or offline data. We evaluate HExA on multi-step reasoning, interactive partially observable games, and physics law discovery tasks. To further evaluate when active experimentation is necessary, we introduce Interphyre, a set of hard procedural physics tasks where we enable tool-calling and intervention APIs. Current frontier LLMs including GPT-6 Astra fail in these settings: on the most challenging Interphyre tasks, we show that HExA can enable such models to near 100% success. Moreover, HExA improves token efficiency compared to naive agentic and memory baselines and enables generalization via hierarchical skill transfer from easier to harder tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出层级实验智能体 HExA：让 LLM 迭代设计与查询相关的实验、把交互经验蒸馏成可复用技能，再整合实验证据作答或行动，全程无需外部监督与离线数据。在新引入的高难程序化物理任务集 Interphyre 上，GPT-6 Astra 等前沿模型原本失败，接入 HExA 后在最难任务上接近 100% 成功率，并提升 token 效率、实现由易到难的技能迁移。
Motivation: LLM 智能体依赖模仿得到的参数化知识，遇到新颖领域或需要先验之外信息的复杂查询时失效：知道物理定律并不等于能在复杂物理系统中可靠推理与执行长程动作。
Method: HExA 是 in-context、以实验为中心的自改进框架，包含三部分：迭代设计并修正与查询相关的实验；增量地把经验蒸馏为可复用、可组合的技能以加速任务内与跨任务实验；整合实验证据给出行动或答案。可搭配任意 LLM（含前沿黑盒模型），不需要外部监督、oracle 解答或离线数据；配套发布带工具调用与干预 API 的 Interphyre 物理任务集。
Result: 在多步推理、部分可观测交互游戏与物理定律发现任务上评估 HExA；在最难的 Interphyre 任务上，GPT-6 Astra 等当前前沿 LLM 原本失败，接入 HExA 后接近 100% 成功率。相较朴素 agentic 与 memory 基线，HExA 提升 token 效率，并通过层级技能迁移从易任务泛化到难任务。
Conclusion: 主动实验——按查询收集针对性证据并把经验沉淀为技能——是前沿 LLM 在新颖物理环境中取得高成功率与 token 效率的关键，且不依赖外部监督。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: The Spec Growth Engine: Spec-Anchored, Code-Coupled, Drift-Enforced Architecture for AI-Assisted Software Development
papers.abstract_en: AI coding agents dramatically accelerate implementation speed but introduce two structural failure modes that existing spec-driven approaches do not fully solve: (1) context explosion -- the agent must reason over an entire repository at once, degrading output quality as the context window fills; and (2) silent spec-code drift -- code evolves, the specification does not, and the divergence becomes invisible until it is costly to repair. We present the Spec Growth Engine, a lightweight framework that addresses both failure modes through a machine-readable spec graph whose nodes carry explicit contract/design separation, a Spine context assembler that scopes agent context to an ownership path, a vertical-slice growth protocol that enforces hardest-first ordering, and a drift gate that makes spec-code divergence a blocking merge condition. The design synthesises well-established software engineering principles (Parnas information hiding, C4, ADRs, Walking Skeleton, Reflexion Models, Fitness Functions) into a lean, code-coupled, machine-enforced whole -- without the overhead of heavy-weight frameworks such as RUP or MDA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Spec Growth Engine：用机器可读的 spec graph（节点区分 contract 与 design）、按 ownership path 限定上下文的 Spine assembler、强制最难优先的 vertical-slice 增长协议，以及把 spec-code 偏差设为合并阻断条件的 drift gate，同时缓解 AI 编码代理的上下文爆炸与静默 spec-code 漂移。
Motivation: AI 编码代理加速实现但带来两种结构性失效：上下文爆炸（代理需同时推理整个仓库，上下文窗口填满后输出质量下降）与静默 spec-code 漂移（代码演进而规范不更新，偏差在修复代价高昂前不可见），现有 spec-driven 方法未完全解决。
Method: 四个组件：携带显式 contract/design 分离节点的机器可读 spec graph；将代理上下文限定到 ownership path 的 Spine context assembler；强制 hardest-first 排序的 vertical-slice 增长协议；把 spec-code 偏差作为阻断合并条件的 drift gate。整体综合 Parnas information hiding、C4、ADRs、Walking Skeleton、Reflexion Models、Fitness Functions 等既有软件工程原则，避免 RUP 或 MDA 类重型框架的开销。
Result: 摘要给出的是设计主张与组件构成，未列出实验指标或数据集；可核验的产出为开源实现（github.com/grabow/spec-growth-engine）及配套实现论文 arXiv:2610.11725。
Conclusion: AI 辅助软件开发的两类失效可以在轻量、代码耦合、机器强制的框架内同时处理，而不必引入 RUP/MDA 级别的流程开销。

papers.title: Erased, but Not Gone: Output Forgetting Is Not True Forgetting
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning (MU) is commonly judged by output forgetting, such as low forget-set accuracy or reduced membership inference. But if output-level success can coexist with retraining-inconsistent residuals in representation space, what kind of forgetting are current evaluations actually certifying? We study this question through retraining-consistent representation forgetting, using a population of retrained models (i.e., trained from scratch without the forget data) as an operational reference distribution for ideal forgetting. Across multiple unlearning methods, datasets, and models, our theoretical analysis and empirical results show that standard output-level evaluation can systematically overestimate the success of unlearning. Under this stronger lens, current methods often appear forgotten at the output layer while exhibiting a structured mismatch relative to retraining. They partially align with retraining on forget samples, remain more inconsistent on retain samples, and tend to leave residual discrepancy localized along retraining-related directions rather than diffuse in representation space. This structured mismatch is characterized by forget/retain asymmetry, directional mismatch, and concentrated residuals along retraining-related directions. In many cases, the discrepancies exceed the variability of independent retraining and lead to a risk of information recovery during relearning attacks. Overall, the results suggest that current MU is often evaluated for apparent forgetting rather than retraining-consistent forgetting. More broadly, retraining reveals what output forgetting hides.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 机器遗忘 (MU) 只用输出级指标（遗忘集准确率、成员推断下降）判定会系统性高估遗忘成功：以从头重训模型群体作为理想遗忘的参考分布，发现现有方法在输出层看似已遗忘，但表征空间仍留下结构化残差——遗忘/保留不对称、方向性失配、残差集中在与重训相关的方向上，且多处差异超过独立重训自身的波动，带来重学习攻击下信息恢复的风险。
Motivation: 输出级遗忘指标可以与重训不一致的表征残差共存，因此当前 MU 评测实际认证的可能只是表面遗忘，而非真正抹除训练数据影响的遗忘。
Method: 提出以重训一致的表征遗忘 (retraining-consistent representation forgetting) 为判据：用一批从头训练、未见过遗忘数据的重训模型构成理想遗忘的参考分布，在多个 MU 方法、数据集和模型上做理论分析与实证比较，刻画表征相对重训的结构化失配。
Result: 跨多种遗忘方法、数据集与模型，标准输出级评测系统性高估遗忘成功；现有方法在遗忘样本上部分对齐重训、在保留样本上更不一致，残差沿重训相关方向集中而非弥散；许多情形下差异超过独立重训的波动，并在重学习攻击中带来信息恢复风险。
Conclusion: 当前机器遗忘多在评测表面遗忘而非重训一致遗忘，重训参考揭示了输出遗忘所掩盖的残差；判定遗忘应对照重训分布检查表征层结构化失配。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: RoboMME-Interference: Benchmarking Robot Memory Under Interference
papers.abstract_en: Robots deployed in realistic settings will accumulate experience across many sessions and tasks over their deployment. The robot's tasks may often require it to remember information from multiple sessions ago, making long-context robot memory important for real-world deployments. However, most robot-memory benchmarks today are based on single episodes or a short context. To measure how current robot memory systems perform on longer sessions with more distractions, we introduce RoboMME-Interference, a cross-session benchmark built on RoboMME (Dai et al., 2026). For each query episode, we construct a session history using the query's relevant prior demonstration followed by a controlled number of unrelated sessions, which we provide to the VLA as memory and measure accuracy. Running RoboMME's released memory-augmented $π_{0.5}$ variants unmodified through this benchmark, we find that while perceptual memory variants improve success when given the history without any distractors, they decay strongly and steadily as unrelated sessions accumulate. The subgoal variants, which read the history with a vision-language model and pass written subgoals to the policy, improve less at their best but hold more of that improvement as distractors accumulate. Adding a retrieval step to the strongest perceptual variant, which selects the section of history most visually similar to the robot's current view and passes only that section to the policy, restores its no-distractor success rate at every interference level. With this release, we emphasize the importance of long-context memory and robustness to interference and show that current systems largely fail on such capabilities. The project page, videos, code, and data are at https://robotmemorybench.com.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出跨会话机器人记忆基准 RoboMME-Interference：对每个查询 episode，把相关历史演示与可控数量的无关会话一起喂给 VLA 测准确率。感知记忆变体在无干扰时提升成功率，但随无关会话累积而强烈且持续衰减；子目标 (subgoal) 变体峰值提升较小却更抗干扰；给最强感知变体加一步按当前视野视觉相似度检索历史片段，可在每个干扰级别恢复其无干扰成功率。
Motivation: 现有机器人记忆基准多基于单 episode 或短上下文，无法衡量系统在长会话、多干扰下的记忆表现，而真实部署需要跨多个会话记住信息。
Method: 基于 RoboMME (Dai et al., 2026) 构建跨会话基准：为每个查询 episode 组装会话历史（相关先前演示 + 受控数量的无关会话），原样运行 RoboMME 发布的记忆增强 π0.5 变体并测准确率；对比感知记忆变体、用 VLM 读历史并把书面子目标传给策略的 subgoal 变体，以及在最强感知变体上加入按当前视野视觉相似度检索历史片段的检索步骤。
Result: 感知记忆变体在无干扰历史下提升成功率，但随无关会话累积强烈且稳步衰减；subgoal 变体最佳时提升较小，却在干扰累积时保住更多提升；加入检索步骤后，最强感知变体在每个干扰级别都恢复其无干扰成功率。
Conclusion: 当前机器人记忆系统在长上下文与抗干扰能力上大体失败：感知记忆靠全历史喂入不可靠，检索式选择历史片段是恢复性能的可行路径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Decoupling the Declarative from the Procedural in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Deploying generalist robotic agents in the real world requires transferable skills. Specifically, a policy trained to clone a behavior from object-specific demonstrations must generalize beyond that object, otherwise data collection requirements become intractable. Recently, fine-tuning of pre-trained billion-parameter Vision-Language Models (VLMs), initially on large-scale robot datasets and then on fewer scenario-specific demonstrations, has emerged as the predominant paradigm for designing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. While these policies achieve state-of-the-art manipulation performance in-distribution, they remain brittle to minor spatial, semantic, and task variations. In this work, we address the inability of current models to decouple the declarative (i.e., concepts and entity semantics) from the procedural knowledge (i.e., how to do something) encoded in their parameters, which is a fundamental bottleneck for zero-shot skill transfer to novel objects. To address this, we propose w$^{2}$VLA, a new VLA model with restructured information flow. Rather than feeding all multimodal tokens from the VLM encoder into a large, opaque transformer-based action expert, our approach modulates the robot state sequence with visual, spatial, and skill information in a compositional and interpretable manner. Unlike popular, state-of-the-art VLAs, we show that our modular approach successfully decouples knowledge representations, enabling robust behavior cloning and unprecedented zero-shot skill transfer capabilities across dissimilar, unseen objects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: w²VLA 重构 VLA 的信息流，不再把 VLM 编码器的全部多模态 token 喂进不透明的 transformer 动作专家，而是以可组合、可解释的方式把视觉、空间与技能信息调制进机器人状态序列，从而把声明性知识（概念与实体语义）和过程性知识（怎么做）解耦。作者称该模块化设计实现了鲁棒的行为克隆，以及跨差异很大的未见物体的前所未有的零样本技能迁移能力。
Motivation: 在物体特定演示上克隆的策略无法泛化到新物体，导致数据采集量不可控；现有 VLA 虽在分布内操作性能达到 SOTA，但对微小的空间、语义与任务变化脆弱，根因是模型参数中声明性与过程性知识无法解耦，阻碍零样本技能迁移。
Method: 提出 w²VLA：不将 VLM 编码器的全部多模态 token 输入大型 transformer 动作专家，改为对机器人状态序列做组合式、可解释的调制，注入视觉、空间与技能信息，重构信息流以分离两类知识表征；训练范式沿用先在大规模机器人数据上微调预训练十亿参数 VLM、再用少量场景特定演示微调的流程。
Result: 在分布内操作上与流行 SOTA VLA 对比，模块化方法成功解耦知识表征，实现鲁棒的行为克隆，并在差异很大的未见物体上展示出作者称为前所未有的零样本技能迁移能力。
Conclusion: 把声明性与过程性知识在架构上分开、以可解释方式调制状态序列，是让 VLA 跨未见物体做零样本技能迁移的可行路径，优于把一切 token 塞进单一动作专家的做法。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: VLA-FAIL: Efficient Task Failure Detection for Finetuned Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) achieve state-of-the-art performance on many robotic manipulation tasks, yet they can still behave unpredictably in out-of-distribution scenarios. Runtime failure detection is therefore essential for the safe real-world deployment of VLAs.However, existing task failure detectors require computationally expensive action sampling, are based on architectural assumptions that limit their applicability to VLAs, or need access to failure rollouts. We propose VLA-FAIL, a lightweight and broadly applicable failure detection framework for VLAs that combines two novel failure detectors with minimal overhead, without requiring failure data. The first, last-layer Mahalanobis distance (LLMD), detects out-of-distribution states by measuring token-wise deviations in last-layer features relative to the training data. The second, action chunk consistency (ACC), exploits the temporal overlap induced by receding-horizon control and detects failures when consecutive action chunks become inconsistent. To capture the trade-off between detection accuracy and detection latency, we introduce \textsc{AUCPDT}, a threshold-independent metric that jointly evaluates precision, recall, and detection time. Through extensive real-world and simulation experiments, we demonstrate that LLMD and ACC capture complementary failure modes whose combination enables reliable and early failure detection across diverse tasks, frequently outperforming significantly more expensive baseline methods. Project page: https://vla-fail.github.io/vla-fail-2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLA-FAIL 为微调后的视觉-语言-动作模型 (VLA) 提供轻量运行时失败检测：LLMD 用最后一层特征相对训练数据的逐 token 马氏距离抓分布外状态，ACC 用滚动时域控制下相邻动作块的时间重叠检测不一致，两者互补且无需失败数据。真实机器人与仿真上二者组合实现可靠且更早的失败检测，常以远低的开销胜过需要动作采样的昂贵基线。
Motivation: VLA 在分布外场景行为不可预测，而现有失败检测器要么需要昂贵的动作采样、要么依赖限制其适用性的架构假设、要么需要失败 rollout 数据。
Method: 两个无需失败数据的检测器：last-layer Mahalanobis distance (LLMD) 在最后一层特征上相对训练数据做逐 token 偏离度量以检测 OOD 状态；action chunk consistency (ACC) 利用滚动时域控制 (receding-horizon control) 产生的时间重叠，在相邻动作块不一致时报失败。另提出阈值无关指标 AUCPDT，联合评估 precision、recall 与 detection time。
Result: 在真实世界与仿真的大量实验中，LLMD 与 ACC 捕获互补的失败模式，二者组合在多样任务上实现可靠且更早的失败检测，并经常显著优于开销高得多的基线方法。
Conclusion: 不依赖失败数据、开销极小的特征偏离加动作块一致性检测，足以支撑 VLA 的安全部署，且检测精度与检测延迟的权衡应由 AUCPDT 这类阈值无关指标衡量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Urban Power Grid Topology and Hierarchy Identification from Open Data
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the complex topology and hierarchy of urban power grid is crucial for energy prognosis, power flow management, and system resilience analysis. However, detailed grid information remains largely proprietary. This information, nevertheless, is crucial especially for analyzing the last-mile distribution networks connecting individual buildings. This paper addresses this challenge by developing an open-data-driven framework to identify urban power grid topology, from high-voltage transmission down to individual building connections. We integrate public infrastructure data (power-lines, substations, transformers, poles) to map the high and medium-voltage grid skeleton. We then leverage geospatial machine learning on OpenStreetMap building data to cluster loads of building energy demand. Upon the clustering, we develop the physical topology of the final distribution lines linking the clustered buildings and low-voltage distribution grids. Our derived grid topology incorporates physical and geographical constraints like voltage level and road networks, thus leading to reasonable topology and hierarchy of grid networks. We apply the developed framework to the districts of Alna in Oslo, Norway, and Waiheke Island in New Zealand, and we reconstruct the complete grid topology that connects all the buildings, power lines, and electricity infrastructure assets. With the developed framework, we provide a critical tool that facilitates power system analysis, e.g., power flow optimization, cascading failure simulation, and grid resilience against the penetration of distributed renewable generation. This work also opens the opportunity to build energy digital twins that fuse power assets and grid topology, geographic constraints, and fine-grained power demand profiles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出开放数据驱动的城市电网拓扑识别框架：整合公开电力设施数据搭建高压与中压骨架，再用 OpenStreetMap 建筑数据做地理空间机器学习聚类负荷，结合电压等级与路网约束推断低压配电线路。在挪威 Oslo 的 Alna 区与新西兰 Waiheke 岛上重建了连接全部建筑与电力资产的完整拓扑层级。
Motivation: 城市电网的详细拓扑与层级信息基本为专有数据，尤其末端配电网络（连接单体建筑）难以获取，制约了潮流管理、级联故障模拟与韧性分析。
Method: 整合公开基础设施数据（输电线、变电站、变压器、电线杆）映射高/中压电网骨架；用地理空间机器学习对 OpenStreetMap 建筑数据聚类用电负荷；在聚类基础上结合电压等级与路网等物理地理约束构建低压配电网的物理拓扑。
Result: 在 Oslo 的 Alna 区与 Waiheke 岛两个案例上应用该框架，重建出连接所有建筑、输电线与电力基础设施资产的完整电网拓扑与层级。
Conclusion: 开放数据加地理空间约束足以重建可用于潮流优化、级联故障模拟与韧性分析的城市电网拓扑，并为融合电力资产、地理约束与细粒度需求曲线的能源数字孪生奠定基础。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: TelcoAgent: A Scalable 5G Multi-KPM Forecasting With 3GPP-Grounded Explainability
authors: V V N K Someswara Rao Koduri
papers.abstract_en: Key Performance Measurement (KPM) forecasting is essential for proactive network management of 5G and next-generation telecom networks. However, existing machine learning (ML) approaches face significant limitations in scalability and explainability, restricting their effectiveness in real-world deployments. We propose TelcoAgent, a foundation model-based framework that enables accurate, scalable, and explainable forecasting of multiple KPMs across diverse network cells without the need for site-specific training. Specifically, the framework comprises three key components: (i) an automated three-agent pipeline that constructs a 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) knowledge graph directly from specification documents, (ii) a scalable, time-series foundation model (TSFM)-based prediction pipeline to deliver accurate, zero-shot forecasting, and finally (iii) a reasoning and explanation pipeline that provides actionable, domain-grounded diagnostics. Evaluated using a 3-month, real-world, city-scale 5G KPM dataset from a U.S.-based network operator, TelcoAgent demonstrates high forecasting accuracy for all 7 considered KPMs per cell across 200 cells, while delivering explainable insights and actionable instructions to address network degradations.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to IEEE GLOBECOM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TelcoAgent 用三段式 agent 流水线把 3GPP 规范转成知识图谱，再接时序基础模型 (TSFM) 做零样本多 KPM 预测，最后由推理模块给出基于规范的诊断解释。在美国某运营商 3 个月、200 个小区的真实 5G 数据上，对每小区 7 个 KPM 均取得高预测精度，且无需按站点单独训练。
Motivation: 5G 网络的多 KPM 预测需要跨大量小区泛化，现有 ML 方法在可扩展性与可解释性上受限，难以落地到真实网络运维。
Method: 框架含三部分：自动化三 agent 流水线从 3GPP 规范文档直接构建知识图谱；基于时序基础模型 (TSFM) 的预测流水线实现零样本预测；推理与解释流水线输出面向规范、可执行的网络劣化诊断。
Result: 在 3 个月、美国运营商城市级真实 5G KPM 数据集上，对 200 个小区的 7 个 KPM 均实现高预测精度，同时给出可解释洞察与针对网络劣化的可执行指令。
Conclusion: 以 3GPP 知识图谱加 TSFM 零样本预测的 agent 框架，可在不做站点级训练的前提下同时满足多 KPM 预测的精度、扩展性与可解释性。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.result: 在 3 个月、美国运营商城市级真实 5G KPM 数据集上，对 200 个小区的 7 个 KPM 均实现高预测精度，同时给出可解释洞察与针对网络劣化的可执行指令。
summary_sections.conclusion: 以 3GPP 知识图谱加 TSFM 零样本预测的 agent 框架，可在不做站点级训练的前提下同时满足多 KPM 预测的精度、扩展性与可解释性。

papers.title: Bistable by Construction: Wall-Clock-Calibrated State Monitors Have No Moment-Detection Regime at Agent Cadence
papers.abstract_en: Runtime monitors for autonomous agents commonly threshold an accumulated internal state - a behavioural baseline, a drift statistic, or, in our prior work, a modelled affective state. We previously reported a State Saturation Trap: threshold-on-state triggers over a continuous affect engine become near-constant alarms on SWE-bench debugging agents (Modgil 2026). A post-release audit found the engine received dt=0 between actions, so its exponential decay never operated: the published trap is a pure-accumulator result. We correct the record (erratum, v2) and treat the flaw as an experiment. The key variable it exposes is whether a monitor's dynamics are calibrated in sample time (per observation, as in CUSUM) or wall-clock time (half-lives in seconds, as in affect models and EMA baselines). On fixed-rate streams these coincide; on agent streams, where inter-action time varies by orders of magnitude, they do not. A pre-registered sweep over uniform intervals (dt in {0..600}s) on 20 trajectories shows the wall-clock level trigger has two regimes: at dt<=1s a constant alarm (20/20; median 18 firings); at dt>=60s silent. Every critical dt lies in (1,30]s. A scriptable gpt-5.4-mini agent loop measures latency at median 1.53s (p90 2.33s), inside the trap regime, vindicating the empirical finding under a corrected mechanism. The structure is a property of the calibration class, not the engine: a minimal wall-clock accumulator over the raw error stream reproduces the same cliff, while a sample-time CUSUM over the identical stream is exactly dt-invariant (20/20). A rising-edge trigger with hysteresis fires 0-3 times per trajectory in every condition. We conclude that wall-clock-calibrated leaky-integrator monitors admit no regime in which they act as moment detectors on agent streams; transition detection escapes the trap at every cadence, but does not recover human intervention timing.
papers.comment: v2: erratum (Sec. 3): cadence runs were logged by a scriptable gpt-5.4-mini loop, not the Claude Code hook; the cross-instrument rho = 0.530 reflects only shared error rate; the abstract's cadence claim is scoped to the harness measured. No number changes. 11 pages, 5 figures. Sequel to arXiv:2606.04296. Code: https://github.com/2025eb1100268-tech/intervention-timing-saturation-trap
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出按墙钟时间校准的泄漏积分监控器（半衰期以秒计）在动作间隔跨数量级的 agent 流上必然落入两难：dt≤1s 时近乎常响（20/20，中位 18 次触发），dt≥60s 时完全静默，临界 dt 全部落在 (1,30]s 区间。gpt-5.4-mini agent 循环实测中位延迟 1.53s（p90 2.33s）正落在陷阱区；改用带迟滞的上升沿触发后每条轨迹仅触发 0–3 次，而样本时间校准的 CUSUM 对 dt 完全不变（20/20）。
Motivation: 运行时 agent 监控普遍对累积状态设阈值报警，但动作间隔不固定时，按秒校准的动态与按观测校准的动态不再等价，导致监控器要么常响要么失声，无法作为瞬时事件检测器。
Method: 先以 erratum 修正先前 State Saturation Trap 结果（原引擎收到 dt=0，实为纯累加器），再把该缺陷转为实验：在均匀间隔扫描（dt ∈ {0..600}s）上做预注册实验，20 条轨迹，对比墙钟阈值触发、样本时间 CUSUM、带迟滞的上升沿触发，并用最小墙钟累加器复现；另用 scriptable gpt-5.4-mini agent 循环测量动作延迟。
Result: 墙钟触发在 dt≤1s 时 20/20 常响（中位 18 次），dt≥60s 时静默，所有临界 dt 落在 (1,30]s；gpt-5.4-mini 循环中位延迟 1.53s、p90 2.33s，处于陷阱区；最小墙钟累加器复现同一悬崖，而样本时间 CUSUM 在相同流上对 dt 完全不变（20/20）；带迟滞的上升沿触发在所有条件下每条轨迹触发 0–3 次；跨仪器 rho = 0.530，仅反映共享错误率。
Conclusion: 墙钟校准的泄漏积分监控在 agent 流上不存在能充当时刻检测器的工作区间；转变检测（transition detection）可逃出陷阱但无法恢复人类干预时机。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Scalable Circuit Learning for Interpreting Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: A prominent research direction in mechanistic interpretability is learning sparse circuits over LLM components to reveal how they jointly produce model behavior. However, raw neurons are polysemantic, making learned circuits hard to interpret. Sparse autoencoder (SAE) features alleviate this, but their high dimensionality makes existing intervention-based circuit learning methods computationally prohibitive. We propose CircuitLasso, a scalable circuit learning approach based on sparse linear regression. CircuitLasso recovers circuits whose structural accuracy matches that of state-of-the-art intervention-based methods on the benchmark data, at a fraction of the computational cost. For interpretability, CircuitLasso efficiently uncovers relationships among SAE features, showing how human-interpretable semantic features propagate through the model and influence its predictions. Finally, we validate the utility of our learned circuits by leveraging their insights to achieve comparable performance at substantially lower cost on a domain-generalization task.
papers.comment: Accepted to the Main Conference of EMNLP 2026 (The 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CircuitLasso，用稀疏线性回归替代干预式电路搜索，在 SAE 特征上学习 LLM 稀疏电路，结构精度与干预式方法相当而计算成本大幅降低。它还能刻画 SAE 特征间语义传播关系，并把学到的电路用于域泛化任务，以显著更低成本取得相当性能。
Motivation: 机制可解释性需要在 LLM 组件上学稀疏电路，但原始神经元多义，SAE 特征虽缓解这一点却维度极高，使现有基于干预 (intervention-based) 的电路学习方法在计算上不可行。
Method: CircuitLasso 把电路学习形式化为稀疏线性回归 (sparse linear regression)，直接在 SAE 特征上恢复电路结构，绕开逐次干预搜索；再用学到的电路刻画 SAE 特征之间的关系，并将电路洞察迁移到域泛化任务。
Result: 在基准数据上，CircuitLasso 恢复电路的结构精度 (structural accuracy) 与最先进干预式方法相当，而计算成本只是其一小部分；学到的电路揭示了人类可解释的语义特征如何在模型中传播并影响预测；借助电路洞察在域泛化任务上以显著更低成本取得相当性能。
Conclusion: 稀疏线性回归足以在 SAE 特征上替代昂贵的干预式电路搜索，且学到的电路既有可解释性又可迁移到下游任务。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PACT: Privileged Trace Co-Training for Multi-Turn Tool-Use Agents
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn tool-use agents must reason, call tools, and adapt to observations across several interaction turns. Post-training such agents is challenging, as reinforcement learning often suffers from sparse rewards and weak credit assignment despite matching the prompt-only inference setting, while supervised fine-tuning on expert traces provides dense process supervision but can over-constrain the model to fixed trajectories. To tackle this, we propose PACT, a Privileged trAce Co-Training framework for multi-turn tool-use agents. The key idea is to use expert traces only as training-time optimization signals rather than rollout-time hints. PACT keeps rollout generation prompt-only, then uses expert traces to guide optimization through two complementary signals: a trace-conditioned RL surrogate that evaluates prompt-only rollouts under expert-trace context, and a component-aware SFT loss that provides annealed process supervision over reasoning and tool-call components. To reduce over-reliance on the training-only trace context, PACT incorporates prompt-only anchoring with standard prompt-only RL updates. Experiments on FTRL, BFCL, and ToolHop show that PACT consistently outperforms strong SFT- and RL-based baselines. Further analyses support the complementarity of the two training objectives and the benefits of component-aware supervision and prompt-only anchoring. These results highlight the effectiveness of privileged trace co-training for multi-turn tool-use learning. The project page is available at https://zhenbangdu.github.io/pact-project-page.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PACT 把专家轨迹只当作训练期的优化信号而非 rollout 提示：rollout 保持 prompt-only，用轨迹条件化的 RL surrogate 在专家轨迹上下文下评估 prompt-only 轨迹，配合分量感知的退火 SFT 损失监督推理与工具调用，并加 prompt-only anchoring 抑制对训练专用上下文的依赖。在 FTRL、BFCL、ToolHop 上一致强于 SFT 与 RL 基线。
Motivation: 多轮工具调用 agent 的后训练两难：RL 奖励稀疏、跨轮 credit assignment 弱；SFT 用专家轨迹给出稠密过程监督，却把模型锁死在固定轨迹上。
Method: PACT（Privileged trAce Co-Training）保留 prompt-only rollout，用两条互补信号优化：trace-conditioned RL surrogate 在专家轨迹上下文下评估 rollout，component-aware SFT loss 对 reasoning 与 tool-call 分量给退火的过程监督；再以 prompt-only anchoring 加入标准 prompt-only RL 更新，降低对训练期轨迹上下文的过依赖。
Result: 在 FTRL、BFCL、ToolHop 三个基准上一致优于强 SFT 基线与 RL 基线；进一步分析支持两个训练目标的互补性，以及分量感知监督与 prompt-only anchoring 各自的收益。
Conclusion: 专家轨迹作为训练期优化信号而非 rollout 提示使用，可以在保持 prompt-only 推理设定的同时拿到稠密过程监督，避免 SFT 的轨迹过约束。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Let Large Language Models Judge Each Other: Multi-Agent Peer-Reviewed Reasoning for Medical Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Objective: To enhance the accuracy, interpretability, and robustness of large language models (LLMs) in medical question answering (MedQA). Method: We designed a multi-agent peer-reviewed reasoning method in which multiple LLM agents independently generate chain-of-thought reasoning with candidate answers, then act as peer reviewers to evaluate each other's reasoning for factual correctness and logical soundness. The highest-rated reasoning chain is selected to produce the final answer. Experiments were conducted with five state-of-the-art LLMs (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, Phi-4, DeepSeek-LLM-7B, GPT-oss-20B) on three benchmark datasets: HeadQA, MedQA-USMLE, and PubMedQA. Performance was compared against single-model chain-of-thought reasoning and chain-of-thought-based majority voting. Results: Peer-reviewed reasoning consistently outperformed both baselines. The best model combination achieved an average accuracy of 0.820 across datasets, exceeding the strongest single model (0.777) and majority voting ensembles (up to 0.789). The method also scaled effectively with more participating models, while peer assessments reliably distinguished high- from low-quality reasoning chains. Conclusion: The proposed multi-agent peer-reviewed reasoning method enables LLMs to act as both solvers and evaluators, yielding superior performance in MedQA. By emphasizing reasoning quality rather than answer agreement alone, this approach improves accuracy, interpretability, and robustness, offering a promising direction for trustworthy biomedical AI systems.
papers.comment: Accepted by the Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association
papers.journal_ref: J Am Med Inform Assoc. 2026;33(9):1649-1659
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出多智能体同行评审推理 (multi-agent peer-reviewed reasoning)：多个 LLM 独立生成带候选答案的思维链，再互相评审事实正确性与逻辑性，取评分最高的推理链作答。在 HeadQA、MedQA-USMLE、PubMedQA 上平均准确率 0.820，高于最强单模型 0.777 与多数投票集成的最高 0.789。
Motivation: 医疗问答中单模型思维链推理的准确性、可解释性与稳健性不足，而多数投票只对齐答案、不评估推理质量。
Method: 五个 SOTA LLM（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-7B、Phi-4、DeepSeek-LLM-7B、GPT-oss-20B）各自生成 CoT 推理与候选答案，随后互为评审者按事实正确性与逻辑性打分，选最高分推理链产出最终答案；基线为单模型 CoT 与基于 CoT 的多数投票。
Result: 最佳模型组合在三个数据集上平均准确率 0.820，超过最强单模型 0.777 与多数投票集成（最高 0.789）；参与模型越多性能越好，且同行评审能可靠区分高质量与低质量推理链。
Conclusion: 让 LLM 同时充当解题者与评审者、以推理质量而非答案一致性为筛选标准，可在 MedQA 上同时提升准确率、可解释性与稳健性。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Experience Makes Skillful: Enabling Generalizable Medical Agent Reasoning via Self-Evolving Skill Memory
papers.abstract_en: Medical agent systems are increasingly expected to support interactive clinical decision making rather than only static question answering. In such settings, effective agents must reuse prior experience across evolving cases, yet existing memory mechanisms often retain raw historical traces that are redundant, noisy, and difficult to govern. More importantly, they rarely distinguish which memories are truly useful for future reasoning. This limits their ability to accumulate compact and reliable experience for long-horizon clinical reasoning. To close this gap, we propose SkeMex, a post-deployment self-evolution framework that improves medical agents through a skill-based memory without updating model weights. SkeMex distills informative interaction trajectories into structured skills that encode reusable procedural knowledge, and organizes them into a multi-branch repository spanning general, task-specific, and action-level experience. To determine which memories should be reused and retained, SkeMex estimates context-dependent utility from environment feedback and uses it to guide value-aware retrieval and repository governance. A closed-loop ``Read--Write--Assess--Govern" lifecycle further supports continual evolution by writing new skills, updating utilities, promoting useful memories, and removing harmful entries. Experiments across diverse clinical tasks show that SkeMex consistently outperforms representative memory-based agents in both offline and online settings. It also generalizes across model backbones and supports transferable skill memory. All data and code will be released publicly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出医疗智能体自进化技能记忆框架 SkeMex：不更新权重，把交互轨迹蒸馏成结构化技能，按环境反馈估计上下文相关效用，用 Read–Write–Assess–Govern 闭环决定哪些记忆被检索、保留或删除。在多种临床任务的离线与在线设置中持续优于代表性记忆型智能体，并可跨 backbone 泛化。
Motivation: 现有智能体记忆多存冗余、嘈杂的原始历史轨迹，难以治理，也很少区分哪些记忆对未来推理真正有用，限制了长程临床推理中经验的积累。
Method: SkeMex 是部署后自进化框架：将信息性交互轨迹蒸馏为编码可复用程序性知识的结构化技能，组织成通用、任务特定、动作级三分支技能库；由环境反馈估计上下文相关效用来引导价值感知检索与库治理，并以 Read–Write–Assess–Govern 闭环写入新技能、更新效用、提升有用记忆、移除有害条目，全程不更新模型权重。
Result: 在多种临床任务上，SkeMex 在离线与在线设置中均持续优于代表性记忆型智能体，并跨模型 backbone 泛化、支持可迁移的技能记忆；数据与代码将公开。
Conclusion: 以结构化技能加效用驱动的治理替代原始轨迹存储，可在不微调权重的前提下让医疗智能体持续积累可靠经验并跨任务迁移。

papers.title: Do More Agents Help? Evaluating Accuracy and Cost in LLM Multi-Agent Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Choosing whether to replace a single-agent controller requires evidence on both task performance and inference expenditure. We present BenchAgent, a shared evaluation framework, and compare six multi-agent workflow configurations against its single-agent reference, BenchAgent Core, across ten reasoning, coding, and tool-use benchmarks. All configurations use GPT-4.1 and common tool and scoring interfaces; Core executions share the same step limits. We measure accuracy and recorded token use over three runs on fixed task sets, with 3,302 instances per configuration per run. EvoAgent reaches 79.70% mean pooled accuracy versus 76.65% for Core and exceeds Core in all three runs; the other five MAS trail by 1.71-8.76 percentage points. LLM-Debate gains 9.67 points on HumanEval but loses 1.96 points in pooled accuracy while consuming 1.39 times the tokens of Core. ChatEval gains 22.25 points on IFEval but trails Core in pooled accuracy with 4.34 times its token consumption. The broad comparison and targeted analyses of retained responses provide evidence for workflow selection and identify answer preservation and resource allocation as directions for subsequent multi-agent optimization.
papers.comment: 27 pages, including supplementary material. Revised evaluation and results; updated author list. Code: https://github.com/LINs-lab/MASArena/tree/BenchAgent
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BenchAgent 统一评测框架在十个推理、编码、工具使用基准上比较六种多智能体工作流与单智能体 Core，全部用 GPT-4.1、相同工具与评分接口。EvoAgent 平均合并准确率 79.70% 高于 Core 的 76.65% 且三次运行全胜，其余五种落后 1.71–8.76 个百分点；LLM-Debate 与 ChatEval 在单项基准上涨分却在合并准确率上为负且 token 消耗达 1.39 与 4.34 倍，说明加智能体不必然更准更省。
Motivation: 是否用多智能体替换单智能体控制器缺少同时覆盖任务性能与推理开销的证据，且既有比较常因模型、工具、评分接口不一致而不可比。
Method: 提出共享评测框架 BenchAgent，以单智能体 BenchAgent Core 为参照，比较六种多智能体工作流配置；全部配置使用 GPT-4.1 与统一工具、评分接口，Core 执行共享步数上限，在固定任务集上跑三次，每个配置每次 3,302 个实例，测量准确率与记录的 token 用量，并对保留的回答做针对性分析。
Result: EvoAgent 平均合并准确率 79.70%，Core 为 76.65%，EvoAgent 三次运行均超过 Core；其余五种 MAS 落后 1.71–8.76 个百分点。LLM-Debate 在 HumanEval 上涨 9.67 点，但合并准确率降 1.96 点且 token 为 Core 的 1.39 倍；ChatEval 在 IFEval 上涨 22.25 点，合并准确率落后 Core 且 token 为其 4.34 倍。
Conclusion: 多智能体工作流的收益是基准特定的，单项涨分常以合并准确率下降和 token 膨胀为代价，工作流选择应同时看准确率与开销；答案保持与资源分配是后续优化方向。

papers.title: Agents' Last Exam
papers.abstract_en: Recent AI systems have achieved strong results on a wide range of benchmarks, yet these gains have not translated into economically meaningful deployment across many professional domains. We argue that this gap is largely an evaluation problem: widely used benchmarks lack sustained performance measurement on real and economically valuable workflows. This paper introduces Agents' Last Exam (ALE), a benchmark designed to evaluate AI agents on long horizon, economically valuable, real world tasks with verifiable outcomes. Developed in collaboration with 250+ industry experts, ALE covers non-physical industries defined with reference to O*NET / SOC 2018 (the U.S. federal occupational taxonomy). It is organized around a task taxonomy with 55 sub fields grouped into 13 industry clusters covering 1K+ tasks. Current results show that the hardest tier remains far from saturated: across mainstream harness and backbone configurations, the average full pass rate is below 1%. ALE is designed as a living benchmark: its task pool grows continuously as new workflows and industries are onboarded. More broadly, ALE is intended not merely as another leaderboard, but as an instrument for closing the gap between benchmark success and GDP relevant impact.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ALE 是面向 AI 智能体的长时程、经济价值导向基准：与 250+ 行业专家合作，按 O*NET/SOC 2018 职业分类构建 13 个行业大类、55 个子领域、1K+ 任务，结果可验证。当前最难档在主流 harness 与 backbone 配置下平均完整通过率低于 1%，远未饱和。
Motivation: 现有 AI 基准分数很高，但没有转化为跨专业领域的经济意义上的实际部署；作者认为根因是评测本身——缺少在真实、有经济价值工作流上的持续性能测量。
Method: 与 250+ 行业专家协作，参照 O*NET/SOC 2018 美国职业分类法定义非实体行业任务，建立 55 子领域、13 行业大类、1K+ 任务的分类体系，任务池随新工作流与行业持续扩充，做成 living benchmark。
Result: 在主流 harness 与 backbone 配置下，最难一档任务的平均完整通过率 (full pass rate) 低于 1%，表明该档远未饱和。
Conclusion: ALE 的定位不是又一个排行榜，而是衡量并缩小基准成绩与 GDP 相关实际影响之间差距的工具。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: The Invisible Hand of Physics: When Video Diffusion Models Know More Than They Show
papers.abstract_en: Modern video diffusion models generate increasingly realistic and temporally coherent videos, motivating their use as candidate world simulators. Yet it remains unclear whether these models internally encode physical structure, or merely reproduce motion patterns seen during training. We study this question by probing video diffusion models along latent trajectories corresponding to real videos with known physical plausibility. To obtain such trajectories, we approximately invert the deterministic sampling process by integrating the learned velocity field backward from a clean video latent to noise, giving access to the model's intermediate states and attention maps. Using these recovered trajectories, we show that physical plausibility is linearly decodable from diffusion transformer states across IntPhys and InfLevel, reaching around 81.27% average accuracy and outperforming dedicated representation-learning baselines such as V-JEPA and VideoMAE. Surprisingly, this signal is absent from the VAE latent input and emerges inside the denoising transformer itself, despite the model not being trained with a self-supervised predictive objective. These findings suggest that physically meaningful representations can arise as a byproduct of generative denoising.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 通过把视频扩散模型的确定性采样过程近似反演（从干净视频 latent 沿学到的速度场反向积分到噪声），恢复出中间状态与 attention map，发现物理合理性可从 diffusion transformer 状态线性解码，在 IntPhys 与 InfLevel 上平均准确率约 81.27%，超过 V-JEPA 与 VideoMAE。该信号不存在于 VAE latent 输入，而是在去噪 transformer 内部涌现，说明物理表征可作为生成式去噪的副产物出现。
Motivation: 视频扩散模型被当作候选世界模拟器，但其内部究竟编码了物理结构还是只复现训练中的运动模式并不清楚；缺少能访问模型中间状态的探针手段。
Method: 沿对应真实视频（已知物理合理性）的 latent 轨迹探测模型：把确定性采样近似反演，即从干净视频 latent 对学到的速度场做反向积分到噪声，从而取得中间状态与 attention map；再在这些状态上做线性解码预测物理合理性，并与 V-JEPA、VideoMAE 等表征学习基线比较。
Result: 物理合理性在 diffusion transformer 状态上线性可解码，在 IntPhys 与 InfLevel 上平均准确率约 81.27%，优于 V-JEPA 和 VideoMAE；该信号在 VAE latent 输入中缺失，只在去噪 transformer 内部出现，而模型并未用自监督预测目标训练。
Conclusion: 物理有意义的表征可以作为生成式去噪的副产物产生，关键信息在去噪 transformer 内部而非输入 latent 中。

papers.title: The Saturation Trap and the Subjectivity of Intervention Timing: Why Affect-Based Triggers and LLM Judges Fail to Time Interventions on Autonomous Agents
papers.abstract_en: As autonomous AI agents move from conversational systems to long-horizon software execution, runtime safety layers that decide when to interrupt an agent have become essential. We study this timing problem using a continuous 18-dimensional affective-dynamics engine (HEART) as a diagnostic probe, evaluating four intervention trigger families - absolute state thresholds, composite state-action patterns, regex reasoning-feature extraction, and zero-shot LLM-as-judge - against human-annotated intervention points on SWE-bench-Verified debugging traces. We report three findings. First, a State Saturation Trap: modeled frustration quickly crosses the threshold and stays at its maximum (v2 erratum: the observer could not register recovery; decay never ran), converting threshold-on-state triggers from moment detectors into near-constant indicators that fire on 39-83% of actions across five trajectories. Second, a capability-and-context floor for LLM judges: a small model(gpt-5.4-mini) never fires, while frontier and cross-vendor models escape the zero-firing floor only with full-trajectory context, reaching only F1 0.17-0.40 at up to 90x the cost. Third, and most importantly, the supervised target is not reproducible among humans: three trained annotators using the same rubric on a 56-action trajectory agree on where to intervene only slightly above chance (location Krippendorff's alpha = +0.047; best pairwise Cohen's kappa = +0.349) and not at all on intervention type (pause degenerate; clarify below chance; reflect only alpha = +0.226). We conclude that intervention timing is a low-reliability construct, making single-annotator F1 an unsuitable optimization target. Our contribution is the joint mapping of this problem across human inter-rater reliability, four detector architectures, a cross-model LLM-judge sweep, and a reproduced saturation effect, rather than any single detector's accuracy.
papers.comment: v2: adds an erratum notice (decay term never executed in replays; the observer could not register recovery). Results otherwise unchanged. 12 pages, 5 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/2025eb1100268-tech/intervention-timing-saturation-trap
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把自主 AI agent 的运行时介入时机问题当作可测量构念来检验：用 18 维情感动力学引擎 HEART 作诊断探针，在 SWE-bench-Verified 调试轨迹上比较四类触发器与人工标注介入点。结果是三重否定：状态饱和陷阱让阈值触发器在 5 条轨迹上 39–83% 的动作持续触发，LLM judge 最好只有 F1 0.17–0.40 且成本高达 90 倍，而三名受训标注者在介入位置上仅略高于随机（Krippendorff's alpha = +0.047）。结论是介入时机本身是低信度构念，单标注者 F1 不应作为优化目标。
Motivation: 长时程软件执行的自主 agent 需要运行时安全层决定何时打断，但现有触发设计默认“该介入的时刻”是一个稳定、可监督的目标，这一前提未经检验。
Method: 以连续 18 维情感动力学引擎 HEART 作为诊断探针，评估四类介入触发器：绝对状态阈值、状态-动作复合模式、regex 推理特征抽取、零样本 LLM-as-judge；对照 SWE-bench-Verified 调试轨迹上的人工标注介入点，并做跨模型 LLM judge 扫描与人类标注者间信度检验。
Result: 状态饱和陷阱：阈值型触发器在 5 条轨迹上于 39–83% 的动作上触发，退化为近常量指示器（v2 勘误：decay 项从未执行，观察者无法记录恢复）。LLM judge：gpt-5.4-mini 从不触发，前沿与跨厂商模型只有在全轨迹上下文下才脱离零触发下限，F1 仅 0.17–0.40，成本最高达 90 倍。人类信度：3 名受训标注者在一条 56 动作轨迹上，介入位置 Krippendorff's alpha = +0.047，最佳成对 Cohen's kappa = +0.349；介入类型上 pause 退化、clarify 低于随机、reflect 仅 alpha = +0.226。
Conclusion: 介入时机是低信度构念，单标注者 F1 是不合适的优化目标；贡献在于把人类信度、四种检测器架构、跨模型 LLM judge 扫描与复现的饱和效应联合映射，而非任何单一检测器的准确率。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.result: 状态饱和陷阱：阈值型触发器在 5 条轨迹上于 39–83% 的动作上触发，退化为近常量指示器（v2 勘误：decay 项从未执行，观察者无法记录恢复）。LLM judge：gpt-5.4-mini 从不触发，前沿与跨厂商模型只有在全轨迹上下文下才脱离零触发下限，F1 仅 0.17–0.40，成本最高达 90 倍。人类信度：3 名受训标注者在一条 56 动作轨迹上，介入位置 Krippendorff's alpha = +0.047，最佳成对 Cohen's kappa = +0.349；介入类型上 pause 退化、clarify 低于随机、reflect 仅 alpha = +0.226。
summary_sections.conclusion: 介入时机是低信度构念，单标注者 F1 是不合适的优化目标；贡献在于把人类信度、四种检测器架构、跨模型 LLM judge 扫描与复现的饱和效应联合映射，而非任何单一检测器的准确率。

papers.title: EvoDrive: Pareto Evolution for Safety-Critical Autonomous Driving via Self-Improving LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Generating safety-critical scenarios is essential for validating and improving autonomous driving systems, yet it inherently requires maximizing adversariality to expose failures while preserving realism. Existing methods usually manage this trade-off with handcrafted heuristics, confining generation to known priors and overlooking underexplored patterns. While recent open-ended agentic evolution can push this limit, unconstrained general agents lack strict simulator grounding and tend to collapse the multi-objective tension into single-scalar maximization. Here we present EvoDrive, the first automated, LLM-based agentic evolution framework for multi-objective scenario generation. EvoDrive employs a simulator-grounded actor-critic architecture where a memory-driven actor iteratively proposes improvements to the generators and critics filter out implausible candidates, and a self-evolving world evaluator routes promising proposals to optimize simulation budgets. EvoDrive further maintains a Pareto archive of evaluated candidates to preserve diverse attack-realism trade-offs and guide future evolution via simulation feedback. Benchmark results on MetaDrive and CARLA show that EvoDrive not only significantly expands the Pareto frontier across various generators, but also produces valuable scenarios for policy training.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvoDrive 用基于 LLM 的智能体进化框架生成自动驾驶安全关键场景，采用仿真器落地的 actor-critic 架构与 Pareto 档案，在 MetaDrive 和 CARLA 上显著扩展了攻击性-真实性的 Pareto 前沿，并产出可用于策略训练的场景。
Motivation: 安全关键场景生成需要在最大化对抗性暴露失效与保持真实性之间权衡，现有方法依赖手工启发式、局限于已知先验，而无约束的通用智能体进化缺乏严格仿真器约束，易把多目标权衡压成单标量最大化。
Method: 提出 EvoDrive：仿真器落地的 actor-critic 架构，其中 memory-driven actor 迭代改进生成器、critic 过滤不合理候选；self-evolving world evaluator 将有前景的提案路由以优化仿真预算；并维护已评估候选的 Pareto 档案，保留多样化的攻击-真实性权衡并用仿真反馈引导后续进化。
Result: 在 MetaDrive 与 CARLA 基准上，EvoDrive 显著扩展了多种生成器的 Pareto 前沿，并产出对策略训练有价值的场景。
Conclusion: 把 LLM 智能体进化约束在仿真器内并用 Pareto 档案保留多目标权衡，可在安全关键场景生成中同时推进对抗性与真实性，且生成场景可反哺策略训练。

papers.title: When Should the Teacher Move? Temporal Coupling and Stability in Self On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Self on-policy distillation trains a student policy against a teacher derived from its own parameter history, yet the teacher's update schedule -- which governs the \emph{temporal coupling} between teacher and student -- has not been systematically studied as a stability variable. Through a controlled schedule sweep on Qwen3-8B, we establish that \emph{isolation periods}, defined as complete teacher freezing between updates, are the key structural property enabling stable learning, not teacher age. To characterize these underlying training dynamics, we introduce a diagnostic framework of temporal KL structure, refresh shock, and length-tail risk. This framework further uncovers \emph{state-oblivious collapse}: optimal short-horizon fixed schedules catastrophically fail under long-horizon training because a clock-driven refresh can copy a transiently drifting student into the teacher in a single, irreversible step. This failure mode is invisible under short-horizon evaluation and mechanistically distinct from EMA's chronic contamination. To address this, we propose \emph{Consolidation-Gated Teacher Refresh} (CGTR), which preserves isolation periods while gating each refresh on joint evidence of reward improvement and length-tail safety, ensuring every teacher movement responds to genuine student consolidation rather than a clock signal. With a single shared parameter set and no per-dataset retuning, CGTR achieves \textbf{zero collapse} and the best final score on all four tasks (Chemistry, Biology, Physics, ToolUse), self-regulating its refresh frequency to each task's learning dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 自蒸馏 (self on-policy distillation) 中教师更新节奏是稳定性变量：在 Qwen3-8B 上的受控调度扫描表明，起作用的是更新之间的完全冻结期 (isolation periods) 而非教师年龄；固定时钟调度在长程训练下会把瞬时漂移的学生一次性不可逆地拷进教师，造成 state-oblivious collapse。提出的 CGTR 用奖励提升与长度尾部安全的联合证据门控每次刷新，实现零崩溃并在四个任务上取得最佳最终分。
Motivation: 自蒸馏中教师由学生自身参数历史导出，其更新调度所决定的时间耦合 (temporal coupling) 一直未被当作稳定性变量系统研究；短程最优的固定调度在长程训练下会灾难性失败。
Method: 在 Qwen3-8B 上做受控调度扫描，提出由 temporal KL structure、refresh shock、length-tail risk 组成的诊断框架；据此提出 Consolidation-Gated Teacher Refresh (CGTR)，保留隔离期并以奖励提升与长度尾部安全的联合证据门控每次教师刷新，单一共享参数集、不做逐数据集调参。
Result: 扫描确立隔离期而非教师年龄是稳定学习的关键结构属性；发现 state-oblivious collapse，即时钟驱动刷新可在单步不可逆地把瞬时漂移的学生拷入教师，且在短程评估下不可见、机制上区别于 EMA 的慢性污染；CGTR 实现 zero collapse，并在 Chemistry、Biology、Physics、ToolUse 四个任务上均取得最佳最终分，刷新频率随各任务学习动态自调节。
Conclusion: 教师刷新应由学生真正巩固的证据门控，而非时钟信号；隔离期是稳定自蒸馏的结构性前提，短程最优的固定调度不能外推到长程训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Unified Benchmark for Dynamic Medical Treatment Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Medical treatment recommendation poses several challenges to reinforcement learning (RL): patient physiology evolves in continuous time, measurements and interventions are performed at irregular intervals, and treatment effects vary substantially across individuals. Existing RL formulations and simulated environments, however, are based on discrete-time MDPs with fixed decision intervals. Thus, it remains difficult to evaluate whether RL methods can handle time-interval-dependent disease progression, personalized treatment response, and safety between consecutive measurement points. To address this gap, we introduce MedGym, a benchmark environment for dynamic treatment recommendation. MedGym models longitudinal patient evolution in a continuous-time framework and constructs a configurable medical RL benchmark from clinical data by using Physics-Informed Neural Networks. The resulting benchmark enables direct comparison between discrete-time and continuous-time methods under irregular treatment timing and patient-specific dynamics. Furthermore, MedGym supports evaluation from clinically important perspectives, such as personalization and trajectory-level safety. By providing a standardized and configurable benchmark for continuous-time dynamic treatment, MedGym enables more realistic and informative evaluation of medical RL methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MedGym：用 Physics-Informed Neural Networks 从临床数据构建连续时间、不规则采样的医疗强化学习基准，让离散时间与连续时间方法在个体化动力学和不规则治疗时序下可直接对比，并支持个性化与轨迹级安全性评估。
Motivation: 现有医疗 RL 公式与仿真环境都基于固定决策间隔的离散时间 MDP，无法评估方法能否处理依赖时间间隔的疾病进展、个体化治疗反应，以及两次测量点之间的安全性。
Method: MedGym 以连续时间框架建模病人纵向状态演化，用 Physics-Informed Neural Networks 从临床数据构造可配置的医疗 RL 基准，支持离散时间与连续时间方法在不规则治疗时序和个体特异动力学下的直接对比，并提供个性化与轨迹级安全等临床视角的评估接口。
Result: 产出一个标准化、可配置的连续时间动态治疗 RL 基准，可对比离散与连续时间方法在不规则治疗时序下的表现，并按个性化与轨迹级安全性评测。
Conclusion: 连续时间、可配置的基准使医疗 RL 方法的评估更贴近真实临床设定，尤其是不规则测量间隔与个体差异下的表现。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Learning Transfers: Kan Extensions of Topological Invariants of Learned Representations
papers.abstract_en: When a learned representation is reused for a new task, which of its structure should survive? A task is a small category, a change of task is a functor $J$, and the invariants of a trained representation form a functor $F$. The left Kan extension $\operatorname{Lan}_JF$ is the invariant that the source and the change of task force on the target: by its universal property, every comparison of the source with an observed target invariant factors through it. The transfer discrepancy is the largest distance, over the target objects, between this extension and the observed invariant. For persistent homology the extension is a cokernel over comma categories, and a functorial version of the discrepancy, which also compares the maps between target objects, is $1$-Lipschitz under interleavings. On finite samples the discrepancy is a bottleneck distance, computed without approximation. For data glued from two pieces whose exclusive parts lie farther apart than the filtration scale, a Mayer-Vietoris sequence identifies what extending homology loses, while extending chains loses nothing. For a merge of labelled point clouds, the degree-zero discrepancy vanishes if and only if some $1$-Lipschitz classifier has a margin above the filtration scale at every sample point. In experiments on sampled manifolds, trained encoders and pretrained image models, every exact prediction holds on every sample. The discrepancy of truncated invariants recovers a hidden merge of separated parts far above chance and tells the intended target of a merge from a permuted control, but across pretrained models it does not track the accuracy of a linear probe.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把「训练表征迁移到新任务时哪些结构应保留」形式化为范畴论问题：任务是小范畴、任务变化是函子 J、训练表征的不变量是函子 F，左 Kan 扩展 Lan_J F 给出源与任务变化强制在目标上的不变量，transfer discrepancy 度量它与观测不变量的最大距离。对持久同调该扩展是逗号范畴上的余核，函子版 discrepancy 在 interleaving 下 1-Lipschitz；在有限样本上 discrepancy 就是 bottleneck distance，可精确计算而无需近似。在采样流形、训练编码器与预训练图像模型上，所有精确预测在每个样本上都成立；discrepancy 能远高于随机水平地检出被分离部分的隐藏合并、并从置换对照判断合并的预期目标，但在预训练模型之间它并不追踪线性探针的准确率。
Motivation: 复用已训练表征时缺少一个可计算的准则来判定源表征的哪些结构应当在新任务上存活，以及观测到的目标不变量与「源强制的不变量」差多少。
Method: 以小范畴刻画任务、函子 J 刻画任务变化、函子 F 刻画训练表征的不变量，取左 Kan 扩展 Lan_J F 作为源强制的不变量并定义 transfer discrepancy 为其与观测不变量在目标对象上的最大距离；对持久同调给出逗号范畴上的余核构造，函子版 discrepancy 同时比较目标对象间的映射并在 interleaving 下 1-Lipschitz，有限样本上化为可精确计算的 bottleneck distance；用 Mayer–Vietoris 序列分析两块拼接数据（独有部分间距大于 filtration 尺度）时扩展同调丢失什么、扩展链则不丢失。
Result: 在采样流形、训练编码器与预训练图像模型上，所有精确预测在每个样本上成立；标签点云合并的零阶 discrepancy 消失当且仅当某个 1-Lipschitz 分类器在每个采样点处的间隔大于 filtration 尺度；截断不变量的 discrepancy 能远高于随机水平地检出被分离部分的隐藏合并，并从置换对照中判断合并的预期目标；但在预训练模型之间该 discrepancy 不追踪线性探针准确率。
Conclusion: 左 Kan 扩展给出迁移中「源强制保留的结构」的普适刻画，其 discrepancy 在持久同调上是可精确计算的 bottleneck 型量，能检测隐藏的拓扑合并，但不等同于下游分类准确率。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: MyoSem: Aligning Electromyography with Natural-Language Action Semantics
papers.abstract_en: Electromyography (EMG) records muscle activation for hand gesture recognition, prosthetic control, and wearable interaction. Existing EMG methods usually formulate hand action understanding as prediction over fixed gesture labels, leaving EMG signals and action-semantic text unaligned in a common feature space and limiting bidirectional querying between signals and hand-action descriptions. We present MyoSem, an EMG--action semantic alignment framework that maps hand EMG and multi-view natural-language action descriptions into a shared feature space for retrieval. MyoSem builds semantic prototypes from multi-view descriptions, encodes EMG with local activation-aware representations, and uses semantic queries to aggregate local EMG evidence for bidirectional EMG--text retrieval. We evaluate MyoSem under seven protocols on NinaPro DB2, EMG2Pose, and NinaPro DB2$\rightarrow$DB3, covering random splits, user shifts, held-out action classes, and able-bodied-to-amputee transfer. Across this evaluation, MyoSem achieves the strongest overall bidirectional retrieval performance among the evaluated methods. Ablations and representation analyses show how semantic prototypes, activation-aware encoding, and semantic queries shape the learned space. Overall, MyoSem moves EMG hand action understanding from fixed-label recognition toward language-queryable semantic retrieval.

papers.title: VITAL: Visual-Semantic Dual Supervision for Enhanced and Interpretable Latent Reasoning in Medical MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Latent reasoning enables reasoning over continuous hidden states rather than explicit tokens, avoiding the language bottleneck and inference overhead of chain-of-thought for medical VQA. However, existing methods suffer from modality collapse, insufficient visual supervision, and train-inference mismatch. Moreover, their opaque latent states offer no interpretability, which is critical in clinical applications. We propose VITAL, a latent-space reasoning framework for medical MLLMs with visual-semantic dual supervision: an auxiliary text decoder reconstructs reasoning chains from latent states, while a visual projector regresses ROI features from a frozen, independent medical vision encoder. Both modules are discarded at inference with zero overhead, yet can be re-attached post-hoc for dual interpretability, providing textual and visual explanations of the reasoning process without sacrificing efficiency. We construct a 61K dataset spanning 9 imaging modalities, exceeding prior medical visual latent reasoning datasets by an order of magnitude. Experiments on 7 benchmarks show that VITAL consistently and substantially outperforms the backbone, all latent reasoning baselines, and medical MLLMs trained on far larger data, achieving state-of-the-art results competitive with trillion-parameter proprietary models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VITAL 用视觉-语义双监督给医学 MLLM 的隐空间推理加约束：辅助文本解码器从隐状态重建推理链，视觉投影头从冻结的独立医学视觉编码器回归 ROI 特征，两者推理时丢弃、零开销，事后可重新挂上做文本与视觉双重可解释。在 7 个医学 VQA 基准上一致且大幅超过骨干、全部隐空间推理基线以及用更大数据训练的医学 MLLM，达到与万亿参数闭源模型可比的 SOTA。
Motivation: 隐空间推理绕开 CoT 的语言瓶颈与推理开销，但现有方法存在模态塌缩、视觉监督不足、训练-推理不匹配，且隐状态不透明，在临床上无法解释。
Method: 在隐空间推理框架上加双监督：辅助文本解码器从隐状态重建推理链，视觉投影头回归来自冻结且独立的医学视觉编码器的 ROI 特征；两个模块训练后丢弃，推理零开销，需要时可事后重挂做双重解释。配套构建 61K 数据集，覆盖 9 种成像模态。
Result: 61K 数据集规模超过此前医学视觉隐空间推理数据集一个数量级；在 7 个基准上一致且大幅优于骨干、所有隐空间推理基线，以及在远更大规模数据上训练的医学 MLLM，达到与万亿参数专有模型可比的 SOTA。
Conclusion: 视觉与语义双监督加事后可重挂的解释模块，可以在不牺牲效率的前提下同时提升医学隐空间推理的性能与可解释性。

papers.title: Unsupervised Identification and Removal of Spurious Correlations During Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning a pretrained language model on a curated dataset can produce spurious correlations between the fine-tuning task and unintended latent factors---such as misaligned personas or political slant---that the curation procedure has entangled with the task. The model can latch onto these spurious correlations, leading to bias and reduced out-of-distribution generalisation. We prove that under reasonable assumptions on task complexity and the spurious correlation, such latent factors can be identified, without supervision, from the weights of a naive LoRA fine-tune. Existing approaches to removing bias, such as activation steering, remove identified factors from residual-stream activations, either at inference or during training. We argue, however, that the goal should be to remove the spurious correlation, not the latent factor itself, as the pretrained model may rely on it for genuine task signal. To enable this, we propose GRASP, GRadient projection of Associated Spurious Patterns, which prevents the model from acquiring new reliance on the identified latent factor while preserving any pretrained content along it. We validate on three fine-tuning tasks. The first two involve emergent misalignment, where fine-tuning on a narrow task---in our case, writing insecure code and giving bad medical advice---leads to misaligned responses on unrelated topics. Here our method completely removes misalignment in the insecure code case and reduces it by ~5x in the bad medical advice case, beating all baselines in the trade-off between misalignment-reduction and task-preservation. The last is a novel political-bias experiment, where fine-tuning on right-skewed Reddit financial-advice data causes political-lean drift on unrelated topics. Here our method reduces drift by more than half, while improving financial task performance, beating all baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 GRASP（GRadient projection of Associated Spurious Patterns）：在 LoRA 微调权重中无监督识别与任务纠缠的潜在因子（如人格、政治倾向），并在训练中投影掉对该因子的新增依赖，同时保留预训练模型沿该方向的真实任务信号。在不安全代码与错误医疗建议两个 emergent misalignment 任务上，不安全代码的错位被完全消除，医疗建议错位降低约 5 倍；在 Reddit 右倾金融建议数据导致的政治倾向漂移上，漂移减少过半且金融任务性能提升，均在「错位削减—任务保持」权衡上胜过全部基线。
Motivation: 人工整理的微调数据集会把任务与不想要的潜在因子（错位人格、政治倾向）纠缠，模型会抓住这些虚假相关，导致偏见和分布外泛化下降；现有 activation steering 类方法直接移除潜在因子本身，可能连带删掉预训练模型赖以完成任务的真实信号。
Method: GRASP 先从朴素 LoRA 微调的权重中无监督识别潜在因子（依赖任务复杂度与虚假相关强度的可识别性证明），再在训练中对相关梯度做投影，阻止模型新增对该因子的依赖，但保留预训练内容沿该方向的成分。
Result: 在三个微调任务上验证：不安全代码写作导致的 emergent misalignment 被完全消除；错误医疗建议任务上的错位降低约 5 倍；在右倾 Reddit 金融建议数据微调引发的无关话题政治倾向漂移上，漂移减少超过一半，同时金融任务性能提升。三项均在错位削减与任务保持的权衡上击败所有基线。
Conclusion: 应移除的是模型对潜在因子的虚假依赖而非因子本身，投影梯度即可在不牺牲任务表现的前提下切断该依赖。
Relevance: 1
