papers.title: MPMMine: Better Benchmarks for Constraint Acquisition
papers.abstract_en: Constraint Acquisition (CA) and related research on the validation and enhancement of Mathematical Programming (MP) models using domain knowledge artifacts are currently limited by inadequate benchmarks. The existing benchmarks are loosely organized, provide inconsistent types and formats of artifacts for individual problems, are designed for benchmarking solvers rather than CA algorithms, include narrow classes of problems, or omit crucial details for the reproducibility of experiments and fair comparison of CA methods. We develop a benchmark dataset, a supporting software package, and a benchmarking tool crafted for the consistent, systematic, and comprehensive assessment of CA algorithms, bridging the gap in algorithmic development and experimental infrastructure. This work presents MPMMine, a benchmark suite designed to assess algorithms that discover, validate, and enhance MP models using diverse artifacts. The development of MPMMine is guided by design rules supporting consistency, standardization, completeness, extensibility, openness, and version control. It adopts a uniform structure and relies on open formats. It provides alternative formulations of MP models per problem, tens of parameter instantiations per MP model, and thousands of exemplary solutions and non-solutions in discrete, continuous, and mixed domains, alongside natural-language descriptions to support text-to-model methods. The mpmmine-py Python package provides an application programming interface for accessing the dataset artifacts. The MPMMine Leaderboard is a~tool that systematically evaluates existing CA algorithms using MPMMine under consistent conditions. It leverages open source implementations, runs them in isolated containers adapting input/output to their needs to build an extensive, interactive scoreboard.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 1 figure, for the associated dataset, see https://github.com/MPMMine/MPMMine
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MPMMine 提出面向约束获取 (Constraint Acquisition) 的基准套件，用统一结构与开放格式替代现有零散基准：每个问题给出 MP 模型的多种替代形式、每个模型数十个参数实例化、离散/连续/混合域中数千个示例解与非解，并附自然语言描述以支持 text-to-model 方法。配套 mpmmine-py API 与在隔离容器中运行开源 CA 算法的 MPMMine Leaderboard，用于在一致条件下系统评测。
Motivation: 现有 CA 基准组织松散、单个问题的工件类型与格式不一致、为求解器而非 CA 算法设计、问题类别狭窄，且缺少复现与公平比较所需细节，制约了 MP 模型验证与增强研究。
Method: 按一致性、标准化、完整性、可扩展性、开放性与版本控制六条设计规则构建基准数据集、软件包与评测工具；提供统一结构与开放格式，含 MP 模型替代形式、每模型数十个参数实例化、离散/连续/混合域的数千示例解与非解及自然语言描述；mpmmine-py 提供数据访问 API，MPMMine Leaderboard 在隔离容器中适配各开源 CA 算法的输入输出并生成交互式榜单。
Result: 基准提供每个问题的多种 MP 模型替代形式、每个模型数十个参数实例化、离散/连续/混合域中数千个示例解与非解，以及配套自然语言描述；数据集见 github.com/MPMMine/MPMMine。
Conclusion: CA 算法的评测应建立在统一结构、开放格式、可版本控制的基准与容器化一致评测流程之上，才能做可复现的公平比较。

papers.title: Automatic-Differentiation-Enabled Finite Element Model Updating: Learning Constitutive Neural Networks from Structural Deformation Data
papers.abstract_en: The identification of constitutive neural network models from heterogeneous full-field deformation data provides a robust alternative to traditional calibration methods based on homogeneous stress-strain experiments, particularly given the high dimensionality of trainable parameters. This work presents ADE-FEMU (Automatic-Differentiation-Enabled Finite Element Model Updating), an end-to-end differentiable framework that integrates a constitutive neural network model within a JAX-FEM nonlinear solver and identifies its parameters through gradient-based minimization of a measurement-mismatch loss, allowing for training on structural data with limited kinetic information. Thus, it can be considered as an extension of finite element model updating (FEMU) for hyperelastic materials, implemented within a GPU-accelerated, fully automatically differentiable finite element framework Newton tangent stiffness and loss gradients are computed automatically using forward- and reverse-mode automatic differentiation throughout the entire pipeline, thereby removing the need for analytic adjoints or offline surrogate models. ADE-FEMU is demonstrated for two architectures: a grey-box Constitutive Artificial Neural Network (CANN), a polyconvex, fully connected model with high flexibility, and a white-box CANN, an expert-system network with phenomenologically interpretable strain-energy terms. Focusing on incompressible isotropic hyperelasticity, ADE-FEMU is evaluated on three open experimental datasets: (1) full digital image correlation (DIC) of a perforated tensile specimen, (2) a reduced-data scenario with a one-dimensional stretch profile and global force-displacement curve, and (3) a heterogeneous matrix-inclusion system in which both phases constitutive laws are identified and generalized to twenty-two previously unseen samples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ADE-FEMU 把本构神经网络嵌进 JAX-FEM 非线性求解器，用自动微分直接对测量失配损失做梯度下降，从异质全场变形数据反演材料参数。在三个开放 DIC 实验数据集上验证，含杂交/白盒 CANN 两种架构，矩阵-夹杂体系中反演的两相本构律可泛化到 22 个未见样本。
Motivation: 传统 FEMU 依赖均匀应力-应变实验标定，且可训练参数维度高；全场异质变形数据难以直接用于梯度式模型更新，解析伴随与离线代理模型的推导成本高。
Method: 在 GPU 加速、全程可自动微分的有限元框架中集成 CANN 本构网络，Newton 切线刚度与损失梯度由前向/反向模式 AD 直接给出，通过梯度最小化 measurement-mismatch loss 识别参数，可在动力学信息有限的结构数据上训练；对比 grey-box（polyconvex 全连接）与 white-box（含可解释应变能项的专家系统）两种 CANN。
Result: 在三个开放实验数据集上评估：(1) 穿孔拉伸试件的全场 DIC，(2) 仅一维伸展剖面加全局力-位移曲线的降数据场景，(3) 矩阵-夹杂体系，两相本构律同时被识别并泛化到 22 个未见样本。

papers.title: COSY: Compositional 3DGS Synthesis for Disentangled Human Head Editing
papers.abstract_en: Recent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) GANs for human heads synthesize and render photorealistic 3D models in real-time and offer a vast variety in identity and appearance. However, controlling specific semantic attributes such as hair color or glasses remains challenging, as edits in the entangled latent space often induce unintended changes in identity or appearance. Although there are several methods that aim to disentangle the latent space post training by estimating directions that only modify certain features, these methods cannot guarantee complete disentanglement and often require pre-trained classifiers. In our approach, we propose a new generator architecture that synthesizes components, such as hair, skin, glasses, and torso, completely independently. This allows for changing the latent vector for one region while keeping the remaining parts fixed. Further, we achieve this separation using only sparse information such as the hair or skin color, eliminating the requirement of segmentation masks or geometric priors, often seen in prior work. To ensure matching shape and lighting conditions during editing, we allow minimal shared information via context tokens between the independent generators. These tokens even allow us to control the shape and light, without any prior annotation. Compared to existing works on GAN-based generation and editing, our method shows better disentanglement, more precise editing control, and competitive visual quality.
papers.journal_ref: ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COSY 用组合式 3DGS 生成器把头发、皮肤、眼镜、躯干等部件完全独立地合成，改一个区域的隐变量即可固定其余部分，从而在人头编辑中实现更干净的解耦。仅凭头发或皮肤颜色这类稀疏信息即可完成分离，无需分割掩码或几何先验；部件间通过 context token 保留最小共享信息以对齐形状与光照，且这些 token 本身可在无先验标注下控制形状与光照。
Motivation: 3DGS GAN 人头生成的隐空间是纠缠的，编辑发色、眼镜等语义属性会连带改变身份或外观；训练后估计解耦方向的做法无法保证完全解耦且常依赖预训练分类器。
Method: 提出新的生成器架构，让头发、皮肤、眼镜、躯干等部件各自由独立生成器合成，编辑时只改动目标区域的隐向量；分离仅用发色/皮肤色等稀疏信息，不需分割掩码或几何先验；部件间通过 context token 传递最小共享信息以保证形状与光照一致。
Result: 与现有 GAN 生成与编辑工作相比，该方法在解耦程度上更好、编辑控制更精确，视觉质量具有竞争力（abstract 未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把部件生成彻底独立、只靠稀疏颜色提示加少量共享 token，就能在不依赖分类器与掩码的前提下实现可控的人头 3DGS 编辑。

papers.title: Is TabPFN the Silver Bullet for Insurance Pricing?
papers.abstract_en: Modelling claim frequency and severity for non-life insurance pricing predominantly relies on generalised linear models (GLMs), with gradient-boosted machines as the leading machine learning alternative. Tabular foundation models (TFMs) present a fundamentally different inference paradigm. By pre-training on large collections of synthetic datasets, TFMs enable inference on new data through in-context learning, without any dataset-specific preprocessing, fitting, or hyperparameter tuning. This paper presents a first empirical evaluation of TabPFN for motor insurance pricing, benchmarking two versions of TabPFN against GLM and XGBoost on two publicly available motor third-party liability (MTPL) datasets. Our results show that TabPFN does not consistently outperform established baselines: it falls behind the GLM on claim frequency, where its performance depends on the size of the in-context training set, but it is competitive on claim severity, where data are scarcer. Its inference times are substantially longer. Although tabular foundation models are promising, particularly in data-scarce settings, TabPFN is not yet ready to replace established actuarial methods for claim frequency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在两个公开的机动车第三者责任 (MTPL) 数据集上，TabPFN 与 GLM、XGBoost 对比后并未稳定胜出：索赔频率上落后于 GLM，表现还取决于 in-context 训练集大小；索赔严重度上在数据更稀缺处有竞争力，但推理时间明显更长。结论是 TabPFN 尚不能替代索赔频率定价中的既有精算方法。
Motivation: 非车险定价长期由 GLM 主导、GBM 作为主要 ML 替代，表格基础模型 (TFM) 提供免预处理、免调参的 in-context 推理新范式，但其在真实保险定价任务上是否真的优于既有方法尚无系统检验。
Method: 对 TabPFN 两个版本做首次实证评估，在两个公开 MTPL 数据集上与 GLM 和 XGBoost 基准对比，分别针对索赔频率 (claim frequency) 与索赔严重度 (claim severity) 两类任务，并考察 in-context 训练集规模的影响。
Result: TabPFN 未一致优于既有基线：索赔频率上落后于 GLM，性能依赖 in-context 训练集大小；索赔严重度上（数据更稀缺处）具有竞争力；推理时间显著长于基线。
Conclusion: 表格基础模型在数据稀缺场景有前景，但 TabPFN 目前尚不足以取代索赔频率定价中的既有精算方法。

papers.title: Do Deep Ensembles Actually Capture Uncertainty in Graph Neural Networks?
papers.abstract_en: While deep ensembles are widely considered to be the default method for uncertainty quantification in deep learning, their effectiveness for graph-structured data is often simply assumed based on successes in domains like computer vision. We investigate standard deep ensembles specifically for message-passing graph neural networks. Benchmarking across eight datasets representing varied tasks and complexities, we reveal that ensembles provide only marginal improvement over a single model. These marginal gains stem primarily from averaging out optimization noise in point predictions rather than from meaningfully better uncertainty estimates. Through an aleatoric-epistemic decomposition, we identify epistemic collapse: independently trained networks consistently converge to overly similar predictions. Because disagreement is the fundamental mechanism through which ensembles capture epistemic uncertainty, this lack of diversity neutralizes their key advantage. Towards explaining this phenomenon, we derive a bound on epistemic variance in terms of the graph topology and Dirichlet energy budget, linking epistemic collapse to the smoothing bias of message passing. Our results suggest that deep ensemble success does not seamlessly transfer to graph machine learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在消息传递图神经网络 (MP-GNN) 上，深度集成 (deep ensembles) 只比单模型带来边际提升，且这些提升主要来自平均掉点预测的优化噪声，而非更好的不确定性估计。作者通过 aleatoric-epistemic 分解发现“epistemic collapse”：独立训练的网络收敛到过于相似的预测，从而瓦解了集成赖以捕捉 epistemic 不确定性的分歧机制。结论是深度集成在 CV 上的成功不能直接搬到图机器学习。
Motivation: 深度集成被视为深度学习不确定性量化的默认方法，但其在图结构数据上的有效性往往只是从计算机视觉的成功类推假设而来，缺少针对 MP-GNN 的检验。
Method: 针对消息传递 GNN 评估标准深度集成，在八个代表不同任务与复杂度的数据集上做基准测试；用 aleatoric-epistemic 分解定位分歧来源，并从图拓扑与 Dirichlet energy budget 推导 epistemic variance 的上界，把 epistemic collapse 与消息传递的平滑偏差 (smoothing bias) 联系起来。
Result: 八个数据集的基准显示集成相对单模型仅有边际改进；这些增益主要来自平均点预测的优化噪声，而非更有意义的不确定性估计。分解显示独立训练网络的预测持续过于相似（epistemic collapse），并给出以图拓扑和 Dirichlet 能量预算表示的 epistemic 方差上界。
Conclusion: 深度集成的成功不会无缝迁移到图机器学习：消息传递的平滑偏差削弱了网络间分歧，而分歧正是集成捕捉 epistemic 不确定性的根本机制。

papers.title: Stochastic MeanFlow Policies: One-Step Generative Control with Entropic Mirror Descent
papers.abstract_en: Combining entropy regularisation with mirror descent in online off-policy reinforcement learning requires expressive policies with efficient sampling and explicit entropy control. Gaussian policies struggle to represent multimodal targets, whereas generative policies often require iterative sampling or lack tractable entropy estimates. We introduce Stochastic MeanFlow Policies (SMFP), a one-step generative policy class that combines MeanFlow-based noise-to-action mappings with Gaussian reparameterisation. The latent mapping captures diverse action modes, while a learnable conditional Gaussian scale provides an analytic entropy lower bound. We use this bound to regulate stochasticity alongside direct value guidance and advantage-weighted MeanFlow regression, enabling entropy-regularised mirror-descent learning with one-step policies. Across seven MuJoCo benchmarks, SMFP achieves strong performance against Gaussian and generative baselines with single-step inference. Additional experiments demonstrate multimodal action modelling and effective exploration in sparse-reward navigation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出随机 MeanFlow 策略 (Stochastic MeanFlow Policies, SMFP)：把 MeanFlow 的噪声到动作映射与 Gaussian reparameterisation 结合，用可学习的条件 Gaussian 尺度给出解析熵下界，从而在单步采样下做熵正则的 mirror-descent 在线 off-policy 强化学习。在七个 MuJoCo 基准上以单步推理取得对 Gaussian 与生成式基线的强性能，并在稀疏奖励导航中展示多模态动作建模与有效探索。
Motivation: 在线 off-policy RL 中把熵正则与 mirror descent 结合，需要既能表达多模态目标、又能高效采样且熵可解析计算的策略；Gaussian 策略表达不了多模态目标，生成式策略则往往需要迭代采样或熵不可解。
Method: SMFP 用 MeanFlow 噪声到动作映射捕获多样的动作模式，叠加可学习的条件 Gaussian 尺度提供解析熵下界；以该下界约束随机性，配合直接价值引导 (value guidance) 与 advantage 加权的 MeanFlow 回归，构成单步策略上的熵正则 mirror-descent 学习。
Result: 在七个 MuJoCo 基准上，SMFP 以单步推理相对 Gaussian 与生成式基线取得强性能；附加实验展示多模态动作建模，以及在稀疏奖励导航中的有效探索。
Conclusion: 解析熵下界加 advantage 加权 MeanFlow 回归，可以让单步生成策略同时满足 mirror descent 的熵控制与高效采样，无需迭代采样即可用于在线 off-policy RL。

papers.title: SURF: Steering the Scalarization Weight to Uniformly Traverse the Pareto Front
papers.abstract_en: Scalarization is widely used in multi-objective optimization owing to its simplicity and scalability. In many applications, the goal is to generate solutions that represent diverse user preferences, ideally with uniform coverage of the Pareto front (PF). However, uniformly sampling scalarization weights usually induces non-uniform coverage of the PF. We explain this mismatch through the geometry of the scalarization path. As the weight varies, the corresponding solutions traverse the PF at a generally nonuniform speed. Integrating this speed gives cumulative arc length. After normalization by the total length, it defines a cumulative distribution function (CDF) on weights whose inverse selects points at equal arc-length intervals. Building on this insight, we propose SURF (Sampling Uniformly along the Pareto Front). For structured problems, including bi-objective bandits, we derive analytical expressions for this CDF map and the resulting PF-aware weight sampling rule. For general problems, SURF alternates between CDF reconstruction and weight sampling. Theoretically, we show that under provable conditions for bi-objective LS, SURF's CDF reconstruction error converges linearly to an $O(N^{-2})$ discretization floor. Empirically, experiments on bandits, multi-objective-gymnasium, and multi-objective LLM alignment demonstrate that SURF efficiently achieves more uniform PF coverage than baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SURF 通过标量化路径的几何解释，把权重采样转为按累积弧长等距取点，从而在 Pareto 前沿上实现均匀覆盖。对双目标 bandit 等结构化问题给出解析 CDF 映射；在 bi-objective LS 上 CDF 重构误差线性收敛到 O(N^{-2}) 离散化下限，并在 bandits、multi-objective-gymnasium 与多目标 LLM 对齐上比基线覆盖更均匀。
Motivation: 多目标优化中均匀采样标量化权重通常导致 Pareto 前沿覆盖不均匀，因为权重变化时解沿前沿的移动速度一般不均匀，难以代表多样化的用户偏好。
Method: SURF 将权重变化时解沿 Pareto 前沿的移动速度积分得到累积弧长，归一化后构造权重上的 CDF，用其逆映射在等弧长间隔取点。结构化问题（含双目标 bandit）推导解析 CDF 映射与 PF-aware 权重采样规则；一般问题在 CDF 重构与权重采样之间交替。
Result: 在 bi-objective LS 上，理论证明在可证条件下 SURF 的 CDF 重构误差线性收敛到 O(N^{-2}) 的离散化下限。在 bandits、multi-objective-gymnasium 与多目标 LLM 对齐实验中，SURF 比基线更高效地实现更均匀的 Pareto 前沿覆盖。
Conclusion: 权重空间的均匀采样不等于前沿空间的均匀覆盖；按累积弧长的逆 CDF 采样权重可以在可证条件下逼近均匀 PF 覆盖，并在多类多目标问题上优于基线。

papers.title: Quadratic Characterizations for Reachability Analysis of Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Quadratic constraints (QCs) are widely used to characterize nonlinearities and uncertainties, but generic analytical characterizations can be conservative on bounded domains. This paper develops a framework for constructing verified quadratic characterizations of scalar relations in the two-dimensional real plane. Candidate quadratic inequalities are locally generated by solving convex quadratic programs using samples from the relation and exterior sample points. They are then verified globally using sum-of-squares certificates over an exact semialgebraic description or, in the case of nonpolynomial relations, over relaxed polynomial descriptions. The resulting verified constraints define a sound overapproximation of the scalar relations over the considered domains. These constraints are directly compatible with existing analysis frameworks based on QCs and pointwise integral quadratic constraints (IQCs) for static nonlinearities and uncertainties, and they can also be embedded in QC-based semidefinite programs for reachability and safety analysis of feedforward neural networks. For smooth activations such as $\tanh$, the method yields domain-dependent quadratic characterizations that constitute an alternative to generic sector- or slope-based descriptions. For ReLU networks, we give methods to reduce conservatism in QC-based reachability analysis of feedforward networks by exploiting dependencies between neurons and tighter local bounds. Numerical examples demonstrate improved reachability results for smooth activations, reduced conservatism for ReLU networks, and applicability beyond neural networks through an example involving saturation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用凸二次规划从关系采样与外部样本点局部生成候选二次不等式，再用平方和 (sum-of-squares) 证书在精确半代数描述上全局验证，得到标量非线性关系的可靠二次刻画 (verified quadratic constraints)。该刻画可直接嵌入基于 QC 的半定规划做前馈神经网络可达性与安全性分析；对 tanh 给出随定义域变化的刻画以替代通用 sector/slope 描述，对 ReLU 网络利用神经元间依赖与更紧的局部界降低保守性，数值算例显示光滑激活可达性结果改善、ReLU 保守性下降，并通过饱和算例说明可推广到神经网络之外。
Motivation: 通用解析的二次约束 (QC) 刻画在有界定义域上过于保守，导致基于 QC/IQC 的神经网络可达性与安全性分析结果偏松。
Method: 对二维实平面上的标量关系，用凸二次规划基于关系采样与外部样本点局部生成候选二次不等式；再用 sum-of-squares 证书在精确半代数描述（非多项式关系则用松弛多项式描述）上全局验证，得到 sound overapproximation。所得约束接入现有 QC 与 pointwise IQC 框架，并嵌入 QC-based 半定规划做前馈网络可达性分析；ReLU 情形通过利用神经元间依赖与更紧的局部界降低保守性。
Result: 数值算例显示：光滑激活 (tanh) 的可达性结果改善，ReLU 网络的保守性降低，并有一个饱和 (saturation) 算例说明方法适用于神经网络之外的非线性。摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 在有界定义域上用采样生成加 SOS 验证得到的域相关二次刻画，是通用 sector/slope 描述的可行替代，可直接接入 QC-based SDP 做神经网络可达性与安全性分析。

papers.title: From SGD to Muon: Adaptive Optimization via Schatten-p Norms
papers.abstract_en: Modern optimizers, like Muon, impose matrix-wise geometry constraints on their updates. These matrix-wise constraints can be unified under Linear Minimization Oracle (LMO) theory. However, all current methods impose fixed LMO geometries for the update rules, chosen by-design or empirically, which are not necessarily optimal according to the problem's geometry. We introduce a novel efficient datadriven criterion for dynamically choosing proxy-optimal update LMO geometries on individual Deep Neural Network layers. Derived in closed form from gradient and activation statistics using a single-step random feature regression surrogate model, our criterion navigates a design space interpolating from SGD to Muon updates. Moreover, integrating parameter-wise preconditioning allows our framework to recover SGD, Muon, Adam, and MuAdam as specific extrema. To make this adaptive approach scalable, we pair it with efficient computational strategies, achieving only a $\sim$ 3% runtime overhead on highly optimized baselines. As a proof of concept, we show that this data-driven optimizer beats or remains competitive with the performance of the best performing optimizer between Muon and AdamW across three different training scenarios. Ultimately, this work provides evidence that LMO geometry can be successfully and efficiently adapted from runtime data, opening a new pathway for optimizer design beyond static geometries.
papers.journal_ref: Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems, Dec 2026, Sydney, Australia
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出由梯度与激活统计闭式导出的数据驱动准则，在单个 DNN 层上动态选择 Linear Minimization Oracle (LMO) 几何，把更新规则放在 SGD 到 Muon 的设计空间上插值；配合参数级预条件可把 SGD、Muon、Adam、MuAdam 恢复为特例。运行时开销仅约 3%，在三种训练场景中打平或超过 Muon 与 AdamW 中较优者。
Motivation: Muon 等现代优化器用矩阵级几何约束更新，但现有方法的 LMO 几何是设计期或经验固定的，未必匹配问题本身的几何。
Method: 用单步随机特征回归代理模型 (single-step random feature regression surrogate)，从梯度与激活统计闭式推导出逐层选择 proxy-optimal LMO 几何的准则；再叠加参数级预条件，使框架覆盖 SGD 到 Muon 的插值空间并恢复 SGD、Muon、Adam、MuAdam 为极点，配以高效计算策略控制开销。
Result: 运行时开销相对高度优化基线仅约 3%；作为概念验证，在三种不同训练场景中，该数据驱动优化器打平或超过 Muon 与 AdamW 中表现最好的那一个。
Conclusion: LMO 几何可以从运行时数据被成功且高效地自适应，优化器设计可走出静态几何的路径。

papers.title: Cross-View Attention Fusion Net: A Prior-Guided Dual-View Representation Learning for Cardiac Output Estimation from Short-Term PPG Signals
papers.abstract_en: Accurate cardiac output (CO) estimation from photoplethysmography (PPG) is promising for unobtrusive hemodynamic monitoring, but remains difficult since CO is jointly determined by cardiac function and vascular tone. Conventional feature-based models use physiologically meaningful PPG descriptors, yet depend on accurate pulse detection and may miss latent temporal relationships. In contrast, fully end-to-end deep learning models learn directly from raw PPG but often underuse established PPG-derived prior information. Here, we introduce the Cross-View Attention Fusion Network (CVAF-Net), a prior-guided dual-view deep learning model for CO estimation from short, fixed-length PPG segments. CVAF-Net processes raw PPG as a temporal view and a feature sequence map (FSM) as a structured prior-guided view, and fuses the two representations through cross-view attention. The model was independently evaluated using 5-, 15-, and 30-s segments from three datasets: simulated pulse waves (3323 subjects), vasoconstriction provocation (79 subjects), and resting/cycling activities (10 subjects), and was compared with multiple machine learning and deep learning benchmarks. CVAF-Net outperformed most benchmark methods and achieved performance comparable to a state-of-the-art Transformer-based model, with a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.19 L/min (MAPE: 3.95%) on simulated data and high accuracy in real-world settings (minimum MAE: 1.20 L/min). Importantly, CVAF-Net reduced FLOPs by twelvefold compared with the leading Transformer-based model. Plausibility analysis showed physiologically consistent CO estimates, with expected correlations with age ($ρ= -0.274$), heart rate ($ρ= 0.894$), and systemic vascular resistance ($ρ= -0.740$). These findings indicate that CVAF-Net provides an accurate, computationally efficient, and generalizable approach for continuous wearable-based CO monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出先验引导的双视图网络 CVAF-Net，把原始 PPG 当时间视图、特征序列图 (FSM) 当结构化先验视图，用 cross-view attention 融合来从短时 PPG 段估计心输出量 (CO)。在模拟脉搏波、血管收缩激发与静息/骑行三个数据集上 MAE 最低 0.19 L/min（MAPE 3.95%），真实场景最低 MAE 1.20 L/min，同时 FLOPs 比领先的 Transformer 模型低约十二倍。
Motivation: CO 同时由心脏功能与血管张力决定：特征法依赖准确的脉搏检测且可能漏掉潜在时序关系，端到端模型又浪费了已有的 PPG 先验信息，短时可穿戴监测需要既准又省算力的估计途径。
Method: CVAF-Net 对 5、15、30 秒定长 PPG 段做双视图处理：原始 PPG 走时间视图，特征序列图 (FSM) 走结构化先验视图，两路表征经 cross-view attention 融合后输出 CO；在三个数据集上独立评测并与多个机器学习、深度学习基准比较。
Result: 模拟脉搏波数据 (3323 名受试者) 上 MAE 0.19 L/min、MAPE 3.95%；真实数据集（血管收缩激发 79 人、静息/骑行 10 人）最低 MAE 1.20 L/min；相对领先的 Transformer 模型 FLOPs 降低十二倍；生理一致性分析给出与年龄 ρ=-0.274、心率 ρ=0.894、系统血管阻力 ρ=-0.740 的相关。
Conclusion: CVAF-Net 在多数基准上更优、与最先进的 Transformer 模型相当，且计算量大幅更低，可作为连续可穿戴 CO 监测的准确、高效、可泛化方案。

papers.title: Sampling-Based Safe Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Safe exploration remains a fundamental challenge in reinforcement learning (RL), limiting the deployment of RL agents in the real world. We propose Sampling-Based Safe Reinforcement Learning (SBSRL), a model-based RL algorithm that maintains safety throughout the learning process by enforcing constraints jointly across a finite set of dynamics samples. This formulation approximates an intractable worst-case optimization over uncertain dynamics and enables practical safety guarantees in continuous domains. We further introduce an exploration strategy based on constraining epistemic uncertainty, eliminating the need for explicit exploration bonuses. Under regularity conditions, we derive high-probability guarantees of safety throughout learning and a finite-time sample complexity bound for recovering a near-optimal policy. Empirically, SBSRL achieves safe and efficient exploration both in simulation and in real robotic hardware, and readily extends to practical deep-ensemble implementations that scale to high-dimensional continuous control problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于采样的安全强化学习 SBSRL：在有限动力学样本集合上联合施加约束，以近似对不确定动力学的最坏情况优化，并用约束认知不确定性 (epistemic uncertainty) 取代显式探索奖励。在正则性条件下导出学习全程的高概率安全保证与近最优策略的有限时间样本复杂度界，并在仿真与真实机器人硬件上实现安全且高效的探索。
Motivation: 安全探索是 RL 落地真实世界的根本瓶颈：对不确定动力学的最坏情况约束优化不可解，显式探索奖励又难以保证全程安全。
Method: SBSRL 是基于模型的 RL 算法，在有限动力学样本集合上联合施加约束来近似最坏情况优化；探索策略通过约束认知不确定性实现，无需显式探索 bonus；可扩展为深度集成 (deep-ensemble) 实现，用于高维连续控制。
Result: 在正则性条件下给出学习全程的高概率安全保证，以及恢复近最优策略的有限时间样本复杂度界；在仿真与真实机器人硬件上均实现安全且高效的探索，并可扩展到高维连续控制问题。
Conclusion: 对有限动力学样本集合联合施加约束，是在连续域中把安全保证带进学习全过程并保持探索效率的可行路径。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Stochastic Compositional Optimization via Hybrid Momentum Frank--Wolfe
papers.abstract_en: Stochastic compositional optimization minimizes $F(f(x), x)$ over a compact convex set when the inner map $f$ is available only through noisy samples. We propose Hybrid Momentum Stochastic Frank--Wolfe, a projection-free method for outer functions $F$ that are jointly convex and Lipschitz but not necessarily differentiable, such as maxima, CVaR, and norms. The method tracks the Jacobian and the value of $f$ with momentum, using a Taylor correction for the value, and passes the tracked linearization to a generalized linear minimization oracle. Under finite-variance noise, it attains an expected generalized Frank--Wolfe gap of order $K^{-1/4}$ for non-convex objectives and, when the linearized models minorize the objective, a last-iterate primal error of order $K^{-1/3}$. The analysis extends to heavy-tailed noise without clipping, with separate moment orders for values and Jacobians. (2023) 的确定性方法。
Motivation: 随机复合优化中内层 f 只有噪声采样，而外层 F 常为 max、CVaR、范数这类非光滑凸泛函；带投影的方法在约束集复杂时不可行，且噪声下跟踪 Jacobian 与函数值容易失稳。
Method: 对 F(f(x),x)（F 联合凸且 Lipschitz、不必可微）设计无投影的 Frank--Wolfe 变体：用动量跟踪 f 的值与 Jacobian，值上施加 Taylor 修正，将跟踪得到的线性化送入广义线性最小化 oracle (generalized LMO)；分析覆盖有限方差与重尾噪声，对值与 Jacobian 分别指定矩阶。
Result: 有限方差噪声下，非凸目标的期望广义 Frank--Wolfe gap 为 K^{-1/4} 阶；当线性化模型 minorize 目标时，last-iterate primal error 为 K^{-1/3} 阶。重尾噪声无需剪切即可分析，值与 Jacobian 使用不同矩阶；精确 oracle 时方法退化为 Vladarean et al. (2023) 的确定性算法。

papers.title: Why Latent Actions Fail, and How to Prevent It
papers.abstract_en: Latent action models (LAMs) aim to learn action-like representations from unlabeled videos by compressing frame-to-frame changes. The frames of in-the-wild videos, however, contain not only the agent's own state but exogenous state such as background clutter. Since the exogenous state introduces changes unrelated to actions, it hinders reliable latent action learning. This paper investigates this problem analytically by extending a linear LAM framework to explicitly model exogenous state. Our analysis reveals two insights: (1) minimizing the standard reconstruction objective produces latent actions that encode exogenous information from future observation; and (2) learning in a representation space that focuses on endogenous components is a key to mitigating the interference of noise. We further show that previously proposed auxiliary objectives, such as action-supervision, provably encourage latent actions to be consistent across exogenous states. These findings are validated through experiments on both linear and nonlinear LAMs, providing a unified theoretical analysis of how exogenous state hinders latent action learning and why common remedies work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在无标注视频的潜动作模型 (LAM) 中，背景杂乱等外生状态 (exogenous state) 会混入帧间变化，使标准重建目标学出的潜动作编码未来观测里的外生信息。把线性 LAM 显式扩展到含外生状态的模型后可证明：只优化重建必然泄漏外生信息，而在只关注内生分量 (endogenous) 的表示空间中学习才能抑制干扰；action-supervision 等辅助目标可被证明促使潜动作跨外生状态保持一致。线性与非线性 LAM 实验验证了这一分析。
Motivation: 野外视频帧里除智能体自身状态外还含背景杂乱等外生状态，其变化与动作无关，导致潜动作学习不可靠；此前缺少对这一干扰机制的统一理论刻画。
Method: 把线性 LAM 框架显式扩展为建模外生状态的形式，对标准重建目标做解析分析，推导两个结论：重建最小化会使潜动作编码未来观测中的外生信息；在聚焦内生分量的表示空间中学习可缓解噪声干扰。并证明 action-supervision 等既有辅助目标能促使潜动作跨外生状态一致，再在线性与非线性 LAM 上做实验验证。
Result: 分析给出两条可证结论：标准重建目标产生的潜动作会编码来自未来观测的外生信息；在关注内生分量的表示空间中学习是抑制噪声干扰的关键。既有辅助目标（如 action-supervision）被证明可促使潜动作跨外生状态保持一致，且这些发在线性与非线性 LAM 上均通过实验得到验证。
Conclusion: 外生状态是潜动作学习失效的根因，而聚焦内生分量的表示与辅助目标之所以有效，是因为它们使潜动作对不同外生状态保持一致——这为常见补救手段给出了统一的理论解释。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Bayesian Nonparametric Mixed-Effect ODEs with Gaussian Processes
papers.abstract_en: Dynamical modelling in pharmacometrics, systems biology, and epidemiology often involves subjects with related but distinct dynamics, observed through temporally sparse and irregular measurements. Classical nonlinear mixed-effects ODE models represent this heterogeneity but rely on parametric vector fields, making them vulnerable to structural misspecification. Existing nonparametric ODE methods typically assume shared dynamics rather than an explicit mixed-effect hierarchy. We propose MEGPODE, a Bayesian nonparametric mixed-effect ODE model that decomposes each subject's vector field into a shared population component and a subject-specific deviation, both endowed with Gaussian process priors. To avoid repeated ODE solves during training, we represent latent trajectories with state-space GP priors and penalize discrepancies between their derivatives and the vector fields on a finite time grid. A single variational objective enables approximate joint inference over trajectories and vector fields, accounting for state uncertainty and dependence between population and subject-specific dynamics. Across heterogeneous oscillatory and biomedical ODE benchmarks, MEGPODE improves population-field recovery and subject-level trajectory prediction relative to strong baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MEGPODE：把每个个体的向量场分解为群体共享分量加个体偏移，两者都赋 Gaussian process 先验，用状态空间 GP 表示潜在轨迹并在有限时间网格上惩罚导数与向量场的偏差，从而避免训练中反复求解 ODE。在异质振荡与生物医学 ODE 基准上，MEGPODE 相对强基线改善了群体场恢复与个体级轨迹预测。
Motivation: 药理学、系统生物学与流行病学中个体动力学相关但不同、观测稀疏且不规则；经典非线性混合效应 ODE 依赖参数化向量场，易受结构误设影响，而现有非参数 ODE 方法通常假设共享动力学而非显式混合效应层级。
Method: MEGPODE 用 GP 先验分别刻画群体共享向量场与个体特异偏移；以状态空间 GP 先验表示潜在轨迹，在有限时间网格上惩罚轨迹导数与向量场的偏差以避免重复 ODE 求解；单一变分目标对轨迹与向量场做近似联合推断，纳入状态不确定性及群体与个体动力学间的依赖。
Result: 在异质振荡与生物医学 ODE 基准上，MEGPODE 相对强基线改善了群体场恢复与个体级轨迹预测（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 以 GP 分层分解向量场并配合变分联合推断，可在稀疏不规则观测下同时恢复群体动力学并预测个体轨迹，缓解参数化向量场的结构误设问题。

papers.title: When Simulation Lies: A Sim-to-Real Benchmark and Domain-Randomized RL Recipe for Tool-Use Agents
papers.abstract_en: Tool-use language agents are evaluated on benchmarks that assume clean inputs, unambiguous tool registries, and reliable APIs. Real deployments violate all these assumptions: user typos propagate into hallucinated tool names, a misconfigured request timeout can stall an agent indefinitely, and duplicate tool names across servers can freeze an SDK. We study these failures as a sim-to-real gap in the tool-use partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP), where deployment noise enters through the observation, action space, reward-relevant metadata, or transition dynamics. We introduce RobustBench-TC, a benchmark with 22 perturbation types organized by these four POMDP components, each grounded in a verified GitHub issue or documented tool-calling failure. Across 21 models from 1.5B to 32B parameters (including the closed-source o4-mini), the robustness profile is sharply uneven: observation perturbations reduce accuracy by less than 5%, while reward-relevant and transition perturbations reduce accuracy by roughly 40% and 30%, respectively; scale alone does not close these gaps. We then propose ToolRL-DR, a domain-randomization reinforcement learning (RL) recipe that trains a tool-use agent on perturbation-augmented trajectories spanning the three statically encodable POMDP components. On a 3B backbone, ToolRL-DR-Full retains roughly three-quarters of clean accuracy and reaches an aggregate perturbed accuracy comparable to open-source 14B function-calling baselines while substantially narrowing the gap to o4-mini. It closes approximately 27% of the Transition gap despite never seeing transition perturbations in training, suggesting that RL on adversarial static tool-use inputs induces a more persistent retry policy that transfers to unseen runtime failures. The dataset, code and benchmark leaderboard are publicly available.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track). Added acknowledgments. Dataset, code, and benchmark leaderboard are available at https://github.com/WillChow66/robustbench-tc-release.git and https://huggingface.co/spaces/willchow66/robustbench-tc-leaderboard
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把工具调用智能体的部署噪声形式化为 tool-use POMDP 中的 sim-to-real gap，提出按四个 POMDP 分量组织、含 22 种扰动的基准 RobustBench-TC。21 个模型（1.5B–32B，含 o4-mini）上观测扰动使准确率下降不足 5%，而 reward-relevant 与 transition 扰动分别下降约 40% 和 30%，且参数规模无法弥合。提出的域随机化 RL 配方 ToolRL-DR 在 3B 骨干上保留约四分之三干净准确率，并在未见过 transition 扰动的情况下弥合约 27% 的 Transition gap。
Motivation: 现有工具调用基准假设干净输入、无歧义工具注册表与可靠 API，而真实部署中用户拼写错误、超时配置与重名工具会直接让智能体失败；这种部署噪声作为 sim-to-real gap 缺少系统化的评测与训练手段。
Method: RobustBench-TC 把部署噪声按观测、动作空间、reward 相关元数据、转移动力学四个 POMDP 分量组织成 22 种扰动，每种都对应一个已验证的 GitHub issue 或有记录的工具调用故障。ToolRL-DR 则在可静态编码的三个 POMDP 分量上，用扰动增强轨迹对工具调用智能体做强化学习训练。
Result: 在 21 个模型（1.5B 至 32B，含闭源 o4-mini）上，观测扰动使准确率下降不足 5%，reward 相关扰动与转移扰动分别下降约 40% 与约 30%，且单靠规模无法弥合。ToolRL-DR-Full 在 3B 骨干上保留约四分之三的干净准确率，聚合扰动准确率与开源 14B function-calling 基线相当，并明显拉近与 o4-mini 的差距；尽管训练中从未出现 transition 扰动，仍弥合约 27% 的 Transition gap。
Conclusion: 工具调用的鲁棒性短板集中在 reward 与 transition 扰动而非观测噪声，模型规模本身不解决问题；在对抗性静态工具输入上做 RL 会诱导更持久的重试策略，从而迁移到训练中未见的运行时故障。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: On the Approximation Complexity of Matrix Product Operator (MPO) Born Machines
papers.abstract_en: Matrix product operator Born machines (MPO-BMs) are tractable tensor-network models for probabilistic modeling, yet their approximation capabilities remain poorly understood in theory. In this paper, we characterize these capabilities from both negative and positive perspectives. As a negative result, we prove that constructing a polynomial-bond MPO-BM approximation to an arbitrary continuous target with bounded KL error is NP-hard. On the positive side, for score-based variational inference, we prove that targets satisfying a log-Sobolev inequality admit polynomial-bond MPO-BM approximations with provable KL guarantees when the loss-induced Hamiltonian is local and has a constant spectral gap. Furthermore, under the same conditions, we construct local importance-sampling estimators and prove that polynomially many local score queries suffice to preserve the KL guarantees.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 刻画 MPO Born machines 的逼近复杂度：对任意连续目标构造有界 KL 误差的多项式键维 (polynomial-bond) MPO-BM 近似是 NP-hard；反之，满足 log-Sobolev 不等式且损失诱导 Hamiltonian 局部、具常数谱隙的目标，可用多项式键维 MPO-BM 达到可证 KL 保证，且多项次局部 score 查询即可保持该保证。
Motivation: MPO-BM 是可 tractable 训练的概率张量网络模型，但其逼近能力在理论上缺乏刻画，既不知道何时能高效逼近，也不知道何时本质上困难。
Method: 从负面与正面两个方向给出理论结果：负面侧证明构造多项式键维 MPO-BM 逼近任意有界 KL 误差的连续目标是 NP-hard；正面侧针对基于 score 的变分推断 (score-based variational inference)，在目标满足 log-Sobolev 不等式、损失诱导 Hamiltonian 局部且有常数谱隙的条件下构造逼近，并设计局部重要性采样 (local importance-sampling) 估计器。
Result: 负面结果：构造有界 KL 误差的多项式键维 MPO-BM 近似任意连续目标是 NP-hard。正面结果：在 log-Sobolev 不等式 + 局部且常数谱隙 Hamiltonian 条件下，多项式键维 MPO-BM 近似具有可证 KL 保证；同条件下多项式数量的局部 score 查询足以保持该 KL 保证。
Conclusion: MPO-BM 的可逼近性由目标的 log-Sobolev 正则性与损失 Hamiltonian 的局部性/谱隙共同决定：一般情形下高效逼近是 NP-hard，而在这组条件下逼近与 score 查询代价都降到多项式。

papers.title: EchoDistill: Robust Large Audio Language Models via Noisy-to-Clean Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) remain vulnerable to acoustic noise, which can obscure task-relevant evidence and produce unreliable responses. We propose EchoDistill, a noisy-to-clean self-distillation framework that uses clean audio as privileged information during post-training. A noisy-input student samples candidate responses reflecting its inference-time behavior, while a frozen copy of the same backbone processes the corresponding clean audio. EchoDistill combines masked response-token distillation, task-gated consistency shaping, and teacher-referenced group-relative optimization to align noisy-input generation with clean-conditioned semantics. Only the student is retained at inference time, introducing no additional inference cost. Across three LALM backbones and three audio domains at -10dB, EchoDistill improves average noisy-input accuracy by 1.63 percentage points over the strongest baseline. On Qwen2.5-Omni, it raises noisy-input accuracy from 59.33% to 62.94%, while clean-audio accuracy increases from 76.56% to 77.56%. Replacing matched audio with random, shuffled, or silent inputs reduces accuracy by 3.08-6.42 points, confirming that matched acoustic evidence contributes to its predictions. Additional evaluations show improvements on held-out additive noises and external benchmarks, while revealing that these gains do not reliably extend to non-additive distortions. These results demonstrate robust post-training improvements under severe additive noise without sacrificing clean-audio capability across diverse tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EchoDistill 用干净音频作特权信息做 noisy-to-clean 自蒸馏后训练，让含噪输入的学生对齐冻结同骨干在干净音频上的语义，在 -10dB 严重加性噪声下把三个 LALM 骨干、三个音频域的平均含噪准确率较最强基线提高 1.63 个百分点，且不损失干净音频能力。
Motivation: 声学噪声会掩盖任务相关证据，使 Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) 给出不可靠回答；推理时又拿不到干净音频，需要在后训练阶段让模型在含噪输入下保持干净条件下的语义。
Method: EchoDistill 框架：含噪输入的学生采样候选响应以反映推理期行为，冻结的同骨干副本处理对应干净音频；三部分组合——masked response-token distillation、task-gated consistency shaping、teacher-referenced group-relative optimization，对齐含噪生成与干净条件语义；推理只保留学生，不增加推理开销。
Result: 在三个 LALM 骨干、三个音频域、-10dB 条件下，含噪输入平均准确率较最强基线提高 1.63 个百分点；Qwen2.5-Omni 上含噪准确率 59.33% → 62.94%，干净音频准确率 76.56% → 77.56%；把匹配音频换成随机、打乱或静音输入使准确率下降 3.08–6.42 点；在留出加性噪声与外部基准上也有提升，但对非加性失真不可靠外推。
Conclusion: 在严重加性噪声下，用干净音频作特权信息的自蒸馏能稳健提升含噪输入准确率且不牺牲干净音频能力，但增益不外推到非加性失真。

papers.title: Vision2Code: A Multi-Domain Benchmark for Evaluating Image-to-Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: We study whether vision-language models (VLMs) can reconstruct structured, graphics-based images by writing executable code to generate them. Existing benchmarks on image-to-code generation are generally limited in the domains they cover, rely on reference source code for evaluation, and do not provide metrics to quantify domain-specific issues. To address this, we introduce Vision2Code, a multi-domain, reference-code-free benchmark containing 539 test examples from 15 different datasets, spanning charts and plots, geometry, graphs, scientific diagrams, documents and 3D spatial scenes. Evaluation is done by executing the generated programs and comparing their rendered outputs to the source images using dataset- and domain-specific rubrics for a VLM judge. We find that the final scores obtained in this manner have substantially higher correlation with human ratings than those obtained via generic VLM rubrics or standard pixel-based, embedding-based or perceptual similarity metrics. We further demonstrate the reliability of our evaluation under repeated sampling from the VLM judges, varying rubric weights, and in the presence of controlled errors. Our results highlight the variability across domains of existing image-to-code generation models, with accuracy on charts and graphs being significantly higher than other domains. Lastly, we demonstrate the utility of our scoring method for rejection sampling of generated programs for fine-tuning, improving Qwen3.5-9B by 16% and Phi-4-MM by 28% compared to their base checkpoints. Our code and data are publicly available at https://image2code.github.io/vision2code/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Vision2Code：多领域、无需参考源码的 image-to-code 基准，共 539 个测试样本、来自 15 个数据集，覆盖图表、几何、图结构、科学示意图、文档与 3D 空间场景。评测方式是执行生成程序并把渲染结果与原图按领域专属 rubric 交由 VLM judge 打分，其分数与人工评分的相关性显著高于通用 rubric 及像素/嵌入/感知相似度指标；用该打分做拒绝采样微调，Qwen3.5-9B 提升 16%、Phi-4-MM 提升 28%。
Motivation: 现有 image-to-code 基准领域覆盖窄、依赖参考源码做评测，且缺少量化各领域特有问题的指标，难以横向比较 VLM 重建结构化图形图像的能力。
Method: 构建 539 例、15 个数据集的多领域基准；评测时执行模型生成的程序，将渲染输出与源图对比，用数据集与领域专属 rubric 让 VLM judge 打分；并检验重复采样、rubric 权重变化与受控错误下的评测可靠性，再用该分数做拒绝采样以筛选程序用于微调。
Result: 按领域 rubric 打分与人工评分的相关性显著高于通用 VLM rubric 及像素、嵌入、感知相似度指标；评测在 VLM judge 重复采样、rubric 权重变化与受控错误下保持可靠；不同领域差异明显，charts 与 graphs 上的准确率显著高于其他领域；拒绝采样微调使 Qwen3.5-9B 提升 16%、Phi-4-MM 提升 28%（相对各自 base checkpoint）。
Conclusion: 执行渲染加领域专属 rubric 的评测比通用或相似度指标更贴近人工判断，且可直接用于拒绝采样微调；现有 image-to-code 模型的能力在领域间高度不均衡，图表类明显强于其他领域。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: MemReread: Enhancing Agentic Long-Context Reasoning via Memory-Guided Rereading
papers.abstract_en: Long-context reasoning tasks have motivated agent-memory approaches that process document chunks sequentially while maintaining a dynamically updated memory, avoiding the quadratic complexity of standard attention. Existing methods often rely on retrieval to recover information discarded during memory overwriting, but remain vulnerable to evidence loss during memory formation and interference from invalid queries. To overcome these limitations, we propose MemReread. Built upon streaming reading, it circumvents intermediate retrieval, triggering question decomposition and targeted rereading when the final memory is insufficient. By recovering indirect evidence that may have been prematurely discarded, MemReread enables non-linear reasoning while preserving the logical flow of document comprehension. We further introduce a reinforcement learning framework that improves length extrapolation and adaptively determines the number of rereading passes according to task complexity, enabling flexible control of computational overhead. Our MemReread-4B outperforms strong baselines on long-context reasoning tasks (e.g., +1.6pp v.s. DeepSeek-V4-Pro on 2WikiMultiHopQA) while maintaining linear time complexity with respect to context length.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemReread 在流式阅读的 agent-memory 框架上取消中间检索，改为在最终记忆不足时触发问题分解与定向重读 (targeted rereading)，并用强化学习决定重读轮数以随任务复杂度调节开销。MemReread-4B 在长上下文推理任务上超过强基线，2WikiMultiHopQA 上比 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 高 1.6pp，同时保持对上下文长度的线性时间复杂度。
Motivation: 顺序处理文档块并动态覆写记忆的方法能避开标准注意力的二次复杂度，但记忆形成阶段会丢失证据，且无效查询带来的检索干扰会进一步损害长上下文推理。
Method: 以流式阅读 (streaming reading) 为基础，绕开中间检索；当最终记忆不足以回答时，先做问题分解再定向重读被过早丢弃的间接证据，形成非线性推理。另配一个强化学习框架，既改善长度外推 (length extrapolation)，又按任务复杂度自适应决定重读轮数，从而控制计算开销。
Result: MemReread-4B 在长上下文推理任务上优于强基线，例如 2WikiMultiHopQA 上比 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 高 1.6pp；相对上下文长度保持线性时间复杂度。
Conclusion: 在 agent-memory 中用按需重读替代中间检索，可以在保持线性复杂度的同时恢复被覆写丢弃的间接证据，提升长上下文推理。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: MAGE: Multi-Agent Self-Evolution with Co-Evolutionary Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving language-model agents must decide what to learn next and how to preserve what they have learned across iterations. Existing systems typically carry this cross-iteration knowledge as natural-language feedback, flat episodic memory, or implicit reinforcement signals, none of which cleanly supports a frozen weak backbone at inference time. This paper introduces MAGE (Multi-Agent Graph-guided Evolution), a framework that externalizes self-knowledge into a four-subgraph co-evolutionary knowledge graph. Its experience subgraph stores both teacher-written failure corrections and the learner's own past correct reasoning traces, which are retrieved as task-conditioned guidance for a frozen execution model. During evolution, the graph, a task-level search bandit, and a skill-level routing bandit are updated from the same reward stream, while the learner's backbone remains unchanged. We further provide structural analysis showing how append-only memory growth, bounded curriculum coverage, and task-filtered retrieval together support stable improvement of the retrieval substrate for frozen-learner evolution. Across nine benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning, multi-hop and open-domain question answering, spatio-temporal analysis, financial numerical reasoning, medical multiple-choice, an open-world survival game, and web navigation, MAGE achieves strong performance against prompt-based frozen-backbone baselines. Ablations show that self-harvested success traces and teacher-written corrections are complementary, with success memories contributing most on reasoning-template-heavy tasks and corrective memories supporting harder composition and interaction settings. Code is available in https://github.com/RuiyiYang01/mage-alg
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MAGE 把自进化 agent 的跨迭代知识外化为四子图协同演化知识图谱，经验子图同时存教师写的失败纠正与学习者自己过去的正确推理轨迹，按任务检索后作为冻结执行模型的引导。图、任务级搜索 bandit 与技能级路由 bandit 从同一条 reward 流同步更新，学习者 backbone 全程不变；在九个涵盖数学推理、多跳与开放域 QA、时空分析、金融数值推理、医学多选、开放世界生存游戏与网页导航的基准上，相对 prompt 式冻结骨干基线取得强表现。
Motivation: 自进化 LM agent 的跨迭代知识目前多以自然语言反馈、扁平 episodic memory 或隐式强化信号承载，都无法在推理时支撑一个完全冻结的弱 backbone。
Method: 提出 MAGE (Multi-Agent Graph-guided Evolution)：四子图协同演化知识图谱，经验子图存教师失败纠正与学习者正确轨迹，检索为任务条件化引导喂给冻结执行模型；演化中图、任务级搜索 bandit、技能级路由 bandit 共用同一 reward 流更新，backbone 不动。另给出结构性分析，说明 append-only 记忆增长、有界课程覆盖与任务过滤检索共同支撑检索基底的稳定改进。
Result: 在九个基准（数学推理、多跳与开放域 QA、时空分析、金融数值推理、医学多选、开放世界生存游戏、网页导航）上相对 prompt-based 冻结骨干基线取得强表现。消融显示自收获成功轨迹与教师纠正互补：成功记忆在推理模板密集任务上贡献最大，纠正记忆支撑更难的组合与交互设置。
Conclusion: 把自知识外化为结构化图谱并让图与两个 bandit 共用 reward 流，可在 backbone 完全冻结的条件下持续改进；成功轨迹与纠正记忆不可互相替代，应按任务类型搭配。
Relevance: 34

summary_sections.method: 提出 MAGE (Multi-Agent Graph-guided Evolution)：四子图协同演化知识图谱，经验子图存教师失败纠正与学习者正确轨迹，检索为任务条件化引导喂给冻结执行模型；演化中图、任务级搜索 bandit、技能级路由 bandit 共用同一 reward 流更新，backbone 不动。另给出结构性分析，说明 append-only 记忆增长、有界课程覆盖与任务过滤检索共同支撑检索基底的稳定改进。
summary_sections.result: 在九个基准（数学推理、多跳与开放域 QA、时空分析、金融数值推理、医学多选、开放世界生存游戏、网页导航）上相对 prompt-based 冻结骨干基线取得强表现。消融显示自收获成功轨迹与教师纠正互补：成功记忆在推理模板密集任务上贡献最大，纠正记忆支撑更难的组合与交互设置。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把自知识外化为结构化图谱并让图与两个 bandit 共用 reward 流，可在 backbone 完全冻结的条件下持续改进；成功轨迹与纠正记忆不可互相替代，应按任务类型搭配。

papers.title: Model Capacity Determines Grokking through Competing Memorisation and Generalisation Speeds
papers.abstract_en: Existing accounts of grokking explain the phenomena in terms of mechanistic frameworks such as circuit efficiency or lazy-to-rich transitions. However, despite a known dependence between grokking and model size, how model capacity shapes grokking remains an open question. We give an information-theoretic account of this relationship on the task of modular arithmetic, showing that grokking does not immediately occur when a model becomes large enough to memorise the training set, but rather emerges as the outcome of a competition between two measurable timescales: a memorisation speed $T_{\text{mem}}(P)$ and a generalisation speed $T_{\text{gen}}(P)$, both of which are functions of model parameter count $P$. Adapting the information capacity framework of Morris et al. (2025), we estimate $T_{\text{mem}}(P)$ on random-label data of equivalent complexity and $T_{\text{gen}}(P)$ on the modular task itself, and show that grokking emerges close to the parameter scale where these timescales intersect. The framework also suggests an empirical model for predicting memorisation speed given model capacity and dataset complexity, recovering the previously reported empirical observation that larger models memorise faster. Overall, we motivate the formalisation of different learning timescales as important abstractions to study when explaining how model capacity shapes grokking on algorithmic tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在模运算任务上，grokking 不是模型大到能记住训练集就立刻出现，而是记忆速度 T_mem(P) 与泛化速度 T_gen(P) 两条随参数量 P 变化的时间尺度竞争的结果；当参数规模接近两者交点时 grokking 才涌现。
Motivation: grokking 与模型规模的依赖关系已知，但模型容量如何塑造 grokking 仍缺乏解释，现有机制性框架（电路效率、lazy-to-rich 转变）未给出容量这一维度的定量说明。
Method: 借鉴 Morris et al. (2025) 的信息容量框架，在模运算任务上分别估计两条时间尺度：在等复杂度的随机标签数据上估计 T_mem(P)，在模运算任务本身估计 T_gen(P)，并据此给出由模型容量与数据集复杂度预测记忆速度的经验模型。
Result: grokking 出现在 T_mem(P) 与 T_gen(P) 交点附近的参数尺度；经验模型复现了此前报告的“更大模型记忆更快”这一观察。
Conclusion: 把不同学习时间尺度形式化为抽象量，是解释模型容量如何塑造算法任务上 grokking 的关键路径。

papers.title: UxSID: Semantic-Aware User Interests Modeling for Ultra-Long Sequence
papers.abstract_en: Modeling ultra-long user sequences involves a difficult trade-off between efficiency and effectiveness. While current paradigms rely on either item-specific search or item-agnostic compression, we propose UxSID, a framework exploring a third path: semantic-group shared interest memory. By utilizing Semantic IDs (SIDs) and a dual-level attention strategy, UxSID captures target-aware preferences without the heavy cost of item-specific models. This end-to-end architecture balances computational parsimony with semantic awareness, achieving state-of-the-art performance and a 0.337% revenue lift in large-scale advertising A/B test.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UxSID 用语义组共享兴趣记忆 (semantic-group shared interest memory) 替代逐 item 搜索或无差别压缩：以 Semantic ID (SID) 加双层注意力在超长用户序列上捕捉 target-aware 偏好，端到端训练兼顾算力与语义。在大规模广告 A/B 测试中取得 0.337% 的收入提升。
Motivation: 超长用户行为序列建模要在效率与效果之间取舍：现有范式要么做 item-specific 搜索、开销大，要么 item-agnostic 压缩、丢掉与目标相关的偏好信息。
Method: 提出 UxSID 框架，核心是语义组共享兴趣记忆：用 Semantic ID (SID) 对 item 做语义分组，配合双层注意力策略 (dual-level attention) 捕捉 target-aware 偏好，整体为端到端架构，避免 item-specific 模型的高昂开销。
Result: 达到 state-of-the-art 性能，并在大规模广告 A/B 测试中带来 0.337% 的收入提升 (revenue lift)。
Conclusion: 语义组共享记忆这条第三条路线可以在压缩超长序列的同时保留目标相关偏好，兼顾计算开销与语义感知，并在真实广告流量上转化为收入增益。

papers.title: Convex Optimization of Spiking Neural Networks with Global and Approximation Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) have been proposed as energy-efficient alternatives to deep neural networks. Their training is non-convex and involves a non-differentiable spike function, so existing methods offer no guarantee of reaching a global optimum. We address this issue by formulating SNN optimization as an equivalent convex optimization problem. Specifically, we show that the weight-decay-regularized training problem for a class of threshold RNNs, including leaky integrate-and-fire SNNs, has zero duality gap and the same optimal value as a convex program. Since the resulting convex programs can have exponentially many variables in the amount of data, we introduce a practical randomized surrogate and establish a high-probability guarantee on its approximation quality. Empirically, the best convex variant outperforms surrogate-gradient training on addition and first-last-XOR, matches its performance on sequential MNIST, and trails a reservoir baseline on base-3 and base-5 addition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把带权重衰减正则的阈值 RNN（含 leaky integrate-and-fire SNN）训练问题证明为与凸规划等价、对偶间隙为零，从而给出全局最优保证；因原凸规划变量数随数据量指数增长，作者提出随机化代理并证明其近似质量的高概率界。在 addition 与 first-last-XOR 上最优凸变体优于 surrogate-gradient 训练，sequential MNIST 上持平，base-3/base-5 addition 上落后于 reservoir 基线。
Motivation: SNN 训练是非凸且含不可微脉冲函数，现有方法无法保证到达全局最优，因此需要把该训练问题改写为可求解的凸形式。
Method: 将阈值 RNN 的权重衰正则训练问题表述为等价凸优化，证明其零对偶间隙且最优值与凸规划一致；针对变量数随数据量指数增长的问题，引入随机化代理 (randomized surrogate) 并建立近似质量的高概率保证。
Result: 最优凸变体在 addition 和 first-last-XOR 上超过 surrogate-gradient 训练，在 sequential MNIST 上与其持平，在 base-3 与 base-5 addition 上落后于 reservoir 基线。
Conclusion: 对这一类阈值 RNN（含 LIF SNN），带权重衰减的训练可获得全局最优保证，且在若干序列任务上实用的凸变体已能匹配或超过 surrogate-gradient 训练，但在更高进制加法上仍不及 reservoir。

papers.title: Can Agents Price a Reaction? Evaluating LLMs on Chemical Cost Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become increasingly capable as tool-using agents, with benchmarks spanning diverse general agentic tasks. Yet rigorous evaluation of scientific tool use remains limited. In chemistry, recent agents can plan syntheses and invoke domain-specific tools, but evaluations often rely on curated demonstrations, expert assessment, or LLM-as-judge scoring rather than exact, judge-free ground truth. We address this gap with chemical procurement cost estimation, a practical task in which an agent must ground chemical identities, retrieve supplier quotes, select valid purchasable packs, normalize quantities, and compute cost from a reaction description. We introduce ChemCost, a benchmark of 1,427 evaluable reactions grounded to a frozen pricing snapshot covering 2,261 chemicals and 230,775 supplier quotes, supporting scalar scoring and stage-level diagnosis of grounding, retrieval, procurement, and arithmetic failures. To evaluate robustness, we further construct controlled noise-injected views that perturb chemical aliases, quantity expressions, missing fields, and input formatting. Experiments with frontier, open-weight, and chemistry-specialized LLM agents show that tool access is necessary but insufficient for solving the task. The strongest agents reach only 50.6% accuracy within 25% relative error on clean inputs and degrade substantially with realistic noise. Stage-level analysis further shows that failures arise from brittle parsing, ineffective evidence integration, invalid pack selection, and non-convergent tool use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出化学采购成本估计基准 ChemCost：1,427 条可评测反应绑定冻结价格快照（2,261 种化学品、230,775 条供应商报价），要求 agent 从反应式出发完成化学物质识别、报价检索、可购包装选择、数量归一化与成本计算，并按 grounding、retrieval、procurement、arithmetic 四阶段给分。最强的前沿/开源/化学专用 LLM agent 在干净输入上仅 50.6% 的准确率（相对误差 25% 以内），加入别名、数量表达、缺失字段与格式扰动的噪声后性能明显下降。
Motivation: 化学工具使用类 agent 的评测多依赖精选示例、专家评分或 LLM-as-judge，缺少免裁判的精确 ground truth；采购成本估计恰好能提供可自动判分的客观答案。
Method: 构建 ChemCost 基准：1,427 条反应绑定冻结价格快照（2,261 种化学品、230,775 条供应商报价），支持标量打分与四阶段（grounding、retrieval、procurement、arithmetic）失败诊断；另构造受控噪声视图，扰动化学别名、数量表达式、缺失字段与输入格式，用于检验鲁棒性。
Result: 在干净输入上最强 agent 仅达到 50.6% 的准确率（相对误差 25% 以内），加噪后性能大幅退化；阶段级分析显示失败来自脆弱解析、证据整合无效、包装选择非法以及工具调用不收敛。
Conclusion: 对化学采购成本任务，接入工具是必要但不充分的：前沿、开源与化学专用 LLM agent 都无法稳定完成从反应式到可核验成本的全链条推理，瓶颈在解析、证据整合与工具使用收敛性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LensVLM: Selective Context Expansion for Compressed Visual Representation of Text
papers.abstract_en: Vision Language Models (VLMs) offer the exciting possibility of processing text as rendered images, bypassing the need for tokenizing the text into long token sequences. Since VLM image encoders map fixed-size images to a fixed number of visual tokens, varying rendering resolution provides a fine-grained compression knob. However, accuracy deteriorates quickly as compression increases: characters shrink below the vision encoder's effective resolution, making them indistinguishable. To address this, we propose LensVLM, an inference framework and post-training recipe that enables VLMs to scan compressed images, then selectively expand only the relevant images to their uncompressed form via learned tools. Building on Qwen3.5-9B-Base, LensVLM maintains accuracy comparable to the full-text upper bound at 4.3$\times$ effective compression and outperforms retrieval-based, text- and visual-compression baselines up to 10.1$\times$ effective compression across seven text QA benchmarks. LensVLM also generalizes to multimodal document and code understanding tasks, with the accuracy gain over baselines growing as compression increases. Our analysis validates this approach: training makes visual compression robust to rendering choices, and as compression grows the model increasingly relies on expanded content rather than unreliable visual reading. The analysis also yields practical tool-choice guidance: text expansion is preferable for rendered text, while high-resolution image expansion suits native documents whose layout cues carry task-relevant information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LensVLM 是一个推理框架加后训练方案：让 VLM 先看压缩渲染的文本图像，再用学习到的工具只把相关部分展开回未压缩形式。基于 Qwen3.5-9B-Base，在 4.3× 有效压缩下保持与全文本上界相当的准确率，最高在 10.1× 有效压缩下仍优于检索式与文本/视觉压缩基线，覆盖七个文本 QA 基准。
Motivation: 把文本渲染成图像可绕开长 token 序列，但 VLM 图像编码器把固定尺寸图映射为固定数量视觉 token，压缩一高字符就低于视觉编码器有效分辨率而不可辨，准确率迅速下降。
Method: LensVLM 用可变渲染分辨率作为压缩旋钮，先让模型扫描压缩图像，再通过学习到的工具选择性地把相关图像展开为未压缩形式；包含推理框架与后训练配方，构建在 Qwen3.5-9B-Base 之上。
Result: 在七个文本 QA 基准上，4.3× 有效压缩时准确率与全文本上界相当，最高至 10.1× 有效压缩仍优于检索式、文本压缩与视觉压缩基线；在多模态文档与代码理解任务上同样泛化，且随压缩增大相对基线的准确率增益变大。分析显示训练使视觉压缩对渲染选择更鲁棒，压缩越高模型越依赖展开内容而非不可靠的视觉读取。
Conclusion: 选择性上下文展开能在高压缩比下保住 VLM 的文本理解准确率；工具选择上，渲染文本宜用文本展开，版面线索承载任务信息的原生文档宜用高分辨率图像展开。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: LensVLM 用可变渲染分辨率作为压缩旋钮，先让模型扫描压缩图像，再通过学习到的工具选择性地把相关图像展开为未压缩形式；包含推理框架与后训练配方，构建在 Qwen3.5-9B-Base 之上。
summary_sections.result: 在七个文本 QA 基准上，4.3× 有效压缩时准确率与全文本上界相当，最高至 10.1× 有效压缩仍优于检索式、文本压缩与视觉压缩基线；在多模态文档与代码理解任务上同样泛化，且随压缩增大相对基线的准确率增益变大。分析显示训练使视觉压缩对渲染选择更鲁棒，压缩越高模型越依赖展开内容而非不可靠的视觉读取。
summary_sections.conclusion: 选择性上下文展开能在高压缩比下保住 VLM 的文本理解准确率；工具选择上，渲染文本宜用文本展开，版面线索承载任务信息的原生文档宜用高分辨率图像展开。

papers.title: Playing the network backward: A Game Theoretic Attribution Framework
papers.abstract_en: Attribution methods explain which input features drive a model's prediction, making them central to model debugging and mechanistic interpretability. Yet backward attribution methods, including gradients, LRP, and transformer-specific rules, lack a shared framework in which to compare the underlying backward calculations. We introduce such a framework by recasting backward attribution as a two-player game on an extended network graph, building on Gaubert and Vlassopoulos' ReLU Net Game. Gradients and the full alpha-beta-LRP family arise as integrals over game trajectories under specific equilibria, so attribution maps become projections of trajectory distributions rather than the primary object. Desired explanation properties, such as localisation focus, robustness to input noise, or stable attention routing, can be specified as game-theoretic concepts, including policy regularization, risk aversion, and extended action sets, and translate directly into novel adaptations of the well-known backward rules. On ViT-B/16, one such selected adaptation of alpha-beta-LRP outperforms prior transformer-specific backward methods across all considered localisation metrics.
papers.comment: 79 pages (9 pages main text, 66 pages appendix). Code: https://github.com/JayPiZimmermann/Playing_The_Network_Backward_Official_Repository
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把反向归因（backward attribution）统一重写为扩展网络图上的两人博弈：梯度与完整 alpha-beta-LRP 家族都成为特定均衡下对博弈轨迹积分的结果，归因图只是轨迹分布的投影。由此可把局部性聚焦、对输入噪声的鲁棒性、注意力路由稳定性等解释性质直接写成博弈论概念（策略正则、风险厌恶、扩展动作集），并导出新的反向规则变体；在 ViT-B/16 上，其中一个 alpha-beta-LRP 改造在所考察的全部局部化指标上超过既有 transformer 专用反向方法。
Motivation: 梯度、LRP 与 transformer 专用规则各自为政，缺少一个能比较其反向计算过程的共同框架，解释性质（局部性、噪声鲁棒性、注意力稳定）也难以系统地施加到规则设计上。
Method: 在 Gaubert 与 Vlassopoulos 的 ReLU Net Game 基础上，把反向归因表述为扩展网络图上的两人博弈；证明梯度与 alpha-beta-LRP 全家族是特定均衡下对博弈轨迹的积分，使归因图成为轨迹分布的投影；再用策略正则、风险厌恶、扩展动作集等博弈论概念形式化解释性质，直接生成反向规则的新变体，并在 ViT-B/16 上检验。
Result: 在 ViT-B/16 上，所选的一个 alpha-beta-LRP 改造在全部所考察的局部化指标上优于此前的 transformer 专用反向方法。
Conclusion: 反向归因方法可以被一个博弈论框架统一覆盖，且解释性质作为博弈概念能直接转化为更强的归因规则。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Fairness-Guided DQN-Based TXOP Control for NR-U/Wi-Fi Coexistence
papers.abstract_en: New Radio operating in unlicensed spectrum (NR-U) and Wi-Fi employ different contention parameters and channel-occupancy durations, which can produce severe coexistence imbalance. This correspondence develops a fairness-guided deep Q-network (DQN) that adjusts the NR-U transmission opportunity (TXOP) using the observed per-node throughput ratio. Two reward designs, Q1 and Q2, expose complementary operating regimes. Q1 promotes strict per-node throughput balance, whereas Q2 admits a broader inter-radio-access-technology fairness region and rewards throughput improvement in an intermediate fairness band. The policies are compared with the default Third Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) listen-before-talk (LBT), an adapted multi-armed-bandit method, a utility-fairness-based tabular Q-learning comparator, and a default-referenced fixed-TXOP baseline. Experiments across four priority classes and asymmetric populations report aggregate throughput, user-level Jain fairness, and concave throughput utility over 20 independent trials. The results characterize the cost of strict fairness, efficiency recovery under moderate relaxation, and transfer from symmetric to asymmetric deployments.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Vehicular Technology
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 NR-U 与 Wi-Fi 因争用参数和信道占用时长不同导致的共存失衡，提出公平性引导的 DQN，用逐节点吞吐量比调节 NR-U 的 TXOP；Q1 追求严格逐节点吞吐均衡，Q2 在中等公平带内额外奖励吞吐提升。在四类优先级与非对称用户群、20 次独立试验中，结果刻画了严格公平的代价、适度放松后的效率恢复，以及从对称到非对称部署的迁移。
Motivation: NR-U 与 Wi-Fi 的争用参数和信道占用时长不同，共存时产生严重失衡；固定 TXOP 或默认 3GPP LBT 无法在公平与聚合吞吐之间自适应取舍。
Method: 构建 fairness-guided DQN，以观测到的逐节点吞吐量比作为状态输入来调节 NR-U 的 TXOP；设计两种奖励 Q1（严格逐节点吞吐均衡）与 Q2（放宽的跨 RAT 公平区间，中等公平带内奖励吞吐提升），并与默认 3GPP LBT、改造的 multi-armed-bandit 方法、utility-fairness 表格型 Q-learning 及默认参考的固定 TXOP 基线对比。
Result: 在四类优先级与非对称用户群上做 20 次独立试验，报告聚合吞吐、用户级 Jain 公平度与凹效用三项指标；结果刻画了严格公平的代价、适度放松公平约束后的效率恢复，以及策略从对称部署到非对称部署的迁移表现。
Conclusion: 严格逐节点公平要以吞吐为代价，而在中等公平带内放松约束并奖励吞吐提升可回收效率；TXOP 应按部署的对称性与公平目标自适应调节，而非固定。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Occam's Razor is Only as Sharp as Your ELBO
papers.abstract_en: The marginal likelihood, also known as the evidence, is regarded as a mathematical embodiment of Occam's razor, enabling hyperparameter selection that avoids overfitting. The evidence lower bound (ELBO) objective from variational inference has also been used for similar purposes. In this paper, we define a signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) for Bayesian linear regression in terms of key hyperparameters controlling signal and noise variance. We then study how ELBO-based hyperparameter learning can under or overestimate SNR depending on the assumed covariance matrix structure in a Gaussian approximate posterior. We prove that assuming a diagonal or low-rank plus diagonal covariance matrix underestimates the SNR, while a low-rank covariance matrix overestimates the SNR. Underestimating the SNR leads to higher than optimal mean squared error on the training set (underfitting), while overestimating SNR leads to lower error (overfitting). Bayesian practitioners hoping to scale to large models should be cautious about how covariance assumptions needed for tractability may impact model selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在贝叶斯线性回归中，ELBO 做超参数学习时对信噪比 (SNR) 的估计方向取决于近似后验协方差的结构：对角或低秩加对角会低估 SNR，纯低秩会高估。低估导致训练集 MSE 高于最优（欠拟合），高估导致误差更低（过拟合），因此可扩展性所需的协方差简化会系统性扭曲基于证据的模型选择。
Motivation: 边际似然（evidence）被视为 Occam's razor 的数学体现，ELBO 常被用作替代做超参数选择；但近似后验的协方差结构为可扩展性所做的简化，会如何扭曲 SNR 估计与由此得到的模型选择，此前缺少刻画。
Method: 在贝叶斯线性回归中，用控制信号方差与噪声方差的关键超参数定义信噪比 (SNR)；随后分析 ELBO 超参数学习在不同高斯近似后验协方差结构（对角、低秩加对角、低秩）下对 SNR 的估计偏差，并给出证明。
Result: 证明了对角或低秩加对角协方差低估 SNR，低秩协方差高估 SNR；低估 SNR 使训练集均方误差高于最优（欠拟合），高估 SNR 使误差更低（过拟合）。
Conclusion: ELBO 并不总能复现 evidence 的 Occam's razor 作用：其超参数结论的偏置方向由近似协方差结构决定，向大模型扩展时必须把这种可扩展性代价计入模型选择。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: Selective Depthwise Separable Convolution for Lightweight Joint Source-Channel Coding in Wireless Image Transmission
papers.abstract_en: Depthwise separable convolutional (DSConv) layers have been successfully applied to deep learning (DL)-based joint source-channel coding (JSCC) schemes to reduce computational complexity. However, a systematic investigation of the layerwise and ratio-wise replacement of standard convolutional (Conv) layers with DSConv layers in JSCC systems for wireless image transmission remains largely unexplored. In this letter, we propose a configurable lightweight JSCC framework that incorporates a selective replacement strategy, enabling flexible Conv-to-DSConv replacement at different replacement ratios and positions. By varying the replacement ratio, we obtain models with different computational complexities and analyze their impact on reconstruction performance. Furthermore, we investigate how replacements at different encoder and decoder depths influence reconstruction quality under a fixed replacement ratio. Our results show that Conv-to-DSConv replacement at the intermediate layers of the encoder and decoder achieves a favorable complexity-performance trade-off, revealing layer-wise redundancy in DL-based JSCC systems. Extensive experiments further demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves substantial parameter reduction with only slight performance degradation, enabling flexible complexity-performance trade-offs for resource-constrained edge devices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可配置的轻量 JSCC 框架，按替换比例与位置选择性地把标准卷积换成 depthwise separable convolution (DSConv)。结果显示在编码器与解码器的中间层做 Conv-to-DSConv 替换能取得较好的复杂度-性能折中，揭示 DL-based JSCC 存在层间冗余，可在大幅减参数的同时仅轻微损失重建质量。
Motivation: DSConv 已用于降低 DL-based JSCC 的计算复杂度，但 JSCC 系统中按层、按比例系统性替换 Conv 为 DSConv 的做法基本未被探索，资源受限边缘设备缺少可调的复杂度-性能折中手段。
Method: 提出可配置轻量 JSCC 框架，支持在不同替换比例与不同位置（编码器/解码器各深度）灵活做 Conv-to-DSConv 替换；通过改变替换比例得到不同计算复杂度的模型并分析其对重建性能的影响，同时在固定替换比例下考察不同深度替换对重建质量的作用。
Result: 在编码器与解码器中间层替换取得有利的复杂度-性能折中；框架实现大幅参数削减而仅有轻微性能下降，为资源受限边缘设备提供可调的复杂度-性能折中。
Conclusion: DL-based JSCC 的卷积层存在层间冗余，中间层是替换 DSConv 的最佳位置，可按需调节复杂度与重建质量的折中。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Physics-guided surrogate learning enables zero-shot control of turbulent wings
papers.abstract_en: Turbulent boundary layers over aerodynamic surfaces are a major source of aircraft drag, yet their control remains challenging due to multiscale dynamics and spatial variability, particularly under adverse pressure gradients. Reinforcement learning has outperformed state-of-the-art strategies in canonical flows, but its application to realistic geometries is limited by computational cost and transferability. Here we show that these limitations can be overcome by exploiting local structures of wall-bounded turbulence. Policies are trained in turbulent channel flows matched to wing boundary-layer statistics and deployed directly onto a NACA4412 wing section at $Re_c=2\times10^5$ without additional training on the wing, constituting zero-shot deployment. The transferred policies reduce total drag by 11.1\%, while state-of-the-art opposition control reduces it by 8.9\%. With the actuation cost taken into account, the corresponding net-energy savings are 10.9\% and 8.8\%, respectively. Surrogate training provides an estimated improvement of four orders of magnitude in exploration efficiency over direct on-wing training, enabling scalable flow control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用物理引导的代理模型 (physics-guided surrogate) 在湍流槽道中训练强化学习减阻策略，再零样本 (zero-shot) 部署到 NACA4412 翼型上，无需在机翼上重训。总阻力下降 11.1%，优于 SOTA opposition control 的 8.9%；计入执行能耗后净节能 10.9% 对 8.8%，代理训练使探索效率比直接在翼上训练提高约四个数量级。
Motivation: 强化学习在典型槽道/平板流动中减阻已超过 SOTA 策略，但真实翼型几何上受限于计算成本与可迁移性：多尺度动力学和逆压梯度下的空间变化使直接在翼上训练不可行。
Method: 利用壁湍流局部结构，把策略训练环境设为与机翼边界层统计量匹配的湍流槽道流，用物理引导的代理模型 (surrogate) 替代直接在翼上探索；训练好的策略直接部署到 Re_c=2×10^5 的 NACA4412 翼段，与 opposition control 对比总阻力与计入执行能耗的净节能。

papers.title: Component-Adaptive and Lesion-Level Supervision for Improved Small Structure Segmentation in Brain MRI
papers.abstract_en: Small lesions in brain MRI are hard to segment because they occupy a tiny fraction of the volume and are dominated by background and larger lesions during voxel-wise optimization, so a model can reach a high Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) while missing many of them. We propose CATMIL, a training objective that adds two auxiliary terms to the standard nnU-Net Dice and cross-entropy loss without changing the architecture. The Component-Adaptive Tversky (CAT) term weights lesion voxels by the inverse size of their connected component, so each lesion contributes nearly equally regardless of volume. The lesion-level Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) term treats each lesion as a bag of voxels and penalizes lesions with no detected voxel. For multiple sclerosis lesion segmentation on MSLesSeg, CATMIL achieves the highest small-lesion recall (0.873 vs. 0.796 for Dice+CE; 95% CI of the difference +0.030 to +0.157, higher in all six test patients) and about 48% fewer missed lesions, with comparable DSC and HD95. The gain holds for lesions of at least 3 mm in diameter, the clinical reading size (recall 0.944 vs. 0.870). Standard losses produce no probability response to most small lesions they miss, so no threshold can recover them. The cost is more small false-positive components; a simple component-size filter removes most of them while keeping the sensitivity gain, and at matched lesion-wise precision CATMIL detects more small lesions with higher lesion-wise F1. An ablation attributes the detection gain to the MIL term. On a second dataset, 3D-MR-MS, CATMIL with the same loss weights again improves small-lesion recall, at a larger false-positive cost and slightly lower DSC. Code: https://github.com/luumsk/SmallLesionMRI
papers.comment: v04: This version added evaluation on a second dataset (3D-MR-MS) and a held-out test set; added statistical significance tests and error analysis; added new references; corrected the optimizer description; update figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CATMIL 训练目标：在 nnU-Net 的 Dice+CE 损失上加两个辅助项，按连通域大小倒数加权病灶体素（Component-Adaptive Tversky），并把每个病灶当作体素包用 MIL 惩罚完全漏检的病灶，从而在不改架构的前提下提升脑 MRI 小病灶召回。在 MSLesSeg 多发性硬化病灶分割上，小病灶召回 0.873 vs Dice+CE 的 0.796（95% CI +0.030 至 +0.157，六名测试患者全部更高），漏检病灶约减少 48%，≥3 mm 临床可读尺寸病灶召回 0.944 vs 0.870，DSC 与 HD95 相当。代价是小假阳性连通域增多，用简单的连通域尺寸过滤即可去除大部分并保留灵敏度增益。
Motivation: 小病灶体积极小，在逐体素优化中被背景和大病灶主导，模型可以拿到很高的 DSC 却漏掉大量小病灶；标准损失对漏检的小病灶几乎不产生概率响应，事后调阈值也救不回来。
Method: CATMIL 在 nnU-Net 标准 Dice+CE 损失上追加两个辅助项，不改架构：Component-Adaptive Tversky (CAT) 项按连通域体积倒数给病灶体素加权，使每个病灶贡献近似相等；病灶级 Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) 项把每个病灶视为体素包，惩罚没有任何体素被检出的病灶。消融把检出增益归因于 MIL 项。
Result: MSLesSeg 上小病灶召回 0.873 vs Dice+CE 0.796，差值 95% CI +0.030 至 +0.157，六名测试患者全部更高，漏检病灶约少 48%，DSC 与 HD95 相当；≥3 mm 病灶召回 0.944 vs 0.870。在匹配病灶级精度下 CATMIL 检出更多小病灶且病灶级 F1 更高。第二个数据集 3D-MR-MS 上同样权重再次提升小病灶召回，但假阳性代价更大、DSC 略降。
Conclusion: 小病灶漏检是损失函数问题而非架构问题：按连通域大小均衡加权并加病灶级 MIL 惩罚即可恢复概率响应，代价是小假阳性增多，需配连通域尺寸过滤；该增益在 3D-MR-MS 上以更大假阳性和略低 DSC 为条件复现。

papers.title: AnomalyAgent: Agentic Industrial Anomaly Synthesis via Tool-Augmented Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Industrial anomaly generation is a crucial method for alleviating the data scarcity problem in anomaly detection tasks. Most existing anomaly synthesis methods rely on single-step generation mechanisms, lacking complex reasoning and iterative optimization capabilities, making it difficult to generate anomaly samples with high semantic realism. We propose AnomalyAgent, an anomaly synthesis agent with self-reflection, knowledge retrieval, and iterative refinement capabilities, aiming to generate realistic and diverse anomalies. Specifically, AnomalyAgent is equipped with five tools: Prompt Generation (PG), Image Generation (IG), Quality Evaluation (QE), Knowledge Retrieval (KR), and Mask Generation (MG), enabling closed-loop optimization. To improve decision-making and self-reflection, we construct structured trajectories from real anomaly images and design a two-stage training framework: supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. This process is driven by a three-part reward mechanism: (1) task rewards to supervise the quality and location rationality of generated anomalies; (2) reflection rewards to train the model's ability to improve anomaly synthesis prompt; (3) behavioral rewards to ensure adherence to the trajectory. On the MVTec-AD dataset, AnomalyAgent achieves IS/IC-L of 2.10/0.33 for anomaly generation, 57.0% classification accuracy using ResNet34, and 99.3%/74.2% AP at the image/pixel level using a simple UNet, surpassing all zero-shot SOTA methods. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/sssjmmm/AnomalyAgent.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 10 figures. Accepted at the ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AnomalyAgent 是一个带自反思、知识检索与迭代优化的工业异常合成智能体，配备 PG、IG、QE、KR、MG 五个工具形成闭环，并用 SFT 加强化学习的两阶段框架与三部分奖励（任务、反思、行为）训练。在 MVTec-AD 上异常生成 IS/IC-L 为 2.10/0.33，用 ResNet34 分类准确率 57.0%，简单 UNet 上图像级/像素级 AP 达 99.3%/74.2%，超过全部零样本 SOTA 方法。
Motivation: 现有异常合成方法多为单步生成，缺少复杂推理与迭代优化，难以产出语义真实度高的异常样本，而异常检测任务本身受数据稀缺制约。
Method: 智能体装备五个工具：Prompt Generation、Image Generation、Quality Evaluation、Knowledge Retrieval、Mask Generation，实现闭环优化；从真实异常图像构造结构化轨迹，采用两阶段训练（监督微调 SFT 后接强化学习），奖励由三部分组成：监督生成异常质量与位置合理性的任务奖励、训练改写合成 prompt 能力的反思奖励、保证轨迹遵循的行为奖励。
Result: 在 MVTec-AD 数据集上，异常生成 IS/IC-L 为 2.10/0.33；用 ResNet34 做分类准确率 57.0%；用简单 UNet 得到图像级与像素级 AP 分别为 99.3% 和 74.2%，超过所有零样本 SOTA 方法。
Conclusion: 把异常合成做成带工具调用与自反思的闭环智能体，并用结构化轨迹加三部分奖励做两阶段训练，能在 MVTec-AD 上生成既真实又多样的异常并提升下游检测指标。

papers.title: Koopman-Based Nonlinear Identification and Model Predictive Control of a Turbofan Engine
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates Koopman operator-based approaches for multivariable control of a two-spool turbofan engine. A physics-based component-level model is developed to generate training data and validate the controllers. A meta-heuristic extended dynamic mode decomposition is adapted, with a cost function designed to accurately capture both spool-speed dynamics and the engine pressure ratio (EPR), enabling the construction of a single Koopman model that can be reused across multiple control strategies. Using the identified time-varying Koopman model, an adaptive Koopman-based model predictive controller (AKMPC) with a disturbance observer is developed and compared with a Koopman-based feedback linearization controller (K-FBLC) and its integrator-augmented version (K-FBLC-I). The Koopman representation further enables nonlinear GTE output limiters, such as rotor-acceleration and turbine-inlet-temperature limits, to be expressed as linear constraints in the AKMPC. The controllers are evaluated for two control configurations of spool speeds and EPR, under both sea-level and varying flight conditions. The results demonstrate that the proposed identification approach enables accurate predictions of both spool speeds and EPR, allowing the Koopman model to be reused flexibly across different control formulations. While all strategies achieve comparable performance in sea-level conditions, the AKMPC demonstrates improved performance under varying flight conditions due to its ability to capture nonlinear dynamics, handle constraints, and compensate for model mismatch. Moreover, the EPR control strategy improves the thrust response. The study highlights the applicability of Koopman-based control and the advantages of the AKMPC framework for robust turbofan engine control.
papers.journal_ref: IET Control Theory & Applications 20, no. 1 (2026): e70169
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用元启发式扩展动态模态分解 (meta-heuristic EDMD) 从部件级涡扇模型数据辨识单一 Koopman 模型，同时拟合双转子转速与发动机压力比 (EPR)，再据此构造带扰动观测器的自适应 Koopman 模型预测控制器 (AKMPC)。在海平面条件下 AKMPC 与 K-FBLC、K-FBLC-I 表现相当，但在变化飞行条件下 AKMPC 因能处理非线性、约束与模型失配而表现更好；EPR 控制策略改善推力响应。
Motivation: 双转子涡扇发动机多变量控制中，转速与 EPR 动态非线性且随飞行条件变化，输出限值（转子加速度、涡轮进口温度）难以直接纳入常规控制器。
Method: 先建立部件级物理模型生成训练数据并验证控制器；用元启发式 EDMD，代价函数同时刻画转子转速动态与 EPR，得到可跨多种控制策略复用的单一 Koopman 模型；基于该时变模型构建 AKMPC 加扰动观测器，并把非线性输出限制器表达为线性约束，与 K-FBLC 及其积分增广版 K-FBLC-I 对比。
Result: 辨识方法能准确预测双转子转速与 EPR，Koopman 模型可灵活复用于不同控制表述；海平面条件下各策略性能相当，变化飞行条件下 AKMPC 性能更优；EPR 控制策略改善推力响应。评测覆盖两种控制配置（转速 + EPR）以及海平面与变化飞行条件。
Conclusion: Koopman 表示使非线性输出限制器化为线性约束，AKMPC 框架在变化飞行条件下对鲁棒涡扇发动机控制更具优势，且单一辨识模型可跨控制策略复用。

papers.title: MVNN: A Measure-Valued Neural Network for Learning McKean-Vlasov Dynamics from Particle Data
papers.abstract_en: Collective behaviors that emerge from interactions are fundamental to numerous biological systems. To learn such interacting forces from observations, we introduce a measure-valued neural network that infers measure-dependent interaction (drift) terms directly from particle-trajectory observations. The proposed architecture generalizes standard neural networks to operate on probability measures by learning cylindrical features, using an embedding network that produces scalable distribution-to-vector representations. On the theory side, we establish well-posedness of the resulting dynamics and prove propagation-of-chaos for the associated interacting-particle system. We further show universal approximation and quantitative approximation rates under a low-dimensional measure-dependence assumption. Numerical experiments on first and second order systems, including deterministic and stochastic Motsch-Tadmor dynamics, two-dimensional attraction-repulsion aggregation, Cucker-Smale dynamics, and a hierarchical multi-group system, demonstrate accurate prediction and strong out-of-distribution generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MVNN 用在概率测度上定义的 cylindrical 特征与 distribution-to-vector 嵌入网络，直接从粒子轨迹数据反推依赖于测度的相互作用 (drift) 项，学习 McKean-Vlasov 动力学。理论上证明了所得动力学的适定性、对应相互作用粒子系统的 propagation-of-chaos，以及在低维测度依赖假设下的万有逼近与定量逼近速率；在 Motsch-Tadmor、attraction-repulsion aggregation、Cucker-Smale 与分层多群体系统上给出准确预测和强 OOD 泛化。
Motivation: 从观测数据反推粒子间相互作用力是生物集体行为建模的核心难题：标准神经网络只吃固定维向量，无法表示依赖于整体分布的 drift 项。
Method: 提出 measure-valued neural network，把标准网络推广到概率测度上：学习 cylindrical 特征，并用 embedding 网络产生可扩展的 distribution-to-vector 表示，从而直接从粒子轨迹观测中推断 measure-dependent drift。
Result: 数值实验覆盖一阶与二阶系统，包括确定性与随机 Motsch-Tadmor dynamics、二维 attraction-repulsion aggregation、Cucker-Smale dynamics 及分层多群体系统，展示准确预测与强 out-of-distribution 泛化；理论侧给出适定性、propagation-of-chaos，以及低维测度依赖假设下的万有逼近与定量逼近速率。
Conclusion: 把网络作用对象从向量换成测度，可以在保留理论保证（适定性、propagation-of-chaos、逼近速率）的同时从粒子数据中学到可泛化的 McKean-Vlasov 相互作用。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: MotionRFT: Unified Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for Text-to-Motion Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-motion generation has advanced with diffusion- and flow-based generative models, yet supervised pre-training remains insufficient to align models with high-level objectives such as semantic consistency, realism, and human preference. Existing post-training methods have key limitations: they (1) target a specific motion representation, such as joints, (2) optimize a particular aspect, such as text-motion alignment, and may compromise other factors; and (3) incur substantial computational overhead, data dependence, and coarse-grained optimization. We present a reinforcement fine-tuning framework that comprises a heterogeneous-representation, multi-dimensional reward model, MotionReward, and an efficient, fine-grained fine-tuning method, EasyTune. To obtain a unified semantics representation, MotionReward maps heterogeneous motions into a shared semantic space anchored by text, enabling multi-dimensional reward learning; Self-refinement Preference Learning further enhances semantics without additional annotations. For efficient and effective fine-tuning, we identify the recursive gradient dependence across denoising steps as the key bottleneck, and propose EasyTune, which optimizes step-wise rather than over the full trajectory, yielding dense, fine-grained, and memory-efficient updates. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of our framework, achieving FID 0.132 at 22.10 GB peak memory for MLD model and saving up to 15.22 GB over DRaFT. It reduces FID by 22.9% on joint-based ACMDM, and achieves a 12.1% R-Precision gain and 21.7% FID improvement on rotation-based HY-Motion. Our project page with code is publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MotionRFT 提出统一的强化微调框架：异构表示多维奖励模型 MotionReward 把不同动作表示映射到以文本为锚的共享语义空间，EasyTune 识别去噪步间的递归梯度依赖这一瓶颈，改为逐步优化而非整条轨迹。在 MLD 上达到 FID 0.132、峰值显存 22.10 GB，比 DRaFT 最多省 15.22 GB；ACMDM（关节表示）FID 降 22.9%，HY-Motion（旋转表示）R-Precision 提升 12.1%、FID 改善 21.7%。
Motivation: 扩散/流模型的监督预训练难以对齐语义一致性、真实感与人类偏好等高层目标；现有后训练方法只针对单一动作表示（如关节）、只优化单一维度且可能损害其他因素，并伴随高计算开销、数据依赖与粗粒度优化。
Method: 框架含两部分：MotionReward 将异构动作映射到以文本为锚的共享语义空间以学习多维奖励，并用 Self-refinement Preference Learning 在无额外标注下增强语义；EasyTune 针对去噪步间的递归梯度依赖，逐步 (step-wise) 而非整条轨迹优化，产生稠密、细粒度且省显存的更新。
Result: MLD 模型上 FID 0.132、峰值显存 22.10 GB，较 DRaFT 最多节省 15.22 GB；关节表示的 ACMDM 上 FID 降低 22.9%；旋转表示的 HY-Motion 上 R-Precision 提升 12.1%、FID 改善 21.7%。
Conclusion: 把奖励统一到文本锚定的共享语义空间并按步做细粒度优化，可在多种动作表示上同时提升文本-动作对齐与生成质量，并显著降低微调显存开销。
