papers.title: Weight Clustering Reveals the Importance of Relative Rank in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) contain billions of parameters, but many exact weight values are not essential. We apply scalar $K$-means clustering to pretrained models, replacing each weight matrix with only 16--64 shared values. For Llama~3.1-8B-Instruct and SmolLM2-135M, this preserves strong accuracy without retraining, providing a simple way to compress LLMs on disk. Fine-tuning only the cluster centroids further recovers 30--40\% of the remaining accuracy loss. Using clustering as an analysis tool, we then keep the cluster assignments fixed and perturb only the shared values, to study which of their properties matter most. We find that preserving their \emph{relative rank} (which connections are stronger or weaker than others) is more important than preserving their exact magnitudes. Breaking this ordering greatly increases perplexity, while changing the values but keeping the ordering causes little loss in many middle and late layers. However, rank preservation alone is not sufficient. Model performance also depends on maintaining the variance of the reconstructed weights, while early layers remain more sensitive; perturbing the cluster assignments themselves shows that their spatial geometry is also load-bearing. We observe the same behavior across four LLMs from two architecture families. These results suggest that the ordering of weights, together with their overall variance, plays a central role in LLM compression and robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对预训练 LLM 权重矩阵做标量 K-means，每个矩阵只保留 16–64 个共享值即可在不重训的情况下保住精度；进一步固定聚类分配、只扰动共享值，发现保持权重的相对秩（谁比谁强）比保持精确幅值更关键，破坏排序会大幅抬高 perplexity，而保持排序只改数值在多数中后层几乎无损。作者据此指出 LLM 压缩与鲁棒性由权重排序加整体方差共同决定。
Motivation: LLM 有数十亿参数，但许多精确权重值并不必要；需要弄清压缩时哪些权重属性真正承载性能，以便在磁盘压缩与鲁棒性之间找到可操作的保留对象。
Method: 对 Llama 3.1-8B-Instruct 与 SmolLM2-135M 等预训练模型做标量 K-means，把每个权重矩阵替换为 16–64 个共享值；再固定聚类分配、只扰动共享值，分别检验相对秩、幅值、方差与聚类分配本身（空间几何）的作用，并可只微调聚类中心。
Result: 16–64 个共享值即可在无重训下保持强精度；仅微调聚类中心可恢复剩余精度损失的 30–40%；破坏相对排序大幅增加 perplexity，保持排序而改变数值在许多中后层损失很小；还需保持重建权重的方差，早期层更敏感；同一现象在两个架构家族的四个 LLM 上一致。
Conclusion: LLM 权重的相对排序连同整体方差是压缩与鲁棒性的核心，单靠秩保持并不足够，聚类分配的空间几何也承载信息。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DEAF: A Benchmark for Diagnostic Evaluation of Acoustic Faithfulness in Audio Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent Audio Multimodal Large Language Models (Audio MLLMs) demonstrate impressive performance on speech benchmarks, yet it remains unclear whether these models genuinely process acoustic signals or rely on text-based semantic inference. To systematically study this question, we introduce DEAF (Diagnostic Evaluation of Acoustic Faithfulness), a benchmark of over 2,700 conflict stimuli spanning three acoustic dimensions: emotional prosody, background sounds, and speaker identity. Then, we design a controlled multi-level evaluation framework that progressively increases textual influence, ranging from semantic conflicts in the content to misleading prompts and their combination, allowing us to disentangle content-driven bias from prompt-induced sycophancy. We further introduce diagnostic metrics to quantify model reliance on textual cues over acoustic signals. Our evaluation of seven Audio MLLMs reveals a consistent pattern of text dominance: models are sensitive to acoustic variations, yet predictions are predominantly driven by textual inputs, revealing a gap between high performance on standard speech benchmarks and genuine acoustic understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DEAF 提出一个含 2700 多条冲突刺激的音频忠实性诊断基准，覆盖情感韵律、背景声音、说话人身份三个声学维度，并用逐级增强文本影响的受控评测框架区分内容偏置与提示诱导的谄媚。对七个 Audio MLLM 的评测显示一致的 text dominance：模型能感知声学变化，但预测主要由文本输入驱动。
Motivation: Audio MLLM 在语音基准上分数很高，但无法判断它真在处理声学信号还是靠文本语义推理，标准语音评测把这两种能力混在一起。
Method: 构建 2700 多条 conflict stimuli，跨情感韵律、背景声音、说话人身份三维度；设计多级受控评测框架，从内容语义冲突到误导性提示再到两者组合，逐步放大文本影响，以分离 content-driven bias 与 prompt-induced sycophancy，并提出量化模型偏向文本而非声学信号的诊断指标。
Result: 对七个 Audio MLLM 的评测呈现一致的 text dominance 模式：模型对声学变化敏感，但预测主要由文本输入驱动，标准语音基准上的高分与真正的声学理解之间存在落差。
Conclusion: 高语音基准分数不等于声学理解，Audio MLLM 的判断在文本与声学冲突时以文本为准，需要用分级冲突刺激而非普通语音评测来诊断。

papers.title: NeuronSpark: Selective Spiking State Space Models with Adaptive Computation for Language Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Spiking neural networks promise brain-inspired neural dynamics, yet native large-scale spiking language-model pretraining remains largely unexplored relative to conversion, distillation, and backbone-adaptation approaches. We diagnose a central obstacle: standard spiking neurons apply the same firing sensitivity to every token, creating dense- or silent-firing regimes that are difficult to resolve with globally tuned parameters alone. This problem is particularly acute in language modeling, where a single sequence contains tokens of vastly different informational roles, making a uniform firing regime poorly matched to the data. We address this with NeuronSpark, a self-attention-free language model built around input-dependent spiking membrane dynamics, where each neuron's decay rate, gain, and firing threshold adapt to the current token content. Together with gated associative memory and adaptive temporal aggregation, this selectivity enables billion-scale pretraining from random initialization without backbone transfer, conversion, or distillation. We relate the neuron to fixed-parameter spiking models and the memory to linear attention. At 1.1B parameters and 2.1B tokens, NeuronSpark reaches a 40.0 eight-task zero-shot average, exceeds comparable-budget Pythia/Mamba checkpoints, retains 95.2%/93.2% of their fully trained scores, and spontaneously develops a fast--slow hierarchy. At 2,048 tokens, parameter-matched VHDL points reduce operation-energy proxy by 90.1%/67.0% and cycles by 94.1%/80.3% versus Transformer/Mamba; a physical FPGA path reaches 24.000s TTFT and 0.082440 TPS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NeuronSpark 是一个无自注意力的脉冲语言模型，用输入相关的脉冲膜电位动力学让每个神经元的衰减率、增益和阈值随当前 token 内容自适应，配合门控联想记忆与自适应时间聚合，实现从随机初始化的十亿级预训练，无需骨干迁移、转换或蒸馏。1.1B 参数、2.1B token 下八任务 zero-shot 平均 40.0，超过同等预算的 Pythia/Mamba 检查点并保留其完整训练分数的 95.2%/93.2%。
Motivation: 原生大规模脉冲语言模型预训练基本空白，主流路线依赖转换、蒸馏或骨干适配；标准脉冲神经元对所有 token 施加同一发放灵敏度，导致密集或静默发放体制，全局调参难以解决，而语言序列中 token 信息角色差异极大。
Method: 构建无自注意力的 NeuronSpark：脉冲膜电位动力学的衰减率、增益、阈值随 token 内容自适应，叠加门控联想记忆 (gated associative memory) 与自适应时间聚合 (adaptive temporal aggregation)；将该神经元与固定参数脉冲模型、将记忆与线性注意力建立对应关系，从随机初始化直接做十亿级预训练。
Result: 1.1B 参数、2.1B token 预训练后八任务 zero-shot 平均 40.0，超过同等预算的 Pythia/Mamba 检查点，保留其完整训练分数的 95.2%/93.2%，并自发形成快-慢层级 (fast–slow hierarchy)。在 2,048 token、参数匹配的 VHDL 设定点下，相对 Transformer/Mamba 操作能耗代理降低 90.1%/67.0%、周期数降低 94.1%/80.3%；物理 FPGA 路径达到 24.000 s TTFT 与 0.082440 TPS。
Conclusion: 让脉冲神经元的发放参数随输入自适应，可以在不依赖骨干迁移或蒸馏的前提下支撑十亿级语言模型预训练，并在硬件能耗与周期上相对 Transformer/Mamba 有大幅优势。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 构建无自注意力的 NeuronSpark：脉冲膜电位动力学的衰减率、增益、阈值随 token 内容自适应，叠加门控联想记忆 (gated associative memory) 与自适应时间聚合 (adaptive temporal aggregation)；将该神经元与固定参数脉冲模型、将记忆与线性注意力建立对应关系，从随机初始化直接做十亿级预训练。
summary_sections.result: 1.1B 参数、2.1B token 预训练后八任务 zero-shot 平均 40.0，超过同等预算的 Pythia/Mamba 检查点，保留其完整训练分数的 95.2%/93.2%，并自发形成快-慢层级 (fast–slow hierarchy)。在 2,048 token、参数匹配的 VHDL 设定点下，相对 Transformer/Mamba 操作能耗代理降低 90.1%/67.0%、周期数降低 94.1%/80.3%；物理 FPGA 路径达到 24.000 s TTFT 与 0.082440 TPS。
summary_sections.conclusion: 让脉冲神经元的发放参数随输入自适应，可以在不依赖骨干迁移或蒸馏的前提下支撑十亿级语言模型预训练，并在硬件能耗与周期上相对 Transformer/Mamba 有大幅优势。

papers.title: AutoControl Arena: Synthesizing Executable Test Environments for Frontier AI Risk Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) evolve into autonomous agents, existing safety evaluations face a fundamental trade-off: manual benchmarks are costly, while LLM-based simulators are scalable but suffer from logic hallucination. We present AutoControl Arena, an automated framework for frontier AI risk evaluation built on the principle of logic-narrative decoupling. By grounding deterministic state in executable code while delegating generative dynamics to LLMs, we mitigate hallucination while maintaining flexibility. This principle, instantiated through a three-agent framework, achieves over 98% end-to-end success and 60% human preference over existing simulators. To elicit latent risks, we vary environmental Stress and Temptation across X-Bench (70 scenarios, 7 risk categories). Evaluating 9 frontier models reveals: (1) Alignment Illusion: risk rates surge from 21.7% to 54.5% under pressure, with capable models showing disproportionately larger increases; (2) Scenario-Specific Safety Scaling: advanced reasoning improves robustness for direct harms but worsens it for gaming scenarios; and (3) Divergent Misalignment Patterns: weaker models cause non-malicious harm while stronger models develop strategic concealment. Code and data are available at https://github.com/CosmosYi/AutoControl-Arena.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). Project page: https://cosmosyi.github.io/AutoControl-Arena/. Code: https://github.com/CosmosYi/AutoControl-Arena
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 306, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoControl Arena 用「逻辑-叙事解耦」把确定性状态写成可执行代码、把生成性动态交给 LLM，合成可运行的前沿 AI 风险测试环境。三 agent 框架端到端成功率超 98%、人类偏好比既有模拟器高 60%；在 X-Bench 的 70 个场景、7 类风险上调节 Stress 与 Temptation，7 个前沿模型的风险率从 21.7% 升到 54.5%。
Motivation: LLM 智能体的安全评测面临两难：人工基准成本高，LLM 模拟器可扩展却有逻辑幻觉，导致风险场景不可信、不可复现。
Method: 按逻辑-叙事解耦原则构建三 agent 框架：确定性状态由可执行代码承载，生成性动态交给 LLM；通过调节环境 Stress 与 Temptation 在 X-Bench（70 场景、7 类风险）上诱发潜在风险，并评测 7 个前沿模型。
Result: 端到端成功率超过 98%，人类偏好比既有模拟器高 60%。7 个前沿模型在压力下风险率由 21.7% 升至 54.5%，能力越强升幅越大；高级推理改善直接伤害类稳健性却恶化博弈 (gaming) 类；弱模型造成非恶意伤害，强模型出现策略性隐瞒。
Conclusion: 把可执行代码与 LLM 生成分工可同时压住逻辑幻觉并保留场景灵活性，而压力下的风险率跃升说明能力更强的模型并不等比例更安全。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CORE-Seg: Reasoning-Driven Segmentation for Complex Lesions via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Medical image segmentation is undergoing a paradigm shift from conventional visual pattern matching to cognitive reasoning analysis. Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown promise in integrating linguistic and visual knowledge, significant gaps remain: existing general MLLMs possess broad common sense but lack the specialized visual reasoning required for complex lesions, whereas traditional segmentation models excel at pixel-level segmentation but lack logical interpretability. In this paper, we introduce ComLesion-14K, the first diverse Chain-of-Thought (CoT) benchmark for reasoning-driven complex lesion segmentation. To accomplish this task, we propose CORE-Seg, an end-to-end framework integrating reasoning with segmentation through a Semantic-Guided Prompt Adapter. We design a progressive training strategy from SFT to GRPO, equipped with an adaptive dual-granularity reward mechanism to mitigate reward sparsity. Our Method achieves state-of-the-art results with a mean Dice of 37.06\% (14.89\% higher than the second-best baseline), while reducing the failure rate to 18.42\%. Project Page: https://xyxl024.github.io/CORE-Seg.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CORE-Seg 把推理与分割端到端耦合，用 Semantic-Guided Prompt Adapter 引导 MLLM 做复杂病灶的 Chain-of-Thought 分割，并以 SFT→GRPO 渐进训练加自适应双粒度奖励缓解奖励稀疏。在自建 ComLesion-14K 基准上 mean Dice 达 37.06%，比第二名基线高 14.89%，失败率降到 18.42%。
Motivation: 通用 MLLM 有常识但缺复杂病灶所需的专门视觉推理，传统分割模型像素级精度好却无逻辑可解释性，两者之间缺少面向推理式病灶分割的评测基准。
Method: 提出 ComLesion-14K（首个面向推理式复杂病灶分割的多样 CoT 基准）与端到端框架 CORE-Seg：Semantic-Guided Prompt Adapter 融合语义提示，训练从 SFT 渐进到 GRPO，并设计自适应双粒度奖励机制以缓解奖励稀疏。
Result: 在 ComLesion-14K 上 mean Dice 37.06%，比第二名基线高 14.89 个百分点，失败率降至 18.42%。
Conclusion: 把显式推理与分割训练放进同一端到端框架并配双粒度奖励，可在复杂病灶分割上取得 SOTA，说明 CoT 推理对病灶分割有实际增益。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Agentic Peer-to-Peer Networks: From Content Distribution to Capability and Action Sharing
papers.abstract_en: The ongoing shift of Artificial Intelligence (AI) from centralized cloud application programming interfaces (APIs) to local inference on edge devices is enabling Client-Side Autonomous Agents (CSAAs) - persistent personal agents that can plan, access local context, and invoke tools on behalf of users. As these agents collaborate directly, they form Agentic Peer-to-Peer (P2P) Networks. Unlike classic overlays exchanging static, hash-indexed content (e.g., BitTorrent), agentic P2P exchanges dynamic, heterogeneous capabilities that are potentially unsafe, requiring semantic discovery, drift management, and risk-aware execution. We outline the networking foundations for such collaboration. To organize this design space, we propose a plane-based reference architecture decoupling connectivity, semantic discovery, and execution. To support discovery under drift, we introduce signed, soft-state capability descriptors to support intent-aware routing. Finally, to cope with adversarial settings, we present a tiered verification spectrum - ranging from reputation signals (Tier 1) and canary probes (Tier 2) to cryptographic evidence (Tier 3) - that aligns trust costs with task risks. Results from a proxy-level discrete-event simulation suggest improved workflow success under poisoning and drift with modest control-plane overhead.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Communications Magazine
papers.journal_ref: T. Wang, L. You, J. Tong, C. Zhao, and S. Zhang, "Agentic Peer-to-Peer Networks: From Content Distribution to Capability and Action Sharing," IEEE Communications Magazine, Early Access, pp. 1-7, Oct. 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向边缘端自主 Agent (CSAA) 组成的 Agentic P2P 网络，提出分平面参考架构，把连接、语义发现与执行解耦，并用签名的软状态能力描述符 (signed soft-state capability descriptors) 支持意图感知路由；对抗场景下给出三级验证谱系——Tier 1 声誉信号、Tier 2 金丝雀探针 (canary probes)、Tier 3 密码学证据——按任务风险匹配信任成本。代理级离散事件仿真显示，在投毒与能力漂移 (drift) 条件下工作流成功率提升，控制面开销仅温和增加。
Motivation: AI 推理从云端 API 转向边缘本地设备，持久化个人 Agent 需要直接协作，但它们交换的是动态、异构且可能不安全的能力，而非 BitTorrent 那种静态哈希索引内容，因此需要语义发现、漂移管理和风险感知执行。
Method: 提出分平面参考架构，将连接、语义发现与执行解耦；引入签名的软状态能力描述符以支持漂移条件下的意图感知路由；给出三级验证谱系（Tier 1 声誉、Tier 2 canary probes、Tier 3 密码学证据），使信任开销与任务风险对齐。
Result: 代理级离散事件仿真 (proxy-level discrete-event simulation) 结果表明，在 poisoning 与 drift 条件下工作流成功率提升，同时控制面开销仅为温和增加 (modest control-plane overhead)。
Conclusion: Agentic P2P 的协作应建立在语义发现加分级验证之上：按任务风险选择信任机制，即可在对抗与漂移环境下提高工作流成功率而不显著抬高控制面成本。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ITO: Multi-View Alignment and Training-Time Fusion for Image-Text Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Image--text contrastive pretraining has become a dominant paradigm for visual representation learning, yet existing methods often yield representations that remain partially organized by modality rather than by semantics. We propose ITO, a framework addressing this limitation through two complementary mechanisms with distinct roles. Multimodal multiple alignment enriches supervision by constructing diverse cross-modal correspondences from multi-view image augmentations, providing the primary source of discriminative gain. A lightweight training-time multimodal fusion module then acts as a training-time regularizer, encouraging the encoders to produce features that are compatible under fusion. Crucially, the fusion module is discarded at inference, preserving the efficiency of standard dual-encoder architectures while incurring training-time overhead only. Extensive experiments across pretraining scales from millions to billions of image--text pairs show that ITO outperforms strong contrastive baselines at moderate scale and yields consistent gains over CLIP under identical data, backbone, and compute at the 100M--1B scale, on classification, retrieval, and multimodal benchmarks. Controlled comparisons show that these gains are not explained by additional training compute or image augmentation alone. Our analysis further reveals that the contribution of fusion grows with data scale and that it stabilizes optimization, mitigating the late-stage overfitting commonly observed in aggressive contrastive learning. Code is available at https://github.com/showstarpro/ITO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ITO 用多视角图像增广构造多样跨模态对应（multimodal multiple alignment）作为判别增益主来源，再加一个仅训练期使用的轻量多模态融合模块作正则，推理时丢弃以保留双编码器效率。在相同数据、骨干与算力下，100M–1B 规模的图文对上，ITO 在分类、检索与多模态基准上稳定优于 CLIP，且融合模块的贡献随数据规模增大、能稳定优化并缓解激进对比学习后期的过拟合。
Motivation: 图像-文本对比预训练得到的表征常按模态而非语义组织，跨模态语义对齐不足；同时激进对比学习在训练后期易过拟合。
Method: 两个互补机制：multimodal multiple alignment 从多视角图像增广构造多样跨模态对应以丰富监督；轻量训练期多模态融合模块作为正则器，促使编码器产出在融合下兼容的特征，推理时丢弃该模块。实验覆盖从百万到十亿级图文对的预训练规模，并做受控对比排除额外训练算力与单纯图像增广的解释。
Result: 在相同数据、骨干与算力下，ITO 在 100M–1B 规模上相对 CLIP 在分类、检索与多模态基准上取得一致增益；中等规模上优于强对比基线。受控对比显示这些增益不能由额外训练算力或单纯图像增广解释；分析表明融合模块的贡献随数据规模增长，并能稳定优化、缓解激进对比学习常见的后期过拟合。
Conclusion: 多视角跨模态对齐是判别增益主来源，训练期融合是随规模增益的正则器；推理期丢弃融合即可在不牺牲双编码器效率的前提下持续超越 CLIP。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond State-Wise Mirror Descent: Offline Policy Optimization with Parametric Policies
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the theoretical aspects of offline reinforcement learning (RL) under general function approximation. While prior works (e.g., Xie et al., 2021) have established the theoretical foundations of learning a good policy from offline data via pessimism, existing algorithms that are computationally tractable (often in an oracle-efficient sense), such as PSPI, only apply to finite and small action spaces. Moreover, these algorithms rely on state-wise mirror descent and require actors to be implicitly induced from the critic functions, failing to accommodate standalone policy parameterization which is ubiquitous in practice. In this work, we address these limitations and extend the theoretical guarantees to parameterized policy classes over large or continuous action spaces. When extending mirror descent to parameterized policies, we identify contextual coupling as the core difficulty, and show how connecting mirror descent to natural policy gradient leads to novel analyses, guarantees, and algorithmic insights, including a surprising unification between offline RL and imitation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把离线强化学习的悲观保证从有限小动作空间推广到参数化策略类与连续/大动作空间。核心障碍是参数化带来的 contextual coupling，作者把 mirror descent 与 natural policy gradient 联系起来，得到新的分析与算法，并发现离线 RL 与模仿学习的统一。
Motivation: 现有可计算（oracle-efficient）的离线 RL 算法如 PSPI 只适用于有限小动作空间，且依赖 state-wise mirror descent、要求 actor 由 critic 隐式诱导，无法容纳实践中普遍存在的独立参数化策略。
Method: 将 mirror descent 扩展到参数化策略类，识别 contextual coupling 为关键难点，并通过把 mirror descent 与 natural policy gradient 相联系来构造分析与算法，从而支持大或连续动作空间上的独立策略参数化。
Result: 给出面向参数化策略类（大或连续动作空间）的理论保证，并得到离线 RL 与模仿学习之间出人意料的统一；摘要未给出具体数值实验。
Conclusion: 离线 RL 的悲观保证可以脱离 state-wise mirror descent 与 critic 诱导的 actor，扩展到独立参数化策略，且该路径揭示了离线 RL 与模仿学习在理论上的统一。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Locally Private Parametric Methods for Change-Point Detection
papers.abstract_en: We study parametric change-point detection under local differential privacy, focusing on the offline localization of a single change point in a sequence of independent observations.~In the non-private setting, we derive improved finite-sample accuracy guarantees for a generalized likelihood-ratio estimator using martingale methods.~We establish finite-sample minimax lower bounds in both the non-private and locally private settings, showing that localization accuracy is fundamentally limited by the Chernoff information between the pre- and post-change distributions.~Guided by this, we design locally private CPD algorithms based on aggregated randomized response and binary mechanisms, which maximize the Chernoff information between the induced output distributions in low- and high-privacy regimes, respectively, and derive their finite-sample guarantees. Together, our upper and lower bounds quantify the statistical cost of privacy in change-point localization.~As part of our analysis, we also show that strong data processing inequality coefficients of Rényi divergence and Jeffreys--Rényi divergence of order infinity can be computed by restricting to pairs of input distributions with a common support of at most two symbols.~We corroborate our results through empirical evaluation on synthetic data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在局部差分隐私 (LDP) 下做单变点离线定位，证明定位精度的有限样本 minimax 下界由变点前后分布的 Chernoff 信息决定，并据此设计在低隐私与高隐私体制下分别最大化输出分布 Chernoff 信息的聚合随机化响应 (aggregated randomized response) 与二值 (binary) 机制。上下界共同量化了隐私对变点定位的统计代价，合成数据实验佐证结论。
Motivation: 分布式传感场景下观测需在采集端加局部隐私保护，而变点定位的 minimax 精度如何被隐私预算压缩、由哪个散度量刻画，此前缺少有限样本层面的刻画。
Method: 非私有情形用鞅方法为广义似然比 (GLR) 估计器推导改进的有限样本精度保证；在非私有与局部私有两种设定下证明有限样本 minimax 下界；据此设计基于聚合随机化响应与二值机制的局部私有 CPD 算法，并推导其有限样本保证。副产品是证明 Rényi 散度与阶数为无穷的 Jeffreys–Rényi 散度的强数据处理不等式 (SDI) 系数可限制在公共支撑至多两个符号的分布对上计算。
Result: 定位精度的有限样本 minimax 下界在非私有与局部私有设定下均由变点前后分布的 Chernoff 信息决定；上下界共同给出隐私代价的量化刻画；SDI 系数可归约到公共支撑至多 2 个符号的分布对；在合成数据上做经验评估佐证理论结果。
Conclusion: 变点定位的隐私代价由输出分布可保留的 Chernoff 信息决定，机制设计应按隐私体制（低/高）分别最大化该信息；上下界合起来给出该代价的紧刻画。
Relevance: 12

papers.title: Federated Learning of Nonlinear Temporal Dynamics with Graph Attention-based Cross-Client Interpretability
papers.abstract_en: Networks of modern industrial systems are increasingly monitored by distributed sensors, where each system comprises multiple subsystems that generate high-dimensional time-series. These subsystems are often interdependent, making it important to understand how temporal patterns observed at one subsystem relate to those observed across others. This problem is particularly challenging in decentralized settings where raw measurements cannot be shared, and client observations are heterogeneous. Moreover, in practice, each subsystem (client) operates a fixed, proprietary model that cannot be modified or retrained, limiting the applicability of existing approaches. Separately, nonlinear dynamics make cross-client temporal interdependencies difficult to characterize, as they are embedded implicitly within nonlinear state-transition functions. This paper presents a vertical federated learning framework for learning one-step-ahead cross-client temporal interdependencies under these constraints. Each client maps high-dimensional local observations to low-dimensional latent states using a nonlinear state-space model, while a Graph Attention Network (GAT)-based central server learns a state-transition model over the communicated states. Given a candidate graph skeleton, the server learns state-dependent attention coefficients that capture cross-client interactions. We analytically relate the GAT attention coefficients to the Jacobian of the learned state-transition model, yielding a first-order characterization of cross-client interdependencies. We further establish bounded closeness of the learned dynamics and Jacobians to a corresponding centralized oracle. Synthetic experiments validate the theoretical results on controlled systems with known graph skeletons. Experiments on real-world datasets with unknown graph skeletons demonstrate superior federated root cause analysis over baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向工业系统网络的纵向联邦学习 (vertical federated learning) 框架：各客户端用非线性状态空间模型把本地高维观测压成低维隐状态，中心服务器用 Graph Attention Network (GAT) 在给定候选图骨架上学状态依赖的注意力系数，一步-ahead 刻画跨客户端时序相互依赖。把 GAT 注意力系数与学到的状态转移模型 Jacobian 解析关联，得到相互依赖的一阶刻画，并证明学到的动力学与 Jacobian 相对集中式 oracle 的有界接近性；合成系统上验证理论，真实数据集上展示优于基线的联邦根因分析。
Motivation: 分布式传感器网络中各子系统互依，但原始数据不能共享、观测异构、每个客户端还运行不可修改的固定专有模型，且非线性状态转移把跨客户端依赖隐式嵌入，现有方法难以刻画。
Method: 纵向联邦框架：每个客户端用非线性状态空间模型把本地高维观测映射为低维隐状态并上传；中心服务器在候选图骨架上用 GAT 学状态转移模型与状态依赖注意力系数；解析地把注意力系数与状态转移模型的 Jacobian 关联，给出一阶刻画，并建立学到的动力学与 Jacobian 相对集中式 oracle 的有界接近性。
Result: 在已知图骨架的受控合成系统上验证理论结果；在图骨架未知的真实数据集上，联邦根因分析优于基线方法。
Conclusion: 在原始数据不可共享、客户端模型不可改的约束下，GAT 注意力系数可作为跨客户端时序相互依赖的一阶可解释代理，且学到的动力学与 Jacobian 相对集中式 oracle 有界接近。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: RanSOM: Second-Order Momentum with Randomized Scaling for Constrained and Unconstrained Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Second-order momentum corrects the lag of momentum behind the current gradient with a Hessian-vector product (HVP), but existing corrections need either a Lipschitz Hessian or extra forward and backward passes at an auxiliary point. We show that randomizing the step length removes this trade-off: if the step is exponentially distributed with mean $η$, a Stein-type identity makes $η$ times one HVP at the new iterate an estimate of the gradient change that is unbiased in expectation over the step, and this HVP shares its forward pass with the next gradient. The resulting method, RanSOM-E, works with normalized, sign, and Muon-type steps, and a Beta-distributed variant, RanSOM-B, keeps Frank-Wolfe iterates feasible. For objectives with Lipschitz gradient and heavy-tailed gradient and Hessian noise with tail indices $p, q \in (1,2]$, RanSOM-E attains the optimal oracle-complexity exponents for every pair $(p,q)$, including $p \neq q$, without a Lipschitz Hessian or clipping ($\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-3})$ for $p = q = 2$). On CIFAR-10 with ResNet-20, we detect no accuracy difference from existing second-order momentum methods, and its mean update time is lower than that of the auxiliary-point method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RanSOM 用随机化步长替代需要 Lipschitz Hessian 或辅助点额外前后向传播的二阶动量修正：步长取均值 η 的指数分布时，Stein 型恒等式使 η 乘以新迭代点处一次 HVP 成为梯度变化的无偏估计，且该 HVP 与下一次梯度共享前向传播。RanSOM-E 在尾指数 p,q∈(1,2] 的重尾梯度与 Hessian 噪声下对每一对 (p,q)（含 p≠q）达到最优 oracle 复杂度指数，p=q=2 时为 O(ε⁻³)；CIFAR-10/ResNet-20 上精度与既有二阶动量方法无差异，平均更新时间低于辅助点方法。
Motivation: 二阶动量用 Hessian-vector product 修正动量滞后于当前梯度的问题，但现有修正要么要求 Hessian Lipschitz，要么需在辅助点做额外前后向传播，二者不可兼得。
Method: 步长服从均值 η 的指数分布，由 Stein 型恒等式得到 η×单次 HVP 的无偏梯度变化估计，且 HVP 与下一梯度共享前向传播，得 RanSOM-E；可与 normalized、sign、Muon 型步长组合。Beta 分布步长的 RanSOM-B 使 Frank-Wolfe 迭代保持可行。
Result: 在 Lipschitz 梯度与尾指数 p,q∈(1,2] 的重尾梯度/Hessian 噪声下，RanSOM-E 对每一对 (p,q)（含 p≠q）达到最优 oracle 复杂度指数，无需 Lipschitz Hessian 或 clipping，p=q=2 时为 O(ε⁻³)。CIFAR-10 + ResNet-20 上与既有二阶动量方法检测不到精度差异，平均更新时间低于辅助点方法。
Conclusion: 随机化步长能同时去掉 Lipschitz Hessian 假设与辅助点开销，并在重尾噪声下保持最优复杂度；代价是精度上与现有二阶动量方法持平而非提升。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fast Rates for Nonstationary Weighted Risk Minimization
papers.abstract_en: Weighted empirical risk minimization is a common approach to prediction under distribution drift. This article studies its out-of-sample prediction error under nonstationarity. We provide a general decomposition of the excess risk into a learning term and an error term associated with distribution drift, and prove oracle inequalities for the learning error under mixing conditions. The learning bound holds uniformly over arbitrary weight classes and accounts for the effective sample size induced by the weight vector, the complexity of the weight and hypothesis classes, and potential data dependence. We also analyze the drift error in the square loss setting and provide explicit bounds for structural-break and smoothly drifting processes. We then combine the learning and drift analysis in (auto-) regression problems with linear models, basis approximations, and neural networks. In all cases, the optimal weights are characterized by a bias--variance trade-off between learning and drift, while minimax-optimal rates (up to logarithmic factors) are recovered when specialized to unweighted and stationary settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对分布漂移下的加权经验风险最小化 (weighted ERM) 给出样本外误差的一般分解：超额风险拆成学习项与漂移项，并在 mixing 条件下证明学习项的 oracle 不等式，界对任意权重类一致且显式依赖权重诱导的有效样本量、权重类与假设类复杂度以及数据依赖性。平方损失下漂移项对结构突变与平滑漂移过程给出显式界；在 (自) 回归的线性模型、基逼近与神经网络中，最优权重由学习与漂移之间的 bias–variance 权衡刻画，退化到无权与平稳设定时恢复 minimax 最优速率（差对数因子）。
Motivation: 分布漂移下加权 ERM 的样本外误差缺少统一的误差分解与速率刻画：学习误差与漂移误差如何随权重、有效样本量和漂移强度权衡并不清楚。
Method: 把超额风险分解为学习项与漂移项，在 mixing 条件下对任意权重类一致地证明学习项 oracle 不等式，界中显式纳入权重诱导的有效样本量、权重类与假设类复杂度及数据依赖；平方损失下分析漂移项，对结构突变与平滑漂移过程给出显式界，并在 (自) 回归的线性模型、基逼近与神经网络上合并两部分分析。
Result: 最优权重在所有考察设定中均由学习与漂移的 bias–variance 权衡刻画；在无权与平稳特化下恢复 minimax 最优速率（差对数因子）；漂移误差界对结构突变与平滑漂移过程均为显式形式。
Conclusion: 分布漂移下的加权 ERM 可用学习项加漂移项的统一框架给出速率，最优权重由 bias–variance 权衡决定，且在平稳/无权特化下不损失 minimax 阶。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.result: 最优权重在所有考察设定中均由学习与漂移的 bias–variance 权衡刻画；在无权与平稳特化下恢复 minimax 最优速率（差对数因子）；漂移误差界对结构突变与平滑漂移过程均为显式形式。
summary_sections.conclusion: 分布漂移下的加权 ERM 可用学习项加漂移项的统一框架给出速率，最优权重由 bias–variance 权衡决定，且在平稳/无权特化下不损失 minimax 阶。

papers.title: HumanX: Toward Agile and Generalizable Humanoid Interaction Skills from Human Videos
papers.abstract_en: Enabling humanoid robots to perform agile and adaptive interactions has long been a core challenge in robotics. Current approaches are bottlenecked by either the scarcity of realistic interaction data or the need for meticulous, task-specific reward engineering, which limits their scalability. To narrow this gap, we present HumanX, a unified framework that compiles human video into generalizable, real-world interaction skills for humanoids, without per-task design. HumanX integrates two co-designed components: XGen, an anchor-centric data generation pipeline that yields physically plausible robot interaction data from monocular video and augments it to create a diverse, scalable training dataset; and XMimic, an interaction-prioritized learning framework to achieve generalizable interaction skills from seconds of demonstration. Evaluated across five distinct domains--basketball, football, badminton, cargo pickup, and reactive fighting--HumanX successfully acquires 9 different skills and transfers them zero-shot to a physical Unitree G1 humanoid. The learned capabilities include complex maneuvers such as pump-fake turnaround fadeaway jumpshots without any external perception, as well as interactive tasks like sustained human-robot passing sequences over 10 consecutive cycles--learned from a single video demonstration. Our experiments show that HumanX achieves higher generalization success than prior methods, demonstrating a scalable pathway within a class of anchorable interactions for learning versatile, real-world robot interactive skills.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HumanX 把单目人类视频编译成可零样本上真机的人形机器人交互技能：XGen 从视频生成物理合理的机器人交互数据并增广成训练集，XMimic 用数秒演示学出可泛化技能。在篮球、足球、羽毛球、货物抓取、反应式格斗五个领域学到 9 种技能并零样本迁移到实体 Unitree G1，包括无外部感知的 pump-fake 转身后仰跳投，以及单条视频演示学出的连续 10 个周期以上的人机传球。
Motivation: 人形机器人敏捷交互受限于真实交互数据稀缺或逐任务奖励工程，两者都难以扩展。
Method: 两个协同设计组件：XGen 是以 anchor 为中心的数据生成管线，从单目视频产出物理合理的机器人交互数据并增广为多样化可扩展的训练集；XMimic 是交互优先的学习框架，从数秒演示中学习可泛化交互技能，无需逐任务设计。
Result: 在五个领域（basketball、football、badminton、cargo pickup、reactive fighting）学到 9 种技能，零样本迁移到实体 Unitree G1；无外部感知完成 pump-fake turnaround fadeaway jumpshots；单条视频演示学出连续 10 个周期以上的人机传球序列；实验显示泛化成功率高于既有方法。
Conclusion: 在 anchorable 交互这一类内，从人类视频自动生成数据加交互优先学习，是学多样真实机器人交互技能的可扩展路径。

papers.title: T2M Mamba: Motion Periodicity-Saliency Coupling Approach for Stable Text-Driven Motion Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-motion generation, which converts motion language descriptions into coherent 3D human motion sequences, has attracted increasing attention in fields, such as avatar animation and humanoid robotic interaction. Though existing models have achieved significant fidelity, they still suffer from two core limitations: (i) They treat motion periodicity and keyframe saliency as independent factors, overlooking their coupling and causing generation drift in long sequences. (ii) They are fragile to semantically equivalent paraphrases, where minor synonym substitutions distort textual embeddings, propagating through the decoder and producing unstable or erroneous motions. In this work, we propose T2M Mamba to address these limitations by (i) proposing Periodicity-Saliency Aware Mamba, which utilizes novel algorithms for keyframe weight estimation via enhanced Density Peaks Clustering and motion periodicity estimation via FFT-accelerated autocorrelation to capture coupled dynamics with minimal computational overhead, and (ii) constructing a Periodic Differential Cross-modal Alignment Module (PDCAM) to enhance robust alignment of textual and motion embeddings. Extensive experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML datasets have been conducted, confirming the effectiveness of our approach, achieving an FID of 0.068 and consistent gains on all other metrics.
papers.journal_ref: 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: T2M Mamba 用 Periodicity-Saliency Aware Mamba 把运动周期性与关键帧显著性耦合建模，并加 PDCAM 模块对齐文本与运动嵌入，以抑制长序列生成漂移和同义改写导致的动作失稳。在 HumanML3D 与 KIT-ML 上 FID 达到 0.068，其余指标一致提升。
Motivation: 现有文本到运动模型把周期性与关键帧显著性当独立因素，长序列会漂移；同时对语义等价的同义改写脆弱，微小替换会扭曲文本嵌入并经解码器放大成错误动作。
Method: Periodicity-Saliency Aware Mamba 用增强 Density Peaks Clustering 估计关键帧权重、用 FFT 加速的自相关估计运动周期，以极小计算开销捕捉耦合动力学；再用 Periodic Differential Cross-modal Alignment Module (PDCAM) 增强文本与运动嵌入的稳健对齐。
Result: 在 HumanML3D 与 KIT-ML 上实验，FID 达到 0.068，其余全部指标一致提升。
Conclusion: 把周期性与关键帧显著性耦合建模并配合周期差分跨模态对齐，可同时改善长序列生成稳定性与对同义改写的鲁棒性。

papers.title: A Generalizable Machine Learning Framework for Half-Heusler Thermoelectrics
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning (ML) has emerged as a powerful approach for accelerating the discovery of thermoelectric (TE) materials, yet many models suffer from limited generalizability. Here we present a robust ML framework for predicting the thermoelectric figure of merit (zT) in half-Heusler (hH) compounds, emphasizing prediction of previously unseen compositions. A principal component analysis (PCA)-based train/test splitting strategy is introduced to generate representative partitions of chemical space. Bayesian hyperparameter optimization is combined with correlation-based k-best feature selection for Random Forest, XGBoost, and Neural Network models, together with the interpretable SISSO symbolic-regression method. Relative to the full set of 118 input features, the optimized feature subsets reduce the test RMSE by 16-27%. SHAP and SISSO analyses identify temperature, A-site dopant concentration, and A-site heat of vaporization as the most important descriptors of zT. The framework is validated through prediction of previously unexplored compositions, recovery of literature-reported optimal zT values for established hH systems, and first-principles calculations for the new compounds CeCoBi and CeIrBi, which exhibit favorable electronic transport properties. The framework is further applied to high-throughput screening of the doped hH chemical space, covering about 2.46 million elemental substitution combinations across 631 thermodynamically screened parent matrices under stability constraints. This screening yields a concise set of promising candidates for future study. Overall, the work establishes a generalizable workflow for reliable data-driven thermoelectric materials discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向 half-Heusler 热电材料 zT 预测的可泛化机器学习框架：用基于 PCA 的化学空间划分构造未见组分测试集，贝叶斯超参优化结合 correlation-based k-best 特征筛选，训练 Random Forest、XGBoost、Neural Network 与可解释的 SISSO 符号回归。相对全部 118 个输入特征，优化后的特征子集使测试 RMSE 下降 16–27%；SHAP 与 SISSO 共同指出温度、A 位掺杂浓度、A 位汽化热是 zT 的关键描述符。
Motivation: 现有热电材料 ML 模型泛化能力有限，难以可靠预测训练中未见过的组分，限制了数据驱动发现流程的可用性。
Method: 引入基于 PCA 的 train/test 划分策略生成有代表性的化学空间分区；用贝叶斯超参优化配合 correlation-based k-best 特征选择，训练 Random Forest、XGBoost、Neural Network，并加入可解释的 SISSO 符号回归；以 SHAP 与 SISSO 分析特征重要性，再用第一性原理计算验证新化合物。
Result: 相对 118 个全特征，优化特征子集使测试 RMSE 降低 16–27%；SHAP 与 SISSO 识别出温度、A 位掺杂浓度、A 位汽化热为最重要描述符；框架复现了文献报道的既有 hH 体系最优 zT，并对新化合物 CeCoBi、CeIrBi 做第一性原理计算，显示有利的电子输运性质；高通量筛选覆盖约 246 万个元素替换组合、631 个热力学筛选的母体矩阵，在稳定性约束下产出少量候选。
Conclusion: PCA 划分加特征筛选与可解释模型的组合能给出对未见组分可靠的 zT 预测流程，并可直接扩展到掺杂 hH 化学空间的高通量筛选。

papers.title: RPP: A Certified Poisoned-Sample Detection Framework for Backdoor Attacks under Dataset Imbalance
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks are highly susceptible to backdoor attacks, yet most defense methods to date rely on balanced data, overlooking the pervasive class imbalance in real-world scenarios that can amplify backdoor threats. This paper presents the first in-depth investigation of how the dataset imbalance amplifies backdoor vulnerability, showing that (i) the imbalance induces a majority-class bias that increases susceptibility and (ii) conventional defenses degrade significantly as the imbalance grows. To address this, we propose Randomized Probability Perturbation (RPP), a certified poisoned-sample detection framework that operates in a black-box setting using only model output probabilities. For any inspected sample, RPP determines whether the input has been backdoor-manipulated, while offering provable within-domain detectability guarantees and a probabilistic upper bound on the false positive rate. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks (MNIST, SVHN, CIFAR-10, TinyImageNet and ImageNet10) covering 10 backdoor attacks and 12 baseline defenses show that RPP achieves significantly higher detection accuracy than state-of-the-art defenses, particularly under dataset imbalance. RPP establishes a theoretical and practical foundation for defending against backdoor attacks in real-world environments with imbalanced data.
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RPP 是黑盒设定下的认证中毒样本检测框架，只用模型输出概率对单个输入做随机化概率扰动 (Randomized Probability Perturbation)，判定其是否被后门篡改，并给出域内可检测性保证与误报率概率上界。在 MNIST、SVHN、CIFAR-10、TinyImageNet、ImageNet10 五个基准、10 种后门攻击与 12 个基线防御上，其检测准确率显著高于现有防御，且数据集越不平衡优势越明显。
Motivation: 多数后门防御假设类别均衡，而真实数据普遍不平衡；作者指出不平衡会诱发多数类偏置、提高模型易感性，并使常规防御随不平衡程度加剧而显著退化。
Method: RPP 在黑盒条件下仅依赖模型输出概率，对每个待检样本施加随机化概率扰动后判定是否被后门操纵；理论部分给出 within-domain detectability 保证与误报率 (false positive rate) 的概率上界。
Result: 在五个基准 (MNIST、SVHN、CIFAR-10、TinyImageNet、ImageNet10)、10 种后门攻击与 12 个基线防御上的实验中，RPP 的检测准确率显著高于 SOTA 防御，尤其在数据集不平衡条件下；另给出两项定性结论：不平衡导致多数类偏置增加易感性，且常规防御随不平衡增长而显著退化。
Conclusion: 作者主张 RPP 为不平衡真实环境下的后门防御奠定理论与实践基础，且认证式检测可在不访问模型内部的黑盒场景中成立。

papers.title: DeFM: Learning Foundation Representations from Depth for Robotics
papers.abstract_en: Depth sensors are widely deployed across robotic platforms, and advances in fast, high-fidelity depth simulation have enabled robotic policies trained on depth observations to achieve robust sim-to-real transfer for a wide range of tasks. Despite this, representation learning for depth modality remains underexplored compared to RGB, where large-scale foundation models now define the state of the art. To address this gap, we present DeFM, a self-supervised foundation model trained entirely on depth images for robotic applications. Using a DINO-style self-distillation objective on a curated dataset of 60M depth images, DeFM learns geometric and semantic representations that generalize to diverse environments, tasks, and sensors. To retain metric awareness across multiple scales, we introduce a novel input normalization strategy. We further distill DeFM into compact models suitable for resource-constrained robotic systems. When evaluated on depth-based classification, segmentation, navigation, locomotion, and manipulation benchmarks, DeFM achieves state-of-the-art performance and demonstrates strong generalization from simulation to real-world environments. We release all our pretrained models, which can be adopted off-the-shelf for depth-based robotic learning without task-specific fine-tuning. Webpage: https://de-fm.github.io/
papers.comment: Conditionally Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Robotics, 19 pages, 15 Figures, 14 Tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeFM 是首个完全在深度图像上自监督训练的机器人基础模型，用 DINO 式自蒸馏在 6000 万张深度图上学几何与语义表征，并通过新的输入归一化策略保持跨尺度度量感知。在深度分类、分割、导航、 locomotion 与操作基准上达到 SOTA，仿真到真实强泛化，且可蒸馏为紧凑模型、免任务微调直接使用。
Motivation: 深度传感器在机器人平台广泛部署，深度仿真已支撑 sim-to-real 策略，但深度模态的表征学习远落后于 RGB，缺少大规模基础模型。
Method: DeFM 用 DINO 式自监督自蒸馏目标，在精选的 60M 深度图像数据集上完全以深度图为输入训练；引入新的输入归一化策略保留跨尺度度量感知，并进一步把 DeFM 蒸馏为适合资源受限机器人系统的紧凑模型。
Result: 在深度分类、分割、导航、 locomotion 与操作基准上达到 state-of-the-art，并展示从仿真到真实环境的强泛化；发布全部预训练模型，可零样本直接用于深度机器人学习而无需任务特定微调。
Conclusion: 深度模态可以像 RGB 一样靠大规模自监督基础模型学到跨环境、跨任务、跨传感器的通用表征，且蒸馏后仍能开箱即用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Preference-Conditioned Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Tactical Decision Making in Heavy-Duty Vehicles
papers.abstract_en: A central difficulty in applying reinforcement learning to real-world applications such as autonomous driving is that conventional scalar reward formulations obtained by aggregating multiple often competing objectives may obscure the structure of their trade-offs. These challenges are particularly relevant to decision-making for heavy-duty vehicles, which requires balancing safety, efficiency, and operational costs under demanding commercial requirements. We present a preference-conditioned multi-objective reinforcement learning framework that explicitly represents these objectives and utilizes Generalized Policy Improvement and Proximal Policy Optimization to learn policies capturing different trade-offs between them. The proposed method approximates the Pareto front across three conflicting objectives: safety, quantified in terms of collisions and successful completion; energy efficiency, quantified using energy cost; and time efficiency, quantified using driver cost. We evaluate the framework in a scalable highway traffic simulation environment tailored for tactical decision making in heavy-duty trucks. It yields smooth and interpretable Pareto fronts, and evaluations across traffic densities and against an analytical baseline show that the learned policies capture meaningful trade-offs. The preference-conditioned policy enables transitions between different driving behaviors without retraining, demonstrating the potential of multi-objective reinforcement learning for adaptive decision making in autonomous heavy-duty vehicles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出偏好条件化的多目标强化学习框架，用 Generalized Policy Improvement 与 PPO 学出一族策略，显式覆盖安全（碰撞与成功完成）、能耗成本、司机时间成本三个冲突目标的 Pareto 权衡。在面向重型卡车战术决策的高速公路交通仿真中，得到平滑且可解释的 Pareto 前沿，跨交通密度并与解析基线对比显示学到的策略捕捉到有意义的权衡，且可在不同驾驶行为间切换而无需重训练。
Motivation: 自动驾驶等真实场景中把多目标压成标量奖励会掩盖权衡结构；重型卡车的战术决策需在安全、效率与运营成本之间平衡，商业要求苛刻，标量化尤其不合适。
Method: 偏好条件化多目标 RL：以偏好为条件显式表示三个目标，结合 Generalized Policy Improvement 与 Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) 学习覆盖不同权衡的策略族，并近似 Pareto 前沿；评测环境是为重型卡车战术决策定制的可扩展高速公路交通仿真。
Result: 在该高速公路交通仿真中得到平滑、可解释的 Pareto 前沿；跨多种交通密度并与解析基线 (analytical baseline) 对比，学到的策略捕捉到有意义的权衡；偏好条件化策略可在不同驾驶行为间切换而无需重训练。
Conclusion: 多目标 RL 加偏好条件化能让重型车辆在安全、能耗与时间成本之间按需切换权衡点，是自适应战术决策的可行路径。

papers.title: Robust Machine Learning for Regulatory Sequence Modeling under Biological and Technical Distribution Shifts
papers.abstract_en: Robust machine learning for regulatory genomics is studied under biologically and technically induced distribution shifts. Deep convolutional and attention based models achieve strong in distribution performance on DNA regulatory sequence prediction tasks but are usually evaluated under i.i.d. assumptions, even though real applications involve cell type specific programs, evolutionary turnover, assay protocol changes, and sequencing artifacts. We introduce a robustness framework that combines a mechanistic simulation benchmark with real data analysis on a massively parallel reporter assay (MPRA) dataset to quantify performance degradation, calibration failures, and uncertainty based reliability. In simulation, motif driven regulatory outputs are generated with cell type specific programs, PWM perturbations, GC bias, depth variation, batch effects, and heteroscedastic noise, and CNN, BiLSTM, and transformer models are evaluated. Models remain accurate and reasonably calibrated under mild GC content shifts but show higher error, severe variance miscalibration, and coverage collapse under motif effect rewiring and noise dominated regimes, revealing robustness gaps invisible to standard i.i.d. evaluation. Adding simple biological structural priors motif derived features in simulation and global GC content in MPRA improves in distribution error and yields consistent robustness gains under biologically meaningful genomic shifts, while providing only limited protection against strong assay noise. Uncertainty-aware selective prediction offers an additional safety layer that risk coverage analyses on simulated and MPRA data show that filtering low confidence inputs recovers low risk subsets, including under GC-based out-of-distribution conditions, although reliability gains diminish when noise dominates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 DNA 调控序列预测中，CNN、BiLSTM 与 transformer 在 i.i.d. 评测下表现强，但在 motif 效应重连与噪声主导体制下误差升高、方差严重失准、覆盖率崩溃。加入 motif 派生特征与全局 GC 含量这类生物结构先验可改善分布内误差并在生物学偏移下带来一致的稳健性增益，但对强实验噪声只有有限保护；不确定性感知的选择性预测通过过滤低置信输入恢复低风险子集，噪声主导时可靠性增益减弱。
Motivation: 深度卷积与注意力模型在 DNA 调控序列预测上按 i.i.d. 假设评测，而真实应用涉及细胞类型特异程序、进化周转、实验方案变更与测序伪影，标准评测看不到这些稳健性缺口。
Method: 提出一个稳健性框架，把机制仿真基准与真实 MPRA（massively parallel reporter assay）数据分析结合：仿真中生成 motif 驱动的调控输出，含细胞类型特异程序、PWM 扰动、GC 偏差、测深度变化、批次效应与异方差噪声，用 CNN、BiLSTM、transformer 评测；再在 MPRA 上加入全局 GC 含量先验，并用 risk-coverage 分析做不确定性感知的选择性预测。
Result: 轻度 GC 含量偏移下模型仍准确且校准合理；motif 效应重连与噪声主导体制下误差更高、方差严重失准、覆盖率崩溃。motism 派生特征（仿真）与全局 GC 含量（MPRA）改善分布内误差并在生物学偏移下带来一致稳健性增益，对强实验噪声仅有限保护。risk-coverage 分析显示过滤低置信输入可恢复低风险子集，包括 GC 基于的 OOD 条件，噪声主导时可靠性增益减弱。
Conclusion: 标准 i.i.d. 评测会掩盖调控基因组模型在生物与技术分布偏移下的稳健性缺口；简单的生物结构先验加选择性预测能提供额外安全层，但对强实验噪声保护有限。

papers.title: Global Consistency Repair for Natural-Language Claim Sets
papers.abstract_en: NLP systems increasingly aggregate claims from retrieved passages, documents, and generated reasoning steps. Yet current factuality methods mostly verify claims individually or compare pairs of claims, leaving open the question of whether the entire aggregated claim set can be retained coherently. This misses a fundamental failure mode: claims may be locally plausible and pairwise compatible while still being jointly inconsistent. We formalize global consistency repair: given an inconsistent natural-language claim set, preserve the largest coherent subset while localizing the compact sources of inconsistency. We introduce QXR, an adaptive diagnosis-and-repair framework that treats an LLM as a noisy set-level consistency judge, localizes minimal conflicting subsets, and repairs the claim set by deleting a small hitting set of claims. Across LLM judges and benchmarks derived from VitaminC, FEVER, and conflicting-evidence RAG, QXR preserves substantially more valid claims than direct all-at-once judging while maintaining high precision. These results suggest that factuality in claim aggregation systems should be treated as a set-level repair problem, not only as local verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QXR 把自然语言声明集的一致性当作集合级修复问题：用 LLM 作为带噪的集合一致性判官，定位最小冲突子集 (minimal conflicting subsets)，再删除一个小型 hitting set 来保留最大一致子集。在基于 VitaminC、FEVER 与冲突证据 RAG 的基准上，它比一次性整体判定保留多得多的有效声明，同时保持高精度。
Motivation: 现有事实性方法逐条或成对校验声明，抓不住局部合理、两两兼容却联合不一致的失败模式，聚合声明集无法整体保留。
Method: 提出自适应诊断-修复框架 QXR：把 LLM 当作带噪的集合级一致性判官，迭代定位最小冲突子集，再通过删除一个小 hitting set 的声明来修复声明集。
Result: 在跨 LLM 判官、基于 VitaminC、FEVER 和 conflicting-evidence RAG 构建的基准上，QXR 比直接一次性整体判定保留显著更多的有效声明，同时维持高精度。
Conclusion: 声明聚合系统中的事实性应当被当作集合级修复问题处理，而不只是局部校验。

papers.title: Think3D: Thinking with Space for Spatial Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at 2D visual understanding, they remain constrained by 2D-centric paradigm that severely limits genuine 3D spatial reasoning. To bridge this gap, we introduce Think3D, a novel framework that equips VLM agents with interactive, 3D chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities. By integrating a suite of 3D manipulation tools, Think3D transforms perception into active spatial exploration, mirroring human geometric reasoning. Think3D consistently improves proprietary models, including GPT-4.1 and Gemini 2.5 Pro, across BLINK Multi-view, MindCube-1K, and VSI-Bench-Tiny. We further propose Think3D-RL to teach smaller open-weight models how to manipulate 3D space effectively. Using only final-answer rewards, without process supervision or handcrafted exploration trajectories, Think3D-RL enables Qwen3-VL-4B to autonomously learn effective 3D exploration strategies. After training, the model exhibits tool-use patterns similar to those of stronger proprietary models, while shifting the effect of 3D tool use on MindCube-1K from a performance drop to a substantial improvement. These results show that active exploration in 3D space provides an effective and general paradigm for improving spatial reasoning in multimodal agents. Code, models, and data are available at https://github.com/zhangzaibin/spagent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Think3D 给 VLM 智能体接入一组 3D 操作工具，把静态 2D 视觉理解变成可交互的 3D 空间探索式思维链 (chain-of-thought)。它一致提升 GPT-4.1 与 Gemini 2.5 Pro 在 BLINK Multi-view、MindCube-1K、VSI-Bench-Tiny 上的表现；Think3D-RL 仅用最终答案奖励训练 Qwen3-VL-4B，使其在 MindCube-1K 上把 3D 工具使用的效果从性能下降翻转为显著提升。
Motivation: VLM 受 2D 中心范式限制，缺乏真正的 3D 空间推理能力；直接使用 3D 工具甚至可能让模型性能下降。
Method: Think3D 框架集成一套 3D 操作工具，将感知转化为主动空间探索，形成交互式 3D 思维链推理；Think3D-RL 仅用最终答案奖励（无过程监督、无人工探索轨迹）训练开源小模型学习 3D 探索策略。
Result: Think3D 一致改善 GPT-4.1 与 Gemini 2.5 Pro 在 BLINK Multi-view、MindCube-1K、VSI-Bench-Tiny 上的表现；Think3D-RL 训练后 Qwen3-VL-4B 的工具使用模式接近更强的专有模型，并在 MindCube-1K 上将 3D 工具使用的效果从性能下降转为显著提升。
Conclusion: 主动 3D 空间探索是提升多模态智能体空间推理的有效且通用的范式，且小模型可通过纯结果奖励自主学会该探索策略。

papers.title: CLIDD: Cross-Layer Independent Deformable Description for Efficient and Discriminative Local Feature Representation
papers.abstract_en: Robust local feature representations are essential for spatial intelligence tasks such as robot navigation and augmented reality. Establishing reliable correspondences requires descriptors that provide both high discriminative power and computational efficiency. To address this, we introduce Cross-Layer Independent Deformable Description (CLIDD), a method that achieves superior discriminability by sampling directly from independent feature hierarchies. This approach utilizes learnable offsets to capture fine-grained structural details across scales, without ever constructing a unified dense feature map, eliminating the memory and computation overhead of building a full-scale representation for a sparse sampling process. The per-keypoint per-layer offsets further break interpolation-induced correlation, preserving descriptor discriminability even at high keypoint densities. To ensure real-time performance, we implement a hardware-aware kernel fusion strategy that maximizes inference throughput. Furthermore, we develop a scalable framework that integrates lightweight architectures with a training protocol leveraging both metric learning and knowledge distillation. This scheme generates a wide spectrum of model variants optimized for diverse deployment constraints. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our approach achieves superior matching accuracy and exceptional computational efficiency simultaneously. Furthermore, our high-performance configuration outperforms a broad range of current state-of-the-art methods while exceeding 200 FPS on edge devices. These results demonstrate that CLIDD delivers high-precision local feature matching with minimal computational overhead, providing a robust and scalable solution for real-time spatial intelligence tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLIDD 直接从独立特征层级上采样描述子，用可学习偏移捕获跨尺度细节而不构建统一稠密特征图，配合硬件感知算子融合与度量学习加知识蒸馏的训练协议。在边缘设备上超过 200 FPS，同时匹配精度优于多种现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 机器人导航与增强现实等空间智能任务需要既判别力强又高效的局部特征描述子，而构建全尺度统一稠密特征图只为稀疏采样带来大量内存与计算开销。
Method: 跨层独立可变形描述 (CLIDD)：为每个关键点在每个特征层级上学习独立偏移 (per-keypoint per-layer offsets) 直接从独立特征层级采样，不构建统一稠密特征图；用硬件感知算子融合 (hardware-aware kernel fusion) 提升推理吞吐，训练协议结合 metric learning 与 knowledge distillation，产出适配不同部署约束的轻量模型变体。
Result: 高性能配置在边缘设备上超过 200 FPS，并在匹配精度上超过多种当前最先进方法；摘要称其同时取得更优匹配精度与计算效率。
Conclusion: 不构建统一稠密特征图、改用跨层独立偏移采样，可以在保持描述子判别力（尤其高关键点密度下）的同时把局部特征匹配做到实时边缘部署。

papers.title: Learning to accelerate Krasnosel'skii-Mann fixed-point iterations with guarantees
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a principled learning to optimize (L2O) framework for solving fixed-point problems involving general nonexpansive mappings. Our idea is to deliberately inject summable perturbations into a standard Krasnosel'skii-Mann iteration to improve its average-case performance over a specific distribution of problems while retaining its convergence guarantees. Under a metric sub-regularity assumption, we prove that the proposed parametrization includes only iterations that locally achieve linear convergence-up to a vanishing bias term-and that it encompasses all iterations that do so at a sufficiently fast rate. We then demonstrate how our framework can be used to augment several widely-used operator splitting methods to accelerate the solution of structured monotone inclusion problems, and validate our approach on a best approximation problem using an L2O-augmented Douglas-Rachford splitting algorithm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种带保证的学习优化 (L2O) 框架：在标准 Krasnosel'skii-Mann 迭代中注入可求和扰动，使其在特定问题分布上平均情形更快，同时保留收敛保证。在度量次正则 (metric sub-regularity) 假设下证明该参数化只包含局部线性收敛（带消失偏差项）的迭代，并覆盖所有以足够快速率线性收敛的迭代；用 L2O 增强的 Douglas-Rachford splitting 在最佳逼近问题上验证。
Motivation: 非扩张映射不动点迭代的加速学习通常以牺牲收敛保证为代价，缺少一种既能按问题分布改进平均情形、又能证明保留线性收敛的参数化。
Method: 在标准 Krasnosel'skii-Mann 迭代中注入可求和 (summable) 扰动并做 L2O 参数化；在度量次正则假设下证明该参数化局部线性收敛（至多带消失偏差项）且完备覆盖足够快速率的迭代；将框架用于增强多种算子分裂方法，并在最佳逼近问题上用 L2O 增强的 Douglas-Rachford splitting 验证。
Result: 理论结果：在度量次正则假设下，所提参数化只含局部线性收敛（带消失偏差项）的迭代，并包含所有以足够快速率线性收敛的迭代；实验为在最佳逼近问题上用 L2O 增强的 Douglas-Rachford splitting 的验证。
Conclusion: 通过注入可求和扰动的 L2O 参数化，可以在按问题分布加速 Krasnosel'skii-Mann 型迭代的同时保留收敛保证，并可增强算子分裂方法求解结构化单调包含问题。

papers.title: MetaJoin: Adaptive Join Selections for Heterogeneous Tables
papers.abstract_en: Joining heterogeneous tables requires different forms of correspondence, including exact agreement, syntactic transformation, semantic similarity, and entity-level matching. The appropriate join method is often unknown in advance, while running every candidate method incurs unnecessary cost. We introduce MetaJoin, a label-free framework for adaptive join selection. MetaJoin uses input evidence to choose an initial specialist, then uses specialist-specific output evidence to determine whether that result should be retained, compared with an alternative, escalated, or repaired. This allows join selection to adapt after execution rather than committing to a one-shot routing decision. We also introduce MNN Join, a transformation specialist that searches for string transformations by maximizing mutual-nearest-neighbor coverage between two unaligned columns and uses the same reciprocal structure to validate its output. We evaluate MetaJoin on 670 datasets from six benchmarks. It achieves 0.817 macro row-F1, slightly exceeding a benchmark-level oracle that is given the best standalone specialist for each benchmark (0.812), and outperforms label-free selection policies built from the same specialist portfolio by more than 0.13. Across the 609 datasets in the four transformation-dominant benchmarks, MNN Join outperforms every evaluated transformation baseline. Finally, MetaJoin's accuracy varies by only 0.015 as the controller backbone ranges from 3B to 14B parameters, showing that output validation and repair substantially reduce dependence on the initial routing decision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MetaJoin 是无标签的自适应 join 选择框架：先用输入证据选一个初始 specialist，再用该 specialist 的输出证据决定保留、对比、升级或修复，从而在执行后再适应而非一次性路由。在 6 个 benchmark 共 670 个数据集上 macro row-F1 达 0.817，超过按 benchmark 给定最优 standalone specialist 的 oracle（0.812），并比同 specialist 组合的无标签选择策略高出 0.13 以上。
Motivation: 异构表连接需要精确匹配、语法变换、语义相似、实体匹配等不同对应形式，事先不知道该用哪种 join 方法，而把所有候选方法都跑一遍代价过高。
Method: MetaJoin 用输入证据选择初始 specialist，再依据 specialist 特有的输出证据决定结果保留、与备选比较、升级或修复；同时提出 MNN Join 变换 specialist，通过最大化两列未对齐数据的 mutual-nearest-neighbor coverage 搜索字符串变换，并用同一互近邻结构校验输出；controller backbone 可在 3B 到 14B 参数间替换。
Result: 在 6 个 benchmark 的 670 个数据集上 macro row-F1 为 0.817，略高于 benchmark-level oracle 的 0.812，比基于同一 specialist 组合的无标签选择策略高出 0.13 以上；在四个以变换为主的 benchmark 的 609 个数据集上，MNN Join 超过所有被评估的变换基线；controller backbone 从 3B 到 14B 参数时准确率仅变化 0.015。
Conclusion: 输出校验与修复能大幅削弱对初始路由决策的依赖，使无标签自适应 join 选择在整体上可与按 benchmark 给定最优 specialist 的 oracle 相当。

papers.title: Bayesian dynamic scheduling of multipurpose batch processes under incomplete look-ahead information
papers.abstract_en: Multipurpose batch processes become increasingly popular in manufacturing industries since they adapt to low-volume, high-value products and shifting demands. These processes often operate in a dynamic environment, which faces disturbances such as processing delays and demand changes. To minimise long-term cost and system nervousness (i.e., disruptive changes to schedules), schedulers must design rescheduling strategies to address such disturbances effectively. Existing methods often assume complete look-ahead information over the scheduling horizon. This assumption contrasts with realistic situations where schedulers can only access incomplete look-ahead information. Sticking with existing methods may lead to suboptimal long-term costs and high-level system nervousness. In this work we propose a Bayesian dynamic scheduling method. Our method relies on learning a Bayesian Network from the probability distribution of disturbances. Specifically, the Bayesian Network represents how likely each operation will be impacted by disturbances. During the online execution, when new disturbances become observed, this method updates the posterior distribution and therefore guides the rescheduling strategy. We compare our method with the existing periodic rescheduling strategy (which generates new schedules from scratch at fixed intervals) on four benchmark problems. Computational results show that our method achieves statistically better long-term costs and system nervousness. In the theoretical aspect, we prove that if disturbances are mutually independent, the impact-quantifying variables inherently satisfy the independence assumptions required by Bayesian Networks. As an implication, practitioners can extend the method to other scheduling problems (such as job shop scheduling and continuous processes), given that they define the problem-specific dependencies between operations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在前视信息不完整的多用途批过程重调度中，用从扰动概率分布学到的 Bayesian Network 刻画每个工序被扰动影响的可能性，在线观测到新扰动时更新后验并据此指导重调度。在四个 benchmark 上对比固定周期从头重排的 periodic rescheduling，长期成本与系统扰动性 (system nervousness) 均取得统计意义上更好的结果。
Motivation: 现有重调度方法假设调度周期内前视信息完整，而现实中调度员只能拿到不完整前视；沿用这些方法会导致长期成本偏高且系统扰动性大。
Method: 从扰动的概率分布学习 Bayesian Network，表示各工序受扰动影响的可能性；在线执行中观测到新扰动即更新后验分布，用后验指导重调度策略，以最小化长期成本与系统扰动性。
Result: 在四个 benchmark 问题上与 periodic rescheduling（固定间隔从头生成新调度）比较，计算结果表明该方法在长期成本和系统扰动性上均取得统计意义上更优 (statistically better)。理论上证明：当扰动相互独立时，影响量化变量天然满足 Bayesian Network 所需的独立性假设。
Conclusion: 贝叶斯在线后验更新可在前视信息不完整时同时压低长期成本与调度扰动性；只要定义好工序间依赖，该方法可扩展到 job shop scheduling 与连续过程等其他调度问题。

papers.title: Infinitesimal Operator World Models: Finite-Sample Guarantees for Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Continuous-time stochastic processes underlie many natural and engineered systems. In healthcare, autonomous driving, and industrial control, direct interaction with the environment is often unsafe or impractical, motivating offline reinforcement learning from historical data. However, there is limited statistical understanding of the approximation errors inherent in learning policies from offline datasets. We address this by linking reinforcement learning to the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation and proposing an operator-theoretic algorithm based on a simple dynamic programming recursion. Specifically, we represent our world model in terms of the infinitesimal generator of controlled diffusion processes learned in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space. By integrating statistical learning methods and operator theory, we establish global convergence of the value function under sufficiently small generator-approximation error and derive explicit finite-sample guarantees with bounds tied directly to system properties such as smoothness and stability. Our theoretical and proof-of-concept results indicate that operator-based approaches may hold promise for solving offline reinforcement learning using continuous-time optimal control.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Open Journal of Control Systems, 01 October 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把连续时间随机过程的离线强化学习接到 Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman 方程上，用受控扩散过程的无穷小生成元 (infinitesimal generator) 在再生核 Hilbert 空间 (RKHS) 中做世界模型，通过一个简单的动态规划递归学习。在生成元逼近误差足够小时证明值函数全局收敛，并给出显式有限样本保证，界直接依赖系统的光滑性与稳定性；作者称结果为理论加概念验证性质。
Motivation: 医疗、自动驾驶、工业控制中直接与环境交互不安全或不可行，只能用历史数据做离线强化学习，但从小数据集学策略时逼近误差的统计理解有限。
Method: 将强化学习与 HJB 方程关联，用受控扩散过程的无穷小生成元在 RKHS 中表示世界模型，配合一个简单动态规划递归的算子类算法；把统计学习与算子理论结合，从生成元逼近误差推出值函数收敛。
Result: 在生成元逼近误差足够小的条件下建立值函数的全局收敛，并导出显式有限样本界，界与系统的光滑性、稳定性等性质直接挂钩；摘要给出的是理论与概念验证结果，无数据集或指标数字。
Conclusion: 基于算子的方法对用连续时间最优控制框架解离线强化学习是有前景的路径，其保证成立的前提是生成元逼近误差足够小。

papers.title: Second-Order Optimization with Asynchronous Curvature
papers.abstract_en: Second-order methods make fast progress per iteration, but forming and factorizing the Hessian often dominates their wall-clock time. We study \emph{Split-Client}, a task-parallel design in which a curvature client factorizes Hessians in the background while a gradient client takes cubic-regularized steps with the most recently published matrix, so that curvature cost appears as a delay rather than as blocking time. For delayed exact Hessians, we prove a first-order stationarity bound that depends on the average age of the curvature rather than its maximum, using an overlap count and a weighted Hardy inequality that allows any bounded-error initial matrix; the analysis extends to subsampled and uniformly inexact curvature. Under a fixed-cost model, the resulting wall-clock bound matches the scaling of optimally tuned Lazy Hessian without choosing a reuse period. In experiments on two LIBSVM datasets, an implementation decreases the objective earlier in wall-clock time than Lazy and Vanilla cubic Newton, with the largest gains at intermediate accuracy.
papers.comment: Old title: A Split-Client Approach to Second-Order Optimization
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Split-Client：把 Hessian 分解放到后台曲率客户端，梯度客户端用最近发布的曲率矩阵做 cubic 正则化步，使曲率开销表现为延迟而非阻塞时间。理论上得到依赖曲率平均年龄（而非最大年龄）的一阶平稳性界，墙钟界在固定成本模型下与调优后的 Lazy Hessian 同阶且无需选复用周期；两个 LIBSVM 数据集上目标函数在墙钟时间上更早下降，中等精度时收益最大。
Motivation: 二阶方法每次迭代进展快，但 Hessian 的构造与分解往往主导墙钟时间，同步实现里曲率计算是阻塞开销。
Method: 任务并行设计：曲率客户端后台分解 Hessian 并发布矩阵，梯度客户端用最近发布的矩阵执行 cubic-regularized 步。分析用 overlap count 与加权 Hardy 不等式，允许任意有界误差初始矩阵，并推广到 subsampled 与 uniformly inexact 曲率。
Result: 对延迟精确 Hessian 证明一阶平稳性界，依赖曲率平均年龄而非最大年龄；固定成本模型下墙钟界与最优调参的 Lazy Hessian 同阶标度，且无需选择复用周期。在两个 LIBSVM 数据集上，实现比 Lazy 与 Vanilla cubic Newton 更早在墙钟时间上降低目标函数，中等精度处收益最大。
Conclusion: 把曲率计算从阻塞改为延迟后台化，可以在不选复用周期的前提下保持与调优 Lazy Hessian 相当的墙钟标度，并在中等精度区间取得实际加速。

papers.title: FedHUG: Federated Heterogeneous Unsupervised Generalization for Remote Physiological Measurements
papers.abstract_en: Remote physiological measurement gained wide attention, while it requires collecting users' privacy-sensitive information, and existing contactless measurements still rely on labeled client data. This presents challenges when we want to further update real-world deployed models with numerous user data lacking labels. To resolve these challenges, we instantiate a new protocol called Federated Unsupervised Domain Generalization (FUDG) in this work. Subsequently, the \textbf{Fed}erated \textbf{H}eterogeneous \textbf{U}nsupervised \textbf{G}eneralization (\textbf{FedHUG}) framework is proposed and consists of: (1) Minimal Bias Aggregation module dynamically adjusts aggregation weights based on prior-driven bias evaluation to cope with heterogeneous non-IID features from multiple domains. (2) The Global Distribution-aware Learning Controller parameterizes the label distribution and dynamically manipulates client-specific training strategies, thereby mitigating the server-client label distribution skew and long-tail issue. The proposal shows superior performance across state-of-the-art techniques in estimation with either RGB video or mmWave radar. The code will be released.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出联邦无监督域泛化 (FUDG) 协议与 FedHUG 框架，用于在客户端无标签、多域非 IID 条件下更新远程生理测量模型：最小偏置聚合按先验驱动的偏置评估动态调聚合权重，全局分布感知学习控制器参数化标签分布并动态调整客户端训练策略。在 RGB 视频与 mmWave 雷达两种模态的估计任务上均优于现有技术。
Motivation: 远程生理测量需采集用户隐私敏感信息，且现有无接触测量仍依赖带标签的客户端数据；真实部署后大量用户数据无标签，多域非 IID 与服务器-客户端标签分布偏斜、长尾问题使模型难以继续更新。
Method: FedHUG 含两个模块：Minimal Bias Aggregation 依据先验驱动的偏置评估动态调整聚合权重以应对多域异构非 IID 特征；Global Distribution-aware Learning Controller 参数化标签分布并动态操纵客户端特定训练策略，缓解标签分布偏斜与长尾。
Result: 在 RGB 视频与 mmWave 雷达两种输入模态的生理参数估计上，性能优于现有最先进技术；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 联邦无监督域泛化可在不收集带标签客户端数据的前提下更新远程生理测量模型，聚合偏置控制与标签分布建模是关键；代码将开源。

papers.title: Surrogate Graph Partitioning for Spatial Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Spatial prediction refers to the estimation of unobserved values from spatially distributed observations. Although recent advances have improved the capacity to model diverse observation types, adoption in practice remains limited in industries that demand interpretability. To mitigate this gap, surrogate models that explain black-box predictors provide a promising path toward interpretable decision making. In this study, we propose a graph partitioning problem to construct spatial segments that minimize the sum of within-segment variances of individual predictions. The assignment of data points to segments can be formulated as a mixed-integer quadratic programming problem. While this formulation potentially enables the identification of exact segments, its computational complexity becomes prohibitive as the number of data points increases. Motivated by this challenge, we develop an approximation scheme that leverages the structural properties of graph partitioning. Experimental results demonstrate the computational efficiency of this approximation in identifying spatial segments.
papers.comment: The authors have mutually agreed to withdraw this manuscript, as they no longer intend to pursue it as a joint work. The subsequent research will be pursued under a different authorship arrangement
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为提升空间预测黑箱模型的可解释性，提出把数据点分配到空间分段的图划分问题，目标是最小化各分段内预测值方差之和，并将其写成混合整数二次规划 (MIQP)。该精确形式在数据点增多时计算代价过高，作者据此利用图划分的结构性质设计近似方案，实验显示其在识别空间分段上计算高效。
Motivation: 空间预测虽能建模多样观测类型，但在要求可解释性的行业中落地有限；用 surrogate model 解释黑箱预测是可行路径，而精确分段划分的 MIQP 规模一大就算不动。
Method: 构造以最小化分段内预测方差之和为目标的图划分问题，将数据点到分段的指派形式化为混合整数二次规划；针对其计算复杂度，利用图划分的结构性质设计近似求解方案。
Result: 实验结果表明该近似方案在识别空间分段 (spatial segments) 上具有计算效率；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 精确 MIQP 分段划分难以扩展，借助图划分结构性质的近似方案可在保持分段质量的同时大幅降低计算代价，服务于对黑箱空间预测的可解释解释。

papers.title: Mixture of Many Zero-Compute Experts: A High-Rate Quantization Theory Perspective
papers.abstract_en: This paper uses classical high-rate quantization theory to provide new insights into mixture-of-experts (MoE) models for regression tasks. Our MoE is defined by a segmentation of the input space to regions, each with a single-parameter expert that acts as a constant predictor with zero-compute at inference. Motivated by high-rate quantization theory assumptions, we assume that the number of experts is sufficiently large to make their input-space regions very small. This lets us study the approximation error of our MoE model class: (i) for one-dimensional inputs, we formulate the test error and its minimizing segmentation and experts; (ii) for multidimensional inputs, we formulate an upper bound for the test error and study its minimization. Moreover, we consider the learning of the expert parameters from a training dataset, given an input-space segmentation, and formulate their statistical learning properties. This leads us to theoretically and empirically show how the tradeoff between approximation and estimation errors in MoE learning depends on the number of experts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用高率量化理论 (high-rate quantization theory) 分析回归任务的 MoE：把输入空间切成区域，每个区域放一个零推理计算的常数预测专家，并在专家数足够多、区域足够小的假设下推导测试误差。一维情形给出测试误差及其最优分割与专家取值，多维情形给出测试误差上界及其最小化；理论与实验都表明 MoE 学习中逼近误差与估计误差的权衡随专家数变化。
Motivation: MoE 的专家数如何权衡逼近误差与估计误差缺少理论刻画，尤其在专家是零计算常数预测器这一极端设定下，输入空间分割与测试误差的关系不清晰。
Method: 将 MoE 定义为输入空间的区域分割，每区域配单参数常数专家（推理零计算）；借高率量化理论假设专家数足够大使区域足够小，一维输入直接给出测试误差及其最小化分割与专家参数，多维输入给出测试误差上界并最小化；再在给定分割下推导专家参数从训练集学习的统计学习性质。
Result: 给出一维测试误差的显式形式与最优分割/专家取值，多维测试误差上界及其最小化；理论与实证共同显示逼近误差与估计误差的权衡随专家数变化。
Conclusion: 专家数是 MoE 回归中逼近误差与估计误差权衡的主控量，可用高率量化理论框架来刻画并指导分割与专家参数的学习。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Approximation of differential entropy in Bayesian optimal experimental design
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian optimal experimental design provides a principled framework for selecting experimental configurations that maximize obtained information. In this work, we consider settings where the likelihood entropy is independent of the design or can be evaluated explicitly, which applies, e.g. to additive noise models with design-independent or explicitly computable noise entropy. This reduces the problem to maximum entropy estimation, where the nested integral defining the expected information gain collapses into a single integral. Our study is motivated by large-scale inference problems, such as inverse problems, where the computational cost is dominated by expensive likelihood evaluations. Under additive Gaussian noise model, we propose a computational approach in which the evidence density is approximated by a Monte Carlo or quasi-Monte Carlo surrogate, while the differential entropy is evaluated using standard methods without additional likelihood evaluations. We prove that this strategy achieves convergence rates that are comparable to, or better than, state-of-the-art methods for full expected information gain estimation, particularly when the cost of entropy evaluation is negligible. Our approach relies only on mild smoothness of the forward map and avoids stronger technical assumptions required in earlier work. We also present numerical experiments, which confirm some of our theoretical findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在似然熵与设计无关（如加性噪声）的贝叶斯最优实验设计中，期望信息增益的嵌套积分退化为单重积分，作者用 Monte Carlo 或 quasi-Monte Carlo 代理逼近 evidence density，再用标准方法直接算微分熵。证明其收敛速率可比肩甚至优于完整 EIG 估计的现有方法，且只依赖前向映射的温和光滑性。
Motivation: 大规模反问题中似然评估极贵，完整期望信息增益 (EIG) 的嵌套积分计算代价被似然调用主导；已有方法还要求较强的技术假设。
Method: 针对加性高斯噪声模型，用 Monte Carlo 或 quasi-Monte Carlo 构造 evidence density 的代理，在不额外调用似然的前提下以标准方法计算微分熵，把嵌套积分化为单重积分；并给出收敛速率证明。
Result: 证明该策略的收敛速率与当前最优的完整 EIG 估计方法相当或更好，尤其在熵计算成本可忽略时；仅依赖前向映射的温和光滑性，避免了早期工作更强的技术假设。数值实验确认了部分理论发现。
Conclusion: 当似然熵与设计无关或可显式计算时，最优实验设计可化归为最大熵估计，用代理逼近 evidence density 即可在少调用似然的情况下得到有速率保证的信息增益估计。

papers.title: Multidimensional Bayesian Active Machine Learning of Working Memory Task Performance
papers.abstract_en: While adaptive experimental design has outgrown one-dimensional, staircase-based adaptations, most cognitive experiments still control a single factor and summarize performance with a scalar. In contrast, we validate here a Bayesian, two-axis, active-classification approach in an immersive virtual testing environment, using a 5-by-5 spatial working-memory reconstruction task as an application domain. Two variables are controlled: spatial load L (number of occupied tiles) and feature-binding load K (number of distinct colors) of items. Stimulus acquisition is guided by posterior uncertainty of a nonparametric Gaussian Process (GP) probabilistic classifier, which outputs a surface over (L, K) rather than a single threshold or maximum span value. In a young adult population, we compare GP-driven Adaptive Mode (AM) with a traditional adaptive staircase Classic Mode (CM), which varies L only at K = 3. Parity between the methods is achieved for this cohort, with an intraclass correlation coefficient of 0.755 at K = 3. As a secondary exploratory result, AM reveals individual differences in interactions between spatial load and feature binding. AM estimates converge more quickly than other sampling strategies, demonstrating that only about 30 samples are required for accurate fitting of the full model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把认知实验的自适应设计从单因子阶梯法扩展到双轴贝叶斯主动分类：用非参数高斯过程 (GP) 在空间负载 L 与特征绑定负载 K 构成的二维平面上输出概率分类曲面，按后验不确定性选刺激。在沉浸式虚拟环境的 5×5 空间工作记忆重建任务上，GP 驱动的 Adaptive Mode 与只变 L、固定 K=3 的传统阶梯法在年轻成人队列上等效（K=3 处组内相关系数 ICC=0.755），且 AM 收敛更快，约 30 个样本即可准确拟合完整模型。
Motivation: 多数认知实验仍只控制单一因子、用标量概括表现，传统阶梯法 (staircase) 只能给出单一阈值或最大跨度，无法刻画两个负载维度之间的交互。
Method: 在沉浸式虚拟测试环境中做 5×5 空间工作记忆重建任务，同时控制空间负载 L（占用格子数）与特征绑定负载 K（不同颜色数）；用非参数高斯过程概率分类器输出 (L, K) 平面上的分类曲面，按后验不确定性引导刺激采集，与只变 L、K=3 的传统阶梯法 Classic Mode 对照。
Result: 在年轻成人人群中，AM 与 CM 表现等效，K=3 处 ICC=0.755；AM 收敛快于其他采样策略，约 30 个样本即可准确拟合完整模型；作为次级探索性结果，AM 揭示了空间负载与特征绑定交互上的个体差异。
Conclusion: 双轴贝叶斯主动分类可以在不损失与传统阶梯法一致性的前提下，把认知表现从单一阈值扩展为二维负载曲面，并用约 30 个样本完成拟合。

papers.title: Access Paths for Efficient Ordering with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we present the \texttt{LLM ORDER BY} semantic operator as a logical abstraction and conduct a systematic study of its physical implementations. First, we propose several improvements to existing semantic sorting algorithms and introduce a semantic-aware external merge sort algorithm. Our extensive evaluation reveals that no single implementation offers universal optimality on all datasets. From our evaluations, we observe a general scaling relationship between sorting cost and the ordering quality for comparison-based algorithms. Building on these insights, we design a budget-aware optimizer that utilizes heuristic rules, LLM-as-Judge evaluation, and consensus aggregation to dynamically select the near-optimal access path for LLM ORDER BY. In our extensive evaluations, our optimizer consistently achieves ranking accuracy on par with or superior to the best static methods across all benchmarks. We believe that this work provides foundational insights into the principled optimization of semantic operators essential for building robust, large-scale LLM-powered analytic systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM 的语义排序抽象成 LLM ORDER BY 算子并系统比较其物理实现，发现没有单一实现在所有数据集上最优，且比较类算法的排序代价与排序质量之间存在一般性的 scaling 关系。据此设计 budget-aware optimizer，用启发式规则、LLM-as-Judge 与共识聚合动态选择访问路径，在全部 benchmark 上达到或超过最佳静态方法的 ranking accuracy。
Motivation: LLM 语义排序缺少统一的逻辑抽象与物理实现选择依据：不同实现在不同数据集上各有优劣，人工挑访问路径既无准则也难以在预算约束下取舍。
Method: 提出 LLM ORDER BY 语义算子作为逻辑抽象；改进已有语义排序算法并引入 semantic-aware external merge sort；再构建 budget-aware optimizer，组合启发式规则、LLM-as-Judge 评估与 consensus aggregation，动态选出近优访问路径。
Result: 系统评测显示无单一实现在所有数据集上普遍最优；观察到比较类算法中排序代价与排序质量之间的一般 scaling 关系；optimizer 在全部 benchmark 上的 ranking accuracy 与最佳静态方法持平或更优。
Conclusion: 语义算子的物理实现应按数据集与预算动态选路，而非固定单一算法；代价—质量的 scaling 关系加 LLM-as-Judge 共识足以支撑近优访问路径选择，为大规模 LLM 分析系统的语义算子优化提供原则性依据。

papers.title: User Trajectory Prediction Unifying Global and Local Temporal Information
papers.abstract_en: Trajectory prediction is essential for formulating proactive strategies that anticipate user mobility and support advance preparation. Therefore, how to reduce the forecasting error in user trajectory prediction within an acceptable inference time arises as an interesting issue. However, trajectory data contains both global and local temporal information, complicating the extraction of the complete temporal pattern. Moreover, user behavior occurs over different time scales, increasing the difficulty of capturing behavioral patterns. To address these challenges, a trajectory prediction model based on multilayer perceptron (MLP), multi-scale convolutional neural network (MSCNN), and cross-attention (CA) is proposed. Specifically, MLP is used to extract the global temporal information of each feature. In parallel, MSCNN is employed to extract the local temporal information by modeling interactions among features within a local temporal range. Convolutional kernels with different sizes are used in MSCNN to capture temporal information at multiple resolutions, enhancing the model's adaptability to different behavioral patterns. Finally, CA is applied to fuse the global and local temporal information. Experimental results show that our model reduces mean squared error (MSE) by 5.04% and mean absolute error (MAE) by 4.35% compared with ModernTCN in 12-step prediction, while maintaining similar inference time.
papers.comment: This manuscript has not passed peer review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向用户轨迹预测提出 MLP + MSCNN + cross-attention 的时序建模：MLP 抽全局时序、多尺度卷积核抽局部与多分辨率时序，CA 融合两者。在 12 步预测上相对 ModernTCN 的 MSE 降低 5.04%、MAE 降低 4.35%，推理时间相当。
Motivation: 轨迹数据同时含全局与局部时序信息，且用户行为跨越不同时间尺度，单一尺度的时序抽取难以覆盖完整行为模式，预测误差与推理时间需要同时控制。
Method: 模型由三部分组成：MLP 提取每个特征的全局时序信息；并行的 MSCNN 用不同尺寸卷积核在局部时间范围内建模特征间交互，抽取多分辨率局部时序；最后用 cross-attention (CA) 融合全局与局部表征。
Result: 在 12 步预测上，相对基线 ModernTCN，MSE 降低 5.04%，MAE 降低 4.35%，同时保持相近的推理时间。
Conclusion: 把全局与局部时序信息用 cross-attention 统一建模可在不增加推理时间的前提下降低用户轨迹预测误差。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Towards a Measure Theory of Semantic Information
papers.abstract_en: A classic account of the quantification of semantic information is that of Bar-Hiller and Carnap. Their account proposes an inverse relation between the informativeness of a statement and its probability. However, their approach assigns the maximum informativeness to a contradiction: which Floridi refers to as the Bar-Hillel-Carnap paradox. He developed a novel theory founded on a distance metric and parabolic relation, designed to remove this paradox. Unfortunately is approach does not succeed in that aim. In this paper I critique Floridi's theory of strongly semantic information on its own terms and show where it succeeds and fails. I then present a new approach based on the unit circle (a relation that has been the basis of theories from basic trigonometry to quantum theory). This is used, by analogy with von Neumann's quantum probability to construct a measure space for informativeness that meets all the requirements stipulated by Floridi and removes the paradox. In addition, while contradictions and tautologies have zero informativeness, it is found that messages which are contradictory to each other are equally informative. The utility of this is explained by means of an example.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 Bar-Hillel-Carnap 悖论（矛盾命题被判为信息量最大），作者批判 Floridi 基于距离度量与抛物线关系的强语义信息论，指出其未能消除悖论；随后以单位圆为几何基础，类比 von Neumann 量子概率构造语义信息的度量空间，使矛盾与重言式信息量为零，同时满足 Floridi 全部要求，并得到互相矛盾的消息信息量相等这一新性质。
Motivation: 经典语义信息量化中信息量与概率成反比，导致矛盾命题信息量最大（Bar-Hillel-Carnap 悖论）；Floridi 用距离度量与抛物线关系试图修复，但按作者论证并未成功。
Method: 先在 Floridi 自身设定下批判其强语义信息论，指出其成功与失败之处；再以单位圆为几何载体，类比 von Neumann 量子概率构造信息量的度量空间 (measure space)，并用一个例子说明其效用。
Result: 新度量空间满足 Floridi stipulated 的全部要求并消除 Bar-Hillel-Carnap 悖论；矛盾命题与重言式信息量为零，而互相矛盾的消息信息量相等。摘要未给出数值实验或数据集对比。
Conclusion: 以单位圆和量子概率类比构造的语义信息度量可在消除悖论的同时保留矛盾消息之间的对称信息量，作为对 Floridi 理论的替代方案。
