papers.title: DeltaLLM: Delta-Key Sparse Attention for Edge LLMs
papers.abstract_en: On-device LLM inference is increasingly important for edge platforms but remains challenging due to high computational and memory demands and tight resource constraints. Modern applications often involve long prompts. Although compact models reduce linear-layer costs through weight compression, attention remains largely unoptimized and becomes the dominant bottleneck, especially during prefilling. Existing attention pruning methods primarily target highly parallel hardware (e.g., GPUs) and long context windows, limiting their suitability for edge scenarios. We present DeltaLLM, a training-free LLM framework based on algorithm-hardware-dataflow co-design to accelerate prefilling attention. DeltaLLM introduces a causal-attention-aware K-only delta formulation that enables Delta-Key reuse across query heads under Grouped-Query Attention (GQA). A context-aware hybrid strategy preserves exact attention near the diagonal while applying delta approximation to nonlocal regions. For score-value multiplication, we propose a vectorized structured sparse online softmax (VSSOS) that converts fine-grained spatial score sparsity into hardware-friendly column-level skipping. A specialized vector-processor architecture and unified sparse/dense attention dataflow exploit the resulting sparsity. Evaluated on BitNet-b1.58-2B-4T and LLaMA3.2-1B-Instruct, DeltaLLM achieves up to 60% Delta-Key sparsity and 63% structured attention-score sparsity with negligible average accuracy loss. On the KV260 FPGA board, it delivers a 1.62x speedup over TeLLMe-v2 while reducing DSP and BRAM usage. These results show that DeltaLLM supports efficient edge LLM deployment and integration with existing pipelines without fine-tuning.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted by IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Artificial Intelligence (TCASAI)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeltaLLM 是面向边缘设备 LLM prefilling 注意力加速的免训练 (training-free) 框架，通过算法-硬件-数据流协同设计把注意力稀疏化落到向量处理器上。在 BitNet-b1.58-2B-4T 与 LLaMA3.2-1B-Instruct 上达到最高 60% Delta-Key 稀疏度与 63% 结构化注意力分数稀疏度，平均精度损失可忽略；在 KV260 FPGA 上相对 TeLLMe-v2 加速 1.62 倍，同时降低 DSP 与 BRAM 占用。
Motivation: 边缘平台上长 prompt 的 LLM 推理受算力与内存约束，权重压缩已降低线性层成本，但注意力（尤其 prefilling 阶段）仍是主要瓶颈；现有注意力剪枝方法面向 GPU 等高并行硬件和长上下文窗口，不适用于边缘场景。
Method: 提出免训练的算法-硬件-数据流协同设计：因果感知的 K-only delta 公式使 Delta-Key 可在 Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) 下跨 query head 复用；上下文感知混合策略在对角线附近保留精确注意力、对非局部区域用 delta 近似；针对 score-value 乘法提出向量化结构化稀疏在线 softmax (VSSOS)，把细粒度空间分数稀疏转成硬件友好的列级跳过；配套设计专用向量处理器架构与统一稀疏/稠密注意力数据流。
Result: 在 BitNet-b1.58-2B-4T 和 LLaMA3.2-1B-Instruct 上达到最高 60% Delta-Key 稀疏度与 63% 结构化注意力分数稀疏度，平均精度损失可忽略；在 KV260 FPGA 板上相对 TeLLMe-v2 加速 1.62 倍，并减少 DSP 与 BRAM 使用。
Conclusion: 注意力的 delta 近似加结构化稀疏可以在不微调的前提下支撑边缘 LLM 部署，并与现有推理流水线集成。

papers.title: From the Fluency Fallacy to the Micro-to-Macro Validity Gap: Opportunities and Pitfalls of LLMs in Social Simulation
papers.abstract_en: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into social simulation has generated enthusiasm but also raises methodological and epistemological challenges. This critical review examines LLMs as cognitive or decision-making components of simulated agents from a computational social science perspective. We argue that their behavioral and epistemic limitations can become systemic vulnerabilities when scaled to multi-agent societies. We map the evolving landscape of LLM-driven platforms, from narrative sandboxes to population-scale simulations, and develop a framework for analyzing the Micro-to-Macro Validity Gap: the propagation, amplification, or contraction of micro-level limitations-including hallucinations, stochastic inconsistency, representational biases, and alignment effects-into agent-level distortions (e.g., persona convergence) and macro-level risks (e.g., artificial consensus and behavioral homogenization). We also highlight evaluative vulnerabilities such as the Fluency Fallacy and automation bias. We identify contexts where LLM-based agents offer operational value, including serious games, participatory environments, and exploratory modeling, distinguishing these uses from confirmatory research with unconstrained models and precise social forecasting. Finally, we examine theory-driven hybrid architectures embedding LLMs in explicit, mechanistic, and reproducible Agent-Based Modeling (ABM) frameworks. While promising, these architectures do not guarantee epistemic control: validity requires multi-level evaluation of environmental dynamics, individual behavior, cross-level interactions, and aggregate outcomes. They also remain vulnerable to physics washing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇批判性综述，主张把 LLM 当作模拟智能体的认知/决策组件时，微观层面的幻觉、随机不一致、表征偏差与对齐效应会在多智能体社会中被传播、放大或收缩，最终变成宏观层面的人工共识与行为同质化。作者认为理论驱动的混合架构（把 LLM 嵌入显式、机制化、可复现的 ABM）虽有前景，但不保证认知可控，有效性必须靠跨层级评估来判定，且仍易受 physics washing 影响。
Motivation: LLM 驱动的社会模拟从叙事沙盒扩展到人口规模，但微观行为与认知缺陷如何跨尺度传导为宏观失真缺少系统分析框架，导致确认性研究与精确社会预测被过度信任。
Method: 从计算社会科学视角做批判性综述，梳理 LLM 驱动平台谱系（叙事沙盒到人口尺度模拟），提出 Micro-to-Macro Validity Gap 分析框架，追踪微观缺陷到智能体级扭曲（如 persona convergence）再到宏观风险的传导路径，并考察嵌入 ABM 的理论驱动混合架构。
Result: 识别出 Fluency Fallacy 与 automation bias 等评估性脆弱点；界定 LLM 智能体有操作价值的场景（serious games、参与式环境、探索性建模），并将其与无约束模型上的确认性研究及精确社会预测区分开；指出混合架构仍需对环境动态、个体行为、跨层级交互与聚合结果做多层评估。
Conclusion: LLM 智能体适合探索性与参与式用途，但不适用于确认性研究和精确社会预测；混合架构的有效性取决于多层评估而非架构本身。

papers.title: LLMail-Inject: A Dataset from a Realistic Adaptive Prompt Injection Challenge
papers.abstract_en: Indirect prompt injection attacks exploit a fundamental weakness of LLMs: executing unauthorized tasks from untrusted sources. Despite the practical significance of this attack vector, existing benchmarks rely on small sets of template-based attacks (100-1,000 examples) that fail to capture the diversity and adaptiveness of real-world adversaries. Consequently, benchmarks are saturated and overfit to static attacks. We introduce LLMail-Inject, a large-scale benchmark of 208,095 distinct human-written attack prompts collected through a public red-teaming challenge with 839 participants. LLMail-Inject evaluates the attack's complete chain of execution: prompts must be retrieved from an email database, evade production-level defenses, and trigger unauthorized tool calls with correct arguments. Evaluation reveals that models that achieve 5% attack success rate (ASR) on existing benchmarks fail more on LLMail-Inject: Meta SecAlign--specifically trained against prompt injection--still yields 32% ASR, GPT-4o exhibits 58% ASR, and GPT-5 mini 47% ASR. We further demonstrate that attacks transfer across domains, achieving 37% ASR on proof-of-concept coding tasks and 28-45% ASR on file management tasks. We release our challenge platform and curated evaluation subsets at multiple difficulty tiers and the full dataset with rich annotations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLMail-Inject 是一个 208,095 条人工撰写攻击提示的大规模间接提示注入基准，来自 839 名参与者的公开红队挑战，要求攻击从邮件库中被检索、绕过生产级防御并触发带正确参数的未授权工具调用。在既有基准上仅 5% ASR 的模型在此显著更差：Meta SecAlign 32%、GPT-4o 58%、GPT-5 mini 47%，且攻击可跨域迁移到编码任务 37%、文件管理任务 28–45%。
Motivation: 现有提示注入基准只用 100–1,000 条模板化攻击，无法覆盖真实对手的多样性与自适应性，导致基准饱和、模型对静态攻击过拟合。
Method: 通过公开红队挑战收集 839 名参与者提交的 208,095 条人工撰写攻击提示，构建 LLMail-Inject；评测覆盖完整执行链——从邮件数据库检索提示、规避生产级防御、触发参数正确的未授权工具调用，并发布挑战平台、多难度分级评测子集与带标注全量数据集。
Result: 在既有基准上 ASR 仅 5% 的模型在 LLMail-Inject 上失败更多：Meta SecAlign（专门针对提示注入训练）ASR 32%，GPT-4o 58%，GPT-5 mini 47%；攻击跨域迁移至概念验证编码任务 ASR 37%，文件管理任务 ASR 28–45%。
Conclusion: 静态模板基准已饱和，无法代表真实自适应提示注入风险；评测必须覆盖检索、防御规避与工具调用的完整执行链，并按难度分级。

papers.title: Intra- and Cross-Scale Feature Interaction Network for Referring Remote Sensing Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Referring remote sensing image segmentation (RRSIS) is a challenging multimodal task that requires accurate localization and pixel-level segmentation of targets specified by natural-language expressions. Existing RRSIS datasets remain limited in image resolution, scene diversity, and category coverage, which restricts the generalization ability and practical applicability of current methods. To advance this field, we introduce NWPU-Refer, the largest and most diverse bilingual RRSIS dataset to date. It contains 15,003 high-resolution images (1024--2048 px) collected from more than 30 countries across five continents, together with 49,745 annotated targets covering single-object, multi-object, and no-target scenarios. We further propose the Multi-scale Referring Segmentation Network (MRSNet), a framework tailored to the characteristics of remote sensing imagery. Specifically, MRSNet incorporates an Intra-scale Feature Interaction Module (IFIM) to refine fine-grained features within each encoder stage and a Hierarchical Feature Interaction Module (HFIM) to integrate cross-scale information while preserving spatial structure. Extensive experiments on NWPU-Refer and RRSIS-D demonstrate that MRSNet achieves strong and competitive performance across multiple metrics, especially under strict IoU thresholds and IoU-based evaluation, validating the effectiveness of the proposed dataset and model. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://github.com/CVer-Yang/NWPU-Refer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向遥感指代分割 (RRSIS) 的 MRSNet，用尺度内特征交互模块 (IFIM) 精修各编码阶段的细粒度特征，再用层级特征交互模块 (HFIM) 在保持空间结构的前提下融合跨尺度信息。配套发布双语数据集 NWPU-Refer：15,003 张 1024–2048 px 高分辨率图像、49,745 个标注目标，覆盖单目标、多目标与无目标场景。在 NWPU-Refer 与 RRSIS-D 上，MRSNet 在多个指标尤其严格 IoU 阈值与基于 IoU 的评测中表现强且有竞争力。
Motivation: 现有 RRSIS 数据集在图像分辨率、场景多样性与类别覆盖上受限，削弱了方法的泛化能力与实用性；同时遥感影像的多尺度特性需要专门的特征交互设计。
Method: MRSNet 由两部分组成：IFIM 在每个 encoder stage 内部做尺度内特征交互以精修细粒度特征，HFIM 做层级跨尺度信息融合并保持空间结构。配套数据集 NWPU-Refer 含 15,003 张 1024–2048 px 图像（30 多个国家、五大洲）与 49,745 个标注目标，含单目标、多目标、无目标三类场景，数据与代码在 GitHub 公开。
Result: 在 NWPU-Refer 与 RRSIS-D 上的实验中，MRSNet 在多个指标上取得强且有竞争力的表现，尤其在严格 IoU 阈值与基于 IoU 的评测下；数据集规模为 15,003 张图像、49,745 个标注目标。
Conclusion: 把尺度内精修与跨尺度融合分开建模，配合大规模高分辨率双语数据集，可在 RRSIS 的严格 IoU 评测下取得有竞争力的分割效果。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Physics-inspired Generative AI models via real hardware-based noisy quantum diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Quantum Diffusion Models (QDMs) are an emerging paradigm in Generative AI that aims to use quantum properties to improve the performances of their classical counterparts. However, existing algorithms are not easily scalable due to the limitations of near-term quantum devices. Following our previous work on QDMs, here we propose and implement two physics-inspired protocols. In the first, we use the formalism of quantum stochastic walks, showing that a specific interplay of quantum and classical dynamics in the forward process produces statistically more robust models generating sets of MNIST images with lower Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) than using totally classical dynamics. In the second approach, we realize an algorithm to generate images by exploiting the intrinsic noise of real IBM quantum hardware with only four qubits. Our work could be a starting point to pave the way for new scenarios for large-scale algorithms in quantum Generative AI, where quantum noise is neither mitigated nor corrected, but instead exploited as a useful resource.
papers.journal_ref: Parigi, M., Martina, S., Venturelli, F.A. et al. Physics-inspired Generative AI models via real hardware-based noisy quantum diffusion. Quantum Mach. Intell. 8, 110 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出两种物理启发的量子扩散模型 (QDM) 协议：其一用量子随机行走 (quantum stochastic walks) 构造前向过程，让量子与经典动力学的特定耦合产生统计上更稳健的生成模型，其 MNIST 生成的 FID 低于纯经典动力学；其二直接利用真实 IBM 量子硬件仅 4 个量子比特的内生噪声生成图像。核心主张是量子噪声不必缓解或纠正，可作为生成资源使用。
Motivation: 现有 QDM 算法受近期含噪量子器件规模限制，难以扩展；作者要绕开噪声纠正，转而把噪声本身变成可用的生成机制。
Method: 协议一在前向过程中引入量子随机行走形式，调节量子与经典动力学的耦合；协议二在真实 IBM 硬件上以 4 qubit 的固有噪声驱动图像生成，两者均为物理启发的 QDM 实现。
Result: 协议一在 MNIST 图像集上取得比完全经典动力学更低的 Fréchet Inception Distance (FID)，且模型统计上更稳健；协议二在仅 4 qubit 的真实 IBM 硬件上实现图像生成。
Conclusion: 量子噪声可以既不缓解也不纠正、而作为有用资源来支撑生成式 AI，作者认为这可成为大规模量子生成算法的起点。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Breaking the Cloak! Unveiling Chinese Cloaked Toxicity with Homophone Graph and Toxic Lexicon
papers.abstract_en: Social media platforms have experienced a significant rise in toxic content, including abusive language and discriminatory remarks, presenting growing challenges for content moderation. Some users evade censorship by deliberately disguising toxic words through homophonic cloak, which necessitates the task of unveiling cloaked toxicity. Existing methods are mostly designed for English texts, while Chinese cloaked toxicity unveiling has not been solved yet. To tackle the issue, we propose C$^2$TU, a novel training-free and prompt-free method for Chinese cloaked toxic content unveiling. It first employs substring matching to identify candidate toxic words based on Chinese homophone graph and toxic lexicon. Then it filters those candidates that are non-toxic and corrects cloaks to be their corresponding toxicities. Specifically, we develop two model variants for filtering, which are based on BERT and LLMs, respectively. For LLMs, we address the auto-regressive limitation in computing word occurrence probability and utilize the full semantic contexts of a text sequence to reveal cloaked toxic words. Extensive experiments demonstrate that C$^2$TU can achieve superior performance on two Chinese toxic datasets. In particular, our method outperforms the best competitor by up to 71% on the F1 score and 35% on accuracy, respectively. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/XDxc-cuber/C2TU-Chinese-cloaked-toxicity-unveiling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 C²TU：面向中文谐音伪装毒性文本的免训练、免提示识别方法，用中文同音字图与毒性词表做子串匹配召回候选，再用 BERT 或 LLM 变体过滤非毒性候选并把伪装纠正回原毒性词。在两个中文毒性数据集上，相对最优基线 F1 最高提升 71%、准确率最高提升 35%。
Motivation: 社交媒体用户用谐音字伪装毒性词绕过审核，现有揭幕方法几乎都为英文设计，中文场景尚无有效方案。
Method: C²TU 先基于中文同音字图 (homophone graph) 与毒性词表做子串匹配，召回候选伪装词；再用两个过滤变体（基于 BERT 与基于 LLM）剔除非毒性候选并纠正伪装。针对 LLM 自回归无法计算整词出现概率的问题，改用整句完整语义上下文来判定。
Result: 在两个中文毒性数据集上，C²TU 相对最优竞争方法 F1 最高提升 71%、准确率最高提升 35%；方法免训练、免提示。
Conclusion: 同音字图加毒性词表的检索式召回配合 BERT/LLM 过滤，可以在中文上解决谐音伪装毒性识别，且无需训练与提示工程。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ReasoningShield: Safety Detection over Reasoning Traces of Large Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) leverage explicit reasoning traces, known as Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, to decompose complex problems into intermediate steps before deriving final answers. However, these reasoning traces introduce unique safety challenges: harmful content can be embedded in intermediate steps even when final answers appear benign. Our study reveals that existing state-of-the-art moderation tools experience significant performance degradation on CoT moderation, with F1 scores dropping by up to 35.2% compared to traditional answer moderation. To address these challenges, we present ReasoningShield, a comprehensive benchmark and a suite of strong lightweight models for CoT safety moderation. Our benchmark includes 9.2K annotated (Query, CoT) pairs with structured stepwise risk analysis, consisting of a 7K-sample training set and a 2.2K human-annotated test set, spanning 10 risk categories, 3 safety levels, and 8 LRMs with diverse reasoning paradigms. To further demonstrate the utility of the benchmark, we develop lightweight models with 1B/3B parameters using a two-stage training strategy. Resources are publicly available: Project Page: https://cosmosyi.github.io/ReasoningShield/, Code: https://github.com/CosmosYi/ReasoningShield, Models: https://huggingface.co/ReasoningShield/models, and Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ReasoningShield/ReasoningShield-Dataset.

papers.title: Heterogeneity-Aware Client Sampling for Optimal and Efficient Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) commonly involves clients with diverse communication and computational capabilities. Such heterogeneity can significantly distort the optimization dynamics and lead to objective inconsistency, where the global model converges to an incorrect stationary point potentially far from the pursued optimum. Despite its critical impact, the joint effect of communication and computation heterogeneity has remained largely unexplored, due to the intrinsic complexity of their interaction. In this paper, we reveal the fundamentally distinct mechanisms through which heterogeneous communication and computation drive inconsistency in FL. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first unified theoretical analysis of general heterogeneous FL, offering a principled understanding of how these two forms of heterogeneity jointly distort the optimization trajectory under arbitrary choices of local solvers. Motivated by these insights, we propose Federated Heterogeneity-Aware Client Sampling, FedACS, a universal method to eliminate all types of objective inconsistency. We theoretically prove that FedACS converges to the correct optimum at a rate of $O(1/\sqrt{R})$, even in dynamic heterogeneous environments. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets show that FedACS outperforms state-of-the-art and category-specific baselines by 4.3%-36%, while reducing communication costs by 22%-89% and computation loads by 14%-105%, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 联邦学习中通信与计算异构会共同扭曲优化轨迹，使全局模型收敛到偏离目标的错误驻点。论文提出异构感知客户端采样方法 FedACS，从机制上消除各类 objective inconsistency，并证明其在动态异构环境下仍以 O(1/√R) 收敛到正确最优点。多数据集实验中 FedACS 相对 SOTA 与类别专用基线提升 4.3%–36%，同时通信开销降低 22%–89%、计算负载降低 14%–105%。
Motivation: FL 客户端在通信与计算能力上的异构会扭曲优化动态并导致 objective inconsistency，全局模型收敛到远离目标的错误驻点；两种异构的联合效应因交互复杂而基本未被研究。
Method: 先给出首个统一的一般异构 FL 理论分析，刻画通信异构与计算异构驱动不一致的不同机制，说明二者如何在任意 local solver 选择下共同扭曲优化轨迹；据此提出 FedACS（Federated Heterogeneity-Aware Client Sampling），一种消除各类 objective inconsistency 的通用客户端采样方法。
Result: 理论上证明 FedACS 在动态异构环境下以 O(1/√R) 速率收敛到正确最优点；多数据集实验中相对 state-of-the-art 与 category-specific 基线提升 4.3%–36%，通信开销降低 22%–89%，计算负载降低 14%–105%。
Conclusion: 通信与计算异构对 FL 不一致的作用机制可被统一刻画，而按该机制设计的客户端采样能同时保证收敛到正确最优点并压低通信与计算开销。

papers.title: WorldGenBench: A World-Knowledge-Integrated Benchmark for Reasoning-Driven Text-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent text-to-image (T2I) models achieve high visual fidelity and accurate explicit grounding from input prompts. However, image generation is fundamentally a process of semantic expansion. Beyond surface-level descriptions, generating authentic visual content requires supplementing prompts with unstated cues, a crucial step that current models frequently overlook. In response, we introduce WorldGenBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate how well T2I systems integrate factual grounding with contextual inference. Unlike prior work that isolates these abilities, WorldGenBench emphasizes their synergy, recognizing that true understanding requires both knowing and reasoning. To enable interpretable evaluation, we propose the Knowledge Checklist Score, which assesses whether generated images faithfully reflect key explicit and implicit semantic elements. Evaluating 24 models reveals persistent gaps: proprietary models like GPT-4o show strong integration, while most open-source systems lag, particularly in culturally diverse and scientific scenarios. Our analysis further identifies common failure modes, including semantic hallucination and the underrepresentation of non-Western knowledge, underscoring the limitations of current models in achieving real-world readiness. These findings highlight the need to guide future T2I models toward deeper, knowledge-aware generation. Project Page: \href{https://dwanzhang-ai.github.io/WorldGenBench/}{https://dwanzhang-ai.github.io/WorldGenBench/}
papers.comment: accepted at the 3rd Workshop on Generative Models for Computer Vision, CVPR 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WorldGenBench 是一个评测文生图 (T2I) 模型能否把事实性知识与上下文推理协同起来的基准，配套提出 Knowledge Checklist Score，逐项检查生成图是否忠实覆盖提示中显式与隐式语义要素。对 24 个模型的评测显示 GPT-4o 等闭源模型整合能力较强，多数开源模型明显落后，尤其在文化多样性与科学场景，并暴露语义幻觉与非西方知识欠表示两类失败模式。
Motivation: 图像生成本质是语义扩展，模型需补全提示中未言明的线索，而现有评测把知识掌握与推理能力割裂开，无法衡量二者协同，也难以解释失败原因。
Method: 提出 WorldGenBench 基准，联合考察事实性 grounding 与 contextual inference 的协同；配套提出可解释的 Knowledge Checklist Score，按生成图是否忠实反映关键显式与隐式语义要素打分，对 24 个 T2I 模型评测。
Result: 24 个模型的评测显示持续差距：GPT-4o 等专有模型整合能力强，多数开源系统落后，文化多样性与科学场景尤其突出；识别出语义幻觉 (semantic hallucination) 与非西方知识欠表示等失败模式。
Conclusion: 当前 T2I 模型离真实世界可用仍有距离，未来方向是把生成推向更深的、知识感知 (knowledge-aware) 的层面，同时兼顾文化多样与科学内容。

papers.title: EmbodiTTA: Resource-Efficient Test-Time Adaptation for Embodied Visual Systems
papers.abstract_en: Continual Test-time adaptation (CTTA) continuously adapts the deployed model on every incoming batch of data. While achieving optimal accuracy, existing CTTA approaches present poor real-world applicability on resource-constrained edge devices, due to the substantial memory overhead and energy consumption. In this work, we first introduce a novel paradigm -- on-demand TTA -- which triggers adaptation only when a significant domain shift is detected. Then, we present OD-TTA, an on-demand TTA framework for accurate and efficient adaptation on edge devices. OD-TTA comprises three innovative techniques: 1) a lightweight domain shift detection mechanism to activate TTA only when it is needed, drastically reducing the overall computation overhead, 2) a source domain selection module that chooses an appropriate source model for adaptation, ensuring high and robust accuracy, 3) a decoupled Batch Normalization (BN) update scheme to enable memory-efficient adaptation with small batch sizes. Extensive experiments show that OD-TTA achieves comparable and even better performance while reducing the energy and computation overhead remarkably, making TTA a practical reality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出按需测试时自适应 (on-demand TTA) 范式与 OD-TTA 框架：仅在检测到显著域偏移时才触发自适应，从而在边缘设备上大幅降低能耗与计算开销，同时保持与持续 TTA (CTTA) 相当甚至更好的精度。
Motivation: 现有 CTTA 对每个到来批次都持续自适应，精度最优但内存开销与能耗大，在资源受限的边缘设备上难以落地。
Method: OD-TTA 含三个组件：轻量域偏移检测机制按需激活 TTA；源域选择模块挑选合适的源模型以保证鲁棒精度；解耦的 Batch Normalization (BN) 更新方案支持小 batch 下的内存高效自适应。
Result: 实验显示 OD-TTA 在能耗与计算开销显著下降的同时，取得相当甚至更优的性能；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 按需触发加解耦 BN 更新可让 TTA 在边缘设备上成为实用方案，而不必为持续自适应付出全部能耗代价。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: WoundAmbit: Bridging State-of-the-Art Semantic Segmentation and Real-World Wound Care
papers.abstract_en: Chronic wounds affect a large population, particularly the elderly and diabetic patients, who often exhibit limited mobility and co-existing health conditions. Automated wound monitoring via mobile image capture can reduce in-person physician visits by enabling remote tracking of wound size. Semantic segmentation is key to this process, yet wound segmentation remains underrepresented in medical imaging research. To address this, we benchmark state-of-the-art deep learning models from general-purpose vision, medical imaging, and top methods from public wound challenges. For a fair comparison, we standardize training, data augmentation, and evaluation, conducting cross-validation to minimize partitioning bias. We also assess real-world deployment aspects, including generalization to an out-of-distribution wound dataset, computational efficiency, and interpretability. Additionally, we propose a reference object-based approach to convert AI-generated masks into clinically relevant wound size estimates and evaluate this, along with mask quality, for the five best architectures based on physician assessments. Overall, the transformer-based TransNeXt showed the highest levels of generalizability. Despite variations in inference times, all models processed at least one image per second on the CPU, which is deemed adequate for the intended application. Interpretability analysis typically revealed prominent activations in wound regions, emphasizing focus on clinically relevant features. Expert evaluation showed high mask approval for all analyzed models, with VWFormer and ConvNeXtS backbone performing the best. Size retrieval accuracy was similar across models, and predictions closely matched expert annotations. Finally, we demonstrate how our AI-driven wound size estimation framework, WoundAmbit, is integrated into a custom telehealth system.

papers.journal_ref: Machine Learning and Knowledge Discovery in Databases. Applied Data Science Track (ECML PKDD 2025). Lecture Notes in Computer Science, vol. 16021, pp. 285-303. Springer, Cham (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WoundAmbit 把语义分割模型标准化基准测试与参考物法尺寸换算整合进远程伤口监测系统：统一训练、增强与交叉验证后，Transformer 架构 TransNeXt 泛化性最高，VWFormer 与 ConvNeXtS backbone 在医师评估中掩膜批准度最好，全部模型在 CPU 上至少每秒处理一张图。
Motivation: 慢性伤口患者（老年人、糖尿病患者）行动不便，远程追踪伤口尺寸可减少线下就诊，但伤口分割在医学影像研究中代表性不足，且缺少统一基准与从掩膜到临床可用尺寸的转换。
Method: 对来自通用视觉、医学影像与公开伤口挑战赛的 SOTA 深度模型做统一基准：标准化训练、数据增强与评估并做交叉评测以减少划分偏差；评估分布外伤口数据集泛化、CPU 计算效率与可解释性；提出基于参考物 (reference object) 的方法把 AI 掩膜换算为临床伤口尺寸，并对五个最佳架构结合医师评估打分；最终集成进定制远程医疗系统。
Result: Transformer 架构 TransNeXt 泛化性最高；所有模型在 CPU 上至少每秒处理一张图像；可解释性分析的显著激活通常落在伤口区域；专家评估显示所有受分析模型掩膜批准度都高，其中 VWFormer 与 ConvNeXtS backbone 表现最好；五个最佳架构的尺寸检索精度相近，预测与专家标注高度吻合。
Conclusion: 标准化基准下现有分割模型已足以支撑 CPU 端远程伤口尺寸监测，瓶颈不在推理速度而在掩膜到临床尺寸的换算与泛化；WoundAmbit 框架已集成进定制远程医疗系统。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.conclusion: 标准化基准下现有分割模型已足以支撑 CPU 端远程伤口尺寸监测，瓶颈不在推理速度而在掩膜到临床尺寸的换算与泛化；WoundAmbit 框架已集成进定制远程医疗系统。

papers.title: Fast localized urban microclimate emulator: wind and temperatures in unseen urban morphologies
papers.abstract_en: Urban microclimate, encompassing wind and temperature fields shaped by building geometry, strongly affects building energy use, pedestrian wind comfort, pollutant dispersion, the urban heat island, and public health. Conventional Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) is computationally prohibitive for rapid assessments, while many deep learning approaches require extensive training data and struggle with generalization to unseen configurations. In this work, we present the Fast Localized Urban Microclimate Emulator (FLUME), a rapid, data-efficient, and geometry-aware framework based on a Fourier neural operator for predicting three-dimensional wind and temperature fields. FLUME assumes that, under prescribed inflow and thermal forcing, much of the spatial variation of these mean fields is controlled by surrounding building geometry. The framework introduces a Multi-Directional Distance Feature (MDDF), which captures geometry over adaptive, visibility-defined spatial scales. By decomposing simulations of only 23 urban blocks into smaller 3D patches enriched with precomputed MDDF information, FLUME enables learning from limited CFD data. The model achieves mean absolute errors of 0.2 m/s for streamwise velocity and 0.19$^{\circ}$C for temperature on unseen urban configurations. A deep ensemble provides a practical proxy for epistemic uncertainty, and conformal prediction transforms these estimates into calibrated prediction intervals. Ensemble spread is positively related to local prediction error, with greater uncertainty in roof-level shear layers, building wakes, and vertical velocity near the ground. These results indicate FLUME's potential for rapid scenario assessment in urban design and urban climate studies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FLUME 用 Fourier neural operator 加多方向距离特征 (MDDF)，从仅 23 个城市街区的 CFD 数据中学出几何感知的三维风温场快速替代模型，在未见过的城市形态上流向速度 MAE 0.2 m/s、温度 MAE 0.19°C。深集成与 conformal prediction 给出校准的预测区间，集成离散度与局部误差正相关，屋顶剪切层、建筑尾流和近地竖向速度不确定性最大。
Motivation: 常规 CFD 计算成本过高，无法支撑城市设计的快速情景评估；多数深度学习方法又依赖大量训练数据，且难以泛化到未见过的建筑配置。
Method: 基于 Fourier neural operator 构建 FLUME，引入 Multi-Directional Distance Feature (MDDF) 在自适应、可见性定义的空间尺度上编码周边建筑几何；把仅 23 个街区的 CFD 模拟切成小 3D patch 并附上预计算 MDDF，使模型能从有限数据学习；用 deep ensemble 作为认知不确定性代理，再用 conformal prediction 转成校准的预测区间。
Result: 在未见过的城市配置上，流向速度平均绝对误差 0.2 m/s，温度平均绝对误差 0.19°C；集成离散度与局部预测误差正相关，屋顶剪切层、建筑尾流与近地竖向速度处不确定性更大。
Conclusion: 在给定入流与热力强迫下，均值风温场的空间变化主要由周边建筑几何控制，因此少量 CFD 数据加几何特征即可支撑快速情景评估。

papers.title: Linear Multi-granular Body Modeling for Text-Driven Motion Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-motion generation is a rapidly growing field at the nexus of multimodal learning and computer graphics, enabling flexible and cost-effective applications in gaming, animation, robotics, and virtual reality. Existing part-aware pipelines typically split the body into segments and then recover whole-body coordination via attention-based fusion, which incurs quadratic complexity and fails to model part-level and whole-body cues simultaneously. Moreover, we observe that naively stacking spatial and temporal modules accumulates redundant features, thereby requiring deeper networks to achieve competitive fidelity. To address these issues, we propose HiSTF Mamba, a linear-time framework composed of Dual-Spatial Mamba, Bi-Temporal Mamba, and the Dynamic Spatiotemporal Fusion Module (DSFM). Dual-Spatial Mamba performs parallel part-based and whole-based modeling to simultaneously capture local joint dynamics and global coordination. Bi-Temporal Mamba employs bidirectional scanning to encode both short-term motion details and long-term dependencies. DSFM further removes redundancy and extracts complementary temporal information before fusing it with spatial features, yielding an expressive spatiotemporal representation. Extensive experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML demonstrate that HiSTF Mamba improves generation fidelity and semantic alignment while requiring substantially fewer parameters than existing segment-based architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HiSTF Mamba 用线性时间的 Mamba 结构做文本到动作生成：Dual-Spatial Mamba 并行做分部件与全身建模，Bi-Temporal Mamba 双向扫描编码短期细节与长期依赖，DSFM 先去冗余再与空间特征融合。在 HumanML3D 与 KIT-ML 上提升生成保真度与语义对齐，同时参数量显著少于现有分段式架构。
Motivation: 现有分部件流程先把身体拆成段、再用 attention 融合恢复全身协调，带来二次复杂度，且无法同时建模部件级与全身线索；朴素堆叠时空模块还会累积冗余特征，需要更深网络才能达到竞争性保真度。
Method: 提出线性时间框架 HiSTF Mamba，含三个组件：Dual-Spatial Mamba 并行执行基于部件与基于全身的建模以同时捕捉局部关节动态和全局协调；Bi-Temporal Mamba 用双向扫描编码短期动作细节与长期依赖；Dynamic Spatiotemporal Fusion Module (DSFM) 先去除冗余、抽取互补时间信息，再与空间特征融合成时空表征。
Result: 在 HumanML3D 与 KIT-ML 上的大量实验表明，HiSTF Mamba 提升生成保真度与语义对齐，且所需参数量显著少于现有 segment-based 架构。
Conclusion: 用线性时间的双向 Mamba 加去冗余融合替代二次复杂度的 attention 分部件管线，可以在更少参数下同时保住部件级与全身级的动作生成质量。

papers.title: Does Knowledge About Perceptual Uncertainty Help an Agent in Automated Driving?
papers.abstract_en: Agents in real-world scenarios like automated driving deal with uncertainty in their environment, in particular due to perceptual uncertainty. Although, reinforcement learning is dedicated to autonomous decision-making under uncertainty these algorithms are typically not informed about the uncertainty currently contained in their environment. On the other hand, uncertainty estimation for perception itself is typically directly evaluated in the perception domain, e.g., in terms of false positive detection rates or calibration errors based on camera images. Its use for deciding on goal-oriented actions remains largely unstudied. In this paper, we investigate how an agent's behavior is influenced by an uncertain perception and how this behavior changes if information about this uncertainty is available. Therefore, we consider a proxy task, where the agent is rewarded for driving a route as fast as possible without colliding with other road users. For controlled experiments, we introduce uncertainty in the observation space by perturbing the perception of the given agent while informing the latter. Our experiments show that an unreliable observation space modeled by a perturbed perception leads to a defensive driving behavior of the agent. Furthermore, when adding the information about the current uncertainty directly to the observation space, the agent adapts to the specific situation and in general accomplishes its task faster while, at the same time, accounting for risks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在自动驾驶代理的强化学习中，把感知不确定性信息直接放进观测空间，代理会针对当前不确定性调整行为：相比只面对被扰动的不可靠观测，加入不确定性信息后整体更快完成行驶任务，同时仍规避碰撞风险。仅被扰动的观测则使代理趋向防御性驾驶。
Motivation: 强化学习面向不确定条件下的自主决策，但通常不被告知环境当前包含多少不确定性；感知不确定性又多在感知域内用误检率或标定误差评估，其对目标导向行动的作用基本未被研究。
Method: 设置一个代理驾驶代理任务：奖励以最快速度行驶完路线且不与其他道路使用者碰撞。通过扰动给定代理的感知来在观测空间中引入受控不确定性，并将不确定性信息加入观测空间以做受控对比实验。
Result: 实验显示，被扰动感知建模的不可靠观测空间导致代理的防御性驾驶行为；把当前不确定性信息直接加入观测空间后，代理会适应具体情境，总体上更快完成任务，同时仍顾及风险。
Conclusion: 把感知不确定性作为观测的一部分提供给驾驶代理，可使其在风险与速度之间做出情境化的权衡，而不只是被动地因观测不可靠而保守。

papers.title: Disentangling Total-Variance and Signal-to-Noise-Ratio Improves Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have been widely adopted as a powerful generative framework across numerous scientific domains, yet their inherently iterative sampling process remains a significant computational bottleneck. While this is typically mitigated by reducing the number of reverse diffusion steps, sample quality becomes highly sensitive to the chosen noise schedule, i.e. the manner in which noise is introduced and the signal is reduced at each step. Although prior work has improved on the original variance-preserving and variance-exploding schedules, these approaches passively adjust the total variance, without direct independent control over it. In this work, we propose a novel total-variance/signal-to-noise-ratio disentangled (TV/SNR) framework, where TV and SNR can be controlled independently. Our approach reveals that schedules with exponentially exploding TV can be consistently improved by adopting a constant TV schedule while preserving the underlying SNR schedule. Furthermore, we demonstrate that generalizing the SNR schedule of optimal transport flow matching significantly enhances generation efficiency. Crucially, these gains remain consistent across various reverse diffusion solvers and reduce the search space to two independent and interpretable parameters, enabling fast and robust sampling for complex scientific applications, such as molecular structure generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出总方差/信噪比解耦 (TV/SNR) 的扩散噪声调度框架，使 TV 与 SNR 可独立控制。结论是：对指数爆炸 TV 的调度，保持原 SNR 调度并改用恒定 TV 可稳定提升样本质量；把最优传输流匹配 (optimal transport flow matching) 的 SNR 调度一般化能显著提高生成效率，且收益在多种反向扩散求解器上一致，搜索空间缩减为两个可独立解释的参数。
Motivation: 减少反向扩散步数是缓解扩散模型迭代采样开销的常用手段，但样本质量对噪声调度高度敏感；已有方差保持 (variance-preserving) 与方差爆炸 (variance-exploding) 调度的改进只能被动调整总方差，无法对 TV 与 SNR 各自独立直接控制。
Method: 构建 TV/SNR 解耦框架，把噪声调度拆成可独立设定的总方差与信噪比两条曲线；在保持底层 SNR 调度不变的前提下替换 TV 曲线（如改为恒定 TV），并把最优传输流匹配的 SNR 调度做一般化推广，最终把调度搜索空间压缩为两个独立且可解释的参数。
Result: 指数爆炸 TV 的调度在改用恒定 TV 后被一致改进；一般化 OT flow matching 的 SNR 调度显著提升生成效率；这些收益在多种反向扩散求解器上保持一致，搜索空间降为两个独立可解释参数，可用于分子结构生成等复杂科学应用。
Conclusion: TV 与 SNR 应当被当作两个独立设计变量而非绑定在一起，解耦后既能稳定提升质量也能加速采样，并让噪声调度调参变成两个可解释维度的快速稳健搜索。

papers.title: Bandits with Anytime Knapsacks
papers.abstract_en: We consider bandits with anytime knapsacks (BwAK), a novel version of the BwK problem where there is an \textit{anytime} cost constraint instead of a total cost budget. This problem setting introduces additional complexities as it mandates adherence to the constraint throughout the decision-making process. We propose SUAK (Strategic Under-utilization for Anytime Knapsacks), an algorithm that utilizes upper confidence bounds to identify the optimal mixture of arms while maintaining a balance between exploration and exploitation. SUAK is an adaptive algorithm that strategically utilizes the available budget in each round in the decision-making process and skips a round when it is possible to violate the anytime cost constraint. In particular, SUAK slightly under-utilizes the available cost budget to reduce the need for skipping rounds. We show that SUAK attains the same problem-dependent regret upper bound of $ O(K \log T)$ established in prior work under the simpler BwK framework, where $K$ denotes the number of arms, and $T$ denotes the time horizon. We also establish an instance-dependent lower bound showing that the $O(K\log T)$ dependence is unavoidable. Finally, we show via extensive simulations that SUAK achieves considerably higher rewards than naive adaptations of BwK algorithms that do not optimize learning under anytime cost constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在带 anytime 成本约束的多臂老虎机 (BwAK) 中提出 SUAK：用上置信界 (UCB) 学最优臂混合，每轮策略性少用一点预算以减少跳轮，仅在可能违反全程约束时才跳过该轮。证明其遗憾上界为 O(K log T)，与更简单的 BwK 框架已知界相同，并给出该 K、T 依赖不可改进的实例相关下界；仿真中奖励显著高于直接套用 BwK 算法的朴素改造。
Motivation: BwK 原本只有总成本预算，而实际系统常要求每一轮都满足成本约束；直接把 BwK 算法套到 anytime 约束上会频繁跳轮、损失奖励，且缺少匹配的遗憾界。
Method: SUAK 用上置信界 (UCB) 识别最优臂混合，逐轮自适应分配可用预算，通过轻微欠用当轮预算来降低跳轮概率，只在可能违反 anytime 成本约束时跳过该轮；分析给出问题相关遗憾上界与实例相关下界。
Result: SUAK 达到 O(K log T) 的问题相关遗憾上界（K 为臂数，T 为时域），与既有 BwK 结果相同；建立实例相关下界表明该 O(K log T) 依赖不可避免；仿真中其奖励显著高于未针对 anytime 成本约束优化的 BwK 算法朴素改造。
Conclusion: 在 anytime 成本约束下，轻微欠用预算加选择性跳轮即可把遗憾保持在 O(K log T)，且该依赖在该问题类中不可改进。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 在带 anytime 成本约束的多臂老虎机 (BwAK) 中提出 SUAK：用上置信界 (UCB) 学最优臂混合，每轮策略性少用一点预算以减少跳轮，仅在可能违反全程约束时才跳过该轮。证明其遗憾上界为 O(K log T)，与更简单的 BwK 框架已知界相同，并给出该 K、T 依赖不可改进的实例相关下界；仿真中奖励显著高于直接套用 BwK 算法的朴素改造。
summary_sections.motivation: BwK 原本只有总成本预算，而实际系统常要求每一轮都满足成本约束；直接把 BwK 算法套到 anytime 约束上会频繁跳轮、损失奖励，且缺少匹配的遗憾界。

summary_sections.result: SUAK 达到 O(K log T) 的问题相关遗憾上界（K 为臂数，T 为时域），与既有 BwK 结果相同；建立实例相关下界表明该 O(K log T) 依赖不可避免；仿真中其奖励显著高于未针对 anytime 成本约束优化的 BwK 算法朴素改造。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在 anytime 成本约束下，轻微欠用预算加选择性跳轮即可把遗憾保持在 O(K log T)，且该依赖在该问题类中不可改进。

papers.title: Leveraging Motion Estimation for Efficient Bayer-Domain Video Convolutional Networks
papers.abstract_en: Existing computer vision pipelines suffer from two efficiency bottlenecks: image signal processors (ISPs) first convert Bayer pixel data to RGB pixel by pixel, and video models repeatedly process temporally redundant frames, leading to high power consumption and latency. In this paper, we propose a novel framework that eliminates the ISP and leverages motion estimation to accelerate video vision tasks directly in the Bayer domain. We introduce Motion Estimation-based Video Convolution (MEVC), which integrates sliding-window motion estimation into each convolutional layer, enabling prediction and residual-based refinement that reduces redundant computations across frames. This design bridges the structural gap between block-based motion estimation and spatial convolution, enabling accurate, low-cost processing. Our end-to-end pipeline supports raw Bayer input and achieves over 70% reduction in FLOPs with minimal accuracy degradation across video semantic segmentation, depth estimation, and object detection benchmarks, using both synthetic Bayer-converted and real Bayer video datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MEVC (Motion Estimation-based Video Convolution)：在 Bayer 域直接做视频卷积，去掉 ISP 逐像素转 RGB 的环节，并把滑窗运动估计嵌入每个卷积层，用预测加残差精修消除帧间冗余计算。在视频语义分割、深度估计、目标检测基准上（合成 Bayer 转换与真实 Bayer 视频数据集）FLOPs 降低超过 70%，精度损失极小。
Motivation: 现有视觉管线有两处效率瓶颈：ISP 逐像素把 Bayer 转 RGB，视频模型又反复处理时间冗余帧，导致高功耗与高延迟。
Method: MEVC 把滑窗运动估计集成进每个卷积层，先做帧间预测再做残差精修，弥合块匹配运动估计与空间卷积之间的结构差距；端到端管线直接接收 raw Bayer 输入，绕过 ISP。
Result: 在视频语义分割、深度估计、目标检测三类基准上，配合合成 Bayer 转换与真实 Bayer 视频数据集，FLOPs 减少超过 70%，同时精度下降极小。
Conclusion: 把运动估计嵌入卷积层可在 Bayer 域内以低开销消除跨帧冗余计算，从而同时省掉 ISP 与大部分视频模型算力。

papers.title: CRM: Retrieval Model with Controllable Condition
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval models for recommendation need to account for outcomes such as watch time while searching large item corpora efficiently. We present the Controllable Retrieval Model (CRM), an outcome-conditioned retrieval framework that adds watch time as an input to the user tower. During training, CRM learns to predict the next item given its observed watch time; at inference, we supply a desired watch time to steer retrieval without retraining. The item tower is independent of the condition, so item embeddings can still be precomputed and indexed for approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search. We implement CRM as both a DNN-based two-tower model and a Decision Transformer. The Transformer interleaves item tokens with watch-time-to-go condition tokens, using the target watch time as a numerical prompt for next-item prediction. For each online request, we choose between the average and maximum watch times in the user's recent history as the condition. CRM is deployed in Kuaishou's short-video recommendation system, which serves over 400 million users. Online A/B tests show video watch time improvements of 0.372% in Kuaishou and 0.457% in Kuaishou Lite.
papers.comment: 4 pages. Revised version with improved presentation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出结果条件化检索框架 CRM：把目标观看时长作为条件喂进 user tower，推理时用期望时长引导检索而无需重训，item tower 与条件解耦以保留 ANN 索引。已部署于快手短视频推荐，线上 A/B 中观看时长提升 0.372%（快手）与 0.457%（快手 Lite）。
Motivation: 推荐检索要在海量物料上高效召回，同时还要照顾观看时长这类结果指标；传统双塔无法在推理时按期望结果调节召回方向。
Method: CRM 把观看时长作为输入加入 user tower，训练时以观测时长为条件预测下一个 item；推理时给定期望时长即可调节检索且不重训。实现为 DNN 双塔与 Decision Transformer 两种形式，Transformer 将 item token 与 watch-time-to-go 条件 token 交错，把目标时长当作数值 prompt；每次请求从用户近期历史的平均或最大时长中选条件。item tower 独立于条件，物料向量可预计算并建 ANN 索引。
Result: 部署于服务 4 亿以上用户的快手短视频推荐系统；线上 A/B 测试中视频观看时长在 Kuaishou 提升 0.372%，在 Kuaishou Lite 提升 0.457%。
Conclusion: 把结果指标作为可调条件注入 user tower，可以在不牺牲 ANN 检索效率的前提下用推理时提示调节召回，并在生产环境带来观看时长的正向收益。

papers.title: Understanding Transformer-based Vision Models through Inversion
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the internal mechanisms of deep neural networks remains a central challenge in machine learning. In computer vision, one promising yet only preliminarily explored approach is feature inversion via inverse networks, which reconstructs images from intermediate representations using trained inverse networks. In this study, we revisit feature inversion via inverse networks, introducing a novel, modular variant that enables a computationally more efficient application of the technique while, in some cases, producing semantically more coherent image reconstructions. We apply our method to large-scale transformer-based vision models, specifically Detection Transformer, Vision Transformer, Swin Transformer, and Data-Efficient Image Transformer, analyzing the resulting reconstructions across network depth. Our main analysis compares Detection Transformer and Vision Transformer, which exhibit the most informative differences among the evaluated architectures. At the same time, results for Swin Transformer and Data-Efficient Image Transformer support the broader applicability of our framework. Our findings reveal gradual representational changes across transformer layers as a shared characteristic of Detection Transformer and Vision Transformer, as well as systematic differences in how they preserve contextual shape and fine-grained image details, and in their robustness to color perturbations. These findings deepen understanding of transformer-based vision models and demonstrate the utility of modular feature inversion as an interpretability tool.
papers.comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), September 2026, available at: https://openreview.net/forum?id=O5sMv2o3EV . Code available at : https://github.com/wiskott-lab/inverse-tvm
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026, ISSN 2835-8856
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出模块化变体的特征反演 (feature inversion) 网络，从中间表示重建图像，并用它沿网络深度分析 Detection Transformer、Vision Transformer、Swin Transformer 与 Data-Efficient Image Transformer 的表征变化。发现 DETR 与 ViT 随层渐进式改变表征，且在保留上下文形状、细粒度细节与对颜色扰动的鲁棒性上存在系统差异。
Motivation: 深度网络内部机制仍是机器学习核心难题；视觉中的特征反演虽有前景但只被初步探索，原方法计算开销大，难以应用到大规模 transformer 视觉模型。
Method: 重访基于 inverse network 的特征反演，提出一种模块化变体，使该技术计算上更高效、部分情形下重建语义更连贯；将方法应用于 DETR、ViT、Swin Transformer 与 DeiT，沿网络深度分析重建结果，主分析对比 DETR 与 ViT。
Result: DETR 与 ViT 在各评估架构中差异信息量最大，二者共享跨层渐进式表征变化这一特征，同时在保留上下文形状与细粒度图像细节的方式、以及对颜色扰动的鲁棒性上存在系统差异；Swin Transformer 与 DeiT 的结果支持该框架的更广适用性。
Conclusion: 模块化特征反演可作为可解释性工具，用于揭示 transformer 视觉模型跨层的表征演化与架构间差异。

papers.title: Conditional Vendi Score: Prompt-Aware Diversity Evaluation for Generative AI Models and LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Generative models guided by text prompts are widely evaluated for fidelity and prompt alignment, yet their ability to produce diverse outputs remains underexplored. Existing diversity metrics such as Vendi and RKE, which are based on the von Neumann and Rényi entropies of kernel matrices, were developed for unconditional models and cannot distinguish prompt-induced from model-induced variability. We address this gap by introducing \textit{Conditional-Vendi} and \textit{Conditional-RKE}, diversity measures derived from the conditional entropy of positive semidefinite matrices. These scores isolate model-induced diversity in prompt-guided generation, with Conditional-RKE enjoying an $O(1/\sqrt{n})$ convergence rate. For Conditional-Vendi, we introduce a truncated-spectrum approximation that yields scalable and consistent estimates. Experiments on text-to-image, image-captioning, and LLM tasks show that the conditional scores recover ground-truth diversity orderings and can also guide diffusion models toward more diverse samples. The codebase is available at https://github.com/mjalali/conditional-vendi.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Conditional-Vendi 与 Conditional-RKE 两个条件多样性度量，基于半正定矩阵的条件熵把 prompt 引起的变异与模型自身引起的变异分离开。Conditional-RKE 具有 O(1/√n) 收敛率，Conditional-Vendi 用截断谱近似得到可扩展且一致的估计；在文生图、图像描述与 LLM 任务上能复现真实多样性排序，并可反过来引导 diffusion 生成更多样的样本。
Motivation: 现有 Vendi、RKE 等基于核矩阵 von Neumann / Rényi 熵的多样性指标是为无条件模型设计的，无法区分 prompt 诱导的变异与模型诱导的变异，而 prompt 引导生成的多样性评估长期被忽略。
Method: 从半正定矩阵的条件熵出发定义 Conditional-Vendi 与 Conditional-RKE，用于隔离 prompt 引导生成中的模型诱导多样性；对 Conditional-Vendi 提出截断谱近似以获得可扩展且一致的估计，并在文生图、图像描述和 LLM 任务上做实验。
Result: Conditional-RKE 具有 O(1/√n) 收敛率；截断谱近似给出可扩展且一致的 Conditional-Vendi 估计；在 text-to-image、image-captioning 与 LLM 任务上，条件分数能复现 ground-truth 多样性排序，并可指导 diffusion 模型产生更多样的样本。
Conclusion: 把 prompt 变异从模型变异中条件化分离后，多样性度量才能在 prompt 引导生成上给出正确排序，并可作为生成过程的多样性引导信号。

papers.title: Deep End-to-End Survival Analysis with Temporal Consistency
papers.abstract_en: In this study, we present a novel Survival Analysis algorithm designed to efficiently handle large-scale longitudinal data. Our approach draws inspiration from Reinforcement Learning principles, particularly the Deep Q-Network paradigm, extending Temporal Learning concepts to Survival Regression. A central argument in our method relies on temporal consistency, a recursive consistency condition between survival predictions made at consecutive states. Our framework introduces a delayed target network that decouples the generation of temporally consistent training targets from model updates, providing a more stable training signal while enabling mini-batch optimization and end-to-end training. Additionally, it supports arbitrarily complex architectures, enabling the modeling of intricate temporal dependencies. Through numerous experiments we provide empirical evidence demonstrating our framework's ability to exploit temporal consistency across datasets of varying sizes. Moreover, our algorithm outperforms benchmarks on datasets with long sequences, demonstrating its ability to capture long-term patterns. Finally, ablation studies show that the degree of target delay has a substantial effect on predictive performance and training variability. Across two distinct survival model families, delayed target updates consistently improve over the same-timescale baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出把 Deep Q-Network 的延迟目标网络思想移植到生存回归 (Survival Regression) 的端到端训练框架：在连续状态间施加生存预测的递归时间一致性约束，并用延迟目标网络把一致目标的生成与模型更新解耦。在多个不同规模数据集上，该框架在长序列数据集上超过基准，且延迟目标更新在两类生存模型族上一致优于同时间尺度基线。
Motivation: 大规模纵向数据的生存分析难以在保持时间一致性的同时做小批量端到端优化，现有方法在长序列上难以捕捉长期依赖。
Method: 借鉴 Reinforcement Learning 的 Deep Q-Network 范式，把 Temporal Learning 扩展到 Survival Regression；核心是相邻状态间生存预测的递归一致性条件 (temporal consistency)，配合延迟目标网络解耦一致目标生成与模型更新，支持小批量优化、端到端训练和任意复杂架构。
Result: 在不同规模的多个数据集上验证时间一致性的可利用性；在长序列数据集上超过 benchmarks；ablation 显示目标延迟程度显著影响预测性能与训练变异度；在两类不同的生存模型族上，延迟目标更新一致优于同时间尺度基线。
Conclusion: 把延迟目标网络引入生存回归，可以在长序列纵向数据上稳定训练并提升预测性能，且该收益跨模型族成立。

summary_sections.result: 在不同规模的多个数据集上验证时间一致性的可利用性；在长序列数据集上超过 benchmarks；ablation 显示目标延迟程度显著影响预测性能与训练变异度；在两类不同的生存模型族上，延迟目标更新一致优于同时间尺度基线。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把延迟目标网络引入生存回归，可以在长序列纵向数据上稳定训练并提升预测性能，且该收益跨模型族成立。

papers.title: Optimising for the Unknown: Domain Alignment for Cephalometric Landmark Detection
papers.abstract_en: Cephalometric Landmark Detection is the process of identifying key areas for cephalometry. Each landmark is a single GT point labelled by a clinician. A machine learning model predicts the probability locus of a landmark represented by a heatmap. This work, for the 2024 CL-Detection MICCAI Challenge, proposes a domain alignment strategy with a regional facial extraction module and an X-ray artefact augmentation procedure. The challenge ranks our method's results as the best in MRE of 1.186mm and third in the 2mm SDR of 82.04% on the online validation leaderboard. The code is available at https://github.com/Julian-Wyatt/OptimisingfortheUnknown.
papers.comment: 1st place in the MICCAI CL-Detection 2024 Challenge: Cephalometric Landmark Detection in Lateral X-ray Images
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 MICCAI CL-Detection 2024 头影测量 landmark 检测挑战，提出域对齐策略：区域面部提取模块加 X-ray 伪影增强，把单点标注的 landmark 预测为热力图概率分布。在线验证榜上 MRE 1.186mm 排名第一，2mm SDR 82.04% 排名第三。

Method: 域对齐策略包含区域面部提取模块 (regional facial extraction module) 与 X-ray 伪影增强流程 (X-ray artefact augmentation)，模型输出 landmark 的热力图概率 locus 而非直接回归单点。
Result: 在 MICCAI CL-Detection 2024 挑战在线验证榜上，MRE 为 1.186mm 排名第一，2mm SDR 为 82.04% 排名第三。

papers.title: Instance-Level Difficulty: A Missing Perspective in Machine Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Current research on deep machine unlearning primarily focuses on improving or evaluating the overall effectiveness of unlearning methods while overlooking the varying difficulty of unlearning individual training samples. As a result, the broader feasibility of machine unlearning remains under-explored. This paper studies the cruxes that make machine unlearning difficult through a thorough instance-level unlearning performance analysis over various unlearning algorithms and datasets. In particular, we summarize four factors that make unlearning a data point difficult, and we empirically show that these factors are independent of a specific unlearning algorithm but only relevant to the target model and its training data. Given these findings, we argue that machine unlearning research should pay attention to the instance-level difficulty of unlearning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 机器遗忘研究只看整体遗忘效果，忽略单个训练样本的遗忘难度差异。论文对多种遗忘算法与数据集做实例级遗忘性能分析，归纳出使某个数据点难以被遗忘的四个因素，并实证表明这四个因素与具体遗忘算法无关，只取决于目标模型及其训练数据。
Motivation: 现有深度机器遗忘研究集中于提升或评估遗忘方法的整体有效性，个体训练样本的遗忘难度差异被长期忽略，导致机器遗忘的更广泛可行性未被充分探索。
Method: 在多种遗忘算法与多个数据集上做实例级遗忘性能分析，从中归纳四个导致单个数据点难以遗忘的因素，并检验这些因素是否随遗忘算法变化。
Result: 归纳出四个使数据点难以遗忘的因素，并实证显示这四个因素独立于具体遗忘算法，只与目标模型及其训练数据相关。
Conclusion: 机器遗忘研究应把实例级遗忘难度作为独立视角纳入评估，因为难度由模型与训练数据决定，而非由遗忘算法决定。

papers.title: Data-Driven Stochastic Optimal Control in Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a fully data-driven approach for optimal control of nonlinear control-affine systems represented by a stochastic diffusion. The focus is on the scenario where both the nonlinear dynamics and stage cost functions are unknown, while only a control penalty function and constraints are provided. To this end, we embed state probability densities into a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) to leverage recent advances in operator regression, thereby identifying Markov transition operators associated with controlled diffusion processes. This operator learning approach integrates naturally with convex operator-theoretic Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman recursions that scale linearly with state dimensionality, effectively solving a wide range of nonlinear optimal control problems. Numerical results demonstrate its ability to address diverse nonlinear control tasks, including the depth regulation of an autonomous underwater vehicle.
papers.journal_ref: Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence, 1 October 2026, Volume 181, Part 6, Article 115698
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出在 RKHS 中嵌入状态概率密度、用算子回归辨识受控扩散过程的 Markov 转移算子，再与凸的算子型 Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman 递推结合，实现动力学与阶段代价均未知的随机最优控制。该递推随状态维度线性扩展，数值上覆盖多类非线性控制任务，包括自主水下航行器 (AUV) 的深度调节。
Motivation: 非线性 control-affine 系统以随机扩散建模时，动力学与阶段代价往往未知、只有控制惩罚与约束可用，传统 HJB 求解随状态维度指数膨胀，难以做数据驱动的随机最优控制。
Method: 把状态概率密度嵌入 reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS)，用算子回归辨识受控扩散过程的 Markov 转移算子；再把该算子接入凸的算子理论 HJacobi-Bellman 递推求解最优控制，复杂度随状态维度线性增长。
Result: 数值结果表明该方法能处理多类非线性控制任务，其中包括自主水下航行器 (AUV) 的深度调节问题。
Conclusion: 算子学习与算子型 HJB 递推结合，可在动力学与代价未知、仅有控制惩罚与约束的条件下求解一大类非线性随机最优控制问题，且不随状态维度指数变差。

papers.title: TernaryLLM: Ternarized Large Language Model
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable performance on Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks, but they are hindered by high computational costs and memory requirements. Ternarization, an extreme form of quantization, offers a solution by reducing memory usage and enabling energy-efficient floating-point additions. However, applying ternarization to LLMs faces challenges stemming from outliers in both weights and activations. In this work, observing asymmetric outliers and non-zero means in weights, we introduce Dual Learnable Ternarization (DLT), which enables both scales and shifts to be learnable. We also propose Outlier-Friendly Feature Knowledge Distillation (OFF) to recover the information lost in extremely low-bit quantization. The proposed OFF can incorporate semantic information and is insensitive to outliers. At the core of OFF is maximizing the mutual information between features in ternarized and floating-point models using cosine similarity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our TernaryLLM surpasses previous low-bit quantization methods on the standard text generation and zero-shot benchmarks for different LLM families. Specifically, for one of the most powerful open-source models, LLaMA-3, our approach (W1.58A16) outperforms the previous state-of-the-art method (W2A16) by 5.8 in terms of perplexity on C4 and by 8.2% in terms of average accuracy on zero-shot tasks.
papers.journal_ref: Machine Intelligence Research (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TernaryLLM 用可学习的 scale 与 shift（DLT）处理权重中的非对称 outlier 与非零均值，再用 OFF 特征蒸馏在三值与浮点模型特征间最大化互信息（以 cosine similarity 度量）来补回极低比特丢失的信息。在 LLaMA-3 上 W1.58A16 相比此前 SOTA 的 W2A16，C4 困惑度改善 5.8，零样本任务平均准确率提升 8.2%。
Motivation: LLM 推理受高计算与内存开销制约，三值化（1.58-bit）能大幅省显存并支持能效更高的浮点加法，但权重与激活中的 outlier 使极端低比特量化难以落地。
Method: 提出 Dual Learnable Ternarization (DLT)，让 scale 与 shift 同时可学习以适配非对称 outlier 和非零均值权重；提出 Outlier-Friendly Feature Knowledge Distillation (OFF)，以 cosine similarity 最大化三值模型与浮点模型特征间的互信息，融入语义信息且对 outlier 不敏感。
Result: 在 LLaMA-3 上，W1.58A16 相对先前 SOTA 方法 W2A16：C4 困惑度改善 5.8，零样本任务平均准确率提升 8.2%；实验覆盖不同 LLM 家族的标准文本生成与零样本基准，均超过此前低比特量化方法。
Conclusion: 把 scale/shift 都设为可学习参数并配合对 outlier 鲁棒的特征蒸馏，可以让 1.58-bit 三值 LLM 超过 2-bit 量化方法，即极端低比特不必以牺牲生成与零样本精度为代价。

papers.title: Perspective-1-Ellipsoid: Formulation, Analysis and Solutions of the Camera Pose Estimation Problem from One Ellipse-Ellipsoid Correspondence
papers.abstract_en: In computer vision, camera pose estimation from correspondences between 3D geometric entities and their projections into the image has been a widely investigated problem. Although most state-of-the-art methods exploit low-level primitives such as points or lines, the emergence of very effective CNN-based object detectors in the recent years has paved the way to the use of higher-level features carrying semantically meaningful information. Pioneering works in that direction have shown that modelling 3D objects by ellipsoids and 2D detections by ellipses offers a convenient manner to link 2D and 3D data. However, the mathematical formalism most often used in the related litterature does not enable to easily distinguish ellipsoids and ellipses from other quadrics and conics, leading to a loss of specificity potentially detrimental in some developments. Moreover, the linearization process of the projection equation creates an over-representation of the camera parameters, also possibly causing an efficiency loss. In this paper, we therefore introduce an ellipsoid-specific theoretical framework and demonstrate its beneficial properties in the context of pose estimation. More precisely, we first show that the proposed formalism enables to reduce the pose estimation problem to a position or orientation-only estimation problem in which the remaining unknowns can be derived in closed-form. Then, we demonstrate that it can be further reduced to a 1 Degree-of-Freedom (1DoF) problem and provide the analytical derivations of the pose as a function of that unique scalar unknown. We illustrate our theoretical considerations by visual examples and include a discussion on the practical aspects. Finally, we release this paper along with the corresponding source code in order to contribute towards more efficient resolutions of ellipsoid-related pose estimation problems.
papers.comment: International Journal of Computer Vision, 2023 (29 pages, 11 figures)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出椭球专用的相机位姿估计理论框架，把单条椭圆-椭球对应（Perspective-1-Ellipsoid）的位姿求解先化为仅位置或仅姿态的估计（其余未知量闭式解出），再进一步化为 1 DoF 单标量问题并给出位姿关于该标量的解析表达式。作者同时发布论文与源码，用于更高效地求解椭球相关位姿问题。
Motivation: 现有文献用通用二次曲面/二次曲线形式化描述椭球与椭圆，难以与其它 quadric/conic 区分，导致特异性丢失；投影方程线性化又造成相机参数过表达，带来效率损失。
Method: 建立椭球专用理论框架（ellipsoid-specific formalism），将位姿估计约化为位置或姿态单侧估计并闭式求剩余未知量，再约化为 1 DoF 问题，推导位姿作为唯一标量未知量的解析式；辅以可视化示例与实践讨论，并随论文发布源码。
Result: 给出约化链条的解析推导：单椭圆-椭球对应 → 位置或姿态单侧估计（其余闭式）→ 1 DoF 单标量问题及其位姿解析式；以视觉示例说明理论结论并讨论实践层面。
Conclusion: 椭球专用形式化能去掉相机参数的过表达，把 P1E 位姿问题压到 1 DoF 上闭式求解，从而更高效地处理椭球相关位姿估计。

papers.title: LeWAM: End-to-End World and Action Modeling with JEPAs
papers.abstract_en: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn compact latent world models without pixel reconstruction. Existing JEPA pipelines typically train visual representations and action-conditioned dynamics before adding a control policy or solver. We introduce LeWAM, an end-to-end JEPA for control with: (1) a joint training objective over next latent state prediction and action flow matching, and (2) an isotropic Gaussian constraint on the latent state, enabling a single model to support direct policy execution and efficient planning by evaluating sampled actions with its learned latent dynamics. Compared with prior JEPAs in visual planning, LeWAM improves success rate from 28.6% to 89.7% on contact-rich tasks and from 10.9% to 46.2% on long-horizon tasks, and plans 32.3 times faster. On behavior cloning tasks in simulation and physical robots, LeWAM is also competitive with established methods. Interpretability analyses show that LeWAM learns control-relevant representations and action distributions effectively guiding test-time planning and control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LeWAM 把 JEPA 的表征学习、动作条件动力学与控制策略合并成一个端到端模型：联合训练下一隐状态预测与动作流匹配 (action flow matching)，并用各向同性高斯约束隐状态，使同一模型既能直接执行策略又能靠隐空间动力学高效规划。在视觉规划基准上，接触丰富任务成功率从 28.6% 提到 89.7%，长程任务从 10.9% 提到 46.2%，规划速度快 32.3 倍。
Motivation: 现有 JEPA 流水线先分别训练视觉表征与动作条件动力学，再外接控制策略或求解器，分阶段训练导致表征与控制目标脱节，规划也偏慢。
Method: 端到端 JEPA：联合训练目标同时包含下一隐状态预测与动作流匹配，并对隐状态施加各向同性高斯约束；推理时既可直接执行策略，也可对采样动作用学到的隐动力学打分做规划，另有可解释性分析检验表征与动作分布是否携带控制相关信息。
Result: 在视觉规划任务上，接触丰富任务成功率 28.6% → 89.7%，长程任务 10.9% → 46.2%，规划速度提升 32.3 倍；在仿真与实体机器人的行为克隆 (behavior cloning) 任务上与既有方法相当。
Conclusion: 把预测、动作生成与控制约束放进同一个 JEPA 端到端训练，可以在接触丰富与长程任务上大幅提高成功率并让规划提速一个数量级以上，且学到的表征确实服务于测试时规划与控制。

papers.title: Deploying RDMA for Large-Scale Inference and Training Workloads
papers.abstract_en: RDMA can reduce communication overhead in distributed machine learning systems, but realizing these benefits in production requires more than replacing TCP. Variable-size messages, concurrent connections, bursty incasts, and service failures introduce challenges that hardware offload alone cannot address. This paper reports our experience deploying ByteExpress, a software communication layer over hardware RDMA, in ByteDance's parameter-server-based inference and training systems. We present three lessons from the deployment: efficient RDMA requires buffer management across application and transport layers; scalable communication requires coordinated management of connections, receive capacity, and outstanding data; and service availability requires recovery above the transport layer. ByteExpress combines an RDMA-aware allocator, zero-copy transfers, QP multiplexing, receive-credit flow control, a software send window, and RPC-assisted recovery. In production inference, ByteExpress reduces mean and P99 model parameter fetch latency by 35.7% and 43.7%, respectively, and total CPU usage by 10.69% compared with kernel TCP. In training, ByteExpress reduces P99 model parameter push latency by up to 74.0% compared with TCP, with no PFC pauses observed at runtime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ByteExpress 是部署在字节跳动 parameter-server 推理与训练系统之上的软件通信层，把 RDMA-aware 分配器、零拷贝、QP 多路复用、接收信用流控、软件发送窗口与 RPC 辅助恢复组合起来，解决纯换 TCP 或纯硬件 offload 处理不了的变长消息、并发连接、突发 incast 与服务故障。生产推理中相对 kernel TCP 把模型参数拉取平均与 P99 延迟分别降 35.7% 与 43.7%，总 CPU 用量降 10.69%；训练中 P99 参数推送延迟最多降 74.0%，运行时未观察到 PFC pause。
Motivation: RDMA 能降低分布式机器学习的通信开销，但生产环境里变长消息、并发连接、突发 incast 与服务故障带来的问题，单靠把 TCP 换成 RDMA 或单靠硬件 offload 都解决不了。
Method: 在硬件 RDMA 之上构建软件通信层 ByteExpress，包含 RDMA-aware 内存分配器、零拷贝传输、QP 多路复用、接收信用 (receive-credit) 流控、软件发送窗口与 RPC 辅助恢复；部署于 ByteDance 基于 parameter-server 的推理与训练系统，经验总结为跨应用与传输层的缓冲管理、连接/接收容量/在途数据的协同管理、传输层之上的服务可用性恢复三条。
Result: 生产推理相对 kernel TCP：模型参数 fetch 平均延迟降 35.7%、P99 延迟降 43.7%、总 CPU 用量降 10.69%；训练相对 TCP：模型参数 push 的 P99 延迟最多降 74.0%，运行时未观察到 PFC pause。
Conclusion: 在生产级 parameter-server 机器学习系统里，RDMA 的收益要靠传输层之上的软件机制（缓冲、连接与容量协同、故障恢复）才能兑现，而不只是替换 TCP 或依赖硬件 offload。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VEPA: Verified Evolving Formal Policy for Lifelong LLM Agent Guardrails
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly operate over sensitive resources, such as private documents and mutable system states, which can create serious safety and security risks. Runtime guardrails should therefore make inspectable, reproducible, and deterministic allow or refuse decisions before potentially irreversible agent actions are executed. However, safety and security requirements are rarely complete before deployment, so guardrails need to keep adapting as new risks emerge. Existing adaptive guardrails learn from deployment experience, but they usually apply safety policies through LLM inference, which can lead to inconsistent decisions and ambiguous policy interpretations. Formal guardrails, on the other hand, enforce policies deterministically, but they usually rely on pre-deployment or task-specific policies and have no mechanism to adapt to newly observed risks. We introduce VEPA, a framework for the verified evolution of formal agent guardrails. VEPA represents the guardrail as a formal policy of executable symbolic rules over typed agent events. During deployment, we use an LLM guided by deployment feedback to propose policy patches that fix newly observed failures while preserving previously correct behavior. Then, a deterministic verifier only accepts policies that are structurally valid and conflict-free. Finally, an evidence-aware authority layer activates a verified rule only when it has enough supporting evidence, so uncertain updates cannot directly affect guardrail decisions. Across ASSEBench-Safety, ASSEBench-Security, and ATBench, VEPA consistently outperforms baselines while expanding the scope of deterministic formal-policy enforcement. These gains also hold under more challenging deployment conditions, including mixed streams, corrupted feedback, and longer horizons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VEPA 把 LLM agent 的运行时护栏表示为可执行的符号规则形式策略，用部署反馈驱动 LLM 提出策略补丁，再由确定性验证器与证据感知的权限层把关，使新风险能被吸收而旧的正确行为不被破坏。在 ASSEBench-Safety、ASSEBench-Security 与 ATBench 上一致优于基线，且在混合事件流、反馈被污染、更长时程等更难的部署条件下优势仍成立。
Motivation: 自适应护栏靠 LLM 推理执行安全策略，决策不一致、策略解释含糊；形式化护栏虽确定可审计，却依赖部署前或任务专用策略，无法吸收新出现的风险。
Method: 护栏被表示为针对带类型 agent 事件的可执行符号规则形式策略；部署期由 LLM 结合部署反馈提出修复新失败、且保持既有正确行为的策略补丁；确定性验证器只接受结构合法且无冲突的策略；证据感知的权限层仅在支撑证据充分时激活已验证规则，使不确定更新无法直接影响决策。
Result: 在 ASSEBench-Safety、ASSEBench-Security 与 ATBench 上一致优于基线，同时扩大了确定性形式策略的覆盖范围；在混合事件流、被污染反馈和更长时程等更严苛部署条件下增益依然保持。
Conclusion: 形式化护栏可以通过验证过的策略演化兼顾确定性执行与对新风险的适应，前提是补丁须经结构与冲突验证、且证据不足的更新不得直接生效。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Spend Where It Matters: Particle Search with MH Refinement for Budget-Constrained Audio-Visual Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Reward-guided inference-time alignment can improve joint audio-visual generation, but optimizing multiple alignment objectives requires many expensive model evaluations, making existing methods costly under limited compute. Particle-based search enables global exploration but incurs estimation error with a finite population, while Metropolis-Hastings (MH) can refine candidates locally but benefits from a strong initialization. We introduce \textbf{S}pend \textbf{W}here \textbf{I}t \textbf{M}atters (\modelname), a two-stage, training-free, reward-agnostic framework that combines particle search with MH refinement under a fixed compute budget. In the first stage, we adaptively allocate particles across denoising checkpoints using online variance estimates, minimizing estimation variance while concentrating compute where it is most useful. This search provides a promising candidate for MH refinement, which uses local noise-and-denoise proposals on completed outputs to further improve reward. By starting from a strong candidate, MH can recover additional reward without requiring a larger particle population or costly global exploration. We show that, at matched compute, combining particle search with MH refinement achieves higher rewards than either approach alone. On \textsc{JavisBench-Mini}, at closely matched compute, \modelname achieves mean relative gains across seven metrics of $30.7\%$ over BoN and $14.1\%$ over EvoSearch with JavisDiT++, and $9.2\%$ over BoN and $17.0\%$ over EvoSearch with LTX-2. Beyond joint audio-visual generation, we also demonstrate the benefits of adaptive particle allocation on SD1.5 image generation, improving AestheticScore by $2.2\%$ and ImageReward by $6.0\%$ over uniform allocation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SWIM：在固定算力预算下把粒子搜索与 Metropolis-Hastings 精修拼成两阶段、免训练、不绑定具体奖励的推理时对齐框架，第一阶段用在线方差估计自适应分配粒子到各去噪检查点，第二阶段在完整输出上做 noise-and-denoise 局部提议继续提奖励。在 JavisBench-Mini 上按接近的算力，七项指标平均相对增益比 BoN 高 30.7%、比 EvoSearch 高 14.1%（JavisDiT++），换 LTX-2 则为 9.2% 与 17.0%。
Motivation: 奖励引导的推理时对齐要同时优化多个对齐目标，模型评估昂贵，算力受限时成本高；粒子搜索全局探索但有限种群带来估计误差，MH 局部精修却依赖强初始化。
Method: 两阶段免训练框架 SWIM：第一阶段按在线方差估计在去噪检查点间自适应分配粒子以压低估计方差，第二阶段以该候选为起点，用对完整输出的 noise-and-denoise 局部提议做 MH 精修；整体在固定算力预算下运行，且不绑定具体奖励。
Result: 在 JavisBench-Mini 上、算力接近匹配时，SWIM 七项指标的平均相对增益比 BoN 高 30.7%、比 EvoSearch 高 14.1%（JavisDiT++），比 BoN 高 9.2%、比 EvoSearch 高 17.0%（LTX-2）；同算力下粒子搜索加 MH 精修的奖励高于任一单独方法。自适应粒子分配迁移到 SD1.5 图像生成后，AestheticScore 比均匀分配高 2.2%，ImageReward 高 6.0%。
Conclusion: 在固定算力下把全局粒子搜索与 MH 局部精修串起来，比单独任一方法更划算；先用自适应分配造出强候选，MH 就能在不扩大种群、不做更贵全局探索的情况下再拿回奖励。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Expressive Power of Random-Feature MPNNs Across Graph Sizes
papers.abstract_en: Continuous random node features increase the expressivity of message-passing neural networks (MPNNs), but existing theoretical analyses are not fine-grained enough to capture their limitations, particularly in approximating functions across graph sizes or under a fixed number of random bits. We develop a population-level framework for size-uniform approximation. For MPNNs with a graph-size-independent Lipschitz bound in their initial features, including standard mean, max, and order-normalized sum architectures, we show that continuous random features can be quantized to finitely many colors with arbitrarily small uniform error in expected output. This reduction lets us transfer limitations on finite-color distinguishability to limitations on size-uniform approximation with continuous random features. We use this framework to prove that these MPNNs are not size-uniformly universal, analyze the expressivity gains from colors and independent trials, and establish incomparability between random-color MPNNs and higher-order Weisfeiler-Leman methods. We also give finite-color MPNN constructions for tree subgraph isomorphism via color coding and a local MST task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在初始特征上具有与图大小无关的 Lipschitz 界的 MPNN（含 mean、max、order-normalized sum 架构）中，连续随机节点特征可被量化为有限多种颜色，且期望输出的统一误差任意小。由此把有限颜色可区分性的局限转移到跨图大小的统一逼近上，证明这类 MPNN 不是 size-uniformly universal，并给出随机颜色 MPNN 与高阶 Weisfeiler-Leman 方法互不可比的结论。
Motivation: 连续随机节点特征虽提升 MPNN 表达力，但现有理论分析不够精细，无法刻画其在跨图大小逼近函数或固定随机比特数下的局限。
Method: 建立 population-level 的 size-uniform 逼近框架：对初始特征满足图大小无关 Lipschitz 界的 MPNN，证明连续随机特征可量化为有限颜色且期望输出统一误差任意小，从而把有限颜色可区分性的限制迁移到统一逼近；并给出基于 color coding 的树子图同构有限颜色构造与一个局部 MST 任务构造。
Result: 证明该类 MPNN 不是 size-uniformly universal；分析颜色数与独立试次带来的表达力增益；建立随机颜色 MPNN 与高阶 Weisfeiler-Leman 方法的互不可比性；给出树子图同构（经 color coding）与局部 MST 任务的有限颜色 MPNN 构造。
Conclusion: 连续随机特征的表达力可用有限颜色量化来界定，其跨图大小统一逼近的上限可由有限颜色可区分性直接推出，且随机颜色 MPNN 与高阶 WL 方法在表达力上互不可比。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Trainable Quantum-Native Language Models: Dissipative Memory, Capacity Limits, and Hardware Validation
papers.abstract_en: We study byte-level autoregressive language models whose hidden state is a small quantum register, whose transitions are learned token-conditioned quantum channels, and whose next-byte probabilities come directly from Born-rule measurements without a learned classical vocabulary projection or softmax. In the fixed-width recurrent setting, unitary dynamics cannot contract or reset stored distinctions; experimentally, unitary recurrence loses to its retrained one-token control in every tested variant. Introducing learned dissipation, then token-conditioned dissipative gating, yields useful memory beyond one token. The gated model improves test negative log-likelihood by 0.20 +/- 0.03 nats/byte over retrained parameter-matched one-token controls at context length 12, and by 0.29-0.33 at longer contexts, but never beats retrained two-token controls. A key-value recall benchmark shows a width-dependent threshold: one stored pair meets the pre-registered accuracy bar at 4-5 memory qubits, two pairs at 6-7, and three pairs remain unsolved. This is consistent with, but does not establish, a capacity explanation for the short effective memory horizon. As a secondary result, one-qubit models reach lower stationary memory entropy than a heuristically optimized classical predictive frontier at matched error in 9/9 seeds. On IBM Heron hardware, computational-basis memory-register distributions show signal against a uniform null in 12/12 circuits across prefixes of up to 12 tokens, next-bit probabilities pass pre-registered accuracy bars at four-token prefixes, and bytes are generated autoregressively by sampling physically measured bit probabilities. The tested models are classically simulable and substantially worse than classical n-gram baselines. We claim no computational quantum advantage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 构建字节级自回归量子原生语言模型：隐状态是小型量子寄存器，转移为 token 条件化的量子信道，下一字节概率直接由 Born 规则测量给出，无经典 softmax 投影。幺正递归在所有测试变体中输给重训的单 token 对照，引入可学习耗散与 token 条件化耗散门控后才获得超过一个 token 的记忆：上下文长度 12 时测试 NLL 相对参数匹配的单 token 对照改善 0.20 ± 0.03 nats/byte，更长上下文改善 0.29–0.33，但始终不敌双 token 对照。
Motivation: 固定宽度幺正递归无法收缩或重置已存信息，导致量子隐状态记忆受限；需要判定这种短记忆是幺正性本身还是容量上限所致，并检验量子寄存器能否在硬件上真实承载跨 token 记忆。
Method: 以小型量子寄存器作隐状态，学习 token 条件化的量子信道作为转移，用 Born 规则测量直接产生下一字节概率；对比幺正递归、可学习耗散、token 条件化耗散门控三种变体，并与重训的参数匹配单/双 token 经典对照比较。另设 key-value recall 基准扫描记忆量子比特数（4–7），并在 IBM Heron 硬件上运行计算基测量电路。
Result: 门控模型在上下文长度 12 上测试 NLL 改善 0.20 ± 0.03 nats/byte（对重训单 token 对照），更长上下文改善 0.29–0.33，但从未胜过重训双 token 对照；幺正递归在每个测试变体中都输给其单 token 对照。key-value recall 呈宽度阈值：1 对在 4–5 记忆量子比特达标，2 对需 6–7，3 对未解决。单量子比特模型在匹配误差下 9/9 个随机种子达到比启发式优化的经典预测前沿更低的稳态记忆熵。IBM Heron 上 12/12 电路在最长 12 token 前缀下相对均匀零假设显示信号，四 token 前缀的下一比特概率通过预注册精度门槛，并按物理测量比特概率自回归采样生成字节。测试模型可被经典模拟，且明显差于经典 n-gram 基线。
Conclusion: 耗散与门控是量子寄存器获得跨 token 有用记忆的必要条件，但当前容量阈值与硬件结果只与容量解释一致、并未确立它；作者明确不主张任何量子计算优势，测试模型仍不及经典 n-gram。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Polyconvex neural-network surrogates with learned paired directional features for anisotropic hyperelastic homogenization
papers.abstract_en: Approximating the effective anisotropic hyperelastic response of a representative volume element (RVE) requires constitutive expressiveness, mechanical consistency, and computational efficiency. This work develops a polyconvex physics-augmented neural network (PANN) construction based on paired directional features whose orientations, stretch powers, and determinant exponents adapt to the RVE response. The features are composed with convex, componentwise nondecreasing cores, realized as an input-convex neural network (ICNN) or an input-convex Kolmogorov-Arnold network (ICKAN). The complete energies satisfy objectivity, an exactly stress-free reference, two-dimensional polyconvexity, and prescribed growth conditions by construction, and nonnegative energy is certified separately for the selected models. On a multicavity and a single-cavity periodic cell, these energies are compared with an Unconstrained energy, trained identically without the curvature and growth constraints, and with three hyperreduced projection-based reduced-order models (HPROMs), which serve as physics-based references. On the first cell, learning the features lowers the stress error sevenfold, and six features suffice on both. The constrained energies remain below one percent in stress error and in the displacement error of a tensile-coupon FE$^2$ application with a full-order reference, whereas the Unconstrained energy and the HPROMs are more accurate inside the data. Beyond the data, however, the Unconstrained energy loses rank-one convexity, and under confined compression it stops below half of the 500 MPa that the constrained energies reach. These results quantify what the guarantees cost in accuracy and what they secure beyond the data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于成对方向特征的多凸物理增强神经网络 (polyconvex PANN)，其方向、伸展幂次与行列式指数随 RVE 响应自适应，并与 ICNN/ICKAN 凸核组合，构造上保证客观性、无应力参考态、二维多凸性与增长条件。在多孔与单孔周期胞上，学习特征使应力误差降为七分之一，受约束能量应力与位移误差均低于 1%；数据之外无约束能量失去 rank-one 凸性，受限压缩下应力不足受约束能量 500 MPa 的一半。
Motivation: RVE 有效各向异性超弹响应的代理模型需要本构表达力、力学一致性与计算效率三者兼得：纯数据驱动能量在数据外可能违反多凸性等物理约束，导致外推失真。
Method: 构建成对方向特征的 polyconvex PANN，特征与逐分量非降凸核组合，凸核由 ICNN 或 ICKAN 实现；能量按构造满足客观性、精确无应力参考态、二维多凸性与规定增长条件，非负性单独认证。在 multicavity 与 single-cavity 周期胞上，与同训练设置但无曲率/增长约束的 Unconstrained energy 及三个基于超降阶投影的 HPROM 对比，并含 tensile-coupon FE² 应用与全阶参考。
Result: 第一个胞上学习特征使应力误差降低七倍，两个胞上六个特征即足够；受约束能量应力误差与 tensile-coupon FE² 位移误差均低于 1%。数据内 Unconstrained energy 与 HPROM 更准，但数据外失去 rank-one 凸性，受限压缩下其应力低于受约束能量所达 500 MPa 的一半。
Conclusion: 物理约束在数据内付出一定精度代价，却在数据外保住凸性与应力增长水平；学习方向特征能以极少特征数达到该受约束精度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Efficient Audio-Visual Speech Enhancement via Reinforcement Learning-Based Neural Architecture Search
papers.abstract_en: Audio-visual speech enhancement (AVSE) improves speech intelligibility in noisy environments but often relies on computationally expensive models unsuitable for resource-constrained edge devices. This paper introduces a reinforcement learning-driven neural architecture search (RL-NAS) framework to discover compact, efficient AVSE architectures. The search space preserves temporal alignment between audio and visual streams, while a novel reward function jointly optimises speech enhancement performance, measured by SI-SNR improvement, and model compactness. Using proximal policy optimisation with constraint-aware action masking, the framework evaluates only 35 candidate architectures and identifies a model with 2.9 million parameters, compared with 22 million in the baseline. The proposed architecture achieves a 14.5 dB SI-SNR improvement, only 0.7 dB below the baseline, while reducing model size by approximately nine-fold. Evaluation on commercial mobile CPUs demonstrates a 4.3-fold reduction in real-time factor, supporting practical on-device deployment. Compared with random search, RL-NAS achieves 92% higher search efficiency. Architectural analysis reveals that shallower but wider temporal convolutional blocks and aggressive visual pathway pruning can maintain enhancement performance while substantially reducing computational requirements. These findings demonstrate the potential of reinforcement learning-guided architecture search for developing lightweight, efficient and deployable multimodal speech enhancement systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用强化学习驱动的神经架构搜索 (RL-NAS) 为音频-视觉语音增强 (AVSE) 搜出紧凑模型：搜索空间保持音视频时序对齐，奖励函数同时优化 SI-SNR 提升与参数量。只评估 35 个候选架构即得到 290 万参数模型（基线 2200 万），SI-SNR 提升 14.5 dB，仅比基线低 0.7 dB，模型缩小约九倍。
Motivation: AVSE 模型计算量大，难以部署到资源受限的边缘设备；手工设计难以同时兼顾增强性能与模型紧凑度。
Method: RL-NAS 框架：搜索空间约束音视频流的时序对齐，奖励函数联合 SI-SNR 改善与模型紧凑度；用 PPO 加上约束感知的动作掩码 (constraint-aware action masking) 搜索，仅评估 35 个候选架构。
Result: 找到 290 万参数模型（基线 2200 万），SI-SNR 提升 14.5 dB，仅低于基线 0.7 dB，模型体积缩小约九倍；商用移动 CPU 上实时因子 (real-time factor) 降低 4.3 倍；相比随机搜索搜索效率高 92%。
Conclusion: 更浅但更宽的时间卷积块配合激进的视觉通路剪枝即可维持增强性能并大幅降低计算量，RL 引导的架构搜索可产出可在设备端部署的轻量多模态语音增强系统。

papers.title: Meta-Reflective Evolution Effectively Improves Production AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM)-guided evolutionary optimization has successfully improved prompts, programs, and even entire AI systems. Most optimization methods select a candidate from the search frontier, then mutate it in one LLM pass based only on its failures. This focus on the frontier can stall on production AI systems, where isolated failures reveal little about complex, hidden interactions. We introduce CoCoEvolve (Cortex Code Evolve), an evolutionary optimizer built around what we call meta-reflection, wherein an agentic mutator (Cortex Code) selectively retrieves evidence from the entire evolutionary history and probes the live system before verifying and proposing mutations. We apply CoCoEvolve to optimize three classes of production AI systems: data agents, LLM-powered data pipelines, and data engineering workflows. On DABStep, CoCoEvolve tops the public leaderboard, reaching 92.8% held-out hard accuracy compared to 78.4% for Meta-Harness and 30.4% for GEPA under matched conditions. Across six LLM data pipeline workloads, it outperforms every evaluated baseline. On data-eng-bench, CoCoEvolve lifts test-set solve rate from 59.1% to 77.4%, past the best baseline of 73.6%. It also has 11 percentage points higher accuracy than GEPA on HotpotQA while remaining competitive with specialized optimizers on established mathematical and systems benchmarks. Matched ablations confirm that each component of CoCoEvolve contributes to these gains, demonstrating the value of meta-reflection for optimizing production AI systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CoCoEvolve（Cortex Code Evolve），用 meta-reflection 让 agentic mutator 从整段进化历史中选择性检索证据并探测活体系统，再验证和提出变异，而非只看搜索前沿的单次失败。在 DABStep 上 held-out hard accuracy 达 92.8%（Meta-Harness 78.4%、GEPA 30.4%），data-eng-bench 求解率从 59.1% 提到 77.4%。
Motivation: 多数 LLM 引导的进化优化只从搜索前沿取候选、再基于其孤立失败做一次变异；生产 AI 系统中孤立失败难以揭示复杂的隐藏交互，优化容易停滞。
Method: CoCoEvolve 围绕 meta-reflection 构建：agentic mutator（Cortex Code）从整个进化历史中选择性检索证据、探测 live system，再验证并提出变异。应用于三类生产系统——data agents、LLM 驱动的数据流水线、数据工程工作流，并做 matched ablation 拆解各组件贡献。
Result: DABStep 上 held-out hard accuracy 92.8%，对比 Meta-Harness 78.4%、GEPA 30.4%（matched conditions），登顶公开榜单；六个 LLM 数据流水线负载上超过所有被评估基线；data-eng-bench 测试集求解率 59.1% → 77.4%，超过最佳基线 73.6%；HotpotQA 准确率比 GEPA 高 11 个百分点，在既有数学与系统 benchmark 上与专用优化器相当。
Conclusion: matched ablation 确认每个组件都对增益有贡献，说明 meta-reflection（检索全历史 + 探测活体系统）是优化生产 AI 系统的关键，而非只依赖前沿候选的单步变异。
