summary_sections.method: CoCoEvolve 围绕 meta-reflection 构建：agentic mutator（Cortex Code）从整个进化历史中选择性检索证据、探测 live system，再验证并提出变异。应用于三类生产系统——data agents、LLM 驱动的数据流水线、数据工程工作流，并做 matched ablation 拆解各组件贡献。
summary_sections.result: DABStep 上 held-out hard accuracy 92.8%，对比 Meta-Harness 78.4%、GEPA 30.4%（matched conditions），登顶公开榜单；六个 LLM 数据流水线负载上超过所有被评估基线；data-eng-bench 测试集求解率 59.1% → 77.4%，超过最佳基线 73.6%；HotpotQA 准确率比 GEPA 高 11 个百分点，在既有数学与系统 benchmark 上与专用优化器相当。
summary_sections.conclusion: matched ablation 确认每个组件都对增益有贡献，说明 meta-reflection（检索全历史 + 探测活体系统）是优化生产 AI 系统的关键，而非只依赖前沿候选的单步变异。

papers.title: EvoBelief: Falsifiable World Models for Self-Improving LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving LLM agents typically improve how they act through accumulated experience, reflection, or skills. Yet even procedurally capable agents can fail when their beliefs about environment dynamics are incomplete, incorrect, or outdated. We study a complementary axis of self-evolution: evolving those beliefs during deployment. Such beliefs can support multiple tasks, but incorrect ones can also propagate across them. We introduce EvoBelief, a self-evolving world model that represents environment knowledge as falsifiable hypotheses. Unexpected outcomes and decision-relevant unknowns trigger hypothesis formation. Later observations and controlled experiments provide independent validation before a rule can guide predictions or plans within its supported scope. Counterexamples narrow or retire rules as the environment changes. The language model remains frozen, and each rule remains linked to its evidence and the decisions it changes. Across four benchmarks spanning static dynamics, hidden drift, and scientific discovery, EvoBelief improves task performance and reuses learned rules across tasks. On ALFWorld without actor-side transition memory, it improves success over the matched Frozen World Model by 23.9% and 31.3% with Claude Haiku 4.5 and GPT-5.4, respectively. On MiniGrid, it revises stale rules and recovers after unannounced dynamics changes. In DiscoveryWorld's Reactor Lab, it discovers and validates quantitative laws, completing 83.3% of Normal-tier and 58.3% of Challenge-tier instances, versus 0% for each evaluated baseline. These results demonstrate self-improvement through testable, revisable environment knowledge rather than model-parameter updates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvoBelief 把 LLM agent 的环境知识表示为可证伪假设：意外结果与决策相关的未知触发假设生成，后续观测与受控实验独立验证后规则才可用于其支持范围内的预测与规划，反例则收窄或淘汰规则。在四个基准上它提升任务表现并跨任务复用规则：ALFWorld 无 actor 侧转移记忆时相对 Frozen World Model 成功率提升 23.9%（Claude Haiku 4.5）与 31.3%（GPT-5.4），DiscoveryWorld Reactor Lab 完成 83.3% Normal 级与 58.3% Challenge 级实例，各基线均为 0%。
Motivation: 自进化 LLM agent 通常只积累经验、反思或技能，但对环境动力学的信念不完整、错误或过期时，程序上再强的 agent 也会失败；错误信念还会跨任务传播。
Method: EvoBelief 是一个自进化世界模型，把环境知识写成可证伪假设：意外结果与决策相关未知触发假设形成，后续观测与受控实验提供独立验证，规则才在其支持范围内指导预测与规划；反例使规则收窄或退役。语言模型保持冻结，每条规则与其证据及它改变的决策绑定。
Result: 在四个覆盖静态动力学、隐藏漂移与科学发现的基准上提升任务表现并跨任务复用规则。ALFWorld 无 actor 侧转移记忆时，相对匹配的 Frozen World Model 成功率提升 23.9%（Claude Haiku 4.5）与 31.3%（GPT-5.4）。MiniGrid 中能修订过期规则并在未预告的动力学变化后恢复。DiscoveryWorld Reactor Lab 完成 83.3% Normal 级与 58.3% Challenge 级实例，各被评估基线均为 0%。
Conclusion: 自提升可以来自可检验、可修订的环境知识而非模型参数更新；规则须绑定证据与支持范围，才能在环境变化时被收窄或淘汰而不跨任务扩散。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Domain Adaptation of SAM 2.1 for Building-Component Segmentation in Image-Based 3D Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: 3D reconstruction of building components using image-based scanning requires appropriate segmentation of the objects in the 2D building images. In order to benefit from consistent grouping of the 2D masks in 3D environments, vision foundation models such as the Segment Anything Model have been utilized by Group Anything with Radiance Fields (GARField) to perform 3D segmentation. This study fine-tuned SAM 2.1 on the HBD dataset, consisting of 2,679 annotated images from 42 buildings, to enhance multi-class segmentation of 2D building images, covering 11 classes (Wall, Window, Ceiling, Door, Column, Beam, Floor, Opening, Curtain Wall, Roof, and Lift). The model was evaluated using per-class IoU, Dice, and mIoU metrics, and the results show an improvement in mIoU from 49.9% to 69.6%, indicating a meaningful improvement in class segmentation and providing a more accurate model for distilling the masks in 3D. SegFormer was then used as a baseline, generating per-class masks for comparison with SAM 2.1, which indicates improvement in some object classes with larger surface area. The masks in the building images were grouped in the neural radiance field, and the pretrained SAM 2.1 was compared with the fine-tuned SAM 2.1 in the newly rendered images. This comparison shows that fine-tuning improves the grouping of building components at a user-selected grouping scale. This advances the application of Group Anything with Radiance Fields (GARField) in 3D, enabling better segmentation of building structures for 3D auto-reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 HBD 数据集（42 栋建筑、2,679 张标注图像、11 个建筑构件类别）上微调 SAM 2.1，把 2D 建筑图像多类分割 mIoU 从 49.9% 提到 69.6%，再把掩膜送入 GARField 的神经辐射场做 3D 分组。微调后在用户选定的分组尺度上构件分组更准，可为基于图像的建筑 3D 重建提供更可靠的掩膜蒸馏来源。
Motivation: 基于图像扫描的建筑构件 3D 重建依赖 2D 图像分割质量；GARField 借助 SAM 做 3D 分组，但通用 SAM 在建筑多类构件（墙、窗、梁、幕墙上等 11 类）上的分割精度不足，制约后续 3D 掩膜蒸馏。
Method: 在 HBD 数据集上微调 SAM 2.1 做 11 类建筑构件分割（Wall、Window、Ceiling、Door、Column、Beam、Floor、Opening、Curtain Wall、Roof、Lift），用 per-class IoU、Dice、mIoU 评估，并以 SegFormer 生成逐类掩膜作基线对比；随后将掩膜在 GARField 的神经辐射场中分组，对比预训练与微调 SAM 2.1 在新渲染图像上的分组效果。
Result: mIoU 从 49.9% 提升到 69.6%；相对 SegFormer 基线，在表面积较大的构件类别上有所改进；在 GARField 新渲染图像对比中，微调模型在用户选定分组尺度上改善了建筑构件的 3D 分组。
Conclusion: 在建筑构件数据上微调 SAM 2.1 能显著提升多类分割并改善 GARField 的 3D 分组质量，从而推进其在建筑结构自动 3D 重建中的应用。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Shift-Aware Identity-Guided Latent Refinement for Referring Audio--Visual Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Referring Audio--Visual Segmentation (Ref-AVS) is an emergent multimodal task requiring the precise identification and segmentation of a specific object based on a natural language expression grounded in both visual and auditory cues. Unlike traditional AVS, which segments generic sound sources, or referring video object segmentation (Ref-VOS), which relies solely on visual--textual grounding, Ref-AVS necessitates fine-grained tri-modal interaction across vision, audio, and language. However, existing methods often fail to maintain consistency when subjected to target shift, a phenomenon where the model erroneously transfers its focus between objects due to transient occlusions, acoustic fading, or identity ambiguities. To address this, we propose a novel Shift-Aware Identity-guided Latent (SAIL) refinement framework. It introduces a dual-token strategy that decouples frame-level dynamics from a global semantic anchor to explicitly model target-shift cues. We design a shift-aware refinement module that rectifies drift by aligning tokens with domain-specific evidence. Finally, we leverage a decoder that integrates the refined embeddings with a continuous memory update to maintain spatio-temporal coherence and identity consistency throughout the video sequence. Extensive experiments conducted on two Ref-AVS benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method, significantly outperforming existing AVS, Ref-VOS, and Ref-AVS approaches. The code will be released after publication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SAIL 框架，用双 token 策略把帧级动态与全局语义锚点解耦来显式建模目标漂移 (target shift)，再用 shift-aware refinement 模块按域证据对齐 token 纠正漂移，并配合连续记忆更新的解码器保持时序一致性。在两个 Ref-AVS 基准上显著优于现有 AVS、Ref-VOS 与 Ref-AVS 方法。
Motivation: Referring Audio-Visual Segmentation 需要视觉、音频、语言三模态细粒度交互，但现有方法在目标漂移下（瞬时遮挡、声音衰减、身份歧义）无法保持目标一致性。
Method: SAIL 框架：双 token 策略将帧级动态与全局语义锚点解耦以建模 target-shift 线索；shift-aware refinement 模块通过将 token 与域特定证据对齐来纠正漂移；解码器融合精炼后的嵌入并做连续记忆更新，以维持时空连贯与身份一致性。
Result: 在两个 Ref-AVS 基准上的实验中，显著优于现有 AVS、Ref-VOS 与 Ref-AVS 方法（摘要未给出具体指标数值）。
Conclusion: 显式建模目标漂移并配合记忆更新，能提升 Ref-AVS 在遮挡与身份歧义下的身份一致性；代码将于论文发表后发布。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Representation Alignment from a Few Paired Data via Distilled Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: Aligning two independently pretrained unimodal encoders typically demands millions of paired examples. In this paper, we study the regime where only $N \sim 100$--$500$ pairs are available, while unpaired data on either side is abundant. Our method expresses every representation by its similarities to the $N$ paired anchors, which places both modalities in a common coordinate system; matches the two point clouds with a single entropic optimal transport problem solved over the entire pool, whose marginal constraints counteract the hubness that defeats nearest-neighbor matching; and distills the resulting plan into two lightweight encoders, so that the correspondence becomes inductive. We additionally put this marginal constraint in relation with the one-step hub corrections of the bilingual lexicon induction literature. Pairing is required only for the anchors: the unpaired collections may be drawn independently from the two marginals, so that no item outside the anchor set needs to have both of its modalities observed. We evaluate on image-text and molecule-text alignment, where our method outperforms existing approaches at the same anchor budget on Flickr30k, MS-COCO and ChEBI-20.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在仅有 N≈100–500 对配对、两侧非配对数据充足的条件下，把每个表示写成对配对锚点的相似度向量，用单个带熵的最优传输 (optimal transport) 问题在整个数据池上匹配两个点云，再把传输计划蒸馏进两个轻量编码器，使对应关系变成归纳式。边缘约束抑制了让最近邻匹配失效的 hubness，在 Flickr30k、MS-COCO、ChEBI-20 上以相同锚点预算胜过已有方法。
Motivation: 对齐两个独立预训练的单模态编码器通常需要数百万配对样本，而现实中图像-文本、分子-文本这类配对往往只有几百条，非配对数据却很充足。
Method: 用 N 个配对锚点作为公共坐标系，把每个表示表示为其对锚点的相似度；在整个数据池上解一个带熵的最优传输问题，其边缘约束对抗 hubness；再把得到的传输计划蒸馏进两个轻量编码器。配对只需覆盖锚点，非配对集合可各自独立采样；作者还将该边缘约束与双语词典诱导 (bilingual lexicon induction) 文献中的一步 hub 修正联系起来。
Result: 在 image-text 与 molecule-text 对齐任务上，于相同锚点预算（N≈100–500 对）下优于已有方法，评测数据集为 Flickr30k、MS-COCO 和 ChEBI-20。
Conclusion: 少量配对锚点加全局最优传输与蒸馏，足以在远低于百万级配对的预算下完成跨模态表示对齐，且配对只需存在于锚点集合。

papers.title: Coordinate-Free Automatic Differentiation
papers.abstract_en: Automatic differentiation (AD) is a cornerstone of modern machine learning. Since all AD frameworks implicitly fix a basis of Euclidean space to define gradients and Jacobians, they natively process mathematical objects that are arrays of a fixed set of coordinates. This makes it awkward to express objects such as rotations, volume forms, and curvatures that arise, for example, in applications of AI to science. Bespoke workarounds lack reusability. We show that (i) a single, basis-independent derivative operator can represent many geometric differential operations, and (ii) this operator can be expressed entirely in terms of existing AD primitives. This reusable transformation can be composed with JAX batching, compilation, and hardware acceleration. Geometry enters as algebraic data. We experimentally demonstrate its reuse across different manifold operators, its composition through a spacetime inverse-problem pipeline, and its use in optimization over different rotor subgroups.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 现有 AD 框架都隐式固定欧氏空间的一组基，导致旋转、体积形式、曲率这类几何对象难以表达。作者证明单一与基无关的导数算子可表示多种几何微分算子，且完全由现有 AD 原语实现，可与 JAX 的 batching、编译和硬件加速组合，几何以代数数据形式进入。实验展示其跨流形算子复用、经时空逆问题管线的组合，以及在 rotor 子群上的优化。
Motivation: AD 框架以固定坐标数组为前提，使旋转、体积形式、曲率等几何对象在 AI for science 中表达笨拙，而定制变通方案缺乏可复用性。
Method: 构造单一与基无关的导数算子，用它表示多种几何微分操作，并将其完全表达为现有 AD 原语；几何以代数数据输入，变换可与 JAX batching、编译和硬件加速组合。
Result: 实验展示该算子在不同流形算子间的复用、在一个时空逆问题 (spacetime inverse-problem) 管线中的组合，以及在不同 rotor 子群上优化中的使用。
Conclusion: 与基无关的导数可以作为可复用变换嵌入现有 AD 栈，几何结构作为代数数据而非硬编码坐标进入自动微分。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Credit Attribution in Timestamped Soccer Networks Using Multivariate Hawkes Processes
papers.abstract_en: The two main traditional player statistics used in soccer are goals scored and assists, with an assist credited when a player's pass immediately leads to a teammate scoring. Attributing credit solely to the player who makes the final pass before a goal fails to account for the contributions of multiple players in the buildup to the goal. Consequently, traditional statistics provide only a limited view of player involvement. In this paper, we use multivariate Hawkes processes (MHPs) to model timestamped sequences of passes and shots, which form continuous-time networks. MHPs provide a branching mechanism where an event (a pass or shot) can be generated as a child of a previous event, which allows us to quantify each pass's contribution to a subsequent pass or shot. This approach distributes credit across multiple passes within an attacking sequence, making it applicable across a wide range of situations. Building on this framework, we propose expected goal involvements (xGI), a metric that measures a player's involvement in creating goal scoring opportunities based on their passes. This metric identifies players who play key roles in creating goal scoring opportunities even if they do not make the final pass, offering a more comprehensive measure of attacking involvement and player performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用多元 Hawkes 过程 (multivariate Hawkes processes) 对带时间戳的传球与射门序列建模成连续时间网络，借助分支机制把一个进球的功劳沿进攻链路分摊到多次传球，而非只记最后一传。据此提出 xGI (expected goal involvements) 指标，识别那些未做最后一传但关键参与创造机会的球员。
Motivation: 传统进球与助攻统计只把功劳记给最后一传的球员，忽略了进球前多名球员的累积贡献，对球员进攻参与度的刻画有限。
Method: 用 MHP 建模带时间戳的传球和射门序列，构成连续时间网络；MHP 的分支机制把每个事件（传球或射门）视为先前事件的子事件，从而量化每次传球对后续传球或射门的贡献，并在此框架上定义 xGI 指标。
Result: 提出 xGI 指标，用于衡量球员通过传球创造进球机会的参与度；该指标能识别未做最后一传但对创造机会起关键作用的球员。
Conclusion: 把功劳沿进攻序列分摊到多次传球，比只记助攻更全面地度量进攻参与和球员表现，且适用于广泛的比赛情境。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: REDaCT: Collapse-Free Unlearning in Large Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: Unlearning in large reasoning models (LRMs) requires removing forget-set information from both the reasoning trace and the final answer. Existing approaches achieve this objective at the cost of reasoning collapse, where the model fails to produce a coherent chain-of-thought (CoT) and does not properly terminate its reasoning process. To address this challenge, we propose REDaCT (REgenerate via Detection and Corrective Tuning), an inference-time unlearning framework for LRMs. REDaCT consists of two key components: (1) a binary leak detector that identifies sentences in the reasoning trace that leak forget-set information, and (2) an embedding optimization module that learns a corrective embedding offline, such that when injected at the first detected leak during inference, it guides subsequent reasoning towards sentences that do not leak forget-set information. Experimental results show that REDaCT completely avoids reasoning collapse, substantially improving reasoning preservation compared to state-of-the-art unlearning methods while maintaining perfect answer forgetting and near-perfect CoT forgetting. Our code is available at: https://github.com/jmaccoby/redact.
papers.comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 19 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Copyright 2026 Association for Computational Linguistics (ACL). Licensed under CC BY 4.0
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REDaCT 是面向大推理模型 (LRM) 的推理时遗忘框架：用二元泄漏检测器定位推理链中泄露遗忘集信息的句子，再在首个泄漏点注入离线学得的纠正 embedding，把后续推理引向不泄露的方向。结果是完全避免推理崩溃，在保持答案完全遗忘与 CoT 近乎完全遗忘的同时大幅改善推理保持。
Motivation: 现有 LRM 遗忘方法虽能从推理轨迹和最终答案中移除遗忘集信息，但代价是推理崩溃——模型无法产生连贯的 CoT，也不能正常终止推理过程。
Method: REDaCT (REgenerate via Detection and Corrective Tuning) 由两部分组成：二元泄漏检测器逐句判定推理轨迹是否泄露遗忘集信息；embedding 优化模块离线学习一个纠正 embedding，在推理时注入首个检测到的泄漏处，引导后续生成不泄露的句子。
Result: 实验显示 REDaCT 完全避免推理崩溃，相比 SOTA 遗忘方法大幅改善推理保持，同时保持完美的答案遗忘 (perfect answer forgetting) 与近乎完美的 CoT 遗忘 (near-perfect CoT forgetting)。
Conclusion: 推理时在首个泄漏点注入纠正信号，可以在不牺牲遗忘强度的前提下解决遗忘与推理崩溃的权衡。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Semantic Views: Certified Reuse of LLM Labels Across Semantic Queries
papers.abstract_en: Semantic query engines evaluate natural-language filters with a large language model, and every evaluation is a costly oracle call. Optimizers that reduce these calls face a dilemma: cascades that trust a cheap proxy miss their precision and recall targets on many queries, methods with finite-sample guarantees save little, and all of them discard the oracle's labels when the query ends. We present SemViews, a certified semantic filter that orders tuples by signals that cost no oracle calls (the labels that earlier queries left behind as semantic views, a local embedding, and a helper model's score), refines that order with labels it must pay for anyway, and certifies its answer with fresh stratified oracle samples. The answer meets user precision and recall targets with probability at least $1-δ$ for every workload and every catalog, so a stale or misleading view can cost oracle calls but never accuracy. On four workloads replayed against 725,000 recorded oracle labels, SemViews meets both targets on 99.63% of queries and saves 28%-45% of the oracle calls, whereas the only prior method in our study with the same guarantee needs 1.32x-1.71x as many calls. When a question returns in different words, views cut its calls by a further 27%-36%, with both targets met on at least 99.8% of such queries; similarity caches and entailment-based reuse meet them on only 17%-47%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SemViews 把历史查询留下的 LLM 标签当作 semantic views，用零成本信号排序元组、用本来就要付的标签细化，再用新分层抽样认证答案，使精度与召回目标以至少 1-δ 概率对任意工作负载和目录成立。在四个工作负载、725,000 条已记录 oracle 标签上，99.63% 查询同时达标并节省 28%-45% oracle 调用；同保证的先前方法需 1.32x-1.71x 调用。
Motivation: 语义查询引擎每次自然语言过滤都是一次昂贵的 LLM oracle 调用；现有优化器要么级联代理在多数查询上失准，要么有限样本保证省得很少，且查询结束后标签全部丢弃。
Method: SemViews 用三类零 oracle 成本信号（先前查询留下的 semantic views 标签、本地 embedding、helper model 打分）对元组排序，用反正要付费的标签细化该顺序，最后用新分层 oracle 抽样认证答案，保证精度与召回目标以至少 1-δ 概率达成。
Result: 在四个工作负载、725,000 条已记录 oracle 标签上重放：99.63% 查询同时满足精度与召回目标，节省 28%-45% oracle 调用；唯一具同等保证的先前方法需 1.32x-1.71x 调用。问题以不同措辞重现时，views 再省 27%-36% 调用，此类查询至少 99.8% 达标，而相似度缓存与基于蕴含的复用仅 17%-47% 达标。
Conclusion: 把历史 LLM 标签当作可认证复用的 semantic views，可以在不牺牲精度与召回保证的前提下显著削减 oracle 调用，且陈旧或误导性 view 只会多花调用、不会破坏准确性。

papers.title: Provenance-grouped protocol for evaluating machine learning in perovskite photovoltaics
papers.abstract_en: Machine-learning models for perovskite solar cells are typically evaluated using random data splits, which we show systematically leak information through massive internal duplication. Because nearly two-thirds of curated devices share their exact recipe with another, random splits primarily reward the mere recall of historical data rather than testing true physical generalisation. To solve this, we mapped the institutional provenance of the Perovskite Database and established a rigorous hierarchy of grouped splits that progressively isolate duplicate devices, publications, and institutions. Benchmarking thirteen models establishes new state-of-the-art performance across all splits and reveals a critical regime shift: while tree ensembles dominate random splits by recognising familiar recipes, their ranking collapses on genuinely unseen institutions and future discoveries, where composition-aware neural architectures excel. Furthermore, feature importance demonstrates that the device architecture and fabrication methodology dictate final efficiency just as strongly as the absorber chemistry. This standardised protocol empowers the community to separate memorisation from true physical discovery.
papers.comment: perovskite solar cells, provenance-grouped protocol, state of art, benchmark
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 钙钛矿光伏 ML 评测的随机划分因大规模重复而系统性泄漏信息：近三分之二器件与另一器件配方完全相同，随机划分主要奖励历史数据记忆而非物理泛化。作者按 Perovskite Database 的机构来源 (provenance) 建立分组划分层级，逐级隔离重复器件、论文与机构；基准测试显示树集成在随机划分上占优但在真正未见机构与未来发现上排名崩塌，成分感知神经架构反而领先。
Motivation: 随机数据划分让钙钛矿器件模型评测测到的是配方记忆而非对新物理的泛化，机构与论文层面的重复使排行榜失真，社区缺少能区分记忆与真实发现的标准协议。
Method: 映射 Perovskite Database 的机构来源，建立逐级隔离重复器件、发表论文、机构的分组划分层级 (grouped splits)；在此协议上基准测试 13 个模型，并用特征重要性分析器件架构、制备工艺与吸收层化学对效率的贡献。
Result: 在全部划分上建立新的 state-of-the-art；约三分之二（nearly two-thirds）的整理器件与另一器件共享完全相同的配方；树集成在随机划分上占优，但在真正未见机构与未来发现上排名崩塌，成分感知神经架构在此占优；特征重要性显示器件架构与制备方法对最终效率的决定强度与吸收层化学相当。
Conclusion: 按来源分组的标准化协议能把记忆与真实物理发现分开，评测钙钛矿 ML 必须在未见机构与未来发现的划分上报告结果，而不能只看随机划分。

papers.title: Faithful and Complete LLM-Assisted Automated Construction of Hierarchical Hardware Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Hardware datasheets contain engineering specifications essential for component selection, system integration, and hardware compatibility verification. However, manual inspection is tedious and error-prone because datasheets are lengthy and heterogeneous, with dense information fragmented across tables, figures, and text. Although large language models (LLMs) can automate this process, naïve one-shot processing omits relevant specifications even when the document fits within the model's context window. We present an automated LLM-driven pipeline that transforms hardware datasheets into general-purpose hierarchical hardware knowledge graphs through chunk-based property extraction, hierarchical routing, and iterative refinement. The framework uses LLMs for information extraction and semantic reasoning while preserving source provenance and applying graph updates through validated instructions and deterministic local execution. This staged design reduces per-query context and maintains traceable intermediate representations. The resulting knowledge graphs provide semantically organized, source-grounded hardware properties for downstream retrieval and reasoning. We evaluate the framework on 20 hardware datasheets spanning diverse component types and document lengths. We assess property faithfulness and introduce inter-graph completeness to measure relative semantic coverage without exhaustive ground truth. Our framework achieves 98.8% property faithfulness compared with 76.1% for the one-shot baseline, while fully covering 83.6% of faithful baseline properties; in the reverse direction, the baseline fully covers only 10.5% of ours. These improvements provide more reliable and comprehensive engineering information for downstream hardware design and verification, reducing the risk of overlooked constraints and incorrect decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LLM 驱动的分层硬件知识图谱构建流水线，用分块属性抽取、层级路由与迭代精炼取代一次性 (one-shot) 处理，并以校验过的指令和确定性本地执行做图更新以保留来源溯源。在 20 份硬件 datasheet 上，属性忠实度 (property faithfulness) 达 98.8%，对比 one-shot 基线 76.1%；新引入的 inter-graph completeness 显示本方法完全覆盖基线忠实属性的 83.6%，反向基线仅覆盖本方法的 10.5%。
Motivation: 硬件 datasheet 篇幅长、格式异构，规格信息分散在表格、图与正文；LLM 一次性处理即使文档在上下文窗口内也会漏掉规格，人工核查又繁琐易错。
Method: 流水线包含分块属性抽取 (chunk-based property extraction)、层级路由 (hierarchical routing) 与迭代精炼 (iterative refinement)，用 LLM 做信息抽取与语义推理，图更新通过校验指令加确定性本地执行完成，保留来源溯源与可追踪的中间表示；评测覆盖 20 份不同元件类型与文档长度的 datasheet，并提出 inter-graph completeness 指标，在无穷举 ground truth 下度量相对语义覆盖。
Result: 属性忠实度 98.8% 对 one-shot 基线 76.1%；本方法完全覆盖基线忠实属性的 83.6%，反向基线仅完全覆盖本方法的 10.5%；评测集为 20 份硬件 datasheet。
Conclusion: 分阶段、可溯源的 LLM 流水线能同时提高硬件属性抽取的忠实度与相对覆盖度，降低漏掉约束和错误决策的风险。

papers.title: NV-Tesseract-AD: Curriculum-Enhanced Conditional Diffusion for Multivariate Time-Series Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: We propose NV-Tesseract-AD, a curriculum learning-enhanced conditional diffusion framework for multivariate time-series anomaly detection. Our central hypothesis is that reconstruction difficulty can be explicitly structured along two complementary axes, masking severity and diffusion noise level, and that training from easier to harder tasks along both axes simultaneously stabilizes optimization and improves residual discriminability. We integrate a Transformer-based diffusion backbone with a three-stage dual curriculum over masking ratios and diffusion timesteps, retaining anomalous samples throughout training and relying on structured corruption to drive self-supervised representation learning. We evaluate NV-Tesseract-AD under two regimes: in-distribution training on the TSB-UAD-M corpus and strict zero-shot transfer to ten EasyTSAD benchmark families without per-dataset tuning. The dual-axis curriculum produces masking-invariant reconstruction, confirmed by a near-zero loss gap between complementary masking strategies within the first training stage, and yields an approximately 3.7-fold improvement in F1 and a 56 percent reduction in MSE relative to a non-curriculum baseline. Zero-shot performance reaches F1 = 0.984 on NAB and F1 = 0.948 on NormA. Weaker results on heterogeneous families are traced to unsupervised threshold calibration rather than reconstruction quality, identifying calibration as the dominant remaining detection bottleneck. Accelerated inference via DPM-Solver++ reduces sampling cost by a factor of 3.5 to 5.7 at the dataset level but couples to thresholding behavior, establishing that the sampler and threshold must be validated jointly. Together, these findings demonstrate that aligning diffusion denoising difficulty with curriculum learning principles provides a principled and practical approach for robust anomaly detection in complex multivariate time series.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NV-Tesseract-AD 用课程学习增强的条件扩散做多变量时间序列异常检测：沿掩码比例与扩散时间步两条轴由易到难训练，异常样本全程保留、靠结构化损坏驱动自监督表征。相对无课程基线 F1 提升约 3.7 倍、MSE 降低 56%，零样本迁移在 NAB 上 F1=0.984、NormA 上 F1=0.948；作者判定剩余瓶颈是无监督阈值标定而非重建质量。
Motivation: 多变量时间序列异常检测中重建难度未被显式组织，优化不稳且残差可分性差；同时逐数据集调参的评测方式难以说明模型的跨数据集迁移能力。
Method: Transformer 扩散骨干加三阶段双课程（dual curriculum），同时沿掩码比例与扩散时间步由易到难推进，训练全程保留异常样本，靠结构化损坏做自监督表征学习；评测分两路：TSB-UAD-M 语料上分布内训练，以及对十个 EasyTSAD benchmark 家族的严格零样本迁移（不做逐数据集调参），推理用 DPM-Solver++ 加速。
Result: 相对无课程基线 F1 提升约 3.7 倍、MSE 降低 56%；训练第一阶段内互补掩码策略之间的损失差接近零，呈掩码不变重建。零样本 F1=0.984（NAB）、F1=0.948（NormA）。DPM-Solver++ 在数据集层面把采样开销降低 3.5 至 5.7 倍，但与阈值行为耦合。异质家族上结果偏弱，作者归因于无监督阈值标定而非重建质量。
Conclusion: 把扩散去噪难度与课程学习对齐能稳健提升多变量时间序列异常检测；检测的主要剩余瓶颈是阈值标定，采样器与阈值必须联合验证。

papers.title: Parametric wave spectrum models for prediction of Stokes drift profiles
papers.abstract_en: In this report, 15 variants of nine parametric models for non-directional ocean wave spectra are reviewed. They are compared against observation-based spectra created by taking spectra measured by moored buoys, binning by wind speed, and averaging. Surface Stokes drift (SSD) and Stokes drift profiles are computed using the model and observation-based spectra, and these are compared. This 'parametric wave model' strategy for estimating Stokes drift is contrasted with other methods for estimating Stokes drift, such as using spectra from a dynamical wave model. Advantages and shortcomings are reviewed. One practical application for Stokes drift profiles is in ocean circulation modeling. Here, the information is used to compute wave-enhanced mixing ('Langmuir turbulence'). We present examples of such cases, in the context of a global ocean model, tested in two modes (coupled and uncoupled) and with two types of forcing (Stokes drift approximated using wind speed and Stokes drift computed using a full ocean wave model). A more comprehensive review of the uncoupled tests with the full ocean wave model can be found in a separate report, Fan et al. (2026). We evaluate simple Stokes drift models that use wind speed and/or wind stress but do not require a dynamical wave model. We find some are sufficiently accurate for routine prediction of SSD. A subset of these models can also predict Stokes drift profiles (via parametric spectra), but none are accurate in this role. The SSD values computed from a very large drifting buoy dataset are compared with the total drift calculated using positional change of the same buoys. The SSD is roughly 25% of the total drift, consistent with expectations based on 'rules of thumb'. However, the scatter is large, indicating that such rules have predictive skill only in the mean sense.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 综述 9 个参数化非方向性波谱模型的 15 个变体，用浮标实测谱按风速分箱平均作参照，比较其 Stokes 漂移剖面估计精度。部分仅用风速/风应力的简单模型足以常规预报表层 Stokes 漂移 (SSD)，但凡通过参数化谱推算剖面的模型都不准；大样本漂流浮标显示 SSD 约占总漂移 25%，散布很大。
Motivation: Stokes 漂移剖面用于海洋环流模式中的波致混合 (Langmuir turbulence) 参数化，但参数化波谱模型相对动力波浪模式的精度与适用范围缺少系统评估。
Method: 综述 9 个参数化波谱模型的 15 个变体，与系泊浮标实测谱（按风速分箱平均）对比，计算并比较 SSD 与 Stokes 漂移剖面；在全局海洋模式中以耦合/非耦合两种模式、两种强迫（风速近似 vs 全波浪模式计算）给出算例；用超大漂流浮标数据集将 SSD 与浮标位置变化得到的总漂移对比。
Result: 部分仅依赖风速/风应力、无需动力波浪模式的简单模型对 SSD 常规预报足够准确；但所有通过参数化谱预测 Stokes 漂移剖面的模型都不准。漂流浮标数据集中 SSD 约为总漂移的 25%，与经验法则一致，但散布很大。
Conclusion: 参数化波谱模型可用于 SSD 的常规预报，但不足以给出 Stokes 漂移剖面；25% 经验法则只在平均意义上有预报技巧。

papers.title: Trajectory Prediction for Autonomous Driving in Road Construction Zones Using Human-in-the-Loop Driving Data
papers.abstract_en: Ego-trajectory prediction in urban roadway work zones remains an underexplored topic in autonomous-driving research, with limited dedicated data and systematic evaluation. Roadway work zones involve temporary changes in the lane layouts and connectivity of the roads, complicating interactions with surrounding vehicles and workers. These changes make future vehicle trajectories difficult to predict. To address these challenges, we collect WZDrive-Data, a multimodal dataset comprising 1,183 work-zone driving segments from 33 drivers, using a human-in-the-loop driving simulator with prerecorded worker animations and VR-controlled workers. Driver control and gaze signals are recorded from human participants, while vehicle trajectories and scene information are obtained from the simulator. Our proposed multimodal ego-trajectory predictor, WZDrive, achieves a mean minADE (K=6) of 1.09 m and minFDE (K=6) of 2.12 m. Compared with the best-performing state-of-the-art baseline for each metric in our benchmark, WZDrive reduces minADE (K=6) by 7.18% and minFDE (K=6) by 13.18%. This research addresses a gap in autonomous-driving research on urban work zones by combining human-in-the-loop data collection with multimodal learning from human driving signals and in the context of work zones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对城市道路施工区自车轨迹预测缺少专用数据的问题，用人在回路 (human-in-the-loop) 驾驶模拟器采集 WZDrive-Data（1,183 段施工区驾驶、33 名驾驶员，含控制与注视信号），并提出多模态预测器 WZDrive。在自建 benchmark 上 WZDrive 的 minADE (K=6) 为 1.09 m、minFDE (K=6) 为 2.12 m，相对各指标最强基线分别降低 7.18% 与 13.18%。
Motivation: 施工区临时改变车道布局与道路连通性，车辆与工人交互复杂，未来轨迹难以预测；该场景缺乏专用数据集与系统性评测。
Method: 用带预录工人动画与 VR 控制工人的驾驶模拟器采集 WZDrive-Data 多模态数据集，记录人类驾驶员的控制与注视信号以及模拟器输出的车辆轨迹和场景信息；据此训练多模态自车轨迹预测器 WZDrive，并在自建 benchmark 上与各指标最强的 SOTA 基线比较。
Result: WZDrive 达到 mean minADE (K=6) 1.09 m、minFDE (K=6) 2.12 m；相对每个指标上表现最好的 SOTA 基线，minADE (K=6) 降低 7.18%，minFDE (K=6) 降低 13.18%。数据集规模为 1,183 段施工区驾驶、33 名驾驶员。
Conclusion: 把人在回路数据采集与来自人类驾驶信号（控制、注视）的多模态学习结合起来，可以填补城市施工区自车轨迹预测这一自动驾驶研究空白。

papers.title: Static Gradient Attribution Underperforms a Density-Matched Random Mask on Loss-Based Forgetting Within LoRA B-Matrix
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient continual learning updates a restricted subset of adapter parameters to incorporate sequential tasks while limiting catastrophic forgetting. Gradient attribution is a common rule for selecting that subset, but it requires an additional backward pass over calibration data. We identify a parameter-pool confound in comparisons between initialization-time gradient masks and unrestricted random masks under standard zero-initialized LoRA ($B=0$): the gradient with respect to $A$ is identically zero ($\partial\mathcal{L}/\partial A=0$), so gradient masks select strictly from the $B$ matrix whereas unrestricted random masks draw from both $A$ and $B$. Such a comparison changes both the selection rule and the candidate parameter pool. Isolating the selection criterion by restricting both approaches to the same parameter pool, we find a negative result: a uniform random mask consistently achieves lower loss-based backward transfer than gradient attribution across seven seeds on Qwen2.5-3B. The effect is concentrated on the medical task, which contributes 80\% of the aggregate; code and math move in the same direction, and legal shows no reliable difference. This advantage is consistent with a stability--plasticity trade-off under the tested task sequence, in which random masking slightly reduces single-task fitting. On the two discrete-option tasks (Medical and Legal), the mean accuracy-BWT difference is not statistically distinguishable from zero.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在零初始化 LoRA（B=0）下，梯度归因选参数时 ∂L/∂A≡0，只能从 B 矩阵选，而无约束随机掩码同时从 A 和 B 抽样，因此常见对比同时改变了选择规则与候选参数池。把两者限制到同一参数池（均为 B 矩阵）后结论反转：在 Qwen2.5-3B 上七个种子中，均匀随机掩码的基于损失的 backward transfer 一致低于（即更少遗忘）梯度归因，优势 80% 来自医疗任务。
Motivation: 持续学习中用梯度归因挑选 LoRA 可更新子集需要在校准数据上多做一次反向传播；而现有初始化期梯度掩码与随机掩码的对比存在参数池混淆，无法判断差异究竟来自选择规则还是候选池。
Method: 先指出零初始化 LoRA 下对 A 的梯度恒为零导致的参数池混淆，再把梯度归因与均匀随机掩码都限制到同一参数池（B 矩阵）以单独隔离选择准则；在 Qwen2.5-3B 上按给定任务序列做七种子实验，用基于损失的 backward transfer（BWT）度量遗忘，并区分医疗、代码、数学、法律四类任务。
Result: 同一参数池下，均匀随机掩码在七个种子上一致取得比梯度归因更低的 loss-based backward transfer；该效应 80% 由医疗任务贡献，代码与数学方向一致，法律无可靠差异。代价是随机掩码使单任务拟合略降。在 Medical 与 Legal 两个离散选项任务上，accuracy-BWT 均值差异与零统计上不可区分。
Conclusion: 在所测任务序列下，梯度归因相对同池随机掩码并无优势，其表面收益可由参数池混淆解释；随机掩码体现为稳定性—可塑性权衡（略降单任务拟合换取更少遗忘）。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: 在零初始化 LoRA（B=0）下，梯度归因选参数时 ∂L/∂A≡0，只能从 B 矩阵选，而无约束随机掩码同时从 A 和 B 抽样，因此常见对比同时改变了选择规则与候选参数池。把两者限制到同一参数池（均为 B 矩阵）后结论反转：在 Qwen2.5-3B 上七个种子中，均匀随机掩码的基于损失的 backward transfer 一致低于（即更少遗忘）梯度归因，优势 80% 来自医疗任务。

papers.title: Neural expectation-maximization and meta-models
papers.abstract_en: We interpret Transformer networks as learned approximations to a hybrid probabilistic-inference procedure that combines max-product Loopy Belief Propagation (LBP) with Expectation--Maximization (EM). In this view, a Transformer performs inference in partially observed Markov Random Fields (MRFs) whose structure and parameters are not given a priori but are inferred from data. We show that self-attention implements a differentiable approximation to max-product LBP on an input-conditioned, dynamically structured MRF, with attention weights encoding learned structural affinities. We further establish an EM correspondence at the level of depth: each layer updates latent representations in an E-step-like forward pass, while the transition $θ^{(l)} \to θ^{(l+1)}$ across layers acts as an implicit M-step. Building on this interpretation, we introduce \emph{meta-models}, a design paradigm in which inputs generate instance-specific parameters, unifying mechanisms such as self-attention, mixture-of-experts, and gated units within a single framework. Empirical results support the proposed perspective.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Transformer 重新解释为混合概率推断的可学习近似：self-attention 是在输入条件化、动态结构的马尔可夫随机场 (MRF) 上做 max-product Loopy Belief Propagation 的可微近似，逐层深度对应 EM 的 E 步与隐式 M 步。据此提出 meta-models 范式，让输入生成实例特定参数，把 self-attention、mixture-of-experts、gated units 统一进同一框架，摘要称实证结果支持该视角。
Motivation: Transformer 的注意力与层级更新缺少统一的概率推断语义，self-attention、MoE、gated unit 各自为政，难以在同一框架下设计与分析。
Method: 将 self-attention 建模为输入条件化动态 MRF 上 max-product LBP 的可微近似，注意力权重编码学到的结构亲和度；把层间 θ^(l)→θ^(l+1) 视作隐式 M 步、每层前向视作 E 步式更新；由此导出 meta-models 设计范式，由输入生成实例特定参数。
Result: 给出 self-attention 对应 max-product LBP、深度对应 EM 的对应关系，并提出统一 self-attention、mixture-of-experts 与 gated units 的 meta-models；摘要以实证结果支持该视角，未给出具体数据集、指标或数值。
Conclusion: Transformer 可视为在推断出来的 MRF 上执行的混合概率推断过程，meta-models 把输入生成参数的机制统一为同一设计范式。

papers.title: Minimax Rates for Estimating Powered Sliced Wasserstein Functionals
papers.abstract_en: We study the two-sample estimation of the powered Sliced Wasserstein functional under projected $r$-th moment assumptions. Let $N=n\wedge m$, where $n$ and $m$ are two sample sizes. We establish the minimax rates in the noncritical regimes. When $p<r<2p$, the minimax risk is of order $N^{-(r-p)/r}$, while for $r>2p$ it is of order $N^{-1/2}$. In both cases, the natural plug-in estimator is minimax rate-optimal. At the endpoint $r=p$, the minimax risk is bounded away from zero, so uniformly consistent estimation is impossible. At the critical order $r=2p$, we obtain the exact worst-case rate of the plug-in estimator and a lower bound for the minimax risk, leaving a logarithmic gap between the lower and upper bounds. The exact minimax rate in this critical case remains open.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在投影 r 阶矩假设下给出 powered Sliced Wasserstein 泛函两样本估计的 minimax 速率：非临界区间 p<r<2p 时风险为 N^{-(r-p)/r}，r>2p 时为 N^{-1/2}，两处 plug-in 估计量都达到速率最优；端点 r=p 时风险一致远离零，一致估计不可能。
Motivation: powered Sliced Wasserstein 泛函的两样本估计在不同矩阶区间缺少统一的 minimax 风险刻画，尤其临界阶与端点处的可估计性边界不明。
Method: 在投影 r 阶矩假设下，以 N=n∧m（n、m 为两样本量）为样本规模，对 powered Sliced Wasserstein 泛函做两样本估计的 minimax 上下界分析，覆盖非临界区间、端点 r=p 与临界阶 r=2p。
Result: p<r<2p 时 minimax 风险为 N^{-(r-p)/r}，r>2p 时为 N^{-1/2}，两种情形下自然的 plug-in 估计量均 minimax 速率最优；r=p 时 minimax 风险有远离零的下界，一致估计不可能；r=2p 时给出 plug-in 估计量的精确最坏情形速率与 minimax 风险下界，上下界之间留有对数间隙。
Conclusion: 非临界区间内 plug-in 估计即为最优，端点 r=p 处一致估计不可行；临界阶 r=2p 的精确 minimax 速率仍是开放问题。

papers.title: KITE: A Knowledge-Injected Temporal Encoder for Time-Series Event Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Forecasting rare, high-cost events in multivariate time-series systems is hard because their precursors are seldom observed, so a purely data-driven model has little to learn from. The engineers who run these systems, however, hold knowledge that precedes such events, information absent from the scarce labels. We call this a semantic prior and inject it into a self-supervised event forecaster through two switchable mechanisms, a covariate mechanism and an attention-bias mechanism, each the identity at its null, so one architecture serves every prior type with no per-dataset architecture search. A prior helps when it supplies information the observed window does not already contain: in a short context an informative prior beats no prior in-domain (pooled h-AUROC over the no-prior baseline: a periodicity clock +14%, p<0.001; a conservation residual +47% at a 0.25 label fraction), and a working prior transfers out-of-domain (+53%), substituting for feature transfer, while priors the window already recovers stay inert and the attention-bias mechanism shows no measurable gain. KITE is a switchable, attributable route to contextual conditioning, and a substrate for scaling toward cross-domain, pretrained time-series foundation world models that carry their governing structure explicitly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KITE 把工程师掌握、稀缺标签中不存在的语义先验 (semantic prior) 注入自监督事件预报器，用两个可切换机制（covariate 与 attention-bias，空先验时均为恒等）让单一架构适配所有先验类型而无需逐数据集搜索架构。短上下文下提供新信息的先验显著优于无先验：周期时钟 pooled h-AUROC 相对无先验基线 +14%（p<0.001），守恒残差在 0.25 标签比例下 +47%；可用先验还能跨域迁移 (+53%) 替代特征迁移，而观测窗口已能恢复的先验保持惰性、attention-bias 机制无可测增益。
Motivation: 多变量时间序列中的稀有高代价事件其前兆极少被观测到，纯数据驱动模型几乎没有可学的样本；而运维工程师掌握先于事件发生、稀缺标签中缺失的知识，这部分信息无法从数据中学到。
Method: KITE 将语义先验通过两个可切换机制注入自监督事件预报器：covariate 机制与 attention-bias 机制，两者在空先验时都退化为恒等映射，因此一个架构覆盖所有先验类型、无需逐数据集架构搜索；先验是否有效取决于它是否提供观测窗口之外的信息。
Result: 短上下文下，有信息量的先验胜过无先验：pooled h-AUROC 相对无先验基线，周期时钟 (periodicity clock) +14%（p<0.001），守恒残差 (conservation residual) 在 0.25 标签比例下 +47%；可用先验跨域迁移 +53%，可替代特征迁移；观测窗口已能恢复的先验保持惰性，attention-bias 机制无可测增益。
Conclusion: 先验只有在补充观测窗口未包含的信息时才有价值——短上下文、跨域、低标签场景下能替代数据与特征迁移，否则无效；KITE 被定位为可切换、可归因的上下文条件化路径，并作为通向显式携带支配结构的跨域预训练时间序列基础世界模型的底座。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Kernelized Parameter Sensitivity Atlases for Amortized Conditional Interpretability
papers.abstract_en: Gradient-based attribution provides input-specific information about model parameters, but computing it via backpropagation for many samples is expensive, while static importance scores discard input dependence. We derive KPSA (Kernelized Parameter Sensitivity Atlas) from a block decomposition of the empirical neural tangent kernel. It measures normalized parameter-group sensitivity, embeds those sources in an explicit query space, and uses a lightweight kernel to estimate sensitivities for unseen inputs. We derive bounds that separate finite-source from irreducible representation error and give margin-based top-$k$ recovery. This paper studies two interpretability applications. Firstly, KPSA identifies parameter groups with high susceptibility to perturbations across vision, forecasting, and protein-modeling setups. Across a fivefold range of parameter budgets ($0.02$-$0.1\%$), its selected groups attain $39$-$85\%$ of the perturbation susceptibility of a first-order backpropagation oracle. In vision and forecasting, these parameter groups form sparse sensitivity circuits that extend across depth and vary systematically with the input. Secondly, we use KPSA on an activation-attribution problem for MLP features in transformers. It retains $81\%$ of the gap between a backpropagation oracle and a constant-sensitivity baseline on vision while increasing batched query-time throughput from 551 to 2,041 images/s and reducing peak GPU memory from 4.55 to 0.44GB. On the protein-modeling task, it recovers $68\%$ of this gap. An ablation of KPSA's kernel aggregation shows that nearest-neighbor retrieval in KPSA space can remain competitive. The empirics show that compact kernel atlases can store useful input-dependent parameter sensitivity while amortizing repeated gradient attribution, a step toward scalable conditional interpretability. Code can be found at https://github.com/Axym-Labs/kpsa .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KPSA 从经验神经正切核 (empirical NTK) 的块分解导出归一化参数组敏感度，把敏感度源嵌入显式查询空间并用轻量核对未见输入做摊销 (amortized) 归因。在 0.02–0.1% 参数预算下，其选出的参数组达到一阶反向传播 oracle 39–85% 的扰动易感性；在视觉激活归因任务上保留 oracle 与常数敏感度基线之间 81% 的差距，批处理查询吞吐从 551 提到 2,041 images/s，峰值显存从 4.55GB 降到 0.44GB。
Motivation: 基于梯度的归因对每个输入都要反向传播，样本一多开销很大；而静态重要性分数丢掉了输入依赖，两者都不能在大量样本上给出可摊销的条件化参数敏感度。
Method: KPSA 对经验 NTK 做块分解，度量归一化后的参数组敏感度，把这些敏感度源嵌入显式查询空间，再用一个轻量核对未见输入估计敏感度；同时给出区分有限源误差与不可约表示误差的界，以及基于间隔的 top-k 恢复保证。评估覆盖视觉、预报 (forecasting) 与蛋白质建模三类设置，应用包括参数组扰动易感性筛选和 transformer 中 MLP 特征的激活归因。
Result: 在 0.02–0.1%（五倍范围）参数预算下，KPSA 选出的参数组达到一阶反向传播 oracle 39–85% 的扰动易感性；视觉与预报设置中这些参数组构成跨深度、随输入系统变化的稀疏敏感度电路。视觉激活归因任务上保留 oracle 与常数敏感度基线之间 81% 的差距，批处理查询吞吐 551 → 2,041 images/s，峰值显存 4.55 → 0.44GB；蛋白质建模任务上恢复该差距的 68%。核聚合消融显示 KPSA 空间中的最近邻检索仍可保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 紧凑的核 atlas 能存住有用的输入依赖参数敏感度并摊销重复梯度归因，是走向可扩展条件化可解释性 (conditional interpretability) 的一步。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Reference-Free Food Volume Estimation from Egocentric Stereo Video
papers.abstract_en: Current stereo vision-based approaches for food portion estimation are hindered by the user burden of using a mobile phone to capture multiple images or placing a reference object in the scene for scale calibration. As a step towards passive dietary intake monitoring, we introduce a method that uses stereo video from a wearable egocentric device to reconstruct food items in true physical scale to accurately estimate volume. By utilizing FoundationStereo for zero-shot stereo matching, SAM 2 for food segmentation, and TSDF fusion over a set of keyframes, our method yields a visually and metrically accurate 3D mesh of any plated food item from a single stereo recording. We leverage the unique offerings of wearables, such as a factory-calibrated stereo baseline and camera poses estimated on-device via visual-inertial odometry (VIO), to perform fully automatic reconstruction without a scale reference object in the scene. We show strong initial volume estimation results across five recorded food items, achieving a mean absolute percentage error of 9.1%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用可穿戴第一人称立体视频做无参照物的食物体积估计：FoundationStereo 零样本立体匹配 + SAM 2 分割 + 关键帧 TSDF 融合，配合出厂标定基线与设备端 VIO 位姿，从单次立体录制直接重建真实物理尺度的 3D 网格。在 5 种记录食物上体积估计 MAPE 为 9.1%。
Motivation: 现有立体视觉食物份量估计要么要求用户手持手机拍多张照片，要么要在场景里放参照物做尺度标定，用户负担重，不利于被动膳食摄入监测。
Method: 用 FoundationStereo 做零样本立体匹配，SAM 2 分割食物区域，对一组关键帧做 TSDF 融合得到 3D 网格；尺度来自可穿戴设备的出厂标定立体基线，相机位姿由设备端视觉惯性里程计 (VIO) 估计，全程无需场景内参照物。
Result: 在 5 种记录食物上取得 9.1% 的平均绝对百分比误差 (MAPE)，单次立体录制即可重建出视觉与度量上准确的餐盘食物网格。
Conclusion: 把出厂标定基线与设备端 VIO 结合零样本立体匹配和 TSDF 融合，可以在不放参照物的前提下自动完成真实尺度的食物体积估计，作者将其定位为被动膳食监测的初步结果。

papers.title: StereoEngine: Scaling Stereo Bimanual Robot Data without Stereo Cameras
papers.abstract_en: Stereo vision is increasingly used for robotic manipulation, with a growing body of work incorporating it into Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. However, the scarcity of large-scale, real-world stereo datasets remains a fundamental bottleneck for scaling such policies. Recent generative monocular-to-stereo methods target settings such as VR content and autonomous driving. No prior work produces realistic synthetic stereo data for robotic manipulation, where stereo supervision has come predominantly from simulation. We propose StereoEngine, which introduces two complementary methods to synthesize stereo data for robotic manipulation. In the first, we warp a monocular (left) video into the right view using estimated depth and inpaint the disoccluded regions with a video diffusion model, lifting monocular demonstrations into stereo pairs without training on real stereo. In the second, we render a stereo pair in simulation and jointly generate both photorealistic views, producing consistent left-right data without any real video as input. StereoEngine outperforms existing baselines in generated stereo quality, and using its synthetic data for policy mid-training or task-specific fine-tuning substantially improves downstream bimanual manipulation. Project website: https://stereoengine.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StereoEngine 为双臂机器人操作合成大规模立体视觉数据，绕开真实立体数据集稀缺：一是用估计深度把单目左视视频 warp 到右视，再用视频扩散模型补全被遮挡区域，无需真实立体数据训练；二是在仿真中渲染立体对并联合生成两个照片级视图，完全不需真实视频输入。生成的立体质量超过现有基线，用其合成数据做策略 mid-training 或任务特定微调能显著改善下游双臂操作。
Motivation: 立体视觉正被引入 VLA 模型，但大规模真实立体数据集稀缺是扩展此类策略的根本瓶颈；机器人操作领域此前的立体监督几乎只来自仿真，没有工作能生成照片级合成立体数据。
Method: 两条互补路径：其一 warp 单目（左）视频到右视，用估计深度处理几何、视频扩散模型补全 disocclusion 区域，把单目演示提升为立体对；其二在仿真中渲染立体对并联合生成两张照片级视图，产出左右一致的数据且无需真实视频输入。
Result: 生成的立体质量超过现有基线；用 StereoEngine 合成数据做策略 mid-training 或任务特定微调，显著改善下游双臂操作表现。
Conclusion: 机器人操作的立体监督可以不依赖真实立体相机或纯仿真渲染，通过单目视频提升或仿真渲染加照片级生成两条路径合成，且足以支撑双臂策略训练。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Categorical Atlas of Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning: Cones, Orbits, and Gauges
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning has hundreds of methods, usually compared by parameter count and benchmark score. We compare them as maps. A pretrained checkpoint is a base point in weight space, and a weight-space method is a smooth map from a small parameter space that starts at that point. These maps form a slice category in which the frozen model is initial and full fine-tuning terminal. Three invariants of the map do most of the work. Its image near the base point governs expressivity, through the first-order image, the dimension, a min-cut bound on rank and whether that point is smooth or an apex. Its fibres, with the optimizer's metric, govern training dynamics. Base change moves the base point and covers splitting initialisations, quantisation, restarts and merging. We prove, for example, that zero-initialised LoRA, and Householder reflection adaptation at its default start under stated rank and parity conditions, begin at the apex of a cone; that no exact initialisation lets LoRA reach an update of rank above twice its own; that exactly orthogonal methods never change a weight's singular values in exact arithmetic, however often they are merged; that under Adam with no epsilon, weight decay or clipping and one shared schedule, LoRA+ from the standard zero initialisation follows exactly the trajectory of plain LoRA with its scale multiplied by the learning-rate ratio; that Adam with shared hyperparameters respects only the signed permutations inside LoRA's continuous symmetry group of full-rank factors; and that the activation function decides when a scaling adapter folds into preceding weights. We classify 382 methods from 138 papers by seven coordinates read off their formulas, with 403 simulation arrows and 485 obstructions. Every numbered result is proved in full, and results due to others are credited where we re-derive them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把参数高效微调 (PEFT) 方法当作权重空间中的映射来分类：预训练检查点是基点，方法是从该点出发的光滑映射，构成以冻结模型为初始对象、全量微调为终结对象的 slice category。用表达力（一阶像、维数、rank 的 min-cut 界、光滑点或锥顶）、训练动力学（纤维配优化器度量）与 base change 三个不变量，从公式读出七个坐标，分类 138 篇论文的 382 个方法，给出 403 条模拟箭头与 485 个障碍。
Motivation: PEFT 有数百种方法，但通行比较只看参数量和 benchmark 分数，缺少能解释初始化、优化轨迹、合并与量化行为的结构性框架。
Method: 把每个 PEFT 方法建模为从低维参数空间到权重空间的光滑映射，构成 slice category；用三个不变量（基点附近的像与一阶像、纤维配 Adam 度量、base change）刻画表达力与动力学；从方法公式读出七个坐标做分类，并对每条编号结论给出完整证明，重述他人结果时注明出处。
Result: 证明：零初始化 LoRA 与默认起点下的 Householder reflection adaptation（在给定 rank 与 parity 条件下）位于锥顶；LoRA 无法通过任何精确初始化达到超过自身两倍 rank 的更新；正交方法在精确算术下永不改变权重的奇异值，无论合并多少次；在无 epsilon、无 weight decay、无 clipping 且共享调度的 Adam 下，标准零初始化的 LoRA+ 轨迹恰等于 scale 乘以学习率比值的普通 LoRA；共享超参的 Adam 只尊重 LoRA 满秩因子连续对称群中的 signed permutation；scaling adapter 是否可折入前层权重由激活函数决定。分类规模为 382 个方法、138 篇论文、403 条模拟箭头、485 个障碍。
Conclusion: PEFT 方法之间的差异可以由少数几个从公式直接读出的几何不变量系统解释，且这些结论能以完整证明的形式确立，而不必依赖 benchmark 排名。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Zebra3D: Efficient Hybrid Foundation Models For Scalable 3D Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D foundation models reconstruct scenes from unposed images, but the quadratic cost of global attention limits their scalability to large view sets. We present Zebra3D, a layerwise sparse-linear hybrid attention framework that improves the efficiency of pretrained 3D foundation models without training from scratch. Across VGGT, HunyuanWorld-Mirror, and $π^3$, we observe a broadly consistent depth-wise pattern: early stages are relatively tolerant to linear replacement, while sensitive middle-to-late stages tend to exhibit more concentrated attention. Zebra3D exploits this structure by assigning linear-centered attention to tolerant stages and tile-sparse attention to sensitive stages, using landmark summaries to preserve unselected context. Closed-form affine fitting enables training-free conversion, while optional post-conversion training combines task supervision with output and relational feature distillation. Across all three backbones, Zebra3D achieves strong reconstruction and camera-pose accuracy at high attention sparsity, with training-free variants remaining close to their dense counterparts. End-to-end speedups increase with input view count, reaching up to $7.1\times$ at 1,024 views. After post-conversion training, Zebra3D-VGGT reaches 80.5\% RealEstate10K AUC@30 at 94\% mean attention sparsity, within 1.1 percentage points of dense VGGT fine-tuned on the same data and schedule.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Zebra3D 用逐层稀疏-线性混合注意力改造已训练好的 3D 基础模型：容忍线性替换的浅层用 linear-centered attention，注意力更集中的中后层用 tile-sparse attention 并以 landmark 摘要保留未选上下文，闭式仿射拟合实现免训练转换。在 VGGT、HunyuanWorld-Mirror、π³ 上，1024 视角端到端加速最高 7.1×；转换后训练的 Zebra3D-VGGT 在 94% 平均注意力稀疏度下达到 RealEstate10K AUC@30 80.5%，距同数据同日程微调的稠密 VGGT 仅 1.1 个百分点。
Motivation: 前馈式 3D 基础模型用全局注意力从无位姿图像重建场景，但全局注意力的二次代价限制了其在大视角集合上的可扩展性。
Method: 逐层混合注意力：对线性替换较容忍的早期层用 linear-centered attention，对敏感的中后层用 tile-sparse attention 并以 landmark 摘要补足未选上下文；闭式仿射拟合 (closed-form affine fitting) 支持免训练转换，可选的转换后训练叠加任务监督、输出蒸馏与关系特征蒸馏 (relational feature distillation)。
Result: 在 VGGT、HunyuanWorld-Mirror、π³ 三个骨干上均观察到一致的深度分布：早期层较容忍线性替换，中后层注意力更集中。端到端加速随输入视角数增长，1,024 视角下最高 7.1×；免训练变体保持接近稠密模型。转换后训练的 Zebra3D-VGGT 在 94% 平均注意力稀疏度下 RealEstate10K AUC@30 达 80.5%，比同数据同训练日程的稠密 VGGT 微调低 1.1 个百分点。
Conclusion: 3D 基础模型的注意力敏感性沿深度分层，因此按层分配线性与 tile-sparse 注意力可在高稀疏度下保住重建与相机位姿精度，且免训练转换已足够接近稠密模型。

papers.title: Spatial Context or Memory? Sizing the Inputs of Neural Surrogates for Partially Observed Fields
papers.abstract_en: Neural surrogates that forecast a physical field from sparse, noisy sensors read a window of nearby sensors and a history of past snapshots. Practitioners choose both by comparing fitted models with each other. Such comparisons cannot tell a model's shortfall from missing information. We measure the trade-off between window and history against the Bayes-optimal error of the same readings. An exact Gaussian analysis shows that noisy or sparse observation of a field with local dynamics makes the optimal forecast read distant sensors only through spatial correlation. On a forced linear field with a known optimum, trained models that read only the window come within 1% of it. We then train such models on viscous Burgers flow and the chaotic Kuramoto-Sivashinsky (KS) equation, with every deciding comparison fixed before any test evaluation. In every field except KS, eight snapshots remove a smaller fraction of the one-snapshot error as the lead time, the number of steps to the forecast target, grows. In KS, for windows up to one correlation length, they remove a larger fraction. This lead-time inversion persists across sensor densities, three architectures and a two-dimensional domain. It shrinks as damping lowers the Lyapunov exponent. Damping also removes the linear instability of KS. We therefore tie the inversion to instability and leave chaos and linear amplification unseparated. For surrogate design the results give two rules. Size the window in correlation lengths of the field. Split a fixed input budget between window and history for the lead time the model will serve, because the best split moves toward wider windows as the lead time grows. In Burgers flow the split chosen at lead time one ends with 13.5 times the best error at lead time eight.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究从稀疏含噪传感器预报物理场时，输入窗口宽度与历史快照数的取舍，并以同一读数的 Bayes-optimal 误差为基准衡量。精确高斯分析表明局部动力学场的最优预报只通过空间相关性读取远处传感器；在 viscous Burgers 与混沌 Kuramoto-Sivashinsky (KS) 上，除 KS 外八个快照随 lead time 增长只能消除更小比例的一快照误差，而 KS 中窗口不超过一个相关长度时反而消除更大比例，即出现 lead-time inversion。作者给出两条设计规则：窗口按场的相关长度定尺寸，固定输入预算按服务的 lead time 在窗口与历史间分配，因为最优分配随 lead time 增大偏向更宽窗口。
Motivation: 实践中神经代理的窗口与历史长度靠互相比较拟合模型来选，这类比较无法区分模型本身的不足与输入信息缺失；需要一个以 Bayes-optimal 误差为参照的取舍度量。
Method: 先对含噪或稀疏观测、局部动力学的场做精确高斯分析，得到最优预报与 Bayes-optimal 误差；再在已知最优解的 forced linear field 上检验只读窗口的模型，随后在 viscous Burgers flow 与混沌 KS 方程上训练模型，所有关键对比在测试评估前固定，并跨传感器密度、三种架构与二维域检验。
Result: forced linear field 上只读窗口的训练模型距已知最优解 1% 以内。除 KS 外，八个快照随 lead time 增长消除的一快窗误差比例更小；KS 中窗口不超过一个相关长度时该比例更大。该 lead-time inversion 在多种传感器密度、三种架构与二维域中持续存在，随阻尼降低 Lyapunov 指数而减弱，阻尼同时移除 KS 的线性不稳定性。Burgers flow 中在 lead time one 选定的分配到 lead time eight 时误差是最优分配的 13.5 倍。
Conclusion: lead-time inversion 与不稳定性挂钩，但混沌与线性放大仍未分离；代理设计上窗口应按相关长度定尺寸，固定输入预算要按服务的 lead time 在窗口与历史间分配。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: A Distributional Framework for Behavioral Characterization and Risk Management of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are stochastic by nature. Repeated executions under the same experimental conditions may produce different responses. We propose a framework that can be applied across the model lifecycle, from task design to residual behavior and continuous monitoring. The method consists of building an empirical response distribution estimated through Monte Carlo simulation. Semantic interventions are introduced to study how these distributions change. We illustrate the framework with two different tasks, borrower classification and music album recommendation, and quantify the resulting distributional changes. The framework is linked to model risk management and governance by measuring robustness and control effectiveness, and characterizing residual behavior. Since it relies only on observed responses, it can also be applied to black-box models accessed through commercial APIs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个基于 Monte Carlo 重复采样的分布框架，用经验响应分布刻画 LLM 的随机行为，并通过语义干预 (semantic interventions) 测量分布变化，从而量化鲁棒性、控制有效性与残余行为。框架覆盖从任务设计到持续监控的全生命周期，且只依赖观测响应，可直接用于商业 API 访问的黑盒模型。
Motivation: LLM 在相同实验条件下重复执行会给出不同响应，单次输出评估无法刻画这种随机性，模型风险管理与治理缺少可操作的行为表征与控制有效性度量。
Method: 对每个任务做 Monte Carlo 重复执行，估计经验响应分布；引入语义干预观察分布如何改变；在借款人分类 (borrower classification) 与音乐专辑推荐两个任务上演示，并把度量与模型风险管理、治理和残余行为表征挂钩。
Result: 在借款人分类和音乐专辑推荐两个任务上量化了语义干预引起的分布变化，并据此测量鲁棒性、控制有效性与残余行为；框架仅依赖观测响应，适用于通过商业 API 访问的黑盒模型。
Conclusion: LLM 行为应以响应分布而非单次输出来表征，分布层面的干预响应度量可直接充当模型风险管理与治理中的鲁棒性和控制有效性指标。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Byzantine-Resilient Federated Large Language Model via Hypergraph Message Passing
papers.abstract_en: Federated Large Language Models (FedLLMs) are promising to deliver privacy-preserving, collaborative intelligence. The decentralized training process is vulnerable to Byzantine attacks that corrupt semantic consistency and factual resilience through malicious model updates. This paper presents a new resilience strategy that prevents semantically corrupted knowledge from propagating during federated aggregation. A defense problem is formulated to jointly maximize global accuracy and suppress manipulated model updates, enabling trustworthy knowledge aggregation without accessing private local data. To strengthen the resilience of FedLLMs, we develop a novel Hypergraph Message Passing Graph Autoencoder (HMP-GAE) framework, where low-rank model updates are represented as nodes in a hypergraph and high-order semantic relationships among multiple agents are exploited through iterative message passing. By leveraging historical checkpoints and cross-agent relational reasoning, HMP-GAE identifies and suppresses semantically inconsistent updates while preserving knowledge alignment among agents throughout federated training. HMP-GAE is implemented using Qwen-2.5 and Llama-3.2 as pretrained FedLLM backbones and evaluated on AG News and Yahoo! Answers datasets. Compared to existing defenses, HMP-GAE improves global accuracy by $1.21$\%, reduces final-model classification semantic entropy by $44.08$\%, and lowers perplexity by $13.34$\%. HMP-GAE outperforms the GAE-based defense by improving the accuracy $1.39$\%, reducing the semantic entropy by $54.5$\%, and lowering perplexity by $35.5$\%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 联邦 LLM 聚合易受拜占庭攻击污染语义一致性，提出超图消息传递图自编码器 HMP-GAE：把低秩模型更新当作超图节点，用迭代消息传递挖掘多智能体高阶语义关系，结合历史检查点识别并压制语义不一致更新。在 Qwen-2.5 与 Llama-3.2 骨干、AG News 与 Yahoo! Answers 上，相比现有防御全局准确率提升 1.21%、语义熵降 44.08%、困惑度降 13.34%。
Motivation: 联邦 LLM 的去中心化训练中，恶意模型更新会破坏语义一致性与事实鲁棒性，且防御必须在不访问各参与方私有本地数据的条件下完成。
Method: 将低秩模型更新表示为超图节点，通过迭代消息传递 (message passing) 利用多智能体间的高阶语义关系；结合历史检查点与跨智能体关系推理的 Hypergraph Message Passing Graph Autoencoder (HMP-GAE)，把防御形式化为同时最大化全局准确率与压制被操纵更新的优化问题。
Result: 在 Qwen-2.5 与 Llama-3.2 预训练骨干、AG News 与 Yahoo! Answers 数据集上：相比现有防御，全局准确率提升 1.21%，最终模型分类语义熵降低 44.08%，困惑度降低 13.34%；相比基于 GAE 的防御，准确率提升 1.39%，语义熵降低 54.5%，困惑度降低 35.5%。
Conclusion: 用超图高阶语义关系推理加历史检查点，可以在不接触本地数据的前提下压制语义被篡改的更新，从而在联邦聚合中同时保住准确率与语义/事实一致性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unsupervised Multimodal Reward Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language reward models are trained on annotated preference pairs, which are expensive to collect, can disagree, and are ranked by benchmark accuracy. We build one with no human preference label: a linear head on an intermediate layer of a frozen Qwen3-VL backbone, trained to score a web caption above a perturbed version of the same caption; labeled data enters only to select the layer. The layer is the decisive choice, worth 5.8 points over the last layer, and one recipe transferred without re-tuning beats or at least matches GPT-4o on three benchmarks at 32B, 6.6 points ahead on VL-RewardBench, from a few thousand parameters at about a thousandth of fine-tuning compute. At an equal pair budget, perturbations teach a frozen head 3 to 5 points more than curated RLAIF-V pairs. Because the backbone is frozen, the objective is convex, and the perturbation sampler specifies the reward, which the benchmark does not identify: two heads trained on disjoint halves of the same perturbations tie on the benchmark and differ by 6.4 points in hallucination judging. Retraining the head on the policy's own verifier-labeled candidates cuts caption hallucination by 5.1 CHAIR points and lifts image-generation pass rate by 5.4, while scoring lower on every reward benchmark. Together, an intermediate-layer probe, free same-image perturbations, and a verifier-driven bootstrap turn give a recipe for multimodal reward modeling that needs no annotator, costs a fraction of fine-tuning, and is specified by the comparisons it is trained on rather than by a benchmark rank.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用冻结 Qwen3-VL 中间层上的线性头做无监督多模态奖励建模：以网页 caption 与其扰动版本的对比为唯一监督，标注数据只用于选层。中间层比最后一层高 5.8 分；单一配方在 32B 上三个基准追平或超过 GPT-4o，VL-RewardBench 领先 6.6 分，参数仅数千、微调算力约为千分之一。
Motivation: 视觉语言奖励模型依赖昂贵且标注者不一致的人工偏好对，且按基准准确率排名，无法确定奖励真正要刻画的行为。
Method: 在冻结 Qwen3-VL 的某个中间层上接线性头，训练目标是给真实网页 caption 打分高于其扰动版本；标注数据仅用于选择层。骨干冻结使目标为凸，扰动采样器即定义奖励；再用策略自身候选经 verifier 标注后重训头部做自举。
Result: 选层价值 5.8 分（相对最后一层）；32B 下单一配方不重调即在三个基准上追平或超过 GPT-4o，VL-RewardBench 领先 6.6 分，参数量数千、微调算力约为千分之一；同等 pair 预算下扰动比人工整理的 RLAIF-V 对多教 3 到 5 分；同一扰动集不相交两半训练的头部基准打平但幻觉判定差 6.4 分；用 verifier 标注重训后 caption 幻觉降 5.1 CHAIR 分、图像生成通过率升 5.4，但在每个奖励基准上得分更低。
Conclusion: 奖励由训练所用的比较指定，而非由基准排名指定：基准分数无法识别奖励在幻觉判定等行为上的差异，无标注的扰动对比加 verifier 自举即可给出可用的多模态奖励。

papers.title: PVBRF-ID: Private, Verifiable and Byzantine-Robust Federated Intrusion Detection for Oilfield Enterprise Networks
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning allows dispersed oilfield sites to train a shared intrusion detector without pooling network traffic, yet its aggregation step forces a choice between privacy and robustness. Byzantine-robust rules must read each update in the clear, whereas secure aggregation hides updates from the checks that detect poisoning. We present PVBRF-ID, a two-server protocol in which sites secret-share their updates and the servers jointly test each update's norm and its cosine similarity to a reference computed on a small clean root set, revealing one accept bit per site. Commitments, Merkle roots and a homomorphic audit make the inclusion of accepted updates publicly verifiable. On a 15-class Edge-IIoTset task with ten sites holding differently distributed data and ten random seeds, PVBRF-ID matched FedAvg on clean data (macro-F1 0.708 vs. 0.706) and withstood sign-flip attacks (0.696 vs. 0.091). Against an adaptive attacker controlling 30% of sites, PVBRF-ID with secure clipping reached 0.641, whereas FedAvg fell to 0.046; plaintext multi-Krum remained higher by 0.052. An update-inference attacker recovered each site's class mix from plaintext updates (Spearman correlation 0.81) but not from one server's view. Backdoors passed the filter, and noise-based mitigation gave only heuristic protection. The implementation uses Python 3.13, NumPy 2.3, 30 rounds and 10 seeds.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables, 3 supplementary tables. Simulation study on public Edge-IIoTset traffic; code and raw results: https://github.com/nawaralseelawi/pvbrf-id
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PVBRF-ID 用两服务器秘密共享把联邦入侵检测的聚合改成「先加密再验」：各站点对更新做 secret sharing，服务器联合检查范数与对干净根集参考向量的余弦相似度，只公开一个 accept bit，再用 commitment、Merkle root 与同态审计保证被接受更新的公开可验证性。在 15 类 Edge-IIoTset、10 站点、10 随机种子下，干净数据 macro-F1 0.708 对 FedAvg 0.706，sign-flip 攻击下 0.696 对 0.091；30% 站点被自适应攻击者控制时带 secure clipping 达 0.641、FedAvg 跌到 0.046。
Motivation: 联邦聚合被迫在隐私与鲁棒性之间二选一：Byzantine-robust 规则必须明文读取每个更新，而 secure aggregation 又把更新藏起来使投毒检测失效。
Method: 两服务器协议：站点 secret-share 更新，服务器联合测试更新范数及其与小规模干净根集 (clean root set) 参考向量的余弦相似度，每站点只揭示一个 accept bit；commitment、Merkle root 与同态审计使被接受更新的纳入公开可验证。实现用 Python 3.13、NumPy 2.3，跑 30 轮、10 个随机种子。
Result: 15 类 Edge-IIoTset、10 个数据分布不同的站点、10 种子：干净数据 macro-F1 0.708 vs FedAvg 0.706；sign-flip 攻击下 0.696 vs 0.091；自适应攻击者控制 30% 站点时 PVBRF-ID + secure clipping 0.641、FedAvg 0.046，明文 multi-Krum 仍高出 0.052。更新推断攻击者从明文更新恢复各站点类别混合的 Spearman 相关为 0.81，从单服务器视角则不能；backdoor 通过过滤，噪声式缓解仅提供启发式保护。

papers.title: Bridging Human and Model Attention: Explainability Analysis of CNN, Mamba, and ViT Architectures with Gaze-Based Validation
papers.abstract_en: High-risk applications of deep learning require precise characterization of model decision-making. We conduct a systematic explainability evaluation across Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Vision Transformers (ViTs), and Vision Mamba (ViM). Unlike predominantly qualitative studies, we quantify the alignment between model attention and human visual perception using eye-tracking ground truth. We formalize this comparison via a standardized normalization pipeline mapping post-hoc attribution maps and gaze heatmaps onto spatial probability distributions. Alignment is evaluated across fine-grained classification, medical imaging, and emotion recognition using architecture-specific XAI methods. We measure fidelity using Jensen-Shannon similarity, Chi-square similarity, and Pearson correlation, three complementary estimators capturing support overlap, mass discrepancy, and structural co-variation. Our results reveal distinct attention dynamics: CNNs tend to exhibit a more global focus, with spatially more diffuse saliency maps that correlate well with human perception in general contexts, while ViTs demonstrate fine-grained, patch-level attention, often focused on discriminative microfeatures. The Mamba architecture shows biased behavior: it achieves strong explainability in medical tasks but exhibits divergent intensity distributions in natural images; our analytical characterization of the metrics makes this dissociation explicit, since near-unit support overlap is attained simultaneously with a vanishing linear correlation. We further analyze the effect of backbone freezing and ensemble strategies on model interpretability. The results highlight how architectural and training choices influence the alignment between model saliency and human visual attention.
papers.comment: Submitted to Image and Vision Computing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 CNN、ViT、Vision Mamba 三类架构做系统性可解释性评估，用眼动追踪 (eye-tracking) 真值量化模型显著图与人类视觉注意的对齐度。结果显示 CNN 显著图更全局弥散、与人类感知相关性好；ViT 聚焦判别性微特征的 patch 级注意；Mamba 在医学任务上可解释性强，但在自然图像上出现近单位支撑重叠 (support overlap) 与线性相关趋零并存的背离。
Motivation: 高风险深度学习应用需要精确刻画模型决策依据，而已有可解释性研究多为定性比较，缺少用人类眼动真值对模型注意做标准化、可量化的对齐评估。
Method: 提出标准化归一化流程，把事后归因图 (post-hoc attribution maps) 与眼动热图映射到同一空间概率分布；在细粒度分类、医学影像、情感识别三类任务上用架构专属 XAI 方法，以 Jensen-Shannon 相似度、卡方相似度、Pearson 相关三个互补估计量分别度量支撑重叠、质量差异与结构共变，并分析 backbone 冻结与集成策略对可解释性的影响。
Result: CNN 呈现更全局、空间上更弥散的显著图，在一般场景下与人类感知相关良好；ViT 呈现 patch 级细粒度注意，常集中于判别性微特征；Mamba 在医学任务上取得强可解释性，但在自然图像上强度分布发散，其近单位支撑重叠与趋零线性相关同时出现。
Conclusion: 架构与训练选择（含 backbone 冻结和集成）会实质改变显著图与人类视觉注意的对齐方式，且支撑重叠与线性相关必须分开报告才能刻画 Mamba 这类背离。

papers.title: Product Monte Carlo: Expectation Under a Product of Densities
papers.abstract_en: Aggregating independently computed sub-sample inferences is a well-known challenge in large-scale Bayesian computation, federated learning, and opinion pooling. The core problem is to approximate a distribution whose density is proportional to a product of individual densities. We propose Product Monte Carlo (PMC), an algorithm for computing arbitrary expectations under a product of densities using only Monte Carlo draws from individual densities. We turn the intractable product expectation into a regression problem by expressing it through a family of computable conditional expectations. Besides the point estimate, our fully Bayesian regression formulation provides coherent uncertainty quantification and principled diagnostics. We establish theoretical guarantees on consistency and characterize convergence rates for the PMC estimator. Across simulated and real-data experiments varying the number, dimensionality, and heterogeneity of the component distributions, PMC achieves higher estimation accuracy, better-calibrated uncertainty coverage, and improved scalability at a lower computational cost than existing methods. In addition, PMC requires no density evaluation, making it applicable to simulation-based inference, as we demonstrate in an application with protein images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Product Monte Carlo (PMC)：只用各子样本密度的 Monte Carlo 抽样，把「密度乘积下的期望」这一难算量改写成一族可计算的条件期望，从而转成回归问题求解。全贝叶斯回归形式同时给出点估计、连贯的不确定性量化与诊断，并证明了相合性与收敛速率；在模拟与真实数据实验中，其估计精度、不确定性覆盖校准和可扩展性均优于现有方法且计算成本更低，且无需密度求值，可直接用于 simulation-based inference（含蛋白图像应用）。
Motivation: 大规模贝叶斯计算、联邦学习与 opinion pooling 中，各子样本独立算出的推断需要聚合成密度乘积形式的分布，但该乘积的归一化常数与密度本身通常不可计算，直接求期望是核心难点。
Method: PMC 只依赖各分量密度的 Monte Carlo 抽样，通过一族可计算的条件期望把乘积期望表示出来，进而转化为回归问题；采用全贝叶斯回归形式输出点估计、不确定性量化与诊断，并给出相合性保证与 PMC 估计量的收敛速率刻画。
Result: 在随分量分布数量、维度与异质性变化的模拟和真实数据实验中，PMC 相比现有方法取得更高估计精度、更好的不确定性覆盖校准，以及以更低计算成本实现的更好可扩展性；无需密度求值，并在蛋白图像上的 simulation-based inference 应用中得到演示。
Conclusion: 把乘积密度期望重写为条件期望回归，可以在只用抽样、不求密度的条件下同时得到相合估计、可用的不确定性量化和更低的计算成本，因此适用于密度不可得的 simulation-based inference。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Primal-Dual Flow Matching for Sample-Wise Constrained Generation
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of learning to generate data while satisfying a prescribed \emph{sample-wise} constraint with a user-specified probability of constraint satisfaction. Starting with a population-level constrained negative log-likelihood minimization and using a flow-matching (FM) parameterization, under regularity assumptions and sufficient expressivity of the velocity field family, we derive guarantees on the probability of constraint satisfaction for the corresponding primal-dual optimization algorithm. We provide a practical implementation of this approach, called Primal-Dual Flow Matching (PDFM), which has direct control over constraint satisfaction rate and requires only binary membership oracle feedback for constraint satisfaction, avoiding the need for differentiable distances, projections, or special structure of the constraint set, such as convexity. We show that PDFM improves constraint satisfaction over vanilla FM and achieves competitive performance against constraint-aware baselines while maintaining distributional fidelity. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZhengyanHuan/PDFM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PDFM 用 primal-dual 优化加 flow matching 参数化，把逐样本约束的满足概率直接变成可控目标：只需二值成员 oracle 反馈，不需要可微距离、投影或约束集凸性。理论上在正则性与速度场族足够表达的假设下给出约束满足概率保证，实验上比 vanilla FM 提高约束满足率，同时保持分布保真度。
Motivation: 逐样本生成约束要求以用户指定概率满足，而常规 FM 与多数约束生成方法依赖可微距离、投影或凸约束集，难以对任意约束集直接控制满足率。
Method: 从总体层面的约束负对数似然最小化出发，用 flow matching 参数化速度场，推导 primal-dual 优化算法的约束满足概率保证；实现为 PDFM，仅用二值成员 oracle 反馈更新对偶变量，无需可微距离、投影或凸性等约束集特殊结构。
Result: PDFM 相对 vanilla FM 提升约束满足率，并在约束感知基线对比中取得有竞争力的性能，同时保持分布保真度；代码发布于 github.com/ZhengyanHuan/PDFM。
Conclusion: 在正则性与速度场表达力足够时，primal-dual 加 flow matching 可以在只用二值成员反馈的条件下直接控制逐样本约束满足概率，且不牺牲分布质量。

papers.title: Toward Maximizing Algebraic Connectivity via Density-Dependent Backbone Construction and Reinforcement Learning Completion
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies an open network design problem of constructing graph topologies with maximum algebraic connectivity under fixed numbers of vertices and edges. A density-dependent approach is proposed that decomposes the design task into two stages: a high-quality, low-cost structural backbone construction and a reinforcement learning completion stage. The method selects the backbone based on density, using complete multipartite graphs in dense regimes and Cayley graphs in low-to-intermediate regimes, and then refines the remaining edges through a learning-based procedure. Numerical results show that the proposed method achieves high algebraic connectivity with favorable runtime scalability, outperforming existing methods. These results support a structural-family-first strategy for scalable network design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定顶点数与边数下最大化代数连通度 (algebraic connectivity) 的网络设计问题，被拆成两阶段：先按图密度选结构族搭低成本骨架——稠密区用完全多部图 (complete multipartite graphs)、低到中等密度区用 Cayley 图——再用强化学习补完剩余边。数值结果显示该方法在获得高代数连通度的同时具备良好的运行时间扩展性，并在对比中优于已有方法。
Motivation: 固定顶点与边预算下构造最大代数连通度的图拓扑是开放的网络设计问题，已有方法在规模增大时难以兼顾解质量与运行时间。
Method: 密度依赖的两阶段分解：按密度选择骨架结构族（稠密区完全多部图、低至中等密度区 Cayley 图）构建高质量低成本骨架，再用基于强化学习的补全阶段 (RL completion) 学习剩余边的放置。
Result: 数值结果显示该方法取得高代数连通度并具备有利的运行时间扩展性，在对比中优于现有方法；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 结构族优先 (structural-family-first) 的策略可支撑可扩展的网络设计：先定骨架结构族、再用学习补边，比直接整体搜索更有效。

papers.title: Critical Mass: Structure-Disjoint Splits Drift With the Libraries They Are Built On
papers.abstract_en: Molecular machine learning evaluates out-of-distribution performance with structure disjoint splits, a construction rule fixed once at the scale its library happened to have: threshold a pairwise distance, then assign whole connected components to folds. For predicting structures from mass spectra, the field has converged on single-linkage clustering under the myopic Maximum Common Edge Subgraph (MCES) distance at a threshold of 10. This convention was set on 29,000 molecules but public libraries now hold 227,690 molecules. MCES is NP-hard per pair over a quadratically growing set, and so the criterion has never been evaluated at that scale. We propose an optimized version of this criterion, allowing for computationally feasible application on the public libraries: Admissible bounds and a union-find skip reduce $2.6 \times 10^{10}$ molecular pairs to only $1.15 \times 10^{7}$ integer programs, a $2{,}259\times$ saving, while provably producing the lossless partition. We find that at this scale the graph percolates. A single component holds $95.5\%$ of the library, capping any test set at $4.5\%$. What remains is not merely smaller, but systematically different: a held-out compound outweighs a training compound 88.1\% of the time, because a fixed absolute budget is a tighter relative tolerance on a larger molecule. Large library benchmarks using this splitting rule naively therefore conflate structural novelty with extrapolation to larger, more complex chemistry.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 分子机器学习用 MCES 距离阈值 10 的单链接聚类做 structure-disjoint 划分，该规则在 29,000 分子时定下，如今面对 227,690 分子的公共库。作者提出可计算的优化判据（admissible bounds + union-find skip），把 2.6×10^10 对分子压到 1.15×10^7 个整数规划、节省 2,259×，且可证明无损；此时图发生渗流，单一连通分量占库的 95.5%，测试集被压到 4.5%，留出化合物以 88.1% 的概率比训练化合物更大，说明该划分把结构新颖性与外推到更大更复杂化学混为一谈。
Motivation: structure-disjoint 划分的构造规则在库规模只有 29,000 分子时被固定，而 MCES 距离每对是 NP-hard、候选对随规模平方增长，导致该判据从未在如今 227,690 分子的公共库上被评估过。
Method: 提出优化版 MCES 单链接聚类判据：用 admissible bounds 与 union-find skip 剪枝，把 2.6×10^10 个分子对缩减为 1.15×10^7 个整数规划，并证明得到的划分是 lossless 的；随后在公共库规模上检验该划分的图结构与训练/测试分子的大小关系。
Result: 计算量从 2.6×10^10 对降到 1.15×10^7 个整数规划，节省 2,259×，且可证明无损划分。在 227,690 分子规模下图发生渗流：单一连通分量占库的 95.5%，任何测试集被封顶在 4.5%；留出化合物以 88.1% 的概率比训练化合物更大，因为固定绝对距离预算在更大分子上等价于更紧的相对容差。
Conclusion: 在该规模下按此规则朴素划分的大型库基准，会把结构新颖性与向更大、更复杂化学的外推混为一谈，因此划分规则必须随库规模重新评估。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Expert-level detection of low-voltage intervals in EEG as a robust biomarker of neonatal encephalopathy
papers.abstract_en: Background: Discontinuity in neonatal EEG is a critical marker of brain dysfunction but can be difficult to quantify visually. Inter-burst intervals (IBIs) are a key characteristic of discontinuity, yet their definition does not easily translate to AI detection. Objectives: To introduce low-voltage intervals (LVIs), defined exclusively by amplitude and duration, as a context-independent alternative to IBIs, develop an AI detection method for LVIs, and assess their clinical utility as a marker of brain injury. Methods: We developed a ConvNeXt model to detect LVIs and compared its performance with existing methods. We then tested the clinical relevance of detected LVIs across four applications: 1) grading background EEG abnormalities on an open benchmark dataset, 2) classifying clinical hypoxic-ischaemic encephalopathy (HIE) grades and comparing with a normal EEG dataset, 3) seizure prediction, and 4) association with seizure burden. Results: For training and validation, 654 hours of per-channel EEG from 123 neonates were reviewed and 51,162 LVIs were annotated. On held-out validation, ConvNeXt had an AUC of 0.996 and a Matthews correlation coefficient of 0.926. Model-reader agreement exceeded inter-reader agreement ($Δκ= 0.025$, 95% CI: 0.007 to 0.045, $p<0.001$), attaining expert-level equivalence. On a combined dataset of 444 neonates, percentage LVI showed a strong association with EEG grades (Spearman's $ρ=0.801$), a moderate association with HIE grades ($ρ=0.384$), a weaker association with seizure burden ($ρ=0.244$), and a strong seizure prediction capacity (AUC $=0.872$). Conclusion: AI detection of LVIs achieves expert-level equivalence, whereas quantitative features do not. Automated LVI quantification provides a robust clinical biomarker of neonatal encephalopathy associated with background EEG activity, HIE severity, and seizure risk.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 8 figures, and 9 tables including the appendix. Under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出仅由幅度与时长定义的低电压间期 (low-voltage interval, LVI) 作为新生儿脑电不连续性的上下文无关指标，并用 ConvNeXt 逐通道检测。在 123 名新生儿、654 小时 EEG、51,162 条标注上，留出验证 AUC 0.996、MCC 0.926，模型-读片一致性超出读片者间一致性 (Δκ=0.025, p<0.001)，达到专家级等效；自动 LVI 可作为新生儿脑病的稳健生物标志物。
Motivation: 新生儿 EEG 的不连续性是脑功能障碍的关键标志，但目视难以量化；间期 (IBI) 的定义依赖上下文，难以直接转成 AI 检测目标。
Method: 定义只依赖幅度与时长的 LVI 替代 IBI，训练 ConvNeXt 逐通道检测并与既有方法比较；再在四个临床任务上检验：开放基准上 EEG 背景分级、HIE 分级分类并与正常 EEG 数据集对照、癫痫发作预测、与发作负荷的关联。
Result: 训练与验证集为 123 名新生儿的 654 小时逐通道 EEG，标注 51,162 条 LVI；留出验证 ConvNeXt AUC 0.996、MCC 0.926；模型-读片一致性高于读片者间一致性 (Δκ=0.025, 95% CI 0.007–0.045, p<0.001)。在 444 名新生儿的合并数据集上，LVI 百分比与 EEG 分级 Spearman ρ=0.801、与 HIE 分级 ρ=0.384、与发作负荷 ρ=0.244，发作预测 AUC=0.872。
Conclusion: AI 检测 LVI 达到专家级等效，而手工定量特征不能；自动 LVI 量化是与 EEG 背景活动、HIE 严重度和发作风险相关的新生儿脑病稳健生物标志物。

papers.title: Amortised Inference through One-Step Implicit Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Efficient sampling from Bayesian posterior distributions in high dimensions remains a hard problem, despite advances in theory and algorithms. Multiple steps are usually required to draw unbiased samples, for example, iterations of an MCMC algorithm or integration steps in a diffusion-based amortised sampler. However, scalable one-step amortised inference remains a challenging open problem. In this work, we build upon recent progress in data-driven generative modelling to offer a possible solution for one-step amortised sampling. Our one-step implicit sampler (OSIS) uses short-time MCMC dynamics to define a local target for the evolution of an implicitly modelled distribution. In the asymptotic limit, the modelled distribution is a fixed point of the MCMC kernel and thus samples from the target. We analyse the convergence properties of OSIS and show connections with other generative modelling and sampling algorithms. We study various design choices and show that OSIS performs well compared to multi-step amortised samplers and non-amortised MCMC baselines while being far more efficient at sampling time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出单步摊销推断 OSIS：用短时 MCMC 动力学定义隐式建模分布演化的局部目标，渐近下该分布是 MCMC 核的不动点，从而从目标后验采样。与多步摊销采样器和非摊销 MCMC 基线相比表现相当，而采样时效率高得多。
Motivation: 高维贝叶斯后验采样通常需要多步（MCMC 迭代或扩散采样器的多步积分），可扩展的单步摊销推断仍是开放问题。
Method: OSIS 用短时 MCMC 动力学构造局部目标，驱动一个隐式生成模型 (implicit generative model) 的分布演化；作者分析其收敛性质，并与其它生成建模和采样算法建立联系，研究多种设计选择。
Result: 在所研究的设计选择下，OSIS 相比多步摊销采样器与非摊销 MCMC 基线表现良好，且采样时开销远低；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 短时 MCMC 核的不动点构造可作为单步摊销后验采样的一条可行路径，在保持采样质量的同时大幅降低采样时成本。
Relevance: 58

papers.title: WoodBR-Cross: A public wood-image dataset and individual-tree-disjoint benchmark for species identification
papers.abstract_en: Wood-image benchmarks can yield optimistic estimates when images from the same tree occur in both training and test sets. WoodBR-Cross contains 4,875 transverse-surface images in 38 operational taxonomic classes, linked to 303 distinct trees identified by numeric catalogue witness codes (codigos-testemunho) in the Brazilian Forest Service collection. A species-level subset comprises 3,406 images, 20 classes and 214 trees. Three tasks compare duplicate-aware image partitions for all classes (A), image partitions for the species subset (B1), and individual-tree-disjoint partitions for that subset (B2). In B2, all images from each tree are kept together, so no tree is shared across training, validation or test within a fold. ResNet-50, ConvNeXt-Tiny and ViT-B/16 were evaluated with three outer folds, internal validation and five training seeds. Handcrafted and frozen-feature baselines complement border-only and randomized-label controls. Validation-selected ConvNeXt-Tiny achieved B2 tree-level macro-F1 of 0.8621 +/- 0.0317; frozen DINOv2 features yielded 0.9000 +/- 0.0722. Values are means and standard deviations across three seed-averaged fold means. Results estimate performance on previously unseen trees from this collection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WoodBR-Cross 指出木纹图像基准若同一棵树的图片同时出现在训练与测试集会给出过于乐观的估计，因此构建了 4,875 张横切面图像、38 个分类、关联 303 棵树的公开数据集，并以个体树不相交 (individual-tree-disjoint) 的 B2 划分做基准。在 B2 上验证集选中的 ConvNeXt-Tiny 达到树级 macro-F1 0.8621 ± 0.0317，冻结 DINOv2 特征达 0.9000 ± 0.0722，反映的是对未见树的性能。
Motivation: 同一棵树的图像跨训练/测试集会造成数据泄漏，使木纹树种识别基准的估计偏乐观；需要按个体树隔离的划分来衡量对新树的泛化。
Method: 数据集含 4,875 张横切面图像、38 个操作分类单元、303 棵树（物种子集 3,406 张、20 类、214 棵树），以巴西林业局收藏的数字见证码 (codigos-testemunho) 关联个体。三个任务：全类去重感知划分 (A)、物种子集图像划分 (B1)、物种子集个体树不相交划分 (B2)，B2 中每棵树的所有图像同折且不跨训练/验证/测试。评估 ResNet-50、ConvNeXt-Tiny、ViT-B/16，三外层折、内部验证、五个训练种子，并配手工特征与冻结特征基线及 border-only、随机标签对照。
Result: B2 树级 macro-F1：验证集选中的 ConvNeXt-Tiny 为 0.8621 ± 0.0317，冻结 DINOv2 特征为 0.9000 ± 0.0722；数值为三个种子平均折均值的均值与标准差。
Conclusion: 按个体树隔离划分得到的性能才是对未见树的估计，冻结 DINOv2 特征在该协议下高于验证选中的 ConvNeXt-Tiny。
Relevance: 0
