papers.title: GeoFitBench-LLM: A Benchmark for Assessing Large Language Models' Capabilities in Geospatial Data Requirements Elicitation for Geo-Analytic Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are becoming central to GeoAI systems, yet their evaluation rarely considers the elicitation of geospatial data requirements. This omission is critical as retrieval oriented geo-analytic tasks cannot be supported reliably without first identifying the necessary datasets and constraints. GeoFitBench-LLM is introduced as a benchmark for assessing whether LLMs can infer the datasets, the supporting resources and the constraints required by geo-analytic requests in natural language. The benchmark is structured around two reasoning dimensions, Spatio-Temporal Relational and Semantic Grounding, reflecting long-standing challenges in geospatial information retrieval and related natural language tasks. Ground truth requirements are encoded in a fixed, provider-independent schema for reproducible evaluation of resource identification and attribute-level specification. Experiments on seven models under minimal prompting indicate that identifying the necessary resources is often achievable, with GPT-5.4 Thinking achieving the best result by recovering the complete set of resources in 66.67% of benchmark requests. Results further indicate that accurate fitness-for-use specification remains more difficult as inferential demands increase.
papers.comment: Presented as an Oral Presentation Paper at GeoAI 2026, Ghent, Belgium. Also available on Zenodo
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 1st International Conference on Geospatial Artificial Intelligence (GeoAI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoFitBench-LLM 用固定、与数据提供方无关的 schema 编码地理分析任务的真实数据需求，从 Spatio-Temporal Relational 与 Semantic Grounding 两个推理维度评测 LLM 能否推断所需数据集、支撑资源与约束。在 minimal prompting 下的 7 个模型中，GPT-5.4 Thinking 表现最好，66.67% 的请求能完整恢复所需资源集合；但随着推断难度上升，属性级 fitness-for-use 规格仍明显更难。
Motivation: GeoAI 系统的评测几乎不考察地理空间数据需求的获取 (elicitation)，而检索导向的 geo-analytic 任务若不能先确定所需数据集与约束，就无法可靠支持。
Method: 提出基准 GeoFitBench-LLM，围绕 Spatio-Temporal Relational 与 Semantic Grounding 两个推理维度组织题目；ground truth 需求编码在固定、provider-independent 的 schema 中，以可复现地评测资源识别与属性级规格；在 minimal prompting 设置下对 7 个模型做实验。
Result: 7 个模型在 minimal prompting 下，识别所需资源通常可行；GPT-5.4 Thinking 取得最佳结果，在 66.67% 的基准请求中恢复出完整资源集合。随着推断需求增加，准确的 fitness-for-use 属性级规格变得更困难。
Conclusion: LLM 已能较可靠地推断 geo-analytic 任务所需的数据资源，但属性级的适用性规格仍是瓶颈，随任务推断难度上升而恶化。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.conclusion: LLM 已能较可靠地推断 geo-analytic 任务所需的数据资源，但属性级的适用性规格仍是瓶颈，随任务推断难度上升而恶化。

papers.title: Recurrent Harness for Agentic Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Language model agents increasingly operate over long interaction streams, requiring online adaptation to distribution shifts through continual learning. However, existing agent harnesses typically either evolve their states only through forward information flow or rely on additional replay or validation data for harness optimization. To address this, we propose ReHarness, a recurrent harness framework for agentic continual learning that complements forward read and write with backward revision under a strictly online streaming protocol. We ask what information could have been captured differently in the harness state to better inform the current instance in the stream. Specifically, after each instance, we leverage the resulting trajectory as feedback to revise the reflections retrieved for that instance, thereby propagating feedback backward through the textual harness state. Across three continual learning benchmarks and three language model backbones, ReHarness consistently outperforms strong raw-context baselines, memory- and reflection-based methods, and prompt optimization approaches. Further analysis shows that ReHarness produces source-grounded and meaningful revisions, corrects overgeneralized or outdated experience under distribution shifts, and improves both stability and plasticity during continual learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReHarness 在严格在线流式协议下给 agent harness 增加反向修订：每次实例结束后用其轨迹作为反馈，回头改写该实例检索到的 reflections，把反馈经文本 harness 状态向后传播。在三个 continual learning benchmark、三种 LLM backbone 上一致优于 raw-context、memory/reflection 与 prompt optimization 基线，并同时改善 stability 与 plasticity。
Motivation: 现有 agent harness 要么状态只沿前向信息流演化，要么优化 harness 时需要额外的 replay 或验证数据，无法在严格在线流式场景下应对分布漂移。
Method: 在前向 read/write 之外引入 backward revision：每个实例结束后把产生的 trajectory 当作反馈，修订该实例检索到的 reflections，使反馈逆向传播进文本 harness 状态；全程遵循 strictly online streaming protocol，不依赖 replay 或验证数据。
Result: 在三个 continual learning benchmark、三种语言模型 backbone 上，ReHarness 一致优于 raw-context 基线、memory- 与 reflection-based 方法以及 prompt optimization 方法；进一步分析显示其修订 source-grounded 且有意义，能纠正分布漂移下过度泛化或过时的经验，并同时提升 stability 与 plasticity。
Conclusion: 把反馈作为对 harness 状态的反向修订而非额外数据，可以在不引入 replay/验证数据的前提下让 agent 在持续学习中兼顾稳定性与可塑性。

papers.title: Incremental Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Human-in-the-Loop Decision Support
papers.abstract_en: We introduce iRAG, a human-in-the-loop decision-support system combining Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with Hybrid Decision-Making. Unlike conventional RAG systems, relying on static Knowledge Bases (KBs), our proposal addresses settings where the KB is initially empty and is progressively populated through human decisions. The system stores previous decisions as retrievable precedents and moves from silent observation to evidence-grounded contestation and, finally, to autonomous handling with abstention. Against an independent baseline, iRAG matches final-decision error under 10% drift without retrieval decay and reduces it under 40% drift across all configurations. Retrieval decay improves performance on changed knowledge while increasing error on stable knowledge, evidencing a stability--plasticity trade-off rather than a general advantage. Human oversight is an architectural provision of the workflow; its usability with real human users remains to be evaluated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 iRAG：在知识库初始为空、靠人类决策逐步填充的场景下，把历史决策存为可检索先例，让系统从静默观察升级到有据异议，最终在弃权机制下自主处理。相对独立基线，10% 漂移下最终决策错误率持平且无检索衰减，40% 漂移下所有配置均降低错误；检索衰减改善变更知识却加重稳定知识错误，体现稳定性-可塑性权衡而非普遍优势。
Motivation: 常规 RAG 依赖静态知识库，无法应对知识库需由人类决策逐步积累、且知识随时间漂移的决策支持场景。
Method: iRAG 将人类历史决策存为可检索先例，工作流分三阶段：静默观察、基于证据的异议 (evidence-grounded contestation)、带弃权的自主处理；对照独立基线，并测试有无检索衰减 (retrieval decay) 在不同漂移水平下的表现。
Result: 10% 漂移下 iRAG 与基线最终决策错误率持平且无检索衰减；40% 漂移下所有配置均降低错误。检索衰减在知识变更时提升性能、在稳定知识上增加错误。
Conclusion: 检索衰减体现稳定性-可塑性权衡而非普遍优势；人类监督是工作流的架构性设计，其对真实用户的可用性仍待评估。

papers.title: Evaluating LLMs for Translating Legacy Fortran Atmospheric Physics to GPU-Accelerated JAX
papers.abstract_en: Legacy Fortran physics packages in atmospheric models such as CESM, WRF, and E3SM pose a barrier to GPU modernization, while manual porting requires accelerator-programming expertise. We present LAFT (LLM-Assisted Fortran Translation), an agentic framework for converting Fortran atmospheric physics parameterizations into GPU-accelerated JAX while preserving numerical agreement with the Fortran reference. LAFT coordinates source-code analysis, translation, repair, runtime validation, and performance profiling. It combines a deterministic front end for metadata extraction and bridge generation, structured translation prompts, numerical validation, and profiling-guided feedback to identify inefficient execution patterns. The bridge handles array-layout conversion separately from scientific computation. We evaluate LAFT using the Kessler warm-rain microphysics scheme and four LLMs: Claude, GPT, Gemini, and Qwen. All four validated translations reproduce the Fortran reference outputs to near floating-point precision for the evaluated case, but their GPU performance differs substantially with execution design. The Gemini-generated implementation achieves up to a 357-fold speedup over serial Fortran in cached execution at 1,000,000 atmospheric columns, excluding compilation and host-device transfers. The results demonstrate that numerical agreement alone does not ensure efficient GPU execution and motivate combining numerical validation with hardware-aware performance analysis. LAFT provides a practical workflow for modernizing legacy atmospheric physics code through LLM-assisted translation, deterministic interface generation, automated validation and repair, and reproducible profiling.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 3 figures, Submission to Journal of Advances in Modeling Earth Systems (JAMES) planned
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LAFT（LLM-Assisted Fortran Translation）agentic 框架，把 CESM/WRF/E3SM 类遗留 Fortran 大气物理参数化转成 GPU 加速 JAX，同时保住与 Fortran 参考的数值一致。用 Kessler 暖雨微物理方案和 Claude、GPT、Gemini、Qwen 四个 LLM 评测，四份译文在所评测算例上都复现到接近浮点精度，但 GPU 性能随执行设计差异巨大：Gemini 版在 1,000,000 个大气柱的缓存执行下相对串行 Fortran 最高 357 倍加速（不含编译与主机-设备传输）。结论是数值一致不等于高效 GPU 执行，必须把数值验证与硬件感知性能分析绑在一起。
Motivation: CESM、WRF、E3SM 等模式里的遗留 Fortran 物理包是 GPU 现代化的拦路虎，而手工移植需要加速器编程专家；同时仅凭数值对齐无法判断移植后的 GPU 效率。
Method: LAFT 协调源码分析、翻译、修复、运行时验证与性能剖析五个环节：确定性前端负责元数据提取与 bridge 生成（把数组布局转换与科学计算分开处理），配合结构化翻译 prompt、数值验证，以及剖析反馈来定位低效执行模式。评测对象是 Kessler 暖雨微物理方案，翻译由 Claude、GPT、Gemini、Qwen 四个 LLM 完成。
Result: 四个 LLM 生成的译文在所评测算例上都把 Fortran 参考输出复现到接近浮点精度；GPU 性能则随执行设计显著分化，Gemini 生成的实现在 1,000,000 大气柱的缓存执行下相对串行 Fortran 最高 357 倍加速（不含编译与主机-设备传输）。
Conclusion: 数值一致本身不能保证高效 GPU 执行，遗留大气物理代码的 LLM 移植要把自动数值验证/修复与硬件感知的可复现剖析绑成一套工作流。

papers.title: MagicBeanStalk: Escaping the RLVR Zero Advantage Trap with Recursive Data Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Data-centric scaling of RLVR has focused on collecting or generating verifiable training problems. However, corpus size alone does not determine whether the dataset provides a useful learning signal for a target policy. To guide the synthesis of effective RLVR data, we experimentally characterize dataset effectiveness as a function of its problems, the target policy, and the training rollout budget. Under this characterization, we show that a large open-source math corpus pooled from widely used RLVR datasets falls almost entirely into a zero-advantage trap: for a fixed target policy and rollout budget, roughly 88% of its problems are solved in every rollout or failed in every rollout. Filtering concentrates what remains, but it can only select, discarding the hard problems. Effective synthetic problems should therefore require the reasoning operations and compositions required to solve those hard problems. Yet their difficulty must be calibrated, so that some rollouts succeed, some fail, and at least one correct solution fits within the training budget. Prompting a teacher to vary hard problems directly does not achieve this. Guided by these empirical principles, we introduce MagicBeanStalk, a top-down decomposition and bottom-up recursive data-synthesis algorithm that grows seed problems into families of substantively new, policy- and budget-calibrated training problems while preserving the seeds' reasoning blueprints. Across 8 math benchmarks, continual RLVR on MagicBeanStalk problems improves gpt-oss-120b from 61.2 to 69.8 (+8.6) and DeepSeek v4Flash from 72.4 to 77.9 (+5.4) on a 16K-token budget. Training on the full 78K source corpus improves by only +1.1 and its best filtered real data subset by +5.8. In finance, we synthesize over 14K verifiable problems from only 340 solutions and improve over base by 6.9 and 2.4 points on SecQue and FinanceBench, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MagicBeanStalk 用自顶向下分解加自底向上递归合成，把种子题长成与目标策略和 rollout 预算校准的新题族，绕开 RLVR 的零优势陷阱：开源数学语料约 88% 的题在固定策略与预算下要么全对要么全错。在 8 个数学基准上，16K token 预算下持续 RLVR 使 gpt-oss-120b 从 61.2 升到 69.8（+8.6），DeepSeek v4Flash 从 72.4 升到 77.9（+5.4），而全量 78K 源语料只涨 +1.1。
Motivation: RLVR 的数据扩展只堆语料规模，但语料规模不等于有效学习信号：固定策略与 rollout 预算下，开源数学语料约 88% 的题全对或全错，处于零优势陷阱；过滤只能筛掉、丢弃难题，无法造出有效难题。
Method: MagicBeanStalk 是自顶向下分解加自底向上递归的数据合成算法：先刻画数据有效性随题目、目标策略与训练 rollout 预算的变化，再让种子题长成保留其推理蓝图 (reasoning blueprint) 的新题族，难度校准到部分 rollout 成功、部分失败且训练预算内至少有一条正确解；直接让 teacher 变换难题被证明无效。
Result: 在 8 个数学基准上，16K token 预算下持续 RLVR：gpt-oss-120b 61.2 → 69.8（+8.6），DeepSeek v4Flash 72.4 → 77.9（+5.4）；全量 78K 源语料仅 +1.1，其最佳过滤真实数据子集 +5.8。金融领域从仅 340 条解答合成超过 14K 道可验证题，SecQue 与 FinanceBench 分别较 base 提升 6.9 与 2.4 分。
Conclusion: 有效 RLVR 数据由题目、目标策略与 rollout 预算三者共同决定，合成题必须复现难题所需的推理操作且难度校准；按此原则合成的数据比扩大或过滤真实语料带来更大提升。

papers.title: Data-driven Optimal Sensor Placement for Aerosol Monitoring in the UK
authors: J. Scott Hosking (2) ((1) University of Engineering and Technology
papers.abstract_en: We develop a data-driven sensor-placement framework and apply it to aerosol monitoring in the United Kingdom (UK). A trained convolutional Gaussian neural process is embedded within the DeepSensor optimisation framework. Genetic optimisation with lazy evaluation and caching reduces mean computational time by 60\% (10$\pm$3 versus 25$\pm$7 minutes) while producing sequential placement performance comparable to the greedy solver. Using the CAMS reference field to construct a retrospective oracle benchmark, Joint NLL improves by about 22\% for Joint-MI-driven genetic placement after five locations for aerosol stations are identified. Seasonal and wind-regime analyses show that agreement between model-based criteria and oracle benchmarks varies with meteorological transport conditions. These results show a computationally efficient approach for data-informed expansion of environmental observing systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 DeepSensor 优化框架中嵌入训练好的卷积高斯过程 (convolutional Gaussian neural process)，用带惰性评估与缓存的遗传算法做气溶胶监测站点选址，平均计算时间从 25±7 分钟降到 10±3 分钟（降 60%），且序贯布点性能与贪心求解器相当。以 CAMS 参考场构造回溯 oracle 基准，五个站点之后 Joint-MI 驱动的遗传布点 Joint NLL 约改善 22%；模型准则与 oracle 的一致性随季节和风况变化。
Motivation: 英国气溶胶观测网需要扩展站点，但布点求解计算昂贵，且基于模型的选址准则在不同气象输送条件下是否可靠缺乏检验。
Method: 训练卷积高斯神经过程并嵌入 DeepSensor 优化框架；用遗传优化配合惰性评估与缓存求解序贯站点放置，与贪心求解器对比；用 CAMS 参考场构造回溯 oracle 基准评估 Joint NLL，并做季节与风况 (wind-regime) 分析。

papers.title: Kronecker Product Attention: Memory-Efficient KV Compression via Structured Factorization
papers.abstract_en: Efficient autoregressive generation is increasingly limited by the memory footprint of the key-value (KV) cache, which grows linearly with sequence length, batch size, and model depth. Existing approaches such as Multi-Query Attention (MQA), Grouped-Query Attention (GQA), Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA), and Tensor Product Attention (TPA) reduce this cost through different trade-offs, but often sacrifice expressivity, require additional positional-encoding machinery, or impose restrictive low-rank structure. We propose Kronecker Product Attention (KPA), which represents key and value activations as sums of Kronecker products of compact, token-dependent matrix factors. KPA strictly generalizes TPA: rank-one vector-outer-product factorization arises as a degenerate Kronecker split, while non-degenerate matrix factors can represent richer block-structured patterns. We further show that a structured rotary embedding operator matched to the Kronecker representation preserves the relative-position property of RoPE while rotating only the compact factors, removing the need for a decoupled RoPE branch as in MLA. Empirically, KPA matches or exceeds TPA, MHA, MQA, GQA, and MLA across four model scales and nine downstream benchmarks under identical training conditions, while achieving up to 10x KV cache compression. The Kronecker head split is a tuneable hyperparameter that allows practitioners to navigate the compression-accuracy trade-off at design time without architectural changes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Kronecker Product Attention (KPA)，把 key/value 激活表示为紧凑、依赖 token 的矩阵因子的 Kronecker 积之和，严格推广 TPA；配套的结构化 rotary 算子只旋转紧凑因子即可保留 RoPE 的相对位置性质，无需 MLA 那样的解耦 RoPE 分支。在相同训练条件下跨四个模型规模、九个下游基准上匹配或超越 TPA、MHA、MQA、GQA、MLA，KV cache 压缩最高达 10x。
Motivation: 自受回归生成的瓶颈是随序列长度、batch 和深度线性增长的 KV cache；现有 MQA、GQA、MLA、TPA 以牺牲表达力、额外位置编码机制或受限低秩结构换取压缩。
Method: KPA 用 Kronecker 积之和表示 key/value 激活，其中非退化的矩阵因子可表达更丰富的块结构模式（退化情形即 TPA 的 rank-one 外积）；设计与 Kronecker 表示匹配的结构化 rotary 算子，只旋转紧凑因子；Kronecker head split 作为可调超参控制压缩-精度权衡，无需改动架构。
Result: 在相同训练条件下，KPA 在四个模型规模、九个下游基准上匹配或超越 TPA、MHA、MQA、GQA、MLA，同时实现最高 10x 的 KV cache 压缩。
Conclusion: Kronecker 结构化因子分解可在不引入解耦 RoPE 或架构改动的前提下同时保住表达力与压缩率，head split 让设计时直接调节压缩-精度权衡。

papers.title: CLEAT: Learning Value-Guided Clarification for Interactive Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents can execute increasingly complex tasks, but effective assistance also requires aligning their actions with goals and constraints that users may leave unstated. We study this problem as interactive intent alignment through clarification. Yet clarification is useful only when the agent can turn the answer into better decisions. As training changes how the agent handles incomplete information and uses additional answers, the same clarification can become more or less useful. We introduce CLEAT (CLarification through valuE-guided Agent co-Training), a framework that co-trains a clarification-value controller and the task policy from shared interaction outcomes. We formulate residual query value to measure the task utility gained by asking rather than proceeding under the current policy, and estimate it through paired rollouts from the same interaction history. These paired returns train the controller to predict clarification value and the task policy to select useful questions and act on the answers. The controller guides subsequent rollout collection, while outcomes from the updated agent provide new value labels that allow clarification guidance to adapt as the agent learns. With Qwen3-4B, CLEAT achieves the highest mean score in all ten evaluation settings across four benchmarks. Gains over the strongest baseline reach 13.2 and 6.5 percentage points on UserGym Travel and IN3 underspecification judgment accuracy, respectively. Ablations show that co-training improves the task policy even when the controller is removed at inference, while adapting clarification guidance to the evolving policy yields further gains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLEAT 把澄清提问建模为可学习的价值决策：用同一交互历史下的成对 rollout 估计 residual query value（问比直接做的任务收益增量），再用该价值标签共同训练澄清控制器与任务策略，且控制器在推理期继续引导 rollout 收集、随策略更新自适应。Qwen3-4B 上在四个基准的十项评测设置中均取得最高平均分，较最强基线在 UserGym Travel 与 IN3 欠约束判定准确率上分别高出 13.2 与 6.5 个百分点。
Motivation: LLM agent 面对用户未言明的目标与约束时需要澄清，但澄清只有在能把答案转成更好决策时才有价值；同一问题的用处会随策略训练而变化，缺少衡量并利用这一价值的机制。
Method: 提出 CLEAT（CLarification through valuE-guided Agent co-TrAining）：定义 residual query value 度量在当前策略下提问相对直接行动的任务效用，用同一交互历史的 paired rollouts 估计该值；这些成对回报同时训练澄清价值控制器（预测提问价值）与任务策略（选有用问题并据答案行动），控制器引导后续 rollout 收集，更新后 agent 的结果又产生新的价值标签，使澄清指导随学习自适应。
Result: 在 Qwen3-4B 上，CLEAT 于四个基准的全部十项评测设置取得最高平均分；相对最强基线，UserGym Travel 与 IN3 欠约束 (underspecification) 判定准确率分别提升 13.2 与 6.5 个百分点。消融显示：即使推理期移除控制器，共同训练仍能改进任务策略，而让澄清指导随策略演化自适应还能带来进一步增益。
Conclusion: 澄清的价值应作为随策略变化的量来共同训练而非静态规则：以 paired rollout 的 residual query value 同训控制器与策略，可在多基准上稳定提升交互式意图对齐表现，且策略改进部分独立于推理期控制器。

papers.title: SynAct: Synergistic Active Feedback Learning for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents executing multi-step workflows fail in two fundamentally different ways: recoverable slips, which further attempts can repair, and knowledge gaps, which retrying cannot resolve. Expert feedback can address the latter, but expert attention is scarce. The key challenge is therefore not whether to ask for feedback, but where feedback can change the outcome. Existing approaches either avoid expert feedback, allowing agents to reinforce their own errors, or allocate feedback at the task level without identifying consequential decisions. We present SynAct, an active learning framework that treats expert attention as the binding constraint and allocates feedback at the level of individual decisions. SynAct ranks decisions by the mutual information between the selected action and the terminal outcome across repeated rollouts, queries an expert at the highest-value decisions, and distills the resulting corrections into transferable rules that the agent can reuse without expert access at deployment. We theoretically characterize what this signal identifies under finite repeated sampling: with k rollouts and at least m observations per action, outcome-constant decisions have zero mutual information, while outcome-separating decisions have mutual information at least H2(m/k) bits, yielding exact separation for any threshold t in (0,H2(m/k)). This also explains why success-based acquisition can be blind when all rollouts fail: success is constant even when failed runs reach different outcomes. Across four agent benchmarks and four models spanning three families, SynAct improves held-out accuracy in all 16 evaluated settings, by +11.7pp on average. The same signal transfers to inference-time routing, where SynAct outperforms budget-matched cascade, uncertainty, and expert-judge routers in 15 of 16 settings, while a single targeted correction outperforms seven additional unaimed retries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SynAct 把专家注意力当作稀缺约束，用多次 rollout 中动作与终局结果的互信息给单步决策排序，在互信息最高的决策处向专家提问，并把纠正蒸馏成可复用规则。理论上 k 次 rollout、每动作至少 m 次观测时，结果恒定的决策互信息为 0、结果可分的决策至少 H2(m/k) bits，阈值取 (0, H2(m/k)) 内可精确分离；四个 benchmark、四个模型共 16 个设置上 held-out accuracy 全部提升，平均 +11.7pp。
Motivation: LLM agent 的多步失败分两类：可由重试修复的 recoverable slips 与重试无效的 knowledge gaps；现有方法要么完全不问专家让 agent 强化自身错误，要么在任务层面分配反馈而识别不出真正改变结果的决策。
Method: 在重复 rollout 上计算所选动作与终局结果的互信息，按该信号给单个决策排序，在最高价值处查询专家，再把纠正蒸馏成部署时无需专家即可复用的规则；推理时同一信号用于路由，与 budget-matched cascade、uncertainty、expert-judge 路由器对比。
Result: 四个 agent benchmark、跨三个模型家族的四个模型共 16 个设置中，held-out accuracy 全部提升，平均 +11.7pp；推理时路由在 16 个设置中的 15 个上超过 budget-matched cascade、uncertainty 与 expert-judge 路由器；单次针对性纠正超过七次无目标重试。理论上 k 次 rollout、每动作至少 m 次观测时结果恒定决策互信息为 0，结果可分决策至少 H2(m/k) bits，任意阈值 t∈(0,H2(m/k)) 可精确分离。
Conclusion: 反馈应按单步决策的互信息而非任务级成败来分配：成功信号在所有 rollout 都失败时会失明，而互信息仍能区分结果可分的决策，并可同时用于专家查询与推理时路由。

papers.title: Feature Competition and Its Representational Origins in Vision Language Models: Evidence from the Stroop Paradigm
papers.abstract_en: When you ask a vision-language model (VLM) a question with an image, it answers your question based on the image. But to act means to choose: saying one thing means choosing to respond not say another. This becomes an issue when the image contains multiple features that equally relate to the question at hand: how would VLMs choose to respond? This problem is precisely studied by the classical Stroop task in psychology: among a set of deliberately designed images whose text and color conflicts (e.g., \textcolor{blue}{RED}), participants are instructed to report the color. We adapt this psychological paradigm to a benchmark and prompted a range of contrastive and generative VLMs on their behavior. Across models, we observe a persistent bias toward the feature of text in Stroop images: when text and color disagree, models preferentially generate responses centered to the text rather than color. We then opened the black box and examined the source of this bias and why certain features influences the model's behavior more than others. In the embedding space, we found that textual cues are represented more strongly and separably than color cues. This representational asymmetry predicts intervention success: steering models toward text-related directions is substantially easier than steering them toward color-related directions. Using a classical psychological paradigm, we demonstrate, at both behavioral and representational levels, that distinct features within the same image can exert unequal influence on VLM behavior. Our findings suggest that VLMs assign different degrees of saliency to different features within the same image, highlighting the need to understand how cue-specific saliency shapes their performance in widely used downstream applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把经典 Stroop 范式改造成图像-文本冲突基准，测试一批 contrastive 与 generative VLM：当图中文字与颜色不一致时，模型普遍偏向按文字作答而非按颜色。表征分析显示文字线索在 embedding 空间中更强、更可分，这种不对称还预测干预难度——把模型朝文字方向 steering 明显比朝颜色方向容易。
Motivation: VLM 在图像含多个与问题同等相关的特征时如何取舍尚不清楚；Stroop 冲突正好提供一个可控场景，用来检验同一图像内不同特征对模型行为的影响力是否均等。
Method: 将心理学 Stroop 范式（如蓝色写的 RED，要求报告颜色）适配为基准，对多组 contrastive 与 generative VLM 进行 prompting，先记录行为层面的反应偏向，再进入 embedding 空间分析表征强度与可分性，并做方向性 steering 干预检验。
Result: 跨模型观察到持续的文字特征偏向：文字与颜色冲突时，生成的回答以文字为中心而非颜色；embedding 空间中文字线索比颜色线索表征更强、更可分，且该表征不对称可预测干预成功——朝文字方向 steering 显著易于朝颜色方向。
Conclusion: 同一图像内不同特征对 VLM 行为的影响并不均等，cue-specific saliency 在行为与表征两个层面都成立，理解这种显著性差异对下游应用表现至关重要。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: 将心理学 Stroop 范式（如蓝色写的 RED，要求报告颜色）适配为基准，对多组 contrastive 与 generative VLM 进行 prompting，先记录行为层面的反应偏向，再进入 embedding 空间分析表征强度与可分性，并做方向性 steering 干预检验。
summary_sections.result: 跨模型观察到持续的文字特征偏向：文字与颜色冲突时，生成的回答以文字为中心而非颜色；embedding 空间中文字线索比颜色线索表征更强、更可分，且该表征不对称可预测干预成功——朝文字方向 steering 显著易于朝颜色方向。
summary_sections.conclusion: 同一图像内不同特征对 VLM 行为的影响并不均等，cue-specific saliency 在行为与表征两个层面都成立，理解这种显著性差异对下游应用表现至关重要。

papers.title: Cancerous Backdoor Attack: Gradual Activation via Invisible Tokens and A Stage Controller
papers.abstract_en: Backdoor Attacks on Large Language Models (LLMs) typically follow a trigger-response pattern, where satisfying a trigger condition activates a single terminal behavior. However, this single-point backdoor activation does not explore attacks in which malicious behavior develops gradually through multiple intermediate stages before reaching the terminal activation stage. We present Cancerous Backdoor Attack, that gradually corrupts an LLM's reasoning over a sequence of interactions by leveraging invisible tokens and a stage controller. Specifically, invisible tokens provide hidden stages to the model without appearing in the user's visible request and the stage controller tracks the attack's progression during inference to realize gradual activation. We evaluate Cancerous Backdoor Attack across several reasoning datasets. The attack consistently produces gradual reasoning corruption across models and tasks. We compare Cancerous Backdoor Attack with prior backdoor attack baselines to demonstrate our proposed attack outperforms the baselines. Our results indicate that reasoning corruption can develop gradually before it becomes visible, making answer accuracy alone insufficient for detecting backdoor attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Cancerous Backdoor Attack：用不可见 token 提供隐藏阶段、用 stage controller 在推理中跟踪进度，使 LLM 推理在多轮交互中被逐级腐蚀而非一次性触发。在多个推理数据集上跨模型跨任务都产生渐进式腐蚀，并在对比中胜过既有后门攻击基线；结论是仅看答案准确率不足以检测后门。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 后门攻击都是触发-响应的单点激活，恶意行为一步到位，无法刻画在多个中间阶段逐步发展、在可见之前就已腐蚀推理的攻击。
Method: 不可见 token 在用户可见请求之外注入隐藏阶段，stage controller 在推理期跟踪攻击进度以实现渐进激活；在多个推理数据集上评测，并与既有后门攻击基线对比。
Result: 在多个推理数据集上，攻击跨模型、跨任务一致地产生渐进式推理腐蚀；对比既有后门攻击基线，Cancerous Backdoor Attack 表现更优。
Conclusion: 推理腐蚀可以在显形之前逐步发展，因此仅凭答案准确率不足以检测后门攻击，需要能观察中间阶段的检测手段。

papers.title: Machine Learning and Time-Series Foundation Models for Day-Ahead Electricity Forecasting in a University Building
papers.abstract_en: Day-ahead electricity forecasts can help building operators schedule heating, ventilation, and other services around anticipated demand. Choosing a forecasting model also requires balancing accuracy with its forecast-time inputs, local training, and computational requirements. We benchmark statistical, machine-learning, recurrent neural-network, and pretrained TimesFM models for a university building. We use chronological validation and evaluate all configurations on the same 57 test days, comparing accuracy across workdays, weekends, and holidays alongside local fitting and forecasting time. Weather covariates use retrospective observations. TimesFM 3.0 with covariates achieves the lowest overall errors, reducing mean absolute error by approximately 43\% relative to weekly seasonal-naive forecasting. XGBoost remains competitive, although paired daily comparisons do not establish a clear mean-absolute-error advantage for TimesFM. TimesFM also performs strongly using only past electricity consumption. Adding covariates improves its holiday forecasts but slightly worsens workday and weekend forecasts, leaving overall mean absolute error almost unchanged. TimesFM requires no building-specific weight training, while XGBoost offers rapid local fitting and inference. The evaluated LSTM takes longer to fit without outperforming either approach. An exploratory historical evaluation reveals seasonal variation, while a separate weather-source comparison produces only small changes in the selected TimesFM configuration's accuracy. These results support pretrained TimesFM as a strong initial forecasting baseline for this building, with XGBoost as a competitive locally fitted alternative. Covariates are particularly useful when improved holiday forecasts justify the additional input preparation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在一所大学建筑的日前用电预测上，带天气协变量的预训练时序基础模型 TimesFM 3.0 取得最低总体误差，相对周季节性 naive 基线把 MAE 降低约 43%。但配对逐日比较并未确立 TimesFM 相对 XGBoost 的明确 MAE 优势，且协变量只改善节假日预报、反而略差于工作日和周末，总体 MAE 几乎不变。作者建议把 TimesFM 作为该建筑的强初始基线，仅在需要更好节假日预报时才付出协变量准备成本。
Motivation: 建筑运营方需要日前用电预报来安排供暖、通风等服务，但选模型要在精度、预报时可用输入、本地训练成本与算力之间权衡，缺少在同一测试集上对统计、机器学习、循环网络与预训练基础模型的统一比较。
Method: 对同一所大学建筑，比较统计方法、XGBoost、LSTM 与预训练 TimesFM（含带协变量与仅用历史用电两种配置）；采用按时间顺序的验证 (chronological validation)，全部配置在相同的 57 个测试天上评估，按工作日、周末、节假日分层比较精度，并同时记录本地拟合与预报耗时；天气协变量使用回顾性观测 (retrospective observations)。
Result: TimesFM 3.0 带协变量取得最低总体误差，相对周季节性 naive 预报把 MAE 降低约 43%；配对逐日比较未确立 TimesFM 相对 XGBoost 的明确 MAE 优势；TimesFM 仅用历史用电也表现强劲；加协变量改善节假日预报但略差于工作日与周末，总体 MAE 几乎不变；LSTM 拟合更慢且不优于另两种方案；探索性历史评估显示季节性变化，不同天气来源对比只带来所选 TimesFM 配置精度的小幅变化。
Conclusion: 预训练 TimesFM 可作为该建筑无需本地权重训练的强初始日前用电预报基线，XGBoost 是拟合与推理都快的本地化竞争方案；协变量的价值取决于是否值得为节假日预报改善付出额外输入准备。

papers.title: ForcingBooster: Adaptive Patch-wise Denoising for Fast Autoregressive Video Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive video diffusion models have become a leading approach to real-time interactive video generation and video world modeling. However, existing methods typically allocate computation uniformly across space when generating the next video chunk, updating all patches with the same denoising schedule and number of function evaluations. This ignores the spatial heterogeneity of video content: static, simple, or recurring regions are often easier to denoise, while other regions require further refinement or additional context. A uniform budget thus leads to redundant computation on easy patches, whereas reducing the fixed step count can leave difficult patches insufficiently refined. We introduce \methodname{}, a general framework that dynamically allocates denoising steps to individual patches: easy patches stop early to improve efficiency, while difficult patches receive more refinement steps. This design accelerates generation with negligible quality degradation. Our method is compatible with most existing few-step autoregressive diffusion models, requiring only a lightweight routing module with modest training. Experiments demonstrate that \methodname{} reduces the total number of denoising steps applied across video patches by about 50\% while maintaining visual quality comparable to the four-step baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ForcingBooster 为自回归视频扩散提出按 patch 自适应分配去噪步数的框架：简单、静止或重复区域提前停止，困难区域获得更多细化步，从而在保持画质的同时加速生成。总去噪步数约减少 50%，视觉质量与四步基线相当。
Motivation: 现有自回归视频扩散在生成下一个 chunk 时对所有 patch 均匀分配计算（相同去噪调度与函数评估次数），忽略视频内容的空间异质性，导致简单区域冗余计算、困难区域细化不足。
Method: 引入轻量路由模块 (routing module)，按 patch 动态分配去噪步数：易 patch 提前停止、难 patch 获得更多细化步；仅需少量训练，兼容多数现有少步自回归扩散模型。
Result: 在实验中，跨视频 patch 的总去噪步数减少约 50%，同时保持与四步基线 (four-step baseline) 相当的视觉质量。
Conclusion: 按 patch 自适应分配去噪计算可以在几乎不损失画质的前提下显著加速自回归视频扩散，且该设计可作为通用框架接入现有少步模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MemReg: Streaming Outdoor LiDAR Point Cloud Registration with Hybrid Memory Buffers
papers.abstract_en: Prior outdoor LiDAR registration works are commonly limited by the pair-wise input paradigm, which neglects temporal correlations inherent within streaming sequences. In this paper, we propose a novel multi-frame outdoor point cloud registration network for streaming LiDAR scans enhanced with pose-related memory buffers. The key observation is that long-term temporal LiDAR sequences can provide rich global contextual information to complete sparse measurements, filter outliers, and address low-overlap problems, thereby boosting registration performance. Specifically, two hybrid memory buffers are designed, including an implicit memory feature buffer and an explicit memory pose buffer, to store and dynamically update pose-related temporal features. Moreover, a novel dynamic history weighting module is developed to adaptively fuse current and history pose-related features. Extensive experiments on three outdoor datasets, including KITTI, nuScenes, and Apollo-Southbay, demonstrate state-of-the-art performance of MemReg, surpassing all previous pair-wise methods and also multi-frame SLAM systems. Our method also generalizes surprisingly well to multiview indoor registration scenarios with rather competitive performance on 3DMatch, 3DLoMatch, and ScanNet. Code will be released at https://github.com/IRMVLab/MemReg.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemReg 把室外 LiDAR 配准从两帧配对范式改为流式多帧配准，用隐式记忆特征缓冲与显式位姿记忆缓冲存取时序位姿相关特征，再由动态历史加权模块自适应融合当前与历史特征。在 KITTI、nuScenes、Apollo-Southbay 上达到 SOTA，超过所有既有两帧方法与多帧 SLAM 系统，并在 3DMatch、3DLoMatch、ScanNet 室内多视配准上也有竞争力。
Motivation: 既有室外 LiDAR 配准多为两帧配对输入，丢掉流式序列中的时序相关性，稀疏量测、外点与低重叠问题无法借助历史帧补足。
Method: 提出带位姿相关记忆缓冲的多帧配准网络：隐式记忆特征缓冲与显式记忆位姿缓冲存储并动态更新时序位姿相关特征，动态历史加权模块 (dynamic history weighting) 自适应融合当前与历史特征，用于补全稀疏量测、滤除外点、缓解低重叠。
Result: 在 KITTI、nuScenes、Apollo-Southbay 三个室外数据集上取得 SOTA，超过全部既有两帧配准方法与多帧 SLAM 系统；在 3DMatch、3DLoMatch、ScanNet 室内多视配准上同样具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 流式序列中的长期时序信息配到位姿相关记忆缓冲，能系统性优于两帧配对范式，且该范式可迁移到室内多视配准；代码将发布于 github.com/IRMVLab/MemReg。

papers.title: Mesh-Native Tokenisation: Retrofitting Foundation Models to Unstructured Data
papers.abstract_en: Physics foundation models are an increasingly popular approach for building versatile emulators for spatiotemporal systems. They require tokenisation layers that lift physical field data into a latent representation suitable for dynamic processing. A typical choice for this layer is a convolutional encoder, which lifts field information in a locality-aware way and can be trained very efficiently. However, this choice cannot be applied to a large class of scientific computing problems where data are represented on unstructured meshes, for example simulations on domains with curved boundaries. Such data typically require graph neural network architectures, which are more expensive to train and, in the form currently used, encode information differently from their CNN counterparts, thus limiting the portability of physics emulators between these data regimes. In this work we introduce Mesh-Native Convolution (MNC), a locality-aware tokenisation layer that encodes unstructured mesh-based data in a way that is analogous to CNNs. This approach leads to models that can be trained once on mesh data and then deployed to arbitrary unstructured meshes, even if these are irregular, with minimal retraining. We show that this tokenisation approach can be used to retrofit grid-pretrained foundation models efficiently on unstructured meshes and provide theoretical results to confirm the consistency of this approach with classical CNN encoders. We demonstrate the favourable performance of this retrofitting approach, which in many cases reaches acceptable accuracy even in zero-shot deployment, and outperforms existing baselines after only a few epochs of fine-tuning, thus providing an efficient bridge between the two data regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Mesh-Native Convolution (MNC)，一种面向非结构网格的局部性感知 tokenisation 层，使编码方式与 CNN 类比，从而把网格预训练的物理基础模型改造 (retrofit) 到任意非结构网格上部署。零样本部署在许多情形即达可接受精度，少量 epoch 微调后超过现有基线，并给出与经典 CNN 编码器一致性的理论结果。
Motivation: 物理基础模型的 tokenisation 常用卷积编码器，但曲边界等非结构网格数据只能用训练更贵、编码方式不同的 GNN，导致仿真器难以在两种数据体制间迁移。
Method: 引入 MNC 局部性感知 tokenisation 层，以类 CNN 的方式编码非结构网格数据；用它改造网格预训练的 foundation model，并给出与经典 CNN 编码器一致性的理论结果，支持在不规则网格上以极少重训练部署。
Result: 该改造路线在许多情形下零样本部署即达可接受精度，且仅经少量 epoch 微调便优于现有基线；配套给出与经典 CNN 编码器一致性的理论结果。
Conclusion: 以类 CNN 的网格原生 tokenisation 可在非结构网格与结构网格之间架桥，让网格预训练模型经极少重训练迁移到任意不规则网格。

papers.title: Self-Preservation in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning (CL) seeks to adapt pretrained models while preserving prior capabilities. Yet the tasks supplied for preservation cover only part of what a model knows, while forgetting can extend beyond them. Recent work shows that language models can supplement this limited evidence by generating useful replay without access to their original training data. This raises a question about self-preservation: can a model help choose preservation targets that protect its own capabilities more broadly? To study this question, we organize task descriptions and their examples into Task Banks, whose entries can be selected and combined to guide replay generation by a frozen model. Continual instruction tuning with Qwen models of varying sizes yields three findings. First, the new task and learning rate shape which prior capabilities degrade, while tracking previously correct answers reveals losses that average accuracy can conceal. Second, generated replay reduces forgetting on tasks outside the bank. Combining partial banks strengthens this protection, improving mean retention of previously correct answers over either bank alone across the tested sizes. Third, the model can also help choose replay targets: selection informed by the new task improves mean held-out retention over random selection at 4B, with similar new-task gains, although smaller models show no corresponding advantage. Under a fixed example budget, however, replacing new-task examples with replay improves preservation at the cost of smaller new-task gains. Together, these findings show that models can support broader self-preservation by generating replay data and, in some settings, choosing which tasks to replay.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在持续学习中把任务描述与示例组织成 Task Bank，用冻结模型据此生成 replay 数据并选择回放目标，可在不接触原始训练数据的情况下减少库外任务遗忘。跨 Qwen 多个规模，组合部分 Task Bank 比单一 bank 更高提升“此前答对题”的平均保持率；按新任务信息选择回放目标在 4B 上优于随机选择，但更小模型没有这一优势。固定示例预算下，用 replay 替换新任务示例会提升保持率、同时牺牲部分新任务增益。
Motivation: 持续学习中用于保护的既有任务只覆盖模型知识的一部分，遗忘却可能超出这些任务；而模型缺少原始训练数据，无法直接回放。
Method: 把任务描述及其示例组织为 Task Bank，条目可被选择与组合以引导冻结模型生成 replay；在不同规模的 Qwen 模型上做持续指令微调 (continual instruction tuning)，并跟踪此前答对的题目以暴露平均准确率掩盖的损失。
Result: 三项发现：新任务与学习率决定哪些既有能力退化，追踪此前正确答案可揭示平均准确率掩盖的损失；生成的 replay 减少 bank 之外任务的遗忘，合并部分 bank 比任一单独 bank 在各测试规模上都提高此前正确答案的平均保持率；按新任务信息选择回放目标在 4B 上提高平均 held-out 保持率（相对随机选择）且新任务增益相当，更小模型无此优势；固定示例预算下以 replay 替换新任务示例提升保持率但新任务增益变小。
Conclusion: 模型可以通过生成 replay 数据、并在部分设置下自行选择回放任务来支持更广的自我保护；这一选择优势依赖模型规模，且保护既有能力与新任务增益之间存在预算权衡。

papers.title: STAPLE: Static Sparse Upcycling of Pretrained Checkpoints via Embedding Modules
papers.abstract_en: Sparse computation can scale the parametric capacity of LLMs without proportionally increasing active computation, but pretraining sparse architectures remains expensive and data-hungry. Existing sparse upcycling methods mainly target Mixture-of-Experts models, where expert homogeneity, sample inefficiency, and system overheads can limit practical scalability. Static sparse memory offers predictable access and token-specific updates that can help address these challenges, but naively integrating it into pretrained computation yields poor returns. In this work, we introduce STAPLE, a recipe built upon STEM for integrating static sparse memory into pretrained models. Whereas STEM replaces FFN up-projections with token-indexed embeddings, STAPLE retains them and adds the embeddings as a residual pathway, preserving pretrained computation while learning complementary token-specific information in a scalable manner. On OLMo-2 1B, STAPLE improves over continued dense training by 4.27 points on HumanEval, 2.80 on MBPP, 2.27 on GSM8K, and 1.65 on DROP. Average performance increases with static capacity, and improvements persist on the larger OLMo-2 7B backbone. STAPLE also outperforms static sparse baselines such as STEM and an Engram-style model, and achieves a higher average score than an MoE upcycling baseline while decoding 2x faster with less than half its GPU model memory and measured GPU energy per token in our throughput-oriented decoding evaluation. Importantly, despite introducing billions of parameters late in training, our host-offloaded implementation keeps generation throughput within 1.5% and training throughput within 3% of the dense baseline, while caching only the ~5% most frequent embeddings on GPU. These results show that static sparse memory can provide a sample-efficient, scalable, and sustainable path for expanding pretrained models without sparse pretraining from scratch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STAPLE 把静态稀疏记忆以残差通路接入已预训练 LLM：保留 STEM 所替换的 FFN 上投影，把 token 索引 embedding 作为附加分支，从而在不重训稀疏架构的前提下扩容。在 OLMo-2 1B 上相对 continued dense training 提升 HumanEval 4.27、MBPP 2.80、GSM8K 2.27、DROP 1.65 分，7B 上增益仍在，且解码比 MoE upcycling 基线快 2 倍、GPU 显存与每 token 能耗不到其一半。
Motivation: 稀疏架构能扩参数容量而不等比增加活跃计算，但从头预训练稀疏模型昂贵且吃数据；现有 sparse upcycling 主要面向 MoE，受专家同质性、样本低效与系统开销限制，而把静态稀疏记忆直接塞进预训练计算收益很差。
Method: 以 STEM 为底的接入配方：STEM 用 token 索引 embedding 替换 FFN 上投影，STAPLE 保留上投影、把 embedding 作为残差通路相加，保留预训练计算并学互补的 token 特异信息；配合 host-offloaded 实现，只把约 5% 最高频 embedding 缓存在 GPU 上。
Result: OLMo-2 1B 上相对 continued dense training：HumanEval +4.27、MBPP +2.80、GSM8K +2.27、DROP +1.65；平均性能随静态容量增长，OLMo-2 7B 上增益保持。优于 STEM 与 Engram 式静态稀疏基线，平均分高于 MoE upcycling 基线且解码快 2 倍、GPU 模型显存与每 token 实测能耗不到其一半（吞吐导向的解码评测）。引入数十亿参数后，生成吞吐相对 dense 基线偏差在 1.5% 以内、训练吞吐在 3% 以内，GPU 仅缓存约 5% 最高频 embedding。
Conclusion: 静态稀疏记忆提供了一条样本高效、可扩展、可持续的扩容路径：不必从头做稀疏预训练，也不牺牲宿主模型的吞吐与显存。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Binary Verifiable Rewards: Behavioral Self-Rewarding for SWE Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) provides reliable supervision for software engineering agents through executable tests, but binary rewards fail to distinguish trajectories with substantially different debugging quality. We investigate whether the current policy can judge its own trajectories and use these judgments to improve task performance without a separately trained reward model. To this end, we introduce Behavioral Self-Rewarding (BSR), a reward-refinement method that reuses the policy to compare observable debugging behavior among trajectories from the same task with the same verifier outcome. BSR aggregates pairwise preferences into task-local scores and converts them into bounded auxiliary rewards, introducing reward contrast while preserving the verifier-defined pass/fail ordering. This provides additional supervision from already-collected trajectories without requiring new environment interactions. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench-Live show consistent improvements across the evaluated Qwen3-14B and Qwen3-32B configurations, supporting using the policy's own comparative judgments as a complementary learning signal for training software engineering agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BSR 让策略自己比较同一任务、同一测试通过/失败结果下的多条调试轨迹，把成对偏好聚合成任务内分数并转成有界辅助奖励，在保持验证器 pass/fail 排序的前提下引入奖励对比。在 SWE-bench Verified 与 SWE-bench-Live 上，Qwen3-14B 与 Qwen3-32B 的各配置均一致提升，且不需要新的环境交互或单独训练的 reward model。
Motivation: RLVR 用可执行测试给 SWE agent 提供可靠监督，但二值奖励无法区分调试质量差异很大的轨迹，且单独训练 reward model 成本高。
Method: Behavioral Self-Rewarding (BSR)：复用当前策略对同一任务、同一 verifier 结果的轨迹两两比较可观测调试行为，把成对偏好聚合成任务局部分数，再转为有界辅助奖励，与验证器奖励叠加；监督来自已收集轨迹，无需新环境交互。
Result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 和 SWE-bench-Live 上，Qwen3-14B 与 Qwen3-32B 的各评估配置均取得一致提升（abstract 未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 策略自身的比较判断可以作为训练 SWE agent 的补充学习信号，同时保持验证器定义的 pass/fail 排序不被破坏。

papers.title: SpireBench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Strategic Play of Agentic Models with Slay the Spire
papers.abstract_en: Agentic large language models now tackle complex tasks, yet strategic reasoning over long horizons is under-studied: most agentic benchmarks are short and episodic, and performance on long tasks is hard to dissect into stored knowledge, reasoning and luck. We introduce SpireBench, in which models play the complete commercial deck-builder Slay the Spire (StS), where early decisions decide long-term success. Across 20 large language models (LLMs) at the game's highest difficulty, frontier models beat heuristic baselines and match the average human player but remain far behind experts. This gap widens as the run lengthens: the strongest models win the first act as often as experts, then fall behind. What separates strong models from weak is how well they play each fight; all of them misjudge risk over a run, preserving health rather than spending it to grow stronger. A comprehensive, self-consistent renaming of every game term shows that part of their performance rests on prior knowledge of the game, and models do not improve from the memories they write across runs, which are often wrong and overly cautious. Our harness is the first to give a model the complete original game, and we compare it with existing harnesses. Overall, SpireBench offers an unsaturated long-horizon benchmark with tools to locate where and why agents fail.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SpireBench：让 LLM 完整游玩商业卡组构筑游戏 Slay the Spire，以检验长时程策略推理。在最高难度下评测 20 个 LLM，前沿模型胜过启发式基线、接近普通玩家但远逊专家，且差距随局程拉长而扩大；模型普遍误判整局风险、过度保血而非换血成长，改写全部游戏术语后表现下降说明部分成绩来自对游戏的先验知识，跨局自写记忆也无改进。
Motivation: 现有 agentic 基准多为短回合任务，长时程任务上的表现难以拆分为存储知识、推理与运气，长 horizon 策略推理研究不足。
Method: 构建 SpireBench harness，首次让模型运行完整原版 Slay the Spire，在最高难度下评测 20 个 LLM，并与启发式基线及已有 harness 对比；另做全量游戏术语的自洽重命名以剥离先验知识，并检查模型跨局写入的记忆。
Result: 20 个 LLM 在最高难度下：前沿模型胜过启发式基线、与普通玩家平均相当但远低于专家；最强模型第一幕胜率与专家相当，随后落后，差距随局程扩大；强弱模型的区分在单场战斗的发挥，所有模型都误判整局风险、过度保血；术语重命名后部分性能消失；模型不因跨局自写记忆而改善，且记忆常错误且过度保守。
Conclusion: 长时程策略失败主要来自逐场战斗发挥与整局风险管理，而非单纯知识缺口；模型的自我记忆机制当前无效且偏保守，SpireBench 提供了定位失败位置与原因的未饱和工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Know What You Don't Know: Agentic Data Synthesis by Evolving Generation Space for Closed-Loop Learning
papers.abstract_en: The continued improvement of large language models increasingly depends on synthetic experience, yet effective data synthesis for interactive agents requires not only executable and verifiable trajectories, but also interactions that provide learning value for the current task agent. Existing methods increasingly incorporate environment feedback, data validation, or learner failures, but still face a feedback-to-decision gap: observed weaknesses do not directly specify how future synthesis should change, or whether they can be represented by the current synthesis space. To address this gap, we propose EvoSyn, a learning-feedback-driven multi-agent framework that organizes synthesis around a revisable state specifying what interaction factors can be deliberately generated and where synthesis effort should be allocated. A role-specialized multi-agent system translates learner feedback into synthesis revisions, while a Designer allocates synthesis directions and a Planner grounds them into executable experience. This process enables within-space adaptation toward weak or under-covered regions and synthesis-space expansion that promotes newly discovered factors into explicit generation controls. Experiments on $τ^2$-Bench and CAR-Bench show that EvoSyn improves average task success by 13.3 points over the strongest synthesis baseline, while producing higher-quality and structurally broader synthetic experience and discovering controllable factors missed without learner feedback.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Realism VS Accuracy: Event Sequence Forecasting from a Generative Modeling Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Event sequences are chains of random events, each described by heterogeneous (numerical and categorical) features. The problem of event sequence forecasting occurs in finance, healthcare, business process intelligence, and other fields. In this work, we study multi-horizon forecasting of event sequences as a conditional generative modeling problem. We evaluate forecasts not only for prediction accuracy, but also for distributional realism. To this end, we present a benchmark comprising metrics for both quality aspects, strong statistical baselines, recent models adapted from adjacent fields, and curated real-world datasets. Careful evaluation reveals that no method excels at both accuracy and realism, highlighting a fundamental trade-off between the two. Finally, we introduce Wasserstein BaryBooster, an algorithm that aggregates samples from a realism-strong diffusion model into a state-of-the-art predictor, demonstrating that distributional realism can be converted into prediction accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/xaosina/event-sequence-forecasting.
papers.comment: Spotlight at the NeurIPS 2026 Track on Evaluations and Datasets. Code: https://github.com/xaosina/event-sequence-forecasting
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把事件序列多步预报当作条件生成建模问题，同时评测预测精度与分布真实感，发现现有方法无法兼顾两者，存在根本性权衡。提出 Wasserstein BaryBooster，把真实感强的 diffusion 模型样本聚合进 SOTA 预测器，将分布真实感转化为预测精度。
Motivation: 事件序列（异质数值与类别特征构成的随机事件链）在金融、医疗、业务流程挖掘中需要多步预报，但既有方法只按预测精度评测，分布真实感这一维度既无标准度量也无系统比较。
Method: 构建覆盖精度与真实感两类度量、强统计基线、从相邻领域改编的近期模型以及精选真实数据集的 benchmark；再提出 Wasserstein BaryBooster，用 Wasserstein 重心方式把 realism-strong diffusion 模型的生成样本聚合进 SOTA 预测器。
Result: 系统评测显示没有任何方法在精度与真实感上同时占优，二者存在根本权衡；Wasserstein BaryBooster 演示了分布真实感可转化为预测精度。论文为 NeurIPS 2026 Track on Evaluations and Datasets Spotlight，代码已开源。
Conclusion: 事件序列预报中精度与分布真实感不可兼得，但真实感可通过样本聚合注入预测器以换取精度提升；评测应同时报告这两类指标。

papers.title: Mind the Temporal Gap: Evaluating Video Models for Temporal Understanding in Driving
papers.abstract_en: Modern video-language models are increasingly treated as general-purpose video reasoners, yet it remains unclear whether they robustly capture temporal dynamics in safety-critical settings such as driving. We study this question through controlled ego-motion tasks that require identifying actions from driving videos. Across video-language models, we find that standard prompting, visual prompting, few-shot prompting, and chain-of-thought prompting remain unreliable and highly task- and model-dependent, with persistent class biases, although newer models show substantial task-specific few-shot gains. In contrast, lightweight LoRA finetuning and simple probes trained on intermediate visual features recover strong motion-discriminative performance, indicating that motion-relevant cues are often present inside the models but are not reliably used by the final video-to-language pathway. These results suggest that, in driving, current video-language models remain unreliable temporal reasoners and often behave more like frame-level, bias-driven recognizers than dependable temporal world models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在驾驶自运动 (ego-motion) 识别任务上系统评测视频-语言模型的时间理解能力，发现标准提示、视觉提示、few-shot 与 chain-of-thought 提示都不可靠且高度依赖任务与模型，并有持续的类别偏置；而轻量 LoRA 微调和基于中间视觉特征的简单探针能恢复强运动判别性能，说明运动线索存在于模型内部但未被最终的视频到语言通路使用。
Motivation: 视频-语言模型被当作通用视频推理器用于驾驶这类安全关键场景，但它们是否真正捕捉时间动态并不清楚。
Method: 在需要从驾驶视频中识别动作的受控自运动任务上评测多种视频-语言模型，对比标准提示、视觉提示、few-shot 提示与 chain-of-thought 提示，并与轻量 LoRA 微调及在中间视觉特征上训练的简单探针比较。
Result: 四类提示策略均不可靠且高度任务与模型依赖，存在持续的类别偏置，较新模型在特定任务上有明显的 few-shot 提升；LoRA 微调与中间特征探针恢复出强运动判别性能。
Conclusion: 当前视频-语言模型在驾驶中仍是不可靠的时间推理器，行为更像逐帧、受偏置驱动的识别器而非可信的时间世界模型；运动信息在内部表征中存在但未被语言输出通路利用。

papers.title: Scaling Multi-Teacher Distillation for Digital Pathology
papers.abstract_en: Multi-teacher distillation allows transferring knowledge from multiple "teacher" networks to a single "student" network. This method is promising in fields such as digital pathology, where many powerful foundation models were proposed recently. However, as we show in this paper, the standard multi-teacher distillation approach reacts poorly to an increase in the number of teachers used to train a student encoder. We demonstrate that learning teacher-specific representations is a key to scaling in MTD. Importantly, different design choices, such as learnable teacher tokens, a tailored attention scheme, additional mixture-of-experts layers and a contrastive loss, are proposed to better learn such teacher-specific representations. We show that our method better scales with respect to the number of considered teachers, allowing us to train compact student encoders, up to 10x more efficient than larger teacher foundation models, while matching their performance and even outperforming them on a large set of tile-level and slide-level tasks. We conduct a thorough empirical validation, evaluating more than 10 foundation models on 39 tasks spanning tile and slide levels. As a result, we release a new collection of strong and efficient foundation models, named OMNI, trained from the knowledge of 10 state-of-the-art foundation models. We finally conduct an analysis of the learned teacher-specific representations, highlighting their complementarity and explaining why they can be easily aggregated at downstream time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 数字病理多教师蒸馏 (MTD) 在教师数量增加时性能变差，本文把「学到教师专属表征」当作扩展关键，用可学习教师 token、定制注意力、额外 MoE 层与对比损失来显式建模这类表征。在 10 个以上基础模型、39 个 tile 与 slide 级任务上验证，所得紧凑学生编码器比大型教师基础模型最高高效 10 倍，同时匹配并在大范围任务上超过它们，并发布由 10 个 SOTA 基础模型蒸出的 OMNI 模型集。
Motivation: 数字病理近期出现大量基础模型，标准多教师蒸馏随教师数增加反而反应变差，无法把更多教师的知识有效压进一个紧凑学生编码器。
Method: 提出四项设计来学教师专属表征：可学习的教师 token、定制的注意力机制、额外的 mixture-of-experts 层以及对比损失 (contrastive loss)，据此训练紧凑学生编码器；在 10 个以上基础模型上做实证验证，覆盖 39 个 tile 级与 slide 级任务。
Result: 学生编码器最高比大型教师基础模型高效 10 倍，同时匹配其性能，并在大范围 tile 级与 slide 级任务上超过教师；验证覆盖 10 个以上基础模型与 39 个任务；最终发布由 10 个 SOTA 基础模型训练得到的 OMNI 模型集。
Conclusion: 多教师蒸馏要随教师数扩展，必须显式学出互补且可聚合的教师专属表征；据此可把多个大基础模型的知识压进一个既小又强的学生编码器。

papers.title: DiffusionART: Efficient, Stable and Scalable Reinforcement of Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Online reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tunes diffusion models with black-box rewards, but reverse-process methods such as Flow-GRPO are limited in efficiency by poor credit assignment, while forward-process methods such as DiffusionNFT are efficient yet unstable without carefully tuned exponential-moving-average (EMA) off-policy training. We show that NFT-style objectives contain a hidden forward--reverse consistency force that joint positive--negative training cancels only partially, and that EMA stabilizes training through restoration rather than off-policy rollouts. We introduce DiffusionART (Diffusion Reinforcement with Aggregation-First Reward Tilting), which aggregates each prompt's rewards into a shared reward-improving direction for reverse-process states, removing the consistency force by construction, and adds a trust-region-masked second update for drift-adaptive restoration without EMA tuning. It requires no differentiable reward model, remains effective with fewer samples per prompt, and supports pairwise reward models (DiffusionART-Pairwise). Across image and video generation, DiffusionART trains efficiently and stably without per-task tuning. In particular, on HunyuanVideo-13B with equally weighted visual and motion quality rewards, DiffusionART reaches the late-stage mean reward levels of DiffusionNFT and Flow-GRPO-Fast with 12.02 and 11.72 times fewer GPU hours, respectively, while achieving 28.8% and 53.0% higher mean training rewards.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DiffusionART 把同一 prompt 的奖励聚合成共享的奖励提升方向，从构造上消掉 NFT 类目标里隐藏的 forward-reverse consistency force，再用 trust-region 掩码的第二次更新做漂移自适应恢复，从而不调 EMA 也能稳定训练。在 HunyuanVideo-13B 上以等权视觉与运动质量奖励训练，达到 DiffusionNFT 与 Flow-GRPO-Fast 后期平均奖励水平所需 GPU 小时分别少 12.02 倍和 11.72 倍，同时平均训练奖励高 28.8% 和 53.0%。
Motivation: 在线 RL 微调扩散模型时，reverse-process 方法（如 Flow-GRPO）因 credit assignment 差而效率低，forward-process 方法（如 DiffusionNFT）则必须精调 EMA 才不发散。
Method: Aggregation-First Reward Tilting：把每个 prompt 的奖励聚合为作用于 reverse-process 状态的共享奖励提升方向，构造性移除 consistency force；再加一次 trust-region 掩码的第二步更新做 drift-adaptive restoration，替代 EMA 调参。不需要可微奖励模型，每 prompt 采样数更少仍有效，并支持 pairwise 奖励模型（DiffusionART-Pairwise）。
Result: 在图像与视频生成上，DiffusionART 无需逐任务调参即可高效稳定训练。HunyuanVideo-13B 上等权视觉与运动质量奖励下，达到 DiffusionNFT 与 Flow-GRPO-Fast 的后期平均奖励水平分别少用 12.02 与 11.72 倍 GPU 小时，平均训练奖励分别高 28.8% 与 53.0%。
Conclusion: 把奖励聚合成共享提升方向并用 trust-region 第二步做恢复，可以在不调 EMA 的前提下同时拿到 forward-process 的效率与训练稳定性。

papers.title: An all-transistor physical-learning transformer can be trained to perform in-context learning
papers.abstract_en: Most systems trained by equilibrium propagation or coupled learning are in the same class as multi-layer perceptrons: while they may be universal function approximators, they struggle to learn associative tasks which are easy for transformers. Equilibrium propagation relies on a bidirectional flow of information through the physical system between input and output. The reverse flow is broken by more complex nonlinear systems, such as those performing multiplication which is needed to express dot-product attention. Here we explicitly restore this bidirectional flow by introducing extra circuit elements for this purpose into a double or dyadic circuit. We then use these ideas to construct an attention mechanism exploiting the exponential current law of sub-threshold MOSFET devices. We show that in simulations this circuit can be trained to perform a simple in-context learning task, despite using realistic reverse components which transmit only an approximate gradient. For this training to succeed we need cross-entropy loss (not mean squared error). We generate nudges appropriate for this loss using a novel floating circuit element, based on the same MOSFET sub-circuit used for softmax. We train the resistors in this circuit using the Lion optimiser, which can be implemented using one capacitor per parameter to store local memory of past gradient estimates.

papers.title: MIRAGE: Metric Inference and Reliability-Aware Gaussian Estimation from Feed-Forward Vision
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D priors enable high-quality reconstruction from image streams but often lack reliable metric scale and suffer from long-term trajectory drift. In contrast, LiDAR--inertial estimation provides metrically accurate motion but lacks the image-space consistency needed for high-fidelity reconstruction. We propose $MIRAGE$, which anchors feed-forward visual geometry to LiDAR--IMU metric motion and regulates online pose corrections according to correspondence support and cross-modal agreement, jointly enabling accurate metric pose estimation and high-fidelity Gaussian reconstruction. Experiments on Oxford Spires, M2DGR and INS show that MIRAGE achieves accurate metric trajectory estimation, outperforming COLMAP, a widely used but computationally expensive reference for vision-only benchmarks. Motivated by the scarcity of long-horizon monocular benchmarks for large-scale indoor reconstruction, we further build a multimodal data-collection platform and use MIRAGE to establish accurate 6-DoF reference trajectories for a new vision-only benchmark. We benchmark recent monocular large-scale reconstruction methods on this dataset, providing a systematic evaluation of their performance in long-horizon indoor scenes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MIRAGE 把前馈视觉几何锚定到 LiDAR-IMU 的米制运动上，并按对应点支撑度与跨模态一致性在线调节位姿修正，同时得到米制位姿与高保真 Gaussian 重建。在 Oxford Spires、M2DGR 与 INS 上轨迹精度超过 COLMAP，并被用来为新的纯视觉大规模室内基准建立 6-DoF 参考轨迹。
Motivation: 前馈 3D 先验重建质量高但缺可靠米制尺度且长时漂移，LiDAR-惯性估计米制准却缺图像空间一致性，两者互补但缺少把视觉几何约束到米制运动的在线机制。
Method: 将前馈视觉几何锚定到 LiDAR-IMU 米制运动，按对应点支撑度与跨模态一致性调节在线位姿修正；另搭建多模态采集平台，用 MIRAGE 生成 6-DoF 参考轨迹以建立纯视觉室内基准。
Result: 在 Oxford Spires、M2DGR 与 INS 上实现准确的米制轨迹估计，超过视觉-only 基准中常用的高开销参考方法 COLMAP；并用该平台与 MIRAGE 建立新纯视觉基准，对近期单目大规模重建方法做系统评测。
Conclusion: 把前馈视觉几何用 LiDAR-IMU 米制运动做锚、按跨模态一致性在线调节修正，可同时获得米制轨迹与高保真重建，并可反过来充当大规模室内重建基准的参考轨迹来源。

papers.title: CASTER: Formalizing Zero-Shot Manipulation from Synthetic Videos as Constrained Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Prior research on learning from humans often requires real human demonstrations. But advances in video generation models offer a new paradigm: we can now prompt these generators to make synthetic videos of the task. On the plus side, these synthetic videos take place in the robot's current environment, and do not require actual human teaching. However, while the generated videos appear to show plausible motions, they lack both physical consistency and robot grounding, and thus the robot cannot directly roll out the trajectory shown by the video. In this paper we seek to formalize the process of going from synthetic video generation to real-world robot trajectories for zero-shot manipulation tasks. We recognize that this problem is an instance of constrained optimization. The object trajectories extracted from the synthetic video provide an initial guess at the correct motion, and the robot must refine these trajectories (for instance, within a digital twin) while enforcing physical feasibility and semantic consistency. Our optimization-based formalism provides insights into the video generation properties necessary for success. Specifically, we show that the video generation must probabilistically seed the search within a semantic basin of attraction where the trajectory can be locally modified without losing its task alignment. Our analysis further reveals that state-of-the-art approaches can be viewed as instances of our unified formalism with key simplifications. In our experiments we remove these simplifications to more closely match the underlying optimization, leading to more robust zero-shot trajectories from synthetic videos and improving average task success by 34.1% compared to the best-performing baseline. See videos at our project website: https://collab.me.vt.edu/CASTER
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CASTER 把「合成视频→真实机器人轨迹」的零样本操作问题形式化为约束优化：视频抽出的物体轨迹作初值，机器人在数字孪生中精修轨迹并同时满足物理可行性与语义一致性。该形式化指出视频生成必须以概率方式把搜索播种到语义吸引域 (semantic basin of attraction) 内，使轨迹可局部修改而不丢任务对齐；按此去掉现有方法的简化后，平均任务成功率比最强基线提高 34.1%。
Motivation: 视频生成模型能在机器人当前环境中合成任务演示，但生成视频缺乏物理一致性与机器人接地，机器人无法直接执行其中轨迹，缺少从合成视频到可执行轨迹的形式化路径。
Method: 将零样本操作形式化为约束优化：以合成视频中提取的物体轨迹为初值，在数字孪生内精修，约束为物理可行性与语义一致性；分析给出视频生成需满足的条件（概率性播种到语义吸引域），并把现有 SOTA 方法识别为该统一形式化在若干简化下的特例，实验中移除这些简化。
Result: 移除简化、更贴近底层优化后，合成视频产生的零样本轨迹更鲁棒，平均任务成功率相对最强基线提高 34.1%。
Conclusion: 从合成视频做零样本操作本质上是带物理与语义约束的轨迹优化，视频生成的质量标准是能否把搜索概率性地放进语义吸引域，而非视频看起来是否合理。

papers.title: Sample-Adaptive Zeroth-Order Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization offers a memory-efficient alternative to backpropagation for fine-tuning large language models. However, existing ZO methods typically sample training examples uniformly, overlooking their evolving importance and leaving avoidable estimation variance. To address this limitation, we propose Sample-Adaptive Zeroth-Order Optimization (SAZO), which learns sample importance online and adaptively allocates queries to accelerate convergence. SAZO extracts gradient-norm information from existing directional differences to estimate sample importance without access to true gradients. Furthermore, to track evolving importance from sparse minibatch feedback, SAZO maintains per-example exponential moving averages that aggregate observations across updates. The method requires no additional model evaluations and only $O(N)$ additional scalar state compared with MeZO. We prove that SAZO asymptotically matches the leading convergence term of the minimum-variance sampling oracle, and achieves a strictly faster convergence rate than standard methods. Extensive experiments across four model families demonstrate improved average downstream performance and up to $6\times$ faster convergence to the same training loss in terms of query count.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAZO 在零阶 (ZO) 大模型微调中在线学习样本重要性并自适应分配查询：从已有方向差分中提取梯度范数信息估计重要性，用逐样本 EMA 跟踪其演化，无需真梯度、不增加模型评估，仅比 MeZO 多 O(N) 标量状态。理论上渐近匹配最小方差采样 oracle 的主收敛项且严格快于标准方法，四类模型上平均下游性能提升、达到同等训练 loss 最多快 6×（按查询数）。
Motivation: 现有 ZO 微调方法均匀采样训练样本，忽略样本重要性的演化，留下本可避免的估计方差，拖慢收敛。
Method: SAZO 从已有的方向差分 (directional differences) 中提取梯度范数信息来估计样本重要性，无需访问真梯度；用逐样本指数滑动平均 (per-example EMA) 聚合稀疏 minibatch 反馈以跟踪重要性演化，并据此自适应分配查询。相对 MeZO 不需额外模型评估，只多 O(N) 标量状态。
Result: 理论上 SAZO 渐近匹配最小方差采样 oracle (minimum-variance sampling oracle) 的主收敛项，并严格快于标准 ZO 方法的收敛率；在四个模型家族的实验中平均下游性能提升，按查询数计达到相同训练 loss 最多快 6×。
Conclusion: 在 ZO 微调里按在线估计的样本重要性分配查询，可以在不增加模型评估的前提下同时改善下游性能与查询效率。

papers.title: Fly-by-Code: Embodied Coding Agents for Aerial Manipulation with Active Visual and Physical Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Embodied coding agents construct robot policies from natural-language instructions by generating executable programs and refining them from execution feedback. This refinement assumes that execution feedback reveals whether the task succeeded and, after a failure, provides sufficient evidence to guide program revision. Aerial manipulation violates this assumption in two ways. Payload constraints restrict onboard camera coverage and leave task-critical outcomes outside the robot's view (partial observability), while strong dynamic coupling and limited control margins make physical interactions fragile (limited interaction robustness) and leave failure causes unresolved. Re-examining the same feedback cannot recover observations that were never collected or separate failure causes that the available evidence does not distinguish. To acquire this missing evidence, we introduce Active Feedback (AF), an active "View and Probe" framework. When execution feedback leaves unresolved questions, the agent synthesizes a separate diagnostic program that runs in simulation to inspect unseen outcomes from informative viewpoints (View) or test hypotheses about failure causes through targeted physical interactions (Probe). Across six simulated aerial manipulation tasks with 60 trials per condition, AF reduces false completion declarations from 25 to 5 and raises final task success from 31.7% to 75% compared with terminal feedback under the same coding-agent configuration and task-execution limit. Using shared robot APIs, task programs refined with AF in simulation run on a physical aerial manipulator without task-program source-code modification and complete multi-stage manipulation tasks in the real world. These results show that executable diagnosis fills gaps in execution feedback for embodied coding agents, improving both completion assessment and program refinement in aerial manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Active Feedback (AF)：当具身编码 agent 的执行反馈无法判定成败或无法区分失败原因时，另合成一个诊断程序，在仿真中从信息量大的视角查看未观测结果 (View) 或做针对性物理试探 (Probe) 来补齐证据。在 6 个仿真空中操作任务、每条件 60 次试验中，误报完成从 25 次降到 5 次，最终任务成功率从 31.7% 升到 75%；经 AF 在仿真中精修的任务程序不改源码即可在实体空中操作器上完成多阶段操作。
Motivation: 具身编码 agent 依赖执行反馈来判定成败并指导程序修订，但空中操作中载荷限制使关键结果落在机载相机视野外（部分可观测），强动态耦合与有限控制裕度又使物理交互脆弱、失败原因无法归因；反复重看同一份反馈补不回没采集到的观测。
Method: Active Feedback 的 View and Probe 框架：执行反馈留下未决问题时，agent 合成一个独立诊断程序，在仿真中或从信息量大的视角检查未观测结果 (View)，或通过针对性物理交互检验关于失败原因的假设 (Probe)，再据此修订任务程序；真机部署通过共享 robot API，任务程序源码不改。
Result: 在 6 个仿真空中操作任务、每条件 60 次试验、相同 coding-agent 配置与任务执行上限下，AF 相比 terminal feedback 把误报完成从 25 次降到 5 次，最终任务成功率从 31.7% 提到 75%；用 AF 在仿真中精修的程序在实体空中操作器上不改任务程序源码即完成多阶段真机操作。
Conclusion: 可执行的诊断程序能补上执行反馈的证据缺口，同时改善完成判定与程序修订，且仿真中精修的程序可经共享 API 直接迁移到真机空中操作。

summary_sections.conclusion: 可执行的诊断程序能补上执行反馈的证据缺口，同时改善完成判定与程序修订，且仿真中精修的程序可经共享 API 直接迁移到真机空中操作。

papers.title: AutoIndexer: Flexible-Order Decoding by Training Causal Models on Chains of Edits
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive decoding is less suited to non-causally ordered data, e.g., cross-references or future dependencies, since their outputs cannot be revised post hoc, unlike iterative human reasoning. Diffusion LLMs partially mitigate this limitation but still cannot flexibly insert or remove arbitrary numbers of tokens from a pre-generated context. We design AutoIndexer as a generative model with a novel training and decoding mechanism that simulates a Chain of Edits, allowing the model to flexibly modify its prior outputs in hindsight via token insertions, substitutions, and deletions. The model learns to predict marker tokens for opening and closing edits, simultaneously moving a cursor to positions in the existing token sequence, analogous to a text editor. Training sequences are obtained by perturbing ground-truth labels with inverse chained edit operations, and the model learns to edit by undoing those inverses. The perturbation training allows AutoIndexer to be robust to erroneous context and adaptable to editing tasks such as code correction. We demonstrate that our method exhibits post-generation context-editing capabilities that most autoregressive and diffusion models lack without compromising performance on standard LLM benchmarks. The code is available at https://github.com/AutodeskAILab/autoindexer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AutoIndexer 用 Chain of Edits 式训练与解码，让因果语言模型像文本编辑器一样在已生成序列上移动光标并插入、替换、删除 token，从而事后修改非因果顺序的输出（如交叉引用）。训练序列由对真值标签施加逆向链式编辑扰动得到，模型通过撤销这些逆向操作学会编辑；作者称该方法获得多数自回归与扩散模型缺乏的生成后上下文编辑能力，且不牺牲标准 LLM benchmark 表现。
Motivation: 自回归解码无法事后修订输出，对交叉引用、未来依赖这类非因果顺序数据不适用；扩散 LLM 虽部分缓解，仍不能在已生成上下文中灵活插入或删除任意数量 token。
Method: 设计 AutoIndexer：生成模型配新训练与解码机制模拟 Chain of Edits，模型预测开闭编辑的 marker token 并同时把光标移到既有 token 序列位置，支持插入、替换、删除；训练序列通过对真值标签施加逆向链式编辑扰动构造，模型靠撤销逆向操作学习编辑，扰动训练同时带来对错误上下文的鲁棒性与向代码纠错类编辑任务的适配。
Result: 演示该方法具备生成后上下文编辑能力，而多数自回归与扩散模型不具备；在标准 LLM benchmark 上性能不妥协。代码发布于 github.com/AutodeskAILab/autoindexer。
Conclusion: 把训练目标从预测下一个 token 改为撤销逆向编辑链，可让因果模型获得事后修订能力而不损失常规语言建模表现，并顺带获得对错误上下文的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Transformer-Based Masked Diffusion Models Provably Learn Distributions with Latent Structure
papers.abstract_en: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) generate discrete data by iteratively unmasking multiple tokens in parallel using a learned mask predictor. Their output carries two errors: parallelization error due to parallel sampling, and estimation error from the mask predictor learned with finite samples. Existing theory treats these errors separately, and the available statistical bounds typically scale with the number $V^L$ of length-$L$ sequences over a vocabulary of size $V$, suffering from the curse of dimensionality. In this work, we establish end-to-end statistical guarantees showing that transformer-based MDMs learn structured distributions with a sample complexity governed by their latent structure. Specifically, we model this structure through mixtures of hidden Markov trees, which capture latent dependencies within components and heterogeneity across components. When the data distribution is well approximated by such a mixture, a transformer-based MDM with parallel unmasking schedules achieves $\varepsilon$-accurate sampling in KL divergence with $\widetilde{O}(LK_{\mathrm{par}}/\varepsilon)$ training samples, where $K_{\mathrm{par}}$ is polynomial in $L$, $V$, the number of hidden states, and the number of mixture components. The transformer network and sampling procedure require no knowledge of the tree topologies or component parameters, thereby adapting to the unknown latent structure automatically. Overall, our results provide theoretical justification for the empirical effectiveness of MDMs on real-world data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对基于 Transformer 的掩码扩散模型 (masked diffusion model, MDM) 给出端到端统计保证：当数据分布可被隐马尔可夫树混合模型 (mixture of hidden Markov trees) 良好近似时，并行解掩码采样达到 KL 散度 ε 精度只需 Õ(LK_par/ε) 个训练样本，K_par 对 L、V、隐状态数与混合成分数仅为多项式，从而绕开 V^L 的维数灾难。网络与采样过程无需知道树拓扑或成分数参数，可自动适配未知隐结构。
Motivation: 现有理论把并行采样误差与掩码预测器的有限样本估计误差分开处理，统计界通常随长度 L、词表 V 的序列数 V^L 缩放，遭遇维数灾难，无法解释 MDM 在真实数据上的经验有效性。
Method: 用隐马尔可夫树的混合来刻画数据的隐结构（分量内隐依赖、分量间异质性），在此模型下分析带并行解掩码调度的 Transformer MDM，联合界定并行化误差与估计误差，得到以隐结构 governs 的样本复杂度；网络与采样均不需树拓扑或分量参数。
Result: 数据分布被该混合模型良好近似时，Transformer MDM 以 Õ(LK_par/ε) 训练样本实现 KL 散度下 ε 精度采样，其中 K_par 是 L、V、隐状态数、混合成分数的多项式，取代随 V^L 缩放的既有界。
Conclusion: MDM 的样本复杂度由数据隐结构而非序列空间大小决定，这为 MDM 在真实数据上的经验有效性提供了理论依据。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Equal-Budget Monte Carlo Tree Search versus Randomized-Restart List Scheduling for DAG Workflows: A Controlled Equal-Budget Computational Study
papers.abstract_en: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) is often proposed for scheduling directed-acyclic-graph (DAG) workflows, yet most studies never run the comparison that could refute it - giving a much simpler method the same search effort. We run that comparison under a controlled protocol. All arms receive an identical budget - the same number of candidate schedules built and evaluated: an MCTS scheduling method, preregistered as the main arm; a randomized-restart list scheduler with no search tree as the control; and a textbook-UCT MCTS arm as a registered follow-up on the same domain. The analysis plan was locked before data collection; an independent checker confirmed all 768 confirmation-stage schedules valid with correct finish times. At the main budget of 2048 evaluated schedules, MCTS is 2.88% worse than the restarts (95% CI [-3.62%,-2.15%]; the 72 of 96 held-out instances with positive baseline-relative headroom). The deficit is not budget starvation: on the separate exploration pool restarts self-improve by 1.85% where MCTS gains 0.24%, and 700 of 720 of MCTS's first results are merely the warm start it was handed. The studied selection rule locks deterministically onto the first-expanded child, keeping its trials correlated while restarts draw gains from the tails; the causal link to makespan remains an inference. A structural map locates where the tree stops paying: restarts win on sparse irregular workflows, no difference is detectable on regular layered ones, and dense ones leave no room to improve. Swapping the rule for textbook UCT removes most of the deficit (-0.26%, 95% CI [-0.71%,+0.23%]) without reversing its sign. Results are confined to a controlled synthetic domain (N in {8,16,32} tasks, 2-8 processors, budgets up to 2048); we make no claim about larger budgets.
papers.comment: 19 pages, 4 figures. Preregistered negative result with an open evaluation protocol; companion artifacts archived at 10.5281/zenodo.22929494 and 10.5281/zenodo.22930513
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在等预算条件下对 DAG 工作流调度做预注册对照实验：MCTS 相比随机重启列表调度在 2048 个已评估调度预算下 makespan 差 2.88%（95% CI [-3.62%,-2.15%]），换成 textbook UCT 后差距缩到 -0.26%（95% CI [-0.71%,+0.23%]）。结论是该 MCTS 选择规则在稀疏不规则工作流上不划算，规则换成 UCT 可消除大部分劣势。
Motivation: 文献常提议用 MCTS 调度 DAG 工作流，却很少做能证伪它的对照——让更简单的方法拿到同样的搜索预算。
Method: 受控等预算协议：所有 arm 获得相同的已构建并评估的候选调度数；主 arm 为预注册的 MCTS 调度方法，对照为无搜索树的随机重启列表调度器，注册后续 arm 为 textbook-UCT MCTS。分析计划在采集数据前锁定，独立检查器核验全部 768 份确认阶段调度有效且完工时间正确；另设探索池观察自改进。
Result: 主预算 2048 个已评估调度下，MCTS 比重启差 2.88%（95% CI [-3.62%,-2.15%]；96 个留出实例中 72 个存在正的相对基线 headroom）。探索池上重启自改进 1.85% 而 MCTS 仅 0.24%；MCTS 首批结果中 700/720 只是给定的热启动。换成 textbook UCT 后差距为 -0.26%（95% CI [-0.71%,+0.23%]）。结构图显示重启在稀疏不规则工作流上胜出，规则分层工作流上无可检出差异，稠密工作流无改进空间。域为 N∈{8,16,32} 任务、2–8 处理器、预算至 2048。
Conclusion: 被研究的选择规则会确定性锁死在首个展开的子节点上，使试验相关而重启从尾部取收益；把规则换成 textbook UCT 可消除大部分劣势但不反转符号。结论限于该受控合成域，作者不对更大预算作声明。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Enriched Holomorphic Neural Networks for 2D and 3D Laplace Problems
papers.abstract_en: Boundary-value problems for the Laplace equation develop singular behaviour near corners, edges and junctions that smooth approximators resolve poorly. We combine holomorphic neural networks with singular functions derived from the local geometry and boundary conditions. The representation is harmonic by construction, so no interior residual is needed: the network fits the smooth remainder from boundary data alone, and the enrichment terms capture the singular behaviour. Singular exponents are trainable, so the construction also applies when the local expansion is not known in advance. We extend the approach to three dimensions using independent networks evaluated along complex null directions. The enriched model is the most accurate tested method on every problem. Its margin is several orders of magnitude where the enrichment captures the singularity exactly, and a factor of about 1.7-2.1 over the next-best method on a CdZnTe radiation detector with many singular sites, in both two and three dimensions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把全纯神经网络 (holomorphic neural networks) 与由局部几何和边界条件导出的奇异函数 (singular functions) 相结合求解 Laplace 边值问题：表示天然调和，无需内部残差，网络只从边界数据拟合光滑余项，奇异项负责角点、棱边和结点处的奇性，且奇异指数可训练。在富集项精确捕捉奇性的问题上精度领先若干个数量级；在含多个奇异位置的 CdZnTe 辐射探测器上，二维和三维均比次优方法好约 1.7–2.1 倍。
Motivation: Laplace 边值问题在角点、棱边和结点附近产生奇性，光滑逼近器难以分辨，导致常规神经求解器精度受限。
Method: 将全纯神经网络与由局部几何和边界条件导出的奇异函数结合；表示按构造调和，因此不需要内部残差，仅用边界数据拟合光滑余项，奇异项显式捕捉奇性，奇异指数设为可训练参数；三维扩展使用沿复零方向 (complex null directions) 求值的独立网络。
Result: 富集模型在所测试的每个问题上都是最准确的方法：当富集项精确捕捉奇性时，领先幅度达若干个数量级；在含多个奇异位置的 CdZnTe 辐射探测器上，二维与三维均比次优方法好约 1.7–2.1 倍。
Conclusion: 把几何导出的奇异函数嵌入调和表示，可以在不引入内部残差的前提下大幅提高角点与棱边附近 Laplace 解的精度，且在奇性位置众多的三维探测器几何上仍保持优势。

papers.title: Efficient Learning of Survival Analysis Models Under Outcome-Dependent Truncation and Censoring
papers.abstract_en: Modern machine learning models are typically trained on data assumed to be representative of the predictive tasks the model will face in the future, but practical datasets violate this assumption. We focus on outcome-dependent truncation in which an observation appears in the training data depending on its label. Our work connects two largely distinct literatures: efficient learning under truncation and survival analysis. Existing methods for truncated survival analysis do not characterize the optimization landscape and instead rely on iterative procedures such as expectation maximization. We address this gap and prove that Cox regression can be efficiently learned under truncated and right-censored data using first-order optimization when the baseline hazard is known (despite nonconvexity). In contrast, when the baseline hazard is learned jointly, we construct identifiable and correctly specified models whose negative log-likelihood contains strict suboptimal local minima. On experiments with four survival datasets, we show that accounting for truncation reduces the prediction bias induced by naive Cox regression and extends to neural networks. We also show orders of magnitude speedups compared to standard expectation maximization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在观测是否进入训练集取决于其标签（outcome-dependent truncation）的截断+右删失数据上，证明已知基线风险 (baseline hazard) 时 Cox 回归可用一阶优化高效学到，尽管目标非凸；而联合学习基线风险时，可构造可识别且正确设定的模型，其负对数似然含严格次优局部极小。四个生存数据集实验显示，建模截断能降低朴素 Cox 回归的预测偏差并可扩展到神经网络，相比标准 EM 有数量级加速。
Motivation: 实际数据集并不对未来任务具代表性：观测是否进入训练集可能取决于标签本身（outcome-dependent truncation）。截断生存分析现有方法不刻画优化 landscape，只能依赖 EM 一类迭代过程，效率与理论都缺位。
Method: 把截断下高效学习与生存分析两个文献连接起来，对截断+右删失下的 Cox 回归做理论分析：已知基线风险时证明一阶优化可高效学习；联合学习基线风险时构造可识别、正确设定但 NLL 含严格次优局部极小的模型。实验在四个生存数据集上比较建模截断与朴素 Cox 回归，并扩展到神经网络。
Result: 在四个生存数据集上，建模截断降低了朴素 Cox 回归引入的预测偏差，方法可扩展到神经网络；相比标准 expectation maximization 有数量级 (orders of magnitude) 加速。理论结果：已知 baseline hazard 时一阶优化可高效学习（尽管非凸）；联合学习时存在严格次优局部极小。
Conclusion: 截断生存分析的非凸性在已知基线风险时不妨碍一阶优化高效学习，而联合估计基线风险会引入严格次优局部极小；实践中应显式建模截断以消除朴素 Cox 的偏差，并可用一阶优化替代 EM。
