papers.title: Market Impact Estimation via Causal Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: When a trader executes a large order, the relevant question is not \emph{what will the price be?} but \emph{what would the price have been had I not traded?} Market impact is thus a causal quantity, yet classical models (Almgren--Chriss, propagators) regress price on flow, which is biased whenever informed flow moves prices through information as well as trading. We present a proof-of-concept \emph{Causal Market Simulator}: a continuous-time causal prior-data fitted network (PFN) trained on a synthetic market prior in which a hidden informational flow confounds the flow--price relation by construction, with confounding strength an exact per-episode knob. On this prior, the naive estimator's bias follows a closed form we confirm empirically (up to 68\% overestimation), while the PFN tracks the unbiased true-parameter oracle at high confounding. Its \emph{do-ablated twin}, the same model with the intervention inputs removed, collapses onto the pre-window mean. Zero-shot, the model responds at the ground-truth scale to metaorders in an ABIDES limit-order book ($+0.38$ pre-onset standard deviations against seed-replay counterfactuals), and its intervention response replicates on about 2,300 detected flow bursts in BTC/ETH/SOL perpetuals and 3,800 on Nasdaq equities, evidence consistent with, though not proof of, causal transfer. Off-prior the response degrades gracefully, and split-conformal recalibration repairs interval calibration. Transfer hinges on encoding the metaorder as added flow rather than a clamped price level, not on more training. A recurrent state-space variant closes the remaining shape gap: its impact accrues over execution duration where the transformer's stays flat, raising the correlation with measured metaorder impact from $+0.68$ to between $+0.92$ and $+0.96$, at the cost of weaker on-prior deconfounding that traces to the training recipe rather than to recurrence.
papers.comment: In 7th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance (ICAIF '26), November 14-17, 2026, Milan, Italy
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出因果市场模拟器 (Causal Market Simulator)：在含隐藏信息流混淆的合成市场先验上训练连续时间 causal prior-data fitted network (PFN)，直接估计「若我没交易价格会怎样」这一反事实市场冲击。合成先验上朴素估计量最高高估 68%，PFN 在高混淆下贴合无偏 oracle；零样本在 ABIDES 订单簿上对 metaorder 给出 +0.38 个 onset 前标准差的响应，并在约 2300 个加密永续与 3800 个 Nasdaq 流爆发上复现。
Motivation: 市场冲击是因果量，但 Almgren–Chriss、propagator 等经典模型把价格对流量回归，当知情流量同时通过信息渠道推动价格时该回归有偏，无法回答交易者真正关心的反事实价格问题。
Method: 在合成市场先验上训练连续时间 PFN，其中隐藏的信息性流量按构造混淆 flow–price 关系，且混淆强度是逐 episode 可精确调节的旋钮；模型带干预输入，配套 do-ablated twin（移除干预输入）作为对照，并提供 recurrent state-space 变体；off-prior 情形用 split-conformal 重校准修复区间覆盖。
Result: 合成先验上朴素估计量偏差有闭式解并经实证确认，最高 68% 高估，PFN 在高混淆下跟踪无偏真参 oracle，do-ablated twin 塌缩到 pre-window 均值；零样本在 ABIDES 限价订单簿上相对 seed-replay 反事实给出 +0.38 个 onset 前标准差的 metaorder 响应，干预响应在约 2300 个 BTC/ETH/SOL 永续流爆发与 3800 个 Nasdaq 股票流爆发上复现；recurrent state-space 变体把与实测 metaorder 冲击的相关性从 +0.68 提到 +0.92 至 +0.96，代价是 on-prior 去混淆变弱。
Conclusion: 迁移的关键在于把 metaorder 编码为新增流量而非钳定价格水平，而非加大训练量；因果迁移的证据与之相符但不构成证明，recurrent 变体的去混淆退化源自训练配方而非循环结构本身。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: EliteTable: Self-Improving Program Search for Executable Control Policies
papers.abstract_en: EliteTable is a self-improving program-search algorithm guided by large language models (LLMs) that uses a fixed-capacity table of high-scoring solutions to guide new proposals, edits of existing solutions, and remixes of several solutions. Performance was evaluated across six Gymnasium control tasks, each with ten generations and fifty candidate slots per generation. Each task was evaluated across ten independently initialized searches. Candidate-score medians rose between the first and final generations in all six tasks, and selected-winner search-score medians rose in five. In CartPole-v1, the selected winner reached the search-score ceiling in the first generation of all ten searches. All ten paired held-out endpoints improved in four of the six tasks. BipedalWalker-v3 and CarRacing-v3 improved without reaching their reporting targets. Six of ten Acrobot-v1 searches declined on held-out episodes, and the median paired change was negative. The results document improvement during program search and the transfer of selected-winner gains to new episodes in some tasks. Comparisons and ablations are needed to establish EliteTable's relative performance and the contributions of its components.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EliteTable 是由 LLM 引导的自改进程序搜索算法，用固定容量的高分解表 (fixed-capacity elite table) 驱动新提案、对现有解的编辑与多解混合 (remix)。在六个 Gymnasium 控制任务上，六项任务的候选分数中位数从第一代到末代均上升，五项任务的获胜者搜索分数中位数上升；但迁移不稳：六项任务中四项的留出回合配对端点全部改善，Acrobot-v1 十次搜索中有六次在留出回合上退化且配对变化中位数为负。
Motivation: LLM 引导的程序搜索在控制策略上缺少跨任务、跨回合的可迁移性证据：搜索期内的分数提升未必迁移到新回合，且各任务表现可能分化。
Method: 维护固定容量的高分解表，由 LLM 据此生成新候选、编辑已有解并混合多个解；在六个 Gymnasium 任务上每个跑十代、每代五十个候选槽位，每个任务用十次独立初始化的搜索评估，比较第一代与末代的候选分数中位数、获胜者搜索分数中位数以及留出回合上的配对端点变化。
Result: 六个任务的候选分数中位数第一代到末代全部上升，五个任务的获胜者搜索分数中位数上升；CartPole-v1 中获胜者在全部十次搜索的第一代即达搜索分数上限；六项任务中四项的十对留出端点全部改善；BipedalWalker-v3 与 CarRacing-v3 改善但未达报告目标；Acrobot-v1 十次搜索中六次在留出回合上退化，配对变化中位数为负。
Conclusion: 程序搜索期内确有提升且在部分任务上迁移到新回合，但迁移因任务而异并可能反向；作者明确指出需要对比实验与消融来确立 EliteTable 的相对性能和各组件贡献。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Structural and Representational Agency in LLM-Driven Timbre Generation and Interpolation
papers.abstract_en: Generative creative interfaces routinely report the user's position within a space of possibilities. Such displays imply that the quantities shown were measured from the artefact; in a growing class of systems they are instead predicted by a language model describing its own output, and the two are indistinguishable on screen. Most creative domains lack an agreed measurement against which such a self-report can be checked; audio admits one. In a measurement study of a working LLM-driven timbre interface, what a user can cause proves separable from what the interface reports. The first is exactly characterisable: the reachable set is a zonotope whose dimension increases by one per sound placed, so the space the model may act within is demonstrably the user's own. The second is inaccurate. The displayed position differs from measurement by approximately three times the width of that region, and the error has two independent sources: model-predicted coordinates, whose accuracy varies twofold between the two models evaluated, and the interpolation step, which arises from combining synthesiser parameters and is unaffected by model quality. End to end, 26 of 36 refinement instructions produced no perceptible change, and under the weaker model the facility performed no action while reporting convergence. Effective agency (what a user can cause) and epistemic agency (whether they can know it) are therefore separable and independently engineered: structurally enforced constraints survive model failure, whereas guarantees resting on the model's own report do not. The failure mode that remains is silence presented as success. We close with a short protocol for building and auditing such displays.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Main Conference, Creative AI Track)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于 LLM 驱动音色 (timbre) 生成界面的测量研究：用户能造成什么 (effective agency) 与界面报告什么 (epistemic agency) 可分离。可达集是 zonotope，每放置一个声音维度加一，结构上由用户掌控；但显示位置与实测偏差约为该区域宽度的三倍，36 条细化指令中 26 条无可感知变化，弱模型下系统无动作却报告已收敛。
Motivation: 生成式创意界面常把语言模型对自身输出的预测当作实测结果展示，两者在屏幕上无法区分；多数创意领域缺少可核对的测量标准，而音频恰好提供了一个。
Method: 在一个可运行的 LLM 驱动音色界面上做测量研究：把用户可达集刻画为 zonotope（每放置一个声音维度加一），将显示坐标与合成器实测结果对比，并把误差拆成模型预测坐标与插值两部分，评估两个模型。
Result: 显示位置与实测偏差约为该区域宽度的三倍；两个被评估模型的坐标精度相差两倍；插值误差源于合成器参数组合，与模型质量无关；端到端 36 条细化指令中 26 条无可感知变化；弱模型下系统未执行任何动作却报告收敛。
Conclusion: 结构性约束在模型失效时依然成立，而依赖模型自报告的保证不成立；剩余的失败模式是把沉默呈现为成功，作者给出构建与审计此类显示的简短协议。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: CacheScope: Exact-Compute Allocation for Training-Free Diffusion Acceleration
papers.abstract_en: Training-free feature reuse accelerates diffusion transformer inference by replacing full denoising computation at selected steps with cached approximations. Existing methods mainly improve the reconstruction of skipped features, but we find that once a stable first-order reconstructor is used, increasing reconstruction complexity brings limited gains, whereas the placement of exact-computation steps has a much larger effect on fidelity. More importantly, absolute shallow-probe variation is jointly affected by input-trajectory displacement and network response strength, and therefore does not directly reflect cache risk. We address this confounding by normalizing probe-output variation with the corresponding input displacement, yielding a directional gain per unit trajectory movement. Based on this signal, we propose CacheScope, which identifies high-risk reuse steps online and selectively falls back to full denoising computation while leaving the underlying cache reconstructor unchanged. CacheScope requires no additional training, gradients, auxiliary networks, or prompt-specific offline schedule optimization. Across FLUX.1-dev, Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, and Open-Sora 1.2, CacheScope achieves up to 3.57x acceleration and reduces median LPIPS by up to 70.1% over the strongest probe-based baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CacheScope 用「探头输出变化量除以输入轨迹位移」得到单位位移的方向性增益，线上识别缓存复用的高风险步并回退到完整去噪计算，缓存重建器本身不动。在 FLUX.1-dev、Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B、Open-Sora 1.2 上最高 3.57x 加速，中位 LPIPS 相对最强探头基线最多降低 70.1%。
Motivation: 训练无关的特征复用加速里，重建器复杂度提升收益有限，而绝对浅探头变化同时受输入位移与网络响应强度影响，不能直接反映缓存风险，导致精确计算步的放置缺乏可靠信号。
Method: 先固定一个稳定的一阶重建器，再把探头输出变化按对应输入位移归一化为单位轨迹移动的方向性增益；CacheScope 据此线上定位高风险复用步、选择性回退完整去噪，无需训练、梯度、辅助网络或按 prompt 的离线调度优化。
Result: 在 FLUX.1-dev、Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B、Open-Sora 1.2 上最高 3.57x 加速，中位 LPIPS 相比最强探头基线最多降低 70.1%；同时发现一旦使用稳定的一阶重建器，提高重建复杂度收益有限，而精确计算步的放置对保真度影响大得多。
Conclusion: 缓存风险应由归一化的方向性增益而非绝对探头变化判定，据此只调度精确计算步的位置就能在不改重建器的前提下同时拿到加速与保真度。

papers.title: GlucoPRISM: Protocol-Supervised Pretraining for Cross-Cohort Glucose Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) foundation models encode each day as one vector that mixes who the person is, what happened that day and how the sensor measured it, so measurement differences travel with the representation into new cohorts. We ask whether pretraining can place the measurement component that harms transfer in known coordinates, so that deployment drops them with a fixed projection and no target data. GlucoPRISM supervises a GlucoFM backbone with response contracts, rules for how each part of the representation should change when only the day or only the sensor changes: a 64-dimensional Trait band should change with neither, a 48-dimensional State band only across days, and a 16-dimensional Sensor band should track the device. Synthetic sensor views calibrated on paired Dexcom and Libre recordings, different-day pairs and glucose-summary targets supply this supervision without clinical labels. Across twelve cross-cohort directions, dropping the Sensor band from the same frozen encoder raises mean transfer AUROC from 68.75 to 73.57, against 69.3 for GlucoFM. The gain has two parts. Into CGMacros, the one target cohort recorded with two sensor types, filtering adds 11 to 19 points, and this holds when the generator is recalibrated on half of the participants and scored on the other half. On the other eight directions filtering is neutral and the encoder itself exceeds GlucoFM by 3.5 points. The device remains linearly decodable after filtering, so the filter removes a device-related component that harms transfer rather than all measurement information. The retained bands improve window AUROC on thirteen of fourteen public task--cohort cells (Holm-adjusted p=0.031) and correlation on fourteen of fifteen clinical endpoints in an external cohort of 9,303 participants.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GlucoPRISM 用响应契约 (response contracts) 监督 GlucoFM 预训练，把表征拆成 64 维 Trait、48 维 State、16 维 Sensor 三个频带，部署时用固定投影丢掉 Sensor 频带即可跨队列迁移，无需目标数据。在 12 个跨队列方向上，丢弃 Sensor 频带使平均迁移 AUROC 从 68.75 升到 73.57，高于 GlucoFM 的 69.3。
Motivation: CGM 基础模型把「这个人是谁」「当天发生了什么」「传感器怎么测」混进同一个日向量，测量差异随表征带进新队列，跨队列部署需要目标数据才能校正。
Method: 以 GlucoFM 为骨干，用响应契约约束各频带：Trait 频带在只换日或只换传感器时都不变，State 频带只跨日变化，Sensor 频带跟踪设备。监督信号来自在配对 Dexcom 与 Libre 记录上校准的合成传感器视图、不同日配对和血糖摘要目标，无需临床标签。
Result: 12 个跨队列方向上，同一冻结编码器丢弃 Sensor 频带使平均迁移 AUROC 从 68.75 升至 73.57，GlucoFM 为 69.3。在唯一用两种传感器记录的目标队列 CGMacros 上，过滤带来 11 到 19 个点的提升，且在一半被试上重校准生成器、另一半被试上打分时仍成立；其余 8 个方向过滤为中性，编码器本身超出 GlucoFM 3.5 个点。过滤后设备仍可被线性解码。保留频带在 14 个公开任务-队列格中的 13 个上提升窗口 AUROC（Holm 校正 p=0.031），并在 9,303 人外部队列的 15 个临床终点中的 14 个上提升相关性。
Conclusion: 把伤害迁移的测量成分放进已知坐标并用固定投影丢弃，可以在无目标数据的条件下提升跨队列迁移；过滤移除的是伤害迁移的设备相关成分，而非全部测量信息。

papers.title: Behind-the-Meter Photovoltaic Visibility from Net Smart Meters: Deployment Regimes and Operational Insights
papers.abstract_en: Distribution operators need visibility of behind-the-meter photovoltaic (PV) generation, yet most residential customers are observed only through net smart meters. Deep-learning-based PV disaggregation can restore this visibility, but its operational value depends on whether the model serves known customers, new customers, future periods, or new regions. We quantify this dependence using four deployment regimes that separate household transfer from temporal extrapolation, applied to Ausgrid smart-meter data with cross-dataset adaptation to the Pecan Street data. Using a fixed training protocol, we benchmark representative deep sequence architectures for PV disaggregation under regime-matched evaluation. At a fixed 48-hour context length, daylight mean absolute error (MAE) of the best model rises from 0.104~kW on seen households in the future test period to 0.185~kW on unseen households over the same period, and under a fixed training contract the deployment regime explains far more of the error variation than model choice. Under target-domain normalization, fine-tuning on five target-region households reduces source-model transfer error by 28\%--36\%. Long input windows help known-customer extrapolation, while their new-customer benefits vary by model. These findings suggest regime-matched error budgets, limited target supervision for model adaptation in new regions, and use-case-dependent context selection for energy data analytics.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Accepted at the 10th IEEE Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (IEEE EI2 2026). IEEE Xplore publication pending
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用净智能电表做表后光伏出力分解时，部署场景比模型选型更决定误差：固定 48 小时上下文，最佳模型在已知用户未来时段的日间 MAE 为 0.104 kW，换到同期未见用户升到 0.185 kW，且部署场景解释的误差方差远大于模型差异。在目标域归一化下，仅用 5 个目标区域用户微调即可把源模型迁移误差降低 28%–36%。作者主张按场景给误差预算、在新区域用少量目标监督做适配、并按用例选上下文长度。
Motivation: 配电商需要表后 (behind-the-meter) 光伏出力可见性，但居民用户只以净电表读数被观测；深度学习分解能否迁移取决于服务对象是已知用户、新用户、未来时段还是新区域，这一区分此前未被量化。
Method: 提出四种部署场景 (deployment regimes)，把用户迁移与时间外推解耦；在 Ausgrid 智能电表数据上以固定训练协议对代表性深度序列架构做场景匹配评测，并向 Pecan Street 数据做跨数据集适配，输入上下文固定为 48 小时。
Result: 固定 48 小时上下文下，最佳模型日间 MAE 从已知用户未来时段的 0.104 kW 升到同期未见用户的 0.185 kW；固定训练契约下部署场景解释的误差方差远多于模型选择；目标域归一化加 5 个目标区域用户微调使源模型迁移误差降低 28%–36%；长输入窗口利于已知用户外推，而对新用户的收益因模型而异。
Conclusion: 表后光伏分解的误差预算必须按部署场景分别给出，新区域靠少量目标监督适配，上下文长度按用例选择而非统一设定。

papers.title: MolP2SBench: Do LLMs Really Reason from Molecular Properties to Structure?
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in molecular discovery and structure elucidation, where decisions depend on physical observations. Existing evaluations primarily focus on end-to-end molecular reconstruction, where correct predictions do not necessarily indicate reliance on the supplied properties. We introduce MolP2SBench, a benchmark for molecular property-to-structure (P2S) reasoning in LLMs. Each task presents a masked molecular scaffold with given properties and asks the model to select the missing structure from plausible candidates. We shuffle or replace properties to test reliance on correct property-structure pairing and responsiveness to counterfactual property changes. A channel-wise leaderboard uses Property-Grounded Recovery (PGR), giving equal weight to source and counterfactual recovery. Evaluating seven models, we find that LLMs can use physical properties for structure prediction, but performance varies substantially across property types. Higher accuracy with a property does not necessarily imply greater responsiveness to it: a model may benefit more from $^1$H NMR than from $^{13}$C NMR, yet be less likely to change its prediction when the $^1$H data is replaced. LLM performance also need not reflect the relative difficulty of these properties for human chemists. Although UV-Vis spectra provide less direct structural information than NMR spectra, Astra achieves higher accuracy with UV-Vis data than with NMR peaks. MolP2SBench supports studying how LLMs extract and use physical-property information, revealing patterns that may differ from conventional chemical intuition and providing a foundation for more reliably property-grounded models for molecular and quantum-chemical inference. Code and dataset: https://github.com/DUAL-Xiao/MolP2SBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MolP2SBench 用掩码分子骨架 + 给定性质让 LLM 从候选中选出缺失结构，并通过打乱/替换性质检验模型是否真正依赖性质-结构配对。评测七个模型发现 LLM 确实能用物理性质做结构预测，但准确率与对性质的响应度并不一致：Astra 用 UV-Vis 的准确率反而高于 NMR 峰，且高准确率不等于替换该性质时会改变预测。
Motivation: 现有分子评测只看端到端重建是否正确，无法判断预测是否真的依赖给定性质；而性质到结构的推理可靠性直接关系到分子发现与结构解析中基于物理观测的决策。
Method: 提出分子性质到结构 (property-to-structure, P2S) 基准：每个任务给出掩码分子骨架与性质，让模型从合理候选中选出缺失结构；通过打乱或替换性质构造反事实，检验对正确配对的依赖与对性质变化的响应；用等权源性质与反事实恢复的 Property-Grounded Recovery (PGR) 做分通道排行榜，评测七个模型。
Result: 七个模型上 LLM 能利用物理性质做结构预测，但不同性质类型间表现差异显著；准确率高不代表响应度高（如模型从 1H NMR 获益可能多于 13C NMR，却在 1H 数据被替换时更少改变预测）；LLM 表现也不必对应人类化学家的难度排序——UV-Vis 谱提供的结构信息少于 NMR，但 Astra 用 UV-Vis 的准确率高于用 NMR 峰。
Conclusion: LLM 对物理性质的利用模式可能偏离传统化学直觉，仅凭端到端准确率无法判定模型是否真正 grounded 在性质上；PGR 这类配对与反事实评测是通向更可靠性质驱动的分子与量子化学推理的基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Workhorse: Learning Robust Whole-Body Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from Human Data
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid robots still struggle to plan contact-rich whole-body manipulation from egocentric RGB and proprioception. Workhorse learns such manipulation from robot-free human demonstrations. A visual planner predicts five-link targets: the poses of the torso, both wrists, and both feet. A reinforcement-learning whole-body tracker follows them on the robot. Both policies train separately on the same recorded human poses, without retargeting. We augment the training data of each policy to imitate the errors that the other makes at deployment. On a real Unitree G1, Workhorse transport boxes with its hands and a kick, catches a thrown box, and topples and climbs a suitcase. During box transport, we show recoveries after a person pushes the robot or takes the box away. In a simulated copy of the demonstration room, the system completes box transport in 77% of episodes, and in 64% under 40 N.s pushes. With both policies retrained from the same demonstrations, a simulated second humanoid completes box transport in 83% of episodes without pushes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Workhorse 从无人体到机器人的重定向 (retargeting) 的纯人类演示中学习全身操作：视觉规划器预测躯干、双腕、双足共五个连杆目标，强化学习全身跟踪器在机器人上跟随，两者用同一份人类姿态数据分别训练，并互相注入对方在部署时会犯的误差做数据增强。在 Unitree G1 实机上完成搬箱、踢、接抛来的箱子、推倒并爬上行李箱；仿真中搬箱成功率 77%，在 40 N.s 推挤下 64%，同一演示重训后第二个仿真人形无推挤时 83%。
Motivation: 人形机器人难以从第一人称 RGB 与本体感觉规划接触密集的全身操作，且通常依赖昂贵的机器人演示与重定向流程。
Method: 视觉规划器从 egocentric RGB 预测五连杆目标（躯干、双腕、双足位姿），强化学习全身跟踪器在机器人上跟随；两策略在同一份录制人类姿态上分别训练、不做 retargeting，并各自增强训练数据以模仿对方在部署时产生的误差。

papers.title: Work While They Sleep: Exploiting Evaluation Latency for Fully Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Black-box optimization problems are ubiquitous across science and engineering, often dealing with expensive objective functions. This objective latency has two consequences during optimization: (i) the objective evaluation dominates execution time, and (ii) sample-efficient algorithms are crucial to accelerate development and avoid wasting resources. Bayesian optimization (BO) methods are the \textit{de facto} choice of planners for suggesting the next point to try. Standard BO fits the surrogate model's hyperparameters with a point estimate. Alternatively, a fully Bayesian approach uses model averaging to account for uncertainty over the hyperparameters, leading to better uncertainty estimates---useful in the low-data regime that is pervasive in BO. However, it is often prohibitively expensive and thus rarely used. In this work, we propose ELF-BO, an algorithm that uses the objective evaluation latency to headstart the computation of the next suggestion, allowing for fully Bayesian optimization without incurring substantial decision-time costs. This is done by sampling from the hyperparameter posterior \emph{while} the objective is being evaluated, only requiring reweighting of the samples once the objective value is observed. Across synthetic functions and real-world applications, we show that ELF-BO matches the performance of fully Bayesian methods while only incurring decision latency on par with or better than standard BO. Thus, ELF-BO makes fully Bayesian optimization practical in real-world use cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ELF-BO 利用目标函数评估本身的延迟，在评估进行的同时从超参数后验采样，观测到目标值后仅对样本做一次重加权，从而在不增加决策时间的前提下实现 fully Bayesian 优化。在合成函数与真实应用上，它达到 fully Bayesian 方法的性能，而决策延迟与标准 BO 持平或更好。
Motivation: 标准 BO 用点估计拟合超参数，不确定性刻画不足；fully Bayesian 的模型平均在低数据下更准，但计算太贵而很少被用，原因是决策时间难以承受。
Method: ELF-BO 在目标函数被评估的空档期从超参数后验采样，等目标值返回后对已有样本做重加权，把采样开销藏进 objective evaluation latency，从而避免额外决策成本。
Result: 在合成函数与真实应用场景中，ELF-BO 的性能与 fully Bayesian 方法相当，而决策延迟与标准 BO 持平或更低。
Conclusion: 目标评估延迟可以被用来摊掉后验采样开销，使 fully Bayesian 优化在真实场景中变得实用。

papers.title: Explicit Asymptotic Bounds for Sequential Calibration Beyond $T^{2/3}$
papers.abstract_en: Probability forecasts are calibrated when predicted probabilities match empirical outcome frequencies: among events assigned a probability $p$, we'd hope that the fraction of positive outcomes is close to $p$. We study the problem of sequential forecasting of binary outcomes. The classical $O(T^{2/3})$ bound on expected cumulative $\ell_1$-calibration error established by Foster and Vohra stood for over two decades until Dagan et al. reduced the exponent $2/3$ by an unspecified constant. We establish a new two-phase recursive labeling strategy for the sign-preservation-with-reuse game that yields the bound $O(n^αt^β)$ for all choices of space and time. We then sharpen the reduction from upper bounds on sign preservation to calibration by modifying the equivalence of Dagan et al. to use only $O(\log T)$ instances of the sign-preservation-with-reuse game. This lets us establish an explicit bound of $O(T^{0.662942288})$, the first explicit exponent below $2/3$ for sequential calibration, by combining both improvements and choosing explicit feasible parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对二元结果的序贯概率预报校准，提出 sign-preservation-with-reuse 博弈的两阶段递归标注策略，得到对任意空间与时间选择都成立的 $O(n^αt^β)$ 界；再把 Dagan et al. 的归约改为只需 $O(\log T)$ 个博弈实例，最终给出显式指数 $O(T^{0.662942288})$，是首个低于 $2/3$ 的显式序贯校准指数。
Motivation: Foster–Vohra 的期望累积 $\ell_1$-校准误差 $O(T^{2/3})$ 界保持了二十多年，Dagan et al. 虽把 $2/3$ 的指数降低但常数未指定，缺少可直接使用的显式指数。
Method: 为 sign-preservation-with-reuse 博弈设计两阶段递归标注策略，导出 $O(n^αt^β)$ 界；随后修改 Dagan et al. 的符号保持到校准的等价归约，使其仅用 $O(\log T)$ 个该博弈实例，并选取显式可行参数合并两项改进。
Result: 得到显式界 $O(T^{0.662942288})$，为序贯校准首个低于 $2/3$ 的显式指数；博弈侧界为 $O(n^αt^β)$，归约仅需 $O(\log T)$ 个实例，对照的是 Foster–Vohra 的 $O(T^{2/3})$ 与 Dagan et al. 的非显式降指数结果。
Conclusion: 两阶段标注与对数实例数归约结合，可以把序贯校准的 $2/3$ 指数推进为一个显式可写的更小指数 $0.662942288$。

papers.title: BiGym 2.0: Benchmarking Learned and Agent-Developed Policies for Humanoid Household Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid household manipulation requires the arms to act while the body balances, steps and changes posture. We present BiGym 2.0, an adaptation of BiGym for the Unitree G1 across 20 household tasks using a unified whole-body controller for demonstration and evaluation. The suite provides 60 native human virtual-reality demonstrations per task with synchronised multi-camera views and full-body execution records. We benchmark vision-language-action fine-tuning, imitation learning, demo-driven reinforcement learning, and cold-start coding agents given the interaction budget of online reinforcement learning. With the same onboard views, proprioception and whole-body controller for every method, vision-language-action fine-tuning has the highest nine-task mean, and agent-developed programs outperform every demo-driven reinforcement learning baseline on this mean and lead on bimanual reaching. Cross-workspace stacking remains open, $π_{0.5}$ stays low on pick-box, and multi-object transport is hard for imitation learning, demo-driven reinforcement learning and coding agents. All environments, human demonstrations, and evaluation traces are open-sourced at https://github.com/swirl-uk/BiGym2.
papers.comment: 23 pages. Updated the demonstration image in Figure 5, clarified observation interfaces, and improved HTML rendering of figures, author layout and code listings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BiGym 2.0 把 BiGym 改造成面向 Unitree G1 人形机器人的全身操作基准：20 个家庭任务，统一的全身控制器用于演示与评测，每任务 60 条真人 VR 演示（含同步多相机视角与全身执行记录）。在相同机载视角、本体感知与控制器下对比 VLA 微调、模仿学习、演示驱动 RL 与冷启动 coding agent：VLA 微调九任务均值最高，agent 开发的程序在该均值上超过所有演示驱动 RL 基线并在双臂抓取上领先；跨工作区堆叠、pick-box 上的 π0.5、多物体搬运对各方法仍然困难。
Motivation: 人形机器人家庭操作要求手臂作业同时保持平衡、迈步与变姿态，现有基准缺少在统一全身控制下公平比较学习型策略与 agent 自主开发策略的平台。
Method: 以 BiGym 为基础适配 Unitree G1，20 个家庭任务共用一个全身控制器；提供每任务 60 条真人 VR 演示（同步多相机与全身执行记录）；在相同机载视角、本体感知与控制器条件下评测 VLA 微调、模仿学习、演示驱动 RL，以及在在线 RL 交互预算下的冷启动 coding agent。
Result: VLA 微调取得九任务均值最高；agent 开发的程序在该均值上超过每一个演示驱动 RL 基线，并在双臂抓取 (bimanual reaching) 上领先；跨工作区堆叠 (cross-workspace stacking) 仍未解决，π0.5 在 pick-box 上得分仍低，多物体搬运 (multi-object transport) 对模仿学习、演示驱动 RL 与 coding agent 都困难。
Conclusion: 在统一全身控制与相同观测条件下，VLA 微调是九任务均值最强的路线，而 agent 自主开发的程序已能超过演示驱动 RL；跨工作区堆叠与多物体搬运是公认开放难题。全部环境、人类演示与评测轨迹已在 GitHub 开源。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Protective Perturbations Must Survive the Resize: Scale-Robust Image Immunization against Malicious Editing
papers.abstract_en: While instruction-guided editors built on diffusion transformers can turn a personal photo into a convincing forgery with a single sentence, protective perturbations aim to make such edits fail before the photo is ever shared. The threat is most acute for the photos people actually share, which have 10 megapixels or more and which current editors first downscale by a factor that the owner does not know. Existing protections are computed at one resolution or averaged over random scales, and they lose most of their effect once the photo is downscaled. They implicitly assume that the editor sees the scale for which they were optimized, or that protecting the average scale protects every scale. We propose SRIM, a protection that remains effective at every scale an editor may use, without knowing its preprocessing and at the same computational cost as standard expectation over transformation. SRIM covers the range of scales implied by the photo size with anchor scales and spends each optimization step on the scale where the protection is currently weakest. A spectral analysis shows that this worst-case protection degrades only logarithmically with the width of the range, a value that averaging over scales cannot reach. Extensive experiments on full-resolution photos and popular instruction-guided editors validate that SRIM gives the strongest protection, outperforming existing methods even with a quarter of their $\ell_\infty$ budget, remaining the strongest under input purification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SRIM 针对指令引导扩散编辑器先按未知比例缩小图片的威胁，用 anchor scales 覆盖照片尺寸隐含的整个缩放范围，并把每步优化花在当前最弱的那个尺度上，使保护扰动在任意缩放后仍存活。谱分析表明最坏尺度上的保护强度只随范围宽度对数衰减，这是对各尺度取平均达不到的；在全分辨率照片与主流编辑器上，SRIM 即使只用现有方法四分之一的 ℓ∞ 预算仍最强，且在输入净化下保持最强。
Motivation: 10MP 以上的分享照片会被编辑器按所有者不知的比例下采样，现有保护只在单一分辨率或随机尺度平均上计算，一旦缩小就大部分失效，隐含假设编辑器看到的正是优化时的尺度。
Method: SRIM 以照片尺寸隐含的尺度范围布置 anchor scales，每个优化步骤把算力集中在当前保护最弱的尺度上（最坏情况优化），计算成本与标准 expectation over transformation 相同；并给出保护强度随范围宽度的谱分析。
Result: 谱分析显示最坏尺度保护只随尺度范围宽度对数退化，优于对尺度取平均所能达到的水平；在全分辨率照片与流行指令引导编辑器上，SRIM 用现有方法四分之一的 ℓ∞ 预算仍取得最强保护，并在输入净化 (input purification) 下保持最强。
Conclusion: 跨尺度保护必须按最坏尺度而非平均尺度优化：只要覆盖照片尺寸对应的尺度范围，就能在不知道编辑器预处理的情况下让扰动在缩放后存活。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: KineWorld: Action-Induced Transport Fields for Embodied World Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Embodied world models predict the visual consequences of candidate actions before execution. However, existing action-conditioned world models often adopt uniformly weighted visual generation objectives that can be misaligned with embodied prediction needs. Even with explicit motion conditioning, these objectives can underemphasize spatially sparse changes that are critical to interaction. We propose KineWorld, a transport-aware world-modeling framework that extends robot kinematics from motion conditioning to the spatial allocation of generative supervision. Kinematic Transport Lifting (KTL) constructs renderer-derived, camera-aligned transport fields from commanded robot motion. Transport-Aware World Diffusion (TAWD) calibrates their motion support on the video-latent grid and reweights future-RGB flow matching through a normalized mixture of uniform and transport-focused distributions. We train KineWorld using ALOHA-AgileX bimanual manipulation data from RoboTwin 2.0. KineWorld achieves an EWMScore-P of 68.95 in single-view evaluation and a TWB-Score of 54.82 in multi-view evaluation. These results support a shift from appearance fitting toward action-consequence modeling for embodied decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: GOTT: Object-centric Dexterous Manipulation with a Reusable Cross-Embodiment Primitive
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models and large-scale human data provide rich sources of manipulation intent, but translating this intent into multi-fingered robot behavior remains difficult. Dexterous hands still lack a reusable low-level primitive that reliably establishes contact across tasks and embodiments. We propose GOTT, a reach-acquire-move framework built around a single cross-embodiment contact-acquisition primitive. Given a robot-agnostic object trajectory and a reach specification, GOTT first brings the hand near a task-relevant contact region. The shared closed-loop primitive then establishes stable contact from this approximate initialization, and a pose-conditioned controller tracks the desired object motion. Reach specifications may come from future-aware planning, external models, or human demonstrations, while the primitive and tracking backend remain unchanged. Simulation and real-world experiments show that GOTT is able to establish robust contact across diverse objects, arm-hand platforms, and seen and unseen hand morphologies. It also consistently improves end-to-end task success over open-loop grasp execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GOTT 提出 reach-acquire-move 框架，核心是一个跨具身 (cross-embodiment) 的接触获取原语：给定机器人无关的物体轨迹与 reach 规格，先把手移到任务相关接触区域附近，再由共享的闭环原语从该近似初值建立稳定接触，最后用位姿条件控制器跟踪物体运动。仿真与真实实验显示它能在多样物体、多种臂-手平台以及已见与未见手形态上稳健建立接触，并一致提升端到端任务成功率（相对开环抓取执行）。
Motivation: 基础模型与大规模人类数据富含操作意图，但把意图转成多指机器人行为仍然困难；灵巧手缺少一个能跨任务、跨具身可靠建立接触的可复用低层原语。
Method: GOTT 分三段：reach 阶段把手带到任务相关接触区域；共享的闭环接触获取原语从近似初始化建立稳定接触；位姿条件控制器跟踪期望物体运动。reach 规格可来自 future-aware planning、外部模型或人类演示，而原语与跟踪后端保持不变。
Result: 仿真与真实实验中，GOTT 在多样物体、多种臂-手平台、已见与未见手形态上均能稳健建立接触，并在端到端任务成功率上一致优于开环抓取执行 (open-loop grasp execution)。
Conclusion: 把接触获取做成单一跨具身闭环原语、与上层意图来源解耦，可在不同手形态和平台上复用并稳定提升操作成功率。

papers.title: Spatial Memory Intelligence: Endowing World Models with Understanding-Driven Long-Term Memory
papers.abstract_en: Long-video generation and world models have shown strong potential for interactive entertainment and embodied simulation by predicting future observations conditioned on user actions and historical memory. However, as memory sequences grow longer and their structures become increasingly complex, managing long-range spatial context becomes increasingly challenging, calling for a more intelligent and systematic memory-management strategy. Building on the advancing spatial reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and the broader vision of unified models, we propose Spatial Memory Intelligence (SMI), the first framework to systematically employ an understanding model for spatial-memory management in long-video world models. SMI introduces four coordinated atomic operations: spatial clustering, within-cluster sparsification, action-aware retrieval, and reliability-aware filtering. Extensive experiments across multiple baselines, benchmarks, and world-model backbones demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of SMI, achieving comprehensive improvements in memory sparsity, generation stability, and spatial consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SMI 用多模态大模型 (MLLM) 作为理解器来管理长视频世界模型的空间记忆，提出四个协同原子操作：空间聚类、簇内稀疏化、动作感知检索 (action-aware retrieval) 与可靠性感知过滤。在多个基线、benchmark 与世界模型 backbone 上实验，记忆稀疏性、生成稳定性与空间一致性均获得综合提升。
Motivation: 长视频生成与世界模型中，记忆序列变长、结构变复杂后，长程空间上下文难以管理，需要更智能、系统化的记忆管理策略。
Method: 提出 Spatial Memory Intelligence (SMI)，首个用理解模型系统化管理长视频世界模型空间记忆的框架；包含四个原子操作——空间聚类、簇内稀疏化、动作感知检索、可靠性感知过滤，依托 MLLM 的空间推理能力与统一模型愿景。
Result: 在多个基线、多个 benchmark 与多种世界模型 backbone 上实验，SMI 在记忆稀疏性、生成稳定性与空间一致性三方面均取得综合改进。
Conclusion: 把空间记忆管理交给理解模型并按四个原子操作分工，可在长视频世界模型中同时改善记忆压缩与生成的时空一致性，且跨 backbone 具有泛化性。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Selection-Based Structured Reasoning: Toward Efficient Multimodal Search Agents
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal agents commonly generate free-form reasoning before each action. For small models, limited model capacity can result in lengthy reasoning that provides little useful guidance for action generation while incurring substantial inference cost. To address this challenge, we introduce Selection-based Structured Reasoning (SSR), a framework that reformulates reasoning as selection instead of open-ended generation. SSR represents recurring high-level reasoning as pre-specified, reusable natural-language candidates. At each turn, the model selects from these reasoning candidates based on their likelihoods given the current context, without requiring an auxiliary task head. Using pre-specified reasoning traces enables parallel scoring, where teacher-forced prefilling computes token likelihoods concurrently within and across candidates using a shared context KV cache. We evaluate SSR on seven multimodal search benchmarks using 2B and 4B models. Across multiple reinforcement learning objectives and supervised fine-tuning, SSR delivers significant efficiency gains without sacrificing task performance. SSR achieves an average success rate competitive with leading search agents of the same scale, while reducing per-turn reasoning latency by over 90% and total per-question model inference latency by 28-54%. Project page: https://zfy0314.github.io/ssr-webpage/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SSR 把多模态搜索 agent 的自由生成式推理改造成从预置可复用自然语言候选中做选择，用共享 KV cache 的 teacher-forced prefilling 并行打分，无需额外任务头。在七个多模态搜索 benchmark 上用 2B/4B 模型，配合多种 RL 目标与 SFT，平均成功率与同规模领先 search agent 相当，单轮推理延迟降低 90% 以上，每题总推理延迟降低 28–54%。
Motivation: 小模型容量有限，自由形式的长推理对动作生成帮助不大却带来可观推理开销，多模态搜索 agent 需要在不掉任务性能的前提下压低延迟。
Method: SSR 将高层推理表示为预置、可复用的自然语言候选，每轮按当前上下文下的候选似然做选择，不引入辅助任务头；候选间与候选内用共享上下文 KV cache 并行 teacher-forced prefilling 计算 token 似然，训练覆盖多种强化学习目标与监督微调。
Result: 在七个多模态搜索 benchmark、2B 与 4B 模型上，SSR 平均成功率与同规模领先 search agent 相当，单轮推理延迟降低超过 90%，每题总模型推理延迟降低 28–54%。
Conclusion: 把推理从开放生成改为结构化选择，可以在小模型多模态搜索 agent 上大幅削减推理延迟而不牺牲任务表现。

papers.title: FlowSGS: Improving Flow Priors for Inverse Imaging with Stochastic Interpolants
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching has emerged as the state-of-the-art generative model and has been used for plug-and-play (PnP) priors to solve inverse problems in computational imaging. However, existing flow-based inverse solvers make simplifying approximations in posterior sampling and/or assume linear forward models. In contrast, principled diffusion-based methods exist but are computationally expensive. To circumvent these problems, we introduce FlowSGS, a flow-based posterior sampling method using Split Gibbs Sampling (SGS) with annealed coupling, and make flow-specific interventions to the prior sampling and annealing steps, theoretically grounded in the Stochastic Interpolants (SI) framework. Using a novel timestep correction and accelerated warm-up with one-step flow models, our method is faster and more accurate than the state of the art across a range of imaging problems. We demonstrate the first use of flow-based samplers for a nonlinear inverse problem (Fourier phase retrieval) and apply one-step flow models to principled Bayesian inverse imaging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlowSGS 把 Split Gibbs Sampling (SGS) 与退火耦合 (annealed coupling) 接到 flow prior 上做后验采样，并针对 prior 采样与退火步给出由 Stochastic Interpolants (SI) 框架支撑的 flow 专属干预，包括 timestep correction 和用 one-step flow model 的加速 warm-up。作者称该方法在一系列成像逆问题上比现有 SOTA 更快更准确，并首次把 flow-based sampler 用于非线性逆问题（Fourier phase retrieval）。
Motivation: 现有 flow-based 逆问题求解器在后验采样中做简化近似、且多假设线性前向模型；原则上更严谨的 diffusion 方法又计算代价过高。
Method: FlowSGS：以 Split Gibbs Sampling 结合 annealed coupling 做 flow-based 后验采样，在 prior 采样与 annealing 步加入 flow-specific 干预，理论依据为 Stochastic Interpolants 框架；配合新的 timestep correction 与基于 one-step flow models 的 accelerated warm-up。
Result: 在一系列成像逆问题上比 SOTA 更快更准确（摘要未列具体数值）；首次将 flow-based sampler 用于非线性逆问题 Fourier phase retrieval，并把 one-step flow models 用于 principled Bayesian inverse imaging。
Conclusion: 带 SI 理论支撑的 SGS 后验采样加 timestep correction 与 one-step warm-up，可让 flow prior 在线性与非线性成像逆问题上同时兼顾速度与精度。

papers.title: Predicting Social Media Engagement using Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Social media platforms are popular channels for disseminating information, owing to their large user bases and ease of access. Companies also use social media as an important aspect of the advertising process. By creating high-quality posts, companies can strengthen their engagement metrics and increase their follower count. While a growing body of research has examined social media engagement, fewer studies have jointly examined the visual, textual, and temporal features of image posts, even though these features collectively determine the performance of content on social media. To understand the important drivers of social media engagement, we collect image posts of furniture firms on Facebook and extract visual, temporal, and textual features from them using text and image analytics methods. We evaluate several machine learning models--including Random Forest, Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM), and eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost)--to assess the drivers and the prediction power of social media engagement using the features from our data. Our primary model, LightGBM, explains 81.8% of the variance in the engagement score, 2.3 times that of our baseline model. We observed that brand-relative deviation features, which capture how far a post departs from its brand's norms, are the strongest predictors, accounting for 51.3% of total importance. Our research quantifies the extent to which these features are associated with interactions and provides recommendations that organizations may consider.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 2 tables, 1 figure. Accepted at 19th International Conference on Social Computing, Behavioral-Cultural Modeling, & Prediction and Behavior Representation in Modeling and Simulation (SBP-BRiMS 2026) as Working/Poster Papers (non-archival proceedings)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Facebook 家具企业图片帖的视觉、时间、文本三类特征预测互动表现，LightGBM 解释了互动得分 81.8% 的方差，是基线模型的 2.3 倍。品牌相对偏离特征（帖子偏离该品牌常态的程度）贡献了 51.3% 的总重要性，是最强预测因子。
Motivation: 已有社交互动研究多单独考察视觉、文本或时间特征，缺少对图片帖三类特征的联合分析，企业难以判断哪些因素真正驱动互动。
Method: 采集 Facebook 家具企业图片帖，用文本与图像分析方法抽取视觉、时间、文本特征，训练并比较 Random Forest、LightGBM、XGBoost 等模型预测互动得分，以特征重要性识别驱动因子。
Result: 主模型 LightGBM 解释互动得分 81.8% 的方差，为基线模型的 2.3 倍；品牌相对偏离特征占总特征重要性的 51.3%，是最强预测因子。
Conclusion: 视觉、时间、文本特征联合可高精度预测社交互动，而帖子相对本品牌常态的偏离程度比绝对内容属性更能决定表现。

summary_sections.method: 采集 Facebook 家具企业图片帖，用文本与图像分析方法抽取视觉、时间、文本特征，训练并比较 Random Forest、LightGBM、XGBoost 等模型预测互动得分，以特征重要性识别驱动因子。

summary_sections.conclusion: 视觉、时间、文本特征联合可高精度预测社交互动，而帖子相对本品牌常态的偏离程度比绝对内容属性更能决定表现。

papers.title: API Benchmark Scores Do Not Reliably Transfer to Chatbot Interfaces
papers.abstract_en: Benchmark scores are a central currency in model releases: they inform purchasing decisions, shape public trust, and influence policy. Yet, a key assumption underlying benchmark scores is that the model performance measured through APIs faithfully reflects the behavior of deployed systems. We challenge this assumption by auditing ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini across seven systems and nine benchmarks spanning general capability, social bias, and sycophancy. We find systematic API--interface differences in both accuracy and consistency. On average, API evaluations score 3.4 percentage points higher in accuracy and 2.1 percentage points higher in test--retest agreement than corresponding interface evaluations. For ChatGPT, the performance difference between API and interface access rivals the API-only difference between GPT 5.3 and GPT 5.4. Put differently, switching access surfaces can degrade performance as much as downgrading a full model version. We further test whether exposed API controls can reproduce interface behavior by varying system prompts, sampling parameters, and reasoning settings. These controls shift behavior in some cases but do not reliably eliminate the gap. Our findings document a context-validity gap: measurements obtained through APIs do not necessarily generalize to corresponding deployed interfaces, complicating the use of API evaluations as proxies for deployed systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 共 7 个系统、9 个基准的审计显示，API 测得的准确率平均比对应聊天界面高 3.4 个百分点，重测一致性高 2.1 个百分点；ChatGPT 上 API 与界面的差距相当于 GPT 5.3 与 GPT 5.4 的版本差。调节 system prompt、采样参数与 reasoning 设置只能在部分情况下缩小差距，不能可靠消除，因此 API 分数不能直接当作部署界面表现的代理。
Motivation: 基准分数被用于采购决策、公众信任与政策，但其前提是 API 测得的性能忠实反映部署系统；这一前提若不成立，模型发布与监管所依赖的证据链就失真。
Method: 对 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 的 7 个系统在 9 个覆盖通用能力、社会偏见与谄媚 (sycophancy) 的基准上做 API 与界面配对审计，比较准确率与 test-retest agreement；再通过改动 system prompt、采样参数与 reasoning 设置，检验暴露的 API 控制能否复现界面行为。
Result: API 评估平均比界面评估高 3.4 个百分点准确率、高 2.1 个百分点重测一致性；ChatGPT 上 API 与界面的性能差距与 GPT 5.3 到 GPT 5.4 的 API-only 版本差相当；API 控制项在部分情况下能移动行为但不能可靠消除差距。
Conclusion: 存在 context-validity gap：API 上的测量不必然推广到对应部署界面，API 评估作为部署系统代理会系统性高估表现，切换访问面造成的退化可与整代模型降级相当。

papers.title: From Mastery Profile to Simulated Response: Stochastic Student Knowledge Graphs (SSKG) for Faithful LLM Student Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate students at different mastery levels to generate synthetic training data and stress-test tutoring systems. Existing approaches primarily leverage an LLM to answer questions or perform tests while instructing it to simulate various skill levels. However, LLMs tend to execute at their full built-in capability regardless of target skill levels. We demonstrate this limitation on SAT questions across five mastery levels, where three LLMs consistently achieve 96.8-100\% accuracy. To faithfully simulate student behavior, we propose a Stochastic Student Knowledge Graph (SSKG)-based approach that leverages the strengths of LLM in different ways. Using human-in-the-loop workflows, LLMs extract a Curriculum Knowledge Graph (CKG) from course materials, decompose solution paths into CKG triples, and map incorrect distractors. A student's mastery profile is represented as an SSKG, assigning mastery probabilities to CKG triples. When solving a problem, the SSKG is sampled to determine the outcome, after which an LLM generates a rationale consistent with the sampled result. Compared to seven baselines which fail to separate profiles and maintain 86.5-100\% accuracy, our SSKG-based approach achieves 44.1-85.2\% accuracy from low to high-mastery profiles, creating a clear monotonic gradient. An ablation study demonstrates that taxonomy awareness contributes most significantly to these fidelity gains, particularly for lower-mastery profiles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出随机学生知识图谱 (SSKG)：先从课程材料抽取课程知识图谱 (CKG) 并把解题路径分解为三元组，再给每个学生画像的三元组赋掌握概率，解题时先采样 SSKG 决定对错、由 LLM 生成与采样结果一致的理由。在 SAT 五个掌握水平上，七个基线无法区分画像、准确率停在 86.5–100%，而 SSKG 给出 44.1–85.2% 的单调梯度。
Motivation: 用 LLM 模拟不同水平学生以生成合成训练数据和压测辅导系统时，LLM 会按自身满能力作答，无视目标技能水平，导致画像之间无法区分。
Method: 人在回路工作流中，LLM 从课程材料抽取 CKG、把解题路径分解为 CKG 三元组并映射错误干扰项；学生掌握画像表示为 SSKG，对三元组赋掌握概率；解题时采样 SSKG 决定结果，再由 LLM 生成与结果一致的理由。
Result: 在 SAT 问题、五个掌握水平上，三个 LLM 直接作答一致达到 96.8–100% 准确率；七个基线无法区分画像，维持 86.5–100%；SSKG 方法从低到高掌握画像给出 44.1–85.2% 的准确率，形成清晰单调梯度。消融显示 taxonomy awareness 对保真度提升贡献最大，对低掌握画像尤其明显。
Conclusion: 把作答结果的决定权交给可采样的知识图谱、让 LLM 只负责生成一致理由，才能让模拟学生在不同掌握水平上呈现可区分的单调行为；其中 taxonomy awareness 是保真度的关键来源。

papers.title: Provable Parameter-Free Fixed-Point Algorithms with Linear Convergence Rates
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we develop provable parameter-free fixed-point algorithms for contractive mappings, with an emphasis on automatically exploiting hidden contractivity without requiring prior knowledge of the contraction factor. Our first method is a parameter-free variant of the Halpern fixed-point iteration with no line-search, bisection, or prior estimate of the contraction factor, while retaining essentially the same per-iteration computational cost as classical fixed-point schemes. We establish explicit linear convergence rates for both the fixed-point residual and the distance to the unique fixed point. The second algorithm is also a parameter-free Halpern method, but it requires a line-search procedure to find a local estimate for the contraction factor, which may need a few additional operator evaluations. This method also enjoys explicit linear convergence guarantees. We further extend these ideas in two directions. First, using the relation between Halpern iterations and Nesterov-type accelerated fixed-point schemes, we derive parameter-free Nesterov-type (three-term) variants that inherit linear convergence in the contractive setting. Second, by combining the proposed fixed-point schemes with Tikhonov regularization, we obtain new methods for solving cocoercive equations and establish an iteration complexity of $\mathcal{O}({ε^{-1}\log(ε^{-1})})$ for computing an $ε$-solution, provided that a valid lower bound on the cocoercivity constant is available. Numerical experiments on several examples demonstrate that the proposed algorithms are competitive with, and often outperform, existing adaptive fixed-point methods. In particular, the methods successfully exploit contractive behavior when it is present on the selected nonexpansive test problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出两类无需事先知道压缩因子的 Halpern 型参数自由不动点算法：一种免线搜索、每迭代代价与经典方案相当，另一种用线搜索估计局部压缩因子；两者都给出不动点残差与到唯一不动点距离的显式线性收敛率。再经 Halpern 与 Nesterov 型加速的对应关系导出三项式参数自由变体，并结合 Tikhonov 正则化求解 cocoercive 方程，得到 ε-解的迭代复杂度 O(ε⁻¹log(ε⁻¹))。
Motivation: 压缩映射的不动点迭代通常需要已知压缩因子或做二分/线搜索来选步长，而该因子往往是隐藏的、事先难以估计的；作者要让算法在不掌握该先验的情况下仍保有可证的线性收敛。
Method: 第一个方法是免线搜索、免二分、免压缩因子先验估计的 Halpern 不动点迭代参数自由变体，保持与经典方案基本相同的单次迭代代价；第二个方法同为参数自由 Halpern，但用线搜索寻找压缩因子的局部估计，代价是多几次算子求值。再利用 Halpern 迭代与 Nesterov 型加速不动点格式的关系导出参数自由三项式变体，并把所提格式与 Tikhonov 正则化结合以处理 cocoercive 方程。
Result: 对不动点残差与到唯一不动点距离都建立了显式线性收敛率；Nesterov 型三项式变体在压缩设定下继承线性收敛；cocoercive 方程在 cocoercivity 常数下界已知时的 ε-解迭代复杂度为 O(ε⁻¹log(ε⁻¹))。在若干例子上的数值实验中，所提算法与已有自适应不动点方法相当且常常更优，并在选定的非扩张测试问题上成功利用了其压缩行为。
Conclusion: 不动点算法可以在不预先知道压缩因子的前提下仍获得显式线性收敛，隐藏的压缩性可被自动利用；Tikhonov 正则化路线则把该思路扩展到 cocoercive 方程并给出可证的迭代复杂度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fast LapSum: Exact Differentiable Top-$k$ at Million Scale
papers.abstract_en: Selecting the top-$k$ elements is a fundamental operation for inducing sparsity in large-scale models and optimization problems, enabling robust expert activation, token routing or attention pruning. However, hard top-$k$ is non-differentiable, while existing differentiable alternatives become increasingly expensive as the number of coordinates grows. We introduce Fast LapSum, a scalable solver for the LapSum soft top-$k$ formulation that preserves an exact selection mass of $k$, while supporting end-to-end differentiation. In Fast LapSum, we reduce sorting cost using probabilistic bracketing, which restricts sorting to a narrow band of scores around the threshold using a binomial order-statistic from kernel-noised samples. A certification pass upgrades the probabilistic localization to a verified one at the cost of one additional linear pass, with a full-sort fallback that covers the worst-case scenario. Our certified GPU implementation processes $10^6$, $10^7$, and $10^8$ scores in median times of $0.92$, $1.39$, and $7.24$ ms, respectively, making exact-budget soft top-$k$ practical within million-scale optimization loops. We demonstrate this capability in two applications: megapixel sparse adversarial examples with a small fraction of initial image pixels, where Fast LapSum achieves an order-of-magnitude speedup over state-of-the-art methods, and 3D Gaussian splatting. In the latter, we use Fast LapSum to reduce the number of Gaussians produced by Adaptive Density Control to a substantially smaller number while retaining nearly the same rendering quality and massively reducing computation. These results demonstrate that exact-budget differentiable top-$k$ can be incorporated into practical million-scale optimization pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Fast LapSum 是 LapSum 软 top-k 的可扩展求解器，用核噪声采样的二项次序统计量做概率括号化，把排序限制在阈值附近的窄带内，再用一次线性扫描的认证 pass 把概率定位升级为已验证定位，最坏情况回退到全排序。认证 GPU 实现在 10^6、10^7、10^8 个分数上中位耗时 0.92、1.39、7.24 ms，使精确预算的可微 top-k 能进入百万级优化循环。
Motivation: 硬 top-k 不可微，而现有可微替代方案随坐标数增长开销急剧上升，难以支撑大模型稀疏化与百万级优化中的专家激活、token 路由、注意力剪枝。
Method: 针对 LapSum 软 top-k 形式求解，保持精确的选择质量 k 并支持端到端求导；用核噪声采样的二项次序统计量做概率括号化以缩小排序范围，再以一次额外线性 pass 的认证步骤升级为已验证定位，最坏情况回退到全排序。
Result: 认证 GPU 实现处理 10^6、10^7、10^8 个分数的中位时间分别为 0.92、1.39、7.24 ms。在少量初始像素的百万像素稀疏对抗样本上，Fast LapSum 相对 SOTA 方法取得一个数量级的加速；在 3D Gaussian splatting 中用它削减 Adaptive Density Control 产生的高斯数量，渲染质量几乎不变而计算量大幅下降。
Conclusion: 精确预算的可微 top-k 可以直接嵌入百万级优化管线，前提是用概率括号化加认证扫描把排序开销压到线性量级。

papers.title: The Fourth Quadrant: A Stylized View of Benign Misfitting
papers.abstract_en: Training error is what we can observe on a training set; test error is the quantity we care about. We study squared-error linear regression in a deterministic $(d+1)$-dimensional single-spike model. Each training vector has spike coordinate $\sqrtγ$, $γ>1$, and equal-norm, mutually orthogonal nuisance components. Training labels are $1$. Fresh test points are centered Gaussian with covariance $\operatorname{diag}(γ,1,\ldots,1)$ and noise-free label $x[1]/\sqrtγ$. We compute the exact train--test tradeoff for linear predictors in the training span. When the spike direction is unknown, allowing all linear predictors does not improve this tradeoff, on average or in the worst case over directions consistent with the data. There is a range of training-set sizes where every span predictor that generalizes well must fit the training data worse than the zero predictor. We call this benign misfitting, or the fourth quadrant. At its sharpest, test error tends to zero while training error diverges, with both zero-predictor errors normalized to one. The best span predictor begins to generalize when $n\gg d/γ^2$, while interpolation needs $n\gg d/γ$. In the intervening window $d/γ^2\ll n\ll d/γ$, useful span prediction lies beyond interpolation: training predictions overshoot the labels. One-pass stochastic gradient descent with a large constant learning rate attains small test error throughout this window, matching the best span predictor up to a logarithmic factor, while leaving large empirical training error. Finally, the nuisance component responsible for the training misfit also controls adversarial sensitivity.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在确定性 (d+1) 维单尖峰线性回归模型中，存在样本量窗口 d/γ²≪n≪d/γ，其中训练 span 内任何测试误差小的预测器都必须比零预测器更差地拟合训练数据，作者称之为良性误拟合（benign misfitting，第四象限）。该窗口内泛化起点是 n≫d/γ² 而插值需要 n≫d/γ，大常数学习率的单遍 SGD 可达到小测试误差（与最优 span 预测器仅差一个对数因子），同时保持很大的经验训练误差。
Motivation: 训练误差可观测而测试误差才是目标，但在单尖峰模型里二者存在精确权衡：按训练误差选模型会系统性地拒绝真正泛化的解，插值与泛化在样本量上并不同步。
Method: 在 (d+1) 维单尖峰线性回归中计算训练 span 内线性预测器的精确 train–test 权衡：训练向量尖峰坐标为 √γ（γ>1）、等范数正交 nuisance 分量、标签为 1，测试点为协方差 diag(γ,1,…,1) 的中心高斯且无噪标签 x[1]/√γ；并分析尖峰方向未知时对方向取平均与最坏情形，以及大常数学习率的单遍 SGD。
Result: 尖峰方向未知时允许全部线性预测器并不改善该权衡（平均与最坏情形皆然）；泛化起点 n≫d/γ² 而插值需 n≫d/γ，窗口 d/γ²≪n≪d/γ 内最优 span 预测器的训练预测超出标签；最尖锐情形下测试误差趋于 0 而训练误差发散（两者均以零预测器误差归一为 1）；单遍 SGD 在整个窗口内测试误差小、与最优 span 预测器仅差一个对数因子且经验训练误差仍大；造成训练误拟合的 nuisance 分量同时控制对抗敏感性。
Conclusion: 在该模型中，训练误差与泛化可以反向变动，训练 span 内的插值不是泛化的必要条件，且造成训练误拟合的方向正是对抗敏感性的来源。

papers.title: First-Order In-Context Shapley: Scalable Data Auditing for LLM Alignment and Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Post-training alignment of Large Language Models is increasingly bottlenecked by data quality: preference and instruction-tuning corpora accumulate label noise, safety inversions, and inter-annotator contradictions that deduplication misses and full-corpus LLM judging cannot afford. While Data Shapley offers a principled valuation framework, exact computation requires intractable retraining, and embedding surrogates like KNN-Shapley fail to separate high- from low-utility demonstrations ($ρ= 0.0003$ with generative utility). We introduce an inference-only valuation pipeline that computes the first-order term of an in-context cooperative game over semantic $k$-NN neighborhoods in $O(k)$ forward passes without parameter updates, correlating positively with multi-shot Monte-Carlo in-context Shapley on 100% of targets at 19x less compute. Projecting pairwise log-likelihood shifts onto a directed influence graph characterizes each record via three signals: outgoing Exemplifying Advantage, incoming Exemplified Advantage, and a topological One-of-a-Kind Score protecting rare prompts. Pre-filtering restricts LLM twin arbitration to 1%-5% of records while achieving 4.5x enrichment in confirmed errors on HelpSteer2 and 2.2x on Anthropic HH-RLHF, catching contradictions that zero-shot likelihood and margin filters miss. During DPO training, confirmed contradictions oppose the update far more often than clean records (56.7% vs. 37.0% in LoRA gradients) and stay below chance in reward accuracy. Finally, auditing the HH-RLHF benchmark exposes label errors where aligned models disagree with human labels 73%-83% of the time, and retraining DPO after repairing or filtering flagged records improves reward accuracy by +0.5%-0.6% overall and +3.1%-3.5% on repaired inversions, even without LLM arbitration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出推理期数据审计管线：在语义 k-NN 邻域上计算上下文合作博弈的一阶项，O(k) 次前向、不更新参数即可给 LLM 对齐数据打分。与多轮 Monte-Carlo 上下文 Shapley 在 100% 目标上正相关，算力少 19 倍；预筛后 LLM 仲裁只覆盖 1%–5% 记录，HelpSteer2 上确认错误富集 4.5 倍、Anthropic HH-RLHF 上 2.2 倍。
Motivation: 偏好与指令微调语料积累标签噪声、安全反转和标注者矛盾，去重查不出，全量 LLM 判别又用不起；Data Shapley 精确计算需不可行的重训练，KNN-Shapley 等 embedding 代理与生成式效用的相关只有 ρ=0.0003，分不开高低效用样本。
Method: 推理期管线在语义 k-NN 邻域上取上下文合作博弈的一阶项，O(k) 次前向、无参数更新；把成对 log-likelihood 偏移投影到有向影响图，得到三个信号：向外的 Exemplifying Advantage、向内的 Exemplified Advantage、保护稀有 prompt 的拓扑 One-of-a-Kind Score。用预筛把 LLM twin 仲裁限制在 1%–5% 记录，并在 DPO 训练中检查被标记记录的 LoRA 梯度方向与 reward accuracy。
Result: 与多轮 Monte-Carlo 上下文 Shapley 在 100% 目标上正相关，算力少 19 倍；预筛加仲裁在 HelpSteer2 上确认错误富集 4.5 倍、Anthropic HH-RLHF 上 2.2 倍。DPO 训练中确认矛盾记录与更新方向相反的比例为 56.7%，干净记录为 37.0%（LoRA 梯度），reward accuracy 低于随机水平。审计 HH-RLHF 发现对齐模型与人工标签不一致占 73%–83%；修复或过滤被标记记录后重训 DPO，reward accuracy 整体提升 +0.5%–0.6%，在修复的反转样本上提升 +3.1%–3.5%，且不依赖 LLM 仲裁。
Conclusion: 一阶上下文 Shapley 加影响图三信号可以在不重训练的前提下定位对齐语料与评测基准中的有害记录，修复这些记录能直接换来 DPO reward accuracy 的提升。

papers.title: MIRROR: Learning from the Other View for Multi-Modal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) can behave very differently depending on whether the same underlying problem is presented textually or visually. This inconsistency suggests that different views expose different reasoning paths and failure modes that standard multimodal post-training does not fully exploit. To study and exploit this phenomenon, we construct ODA-Data, a high-quality paired multimodal geometry dataset with text-dominant, image-dominant, and combined image+text views of the same problems, together with splits for training and evaluating view dependent reasoning behaviors. We then develop Modality-Informed Reciprocal Reasoning Optimization (MIRROR), a reinforcement learning approach that derives a cross-view self-distillation signal from the model's own modality-dependent capabilities. For each problem, MIRROR evaluates the model under all views, selects the best-performing view as a teacher, and trains the remaining views using a GRPO task-reward objective augmented with a reverse-KL regularizer toward that teacher. Across reasoning benchmarks that evaluate on multimodal mathematics problems, MIRROR improves over standard RL and yields more accurate and consistent behavior across different input modality representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MIRROR 用同一几何题的文本主导、图像主导、图文合并三种视图构造 ODA-Data，并以模型自身表现最好的视图作教师，通过带 reverse-KL 正则的 GRPO 做跨视图自蒸馏，使 VLM 在不同输入模态下给出更一致、更准确的推理。
Motivation: 同一问题以文本或图像呈现时 VLM 表现差异很大，说明不同视图暴露不同推理路径与失败模式，而标准多模态后训练没有利用这一点。
Method: 构建配对多模态几何数据集 ODA-Data，含 text-dominant、image-dominant、image+text 三种视图及训练/评测划分；MIRROR 对每道题在全部视图下评估模型，选表现最佳视图作教师，用 GRPO 任务奖励目标训练其余视图，并加入指向该教师的 reverse-KL 正则。
Result: 在多模态数学推理基准上，MIRROR 相对标准 RL 有提升，并在不同输入模态表示下带来更准确、更一致的行为。
Conclusion: 模型自身的模态依赖能力可以互为教师，跨视图自蒸馏比单纯多模态后训练更能收敛视图间的推理差异。

papers.title: Neural Voxel Dynamics: Learning Volumetric Feature Advection for 3D Physics in V-JEPA Latent Space
papers.abstract_en: We present Neural Voxel Dynamics, a self-supervised framework for learning 3D latent dynamics from monocular video. While generative video models now produce visually compelling motion, their predominantly 2D representations provide limited geometric structure for modeling and controlling physical interactions. Instead, we learn dynamics in a lifted volumetric latent space. Specifically, we unproject semantic Video Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (V-JEPA) features into a voxel grid using monocular depth priors, producing a geometrically grounded representation that retains rich video features. We then introduce Volumetric Feature Advection, an action-conditioned transition model that predicts the evolution of these latent features directly in 3D. Unlike hybrid approaches that assume access to privileged physics-engine states or explicit simulation during training and/or inference, we learn only using video-derived supervision and, if available, actions, allowing a single latent dynamics model to represent heterogeneous material-dependent phenomena, unifying rigid-body and fluid dynamics. We evaluate across multiple datasets (synthetic and real) and unseen scenarios (e.g., new boundary conditions, OOD generalization), measuring both predictive fidelity and 3D geometric consistency. We report physical plausibility with Physics-IQ using videos decoded from predicted latent states and videos generated from predicted optical flow. Our results show that geometrically lifting pretrained video latent representations provides a scalable route toward dynamic world models that learn structured 3D physical dynamics without access to privileged simulator state.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Neural Voxel Dynamics 用单目深度先验把 V-JEPA 视频特征反投影到体素网格，在体素潜空间里用动作条件化的 Volumetric Feature Advection 直接预测 3D 潜特征演化，从而只靠视频监督（及可得的动作）统一刚体与流体等异质材料现象。作者在合成与真实多数据集、未见边界条件与 OOD 场景上评测预测保真度与 3D 几何一致性，并用 Physics-IQ 报告物理合理性。
Motivation: 生成式视频模型的表示以 2D 为主，缺少建模与控制物理交互所需的几何结构；混合方法又依赖特权物理引擎状态或显式仿真。
Method: 先用单目深度先验将语义 V-JEPA 特征 unproject 到体素网格，得到保留视频特征的几何化表示；再引入动作条件化的 Volumetric Feature Advection 转移模型，在 3D 中直接预测潜特征演化；训练只用视频导出的监督与（若有的）动作，不接触模拟器状态。
Result: 在多个合成与真实数据集及未见场景（新边界条件、OOD 泛化）上评测预测保真度与 3D 几何一致性；物理合理性用 Physics-IQ 度量，分别基于从预测潜状态解码的视频和从预测光流生成的视频报告。
Conclusion: 几何化提升（lifting）预训练视频潜表示，是在不访问特权模拟器状态的前提下学习结构化 3D 物理动力学的可扩展路径，单个潜动力学模型即可覆盖刚体与流体。

papers.title: Lesion-DDPM: Lesion-Enhanced 3D Diffusion for MS MRI Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: 3D FLAIR MRI is widely recommended as one of the standard MRI sequences for brain imaging in multiple sclerosis (MS), but publicly available MS datasets remain relatively small and vary across scanners, acquisition protocols, and lesion patterns. This scarcity and variability hinder the development of robust neuroimaging machine learning models and are particularly challenging for generative models that aim to synthesize images while preserving small, sparse lesions. We propose Lesion-DDPM, a 3D conditional diffusion framework for lesion-aware FLAIR synthesis that incorporates multi-level anatomical mask injection together with a lesion-weighted reconstruction loss to emphasize lesion voxels while maintaining global brain structure. Using a curated subset of the MSLesSeg dataset, we compare Lesion-DDPM with representative state-of-the-art GAN- and diffusion-based models, assessing both image-generation metrics and downstream 3D U-Net segmentation. In our experiments, Lesion-DDPM achieved the lowest lesion-region reconstruction error among all methods. In a downstream 3D U-Net lesion segmentation task, a model trained only on Lesion-DDPM-generated scans and evaluated on real MRIs reached a Dice score of 0.616 compared with 0.569 for the best competing synthetic dataset. When Lesion-DDPM images were added to the real training set, the Dice score further increased to 0.685.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Lesion-DDPM 是面向多发性硬化 (MS) 3D FLAIR MRI 的条件扩散合成框架，用多层级解剖掩膜注入加病灶加权重建损失，在保持整体脑结构的同时保住小而稀疏的病灶。在 MSLesSeg 数据集上，仅用其生成扫描训练的下游 3D U-Net 在真实 MRI 上 Dice 达 0.616，优于最佳竞争合成集的 0.569；与真实训练集混合后 Dice 升至 0.685。
Motivation: 公开 MS 数据集规模小、且跨扫描仪、采集协议与病灶形态差异大，使生成模型难以在合成图像中保留小而稀疏的病灶，进而限制鲁棒神经影像模型的训练。
Method: 提出 3D 条件扩散框架 Lesion-DDPM：以多层级解剖掩膜注入 (multi-level anatomical mask injection) 提供结构条件，配合病灶加权重建损失 (lesion-weighted reconstruction loss) 强调病灶体素；在 MSLesSeg 精选子集上与代表性 GAN 和扩散模型对比，评估图像生成指标与下游 3D U-Net 分割。

papers.title: CoRef-DETR: Decoupled Global Context and Selective Boundary-Category Refinement for Underwater Instance Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Underwater instance segmentation supports marine surveys, aquaculture, and underwater robotics. Haze, colour casts, and low contrast blur object boundaries, and recent benchmarks distinguish up to 158 fine-grained categories. Most of the strongest published methods have 219 to 632 million parameters. This paper proposes CoRef-DETR, a compact detection transformer that targets three error sources of a real-time detector: context, boundaries, and categories. First, a decoupled global context (DGC) detector, with the base detector's 33.4 M parameters, applies global self-attention to a 384-pixel token grid but supervises and decodes masks in a 576-pixel frame. Second, a posterior-conditioned boundary refiner with 47.7 k parameters corrects mask logits on predicted boundaries, and a quality score on the corrected masks re-ranks the detections. Third, a crop-probe category branch on frozen DINOv2 features revises the categories of at most three masks per image, choosing between soft fusion and a confident-disagreement gate with a rule fixed on validation data. On five protocols of UIIS, UIIS10K, USIS10K, and USIS16K, CoRef-DETR achieves state-of-the-art mask average precision (AP), exceeding the strongest published results by 2.3 to 5.2 points. On the same test images, it also outperforms three reproduced recent methods, on USIS16K with its category branch. Running in half precision with TensorRT, CoRef-DETR processes an image in a median of 26 to 37 ms on an NVIDIA T4 GPU, 1.4 to 11 times faster than these methods. Ablations quantify each stage, and an error analysis locates the remaining error in crowds of small objects.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to the Elsevier for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出紧凑型水下实例分割检测器 CoRef-DETR（33.4 M 参数），用解耦全局上下文 (DGC) 检测器、后验条件边界修正器 (47.7 k 参数) 与基于冻结 DINOv2 特征的 crop-probe 类别分支分别针对上下文、边界、类别三类误差。在 UIIS、UIIS10K、USIS10K、USIS16K 五个协议上 mask AP 超出最强已发表结果 2.3 至 5.2 点，T4 GPU 半精度 TensorRT 下中位单图 26 至 37 ms，比对照方法快 1.4 至 11 倍。
Motivation: 水下雾、色偏与低对比度模糊目标边界，最新基准细粒度类别多达 158 类，而最强已发表方法参数量在 2.19 亿至 6.32 亿之间，难以实时运行。
Method: DGC 检测器在 384 像素 token 网格上做全局自注意力，但在 576 像素帧上监督并解码 mask；后验条件边界修正器在预测边界上修正 mask logits，并用修正后 mask 的质量分数重排检测结果；crop-probe 类别分支在冻结 DINOv2 特征上每图最多修正三个 mask 的类别，软融合与 confident-disagreement 门控之间的规则在验证集上固定。
Result: 在 UIIS、UIIS10K、USIS10K、USIS16K 五个协议上取得 state-of-the-art mask AP，超出最强已发表结果 2.3 至 5.2 点；在相同测试图像上优于三个复现的近期方法（在 USIS16K 上启用类别分支）。半精度 TensorRT 在 NVIDIA T4 上中位单图 26 至 37 ms，比这些方法快 1.4 至 11 倍；基础检测器 33.4 M 参数，边界修正器 47.7 k 参数。
Conclusion: 把上下文、边界、类别三类误差分开建模，可以在把参数量压到 33.4 M 的同时超过 2.19 亿至 6.32 亿参数的已发表方法并保持实时速度；剩余误差集中在小目标密集场景。

papers.title: Latent Reward Steering: An Adaptive Inference-Time Framework that Implicitly Promotes Cognitive Behaviors in Reasoning LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Strong reasoning depends not only on model knowledge but also on how effectively cognitive behaviors are deployed during generation. Existing methods often rely on explicit behavior-level control, making them insufficiently adaptive when failures and required corrections vary across reasoning states, tasks, and models. To this end, we propose Latent Reward Steering (LRS), an adaptive inference-time framework that promotes cognitive behaviors by optimizing the sparse-autoencoder (SAE) latent states that implicitly carry them. Rather than relying on predefined cognitive behaviors or steering directions derived from them, LRS trains a latent reward model on reasoning traces by final answer correctness to estimate the quality of intermediate latent states. During inference, reward gradients provide state-specific correction directions for fragile latent states, while a reward and confidence gate restricts intervention to states the reward signal flags as fragile. Experiments on multiple reasoning LLM backbones and benchmarks show that \ours consistently improves performance over various baselines, and post-hoc analyses further indicate that \ours implicitly promotes good cognitive behaviors that fix the original reasoning errors. Code is available at: https://github.com/jiakanglee/Latent-Reward-Steering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出推理时框架 Latent Reward Steering (LRS)：用稀疏自编码器 (SAE) 潜变量承载认知行为，训练潜变量奖励模型按最终答案正确性给中间状态打分，推理时用奖励梯度对脆弱状态做定向修正，并由奖励与置信度门控限制干预范围。在多个推理 LLM 主干与基准上，LRS 相对多种基线一致提升性能，事后分析显示它隐式促成了修复原始推理错误的良好认知行为。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖显式的行为级控制，需要预定义认知行为或由其导出的固定转向方向，当失败与所需修正随推理状态、任务和模型变化时自适应性不足。
Method: LRS 在推理轨迹上以最终答案正确性为标签训练潜变量奖励模型，用于估计 SAE 中间潜状态质量；推理时奖励梯度为脆弱潜状态提供状态相关的修正方向，奖励与置信度门控 (reward and confidence gate) 只在被奖励信号标记为脆弱的状态上干预，不依赖预定义认知行为或转向方向。
Result: 在多个推理 LLM 主干和基准上，LRS 相对多种基线一致提升性能；事后分析表明 LRS 隐式促进修复原始推理错误的良好认知行为。
Conclusion: 在 SAE 潜空间上做带门控的奖励梯度干预，可以在不显式定义认知行为的情况下自适应地改善推理正确性。

papers.title: TokenSwap: Benchmarking and Reducing the Modality Gap in Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) should exhibit cross-modal consistency, generating consistent responses given semantically equivalent inputs across modalities. However, we observe a systematic discrepancy in model predictions under such cross-modal variations. Specifically, we define the modality gap as the difference in model performance under semantically equivalent textual and multimodal inputs. We introduce TokenSwap, a method that constructs such inputs by replacing textual concepts with semantically aligned images, resulting in sequences where visual tokens are interleaved with text tokens. Based on TokenSwap, we transform existing text-based benchmarks (e.g., MMLU) into image-interleaved counterparts, resulting in TokenSwap-Bench. Across 42 MLLMs, we observe a pervasive modality gap, with performance decreasing by 4.2% to 47.4% when moving from text-only to image-interleaved inputs, averaging 19.6% +/- 3.3% across models. Notably, reasoning models exhibit consistently smaller gaps, achieving an average gap of 10.1% compared to 25.5% for non-reasoning models, suggesting greater robustness in multimodal reasoning across equivalent textual and visual representations. In contrast, neither prompting strategies nor scaling training compute alone reliably reduces the modality gap. Finally, we demonstrate that incorporating TokenSwap during training effectively mitigates this gap, improving cross-modal alignment while preserving strong text-only and vision-language model performance. The project page is available at https://dongxzz.github.io/TokenSwap/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TokenSwap 把文本 benchmark 中的概念替换成语义对齐的图像，构造图文交错输入，从而量化多模态大模型的 modality gap。在 42 个 MLLM 上，从纯文本换成图文交错输入后性能平均下降 19.6% ± 3.3%（各模型 4.2%–47.4%）；推理模型平均 gap 10.1%，非推理模型 25.5%。仅靠 prompting 或扩大训练算力都无法可靠缩小该 gap，而在训练中加入 TokenSwap 可以有效缓解。
Motivation: 多模态大模型对语义等价的文本与图文输入给出不一致的预测，跨模态一致性缺少可复现的度量与可操作的缩小手段。
Method: 定义 modality gap 为语义等价的纯文本与多模态输入下的性能差；TokenSwap 用语义对齐的图像替换文本概念，生成图文 token 交错序列，并据此把 MMLU 等文本 benchmark 转成图文交错版本 TokenSwap-Bench；再在训练中引入 TokenSwap 以缩小该 gap。
Result: 在 42 个 MLLM 上，纯文本改为图文交错输入后性能下降 4.2% 至 47.4%，跨模型平均 19.6% ± 3.3%；推理模型平均 gap 10.1%，非推理模型 25.5%；prompting 策略与单独扩大训练算力均不能可靠缩小 gap；训练中加入 TokenSwap 可缓解 gap，同时保持纯文本与视觉-语言性能。
Conclusion: modality gap 是 MLLM 的普遍且系统性的问题，推理能力与之负相关，但算力与提示词不是解法，训练期的图文交错数据替换才是。

papers.title: FactoryNet: A Large-Scale Dataset toward Industrial Time-Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Industrial machines are actuated systems, yet most open time-series corpora record sensor outcomes alone; the few that do log commanded signals expose them in vendor-specific forms that differ from machine to machine, so commanded intent and measured response cannot be compared across embodiments. We introduce FactoryNet, a pretraining corpus for industrial time-series: 113M datapoints across 57k end-to-end task executions (15k real, 42k synthetic) on seven embodiments and four tasks, with 27 annotated anomaly types alongside healthy baselines and counterfactual pairs. Every signal in every source is mapped into a single control-theoretic schema, Setpoint, Effort, Feedback, Context (S-E-F-C), which expresses any actuated system in a common representational frame and makes commanded-versus-realized dynamics readable as explicit prediction residuals. Using the corpus, we find that a task-phase model trained on simulation, with no real phase labels, recovers roughly two thirds of the real-data ceiling on both robots, and that transfer holds within a robot family but rarely across manufacturers. Fault signatures behave differently: an uncalibrated simulator gives no detectable fault signal on either robot, and aligning the feature distributions does not repair it. What separation there is comes from Effort: motor current distinguishes faults where measured tool motion is close to chance, and calibrating the simulator to reproduce that one channel recovers a payload fault on the real robot. We read this as simulation capturing the stable structure of a task while fault behaviour stays diverse and fault-type specific. We release FactoryNet as a growing, multi-embodiment substrate for industrial foundation models.
papers.comment: Accepted at AI4Physics and FMSD, ICML 2026. Code: https://github.com/Forgis-Labs/FactoryNet
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FactoryNet 把工业机器的指令信号与实测响应统一进控制论四元 schema（Setpoint-Effort-Feedback-Context），建成 113M 数据点、57k 端到端任务执行（15k 真实、42k 合成）的工业时序预训练语料，覆盖 7 种本体、4 类任务与 27 种标注异常。仿真训练、无真实阶段标签的 task-phase 模型在两台机器人上恢复约三分之二的真实数据上限，且迁移只在同族机器人内成立、跨厂商基本失效；故障信号只出现在 Effort 通道（电机电流），对齐特征分布无法修复未标定模拟器的故障检测缺失。
Motivation: 开放时序语料大多只记录传感器结果，少数记录指令信号的又各用厂商私有格式，导致指令意图与实测响应无法跨本体比较，工业基础模型缺少统一预训练底座。
Method: 构建 FactoryNet 语料：113M 数据点、57k 端到端任务执行（15k 真实 + 42k 合成）、7 种本体、4 类任务、27 种标注异常类型并配健康基线与反事实对；所有信号映射到统一控制论 schema S-E-F-C，使指令与实现动力学表现为显式预测残差；在此之上训练 task-phase 模型并做仿真到真实的迁移与故障检测分析。
Result: 仿真训练且无真实阶段标签的 task-phase 模型在两台机器人上恢复约三分之二（roughly two thirds）的真实数据上限；迁移在同机器人族内成立、跨厂商很少成立。未标定模拟器在两台机器人上都检测不到故障信号，对齐特征分布也不修复；分离度来自 Effort：电机电流能区分故障，而实测工具运动接近随机水平，把模拟器标定到复现该单一通道即可在真实机器人上恢复一个 payload 故障。
Conclusion: 仿真捕捉的是任务的稳定结构，故障行为仍多样且故障类型特异，因此跨本体迁移与故障检测必须分开处理，且故障检测的关键通道是 Effort（电机电流）而非运动反馈。

summary_sections.motivation: 开放时序语料大多只记录传感器结果，少数记录指令信号的又各用厂商私有格式，导致指令意图与实测响应无法跨本体比较，工业基础模型缺少统一预训练底座。
summary_sections.method: 构建 FactoryNet 语料：113M 数据点、57k 端到端任务执行（15k 真实 + 42k 合成）、7 种本体、4 类任务、27 种标注异常类型并配健康基线与反事实对；所有信号映射到统一控制论 schema S-E-F-C，使指令与实现动力学表现为显式预测残差；在此之上训练 task-phase 模型并做仿真到真实的迁移与故障检测分析。
summary_sections.result: 仿真训练且无真实阶段标签的 task-phase 模型在两台机器人上恢复约三分之二（roughly two thirds）的真实数据上限；迁移在同机器人族内成立、跨厂商很少成立。未标定模拟器在两台机器人上都检测不到故障信号，对齐特征分布也不修复；分离度来自 Effort：电机电流能区分故障，而实测工具运动接近随机水平，把模拟器标定到复现该单一通道即可在真实机器人上恢复一个 payload 故障。

papers.title: Beyond Pairs: Your Language Model is Secretly Optimizing a Preference Graph
papers.abstract_en: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) aligns language models using pairwise preference comparisons, offering a simple and effective alternative to Reinforcement Learning (RL) from human feedback. However, in many practical settings, training data consists of multiple rollouts per prompt, inducing rich preference structure that pairwise DPO fails to exploit. Collapsing such data into independent pairs discards transitivity, introduces redundant or conflicting supervision, and can lead to unstable optimization. We propose Graph Direct Preference Optimization (GraphDPO), a structured generalization of DPO that operates over directed acyclic preference graphs induced by rollout rankings. GraphDPO encodes dominance relations as edges and optimizes a graph-structured Plackett--Luce-inspired objective that aggregates supervision over dominated neighborhoods, propagating the transitive structure of the input preferences while recovering standard DPO as a special case. GraphDPO naturally handles tied and incomparable responses through an equivalence-class construction: responses with identical preference signals form graph layers, incomparable responses share a layer without an edge, and absent edges contribute zero loss, preventing the spurious gradients that strict total-order objectives incur. Under this layered construction, GraphDPO maintains linear per-prompt complexity via efficient log-sum-exp aggregation. We further incorporate optional ground-truth anchoring by inserting verified solutions as dominant nodes and applying an annealed schedule that stabilizes early training while gradually relaxing oracle supervision. Experiments on reasoning and program synthesis tasks demonstrate superior performance, suggesting that graph-structured preference modeling is a scalable and robust alternative to pairwise and listwise alignment objectives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GraphDPO 把同一 prompt 的多次 rollout 排序组织成有向无环偏好图，用 Plackett–Luce 风格的图结构目标在被支配邻域上聚合监督，标准 DPO 是其特例。等价类分层处理并列与不可比回答，缺失边贡献零损失以避免伪梯度，每 prompt 复杂度保持线性；在推理与程序合成任务上表现优于 pairwise/listwise 对齐目标。
Motivation: 同一 prompt 的多 rollout 数据被压成独立 pair 后丢失传递性，还引入冗余或冲突监督，导致 DPO 优化不稳。
Method: 以 rollout 排序诱导 DAG，支配关系作边，优化图结构 Plackett–Luce 目标并在被支配邻域上聚合；相同偏好信号构成图层，不可比回答同层无边、零损失；用 log-sum-exp 聚合保持线性每 prompt 复杂度，并可插入已验证解作支配节点、配合退火调度做 ground-truth anchoring。
Result: 在推理与程序合成任务上，GraphDPO 表现优于 pairwise 与 listwise 对齐目标；每 prompt 复杂度为线性。
Conclusion: 图结构偏好建模是比 pairwise/listwise 对齐更可扩展、更稳健的替代，且能以 DPO 为特例统一处理并列与不可比样本。

papers.title: FactoryBench: Evaluating Industrial Machine Understanding
papers.abstract_en: We introduce FactoryBench, a benchmark for evaluating time-series models and LLMs on machine understanding over industrial robotic telemetry. Q&A pairs are organized along four causal levels (state, intervention, counterfactual, decision) instantiating Pearl's ladder of causation, and span five answer formats: four structured formats are scored deterministically and free-form answers are scored by an LLM-as-judge voting protocol. We propose a scalable Q&A generation framework built around structured question templates, present FactoryWave (a dense, multitask, multivariate sensor dataset collected from a UR3 cobot and a KUKA KR10 industrial arm), and construct FactoryBench as a large-scale benchmark of over 70k Q&A items grounded in roughly 15k normalized episodes from FactoryWave, AURSAD, and voraus-AD. Zero-shot evaluation of six frontier LLMs shows that no model exceeds 50% on structured levels or 18% on decision-making, revealing a wide gap between current models and operational machine understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FactoryBench 是面向工业机器人遥测的机器理解基准：用结构化问题模板生成 Q&A，按 Pearl 因果阶梯组织成 state、intervention、counterfactual、decision 四级，覆盖五种答案格式。零样本评测六个前沿 LLM，结构化层级无一超过 50%，决策层级无一超过 18%，说明现有模型与可操作的机器理解之间差距很大。
Motivation: 时间序列模型与 LLM 在工业机器人遥测上的因果级机器理解缺少统一评测：既有数据集要么只覆盖浅层状态识别，要么无法区分干预、反事实与决策层级的能力。
Method: 提出基于结构化问题模板的可扩展 Q&A 生成框架；发布 FactoryWave（UR3 协作机器人与 KUKA KR10 工业臂采集的稠密多任务多变量传感器数据集）；以 FactoryWave、AURSAD、voraus-AD 约 15k 条归一化 episode 构建 70k+ 条 Q&A，四级因果层级对应 Pearl 因果阶梯，五种答案格式中四种结构化格式确定性打分，自由文本用 LLM-as-judge 投票协议评分。
Result: 零样本评测六个前沿 LLM：结构化层级无一超过 50%，决策层级无一超过 18%；基准规模为 70k+ 条 Q&A，基于约 15k 条归一化 episode，来自 FactoryWave、AURSAD 与 voraus-AD。
Conclusion: 当前前沿 LLM 在工业遥测的因果级机器理解上远未达到可操作水平，尤其在决策层级；结构化模板生成加因果分层是评测这类能力的可行路径。

papers.title: Constrained Triple-Head Price Optimization (C3PO) Network for Discrete-Choice Models
papers.abstract_en: We propose a Constrained Triple-Head Price Optimization (C3PO) network for real-time bi-level decision making in discrete-choice environments. In these settings, a seller selects product or service offerings to achieve business objectives, while heterogeneous users make personalized acceptance or rejection decisions based on their preferences, ultimately determining seller outcomes. Existing approaches that fine-tune pre-trained tabular foundation models on synthetic data are limited by their imitation-learning paradigm and inability to enforce common pricing rules, including cross-product and global constraints. C3PO addresses these limitations through a novel transformer-based architecture that jointly integrates price imitation learning, multi-task revenue prediction, and in-context elasticity learning to generate robust pricing recommendations across domains without retraining. A lightweight differentiable constraint layer enables generated prices to satisfy business constraints while optimizing the revenue objective. We demonstrate strong out-of-distribution performance on simulated, synthetic, and real-world datasets. Across simulated benchmarks where the calibrated MNL model is misspecified relative to the ground-truth choice model, C3PO improves expected revenue by 1.4 to 7.9 percentage points over a calibrated MNL baseline. The constraint layer reduces average absolute constraint violations by more than 50\%. We further deploy the model in real-world applications, including healthcare tender pricing and airline ancillary pricing, where C3PO improves directional pricing effectiveness, measured by price-increase and price-decrease recall, by 18--34 percentage points depending on the baselines considered, including calibrated MNL, classical optimization, and off-the-shelf tabular foundation-models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: C3PO 是面向离散选择 (discrete-choice) 环境的实时双层定价网络，用 transformer 联合做价格模仿学习、多任务收入预测与 in-context 弹性学习，再接一个轻量可微约束层强制满足业务约束。在标定 MNL 相对真实选择模型误设的模拟基准上，期望收入比标定 MNL 基线高 1.4–7.9 个百分点，约束层使平均绝对违约下降超过 50%。
Motivation: 现有方法在合成数据上微调表格基础模型，受模仿学习范式限制，且无法强制执行跨产品与全局定价规则等常见约束。
Method: transformer 架构联合三个头：价格模仿学习、多任务收入预测、in-context 弹性学习，跨域生成定价建议而无需重训练；外接轻量可微约束层，使生成价格在优化收入目标时满足业务约束。
Result: 在标定 MNL 相对真实选择模型误设的模拟基准上，C3PO 期望收入比标定 MNL 基线提高 1.4 至 7.9 个百分点；约束层使平均绝对约束违约降低超过 50%；在医疗招标定价与航空辅营定价的真实部署中，方向性定价有效性（涨价与降价 recall）相对基线提高 18–34 个百分点，基线包括标定 MNL、经典优化与现成表格基础模型。
Conclusion: 把模仿、收入预测与弹性学习放进同一 transformer 并叠加可微约束层，可在不重训练的情况下同时改善离散选择定价的收入与约束满足，且对模型误设和分布外数据稳健。
Relevance: 0
