papers.title: Training Non-Differentiable Networks via Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: Hard thresholds, quantization, and discrete routing can produce training losses with flat regions and jumps, where ordinary gradients vanish or are undefined. We introduce PolyStep, a forward-only optimizer that evaluates rotated polytope probes and moves parameter blocks along weighted averages of the probe directions. We derive the weights from one-sided entropic transport and use its uncoupled softmax solution in our primary experiments. Our analysis explains when variation among probe costs produces motion and when that motion decreases the loss. On a regular simplex, nonconstant costs always give a nonzero direction. For monotone ridge losses, the softmax update cannot increase the loss at any positive temperature; a perturbation bound gives sufficient conditions for descent near curved jumps. For bounded measurable losses, we randomize the probe radii and identify an exact smoothing whose gradient equals the expected linear cost-weighted direction up to scale. This identity yields a stationarity bound for an idealized fixed-temperature variant: under regularity and sampling assumptions stronger than those met by our trained configurations, the bound has an $O(T^{-1/2})$ term and a persistent bias floor. We evaluate the practical method on networks with hard operations, discrete optimization, and policy search. On MNIST with hard-threshold spiking neurons, PolyStep reaches $93.0 \pm 0.2\%$, compared with $79.6 \pm 5.2\%$ for the best-tuned gradient-free baseline at matched evaluations. These gains come with a query cost proportional to the search dimension per fresh step, which limits the number of updates available at a fixed budget.
papers.comment: 95 pages, 29 tables, 8 figures. Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR). Code: https://github.com/anindex/polystep
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PolyStep 是一个 forward-only 优化器，用旋转多面体探针 (rotated polytope probes) 评估损失，再沿探针方向的加权平均移动参数块，权重来自 one-sided entropic transport 的 uncoupled softmax 解，用于训练含硬阈值、量化、离散路由等不可微算子的网络。在 MNIST 硬阈值脉冲神经元上达到 93.0±0.2%，同评估预算下最好的调参无梯度基线为 79.6±5.2%。代价是每个新步的查询开销与搜索维度成正比，固定预算下可用更新次数受限。
Motivation: 硬阈值、量化、离散路由会让训练损失出现平坦区与跳变，普通梯度在这些位置消失或无定义，反向传播类方法无法训练这类网络。
Method: PolyStep 为 forward-only 优化器：在参数块上评估旋转多面体探针，按 one-sided entropic transport（主实验用 uncoupled softmax 解）导出的权重对探针方向做加权平均并移动参数。理论部分给出：正单纯形上探针代价非常数即产生非零方向；单调 ridge 损失下 softmax 更新在任意正温度都不会增大损失，扰动界给出曲跳变附近下降的充分条件；对有界可测损失随机化探针半径，构造一个精确平滑，其梯度等于期望的线性代价加权方向（差一尺度），由此得到理想化固定温度变体的驻留性界，含 O(T^{-1/2}) 项与持续偏差底。
Result: 在含硬算子、离散优化与策略搜索的网络上评估：MNIST 硬阈值脉冲神经元上 PolyStep 93.0±0.2%，同评估预算下最好的调参无梯度基线 79.6±5.2%。驻留性界含 O(T^{-1/2}) 项与持久偏差底，且其正则性与采样假设强于实际训练配置所满足的条件。每个新步的查询开销与搜索维度成正比。
Conclusion: 用探针代价的变异性代替梯度，可以在不可微算子上产生并保证下降方向，代价是随搜索维度线性增长的查询开销，限制了固定预算下的更新步数。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Approximating Uniform Random Rotations by Two-Stage Structured Hadamard Rotations in High Dimensions
papers.abstract_en: Uniform random rotations are useful in fast Johnson--Lindenstrauss embeddings, kernel approximation, communication-efficient learning, and recent AI compression pipelines, but are computationally expensive to generate and apply in high dimensions. A practical alternative repeats Walsh--Hadamard transforms with random sign diagonals. Applying this structured rotation twice has shown empirical benefits, but supporting theory remains limited. We study the approximation quality of the two-stage structured Hadamard rotation. Here $d$ is the dimension of the rotated vector. On the positive side, we prove explicit, nonasymptotic upper bounds of order $\sqrt{\log d/d}$ in both Kolmogorov and Wasserstein-1 distance for corresponding coordinates scaled by $\sqrt d$, uniformly over unit inputs and coordinates. For the input $u=e_1$, both distances also have lower bounds of order $d^{-1/2}$ at every coordinate. On the negative side, we prove an explicit lower bound on the Wasserstein-1 distance between the full vector distributions, showing a substantial discrepancy that does not vanish as $d$ grows for the input $u=e_1$. For the same input, we also prove a matching asymptotic upper bound, showing that the lower-bound scale is sharp. Taken together, the results identify a separation between one-dimensional marginal behavior, where approximation improves with dimension, and the full-vector law, where a nonvanishing Wasserstein-1 discrepancy remains. The marginal bounds control coordinate threshold probabilities and expected scalar Lipschitz losses, including expected averages over coordinates. They do not establish joint-coordinate approximation, and the full-vector separation does not imply failure of a particular algorithm. Connecting these distributional results to performance guarantees for specific algorithms remains open.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 两阶段结构化 Hadamard 旋转（重复 Walsh–Hadamard 变换加随机符号对角阵）在单坐标边缘分布上以 √(log d/d) 速率逼近均匀随机旋转，但对输入 u=e_1 的全向量分布存在不随 d 消失的 Wasserstein-1 差距。结论是：边缘近似随维数改善可用于阈值概率与标量 Lipschitz 损失，全向量层面的逼近则不成立，把该分布结果接到具体算法保证仍是开放问题。
Motivation: 均匀随机旋转在 fast Johnson–Lindenstrauss 嵌入、核近似、通信高效学习与 AI 压缩中常用，但高维下生成与施加代价高；两阶段结构化 Hadamard 旋转已有经验收益，支撑理论却不足。
Method: 研究两阶段结构化 Hadamard 旋转（重复 Walsh–Hadamard 变换配随机符号对角阵）对均匀随机旋转的逼近质量，对缩放 √d 后的对应坐标在 Kolmogorov 与 Wasserstein-1 距离下给出显式非渐近上界，并对输入 u=e_1 给出边缘下界与全向量 Wasserstein-1 的显式下界及匹配渐近上界。
Result: 对任意单位输入与坐标，Kolmogorov 与 Wasserstein-1 距离上界为 √(log d/d) 量级；对 u=e_1 每个坐标的两种距离均有 d^{-1/2} 量级下界。u=e_1 下全向量分布的 Wasserstein-1 存在显式下界，其量级不随 d 增大而消失，并有匹配的渐近上界说明该下界尺度是紧的。
Conclusion: 存在一维边缘与全向量法则的分离：边缘逼近随维数改善，可控制坐标阈值概率与期望标量 Lipschitz 损失（含跨坐标期望平均），但不建立联合坐标逼近；全向量分离也不意味着某个具体算法失败，把结果接到算法性能保证仍待解决。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DeVI: Physics-based Dexterous Human-Object Interaction via Synthetic Video Imitation
papers.abstract_en: Physics-based character control for dexterous Human-Object Interaction (HOI) relies heavily on motion-capture data, which limits its applicability beyond captured scenarios. Meanwhile, video generative models can synthesize realistic HOI videos for unseen objects and scenarios directly from text prompts, but 3D interactions learned from such synthetic data remain kinematic without ensuring physical plausibility. Imitating these videos with physics-based control is a promising direction, yet unreliable object tracking and hand-object misalignment make it difficult to obtain accurate imitation targets. We present DeVI (Dexterous Video Imitation), a novel framework that learns physics-based character control for dexterous HOI by imitating text-conditioned synthetic videos. To address unreliable 3D object motion reconstruction, we introduce hybrid imitation targets that combine reconstructed 3D human motion with tracked 2D object trajectories, bypassing the explicit reconstruction of the 3D object motion. Our Visual HOI Alignment further refines the human reference to align with both the generated video and the initial 3D object configuration, making it suitable for physical interaction. Extensive experiments show that DeVI's hybrid representation is more effective than those used by the baselines and that Visual HOI Alignment improves reconstruction quality and imitation success. We further demonstrate physically plausible functional manipulation from text instructions, including target-aware interactions and articulated object manipulation, without requiring motion-capture demonstrations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeVI 用文本条件的合成视频模仿来学物理可控的灵巧手-物交互 (dexterous HOI)：混合模仿目标把重建的 3D 人体动作与 2D 物体轨迹绑在一起，绕开不可靠的 3D 物体重建；Visual HOI Alignment 再把人体参考对齐到生成视频与初始 3D 物体配置。实验显示该混合表示比基线所用表示更有效，对齐模块提升重建质量与模仿成功率，并能在无需动捕示范下完成目标感知交互与铰接物体操作。
Motivation: 物理角色控制依赖动捕数据，泛化受限；视频生成模型能为未见物体合成 HOI 视频，但其中的 3D 交互是运动学的，且 3D 物体跟踪不可靠、手-物错位，导致模仿目标不准。
Method: DeVI 框架以文本条件合成视频为模仿源：混合模仿目标结合重建的 3D 人体动作与跟踪到的 2D 物体轨迹，避免显式重建 3D 物体运动；Visual HOI Alignment 精修人体参考，使其同时对齐生成视频与初始 3D 物体配置，从而可用于物理交互。
Result: 实验表明 DeVI 的混合表示比基线所用表示更有效，Visual HOI Alignment 提升重建质量与模仿成功率；并演示了从文本指令出发的物理合理功能操作，包括目标感知交互与铰接物体操作，全程无需动捕示范。
Conclusion: 以合成视频为模仿目标、用混合 2D/3D 表示绕开不可靠的 3D 物体重建，可以在不依赖动捕的前提下学到物理合理的灵巧操作。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Reinforcement learning for inverse silhouette design and rapid laser cutting of compact parallelogram quad kirigami prototypes
papers.abstract_en: Kirigami is an increasingly useful fabrication method to produce shape-programmable metamaterial structures. However, inverse design remains difficult because deployment is nonlinear, and feasible cut layouts must satisfy discrete compatibility rules, avoid overlap, and map one target shape to valid designs. We present RL-Kirigami, an inverse design framework that combines optimal-transport conditional flow matching (OT-CFM) with reinforcement learning to generate compatible ratio fields for compact reconfigurable parallelogram quad kirigami. A marching decoder enforces global geometric compatibility, and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) aligns the generator with nondifferentiable rewards for silhouette matching, feasibility, and ratio-field regularity. Across procedurally generated target shape instances, a single sample from the pretrained OT-CFM prior reached $94.2\%~\mathrm{sIoU}$ and outperformed solver baselines while reducing forward simulator evaluations from hundreds to $1$. GRPO improved accuracy to $94.91\%~\mathrm{sIoU}$ and, with regularity included, reduced $\mathrm{TV}(\mathbf{x})$ from $0.95$ to $0.81$ while maintaining $94.83\%~\mathrm{sIoU}$. Generated layouts were exported to DXF and laser cut in $50~μ\mathrm{m}$ polymeric sheets to produce deployable prototypes in $8.0\pm 1.0$ minutes per part. These results support a manufacturing-aware inverse design workflow for deployable kirigami metamaterials under geometric feasibility constraints. Code is available at https://github.com/milad1378yz/RL-Kirigami.
papers.journal_ref: Materials & Design 268 (2026), 116545
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RL-Kirigami 用最优传输条件流匹配 (OT-CFM) 生成平行四边形 quad kirigami 的兼容 ratio field，再用 GRPO 对齐轮廓匹配、可行性与正则性三类不可微奖励，marching decoder 强制全局几何兼容。预训练 OT-CFM 单次采样即达 94.2% sIoU 并把前向仿真调用从数百次降到 1 次，GRPO 提到 94.91%，加入正则项后 TV(x) 从 0.95 降到 0.81 且保持 94.83% sIoU；DXF 导出后激光切割 50 μm 聚合物片，单件 8.0±1.0 分钟。
Motivation: kirigami 部署是非线性的，可行切割布局须满足离散兼容规则、避免重叠且一个目标形状要映射到有效设计，逆设计因此困难。
Method: OT-CFM 先验生成兼容 ratio field，marching decoder 施加全局几何兼容约束，GRPO 以轮廓 sIoU、可行性、ratio field 正则性三类不可微奖励微调生成器；目标形状实例为程序化生成，成品导出 DXF 后激光切割。
Result: 预训练 OT-CFM 单样本 94.2% sIoU，优于 solver 基线，前向仿真评估从数百次降到 1 次；GRPO 提升至 94.91% sIoU；加入正则后 TV(x) 由 0.95 降至 0.81，同时保持 94.83% sIoU；50 μm 聚合物片单件切割耗时 8.0±1.0 分钟。
Conclusion: 在几何可行性约束下，生成先验加不可微奖励的 RL 对齐可做出制造感知的可展开 kirigami 超材料逆设计流程，兼顾精度、仿真开销与切割节拍。

papers.title: A Systematic Study of Cross-Modal Typographic Attacks on Audio-Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: As audio-visual multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in safety-critical applications, understanding their cross-modal vulnerabilities is essential. To this end, we introduce Multi-Modal Typography, a systematic study examining how perturbations added to speech and on-screen text impact audio-visual reasoning of closed- and open-source models. For instance, on the WorldSense benchmark, the attack success rate (ASR) against Gemini 3.7 Flash increased from 9.53\% to 43.41\%, highlighting its vulnerability. We analyze the cross-modal effects of unimodal and multimodal attacks and evaluate how specific properties of the attacks impact the overall multi-modal reasoning. By applying fine-tuning as a mitigation, we lower the ASR of Qwen2.5-Omni-7B on WorldSense from $60.6\%$ to $52.0\%$. Our findings across multi-modal reasoning tasks, content moderation, and offline robot task selection benchmarks establish multi-modal typography as a critical and underexplored attack strategy in multi-modal reasoning. Code and data will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统研究跨模态排版攻击 (cross-modal typography attacks)：在语音与屏幕文字中加入扰动即可显著破坏音频-视觉 MLLM 的推理。WorldSense 上 Gemini 3.7 Flash 的攻击成功率 (ASR) 从 9.53% 升到 43.41%；微调可把 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 的 ASR 从 60.6% 降到 52.0%，缓解有限。
Motivation: 音频-视觉 MLLM 正进入安全攸关场景，但语音与屏幕文字之间的跨模态脆弱性几乎未被系统刻画，攻击面未知。
Method: 提出 Multi-Modal Typography，在语音和屏幕文字中加入排版类扰动，对闭源与开源模型分别施加单模态与多模态攻击，分析攻击属性对推理的影响，并以微调作为缓解手段，在多模态推理、内容审核与离线机器人任务选择基准上检验。
Result: WorldSense 上 Gemini 3.7 Flash 的 ASR 由 9.53% 升至 43.41%；微调使 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 在 WorldSense 上的 ASR 从 60.6% 降至 52.0%。
Conclusion: 多模态排版是对音频-视觉推理的关键且研究不足的攻击策略，微调只能部分降低 ASR。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mixture-Greedy for Online Generative Model Selection: Is UCB Necessary in Diversity-Aware Multi-Armed Bandits?
papers.abstract_en: Efficient selection among multiple generative models is increasingly important in modern generative AI, where sampling from suboptimal models is costly. This problem can be viewed as a multi-armed bandit (MAB) task. Under diversity-aware evaluation scores, a non-degenerate mixture of generators can outperform any individual model, distinguishing this MAB setting from classical best-arm identification. Prior approaches incorporate an Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) exploration bonus into the mixture objective. However, across multiple datasets and evaluation metrics, we observe that the UCB term consistently slows convergence and reduces sample efficiency. In contrast, a simple Mixture-Greedy strategy without explicit UCB-type optimism converges faster and achieves even better performance, particularly for widely used metrics such as FID and Vendi where tight confidence bounds are difficult to construct. We provide theoretical insight explaining this behavior: under structural conditions, diversity-aware objectives induce implicit exploration by favoring interior mixtures, leading to sampling of all arms and sublinear regret guarantees for diversity-based objectives. These results suggest that in diversity-aware multi-armed bandits, e.g., for generative model selection, exploration can arise intrinsically from the objective's geometry.
papers.comment: Accepted and published at the UAI 2026 Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多样性感知评分下，混合生成器可优于任何单模型，此时 MAB 目标不是选最优臂而是选混合比例。作者发现带 UCB 探索项会拖慢收敛、降低样本效率，而去掉显式乐观项的 Mixture-Greedy 在 FID、Vendi 等指标上收敛更快且性能更好；理论上在结构条件下，多样性目标的几何会偏好内部混合、自发探索所有臂并给出次线性 regret。
Motivation: 生成式 AI 中从次优模型采样代价高，需在线选模型；多样性评分使最优解是非退化混合，经典 best-arm identification 与 UCB 乐观探索在此设定下反而拖慢收敛。
Method: 把多生成器选择建模为 diversity-aware multi-armed bandit，提出不含 UCB 项的 Mixture-Greedy 直接优化混合目标；在多个数据集与指标（FID、Vendi）上与带 UCB 探索项的方法对比，并给出结构条件下隐式探索与次线性 regret 的理论分析。
Result: 跨多个数据集与评估指标，UCB 项一致地减慢收敛并降低样本效率；Mixture-Greedy 收敛更快且性能更好，在 FID 与 Vendi 这类难以构造紧置信界的指标上尤其明显。
Conclusion: 在多样性感知 MAB 中探索可由目标几何内在产生，无需显式 UCB 式乐观项；生成器选择即为该设定的实例。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.motivation: 生成式 AI 中从次优模型采样代价高，需在线选模型；多样性评分使最优解是非退化混合，经典 best-arm identification 与 UCB 乐观探索在此设定下反而拖慢收敛。
summary_sections.method: 把多生成器选择建模为 diversity-aware multi-armed bandit，提出不含 UCB 项的 Mixture-Greedy 直接优化混合目标；在多个数据集与指标（FID、Vendi）上与带 UCB 探索项的方法对比，并给出结构条件下隐式探索与次线性 regret 的理论分析。
summary_sections.result: 跨多个数据集与评估指标，UCB 项一致地减慢收敛并降低样本效率；Mixture-Greedy 收敛更快且性能更好，在 FID 与 Vendi 这类难以构造紧置信界的指标上尤其明显。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在多样性感知 MAB 中探索可由目标几何内在产生，无需显式 UCB 式乐观项；生成器选择即为该设定的实例。

papers.title: On the Rate of Convergence of GD in Non-linear Neural Networks: An Adversarial Robustness Perspective
papers.abstract_en: We study the convergence dynamics of Gradient Descent (GD) in a minimal binary classification setting, consisting of a two-neuron ReLU network and two training instances. We prove that even under these strong simplifying assumptions, while GD successfully converges to an optimal robustness margin, effectively maximizing the distance between the decision boundary and the training points, this convergence occurs at a prohibitively slow rate, scaling strictly as $Θ(1/\ln(t))$. To the best of our knowledge, this establishes the first explicit lower bound on the convergence rate of the robustness margin in a non-linear model. Through empirical simulations, we further demonstrate that this inherent failure mode is pervasive, exhibiting the exact same tight convergence rate across multiple natural network initializations. Our theoretical guarantees are derived via a rigorous analysis of the GD trajectories across the distinct activation patterns of the model. Specifically, we develop tight control over the system's dynamics to bound the trajectory of the decision boundary, overcoming the primary technical challenge introduced by the non-linear nature of the architecture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在两神经元 ReLU 网络、两个训练样本的最小二分类设定下，梯度下降 (GD) 能收敛到最优鲁棒性间隔（最大化决策边界到训练点的距离），但收敛速率严格为 Θ(1/ln t)，慢到不可用。作者称这是非线性模型中鲁棒性间隔收敛速率的首个显式下界，并通过数值模拟显示该速率在多种自然初始化下一致出现。
Motivation: 非线性网络中 GD 收敛速率缺少显式下界，尤其是以对抗鲁棒性间隔为度量时；即便极简设定也无人给出紧的速率刻画。
Method: 在两神经元 ReLU 网络加两个样本的二分类设定上，逐个激活模式 (activation pattern) 分析 GD 轨迹，对系统动力学做紧控制以界定决策边界轨迹，从而导出鲁棒性间隔的收敛速率上下界。
Result: GD 收敛到最优鲁棒性间隔，但速率严格为 Θ(1/ln t)；数值模拟显示该紧速率在多种自然网络初始化下完全一致。
Conclusion: 即使在高度简化的非线性网络中，鲁棒性间隔的收敛也本质上是对数级缓慢，是 GD 的一种固有失效模式。

papers.title: Bridge Matching Sampler: Scalable Sampling via Generalized Fixed-Point Diffusion Matching
papers.abstract_en: Sampling from unnormalized densities using diffusion models has emerged as a powerful paradigm. However, while recent approaches that use least-squares `matching' objectives have improved scalability, they often necessitate significant trade-offs, such as restricting prior distributions or relying on unstable optimization schemes. By generalizing these methods as special forms of fixed-point iterations rooted in Nelson's relation, we develop a new method that addresses these limitations, called Bridge Matching Sampler (BMS). Our approach enables learning a stochastic transport map between arbitrary prior and target distributions with a single, scalable, and stable objective. Furthermore, we introduce a damped variant of this iteration that incorporates a regularization term to mitigate mode collapse and further stabilize training. Empirically, we demonstrate that our method enables sampling at unprecedented scales while preserving mode diversity, achieving state-of-the-art results on complex synthetic densities and high-dimensional molecular benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Bridge Matching Sampler (BMS)：把基于最小二乘 matching 目标的扩散采样方法统一为以 Nelson 关系为根的不动点迭代，从而用单一目标学习任意先验分布与目标分布之间的随机传输映射。带阻尼与正则项的变体抑制 mode collapse 并稳定训练，在复杂合成密度与高分子基准上达到 state-of-the-art，可扩展到前所未有的采样规模且保持 mode 多样性。
Motivation: 从非归一化密度采样的扩散方法中，最近的 least-squares matching 类目标虽提升了可扩展性，但代价明显：要么限制先验分布，要么依赖不稳定的优化方案。
Method: 将现有 matching 方法统一为基于 Nelson 关系的不动点迭代形式，据此构造 BMS，用单一、可扩展且稳定的目标学习任意先验到目标分布的随机传输映射；另引入带阻尼的迭代变体，加入正则项以缓解 mode collapse 并进一步稳定训练。
Result: 在复杂合成密度与高分子 (molecular) 高维基准上取得 state-of-the-art 结果，实现前所未有的采样规模并保持 mode 多样性；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 以不动点迭代统一 matching 类扩散采样后，可以在不限制先验、不牺牲稳定性的前提下扩展到高维非归一化密度采样，阻尼正则变体是保持 mode 多样性的关键。

papers.title: CoMMa: Contribution-Aware Medical Multi-Agents for Decentralized Oncology Decision Support
papers.abstract_en: Recent multi-agent frameworks have shown promise for oncology decision support, yet most assume centralized data access and rely on prompt-based assignment, limiting their applicability in privacy-sensitive clinical settings. We propose Contribution-Aware Medical Multi-Agents (CoMMa), a decentralized LLM-agent framework where specialists operate on partitioned clinical data streams. Unlike prior approaches that share inputs across agents, CoMMa enforces data decentralization to include stronger role specialization and further enhances this via agent-specific finetuning. To enable reliable and interpretable coordination, we introduce a contribution-aware aggregation mechanism that replaces stochastic, narrative-based reasoning with deterministic embedding projections to approximate each agent's marginal utility. This yields explicit credit assignment over agents, providing a stable and interpretable decision pathway aligned with clinical requirements. We evaluate CoMMa on multiple oncology benchmarks, including real-world multidisciplinary tumor board datasets from large academic hospitals in North America and East Asia, as well as public datasets, demonstrating strong performance and generalization across heterogeneous clinical settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoMMa 把肿瘤学多智能体决策支持改成去中心化架构：各专科 LLM agent 只接触切分后的临床数据流，用 agent 专属微调强化角色分工，并以确定性 embedding 投影替代随机的叙述式推理来近似每个 agent 的边际贡献，从而给出显式、可解释的 credit assignment。在北美与东亚大型学术医院的真实多学科肿瘤委员会数据集及公开数据集上评估，显示强性能与跨异质临床场景的泛化。
Motivation: 现有肿瘤学多智能体框架默认中心化数据访问、靠 prompt 指派角色，无法用于隐私敏感的临床环境。
Method: CoMMa 是去中心化 LLM-agent 框架：专科 agent 各自运行在切分的临床数据流上，通过 agent 专属微调加强角色特化；协调由贡献感知聚合机制完成，用确定性 embedding 投影近似各 agent 的边际效用，取代随机、基于叙述的推理，形成显式 credit assignment。
Result: 在多个肿瘤学基准上评估，包括北美与东亚大型学术医院的真实多学科肿瘤委员会 (multidisciplinary tumor board) 数据集和公开数据集，结果显示强性能，并在异质临床设置间具备泛化能力。
Conclusion: 数据去中心化加上基于边际贡献的确定性聚合，可以在不共享输入的前提下给出稳定、可解释、符合临床要求的多智能体决策路径。

papers.title: ERIS: Enhancing the Privacy-Utility-Scalability Trade-Off in Federated Learning via Federated Shard Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: Scaling Federated Learning (FL) to billion-parameter models forces a challenging trade-off between privacy, scalability, and model utility. Existing solutions often tackle these challenges in isolation, sacrificing accuracy, relying on costly cryptographic tools, or introducing communication and optimization inefficiencies that affect convergence. We introduce ERIS, an FL framework centered on Federated Shard Aggregation (FSA), a novel mechanism that partitions each client update into non-overlapping shards whose aggregation is distributed across multiple client-side aggregators. FSA removes the central aggregation bottleneck, limits the information visible to any single observer, and preserves the centralized FL update after reassembly. ERIS can further readily integrate Distributed Shifted Compression (DSC) to reduce transmitted payloads and exposed coordinates. We prove that ERIS preserves convergence under standard assumptions and bounds mutual information leakage by the observable fraction of each update, decreasing with the number of client-side aggregators, and with the compression level when DSC is enabled. Experiments across image and text tasks, including large language models, show that ERIS achieves FedAvg-level utility while substantially reducing communication bottlenecks and improving robustness to membership inference and reconstruction attacks, without relying on heavy cryptography or utility-degrading perturbations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ERIS 提出 Federated Shard Aggregation (FSA)，把每个客户端更新切成互不重叠的分片、分发给多个客户端侧聚合器，从而去掉中心聚合瓶颈并限制任何单一观察者可见的信息。论文证明重装后等价于集中式 FL 更新，且互信息泄漏随聚合器数量下降、启用 DSC 后随压缩率进一步下降；在图像与文本（含大语言模型）任务上达到 FedAvg 级效用，同时降低通信开销并提升对成员推断与重构攻击的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 十亿参数级模型的联邦学习在隐私、可扩展性与模型效用之间被迫取舍：现有方案往往孤立处理某一问题，代价是精度下降、依赖昂贵密码学工具，或引入影响收敛的通信与优化低效。
Method: 核心机制为 Federated Shard Aggregation (FSA)：将每个客户端更新划分为互不重叠的分片，聚合任务分布到多个客户端侧聚合器，重装后保持与集中式 FL 相同的更新；可叠加 Distributed Shifted Compression (DSC) 以削减传输载荷与暴露坐标数。理论上在标准假设下证明收敛性，并给出互信息泄漏上界。
Result: 互信息泄漏上界随客户端侧聚合器数量下降，启用 DSC 时随压缩率进一步下降；在图像与文本任务（含大语言模型）上达到 FedAvg 级效用，同时实质性降低通信瓶颈，并提升对成员推断 (membership inference) 与重构攻击 (reconstruction attacks) 的鲁棒性，无需重型密码学或降低效用的扰动。
Conclusion: 把聚合职责按分片分散到多个客户端侧聚合器，可以在不牺牲效用、不引入重型密码学的前提下同时改善 FL 的隐私、可扩展性与通信效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: COBALT: Contextual Bandit Learning with Offline Trajectories for Multi-Turn Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Training large language models (LLMs) for multi-turn code generation typically relies on online reinforcement learning (RL), in which models learn from repeatedly generated online rollouts. Although effective, online RL can be costly and unstable. In this paper, we present contextual bandit learning with offline trajectories (COBALT), a simple method that reuses offline multi-turn trajectories to efficiently train LLMs for multi-turn code generation. Building on the observation that multi-turn code generation is a one-step recoverable Markov decision process, COBALT first collects code generation trajectories using a reference LLM and divides them into partial trajectories. Then, during online bandit learning, the LLM is trained to complete each partial trajectory through single-step code generation. On LiveCodeBench, COBALT substantially improves R1-Distill 8B and Qwen3 8B by up to 9.0 and 6.2 absolute Pass@1 points and matches the performance of two multi-turn online RL baselines using GRPO and VeRPO. We also perform a perturbation-based analysis of in-context reward hacking and show that Cobalt can improve robustness to misleading execution feedback. Overall, our results demonstrate that Cobalt is a promising solution for multi-turn code generation. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/OSU-NLP-Group/cobalt.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COBALT 把多轮代码生成视为一步可恢复的 MDP，用参考 LLM 的离线轨迹切成部分轨迹，再以单步代码生成完成各段的 contextual bandit 方式训练 LLM，避免在线 RL 的高成本与不稳。在 LiveCodeBench 上 R1-Distill 8B 与 Qwen3 8B 的 Pass@1 最多分别提升 9.0 和 6.2 个绝对百分点，追平 GRPO 与 VeRPO 两个多轮在线 RL 基线。
Motivation: 多轮代码生成通常靠在线 RL 训练，需要反复生成 rollout，成本高且训练不稳定；离线多轮轨迹尚未被有效复用。
Method: 先用参考 LLM 采集代码生成轨迹并切成部分轨迹；在线 bandit 学习阶段让被训 LLM 通过单步代码生成补全每个部分轨迹，即 COBALT（contextual bandit learning with offline trajectories）。另做基于扰动的 in-context reward hacking 分析。
Result: 在 LiveCodeBench 上，COBALT 使 R1-Distill 8B 与 Qwen3 8B 的 Pass@1 最多分别提升 9.0 和 6.2 个绝对百分点，并匹配两个使用 GRPO 与 VeRPO 的多轮在线 RL 基线；扰动分析显示其对误导性执行反馈的鲁棒性提高。
Conclusion: 把多轮代码生成当作一步可恢复 MDP、用离线轨迹做 bandit 训练，可以在少依赖在线 rollout 的情况下达到在线 RL 的多轮代码生成水平，并缓解 in-context reward hacking。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 先用参考 LLM 采集代码生成轨迹并切成部分轨迹；在线 bandit 学习阶段让被训 LLM 通过单步代码生成补全每个部分轨迹，即 COBALT（contextual bandit learning with offline trajectories）。另做基于扰动的 in-context reward hacking 分析。
summary_sections.result: 在 LiveCodeBench 上，COBALT 使 R1-Distill 8B 与 Qwen3 8B 的 Pass@1 最多分别提升 9.0 和 6.2 个绝对百分点，并匹配两个使用 GRPO 与 VeRPO 的多轮在线 RL 基线；扰动分析显示其对误导性执行反馈的鲁棒性提高。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把多轮代码生成当作一步可恢复 MDP、用离线轨迹做 bandit 训练，可以在少依赖在线 rollout 的情况下达到在线 RL 的多轮代码生成水平，并缓解 in-context reward hacking。

papers.title: Query-Guided Spatial-Temporal-Frequency Interaction for Music Audio-Visual Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Audio--Visual Question Answering (AVQA) is a challenging multimodal task that requires jointly reasoning over audio, visual, and textual information in a given video to answer natural language questions. Inspired by recent advances in Video QA, many existing AVQA approaches primarily focus on visual information processing, leveraging pre-trained models to extract object-level and motion-level representations. However, in those methods, the audio input is primarily treated as complementary to video analysis, and the textual question information contributes minimally to audio--visual understanding, as it is typically integrated only in the final stages of reasoning. To address these limitations, we propose a novel Query-guided Spatial--Temporal--Frequency (QSTar) interaction method, which effectively incorporates question-guided clues and exploits the distinctive frequency-domain characteristics of audio signals, alongside spatial and temporal perception, to enhance audio--visual understanding. Furthermore, we introduce a Query Context Reasoning (QCR) block inspired by prompting, which guides the model to focus more precisely on semantically relevant audio and visual features. Extensive experiments conducted on two AVQA benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method, achieving significant performance improvements over existing Audio QA, Visual QA, Video QA, and AVQA approaches. The code is released under https://github.com/lik1996/QSTar.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 QSTar：用问题引导的线索同时调制视觉的空间、时间与音频的频域特征，再加一个受 prompt 启发的 Query Context Reasoning (QCR) 块，把文本问题提前注入音视觉理解而非只在推理末端拼接。在两个 AVQA benchmark 上相对 Audio QA、Visual QA、Video QA 与 AVQA 现有方法均有明显提升。
Motivation: 现有 AVQA 方法把视觉当主干、音频当补充，文本问题通常只在推理最后阶段接入，导致问题信息对音视觉联合表征的约束太弱。
Method: QSTar 交互模块在空间、时间维度之外显式引入音频的频域特征，并用问题引导的线索 (question-guided clues) 联合调制三者；QCR 块借 prompt 思路生成查询上下文，使模型聚焦语义相关的音视觉特征。
Result: 在两个 AVQA benchmark 上，相对 Audio QA、Visual QA、Video QA 与 AVQA 现有方法取得显著性能提升；代码已开源至 github.com/lik1996/QSTar。
Conclusion: 把问题文本与音频频域信息在交互阶段就注入音视觉表征，比仅在末端融合更能提升 AVQA 答题效果。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Probabilistic Multi-Agent Aircraft Landing Time Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate and reliable aircraft landing time prediction is essential for effective resource allocation in air traffic management. However, the inherent uncertainty of aircraft trajectories and traffic flows poses significant challenges to both prediction accuracy and trustworthiness. Therefore, prediction models should not only provide point estimates of aircraft landing times but also the uncertainties associated with these predictions. Furthermore, aircraft trajectories are frequently influenced by the presence of nearby aircraft through air traffic control interventions such as radar vectoring. Consequently, landing time prediction models must account for multi-agent interactions in the airspace. In this work, we propose a probabilistic multi-agent aircraft landing time prediction framework that provides the landing times of multiple aircraft as distributions. We evaluate the proposed framework using an air traffic surveillance dataset collected from the terminal airspace of the Incheon International Airport in South Korea. The results demonstrate that the proposed model achieves higher prediction accuracy than the baselines and quantifies the associated uncertainties of its outcomes. In addition, the model uncovered underlying patterns in air traffic control through its attention scores, thereby enhancing explainability.
papers.comment: Revised version; experiments were rerun after correcting a data leakage issue
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出概率多智能体 (probabilistic multi-agent) 飞机落地时间预测框架，把多架飞机的落地时间作为分布输出，通过注意力机制显式建模空管雷达引导等邻机交互。在仁川国际机场终端区空管监视数据上，预测精度高于基线并给出不确定度，注意力分数还揭示了空管决策的潜在模式。
Motivation: 飞机轨迹与交通流本身不确定，点估计无法支撑空资源分配的可信度；而邻机受空管雷达引导相互影响，单机独立建模会丢掉这段交互信息。
Method: 框架以多智能体方式联合输出多架飞机落地时间的分布（而非单点），用注意力机制刻画邻机间由空管干预产生的交互，并以注意力分数提供可解释性；在仁川国际机场终端区的空管监视数据集上与基线对比评估。
Result: 在仁川国际机场终端区监视数据上，所提模型预测精度高于基线，同时给出结果的不确定度；注意力分数揭示了空中交通管制的潜在模式。arXiv 注记说明修正数据泄漏问题后实验已重跑。
Conclusion: 把落地时间当作带交互的分布来预测，既能提高精度、量化不确定度，又能通过注意力分数解释空管行为。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: HAFixAgent: History-Aware Agentic Program Repair
papers.abstract_en: Automated program repair (APR) has recently shifted toward large language models and agent-based systems, while prior work shows that repository history can help repair single-line bugs. We conduct a large-scale empirical study of whether, how much, and under what conditions repository history improves agentic APR beyond this setting. We present HAFixAgent, a history-aware program repair agent that injects blame-derived repository context into its repair loop. Across 854 Defects4J (Java) and 501 BugsInPy (Python) bugs, we first show that bug-relevant history is widely available. We then evaluate HAFixAgent across three base models under perfect fault localization. The best history heuristic improves over non-history from +4.4% on Defects4J and +1.1% on BugsInPy with the strongest model to as much as +64.3% with weaker models. HAFixAgent also outperforms RepairAgent by +56.6% and BIRCH-feedback by +47.1% on the strongest model, showing that it is a strong repair agent independent of history. The three history heuristics are complementary: each repairs a different subset of bugs, so their hybrid significantly repairs more bugs than non-history (McNemar's test, p < 0.001), and this advantage persists under realistic spectrum-based fault localization. Individual history heuristics are generally no more expensive than non-history in agent steps or tokens under either localization setting, while the hybrid costs roughly twice a single run in a cascade setting.
papers.comment: Evaluation: on both realistic spectrum-based fault localization and perfect fault localization Benchmarks: Defects4J and BugsInPy Subject LLMs: DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp, Qwen3-Coder-Next, and Devstral-Small-2
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HAFixAgent 把 blame 导出的仓库历史上下文注入 LLM 修复循环，在 854 个 Defects4J 与 501 个 BugsInPy bug 上检验历史对 agentic APR 的增益。最优历史启发式在完美故障定位下相对无历史提升 +4.4%（Defects4J）与 +1.1%（BugsInPy，最强模型），弱模型上最高 +64.3%；三种启发式互补，混合修复显著多于无历史（McNemar 检验 p < 0.001），且优势在真实 spectrum-based 定位下保持。
Motivation: 已有工作只证明仓库历史能修单行 bug，而 agentic APR 中历史在多大范围、什么条件下带来增益尚无大规模证据。
Method: 提出 HAFixAgent，将 blame 派生的仓库上下文注入修复循环，比较三种历史启发式及其混合；在 Defects4J（Java）与 BugsInPy（Python）上，用 DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp、Qwen3-Coder-Next、Devstral-Small-2 三个模型，分别在完美故障定位与 spectrum-based 故障定位下评测，并与 RepairAgent、BIRCH-feedback 对比。
Result: 854 个 Defects4J 与 501 个 BugsInPy bug 中 bug 相关历史广泛存在；完美定位下最优历史启发式相对无历史在 Defects4J 提升 +4.4%、BugsInPy +1.1%（最强模型），弱模型上最高 +64.3%；最强模型上 HAFixAgent 超过 RepairAgent +56.6%、BIRCH-feedback +47.1%；混合启发式显著多修 bug（McNemar 检验 p < 0.001），优势在真实 spectrum-based 定位下保持；单个启发式的 agent 步数与 token 开销一般不高于无历史，混合级联约为单次运行的两倍。
Conclusion: 仓库历史对 agentic APR 有稳定但幅度依赖模型强度的增益，三种历史启发式互补应混合使用；HAFixAgent 本身也是不依赖历史的强修复 agent。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: A Theory of the Mechanics of Information: Generalization Through Measurement of Uncertainty (Learning is Measuring)
papers.abstract_en: Traditional machine learning relies on explicit models and domain assumptions, often limiting flexibility and interpretability. We introduce a "model-free" framework of instance-based learning using surprisal (information theoretic uncertainty) to directly analyze and perform inferences from raw data, eliminating distribution modeling, reducing bias, and enabling efficient updates including direct edits and deletion of training data. By quantifying relevance through uncertainty, the approach enables generalizable inference across tasks including generative inference, causal discovery, anomaly detection, and time series forecasting. Our approach emphasizes traceability, interpretability, and data-driven decision making, offering a unified, human-understandable framework for machine learning, can be adapted to virtually all machine learning tasks, achieving competency across all and state-of-the-art performance on anomaly detection and some supervised tasks. The mathematical foundations create a "physics" of information, which enable these techniques to apply effectively to a wide variety of complex data types, including missing data. Our results suggest that this may be a viable foundation upon which to build scalable machine learning and artificial intelligence that can maintain human understandability of the underlying mechanics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于 surprisal（信息论不确定性）的免模型实例学习框架，直接从原始数据做推理，无需显式分布建模，并支持对训练数据的直接编辑与删除。该框架覆盖生成推理、因果发现、异常检测与时序预测等任务，作者称在异常检测和部分监督任务上达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: 传统机器学习依赖显式模型与领域假设，限制了灵活性与可解释性，且训练数据难以直接编辑或删除。
Method: 以 surprisal 度量实例不确定性并据此量化相关性，构建免分布建模的实例推理框架；数学基础被作者称为信息的 physics，可处理含缺失数据的复杂数据类型。
Result: 无具体数值；定性结论为框架可跨生成推理、因果发现、异常检测、时序预测等任务泛化，并在异常检测和部分监督任务上达到 state-of-the-art。
Conclusion: 以不确定性度量为核心的免模型学习可作为可扩展、且保持人类可理解性的机器学习与 AI 基础。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: ABLEIST: Intersectional Disability Bias in LLM-Generated Hiring Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly under scrutiny for perpetuating identity-based discrimination in high-stakes domains such as hiring, particularly against people with disabilities (PwD). However, existing research remains largely Western-centric, overlooking how intersecting forms of marginalization--such as gender and caste--shape experiences of PwD in the Global South. We conduct a comprehensive audit of six LLMs across 2,820 hiring scenarios spanning diverse disability, gender, nationality, and caste profiles. To capture subtle intersectional harms and biases, we introduce ABLEIST (Ableism, Inspiration, Superhumanization, and Tokenism), a set of five ableism-specific and three intersectional harm metrics grounded in disability studies literature. Our results reveal significant increases in ABLEIST harms towards disabled candidates--harms that many state-of-the-art models failed to detect. These harms were further amplified by sharp increases in intersectional harms (e.g., Tokenism) for gender and caste-marginalized disabled candidates, highlighting critical blind spots in current safety tools and the need for intersectional safety evaluations of frontier models in high-stakes domains like hiring.
papers.comment: To appear at AIES 2026. Please cite AIES version when the proceedings are available
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ABLEIST 对六个 LLM 的 2,820 个招聘场景做交叉性残障偏见审计，提出 5 项残障主义与 3 项交叉性伤害指标。结果显示面向残障候选人的伤害显著上升，且性别与种姓边缘化叠加时（如 Tokenism）进一步放大，而多数前沿模型的安全工具检测不到这些伤害。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 招聘偏见研究以西方为中心，忽略 Global South 中性别、种姓与残障的交叉边缘化，且现有安全工具对这类细微交叉伤害存在盲区。
Method: 审计六个 LLM，覆盖 2,820 个组合了残障、性别、国籍与种姓画像的招聘场景；提出 ABLEIST 指标集（Ableism、Inspiration、Superhumanization、Tokenism），含 5 项残障主义专属指标与 3 项交叉性伤害指标，均依据残障研究文献构建。
Result: 面向残障候选人的 ABLEIST 伤害显著上升；性别与种姓边缘化的残障候选人遭受的交叉性伤害（如 Tokenism）进一步急剧上升；多数 SOTA 模型未能检测到这些伤害。
Conclusion: 前沿模型在招聘这类高风险领域存在交叉性安全盲区，需要针对边缘化交叉画像做专门的安全评估。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 前沿模型在招聘这类高风险领域存在交叉性安全盲区，需要针对边缘化交叉画像做专门的安全评估。

papers.title: Discovering Phase Space Structure in Learned Hamiltonian Systems
papers.abstract_en: Mechanics-inspired neural dynamical models improve interpretability and physical consistency, but they usually assume a known configuration space, fixed physical parameters, and deterministic prediction from a prescribed initial condition. We introduce Structured Phase Space GAN (SPS-GAN), a conditional generative model that learns structured dynamics from both Cartesian trajectories and video. SPS-GAN combines a port-Hamiltonian backbone with adversarial conditional generation, allowing conservative, dissipative, and forced systems to be represented in a single architecture. To infer latent mechanical structure from raw observations, we use a cyclic-coordinate loss that recovers both the system degrees of freedom and canonical coordinates without access to the true phase space. Experiments on simulated and real-world systems show that SPS-GAN improves trajectory accuracy over supervised dynamics baselines and video consistency over generative baselines, while consistently recovering the correct latent mechanical coordinates across observation modalities and dynamical regimes.
papers.comment: Accept to The 40th Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Camera-ready to come
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Structured Phase Space GAN (SPS-GAN)：以 port-Hamiltonian 为骨干的条件生成模型，可从笛卡尔轨迹和视频两类观测中同时学习保守、耗散与受迫系统，并用 cyclic-coordinate loss 在不接触真实相空间的前提下恢复自由度与正则坐标。在模拟与真实系统实验中，它相对监督动力学基线提高轨迹精度、相对生成基线提高视频一致性，并在不同观测模态与动力学机制下稳定恢复正确的隐含力学坐标。
Motivation: 力学启发的神经动力学模型通常预设已知位形空间、固定物理参数和给定初值下的确定性预测，无法从原始观测中反推隐含的相空间结构。
Method: SPS-GAN 用 port-Hamiltonian 骨干结合对抗式条件生成，把保守、耗散与受迫系统统一进一个架构；训练时加入 cyclic-coordinate loss，从原始观测（笛卡尔轨迹与视频）中同时辨识系统自由度与正则坐标，无需真实相空间标签。
Result: 在模拟与真实系统上，SPS-GAN 相对监督动力学基线提升轨迹精度，相对生成基线提升视频一致性，并在多种观测模态与动力学机制下一致恢复出正确的隐含力学坐标。
Conclusion: 力学结构可以直接从原始观测中被推断出来，且统一的 port-Hamiltonian 条件生成架构能同时覆盖保守、耗散与受迫系统而不牺牲跨模态的坐标恢复。

papers.title: Regression-adjusted Monte Carlo Estimators for Shapley Values and Probabilistic Values
papers.abstract_en: With origins in game theory, probabilistic values like Shapley values, Banzhaf values, and semi-values have emerged as a central tool in explainable AI. They are used for feature attribution, data attribution, data valuation, and more. Since exact computation can require exponential time, research has focused on efficient approximation methods using two techniques: Monte Carlo sampling and linear regression formulations. In this work, we present a new way of combining both of these techniques. Our approach is more flexible than prior algorithms, allowing for linear regression to be replaced with any function family whose probabilistic values can be computed efficiently. This allows us to harness the accuracy of tree-based models like XGBoost; with cross-fitting, the method also produces unbiased estimates. From experiments across eight datasets, we find that our methods give state-of-the-art performance for estimating probabilistic values. For Shapley values, the error of our methods can be $11\times$ lower than Permutation SHAP (the most popular Monte Carlo method), $6.5\times$ lower than Kernel SHAP (the most popular linear regression method), and $3.4\times$ lower than Leverage SHAP (the prior state-of-the-art Shapley value estimator). For more general probabilistic values, we can obtain error $390\times$ lower than the best estimator from prior work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出把 Monte Carlo 抽样与回归结合的新框架，用任意可高效计算 probabilistic values 的函数族（如 XGBoost）替代线性回归，配合 cross-fitting 得到无偏估计。在八个数据集上，对 Shapley values 的误差比 Permutation SHAP 低 11×、比 Kernel SHAP 低 6.5×、比 Leverage SHAP 低 3.4×，对更一般的 probabilistic values 误差比既有最优估计量低 390×。
Motivation: Shapley、Banzhaf 等 probabilistic values 精确计算需指数时间，现有近似只沿 Monte Carlo 抽样与线性回归两条路线各自发展，精度受限。
Method: 将 Monte Carlo 抽样与回归估计统一为一个更灵活的框架：回归环节可替换为任意能高效计算 probabilistic values 的函数族，从而接入 XGBoost 等树模型；用 cross-fitting 保证估计无偏。
Result: 八个数据集实验显示达到 state-of-the-art：Shapley value 误差较 Permutation SHAP 低 11×、较 Kernel SHAP 低 6.5×、较 Leverage SHAP 低 3.4×；对更一般的 probabilistic values，误差较既有最优估计量低 390×。
Conclusion: 把回归环节从线性模型放开到任意可高效求值的函数族，是提升 probabilistic values 估计精度的更优路径，且 cross-fitting 可同时保住无偏性。

papers.title: UniConFlow: A Unified Constrained Flow-Matching Framework for Certified Motion Planning
papers.abstract_en: Generative models have become increasingly powerful tools for robot motion generation, enabling flexible and multimodal trajectory generation across various tasks. Yet, most existing approaches remain limited in handling multiple types of constraints, such as collision avoidance, actuation limits, and dynamic consistency, which are typically addressed individually or heuristically. In this work, we propose UniConFlow, a unified constrained flow matching-based framework for trajectory generation that systematically incorporates both equality and inequality constraints. Moreover, UniConFlow introduces a novel prescribed-time zeroing function that shapes a time-varying guidance field during inference, allowing the generation process to adapt to varying system models and task requirements. Furthermore, to further address the computational challenges of long-horizon and high-dimensional trajectory generation, we propose two practical strategies for the terminal constraint enforcement and inference process: a violation-segment extraction protocol that precisely localizes and refines only the constraint-violating portions of trajectories, and a trajectory compression method that accelerates optimization in a reduced-dimensional space while preserving high-fidelity reconstruction after decoding. Empirical validation across three experiments, including a double inverted pendulum, a real-to-sim car racing task, and a sim-to-real manipulation task, demonstrates that UniConFlow outperforms state-of-the-art generative planners and conventional optimization baselines, achieving superior performance on certified motion planning metrics such as safety, kinodynamic consistency, and action feasibility. Project page is available at: https://uniconflow.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniConFlow 把等式与不等式约束统一写进 flow matching 轨迹生成，并用 prescribed-time zeroing 函数在推理期塑造时变引导场，使生成过程适配不同系统模型与任务。再以 violation-segment extraction 只精修违反约束的轨迹段、以轨迹压缩在降维空间加速优化，最终在双倒立摆、真车模拟赛车与 sim-to-real 操作三项实验上超过生成式规划器与传统优化基线。
Motivation: 机器人运动生成的生成模型在多类约束（避障、执行器限幅、动力学一致性）上通常逐个或启发式处理，难以统一纳入；长时域高维轨迹的生成还带来计算压力。
Method: 基于 constrained flow matching 的统一轨迹生成框架：同时纳入等式与不等式约束，用 prescribed-time zeroing 函数在推理期塑造时变引导场；配合 violation-segment extraction protocol 定位并只精修违反约束的轨迹段，以及轨迹压缩在降维空间加速优化、解码后保持高保真重建。
Result: 在三项实验（double inverted pendulum、real-to-sim car racing、sim-to-real manipulation）上，UniConFlow 超过 state-of-the-art 生成式规划器与传统优化基线，在 certified motion planning 指标 safety、kinodynamic consistency、action feasibility 上取得更优表现。
Conclusion: 把多类约束统一进 flow matching 并配合分段精修与轨迹压缩，可在保持安全、动力学一致性与动作可行性的前提下完成长时域高维轨迹生成。

papers.title: Optimizable Model Averaging for Ensembling Heterogeneous Model Outputs
papers.abstract_en: Foundation model ensembles can improve accuracy and robustness, but full fine-tuning and parameter-space merging are often expensive or impossible when candidate models have different architectures. We propose Optimizable Model Averaging (OMA), a black-box approach that learns nonnegative model-combination weights, one scalar coefficient per model, to average the candidate models' predictive probabilities, leaving all model parameters frozen, by minimizing regularized predictive entropy. A central challenge is that minimizing predictive entropy can favour confidently incorrect models: increased confidence need not imply improved accuracy or calibration. We therefore examine regularization as a mechanism for controlling adaptation and empirically evaluate its effect on calibration, observing lower expected calibration error in selected configurations, alongside better performance-calibration trade-offs than model output averaging. As foundation models continue to advance, these approaches will enable the incorporation of future, potentially much better models to improve performance on challenging text and image classification tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Optimizable Model Averaging (OMA)：对异构架构的候选基础模型只学每模型一个非负标量权重，冻结全部参数，通过最小化带正则的预测熵来平均预测概率。正则用于抑制“最小化预测熵偏向自信但错误的模型”这一失效模式，选定配置下期望校准误差 (ECE) 更低，且性能-校准权衡优于直接的模型输出平均。
Motivation: 候选模型架构不同时，全量微调与参数空间合并昂贵或不可行；而单纯最小化预测熵会奖励自信错误的模型，置信度上升不等于精度或校准改善。
Method: 黑盒方法 OMA：每个候选模型学一个非负标量组合系数，模型参数全部冻结，对预测概率做加权平均，目标为带正则的预测熵；以正则强度控制对基础模型的适应程度，并考察其对校准的影响。
Result: 在选定正则配置下观察到更低的期望校准误差 (ECE)，相对模型输出平均 (model output averaging) 给出更好的性能-校准权衡；任务为文本与图像分类。
Conclusion: 冻结参数、只优化组合权重加正则化预测熵，可在异构基础模型上同时改善精度与校准，并便于后续接入更强的新模型。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Auditing Prompt Injection Defenses Before They Reach Users: What Strong Adversaries Reveal
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly deployed in user-facing products that handle sensitive personal data while interacting with untrusted external content. This makes them a prime target for prompt injection attacks, in which an adversary injects malicious instructions in that content to hijack the model. Fine-tuning-based defenses have been proposed to mitigate these attacks by training models to follow benign user instructions and ignore injected ones. Lacking formal guarantees, these defenses are evaluated empirically against the most effective realistic attacks available at the time, often reporting near-zero attack success rates -- giving developers, and the users who depend on them, a false sense of security and leaving open the possibility that future, more capable attacks could circumvent them and cause severe consequences in widely deployed systems. In this paper, we argue that developers should stress-test their defenses before release, and we introduce an auditing framework that does so without requiring defenders to invent the next state-of-the-art attack. Our key insight is that the fine-tuning process itself yields useful artifacts: intermediate checkpoints that serve as stepping stones for optimization-based attacks. Although these artifacts are unavailable to real attackers, we show that the vulnerabilities they expose are genuine and can be exploited by realistic adversaries. Instantiating our framework with optimization-based attacks such as GCG and BEAST, we raise attack success rates against state-of-the-art defenses from near zero to as high as 96\%, revealing weaknesses missed by prior evaluations. Our results show that current evaluation practices can substantially overestimate robustness, and that auditing defenses under strong adversaries before deployment shortens the feedback loop and helps prevent attacks from causing real-world harm to users.
papers.comment: Published as a workshop paper (oral) at HAIPS@COLM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对基于微调的 prompt injection 防御缺乏形式化保证、只在当时最强攻击下报出接近零成功率的问题，提出发布前审计框架：把微调过程的中间 checkpoint 当作优化式攻击（GCG、BEAST）的跳板。对 SOTA 防御的攻击成功率从接近零被抬到最高 96%，说明现有评测实践会大幅高估鲁棒性。
Motivation: 面向用户的 LLM 会处理敏感个人数据并接触不可信外部内容，微调式防御只靠当时可得的攻击做经验评测，接近零的 ASR 给开发者和用户虚假安全感，未来更强的攻击可能绕过。
Method: 审计框架利用微调过程自身产物——中间 checkpoint——作为优化式攻击的起点；实例化为 GCG 与 BEAST 两类优化式攻击，对 SOTA 防御做发布前压力测试，无需防御者自行发明下一代攻击。
Result: 对 SOTA 防御的攻击成功率从接近零升至最高 96%（GCG、BEAST 实例化），暴露先前评测漏掉的弱点。
Conclusion: 当前评测实践会大幅高估防御鲁棒性；在部署前用强对手审计防御能缩短反馈回路，防止攻击对真实用户造成伤害。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mechanisms of Multimodal Synchronization: Insights from Decoder-Based Video-Text-to-Speech Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Unified decoder-only transformers have shown promise for multimodal generation, yet how sequence design affects synchronization across modalities with heterogeneous sampling rates remains underexplored. We investigate this through video-text-to-speech (VTTS) synthesis, a controlled task requiring fine-grained temporal alignment between sparse text, video, and continuous speech. Using Visatronic, a unified decoder-only transformer trained on VoxCeleb2, we examine complementary modality contributions, positional encoding strategies, the effects of modality ordering on in-domain performance and cross-domain transfer, and phoneme-level timing errors. Global sequential indexing, which assigns position IDs in concatenation order, and co-temporal ordered indexing, which assigns identical IDs to temporally corresponding video and speech tokens, achieve comparable in-domain synchronization. Under domain shift, however, synchronization depends on the interaction between token ordering and position-ID design. Text-first co-temporal indexing transfers most robustly among the evaluated variants without requiring explicit timestamp metadata. Text and video provide complementary signals: text supports intelligibility, while video contributes temporal cues and emotional expressiveness. Modality ordering also introduces a trade-off: video-first ordering achieves stronger in-domain performance, whereas text-first ordering generalizes more robustly among the timestamp-informed prefix variants. Training on diverse, in-the-wild data is associated with more transferable behavior, although isolating its contribution requires targeted ablations. We introduce TimeSync, a phoneme-level synchronization metric that reveals temporal misalignments overlooked by frame-level metrics. Together, these findings establish VTTS as a testbed for understanding temporal synchronization in unified multimodal decoders.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在统一 decoder-only 多模态生成中，序列设计如何影响异构采样率模态间的同步尚不清楚。以 Visatronic（VoxCeleb2 训练的 video-text-to-speech 模型）为受控任务，发现域内时全局顺序索引与共时索引同步相当，但域外迁移时同步取决于 token 排序与 position-ID 设计的交互：text-first 共时索引在不依赖显式时间戳元数据的前提下迁移最稳。
Motivation: 统一 decoder-only transformer 做多模态生成时，稀疏文本、视频与连续语音采样率差异大，序列设计（模态排序、position-ID）如何影响跨模态时间同步缺乏系统研究。
Method: 用 Visatronic 在 VoxCeleb2 上训练，对比全局顺序索引 (global sequential indexing) 与共时有序索引 (co-temporal ordered indexing)，考察模态贡献、模态排序（video-first vs text-first）对域内性能与跨域迁移的影响，并提出音素级同步指标 TimeSync。
Result: 全局顺序索引与共时有序索引在域内同步上表现相当；域外迁移时 text-first 共时索引在所评估变体中最稳健，且无需显式时间戳元数据。文本支撑可懂度，视频贡献时序线索与情感表现力；video-first 域内更强，text-first 在带时间戳前缀变体中泛化更稳。TimeSync 能揭示帧级指标忽略的音素级时间错位。
Conclusion: VTTS 可作为理解统一多模态 decoder 中时间同步的受控试验台；域外同步由 token 排序与 position-ID 设计共同决定，而非单一索引方案。野外多样数据与可迁移行为相关，但其独立贡献需专门消融。

papers.title: Provably Accurate Shapley Value Estimation via Leverage Score Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Originally introduced in game theory, Shapley values have emerged as a central tool in explainable machine learning, where they are used to attribute model predictions to specific input features. However, computing Shapley values exactly is expensive: for a general model with $n$ features, $O(2^n)$ model evaluations are necessary. To address this issue, approximation algorithms are widely used. One of the most popular is the Kernel SHAP algorithm, which is model agnostic and remarkably effective in practice. At the time of our original submission, no strong non-asymptotic complexity guarantees were known for Kernel SHAP. We address this issue by introducing Leverage SHAP, a lightweight modification of Kernel SHAP that provides provably accurate Shapley value estimates with just $O(n\log n)$ model evaluations. Our approach takes advantage of a connection between Shapley value estimation and agnostic active learning by employing leverage score sampling, a powerful regression tool. Beyond theoretical guarantees, we find that Leverage SHAP achieves an approximately $50\%$ reduction in error compared to the highly optimized implementation of Kernel SHAP in the widely used SHAP library [Lundberg & Lee, 2017].
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Leverage SHAP：对 Kernel SHAP 做轻量改造，用 leverage score sampling 从 Shapley 值估计与 agnostic active learning 的联系出发，把精确计算所需的 O(2^n) 次模型评估降到 O(n log n) 次并给出非渐近精度保证。在广泛使用的 SHAP 库（Lundberg & Lee, 2017）高度优化的 Kernel SHAP 实现上，误差约降低 50%。
Motivation: 精确计算 n 个特征的 Shapley 值需要 O(2^n) 次模型评估，实践中只能依赖近似算法；而 Kernel SHAP 虽然常用，在原投稿时缺少强的非渐近复杂度保证。
Method: Leverage SHAP 对 Kernel SHAP 做轻量修改，利用 Shapley 值估计与 agnostic active learning 的对应关系，采用回归中的 leverage score sampling 选取需要评估的模型子集，从而以 O(n log n) 次模型估计得到带理论保证的 Shapley 值。
Result: 模型评估复杂度从精确计算的 O(2^n) 降到 O(n log n)；相比 SHAP 库中高度优化的 Kernel SHAP 实现，误差约降低 50%。
Conclusion: 借助 leverage score sampling，Shapley 值可以在远少于指数次模型评估下达到可证明的精度，Kernel SHAP 缺少非渐近保证的问题由此被补上。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Linearized Wasserstein dimensionality reduction with approximation guarantees
papers.abstract_en: We introduce LOT Wassmap, a computationally feasible algorithm to uncover low-dimensional structures in the Wasserstein space. The algorithm is motivated by the observation that many datasets are naturally interpreted as probability measures rather than points in $\mathbb{R}^n$, and that finding low-dimensional descriptions of such datasets requires manifold learning algorithms in the Wasserstein space. Most available algorithms are based on computing the pairwise Wasserstein distance matrix, which can be computationally challenging for large datasets in high dimensions. Our algorithm leverages approximation schemes such as Sinkhorn distances and linearized optimal transport to speed-up computations, and in particular, avoids computing a pairwise distance matrix. We provide guarantees on the embedding quality under such approximations, including when explicit descriptions of the probability measures are not available and one must deal with finite samples instead. Experiments demonstrate that LOT Wassmap attains correct embeddings and that the quality improves with increased sample size. We also show how LOT Wassmap significantly reduces the computational cost when compared to algorithms that depend on pairwise distance computations.
papers.journal_ref: Applied and Computational Harmonic Analysis, 74 (2025), 101718
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Wasserstein 空间的降维算法 LOT Wassmap，用 Sinkhorn 距离与线性化最优传输 (linearized optimal transport, LOT) 近似替代成对 Wasserstein 距离矩阵，直接在概率测度数据上做流形学习。在近似与有限样本条件下给出嵌入质量保证，实验显示嵌入正确且随样本量增大而改善，同时相比依赖成对距离计算的算法显著降低计算开销。
Motivation: 许多数据集本质是概率测度而非 R^n 中的点，需要在 Wasserstein 空间做流形学习；但现有算法要先算成对 Wasserstein 距离矩阵，在高维大数据上计算代价过高。
Method: LOT Wassmap 用 Sinkhorn 距离与线性化最优传输近似加速计算，绕开成对距离矩阵的显式构造；在测度无显式描述、只能拿到有限样本的情形下也给出嵌入质量的理论保证。
Result: 实验中 LOT Wassmap 得到正确嵌入，且嵌入质量随样本量增加而提升；相比依赖成对距离计算的算法显著降低计算开销。
Conclusion: 借助 Sinkhorn 与 LOT 近似可在不构造距离矩阵的前提下完成 Wasserstein 空间降维，并保有嵌入质量保证与计算效率优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CircuitTree: Composing Circuits into A Syllable Transcriber
papers.abstract_en: The goal of circuit discovery is to decompose a monolithic neural network into tiny modular subnetworks which are interpretable in the sense that each does an identifiable subtask. We develop a practical method for composing arbitrarily many circuits into a single model. We propose a greedy, density-scaled composition algorithm that overcomes limitations of previous attempts to compose circuits by naive union, then generalize it to $N$ circuits via CircuitTree, a new data structure built on a $Θ(N\log N)$ tree-compose schedule. We compose circuits pruned from HuBERT for classifying individual phonemes into a syllable classifier, a capability none of the 39 phoneme circuits has individually. Chaining CircuitTrees into a hierarchy-of-circuits pipeline, we transcribe open syllables at 64.8\% accuracy, within 1.2 points of a 66.0\% ceiling that shares no circuitry at all, with 99.5\% of circuit components shared.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CircuitTree 用贪心、密度缩放的组合算法把任意多个电路 (circuit) 拼成单一模型，并以 Θ(N log N) 的 tree-compose 调度推广到 N 个电路。把从 HuBERT 剪枝出的 39 个音素电路组合成音节分类器后，开音节转写准确率 64.8%，距完全不共享电路的 66.0% 上限仅 1.2 个百分点，同时共享 99.5% 的电路组件。
Motivation: 电路发现 (circuit discovery) 想把整体网络拆成可解释的小模块，但此前用朴素并集 (naive union) 组合电路的做法受限，且单个音素电路不具备音节分类这类组合能力。
Method: 提出贪心、密度缩放的电路组合算法，克服朴素并集的局限；再以 CircuitTree 数据结构和 Θ(N log N) 的 tree-compose 调度推广到 N 个电路，并把多个 CircuitTree 串成 hierarchy-of-circuits 流水线。
Result: 从 HuBERT 剪枝出 39 个单音素分类电路，组合后获得单个电路都不具备的音节分类能力；开音节转写准确率 64.8%，与完全不共享电路的 66.0% 上限相差 1.2 个百分点，电路组件共享率 99.5%。
Conclusion: 电路可以被组合成具备新能力的更大模型，且共享绝大部分组件时性能接近完全独立电路的上限。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Looking Under the Streetlight: Evaluation in Generative Molecular Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: This position paper argues that the generative molecular dynamics (GenMD) community is not properly evaluating its progress: current evaluations let a model match what is reported while being arbitrarily wrong on what was claimed, which risks over-claiming advantage over classical baselines. This reflects a structural misalignment between common evaluation practices and the scientific tasks the field sets for itself. The reason is that the ground truth---exhaustive molecular dynamics on the systems of interest---is computationally costly, and this cost is what motivates the field. With ground truth inaccessible, evaluation drifts toward convenient proxies, and the resulting norms entrench easily. We identify misaligned evaluation patterns that persist as a community-level equilibrium, and propose concrete observables, reporting standards, and benchmark designs, both computational and experimental, that better reflect what GenMD aspires to deliver. Our aim is to give the field shared language and tools for evaluation that match its scientific ambitions before today's conventions calcify into norms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 生成式分子动力学 (GenMD) 的现有评测让模型在被报告的量上对齐、在被声称的性质上却可以任意错误，从而高估相对经典基线的优势。作者把这归因于穷举 MD 作为 ground truth 计算代价过高、评测被迫退向方便的代理量，并提出可观测量、报告规范与计算+实验两类 benchmark 设计来纠正。
Motivation: GenMD 的科学目标与评测实践结构性错位：ground truth（对目标体系做穷举分子动力学）代价高昂，正是该领域存在的理由，评测因此滑向代理指标并固化成社区均衡。
Method: 作为 position paper，先识别作为社区级均衡而持续存在的错位评测模式，再提出具体的可观测量、报告标准，以及计算与实验两类 benchmark 设计，为领域提供共享的评测语言与工具。
Result: 指出当前评测存在可构造的失效：模型能匹配报告量而在声称性质上任意错误，进而可能过度声称优于经典基线；论文给出错位模式清单与配套可观测量、报告规范和 benchmark 设计。
Conclusion: 评测规范应在惯例固化为标准之前与 GenMD 的科学雄心对齐，否则代理指标会把过度声称锁进社区规范。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: TerraAgent: Demonstration-Grounded Multi-Agent Reasoning for Long-Context Remote Sensing Visual Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing visual question answering (RS-VQA) requires answers that truly depend on image evidence, yet current remote sensing multimodal large language models (RS MLLMs) are still evaluated mainly by accuracy, which cannot reveal whether a correct answer was produced without using the image. This setting introduces three challenges: demonstrations retrieved across different ground sample distances (GSD), sensors, and city textures may be poorly matched; real queries often involve long visual contexts from multi-scale tiles, multi-temporal frames, and retrieved knowledge, where evidence can be diluted and errors can propagate through multi-step reasoning; and prior-only answering remains invisible to standard metrics. We present AVA, a training-free framework that wraps a frozen RS MLLM with three modules. GDR performs GSD-bucketed, scene-graph-based demonstration retrieval and filters demonstrations whose answers are unsupported by their images. MACE decomposes each query into an evidence-typed sub-question DAG, routes sub-questions to suitable perception tools, and records verified provenance in a shared evidence ledger with bounded re-perception. CVA audits the final answer through counterfactual perturbations of cited evidence, including ablation and swap, and computes a visual-dependency score for confidence calibration and evidence-forcing re-query. On RSVQA-LR/HR, VRSBench, and LHRS-Bench, AVA improves average accuracy by up to 2.40 points over the strongest same-setting baselines, raises the visual-dependency score from 0.28 to 0.49, reduces the prior-only answer rate from 46.2 percent to 21.7 percent, and lowers the hallucination rate from 17.1 percent to 9.8 percent, with 2.6x the cost of a single backbone forward pass and no fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AVA 是一个免训练的遥感 VQA 框架，用 GSD 分桶的示例检索、证据类型子问题 DAG 分解与反事实证据审计，逼迫答案真正依赖图像。在 RSVQA-LR/HR、VRSBench、LHRS-Bench 上平均精度最多提升 2.40 点，视觉依赖分从 0.28 升到 0.49，prior-only 回答率从 46.2% 降到 21.7%，幻觉率从 17.1% 降到 9.8%。
Motivation: RS MLLM 只用准确率评测，无法区分答案是否真的用了图像证据；跨 GSD、传感器、城市场景纹理检索的示例可能错配，长视觉上下文（多尺度瓦片、多时相帧、检索知识）中证据被稀释且多步推理会传播错误。
Method: AVA 包裹冻结的 RS MLLM，含三个模块：GDR 做 GSD 分桶、基于 scene-graph 的示例检索并过滤图像不支持其答案的示例；MACE 把查询分解为带证据类型的子问题 DAG，将子问题路由到感知工具并在共享 evidence ledger 中记录可核验 provenance，带受限重感知；CVA 对引用证据做反事实扰动（ablation 与 swap）审计最终答案，计算 visual-dependency score 用于置信度校准与 evidence-forcing 重查询。

papers.title: TraceICL: Thread-Resolved Demonstration Curation with Consistency Calibration for Robust Multimodal In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: Interleaved multimodal in-context learning (ICL) lets frozen large vision-language models (LVLMs) acquire new tasks from a handful of image-text-answer demonstrations, yet it remains fragile: demonstrations bind to the wrong images, redundant exemplars crowd out informative ones, and noisy answers are copied verbatim into predictions. We present AVA, a training-free framework that organizes the demonstration pipeline of multimodal ICL into three composable stages. A Thread-Resolved Decomposer (TRD) segments the interleaved context into per-sample threads and re-stitches them with explicit boundaries, restoring image-text binding. An Influence-scored Demonstration Selector (IDS) estimates each candidate's marginal influence with one extra forward pass, removes redundancy, and orders the survivors by descending value. A Weak-to-Strong Consistency Calibration (WSC) module scores each demonstration by a weak sibling model's reconstruction confidence and softly reweights its contribution during decoding. On five vision-language benchmarks with interleaved 4-shot prompts, AVA improves the strongest same-setting baseline by +1.7 points on average, with gains of up to +2.4 points on VizWiz, shrinks the require-visual performance gap on ScienceQA-IMG, and retains most of its gain under 30% noisy demonstrations, at a 26% latency overhead that an offline cache amortizes. No gradients are ever computed; the LVLM stays frozen.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AVA 是免训练的多模态上下文学习 (multimodal ICL) 演示编排框架，把演示流水线拆成 TRD、IDS、WSC 三个可组合阶段：TRD 按样本线程切分交错上下文并显式边界重拼以恢复图文绑定，IDS 用一次额外前向估计边际影响并去冗余排序，WSC 用弱孪生模型的重建置信度软重加权演示。在五个视觉-语言基准的交错 4-shot 提示上，AVA 平均比同设置最强基线高 1.7 分，VizWiz 上最高 +2.4 分。
Motivation: 冻结 LVLM 的交错多模态 ICL 很脆弱：演示绑定到错误图像、冗余样例挤占有信息量的样例、噪声答案被逐字复制进预测，而现有做法缺少对演示流水线的分阶段控制。
Method: AVA 全程不计算梯度、LVLM 保持冻结，含三个模块：Thread-Resolved Decomposer (TRD) 把交错上下文切成逐样本线程并带显式边界重拼；Influence-scored Demonstration Selector (IDS) 用一次额外前向估计候选边际影响、去冗余并按价值降序排列；Weak-to-Strong Consistency Calibration (WSC) 按弱孪生模型的重建置信度给每个演示打分并在解码时软重加权。
Result: 在五个视觉-语言基准、交错 4-shot 提示下，AVA 平均比同设置最强基线 +1.7 分，VizWiz 上最高 +2.4 分，缩小了 ScienceQA-IMG 的需视觉 (require-visual) 性能差距；在 30% 噪声演示下保留大部分增益，延迟开销 26%，可用离线缓存摊销。

papers.title: CORAL-KV: Compact Cross-Layer Prediction and Residual Coding for Autoregressive Video KV Caches
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive video diffusion models maintain a growing attention key-value (KV) cache, making memory a key bottleneck for long video generation. Recently, clustering-based quantization has emerged as an effective method to compress video KV caches by grouping similar key and value vectors then quantizing residual errors. However, when later frames attend to the compressed history, small reconstruction errors can compound as the video grows. Beyond the within-layer similarity exploited by clustering, we find strong dependencies across cache layers in video models. This motivates Coral-KV - Calibrated Offline, Residual-coded, and Adapted Locally - a KV-cache compression framework that uses cache states in each layer to predict keys and values in subsequent layers, then quantizes the remaining prediction residuals. We construct compact block-diagonal-plus-low-rank (block-DPLR) predictors: block-diagonal components model channel relationships within each attention head, while a global low-rank term models dependencies between heads. Coral-KV exposes a flexible fidelity-memory trade-off: it can reuse its predictors across videos or refit lightweight block-diagonal predictors to the current video for higher fidelity. Across extensive evaluations on both HY-WorldPlay and MAGI-1, our reusable configuration improves PSNR over QVG-4 by 0.32 dB and 4.95 dB, respectively, while using 48% and 37% less cache memory. Against QVG-Pro, our video-adapted configuration improves MAGI-1 PSNR by 3.77 dB while using 33.7% less cache memory. Coral-KV also maintains higher reconstruction fidelity over extended generation and reduces temporal discontinuities while retaining comparable generation latency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Coral-KV 用跨层预测加残差编码压缩自回归视频扩散模型的 KV cache：先用每层缓存状态预测后续层的 key/value，再对预测残差量化，预测器采用 block-diagonal-plus-low-rank (block-DPLR) 结构。在 HY-WorldPlay 与 MAGI-1 上，可复用配置相对 QVG-4 分别以少 48% 和 37% 缓存内存换来 PSNR 提升 0.32 dB 与 4.95 dB；视频适配配置在 MAGI-1 上比 QVG-Pro 高 3.77 dB 且少用 33.7% 缓存内存。
Motivation: 视频扩散模型的 KV cache 随生成长度不断增长，成为长视频生成的内存瓶颈；聚类量化只利用层内相似度，后帧注意被压缩历史时小的重建误差会随视频增长累积。
Method: Coral-KV 分三步：Calibrated Offline 用每层缓存状态预测后续层 key/value，Residual-coded 对预测残差量化，Adapted Locally 可复用预测器或针对当前视频重拟合轻量 block-diagonal 预测器。block-DPLR 预测器中 block-diagonal 分量建模单个 attention head 内的通道关系，全局 low-rank 项建模 head 间依赖，从而给出保真度与内存的可调折中。
Result: 在 HY-WorldPlay 与 MAGI-1 上，可复用配置 PSNR 分别比 QVG-4 高 0.32 dB 与 4.95 dB，缓存内存分别少 48% 与 37%；视频适配配置在 MAGI-1 上比 QVG-Pro 的 PSNR 高 3.77 dB，缓存内存少 33.7%。Coral-KV 在更长生成中保持更高重建保真度、减少时间不连续，且生成延迟相当。
Conclusion: 跨层依赖（而不只是层内聚类）是视频 KV cache 压缩的有效信号源，block-DPLR 预测加残差量化能在更少缓存内存下提高重建保真度，并允许在跨视频复用与逐视频重拟合之间按需取舍。

papers.title: Where should the null live? Surrogate tests for clustering of threshold-derived air-quality indices, with application to PM2.5 exceedances in Chile
papers.abstract_en: Air-quality and climate monitoring routinely convert native-resolution measurements into exceedance counts before testing whether high values cluster in time. A surrogate null can be imposed on the derived index or on the native series and then propagated through the same thresholding and aggregation. We show that the two placements can encode different scientific hypotheses and lead to opposite conclusions. In 31 Chilean PM2.5 monitoring stations (2018--2025), weekly clustering of days above the 50 ug m^-3 national 24-hour standard was significant at all stations under an index-level IAAFT null but at only two under a daily native-resolution null; a native generative null with seasonal marginals and short-memory Gaussian-copula dependence agreed with the native surrogate at 30 of 31 stations. Across thresholds spanning the WHO guideline (15 ug m^-3) to the Chilean episode-alert level (80 ug m^-3), index-only rejections increased from 8 of 31 to all eligible stations as monthly event probabilities became more seasonally concentrated, and equalizing monthly event probabilities at the 50 ug m^-3 level reduced index-only decisions from 29 to five. We formalize the issue as null transport through a lossy observation map: an exact aggregate-level equivalent of a native null exists if and only if the randomization kernel is lumpable with respect to that map. A within-fiber diagnostic, which perturbs native amplitudes while keeping the observed index exactly fixed, shows that this condition fails in the monitoring data: the native null distribution moved by a median of 18 times its Monte Carlo variability. Weekly clustering of PM2.5 exceedances in Chile is therefore fully compatible with seasonality plus short-memory daily persistence, and index-level surrogate rejections should not be read as evidence about daily concentration dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对阈值衍生的空气质量指数做替代数据检验时，把 null 放在指数层面还是原始序列层面会编码不同科学假设并给出相反结论：智利 31 个 PM2.5 站 2018–2025 年，50 µg/m³ 标准以上日数的周内聚集在指数层 IAAFT null 下全部显著，而在日尺度原始 null 下仅 2 站显著。作者据此判定指数层拒绝不能读作日尺度浓度动态的证据。
Motivation: 监测数据常规做法是先把原生分辨率测量转成超标计数再检验时间聚集，但 null 施加位置的选择未被形式化，可能把季节性误读成日尺度动力学。
Method: 比较指数层 IAAFT null、日尺度原始层 surrogate null、以及带季节边缘与短记忆 Gaussian-copula 依赖的原始生成 null；把问题形式化为经有损观测映射的 null transport，指出原始 null 存在精确聚合层等价当且仅当随机化 kernel 对该映射可 lumpable；并用 within-fiber 诊断（扰动原始振幅而保持观测指数不变）检验该条件。
Result: 31 个智利 PM2.5 站（2018–2025）中，50 µg/m³ 24 小时国标以上日数的周内聚集在指数层 IAAFT null 下全部 31 站显著，日尺度原始 null 下仅 2 站显著；原始生成 null 与原始 surrogate 在 30/31 站一致。阈值从 WHO 指南 15 µg/m³ 到智利 80 µg/m³ 预警水平，指数层拒绝数从 8/31 增至全部合格站点；在 50 µg/m³ 处把各月事件概率拉平后，指数层拒绝从 29 站降到 5 站。within-fiber 诊断显示 lumpable 条件在监测数据中不成立：原始 null 分布移动量为 Monte Carlo 变动中位数的 18 倍。
Conclusion: 智利 PM2.5 超标事件的周内聚集完全可由季节性加日尺度短记忆持续性解释，指数层替代检验的拒绝不应解读为日尺度浓度动态的证据。

papers.title: Beyond Prediction-Set Size: Quantifying Conformal Uncertainty through Credal Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Prediction-set size offers a coarse summary of conformal uncertainty. We develop a richer perspective through the geometry of credal sets: families of probability distributions compatible with conformal prediction (CP) regions. We establish this representation for split CP, extending a correspondence recently identified for full CP. Building on this representation, we derive analytical characterisations and exact algorithms for several widely used credal uncertainty measures, reducing potentially exponential computations to linear time after sorting the conformal p-values. We further unify several of these measures with classical conformal summaries by integrating set-size penalties based on Tsallis entropies across error levels. We also prove an impossibility theorem: for common split-conformal regression constructions, uncertainty summaries of the induced credal sets cannot distinguish between inputs. Classification experiments on selective prediction and distribution-shift detection show that these summaries often recover useful ranking information lost by prediction-set size at a fixed error level, enabling finer-grained uncertainty assessment. These results establish credal geometry as a principled framework for quantifying conformal uncertainty and understanding its limitations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 split conformal prediction 的预测区间视为 credal set（与 CP 区域兼容的分布族），用其几何刻画不确定性：多个 credal 不确定性度量可在对 conformal p-value 排序后以线性时间精确计算，而非指数枚举。在选择性预测与分布偏移检测的分类实验中，这些度量常能恢复固定错误水平下被预测集大小丢失的排序信息。
Motivation: 预测集大小只是 conformal 不确定性的粗粒度摘要，在固定错误水平下无法区分不同输入的不确定性，需要更细粒度的量化方式。
Method: 建立 split CP 与 credal set 的对应表示（推广已有的 full CP 结果），推导多个 credal 不确定性度量的解析刻画与精确算法，将指数级计算降为排序 p-value 后的线性时间；并用基于 Tsallis 熵的集合大小惩罚在多个错误水平上统一这些度量与经典 conformal 摘要。
Result: 证明一个不可能性定理：对常见的 split-conformal 回归构造，其诱导 credal set 的不确定性摘要无法区分不同输入。分类实验（选择性预测与分布偏移检测）显示这些摘要常能恢复固定错误水平下被预测集大小丢失的排序信息。
Conclusion: credal geometry 为量化 conformal 不确定性提供了有原则的框架，同时明确了其在 split-conformal 回归上的固有局限（无法区分输入）。

papers.title: ManzaiSet: A Multimodal Dataset of Viewer Responses to Japanese Manzai Comedy
papers.abstract_en: We introduce ManzaiSet, a multimodal dataset of individual viewer responses to Japanese manzai comedy. The corpus contains 2,301 viewer-performance recordings from 241 native Japanese speakers, totaling 191.8 hours of facial video and microphone audio. Participants watched up to 10 shared professional performances in randomized order at home and rated each performance on a 0-100 scale. Exploratory analyses yielded three findings. First, viewers differed in both their average ratings and how much their ratings varied across performances. Viewers who rated one random half of the performances highly also tended to rate the other half highly within the same viewing sequence. Second, performances watched later in the sequence received higher ratings on average. Third, after multiple-comparison correction, no statistically significant differences in viewer responses were found between humor categories. ManzaiSet supports the study of individual differences by linking shared Japanese comedy performances to viewer ratings, viewing order, and audiovisual responses.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 3 figures. Revised description of dataset construction, exploratory analyses, and limitations. Presented at the ICCV 2025 Workshop on Affective & Behavior Analysis in-the-Wild (ABAW)
papers.journal_ref: 2025 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision Workshops (ICCVW), pp. 42-50, 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ManzaiSet 是一个日语漫才 (manzai) 观众多模态反应数据集：241 名母语者在家观看最多 10 场同一专业演出，产生 2,301 条观看-演出记录、191.8 小时面部视频与麦克风音频，并按 0–100 量表打分。探索性分析给出三条结论：个体在均值与跨演出评分波动上都不同，且同一观看序列内前半场高分者后半场也倾向高分；序列靠后的演出平均得分更高；经多重比较校正后，不同幽默类别之间的观众反应无统计显著差异。
Motivation: 现有喜剧/幽默数据集多以内容本身为单位，缺少把同一组演出共享给大量观众、从而把个体差异与观看顺序效应分离开来的多模态反应语料。
Method: 采集 241 名日语母语者的居家观看数据：每人随机顺序观看至多 10 场共享专业漫才演出，同步记录面部视频与麦克风音频，演出后按 0–100 量表评分；以观看序列内随机对半划分检验评分一致性，并对幽默类别比较做多重比较校正。
Result: 数据集含 2,301 条观看-演出记录、241 名说话人、191.8 小时面部视频与麦克风音频、0–100 评分。探索性分析发现：观众在平均评分与跨演出评分方差上均存在个体差异；在随机对半划分的两半演出上评分一致（前半高者后半也高）；序列中较晚观看的演出平均评分更高；多重比较校正后幽默类别间无统计显著差异。
Conclusion: 共享演出加个体评分的设计能同时刻画观众个体差异与观看顺序带来的评分抬升，而幽默类别本身在该数据上不驱动反应差异。

papers.title: Energy-Efficient Spiking Neural Networks for Sensing-Aided Beam Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Sensing-aided beam prediction can reduce the beam-training overhead of millimeter-wave (mmWave) systems by leveraging environmental information from complementary modalities such as vision and position. However, the resulting sensing and inference pipeline can be energy-intensive, motivating the use of energy-efficient spiking neural networks (SNNs) as an alternative to conventional artificial neural networks (ANNs). In this work, we develop SNN architectures for beam prediction and systematically compare them with ANNs using position-only, vision-only, and multimodal inputs. Our results show that compact ANNs consistently outperform SNNs for position-only sensing. In contrast, for vision and multimodal sensing, SNNs achieve higher accuracy than ANNs at similar energy costs and require up to an order of magnitude less energy at a comparable accuracy. For example, the multimodal SNN achieves 58.08% top-1 accuracy, outperforming the closest-energy ANN by 18.11 percentage points. We further show that SNN accuracy is limited by the binary communication between layers rather than by model size. These results demonstrate the potential of SNNs for energy-efficient sensing-aided beam prediction while highlighting their accuracy limitation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在毫米波 (mmWave) 感知辅助波束预测中，SNN 在视觉与多模态输入下以相近能耗取得高于 ANN 的准确率，且在可比准确率下能耗最多低一个数量级；多模态 SNN top-1 达 58.08%，比最接近能耗的 ANN 高 18.11 个百分点。但纯位置输入下紧凑 ANN 一致优于 SNN，且 SNN 精度瓶颈来自层间二值通信而非模型规模。
Motivation: 感知辅助波束预测可降低 mmWave 波束训练开销，但其感知与推理流水线能耗高，需要在保持准确率的同时压缩推理能耗。
Method: 构建面向波束预测的 SNN 架构，并与 ANN 在位置-only、视觉-only、多模态三种输入上做系统对比，同时考察准确率与能耗；另分析 SNN 精度的限制来源（层间二值通信 vs 模型规模）。
Result: 位置-only 感知下紧凑 ANN 一致优于 SNN；视觉与多模态输入下 SNN 在相近能耗下准确率高于 ANN，且在可比准确率下能耗最多低一个数量级。多模态 SNN top-1 准确率 58.08%，比最接近能耗的 ANN 高 18.11 个百分点。SNN 精度受限于层间二值通信而非模型大小。
Conclusion: SNN 适合视觉与多模态感知辅助波束预测的低能耗部署，但纯位置场景仍应选 ANN，且 SNN 的精度上限由二值通信决定。

papers.title: EarLog: Opportunistic Ear Physiology Sensing toward Personalized Hearing Risk Awareness
papers.abstract_en: Many headphone users risk irreversible hearing damage during high-load listening, yet current protection still relies on sound-pressure limits. Clinical tests detect damage after it becomes measurable, leaving the risk-accumulating process unobserved. The acoustic reflex (AR), an involuntary response to high acoustic load, marks when the ear enters a protective state. AR traces are weak, and existing measurements require dedicated probes and controlled conditions that are difficult to maintain during everyday audio. We present EarLog, which turns playback, the dominant interference, into an opportunistic probe. EarLog introduces content-conditioned residual sensing to suppress variations caused by nonstationary content, individual ear acoustics, and device response. It identifies weak AR through loudness-dependent changes and localized spectral irregularities in the residual. A resonance-constrained sparse finite impulse response (FIR) model captures the short-window response. Dual-microphone observations, mild-distortion recovery, and cross-session reference updates keep detection usable under low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), fit changes, and environmental drift. EarLog runs in real time on an embedded controller using a low-cost dual-microphone add-on. We evaluate it with 81 participants, 16 headphone models, and more than 400 hours of recordings. EarLog achieves 99.0% sensitivity and 98.7% specificity on a clinically referenced benchmark. EarLog records listener-specific AR events during everyday listening, providing data for future longitudinal studies of hearing risk.
papers.comment: 22 pages. Accepted at ACM MobiCom 2026. Includes appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EarLog 把耳机播放声本身当作机会性探测信号，用内容条件化残差感知从日常收听中提取微弱的声学反射 (acoustic reflex, AR) 事件，实时判断耳部何时进入保护状态。在 81 名受试者、16 款耳机、400 小时以上录音上，对临床参考基准达到 99.0% 灵敏度与 98.7% 特异度。
Motivation: 听力损伤的高负荷风险累积过程目前不可观测：临床检测要等损伤可测才报警，而声学反射测量依赖专用探头和受控条件，日常收听中难以维持。
Method: 内容条件化残差感知抑制非平稳内容、个体耳道声学与设备响应带来的变化；通过响度依赖变化与残差中的局部谱不规则识别弱 AR，用共振约束稀疏 FIR 模型刻画短窗响应；双麦克风观测、轻度失真恢复与跨会话参考更新维持低 SNR、佩戴贴合变化与环境漂移下的可用性，整体在嵌入式控制器上实时运行，硬件为低成本双麦克风附加件。
Result: 在 81 名参与者、16 款耳机型号、超过 400 小时录音上评测，于临床参考基准达到 99.0% 灵敏度与 98.7% 特异度。
Conclusion: 把干扰性的播放声转为探测源，可在日常收听中记录个体化的 AR 事件，为听力风险的纵向研究提供数据。

papers.title: Acoustic Biomarkers for Alzheimer's Disease Detection from Spontaneous Speech
papers.abstract_en: Alzheimer's disease (AD) remains a major public health challenge, and early identification is crucial for timely intervention and care planning. Recent work has shown that speech-based digital biomarkers can capture subtle changes in vocal production, prosody, and timing that often precede or accompany cognitive decline. In this study, we investigate whether acoustic features extracted from spontaneous speech can reliably distinguish individuals with AD from healthy controls. Using a structured speech dataset derived from the Cookie Theft picture-description task, we extract clinically informative low-level descriptors spanning prosodic, spectral, and temporal domains, and evaluate a range of machine learning classifiers. Our results indicate that acoustic biomarkers carry strong discriminative value, with the best-performing models achieving clinically meaningful separation between diagnostic groups. These findings support the use of non-invasive, low-cost audio-based screening tools and motivate further work on multimodal and longitudinal assessment frameworks for dementia risk detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 从 Cookie Theft 看图说话任务的自发语音中提取韵律、频谱、时域低层描述符 (low-level descriptors)，用多种机器学习分类器区分阿尔茨海默病 (AD) 与健康对照，最佳模型在诊断组间达到作者所称的临床有意义分离。结论是声学生物标志物可支撑低成本、非侵入的语音筛查工具。
Motivation: AD 早期识别对干预和照护规划至关重要，而语音数字生物标志物能捕捉先于或伴随认知下降的发声、韵律与节奏变化，需要验证其能否可靠区分 AD 与健康人。
Method: 基于结构化的 Cookie Theft 图片描述语音数据集，提取覆盖韵律、频谱、时域三个域的低层描述符特征，再评估一系列机器学习分类器。
Result: 最佳模型在 AD 与健康对照诊断组之间取得作者所称具有临床意义的分离；摘要未给出具体数据集规模、分类器名称或指标数值。
Conclusion: 声学生物标志物具有强判别价值，支持用非侵入、低成本的音频筛查工具做 AD 识别，并指向多模态与纵向评估框架。
