papers.title: An Input-Dependent Readout Phase for Resonant Sequence Models
papers.abstract_en: Sequence models with a fixed-size state avoid the quadratic cost of attention, but face a design choice. An input-dependent state transition gives content-dependent memory at the cost of FFT-based training, while a fixed transition keeps the O(T log T) convolutional path but reads memory the same way for every input. ResonatorLM, a recent model of the second kind, reads a bank of damped complex oscillators through a fixed learned phase per head. We make that readout phase a function of the current token, which adds input dependence to the read only, keeps the convolution exact, and costs 0.2 percent more parameters. An analysis of the untrained bank shows that phase does encode elapsed time, but an ordinary token falls below the background within 2-8 steps and no choice of damping extends linear reconstruction beyond about 16 tokens. In 6M-parameter character-level models on WikiText-2, the input-dependent phase matches the original at the training length and removes its failure beyond it: trained on 256 tokens and tested on 1024, perplexity falls from 12.81 to 3.76. We trace the failure to long-memory heads that accumulate more history than training exposed them to. The learned phase tracks the current character rather than distance and does not improve retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 ResonatorLM 每个头固定的读出相位改成当前 token 的函数，只给读出端加输入依赖，卷积路径仍精确、参数只多 0.2%。在 6M 参数字符级模型上，训练长度 256、测试 1024 时困惑度从 12.81 降到 3.76，消除了原模型超出训练长度后的失效。
Motivation: 固定状态转移保住 O(T log T) 卷积路径，但读出方式对所有输入相同，导致超出训练长度后性能崩溃；输入依赖转移又必须付 FFT 训练代价。
Method: 将 ResonatorLM 阻尼复振荡器组的固定学习相位替换为当前 token 的函数，仅在读出端引入输入依赖，保持卷积精确；在 WikiText-2 上训练 6M 参数字符级模型，训练长度 256、测试 1024，并对未训练振荡器组做相位分析。
Result: 训练 256 测 1024 时困惑度 12.81 → 3.76，参数开销 +0.2%；未训练分析显示相位编码流逝时间，但普通 token 在 2-8 步内跌入背景噪声，任何阻尼取值都无法把线性重构扩展到约 16 token 以外；失效被归因于长记忆头累积超出训练暴露的历史，学习到的相位跟踪当前字符而非距离，且不改善检索。
Conclusion: 把输入依赖只加在读出端即可消除固定相位读出的长度外推失效，代价近乎可忽略；但该相位跟踪的是当前字符而非时间距离，因此不提升检索能力。

papers.title: Kairos: Toward a Byte-Level Foundation Model for Every Modality
papers.abstract_en: Small language models trained on a single local machine leave little room for architectural trial and error. Kairos combines bidirectional gated-DeltaNet linear attention and sliding-window attention over shared projections (LiZAttention2), block-wise Attention-Residual aggregation, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) feed-forward layer and a multi-scale byte-level codec, trained with a uniform-noise denoising objective over one byte space shared by text, image, audio, video, lidar and control streams; this report asks whether the combination optimizes at all before asking whether it is useful. We give code-derived algorithms for each component, including a cross-session recurrent-state memory gate, then run convergence sanity checks: overfittinga single 440-byte sentence at 1--15M parameters, text only, with three seeds for codec and attention choices and single-run sweeps for seven further factors. The two attention variants tested at 3\,000 steps (LiZAttention2 and window attention alone) reach a minimum loss near $10^{-3}$. After 600 steps, the mean minimum loss ranges from 0.018 (patch codec) to 0.354 (depthwise convolutional codec) with an identical ranking on three seeds. An apparent advantage of shared over separate attention projections closes with more steps or more diverse data and reverses when the projections are frozen: it is a convergence-speed effect, not a capacity effect. These checks suggest that the implementation optimizes; they say nothing about generalization, multimodal training or comparison with existing models, which a planned pretraining run is meant to address. The Discussion sizes a 200M-total/25M-active target analytically; none of its throughput figures is measured. Code is available at https://github.com/fabienfrfr/Kairos . Python package at https://pypi.org/project/kairos-fm/ .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Kairos 是一个字节级多模态基础模型方案：用 LiZAttention2（双向 gated-DeltaNet 线性注意力与滑窗注意力共享投影）、块级 Attention-Residual 聚合、稀疏 MoE 前馈和多尺度字节 codec，在统一字节空间上做均匀噪声去噪目标。在单句 440 字节过拟合的收敛性检查中，3000 步时两种注意力最低损失约 1e-3；600 步时 codec 平均最低损失从 patch 的 0.018 到 depthwise convolutional 的 0.354，共享投影的优势只是收敛速度效应而非容量效应。
Motivation: 单机训练小模型时架构试错空间极小，作者先回答「这套组合能不能优化」，再谈是否有用，避免直接投入大规模预训练。
Method: 组件包括 LiZAttention2（gated-DeltaNet 线性注意力与滑窗注意力共享投影）、块级 Attention-Residual 聚合、稀疏 MoE 前馈、多尺度字节 codec，统一在文本/图像/音频/视频/lidar/control 的字节空间上做均匀噪声去噪；给出各组件的代码推导算法与跨会话循环状态记忆门。收敛检查为过拟合单句 440 字节、1–15M 参数、仅文本，codec 与注意力选择用三个种子，另有七个因素的单次扫描。
Result: 两种注意力变体（LiZAttention2 与仅滑窗注意力）在 3000 步时最低损失约 1e-3；600 步时各 codec 平均最低损失从 patch codec 0.018 到 depthwise convolutional codec 0.354，三个种子上排序一致。共享与分离注意力投影的差距随步数增加或数据多样化而消失，冻结投影后反转，属收敛速度效应。Discussion 中 200M 总参数/25M 激活参数的目标为解析估算，吞吐数字均非实测。
Conclusion: 这些检查只说明实现能优化，不涉及泛化、多模态训练或与现有模型的比较；后者留给计划中的预训练运行。

papers.title: Algebraic Integer Quantization for Machine Learning Applications
papers.abstract_en: In this article, we propose algebraic integer number formats (AINF) as a framework for highly configurable and accurate compressed computation. A key property of AINF is its straightforward reduction to purely integer arithmetic, enabling error-free multiply-accumulate operations. We develop a matrix multiplication engine that exploits this property, obtaining performance within a predictable factor of the most efficient numerical counterparts on modern hardware accelerators. Another key advantage of AIQ is the freedom to select algebraic integers tailored to the numerical characteristics of a given use case, offering optimization opportunities that are fundamentally unavailable in floating-point or fixed-point formats. Motivated by these properties, we introduce algebraic integer quantization (AIQ), a lossy compression format for large language model (LLM) inference, and provide results demonstrating that AIQ achieves competitive accuracy compared to the industry-standard MX format across a diverse set of models and benchmarks at equivalent bit-per-parameter budgets. The experiments presented in this article employ algebraic integers of degree two (quadratic integers); generalizations to higher-order and, in particular, multidimensional algebraic integers promise even greater computational advantages and remain a promising direction for future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出代数整数量化 (algebraic integer quantization, AIQ)：用可约化为纯整数运算的代数整数数制 (AINF) 做无误差乘加，并据此构造 LLM 推理的有损压缩格式。在等 bit-per-parameter 预算下，AIQ 在多种模型与基准上取得与业界标准 MX 格式相当的精度。
Motivation: 浮点与定点格式无法按用例数值特性挑选表示基数，且乘加带舍入误差；LLM 推理需要在固定比特预算下更灵活的压缩表示。
Method: 提出 AINF 框架，把运算约化为纯整数算术以实现无误差乘加；据此构造矩阵乘法引擎，并引入面向 LLM 推理的 AIQ 有损压缩格式，可按用例选择代数整数；实验使用二次代数整数（degree two）。
Result: 在等 bit-per-parameter 预算下，AIQ 在多种模型和基准上达到与 MX 格式相当的精度；矩阵乘法引擎性能处于最高效数值实现的一个可预测倍数范围内。
Conclusion: 按用例挑选代数整数可在固定比特预算下保持竞争力精度，且比浮点/定点多出优化自由度；高阶与多维代数整数留作后续方向。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Faithfulness Without Anchors: A Position Paper on the Structural Misalignments of Explainable AI Faithfulness Metrics for Feature Importance
papers.abstract_en: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) tools have often been presented as methods to increase trust in machine learning models by making aspects of their algorithms more human-understandable. However, evidence accumulated over the last decade points to an overall failure of this objective, instead promoting overreliance on incorrect predictions, which can subsequently lead to algorithmic aversion. Rather, XAI appears to function primarily as a debugging tool, useful for obtaining anecdotal insights into, for example, features learned by the model. One of the main issues underlying this limitation is that XAI methods often oversimplify the inner workings of the model, resulting in misalignment between the explanation and the model itself - a behavior referred to as unfaithfulness or infidelity. Faithfulness can be interpreted as the degree of approximation between an explanation and the model. Computing faithfulness in a rigorous manner would thus make it possible to quantify one of the various elements of trustworthiness of an explanation. However, existing metrics present significant limitations, making this quantification either infeasible or computationally expensive. In this position paper, we outline five major shortcomings of current faithfulness metrics and propose four possible avenues for research to bolster their reliability.
papers.comment: Presented at the IJCAI-ECAI 2026 Workshop on Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇 XAI 立场论文：可解释性工具十年证据显示其并未建立信任，反而助长对错误预测的过度依赖与算法厌恶，实际更像调试工具。根因是解释与模型本身失配（unfaithfulness/infidelity），而现有 faithfulness 度量要么不可行、要么计算昂贵；论文归纳出当前 faithfulness 度量的五大结构性缺陷，并提出四条研究路径以提升其可靠性。
Motivation: faithfulness 本可量化解释的可信度，但现有度量存在显著局限，使这种量化要么不可行、要么计算代价过高，从而阻碍对 XAI 解释可靠性的严格评估。
Method: 以立场论文形式系统梳理现有 faithfulness 度量（将 faithfulness 定义为解释对模型的近似程度），归纳五项主要结构性缺陷，并据此提出四条改进研究方向。
Result: 给出五项当前 faithfulness 度量的主要缺陷与四条提升其可靠性的研究路径；论文同时陈述过去十年的证据表明 XAI 总体上未能提升信任，反而促成对错误预测的过度依赖并可能导致算法厌恶。
Conclusion: XAI 的主要价值在于作为调试工具而非建立信任；在现有 faithfulness 度量的结构性错位被解决之前，对解释可信度的严格量化难以实现。

papers.title: TTS-Q: Perception-Guided Post-Training Quantization of Text-to-Speech Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) can clone a voice from seconds of audio. Yet the quality comes from billion-parameter diffusion transformers whose size and multi-step sampling put them out of reach of the on-device, assistive, and real-time applications that need them most. Post-training quantization (PTQ) shrinks such models without retraining, but it has been built for language and vision, not speech. At 4 bits, a strong quantizer leaves intelligibility close to full precision but consistently erodes speaker timbre, so error rates stay low while the voice drifts from the target speaker. We ask why quantization hurts speech, where the damage lives, and whether it can be repaired without retraining. To find out, we run the first 4-bit weight-and-activation (W4A4) PTQ study of a TTS diffusion transformer at 1B and 3.5B. The timbre cost comes from both the weight and the activation quantization, but only the activation part has the timestep structure a precision schedule can exploit. We therefore introduce TTS-Q, which selects hard-to-quantize items from task-matched calibration candidates and applies a budget-balanced mixed-precision schedule that assigns higher precision to late-step feed-forward activations. TTS-Q recovers timbre best at both scales, at no cost to intelligibility. Separately, the deployed calibrated-W4A4 reference reduces peak memory on GPU, providing a practical reference for resource-constrained TTS deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TTS-Q 针对 TTS diffusion transformer 的 4-bit PTQ 音色漂移问题，用任务匹配校准候选中挑选难量化条目，并施加预算均衡的混合精度调度，把更高精度分配给后期 timestep 的 feed-forward 激活。在 1B 与 3.5B 两个规模上，TTS-Q 的音色恢复最好，且不牺牲可懂度；部署版 calibrated-W4A4 参考实现降低了 GPU 峰值内存。
Motivation: 十亿参数级 TTS diffusion transformer 因模型规模与多步采样难以部署到端侧、辅助与实时场景；现有 PTQ 方法面向语言与视觉，未针对语音，4-bit 下可懂度接近全精度但说话人音色持续劣化。
Method: 首个针对 TTS diffusion transformer 的 4-bit 权重与激活 (W4A4) PTQ 研究，覆盖 1B 与 3.5B 两个规模；TTS-Q 从任务匹配的校准候选中筛选难量化条目，再用预算均衡的混合精度调度，为后期 timestep 的 feed-forward 激活分配更高精度。
Result: 音色损失同时来自权重与激活量化，但只有激活部分具备可被精度调度利用的 timestep 结构；TTS-Q 在 1B 与 3.5B 两个规模上音色恢复最佳且不损失可懂度；部署的 calibrated-W4A4 参考实现降低 GPU 峰值内存。
Conclusion: TTS 扩散模型 4-bit 量化的音色损伤主要可通过激活侧的 timestep 感知混合精度调度修复，无需重训练。

papers.title: Neuromorphic Satellite Intelligence: A Formal Framework for Event-Driven Architectures, Spike-Based Algorithms, and Quantitative Energy-Accuracy Trade-offs
papers.abstract_en: Satellite onboard computing faces an irreducible tension: mission intelligence requirements grow monotonically while power, mass, and radiation budgets remain fixed. This paper advances the state of the art on three fronts. First, we develop a formal mathematical model of spiking neural computation for satellite workloads, deriving closed-form expressions for energy consumption as a function of network sparsity, firing rate, and synaptic fan-out. Second, we propose three original algorithms -- a Spiking Kalman-Complementary Filter (SKCF) for attitude estimation, a Temporal Contrast Anomaly Detector (TCAD) for spacecraft health monitoring, and a Spike-Based Adaptive Modulation and Coding (SAMC) scheme for cognitive satellite links -- each with pseudocode and analytical complexity bounds. Third, we introduce a quantitative Energy-Accuracy-Latency (EAL) trade-off surface and populate it with numerical estimates derived from published silicon measurements of Loihi and SpiNNaker, enabling direct comparison with FPGA and GPU baselines. A taxonomy of four radiation-aware neuromorphic architecture classes is refined with fault-rate models. Continual on-orbit learning is formalized through a constrained Spike-Timing Dependent Plasticity (STDP) rule that provably bounds weight drift. Case studies for a 12U CubeSat Earth observation mission, a GEO communications payload, and an autonomous deep-space probe provide concrete, quantified design points. Our analysis shows that neuromorphic implementations can achieve 8 to 47 times energy reduction over GPU baselines while maintaining inference accuracy within 2.1\% for representative satellite workloads.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为星载计算提出脉冲神经计算的形式化能耗模型与三个事件驱动算法（姿态估计 SKCF、健康监测 TCAD、认知链路 SAMC），并用 Loihi 与 SpiNNaker 的硅测数据填充能量-精度-时延 (EAL) 权衡面。分析显示在代表性卫星工作负载上，神经形态实现相对 GPU 基线可省 8–47 倍能耗，推理精度保持在 2.1% 以内。
Motivation: 星载智能需求单调增长，而功耗、质量与抗辐射预算固定，通用 GPU/FPGA 方案难以在该约束下同时满足精度与时延。
Method: 建立脉冲神经计算的闭式能耗模型（依赖网络稀疏度、发放率、突触扇出）；提出 SKCF、TCAD、SAMC 三个算法并给出伪码与解析复杂度；引入 EAL 权衡面并用 Loihi、SpiNNaker 已发表硅测数据填充，与 FPGA、GPU 基线对比；用受约束 STDP 规则形式化在轨持续学习并证明权重漂移有界，配合四类抗辐射神经形态架构的故障率模型。
Result: 在 12U CubeSat 对地观测、GEO 通信载荷与自主深空探测器三个案例中给出量化设计点；神经形态实现相对 GPU 基线能耗降低 8 至 47 倍，推理精度保持在 2.1% 以内。
Conclusion: 在功耗与辐射预算固定的星载场景下，事件驱动脉冲架构可在精度损失不超过 2.1% 的前提下取得数量级能耗优势，且在轨学习的权重漂移可被约束 STDP 规则证明性地限定。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: A Sampling Complexity-aware Framework for Discrete-time Fractional-Order Dynamical System Identification
papers.abstract_en: A variety of complex biological, natural and man-made systems exhibit non-Markovian dynamics that can be modeled through fractional order differential equations, yet, we lack sample comlexity aware system identification strategies. Towards this end, we propose an affine discrete-time fractional order dynamical system (FoDS) identification algorithm and provide a detailed sample complexity analysis. The algorithm effectively addresses the challenges of FoDS identification in the presence of noisy data. The proposed algorithm consists of two key steps. Firstly, it avoids solving higher-order polynomial equations, which would otherwise result in multiple potential solutions for the fractional orders. Secondly, the identification problem is reformulated as a least squares estimation, allowing us to infer the system parameters. We derive the expectation and probabilistic bounds for the FoDS parameter estimation error, assuming prior knowledge of the functions \( f \) and \( g \) in the FoDS model. The error decays at a rate of \( N = O\left( \frac{d}ε \right) \), where \( N \) is the number of samples, \( d \) is the dimension of the state variable, and \( ε\) represents the desired estimation accuracy. Simulation results demonstrate that our theoretical bounds are tight, validating the accuracy and robustness of this algorithm.
papers.journal_ref: American Control Conference (ACC) 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向采样复杂度的离散时间分数阶动力系统 (FoDS) 辨识算法：避开求解高阶多项式方程以消除分数阶的多解性，再把辨识改写为最小二乘估计。在已知模型函数 f、g 的前提下，参数估计误差的期望与概率界随样本数以 N = O(d/ε) 衰减，仿真验证理论界是紧的。
Motivation: 生物、自然与人造系统中大量非马尔可夫动力学需用分数阶微分方程建模，但缺少考虑采样复杂度的系统辨识策略，且含噪数据下分数阶次的求解存在多解问题。
Method: 两步走的仿射离散时间 FoDS 辨识：第一步避免求解高阶多项式方程，绕开分数阶次的多解；第二步将辨识重构为最小二乘估计以推断系统参数。在假设已知 FoDS 模型中函数 f 与 g 的条件下推导参数估计误差的期望界与概率界。
Result: 推导出误差随样本数衰减速率 N = O(d/ε)，其中 d 为状态变量维数、ε 为目标估计精度；仿真结果显示理论界是紧的，验证了算法的准确性与鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 把分数阶辨识转为最小二乘并绕开多项式求根，可在含噪数据下给出紧的采样复杂度界，样本需求随状态维数线性、随目标精度倒数增长。
Relevance: 1
